Like," [berwyn.heShe] says drolly, [berwyn.hisHer] eyes scanning the room you’re in. "Keep having wild adventures. Keep living in this massive fortress. There isn't much else I'd need in life, I think." |"Me neither," [berwyn.name] answers with a flippant shrug. "Enchantment and archery is all I really put my attention towards. Everything else is just icing on the top. Like," [berwyn.heShe] says drolly, [berwyn.hisHer] eyes scanning the room you’re in. "Keep having wild adventures. Keep living in this massive fortress." [berwyn.HisHer] eyes fall to yours[berwyn.dsn |, and [berwyn.hisHer] mouth curls into a lecherous smirk. "Keep fucking my pet [pc.race] and my hot teacher. You know, the simple life. |, and the corners of [berwyn.hisHer] mouth curl upward sweetly. "Keep getting railed by my [pc.mf |stud and my hot teacher |two mistresses ], whenever they want. That sounds like all I need. |, and [berwyn.hisHer] mouth curls into a wry smile. "Have lots of sex with you and my hot, big-tittied teacher. You know, the simple stuff. ]" At the end of that last sentence, Matiha’s body jolts upright and her cheeks balloon as she struggles to keep her tea from exploding out of her nose. "[berwyn.name]!" she shouts. "Am I wrong?" [berwyn.heShe] asks. Matiha huffs, wiping her chin with the back of her sleeve. "Not at the tea table...!" she whispers hoarsely. "Don’t bang on the tea table. Got it." Matiha’s eyes widen and her lips purse with barely-concealed indignation. Her normally pale skin slowly turns red. "I’ll be taking this out on you later," she spits. "Do you promise?" Matiha grunts in frustration, but says nothing more and doesn’t get up to leave. [berwyn.name] is clearly on to something. ]'

rows.original: So, after all of that – after stopping Matiha from her clouded, deluded goals and rescuing Savarra... what happens next?
rows.translation: 那么，在经历了这一切之后——在阻止了玛蒂哈追求那些虚幻的目标、并拯救了萨瓦拉之后……接下来会发生什么呢？
rows.raw: "So, after all of that – after stopping Matiha from her clouded, deluded goals and rescuing Savarra... what happens next?"

rows.original: Now that you have both [berwyn.name] and Matiha together, you admit to them that you’ve always been curious about one thing in particular. "Ask," Matiha says with a warm smile. You say that you’ve heard bits and pieces of the whole story, but you’ve never heard the full thing. You’re curious how she and [berwyn.name] met and what their life together was like. At least, what it was like up until things got... weird. "You know, I’ve always been curious about that myself," [berwyn.name] says, scratching at [berwyn.hisHer] chin. "There’s something about how we met that always felt off to me." Matiha says nothing in response; she instead lowers her eyes and takes another drink of her tea. When she finishes, she places her cup on its platter, but she doesn’t lift her eyes. "So, it starts with me running away from home," [berwyn.name] recounts. "We lived on a farm. A vineyard, actually; we grew grapes. We also made our own wines, but I was too young to be allowed to drink any before I left." [berwyn.HisHer] head tilts to the side and [berwyn.hisHer] mouth crooks awkwardly as [berwyn.heShe] remembers it. "I thought it sucked. Hours a day, every day, in the hot sun, working the fields, getting all sweaty even if you were nearly naked...." Matiha’s lips slyly curl inwards as she imagines it. "It was no secret to my folks that I wanted to learn magic after I found grandpa’s old journals. The stories he wrote and the descriptions he used... he captured my imagination, and from my imagination came an idea, and from an idea came a yearning. Naturally, my parents disagreed." Because they wanted [berwyn.himHer] to stay and help with the farm? "What they told me was that it was dangerous," [berwyn.heShe] answers. "And yeah, I knew that it was. Grandpa was a battlemage. There wouldn’t be a need for a thing like a ‘battlemage’ to exist in a safe world." [berwyn.HeShe] pounds back [berwyn.hisHer] tea before reaching for the kettle to pour [berwyn.himHer]self another cup. "Frankly, that just made me want it more. The thrill; the adventure; the challenge! Living on a vineyard is no life, guys. Hell, living on any farm is difficult for a kid growing up: all that space and nothing to do and nobody to do it with." "So, I tried to teach myself. Grandpa didn’t write any, like, instructional booklets or anything like that, so when my dad sent me into the town to run some errands for him, I stopped at the library to pick up the easiest book they had on the subject. The very first spell I managed to learn was how to change the color of a flame on a wax candle. Turned it from red to green." You note that this is kind of diverging from the topic that you had asked about from the beginning.... "Yeah, I’m getting to that," [berwyn.name] insists, hushing you by pointing [berwyn.hisHer] hand at you and motioning to the floor. "I made the mistake of showing off my magic to my folks. I had hoped that if I showed them that I was serious and that I had put in the work, then I’d get my blessing." [berwyn.HeShe] stops, immediately going totally silent. [berwyn.HeShe] thumbs the rim of [berwyn.hisHer] teacup errantly as [berwyn.heShe] tries to shore up the courage to continue. "Well, he didn’t touch me, but he ripped the book I checked out from the library right in half," [berwyn.heShe] eventually says, continuing on like [berwyn.heShe] hadn’t skipped a beat. "He cursed me out for a solid fifteen minutes. I don’t even remember what he was that mad about; I just remember him grabbing the book and ripping the damn thing apart." "So, anyway, I ran away two days after that. I wasn’t going to wake up before my noted-farmer father, so I ran at the stroke of midnight, long after he and mom had gone to bed. I knew that there was a mage’s school a long way to the north, and I knew it was going to be a tough trip, but I figured that if I could make it, then I could do anything that grandpa did." [berwyn.name] slams back [berwyn.hisHer] teacup, once again finishing it off before either you or Matiha have had the chance to finish your first. "First thing in the morning," [berwyn.name] says, pointing towards Matiha with [berwyn.hisHer] ring and pinkie fingers while [berwyn.hisHer] eyes stay on you, "I ran into Matiha. I hadn’t even made it to the other side of the city by then. She’s got that huge mage hat; she’s wearing some thin mage robes; and she says to me, and I quote, ‘you look like you could make the perfect mage, with some training.’ And I figure, well, she looks like a mage; she knows I want to be a mage; and she’s hot as sin, so, you know, my mouth is saying ‘yes ma’am’ before my brain has a chance to process anything." Huh. Sounds like convenient timing. "Yeah, like I said before, that’s what felt off to me," [berwyn.heShe] replies, turning [berwyn.hisHer] gaze to Matiha. "It was way too perfect. You knew exactly where I was and you knew exactly what I wanted. What’s up with that?" The entire time, Matiha’s eyes have been cast downward, and she hadn’t touched her tea since you asked your question. Her expression is stiff and pensive and her back is perfectly straight, bracing for some form of blowback; she knows she has some explaining to do. "I’d like to remind you both that, by the time I had met you, [berwyn.name], I had been under the corruptive influence of the Vodo rune stone for many decades," she starts. "Okay," is [berwyn.hisHer] only reply. "I was obsessed with learning more about the stone. I was desperate to learn how to tap into and harness the thousands of years of ambient mana stored within it; I would have done anything." She lifts her teacup to her lips as if she were about to take a drink, but she stops, deciding that now isn’t the time. "Fiodoir... seemed to have an intrinsic understanding on how to tap into the stone, but he didn’t pass his knowledge to me, and not to the level that I would later achieve." Matiha finally lifts her eyes – but then her head tilts to one side, slumping in her seat as she shamefully recalls her actions. "Fiodoir had a son by the time we had found that rune stone among the debris of the hurricane. At the time, I supposed that the talent wasn’t something to do with Fiodoir’s knowledge or talents as a mage; it was something to do with him specifically. Something to do with his bloodline. It was too early after our... break up for me to try and persuade your father, [berwyn.name], so I waited until he had a child himself before I made my move." [berwyn.name] tilts [berwyn.hisHer] head in confusion. "‘Made your move?’ What does that mean?" "I mean," she continues, before her breath catches in her throat. She takes a drink from her tea to swallow it back down. "I knew who you were from the start. I knew you were Fiodior’s grandchild. I knew why you had run away from home. I was keeping track of your activities on your vineyard, waiting for the right opportunity to introduce myself. And you running away from home... presented the opportunity to me." "Ah, so you were spying on me?" [berwyn.name]’s attitude and tone is surprisingly calm and collected, given the news. Both you and Matiha turn towards [berwyn.himHer] curiously, trying to get a good read on what [berwyn.heShe] is really thinking. "That’s... correct, yes," she haltingly answers. "I had outlined a number of approaches towards getting you to come with me. First, I was going to convince you; if that didn’t work, I was going to seduce you; and if that didn’t work...." She looks down at her tea, watching her reflection in the cup’s dark liquid. You wonder what she sees. "I was going to do anything to try and unlock the Vodo rune stone and it’s power," she says. "I was... prepared for anything. Let’s just say that... we should be thankful that you didn’t need much convincing at the time." [berwyn.name] hums to [berwyn.himHer]self and takes another drink from [berwyn.hisHer] tea. And that’s the whole reaction. "If I’m honest, I would have preferred to not have elaborated on how we met," Matiha continues. "There are some things better left unsaid, and that was one of them. I’m not proud of my mindset and way of thinking while I was under the influence of that stone." "If you’re worried that I’m mad, don’t be," [berwyn.name] says, meeting Matiha’s downtrodden gaze with a toothy smile. "I’m not one to hold a grudge. Look at where we are, in the end." [berwyn.HeShe] motions to the room you’re sitting in – a large, well-furnished office sitting at the top of a fortress’s tower. "It could have ended worse." Matiha, however, maintains her posture – but her expression softens ever so slightly. "Do you mean that?" "The only thing I’m not a fan of is you changing my body without my permission," [berwyn.heShe] says, knocking back [berwyn.hisHer] third cup of tea since you had started this topic. "But it’s not like that ended poorly, either, especially since I had the opportunity to change it again." Matiha remain stiff-backed. Maybe she just doesn’t believe that [berwyn.name] is willing to look past the transgressions she had just admitted to doing. "Look, if you need me to say the actual words, Matiha, I’ll say them," [berwyn.heShe] says with a loose shrug. "I forgive you." Finally, Matiha smiles. She tries to hide it behind taking a drink from her teacup, but the corners of her mouth lift up around the cup’s raised rim.

[berwyn.name]是如何相识的，以及他们共同度过的那些日子是怎样的。至少，在一切都变得……奇怪之前，是怎样的。 “你知道，我自己也一直很好奇这个问题。 [berwyn.name]一边说，一边挠着[berwyn.hisHer]我们相遇的方式，总让我觉得有些不对劲。” 玛蒂哈没有回应，只是低下头，又喝了一口茶。喝完后，她把茶杯放在茶托上，但仍然没有抬头。 “那么，故事是从我离家出走开始的。 [berwyn.name]我们住在农场里，实际上是一个葡萄园，我们种植葡萄。还会自己酿酒，不过在我离开之前，我还太小，不允许喝酒。 [berwyn.HisHer]头部向一侧倾斜[berwyn.hisHer]嘴巴不自然地扭曲着，说道[berwyn.heShe]记得那些日子。“我觉得那真是太糟糕了。每天都要在烈日下工作好几个小时，在田里劳作，即使几乎一丝不挂，也会满身大汗……” 当玛蒂哈回想起那些情景时，她的嘴角不由得微微上扬，露出一丝苦笑。 在我发现爷爷留下的那些旧日记之后，我想学习魔法这件事对我的家人来说已经不是什么秘密了。他写下的那些故事以及他使用的那些描述……它们激发了我的想象力，而我的想象力又产生了一个想法，这个想法最终让我产生了强烈的渴望。当然，我的父母不同意。” 因为他们希望这样。 [berwyn.himHer]们告诉我，那样做很危险。 [berwyn.heShe]是的，我早就知道会是这样。爷爷就是一名战斗法师。在这样一个安全的世界里，根本不需要‘战斗法师’这样的存在。 [berwyn.HeShe]奋力反击[berwyn.hisHer]先喝杯茶，再去拿水壶倒水。 [berwyn.himHer]再给自己倒一杯吧。说实话，这反而让我更加想要喝了。那种刺激感、那种冒险精神、那种挑战……伙计们，住在葡萄园里根本算不上是生活。真的，那根本不是生活任何对一个正在成长的孩子来说，在农场里生活是一件很困难的事：有那么大的空间，却没有什么事情可做，也没有人可以一起做这些事情。” “所以，我尝试自己学习。爷爷并没有编写任何指导手册之类的东西，因此当爸爸让我去镇上帮他跑一些差事时，我就会去图书馆，找他们那里有关这个主题的最简单的书籍来阅读。我第一个成功学会的法术，就是如何改变蜡烛上火焰的颜色——把它从红色变成绿色。 你会注意到，这个内容其实有点偏离了你最初提出的问题范围了。是的，我正要谈到这个。 [berwyn.name]坚持着自己的观点，甚至用手指着你来让你安静下来。 [berwyn.hisHer]把手伸向你，同时指向地面说道：“我犯了一个错误，那就是在家人面前炫耀我的魔法。我原本希望，如果我能让他们看到我是认真对待这件事、确实付出了努力的，那么他们就会批准我的决定。 [berwyn.HeShe]突然间，一切都安静了下来。 [berwyn.HeShe]心不在焉地用拇指摩挲[berwyn.hisHer]茶杯的边缘，同时[berwyn.heShe]努力鼓起继续说下去的勇气。 “嗯，他并没有动手。我但他却把我从图书馆借来的那本书直接撕成了两半。 [berwyn.heShe]最终说道，然后继续说道[berwyn.heShe]我一点都没迟疑。他骂了我足足十五分钟，我甚至都不记得他到底因为什么事那么生气；我只记得他抓起那本书，把它撕得粉碎。” “总之，就在那之后两天，我就逃走了。我本来并不打算比我那位务农为生的父亲更早起床，所以我在午夜时分才匆忙出发，那时他和妈妈早已上床睡觉了。我知道在北方很远的地方有一所法师学校，我也知道这段路会非常艰难，但我坚信，如果我能到达那里，那么我就能够做到爷爷所能做的一切。" [berwyn.name]强力反击[berwyn.hisHer]茶杯，又一次在你或玛蒂哈有机会喝完第一杯之前就被喝光了。首先早上的事情。 [berwyn.name]说着，她指向了玛蒂哈。 [berwyn.hisHer]同时弯曲无名指和小指[berwyn.hisHer]我的目光一直追随着你，”我说，“我遇到了玛蒂哈。那时我甚至还没走到城市的另一边。她戴着那顶巨大的法师帽，穿着薄薄的法师长袍，然后她对我说——我原话是这么说的：‘你再接受一些训练，肯定能成为一名出色的法师。我想，她看起来就像个法师；她知道我想成为一名法师；而且她长得也非常迷人，所以，你知道的，在我的大脑还有时间思考之前，我的嘴巴就已经先答应她了。” 嗯，听起来时机把握得真好啊。 是的，就像我之前说的，正是这一点让我觉得不对劲。 [berwyn.heShe]回复，回应[berwyn.hisHer]注视着玛蒂哈，说道：“这一切简直太完美了。你完全知道我在哪里，也完全明白我想要什么。这是怎么回事？” 整个过程中，玛蒂哈的目光一直低垂着，自从你提出那个问题后，她就再也没有碰过茶。她的表情僵硬而深思，背部也挺得笔直，似乎在准备迎接某种责备；她知道，自己必须做出解释。 “我想提醒你们俩，在我遇到你们的时候[berwyn.name]几十年来，我一直受到沃多符文石的腐蚀性影响，”她开始说道。 “好吧，”对方回应道。 [berwyn.hisHer]我一心想要深入了解这种石头。我迫切地想要学会如何利用其中储存的、历经数千年的能量；为了达到这个目的，我愿意做任何事情。任何东西。她将茶杯举到唇边，似乎准备喝下一口，但最终停下了动作，觉得现在还不是时候。“菲奥多尔……似乎天生就懂得如何运用那种石头，但他并没有将自己的知识传授给我，至少没有传授到我后来能够掌握的那种程度。玛蒂哈终于抬起了眼睛——但随后她的头又偏向了一侧，瘫坐在椅子上，羞愧地回想起了自己的所作所为。 “在我们从飓风留下的废墟中找到那块符文石的时候，菲奥多尔已经有了一个儿子。当时，我认为这种天赋与菲奥多尔作为法师所拥有的知识或能力并无关系；这种天赋与他本人有着密切的联系，与他所处的血脉传承有关。在我们……之后，为时还太早，无法得出更确切的结论。你先分开吧，这样我就能试着说服你的父亲了。 [berwyn.name]所以，我一直等到他自己有了孩子，才采取了行动。 [berwyn.name]倾斜[berwyn.hisHer]困惑地问道：“‘你已经采取了行动？’这是什么意思？” “我的意思是，”她继续说道，但话到一半突然停住了，喘了口气，然后喝了一口茶来压下心中的情绪。“从一开始，我就知道你是谁。我就知道你是菲奥迪奥尔的孙子。我也明白你为什么离家出走。我一直在关注你在葡萄园里的活动，等待合适的时机来介绍自己。而你，竟然真的离家出走了……这其实给了我一个机会。” “啊，原来你一直在监视我？ [berwyn.name]考虑到这个消息，他的态度和肌肉度出奇地冷静沉着。你和玛蒂哈都转向了他。 [berwyn.himHer]奇怪的是，我试图仔细理解其中的含义[berwyn.heShe]真的在认真思考。 “那……没错，是的，”她结结巴巴地回答道，“我确实想出了几种办法来说服你跟我一起走。首先，我打算说服你；如果那不行，我就打算诱惑你；而如果那个没成功……” 她低头看着自己的茶，注视着杯中深色液体中倒映出的自己的影像。你会想知道，她看到了什么。 “我本来是打算任何东西我试图解开沃多符文石及其蕴含的力量，”她说，“我当时已经做好了面对任何情况的准备。这么说吧……我们真的应该庆幸，当时你并没有需要太多的说服才决定行动。 [berwyn.name]轻声哼唱着[berwyn.himHer]自己喝了一口，然后又拿起了杯子准备再喝一杯。 [berwyn.hisHer]说实话，我本不想详细说明我们是如何相识的，”玛蒂哈继续说道，“有些事情最好保持沉默，这件事就是其中之一。在那种石头的影响下，我的心态和思维方式让我感到羞愧。” “如果你担心我会生气，那就别担心了。 [berwyn.name]笑着说，目光与玛蒂哈那充满压抑与痛苦的眼神相遇：“我可不是那种会记仇的人。看看我们最终都到了什么地步吧。 [berwyn.HeShe]你看看你现在所在的这个地方——这是一间位于堡垒塔楼顶层的宽敞、设施齐全的办公室。“情况本可能更糟。” 然而，玛蒂哈依然保持着原来的姿势，只是她的表情稍微柔和了一些。“你是这个意思吗？” “我唯一不喜欢的一点就是，你在我没有同意的情况下就改变了我的身体。 [berwyn.heShe]说着，一饮而尽[berwyn.hisHer]自从你开始讨论这个话题以来，这已经是第三次提到了。“不过，事情的结局也并不糟糕，尤其是因为我还有机会再次改变它。” 玛蒂哈依然保持着僵硬的态度。也许她只是不相信这一点罢了。 [berwyn.name]愿意原谅自己刚刚承认犯下的那些过错。 “听着，如果你需要我把这些话明确说出来，玛蒂哈，我一定会说的。 [berwyn.heShe]松松地耸了耸肩，说道：“我原谅你。” 终于，玛蒂哈露出了微笑。她试图通过端起茶杯喝一口茶来掩饰自己的笑容，但茶杯边缘的弧度还是让她的嘴角微微上扬。

Her expression is stiff and pensive and her back is perfectly straight, bracing for some form of blowback; she knows she has some explaining to do. "I’d like to remind you both that, by the time I had met you, [berwyn.name], I had been under the corruptive influence of the Vodo rune stone for many decades," she starts. "Okay," is [berwyn.hisHer] only reply. "I was obsessed with learning more about the stone. I was desperate to learn how to tap into and harness the thousands of years of ambient mana stored within it; I would have done anything." She lifts her teacup to her lips as if she were about to take a drink, but she stops, deciding that now isn’t the time. "Fiodoir... seemed to have an intrinsic understanding on how to tap into the stone, but he didn’t pass his knowledge to me, and not to the level that I would later achieve." Matiha finally lifts her eyes – but then her head tilts to one side, slumping in her seat as she shamefully recalls her actions. "Fiodoir had a son by the time we had found that rune stone among the debris of the hurricane. At the time, I supposed that the talent wasn’t something to do with Fiodoir’s knowledge or talents as a mage; it was something to do with him specifically. Something to do with his bloodline. It was too early after our... break up for me to try and persuade your father, [berwyn.name], so I waited until he had a child himself before I made my move." [berwyn.name] tilts [berwyn.hisHer] head in confusion. "‘Made your move?’ What does that mean?" "I mean," she continues, before her breath catches in her throat. She takes a drink from her tea to swallow it back down. "I knew who you were from the start. I knew you were Fiodior’s grandchild. I knew why you had run away from home. I was keeping track of your activities on your vineyard, waiting for the right opportunity to introduce myself. And you running away from home... presented the opportunity to me." "Ah, so you were spying on me?" [berwyn.name]’s attitude and tone is surprisingly calm and collected, given the news. Both you and Matiha turn towards [berwyn.himHer] curiously, trying to get a good read on what [berwyn.heShe] is really thinking. "That’s... correct, yes," she haltingly answers. "I had outlined a number of approaches towards getting you to come with me. First, I was going to convince you; if that didn’t work, I was going to seduce you; and if that didn’t work...." She looks down at her tea, watching her reflection in the cup’s dark liquid. You wonder what she sees. "I was going to do anything to try and unlock the Vodo rune stone and it’s power," she says. "I was... prepared for anything. Let’s just say that... we should be thankful that you didn’t need much convincing at the time." [berwyn.name] hums to [berwyn.himHer]self and takes another drink from [berwyn.hisHer] tea. And that’s the whole reaction. "If I’m honest, I would have preferred to not have elaborated on how we met," Matiha continues. "There are some things better left unsaid, and that was one of them. I’m not proud of my mindset and way of thinking while I was under the influence of that stone." "If you’re worried that I’m mad, don’t be," [berwyn.name] says, meeting Matiha’s downtrodden gaze with a toothy smile. "I’m not one to hold a grudge. Look at where we are, in the end." [berwyn.HeShe] motions to the room you’re sitting in – a large, well-furnished office sitting at the top of a fortress’s tower. "It could have ended worse." Matiha, however, maintains her posture – but her expression softens ever so slightly. "Do you mean that?" "The only thing I’m not a fan of is you changing my body without my permission," [berwyn.heShe] says, knocking back [berwyn.hisHer] third cup of tea since you had started this topic. "But it’s not like that ended poorly, either, especially since I had the opportunity to change it again." Matiha remain stiff-backed. Maybe she just doesn’t believe that [berwyn.name] is willing to look past the transgressions she had just admitted to doing. "Look, if you need me to say the actual words, Matiha, I’ll say them," [berwyn.heShe] says with a loose shrug. "I forgive you." Finally, Matiha smiles. She tries to hide it behind taking a drink from her teacup, but the corners of her mouth lift up around the cup’s raised rim.'

rows.original: [matiha.blankP |You ask Matiha if she... well... you know that she enjoys being a mother and raising a small cadre of witches and warlocks, but you were thinking of maybe her going on Brown Leaf for a little while. At least until things settle down and you’ve both gotten things under control. Having just one kid is a lot of work; adding any more can be difficult. Matiha tilts her head and furrows her brow only slightly, as if she’s confused by what you’re asking of her. "Why is it that I have to be the one to go on Brown Leaf?" she asks. "You’re the one that can’t keep your seed under control." That’s– You don’t think you’ve ever been accused of being ‘too virile’ before. She hums as she considers your request. "As you said: I was rather enjoying being a mother, [pc.name]. I would like to do it again." She hangs her head slightly, her eyes drifting across the floor and her finger tapping on her chin. "But... perhaps you’re right. I’m approaching this too emotionally. There are realities and difficulties that come with raising a child properly... even if that one lovely lupine girl is doing most of the heavy lifting when we’re away. Adding more ‘little witches and warlocks’ is perhaps not the route we ought to be taking." She pauses as she thinks some more about it. "Very well," she says a moment later, lifting her head and causing the sagging tip of her hat to bob up and down. "I happen to have a reserve of Brown Leaf meant for alchemical studies. It would be no hassle to use it for personal reasons." That was easy. |You ask Matiha if she’s still on the Brown Leaf. "Yes," she answers simply. "I’ve been taking it once a day as my morning tea. Luckily, it’s not too bad." You ask if she wants to go back off it. And... see where life takes you from there. "This, after you had asked me to go on it in the first place?" she teases, turning her head to one side and resting her cheek on her shoulder as she narrows her eyes on you. "I’ve already forgotten what it’s like to go through every stage of pregnancy – but I remember that I enjoyed it quite a lot, and that I was fond of the idea of having another. Rediscovering all the joys of parenthood sounds like a wonderful time to me." Her left hand reaches to you, her fingers dancing up your [pc.chest] before suddenly crooking into the collar of your [pc.upperGarments]. "And I’m sure you’re looking forward to your part in the act," she says, the tip of her tongue snaking out from the corner of her mouth and running a long, wet line across her upper lip. In all honestly, you can’t deny the... enjoyment that you get out of doing ‘your part.’ "That’s what I thought," she says, laughing to herself before letting you go. ]
rows.translation: [matiha.blankP |你问玛蒂哈，她是否……嗯……你知道她很喜欢当母亲，也喜欢抚养那一群小巫师和小男巫，但你是想问她是否可以去布朗叶那里待一段时间。至少等到情况稳定下来，你们俩都能把各自的事情处理好之后再回来。只有一个孩子就已经很麻烦了；再要一个的话，就会更加困难了。 玛蒂哈微微歪着头，眉头轻轻蹙起，似乎对你提出的要求感到困惑。“为什么非得让我去参加‘棕叶行动’呢？她问道，‘就是你，总是控制不住自己的欲望。’” 那就是…… 你该不会从来没被人指责过‘过于好色’吧？ 她一边思考你的请求，一边轻声哼着曲子。正如你所说，我确实很享受当母亲的乐趣。 [pc.name]我真的很想再试一次。”她微微低下头，目光落在地板上，手指轻轻敲打着下巴，“但是……也许你是对的。我确实太过于情绪化了。正确抚养一个孩子，确实需要面对许多现实问题与困难。……即使在我们不在的时候，是那个可爱的狼族女孩在承担大部分重任。增加更多的‘小女巫和小巫师’或许并不是我们应该选择的道路。” 她停顿了一下，继续思考着这个问题。好吧，”片刻之后，她抬起头，帽子的帽檐随之上下晃动，“我正好还有一些用于炼金研究的棕叶储备。把这些叶子用来满足个人需求，应该不会有什么麻烦。那太简单了。 |你询问玛蒂哈是否还在继续服用那种名为“棕叶”的药物。 “是的，”她简单地回答，“我每天早上都会把它当作茶来喝。幸运的是，效果还不错。” 你又问她是否想停止服用它。这就是你当初让我参与这件事的原因吗？”她调皮地问道，把头偏向一边，脸颊倚在肩上，眯着眼睛看着你。我已经完全忘记了怀孕过程中的每一个阶段是怎样的了——但我记得，那段时光让我感到非常愉快，而且我也很期待能再要一个孩子。重新体验为人父母的种种喜悦，对我来说，肯定是一段非常美好的时光。她的左手伸向你，手指轻轻触碰着你的[pc.chest]在突然绕到你的脖子上之前[pc.upperGarments]我相信你们一定都很期待你的参与其中，”她说，舌尖从嘴角探出，划过上唇，留下一道长长的湿痕。 说实话，你不得不承认……尽自己的一份力确实会带来乐趣。 “我也是这么想的，”她笑着自言自语，然后才放你离开。 ]

rows.raw: ' You wake sometime later. Your mind is a groggy, blurry place, and your eyes are crusted over and unfocused when you manage to open them. But at least the light of the room is fairly dim. Your muscles are all stiff from staying in the same position for so long, but it’s a good kind of stiff: the kind that you can work out with a stretch or two. As you squirm in the bed, you feel the warm body of someone else being in there with you, although you can’t make out silhouettes in your mind’s eye. Eventually, when you manage to get them open, [berwyn.andMatiha |[berwyn.dsn |the first thing you see is the flawless complexion of Matiha’s face as she gently rests her cheek on [berwyn.cupRange 0 2 |[berwyn.name]’s warm, chocolaty chest |[berwyn.name]’s warm, soft, chocolaty breast ] staring back at you with a contented smile across her lips. And when you turn your head to the left slightly, you see [berwyn.name] staring down at you, wearing the same expression. "We didn’t want to disturb you," [berwyn.name] says, [berwyn.hisHer] fingers stroking [pc.hasHair |your [pc.hair] |your head ]. "And I’m enjoying being the center of attention." |the first thing you see is [berwyn.name] staring back up at you with a warm, contented smile on [berwyn.hisHer] face, [berwyn.hisHer] piercing blue eyes watching you like [berwyn.heShe] just found the stars for the first time in [berwyn.hisHer] life. And across your chest, on your left, is Matiha, giving you much the same expression: a gentle smile on her lips that raises her cheeks to her eyes, looking like she’s found peace. [silly |"You’re finally awake," |"Morning, sleepyhead," ] Matiha says playfully, reaching up to run her finger down the bridge of your nose. [silly |"You were trying to cross the border, right? rows.original: [rand |When you enter the office in the fortresses’ tower, you find [berwyn.name] nose deep in a book – as usual – but, more interestingly, in [berwyn.hisHer] hands are a pair of knitting needles instead of wands, although neither of the needles have thread on or around them. You ask [berwyn.himHer] if [berwyn.heShe]’s traded in [berwyn.hisHer] usual tools for something a little more mundane... or maybe they’re enchanted? "That’s what I’m trying to go for, actually," [berwyn.heShe] answers without looking up from [berwyn.hisHer] book. "I’m not a seamstress and I’m not going to pretend that I am one or that I could even be one. But I’m pretty okay at magic, all things considered." [berwyn.HeShe] turns the page with [berwyn.hisHer] free hand, [berwyn.hisHer] index finger going to the first line at the top of the page to help [berwyn.himHer] focus. "There’s gotta be a way that I can enchant these needles to do all the hard work for me." If [berwyn.heShe] enchants the needles to ‘do all the hard work,’ then... that sort of removes the spirit of the act, doesn’t it? You don’t know what [berwyn.heShe]’s planning on making, but, one, you presume it’s for [berwyn.hisHer] upcoming baby, and two, you’d think it ought to be something of a labor of love. "Sure, and I agree," [berwyn.heShe] says, looking up from [berwyn.hisHer] book and twiddling [berwyn.hisHer] knitting needles between [berwyn.hisHer] fingers rather dexterously. "But let’s say I make a little cozy for the kid to sleep in at night. I’m not any good at sewing; what if it comes out shitty? The size is all wrong; the limbs are all lopsided; maybe it just won’t fit over the baby properly and, like, half of their torso is exposed. I want to make something for the kid, but I don’t want to make something bad." "And that’s where this comes in," [berwyn.heShe] finishes, tapping on the book’s page with the tip of [berwyn.hisHer] needles. "This is the labor that I am putting my love into, [pc.name]. I put in the work to enchant the needles, and, the theory is, they do the rest of the work for me. I’d still decide on things like patterns and colors, but they’d do all the skillful stuff that I’m not about." [pc.isBimbo |Oh. That makes sense! You think. You’re not much of a thinker; you’re more of a doer, and if [berwyn.name] says that this is the better way to do things, then, sure! That makes sense! You think. |... On the one hand, it’s not exactly a traditional approach to knitting, or to making something out of love for someone else. There’s... a certain value in sitting down and putting the time into each individual project because you want to, and not because you’re bad at it. In fact, wanting to do it in spite of your lack of skill is what makes the intent so special. But on the other, you can’t really argue against [berwyn.hisHer] logic. There’s value in producing something heartfelt, even if it comes out bad... but there’s value – more obvious value – in making something useful, too. And [berwyn.heShe]’s not wrong in that putting in the effort to make it work in the first place has love, too. ] You ask [berwyn.himHer] how well it’s coming along; [berwyn.heShe] winces, [berwyn.hisHer] left cheek rising up slightly, at the question. "It’s a lot trickier than I thought it’d be, that’s for sure," [berwyn.heShe] sighs, clicking the needles together like chopsticks. "It’s pretty easy to enchant an object to do something simple, like a broom to sweep a floor... as long as you don’t care where all the dust goes. [rand |I can get the needles to move and knit, but I can’t get them to measure properly... and I can’t get them to know when to stop. |I can get the needles to stop when they’ve done a loop, but I have to command them to start again just for another loop. It’d be faster to learn how to knit myself. |I can get the needles to knit with a certain color, but not in patterns or intervals: if I tell them to knit with red yarn, they’ll just use that until they run out, and then they stop completely. |I can get the needles to knit in patterns, with different colors and shapes, but as soon as I get distracted by something, the needles get confused and start knitting whatever it is I was thinking of when I was distracted. ]" [berwyn.HeShe] leans [berwyn.hisHer] elbow on the desk and rests [berwyn.hisHer] cheek on [berwyn.hisHer] raised palm, [berwyn.hisHer] eyes boorishly watching the points of the needles spin across [berwyn.hisHer] fingers. "Whenever I think I solve one issue, a different one pops up, and I’m back to where I started." [berwyn.name] pauses, twiddling the knitting needles a bit more before slamming them into the spine of the book [berwyn.heShe] had opened and flipping its lid closed. "That’s enough for today, I think," [berwyn.heShe] says as [berwyn.heShe] stands, fluffing [berwyn.hisHer] robe from underneath [berwyn.himHer]self. "I could use the break. [pc.name], distract me." |When you enter the office in the fortresses’ tower, you find [berwyn.name] nose-deep in a book – as usual – but, more interestingly, you find a number of toys lined up across the length of [berwyn.hisHer] desk. Dozens of them, all of them made of wood, depicting everything from little, featureless men and women with plain wooden spheres for heads and hands, to what appears to be a horse-drawn carriage with no driver and nothing in it, to animals, including birds, dogs, and dolphins. [berwyn.name]’s left hand holds the book open, while [berwyn.hisHer] right is holding a wand, its tip faintly glowing purple. Sitting at the foot of the desk closer to you is a bucket filled with water, and from how soaked the floor around it is, something’s been splashing around in it lately. You tell [berwyn.himHer] that you didn’t take [berwyn.himHer] to be the type to play with dolls. [silly |"They’re action figures, [pc.mf |dad |mom ]," [berwyn.heShe] pouts. |"Maybe not dolls, exactly," [berwyn.heShe] responds. ] "When I was a kid, I was pretty starved for... engagement. I grew up on a vineyard, way outside of city limits; any friends I had lived a half-hour walk away; I was interested in magic, but my parents didn’t want me reading up on it; so... all I really had to keep me entertained was any toy that I could find." [berwyn.HeShe] flips [berwyn.hisHer] wand so that its stem rests between [berwyn.hisHer] middle and ring fingers, and [berwyn.heShe] reaches forward with the same hand to grab onto one of the toys, lifting it up and spinning it around, inspecting the wood it’s made of. "Hell, I’d make do with rocks, if I needed. Smooth ones; funny-shaped ones; ones that were discolored... if it looked particular at all, then I’d find a use for it." So, then [berwyn.heShe] made all of these toys for [berwyn.hisHer] baby? So that your kid has all the toys that they could ask for, when [berwyn.heShe] didn’t have that same privilege growing up? "Not quite," [berwyn.heShe] responds. "I bought all of these toys. Some of them aren’t even toys," [berwyn.heShe] continues, motioning to some of the featureless, person-shaped dolls with spheres for heads and hands. "Some of them are meant for art." So, then, what’s the plan? "I’m hoping to enchant the toys so that they can move on their own," [berwyn.heShe] answers as [berwyn.heShe] picks up the horse-drawn carriage toy. "Take this one. Wouldn’t it be neat if you put it down, and then the hors[silly |ies |es ] start galloping on their own? Or one of the dolphin toys – what if you put it in water, and then it started swimming? That sounds awesome, right?" Well... yes, but... on the other hand, making what you can out of what you have is a part of the wonders of being a child, isn’t it? Like, [berwyn.heShe] just said that [berwyn.heShe] used to play with rocks. That rock could be anything. It could be a person, or a monster, or a vehicle, or some kind of flying platform for other characters to stand on or something. Once the hors[silly |i ]e-drawn carriage starts acting like a hors[silly |i ]e-drawn carriage, there isn’t anything else it could be, you know? "I had thought of that," [berwyn.heShe] says, "and I’m trying to work in a condition to the enchantment so that it ‘fails’ on command. So if the baby didn’t want the carriage to move, then it wouldn’t." [berwyn.name] pauses and rests [berwyn.hisHer] cheek on [berwyn.hisHer] free left hand, using [berwyn.hisHer] elbow to keep the book propped open. [berwyn.HeShe] takes a long, frustrated sigh through [berwyn.hisHer] nose, turning the carriage around to see its rear side, although you sort of doubt [berwyn.heShe]’s looking at anything in particular. You take it that progress is slow. "Progress... isn’t," [berwyn.heShe] says with another sigh of dejection. "Back when you and I had our adventure claiming the tower from Matiha, I could conjure golems made of stone to help when things got dicey during combat. It’s one thing to make a thing made out of rocks and shaped like a person and telling it to swing at a target until it couldn’t anymore; it’s a whole other thing to give it more complex instructions, even if the complexity is ‘don’t do anything if I don’t want you to.’ You want to know how well progress is going?" [rand |[berwyn.name] taps the tip of [berwyn.hisHer] wand against the carriage; a dull, hazy purple aura envelops the toy before infusing with it, settling into the wood’s lacquer. Then, [berwyn.heShe] gets up and sets it down on the floor – and as soon as the wheels of the carriage touch the brick, the whole thing is off like a shot, zooming faster than you were ready for straight into the nearby wall... where there’s a pile of other torn, destroyed kindling. "I don’t think it’s out of the realm of possibility," [berwyn.heShe] says as [berwyn.heShe] stands. |[berwyn.name] sets down the carriage and picks up one of the dolphins before touching the tip of [berwyn.hisHer] wind to it; a dull, hazy purple aura envelops the toy before infusing with it, settling into the wood’s lacquer. With a practiced flick of the wrist, [berwyn.heShe] tosses the dolphin into the bucket of water – and then the toy jumps right back out, the wood bending and twisting as the dolphin flops across the floor like a fish out of water, desperately trying to find its way back to the ocean and getting water everywhere as it does. "I don’t think it’s out of the realm of possibility," [berwyn.heShe] says as [berwyn.heShe] stands, picking up the flopping dolphin and touching [berwyn.hisHer] wand to it again. Instantly, the wood settles once more, as if nothing had happened. |[berwyn.name] sets down the carriage and picks up one of the featureless person-shaped dolls before touching the tip of [berwyn.hisHer] wand to it; a dull, hazy purple aura envelops the toy before infusing with it, settling into the wood’s lacquer. Gingerly, [berwyn.heShe] sets the toy onto its feet – and it starts to move, putting one ‘hand’ forward as it takes a step... and instantly falls to pieces, as if the pieces holding it all together simply no longer existed. And then the individual pieces start to move as well. "I don’t think it’s out of the realm of possibility," [berwyn.heShe] says as [berwyn.heShe] stands, tapping the tip of [berwyn.hisHer] wand against one of the still-moving pieces. Just like that, all of the pieces fall silent one more, as if nothing had happened. ] "But it’s going to take a lot more research than I’ve done now, and I’ve been at it for a while. [berwyn.heShe]不查资料就能回答出来[berwyn.hisHer]我并不是裁缝，也不会假装自己是裁缝，更不会声称自己有能力成为裁缝。是一、不过总体来说，我在魔法方面还是挺在行的。 [berwyn.HeShe]翻开新的一页，继续前进[berwyn.hisHer]有充分的自由去发挥。 [berwyn.hisHer]将食指放在页面顶部的第一行上，这样就能方便地查看内容了。 |哦，原来如此！你是这么想的。其实你并不是一个喜欢深思熟虑的人，你更是一个行动派，对吧？ [berwyn.name]如果有人说这是更好的做事方式，那么，当然！这确实有道理！你会这么想。 As you climb the stairs to the tower, you can’t help but feel like something... is amiss. Something is different. You can’t tell what: its not like the echo of your footsteps sounds any different or that the walls are shaped unusually (which, given the nature of the tower, isn’t such a hard thing to imagine).

    Your path to the office passes in front of [berwyn.name]’s quarters, where you hear heavy but steady breathing. A part of you thinks that [berwyn.heShe] could be working out – or, knowing [berwyn.hisHer] history, [berwyn.heShe] could be in the middle of some ‘personal time’ – but your instincts know better. 当你爬上通往塔楼的楼梯时，你不禁觉得有些事情……不太对劲。有些地方与众不同。但你却说不出具体是什么地方：你的脚步声并没有变得异常，墙壁的形状也并没有什么奇怪之处（考虑到这座塔楼的性质，这样的想象其实也并不难）。

你通往办公室的路需要经过[berwyn.name]在那个房间里，你能听到重型而规律的呼吸声。你内心有一部分在想[berwyn.heShe]也许会有好结果吧——或者说，相信肯定会的。 [berwyn.hisHer]历史， [berwyn.heShe]可能她正在享受“个人时间”……但你的直觉告诉你，事情并非如此。当你打开门时，你发现[berwyn.himHer]开启[berwyn.hisHer]躺在床上，双腿摊开。 [berwyn.hisHer]长袍被撩到了腰部以上。 [berwyn.hisHer]腰部，而且地板和床上都有一些深色的斑点。 [berwyn.heShe]就躺在那儿。[pc.name]！” [berwyn.heShe]那些呼喊声。如果视线真的具有穿透力，你早就被那些声音刺穿心脏了。 [berwyn.hisHer]呆呆地望着那个地方。[berwyn.numKids 0 1
        |地板上的某个地方有一块路标宝石。把它捡起来，握住我的手，然后捏一下它！

这个宝石很容易找到：在离床几英尺远的地板上，有一颗被紫色丝带绑着的紫色宝石，它应该是被不小心碰掉掉在那里的。 [berwyn.hisHer]床边的桌子[berwyn.hisHer]开始出现收缩现象了， [berwyn.heShe]已经瘫痪得太严重，无法被触及了。你随意处理吧。 [berwyn.heShe]我就跟你说过：你只需要捡起那颗宝石，然后将手伸进去就行了。 [berwyn.hisHers];

rows.original: All of the excitement drains [berwyn.name] of [berwyn.hisHer] energy, and understandably so; a short while after the ‘event,’ [berwyn.heShe]’s out like a light, leaving you and Gwyneth to clean up the baby and get yourself comfortable with [var0 |him |her ] while you wait for [berwyn.name] to recover. It takes a few hours, but, eventually, [berwyn.heShe] does: with a moan and a twist of [berwyn.hisHer] head, [berwyn.hisHer] eyes blink open to the [dayNight |sun |moon ]light illuminating you and your new baby together. "[pc.name]...?" [berwyn.heShe] asks blearily; you can hear the dryness in [berwyn.hisHer] throat. You tell [berwyn.himHer] that you’re here, and that it’s all finally over: [berwyn.heShe]’s had the baby. You had considered leaving [var0 |him |her ] in Gwyneth’s care, but you figured that [berwyn.heShe] would want to see what the fuss is all about when [berwyn.heShe] came to. [berwyn.name]’s eyes go from yours to the baby’s, nestled in your arms, [var0 |him |her ]self sound asleep. [var0 |He |She ]’s had a big day, too. "Wow," [berwyn.heShe] whispers to [berwyn.himHer]self. "[berwyn.numKids 1 2 |That came out of me?" [berwyn.heShe] asks louder, more directly to you. "I pushed a whole-ass baby out of my body?" ... "I once reconstituted myself from nothing but pure ether," [berwyn.heShe] says, "and now, I’ve made a whole other lifeform from nothing but an egg and a bit of nut. rows.translation: 所有的兴奋感都消失了。 [berwyn.name]的[berwyn.hisHer]能量，这也是可以理解的；在“那个事件”发生不久之后[berwyn.heShe]一下子就熄灭了，于是你就和格温妮丝一起负责照顾宝宝，然后让自己舒服地休息一下。 [var0 |他 |她 ]在您等待的时候[berwyn.name]需要几个小时的时间，但最终，一切都会恢复如常。 [berwyn.heShe]随着一声呻吟和身体的扭曲[berwyn.hisHer]头部[berwyn.hisHer]眼前的一切豁然开朗。 [dayNight |太阳 |月亮 ]光芒照亮了你和你的新生宝宝。[pc.name]……？” [berwyn.heShe]含糊地问道；你能听出他的声音里带着干涩。 [berwyn.hisHer]你说吧。 [berwyn.himHer]你能来到这里，意味着这一切终于结束了[berwyn.heShe]你已经生了孩子。你曾经考虑过离开。 [var0 |他 |她 ]在格温妮丝的照顾下，但你应该早就想到了这一点。 [berwyn.heShe]当人们想知道究竟发生了什么事情，自然会想要一探个究竟。 [berwyn.heShe]来到了。 [berwyn.name]她的目光从你身上移到了你怀中的婴儿身上。 [var0 |他 |她 ]很快就睡着了。 [var0 |他 |她 ]今天也是他们非常忙碌的一天呢。‘哇， [berwyn.heShe]低声对……说[berwyn.himHer]自我。[berwyn.numKids 1 2 |那话真的是我说的吗？ [berwyn.heShe]用更响亮、更直接的方式向你提问：“我是真的把一个完整的婴儿从自己身体里生了出来吗？” ……虽然没有多少母亲会用这种方式来描述这个过程，但事实确实如此。 [berwyn.HeShe]盯着你怀中的婴儿看了一会儿，最终还是笑了起来。 [berwyn.himHer]我曾经仅凭纯粹的以太将自己重新凝聚而成。 [berwyn.heShe]说：“现在，我只用一个蛋和一点点坚果，就创造出了另一种全新的生命形态。这又是我成就清单上的另一项成就。 |无论我重复这个过程多少次，事实依然是…… 那就是我的宝贝——那是你和我白手起家创造出来的东西，永远都不会过时。” 那么，这是否意味着[berwyn.heShe]有人愿意再做一次吗？ [berwyn.name]先是暂停，然后又消沉下去。 [berwyn.hisHer]肩膀变得无力， [berwyn.hisHer]惊得目瞪口呆[berwyn.hisHer]这不是一个非黑即白的问题，我想你也明白这一点。 [berwyn.heShe]说：“我从来都没有想要本来想不做，但结果还是发生了，而且体验真的很棒。然而之后我的宫缩开始了，一切又变得糟糕起来。暂时就先这么想吧：“如果发生了，那就让它发生吧”，好吗？ ] [berwyn.HeShe]从床上坐起来（因为疼痛而微微皱起了眉头），然后朝你的方向说道：“让我看看。 [berwyn.heShe]提出这些要求，而你也只能默默接受，然后将你的“新宝贝”交出去。 [var0 |男孩 |女孩 ]向[berwyn.himHer]这个婴儿还没有长出头发，眼睛也闭着——但是[var0 |他 |她 ]拥有[berwyn.name]他的肤色更深，所以，你可以想象[var0 |他 |她 ]会随父母一方的外貌或性格特征而成长[berwyn.himHer]那孩子长得可真漂亮。 [berwyn.heShe]窃笑。 [berwyn.HeShe]很可能也在想你正在想的事情。

rows.original: You and [berwyn.name] spend the rest of the day recuperating from all of the difficulties that naturally come with childbirth. The baby wakes up a few times, always to make some small yawling noise, hungry for some of [var0 |his |her ] mother’s milk, and then goes right back to sleep as soon as [var0 |he |she ]’s satisfied. Which is perfect for you two: bonding with your kid and your kid’s mom is much easier when most of the stress around the baby is on guessing on when [var0 |he |she ]’s going to get hungry again. When morning rolls around, [berwyn.name] is healthy enough to get up and start moving (to say nothing of the bedsores [berwyn.heShe] was starting to get), albeit with a bit of a wobble in [berwyn.hisHer] gait. Like you two had discussed[berwyn.numKids 2 | back when you first learned that you were going to be parents ], your lifestyle is too active to bring a baby with you on your journeys, and the Ways Between is no place for a child, so, you both know that it’s best to leave your kid with Gwyneth in the nursery. She’s an experienced caretaker: you feel confident and secure in her ability to look after your baby. [berwyn.name] is slow and [berwyn.hisHer] pace is a bit unsteady as you walk [berwyn.himHer] back to the Wayportal in the center of the village. As you approach the stone, you ask [berwyn.himHer] if [berwyn.heShe]’d like you to walk [berwyn.himHer] to [berwyn.hisHer] room or office in the tower. "No," [berwyn.heShe] answers, "I gotta do that myself. If I can’t climb a flight of stairs, I can’t expected to be very independent, can I?" [berwyn.heShe] giddily interrupts, [berwyn.hisHer] tail swishing behind [berwyn.himHer]self. "Do some shopping, maybe? Grab a beer at the tavern, see what Garth’s been up to?" ... No, actually, you don’t want to do any of that. [berwyn.name]’s expression slowly drops, [berwyn.hisHer] ears folding flat and [berwyn.hisHer] tail stops wagging. "Oh." If you didn’t know better, you’d think you’d need to start laying off some of the sweets and desserts and leaving some more food for the others. But you know that you’re pregnant, and it’s really starting to show: your stomach is rounded and wobbly and it’s getting heavier by the day. Your gait is widening and it sometimes feels like you need to relearn how to walk.

    Still, though, things are progressing smoothly. Aside from the obvious issues, you feel fine. And you haven’t gotten to the cravings or the spikes in libido yet, so... pessimistically, you still have those to look forward to.
rows.translation:
要不是你心里有数，你会以为自己该少碰些糖果和甜点，多给其他人留点食物。但你知道自己怀孕了，而且肚子已经很明显了：你的腹部圆滚滚、软塌塌的，一天比一天沉。你走路的步幅越来越宽，有时甚至觉得自己得重新学怎么走路。

    不过，事情进展得还算顺利。除了那些显而易见的问题，你感觉还不错。而且你还没到嘴馋或者性欲猛增的阶段，所以……往坏处想，这些还都在前头等着你呢。
rows.raw:
"
    If you didn’t know better, you’d think you’d need to start laying off some of the sweets and desserts and leaving some more food for the others. But you know that you’re pregnant, and it’s really starting to show: your stomach is rounded and wobbly and it’s getting heavier by the day. Your gait is widening and it sometimes feels like you need to relearn how to walk.

    Still, though, things are progressing smoothly. Aside from the obvious issues, you feel fine. And you haven’t gotten to the cravings or the spikes in libido yet, so... pessimistically, you still have those to look forward to."

rows.original: Phew, it’s getting hard to do much of anything lately. Your stomach is really starting to get swollen with [berwyn.name]’s kid[berwyn.cockRange 0 3 | | – or kids, given how much [berwyn.heShe] can put out in one nut ]. You’ve had weird cravings for everything from the taste of metal, to steaks grilled rare, to, in one weird instance, you wanting to eat dirt. And none of that is touching on how libidinous you feel like you can get sometimes. All of that aside, though, you feel... oddly chipper. As difficult as it can be to walk sometimes, you still have this occasional urge to skip and prance, which you wouldn’t mind doing if it didn’t come with the risk of tripping and falling. When you’re alone, you find yourself humming while at least one of your hands rests on your baby bump. It’s hard to keep you in a bad mood for long. You must be getting close to delivering. You aren’t positive how close, but it shouldn’t be too much longer now.
rows.translation: 呼，最近真的很难做任何事情了。你的肚子也开始明显肿起来了[berwyn.name]那个孩子的父亲[berwyn.cockRange 0 3 | | – 或者孩子们，考虑到他们的年龄，这种情况更是常见。 [berwyn.heShe]一劳永逸 ]你曾经有过一些奇怪的食欲，从渴望品尝金属的味道，到想要吃半生不熟的牛排，甚至有一次还想吃土。而这些，都远远无法形容你有时会感到自己有多么好色。 不过，撇开这一切不谈，你却感到……出奇地兴奋。尽管有时候走路会让人感到很吃力，但你还是会时不时地想要蹦蹦跳跳，要是不会因此而摔倒的话，你肯定很乐意这么做。当你独自一个人的时候，你会不由自主地哼起歌来，而你的双手中至少有一只会放在自己的肚子上。这样的时候，你很难长时间保持坏心情。 你应该已经快要分娩了吧？不过你还不太确定。如何快了，应该不会再拖延太久了。

rows.original: You put one foot in front of the other – and then, as if you had taken just one step too far and your body couldn’t take it anymore, it suddenly happens: your water breaks. Your stomach had been feeling particularly saggy and swollen lately, but... you had been putting it off for just a moment too long, it seems.
rows.translation: 你一步一步向前走——然后，仿佛你只是多走了一步，身体就再也承受不住了，事情突然就发生了：你的羊水破了。最近你的肚子一直感觉格外松弛、肿胀，可是……看来你把它拖得太久了。

rows.original:
Thinking quickly, you reach into your pocket to withdraw the signet stone that you use to summon [berwyn.name]’s tower, but you think twice: you’re in a populated area, and [berwyn.name][matiha.atFortress
            | and Matiha
        ] generally try to make it a point to not move the tower somewhere especially visible.
        
        Still, you’re in no short supply of help: once it’s made obvious that you’re about to give birth in a populated area, you’re surrounded by people willing to give help, with some others running off to find someone more experienced. You’re given space, water, something to rest your head on – and, thankfully, a set of hands that’s familiar enough with deliveries that you’re comfortable that you’re in capable hands.
        
        To your mild surprise, you hear [berwyn.name]’s voice among the crowd surrounding you, pushing [berwyn.hisHer] way towards you. "Out of the way!" [berwyn.heShe] shouts, "I’m the father, give me some space!"
        
        Soon, [berwyn.heShe]’s by your side, [berwyn.hisHer] hand in yours and giving you a firm squeeze. Given the pain and motions you’re going through, you’re pretty sure you’re squeezing [berwyn.hisHers] harder than [berwyn.heShe]’s squeezing yours. You ask [berwyn.himHer] how [berwyn.heShe] got here.
        
        "I got the signal when you gripped onto the charm I gave you," [berwyn.heShe] explains, "but you must not have squeezed very hard, because the call was weak. I put two and two together, and–"
        
        [berwyn.HeShe] pauses, looking around the group of strangers surrounding you two.
        
        "Well, the tower is elsewhere," [berwyn.heShe] finishes, leaning in closer to you to whisper. "But that’s not important right now. There’s something else you ought to be focusing on!"
        
        Time passes in a hazy blur; all you really remember by the time things are over is [berwyn.name] occasionally saying things to you; the sound of the crowd surrounding you on all sides; and the pain rippling through your body. Eventually, though, the worst of it passes rather suddenly: one minute, you’re pushing a living being[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
            |
            | – maybe more than one –
        ] through your body, and the next, it’s over... and you have [berwyn.cockRange 0 3
            |a crying, messy little pup of a lupine in your arms, brought into the world after one hell of a ride. It looks like a [berwyn.numKids 0 1 2
                |boy
                |girl
                |[rand
                    |boy
                    |girl
                ]
            ]
            |[var0
                |a pair
                |a triplet set
                |a quadruplet set
                |a quintuplet set
            ] of crying, messy little pups in your arms, brought into the world after one hell of a ride. Maybe it’s a good thing you don’t remember most of that
        ].
        
        All of the excitement of having given birth to your kid[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
            |
            |s
        ] has given you so much exhaustion that the indignity that you just had them in the middle of the street doesn’t really cross your mind. Your body doesn’t have any more energy to keep itself upright, and now that your kids are born, you allow yourself to pass out.

rows.original:
Thinking quickly, you reach into your pocket to withdraw the signet stone that you use to summon [berwyn.name]’s tower, and you give it as strong of a squeeze as you can manage, but a contraction rips the strength from your fingers; you barely have the wherewithal to keep yourself from losing your grip on it and losing it somewhere in the area around yourself. You’re brought to your knees and left to [party.som
            |the wilds to fend for yourself – while you’re in the middle of giving birth
            |the care of [comp1.name] here in the middle of basically nowhere
            |the care of [comp1.name] and [comp2.name] here in the middle of basically nowhere
        ].
        
        Still, although you didn’t think you squeezed the stone hard enough, you feel the familiar rush of wind as it whips around you, and the pressure in the air takes a sudden dip – and then, with a loud bang and a flash of light, the tower begins to form a fair distance away from you, brick-by-brick until the whole of the fortress is constructed from nothing. You could have sworn you didn’t squeeze it hard enough for [berwyn.name] to get the message... but you’re not about to complain.
        
        [party.som
            |You barely make it to the gate to the fortress’s courtyard
            |[comp1.name] barely gets you to the gate to the fortress’s courtyard
            |Your allies barely get you to the gate to the fortress’s courtyard
        ] before [berwyn.name] is there to meet you, running as quickly as [berwyn.hisHer] mage robes will allow. rows.original:
When you awake, you’re in a comfortable bed, tucked snugly underneath the sheets with [var0
            |a nice, fluffy pillow
            |an actual pillow
        ] underneath your head. Your body is cramped and sore, particularly in your groin, but... other than that, you feel kind of... light. Languid. You feel like, if you had a few days to recover, you could probably go for a sprint, and you’d run faster than you have in months.
        
        When you stir, your hand brushes against someone else’s; someone beside your bed jolts upright at the feel of your fingers against theirs. Your vision focuses, and you see [berwyn.name]’s big, blue eyes staring back at you – they, too, are unfocused, so much that one is pointing in a different direction from the other before they slowly settle.
        
        "[pc.name]," [berwyn.heShe] says blearily. "Are you alright? How are you feeling?"
        
        You answer that you’ve been better, but you also feel like you’re on the road to recovery.
        
        [berwyn.HeShe] smiles, one cheek rising higher than the other. "That’s good to hear."
        
        You ask [berwyn.himHer] where you are and how you got here.
        
        "We’re back in Hawkethorne, at the Frost Hound," [berwyn.heShe] answers, [berwyn.hisHer] head rolling on [berwyn.hisHer] shoulders to scan the room. "I brought you here after you passed out[party.som
            |
            |, with a lot of help from [comp1.name]
            | with some help from [comp1.name] and [comp2.name]
        ], once I got the kids under control." [berwyn.HeShe] rubs at [berwyn.hisHer] cheek and across [berwyn.hisHer] eyes, trying to wipe the exhaustion away from them. "We’ve both had a pretty hectic day so far, huh?"
        
        And... your [berwyn.cockRange 0 3
            |baby
            |babies
        ]?
        
        "Safe in the nursery with Gwyneth."
        
        You lay your head back down on the pillow. That’s a relief to hear.
        
        [berwyn.name]’s hand reaches forward to yours, gently wrapping [berwyn.hisHer] fingers around your palm and giving you a light squeeze. "My plan was to stay here for the rest of the day, with you and the kid[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
            |
            |s
        ]. I’ve already got my old room booked and everything," [berwyn.heShe] says. "Hopefully you’ll be good enough to leave by tomorrow... although I wouldn’t be surprised if you walked funny for a bit."
        
        [berwyn.HeShe] smiles well-meaningly at [berwyn.hisHer] own joke. Frankly, as cute as [berwyn.heShe] is, you don’t really have the [pc.isDK
            |character
            |strength
        ] to laugh.
rows.translation:
你醒来时正躺在一张舒适的床上，惬意地裹在被单之下，脑袋下方垫着[var0
            |一只舒适蓬松的枕头
            |一只真正的枕头
        ]。你的身体僵硬酸痛，胯部尤其严重，不过……除此之外，你感觉有些……轻盈，慵懒。你觉得只要休养几天，大概就能出门冲刺，而且会跑得比过去几个月里的任何时候都快。
        
        你刚一动弹，手便擦过另一个人的手；守在床边的人感受到你的手指，猛地坐直身体。视野逐渐清晰，你看见[berwyn.name]那双蓝色大眼睛正回望着你——那双眼同样没有聚焦，其中一只甚至朝着与另一只不同的方向，随后才慢慢恢复正常。
        
        “[pc.name]。”[berwyn.heShe]睡眼惺忪地说道。“你没事吧？感觉怎么样？”
        
        你回答说，感觉算不上最好，但也觉得自己正在逐渐康复。
        
        [berwyn.HeShe]笑了，一侧脸颊扬得比另一侧更高。“听你这么说真好。”
        
        你问[berwyn.himHer]这里是什么地方，自己又是怎么来的。
        
        “我们回到鹰棘镇了，就在霜犬酒馆。”[berwyn.heShe]一边回答，一边让[berwyn.hisHer]脑袋在[berwyn.hisHer]双肩上转动，环顾房间。“等我安顿好孩子们后，就把昏过去的你带到了这里[party.som
            |
            |，还多亏[comp1.name]帮了大忙
            |，期间也得到了[comp1.name]和[comp2.name]的帮助
        ]。”[berwyn.HeShe]揉了揉[berwyn.hisHer]脸颊与[berwyn.hisHer]眼睛，试图擦去其中的疲惫。“到目前为止，我们今天都过得相当忙乱，对吧？”
        
        那么……你的[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
            |宝宝
            |宝宝们
        ]呢？
        
        “安全地待在育婴室，由格温妮丝照顾。”
        
        你将头重新放回枕头。听到这个消息，你终于松了口气。
        
        [berwyn.name]朝你伸出手，以[berwyn.hisHer]手指轻轻裹住你的手掌，柔和地捏了一下。“我原本打算用今天剩下的时间陪在这里，陪着你和孩子[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
            |
            |们
        ]。以前的房间我都已经订好了。”[berwyn.heShe]说道。“希望到明天，你的状态已经好到可以离开……不过，就算你有一阵子走路姿势古怪，我也不会意外。”
        
        [berwyn.HeShe]为[berwyn.hisHer]自己的玩笑露出一抹善意的微笑。坦白说，[berwyn.heShe]虽说很可爱，你现在实在没有[pc.isDK
            |兴致
            |力气
        ]发笑。

rows.original:
The next morning, you manage to pull yourself out of the bed, although your stance is wobbly and your crotch is still sore. Still, you’re healthy enough to be up and about after spending the whole last day recovering; the soreness will fade with a bit of time and motion.

            [berwyn.name] is with you for the morning, introducing you to your bab[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
                |y
                |ies
            ] in the nursery before you two get breakfast. [berwyn.HeShe]’s particularly attentive towards the kid[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
                |
                |s
            ]: [berwyn.heShe] wiggles [berwyn.hisHer] fingers in front of their eyes, watching how their eyes follow and track their motion – right up until [berwyn.heShe] pinches their nose, and the little thing erupts into a fit of giggles and raspberries[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
                |
                |. [berwyn.HeShe]’s even good enough to multitask, giving each of your kids equal attention... although you need to step in and give [berwyn.himHer] a bit of help when one of them starts tugging on [berwyn.hisHer] hair hard enough to yank [berwyn.hisHer] head around
            ].
            
            When noon rolls around, you and [berwyn.name] depart the Frost Hound for the Waystone Portal in the center of the village. As much fun as you two are having with your family, you both still have your duties... although there’s nothing to say you can’t come back whenever you want for a bit more quality time.
            
            [berwyn.name] gives you a warm hug (and [berwyn.hisHer] hand rests on the breadth of your [pc.ass] for a moment) before pulling away. "You know where to find me," [berwyn.heShe] says as [berwyn.heShe] steps into the portal.
            
            Now... back to what you were doing.
rows.translation:
第二天早上，你终于勉强从床上爬了起来，虽然站得还不稳，胯部也仍然有些酸痛。不过，经过一整天的休息和恢复，你已经足够健康，可以起身活动了；这点酸痛只要稍加活动，过些时候就会消退。

            [berwyn.name]上午陪着你，在你们俩吃早餐之前，先带你去育婴室认识你的宝宝[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
                |y
                |ies
            ]。[berwyn.HeShe]对小家伙[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
                |
                |
            ]格外上心：[berwyn.heShe]把[berwyn.hisHer]手指在他们眼前晃来晃去，看着他们的眼睛如何追随、追踪手指的动作——直到[berwyn.heShe]捏住他们的小鼻子，小家伙便爆发出一阵咯咯的笑声和噗噗的吐泡泡声[berwyn.cockRange 0 3
                |
                |。[berwyn.HeShe]甚至还能一心多用，给每个孩子同等的关注……不过当其中一个孩子开始拽[berwyn.hisHer]头发，把[berwyn.hisHer]头都拽得偏过去时，你还是得上前帮[berwyn.himHer]一把
            ]。
            
            中午时分，你和[berwyn.name]离开霜犬酒馆，前往村子中央的路石传送门。你们俩和家人在一起虽然很开心，但各自都还有职责在身……不过话说回来，谁也没说你不能随时回来，再多享受一点天伦之乐。
            
            [berwyn.name]给了你一个温暖的拥抱（[berwyn.hisHer]手还在你[pc.ass]上停留了片刻），然后才松开。“你知道去哪儿找我，”[berwyn.heShe]说着，[berwyn.heShe]走进了传送门。
            
            那么……回去继续你刚才在做的事吧。

rows.original: As you go to extend the vial to the elven alchemist, her head whips to face it, nose scrunching at its blighted scent. "No," she exclaims. "I'll have nothing to do with whatever that is." But— "No. I don't know what it is, but it exudes a tainted aura the likes of which I've never seen, and I'll not have it in my shop! Take it elsewhere, if you must know more about it." Well alright then.

rows.original: "Hmmm? What's this?" The tanuki takes the vial from your hands and surveys its contents. "Ah, seems to be some kind of milk-based transformative. Not really my thing, I'm afraid. My methods are much more refined." Lady Evergreen extends the container back to you, letting you take it before adding on to her thoughts. "You know, Senja's found some enchanted corsets lying about the forest during her trips to town. My bet is that there's a witch wandering around the forest who might specialize in this sort of thing. Perhaps take it up with her?" [flags.VIVIANE_MET|Oh, she must mean Viviane. You'll have to ask her.|[flags.WITCH_CORSET_FOUND|You've found one such corset as well. Perhaps it's time you investigate its creator further.|You'll do that, then.]]
rows.translation: “嗯？这是什么？”狸猫从你手中接过小瓶，端详着里面的东西。“啊，似乎是某种以乳汁为基础的变形药剂。恐怕不是我擅长的领域。我的手段可要精妙得多。” 常青女士把容器递还给你，等你接过后又补充道：“你知道吗，森娅进城时，曾在森林里发现几件散落的附魔束腰。我猜森林中游荡着一个专精此道的女巫。也许你该拿去问问她？” [flags.VIVIANE_MET|哦，她肯定是在说薇薇安。你得去问问她。|[flags.WITCH_CORSET_FOUND|你也找到过一件这样的束腰。也许该进一步调查它的制作者了。|那就这么办吧。]]

rows.original: You hand the vial to Senja, telling her that her mother thought she might know something more. "Hmm, me?" Senja says, quirking a brow. She takes the vial and gives it a quick sniff, curling her button nose up at it. "Well, I'm no archmage yet, but the first thing mother ever taught us was how to smell danger. And this, this is like nothing I've ever encountered before. It's not Wraith-touched, but there's a corruption about it — some kind of dark alchemy, maybe." You nod, saying that her mother expected Senja might know somebody specialized in this sort of thing. The younger witch rocks on her heels, thinking. "Well, I've only seen her fleetingly, but there's another witch in the forest to the south, back across the river. I don't think she's an archmage, but I've seen her just casually chucking magic items out of her walking house at night, so she's clearly a powerful enchanter. Just wander around in the forest in the dark — I'm sure you'll run into her eventually. She's very hard to miss." Then why has she only seen this other witch at a distance, then? Senja blushes. "She's... she's really pretty. And her walking house is really spooky. Remember what I said about sniffing out danger? I don't think it's just perfume I keep catching on the wind." [silly|Damn, calling another witch stinky. Low blow.|You chuckle. Guess you'll have to smell for yourself.] "Mmm! So, anything else I can do for you?[flags.SENJA_FUCKED| Or to you?]"
rows.translation: 你将小瓶递给森娅，告诉她，她母亲认为她或许会知道更多线索。 “嗯，我吗？”森娅扬起一边眉毛说道。她接过小瓶，飞快地嗅了一下，随后嫌恶地皱起小巧的鼻子。“好吧，我还不是大法师，不过母亲最早教我们的本领，就是如何嗅出危险。而这东西……我从未遇到过类似的气味。它没有受到幽灵侵染，却带着一股腐化气息——或许是某种黑暗炼金术。” 你点点头，告诉她，她母亲觉得森娅或许认识专精此道的人。 年轻女巫以脚跟来回摇晃身体，陷入思索。“嗯，我只远远瞥见过她几次，不过南方森林里还有另一位女巫，就在河流对岸。我觉得她应该不是大法师，可我亲眼见过她在夜里漫不经心地从会走路的房子里往外扔魔法物品，所以她显然是位强大的附魔师。你只要天黑后在森林里随便转转——我相信迟早会碰见她。她非常显眼。” 可既然如此，为什么她只敢远远看着那位女巫？ 森娅脸红了。“她……她真的很漂亮。而且她那座会走路的房子也真的很吓人。还记得我说过要嗅出危险吗？我总能从风里闻到她的气味，而且我觉得那可不只是香水。” [silly|好家伙，居然说另一位女巫臭。太过分了。|你轻声一笑。看来你得亲自去闻闻。] “嗯！那么，还有什么需要我替你做的吗？[flags.SENJA_FUCKED|或者……对你做的？]”

[silly|[pc.hasRealCock|[viviane.fucked|"Is that a vial in your pants or are you just happy to see me?"|"So, what is it you want to show me?"]|"So, what is it you want to show me?"]|"So, what is it you want to show me?"]

    You draw the vial of succubus milk from your pack and extend it to the witch. She takes it nonchalantly and begins her cursory inspection of its contents. 
    
    "Hmmm... fluid, likely milk based on color and viscosity." Viviane pops the cork off and takes a quick waft of the air, giving a gentle nod after. "Yup, that's definitely where the vagina smell was coming from. I'm hesitant to even question what kind of milk smells like the female orgasm, but then, I'm guessing that's why you're here, huh?"
    
    Yeah. You need to know the extent of its effects since you're [var0|aware that it's a transformative|pretty sure it's some kind of transformative]. 
    
    "That does explain why you're here. Needed an alchemist crazy enough to experiment with this sort of thing."
    
    Exactly.
    
    "Makes sense. Tell you what, I'll hold onto this to start my study of it. If you can bring me, say, nine more vials of the stuff, I should be able to properly investigate, but this is a good start."
    
    Are you going to warn her of the origin and risks of this material?

    你从背包中取出一瓶魅魔乳汁，递给女巫。她漫不经心地接过，开始粗略检查其中的内容。

    没错。你需要了解它的完整效果，因为你[var0|已经知道这是一种变形物|相当确定这是什么变形物]。
    
    “这就解释了你为何会来。你需要一个疯狂到愿意拿这种东西做实验的炼金术士。”
    
    正是如此。
    
    “有道理。这样吧，我先留下这瓶，着手研究。如果你能再给我带来，比如说九瓶这种东西，我应该就能妥善调查清楚；不过这已经是个不错的开始。”
    
    你要提醒她这种材料的来源与风险吗？

    You draw the vial of succubus milk from your pack and extend it to the witch. She takes it nonchalantly and begins her cursory inspection of its contents. 
    
    "Hmmm... fluid, likely milk based on color and viscosity." Viviane pops the cork off and takes a quick waft of the air, giving a gentle nod after. "Yup, that's definitely where the vagina smell was coming from. I'm hesitant to even question what kind of milk smells like the female orgasm, but then, I'm guessing that's why you're here, huh?"
    
    Yeah. You need to know the extent of its effects since you're [var0|aware that it's a transformative|pretty sure it's some kind of transformative]. 
    
    "That does explain why you're here. Needed an alchemist crazy enough to experiment with this sort of thing."
    
    Exactly.
    
    "Makes sense. Tell you what, I'll hold onto this to start my study of it. If you can bring me, say, nine more vials of the stuff, I should be able to properly investigate, but this is a good start."
    
    Are you going to warn her of the origin and risks of this material?
    '

rows.original:
As she pockets the vial, you're compelled to give her the information you do have: that the vial was acquired from some of your demonic foes and that it's likely highly corruptive. She should be careful during her investigation.

        "Nareva's tits, it's a good thing you warned me! I was going to just drink the stuff. It's how I usually investigate anything I think might be transformative. Years and years of transformative magic from the items I used or crafted left me 'malleable' enough to just... do that."
        
        Whew, it really is a good thing you warned her. Don't want her getting corrupted, after all.
        
        "So, uhh, is there anything else you need?"

rows.original: Viv, have you been taste testing these? "I mean yeah. It's how I usually investigate anything I think might be transformative. Years and years of transformative magic from the items I used or crafted left me 'malleable' enough to just... do that. Why?" These are most likely corruptive. You got them from imps and demons, after all. She really should be safer. Viviane mouths emptily for a moment as her face contorts through a range of emotions as she processes this knowledge and its implications. "Ah. Yeah I definitely don't want to be drinking any more of this stuff, then. Right, well, I'll uh, test this batch in a safer way. Thanks!" Sure thing. Wouldn't want her getting corrupted. "Now, anything else you need?"

rows.original:
You're journeying through the forest [party.som||with [comp.name] |with your companions] when you hear a familiar rustling of leaves, with a related creaking sound following soon after. Before long, you're greeted by the sight of Viviane's walking house, the roots it uses as legs shambling along the ground towards you.

    The house finally clears the last trees between you and it and takes the opportunity to settle, providing the chance for its occupant to exit. Viviane throws the door open and waves you in with a look of terrified urgency, complete with bags under her eyes and hat not on quite right. [party.Yall] oblige the disheveled witch, entering her not-so-humble abode posthaste. She immediately guides [party.som||the two of |the three of ]you to the familiar seating room and takes a seat. 
    
    "Good, you've come. I... I finished the research," Viviane says as she drums her fingers along the arm of her seat.

你正在森林中穿行。 [party.som||与[comp.name]一起  |和你的朋友们一起]当你听到那熟悉的树叶沙沙声，紧接着便是那令人联想到老房子吱嘎作响的声音时，不久之后，你便看到了薇薇安的“移动房屋”——它用那些被当作“腿”使用的根系在地面缓缓地向你移动过来。

rows.original:
"Any chance you can make," you start, lowering your voice, "a mold for a wedding ring?"

    Ogrish wipes sweat from his brow. "Huh. Not my usual fare, but I can handle that for you. Pretty difficult to get the size right without having her here, though. How big is her hand?"
    
    It eventually comes down to scratching two markings into some clay, your best guess as to her finger diameter. You are, fortunately, pretty well-acquainted with it by now. As luck would have it, Brienne wanders closer right as you're showing Ogrish.
    
    "Hi," she says. "What are you [pc.mf
        |guys
        |two
    ] up to?"
    
    Your mind races to think of an excuse as she lays eyes on the item – before you realize that what she's seeing is two haphazardly scratched lines on the side of a clay pot. This means absolutely nothing to her. "Decorating."
    
    She arches an eyebrow. "Yeah, looks great. Way to go, [pc.name]."
    
    "Thanks. Can you give me your hand for a moment?" you say.
    
    She holds out her hand and you take it with both of yours, teasing her fingers apart while she looks on in puzzlement. You straighten out each of them one by one, lingering a little longer than usual on her ring finger. Brienne's none the wiser. "Are we doing something?"
    
    "Sure," you say. "It's a routine inspection. You pass."
    
    Brienne giggles. "Yay."
    
    You give Ogrish a glance. The orc nods in acknowledgement.
    
    "I guess we'd better go. Thanks, Ogrish," you say.
    
    "I'll get your stuff in a day," he says.
    
    "Ooh," Brienne says as you walk away. "Getting something?"
    
    You nod. "Something special. I'll show you some other time."
    
    You take Brienne to the bakery and get some food as penance for your harmless trick. All that's left is to wait a day and scrounge up some electrum – Ogrish said he'd do it for free given how easy the work is, but you'll pay him a couple hundred for the effort. All in all, you'll need[pc.bri3
        | nine thousand and two hundred electrum to cover the cost of the mold and three rings.
        | three thousand and two hundred electrum to cover the cost of the mold and the ring.
    ] That doesn't seem so bad when you're eating a fresh, warm pastry.
rows.translation:
“你有没有可能，”你压低声音开口道，“做一个结婚戒指的模具？”

    奥格里什擦了擦额头上的汗。“嗯。这不是我平常接的活儿，不过我可以帮你做。不过她本人不在，尺寸很难拿准。她的手有多大？”
    
    最后只能靠在一块黏土上划出两道记号，作为你对她手指直径的最大胆猜测。幸好，你如今对那个尺寸已经相当熟悉了。也真巧，就在你给奥格里什看的时候，布蕾妮恰好晃了过来。
    
    “嗨，”她说。“[pc.mf
        |你们这些家伙
        |你们两个
    ]在忙什么呢？”
    
    她看到那东西时，你脑子里飞快地转着找借口——然后你才意识到，她看到的只是黏土罐侧面两道随手划出的线。这对她来说毫无意义。“在装饰。”
    
    她挑了挑眉。“是啊，看着很棒。干得好，[pc.name]。”
    
    “谢谢。能把手借我一下吗？”你说。
    
    她伸出手，你用双手接住，把她的手指一根根捻开，她困惑地看着。你把每根手指都捋直，在她的无名指上比平时多停留了一会儿。布蕾妮完全没有察觉。“我们这是在做什么吗？”
    
    “当然，”你说。“这是例行检查。你通过了。”
    
    布蕾妮咯咯笑了。“好耶。”
    
    你看了奥格里什一眼。这个兽人点头会意。
    
    “我想我们该走了。谢谢你，奥格里什，”你说。
    
    “一天之内我就把你的东西做好，”他说。
    
    “哦，”你走开时布蕾妮说。“要拿什么东西吗？”
    
    你点点头。“一件特别的东西。改天给你看。”
    
    你带布蕾妮去了面包店，买了些吃的，作为对这次无害小把戏的补偿。剩下的就是等上一天，再凑出一笔琥珀金——奥格里什说这活儿很简单，他可以免费做，但你还是会付他几百枚作为酬劳。总而言之，你需要[pc.bri3
        | 九千二百枚琥珀金，用来支付模具和三枚戒指的费用。
        | 三千二百枚琥珀金，用来支付模具和戒指的费用。
    ]当你吃着新鲜温热的糕点时，这似乎也没那么糟。

rows.original: "Any luck on [pc.bri3 |those molds |that mold ]?" you say. The orc nods, producing a small pouch. "In here." "You're a lifesaver," you say. "Thanks, Ogrish." You leave him a couple hundred electrum for his services and head back down the road towards Ivris only to be ambushed by an eight and a half foot cowgirl. "Hi!" "Hey," you say, smiling up at her as she beams at you. "Everything good?" "I just ate at Garth's, so as far as I'm concerned everything's peachy," Brienne says. "What's that?" She points at the pouch. "It's a secret," you say. "Oooh, a secret," she says. "Do I get to see it later?" "Eventually," you say, giving her a wink. "Chat to Garth for a bit. I can't have the recipient of the gift spoiling herself before I have it ready." "Aw, fine," she says. Bending down, she gives you a kiss on the cheek before hopping away. "See you soon, lover!" You wave, continuing down the road until you enter Ivris' shop. "Hi, Ivris." "Hi, [pc.name]," the blind girl says, smiling at you. "Are you following up on the ring thing?" "Sure am," you say. "I have [pc.bri3 |some molds |a mold ] for you, if you want to get started." "Okay. Let me get everything ready," she says. "You have the electrum, right?" You jingle a coinpurse. "Perfect. Leave it all here and you can come back in an hour." You step outside, wondering what to do. The choice seems obvious enough. Walking back up the road, you enter the familiar scene of Garth's tavern [dayNight |during the day – some regulars scattered around, a few people in off the road, and your friends |during the evening – a few regulars keeping the old wolf company, and your friends ]. Brienne's posted up at the bar, telling Garth a story as he looks on in amusement. Walking up behind her, you give her a light spank and smile as she gasps, looking around. "Heard this one before." She laughs. "Well, yeah. You were there for it!" After a few minutes of chatting between the three of you, Brienne excuses herself to talk to Cait for a moment. Garth gives you a look. "Not many [pc.mf |women |people ] out there as devoted as she is," he says. You smile. "The ring's being made right now." The old wolfman nods in approval as he washes off a plate.
rows.translation: 有进展吗？ [pc.bri3 |那些模具 |那种模式 ]真是帮了大忙，”你说。 奥格里什点了点头，掏出一个小袋子：“就在这里。” “你真是救了我一命，”你说，“谢谢你，奥格里什兄弟。” 你给了他几百枚电银作为酬劳，然后继续沿着道路向艾薇莉丝方向前进，结果却遭到了一位身高八英尺半的牛仔女子的伏击。嗨！” “嘿，”你微笑着对她说，而她也正开心地望着你。“一切都好吗？” “我刚刚在加思的店里吃了饭，所以对我来说，一切都很好。”布蕾妮说。“那是什么？”她指了指那个小袋子。 这是个秘密，”你说。 “哦哦，真是个秘密嗯，”她说，“等会儿我能看看吗？” “当然可以，”你眨了眨眼回答，“先和加思聊一会儿吧。总不能让礼物的接收者在礼物准备好之前就迫不及待地拆开它吧。” “哦，好吧，”她说着弯下腰，在你的脸颊上亲了一下，然后蹦蹦跳跳地跑开了。“回头见，亲爱的！” 你挥了挥手，继续沿着路走去，最终来到了艾薇莉丝的商店。“嗨，艾薇莉丝。” “嗨， [pc.name]，那个戒指的事情，你还在跟进吗？”那位盲女微笑着对你说道。 “当然在跟进，”你回答道，“我已经[pc.bri3 |一些模具 |一个模板 ]对你来说，如果想马上开始的话，这个选择挺合适的。” “好的。让我把所有东西都准备好吧，”她说。“你应该有那种银币吧？”你晃了晃钱袋。“太好了。把所有东西都留在这里，一小时后你再回来就行了。” 你走出门外，不知道该做什么。这个选择似乎相当明显。你沿着原路走回去，重新来到了加思酒馆那熟悉的场景中。 [dayNight |白天时，一些常客会分散在各个地方，还有几个人会去一些不那么常规的地方，当然，也会有一些人和你的朋友们在一起。 |晚上时分，有几位常客陪着那位老友，还有你的朋友们也在场。 ]布蕾妮坐在酒吧里，给加斯讲着一个故事，加斯则在一旁饶有兴致地听着。 你走到她身后，轻轻拍了她一下，她吓了一跳，四处张望，然后笑着说：“这个故事我以前听过。” 她笑了起来：“是啊，你当时也在场啊！” 你们三个人聊了几分钟后，布蕾妮便借口要去和凯特说几句话。加斯看了你一眼。 “没多少人[pc.mf |女性玩家 |人们 ]像她那样全心投入的人，真是难得。”他说。 你微笑着回答：“那枚戒指正在制作中呢。” 那位老狼人一边洗着盘子，一边点头表示赞同。

You leave him a couple hundred electrum for his services and head back down the road towards Ivris only to be ambushed by an eight and a half foot cowgirl. "Hi!" "Hey," you say, smiling up at her as she beams at you. "Everything good?" "I just ate at Garth's, so as far as I'm concerned everything's peachy," Brienne says. "What's that?" She points at the pouch. "It's a secret," you say. "Oooh, a secret," she says. "Do I get to see it later?" "Eventually," you say, giving her a wink. "Chat to Garth for a bit. I can't have the recipient of the gift spoiling herself before I have it ready." "Aw, fine," she says. Bending down, she gives you a kiss on the cheek before hopping away. "See you soon, lover!" You wave, continuing down the road until you enter Ivris' shop. "Hi, Ivris." "Hi, [pc.name]," the blind girl says, smiling at you. "Are you following up on the ring thing?" "Sure am," you say. "I have [pc.bri3 |some molds |a mold ] for you, if you want to get started." "Okay. Let me get everything ready," she says. "You have the electrum, right?" You jingle a coinpurse. "Perfect. Leave it all here and you can come back in an hour." You step outside, wondering what to do. The choice seems obvious enough. Walking back up the road, you enter the familiar scene of Garth's tavern [dayNight |during the day – some regulars scattered around, a few people in off the road, and your friends |during the evening – a few regulars keeping the old wolf company, and your friends ]. Brienne's posted up at the bar, telling Garth a story as he looks on in amusement. Walking up behind her, you give her a light spank and smile as she gasps, looking around. "Heard this one before." She laughs. "Well, yeah. You were there for it!" After a few minutes of chatting between the three of you, Brienne excuses herself to talk to Cait for a moment. Garth gives you a look. "Not many [pc.mf |women |people ] out there as devoted as she is," he says. You smile. "The ring's being made right now." The old wolfman nods in approval as he washes off a plate.'

rows.original:
You slip out of the inn after chatting to Brienne and Cait for a bit, promising a hasty return. It's been a while now, time to check on Ivris. You enter the store to find the woman lounging behind the counter, looking up as you come in.

        "Back again," you say. "How'd it go?"
        
        "Great, actually," Ivris says. "I won't lie, I'm proud of how well [pc.bri3|they|it] turned out. Here you go."
        
        The elven girl hands over [pc.bri3
            |three lustrous golden rings, each a slightly different size. You glance at them in your palm before stowing them away somewhere safe – they're
            |a ring of lustrous gold. You glance at it in your palm before stowing it away somewhere safe – it's
        ] perfect.
        
        "Thanks, Ivris," you say. "You can keep the silver."
        
        "Oh, thanks! It's a pretty useful reagent. I was going to see if you wanted it for anything," she says. "Thanks for stopping by."
        
        You bid her farewell and step outside, thinking of what to do. You already know you'd like to propose to her at her old home, in Khor'minos. In the yard. In the evening, too, with the phosphorescence providing some light. You nod. That sounds perfect.

和布蕾妮与凯特聊了一会儿后，你悄悄地离开了酒馆，承诺会尽快回来。现在时间已经过去一段时间了，是时候去看看艾薇莉丝了。你走进商店，发现那位女士正懒洋洋地坐在柜台后面，看到你进来后，她抬起了头。

        “又回来了啊，”你说，“最近怎么样？”
        
        “其实挺好的，”艾薇莉丝回答道，“说实话，我为自己取得的成绩感到非常自豪。 [pc.bri3|他们|它]结果就是这样。给你。”
        
        那位精灵女孩将东西递了过来。 [pc.bri3
            |三枚光泽灿烂的金戒指，每枚的尺寸都略有不同。你将它们放在手掌中端详片刻，随后把它们藏到了一个安全的地方——它们确实非常珍贵。
            |一枚闪闪发光的金戒指。你将它握在手中端详片刻，随后便将其妥善藏了起来——它确实非常珍贵。
        ]太好了。”
        
        “谢谢，艾薇莉丝，”你说，“这些银子你留着吧。”
        
        “哦，太感谢了！这种炼金材料确实非常有用。我本来还想着看看你是否需要呢。”她说道，“谢谢你的轻型临。”
        
        你跟她道别后走出了门外，开始思考接下来该做什么。你已经决定要在她的故乡——科尔米诺斯，就在那个院子里，在傍晚时分，借着磷轻型带来的微光，向她求婚。这个主意听起来太完美了。
