rows.original: "Let's hang out in the yard for a bit," you say. "Sure!" Brienne says, taking your offered hand and smiling. "It's nice out there." "[cassia.fucked |Cass |Your mom ] and Rina work pretty hard on the garden," you note as you walk out with her, past the pretty flowers. "Yeah! It's a point of pride for mom, I think," she says. "Kind of like meditation, too." You stand out in the yard together, the ring held tightly in your free hand. No sense in dropping it now. "I'm really glad we came here together, you know," Brienne says quietly, squeezing your hand. "I don't think... I would have come back here on my own. More fool me. So thanks, [pc.name]. I dunno where I'd be without you." You look at her for a second, just taking in the sight of her gazing out over the blue-lit landscape with the buildings of Khor'minos in the distance. Gods, she is beautiful. You drop to one knee as Brienne turns her head to look at you, following along with a look of faint puzzlement. Bringing your other hand up, you unfurl your fist to reveal the golden ring contained within and hold it out. Brienne's face goes from confusion to realization to happiness before she bursts into tears on the spot. "Brienne, will you marry me?" you say. "Yes," she says, her lower lip quivering. "Gods, yes." You stand and the amazon cowgirl just about picks you off the ground in a hug, squeezing you tight and rubbing her face into your [pc.hasHair |hair |head ] in a display of clumsy affection. Laughing, you pull her close with one arm and scratch her fluffy ear with the other – guiding her into a warm, loving kiss. She's all over you, clutching at you like she never wants to let you go, and you suppose that's partially the point. You kiss her until her tears have run dry, comforting her in the evening light. "I've wanted this," Brienne murmurs. "I know," you say, rubbing her back. "Sorry I kept you waiting." She kisses you again, gentler this time, and pulls back. "I'm already looking forward to the ceremony... ooh! We'll have to talk about churches and stuff. And who to invite!" "Yeah, I'll drag all that out of you later," you say. Brienne giggles. "You're right. Let's enjoy the moment a little longer." You stay out in the yard together with Brienne for another few hours, sitting side by side on the ground with your fingers wound through hers. Your wife-to-be is as happy and chatty as ever, and when you finally head back indoors for the night it's in good cheer. You'll sleep well tonight. "Do you think we can fuck all night without waking up mom?" Brienne whispers. Maybe not that well...
rows.translation: “我们去院子里待一会儿吧。”你说道。 “好呀！”布蕾妮接过你伸出的手，微笑着说道。“外面很舒服。” “你[cassia.fucked |卡丝 |母亲 ]和莉娜非常用心地照料花园。”你牵着她走过美丽花丛时说道。 “是啊！我觉得母亲对此相当自豪。”她说。“而且，这也有点像冥想。” 你们一同站在院子里，另一只手紧紧握着戒指。可不能现在把它弄掉。 “我真的很高兴我们一起来到了这里。”布蕾妮轻声说道，握紧你的手。“我觉得……如果只有自己，我不会回到这里。是我太傻了。所以，谢谢你，[pc.name]。没有你，我真不知道自己会在哪里。” 你看了她片刻，只是静静欣赏她眺望蓝光笼罩的大地，而远方矗立着科尔米诺斯的建筑。诸神啊，她真美。 布蕾妮转头看你，带着淡淡的困惑顺着你的动作垂下视线；你单膝跪地，抬起另一只手，摊开拳头，露出掌中的金戒指，将它递到她面前。布蕾妮的神情从困惑变成恍然，再化作喜悦，随后当场泪如泉涌。 “布蕾妮，你愿意嫁给我吗？”你问道。 “愿意。”她的下唇微微颤抖。“诸神啊，我愿意。” 你刚站起来，这位亚马逊牛女便在拥抱中差点将你整个人举离地面；她紧紧搂着你，将脸埋进你的[pc.hasHair |头发 |头顶 ]，笨拙地表达爱意。你笑着用一只手将她拉近，另一只手挠着她毛茸茸的耳朵——引导她与你交换一个温暖而充满爱意的吻。她整个人都缠在你身上，牢牢抱住你，仿佛永远不愿放手；而你想，这也正是求婚的部分意义。你不断吻她，直到泪水流尽，在夜色下安慰着她。 “我一直都想要这一刻。”布蕾妮喃喃说道。 “我知道。”你抚摸着她的后背。“抱歉让你等了这么久。” 她再次吻你，这次温柔了许多，随后稍稍退开。“我已经开始期待婚礼了……哦！我们得谈谈教堂之类的事情。还有该邀请谁！” “是啊，等会儿我会把这些全都从你嘴里问出来。”你说道。 布蕾妮咯咯一笑。“你说得对。我们再享受一会儿这一刻吧。” 你和布蕾妮又在院子里待了几个小时，肩并肩坐在地上，手指与她十指相扣。你的准妻子仍像往常一样开心健谈；等你们终于在夜里回到室内时，两人都心情愉快。今晚你一定能睡得很好。 “你觉得我们能彻夜做爱，又不吵醒母亲吗？”布蕾妮低声问道。 或许也不会睡得那么好……

rows.original:
You awaken late in the morning next to your wife-to-be, her arm draped over you and her gentle snoozing in your ear. She's all cuddled up after your incredible effort last night, and you give her a quick kiss on the cheek as you extricate yourself from her grasp. She grumbles as you leave, flicking her ear, but is mollified when you give her another kiss.
        
        She awakens as you hop off the edge of the bed, rolling over to look at you.
        
        "Hey," you say, smiling at her. "Good morning, wife."
        
        She smiles. "Good morning, [pc.mf
            |husband
            |wife
        ]."
        
        You laugh. "Better get up if you want some breakfast. Then we can talk about the church stuff, if you want."
        
        Brienne nods. "Sounds good... oof." She stretches out for several seconds until she's shaking, then relaxes with a sigh. "I'll be a few minutes."
        
        You give her one more kiss on the cheek for good measure. "See you out in the lounge, then."
        
        You'll have to arrange details for the marriage by talking to Brienne[pc.bri3
            | – including finally revealing your master plan, should you go through with it
        ].
rows.translation:
第二天上午，你睡到很晚才醒来，身旁是即将成为你妻子的她，她的手臂搭在你身上，轻柔的鼾声在你耳边回荡。经过你昨晚那番惊人的努力，她已经紧紧依偎在你身边。当你从她的怀抱中挣脱出来时，你快速地在她的脸颊上吻了一下。你离开时，她嘟囔着甩了甩耳朵，但当你再给她一个吻时，她就被安抚下来了。
        
        当你从床边跳下来时，她醒了过来，翻了个身看着你。
        
        “嘿，”你微笑着对她说。“早上好，老婆。”
        
        她微笑着。“早上好，[pc.mf
            |丈夫
            |妻子
        ]。”
        
        你笑了起来。“如果你想吃早餐，最好赶紧起来。然后，如果你愿意的话，我们可以谈谈教堂的那些事。”
        
        布蕾妮点了点头。“听起来不错……哎哟。”她伸展了好一会儿，直到全身发抖，才叹了口气放松下来。“我几分钟就好。”
        
        你又在她的脸颊上亲了一下，算是保险。“那我们客厅见吧。”
        
        你得和布蕾妮谈谈，把婚礼的细节安排好[pc.bri3
            | ——包括最终揭露你的宏伟计划，如果你真的决定实施它的话
        ]。

rows.original:
[first BRIENNE_MAR_TM
        |"So, about Khor'minoan marriage ceremonies..." you say.

        "Ooh, go on," Brienne says, smiling. "What about them?"
        
        "What are they like?" you say. "Do they take place in a church?"
        
        Brienne nods. "Yup. You can be married in a church of any denomination, though most people get married in the Pantheon which covers all of the gods. That allows for some really huge, fancy ceremonies. Big public affair, a banquet, lots of drinking and eating, usually goes all day long after your vows." She smiles. "It's expected that the [pc.mf
            |bride and groom
            |couple
        ] slip away mid-event and come back later to join in the drinking and dancing, of course. Nobody wants to keep them trapped there talking to everyone, y'know? It's their event, they can do what they like."
        
        "Is there room for smaller ceremonies?" you say.
        
        "Yeah, there are smaller churches you can go to," she says. "If we want a small ceremony, we can go to one of those and just invite my family. No need for anything else."
        
        "What do you prefer?" you say.
        
        Brienne smiles. "I could go either way, really. I'd like to have our marriage be a big thing the whole city knows about — Brienne and [pc.name], united forever! But a smaller church would feel more intimate. How about you?"
rows.translation:
[first BRIENNE_MAR_TM
        |“所以，关于科尔米诺斯的婚礼仪式……”你说道。

        “哦，说下去，”布蕾妮微笑着说。“怎么了？”
        
        “那是什么样的？”你问。“会在教堂里举行吗？”
        
        布蕾妮点点头。“会呀。你可以在任何教派的教堂里结婚，不过大多数人会在万神殿结婚，那里涵盖了所有神祇。那样就能办出特别盛大、特别气派的仪式。大型公开场合、宴席、很多酒和食物，通常在宣誓之后会持续一整天。”她笑了笑。“当然，大家都默认[pc.mf
            |新娘和新郎
            |这对新人
        ]会在活动中途溜出去，之后再回来一起喝酒跳舞。没人想把他们困在那里跟所有人寒暄，你懂吧？这是他们的活动，他们想怎么做就怎么做。”
        
        “有没有空间办小一点的仪式？”你问。
        
        “有啊，也有小一些的教堂可以去，”她说。“如果我们想办小型仪式，就可以去那种地方，只邀请我的家人。别的都不需要。”
        
        “你更喜欢哪种？”你问。
        
        布蕾妮微笑起来。“其实我两种都可以。我希望我们的婚姻能成为全城都知道的大事——布蕾妮和[pc.name]，永远结合！不过小一点的教堂会感觉更亲密。你呢？”

That allows for some really huge, fancy ceremonies. Big public affair, a banquet, lots of drinking and eating, usually goes all day long after your vows." She smiles. "It's expected that the [pc.mf
            |bride and groom
            |couple
        ] slip away mid-event and come back later to join in the drinking and dancing, of course. Nobody wants to keep them trapped there talking to everyone, y'know? It's their event, they can do what they like."
        
        "Is there room for smaller ceremonies?" you say.
        
        "Yeah, there are smaller churches you can go to," she says. "If we want a small ceremony, we can go to one of those and just invite my family. No need for anything else."
        
        "What do you prefer?" you say.
        
        Brienne smiles. "I could go either way, really. I'd like to have our marriage be a big thing the whole city knows about — Brienne and [pc.name], united forever! But a smaller church would feel more intimate. How about you?"
        
        '

'
        |"So, about where we'll have the ceremony..." you say.

        "Oh, have you decided?" Brienne says, smiling. "I'm happy with whatever."
    ]'

            Is this your choice?
rows.translation:
你可能更倾向于举办一场规模较小、氛围更加亲密的婚礼，只让布蕾妮的家人参加。
    
            这就是你的选择吗？
rows.raw:
"
            You'd prefer a smaller, more intimate marriage ceremony with just the members of Brienne's family present.
    
            Is this your choice?"

rows.original:
"Let's go with the small ceremony," you say. "I like the idea of something more private, just between us."
    
                "Yeah, okay!" Brienne says. "Let's make some plans, then..."
                
                You hash out some ideas about where and when to have the ceremony. You're looking forward to the day already, but the tedium of arranging it all is a barrier — at least you'll be figuring it out with your wife-to-be. The two of you spend some time walking around the city, half sightseeing and half looking for a church to have the ceremony in.
                
                After you've stopped to have some food you happen upon a small, stout-looking lupine man wearing glasses, just closing up what looks to be a church.
                
                "Hello," you say. "Are you a minister here?"
                
                "That I am," he says. "Are you interested in the church's services?"
                
                "We were hoping to find a smaller, less ostentatious place than the Pantheon to get married," Brienne says. "Do you perform marriages?"
                
                The lupine nods. "I do. I should introduce myself. I'm Father Tanith, the minister of this church. My wife and I have been keeping it afloat for some decades, now."
                
                "I'm [pc.name], and this is my wife-to-be Brienne," you say, smiling as you put an arm around your amazonian girlfriend. She giggles, cheeks flushing a little red.
                
                "Pleased to meet the two of you," Father Tanith says. "You're welcome to be married here any time you wish. Though my wife will be annoyed if you make it right now."
                
                "Ha! We need to get some things together first," Brienne says, smiling down at the elderly lupine. "But we appreciate the availability."
                
                "It's the least I can do for a couple so obviously in love," he says. "Hopefully I'll be seeing you soon, then."
                
                You bid Father Tanith goodbye and watch him trundle away, presumably to his home and waiting wife.
                
                "What a nice old man," Brienne says. She looks at you. "Do you think we'll be like that when we're old?"
                
                "Ha, if we get the chance," you say. "Who's to say there won't be another adventure after this one?"
                
                "True... oh well," she says, leaning against you and interlocking her fingers with yours. "I'd be happy either way."
                
                "Yeah," you say, squeezing her hand. "Me too."
rows.translation:
“就办一场小型仪式吧。”你说道。“我喜欢更私密的感觉，只有我们两个人。”
    
                “嗯，好呀！”布蕾妮说道。“那我们就来制订计划吧……”
                
                你们仔细商讨了婚礼的时间与地点。你已经开始期待那一天，可安排这一切的烦琐工作却是一道障碍——至少，你会同自己的准妻子一起把事情安排妥当。你们在城里逛了一阵，一半是在观光，一半则是在寻找可以举行婚礼的教堂。
                
                你们停下来吃过一些东西，随后偶遇一位戴着眼镜、身材矮壮的狼族男人；他正准备关上一栋看起来像教堂的建筑。
                
                “你好。”你说道。“你是这里的牧师吗？”
                
                “正是。”他回答。“你们对本教堂的礼拜仪式感兴趣吗？”
                
                “我们想找个比万神殿更小、更朴素的地方举行婚礼。”布蕾妮说道。“你主持婚礼吗？”
                
                狼族男人点点头。“主持。我应该先自我介绍。我是塔尼思神父，这座教堂的牧师。几十年来，一直是我和妻子在维持这里的运作。”
                
                “我是[pc.name]，这位是我的准妻子布蕾妮。”你说着，微笑着伸手搂住自己的亚马逊女友。她咯咯一笑，双颊微微泛红。
                
                “很高兴认识二位。”塔尼思神父说道。“无论什么时候，只要你们愿意，都可以来这里结婚。不过，如果你们现在就要举行婚礼，我妻子大概会很不高兴。”
                
                “哈！我们得先准备一些东西。”布蕾妮低头望着年迈的狼族，微笑着说道。“不过，能随时来这里举行婚礼，我们非常感激。”
                
                “面对你们这样一对显然深爱彼此的伴侣，这是我至少应该做的。”他说。“那么，希望很快能再次见到你们。”
                
                你们向塔尼思神父告别，看着他缓步离开，大概是回家去见等待着他的妻子。
                
                “真是位和善的老人。”布蕾妮说道。她转头看你。“你觉得我们老了以后也会像他们那样吗？”
                
                “哈，前提是我们有那个机会。”你说道。“谁能断定这场冒险之后不会再有另一场呢？”
                
                “也是……好吧。”她说道，靠到你身上，将手指与你交扣。“无论如何，我都会很幸福。”
                
                “是啊。”你握紧她的手。“我也是。”

rows.translation: 你喜欢那种简单而私密的仪式，只有家人参加。
rows.raw: "You like the idea of a small, intimate ceremony. Just the family."

rows.original:
You'd prefer a larger ceremony, more akin to a giant all-day party where anyone can attend, drink, eat, and dance.

            Is this your choice?
rows.translation:
你更倾向于举办一场规模更大的仪式，让它更像是一场全天候的盛大派对，任何人都可以参加，尽情享用美食、饮酒，尽情跳舞。

            这就是你的选择吗？
rows.raw:
"
            You'd prefer a larger ceremony, more akin to a giant all-day party where anyone can attend, drink, eat, and dance.

            Is this your choice?"

rows.original: "Let's go with the big ceremony," you say, smiling. "Having a wedding party at the Pantheon seems like it'd be great." "Yeah, okay!" Brienne says. "Let's make some plans, then..." You hash out some ideas about where and when to have the ceremony. You're looking forward to the day already, but the tedium of arranging it all is a barrier – at least you'll be figuring it out with your wife-to-be. The two of you head to the Pantheon, looking for someone who can tell you about the marriage services. A gigantic building with room enough for worship of all seven of the gods, the Pantheon stands tall near the centre of the minotaur city. Each of the Seven has a dedicated shrine contained within, and helpfully enough there's a priest wandering through the area you catch the attention of. "Ah, hello," he says, smiling. "Visitors to the Pantheon?" "Hi there. I'm [pc.name] and this is my fiancee, Brienne," you say, indicating the eight foot six cowgirl following behind you. She waves. "I was wondering if we could talk to you about getting married here." "You want to have a Pantheon marriage? Wonderful!" the priest says, smiling wide as he sweeps an arm out as though to reveal the grounds. "It's a popular choice here, maybe more than ever in light of current events. Are either of you from Khor'minos?" He looks at Brienne. "You'll have to forgive me for asking." Brienne laughs. "It's a long story, but I am Minoan-born and bred. I grew up here." "I'm from elsewhere. We met after she left to adventure," you say. "And now we've ended up back where she started." "Ah, you do have the look of the well-traveled," the priest says. Brienne looks down at herself. "You could say that." The priest laughs. "I was referring to the worldly looks in your eyes rather than the state of your clothes – though, really, you're not that far off the current trends in the clothing market. Regardless, I'm glad you're back – the city welcomes you, and I'd be more than happy to officiate a wedding of a child of Khor'minos. My name is Tremisce, a minister here at the temple. Let us retire to a room that we might talk the details over." "Sure thing," you say. You decide to get married under Lumia's blessing – not that Brienne is particularly ardent about her worship, but it does run in her family, and that's what feels right to her. According to Tremisce, there's room to have a marriage ceremony in a week. Apparently their marriage schedule is so busy recently that you're lucky to even be able to have one within a month, so that's fortuitous timing. "I take it I'm not rushing you," Tremisce says. "No, not really," you say. "We've been together for a while now. It's something both of us have thought about." Brienne nods. "The sooner the better, as far as I'm concerned." Tremisce smiles. "Well, good. I'll start getting everything ready for your big day, then. Marriages at the Pantheon are a big public affair, though we make sure it's relatively respectful. Everyone appreciates a giant party given what's been going on, and nobody wants them to stop. The revellers are a chatty bunch but they know not to push boundaries. And, of course, it's expected that the couple slips away to have fun on their own. The party goes on without them." "Sounds like a festival," you say. Tremisce laughs. "That's a good way to put it, especially given it's happening daily now. A month-long festival celebrating joyous union is one of the better uses of the kingdom's money, I think." You and Brienne bid goodbye to the minister and head home, passing by some of the shrines on the way out. It's quite the place to be married, you think. Brienne leans against you and interlocks her fingers with yours, and you walk like that the rest of the way to her family's house.
rows.translation: 我们就办一场盛大的仪式吧，”你微笑着说，“在七神举行婚礼派对，肯定非常棒。” “嗯，好啊！”布蕾妮答应道，“那我们先制定一下计划吧……” 你们一起讨论了仪式的地点和时间安排。你已经迫不及待地期待着那一天的到来了，但筹备过程中种种繁琐的事情却成了阻碍——至少你还可以和你的未婚妻一起共同解决这些问题。你们俩一起来到了七神，希望能找到有人能告诉你们关于婚礼仪式的相关事宜。 这座巨大的建筑足以容纳对七位神明的祭祀活动，它矗立在弥诺陶洛斯城市的中心附近。其中每一位神明都有专门供奉他们的神龛，而且幸运的是，总会有一名祭司在周围走动，你会很容易就引起他们的注意。 啊，你好，”他微笑着说，“是来参观七神的吗？” “嗨，我是[pc.name]这位是我的未婚妻，布蕾妮，”你说道，同时指向跟在你身后的那位身高八英尺六英寸的牛仔女孩。她向大家点了点头。“我们想请教您，是否可以在这里举行婚礼。” “你们想在这里举行一场‘七神婚礼’吗？太棒了！”牧师笑着说，他伸开手臂，仿佛是在展示周围的景色。“在这里，这是大家非常喜欢的选择……考虑到当前的情况，这种选择可能比以往任何时候都更受欢迎。你们当中有谁来自科尔米诺斯吗？”他看着布蕾妮问道。请原谅我提出这样的请求。 布蕾妮笑了：“这是个漫长的故事，但我确实是在米诺斯出生的，并在这里长大的。” “我来自其他地方。她在开始冒险之旅后，我们才相识的，”你说道，“而现在，我们又回到了她最初出发的地方。” “啊，你确实有着一个游历过许多地方的人该有的样子，”牧师说道。 布蕾妮低头看了看自己。“这么说也没错。” 牧师笑了起来：“我指的是你眼中的那种世俗气息，而不是你的穿着——不过说实话，你的穿着确实与当前时尚潮流相差不远。无论如何，我很高兴你回来了——这座城市欢迎你，而且我非常乐意为一位来自科尔米诺斯的孩子的婚礼主持仪式。我叫特雷米塞，是这座寺庙的祭司。让我们去一个私密的房间，详细讨论一下相关事宜吧。" 当然可以，”你说道。 于是你决定在卢米娅的祝福下结婚——虽然布蕾妮对她的崇拜并不特别热衷，但确实这种传统在她的家族中很常见，对她来说，这才是正确的选择。据Tremisce说，一周后举行婚礼也是完全可行的。显然，他们最近的婚礼安排非常紧张，能够在一个月内举行婚礼就已经算是非常幸运了，所以这个时间安排真是恰到好处。 我想我并没有催你吧，”特雷米斯说。 “没有，其实并没有，”你回答道，“我们在一起已经有一段时间了，这个事情我们俩都考虑过。” 布蕾妮点了点头：“在我看来，越快越好。 特雷米塞微笑着说道：“嗯，很好。那我就开始为你的大喜之日做准备了。在七神举行婚礼本来就是一件盛大的公开活动，不过我们会确保整个过程保持一定的庄重氛围。考虑到最近发生的一些事情，大家都很期待能举办一场盛大的派对，而且也没人希望这种庆祝活动停止。那些参加派对的人虽然爱闲聊，但他们也知道不能越界。当然，人们也期待新婚夫妇能够趁大家不注意的时候偷偷溜出去享受属于他们自己的欢乐时光。即使他们不在场，派对也会继续进行下去。 听起来就像一场节日啊，”你说。 特雷米塞笑了：“这么说确实很贴切，尤其是现在这种活动每天都在进行的话。我认为，举办一场持续一个月、用来庆祝美好结合的节日，确实是合理利用王国资金的好办法。 你和布蕾妮向那位牧师道别后便启程回家，途中经过了几座神龛。你心想，这里确实是个非常适合结婚的地方。布蕾妮靠在你的身上，她的手指与你的手指紧紧相握，就这样你们一起走完了剩下的路程，来到了她家的所在地。

rows.original: A big ceremony everyone can come to sounds fun.
rows.translation: 一场大家都能参加的盛大仪式听起来一定很有趣。
rows.raw: "A big ceremony everyone can come to sounds fun."

rows.original: "What if we had a big ceremony... with you, your sister, and your mom?" you say. Brienne gasps, eyes widening. "Oh my god! That's such a good idea! You could marry all three of us at once...!" "I thought you might like that," you say. "Ooohhh, maaannnnn," she mutters, ears flicking up and down and tail swishing side to side as she thinks hard. "That's like, perfect... I can't believe I didn't think of it!" Brienne looks up, grinning. "You are so smart!" "I try," you say modestly, catching Brienne as she practically leaps into your arms. The cowgirl peppers you with kisses, brushing her ears against your cheeks and smiling as she hums in happiness. "Mmmm, I can already imagine it," she says dreamily. "You making us the three happiest women on the planet, having all of us at your beck and call. I'm so excited!" "We'll have to talk about it with the other two first," you say, reaching up to rub her ears. Brienne closes her eyes and holds her head steady to be lavished with attention, a long, satisfied sigh on her lips. "You know, make sure they're okay with it." "Hmmhh... I think they will be," Brienne purrs. "They're already head over hooves for you." "Hmm," you say, smiling. "Pleeeeaaaase do it for me," Brienne pleads, opening her eyes to beg as cutely as she can. "I'll never ask you for anything else, I promise! This'd be like my biggest dream ever!"
rows.translation: “要是我们能举办一场盛大的仪式……有你、你姐姐还有你妈妈一起参加，怎么样？”你说道。 布蕾妮倒吸一口凉气，眼睛瞪得大大的。“天啊！这真是 太 棒的主意了！你可以同时把我们三个都娶了……！” “我想你可能会喜欢这个主意，”你说道。 “哦哦哦，天——哪——”她喃喃道，耳朵上下摆动，尾巴也左右摇晃，似乎正在认真思考。“那简直，完美……我真不敢相信我居然没想到这个！”布蕾妮抬起头，笑着说道。“你真是太聪明了！” “我只是尽力而已，”你谦虚地说，同时接住了几乎整个人扑进你怀里的布蕾妮。 这位女牛仔在你脸上一连串地亲吻，用耳朵蹭着你的脸颊，开心地哼着，微笑着。 “嗯……我都能想象到那种情景了，”她梦幻般地说道。“你让我们成为这个星球上最幸福的三位女性，让我们全都听候你的差遣。我真的太兴奋了！” “不过我们得先和另外两位商量一下，”你一边说，一边伸手揉了揉她的耳朵。布蕾妮闭上眼睛，稳稳地抬起头，任由你尽情宠爱，唇间逸出一声漫长而满足的叹息。“你知道的，得确认她们也愿意才行。” “嗯……我想她们会的，”布蕾妮轻声说道。“她们早就为你倾倒得四蹄朝天了。” “嗯，”你微笑着说。 “求——求你了，就为我这么做吧，”布蕾妮睁开眼睛，用她能摆出的最可爱的样子恳求道。“我以后再也不会向你提任何要求了，我保证！这简直是我这辈子最大的梦想了！”
rows.raw: ' "What if we had a big ceremony... with you, your sister, and your mom?" you say. Brienne gasps, eyes widening. "Oh my god! That's such a good idea! You could marry all three of us at once...!" "I thought you might like that," you say. "Ooohhh, maaannnnn," she mutters, ears flicking up and down and tail swishing side to side as she thinks hard. "That's like, perfect... I can't believe I didn't think of it!" Brienne looks up, grinning. "You are so smart!" "I try," you say modestly, catching Brienne as she practically leaps into your arms. The cowgirl peppers you with kisses, brushing her ears against your cheeks and smiling as she hums in happiness. "Mmmm, I can already imagine it," she says dreamily. "You making us the three happiest women on the planet, having all of us at your beck and call. I'm so excited!" "We'll have to talk about it with the other two first," you say, reaching up to rub her ears. Brienne closes her eyes and holds her head steady to be lavished with attention, a long, satisfied sigh on her lips. "You know, make sure they're okay with it." "Hmmhh... I think they will be," Brienne purrs. "They're already head over hooves for you." "Hmm," you say, smiling. "Pleeeeaaaase do it for me," Brienne pleads, opening her eyes to beg as cutely as she can. "I'll never ask you for anything else, I promise! This'd be like my biggest dream ever!"'

rows.original: "Alright," you say, and Brienne cheers, nuzzling into you as hard as she can. "Thank you so much, [pc.name]!" she squeals. "Oh my gosh, I love yooouuuu!" "Love you too, babe," you say. "God. I can't wait," Brienne murmurs, her eyes practically glowing with eagerness. "You could put all of us on leashes... make me and Rina be your housemaids while you fuck our mom... you could do anything you want to us. Nnfh!" [rina.isDom |"More likely that Rina has us on leashes," you remind her. "True," she admits. "But she can play nice if you ask." |"Straight into the fantasies, huh?" you say. "Of course," she says, grinning. "This is a dream coming true for me, here." ] You hash out some ideas about where and when to have the ceremony. You're looking forward to the day already, but the tedium of arranging it all is a barrier – at least you'll be figuring it out with one of your wives-to-be. The two of you head to the Pantheon together, looking for someone who can tell you about the marriage services. A gigantic building with room enough for worship of all seven of the gods, the Pantheon stands tall near the centre of the minotaur city. Each of the Seven has a dedicated shrine contained within, and helpfully enough there's a priest wandering through the area you catch the attention of. "Ah, hello," he says, smiling. "Visitors to the Pantheon?" "Hi there. I'm [pc.name] and this is my fiancee, Brienne," you say, indicating the eight foot six cowgirl following behind you. She waves. "I was wondering if we could talk to you about getting married here." "You want to have a Pantheon marriage? Wonderful!" the priest says, smiling wide as he sweeps an arm out as though to reveal the grounds. "It's a popular choice here, maybe more than ever in light of current events. Are either of you from Khor'minos?" He looks at Brienne. "You'll have to forgive me for asking." Brienne laughs. "It's a long story, but I am Minoan-born and bred. I grew up here." "I'm from elsewhere. We met after she left to adventure," you say. "And now we've ended up back where she started." "Ah, you do have the look of the well-traveled," the priest says. Brienne looks down at herself. "You could say that." The priest laughs. "I was referring to the worldly looks in your eyes rather than the state of your clothes – though, really, you're not that far off the current trends in the clothing market. Regardless, I'm glad you're back – the city welcomes you, and I'd be more than happy to officiate a wedding of a child of Khor'minos. My name is Tremisce, a minister here at the temple. Let us retire to a room that we might talk the details over." "Sure thing," you say. "This might be complicated." You sit down and get to talking with Tremisce – a polygamous marriage ceremony isn't that unusual, but the family aspect catches him off-guard for a moment. He laughs. "I suspect you're going to kick off a fresh wave of Minoan adventurers after they see this, [pc.name]," he says. "I wonder if this'll spark a new trend among the nobles..." "Surely not," you chuckle. "Oh, you'd be surprised," Tremisce says, smirking. "Though I don't think they'll be quite as sincere about it as you are. Now, then. Down to details." You decide you'll get married under Lumia's blessing – not that Brienne and her family are particularly ardent about worship, but it does run in the family, and that's what feels right to Brienne. According to Tremisce, there's room to have a marriage ceremony in a week. Apparently their marriage schedule is so busy recently that you're lucky to even be able to have one within a month, so that's fortuitous timing. "I take it I'm not rushing you," Tremisce says. "No, not really," you say. "We've all been together for a while now, and besides... the life of an adventurer doesn't exactly allow for holding off and waiting." Brienne nods. "The sooner the better, as far as I'm concerned." Tremisce smiles. "Well, good. I'll start getting everything ready for your big day, then. Marriages at the Pantheon are a big public affair, though we make sure it's relatively respectful. Everyone appreciates a giant party given what's been going on, and nobody wants them to stop. The revellers are a chatty bunch but they know not to push boundaries. And, of course, it's expected that the couple – or more, in this case – slips away to have fun on their own. The party goes on without them." "Sounds like a festival," you say. Tremisce laughs. "That's a good way to put it, especially given it's happening daily now. A month-long festival celebrating joyous union is one of the better uses of the kingdom's money, I think." You and Brienne bid goodbye to the minister and head home, passing by some of the shrines on the way out. It's quite the place to be married, you think. Brienne leans against you and interlocks her fingers with yours, and you walk like that the rest of the way to her family's house.
rows.translation: 好吧，”你说道，布蕾妮高兴地欢呼起来，紧紧地依偎在你身边。 “真的太感谢你了[pc.name]啊！”她尖叫道，“天啊，我太爱你了！！” “我也爱你，宝贝。”你说道。 “天啊，我等不及了……”布蕾妮喃喃道，她的眼睛里充满了渴望，“你可以把我们所有人都拴在绳子上……让我和瑞娜成为你的女仆，而你则和我们的妈妈做爱……你可以对我们为所欲为……真的，什么都行！ [rina.isDom |更有可能的是，莉娜已经我们她需要被牵着才行，”你提醒她。 “确实，”她承认道，“但如果你请求她，她也是会配合的。 |直接进入了幻想世界，是吧？”你说。 “当然了，”她笑着说，“对我来说，这里简直就是梦想成真的地方。 ] 你们一起讨论了举行仪式的地点和时间。你们已经非常期待那一天的到来了，但安排各种细节的繁琐过程却成为了一个障碍——至少，你们可以和未来的妻子们一起共同解决这些问题。你们两个一起前往七神，寻找能够向你们介绍婚礼相关事宜的人。 七神是一座巨大的建筑，其规模足以容纳对七位神明的祭祀活动，它矗立在弥诺陶洛斯城市的中心地带。七神殿中的每一座都设有专门供奉这些神明的神龛，而且幸运的是，你会遇到一位在附近游荡的祭司，他会主动与你搭话。 “啊，您好，”他微笑着说道，“是来参观七神的吗？嗨，我是[pc.name]这位是我的未婚妻，布蕾妮，”你说道，同时指向跟在你身后的那位身高八英尺六英寸的牛仔女孩。她向大家点了点头。“我们想请问您，是否可以在这里举行婚礼。” “你们想在这里举行一场‘七神婚礼’吗？太棒了！”牧师笑着说，他伸开手臂，仿佛是在展示周围的景色。“在这里，这是大家非常喜欢的选择；考虑到当前的情况，这种选择可能比以往任何时候都更受欢迎。你们当中有谁来自科尔米诺斯吗？”他看着布蕾妮问道。请原谅我提出这样的请求。 布蕾妮笑了：“这是个漫长的故事，但我确实是在米诺斯出生的，并在这里长大的。” “我来自其他地方。她在踏上冒险之旅后，我们才相遇的，”你说道，“而现在，我们又回到了她最初出发的地方。” “啊，你确实有着一个饱经风霜的人该有的样子，”牧师说道。 布蕾妮低头看了看自己。“这么说也没错。” 牧师笑了起来：“我指的是你眼中的那种世俗气息，而不是你的穿着——不过说实话，你的穿着确实与当前时尚潮流相差不远。无论如何，我很高兴你回来了——这座城市欢迎你，而且我非常乐意为一位来自科尔米诺斯的孩子的婚礼主持仪式。我叫特雷米塞，是这座寺庙的祭司。让我们去一个私密的房间，详细讨论一下相关事宜吧。" 当然可以，”你说，“不过这事儿可能会有点复杂。” 你坐下来，开始与特雷米塞交谈——多配偶婚姻仪式其实并不罕见，但涉及到家庭方面的内容时，他还是有些措手不及。他笑了笑。 我猜，当米诺斯地区的冒险者们看到这个之后，一定会掀起一股新的冒险热潮。 [pc.name]，我想知道，这会不会在贵族们中引发一种新的潮流……”他说。 “肯定不会吧，”你笑着说。 “哦，你可能会大吃一惊的，”特雷米塞 smirk着说道，“不过我觉得他们不会像你这样真心实意地去做这件事。那么，现在该讨论细节了。” 你决定在卢米娅的祝福下结婚——虽然布里恩和她的家人并不是特别热衷于宗教仪式，但确实这种传统在他们的家族中代代相传，对布蕾妮来说，这也正是她认为正确的做法。据特雷米塞所说，一周后就可以举行婚礼仪式了。显然，他们最近的婚礼安排非常紧张，能够在一个月内举行婚礼就已经算是非常幸运了，所以这个时间安排真是再合适不过了。 我想我并没有催你吧，”特雷米斯说。 “不，并没有，”你回答道，“我们大家已经在一起一段时间了，而且……冒险者的生活本身就不允许我们拖延或等待。” 布蕾妮点了点头：“在我看来，越快越好。 特雷米塞微笑着说道：“嗯，很好。那我就开始为你的大喜之日做各种准备了。在七神举行婚礼本来就是一件盛大的公开活动，不过我们会确保整个过程保持一定的庄重氛围。考虑到最近发生的一些事情，大家都很期待能举办一场盛大的派对，而且也没人希望这种庆祝活动停止。那些参加派对的人虽然爱闲聊，但他们也知道不能越界。当然，人们也期待新婚夫妇——或者在这个情况下，是几对新人——能够偷偷溜走，独自享受属于他们的欢乐时光。即使他们不在场，派对也会继续进行下去。 听起来就像一场节日啊，”你说。 特雷米塞笑了：“这么说确实很贴切，尤其是现在这种活动每天都在进行的话。我认为，举办一场持续一个月、用来庆祝美好姻缘的节日，绝对是合理利用王国资金的好办法。 你和布蕾妮向那位牧师道别后便启程回家，途中还经过了几座神殿。你心想，这里确实是个非常适合举行婚礼的地方。布蕾妮靠在你的身上，她的手指与你的手指紧紧相握，就这样你们一起走完了剩下的路程，来到了她家的所在地。

rows.original: "Come out to the garden with me?" you say. Cassia smiles. "Okay." You step out into Cassia's yard, looking over the faintly blue-lit landscape of the village. It's nice out here – the garden is blooming, as ever, thanks to Cassia's efforts in maintaining it and Rina's help. You take her hand and gently squeeze it. "I love you a lot, you know," you say. You feel her squeeze back. "I know. I love you too, [pc.name]," Cassia murmurs. "So much it worries me." You pause. "That's actually what I wanted to talk about." Turning to Cassia, you see her eyes are brimming with tears. "Are you not coming back?" "I am," you assure her, pulling the cow-woman into a hug and rubbing her back. "I'll definitely come back, Cass. But it's true that what I do is very dangerous." "You're always so cavalier, I... I know it's a little bit of fantasy, what we do," she says softly, wrapping her arms around you. "But it's nice to shut out the world sometimes." "It is," you say. "That's part of why I love it here. This is my home away from home.[cassia.anyKids | But now that we have kids, I have to take this seriously, Cass. I love you, and I love our beautiful babies. |[cassia.pregStage 1 | But now that we're going to have kids, I have to take this seriously, Cass. I love you, and I'll love our children. | But ] ] I don't know where my adventures will take me. Ideally, right back into your open arms, but I can't be sure. And the thought of leaving you behind without having acknowledged that you and your daughters really matter to me, that's what hurts me the most." You look Cassia in the eye. "I don't want any of us to have... lingering regrets." She nods slowly. "So... what do you want to do...?" You let her go and reach for what you've been saving. Sinking down to one knee, you look up at the beautiful woman that's brought you so much joy, producing the golden ring. "Cassia. Will you marry me?" you ask. The tears that Cassia was holding back begin to spill down her cheeks. She bites back a lip quiver and nods. "Yes. I will..." She starts to cry in earnest as you rise to your [pc.hasToes|feet|hooves] and hug her, getting back the fiercest embrace the cowgirl can give as she sobs into your [pc.isHeight 77|chest|shoulder] and you run your fingers through her hair, stroking her back. "It'll be okay," you say. "We'll get married, I'll beat back the demons, and I'll come back [cassia.anyKids |so we can raise our kids and live happily ever after. |[cassia.pregStage 1 |in time to look after our kids so we can live happily ever after. |so we can live happily ever after. ] ]" "You promise?" Cassia mumbles. "I promise," you say, squeezing her tight. She slowly recovers, closing her eyes as you brush the tears away. "As long as you promise I won't lose you, [pc.name]." You smile at her as she opens her eyes. "I'll be here for you." She smiles back. "I'll hold you to that." You help her clean up and keep her company as she takes a nap, cuddling up against you in a warm, soft embrace. If this is what the rest of your life will be like, it's hard to think of any complaints. You look at the sleeping cowgirl, chest rising and falling with slow breaths. You won't leave her with any lingering regrets.
rows.translation: 陪我去花园吧？”你说道。 卡茜娅微笑着回答：“好啊。” 你们一起走出了卡茜娅的院子，望着村庄里那被淡淡蓝光笼罩的景色。外面的空气真好——花园里开满了花，这都要归功于卡茜娅的精心照料以及莉娜的帮助。你握住了她的手，轻轻捏了捏。 “你知道的，我非常爱你。”你说道。 你感觉到她也回握了一下你的手。“我知道。我也爱你。 [pc.name]，卡茜娅轻声说道，‘这个问题让我非常担心。’” 你停顿了一下，然后说道：“其实，这正是我想谈的事情。” 你转向卡茜娅，看到她的眼里噙满了泪水。“你不会不回来了吧？” “我一定会回来的，”你安慰她，将这位牛仔姑娘搂进怀里，轻轻拍着她的背。我一定会回来的，卡丝。但说实话，我做的事情确实非常危险。” “你总是这么满不在乎，我……我知道我们正在做的事情有点像幻想，”她轻声说道，然后搂住了你。不过，有时候能够远离尘世，确实是一件很惬意的事情。” “确实如此，”你说道，“这也是我之所以喜欢这里的原因之一。这里对我来说，就像是第二个家一样。[cassia.anyKids | 但现在我们有了孩子，我必须认真对待这件事了，卡丝。我爱你，也爱我们那些可爱的宝宝们。 |[cassia.pregStage 1 | 但现在我们打算要孩子了，所以我必须认真对待这件事，卡丝。我爱你，也会爱我们的孩子。 | 但是 ] ]我不知道我的冒险会将我带到哪里。理想情况下，应该是回到你的怀抱中，但我不能确定。而一想到要在没有向你表达你和你的女儿们对我来说真的非常重要这一事实的情况下离开你，我就觉得无比痛苦。你要直视卡茜娅的眼睛。”“我不想我们中的任何人留下……任何遗憾。” 她缓缓点了点头。“那么……你打算怎么做……？” 你松开她的手，取出了自己一直保存着的那个东西。你单膝跪地，抬头看着这位给自己带来无数欢乐的美丽女子，然后将那枚金戒指拿了出来。 卡茜娅，你愿意嫁给我吗？”你问道。 卡茜娅强忍着的泪水终于开始从脸颊上滑落。她咬住嘴唇，点了点头：“愿意……我愿意。” 当你用[pc.hasToes|脚|蹄子]站起身并抱住她时，她终于彻底哭了出来，让她在你怀里抽泣时，能够给你最热烈、最深情的拥抱。 [pc.isHeight 77|箱子|肩膀]你用手指轻轻梳理她的头发，轻抚着她的后背。 “一切都会好起来的，”你说，“我们会结婚的，我会战胜那些困难，然后一定会回到你身边。 [cassia.anyKids |这样我们就能抚养孩子，过上幸福的生活。 |[cassia.pregStage 1 |这样我们就能有时间照顾孩子，从而过上幸福的生活。 |这样我们就能幸福地生活在一起了。 ] ]你真的承诺吗？”卡茜娅低声问道。 “我承诺，”你紧紧握住她的手说道。 她渐渐平静下来，闭上眼睛，而你则轻轻拭去她脸上的泪水。“只要你承诺我不会再失去你[pc.name]当她睁开眼睛时，你对她笑了笑：“我会一直在你身边的。” 她也笑了：“那我可要你说到做到哦。” 你帮她收拾干净，然后在她小睡的时候陪在她身边，她紧紧地依偎在你怀里，温暖而舒适。如果余生的每一天都能这样度过，那就真的没有什么可抱怨的了。你看着那位正在熟睡的牛仔姑娘，她的胸膛随着缓慢的呼吸而起伏着……你不会让她留下任何挥之不去的遗憾。
rows.raw: ' "Come out to the garden with me?" you say. Cassia smiles. "Okay." You step out into Cassia's yard, looking over the faintly blue-lit landscape of the village. It's nice out here – the garden is blooming, as ever, thanks to Cassia's efforts in maintaining it and Rina's help. You take her hand and gently squeeze it. "I love you a lot, you know," you say. You feel her squeeze back. "I know. I love you too, [pc.name]," Cassia murmurs. "So much it worries me." You pause. "That's actually what I wanted to talk about." Turning to Cassia, you see her eyes are brimming with tears. "Are you not coming back?" "I am," you assure her, pulling the cow-woman into a hug and rubbing her back. "I'll definitely come back, Cass. But it's true that what I do is very dangerous." "You're always so cavalier, I... I know it's a little bit of fantasy, what we do," she says softly, wrapping her arms around you. "But it's nice to shut out the world sometimes." "It is," you say. "That's part of why I love it here. This is my home away from home.[cassia.anyKids | But now that we have kids, I have to take this seriously, Cass. I love you, and I love our beautiful babies. |[cassia.pregStage 1 | But now that we're going to have kids, I have to take this seriously, Cass. I love you, and I'll love our children. | But ] ] I don't know where my adventures will take me. Ideally, right back into your open arms, but I can't be sure. And the thought of leaving you behind without having acknowledged that you and your daughters really matter to me, that's what hurts me the most." You look Cassia in the eye. "I don't want any of us to have... lingering regrets." She nods slowly. "So... what do you want to do...?" You let her go and reach for what you've been saving. Sinking down to one knee, you look up at the beautiful woman that's brought you so much joy, producing the golden ring. "Cassia. Will you marry me?" you ask. The tears that Cassia was holding back begin to spill down her cheeks. She bites back a lip quiver and nods. "Yes. I will..." She starts to cry in earnest as you rise to your [pc.hasToes|feet|hooves] and hug her, getting back the fiercest embrace the cowgirl can give as she sobs into your [pc.isHeight 77|chest|shoulder] and you run your fingers through her hair, stroking her back. "It'll be okay," you say. "We'll get married, I'll beat back the demons, and I'll come back [cassia.anyKids |so we can raise our kids and live happily ever after. |[cassia.pregStage 1 |in time to look after our kids so we can live happily ever after. |so we can live happily ever after. ] ]" "You promise?" Cassia mumbles. "I promise," you say, squeezing her tight. She slowly recovers, closing her eyes as you brush the tears away. "As long as you promise I won't lose you, [pc.name]." You smile at her as she opens her eyes. "I'll be here for you." She smiles back. "I'll hold you to that." You help her clean up and keep her company as she takes a nap, cuddling up against you in a warm, soft embrace. If this is what the rest of your life will be like, it's hard to think of any complaints. You look at the sleeping cowgirl, chest rising and falling with slow breaths. You won't leave her with any lingering regrets. '

rows.original: "Can we talk in the garden?" you say. "Of course," Rina says, taking your hand and squeezing it with a smile. You lead her outside and into the garden, stepping into the garden she's taken care of for years and looking over the flowers. "I guess mom was right," Rina says. "It does pay off to care about something for so long." You smile. "It does take a while, but you end up appreciating it." You lean forward and take one of the long-stalked white flowers, plucking it out of the bush and placing it behind Rina's ear. She giggles. "Do I look pretty?" "So pretty," you say, rubbing her ear a bit. "Listen, Rina... I've really enjoyed all the time I've spent with you." [rina.hasKids |Rina smiles sadly. "Are you leaving?" "No," you say, squeezing her hand. "But we have our children now, [rina.pregStage 1 |and you're pregnant again. You all mean so much to me. |and you all mean a lot to me. ] I owe it to you to tell you that what I'm doing is dangerous, Rina." She nods, casting her eyes downwards. "You are an adventurer, after all." "I promise I won't do to you what your father did to your mother," you say, pulling her in. "It won't come to that. But more than that... I want you to know how much I appreciate and love you now. I don't want to leave this until later." |[rina.pregStage 1 |Rina's face sinks. "Are you going to leave?" "No," you say, squeezing her hand. "But you're pregnant now, and you mean so much to me. I owe it to you to tell you that what I'm doing is dangerous, Rina." She nods, casting her eyes downwards. "I know. You're an adventurer, after all." "I promise I won't do to you what your father did to your mother," you say, pulling her in. "It won't come to that. But more than that... I want you to know how much I appreciate and love you now. I don't want to leave this until later." |"Are you leaving?" Rina says, anxious. "I mean, I'll be sad, but you'll come back, right?" You squeeze her hand. "I have to fight, Rina. I promise I won't leave you, but you're important enough to me that I need you to know that what I do is dangerous." Her face sinks. "I mean... I know you're an adventurer..." You pull her into a quick hug, squeezing the little tomboy cowgirl tightly. "I promise I won't do to you what your father did to your mother. It won't come to that. But more than that... I want you to know how much I appreciate and love you now. I don't want to leave this until later." ] ] You step back and reach down for what you've been hiding, sinking down to one knee as you produce the golden ring you had made and hold it out. "Rina, will you marry me?" Rina's mouth falls open in shock as she gasps, a hand rising to her face in surprise. You can tell this wasn't what she expected, but as you smile up at her you can see her working it all out for herself. She nods, unable to summon words, and tears begin to gather in her eyes as you rise to hug her. Throwing her arms around you, Rina lays her head against you and cries in both happiness and sadness. "It'll all be okay," you murmur to her. "I'll come back to you, I promise." "I know," she manages. "I know you will." You brush away Rina's tears and kiss her, embracing her wholeheartedly in the wake of all the emotion. After helping her clean up in the shower, she decides on a nap in bed – you can hardly blame her. You pull the blankets up and give her a good night kiss, sitting down next to her. "I love you," Rina mumbles, reaching out for your hand. "I love you too," you whisper back. She falls asleep with her hand held in your own, breathing slowly while you watch over her. You nod to yourself absentmindedly. This is worth protecting.

rows.original: The day is finally here. [flags.BRIENNE_MAR 8 9 10 |Cassia and Rina take Brienne to the church, in accordance with the ritual of the bride and groom not meeting prior to the event itself – though with the mild exception of her giving you a quick kiss on the cheek before she hurries away. You head there yourself not long after, sitting idly in one of the central hall's adjoining rooms in Father Tanith's church. Your thoughts drift to all of the good times you've spent with Brienne, from the start of your adventure until now. In Khor'minos, the bride is the one who stands at the altar, and as a result it's your job to hurry up and wait. Funnily enough, you find you're not nervous at all. All that remains is a desire to see your bride-to-be, and when a soft knock sounds at the door you rise from your chair with anticipation. [var0] You're stunned into silence by what you see when you enter the ceremony hall. Your gorgeous bride is wearing the most amazing white dress you've ever seen, the amazonian cowgirl almost divine in her radiant beauty, and when she turns and smiles at you – beaming with pure happiness with her long golden locks flowing behind her – you fall in love all over again. She's surrounded by impossible scenery, standing amidst a dark, grassy field speckled with fluorescent blue mushrooms with purple flowers hanging overhead, suspended from a tree with a twisted trunk and long, sprawling branches. Magic leylines criss-cross the rolling hills in the distance, and the purple night sky is lit bright by what you can only surmise are brilliant stars. She's holding a bouquet of pretty flowers, glowing an almost metallic blue. You've never seen anything like it. Feeling almost like you're in a dream, you approach the altar. Tanith gives you a nod of acknowledgement, your gaze torn between the little lupine priest and your wonderful bride for a moment. "What is this?" you whisper to him. Tanith smiles. "A bit of magic for our young couple. A return to nativity, if you will. Are you ready for your vows?" You nod, and so does Brienne. You turn to face each other, and you can see she's already trying not to break into tears of joy as she puts the flowers atop Tanith's pedestal. You smile up at her, taking her hands in your own and squeezing her palms in a gesture of comfort. "Brienne." Tanith starts. "Do you swear to accompany [pc.name] on your journey through life, to protect and support [pc.himHer] in [pc.hisHer] endeavors, and to be at [pc.hisHer] side as [pc.hisHer] beloved forevermore?" Brienne takes a second to calm herself down before nodding. She squeezes your hands back. "I do." "And you, [pc.name]. Do you swear to defend and comfort Brienne in her need, to treasure her as the sacred light of your life, and to love her forevermore?" You nod once, holding Brienne's gaze. "I do." Tanith closes his book. "You may kiss the bride." It may be the most chaste kiss you've ever given her, but when Brienne's lips meet your own it's like a great bell has been rung. Unsurety and anxiety are banished with its tone, your [pc.hasScales |scaled skin feeling as though wind has brushed across it |[pc.sfs |hair |fur |scales |feathers ] standing on end ] as certainty takes their place. You'll be spending the rest of your life in this wonderful woman's company, and she in yours. Nothing could make you happier. rows.raw: " The day is finally here. [flags.BRIENNE_MAR 8 9 10 |Cassia and Rina take Brienne to the church, in accordance with the ritual of the bride and groom not meeting prior to the event itself – though with the mild exception of her giving you a quick kiss on the cheek before she hurries away. You head there yourself not long after, sitting idly in one of the central hall's adjoining rooms in Father Tanith's church. Your thoughts drift to all of the good times you've spent with Brienne, from the start of your adventure until now. In Khor'minos, the bride is the one who stands at the altar, and as a result it's your job to hurry up and wait. Funnily enough, you find you're not nervous at all. All that remains is a desire to see your bride-to-be, and when a soft knock sounds at the door you rise from your chair with anticipation. [var0] You're stunned into silence by what you see when you enter the ceremony hall. Your gorgeous bride is wearing the most amazing white dress you've ever seen, the amazonian cowgirl almost divine in her radiant beauty, and when she turns and smiles at you – beaming with pure happiness with her long golden locks flowing behind her – you fall in love all over again. She's surrounded by impossible scenery, standing amidst a dark, grassy field speckled with fluorescent blue mushrooms with purple flowers hanging overhead, suspended from a tree with a twisted trunk and long, sprawling branches. Magic leylines criss-cross the rolling hills in the distance, and the purple night sky is lit bright by what you can only surmise are brilliant stars. She's holding a bouquet of pretty flowers, glowing an almost metallic blue. You've never seen anything like it. Feeling almost like you're in a dream, you approach the altar. Tanith gives you a nod of acknowledgement, your gaze torn between the little lupine priest and your wonderful bride for a moment. "What is this?" you whisper to him. Tanith smiles. "A bit of magic for our young couple. A return to nativity, if you will. Are you ready for your vows?" You nod, and so does Brienne. You turn to face each other, and you can see she's already trying not to break into tears of joy as she puts the flowers atop Tanith's pedestal. You smile up at her, taking her hands in your own and squeezing her palms in a gesture of comfort. "Brienne." Tanith starts. "Do you swear to accompany [pc.name] on your journey through life, to protect and support [pc.himHer] in [pc.hisHer] endeavors, and to be at [pc.hisHer] side as [pc.hisHer] beloved forevermore?" Brienne takes a second to calm herself down before nodding. She squeezes your hands back. "I do." "And you, [pc.name]. Do you swear to defend and comfort Brienne in her need, to treasure her as the sacred light of your life, and to love her forevermore?" You nod once, holding Brienne's gaze. "I do." Tanith closes his book. "You may kiss the bride." It may be the most chaste kiss you've ever given her, but when Brienne's lips meet your own it's like a great bell has been rung. Unsurety and anxiety are banished with its tone, your [pc.hasScales |scaled skin feeling as though wind has brushed across it |[pc.sfs |hair |fur |scales |feathers ] standing on end ] as certainty takes their place. You'll be spending the rest of your life in this wonderful woman's company, and she in yours. Nothing could make you happier. The scenery fades and you're in the church again, the pews filled with your companions and local friends. Cassia is in tears already, Rina rubbing her back while smiling at her big sister. The ceremony passes without issue, and after the celebrations end you thank Father Tanith profusely before heading back to the house of what are now your in-laws. The cowgirl family is now your family, and it's nice to be back home with your lovely wife. |Cassia and Rina escort Brienne to the Pantheon, in accordance with the ritual of the bride and groom not meeting prior to the event itself – though with the mild exception of her giving you a quick kiss on the cheek before she hurries away. rows.original: [rina.married |The trip home with your new wives is wonderful, of course, but there's still the matter of what's inevitably going to happen once you're indoors. The lady of the house takes initiative, the big cowgirl smiling as she wraps her tail around your waist. "You don't mind if I have [pc.himHer] first, do you, girls?" Cassia says. "Me second," Rina chirps. "Bri, you get [pc.himHer] all the time when you're out adventuring." Brienne smiles. "Okay, fine. I'll wait." You squeeze Cassia's asscheek. rows.raw: " [rina.married |You bring Brienne and Rina upstairs to sleep with you and Cassia for the night, and though the bed is big enough – just – there's a lot of giggling as the four of you snuggle up. In the end, blankets are unnecessary. You sleep in a happy pile of snoozing cowgirls, united in marriage. Several hours pass by before you're awoken by rustling – Cassia is getting up. She gives you a soft kiss on the lips and a smile before she slips her toga on and goes downstairs. The next to get up is Rina, rolling over and just about falling out of bed before catching herself and getting dressed. She gives you a kiss That leaves you with Brienne who is, unsurprisingly, still dead asleep. You could wake her but... you'd rather lie here with your amazonian wife sprawled across you, your fingers running through her long golden hair. She'll wake up when she smells breakfast anyway. You give her a light hug as she gently breathes, reflecting on your newfound status. No matter what happens from here on out, the four of you will always have each other. |You beat an early retreat from the inn in the morning lest you have to deal with complaints about last night's noises. Neither of you were particularly subtle and your wife's 'singing voice' carries pretty far, as Garth could probably attest. With shaky legs but a clear head, you're free to revel in the situation itself: Brienne is now your wife, and you are now [pc.mf |her husband |hers ]. She leans against you, tail coming up to wrap around your waist, and you slowly walk home with your arm around her. No matter what happens from here on out, you will always have each other. ] "

rows.original: Ever since the thought first occurred to you – and no doubt him – each of you have danced around it. There's been teasing and implying, but it's time to divine your true intentions. Do you want to marry Brint, or are you happy the way things are?
rows.translation: 自从这个想法第一次出现在你们的脑海中——毫无疑问，他也一样——你们俩就一直在回避这个话题。虽然有过一些调侃和暗示，但现在是时候弄清楚你们的真实意图了。你们是真的想嫁给布林特，还是对现状感到满意呢？
rows.raw: "\n    Ever since the thought first occurred to you – and no doubt him – each of you have danced around it. There's been teasing and implying, but it's time to divine your true intentions. Do you want to marry Brint, or are you happy the way things are?"

rows.original: The more you think about him, the more sense everything begins to make. The long, arduous nights spent at his side, the good cheer when he's at your side on your adventures, the way you just want to smile whenever he's talking or telling you a joke, the exhilaration when he's fighting alongside you... aah. You might be the last person to have realized it. You really do love Brint. It's difficult to imagine what your future would even look like without him, and you're not interested in clarifying the matter. You want him to stay by your side, and hopefully to spend the rest of your life together. Even if that life is lost in battle against demonic invaders, at least it would be at your lover's side. You'll have to talk about this with him... somewhere romantic. Maybe in the yard of his family home, surrounded by all the flowers with the soft blue lighting at night... that sounds nice.
rows.translation: 你越仔细思考他的事情，就越会发现一切似乎都合情合理。那些看似漫长艰苦的与他共度的每一个夜晚，他在你冒险途中带给你的欢乐与支持，每当他说话或讲笑话时，你总会不由自主地露出微笑，还有当他与你并肩作战时的那种振奋感……啊，你或许才是最后一个意识到这些的人。 你真的是非常爱布林特。很难想象，如果没有他，你的未来会是什么样子，而你也不愿意去澄清这件事。你希望他能够一直陪伴在你身边，希望你们能够一起度过余生。即使在那场与恶魔入侵者的战斗中失去生命，至少也能与你的爱人在一起。 你得和他谈谈这件事……选择一个浪漫的地方。也许可以在他家的院子里，在夜色中，周围环绕着盛开的鲜花，享受柔和的蓝光。…听起来不错啊。

rows.original: You want to marry the one that you love.
rows.translation: 你想要嫁给那个你爱的人。
rows.raw: "You want to marry the one that you love."

rows.original: Truth be told, you don't know what your true feelings about Brint are yet. That's something you'll consider later... if there is a later. The gods know you don't exactly have all the free time in the world. Still, you can come back to this decision some other time.
rows.translation: 说实话，你目前还不知道自己对布林特真正的感受是什么。那是你以后再去考虑的事……如果还有以后的话。众神都知道，你并没有那么多空闲时间。不过，你总可以改天再来做这个决定。

rows.original: You haven't made up your mind.

rows.translation: 我就喜欢这种随意的风格

rows.original: When it comes down to it, no. You're content to keep it casual – and clearly, so is he. Both of you have fun on the side, and that's how you like it. Being too tied down isn't how you operate, free spirit that you are, and marriage to Brint isn't in the cards.
rows.translation: 说到底，并不是这样的。你愿意保持这种随意的关系——显然，他也是这么想的。你们俩在一起时都能获得乐趣，而这正是你们所喜欢的。对于你们这样的自由灵魂来说，被束缚在一起并不是你们的生活方式，因此与布林特结婚显然不在考虑范围内。
rows.raw: "\n        When it comes down to it, no. You're content to keep it casual – and clearly, so is he. Both of you have fun on the side, and that's how you like it. Being too tied down isn't how you operate, free spirit that you are, and marriage to Brint isn't in the cards."

rows.original: "Want to hang out in the yard for a while?" you ask. Brint smiles. "Sure. I was about to ask you the same. Let's go." "[cassia.fucked |Cass |Your mom ] and Rina work pretty hard on the garden," you note as you walk out with him, past the pretty flowers. "Yeah. It's a point of pride for mom, I think," he says. "Kind of like meditation, too." You stand out in the yard together, holding on to Brint's hand. He's very warm. "I'm really glad we met, you know," you say, squeezing his hand. "It's been a long journey, and I'm glad you've been at my side for it." Brint looks at you for a few seconds, his expression neutral and unreadable, and lets out a breath. "Me too. Actually..." You watch, slightly confused as he lets go of your hand and turns towards you. He drops to one knee, bringing up his other hand and unfurling it. There – in the center of his palm – is a lustrous golden ring. "To be honest, I'd have liked to have asked you somewhere more spectacular than our backyard," Brint says, "but it'll have to do. [pc.name]... will you marry me?" You smile, tears coming to your eyes. "Yes." He stands and you throw your arms around him as best you can, his gentle embrace all but lifting you off the ground as he pulls you in against his muscular body. You kiss him then, as desperate to show your love as you are your commitment to him, and the feeling of his giant hand in the small of your back is a comfort you're so well acquainted with it feels like being home. "Gods, I've wanted this," you murmur. Brint laughs. "Is it weird to say I'm already impatient? I want to hurry up and spend the rest of our lives together." You laugh with him. "No, I feel it too." "We'll have to talk about the ceremony," he says, lifting you up with one hand on your butt. Now you're eye-level, and he gives you a little kiss. "Churches, who to invite, all that." "We can figure it all out later," you say, rubbing his shoulders. "Let's enjoy the moment a little longer." Brint chuckles. "You're right." You stay out in the yard together with him for another few hours, slung in his arms. Your husband-to-be is as happy and chatty as ever, and when you finally head back indoors for the night it's in good cheer. You'll sleep well tonight. "Wanna try going all night without waking everyone up?" Brint whispers. Maybe not that well...
rows.translation: “要不要去院子里待一会儿？”你问道。 布林特笑了。“好啊。我正想问你呢。走吧。” “[cassia.fucked |卡丝 |你妈妈 ]和莉娜在花园里下了不少功夫，”你和他一起走出去，路过那些漂亮的花时说道。 “是啊。我想这对妈妈来说是件值得骄傲的事，”他说，“也有点像冥想。” 你们一起站在院子里，你握着布林特的手。他很温暖。 “你知道吗，我真的很庆幸遇见了你，”你说着，握紧他的手，“这一路走来很漫长，我很高兴有你陪在我身边。” 布林特看了你几秒，神情平静而难以捉摸，然后呼出一口气。“我也是。其实……” 你有些困惑地看着他松开你的手，转身面向你。他单膝跪下，抬起另一只手，摊开手掌。 那里——在他掌心中央——是一枚光泽闪亮的金戒指。 “说实话，我本想在比我们后院更气派的地方问你，”布林特说，“不过也只能将就了。[pc.name]……你愿意嫁给我吗？” 你微笑着，泪水涌上眼眶。“愿意。” 他站起身，你尽力张开双臂抱住他；他温柔地回抱，将你搂向自己肌肉结实的身躯，几乎把你抱离了地面。你随即吻了他，既急切地想表达爱意，也急切地想表明承诺；而他那只大手贴在你后腰上的触感，是你熟悉得如同回家一般的慰藉。 “天哪，我一直盼着这一刻，”你低声说道。 布林特笑了。“我说我已经等不及了，会不会很奇怪？我想赶紧开始和你共度余生。” 你也跟着笑了。“不会，我也有同感。” “我们得商量一下仪式的事，”他说着，一只手托着你的屁股把你举起来。现在你们视线齐平，他轻轻吻了你一下。“教堂、邀请谁，诸如此类。” “这些我们以后再慢慢想，”你说着，揉了揉他的肩膀，“让我们再多享受一会儿这一刻吧。” 布林特轻笑。“你说得对。” 你又被他的手臂搂着，和他在院子里待了好几个小时。你这位准丈夫一如既往地开心、健谈，等你们终于回屋过夜时，气氛也愉快极了。今晚你会睡得很香。 “想不想试试一整晚都不吵醒别人？”布林特低声说道。 也许没那么香……

rows.original:
You awaken late in the morning on top of your husband-to-be, all but draped over him like a rug. You're all cuddled up after your incredible effort last night, and you give him a quick kiss on the cheek as you check how much of your body you can move right now. It's... workable.
        
        "G'morning," Brint rumbles.
        
        "Hey, you," you say, rubbing his big, broad chest. "Jeez, you were like a beast last night... I liked it."
        
        He grins. "Lot more where that came from now that we're gonna get married."
        
        "I'll get you some breakfast, stud," you say, slowly sliding off him. Then we can talk about church stuff, if you want."
        
        Brint nods. "Sounds good." He rubs his eyes. "I'll be up in a minute."
        
        You give the big minotaur a kiss on the cheek for good measure. "See you out in the lounge, then."
        
        You'll have to arrange details for the marriage by talking to Brint.
rows.translation:
清晨，你在即将成为你丈夫的人身上醒来，几乎像一条毯子一样盖在他身上。经过昨晚的疯狂亲密接触后，你们紧紧依偎在一起，你轻轻吻了吻他的脸颊，同时试着活动一下自己的身体，看看现在还能动哪些部位。这个办法……是可行的。
        
        “早上好，”布林特低沉地说道。
        
        “嘿，你，”你一边说，一边揉着他那宽厚的胸膛。“天啊，昨晚你简直像头野兽一样……不过我挺喜欢的。”
        
        他咧嘴笑了。“等我们结婚后，这种表现还会更多呢。”
        
        “我去给你弄点早餐，宝贝，”你说道，一边慢慢从他身上爬下来。然后，如果你愿意的话，我们可以聊聊关于教会的事情。”
        
        布林特点了点头。“听起来不错。”他揉了揉眼睛。“马上就起来。”
        
        你又亲了那只巨大的弥诺陶洛斯的脸颊一下，以确保万无一失。“那我们休息室见吧。”
        
        你得和布林特谈谈，才能确定婚礼的具体细节。

rows.original:
[first BRINT_MAR_TM
        |"So, about Khor'minoan marriage ceremonies..." you say.

        Brint smiles. "What about 'em?"
        
        "What are they like?" you say. "Do they take place in a church?"
        
        He nods. "Yup. You can be married in a church of any denomination, though most people get married in the Pantheon which covers all of the gods. Huge, fancy ceremonies – big public affair, a banquet, lots of drinking and eating, usually goes all day long after your vows." He grins. "It's expected that the [pc.mf
            |couple
            |bride and groom
        ] slip away mid-event and come back later to join in the drinking and dancing, of course. Nobody wants to keep them trapped there talking to everyone, y'know? It's their event, they can do what they like."
        
        "Is there room for smaller ceremonies?" you say.
        
        "Yeah, there are smaller churches you can go to," he says. "If we want a small ceremony, we can go to one of those and just invite my family. No need for anything else."
        
        "What do you prefer?" you say.
        
        Brint shrugs. "I could go either way, really. I'd like to have our marriage be a big thing the whole city knows about – Brint and [pc.name], united forever! But a smaller church would feel more intimate. How about you?"

rows.original:
"Let's go with the small ceremony," you say. "I like the idea of something more private, just between us."

                "Yeah, okay," Brint says. "Let's make some plans, then."
                
                You hash out some ideas about where and when to have the ceremony. You're looking forward to the day already, but the tedium of arranging it all is a barrier – at least you'll be figuring it out with your husband-to-be. The two of you spend some time walking around the city, half sightseeing and half looking for a church to have the ceremony in.
                
                After you've stopped to have some food you happen upon a small, stout-looking lupine man wearing glasses, just closing up what looks to be a church.
                
                "Hello," you say. "Are you a minister here?"
                
                "That I am," he says. "Are you interested in the church's services?"
                
                "We're looking to find a smaller, less ostentatious place than the Pantheon to get married," Brint says. "Do you do marriages?"
                
                The lupine nods. "I do. I should introduce myself. I'm Father Tanith, the minister of this church. My wife and I have been keeping it afloat for some decades, now."
                
                "I'm Brint, and this is my [pc.mf
                    |husband
                    |wife
                ]-to-be [pc.name]," Brint says, smiling as he puts an arm around you. You [pc.mascFem
                    |smile with him, blushing a little

rows.original: "Let's go with the big ceremony," you say, smiling. "Having a wedding party at the Pantheon seems like it'd be great." "Yeah, okay," Brint says. "Let's make some plans, then." You hash out some ideas about where and when to have the ceremony. You're looking forward to the day already, but the tedium of arranging it all is a barrier – at least you'll be figuring it out with your husband-to-be. The two of you head to the Pantheon, looking for someone who can tell you about the marriage services. A gigantic building with room enough for worship of all seven of the gods, the Pantheon stands tall near the centre of the minotaur city. Each of the Seven has a dedicated shrine contained within, and helpfully enough there's a priest wandering through the area you catch the attention of. "Ah, hello," he says, smiling. "Visitors to the Pantheon?" Brint steps forward with a smile, extending his hand. "Brint. This is my fiance[pc.mf | |e ], [pc.name]," he says, indicating you. You wave. "I was wondering if we could talk to you about getting married here." "You want to have a Pantheon marriage? Wonderful!" the priest says, smiling wide as he sweeps an arm out as though to reveal the grounds. "It's a popular choice here, maybe more than ever in light of current events. Are either of you a citizen?" He looks at Brint. "Apologies, I have to ask." Brint nods. "Minoan born and bred. I grew up in Tel'duum." "Aah, of course!" the priest says, brightening. "I seem to remember watching some wrestling competitions with representatives from there... regardless, I'm glad you're back – the city welcomes you, and I'd be more than happy to officiate a wedding of a child of Khor'minos. My name is Tremisce, a minister here at the temple. Let us retire to a room that we might talk the details over." "Sure thing," you say. You decide to get married under Lumia's blessing – not that Brint is particularly ardent about his worship, but it does run in his family, and that's what feels right to you two According to Tremisce, there's room to have a marriage ceremony in a week. Apparently their marriage schedule is so busy recently that you're lucky to even be able to have one within a month, so that's fortuitous timing. "I take it I'm not rushing you," Tremisce says. "No, not really," you say. "We've been together for a while now. It's something both of us have thought about." Brint nods. "The sooner the better, as far as I'm concerned." Tremisce smiles. "Well, good. I'll start getting everything ready for your big day, then. Marriages at the Pantheon are a big public affair, though we make sure it's relatively respectful. Everyone appreciates a giant party given what's been going on, and nobody wants them to stop. The revellers are a chatty bunch but they know not to push boundaries. And, of course, it's expected that the couple slips away to have fun on their own. The party goes on without them." "Sounds like a festival," you say. Tremisce laughs. "That's a good way to put it, especially given it's happening daily now. A month-long festival celebrating joyous union is one of the better uses of the kingdom's money, I think." You and Brint bid goodbye to the minister and head home, passing by some of the shrines on the way out. It's quite the place to be married, you think. You lean against Brint and interlock your fingers with his, and you walk like that the rest of the way to his family's house.

rows.original: "Everything okay with the ceremony?" you ask. Brint nods. "We've got it all handled, don't worry." You beam with happiness. "You're a wonderful lover, Brint. I'm so lucky to have you." Brint leans down to give you a kiss. "Thanks, babe." "Oh! Do you have anything to wear for it?" you ask. He smiles. "Yeah, don't worry. I'm not showing up to my own wedding in the leathers. I promise it won't disappoint, either." "I see you've got it handled," you say, smiling. "I'll be waiting with bated breath, then." Your marriage ceremony will be in a week.

rows.original: The day is finally here. [flags.BRINT_MAR 5 6 |Cassia and Rina take you to the church, in accordance with the ritual of the [pc.mf|couple|bride and groom] not meeting prior to the event itself – though with the mild exception of you giving Brint a quick kiss on the cheek before you hurry away. He'll be joining you before long, and for now you have to prepare. You talk to the two girls and Tanith while idly thinking of the good times you've spent with Brint, and it becomes apparent the wedding is going to be a little bit more magical than you'd expected. In Khor'minos, the [pc.mf|one presented the ring|bride] is the one who stands at the altar, and as a result it's your job to hurry up and wait for him, all dressed up. Funnily enough, you find you're not nervous at all. All that remains is a desire to see your groom, and when Tanith sends for him you feel a tingle of anticipation as well as magic. The room around you begins to change, the entire church shimmering for a moment, and in your astonishment you look around. You're suddenly surrounded by impossible scenery, standing amidst a dark, grassy field speckled with fluorescent blue mushrooms with purple flowers hanging overhead, suspended from a tree with a twisted trunk and long, sprawling branches. Magic leylines criss-cross the rolling hills in the distance, and the purple night sky is lit bright by what you can only surmise are brilliant stars. In your hands you have a bouquet of pretty flowers, glowing an almost metallic blue. You've never seen anything like it. Feeling almost like you're in a dream, you turn to look at your lover as he approaches the altar. He's in a traditional Minoan toga with a blue sash, golden jewelry adorning his formidable body, and wearing a heart-winning smile. You're stunned into silence, mouth slightly agape as you fall in love all over again. "Appreciate the show," Brint murmurs to Tanith. Tanith smiles. "A bit of magic for our young couple. A return to nativity, if you will. Are you ready for your vows?" You nod, and so does Brint. You turn to face each other, and you're already trying not to break into tears of joy while you put the flowers atop Tanith's pedestal. You smile up at Brint as he takes your hands in his own, squeezing your palms in a gesture of comfort. "[pc.name]." Tanith starts. "Do you swear to accompany Brint on your journey through life, to protect and support him in his endeavors, and to be at his side as his beloved forevermore?" You take a moment to appreciate it all, and squeeze Brint's hands back. "I do." "And you, Brint. Do you swear to defend and comfort [pc.name] in [pc.hisHer] need, to treasure [pc.himHer] as the sacred light of your life, and to love [pc.himHer] forevermore?" He nods once, holding your gaze. "I do." Tanith closes his book. "Adorn the ring and you may kiss [pc.mf|your beloved|the bride]." [var0] Brint gets down on one knee with the ring in his hand, and you hold out your finger as he slowly and carefully slides it on. Only the barest sense of decorum keeps you from springing directly into his arms before he kisses you, and what a kiss it is. With your eyes closed, you can feel every bit of unsurety and anxiety over your future being banished from your body. You'll be spending the rest of your life in this wonderful man's company, and he in yours. Nothing could make you happier. The scenery fades and you're in the church again, the pews filled with your companions and local friends. Cassia is in tears already, Rina rubbing her back while smiling at her big brother. The ceremony passes without issue, and after the celebrations end you thank Father Tanith profusely before heading back to the house of what are now your in-laws. Magic leylines criss-cross the rolling hills in the distance, and the purple night sky is lit bright by what you can only surmise are brilliant stars. In your hands you have a bouquet of pretty flowers, glowing an almost metallic blue. You've never seen anything like it. Feeling almost like you're in a dream, you turn to look at your lover as he approaches the altar. He's in a traditional Minoan toga with a blue sash, golden jewelry adorning his formidable body, and wearing a heart-winning smile. You're stunned into silence, mouth slightly agape as you fall in love all over again. "Appreciate the show," Brint murmurs to Tremisce. Tremisce smiles. "Temple magic. A return to roots, so to speak. Are you ready for your vows?" You nod, and so does Brint. You turn to face each other, and you're already trying not to break into tears of joy. You smile up at Brint as he takes your hands in his own, squeezing your palms in a gesture of comfort. "[pc.name]." Tremisce starts. "Do you swear to accompany Brint on your journey through life, to protect and support him in his endeavors, and to be at his side as his beloved forevermore?" You take a moment to appreciate it all, and squeeze Brint's hands back. "I do." "And you, Brint. Do you swear to defend and comfort [pc.name] in [pc.hisHer] need, to treasure [pc.himHer] as the sacred light of your life, and to love [pc.himHer] forevermore?" He nods once, holding your gaze. "I do." Tremisce closes his book. "Adorn the ring and you may kiss [pc.mf|your beloved|the bride]." Only the barest sense of decorum keeps you from springing directly into his arms before he kisses you, and what a kiss it is. With your eyes closed, you can feel every bit of unsurety and anxiety over your future being banished from your body. You'll be spending the rest of your life in this wonderful man's company, and he in yours. Nothing could make you happier. The scenery fades and the crowd is on their hooves and feet, clapping and cheering for the two of you as you laugh and smile, the first of your moments together as [pc.mf |husbands |husband and wife ] spent in good cheer. You take your flowers and toss them towards the crowd, sending it sailing into a pack of cowgirls who eagerly hold their hands up to receive it. You don't get to see who catches it, already surrounded by a group of revellers congratulating you, and a few cowgirls almost crying as they tell you how [pc.mascFem |wonderful |beautiful ] you look on your big day. The two of you eventually manage to extricate yourselves from the crowd to make your way to some food, Brint giving you a glance as he indicates a cake on the table with a subtle nod of his horned head. You roll your eyes before you pick up the knife, cutting him a piece and handing it on a plate to your delighted husband, who happily picks it up and begins munching away. "Well, it's our wedding," you say, trying mostly to convince yourself. "Nobody can complain if the [pc.mf|ones married|bride and groom] eat the whole cake." Brint chuckles. "I've got the room for it." Resigned to your fate, you start cutting more pieces. The crowd hasn't even begun to disperse by the time you leave with Brint after thanking Tremisce, the participants still happily getting drunk and dancing while the big minotaur escorts you away hand-in-hand, heading back to the house of what are now your in-laws. Brint's family is now your family, and it's nice to be back home with your lovely minotaur husband. ]
