rows.original: You take a single step forward into the room and inhale sharply as it lights up all at once, glowing intensely before fading to a more comfortable level. There's runes all over the walls, layered on each other multiple times to the point you probably couldn't read them even if you knew the applicable alphabet. [party.has brint|"Nice and foreboding," Brint grunts.|[party.has arona|"Cozy welcome," Arona mutters.|]] At the opposite end of the room stands a single mannequin, covered in what looks like a set of ceremonial armor. The mannequin itself looks to be very large, its frame wide and imposing. Taking a closer look, you reach out and touch the armor. You're not surprised at all when it glows slightly at the contact — though you can't feel the grooves of the inscription, the armor itself is covered in runes as well. The plate is a shiny, reflective gold, the entire set including some mail chausses, a breastplate, wristguards, and what looks like a solid gold ring to be put around the neck. All in all, it looks very nice, albeit ostentatious. [party.som |There doesn't seem to be anything you can do with it yourself, though. Maybe if you come back with someone they can try putting it on. |You could try having your companion put it on. "So... want to try it on?" you ask, smiling as you tap the breastplate. |You could try having one of your companions put it on. "So... anyone want to try it on?" you ask, smiling as you tap the breastplate. ] [party.has arona|Arona grunts. "As much as I'd like to put on the pretty golden armor, [pc.name], I don't think it'd fit."] [party.has cait|"Nope," Cait says, grimacing. "Not that it'd fit, but I'm not falling in love with the look of it, either."] [party.has kiyoko|"I don't think it would fit me," Kiyoko says, smiling faintly. "Or go well with my fur, for that matter."] [party.has berwyn|"I'm not wearing that," Berwyn mutters.] [party.has brint|"Well..." Brint says, eyeing it carefully. "It does look like it would fit me, [pc.name]. Should I?" You could have Brint put the glowing golden rune-inscribed armor on.]
rows.translation: 你向前迈出一步走进房间，猛地吸了口气，整个房间瞬间亮了起来，光芒刺眼，随后又渐渐暗到较为舒服的程度。墙上到处都是符文，一层又一层地反复叠压，就算你认得那种文字，恐怕也读不出来。 [party.has brint|“又漂亮又阴森，”布林特咕哝道。|[party.has arona|“温馨的欢迎，”阿罗娜低声说。|]] 房间的另一端立着一个孤零零的人体模型，身上罩着一套看起来像是仪式用护甲的东西。模型本身看起来非常高大，骨架宽阔而威严。你凑近细看，伸手摸了摸那套护甲。 接触到它时，它微微发光，你一点也不意外——虽然你摸不出铭文的凹槽，但这套护甲本身也覆满了符文。甲片是闪亮的、能映出人影的金色，整套装备包括锁甲腿甲、一副胸甲、护腕，还有一枚看起来要套在脖子上的实心金环。总而言之，它看起来非常漂亮，只是有些招摇。 [party.som |不过，你自己似乎拿它没什么办法。也许你带个人回来，他们能试着把它穿上。 |你可以让你的同伴试着把它穿上。 “那么……想试试吗？”你微笑着问道，一边敲了敲胸甲。 |你可以让你的某位同伴试着把它穿上。 “那么……有人想试试吗？”你微笑着问道，一边敲了敲胸甲。 ] [party.has arona|阿罗娜哼了一声。“虽然我很想穿上那套漂亮的金色护甲，[pc.name]，但我觉得它不合身。”] [party.has cait|“不行，”凯特皱起眉头。“倒不是说它不合身，只是我也没喜欢上它的样子。”] [party.has kiyoko|“我觉得它不适合我，”清子淡淡地笑着说。“而且也不配我的毛皮。”] [party.has berwyn|“我才不穿那个，”贝尔温低声说。] [party.has brint|“嗯……”布林特仔细地端详着它，说道。“它看起来确实合我的身，[pc.name]。我该穿上吗？” 你本可以让布林特穿上那件刻着发光金色符文的护甲。]
rows.raw: ' You take a single step forward into the room and inhale sharply as it lights up all at once, glowing intensely before fading to a more comfortable level. There's runes all over the walls, layered on each other multiple times to the point you probably couldn't read them even if you knew the applicable alphabet. [party.has brint|"Nice and foreboding," Brint grunts.|[party.has arona|"Cozy welcome," Arona mutters.|]] At the opposite end of the room stands a single mannequin, covered in what looks like a set of ceremonial armor. The mannequin itself looks to be very large, its frame wide and imposing. Taking a closer look, you reach out and touch the armor. You're not surprised at all when it glows slightly at the contact — though you can't feel the grooves of the inscription, the armor itself is covered in runes as well. The plate is a shiny, reflective gold, the entire set including some mail chausses, a breastplate, wristguards, and what looks like a solid gold ring to be put around the neck. All in all, it looks very nice, albeit ostentatious. [party.som |There doesn't seem to be anything you can do with it yourself, though. Maybe if you come back with someone they can try putting it on. |You could try having your companion put it on. "So... want to try it on?" you ask, smiling as you tap the breastplate. |You could try having one of your companions put it on. "So... anyone want to try it on?" you ask, smiling as you tap the breastplate. ] [party.has arona|Arona grunts. "As much as I'd like to put on the pretty golden armor, [pc.name], I don't think it'd fit."] [party.has cait|"Nope," Cait says, grimacing. "Not that it'd fit, but I'm not falling in love with the look of it, either."] [party.has kiyoko|"I don't think it would fit me," Kiyoko says, smiling faintly. "Or go well with my fur, for that matter."] [party.has berwyn|"I'm not wearing that," Berwyn mutters.] [party.has brint|"Well..." Brint says, eyeing it carefully. "It does look like it would fit me, [pc.name]. Should I?" You could have Brint put the glowing golden rune-inscribed armor on.]'

rows.original: "Sure," you say. [ pc.dcb |"At least whatever bad thing happens presumably won't be happening to me." |"Be careful, though. If you feel anything wrong, just take it off." |"Totally be careful, though! It looks weird." ] Brint slowly takes off his clothes, turning to the armor and inspecting it. He takes the breastplate off the dummy, rapping it with his hand and grunting. "Not a shock, but this isn't gold," he says. "Just painted like it. Regular bronze, far as I can tell. Still, seems like it'll fit. Help me strap it up." He places it over his muscular chest and presses down, pulling the backpiece closer only to surprise the both of you when it automatically clamps together. Luckily, it doesn't seem to have pinched any of his fur or skin — but the prospect of a magically-sealing armor is concerning. You exchange a glance. Bending down, he tugs at the chausses. Perhaps surprisingly, they fit his muscular hooved legs perfectly — sliding up with no issue, and staying there once in place. There's even a leather strap on the inside to 'contain' him. His old wristguards come off and the ones click into place, leaving only the neckpiece. He tugs it off the mannequin and eyes it carefully, turning it over in his hands. To you it appears perfectly smooth, without any lines whatsoever, little more than a golden ring. Furrowing your brow, you open your mouth. "How are you going to put it on?" you ask him. "Strangest thing," he says slowly, flipping it over in particular fashion and turning it a little. "I can see it in my head... how I'm meant to put it on." He presses the ring to his wide, muscular neck and the bronze in contact with his skin passes through him, solidifying once more around the back of his neck as it clicks into place. At once he grunts and staggers, sticking an arm out to steady himself. "Brint?!" you say, stepping forward to [pc.isHeight 72|grab his shoulder.|touch his waist.] "Are you okay?" "Nnn... fine," Brint says, shaking his head. "Head feels a little funny, though. I'd like to get out of here." Half-supporting the giant minotaur as best you can, you carefully exit the hollow and find he quickly recovers in the outside world. Stretching out, he flexes experimentally, grunting. Seems like the old Brint. Grinning, he turns to you. "Alright, I feel better again out here. The outside air is fantastic," he says, sniffing the valley's fresh air before sighing in contentment. "Let's head out, [pc.name]." You're not sure that you've all gotten away without consequence but for now, at least, things are fine.
rows.translation: “好吧。”你说道。[ pc.dcb |“至少，无论会发生什么坏事，想来都不会发生在我身上。” |“不过要小心。如果感觉哪里不对，就立刻把它脱下来。” |“不过，你一定要超级小心！它看起来很古怪。” ] 布林特缓缓脱下衣物，转向那套盔甲仔细检查。他从假人身上取下胸甲，以手敲了敲，发出一声闷哼。 “意料之中，这不是黄金。”他说道。“只是涂成了金色。据我判断，就是普通青铜。不过，看起来应该合身。帮我把它系好。” 他将胸甲盖上肌肉发达的胸膛，向下按压，拉近背甲；出乎你们两人意料，甲片竟自动扣合。幸运的是，它似乎没有夹住他的任何毛发或皮肤——不过，一套能以魔法自行封闭的盔甲仍然令人担忧。你们交换了一下眼神。 他弯下腰，拉扯腿甲。或许有些出人意料，它们完美贴合了他肌肉发达的有蹄双腿——顺畅地一路滑上去，到位后便稳稳停住。内侧甚至还有一条皮带，可以将他的那话儿“收纳”起来。他摘下旧护腕，新护腕随即咔哒扣上，只剩颈甲还未穿戴。 他从假人身上扯下颈甲，小心地端详，在手中翻来覆去。你看不出上面有任何缝隙，它完全光滑，简直只是一只金色圆环。你皱起眉头，张开嘴。 “你打算怎么戴上它？”你问他。 “真奇怪。”他缓缓说道，以特定方式将其翻转，又稍稍旋动。“我能在脑海里看见……该怎样把它戴上。” 他将圆环按向自己宽阔而肌肉发达的脖颈；与皮肤接触的青铜竟从他身体中穿过，又在颈后重新凝成实体，咔哒一声锁定。布林特立刻闷哼一声，脚步踉跄，伸出一条手臂稳住身体。 “布林特？！”你一边喊，一边上前[pc.isHeight 72|抓住他的肩膀。|扶住他的腰。]“你没事吧？” “嗯……没事。”布林特摇着头说道。“不过脑袋感觉有点古怪。我想离开这里。” 你尽力半扶着这个巨大的弥诺陶洛斯，小心地离开树洞；来到外界后，他很快恢复过来。他舒展身体，试探性地绷紧肌肉，发出闷哼。看起来还是从前那个布林特。他咧嘴一笑，转向你。 “好啦，一到外面我就又感觉好多了。外面的空气太棒了。”他说着，嗅了嗅山谷里的新鲜空气，满足地叹息一声。“我们走吧，[pc.name]。” 你无法确定大家是否真的毫无后果地逃脱，不过至少眼下，一切安好。

The slightly claustrophobic experience just makes you appreciate the greater world all the more.

rows.original: Go back the way you came.

"So uh, [pc.name]," Brint says, catching you alone. "There's something going on with the armor after all." [pc.dcb |"You're not going to explode, are you?" you say, grimacing. "Ha, probably not," he chuckles. "But there's something else." |"Is everything okay?" you ask, concerned. "Maybe... I'm not sure," he says. "Let me tell you about it." |"Aw, no!" you gasp, dismayed. "Are you okay, babe?" "Should be fine," he says, grinning. "But just in case, let me tell you about what's going on, [pc.name]." ] You listen intently as he fills you in on the two main problems. The first is that the armor, simply put, will not come off. "You can't remove it?" you say, eyebrows raised. "At all," he says, nodding. "It's not even like it'd be hard to take off, it just... doesn't happen. I don't know how to explain it." "Damn," you swear, thinking. "Maybe we should visit the town priest to see what he makes of it." "That's not all," Brint continues. He fills you in on the strange dreams he's started having. Dreams about sex aren't uncommon, but the sheer frequency and amount of them seem extremely odd by the way he describes it. "Whenever you close your eyes?" you say, wanting to make sure you didn't mishear him. "Every time," he replies. "I keep waking up all messy. The weirdest part is that all the dreams feature me — but not as myself. Like I'm the cowgirl being fucked by myself." "Hold on," you say, a crease in your brow. "So you're always a woman in these dreams? Not male?" "Yeah," he says, shrugging. "A sexy stacked cowgirl, just like the ones back home but uh, a fair bit more muscular." "And you're being fucked by... yourself?" you prompt him. "Definitely me," he says, nodding and chuckling. "I'd recognize that handsome rogue anywhere. Only I wish he wasn't so intent on plowing me in particular. Never been into that idea much." You discuss it further. The most logical assumption is that the armor itself is causing the dreams, barring Brint's sudden acquisition of a genderbending fetish to go hand in hand with extreme narcissism. They don't seem too awful on their own, but... you have a sneaking suspicion it's not going to end at dreams. "Alright," you decide. "Let's see the priest. Maybe he'll know what to do."
rows.translation: “那么，呃，[pc.name]，”布林特趁你独自一人时说道，“那套盔甲果然还是出了问题。” [pc.dcb |“你不会是要爆炸了吧？”你皱着眉说道。 “哈，大概不会，”他轻笑道，“不过还有别的事。” |“一切还好吗？”你关切地问道。 “也许吧……我也不确定，”他说，“让我跟你说说。” |“啊，不要！”你惊慌地倒抽一口气，“你还好吗，宝贝？” “应该没事，”他咧嘴笑道，“不过以防万一，还是让我跟你说说发生了什么吧，[pc.name]。” ] 你专注地听着他讲那两个主要问题。第一个问题，简单来说，就是那套盔甲根本脱不下来。 “你脱不掉它？”你挑起眉毛问道。 “完全脱不掉，”他点头说道，“倒不是说它有多难脱，它就是……脱不下来。我也不知道该怎么解释。” “该死，”你一边咒骂一边思索，“也许我们该去镇上找祭司看看，听听他怎么说。” “还不止这些，”布林特继续说道。 他接着讲了讲他最近开始做的那些怪梦。做春梦并不稀奇，但照他描述的那种频率和数量，实在异常得离谱。 “每次一闭上眼就会？”你问道，想确认自己没有听错。 “每一次，”他答道，“我醒来时总是一片狼藉。最奇怪的是，所有梦里都有我——但又不是我自己。就好像我是那个被自己操的牛仔女孩。” “等等，”你皱起眉头，“所以你在这些梦里总是女人？不是男人？” “是啊，”他耸耸肩，“一个性感丰满的牛仔女孩，就像老家那些姑娘一样，不过，呃，肌肉结实得多。” “而操你的是……你自己？”你追问道。 “绝对是我，”他点头轻笑，“那个英俊的浪子我走到哪儿都认得出来。只是我希望他别老盯着我一个人干。我对那种玩法一直没什么兴趣。” 你们又讨论了一阵。最合理的推测是，这些梦是那套盔甲本身造成的——除非布林特突然同时患上了变性癖和极端的自恋。单看这些梦，似乎还没那么糟，但是……你隐隐觉得，事情不会止于做梦。 “好吧，”你下定决心，“我们去见祭司。也许他知道该怎么办。”

You maneuver the beefy bull into a sitting position as he steadies himself with his weapon, head swaying from side to side. He only seems half-there, his eyelids drooping as he begins to pant. rows.original: [party.has arona |"Ha ha, that's what I'm talking about!" Arona crows, slapping her hand down on Brint's shoulder. He doesn't budge an inch. "Let's get you back to town, cowboy. Then I'll show you a good time." You and Arona walk Brint back to town, at which point she disappears upstairs with him. |Arona would be thrilled to give Brint a hard fucking to 'fix' him, no doubt. You walk Brint back to town and tell Arona about the situation, asking her if she thinks she can help. She's barely stopped laughing before she disappears upstairs with him. ] You wait around the inn for a while, passing the time until Arona comes back downstairs covered in a sheen of sweat and grinning like she's killed a mammoth. She heads straight to you and sits down and you wince momentarily as the smell of minotaur musk hits your nose. "God damn," she says, settling back in her chair and relishing the moment. "He was like a girl up there." Ordinarily you might not ask further, but that particular wording sets your mind jogging. "Like a girl. Like a girl how?" Arona raises an eyebrow at you. "This is important," you say, deadset. "I need to know." "Hell, I dunno, he just... was," Arona shrugs, waving her hand as she leans back in the chair. "Moaning, shaking, hugging a pillow, begging for more. Didn't expect that outta him, truth be told." "Huh," you mutter. "You know... that armor he's wearing might actually be turning him into a girl." "No shit?" Arona says, halting her lean mid-air with wide eyes. "That's..." She pauses, considering the prospect. Leaning forward and bringing her chair back down to the ground with a loud thud that draws a couple of stares, she leans across the table and grins at you. "That's fucking awesome!" rows.original: "I could use some help, actually. Particularly, with dealing with this armor," you tell him. With a nod to Brint he steps forward, knocking his hand against his golden armor. Sanders looks surprised, leaning in to inspect the breastplate. He puts his hand out against it and sighs. "This is cursed quite severely, [pc.name]. Where did you find it?" he asks. You explain the circumstances behind the acquisition of the armor, with Brint chipping in to introduce himself and explain what's been happening to him. Sanders nods along, his gaze growing distant when you finish up. "Hmm..." Sanders hums, considering the situation. "I wonder... this sounds very similar to an old, deprecated method the marefolk of the Harvest Valley used to utilize. For when the men became mad and they decided to take matters into their own hands." He shakes his head wearily. "Playing at being gods. They'd long since moved on from such heretical magic, I thought. I suppose this must be a relic of a bygone time. Much like myself, come to think of it." "Is it possible to un-curse it?" Brint asks hopefully. "Yes," Sanders says, nodding slowly. "It will not be easy. But it is the least I can do for you, my friend. I will not idly stand by while this armor seeks to corrupt you. Come." Beckoning Brint towards the altar, Sanders bids the minotaur stand before him and puts his fingertips against the armor once more, sighing heavily and shaking his head. "This is even worse than I had feared. How long have you been wearing this?" he asks. [var0 |"No more than a day," Brint replies, looking down at it. "Is it that bad?" "I suspect that left unhindered, this would change you completely within a matter of days," |"I suspect you have but a few days left at best," |"I suspect you have, at most, a day or two before you are irrevocably changed," ] Sanders says darkly, lowering his hand. "This is going to require a less delicate touch. Wait for me. I will return." He walks into a back room, leaving you with a slightly nervous [party.compNames] for company. Chatter passes among you until Sanders returns, bearing a worn warhammer instead of his staff. A faded insignia is visible on the haft of it — the symbol of Lady Lumia. "Tell me you're not going to hit the breastplate with that," Brint says. Sanders cracks a genuine smile. "No, friend. This is simply a different magic focus, similar to my staff." The smile fades little by little. "It differs only in its application." Looking at Sanders now, you doubt he's used the hammer in a while. [flags.SANDERS_TALK_ORDER|Five years ago it was that he retired, he said.|You'll have to ask him a little about himself later.] You can see a faint light glowing within and have to wonder if it's coming from him or the weapon. Your question is answered as he raises the hammer and begins to pray, a shimmering golden aura covering his hands and radiating outwards to his entire body, encasing him in what you would swear looks like armor. Looking closer, you wonder if your eyes are playing tricks on you — it looks as if Sanders' eyes are aflame... "O Lumia, lay your most sacrosanct of blessings upon your paladin," he murmurs. "It is in your name that we set forth, in your name that we seek out corruption, in your name that we expel evil." Sanders takes his other hand from Brint's breastplate and wraps it around the handle of the hammer, his knuckles whitening as he strains to hold it. For the merest of moments — you see something arise from Sanders. A wispy figure made of light, contained in a suit of fullplate and drawing a massive warhammer back. It swings with an unearthly speed and — "—" Sanders whispers indistinctly. "Et-" The last syllable of the incantation is cut off by an enormous explosion. Every single window in the chapel shatters, the glass blowing outwards, the paintings on the walls shredded to bits in an instant, a whirlwind of air tearing through the building with such magnitude you can scarcely breathe — Then you're sitting on your pew in a wholly undamaged chapel, looking around before a nonplussed Brint suddenly reaches forward to grab the priest. His breastplate falls free, coming loose and hitting the ground. By the time you've reached the two of them to support Sanders, the armor has faded away to nothing more than dust in the eerie wind sweeping through the church. "Hah," Sanders grunts as you gingerly place him in a pew, still clinging to his hammer. "I'd half-expected that not to work. Lumia..." After a few seconds during which he seems to be very far away, he turns his head back towards Brint, just a concerned old man. "And you, friend? Are you well?" he asks. "Fitter than ever," Brint says, grinning. "Thank you, Brother. I feel better already." "I'm glad," Sanders says with a gentle smile. "That is, after all, what we fought for. Now," he continues, slowly getting back to his feet. "I think I'm going to rest a while." "You've certainly earned it," you say, helping him up and making to leave. "Thank you, Brother Sanders. You've saved my friend's life." "Of course," he says, chuckling. "Remember, any time you need healing or guidance, I will be here for you. But perhaps not in the next six or seven hours — I do need some sleep." Collecting your things and checking Brint over, you walk towards the door after Brint. "Ah, and [pc.name]," Sanders calls after you. "I would appreciate it if we did not talk of the ritual. Some things are... better left buried." Giving him a respectful nod, you thank him once more and leave the chapel behind. "Hell," Brint grunts once you're outside. "If this was 15 years ago we could have just taken him with us. Show Kasyrra what for." You're inclined to agree.

这个咒语的最后一个音节在一声巨大的爆炸声中戛然而止。小教堂里的每一扇窗户都碎成了碎片，玻璃片向四处飞溅；墙上的画作也在瞬间被撕得粉碎。一股强大的气流以惊人的力量冲破了整个建筑，让人几乎无法呼吸…… 然后你坐在一座完好无损的小教堂里，环顾四周，这时一个显得有些困惑的布林特突然向前冲去，抓住了那位牧师。牧师的胸甲脱落下来，松开后掉在了地上。当你赶到他们身边去帮助桑德斯时，那套盔甲早已在教堂里吹荡的诡异寒风中化为尘埃，消失得无影无踪了。 哈，”桑德斯哼了一声，而你则小心翼翼地把他安置在长椅上，他仍然紧握着那把锤子。“我其实半期待着这种方法会失败呢……卢米娅……” 过了几秒钟，他似乎仿佛沉浸在遥远的思绪之中，随后又把头转回到布林特身边，此刻的他，只是一个充满担忧的老人罢了。 那你呢，朋友？你一切都好吗？”他问道。 “比以往任何时候都要健康，”布林特笑着说，“谢谢你，兄弟。我现在感觉好多了。” “我很高兴，”桑德斯温柔地笑了笑，“毕竟，这正是我们为之奋斗的目标。现在，”他继续说道，慢慢站了起来，“我想我该休息一会儿了。 你确实值得这个奖励，”你说道，扶他站起来准备离开。“谢谢你，桑德斯修士。你救了我朋友的命。” “当然，”他笑着说，“记住，无论什么时候你需要治疗或帮助，我都会在这里支持你。不过接下来的六七个小时我可能没空——我确实需要睡一会儿。 收拾好自己的东西，确认布林特已经离开后，你跟在布林特身后走向门口。 “啊，对了[pc.name]，桑德斯在叫你呢。”“我希望我们不要再谈论那个仪式了。有些事情……最好被埋藏在心底。” 你恭敬地点了点头，再次向他道谢，然后离开了小教堂。 “该死，”布林特在外面抱怨道，“要是15年前发生这种事，我们就可以直接带他一起走了。让卡希拉看看我们这么做的意义。” 你也有同感。
rows.raw: ' "I could use some help, actually. Particularly, with dealing with this armor," you tell him. With a nod to Brint he steps forward, knocking his hand against his golden armor. Sanders looks surprised, leaning in to inspect the breastplate. He puts his hand out against it and sighs. "This is cursed quite severely, [pc.name]. Where did you find it?" he asks. You explain the circumstances behind the acquisition of the armor, with Brint chipping in to introduce himself and explain what's been happening to him. Sanders nods along, his gaze growing distant when you finish up. "Hmm..." Sanders hums, considering the situation. "I wonder... this sounds very similar to an old, deprecated method the marefolk of the Harvest Valley used to utilize. For when the men became mad and they decided to take matters into their own hands." He shakes his head wearily. "Playing at being gods. They'd long since moved on from such heretical magic, I thought. I suppose this must be a relic of a bygone time. Much like myself, come to think of it." "Is it possible to un-curse it?" Brint asks hopefully. "Yes," Sanders says, nodding slowly. "It will not be easy. But it is the least I can do for you, my friend. I will not idly stand by while this armor seeks to corrupt you. Come." Beckoning Brint towards the altar, Sanders bids the minotaur stand before him and puts his fingertips against the armor once more, sighing heavily and shaking his head. "This is even worse than I had feared. How long have you been wearing this?" he asks. [var0 |"No more than a day," Brint replies, looking down at it. "Is it that bad?" "I suspect that left unhindered, this would change you completely within a matter of days," |"I suspect you have but a few days left at best," |"I suspect you have, at most, a day or two before you are irrevocably changed," ] Sanders says darkly, lowering his hand. "This is going to require a less delicate touch. Wait for me. I will return." He walks into a back room, leaving you with a slightly nervous [party.compNames] for company. Chatter passes among you until Sanders returns, bearing a worn warhammer instead of his staff. A faded insignia is visible on the haft of it — the symbol of Lady Lumia. "Tell me you're not going to hit the breastplate with that," Brint says. Sanders cracks a genuine smile. "No, friend. This is simply a different magic focus, similar to my staff." The smile fades little by little. "It differs only in its application." Looking at Sanders now, you doubt he's used the hammer in a while. [flags.SANDERS_TALK_ORDER|Five years ago it was that he retired, he said.|You'll have to ask him a little about himself later.] You can see a faint light glowing within and have to wonder if it's coming from him or the weapon. Your question is answered as he raises the hammer and begins to pray, a shimmering golden aura covering his hands and radiating outwards to his entire body, encasing him in what you would swear looks like armor. Looking closer, you wonder if your eyes are playing tricks on you — it looks as if Sanders' eyes are aflame... "O Lumia, lay your most sacrosanct of blessings upon your paladin," he murmurs. "It is in your name that we set forth, in your name that we seek out corruption, in your name that we expel evil." Sanders takes his other hand from Brint's breastplate and wraps it around the handle of the hammer, his knuckles whitening as he strains to hold it. For the merest of moments — you see something arise from Sanders. A wispy figure made of light, contained in a suit of fullplate and drawing a massive warhammer back. It swings with an unearthly speed and — "—" Sanders whispers indistinctly. "Et-" The last syllable of the incantation is cut off by an enormous explosion. Every single window in the chapel shatters, the glass blowing outwards, the paintings on the walls shredded to bits in an instant, a whirlwind of air tearing through the building with such magnitude you can scarcely breathe — Then you're sitting on your pew in a wholly undamaged chapel, looking around before a nonplussed Brint suddenly reaches forward to grab the priest. His breastplate falls free, coming loose and hitting the ground. By the time you've reached the two of them to support Sanders, the armor has faded away to nothing more than dust in the eerie wind sweeping through the church. "Hah," Sanders grunts as you gingerly place him in a pew, still clinging to his hammer. "I'd half-expected that not to work. Lumia..." After a few seconds during which he seems to be very far away, he turns his head back towards Brint, just a concerned old man. "And you, friend? Are you well?" he asks. "Fitter than ever," Brint says, grinning. "Thank you, Brother. I feel better already." "I'm glad," Sanders says with a gentle smile. "That is, after all, what we fought for. Now," he continues, slowly getting back to his feet. "I think I'm going to rest a while." "You've certainly earned it," you say, helping him up and making to leave. "Thank you, Brother Sanders. You've saved my friend's life." "Of course," he says, chuckling. "Remember, any time you need healing or guidance, I will be here for you. But perhaps not in the next six or seven hours — I do need some sleep." Collecting your things and checking Brint over, you walk towards the door after Brint. "Ah, and [pc.name]," Sanders calls after you. "I would appreciate it if we did not talk of the ritual. Some things are... better left buried." Giving him a respectful nod, you thank him once more and leave the chapel behind. "Hell," Brint grunts once you're outside. "If this was 15 years ago we could have just taken him with us. Show Kasyrra what for." You're inclined to agree. '

rows.original:
"Oh, hey, [pc.name]!" Brint calls. "Check it out."

    "You're back in your usual clothes," you say. "What happened to that golden armor?"
    
    "Weirdest thing, I woke up and it was just fuckin' gone," he says. "No trace of it in my room or anything."
    
    "Huh. When'd that happen?" you say.
    
    "Right after you set out for Khor'minos, pretty much," he says, scratching his head. "Weird, man. Well... whatever, I guess. I'll be glad to get some proper sleep and all."

    “差不多就是你在前往科尔米诺斯的路上之后吧，”他挠着头说，“真奇怪……算了，反正现在能好好睡一觉也不错。

This place has been abandoned for a looooong time." "Think your dad could be here?" you ask. Cait hesitates, peering through the gates. "Honestly? Yeah. This is exactly the sort of thing he'd do. If a caravan came here a hundred years ago, then clearly when he turns up another caravan will. Especially considering... yeah, this is the road to Tychris, and he really wanted to go there. No way he'd make it over the mountains without our cart and horse, though." [var1 |Actually he might not be wrong about that. Ah, I'm sure the cult's taken him. Poor Mister Raisin." She sighs and runs a hand through her bright-dyed hair. "I hope Dad's here. If not... the Marches are a really, really big place it turns out." [pc.bg hunter barbarian |"I'm pretty good at tracking," you offer. |You shrug helplessly. When you finally reach the main building, Cait's tail is wrapped around a leg, and she's clutching her staff tight to her chest. "I really hope he's here..." she whines, putting her hand against the door. One good push renders it open, revealing a tavern-like interior complete with bar and tables and even a stage, though all of them have been smashed to pieces or rotted away to skeletons with the passage of years. Great stone pillars hold up the sagging roof, likely the only reason this whole place hasn't collapsed in on itself after decades, maybe even centuries, without repair. And just as you're getting inside, everything explodes. Green flame erupts in a semi-circle before you, boxing you in against the door. Smoke billows into the high-posted ceiling, making you cough as your eyes water. "What the f-" A huge and ghostly image rises from the smog, a catfolk man dressed in flowing robes and a broad hat, carrying a staff encrusted with gemstones. A long, wispy beard flows from his chin, billowing in the whirlwind created by the flames. He addresses you with a booming voice, potent enough that you feel each syllable in your bones. "I AM BARNAPHOUS ZETHRA, WIZARD-LORD OF THE EASTERN DUNES." The wizard extends his staff and a blast of light shoots forth, creating a sun-bright blast just behind you. "TURN NOW AND FLEE, AND YOU MAY BE SPARED YOUR-" Cait pushes past you and cracks her staff on the ground. "Dad! It's me, Cait. Cut it out." The titan sputters, and when you blink, the fires gutter out as if they were never there. The great wizard looming above you becomes nothing but mist, blowing away to nothing as the smoke dissipates. And then a much more reasonably-sized, if heavyset, fellow shuffles out from behind the old curtain on the stage, adjusting a loose-fitting shirt and a small red cap clinging to his head between a pair of graying feline ears. He smiles at [party.som | |you both |your group ], "Caitriss! Ah, it's so good to see you, sweetheart. And your friend[party.som | | |s ], too." "Dad!" Cait cries, dropping her staff and running to her father's arms. The elder catfolk embraces her warmly, and for a moment their tails intertwine. Barnaphous is about the same height as his daughter, you note, huskily built with slightly darker skin and fur that might once have been a light brown, now largely gray. A short but full beard clings to his jowls, framing a smile so warm that it all but closes his eyes. His clothes are much more modest than Cait's, a full tunic and trousers, but the rich silks they're woven from [pc.bg noblescion |instantly tells you that he's from money, same as you. Probably high nobility. |speaks of wealth, but not overly flaunted. ] "I apologize for the smoke and mirrors," he says, stepping back with hands on his daughter's shoulders. "It's proven effective in warding off all these unnecessarily aggressive folk here in the valley. Centaurs and horse-people and a singularly topless mothfolk! I say, what's the world coming to?" rows.translation: [var0 |这里真是乱七八糟，”凯特说道，她透过破碎的大门望向商队旅馆的庭院。高高的草丛杂乱无章地生长在破碎的鹅卵石之间，从那些腐烂的驴车残骸和被踢开的侧门旁蜿蜒而过。天啊，这个地方已经被废弃很久很久了。” “你觉得你爸爸可能会在这里吗？”你问道。 凯特犹豫了一下，透过大门望去：“说实话，有可能。这种事正是他会干出来的。如果一百年前有一支商队来到过这里，那么现在再有一支商队出现也是理所当然的。尤其是考虑到……没错，这条路就是通往提克里斯的，而他确实非常想去那里。不过，如果没有我们的马车和马匹，他绝对不可能翻越那些山脉。" [var1 |其实他这么说也许并没有错。只是时机把握得不太好罢了；你应该想想，既然皇室专门派人来接你，他们怎么可能还会去接他呢……前提是那个商队真的在这个时间出现在这里的话。 ]不管你的马发生了什么事，总之我在雪地里根本没看到任何尸体。” 凯特眨了眨眼：“天啊，我根本没想过要去找它！啊，肯定是那个邪教组织把马带走了。可怜的莱辛先生……”她叹了口气，用手捋了捋自己那染得鲜艳的头发，“希望爸爸在这里。如果不在的话……原来边境地区真是大得惊人啊。 [pc.bg hunter barbarian |我挺擅长追踪目标的，”你说道。 |你无奈地耸了耸肩：“希望我们不需要这样做吧。 ] 凯特向你投来一个感激的微笑，从背后取下她的法杖，然后开始朝着主建筑的残余部分走去。你也将手放在了自己的[pc.weapon]然后跟着她进去。 [party.randComp brint brienne |啊，我对这件事有一种不好的预感，”布林特抱怨道。 |哦，我对这件事有种不好的预感，”布蕾妮抱怨道。 ] [party.has arona |阿罗娜笑着坐到你身边：“不知道那个妓女的老公是不是和她一样容易上床？以前从来没听说过有父女组合会这样……” “阿罗娜！”凯特气呼呼地说，“现在不是说这个的时候。而且，他根本不是你喜欢的类型……太喜欢魔法了。” “嗯……我们等着看吧。 ] 走到那扇大门其实需要走一段相当长的距离；这个庭院的规模确实足够大，至少可以容纳二十多辆重型的马车，而且路上还有几座侧厅——一间马厩，以及可能是一间仓库——你都必须经过它们。每当你经过其中的一座建筑时，凯特都会凑近门边，朝着敞开的门里喊：“喂？爸爸？”而你所能听到的，只有草丛和树叶在石头上沙沙作响的声音。 当你终于来到主楼时，凯特的尾巴缠在一条腿上，她紧紧地将法杖抱在胸前。“我真心希望他在这里……”她边说着，边将手放在门上。轻轻一推，门便打开了——里面是一间类似酒馆的场所，有吧台、桌子，甚至还有一个舞台，只不过这些设施都已经被岁月摧残得支离破碎，或者早已腐烂成骨架了。巨大的石柱支撑着那垂下来的屋顶，这或许正是为什么这个地方在几十年甚至几个世纪以来都没有在无人修缮的情况下倒塌的原因。 就在你刚走进去的时候，一切都发生了爆炸。 绿色的火焰在你面前呈半圆形迸发出来，将你逼到了门边。浓烟弥漫到高高的天花板上，让你不停地咳嗽，眼泪也忍不住流了出来。搞什么鬼……” 一片浓烟中浮现出一个巨大的、仿佛幽灵般的形象——一个身着飘逸长袍、头戴宽大帽子的猫族男子，手中握着一根镶嵌着宝石的法杖。他下巴上垂着一条长长的、纤细的胡须，在火焰卷起的旋风中飘扬着。他用一种充满力量的声音与你对话，那种声音如此有力，以至于你能感受到每一个音节都在你的骨子里回荡。 "我是巴纳法斯·泽斯拉，东方沙丘的巫师领主。巫师伸出法杖，一道光芒骤然射出，在你身后形成一道耀眼的光芒。现在就逃跑，或许还能保住性命……凯特从你身边挤过去，将她的法杖重重地摔在地上。“爸爸！是我，凯特。别这样了。” 那个巨人发出阵阵嘶哑的声音，而当你眨眼再看时，那些火焰已经熄灭了，仿佛从来就没有存在过。站在你上方的那位伟大巫师也化作了一团雾气，随着烟雾的消散而彻底消失了。 ]爸爸！”凯特哭喊着，扔掉手中的法杖，跑向父亲的怀抱。那位年长的猫族热情地拥抱了她，他们的尾巴在这一刻紧紧地缠在了一起。你会注意到，巴纳福斯的身高和他女儿差不多，体格魁梧，皮肤和毛发颜色略深，原本可能是浅棕色的，现在已经变成了灰色。他下巴上留着一撮短而浓密的胡须，那笑容如此温暖，仿佛让他都不想睁开眼睛。他的穿着比凯特要朴素得多——只穿着一件长袍和裤子，但这些衣物所用的丝绸质地极为精美。 Tall grass is growing in haphazard clumps between broken cobbles, weaving in between the remnants of rotting donkey-carts and kicked-in side doors. "Man. This place has been abandoned for a looooong time." "Think your dad could be here?" you ask. Cait hesitates, peering through the gates. "Honestly? Yeah. This is exactly the sort of thing he'd do. If a caravan came here a hundred years ago, then clearly when he turns up another caravan will. Especially considering... yeah, this is the road to Tychris, and he really wanted to go there. No way he'd make it over the mountains without our cart and horse, though." [var1 |Actually he might not be wrong about that. Just missed his timing, probably; you doubt the royal family will ferry him when they sent someone for you specifically. If said caravanner is around at this hour at all. ]"Whatever happened to your horse, anyway? I never saw a body in the snow." Cait blinks. "Holy Mallach, I never even thought to go looking for it! Ah, I'm sure the cult's taken him. Poor Mister Raisin." She sighs and runs a hand through her bright-dyed hair. "I hope Dad's here. If not... the Marches are a really, really big place it turns out." [pc.bg hunter barbarian |"I'm pretty good at tracking," you offer. |You shrug helplessly. "Hopefully we won't need to." ] Cait gives you an appreciative smile, grabs her staff off her back, and starts heading towards what remains of the main building. You set a hand on your [pc.weapon] and follow her in. [party.randComp brint brienne |"Ah, I got a bad feeling about this," Brint grumbles. |"Oh, I've got a bad feeling about this," Brienne grumbles. ] [party.has arona |Arona sidles up beside you with a grin. "Wonder if the harlot's old man is as fuckable as she is? Never claimed a father-daughter pair before." "Arona!" Cait huffs. "Not the time. Besides, he's not really your type. Too wizardy." "Ehhh. We'll see." ] It's a surprisingly long walk to the doors; the courtyard was built big enough to shelter two dozen heavy wagons at least, and there's a couple of side buildings — a stable and what might be a warehouse — you have to pass by on your way. When you walk by each of them, Cait leans towards it and shouts "Hello? Dad?" into its open doors. Your only response is the rustling of grass and leaves over the stones. When you finally reach the main building, Cait's tail is wrapped around a leg, and she's clutching her staff tight to her chest. "I really hope he's here..." she whines, putting her hand against the door. One good push renders it open, revealing a tavern-like interior complete with bar and tables and even a stage, though all of them have been smashed to pieces or rotted away to skeletons with the passage of years. Great stone pillars hold up the sagging roof, likely the only reason this whole place hasn't collapsed in on itself after decades, maybe even centuries, without repair. And just as you're getting inside, everything explodes. Green flame erupts in a semi-circle before you, boxing you in against the door. Smoke billows into the high-posted ceiling, making you cough as your eyes water. "What the f-" A huge and ghostly image rises from the smog, a catfolk man dressed in flowing robes and a broad hat, carrying a staff encrusted with gemstones. A long, wispy beard flows from his chin, billowing in the whirlwind created by the flames. He addresses you with a booming voice, potent enough that you feel each syllable in your bones. "I AM BARNAPHOUS ZETHRA, WIZARD-LORD OF THE EASTERN DUNES." The wizard extends his staff and a blast of light shoots forth, creating a sun-bright blast just behind you. "TURN NOW AND FLEE, AND YOU MAY BE SPARED YOUR-" Cait pushes past you and cracks her staff on the ground. "Dad! It's me, Cait. Cut it out." The titan sputters, and when you blink, the fires gutter out as if they were never there. The great wizard looming above you becomes nothing but mist, blowing away to nothing as the smoke dissipates. And then a much more reasonably-sized, if heavyset, fellow shuffles out from behind the old curtain on the stage, adjusting a loose-fitting shirt and a small red cap clinging to his head between a pair of graying feline ears. He smiles at [party.som | |you both |your group ], "Caitriss! Ah, it's so good to see you, sweetheart. And your friend[party.som | | |s ], too." "Dad!" Cait cries, dropping her staff and running to her father's arms. The elder catfolk embraces her warmly, and for a moment their tails intertwine. Barnaphous is about the same height as his daughter, you note, huskily built with slightly darker skin and fur that might once have been a light brown, now largely gray. A short but full beard clings to his jowls, framing a smile so warm that it all but closes his eyes. His clothes are much more modest than Cait's, a full tunic and trousers, but the rich silks they're woven from [pc.bg noblescion |instantly tells you that he's from money, same as you. Probably high nobility. |speaks of wealth, but not overly flaunted. ] "I apologize for the smoke and mirrors," he says, stepping back with hands on his daughter's shoulders. "It's proven effective in warding off all these unnecessarily aggressive folk here in the valley. Centaurs and horse-people and a singularly topless mothfolk! I say, what's the world coming to?" He shakes his head with a laugh and pats Cait. "Have you been well, sweetie? Things seem rather dangerous around these parts! [cait.thicknessRange 40 |Ah, but I see you've been eating well, at least! |[cait.cupRange EE |My, you've, uh, filled out quite a bit, my dear. rows.original: Several emotionally-charged minutes later... You're sitting nearby, listening to the last sniffling sobs emanating from your catgirl [cait.fucked|concubine|companion] into her father's chest. Barnaphous has his arms tight around her, stroking Cait's hair. He's a bit teary-eyed as well, but with the fleeting ray of hope Evergreen gave you delivered along with the tragic disappearance of his younger child, he hasn't taken the news as badly as Cait has for retelling it. When he's finally able to peel Cait off of his tear-streaked shirt, the elder catfolk turns his attentions to you. "I understand I have much to thank you for, [pc.mascFem|sir|madam]. You did your best to save [silly|Callabaster Chimes|Calladona] when no one else would lift a finger. The markings of a true hero, that. My sweet Caitriss would certainly have been lost without you... and it would have been much longer before we reunited. So thank you, from the bottom of my heart." He stands up, helping Cait up along after him. "I am Lord Barnaphous Zethra, Magister of Jassira... but my friends may just call me Barney. And I'm sure we're going to be fast friends, you and I." The wizard extends a hand to you invitingly. "[pc.name]." You [pc.dcb|give it a firm, brisk shake. "Pleasure's mine, old timer."|shake it warmly. "A pleasure. Cait's told me a lot about you."|shake it, and use the opportunity to pull the chubby kitty-man into a great big squishy hug. "Best friends forever!"]
rows.translation: 情绪激荡的几分钟后…… 你坐在附近，听着猫女[cait.fucked|爱妾|同伴]埋在父亲胸前发出最后几声抽泣。巴纳福斯紧紧搂着她，轻抚凯特的头发。他的眼中也泛着些许泪光，不过，你在告知小女儿不幸失踪的消息时，也带来了常青女士给予的那一线短暂希望，因此他的反应并不像重新讲述此事的凯特那般悲痛。 等他终于将凯特从自己泪痕斑斑的衬衫前拉开，年长的猫人转而将注意力放到你身上。“我明白，自己有许多事情需要感谢您，[pc.mascFem|先生|女士]。旁人都不肯伸出援手时，您竭尽全力想要拯救[silly|卡拉巴斯特·风铃|卡拉多娜]。这正是真正英雄的标志。没有您，我亲爱的凯特丽丝肯定也会失踪……而我们重逢的时间还会推迟更久。所以，我从心底感谢您。” 他站起身，也扶着凯特一起起来。“我是巴纳福斯·泽斯拉勋爵，贾西拉魔导师……不过，朋友们只管叫我巴尼。我相信，你我很快就会成为朋友。”法师主动向你伸出手。 “[pc.name]。”你[pc.dcb|有力而干脆地握住他的手。“荣幸属于我，老家伙。”|热情地与他握手。“幸会。凯特跟我说过许多关于你的事。”|握住他的手，趁机将这个胖乎乎的猫人拉进一个又大又柔软的拥抱。“永远都是最好的朋友！”]
rows.raw: ' Several emotionally-charged minutes later... You're sitting nearby, listening to the last sniffling sobs emanating from your catgirl [cait.fucked|concubine|companion] into her father's chest. Barnaphous has his arms tight around her, stroking Cait's hair. He's a bit teary-eyed as well, but with the fleeting ray of hope Evergreen gave you delivered along with the tragic disappearance of his younger child, he hasn't taken the news as badly as Cait has for retelling it. When he's finally able to peel Cait off of his tear-streaked shirt, the elder catfolk turns his attentions to you. "I understand I have much to thank you for, [pc.mascFem|sir|madam]. You did your best to save [silly|Callabaster Chimes|Calladona] when no one else would lift a finger. The markings of a true hero, that. My sweet Caitriss would certainly have been lost without you... and it would have been much longer before we reunited. So thank you, from the bottom of my heart." He stands up, helping Cait up along after him. "I am Lord Barnaphous Zethra, Magister of Jassira... but my friends may just call me Barney. And I'm sure we're going to be fast friends, you and I." The wizard extends a hand to you invitingly. "[pc.name]." You [pc.dcb|give it a firm, brisk shake. "Pleasure's mine, old timer."|shake it warmly. "A pleasure. Cait's told me a lot about you."|shake it, and use the opportunity to pull the chubby kitty-man into a great big squishy hug. "Best friends forever!"]'

rows.original: "So why're you here, Barney?" you ask. "Doesn't look like there's much left of this place." He laughs heartily. "Waiting, mostly! You're right, the caravanserai isn't much to look at now, but once upon a time, this was part of the great northern caravan route that connected the Belharan Heartland to the Marches, and even beyond! There's a great deal of history buried in the bones of this structure, my dear [pc.name]. Of course, the primary reason I'm here is the perhaps-foolish hope that there will be a caravan passing through soon. This is still the only road between Hawkethorne and Tychris, as far as any map shows, and I do so want to get to the city of mirrors!" Cait sighs and laughs with him. "You've been waiting here this whole time trying to hitchhike?" "Well, I was waiting for you and the cart to pass by. But when you never came, I simply assumed you'd gone on to Tychris ahead of me — and I'm not about to walk all that way by myself. Even I'm canny enough to realize that the land's much too dangerous to go it alone, indeed I am!" "And you didn't think to wait in town like a normal person?" Barney sputters, "W-well look here, Caitriss, this caravanserai is so full of history! A much more interesting place to stay than a musty backwater hamlet that smells of sodden lupine..." "Hawkethorne's really nice!" Cait protests. "The town elder's a good man, and I delivered eight whole grandkids for him right after the blizzard! It's a little podunk, sure, but the people there are so rustic. You should give them a chance." [party.has brint|"It is a little musty though," Brint grins." Cait snickers. "Now that you're there, big guy, yeah it is!"]
rows.translation: “你为什么会在这里，巴尼？”你问道。“这里看起来可没剩下多少东西。” 他爽朗地大笑起来。“主要是在等人！你说得没错，这座商旅驿站现在其貌不扬，可很久以前，这里曾是北方商路的一部分；那条大道将贝尔哈兰腹地与边疆相连，甚至延伸到更遥远的地方！亲爱的[pc.name]，这座建筑的骨架里埋藏着大量历史。当然，我待在这里的主要原因，是抱着一个或许有些愚蠢的希望：很快会有商队途经此地。从任何地图来看，这依然是鹰棘镇与提克里斯之间唯一的道路，而我实在太想去镜之城了！” 凯特叹了口气，与他一起笑起来。“所以，你一直待在这里，就是为了搭顺风车？” “好吧，我原本在等你们的马车经过。可是你们迟迟没有出现，我便以为你们已经先我一步去了提克里斯——而我绝不会独自走完那么远的路。就连我也精明到足以明白，这片土地太过危险，实在不适合单独旅行；确实如此！” “你就没想过像个正常人一样，在镇里等着吗？” 巴尼结结巴巴地反驳：“那、那个，你听我说，凯特丽丝，这座商旅驿站里充满了历史！比起一座散发着湿漉漉狼族气味、又霉又偏僻的小村庄，这里可有趣多了……” “鹰棘镇真的很好！”凯特抗议道。“镇上的长老是个好人，而且暴风雪过后，我还一口气替他生了八个孙辈！那里确实有点偏僻，可居民们都很质朴。你应该给他们一次机会。” [party.has brint|“不过，那里的确有一点霉味。”布林特咧嘴笑道。 凯特窃笑起来。“现在有你这个大家伙待在那里，当然有啦！”]

rows.original: What's Barney been doing here in an old ruins for weeks?
rows.translation: 巴尼在这片古老的废墟里待了好几周，他到底在干什么呢？
rows.raw: "What's Barney been doing here in an old ruins for weeks?"

rows.original:
"Wait, you said you were a lord...?"

        "Hmm? Oh, well, yes," Barney laughs, adjusting his cap. "My wife, Randa, is the state treasurer for Sultana Nadia El-Qesirren — that being the ruler of Jassira, of course. A very old and powerful family, Randa's! I myself am just a second son of a noble house, more of a tinkerer than a statesman, but my wife's position necessitates the lordly title, yes. Yes indeed!"
        
        You quirk a brow. "I thought Cait's mom was from the temple..."
        
        "Oh, she is! My beloved Nadira is by far the most beautiful and renowned woman to serve in the Great Temple of Mallach. Descended from northern royalty, she is! Oh! I see where the confusion may have come from — I suppose Caitriss never mentioned my noble wife, hmm?"
        
        "I... I don't really know her," Cait shrugs. "Lady Randa just... never came up."
        
        Barney just chuckles. "It's quite alright, sunflower. It's unfortunate, but my two families have precious little opportunity to interact. In truth, I was hoping that once our tour of the western continent had come to an end, Caitriss and Calladona would come to live in my estate, but..."
        
        "So, wait..." you rub your chin, glancing between the wizard and his daughter. "Cait's nobility? Royalty, even?"
        
        "Er... n-not really, no," Cait says, shifting her weight around. "I've got royal blood, I guess, but Jassira conquered that blood's land five generations back. My several-greats-grandmother and all but the eldest of the king's daughters were enslaved and given over to Mallach by the sultan of the time. And daughters born to the Temple's harlots don't automatically inherit their fathers' noble titles. We're... destined to continue at the Temple unless our fathers acknowledge us in the court."
        
        Barney snorts and waves his hand. "Nobility, royalty, all a bunch of nonsense if you ask me. Never let some stuffy old tradition tell you what you are or can be, my sweet. You're smarter than nine-tenths of the airheaded noble brats I've tutored. Just wait until we get home, and you and your sister will live as indulgently as the princesses themselves. No daughter of mine will be treated like some godling's property!"
        
        The wizard reaches over and pulls Cait over, squeezing her into his arms. "Neither Randa nor the Sultana herself will ever convince me that you're lesser than I am. You're oh so very much more than I'll ever be, Caitriss."
        
        "Aw, Dad! Come on..."
rows.translation:
“等等，你说你是位领主……？”

        “嗯？哦，对，没错，”巴尼笑着整了整帽子，“我的妻子兰达是苏丹娜·纳迪娅·埃尔-凯西伦的财政大臣——苏丹娜当然就是贾西拉的统治者。兰达出身于一个非常古老而显赫的家族！我自己只是一个贵族家庭的次子，与其说是政治家，不如说是个爱捣鼓东西的人，但我妻子的身份让我必须拥有这个领主头衔，没错，确实如此！”
        
        你挑了挑眉毛。“我以为凯特的妈妈是神庙出身……”
        
        “哦，她确实是！我亲爱的纳迪拉，绝对是马拉克大神殿里最美貌、最负盛名的女人。她可是北方王族的后裔！哦！我明白这误会是怎么来的了——我猜凯特丽丝从没提过我那位高贵的妻子，对吧？”
        
        “我……我其实不太认识她，”凯特耸了耸肩，“兰达夫人只是……从来没被提起过。”
        
        巴尼只是轻笑。“没关系的，向日葵。虽然有些遗憾，但我这两个家庭实在难得有来往的机会。说实话，我本来希望等我们结束西大陆的巡演之后，就让凯特丽丝和卡拉多娜搬来我的庄园住，可是……”
        
        “那么，等等……”你摸着下巴，目光在巫师和他女儿之间来回移动，“凯特是贵族？甚至是王族？”
        
        “呃……其、其实不算吧，”凯特说着，身体不安地挪了挪，“我确实有王室血统，这没错，但贾西拉在五代之前就征服了那片血统所属的土地。我的几位高祖母，以及国王所有女儿中除长女以外的所有人，都被当时的苏丹奴役，献给了马拉克。而神庙妓女生下的女儿，并不会自动继承她们父亲的贵族头衔。我们……注定要留在神庙里，除非父亲们在宫廷上承认我们。”
        
        巴尼哼了一声，摆了摆手。“贵族、王族，在我看来全是一派胡言。别让那些陈腐的旧传统规定你是什么、能成为什么，我的宝贝。你比我教过的那群没脑子的贵族崽子中十分之九的人都要聪明。等我们回到家，你和你妹妹就能像公主们一样尽情享受生活。我的女儿，绝不会被当成什么神裔的财产！”
        
        巫师伸手把凯特拉过来，紧紧搂进怀里。“无论是兰达还是苏丹娜本人，都别想让我相信你比我低一等。你比我所能成为的一切都要优秀得多，凯特丽丝。”
        
        “哎呀，爸爸！别这样……”

rows.original: Wait, did he say he was a Lord?
rows.translation: 等等，他刚才说自己是个领主吗？
rows.raw: "Wait, did he say he was a Lord?"

rows.original:
[pc.bg arcanist|"That was interesting showmanship," you comment, indicated the flash-burnt bits of wood nearby. "Mixing illusions and stage magic together. You must have some experience with the Art.|"That was impressive magic earlier..." you comment, indicated the flash-burnt bits of wood nearby. "You must be a powerful wizard!]"

        Barney and Cait both snicker, exchanging a glance. Did you say something funny?
        
        "Oh, well, I'm not much of a magician. As my beloved Nadira likes to say, I'm the most major of the minor prestidigitators — I command but a few measly cantrips I've picked up along the way. No, my friend, most of what you saw was tricks of the light and a little flash powder I picked up in Dearra. I've had all too much free time here to set up that little spectacle to keep away the angry wildlife — and the centaurs, too. Very aggressive bunch!"
        
        "Yeah," Cait adds, rubbing her dad's shoulder. "I'm pretty sure I've got more magic in my tail than dad's got altogether. But he's the one that inspired me to learn in the first place... well, more than the rituals the Temple taught us anyway. I'll always remember the way he'd conjure light and shadow all over the walls of our bedroom when we'd go to sleep, making shapes of heroes and monsters... oh, the stories you'd make up for us..."
        
        Barney just smirks and adjusts his cap.
rows.translation:
[pc.bg arcanist|“这场表演很有意思。”你指着附近被闪焰烧焦的木片评论道，“把幻术和舞台戏法混在一起——看来你对魔法之道颇有经验。”|“刚才的魔法真令人印象深刻……”你指着附近被闪焰烧焦的木片评论道，“你一定是位强大的巫师！”]

        巴尼和凯特相视一眼，都窃笑起来。你说了什么好笑的话吗？
        
        “哦，其实我算不上什么魔法师。正如我亲爱的纳迪拉常说的，我只是小把戏师里最厉害的那个——会的不过是旅途中零星学来的几手小法术。不，朋友，你刚才看到的大多只是光影把戏，再加上一点我从迪拉弄来的闪光粉。我困在这里的空闲时间实在太多，足够布置那场小表演，用来吓退暴躁的野兽——也包括半人马。那帮家伙可凶得很！”
        
        “是啊。”凯特揉着父亲的肩膀补充道，“我敢说，我尾巴里的魔力都比爸爸全身加起来多。不过最初激励我学习魔法的人就是他……至少，比神殿教我们的那些仪式更能打动我。我永远记得小时候入睡前，他会让光影布满卧室的墙壁，变成英雄和怪物的模样……哦，还有你给我们编的那些故事……”
        
        巴尼只是咧嘴一笑，扶正了帽子。

rows.original: What was that magic he was weaving when you walked in?

rows.raw: "What was that magic he was weaving when you walked in?"

rows.original:
"We should get back to Hawkethorne," you suggest. "[pc.dcb|Come on, old man.|You should come with us, Barney.|C'mon best friend, let's go together!]"

        "Oh! Uh, well, what about Tychris?" Barney gasps. "I might miss the caravan-"
        
        Cait sighs. "Dad! There's no caravan coming through here. Ever. You're going to be lucky if you find a trader to take you that way in town. But how can you even be thinking of leaving? Calla's gone missing. We've got to find a way to save her!"
        
        "Caitriss. Weren't you listening to Lady Evergreen. Or to yourself?" Barney puts his hands on her shoulders, making Cait look him in the eye. "The portal's closed, dear. We can't open it ourselves. It may not open for another year. Sitting here moping won't help your sister, but venturing out and consulting with the mages of Tychris and other cities of the north may yet provide some clues. They might! So keep a stiff upper lip, my sweet! We'll do what we can on our side, learn as much as we can, and be ready to come get her when the portal opens again. Hmm?"
        
        He's certainly taking this well. You're not sure if Barney here is a beacon of optimism or just doesn't understand the demonic threat. 
        
        Before you can dwell on the question too much, you've already exited the old caravanserai, followed by Barney and [party.som||Cait|your companions]. 
        
        And somebody's waiting for you outside. Several somebodies.
rows.translation:
“我们该回鹰棘镇了。”你提议道，“[pc.dcb|走吧，老头。|巴尼，你应该跟我们一起走。|走吧，挚友，我们一起回去！]”

        “哦！呃，可提克里斯怎么办？”巴尼倒吸一口气，“我可能会错过商队——”
        
        凯特叹了口气。“爸爸！根本不会有商队经过这里，永远不会。你到了镇上以后，要是能找到愿意捎你过去的商人就算走运了。可你怎么还想着离开？卡拉失踪了，我们必须想办法救她！”
        
        “凯特里丝。你没听常青女士说吗？还是连自己说过的话也忘了？”巴尼双手按住她的肩膀，让凯特直视自己。“亲爱的，传送门已经关闭了。我们凭自己打不开它，而且它也许要一年以后才会再次开启。坐在这里闷闷不乐救不了你姐姐；出去请教提克里斯以及北方其他城市的法师，倒还有可能找到线索。真的有可能！所以振作起来吧，亲爱的！我们会在外面尽己所能，尽量查明更多事情；等传送门再次开启，我们就能准备好去接她了。好吗？”
        
        他接受得可真快。你不知道眼前的巴尼究竟是乐观精神的灯塔，还是根本没有理解恶魔的威胁。
        
        你还没来得及细想，就已经离开了老旧的商队驿站；巴尼和[party.som||凯特|你的同伴们]跟在身后。
        
        外面有人在等你，而且还不止一个。
rows.raw:
"
        "We should get back to Hawkethorne," you suggest. "[pc.dcb|Come on, old man.|You should come with us, Barney.|C'mon best friend, let's go together!]"

        "Oh! Uh, well, what about Tychris?" Barney gasps. "I might miss the caravan-"
        
        Cait sighs. "Dad! There's no caravan coming through here. Ever. You're going to be lucky if you find a trader to take you that way in town. But how can you even be thinking of leaving? Calla's gone missing. We've got to find a way to save her!"
        
        "Caitriss. Weren't you listening to Lady Evergreen. Or to yourself?" Barney puts his hands on her shoulders, making Cait look him in the eye. "The portal's closed, dear. We can't open it ourselves. It may not open for another year. Sitting here moping won't help your sister, but venturing out and consulting with the mages of Tychris and other cities of the north may yet provide some clues. They might! So keep a stiff upper lip, my sweet! We'll do what we can on our side, learn as much as we can, and be ready to come get her when the portal opens again. Hmm?"
        
        He's certainly taking this well. You're not sure if Barney here is a beacon of optimism or just doesn't understand the demonic threat. 
        
        Before you can dwell on the question too much, you've already exited the old caravanserai, followed by Barney and [party.som||Cait|your companions]. 
        
        And somebody's waiting for you outside. Several somebodies."

rows.original: A pack of centaurs have marched through the gates, huge horse-men with sweat-sheened chests bulging with muscles... and hanging equine cocks swinging free beneath their massive bodies, half-engorged with perpetual, corrupted arousal. They're all blatantly nude, armed with a motley mix of cudgels and spears. "O-oh dear," Barney gasps. "Um. Perhaps we should get back inside..." "Your parlor tricks won't save you this time, wizard!" the leader of the pack bellows, scraping his front hooves on the cobblestones. "Now we've got a witch of our own!" He jerks a thumb to a woman riding side-saddle on his back. Her voluptuous figure is clad in a crimson coat and tall fuck-me boots with prominent heels. A wide-brimmed red hat rests atop her head, perforated by a pair of perky brown ears mottled with black, and a long bushy tail of the same coloration wags eagerly off the other side of the centaur's backside. Now that you look, you can see fur sticking up under her long black gloves and leather boots. Besides those animalistic traits, she seems largely human, with rich caramel skin and black lips twisted into a sadistic little grin. She slides down off the back of the centaur, and when her feet hit the ground a thick stream of white cream, still steaming fresh, spills down her thigh from under her pant leg and pools underfoot. Her steed chuckles and thrusts a hand down the back of her pants, forcefully enough to make her rock forward, and leak more of his seed onto the ground. With a grunt of effort, she thrusts back on his hand and draws a long, curved bronze blade off her hip, giving it a whirl that might be rather threatening if she wasn't impaled on the centaur's thick digits and drooling his cum. "What cheap brothel did they drag you out of?" Cait huffs, stepping and whirling her staff — first over one shoulder, then the other, before catching it under an arm and charging the head of it with white fire. "Come on, even a first-year student can sword-dance better than that." The half-hyena woman barks a sharp peal of laughter, thrusting her sword out towards your priestess in a mock duelist's challenge. "My new husbands collared me juuuust for you!" she says between laughs, tugging at a tight leather choker around her neck. A leash chains it to her corrupted steed's gauntlet. "After they broke me, master said that if I unweave some spells, they'd let me keep the wizard that wove 'em. I was expecting a cute boy to sheathe my clit in. You'll do even better, pink-hair!" Barney looks worriedly between his daughter and you. "W-what did they do to that girl?" The lead centaur takes a forceful step forward, raising the mace in his hand threateningly. "You're gonna find out soon enough, old man. You can watch us break in your girlie there. Then we get to you." [party.has arona|Barney starts to stammer something, but Arona shoulders her way past him and hefts her hammer up. "Back off, horsemeat. You ain't breakin in shit while I'm around." "A-Arona?" Cait gasps from behind the she-orc. "What's gotten into you?" Your amazonian bodyguard snarls. "I ain't letting any fuckbeast collar you before I do." "Ha! There's the orc I know." Beside you, Barney's sputtering and raising his hand up, conjuring a flickering candle's worth of flame. | "H-how dare you!" Barney sputters, raising up his hands and conjuring a candle's worth of flame. "Nobody threatens my daughter like that!"] Cait puts a hand on his wrist, gently lowering it, and steps up ahead of him with staff held at the ready. "You go take cover, dad!" she says, stoking radiant whitefire to wreathe the gemstone in her staff's head. "Just watch. [pc.name] and I have this!"
rows.translation: 一队半人马从城门处涌了进来——这些高大的马人身上汗水淋漓，肌肉虬结的胸膛在阳光下闪闪发光……他们巨大的身躯下方，悬挂着那些半勃起的马阴茎，仿佛永远处于亢奋状态。他们全都赤裸着上身，手中拿着各式各样的棍棒和长矛。 哦，天哪，”巴尼惊呼道，“嗯，也许我们应该回到屋里去……” “这次你的把戏可救不了你，巫师！”狼群的首领咆哮道，它的前爪在鹅卵石上刮出了刺耳的声音，“现在我们也有自己的女巫了！ 他用拇指指向骑在他背上的那位女子。她那丰满的身姿穿着一件深红色的外套，脚上穿着高跟靴子，鞋跟十分醒目。她头上戴着一顶宽边红帽，帽子上有一对棕色耳朵，耳朵上还点缀着黑色的斑点；而在半人马的背部另一侧，还摇动着一条同样颜色、浓密的长尾巴。仔细看的话，你会发现她那双黑色长手套和皮靴下面露出了毛发。除了这些动物般的特征外，她看起来还是非常像人类——拥有深棕色的皮肤，黑色的嘴唇微微上扬，露出一种残忍而略带讽刺的笑容。 她从半人马的背上滑下来，当她的双脚触地时，一股浓稠的白色乳状物——仍然冒着热气——从她的裤腿下方流了出来，汇聚在她脚边。她的坐骑轻声笑了起来，还用手在她的裤腿后面用力一抹，这一下让她向前倾倒，更多的精液就这样洒在了地上。她使出吃奶的力气，用力推开他的手，然后从腰间抽出一把长长的、弯曲的青铜刀，挥舞起来。如果她没有被半人马的粗壮手指刺住，也没有在它的精液中昏昏沉沉的话，这一招恐怕会显得相当具有威胁性。 他们到底是从哪家破妓院里找来的？你这算什么？”凯特气呼呼地说，一边走一边旋转着手中的法杖——先把它甩到一边肩膀上，再甩到另一边肩膀上，然后把它夹在臂下，用白色的火焰向法杖的顶端冲去。“拜托，就连一个一年级学生也能跳出比这更好的剑舞啊。那个半鬣狗形态的女人发出尖锐的笑声，将剑指向你的女祭司，仿佛在模仿决斗者的姿态发起挑战。“我的新丈夫们可是因为你才给我戴上了这个项圈呢！”她边笑边说着，拉了拉自己脖子上的那条紧绷的皮制项圈。一条皮带将它系在那匹被腐蚀了的骏马的护手之上。“他们把我弄坏之后，主人说如果我能解开一些咒语，他们就会允许我留下那个编织这些咒语的巫师。我原本以为会是一个可爱的男孩来帮我恢复……你做得甚至更好，红发女孩！巴尼忧心忡忡地望着他的女儿和你，问道：“他们到底对那个女孩做了什么？” 为首的半人马猛地向前迈了一步，手中举着长矛，显得十分威胁。老头子，你很快就会知道的。你可以看着我们闯进你那个女人所在的地方，然后我们就来对付你。 [party.has arona|巴尼开始结结巴巴地说些什么，但阿罗娜挤过他，举起了她的锤子。“退开，马肉！有我在，你什么也破坏不了。” “阿、阿罗娜？”凯特在那个兽人女子身后惊呼道。你到底怎么了？” 你的亚马逊式保镖怒吼道：“在我之前，绝对不会让任何混蛋抓住你。” “哈！这才是我认识的那个兽人啊。” 在你身边，巴尼正结结巴巴地说着，同时举起手来，召唤出了一簇摇曳的火焰——那火焰的大小，大概只有一支蜡烛那么大。 | 你、你竟敢这样！”巴尼气得结结巴巴，举起双手，凝聚出一簇仅相当于一支蜡烛大小的火焰，“没有人有资格那样威胁我的女儿！] 凯特把手放在他的手腕上，轻轻地将他的手臂放下来，然后拿着法杖走在他的前面。“你快去找个地方躲起来吧，爸爸！”她说着，点燃了法杖顶端的白色火焰，让火焰环绕着法杖顶端的宝石。“只要看着就好。 [pc.name]而且我还有这个！

rows.original: Now that Cait's found her dad, it's time to head back.
rows.translation: 现在凯特已经找到了她的父亲，是时候回家了。
rows.raw: "Now that Cait's found her dad, it's time to head back."

rows.original: "F-fuck! Back to the hills, flee!" the pack's leader bellows, rearing up on his hind legs and desperately wheeling for the gates. The half-conscious gnoll at the end of his leash gasps, collar pulled tight. When the centaurs start galloping off, she's thrown to the ground and dragged along behind them, gagging and grasping at what's become a noose around her neck. "Not so fast!" Cait snarls, spinning her staff around and hurling a bolt of divine fire after the fleeing horse-men. The bolt sears through the leather leash, snapping it in half; the poor gnoll witch rolls to a stop twenty paces past where she'd started, dazed and gasping for breath. If her corrupted master even notices he's been robbed, he clearly doesn't care: the pack breaks through the caravanserai's gates and makes for the hills as fast as their legs can carry them. "And don't come back!" Barney adds, patting Cait on the shoulder. "Bravo, my sweetling! I never imagined my darling little sunflower could muster such violence. My, but you have grown since we've been apart, yes indeed!" Cait gives him a little smile and couches her staff under an arm, blowing out the flickering remnants of her white fire, and starts walking towards the collapsed figure in the middle of the courtyard. "Now I kinda feel bad about that brothel comment. What did those brutes do to her?" You follow the catgirl over as she takes a knee besides the gagging gnoll. This time, rather than searing flames, Cait conjures healing light around her hand and presses it against the girl's neck. "Mallach preserve this poor, broken thing... let her pains and suffering be eased by-" Mid-prayer, the halfbreed rolls onto her side and vomits up a stream of white all over the cobblestones — enough to make even Cait recoil. When it passes, the girl's eyes roll back in her head, and she passes out entirely. "That... I should have expected that from a whole pack of centaur men," Cait sighs. "[var0|Even after you saved their village, I guess there's still some that refuse to see the light. Just one more reason to get rid of this cult and their darkness!|We really need to do something about these bastards. So much corruption running rampant.]" Barney finally catches up a moment later, doffing his cap and looking down with concern. "Oh my... but Caitriss, don't those clothes look familiar?" "What?" Cait blinks, glancing down at the red tunic and boots, and the discarded bronze sword. "Oh, yeah... just like Calla used to wear. They're not her clothes, dad, Calla wore a skirt and I don't think she'd fit in that top, but... it is pretty close, yeah. And I gotta admit, her fighting style kinda reminded me of Calla too. She really did love that spellblade you bought her in Zhenna. Gods, now I feel even sorrier for this girl." Cait sighs, then passes her staff and the gnoll's bronze sword off to her dad. "Okay, okay... let's bring her back to town and get her cleaned up. And you're coming with us, dad! No excuses!" "Oh, very well. My plans for Tychris can be put on hold a while for you, sweetling."
rows.translation: 他妈的！快逃回山里去！”狼群的首领发出怒吼，用后腿站立起来，拼命朝大门方向跑去。 被绳子牵着的那个半昏迷状态的豺狼发出喘息声，它的项圈被紧紧地拽住。当半人马们开始飞奔离去时，它被甩到地上，被拖在后面，不停地咳嗽着，同时拼命抓住缠绕在它脖子上的绳子。 别想这么容易就逃掉！”凯特怒吼着，旋转着手中的法杖，向那些逃窜的骑士们射出了一道神圣火焰。那道火焰灼烧着皮革制成的缰绳，将其直接烧成了两截；可怜的侏儒女巫在距离起点二十步的地方摔倒了，她头晕目眩，喘着粗气，根本无法继续逃跑。如果她那个腐败的主人哪怕注意到自己的东西被抢了，他显然也不会在意：那些劫匪冲破商队的营帐大门，以最快的速度向山区逃去。 “而且别想回来！巴尼拍了拍凯特的肩膀，说道：“太棒了，我的宝贝！我从来没想过我这个可爱的小向日葵竟能展现出这样的力量……哎呀，你真是拥有自从我们分开后，我确实成长了很多！” 凯特对他微微一笑，将法杖夹在臂下，吹灭了那团摇曳不定的白色火焰，然后开始朝着庭院中央那个倒下的身影走去。现在我有点后悔说了那句关于妓院的话。那些混蛋到底对她做了什么？” 你跟着那个猫女走了过去，她站在那个正在作呕的豺狼旁边单膝跪地。这一次，凯特并没有释放灼热的火焰，而是在手中凝聚出治愈之光，然后将它放在那个女孩的脖子上。马拉赫，请保佑这个可怜而受伤的孩子……让她的痛苦得以缓解吧——” 就在她祈祷的过程中，这个混血女孩突然侧翻过来，吐出一大口白色液体，溅得到了处的鹅卵石上——就连凯特看到这一幕，也不由得退后了几步。当那东西袭来时，女孩的眼睛翻白，彻底失去了意识。 “这种事……对于一整群半人马男人来说，我早该料到的。”凯特叹了口气说道。[var0|即使你拯救了他们的村庄，我想仍然会有一些人拒绝接受光明。这正是消灭这个邪教组织及其带来的黑暗势力的又一个理由！|我们真的必须对这些混蛋采取行动了。腐败现象已经变得如此猖獗。]过了一会儿，巴尼终于追上了他们，他摘下帽子，忧心忡忡地低头看着说道：“天啊……凯特，这些衣服看起来是不是很眼熟？” “什么？”凯特眨了眨眼，低头看了看那件红色束腰外衣、靴子，还有那把被丢弃的青铜剑。“哦，对……就像卡拉以前穿过的那样。这些衣服……应该不是她的吧。她衣服啊，爸爸，卡拉穿了条裙子，我觉得她穿那件上衣肯定不太合适，不过……也还差不多吧。而且我得承认，她的战斗风格确实让我想起了卡拉。她真的很喜欢你在珍娜那里给她买的那把法术剑。天啊，现在我想起来更加令人难过的是……就是为了这个女孩。” 凯特叹了口气，然后把她的法杖和那把诺尔的青铜剑交给了父亲。“好吧，好吧……我们把她带回城里，让她洗个澡，换身衣服。而且你一定要跟我们一起去，爸爸！没有商量的余地！” “哦，好吧。为了你，我关于提克里斯的计划可以暂时搁置一段时间了，亲爱的。

rows.original: An hour later... Cait emerges from the chapel of Velun with a smile, carrying a new pack tucked under an arm. "Brother Sanders [flags.LIADEN_SANDERS|and Liaden say|says] that the half-gnoll will be alright. She's been pretty roughed up and abused, but... well, at least physically, she'll heal up with some care. Sanders asked that I come back and check up on her when I can, said I have a 'comforting presence.' He's such a nice old guy." "Mmm, indeed," Barney says, still struggling not to pinch his nose closed. Some of the townsfolk, especially the lupines, give him funny looks from their porches and windows. "What do you have there, Caitriss?" Cait comes over and swats his hand down. "Her things. Sanders told me to throw them away, but... It'd just be a waste of good armor. And they really do remind me of Calla's. I think I can get the stink of centaur out with some washing." She puts a hand on the bronze blade now slung on her hip and grins. "Plus, this sword of hers is beautiful, and it's got a spellblade focus in the hilt. I think... I don't know what I'm thinking, but I know I want to keep it, at least until she recovers. rows.original:
"I'm glad you asked, [calise.fucked
        |darling
        |my friend
    ]! While you were breaking up those demonic smugglers, I've been doing some research with the help of the king's inner [silly
        |cow-ncil
        |council
    ]. Khor'minos is an incredibly ancient city, with roots all the way back to before Savarrans had even mastered bronze. But always, this city was gifted with exceptional shamans — priests, now, and paladins."
    
    As she's speaking, another group of Khor'minoan soldiers approach from the gates; you quickly recognize the small, slender figure of Isadora among them. The human legionnaire snaps a crisp salute to Calise, "Ay-ah, Champions. Reporting as ordered."
    
    [party.has brint
        |"Ay-ah, Isadora," Brint says, giving her a friendly smile.
    ]
    
    The Velunite claps a hand onto Isadora's slender shoulder. "At-ease, soldier. What's the word from the palace?"
    
    "The Pantheon has approved your request, Lady Calise, and the generals have agreed to step up patrols to cover your absence."
    
    "Excellent. Ah, but we've left poor [pc.name] in the dark — come, [calise.fucked
        |darling
        |my friend
    ], take a look at this."
    
    The paladin takes a scroll from one of her subordinates and unfurls it, revealing deeply yellowed, age-cracked parchment and a faded ink drawing of the mountains above. You recognize the Black Gates at their base, but at the top are several other structures — a Belharan bath house and a temple at the mountain's peak, and near the middle of the rise, a ring of structures altogether labeled the 'Grave of Saints.' Calise taps her finger on the name. 
    
    "Back when the metropolis of Khor'minos was nothing but a subterranean village, the primitive tribes that lived here buried their dead in great catacombs that still honeycomb the mountain. The most powerful and respected minotaurs, though, received temple-mausoleums built in their honor on the mountainside. My research has led me to believe that one of these crypts is dedicated to a minotaur woman named Persenne. Isadora, dear, do you remember the legend?"
    
    "Y-yes ma'am," the younger warrior stammers out. "Of course."
    
    There's a momentary pause before Calise chuckles and gestures at Isadora. "Well? You may not be a minotaur, but you're as Khor'minoan as anyone. Let's hear it from a native."

    就在她说话的时候，另一群科尔米诺斯的士兵从城门处走了过来；你立刻在他们中间认出了伊莎多拉那娇小纤细的身影。这名人类军团士兵向卡莉丝敬了一个标准的礼：“报告，冠军们。我已按命令前来报到。
    
    [party.has brint
        |哎呀，伊莎多拉，”布林特笑着说，露出了友好的笑容。
    ]
    
    维伦信徒轻轻拍了拍伊莎多拉纤细的肩膀：“别紧张，士兵。宫廷那边有什么消息吗？”
    
    “七神已经批准了你的请求，卡莉丝女士，各位将军也同意加强巡逻，以弥补你不在期间的空缺。”
    
    “太好了。啊，不过我们还是忘了照顾那位可怜的人[pc.name]一无所知——来吧， [calise.fucked
        |亲爱的
        |我的朋友
    ]来看看这个。”
    
    圣骑士从一名下属手中接过一份卷轴，将其展开。卷轴上的羊皮纸已经变得深黄且布满裂痕，上面用褪色的墨水绘制着山峦的轮廓。你可以认出山脚处就是那道黑色大门，但在山顶还有其他几座建筑——一座贝拉兰人的浴场，以及一座位于山顶的神庙；而在山体中部附近，还有一组被标记为“圣徒墓地”的建筑群。卡莉丝用手指轻轻敲着那个名字。
    
    “在很久以前，当科尔米诺斯这座大都市还只是一个地下村落的时候，生活在这里的原始部落会将他们的死者埋葬在那些巨大的地下墓穴中，而这些墓穴至今仍然遍布整座山脉之中。然而，那些最强大、最受尊敬的弥诺陶洛斯，却在山坡上获得了为他们建造的庙宇陵墓。我的研究让我相信，其中一座陵墓是专门为一位名叫珀尔森妮的弥诺陶洛斯女性而建的。伊莎多拉，亲爱的，你还记得那个传说吗？”

    一阵短暂的沉默之后，卡莉丝轻笑着，示意伊莎多拉继续说：“那么？你虽然不是弥诺陶洛斯，但你的血统和任何科尔米诺人一样，都是纯正的科尔米诺人。让我们听听本地人的说法吧。

rows.original: Isadora blushes. "O-of course, sorry. Persenne was the Great Shaman of the Minos tribe, the biggest of all the tribes in Undermountain, when a plague broke out. Not just any plague, but one that ate at the victims' very souls. Even if you survived, you came out the other end frothing mad. No magic could stem the spread of the sickness until even Persenne's own husband, the chieftain, succumbed to the madness. He nearly killed her before he was overpowered and chained by his warriors. The shamaness was overcome with grief, and went to the mountaintops to pray for her peoples' salvation." "She fasted for seven days, alone on the windy peaks, before finally collapsing from exposure. While she was unconscious, the legend goes, Persenne received a vision from Tira herself. The shamaness was offered a bargain: to accept Tira as her one and only goddess, that she must renounce her druidic faith, and in exchange Tira would give her the means to heal broken souls. Of course, she accepted, and Tira imbued Persenne's wedding ring with godly power. She returned to the tribe a changed woman, full of cold confidence, and healed her husband. I imagine she did the other Minos folk, too, because they made her the first High Priest of the city. Built themselves a Tiran temple over the old druids' circle at her command." Calise nods along. "And what happened to the ring?" "The Ring of Fate was buried with her and her husband, out in the Grave of Saints, per Tira's dictate." "So there you have it, [pc.name]," Calise says. "A ring that can heal wounded souls, buried just a few hours' walk from here. Given the circumstances, I've petitioned the city Pantheon for the right to go and retrieve it." Isadora frowns, biting a lip to keep from speaking out. [party.comp brint brienne |Brint grumbles, hoofing the floor. "I don't like this, [pc.name]. Persenne's a hero. This is grave robbing." |Brienne sighs, "I don't like the idea of grave robbing, but considering the circumstances..." ] "I know it's not going to be a popular course of action," Calise says, squeezing Isadora's shoulder, "but I won't stand by while [pc.name] and hundreds of our fellow warriors risk their souls when there's a way to stop the corruption within reach. Don't you think Persenne would want your people to use the ring if the plague came back?" The younger woman sighs. "I... I suppose you're right." "So! My dear Champion, consider this an optional step — I wouldn't be mad if you consider yourself above a little grave robbing — but I truly believe that in my hands, this ring could be even more powerful a tool than on Persenne's hand. Imagine if I could extend the ring's protection over the entire army? What if... what if I could use it to banish demons outright, or revert them to their mortal forms? Can you see why I'm so interested?"

rows.original: "Good! Then you and I shall go together and retrieve the Ring of Fate!" "We will?" Calise nods. "Of course! I've asked the king and his generals to run interference for us, to keep the demons distracted while we're away — but I'll need your help to make it to the Grave of Saints. "Safe travels, Champions," the minotaur soldiers with her say, thumping their breastplates. "Khor Aterna!" "Khor Aterna!" Calise shouts back, lifting her axe. Come and see me when I return, and we will discuss the next step in our campaign — eradicating the demons' breeding pits."

            Calise turns from you to Isadora, whispering something into the young soldier's ear before motioning for her and the minotaurs to head back into the city. The champion gives you another sidelong glance, as if waiting for you to change your mind, before hefting her axe onto her shoulder and marching past you towards the Undermountain road.

rows.translation: 为了得到一枚源自远古的神话戒指而去盗墓，这实在不像是值得你或卡莉丝花费时间去做的事情。
rows.raw: "Going grave robbing for a mythical ring out of ancient history doesn't really sound like a worthwhile use of your time or Calise's."

rows.original:
Isadora is waiting at the same post Calise usually maintains, peaking with a group of minoan soldiers that are kneeling down to her level. When she sees you coming, though, the young soldier immediately breaks off from her cohorts and comes running. "Champion! Thank the gods you've returned!"
    
    "Woah, slow down," you say. Your hands grab Isadora's shoulders before she can tackle you down. "What's wrong?"
    
    "It's the lady Calise! She's just returned from her quest, but... but she's badly wounded. Please, she's been asking for you. Come with me."
    
    Gods damn it. You nod, letting Isadora lead you towards the city gates. It's a short walk from the walls to a small apartment, decorated with warm orange paint and covered with luminescent fungal blooms around its windows. A pair of Chargers are standing at the door, grandhammers crossed protectively over it. They lift them as you approach, nodding wordlessly to Isadora as she takes you inside. There are more soldiers here, and several priests in Velun's green and Tira's black have all clustered around one of the inner doors. They part for you, murmuring discontentedly as Isadora pushes through to the bedchamber inside.
rows.translation:
伊莎多拉正在卡莉丝平时常驻的那个岗位上等待，她正与一群跪在她面前的米诺斯士兵交谈着。然而，当她看到你走过来时，那位年轻的士兵立刻从同伴们中间抽身出来，跑了过来。“冠军！感谢神明，你终于回来了！”
    
    “哇，慢一点，”你说道。在伊莎多拉试图扑倒你之前，你抓住了她的肩膀。“怎么了？”
    
    “是卡莉丝女士！她刚刚完成任务回来，但是……但是她受了重伤。求你了，她一直在找你。跟我来吧。”
    
    该死的。你点了点头，让伊莎多拉带你朝着城门走去。从城墙那里走到那套小公寓只需要短短的一段路，公寓的墙壁被涂成了温暖的橙色，窗户周围还开满了会发光的真菌。一对冲锋者站在门口，将巨锤交叉着挡在门前。当你靠近时，他们抬起了巨锤，在伊莎多拉领你进去时无声地向她点了点头。这里还有更多的士兵，以及几位身着维伦的绿色与蒂拉的黑色的祭司，他们全都聚集在其中一扇内门附近。他们为你让开道路，在伊莎多拉挤过去走进里面的卧室时不满地低声嘟囔着。

rows.original:
Calise is sitting in the bed, wearing a loose toga and a number of bandages around her stomach and shoulder. She's paler than you remember, lips chapped and ghostly; she's clearly lost a lot of blood. Still, she manages a wan smile, gesturing the pair of you in.

        "Ah, my dear Isadora, and my Champion. Thank you both for coming," she says, face scrunching in greater discomfort with every word. 
        
        "I'm afraid my mission... was a failure. A cultist assassin attacked me before I reached the tomb. It was all I could do to retreat, keeping the poison burning my veins at bay before she could finish me off. Other demons assaulted the Grave; no doubt they made off with anything of value inside. I am truly sorry for leading them to your peoples' heritage, Isadora."
        
        Isadora takes a knee beside the bed, wrapping her hands around Calise's. "I'm just glad you're okay, Lady Calise."
        
        The Champion chuckles — and immediately regrets the act, nearly doubling over in pain. "Ah! I will be, Isadora. Thank you for finding [pc.name] for me. Could you excuse us a moment?"
        
        "I... Alright, Champion." Isadora lowers her head and stands, retreating to the gathering of priests. 
        
        Calise shakes her head. "Poor girl. I'm afraid she's growing quite smitten with me. As for you, though: I am nearly well enough to walk again, but I'm afraid this injury will make the next step of our crusade a little more difficult. Still, this imp breeding farm must be destroyed at all costs. Come and see me at the usual place in a day, and we can discuss our plans."
        
        [pc.dcb
            |"As long as you don't plan on being dead weight."
            |You nod, squeezing Calise's hand. "Rest well."
            |You lean in and give Cali the biggest hug you dare attempt in her condition. "Feel better soon!"
        ]
        
        "I'll try my best. Now go and let me catch some sleep, hmm?"
        
        You nod and follow Isadora back out.
rows.translation:
卡莉丝坐在床上，身穿宽松的托加长袍，腹部与肩膀缠着许多绷带。她比你记忆中更加苍白，嘴唇干裂，毫无血色；显然，她失去了大量鲜血。尽管如此，她仍勉强挤出一丝苍白的笑容，示意你们两人进来。

        “啊，我亲爱的伊莎多拉，还有我的冠军。谢谢你们两位前来。”她说道，每吐出一个字，脸上的痛苦神情都会加深。 
        
        “恐怕我的任务……失败了。在我抵达陵墓以前，一名邪教刺客袭击了我。我只能拼尽全力撤退，压制血管中灼烧的毒素，才没让她彻底结果我的性命。还有其他恶魔袭击了墓地；毫无疑问，他们已将里面所有贵重物品洗劫一空。伊莎多拉，我真的非常抱歉，是我把他们引向了你族人民的遗产。”
        
        伊莎多拉单膝跪在床边，以双手握住卡莉丝的手。“你平安无事就好，卡莉丝女士。”
        
        冠军轻笑起来——又立刻为这个举动感到后悔，险些因疼痛弯成一团。“啊！我会好起来的，伊莎多拉。谢谢你替我找来[pc.name]。可以让我们单独待一会儿吗？”
        
        “我……好吧，冠军。”伊莎多拉垂下脑袋，站起身，退向聚在一起的祭司们。 
        
        卡莉丝摇摇头。“可怜的姑娘。恐怕她越来越迷恋我了。至于你：我已经快要康复到可以重新行走，不过这次受伤恐怕会让讨伐行动的下一步更加困难。尽管如此，我们必须不惜一切代价摧毁那座小恶魔繁育场。一天后，到老地方来见我，我们可以商讨计划。”
        
        [pc.dcb
            |“只要你没打算成为累赘。”
            |你点点头，握紧卡莉丝的手。“好好休息。”
            |你倾身靠近，在不伤到卡莉丝的前提下尽可能给了她一个大大的拥抱。“早日康复！”
        ]
        
        “我会尽力。现在离开这里，让我睡一会儿，好吗？”
        
        你点点头，跟随伊莎多拉走了出去。

rows.original:
[var0
        |You hear Calise long before you see her. The curving tunnels surrounding the Steps of Sorra turn her voice, soft and sonorous, into an echo that booms as forcefully as a dragon's roar. She's singing, a wordless melody that sounds as mournful as a dirge. Your pace quickens up the stairs, and soon enough you're approaching Calise, sitting on the final step of the great circling stairway with a rucksack and her axe resting casually beside her. Her eyes are closed, and she sways slowly from side to side as the melody swells. That thick reddish-brown hair of hers spills around her shoulders, and those crimson lips are pursed into the most perfect 'O' as the song climaxes in a high, soulful wail.
    
        Her eyes open, settling on you, and she smiles. "Ah, my dear Champion! I'm glad to see you made it safe and sound. Are you ready [silly
            |for a bit of jolly cooperation
            |to sally forth together
        ]?"
        |"Ah, my dear Champion! I'm glad to see you made it safe and sound. Are you ready [silly|for a bit of jolly cooperation|to sally forth together]?"
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |在看到卡莉丝之前，你就已经先听到了她的声音。环绕在索拉的台阶周围的弯曲隧道使她的声音——那柔和而悠扬的嗓音——变成了回荡在空气中、威力不亚于龙吼的回声。她正在唱歌，那无词的旋律听起来充满了哀伤，就像挽歌一般。你加快脚步跑上楼梯，不久就来到了卡莉丝所在的地方。她坐在那座环绕而建的楼梯的最后一级台阶上，身边随意地放着背包和斧头。她闭着眼睛，随着旋律的渐强，身体缓缓地左右摇晃着。她那浓密的红棕色头发披散在肩头，当歌曲达到高潮，她那绯红的嘴唇紧紧抿成一个完美的‘O’形，发出高亢而充满感情的歌声。
    
        她睁开眼睛，目光落在你身上，然后露出了微笑。“啊，我亲爱的冠军！看到你平安无事地回来了，我真是太高兴了。你准备好[silly
