"I hope you've got something warm to wear," Calise says, hefting her pack onto her back. "I understand the winds on the peaks can be brutally cold."
        
        [calise.fucked
            |"We'll just have to keep each other warm," you say, slipping an arm around Calise's waist. 
            
            She smiles and squeezes your hand. "I'll hold you to that, [pc.name]."
            |"I'll manage," you tell her, gesturing towards the top of the steps. "Shall we?"
        ]
        
        [party.comp brint brienne
            |"She's not kidding," Brint says, already rubbing his hands together. "It gets damn chilly up here."
            |Brienne wraps her arms protectively around you, smooshing her breasts into your back. "She's not kidding about how cold it gets up here. You'll keep me warm, won't you?"
        ]
        
        [party.has etheryn
            |"Thank the goddess," Ryn murmurs, walking ahead of the group for once. "It feels so nice up here!"
        ]
        
        [party.has cait
            |"So many... stairs..." Cait huffs, glancing back down. "[pc.name] my legs are turning to jelly. Please tell me we don't have to do more climbing."
            
            "Don't worry, kitten," Calise says, "it's all down hill from here."
        ]
        
        [party.has agni
            |Agnimitra stretches her wings. "Steps of Sorra, huh? Y'know, I hear there's a big nest of other harpies up here. We ought to go visit sometime. Might be some of my descendants are roosting nearby."
        ]
        
        Calise takes point, securing her helm and veil back into place as she walks. The Steps end in ramping incline, and finally let out into a great semi-circular archway that deposits your party out on a snow-swept mountainside. The drop in temperature as soon as you step out into the wind hits you like a slap across the face, [calise.fucked
            |[party.has brienne
                |and soon enough you're sandwiched in between Calise and Brienne, sharing as much body heat as the three of you can. Gods, but Cali's warm!
                |but Calise's quick to squeeze you tight, sharing her body heat. Gods but she's warm!
            ]
            |You wrap your arms around yourself, shivering in the freeze.
        ] The paladin leads you a short ways from the cave exit, to where the path doubles back and begins heading back down the mountain. Unfortunately for you, it's a very, very narrow path, barely wide enough for minotaurs to walk single-file and coated in ice and snow. It's also exposed to the chill wind all the way down, and soon enough you hear Sorra's howling tearing past your [pc.ears]. 
        
        "Try not to fall!" Calise shouts over the wind. "I've no wings to catch you."
        
        [pc.hasWings
            |"If you fall, I'll catch you!" you shout back, flexing your wings.
            
            Calise laughs. "Velun be praised — what a hero!"
            |Damn it, now you're looking over the edge. Gods but it is a long way down...
        ]

rows.original: It takes well over an hour to slowly march down the mountainside, fighting against unsteady footing in the snow and the buffeting winds alike. Calise's plume and hair whip wildly behind her. "Damn this cold," she says through gritted teeth, "I can barely feel my toes!" [var0 |You're faring a bit better, but still, you'd really like to get out of the storm at least. |You're right there with her. This storm is killer. ] "How much farther?" "We'd have been there by now if the weather was clear." [party.has etheryn |At least Ryn is having a good time. The pale elf's stripped off her cloak and is all but prancing through the blizzard, deftly stepping over snow and ice as easily as if it were grass. She's got a great big smile on her face — when you can see it through the snow. "Ryn, don't get so far ahead!" ] [party.has agni |Agni's body heat is a blessed relief, at least. When the phoenix beats her wings, warmth comes radiating off her. Snow that dares to settle on her bronzed flesh melts away instantly, leaving her more drenched than frozen. ] It's getting darker, too, accompanied by the distant rumble of thunder— ZAP! A lightning bolt strikes the path a few paces ahead of you, slamming into the stone with enough force to send ice and rocks flying. You stumble back, coughing, as the reek of ozone assails your nose. When your vision clears, you can see Calise clinging to the rockface ten feet ahead — and a gulf in the path between you, blown out by the impact. "Are you okay?" she shouts. When you nod, she extends her axe haft-first towards you. "Jump, I'll catch you!" [pc.hasWings |Even with your wings, the wind's picked up so much now that you're happy for the help. ]You brace your legs, getting ready to jump, only to be blown back by another blast of lightning. This time, Calise senses it coming and swings her axe up, catching the bolt and deflecting it with a glimmering veil of magic. In the burst of light, you catch sight of several dark shapes moving just beyond the cliffside path, great wings propelling them effortlessly despite the gale.
rows.translation: 在雪地上艰难地行进，既要应对不稳定的路面，又要抵挡猛烈的风雪，这一过程花费了一个多小时的时间。卡莉丝的羽毛和头发在身后狂乱地飘动。 “真他妈的冷，”她咬紧牙关说道，“我的脚趾几乎感觉不到任何知觉了！ [var0 |你的情况稍微好一些了，但无论如何，你还是非常希望能够尽快摆脱这场困境。 |你和她在一起，没错。这场风暴实在太危险了。 ]还差多远？” “如果天气好的话，我们现在应该已经到那里了。 [party.has etheryn |至少小琳玩得很开心。这位皮肤苍白的精灵脱掉了她的斗篷，在暴风雪中欢快地奔跑着，她轻松地跨过积雪和冰块，就像那些雪和冰块只是普通的草地一样。她的脸上挂着灿烂的笑容——当然，要是在雪层后面能够看清楚的话的话。 “小琳，别跑得太远了！ ] [party.has agni |至少，阿格尼身上的热量带来了一种令人欣慰的温暖。当凤凰振翅时，她的身体会散发出热浪，那些敢于落在她那古铜色肌肤上的雪花会立刻融化，反而让她的身体变得更加湿润，而非被冻住。 ] 天色也越来越暗了，远处还不时传来雷声 啪！ 一道闪电击中了你前方几步处的道路，巨大的冲击力使得冰块和岩石都被抛向了空中。你踉跄着后退，不停地咳嗽，空气中弥漫着的臭氧气味刺得你鼻子发痛。当视线恢复清晰后，你看到卡莉丝正紧紧抓住前方十英尺处的岩壁——而你们之间的道路则被闪电的冲击力炸出了一个巨大的裂口。 “你没事吧？”她大声问道。当你点头表示没事后，她将斧头的一端朝你伸了过来：“跳过来，我会接住你的！ [pc.hasWings |即使你长了翅膀，现在的风也变得太大太猛了，所以你能得到帮助，真的让人感到庆幸。 ]你绷紧双腿，准备跳跃，却再次被一道闪电击中，被迫向后倒退。这一次，卡莉丝提前感应到了闪电的来袭，她迅速举起斧头，将那道闪电接住，并用一道闪烁的魔法光芒将其偏转开来。在那道光芒中，你隐约看到了几道暗影的身影正在悬崖边的小路上移动——尽管狂风肆虐，它们却凭借巨大的翅膀轻松地翱翔着。

rows.original:
"Harpies!" you shout, grabbing for your [pc.weapon]. 

        "Trespassers!" a voice shouts back, booming over the howling wind. "First you defile the goddess's path, and now you come to defile the tombs of the ancients. Don't deny it!"
        
        One harpy wings down from the rest of the pack, hovering just out of arm's reach between you and Calise. She's a particularly tall, athletic member of the species, with a messy mane of black feather-hair spilling down around bronzed skin and dark makeup. She's wearing a breastplate over her loose tunic and clutching a polearm in her hands, its copper head shaped to resemble a thunderbolt. Electricity crackles over the blade.
        
        Calise hefts her own axe in both hands, planting her feet. "Get out of our way, bird. My Champion and I are on a mission. You will not stop us."
        
        "Won't I?" the harpy hisses. "I've been fooled once already. In the goddess's name, never again!"
rows.translation:
“鹰身女妖！”你大喊着伸手去拿[pc.weapon]。 

        “入侵者！”一个声音越过呼啸狂风高声回应。“你先玷污女神的道路，如今又来亵渎先人的坟墓。别想否认！”
        
        一名鹰身女妖脱离族群俯冲而下，在你与卡莉丝之间、手臂恰好够不到的位置悬停。她在族人中身材格外高挑健美；凌乱的黑色羽发如鬃毛般披散在古铜肌肤和深色妆容周围。宽松束腰外套着一件胸甲，双手紧握一柄长杆武器，铜制刃头塑成雷霆形状，电流在刃上噼啪作响。
        
        卡莉丝双手提起自己的斧头，稳稳站定。“滚开，鸟人。我和我的勇士肩负使命，你阻止不了我们。”
        
        “是吗？”鹰身女妖嘶声道。“我已经被骗过一次。以女神之名，绝不会再有第二次！”

rows.original: You put your hands up[pc.isDK | in a rude gesture | disarmingly ]. "We're here to fight demons, not defile anything. The priests of Khor'minos approved of our mission." "I have their seal, if you care to see it," Calise adds. The leader scowls. "I answer to the gods themselves, not the bickering cave-dweller clerics. We are charged with defending these sacred paths, and already demons have defiled them while impersonating those who should be charged with their protection. No more." The Sorran warrior's spear crackles with electric power, readying to smite you down. [var0 |"W-wait," one of the other harpies chirps, grabbing the leader's wrist. "Isn't [pc.heShe] the one Zhara's been fawning over? The Champion of-" The Sorran raises a wing, silencing her. "Have you forgotten the demons can wear the faces of our friends? Our sisters?" "Ask [pc.himHer] something only Zhara's baby-[pc.mf |daddy |mommy ] would know!" a third harpy says. A sigh. "Fine. I would never hear the end of it from our elder sister if we slew her mate. Tell me true, [pc.raceCute], how many children have you sired on our esteemed red-feathered Wingleader?" "[var1]," you say, completely confident. "[flags.ZHARA_WF_APP |She and our children have moved into my fortress. A bunch of her sisters, too. |She's brought each one to see me in secret at night, when no one is around to harass her in town. ]" The harpy who brought up the idea nods to their paladin leader, and after a final moment's consideration, the crackling energy of her spear fades. "So it is. I... I am sorry, lowlanders. We've been betrayed once already. I could not forgive myself a second failure." "So you're one of Zhara's sisters after all," you say. "Glad we didn't have to fight." She nods. "As am I. We will allow you to pass, but please... there are demons ahead, now infesting the Grave of Saints. Their leader wears the face of our missing sister, Yhrea. If you mean to access the crypts, dispatch them. I am sure the Stormsinger will reward your efforts." [party.has agni |Agni shrugs. "I'm not sure Sorra's rewards are something worth seeking out, but thanks anyway." "Wait, aren't you..." one of the acolytes says, squinting at your phoenix. The leader cuts her off, though. ]"Sisters, come. We have other invaders to smite." The paladin lifts her glaive, and there's a crack of thunder in the heavens. The winds begin to calm as if on command; in a matter of moments the mountainside goes from howling blizzard to still as a summer's day — though still damned cold. "Thank you," Calise says. "I'm... glad we were all able to be reasonable about this. Let's get going — it seems we're not the only ones with this idea." | "Wait, come on!" you shout. "It doesn't have to go this way!" "It does." ]
rows.translation: 你们把手举起来。[pc.isDK | 以一种粗鲁的方式 | 以一种让人感到轻松、没有威胁的方式 ]我们来到这里是为了与恶魔战斗我们没有玷污任何东西，科尔米诺斯的祭司们也认可我们的行动。” “如果你们愿意看的话，我这里有他们的印章，”卡莉丝补充道。 首领皱起了眉头：“我直接向众神负责，而不是向那些整天争吵的洞穴居民牧师们负责。我们的职责是守护这些神圣的道路，然而那些本应负责保护它们的人却假扮他们的身份，让恶魔玷污了这些道路。不能再这样下去了。 这位索拉战士手中的长矛充满了电能，随时准备将你击倒。 [var0 |等、等等，”另一只女妖急促地说道，抓住了首领的手腕，“这样不是[pc.heShe]就是那个扎拉一直讨好的人吗？那个“冠军”…… 索拉信徒展开了一只翅膀，让她安静了下来。“你难道忘记了吗？恶魔是可以伪装成我们朋友的样子的。我们的姐妹们问吧。 [pc.himHer]只有扎拉的宝宝才会懂的东西[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]那你们就知道了！”第三只女妖说道。 “唉……好吧。如果我们杀了我们大姐的伴侣，她肯定会没完没了地责备我们。说实话吧[pc.raceCute]在我们这位受人尊敬的红色羽毛领袖身边，你究竟生了多少孩子呢？[var1]你说得完全正确，”你充满信心地说道。[flags.ZHARA_WF_APP |她和我们的孩子们搬进了我的“堡垒”，她的几个姐妹也跟着搬来了。 |她每晚都会偷偷带其中一个人来见我，那时候镇上没有其他人会来打扰她。 ]那个提出这个想法的鹰身女妖向她的圣骑士领袖点了点头，经过最后一刻的考虑，她手中的长矛散发出的能量也逐渐消失了。“就这样吧……我很抱歉，低地的人们。我们已经被背叛过一次了。我无法原谅自己再次失败。” “所以你其实是扎拉的姐妹之一啊，”你说，“还好我们没有发生冲突。” 她点了点头：“我也是。我们会让你通过的，但请务必小心。前方有恶魔出没，它们现在已经侵入了圣徒墓地。它们的首领竟然戴着我们失踪的妹妹耶蕾亚的面具。如果你想进入地窖，就必须先消灭那些恶魔。我相信，风暴歌手一定会奖励你的努力的。 [party.has agni |阿格尼耸了耸肩：“我不确定索拉提供的奖励是否值得去争取，不过还是谢谢你。” “等等，你难道不是……”其中一个侍从眯着眼睛看着你的凤凰说道。 不过，领头人及时制止了她。 ]姐妹们，过来吧。还有其他的入侵者需要我们共同消灭。”圣骑士举起了她的战刃，此时天空中突然响起了雷声。风仿佛受到了命令般开始平静下来；转眼间，山间原本呼啸的暴风雪变得如同夏日般宁静——只不过依然寒冷刺骨。 “谢谢你们，”卡莉丝说道，“我很高兴我们所有人都能理智地处理这件事。我们走吧，看来不止我们一个人有这个想法。 | 等等，别这样！”你喊道，“事情不一定要这样发展啊！” “但事实就是如此。 ]

She has just enough time to squawk in alarm before she and her flock and blown every which way by the thunderous force.             |You fling the stone as hard as you can, but the wind's blowing so hard that your keen shot is turned aside, passing the stone harmlessly through the flock. The leader scowls, gripping her glaive. "Coward! Draw your weapon, then!"
        ]

rows.original: You glance towards your own harpy. "Agni?" The red-plumed bard nods and takes wing, flying up close enough that the Sorran warrior could easily reach out and cleave her down if she wanted. The younger harpy hesitates, though, as Agni's got no weapon in hand, just her instrument. "Look, kids, I know you think you're doing your duty," Agni says, "but so are we. My good friend [pc.name] here is here trying to save all of Khor'minos from a demon invasion. You've surely gotten wind of what's going on down where the sun don't shine, haven't you?" "We have. And the demons aren't only down below, but on this very peak!" the Sorran bites back. "Corruption has spread far and wide, sister. And we know the demons are shapeshifters, too. Any one of you could be-" "Wait!" Another harpy butts in, flying between the pair. "That's— you're really her, aren't you?" Agnimitra smirks. "Ah, so you have heard of me!" The leader of the wing sighs, shoving the other harpy away. "What did I just say, feather brain, they're shapeshifters. You've seen them! This could be a trick!" "Show us some fire, phoenix!" a third harpy chirps. "Come on!" "Show us!" The leader sighs, lowering her glaive a little more. "Fine. If you are truly Sorra's legendary chosen, then prove it." That's just what the bard wants to hear, you're sure. She gives you a wink over her shoulder before spreading her wings and bringing her gittern to bear. Her fingers dance along the strings, showering sparks down the mountainside before she plucks the first note. In a flash, Agni's playing conjures forth pillars and streaks of dancing flame all around her, engulfing her body in a fiery sirocco. The other harpies recoil from the rush of heat that accompanies her performance, but soon enough they're cheering, whooping and hollering Agnimitra's name. Even the glaive-wielding paladin's face softens, eyes full of wonder as she watches your companion display her goddess-given power. "This proof enough for you?" Agni grins, playing a riff that sends a wave of fleeting sparks dancing around the paladin's face. She can't help but smile. "That... that will do. I'm sorry, Ancient One. Demons have accosted the Grave of Saints already, and... and they wore the faces of our sisters while they defiled the Sevens' sacred ground. They thought to fool us! I did not... could not..." Agni places a hand gently on the woman's shoulder. "Hey, you tried your best. I know you wouldn't have wanted to fight your friends. A group of strangers, though? 'Course we might have been demons. But we're here to fight demons! And we need something out of the Grave to do it. Okay?" Calise hefts her axe back onto her shoulder, breathing a sigh of relief. "Not to rush, ladies, but [pc.name] and I are freezing to death." "Of course. If you're here to slay demons, Ancient, we'll not stop you. I apologize for the storm." The paladin lifts her glaive, and there's a crack of thunder in the heavens. The winds begin to calm as if on command; in a matter of moments the mountainside goes from howling blizzard to still as a summer's day — though still damned cold. "Thank you," Calise says. "I'm... glad we were all able to be reasonable about this." "I've got my ways," Agni grins. "So, we goin' or what?"
rows.translation: 你瞥了一眼自己的女妖同伴。“阿格尼？” 这位红羽吟游者点了点头，然后振翅飞了上来，飞得足够近，以至于那位索拉战士如果愿意的话，完全可以伸手将她击落。然而，年轻的女妖却犹豫了一下——因为阿格尼手中并没有武器，只有她的乐器而已。 “听着，孩子们，我知道你们认为自己是在履行职责，”阿格尼说道，“但我们也是在履行职责啊。我的好朋友[pc.name]在这里，人们正在努力拯救整个科尔米诺斯，让它免受恶魔的侵袭。你们肯定也听说了那些发生在阴暗角落里的可怕事情吧？” “我们确实听说了。而且那些恶魔不仅仅存在于地下，它们就出现在这座山顶上！索拉信徒愤怒地反驳道：‘腐败已经蔓延得非常广泛了，姐妹。而且我们都知道，那些恶魔也会变形。你们中的任何一个人都可能……’” “等等！”另一只女妖插话道，它飞到两人中间：“那……你真的是她吧？阿格尼米特拉露出微笑：“啊，原来如此拥有听说过我吗！” 那支队伍的领头者叹了口气，把另一只女妖推到了一边：“我刚才说了什么？笨蛋，他们可是变形者啊！你亲眼见过他们的！这很可能是个陷阱！” “快给我们看看你的火吧，凤凰！”第三只女妖叫道，“快点！ 给我们看看吧！” 领导者叹了口气，将她的战镰放得更低了一些。“好吧。如果你们真的是索拉传说中的选中者，那就证明出来吧。” 这正是那位吟游诗人想要听到的话。她回头朝你眨了眨眼，然后展开双翼，开始弹奏她的吉特琴。她的手指在琴弦上飞舞，仿佛有火花从指间迸发，沿着山坡向下流淌。当她弹出第一个音符的瞬间，阿格尼的演奏立刻在周围唤起了熊熊燃烧的火焰柱与闪烁的火光，将她的身体完全笼罩在一片炽热的火海之中。其他女妖们被她表演时散发出的强烈热量吓得纷纷后退，但很快，她们就开始欢呼雀跃，高声呼喊着阿格尼米特拉的名字。就连那位手持长剑的圣骑士，看到你的同伴展现出这位女神赋予她的力量时，脸上也露出了惊奇的神情。 这个证据够你信服了吗？”阿格尼微笑着，弹奏了一段旋律，顿时有一阵闪烁的火花在那位圣骑士的脸上跳动。 她忍不住笑了起来：“这……这样就可以了。对不起，古圣。恶魔已经侵扰了圣徒墓地，而且……他们还伪装成我们姐妹的模样，亵渎了七圣的圣地。他们以为这样就能骗过我们！我实在……实在无能为力…… 阿格尼轻轻地将手放在那名女性的肩上：“嘿，你已经尽力了。我知道你并不想和自己的朋友们打架。但面对一群陌生人呢？当然，我们可能会表现得像恶魔一样。不过，我们在这里是为了战斗恶魔！而我们需要从坟墓里获取某种东西才能对付它们。明白吗？” 卡莉丝把她的斧头重新扛在肩上，松了一口气。“各位，别着急，但是[pc.name]我快要冻死了。” “当然。如果你是来消灭恶魔的，古贤，我们不会阻拦你。对于这场暴风雨，我深表歉意。” 圣骑士举起了她的战镰，此时天空中突然响起了雷声。风仿佛受到了指令般开始平静下来；转眼间，山坡上从呼啸的暴风雪变成了宁静如夏日般的景象——只不过依然冷得刺骨。 “谢谢你们，”卡莉丝说道，“我很高兴我们所有人都能在这个问题上保持理智。我有我的办法，”阿格尼笑着说，“那么，我们到底去还是不去呢？
rows.raw: ' You glance towards your own harpy. "Agni?" The red-plumed bard nods and takes wing, flying up close enough that the Sorran warrior could easily reach out and cleave her down if she wanted. The younger harpy hesitates, though, as Agni's got no weapon in hand, just her instrument. "Look, kids, I know you think you're doing your duty," Agni says, "but so are we. My good friend [pc.name] here is here trying to save all of Khor'minos from a demon invasion. You've surely gotten wind of what's going on down where the sun don't shine, haven't you?" "We have. And the demons aren't only down below, but on this very peak!" the Sorran bites back. "Corruption has spread far and wide, sister. And we know the demons are shapeshifters, too. Any one of you could be-" "Wait!" Another harpy butts in, flying between the pair. "That's— you're really her, aren't you?" Agnimitra smirks. "Ah, so you have heard of me!" The leader of the wing sighs, shoving the other harpy away. "What did I just say, feather brain, they're shapeshifters. You've seen them! This could be a trick!" "Show us some fire, phoenix!" a third harpy chirps. "Come on!" "Show us!" The leader sighs, lowering her glaive a little more. "Fine. If you are truly Sorra's legendary chosen, then prove it." That's just what the bard wants to hear, you're sure. She gives you a wink over her shoulder before spreading her wings and bringing her gittern to bear. Her fingers dance along the strings, showering sparks down the mountainside before she plucks the first note. In a flash, Agni's playing conjures forth pillars and streaks of dancing flame all around her, engulfing her body in a fiery sirocco. The other harpies recoil from the rush of heat that accompanies her performance, but soon enough they're cheering, whooping and hollering Agnimitra's name. Even the glaive-wielding paladin's face softens, eyes full of wonder as she watches your companion display her goddess-given power. "This proof enough for you?" Agni grins, playing a riff that sends a wave of fleeting sparks dancing around the paladin's face. She can't help but smile. "That... that will do. I'm sorry, Ancient One. Demons have accosted the Grave of Saints already, and... and they wore the faces of our sisters while they defiled the Sevens' sacred ground. They thought to fool us! I did not... could not..." Agni places a hand gently on the woman's shoulder. "Hey, you tried your best. I know you wouldn't have wanted to fight your friends. A group of strangers, though? 'Course we might have been demons. But we're here to fight demons! And we need something out of the Grave to do it. Okay?" Calise hefts her axe back onto her shoulder, breathing a sigh of relief. "Not to rush, ladies, but [pc.name] and I are freezing to death." "Of course. If you're here to slay demons, Ancient, we'll not stop you. I apologize for the storm." The paladin lifts her glaive, and there's a crack of thunder in the heavens. The winds begin to calm as if on command; in a matter of moments the mountainside goes from howling blizzard to still as a summer's day — though still damned cold. "Thank you," Calise says. "I'm... glad we were all able to be reasonable about this." "I've got my ways," Agni grins. "So, we goin' or what?"'

rows.original:
The stormcaller squawks in shock, collapsing onto the path between you and Calise. "G-goddess preserve me... preserve me from this trial. I am unworthy."

    Your divine companion raises her axe overhead, a vicious snarl on her face, but catches herself at the last moment. Her eyes widen, and her stance relaxes, blade lowering. "Fool. We are here to save the city below — save the world! — while you use your goddess as justification for your own paranoia. Fly back to your nest and bury your head while the true Champions cleanse these lands of corruption."
    
    The harpy shudders, curling her wings about herself.
    
    "Come, [pc.name]. We've no time to waste on the deluded and the weak."
    
    [pc.dcb
        |You nod, hopping the gap in the narrow trail. "Right you are."
        |"Calise! Isn't that a little cruel?" you ask, glancing between the two holy women. 
        
        The Champion bristles for a moment, shoulders tensing... and then she exhales a deep breath and relaxes the grip on her axe. "Y-yes, you're right. I'm... I'm sorry. Velun's way may be nature's wrath, the survival of the fittest, but it must be tempered. As our basest natures must be."
        
        Calise extends a hand to the harpy. "Go home, girl. We are the defenders of Khor'minos, and were sent by the cows to tend to their sacred ground. Whatever has transpired to make you so defensive, we will set it right."
        
        The Sorran says nothing, eyes downcast, but she takes Calise's hand and lets herself be pulled to her feet. The rest of her flock gather 'round, looking anxiously at the axe-wielding amazon until she releases their leader with a squeeze on the shoulder. "All will be well. I swear it."
        
        "So... so be it," the rattled harpy finally answers, putting a hand over Calise's. "I pray you, dispatch the demons in the Grave of Saints. They wore the faces of our missing sisters, and mean to steal or destroy the gods' gifts to their followers."
        
        Calise gives you a look. "We will keep them safe. Come, [pc.name]. Let us make haste."
        |"Aww, Cali, you're being mean. Look at the poor thing," you say, squatting down and giving the defeated harpy a hug. "She was just doin' what she thought was good."
        
        The Champion bristles for a moment, shoulders tensing... and then she exhales a deep breath and relaxes the grip on her axe. "Y-yes, you're right. I'm... I'm sorry. Velun's way may be nature's wrath, the survival of the fittest, but it must be tempered. As our basest natures must be."
        
        Calise extends a hand to the harpy. "Go home, girl. We are the defenders of Khor'minos, and were sent by the cows to tend to their sacred ground. Whatever has transpired to make you so defensive, we will set it right."

The rest of her flock gather 'round, looking anxiously at the axe-wielding amazon until she releases their leader with a squeeze on the shoulder. "All will be well. I swear it."
        
        "So... so be it," the rattled harpy finally answers, putting a hand over Calise's. "I pray you, dispatch the demons in the Grave of Saints. They wore the faces of our missing sisters, and mean to steal or destroy the gods' gifts to their followers."
        
        Calise gives you a look. "We will keep them safe. Come, [pc.name]. Let us make haste."
    ]
    
    You leave the harpies behind and carry on towards the Grave. A few minutes later and the storm begins to break, as surely as its conjurer's will has. Calise breathes a sigh of relief, shaking our her snow-wetted hair. "We should be there in moments, my [calise.fucked
        |love
        |friend
    ]!"

风暴召唤者惊恐地尖叫着，倒在了你和卡莉丝之间的小路上。“女神啊，请拯救我……请让我免于这场考验吧。我实在不配。”

你的神圣伙伴将斧头高高举过头顶，脸上露出凶狠的表情，但在最后一刻还是控制住了自己。她的双眼瞪得大大的，姿势也放松了下来，手中的剑也放了下来。“傻瓜。我们来到这里是为了拯救下面的城市——拯救整个世界！而你却把你的女神当作自己偏执行为的借口。回到你的巢穴里去吧，躲起来吧，让真正的勇士们来清除这些土地上的腐败吧。那只女妖瑟瑟发抖，将翅膀紧紧地围在身上。

“来吧， [pc.name]我们没有时间去浪费在那些自欺欺人、软弱无能的人身上。
    
    [pc.dcb
        |你点了点头，跳过了狭窄小路上那道缝隙。“没错，就是这样。
        |卡莉丝！这样不是有点太残忍了吗？”你边说边将目光在两位神圣的女性之间来回扫视。

冠军少女瞬间绷紧了身体，肩膀也变得僵硬起来……但随后她深吸一口气，放松了握在斧头上的手。是的是的，你说得对。我……我很抱歉。维伦的做法或许代表着自然的惩罚，代表着适者生存的法则，但这种法则也必须得到约束。就像我们最原始的本能一样，也需要被控制。”

卡莉丝向那位女妖伸出了手：“回去吧，姑娘。我们是科尔米诺斯的守护者，是受众神的派遣来守护这片神圣土地的。无论发生了什么让你如此戒备，我们一定会把一切弄好。

索拉信徒没有说话，只是低着头，但她握住了卡莉丝的手，让对方将自己拉了起来。她的其他同伴们都围了上来，焦虑地望着那个手持斧头的亚马逊女子，直到她轻轻捏了捏他们首领的肩膀，才让他们放心：“一切都会好起来的。我发誓。”

“那么……那就这样吧。”这个惊慌失措的哈比女最终说道，然后把手放在了卡莉丝的手上。我恳求你，赶走圣徒墓地里的那些恶魔吧。它们披着我们失踪姐妹的面容，企图窃取或毁掉神明赐予信徒们的礼物。”

卡莉丝看了你一眼，说道：“我们会保护好它们的。来吧， [pc.name]我们赶紧吧。
        |哎呀，卡莉，你太刻薄了。看看这只可怜的家伙吧，”你蹲下来，抱住了那只被击败的哈比。“她只是在做她认为正确的事情而已。”

冠军瞬间变得紧张起来，肩膀也绷得紧紧的。然后她深深地呼出一口气，松开了紧握着斧头的手。“是的是的，你说得对。我……我很抱歉。维伦的方式或许代表着自然的惩罚，代表着适者生存的法则，但它必须得到约束。就像我们最原始的本性也需要被约束一样。卡莉丝向那只女妖伸出了手：“回去吧，姑娘。我们是科尔米诺斯的守护者，是受命来守护这片神圣土地的。无论发生了什么让你如此戒备，我们一定会把事情解决好的。索拉信徒一言不发，低着头，但她握住了卡莉丝的手，任由对方将自己拉了起来。她的其他同伴也围了过来，焦急地注视着这位手持斧头的亚马逊女子，直到她轻轻捏了捏他们领袖的肩膀，示意他们可以离开了。一切都会好起来的。我发誓。”

“那么……就这样吧，”那个惊慌失措的哈比终于回答道，她将手放在卡莉丝的手上。“我恳求你，去消灭圣徒墓地里的那些恶魔吧。它们披着我们失踪姐妹的面具，企图窃取或毁掉神明赐予信徒们的礼物。卡莉丝看了你一眼，说道：“我们会保护好他们的。来吧， [pc.name]我们赶快吧。
    ]
    
    你把那些女妖抛在身后，继续朝着墓地前进。几分钟后，暴风雨正如它的召唤者所愿，开始逐渐平息。卡莉丝松了一口气，摇动着我们被雪水浸湿的头发，说道：“再过一会儿我们就应该到了。 [calise.fucked
        |爱
        |朋友
    ]！"

rows.original:
You stumble back, all but smoking from the number of times lightning bolts have scoured your body. Gods, everything hurts. Your [pc.weapon] clatters out of your hands, falling down the cliffside and out of sight. Shit, no!
    
    The Sorran wings down to the path, claws digging into the snow. Her glaive catches you under the chin, forcing your face up to meet her gaze. "Another defiler falls to Sorra's might. And now — go with grace to Tira's embrace. May your soul be scourged clean in the afterlife."
    
    "Wait, no!" Calise shrieks, but it's too late. The harpy [pc.hasWings
        |makes an agonizing strike to your wings before she 
    ]grabs you around the neck and hurls you off the cliff. Wind whips past your face, biting cold; your stomach lurches as the craggy ground races up to meet you. You've got just enough time to scream before a jutting rockface breaks your fall — and your skull.

"There!"

    Calise points ahead to where the path lets out onto a stretch of even ground, maybe twenty feet across, dominated by a pair of enormous marble statues that stand proudly on either side of a vaulted door. One statue depicts the nude, slender figure of Sorra, her feathered wings outstretched and spear held high; the other, the curvaceous body of the human deity Tira, wearing little besides funerary wrappings and a robe, and presenting a headsman's axe. Their weapons touch at the tips, and from that point hangs a single copper lantern lit with a flickering green flame. [pc.bg acolyte
        |A guiding flame for lost souls.
    ]
    
    Calise scowls, pointing at the door. You can just make out that it's wedged open, only by a couple of inches, held open by a half-crushed spear haft. "Weapons ready."
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |"Maybe somebody dropped it?" you suggest. "No? Guess we're not alone, then."
        |You nod, fixing your fingers around your [pc.weapon].
    ]
    
    "Take point, [pc.name]," Calise says. "I'll keep rear guard."

rows.translation:
“就是那里！”

    卡莉丝指向前方，道路在那里延伸到一片平坦的地面上，这片地面大概有二十英尺宽，两侧矗立着一对巨大的大理石雕像，它们骄傲地立在拱形大门的两侧。其中一座雕像塑造的是索拉那赤裸而苗条的身姿，她展开羽翼，高举长矛；另一座则刻画了人类女神蒂拉曲线优美的身体，她身上除了丧葬裹布和一件长袍之外几乎什么也没穿，手里托着一把刽子手的斧头。她们的武器尖端相触，就在那一点上悬挂着一盏铜灯笼，里面燃烧着闪烁的绿色火焰。 [pc.bg acolyte
        |为迷失的灵魂引路之焰。
    ]
    
    卡莉丝皱起眉头，指向那扇门。你勉强能看出门被卡开了，只有几英寸宽，是一根被压扁了一半的矛柄撑住了它。“准备好武器。”
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |“也许是有人把它掉在这儿了？”你提议道。“没有吗？那看来我们并不孤单。”
        |你点了点头，手指握紧了你的[pc.weapon]。
    ]
    
    “你在前面带路，[pc.name]，”卡莉丝说道。“我来殿后。”
    
    [calise.fucked
        |“你只是想找个借口看我的屁股，”你打趣道。
        
        她隔着面纱咧嘴一笑。“嗯。顺便我还能拦住那些我不认可的人，不让他们拿长矛去捅那个漂亮的屁股。”
    ]
rows.raw:
'
    "There!"

    Calise points ahead to where the path lets out onto a stretch of even ground, maybe twenty feet across, dominated by a pair of enormous marble statues that stand proudly on either side of a vaulted door. One statue depicts the nude, slender figure of Sorra, her feathered wings outstretched and spear held high; the other, the curvaceous body of the human deity Tira, wearing little besides funerary wrappings and a robe, and presenting a headsman's axe. Their weapons touch at the tips, and from that point hangs a single copper lantern lit with a flickering green flame. [pc.bg acolyte
        |A guiding flame for lost souls.
    ]
    
    Calise scowls, pointing at the door. You can just make out that it's wedged open, only by a couple of inches, held open by a half-crushed spear haft. "Weapons ready."
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |"Maybe somebody dropped it?" you suggest. "No? Guess we're not alone, then."
        |You nod, fixing your fingers around your [pc.weapon].
    ]
    
    "Take point, [pc.name]," Calise says. "I'll keep rear guard."
    
    [calise.fucked
        |"You just want an excuse to watch my butt," you tease.
        
        She grins beneath her veil. "Mmm. And I'll keep anybody I don't approve of from spearing that pretty behind while I'm at it."
    ]
    
    '

rows.original:
The Tiran graves end at a vaulted door to the east, [flags.RING_DOOR
        |now opened thanks to your efforts
        |currently sealed tightly
    ]. The door depicts Tira once again, painted larger than life and exaggerated to cowgirl-like proportions. The goddess has her headsman's axe in one hand, and the other is holding a lantern aloft, just like the one you saw hanging above the Grave of Saints' entrance. [var0
        |The green jadestone is sitting in the lantern, glowing with a warm and inviting light.
        |You can see a small indentation in the door beneath the painted lantern, barely bigger than your thumb.
    ]
    
    There is an inscription in blockly minoan letters above the goddess head. [flags.RING_DOOR
        |
        |[party.comp brint brienne
            |"Here rest those who served state and goddess both," Brint reads, tracing a meaty hand across the letters.
            |Brienne translates it for you: "Here rest those who served state and goddess both."
            |"Something about resting, serving crown and god. I imagine this must be the royal barrow," Calise says, squinting at the letters.
        ]
        
        Your fellow Champion sighs. "Do you see a door handle anywhere? I don't."
        
        No you do not...
    ]
rows.translation:
蒂拉教会的墓穴在东侧的一扇拱形门前结束。 [flags.RING_DOOR
        |多亏了你们的努力，它现在已经开放了。
        |目前被严密封存着
    ]这扇门上再次描绘了蒂拉的形象——她的形象被夸张地描绘得比实际更大，具有典型的牛仔女孩特征。她一手握着酋长之斧，另一只手高举着一盏灯笼，就如同你在圣徒墓地入口上方看到的那盏灯笼一样。 [var0
        |那块绿色的玉石被放置在灯笼之中，散发着温暖而诱人的光芒。
        |在门上、那个涂了漆的灯笼下方，你可以看到一个很小的凹陷，它的大小几乎只比你的拇指稍大一些。
    ]
    
    在女神的头像上方，用方块状的米诺斯文字刻着一些铭文。 [flags.RING_DOOR
        |
        |[party.comp brint brienne
            |在这里安息的，都是那些既为国家服务也为女神效忠的人们，”布林特边读边用那双粗壮的手指抚过这些文字。
            |布蕾妮为你翻译道：“在这里安息的，都是那些既为国家服务也为女神效忠的人们。
            |关于休息、献上王冠和祭拜神明的事情……我想这应该就是那具皇家陵墓了吧，”卡莉丝眯着眼睛看着那些文字说道。
        ]
        
        你的队友叹了口气：“你们看到门把手了吗？我一点都看不到。”
        
        是啊，你确实没看到……
    ]

rows.original:
Before you head out, you pause and look over your shoulder. The jade tearstone's glowing with that faint inner light. Calise mentioned something about a soul lingering within, didn't she? It would be a shame to just leave it here. You reach out and pluck it out from the indent on the door. The mechanism that unlocked the door rumbles, and the two stone slabs begin sliding closed once again. 

            You close your palm around the stone, feeling its warmth against your [pc.skinFurScales] before slipping it into your pocket.
rows.translation:
在你离开之前，你停了下来，回头看了一眼。那块翡翠泪石正散发着微弱的光芒。卡莉丝不是说过里面似乎有一颗灵魂吗？把它留在这里未免太可惜了。你伸手将它从门上的凹槽中取了出来。解锁门的装置发出嗡嗡声，两块石板又开始缓缓闭合。

            你将石子握在掌心，感受着它传来的温暖。 [pc.skinFurScales]在把它放进口袋之前。

            Before you head out, you pause and look over your shoulder. The jade tearstone's glowing with that faint inner light. Calise mentioned something about a soul lingering within, didn't she?             You close your palm around the stone, feeling its warmth against your [pc.skinFurScales] before slipping it into your pocket."

rows.original: You don't need the door open anymore, so why not take that beautiful stone with you as a keepsake?
rows.translation: 你已经不需要再让门开着了，那么为什么不把那块漂亮的石头带走作为纪念呢？
rows.raw: "You don't need the door open anymore, so why not take that beautiful stone with you as a keepsake?"

rows.original:
You [pc.libidoRange 50
                |plant your hands squarely on Tira's enormous bosoms
                |brace your hands on the door
            ] and give the stone a solid push. It doesn't budge. Calise rolls her sleeves up and steps up beside you, throwing her weight into it as well, but no dice. The door doesn't move an inch. 
            
            "Must be locked," she says, "but I don't see a door handle or keyhole."
            
            "This might have something to do with it," you suggest, eying the goddess's lantern. There's a small indentation in the middle of it, right where the flame ought to be flickering. It looks like something a bit bigger than your thumb could be set into it.
            
            Calise nods. "It just might. Let's see if we can find something that'll fit that hole, hmm?"
            
            There must be something around here that'll do the job...
rows.translation:
你[pc.libidoRange 50
                |把双手端端正正地按在蒂拉硕大的乳房上
                |用双手抵住门
            ]，用力推动石头。它纹丝不动。卡莉丝卷起袖子，走到你身旁，也把全身重量压了上去，可仍然毫无作用。石门一寸也没有移动。 
            
            “一定是锁住了，”她说道，“可我没看见门把手或锁孔。”
            
            “或许和这个有关，”你注视着女神的提灯说道。提灯中央本该有火焰闪烁的地方，留着一处小凹槽，看起来可以嵌入某种比你拇指稍大的东西。
            
            卡莉丝点点头。“确实有可能。我们去找找有没有东西正好能嵌进这个洞，好吗？”
            
            附近一定有什么东西能派上用场……

rows.original:
"This should do it," you say aloud, taking the glowing jade tearstone and holding it up to the lantern's indentation. It is, indeed, a perfect fit. The gem slides in effortlessly, and no sooner have you taken your hand off it than its inner glow beings to bloom — first faintly, a spark of green light in the gloom of the cave, but soon it grows into a brilliant, warm green light that suffuses the entire chamber. 

            Calise sucks in a sharp breath, covering her eyes. The doors rumble, and you hear something grinding in the stone out of sight. Perhaps a bar releasing? You glance at Calise, watching the paladin blinking the dazzle from her eyes, before she finally plants her hands on the door and shoves it open with a heaving push. Stone grinds against stone, forced open by the paladin's tense muscles as she steps into it. You take the other side, helping to force it open the rest of the way. 
            
            "The ring can't be far now," Calise says, forging ahead. "Follow me!"
rows.translation:
应该就可以了，”你大声说道，拿起那颗发光的翡翠泪珠，将其对准灯笼上的凹槽。果然，它完美地契合在了那里。宝石毫不费力地滑了进去，而当你把手拿开后，它内部的光芒立刻开始绽放——起初只是微弱的绿光，在洞穴的昏暗中闪烁着，但很快，那光芒就变得炽烈而温暖，照亮了整个房间。 

            卡莉丝猛地吸了一口凉气，然后捂住了眼睛。门开始缓缓打开，同时还能听到某种在石头上摩擦发出的声响——或许是有什么东西正在被移开吧？你瞥了卡莉丝一眼，看到这位圣骑士正在努力眨眼，试图摆脱眼中的刺眼光芒。最终，她终于双手抓住门框，用力将门推开了。石头与石头相互碰撞，在圣骑士紧张的肌肉力量作用下，门终于被强行打开了。你站在另一侧，协助将门完全推开。
            
            “戒指应该就在不远处了，”卡莉丝边说边继续前进。跟我来！

rows.original: The jade teardrop stone you acquired seems a perfect fit for the door.
rows.translation: 你获得的那块翡翠泪滴石，似乎与那扇门完美契合。
rows.raw: "The jade teardrop stone you acquired seems a perfect fit for the door."

rows.original:
This might be a noble family's mausoleum, [flags.RING_DEAD 2|you've done your best to return the bodies and their grave goods to right order.|but the bodies have been thoroughly defiled, their skeletons shattered to the floor and scattered by the demons searching for booty.] [flags.RING_ROBBERS 2|The tomb raiders themselves are sprawled out where you left them, too dazed to put up any fight.]

    The corridor stretches east and west from here.
rows.translation:
这或许是一座贵族家族的陵墓。 [flags.RING_DEAD 2|你已经尽了最大努力，将这些尸体及其随葬品重新安置到应有的位置。|但这些尸体已经被彻底毁坏了，它们的骨骼被恶魔们砸得粉碎，散落在地上，那些恶魔们正在寻找战利品。] [flags.RING_ROBBERS 2|那些盗墓者也还躺在你离开他们的地方，他们昏昏沉沉的，根本无力反抗。]

    这条走廊从这里向东西两侧延伸开来。
rows.raw:
"
    This might be a noble family's mausoleum, [flags.RING_DEAD 2|you've done your best to return the bodies and their grave goods to right order.|but the bodies have been thoroughly defiled, their skeletons shattered to the floor and scattered by the demons searching for booty.] [flags.RING_ROBBERS 2|The tomb raiders themselves are sprawled out where you left them, too dazed to put up any fight.]

    The corridor stretches east and west from here."

rows.original: You pick up right where the demons left off now that they're out of the way, scooping handfuls of necklaces and rings up into the sack they left on the ground. You get maybe two pounds worth of the stuff before you're given a solid crack over the head by one of Calise's armored gauntlets. "What do you think you're doing!?" the paladin scowls, planting her hands on her hips. "Even a demon... a demon should have better respect for the dead. You're debasing yourself to their level, now?" "Hey," you snap back, "this isn't doing anybody any good here. [pc.dcb |And you're not the boss of me. |This could fund the war effort. |I'm just taking the shinies back where people can enjoy them! ]" [party.has cait|"Come on," Cait mewls. "This isn't right."] [party.has brint|Brint crosses his arms. "C'mon. We're better than this."] [party.has brienne|Brienne looms over Calise. "Leave my [pc.mf|man|woman] alone."] Calise sighs, rubbing her face. "You're a terrible influence. Fine." She squats down and starts shoving treasure into the sack with you, avoiding your eyes all the while until you've secured your little fortune.
rows.translation: 既然那些恶魔已经消失，你可以从它们留下的地方继续捡东西了——把那些项链和戒指一把把装进它们留在地上的袋子里。你大概捡了价值两磅的财物，就在这时，卡莉丝的一只装甲护手猛地击中了你的头部。 “你以为自己在干什么！？”圣骑士怒气冲冲地说道，双手叉腰站在那里。“就算是恶魔……就算是恶魔也不会这么做！应该你们最好对死者怀有尊重。现在你们的行为简直是在与他们同流合污。” “嘿，”你愤怒地反驳道，“这样做根本没有任何好处，也不会让任何人感到好受。 [pc.dcb |你又不是我的上司。 |这笔资金足以支持战争所需的各项开支。 |我只是在把那些闪亮的物品送回人们可以欣赏它们的地方而已！ ]" [party.has cait|拜托，”凯特低声说道，“这样不对。] [party.has brint|布林特双臂交叉，说道：“拜托，我们不应该落到这种地步。] [party.has brienne|布蕾妮俯视着卡莉丝：“离开我的身边。 [pc.mf|男人|女性]独自一人。] 卡莉丝叹了口气，揉了揉脸：“你真是个负面的影响……好吧。” 她蹲下来，开始和你一起把那些财宝塞进袋子里，整个过程中她始终避开了你的视线，直到你把那些小财宝都收好了。

rows.original: Bag up all the gold and jewels the demons had taken; there's a small fortune in grave goods ripe for pillaging.
rows.translation: 把那些恶魔抢走的所有黄金和珠宝都收起来吧——那些陪葬品里可藏着一大笔财富呢，等着你们去抢呢。
rows.raw: "Bag up all the gold and jewels the demons had taken; there's a small fortune in grave goods ripe for pillaging."

rows.original:
"Come on," you say aloud, picking up the cracked remains of a minotaur skeleton. "Let's get these people back to their rest."

            "Let's, indeed," Calise says, rolling up her sleeves and getting to work. Between the [party.solo|two|lot] of you, it only takes half an hour or so to clean up the mess the demons had left behind. You can't surely match up jewelry to specific bodies, so you do what you can to distribute the bones and lucre evenly between the graves. 
            
            When it's done, Calise stands and wipes sweat off on the back of her gauntlet. "Well! I hope these poor souls can rest a little easier now. Even demons should know better than to disturb the dead like this. I'm glad we could take the time."
            
            You nod, dusting off and picking up your [pc.weapon]. "Same. But we should get going."
            
            "Right you are."
rows.translation:
“来吧，”你大声说着，捡起一具弥诺陶洛斯骸骨破裂的残骸。“让这些人重新安息。”

            “确实该这么做，”卡莉丝卷起袖子，开始干活。凭你们[party.solo|两人|这一大群人]的力量，只用了半小时左右便清理完恶魔留下的烂摊子。你实在无法判断每件珠宝具体属于哪具遗骸，只能尽量把骨头与财物均匀分回各座坟墓。 
            
            完成后，卡莉丝站起身，用护手背面擦去汗水。“好了！希望这些可怜的灵魂现在能安息一些。就连恶魔也该明白，不能这样惊扰死者。我很庆幸我们愿意花这点时间。”
            
            你点点头，拍去身上的尘土，拿起[pc.weapon]。“我也是。不过我们该走了。”
            
            “正是。”

rows.original: Return the skeletons to their rightful alcoves along with their grave goods.
rows.translation: 将那些骷髅放回它们应有的位置。以及他们的陪葬品。
rows.raw: "Return the skeletons to their rightful alcoves along with their grave goods."

rows.original: The sounds of crunching bone and giggling whispers reach your ears before you have the chance to round the corner ahead. Calise puts a hand on your chest, pushing you behind her as she plants her back to the wall and peers around. "Demons," she whispers. You lean out when she slips back, taking in the view: there's a group of four colorful succubi packed into the tunnel ahead of you, rifling through the wall graves with heartless disregard for the remains they're throwing about and crunching underhoof. They've recovered a substantial sack of lucre for their troubles, though: dozens of gold rings, gem-clasp amulets, and silver tiaras are piled up in the middle of the group. One of the demonesses lifts up a beautiful necklace, holding it up to the light of a torch she carries. "Wow, who knew all this treasure was up here all this time?" "Imagine all the humiliating things I had to do just to scrape together the hawks for food," another demoness sighs. "What a poor fool I was — should have robbed this place long ago. Now what am I going to do with all this money?" "I don't know," another murmurs. "This place is creepy. I don't want to get my ass eaten by angry ghosts." "How about I eat your ass then?" the second titters. "The only haunting moans we'll be hearing are yours." The fourth of them finally sighs, thumbing a wand on her belt. "Don't take too long, we still need to find this key for Mistress Vacia." The succubi giggle excitedly, two of them merrily pawing the grave goods of dead nobles while the others start getting handsy with more lascivious goods. Calise tightens her hold on her axe. "What crass creatures. How did those airheads find their way up here..." "Perhaps Kasyrra sent them?" "I doubt it," Calise whispers back. "Why would their queen be interested in robbing burial gold from corpses. I hear she made off with the whole treasury of the Winter City already. Anyway, they're in our way. I say it's time to crusade." Calise brings her axe up into a two-handed grip, readying herself for combat.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及绕过前方转角，骨骼碎裂的声音与窃笑低语就已传入耳中。卡莉丝将一只手按上你的胸膛，把你推到身后；她背靠墙壁站稳，探头望向转角另一侧。 “恶魔。”她低声说道。 等她缩回身体，你探头向外望去，将景象尽收眼底：四个色彩鲜艳的魅魔挤在前方隧道里，正在翻找墙上墓穴；她们毫不在意被随手抛得到处都是、又被蹄子踩碎的遗骸。不过，她们的劳动确实换来了一大袋财富：几十枚金戒指、宝石扣饰护符和银制冠冕堆在众人中央。 一名女恶魔拿起一条美丽的项链，将其举到自己携带的火把前。“哇，谁能想到，这么多宝藏一直都藏在上面？” “想想我为了勉强凑齐买食物的鹰币，曾经做过多少丢脸的事。”另一名女恶魔叹息道。“我真是个可怜的傻瓜——早就该来抢劫这里。现在，我该拿这么多钱做什么呢？” “我不知道。”另一个低声说道。“这里好吓人。我可不想让愤怒的幽灵吃掉屁股。” “不如换我来吃你的屁股？”第二个魅魔窃笑道。“到时候我们唯一能听见的闹鬼呻吟，只会来自你的嘴。” 第四名魅魔终于叹了口气，以拇指摩挲着腰带上的魔杖。“别耽搁太久，我们还得替瓦西亚女主人找到这把钥匙。” 魅魔们兴奋地咯咯直笑；其中两个愉快地翻弄已故贵族的陪葬品，另外两个则对更加淫荡的宝贝动手动脚。 卡莉丝握紧斧头。“真是一群粗鄙的生物。那些没脑子的家伙到底怎么找到这里的……” “或许是卡希拉派来的？” “我对此表示怀疑。”卡莉丝低声回答。“她们的女王为什么会对从尸体旁偷走陪葬黄金感兴趣？我听说她已经把冬城的整座宝库洗劫一空了。总之，她们挡住了我们的去路。是时候发起圣战了。” 卡莉丝双手握住斧头举起，做好战斗准备。
rows.raw: ' The sounds of crunching bone and giggling whispers reach your ears before you have the chance to round the corner ahead. Calise puts a hand on your chest, pushing you behind her as she plants her back to the wall and peers around. "Demons," she whispers. You lean out when she slips back, taking in the view: there's a group of four colorful succubi packed into the tunnel ahead of you, rifling through the wall graves with heartless disregard for the remains they're throwing about and crunching underhoof. They've recovered a substantial sack of lucre for their troubles, though: dozens of gold rings, gem-clasp amulets, and silver tiaras are piled up in the middle of the group. One of the demonesses lifts up a beautiful necklace, holding it up to the light of a torch she carries. "Wow, who knew all this treasure was up here all this time?" "Imagine all the humiliating things I had to do just to scrape together the hawks for food," another demoness sighs. "What a poor fool I was — should have robbed this place long ago. Now what am I going to do with all this money?" "I don't know," another murmurs. "This place is creepy. I don't want to get my ass eaten by angry ghosts." "How about I eat your ass then?" the second titters. "The only haunting moans we'll be hearing are yours." The fourth of them finally sighs, thumbing a wand on her belt. "Don't take too long, we still need to find this key for Mistress Vacia." The succubi giggle excitedly, two of them merrily pawing the grave goods of dead nobles while the others start getting handsy with more lascivious goods. Calise tightens her hold on her axe. "What crass creatures. How did those airheads find their way up here..." "Perhaps Kasyrra sent them?" "I doubt it," Calise whispers back. "Why would their queen be interested in robbing burial gold from corpses. I hear she made off with the whole treasury of the Winter City already. Anyway, they're in our way. I say it's time to crusade." Calise brings her axe up into a two-handed grip, readying herself for combat.'

                |Calise, pulling her with you into the shadows

rows.original:
"Mistress Vacia? Is that you?" one of the succubi huffs accusatorily. You hear a blade being drawn from its scabbard. "This isn't funny."

        "Shit," Calise hisses, tightening her grip on her axe. "Do something."
        
        "Retuuuuurn our treasuuuuuure," you groan, "or suffer our cuuuuuuurse."
        
        "That's not Vacia," another succubus gasps. "Who are you?"
        
        You hear hooves approaching, and more blades being drawn.
        
        Calise sighs. "Okay, we'll do it my way then." Green flame crackles along her weapon's blade, a moment before the paladin hefts the weapon up and hurls herself around the corner with a bellowing warcry.

“瓦西亚女士？是您吗？”其中一个魅魔愤怒地质问道。你听到有刀刃从刀鞘中抽出的声音。“这一点都不好笑。”

        “该死，”卡莉丝低声咒骂着，紧紧握住手中的斧头。“快想办法吧。”
        
        “把我们的财宝还回来，”你呻吟道，“否则就要承受我们的报复。”
        
        “那不是瓦西亚……”另一个魅魔惊呼道，“你们到底是谁？”
        
        你听到马蹄声逐渐临近，同时也听到更多的人拔出了刀刃。
        
        卡莉丝叹了口气：“好吧，那就按我的方式来吧。”绿色的火焰在她的武器刀刃上闪烁着，紧接着，这位圣骑士举起了武器，伴随着一声激昂的战吼，冲向了拐角处。

rows.original:
The last of the demons falls, collapsing into the growing pile of mewling demon flesh. 
    
    "W-wait!" she cries, hands up. "Come on, we're just here for Miss Vacia. We didn't mean any harm, honest! L-let us make it up to you, huh?"
    
    Calise sighs. "How quickly [silly
        |the tide turns
        |their attitudes change
    ] when they aren't on top. Tsk. Do what you will, [pc.name], but make it fast — we have work to do."
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |You arch a brow. "Shouldn't you be the first one in line to put a bunch of demons down."
        
        The paladin shrugs. "Imps are one thing. Nearly mindless. These are... they were people, once. As far as we can tell, anyway. If you believe they need to die, then do it. If you wish to use them as stress relief, do so. The victory is as much yours as mine, and I'm in no hurry for either."
        |
        "What, you think I should take them up on it?"
        
        The paladin shrugs. "Do as you will. The victory is as much yours as mine, and it's not my place to decide who lives and dies alone. I would just as soon send them off with their tails between their legs — these aren't mindless imps here."
        
        You see...
    ]

rows.original: Falling to temptation is one of the many trials you face on this adventure, and it fast becomes a genuine tribulation as a wave of sensuous emotion goes through you. The feeling of lust building. Fantasies come to life, and you sigh. Thinking about how much you've gone through up to this point, and the trouble of just getting here, you damn the risks and declare your intentions. [pc.dcb |"We're taking a break here, and these four are going to make it good for us," you say, throwing in a little grunt at Calise especially. "If you want in, you're in. If not, fuck off." |"Don't know about you," you start, gazing at Calise. "But I need a break, and I'm not taking no for an answer." |"Four girls all to us! Come on, let's rest and get plenty of help relaxing!" you say in that chime-like voice impossible to refuse. ] In typical bravado, you handle the needful yourself: reclaim the wealth stolen by these robbers, make sure their weapons are far out of their reach, and make sure that they are as naked as you. That last part is the long one, thanks to impatience. You spend too much time pushing them against the ground and masturbating them through the clench of their legs, feeling quivery and excited by the fact that you're about to orchestrate one hell of an orgy. They watch with flushed faces as you stand before them and cast one last look over the room, doing your best to ignore the drip of femme-cum from your fingers. No cushions, no bedding, no incense, but any port in a storm, so it is said. Besides, voluptuous succubi are comfort enough in a place like this. Breasts, pillows, what's the difference? 青金石在我东南方（Lapis is southeast of me）
紫水晶在我北方（Amethyst is north of me）
翡翠在我东南方（Jade is southeast of me）

rows.original: The lock disengages with a satisfying ching, clattering to the ground and leaving the tomb ripe for plundering. Calise rolls her eyes but steps up to help you push the heavy stone lid aside, toppling it off the side with a grunt of effort. [silly |You've got a first row seat to the gun show all the while, at least. |You glance over, watching the lean muscles on Calise's bare arms tense and flex. ] "All that axe-swinging has really been paying off," you chuckle. "Oh?" the paladin smirks, arching a brow beneath her helm. "Do you like a girl with a little muscle?" [party.has arona |"Yeah [pc.heShe] does," Arona grins, rapping her knuckles on her abs. ] [party.has brienne |"[pc.name] has excellent tastes," Brienne says. ] She puts one hand on a hip and curls the other, flexing. [calise.fucked |You reach over and give a bicep an appreciative squeeze before turning your attention to the tomb. "Damn right I do." |You give her tensed shoulder an appreciative slug before turning your attention to the tomb. ] Just as expected, there's a minotaur skeleton damn near as big and wide as Brint [brint.isBrienne |used to be |is ], with a huge rack of horns that are lifting his skull up — too big to fit in his own sarcophagus with his hooves scraping the bottom. The minotaur's face is still covered with that grimacing gilded mask, covered in dust but otherwise exactly the same as depicted in the murals and sarcophagus cover. [party.has cait |"I wonder what it was for," Cait muses, peering in. "I've heard of some druids wearing wooden masks, but this man clearly served the Seven." ] [party.has etheryn |"Reminds me of some druidic artifacts back home," Ryn says. "They used to be displayed in the cathedral. Left over from the Godswar." ] [party.has brint |Brint snorts. "Damn that's even uglier in person." ] [party.has brienne |Brienne snorts. "That's one cultural relic I think we can leave buried." ] You reach into the tomb and gingerly remove the mask from the skull, working its aged straps over the horns until it comes free. You hold the mask up, running your fingers over its giant, bearded, fatherly face. Acquired the Patrician Mask!
rows.translation: 锁具在解锁时会发出令人满意的声响。叮石头哗啦一声掉落在地上，墓穴顿时暴露在空气中，成为了掠夺的目标。卡莉丝翻了个白眼，但还是走上前帮你把那块重型的石盖推到一边，费了九牛二虎之力才把它弄到了一旁。 [silly |至少，你能够一直处于这场“枪械展览”的第一排观看现场情况。 |你瞥了一眼，看到卡莉丝裸露在外的手臂上那些结实的肌肉正在紧张地收缩与伸展。 ] 那些挥舞斧头的举动果然没有白费，”你笑着说。 “哦？”圣骑士嘴角扬起一丝笑意，头盔下的眉毛微微一挑，“你喜欢有点肌肉的女孩子吗？ [party.has arona |是的。 [pc.heShe]确实如此，”阿罗娜笑着说，同时用指关节敲了敲自己的腹部。 ] [party.has brienne |"[pc.name]的品味确实很高，”布蕾妮说道。 ] 她把一只手叉在腰上，另一只手则弯曲起来展示力量。 [calise.fucked |你伸手握了握他的二头肌，表示赞赏，然后才将注意力转向那座坟墓。“当然会了。 |你在注意到那座坟墓之前，先轻轻拍了拍她那紧绷的肩膀，以表示赞赏。 ]正如预期的那样，那里有一具弥诺陶洛斯骷髅，它的大小和宽度几乎与布林特相当。 [brint.isBrienne |曾经是 |是 ]它的头部长着一排巨大的角，这些角将它的头骨高高撑起，大到根本无法安放在自己的石棺中，它的蹄子还刮擦着石棺的下装。这个弥诺陶洛斯的脸上仍然戴着那副金色的面具，虽然上面积满了灰尘，但与壁画和石棺盖上的描绘完全一样。 [party.has cait |我想知道这东西是用来做什么的，”凯特边说边仔细观察着那个物品。“我听说过有些德鲁伊会戴着木制面具，但这个男人显然是在侍奉七神。 ] [party.has etheryn |这让我想起了家乡的一些德鲁伊神器，”小琳说道，“那些神器曾经被陈列在大教堂里，是神战时期遗留下来的。 ] [party.has brint |布林特哼了一声：“该死，真人看起来更丑了。 ] [party.has brienne |布蕾妮哼了一声：“我觉得那件文物就让它继续埋在地下吧。 ] 你伸手进入墓穴，小心翼翼地将面具从头骨上取下来，将那些陈旧的带子绕过角状突起，直到面具完全取下。你将面具举在手中，用手指轻轻抚摸着它那巨大的、布满胡须的、充满父性特征的面容。 获得贵族面具！

rows.original: "The people must have loved this woman a great deal," Calise muses, looking about the tomb. "The other tombs we've passed were more lavish, more resplendent in wealth, but this one... I can just feel how much adoration went into these goddess murals, the statuary. So much to watch over one soul." [party.has cait |Cait puts a hand over her heart, head lowered. "Me too. I feel terrible for what we're about to do. |The paladin sighs. "But we must do what we must do." ] You give the holy woman a nod and step up towards the raised grave. The engraving on the top of the sarcophagus depicts a young woman, dressed in a feathered tunic and wearing a beautiful silver circlet. A single teardrop is cresting her cheek, falling towards the floor. "Poor thing," Calise says. "I wonder what happened that they'd memorialize her like this." [party.comp brint brienne |Brint shrugs. "Wish I knew the whole story." |Brienne shrugs. "Wish I knew the whole story." ] [party.has agni |Your phoenix bard ruffles her feathers. "Can't remember for the life of me. If I ever knew." ] You and Calise exchange a look and plant your hands on the edge of the lid, heaving it off the top. Inside, there's a silk lining supporting the skeletal body of a small, slender cowgirl. You doubt she was past her prime when she was buried, but there are enough cracks and scars visible in the bones to tell you she saw her share of battles. Likely fell in one, though you can't guess which of her many injuries might have been fatal if so. A silk veil was place around the girl's eyes, obscuring much of her face, but beneath if you can see the faintest hint of golden glimmer in the torchlight. A necklace. Calise brushes the veil aside, grimaces at whatever she sees under it, and retrieves the necklace. A thin chain of gold wire supports a teardrop-shaped jadestone, dangling from amidst a number of gold charms — a labrys, a feather, and an oak leaf. When Calise's fingers brush across the gem, her touch leaves it glowing faintly, lit by a flickering inner light that fades soon after. The paladin furrows her brow and vigorously rubs the stone again between thumb and forefinger, stoking that ember to a full-blown glow. "I'll be," Calise says, watching it brighten. "What a precious little thing you are." "Any idea what it is?" She shakes her head and presses the necklace into your hand. "I'm not much of an arcanist, but I wouldn't be surprised if it was forged from a sliver of that minotauress's soul. I can feel the essence radiating from it, and this jewel is certainly important enough to be her only burial gift." "Reminds me of the lantern outside," you muse, watching the green light within the stone dance and flicker in your hand. Calise was right — you can feel a tingle in your palms where the gem touches your [pc.skinFurScales], warm as a lover's caress. Key Item acquired: Jade Teardrop!
rows.translation: 人们一定非常爱这位女性，”卡莉丝凝视着墓室说道，“我们之前看到的那些墓葬虽然更加奢华、更加富丽堂皇，但这个墓室……我真切地感受到，人们在这些女神壁画和雕像上倾注了多少爱与敬意。这一切，都是为了守护一个灵魂。 [party.has cait |凯特把手放在心上，低下了头。“我也是。对于我们即将要做的事情，我感到非常内疚。 |圣骑士叹了口气：“但我们必须去做该做的事。 ] 你向那位圣女点了点头，然后走向那座高高的坟墓。石棺顶部的雕刻上描绘了一位年轻女子，她穿着羽毛装饰的长袍，头戴一枚精美的银质环饰。一滴泪珠挂在她脸颊上，正缓缓滑落下去。“真可怜，”卡莉丝说道，“不知道发生了什么，才会让他们以这样的方式纪念她。 [party.comp brint brienne |布林特耸了耸肩：“真希望自己能知道整个事情的来龙去脉。 |布蕾妮耸了耸肩：“真希望自己能知道整个事情的来龙去脉。 ] [party.has agni |你的凤凰吟游诗人怒不可遏：“我实在想不起来了。要是我知道的话，肯定早就告诉你了。 ] 你和卡莉丝对视了一眼，然后把手放在盖子的边缘，将盖子掀了开来。里面有一层丝绸衬里，托着一位身材娇小、纤细的牛仔女骨架。你怀疑她下葬时已经过了巅峰期，但从那些骨骼上可见的裂纹和伤痕来看，她显然经历过不少战斗。她很可能摔在了其中某个陷阱里，不过谁也猜不出，她所受的那些伤中，究竟哪一处导致了她的死亡。女孩的眼睛上蒙着丝质面纱，遮住了她面部的大部分轮廓，但在面纱的下方，在火把的光芒中，你能隐约看到一丝金色的光芒。一条项链。 卡莉丝将面纱拨到一边，看到面纱下的景象后不禁皱起了眉头，然后取出了那条项链。一条细金链子上悬挂着一颗泪滴形的翡翠宝石，周围还点缀着几件金制饰品——一把双刃斧、一根羽毛以及一片橡树叶。当卡莉丝的手指触碰到那颗宝石时，它会发出微弱的光芒，那种闪烁的光芒很快又会消失。这位女骑士皱起眉头，用拇指和食指用力揉搓那颗宝石，使得那微弱的光芒重新变得明亮起来。 我会的，”卡莉丝说道，看着那颗宝石逐渐亮起来，“你真是个珍贵的小东西。” “你知道它到底是什么吗？” 她摇了摇头，然后将那条项链递到你手中：“我并不是什么研究神秘事物的专家，但如果这颗宝石真的是用那头米诺陶洛斯的灵魂碎片锻造出来的，我也不会感到惊讶。我能感觉到从中散发出来的那种能量，而这样一颗珍贵的宝石，确实足以成为她唯一的陪葬品。 这让我想起了外面的灯笼，”你边想着，边看着手中石头内部闪烁的绿光。卡莉丝说得对——当宝石与你的手掌接触时，你会感觉到一阵刺痛感。 [pc.skinFurScales]温暖如恋人轻抚般的触感。 获得关键物品：翡翠泪珠！

rows.original: "This must be it!" Calise says, jogging ahead as you come to the last chamber in the Tiran wing of the mausoleum. One grave is raised up above all the rest, even those in the royal wing back south, with steps leading up to a raised sarcophagus shrouded with black veils and surrounded by a titanic mural of the grave goddess, arms open as if to embrace her fallen champion. [party.comp brint brienne |Brint whistles. "So that's Persenne, huh? Hope we've all made her proud over the years." |Brienne whistles. "Persenne's grave. Poor girl, buried so far away from her husband." ] Calise slings her axe over her shoulder and trots up the steps, hurrying to pull the veils away. "[kas.romantic |We're so close, darling! Can't you feel it? |We've almost got it, [pc.name]! ]" the paladin says, smiling. "Finally, something's gone my way." "Just yours?" you ask, following her up. "You can't understand how important the Ring of Fate may be," Calise says. "For both of us. This could — ah, we'll talk about it later. Just help me retrieve it." Calise braces her feet and heaves the lid off the sarcophagus, revealing an inter that is wholly empty... save for a small, black-lacquered box about the size of the paladin's palm. [party.has cait |"Um," Cait says, ears folding. "Wh-where's the body?" |"Hmm." Calise pauses, blinking. "I... I feel like there should be a body in here, no?" ] The paladin glances between you and the tomb, and then picks up the box. "At least we didn't come for naught. Surely this is... yes!" The black box clatters to the floor, leaving a midnight-black ring resting in Calise's hand. Nothing reflects from its surface, no glint of precious metal beneath the aged coloring. Whereas the jade tearstone held an inner radiance eager to be stoked, this artifact seems to absorb all the light that dares touch it. The only flaw, if you could call it that, on its shadowy surface is a single indent in the shape of a teardrop on one side. [pc.isCunning |"Everything you hoped it would be?" you ask, watching Calise's rapturous expression with interest. ] "It's... beautiful," Calise murmurs, tracing tanned fingers across fathomless black metal. "Like a starless night sky." [pc.bg acolyte |"Or like Tira's robes," you suggest. |[party.has cait |"More like Tira's robes," Cait says. |You can't help but see the resemblance, yeah. ] ] The paladin draws in an unsteady breath, closing her fingers around the ring. "[pc.isCunning |I'll have to see it in action, but this power... I think it really just might be what we need. |Such power... it may just be what we need. ] Thank you, [pc.name]. I'm glad to have had you with me for this." "Now," she says, turning back. "The sooner we return to Khor'minos, the sooner I can get to work unlocking the ring's potential!"
rows.translation: 就是这里了！”当你来到陵墓蒂拉教会的翼的最后一间墓室时，卡莉丝快步走在你前面说道。有一座坟墓高出其他所有坟墓，甚至那些位于南侧皇家区域的坟墓也不例外。通往那座坟墓的台阶通向一个被黑色面纱覆盖的石棺，而周围则绘有一幅巨大的壁画——画中的墓神双臂张开，仿佛在拥抱她那位已逝的勇士。 [party.comp brint brienne |布林特吹了声口哨：“原来她是佩尔森，啊？希望这些年来我们都没有让她失望。 |布蕾妮吹了声口哨：“佩尔森的坟墓……可怜的女孩，被埋在了离她丈夫那么远的地方。 ] 卡莉丝把斧头甩到肩上，快步走上台阶，急忙去拉开那些面纱。[kas.romantic |我们已经离成功这么近了，亲爱的！你难道感觉不到吗？ |我们差不多成功了。 [pc.name]！ ]圣骑士微笑着说：‘终于，有些事情开始朝着我期望的方向发展了。’” “只是对你来说而已吗？”你追问道。 “你根本无法理解这件事对……来说有多重要。命运之环也许吧，”卡莉丝说道，“对我们两个人来说都是这样。这个事情……嗯，我们稍后再讨论。现在先帮我把那个东西取出来吧。” 卡莉丝稳住脚步，用力掀开了石棺的盖子，里面竟然空无一物……只有一个大小与圣骑士手掌相当的小黑漆盒子。 [party.has cait |嗯，”凯特说道，耳朵微微耷了下来，“那……尸体在哪里？ |嗯。”卡莉丝停顿了一下，眨了眨眼，“我觉得这里应该有个人吧？ ] 圣骑士将目光在你和那座坟墓之间来回扫视，然后拿起了那个盒子。“至少我们没有白来。这肯定就是……对了！”那个黑色盒子重重地掉在地板上，而卡莉丝的手中则留下一枚深黑色的戒指。它的表面没有任何反轻型，那层陈旧的色彩之下，也没有任何贵金属的光芒。与那些内部蕴含着光芒、亟待被激发光芒的玉泪石不同，这件工艺品似乎吸收了所有试图照射到它身上的光线。如果说它有什么瑕疵的话，那就是在它那阴暗的表面上，有一侧有一个呈泪滴形状的凹陷。 [pc.isCunning |就是你想象中的那样吗？”你问道，饶有兴致地观察着卡莉丝那充满陶醉的表情。 ] 真是……太美了，”卡莉丝轻声说道，她那双晒成棕色的手指轻轻抚过那深邃如夜的黑色金属表面，“就像没有星星的夜空一样。 [pc.bg acolyte |或者像蒂拉的袍子那样，”你建议道。 |[party.has cait |更像是蒂拉的袍子，”凯特说道。 |你确实会忍不住注意到它们之间的相似之处，没错。 ] ] 圣骑士喘着不平稳的气，将手指紧紧握住那枚戒指。[pc.isCunning |我得亲眼看看它的实际效果，但这种力量……我觉得它真的可能正是我们所需要的。 |这样的力量……或许正是我们所需要的。 ]谢谢。 [pc.name]我很高兴你能陪我一起经历这一切。” “现在，”她转过身来说，“我们越早回到科尔米诺斯，我就能越快开始研究如何释放这枚戒指的潜力了！

    Indeed. You [calise.fucked
        |extend a hand to your divine companion, lacing your fingers through hers as you begin trekking back towards the city.
        |earn an approving smile from your divine companion before she waves you on, letting you start the trek back towards the city.
    ] The Sorran windstorm that once threatened to sweep your party off the mountainside has died down to nothing more than a bitter chill, and so you step confidently back onto the narrow downward slope.
    
    And [calise.fucked
        |then you feel Cali's hand tighten on yours so hard you're afraid she's going to break it. Just as soon as it started, her fingers go limp, slipping from your hand.
        |then a moment later you realize that there's one too few sets of footfalls crunching through the snow.
    ]
    
    "Calise?" you ask, turning. 
    
    She's standing a couple paces behind you now, pretty green eyes wide with shock. Both her hands are gripped around a blade of silvery-white iron protruding straight through her breastplate.
rows.translation:
“我们下山吧。”你朝小路挥手示意，“准备好了吗，卡莉丝？”

    “再好不过。”圣骑士[flags.RING_GIVE|用手轻抚你戴着魔法戒指的那只手|在手中翻弄着那枚魔法戒指]，说道，“请带路吧。见识过刚才那一幕后，我想我们不必担心再遭鹰身女妖袭击了。”
    
    确实如此。你[calise.fucked
        |向你的神圣同伴伸出手，与她十指相扣，随后一同踏上回城之路。
        |赢得了神圣同伴赞许的微笑；她挥手示意你先行，让你领头踏上回城之路。
    ]曾险些将你们一行人刮下山崖的索拉风暴，如今只剩下刺骨的寒意。于是，你信步踏上了狭窄的下坡。
    
    而后，[calise.fucked
        |你感觉卡莉突然死死攥住你的手，力道之大，几乎让你担心她会将它捏断。可这阵力道来得快、去得也快；她的手指忽然松软下来，从你掌中滑落。

rows.original:
"Calise!" you gasp, taking a step forward and reaching towards your companion. The sword protruding from her chest slides back wetly; Calise's eyes roll back, and she falls to her knees as a dark, multi-tailed shape leaps over her and lands between you. It's a kitsune, wearing little more than a mesh bodysuit and belts covered in knives and potions, her tails the color of a midnight sky and speckled with white roots like the stars. 
        
        "You missed my heart, stupid bitch," Calise growls, staggering up onto one knee. Blood rushes from between fingers clenched over her wound. 
        
        "I struck exactly where I meant to," the assassin says evenly. She flicks her sword under her arm, drawing it clean. "The veins near the heart. To spread the poison faster. I would like to kill you cleanly, but Michael insists you die screaming. I never could say no to him. My apologies."
        
        The kitsune raises her sword to you, sliding her feet apart and gripping its leather-wrapped handle in both hands. "And now, [pc.ra kitsune
            |to the Champion of Keros. My, my, I never thought the lord of lies would find a new champion in my lifetime. Much less some western barbarian. He truly has no shame, does he? Well, the August Whore isn't here to step in, I'm afraid.
            |the Champion of Frost.
        ] [party.has kiyoko
            |And the lady Ōtomo, too, back from the dead. 
        ]We [flags.FACE_SAW
            |can come face to face properly
            |meet at last
        ]. You've been a thorn in my friend's little cult for far too long. Enough. There's no demon queen here to vouchsafe your life. She'll never know what happened to you and your friends. Perhaps that will set her mind free."
        
        Behind the kitsune, Calise takes a staggering step forward, teeth clenched and knuckles white around her axe — though she's not yet found the strength to lift it from the snowy stones underfoot. She nearly slips, coughing up blood. "You... leave [pc.himHer]... alone."
        
        "Oh? Still standing?" The assassin sighs, adjusting her stance to face you and Calise both. "Not for much longer, though. The blood's blackening. Come, then. I'll make it quick."
        
        [pc.dcb
            |"Calise, stay down. I'll handle this bitch."
            |"Calise! Hang back, conserve your strength! I'll protect you."
            |"Oh no, Cali! Stay down, cutie, I've got this!"
        ]
        
        "Not on your life," Calise snarls through grit teeth. "I will not... let her... argh!" 
        
        "Hmm," the kitsune muses quietly, watching Calise pitch forward onto the snow. "That poison should be strong enough to cripple a minotaur. She's strong. Stronger than any human... ah! How bothersome. Well? Come then, Champion, while she's still breathing. You still have a chance. If you can defeat me."
        
        [calise.fucked
            |"Even if it costs me my life," you tell her, readying your [pc.weapon].
            |[pc.isDK
                |You know full well she'll kill you anyway, if you don't take the first move.
                |"I'm not letting you kill her," you say, readying your [pc.weapon].
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
卡莉丝！”你惊呼着，向前迈出一步，伸手去拉你的同伴。那把刺入她胸口的剑湿漉漉地滑了回来；卡莉丝的眼睛翻白，整个人跪倒在地，与此同时，一个黑色、多尾的怪物从她身上跃过，落在了你们中间。那是一只狐妖，身上几乎只穿着一件网眼紧身衣，腰间系着布满刀刃和药水的腰带；她的尾巴呈现出午夜天空的颜色，上面点缀着如同星星般的白色斑点。
        
        “你没打中我的心，愚蠢的贱人，”卡莉丝咆哮着，踉跄着单膝跪地。血液从她紧握着伤口的手指间涌出。
        
        “我确实击中了目标，”刺客平静地说道。她将剑从身下抽回，动作干净利落。“击中了靠近心脏的静脉，这样毒液就能更快地扩散。我本来想干净利落地杀了你，但迈克尔坚持要让你在惨叫中死去。我从来都无法拒绝他的要求。实在抱歉。
        
        那只狐妖举起了她的剑，双脚分开站立，双手紧紧握住剑柄。现在， [pc.ra kitsune
            |致凯罗斯的冠军……哎呀，我真没想到，在我有生之年内，这个谎言之王还能找到新的拥护者。更何况还是个西方野蛮人……他简直毫无廉耻之心，不是吗？唉，恐怕“八月妓女”也不会来插手这件事了。
            |冰霜冠军。
        ] [party.has kiyoko
            |而大友女士，也仿佛从死里复活了一般。 
        ]我们[flags.FACE_SAW
            |能够真正面对面地交流
            |终于见面了
        ]你早就成了我朋友这个小团体的眼中钉了。够了。这里没有什么恶魔女王会保你的性命。她永远也不会知道你和你的朋友们发生了什么。或许这样，她才能放下心里的负担。”
        
        在那只狐妖的背后，卡莉丝踉跄着向前迈出了一步，牙齿紧咬，手中的斧头把都掐得发白了——但她却还无法将斧头从脚下的积雪中拔起来。她差点滑倒，还咳出了鲜血。“你……快离开吧。 [pc.himHer]……独自一人。”
        
        “哦？还站着吗？”刺客叹了口气，调整姿势，以便同时面对你和卡莉丝。“不过，这样下去也坚持不了多久了。我的血液正在变黑……来吧，我会尽快结束的。
        
        [pc.dcb
            |卡莉丝，趴下。这个麻烦事交给我来处理。
            |卡莉丝！退后一点，保存体力！我会保护你的。
            |哦不，卡莉！躺下来，宝贝，有我在呢！
        ]
        
        绝对不行，”卡莉丝咬紧牙关怒吼道，“我绝不会……让她得逞……啊！”
        
        “嗯，”那只狐妖低声沉思着，看着卡莉丝重重摔倒在雪地上，“那种毒药应该足以让弥诺陶洛斯失去行动能力才对。她很强大，比任何人类都要强……啊！真让人头疼。那么，冠军，趁她还有气的时候，来试试看吧。你还是有机会的……只要你能打败我。
        
        [calise.fucked
            |即使这会让我付出生命的代价，”你对她说，同时做好了准备。 [pc.weapon]。
            |[pc.isDK
                |你心里很清楚，如果你不先采取行动，她迟早会杀了你。
                |我不会让你杀了她，”你说道，同时准备好了行动。 [pc.weapon]。
            ]
        ]

rows.original:
The assassin draws a sharp breath, skidding back across the snow. She's breathing hard, now, gripping her swift sword so tightly that her knuckles are as white as the roots of her hair showing beneath her black dye. "Nya! I can see why Lady Kasyrra [kas.hostile
        |considers you such a threat.
        |is so enamored of you!
    ] It seems even I am not enough to bring you down alone."
    
    She glances between you and where Calise has fallen face-down in the snow, slowly lowering her sword and stepping guardedly back. You pursue, bringing up your [pc.weapon] in counter, ready to strike the final blow. Rather than unleashing another flurry of strikes, though, the assassin leaps backward off the edge of the cliff, somersaulting in the air and disappearing off the cliff. 
    
    Rather than pursuing her, you run to the crumpled paladin. Her mouth and chest are caked in blood, the wound through her breast still open and gushing. You rip off her cloak and push it into the hole, desperately trying to stop the bleeding. No amount of healing magic will be able to close a wound this severe — she needs a surgeon, and if you can't stop the blood loss, she won't make it to town.
    
    [party.has cait
        |"Hold on, Lady Calise!" Cait murmurs, laying her hands over the injury and channeling everything she has in futile desperation. "Please — don't die!"
    ]
    
    Calise groans, teeth clenched and eyes wide and full of agonized tears. "Ma— fuck! Velun's beard, this hurts!" Her hand grabs yours, trembling and weak. When you came up the mountain, the warmth radiating off of Cali was palpable even at a distance; now she's gone clammy. Gods. "D-don't worry about me. I've lived through — hrrk! — through worse."
    
    You very much doubt that. "[pc.isDK
        |Keep quiet, damn you. Save your strength.
        |Calise... save your strength.
    ] We've got to get you back to town."
    
    She hisses, turning your hand to hers and squeezing it. "Don't... don't bother. I'll be... just leave me here to rest. Go on ahead."
    
    The paladin releases your hand[flags.RING_GIVE
        |. "Go. Please... you don't need to see this."
        
        [calise.fucked
            |[pc.isDK
                |"Fuck you," you tell her right back. "Stop telling me what to do. I'm saving your ass if it's the last thing I do."
                |"That's not going to happen."
            ]
        ]
        |, leaving the mystical ring in your palm. "Take it. Go." [calise.fucked
            |
            
            "This is a real bad time to propose," you tell her, closing your fingers around the ring. She laughs, though it turns into an agonized wince. "Come on, Cali. No."
            
            "I wish... I wish there was a good time," she groans. "Go on, love. You don't need to see this." 
            
            [pc.isDK
                |"Fuck you," you tell her right back. "Stop telling me what to do. I'm saving your ass if it's the last thing I do."
                |"That's not going to happen."
            ]
        ]
    ]
    
    You take a deep breath and hook your arms under Calise's legs and shoulders. "This is going to hurt." She's as good as dead if you don't. [pc.isDK
        |[calise.fucked
            |
            |And Khor'minos goes with her. You know exactly who's getting blamed for all this shit, don't you?
        ]
    ]
    
    "Fuck!" Calise howls, weakly kicking her legs and clutching desperately to your shoulders as she's heaved up. There's a sea of red in the snow where she'd fallen. You turn back towards the long, winding path down the mountainside. If you hurry... 
    
    "[pc.name]..." the fallen knight finally manages to say, voice barely more than a whisper now. "[calise.fucked
        |I think... I just... just want you to know I... as short a time as it's been... I love you.
        |Th-thank you... wouldn't have... couldn't have... picked a better Champion to... be here with me. You're everything I wish I could have been...
    ]"
    
    Oh, gods, she's fading fast. You've got to...

        |会把你视作如此大的威胁。
        |会这么迷恋你了！
    ]看来光靠我一个人，还不足以放倒你。”
    
    她的目光在你和脸朝下倒在雪地里的卡莉丝之间来回扫视，缓缓放下剑，警惕地向后退步。你追了上去，举起[pc.weapon]应对，准备给出最后一击。然而，她并没有再放出一连串攻击，而是向后跃出悬崖边缘，在空中翻了个跟头，消失在崖下。 
    
    你没有去追她，而是奔向那个瘫倒在地的圣骑士。她的嘴和胸口糊满鲜血，穿过乳房的伤口仍然敞着，血涌不止。你扯下她的斗篷塞进那个血洞里，拼命想止住出血。这么重的伤，再多的治疗魔法也合不上——她需要外科医生，而如果你止不住失血，她根本撑不到镇上。
    
    [party.has cait
        |“撑住，卡莉丝女士！”凯特低声说，双手按在伤口上，绝望而徒劳地倾注她全部的魔力。“求你了——别死！”
    ]
    
    卡莉丝呻吟起来，牙关咬紧，双眼圆睁，盈满痛苦的泪水。“妈——操！维伦的胡须啊，真他妈疼！”她的手抓住你的手，颤抖而无力。你上山时，隔着老远都能感到卡莉身上散发的暖意；现在她却浑身湿冷。神啊。“别——别管我。我熬过——呃咳！——熬过更糟的。”
    
    你对此深表怀疑。“[pc.isDK
        |闭嘴，该死的。省点力气。
        |卡莉丝……省点力气。
    ]我们得把你送回镇上。”
    
    她嘶了一声，把你的手翻过来攥住。“别……别费事了。我会……就把我留在这儿歇会儿。你先走吧。”
    
    圣骑士松开你的手[flags.RING_GIVE
        |。“走吧。求你了……你不需要看着这一切。”
        
        [calise.fucked
            |[pc.isDK
                |“去你妈的，”你立刻回敬她。“别对我指手画脚。就算这是我做的最后一件事，我也要把你救回来。”
                |“那不可能发生。”
            ]
        ]
        |，把那枚神秘的戒指留在你掌心。“拿着它。走。”[calise.fucked
            |
            
            “这可不是求婚的好时候，”你对她说，手指合拢握住戒指。她笑了，可那笑意变成了痛苦的呲牙。“别这样，卡莉。不行。”
            
            “我也希望……希望有个好时候，”她呻吟道。“走吧，亲爱的。你不需要看着这一切。” 
            
            [pc.isDK
                |“去你妈的，”你立刻回敬她。“别对我指手画脚。就算这是我做的最后一件事，我也要把你救回来。”
                |“那不可能发生。”
            ]
        ]
    ]
    
    你深吸一口气，把手臂兜到卡莉丝的腿弯和肩膀下。“这会很疼。”不这么做，她就死定了。[pc.isDK
        |[calise.fucked
            |
            |科尔米诺斯也会跟着她一起完蛋。你很清楚这堆烂账最后会算在谁头上，对吧？
        ]
    ]
    
    “操！”卡莉丝嚎叫起来，被抱起来时双腿无力地踢动，拼死抓住你的肩膀。她倒下的地方，雪里已经是一片血红。你转身面向那条沿山而下、漫长曲折的小路。如果你够快…… 
    
    “[pc.name]……”倒下的骑士终于勉强开口，声音此刻轻得几乎只是气音。“[calise.fucked
        |我想……我只是……只是想让你知道，我……虽然时间这么短……我爱你。
        |谢——谢谢你……我不会有……不可能有……比你更好的冠军……陪在我身边了。你就是我希望自己能成为的样子……
    ]”
    
    哦，神啊，她正在迅速衰弱。你必须……

rows.original:
"Gods damn it, Cali, stop talking," you say, leaning into the Champion and locking your lips with hers. All the color's gone out of her, leaving just the red lipstick she wears to keep her from looking ghostly, but here at least there's still that spark of her incredible warmth. Her hands tighten desperately around you, eyes focusing for just a moment before fluttering closed. 

        "Mmmm." 
        
        You hold Calise tight and start running, pushing your [pc.legs] as hard as you can straight back down the mountainside. The trip down passes in a blur. The mountaintop harpies give you a wide berth this time, and even the worst of the demons crawling through the Undermountain stop their inevitable attacks when they see the bloodstained woman in your arms — a rare show of humanity from their kind. Your thighs and calves are on fire by the time you cross the self-same bridge you first met Calise on. The scorch-marks from her jade flames pass you by in a blink, but it feels like an eternity and a half before you finally see the stoic walls of Khor'minos rising ahead of you.
        
        The soldiers milling around the outskirt roads jump to their feet when the see someone charging at them, but when they see who you're carrying, they all but drop their weapons scrambling to help you. You lunge past them all the same, running for the gates. Somewhere in the back of your mind, you're dimly conscious of someone screaming for a doctor; of Isadora and a group of soldiers surrounding you, shoving the crowd at the city gates out of the way. You're directed down a side street and into a smart little apartment decorated with warm orange paint and covered with luminescent fungal blooms around its windows. Isadora directs you to the master bed, and a moment later there's a disheveled-looking cowgirl carrying a bag of surgeon's tools at your side, helping to ease the paladin onto the bedding.
        
        "She's lost a lot of blood," the bovine doctor remarks dryly, hurriedly digging through her bag. "Isadora, help me get her armor off. Champion — of Frost, that is — please get out of the way. I need space to work."
        
        You'd protest, were it not for the couple of minotaur troopers already putting hands on your shoulders. You grab Calise's hand one last time, giving it a squeeze before you're dragged out of the bedroom and made to wait.
rows.translation:
该死的，卡莉，别说了，”你说道，身体向前倾，与她的嘴唇紧紧相贴。她的脸色已经变得毫无血色，只有那层红色的口红让她的面容不至于显得过于苍白，但至少，她那令人难以置信的温暖依然存在。她的双手紧紧地抓住你，目光聚焦了片刻，随后缓缓闭上了。

        “嗯……”
        
        你紧紧抱住卡莉，开始奔跑，用力推动着[pc.legs]你用尽全力沿着山坡向下冲去。下山的路程在一片模糊中过去了。这一次，山顶上的那些怪物都避开了你；就连那些在地下山脉中游荡的最凶恶的恶魔，看到你怀里那个浑身是血的女人后，也停止了它们那不可避免的攻击——对于它们这种生物来说，这种行为实在是非常罕见，几乎可以说是人性的体现。当你再次穿过那座你第一次遇见卡莉丝的桥时，你的大腿和小腿已经疼得像着了火一样。她那翡翠般的火焰在瞬间掠过你的身体，但那种灼烧感却仿佛持续了整整一个半世纪，直到你终于看到科尔米诺斯那坚固的城墙出现在眼前。
        
        那些在郊区道路上四处游荡的士兵们，当看到有人朝他们冲过来时，立刻站了起来，但当他们看清你手中拿着什么之后，几乎都放下了武器，争先恐后地过来帮助你。尽管如此，你还是冲过了他们，继续朝着大门跑去。在你潜意识的某个角落，你隐约记得有人正在呼喊医生；记得伊莎多拉和一群士兵将城门处的人群推开，为你让出了道路。你们被引向了一条小街，进入了一间装饰得很精致的公寓——墙壁被涂成了温暖的橙色，窗户周围还点缀着会发光的真菌。伊莎多拉带你来到了主卧室，不一会儿，一位衣着凌乱、手中拿着一袋外科手术工具的牛仔姑娘出现在你身边，帮助那位圣骑士躺到床上。
        
        她失血太多了，”那位弥诺陶洛斯医生干巴巴地说道，同时匆忙地翻找着她的包。“伊莎多拉，帮我把她的盔甲卸下来。那位霜之冠军，请让开一点，我需要空间来操作。”
        
        要不是已经有几名弥诺陶洛斯士兵按在你的肩膀上，你肯定会提出抗议。你最后一次握了握卡莉丝的手部，轻轻捏了捏，然后就被拖出了卧室，被迫等待着。

rows.original:
You're left sitting for what seems like hours, waiting. Several minotaur soldiers — and one cowgirl dressed in a gold-thread toga who introduces herself as an emissary for the palace — come and go, but none are admitted entrance to the bedroom. Isadora stands stolidly in place at the door, hand on her sword, the entire time. The only ones she lets by are other doctors, bulls and cows, young and old, steadily trickling in from across the city. 

    Finally, the first doctor emerges from inside, her arms and toga covered in crimson streaks. Isadora gasps, eyes wide and pleading, unable to speak. 
    
    You rise, stepping up in her place. Through the door, you can see the other doctors clustered around Calise's bed, but little else. "Is she...?"
    
    "She lives," the cow nods, taking a wet rag from one of the Chargers and dabbing at her hands. "Barely, and only by the grace of her god. That wound, and the poison, would have killed [party.has brint
        |even your big lad here." She pats one of Brint's biceps for emphasis.
        |a minotaur lad in his prime."
    ]
    
    The doctor finishes with her hand and sighs. "As it stands, the wound is already healing. Velun's regrowth must run strong in her. She'll be down for a few days, at least, but by Grandfather Green's blessing she may be back in the field before this war is lost. Both of you, give her some space to rest. Any excitement is liable to get her bleeding again, understand? Rest and calm for at least a week."
    
    "Th-that fast?" Isadora blinks. "Gods, she really is strong." 
    
    "Strong, and favored by a god. Now, I need to get back to the field hospital. Send for me if anything changes."
rows.translation:
你只能坐在那里，似乎等了上好几个小时。有几个弥诺陶洛斯士兵，以及一位穿着金色丝线制成的托加、自称是宫殿使者的牛仔女孩，来来去去，但没有人被允许进入卧室。伊莎多拉始终笔直地站在门口，手中紧握着剑。只有其他医生——无论老少——才能从她身边通过，他们陆续从城市的各个角落赶来。

    终于，第一位医生从里面走了出来，她的手臂和长袍上满是猩红色的血迹。伊莎多拉倒抽一口气，双眼睁得大大的，满含恳求，却说不出话来。
    
    你站起身，走到她的身边。透过门，你可以看到其他医生都聚集在卡莉丝的床边，但除此之外，什么也看不见。“她……还活着吗？”
    
    “她还活着，”那个女人点点头，从其中一个医护人员手中接过一块湿布，开始擦拭伊莎多拉的手部。仅仅是她的神明保佑，她才得以活下来。那道伤口，还有那种毒药，本来足以夺去她的生命。 [party.has brint
        |就连你这个大块头也不例外。”她拍了拍布林特的一块二头肌，以强调这一点。
        |一个正值壮年的弥诺陶洛斯少年。
    ]
    
    医生处理完她的伤口后叹了口气：“目前来看，伤口已经在愈合了。维伦体内一定有着强大的再生能力。她至少需要休息几天，但如果有绿祖的庇佑，或许在这场战争结束之前，她就能重新上战场了。你们俩，给她一些休息的时间吧。任何剧烈的活动都可能让她再次出血，明白吗？至少让她休息一周，让身体恢复平静。
    
    “这么快就……？”伊莎多拉眨了眨眼，“天啊，她真的太强大了。”
    
    “强大，而且还得到了某位神明的庇护。现在，我需要回到野战医院去。如果情况有任何变化，请立刻派人来找我。

rows.original:
Isadora nods, speaking quickly in minoan with her head bowed. The doctor pats her cheek and then departs, leaving you and the young human to step into the bedroom while the other healers are finishing their clean-up. Calise is lying under a fresh set of blankets, though you can see bandages running all the way around her shoulder and chest, at the very least. Her thick mane of hair's been pulled back into a ponytail and flicked over the back of the pillow. 

        Calise's eyes are only just opening when you come in and [calise.fucked
            |take her hand. Isadora takes the other, kneeling by the bedside while
            |give her a smile. Isadora kneels by the bedside and takes the paladin's hand,
        ] breathing a sigh of relief. "Thank Velun, you're okay..."
        
        "Thank [pc.name] first and foremost," she says, smiling at you. "I'd be a frozen corpse if not for [pc.himHer]. Oh, dry your eyes, Isadora... all is well."
        
        She caresses the young woman's cheek, visibly resisting the urge to sit up and hug her. 
        
        "Thanks to our dear [pc.name], I'm alive and soon to be well. We've seen the face and tricks of our enemy's most dangerous agent. And we've got the Ring of Fate, too. My near brush with death aside, I would call today a win."
        
        That's right. You reach into your pocket and recover the ring, bringing it out for Isadora to see. 
        
        "When I'm recovered, I'll want to see that in detail," Calise reminds you. "But for now... for now, may it bring you luck while I cannot. And you, Isadora...
