rows.original: Bid Alante goodbye for the night.

"How's the party going?" you ask. [alante.married |"Ah, of course, it's... wonderful to be counted among those important enough to be invited..." Alante says, eyes flicking back and forth. When she sees nobody else close enough to overhear, she leans in and whispers. "I don't really like being here." You smile. "Rather be out on the plains, huh?" She nods fervently, her helmet's plumage wobbling. "Very much so. These functions... I've never felt like I particularly belong amongst the nobles, but they have become much stranger of late. Much stranger." "Stranger how?" you say. "Ah, just- hmm. I am not particularly socially gifted, I confess. So perhaps I am imagining a problem when there is none," Alante says. "It is just little things... off-hand comments. Lingering gazes." She sighs. "I do not appreciate the things they say under their breath to each other. I feel as though I used to command more respect from the nobility. Perhaps my novelty has worn thin..?" She shakes her head. "Regardless, I do not fit in here. After my duties, I will head out- ah... or perhaps," she continues hopefully, "I could see you tonight?" "I'd love to, but it's going to depend on how much time this whole thing takes up," you say. "Oh, of course," Alante says, her ears drooping. "I had forgotten momentarily... the King will most certainly want to talk to you, [pc.name]. And I recommend you indulge him – really. I think it will be beneficial to talk to everyone you can. My captain always tells me that knowing the right people goes a very long way in this city." [party.has brint |"True," Brint says. "It's a big city. Lots of people in important places." Alante nods. "I haven't much use for it myself – especially now that we're married, [pc.name] – but you might find talking to people useful." |[party.has brienne |"Very true," Brienne says. "It's a big city, after all. There's a lot of people in important places." Alante nods. rows.original: [alante.married |"Do you miss fighting in the arena?" you ask. "Not really," Alante says. "A fight is a fight, isn't it?" "The roars of the crowd?" you prod. "Ah, the spectacle. I enjoy observing the techniques of others, but I never found anything special in having others watch me fight," she says. "I get the feeling people around me appreciate the arena on a different level than I do... the fights themselves were fun, though." "Did you have to turn down many suitors?" you say. Alante chuckles. "Maybe less than you think. Truth be told, not many people make it past the first big obstacle." "Cedric," you recall. She nods. "At times, it has been someone else – or even multiple people. But they are all very good at wearing you down even if you're fighting as a team. And that's after besting the rest of the gladiators. In order to even be in the condition to fight me alone, you have to be quite special. And in order to beat me when I'm in peak condition and fully armored, you would have to be absurdly exceptional. A gifted fighter seen once in a few generations." The centauress pauses, realizing what she's saying, and blushes.[party.has brienne | "Aww!" Brienne says. ] You smile. "An absurdly exceptional fighter, huh? Well, thanks, Alante. It's always good to know my wife thinks highly of me." Hopelessly outmatched, all the embarrassed centaur can think to do is clear her throat. "I... I much prefer traveling at your side, [pc.name]. The fights I get into there will at least be meaningful." You rub her black-furred body affectionately. "I much prefer having you at my side too, Alante. Though I'm grateful to the arena for bringing you to me." She lowers her head to hide her expression, but you can still see the hints of a smile under the shadow her helmet casts. |"Do you enjoy fighting in the arena?" you ask. "I enjoy fighting," Alante says. "The exchange of techniques, the excitement of anticipation... it's what I'm good at. Fighting in front of other people doesn't take away or add anything to the experience for me. But I understand most people derive a lot of entertainment from it." "Do you like watching fighting?" you say. She nods. "I like learning from others. Even an amateur might come up with something special! Some unique application of magic or a weapon I haven't seen used often. Every fight is a new opportunity." She thinks for a second. "But I don't think I enjoy it on the same level others do." "Not one for the roar of the crowd, huh?" you say. "I understand." "Really? I've always gotten the feeling not many people do..." Alante says, her brow wrinkling in thought. "I wonder why." You smile. "I think it's fine to enjoy a fight the way you do." "Hmm... well, thank you," she says, nodding. She seems mollified. [var0 |"It's nice to know someone else understands. Will you fight again?" "We'll see, I suppose," you say. "I look forward to it," Alante says earnestly. |"It's nice to know someone else understands." ] ]
rows.translation: [alante.married |“你怀念在竞技场里战斗的日子吗？”你问道。 “其实并不，”阿兰特说。“战斗就是战斗，不是吗？” “那人群的咆哮呢？”你追问道。 “啊，那种场面。我喜欢观察别人的技巧，但我从不觉得让别人观看我战斗有什么特别之处，”她说。“我觉得我周围的人对竞技场的欣赏和我处在不同的层次上……不过打斗本身确实有趣。” “你是不是得拒绝很多追求者？”你说道。 阿兰特轻笑一声。“也许比你想的要少。说实话，没多少人能越过第一道大坎。” “塞德里克，”你回想起来。 她点点头。“有时候是别人——甚至可能是好几个人。但即使你们是团队作战，他们也非常擅长把你消磨殆尽。而那还是在把其余角斗士全部打赢之后的事。想要有资格单独与我一战，你就得相当特别。而要在我状态巅峰、全副武装时击败我，你得异常得出类拔萃才行。那样的天才战士，几代人才出一个。” 半人马女子顿住了，意识到自己在说什么，脸红了。[party.has brienne | “哎呀！”布蕾妮说道。 ] 你笑了笑。“一个异常出众的战士，嗯？好吧，谢谢你，阿兰特。知道妻子这么看重我，总是好事。” 完全无法招架，那尴尬的半人马只能清清嗓子。“我……我更愿意陪在你身边旅行，[pc.name]。在那里打的仗至少是有意义的。” 你深情地抚摸她覆有毛发的黑色身体。“我也更愿意让你陪在我身边，阿兰特。不过我还是要感谢竞技场把你带到了我身边。” 她低下头藏起表情，但你仍能看见她头盔阴影下隐约的笑意。 |“你喜欢在竞技场里战斗吗？”你问道。 “我喜欢战斗，”阿兰特说。“技巧的交锋、开战前的紧张期待……这是我所擅长的。在别人面前战斗，对我来说既不会减损也不会增添什么。但我明白，大多数人从中获得了许多乐趣。” “你喜欢看人打架吗？”你说道。 她点点头。“我喜欢向别人学习。就算是业余者也可能想出什么特别的东西！某种独特的魔法用法，或是我不常见到的武器用法。每一场战斗都是新的机会。”她想了想。“但我想，我并不像别人那样享受它。” “不太喜欢人群的咆哮，嗯？”你说道。“我明白。” “真的吗？我一直觉得没多少人会这样……”阿兰特说着，眉头因思索而皱起。“我想知道为什么。” 你笑了笑。“我觉得像你这样享受战斗没什么不好。” “嗯……好吧，谢谢你，”她说着点点头。她似乎被安抚了。 [var0 |“知道还有别人能理解我，真好。你还会再战斗吗？” “再看吧，我想，”你说道。 “我很期待那一天，”阿兰特认真地说。 |“知道还有别人能理解我，真好。” ] ]

rows.original:
"Would it be possible for you to recruit the gladiators to help me fight with Calise?" you say.
    
    Alante thinks for a moment. "I am not very good at understanding people, but I believe most of the gladiators would leap at the chance to defend Khor'minos."
    
    "Really?" you say.
    
    "Truly," she says, nodding. "It is not easy to be a gladiator. They all have their own reasons for fighting – but every one of them adores the roar of the crowd, so they tell me. Otherwise they would simply join the army."
    
    "I did once wonder if there were any slaves – or anyone who doesn't want to be there – involved in the arena fights," you say.
    
    "Oh, no. I don't think that would work for a multitude of reasons," Alante says. "The most practical of which being that it would make for quite the miserable spectacle for the citizenry. I do not imagine most people being happy about that. Every gladiator is someone that's chosen and trained to fight for the crowd. Well, except me... but that[alante.married
        | was
        |'s
    ] different."
    
    "So they'd be happy to fight?" you say.
    
    "I will gather them up and offer them the choice, but I suspect most of them will be decided on the matter before I have finished talking," Alante says. She smiles slightly. "They have always been supportive of me. I think they think I am some kind of good luck charm."
    
    [alante.married
        |A beautiful goddess of war clad in full armor and untouchable in battle... yes, you can see how a myth of sorts would build up there.
        |It's not too hard to imagine a myth of sorts building up around someone so formidable in the arena.
    ]
    
    "Thank you, Alante," you say. [alante.married
        |"You're a great help to me."
        
        Alante blushes. "Thank you. It makes me happy to hear you say that, [pc.name]. I hope I can continue being helpful to you."
        
        [pc.dcb
            |"Don't worry," you say with a grin. "I doubt I'll ever let you go."
            
            She nods, blushing harder.
            |You smile at the centauress. "Just being yourself is very helpful to me, Alante."
            
            Her cheeks go from pink to scarlet.
            |"Aww, you're so cute!" you say. "Thanks, Alante!"
            
            She looks extremely pleased.
        ]
        |"This'll be really helpful."
        
        She nods. "It is the least I can do for someone undertaking such a dangerous task for our city's sake."
    ]

    “我以前还怀疑过，竞技场的战斗里会不会有奴隶——或者有不情愿参加的人。”你说道。

rows.original: You make to walk over to the group of cowgirls, but Arille approaches you in full view of the group she's with before you can even get to them. "[pc.name]! How good of the hero to grace us with [pc.hisHer] presence," she exclaims, wrapping herself around your arm in a very familiar manner. "Come! We should spend some more time together tonight – I won't hear no for an answer!" "Very clever," you murmur to her as she leads you away from the others, leaving them all but staring open-mouthed. "A noble lady has but a few tools at her disposal," she says, giving you a wink. "They'll be talking about this for weeks. Months, if you're as impressive as I think you are." You can't help but smile. "Not going to lead me through the crowd by my cock this time?" She laughs, a beautiful, sultry sound amidst the chatter of the crowd. "Maybe I should have – that seems to be the direction of this current trend among the rest of the nobles, after all. I can already tell I'm falling out of favor a bit... I spend too much time in the city and not enough time nattering in villas." "Hopefully your proximity to the Champion can restore your standing a bit, eh?" you tease. "Oh, come now," Arille says, squeezing your arm. The way her breasts press against you is decidedly unsubtle. "Any time I can escape the drudgery of looking pretty at a party I'll take it. But your arrival was very timely. Thank you, [pc.name]." She leans in to put a quick kiss on your cheek. "You do look very pretty," you note. She smiles. "I know. Thank you for noticing."

rows.original: [pc.bg noblescion |"I never thought I'd wind up at another damned party," you murmur, looking over the crowd. Arille laughs. "They do get tiresome after a while, don't they? I will admit I'm rather happy to have been invited to the King's party. That's not something that happens every day." "True," you say. "I imagine this is the end goal for many a Minoan patrician." "Oh yes," she agrees. "Many of the generals here run in the same circles as the non-military nobles, so it's all very incestuous. Though watching their lackeys interacting with our esteemed nobility can prove to be quite an amusing pastime. Military directness and polite implications make for an interesting mix." She frowns at two women passing by in extremely risque clothing, enormous breasts just about spilling out of lingerie. The way their asses move as they walk is close to hypnotic, the full outline of their artful curves on display. "I'm being left behind by the latest fashion, apparently," she says. "Perhaps you should peel me out of my dress." You glance at her. "Are you even wearing anything underneath?" Arille smiles, her tail waving suggestively. "Come now, darling. Don't be naive." "This certainly is unlike any other party I've been to," you say, gazing out at the crowd again. "Aah, I thought I detected a noble upbringing," Arille says with a self-satisfied smile. "I do know how to pick them. Any regrets about the adventurer lifestyle, [pc.name]?" "I can honestly say no," you say. "Despite the pleasantness, just being here is a nice reminder that I made the right choice. And besides... it led me to you." "So it did," she murmurs, stroking your arm. |"Do you spend a lot of time at parties like these?" you say. "Oh, but this is how we spend all our time, darling," Arille says, smiling. "A party is the noble's self-expression, their passion, their socialization, their aspiration. We're nothing without a party, [pc.name]. Being invited to one is tacit approval, and climbing ever upwards within the circles is the aim of many a noble. Being invited to the King's party... that's an honor few will ever receive." "Is that the end goal for a Minoan patrician?" you say. "An extension of 'knowing people in high places'?" She nods. "You get the idea. It's not even just about having someone who can do you a favor. Just having had a conversation with the Princess places you in another world with regards to noble society as long as people see you having it. In the same way, being invited somewhere is symbolic." "Hmm. I'm not sure if that all sounds interesting or horrible," you say. "Makes me glad to be an adventurer." "I'd say that adventuring has been working out for you just fine," Arille purrs, stroking your arm. "After all, it led you to me." ]

rows.original: "I spoke to your father," you say. "Ah, yes... he is here," she says, looking over at a gathering of senators and generals. "What did you think?"
rows.translation: “我和你父亲谈过了，”你说。 “啊，是的……他是就在这里，”她说道，目光投向聚集在一起的参议员和将军们，“你觉得怎么样？”
rows.raw: ' "I spoke to your father," you say. "Ah, yes... he is here," she says, looking over at a gathering of senators and generals. "What did you think?" '

rows.original:
"He seemed nice," you say. "Friendly and willing to talk, at least."
        
        "Ah, yes," Arille sighs. "That's father, alright. Probably drinking, too. Loud and friendly is his go-to public persona."
        
        "Is he not the same at home?" you say.
        
        "I'm hardly ever home these days," she points out, casting another glance over at Khaius. "But there is an ever-increasing overlap between that personality and his old one. He's... changed." She shakes her head. "Probably just age. He used to be the life of the party, and I don't think he really wants to let that go."
        
        She doesn't seem to want to talk too much about him. Understandably – their relationship seems to be somewhat of a private matter.
rows.translation:
“他看起来人挺好的，”你说，“至少很友善，也愿意跟人聊天。”
        
        “啊，没错，”阿莉尔叹了口气，“他就是那种父亲。多半也在喝酒。热情友好，就是他惯用的公众形象。”
        
        “那他在家里不是这样的吗？”你问道。
        
        “这些天我几乎从不着家，”她说着又瞥了凯乌斯一眼，“但那种形象与他从前的性格重叠得越来越多了。他……变了。”她摇了摇头。“大概只是年纪大了。他以前总是派对上的焦点，我想他并不真想放下这些。”
        
        她似乎并不愿意过多谈论他。这也情有可原——他们的关系似乎属于私密范畴。

rows.original:
"So how involved with the baths are you?" you say.
    
    "Pretty damn involved," Khaius says with a grin. It's clear this is somewhat of a point of pride. "It's all but got my name on it. I like to be hands-off with managing the place, though. Have you been?"
    
    [flags.KM_BATHS_VISITED|"I have," you say. "They're amazing. I'd never seen anything like them before coming here."
    
    "Quite the spectacle, eh?|"I haven't had the chance," you say.
    
    "Ah, you should. Well worth the trip,]" he says, gesturing with a flagon in his hand. "They weren't nearly as great before I managed to get everything in place. Just about down to the damn masonry. Even the water routing!" He sighs in exasperation. "Close to impossible to get anything done these days."
    
    "I imagine good water is quite important for baths," you say, smiling.
    
    "Ha! Exactly!" Khaius chuckles. "It's pretty high up the list. Along with things like getting the right delegates who can put good employees in place and all that."
    
    "Was it you who came up with the dress code there?" you ask.
    
    "Oh, no, that's a cultural tradition," he says, waving it off. "Quite outdated at this point, but that's how tradition works, I'm told."
    
    "Seems like the people here are wearing less clothes than the bathers," you note.
    
    Khaius laughs. "Ha ha! You might just be right, [pc.name]. Maybe I should look into getting that changed again. Seems as though that's the direction we're heading."
    
    "What do you make of it?" you say.
    
    "I've never been overly attached to tradition, and neither have the nobles," he says, shrugging. "They're always trying to outdo each other with some new thing. If that's what the current fashion is, I have no complaints." He nods at a serving girl passing by, her swaying tits just about fully exposed, before giving you a look. "Just look at her. Only the driest prude would complain. Not to mention the noblewomen in their new dresses, if you can call them that."
    
    [pc.dcb
        |"I'm in favor myself," you say.
        |"They are quite revealing," you agree.
        |"They're pretty!" you say.
    ]
    
    "I'm all for it," he says. "Surrounded by beautiful women in a severe lack of clothing. What's not to love? Hopefully the trend is long-lived."

rows.original:
"Are you close with the King?" you say.
    
    "Kelsaz? Close enough," Khaius says, nodding. "I'm fond of him. I saw a fair amount of him when we were growing up and he never struck me as anything but reasonable. That's grown into him being very... civic-minded." He sighs. "We could do away with at least half of the bloody committees he puts people on."
    
    "Does it work?" you ask.
    
    "Yes. Eventually," he grunts. "Power is so diffuse it's ridiculous. Want to put up a building? The proposal's got to go through seventeen councils first. Then you can maybe talk to someone about it. Then it's back through the councils, but ass-first. Bah! Really, what's the... aah, who cares. King's the King. I don't know why I bother."
    
    "Were things simpler in years past?" you say.
    
    "Lest you think I'm simply nostalgic, I'll say that not everything was better," Khaius says with a lopsided smile. "But we could do with some shedding of weight. You can find inefficiencies all over the city that could be fixed on the spot with the right authority. Instead it goes up a chain of increasingly self-important circles of people whose primary purpose seems to be to obfuscate the matter to the best of their ability."
    
    "I see," you say.
    
    "Aah, I should get more wine," Khaius muses. "At least complaining about it is more fun than seriously discussing it with the nobility."
rows.translation:
“你和国王关系不错吧？”你问道。
    
    “凯尔萨兹？关系还算不错，”凯乌斯点着头说道。“我挺喜欢他的。我们从小一起长大，那时我见过他不少次，他给我的印象一直都很通情达理。后来他变得非常……热心公共事务。”他叹了口气。“他让人们加入的那些该死的委员会，我们至少可以砍掉一半。”
    
    “这真的有用吗？”你问道。
    
    “有用。不过需要时间，”他哼了一声。“权力分散得如此之广，简直荒谬。想盖一栋楼？提案得先过十七个委员会。然后你才能找个人谈谈这件事。接着提案又得再过一遍那些委员会，还是倒着来。呸！说真的，这到底是什么……啊，算了，谁在乎呢。国王就是国王。我不知道自己为什么要费这个劲。”
    
    “过去那些年，事情更简单吗？”你问道。
    
    “免得你以为我纯粹是在怀旧，我得说并非一切都更好，”凯乌斯带着歪嘴的笑容说道。“但我们确实该减减负了。你能在这座城市里到处发现一些只要有权就能当场解决的低效问题。可它们反而被层层上报，经过一圈圈越来越自视甚高的人，而这些人最主要的目的似乎就是尽其所能地把事情搅浑。”
    
    “我明白了，”你说道。
    
    “啊，我该再去弄点酒来，”凯乌斯若有所思地说。“至少抱怨它比跟贵族们正经讨论它更有趣。”

        [pc.bg noblescion|You straighten your back and step to it. He may be a king, but you spent your early life rubbing shoulders with the high and mighty. This sort of thing is what you were brought up for.|No pressure, right?]
        
        [party.has calise

        From his place, and tremendous height, above the other noblemen, the king sees you coming and greets you with a crisply raised hand.         "Champion!" the king says, voice smooth but booming over the din of the party. Every head in earshot turns to you. "[pc.name]. Lady Calise has sung your praises to the rooftops since you arrived. Now, finally, we meet face to face. Be welcome in my halls, Champion of Frost."

            |The king turns his attention to Brienne, giving the titan of a cowgirl at your side an appraising look-over, and then a genial smile. "I had heard one of our city's own daughters accompanied you, Champion! A mighty one, at that! Welcome to the palace..."
            
            "Brienne, Your Majesty," your [brienne.married
                |cow-wife answers. "[pc.name]'s wife!"
                |companion answers.
            ]
            
            "Brienne, citizen of Khor'minos. You have our city's thanks for supporting our champions in their quest."
        ]
        
        The king nods and waves you[party.has etheryn
            | and Ryn
        ] closer. "Tell me, [pc.name][party.has etheryn
            |, Etheryn
        ], how are you finding Khor'minoan hospitality?"
        
        [party.has etheryn
            |"It's amazing. The whole city is," Ryn says wistfully. "And I don't think I've ever eaten so well!"
        ]
        
        You [pc.isDK
            |force a smile
            |just smile
        ] as a pitcher of wine is pushed into your hand, and alongside the nobles around you, take a deep drink. [pc.isPregnant
            |It's a ripe grape juice, not wine, but still tastes damn fine.
            |You can't deny, it's damn fine wine!
        ]
        
        "So," the king says, downing the last of his wine. A collared cow-girl servant scurries over and take the cup from his hand before his arm's finished lowering. "Tell me, [pc.name], you've been taking the fight to these abominations in the realm of Njorhaalt since the start of their invasion. What do you make of the fiends? You're more of an expert than anyone."
        
        One of the generals snorts, but the king plants a heavy hand on the man's shoulder. "And when was the last time you faced down an imp yourself, Marcan? To say nothing of facing down one of the demon queens!"
        
        The plumed bull frowns, but bows his head. "Fair point, Your Grace. Let us hear what the Champion of Frost has to say of them."
    ]

        |[var0
            |冠军！”国王在你获胜时说道。 [var1|勉强完成某事|骄傲地登顶]那些都是些什么事情？”你问道。
            
            你挥了挥手：“只是过去的一些争执罢了。”
            
            国王叹了口气：“真抱歉事情发展成了这样。自从我的‘冲锋者’队被恶魔俘虏之后，他们的队长就变得不再像从前那样了。我会安排人晚些时候去和他谈谈的。
            |你挤过围在国王周围的贵族们，终于再次站在了国王的阴影之下。
            
            “啊，冠军！”国王友好地向你点头说道，“很高兴这么快又见到你。请过来，和我们一起吧！
        ]
        |你[pc.isDK
            |耸耸肩
            |深呼吸来平静你的情绪。
        ]然后，他开始走向那头高耸入云、肌肉虬结、头戴金色月桂冠的黑色公牛。在王座台阶的脚下，一群贵族们围绕着国王，他们像老朋友一样哈哈大笑，大口喝着比人头还大的酒瓶；其中一些人穿着高级军官的羽饰和长袍，另一些人则穿着这座城市统治阶层的深红色托加袍。他们每一个人都是这座城市里富有的领主，都是权势显赫的人物——他们的随意一言一语，都可能造就财富，也可能毁掉人们的命运。
        
        [pc.bg noblescion|你挺直腰板，勇敢地面对这一切。他虽然是个国王，但你的早年生活就是在与那些权贵们打交道中度过的。正是为了应对这类事情，你才接受了这样的成长环境。|没压力吧？]
        
        [party.has calise
            |卡莉丝轻轻拍了拍你的肩膀，然后悄悄离开了，让你有空间将自己牢牢掌握在这一刻。
            |卡莉丝坐在离国王几步远的地方，一边品尝着葡萄酒，一边向你点了点头。
        ]
        
        从他那高高的位置上，远高于其他贵族们，国王看到了你的到来，便高高举起手来向你致意。他的同伴也都转过头来看着你，其中有几个人甚至举起了酒杯或伸出手来表示敬意。当你穿过人群去迎接他们的君主时，有一位将军还拍了拍你的背。
        
        “冠军！”国王说道，他的声音平稳而洪亮，在派对的喧闹声中依然清晰可闻。所有在范围内听到他说话的人，都把目光转向了你。[pc.name]自从你来到这里，卡莉丝女士就一直在到处夸赞你。如今，我们终于能够面对面相见了。欢迎来到我的大厅，冰霜冠军。”
        
        “太好了！”附近的几位贵族纷纷附和着，同时趁机喝了一大口酒。 
        
        [party.has etheryn
            |我眼前看到的，不正是[etheryn.crowned
                |女王
                |准王后
            ]关于Njorhaalt。我从未想过，在我们有生之年内，还会有一位极北精灵再次来到这座城市，更何况还是如此一位出色的领袖。
            
            小琳的脸颊顿时涨得通红， [etheryn.lowConfidence
                |她急切地瞥了一眼自己的鞋子，说道：“谢、谢谢你，凯尔萨兹国王……你太好了……
                |她向国王行了[etheryn.crowned
                    |一个恭敬的颔首礼
                    |一个标准的屈膝礼
                ]谢谢您，凯尔萨兹国王。我从未想过，在我年轻的时候就有机会参观世界上最大的城市。感谢您为我们提供了如此热情的接待，让我们能够来到您这座宏伟的领地。
            ]
        ]
        
        [party.has brint
            |国王将目光转向布林特，同时向你身旁的弥诺陶洛斯致以敬意的点头。“我听说有一位我们城市的子弟与你一同前来，冠军！欢迎来到宫殿……”
            
            “布林特，陛下。 [brint.married
                |[pc.name]她的丈夫。 
            ]卡茜娅之子。”
            
            “布林特，卡茜娅之子，科尔米诺斯的公民。感谢你对我们冠军们的支持，他们的奋斗得到了这座城市的认可与感谢。
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |国王将目光转向布蕾妮，打量了这个站在你身旁的魁梧女牛仔，然后露出了亲切的笑容。“我听说有一位我们城市的女儿陪同着你一起来，冠军！而且还是位非常了不起的女子！欢迎来到宫殿……”
            
            “布蕾妮，陛下。”你的[brienne.married
                |牛妻回答道：“我是[pc.name]的妻子！”
                |同伴答道。
            ]
            
            布蕾妮，科尔米诺斯的公民。感谢你对我们英雄们的事业所给予的支持。
        ]
        
        国王点了点头，示意你过去。[party.has etheryn
            | 还有小琳
        ]告诉我，”克洛瑟说道。 [pc.name][party.has etheryn
            |伊瑟琳
        ]你觉得科尔米诺人的热情好客怎么样？
        
        [party.has etheryn
            |太神奇了……整个城市都是这样，”小琳满怀向往地说，“而且我从来没吃过这么美味的食物！
        ]
        
        你[pc.isDK
            |强颜欢笑
            |只需微笑即可。
        ]就像有人将一杯美酒递到你手中，你便与周围的贵族们一起，深深地喝下这美酒。 [pc.isPregnant
            |这其实是葡萄汁，而不是葡萄酒，但味道确实相当不错。
            |你不得不承认，这酒确实非常不错！
        ]
        
        那么，”国王说着，喝完了杯中的最后一口酒。这时，一名戴着项圈的牛仔装女仆迅速跑过来，在他的手臂还未完全放下之前就从他手中接过了杯子。“告诉我[pc.name]，自从这些邪恶势力入侵以来，你就一直在与它们进行斗争。你对这些恶魔有什么看法？你可比任何人都更了解它们。
        
        其中一位将军哼了一声，但国王却将手重重地放在那人的肩上。那么，马肯，你上一次亲自面对一个小恶魔是什么时候？更不用说去对抗那些恶魔女王了！”
        
        那只长着羽毛的公牛皱起了眉头，但还是低下了头。“您说得有道理，陛下。让我们听听霜之冠军对于它们的看法吧。"
    ]

rows.original: Demons are wretched things, worthy only of derision.
rows.translation: 恶魔不过是些可鄙的东西，只配被人嘲笑。
rows.raw: "Demons are wretched things, worthy only of derision."

rows.original: The demons spreading their corruption, assailing the innocent, hounding your every step — it evokes a fury in you that you've been glad to take out on them in battle.
rows.translation: 那些恶魔四处散播邪恶，侵害无辜，时刻追踪你的脚步——这一切激起了你内心的愤怒，而你在战斗中能够将这种愤怒发泄出来，实在令你感到畅快。
rows.raw: "The demons spreading their corruption, assailing the innocent, hounding your every step — it evokes a fury in you that you've been glad to take out on them in battle."

rows.original: Having seen what demons are capable of, the way they mangle souls to reproduce... it's a nightmare.
rows.translation: 看到那些恶魔究竟有能力做出什么，看到它们是如何摧残灵魂来繁衍后代的……简直就是一场噩梦。
rows.raw: "Having seen what demons are capable of, the way they mangle souls to reproduce... it's a nightmare."

rows.original: Given the state of things here in the palace, you might as well admit the truth: demons get you [pc.hasRealCock|rock hard|soaking wet].
rows.translation: 鉴于宫里目前的状况，你还是承认真相吧：恶魔会让你[pc.hasRealCock|坚如磐石|湿透了]。
rows.raw: "Given the state of things here in the palace, you might as well admit the truth: demons get you [pc.hasRealCock|rock hard|soaking wet]."

rows.original: After all you've seen, the best way to describe your feelings about the demons is... pity. For their victims, and for the demons themselves — because each one of them was victimized to start with, after all.
rows.translation: 经历了这一切之后，用同情来形容你对这些恶魔的感受，再合适不过了。既为他们的受害者感到同情，也为这些恶魔本身感到同情——因为说到底，他们每一个最初也都是受害者。
rows.raw: "After all you've seen, the best way to describe your feelings about the demons is... pity. For their victims, and for the demons themselves — because each one of them was victimized to start with, after all."

rows.original: You have no opinion worth voicing.
rows.translation: 你的意见根本不值得被重视。

rows.original: You curl your nose as you tell the nobles, "They disgust me. What they do to other people, what they debase themselves to..." "Well said," one of the civil patricians says, a huge gray-furred man with a scholarly demeanor. "These creatures are as much a moral taint as a physical one." Another statesman nods enthusiastically. "A creature without a soul is an aberration, an abomination." [party.has kiyoko |You can almost feel the cold fury rising off your fox-wife, even if not a single thing changes in her demure expression at your side. ] [pc.isSoulbound |You glower at the outspoken patrician. "Hey, not everyone without a soul in their body is one of those monsters!" The minotaur's brow furrows. "What do you mean? The Seven teach us that the Wraiths-" ] The scholar waggles his cup. "There are those who have bound their souls directly with the Seven, Narach, or have you forgotten their teachings so readily?" "Peace," says the king, putting a hand on the two mens' shoulders. "Let us all agree that the demons are our enemy, not the Seven or their servants. If there is more than a soul that separates us from them, I leave that to the theologians. At least until someone shows me a soul in their own two hands!" he laughs.
rows.translation: 你皱着鼻子对那些贵族们说道：“他们让我感到恶心。他们对待别人的方式，他们自己所堕落到的地步……” “说得很好，”一位举止文雅、毛发灰白的贵族说道，“这些生物不仅在肉体上令人作呕，在道德上也是极大的污点。” 另一位政治家也热情地点了点头：“没有灵魂的生物，就是畸形的存在，就是可憎的事物。” [party.has kiyoko |你几乎能感觉到那种冰冷的愤怒正从你的狐狸妻子身上散发出来，尽管在她你身边的时候，她的表情依然保持着娴静与端庄，没有任何变化。 ] [pc.isSoulbound |你怒视着那个直言不讳的贵族。“喂，并不是所有没有灵魂的人都是那些怪物中的一员！” 弥诺陶洛斯的眉头紧锁。“你是什么意思？七贤教导我们，那些幽灵—— ] 那位学者晃了晃手中的杯子，说道：“有些人竟然将自己的灵魂直接与七大恶魔或纳拉奇联系在了一起，难道你们真的这么轻易就忘记了他们的教诲吗？” 国王摆了摆手，平静地说道：“大家冷静些。我们应该明确一点：恶魔才是我们的敌人，而不是七大恶魔或他们的仆从。如果真的有什么东西将我们与他们区分开来，那就让神学家们去研究吧。至少，在有人能亲手给我证明这种东西的存在之前，我还不愿意相信这一点！”他笑着说。

rows.original:
"I fucking hate them," you growl. "What they've done, what they're trying to do... they're monsters, plain and simple."
    
    The general, Marcan, gives you a firm nod. "They are. The First Legion has brought back harrowing reports from the outer villages. The things these demons did to those who could not escape the hordes..." He clenches a fist. "It's unforgivable."
    
    "There will be no forgiveness for the demons," the king assures him. "When we break their siege, we follow them whence they came and put the last of them to the sword. For all we've lost."

rows.original:
You glance between the senators and the near-naked arm candy they're parading around — women dressed in barely more than lingerie displayed brazenly in the king's own palace — and smirk. "Honestly?" you tell them, sipping at your[pc.isPregnant
        |juice
        |wine
    ]. "They're almost irresistible. [kas.fucked
        |I've even bedded the demon queen herself. It was the most mindblowing sex of my life.
        |Have even one of you seen the demon queen herself? I've not bedded Kasyrra herself, but the underlings she's made are incredible pieces of work.
    ]"
    
    The noblemen look appropriately scandalized, brows raised and jaws open. Only Calise, standing a bit off beside the king, just cackles. The king finally snickers, snorting wine back into his glass. "I suppose to defeat your enemy, you must know your enemy, isn't that right?"
    
    "Perhaps not carnally, my king," a scholarly patrician whines. 
    
    Another, younger bull in a crimson toga and with two girls at his side wearing little more than lingerie, waves a hand at him dismissively. "Why, considering your affairs, Senator, I don't think you'll expect any of us to believe you'd refuse a succubus in front of you."
    
    "That was a long time ago, son!" 
    
    The general beside you tenses his fist violently, crumpling his wineglass as if it were paper. "Enough! Have you not seen what these demons do to our kingdom, Champion? The way they've ravaged us?"
    
    "Ravaged like a cheap whore," you say. 
    
    "Which is why we're here," Calise chimes in, catching the general's fist before it can take a swing at you. "Your army's built to fight wars against mortal foes; for dealing with demons, you need a... different perspective."
    
    The second statesman laughs bitterly. "The perspective of someone that spends [pc.hisHer] time [kas.fucked
        |sucking the demon queen's cock
        |with a succubus sat on [pc.hisHer] face
    ], you mean?"
    
    The king drains another glass of wine, and takes the crumpled cup from his general, passing both off to a timid slave-girl. "Enough, gentlemen, let's not take to each other's throats. I asked the Champion [pc.hisHer] opinion and it's been given. I value honesty in this court, even when the answers are... unexpected." 
    
    "Unexpected?" the elderly bull says. "My king, to consort with the enemy is treason."
    
    "Then the Champion should be thankful that [pc.heShe] isn't among my subjects. You cannot betray an obligation you never made. And [pc.heShe]'s proven that, judgment aside, [pc.heShe] is effective. Njorhaalt's testament to that."
    
    The old patrician bows his head, clearly as unhappy as the general. "Of course, my king."
    
    Calise puts a hand on the monarch's massive bicep and smiles up at him. "Well spoken, Your Grace."

    ]。 “它们简直让人无法抗拒。 [kas.fucked
        |我甚至和恶魔女王本人发生了关系。那是我一生中最令人难以忘怀的性体验。
        |你们当中有谁见过恶魔女王本人吗？虽然我并没有与卡希拉本人同床共枕，但她手下的那些手下，确实都是非常出色的家伙。
    ]”
    
    那些贵族们都装出一副极为震惊的样子，眉毛扬起，张大嘴巴。只有站在国王旁边稍远处的卡莉丝，忍不住咯咯笑了起来。国王终于也忍不住笑了起来，一边笑着一边把酒重新灌回杯中。“我想，要想战胜敌人，首先就必须了解敌人，对吧？”
    
    “或许并非肉体上的，我的国王，”一位学识渊博的贵族哀怨地说道。 
    
    另一位年轻贵族身穿深红色的托加，身旁还有两位只穿着内衣的女孩，他随意地朝那人挥了挥手，表示不予理会。“嗯，考虑到您目前的处境，参议员，我想您不会指望我们会相信您会拒绝一个出现在您面前的女妖吧。”
    
    “那都是很久以前的事了，孩子！” 
    
    你身旁的将军猛地握紧了拳头，手中的酒杯仿佛纸片一般被捏得粉碎。“够了！难道你没有看到这些恶魔对我们的王国做了什么吗，冠军？他们是如何摧残我们的？”
    
    “就像摧残一个廉价的妓女一样，”你说道。 
    
    “正因为如此，我们才来到了这里，”卡莉丝插话道，及时抓住了将军想要挥向你的拳头。“你们的军队是为与凡人敌人作战而建立的；要对付恶魔，你们需要一种……不同的视角。”
    
    那位第二位政治家苦涩地笑了：“一个把[pc.hisHer]时间都花在[kas.fucked
        |给恶魔女王口交
        |让一个女妖骑坐在[pc.hisHer]脸上
    ]上的人，你是这个意思吗？”
    
    国王又喝了一杯酒，然后从将军手中接过那个皱巴巴的杯子，将它们都递给了一个胆小的女奴。“好了，各位，我们不要互相攻击了。我征求了这位冠军[pc.hisHer]看法，它也已经给出了。在这个宫廷里，我非常重视诚实，哪怕这些答案……有些出乎意料。” 
    
    “出乎意料？”那位年长的公牛说道，“我的国王，与敌人结盟就是叛国行为。”
    
    “那么，这位冠军该庆幸[pc.heShe]并非我的臣民。你无法背弃一个你从未许下的义务。而且抛开评判不谈，[pc.heShe]已经证明了[pc.heShe]是有效的。Njorhaalt的行为就是明证。”
    
    那位老贵族低下了头，显然和那位将军一样不悦。“当然，我的国王。”
    
    卡莉丝将手放在国王粗壮的二头肌上，微笑着对他说：“说得很好，陛下。”

rows.original:
You take a deep drink of your [pc.isPregnant
        |juice
        |wine
    ] before saying, "Honestly? I pity them almost as much as their victims. I've seen how demons are made. I've heard their stories. It turns out most of them are victims themselves, left in a state where they can't help but perpetuate their suffering on others. It doesn't absolve them of their sins, but..."
    
    The general nods. "Taal. We've seen enough of our own people turned to know the truth of that. Having to pit my soldiers against their own countrymen turned evil, it's the sickest part of all this war."
    
    "Now hold just a minute," one of the statesmen says, a younger bull with a pair of lingerie-clad cows at his side. "You can't be suggesting we sympathize with these devils. Not after all they've done to our kingdom. There's no coming back from what they've done to us — to the people they've-"
    
    "I think," the king says, placing a heavy hand on the man's shoulder, "that the Champions would know best if there's any redemption to be had for the demons. What say you, Calise — if the demons are to be pitied, is there any helping them; any chance to restore what was taken from them?"
    
    The paladin's lips draw taut. "I... wish I knew, Your Grace. I believe, at the very least, the gods might be able to if the victim's soul could be found. Though I have yet to meet a demon begging for restoration. Most seem enamored with their newfound power, and the possibilities demonhood brings with it."
    
    "Mmhm." The king takes another long sip of wine. "But is that not demonhood itself speaking? We would not accept the testimony of someone out of their right mind in court. Should we let a belief held while insane condemn someone?"
    
    "What would you have us do, my king?" the general grunts. "Shall we risk more soldiers' souls to capture demons alive? And for what, the hope that the gods will come and save them?"
    
    An elderly senator speaks up: "The gods intervened once before, when demons threatened to overwhelm the world. Do you believe their commitment to us has faltered?" 
    
    "I believe," the general answers, "that I have yet to see the gods get off their asses in this war."
    
    "Blasphemy!"
    
    The king raises a hand sharply, silencing the men. "Enough, gentlemen. General I do not expect you to risk your men for a glimmer of hope. I shall ask what priests remain to us to pray on this matter, however. The gods have not abandoned us! Of this I am sure."

你深深地喝了一口[pc.isPregnant
        |果汁

    ]在说这句话之前，我必须先说明：说实话，我对他们以及他们的受害者都感到同情。我亲眼见过那些人是如何变成恶魔的，也听过了他们的故事。事实上，他们中的大多数本身也是受害者，他们处于这样一种境地：不得不将自己的痛苦转嫁给别人。这并不能免除他们的罪责，但是……
    
    将军点了点头。“没错。我们已经有太多自己的同胞堕落成了那些恶魔，他们自己亲眼见证了这一事实。被迫让我的士兵与那些变节的同胞交战，这才是这场战争中最令人作呕的地方。”
    
    “等等，”一位年轻的政治家插话道，他身边站着两位穿着内衣的妇女。“你们不会是想让我们同情这些恶魔吧？毕竟他们对我们王国做了那么多坏事……他们对我们，以及他们伤害的那些人，所犯下的罪行，已经无法挽回了……
    
    我认为，”国王说着，将重型的手放在那人的肩上，“那些勇士们最清楚是否有可能为恶魔找到赎罪之路。你怎么看，卡莉丝——如果我们应该同情这些恶魔，那么是否还有办法帮助它们；是否还有可能弥补它们所失去的一切呢？
    
    圣骑士的嘴唇紧绷着。“我……真希望自己能知道，陛下。至少，如果能够找到受害者的灵魂，神明或许能给出答案。不过，我至今还没有遇到过哪个恶魔会恳求恢复人类形态。大多数恶魔似乎都沉醉于他们新获得的力量，以及成为恶魔后所带来的种种可能性之中。
    
    嗯……”国王又喝了一大口酒，“但这难道不正是恶魔本身的言论吗？在法庭上，我们也不会接受一个神志清醒之人的证词。难道我们应该让一个人在精神失常的状态下所持有的信念来决定一个人的命运吗？”
    
    “陛下，您想让我们怎么做呢？”将军低沉地问道，“难道我们要冒失去更多士兵生命的危险去活捉那些恶魔吗？而这一切，只是为了寄希望于神明会来拯救他们吗？
    
    一位年长的参议员站出来说：“在过去的某个时刻，当恶魔威胁要毁灭这个世界时，神明们曾经出手干预。你们认为，他们对我们所做出的承诺现在有所动摇吗？”
    
    “我相信，”将军回答道，“在这场战争中，我还没有看到神明们真正采取行动。
    
    亵渎神明！”
    
    国王猛地抬手，让那些人安静下来。“够了，各位。将军，我并不指望你为了那一线希望而让你的士兵们冒生命危险。不过，我需要知道我们还剩下哪些祭司可以为我们祈祷。神明并没有抛弃我们！这一点我确信。

    A long moment hangs in the air before the king throws his head back and laughs. "Well, a philosopher you may not be, Champion, but none doubt your prowess, at least."
    '

rows.original: Excuse yourself from the king, for now. He's not going anywhere, so you can always come back if need be.

rows.raw: "Excuse yourself from the king, for now. He's not going anywhere, so you can always come back if need be."

rows.original:
"I don't think Vrannus is going anywhere," you tell the king, nodding towards the curtain. "Not with that salamander-boy's knot buried in his ass back there."
    
    The idle chatter and laughter among the king's comrades dies on the nobles' lips. The king's jovial expression hardens, eyes narrowing. Silence hangs in the air like a smothering blanket. 
    
    When the king finally replies, his voice is even and measured. "Well, if that's all that's keeping him, then I am sure my son will be out and about before we dine. Now, if you'll excuse yourself, Champion..."
    
    The king turns from you, slaps one of his friends on the back, and takes a cup of wine from a serving girl. 
    
    Conversation over, it seems...
rows.translation:
我觉得弗兰努斯不会去任何地方，”你对国王说道，同时指向那面帷幕。“毕竟他屁股里还嵌着那个火蜥蜴男孩系的结呢。”
    
    国王的同伴们闲聊着、笑着，但那些话在贵族们耳边瞬间戛然而止。国王原本愉悦的表情变得严肃起来，双眼也眯了起来。空气中弥漫着一种令人窒息的沉默。
    
    当国王终于开口时，他的声音平静而稳重：“好吧，如果只是这个原因让他迟迟不回来，那么我相信在我们用餐之前，我的儿子一定会回来的。现在，如果你们不介意的话，冠军……”
    
    国王转过身去，拍了拍一位朋友的背，然后从一位侍女手中拿了一杯酒。
    
    看来，谈话已经结束了……

rows.original:
There's no particularly politic way to go about this with the man himself, but you're curious enough to ask. "Tell me about yourself, King Kelsaz?"
    
    The king takes a fresh cup from a passing servant and takes a long draught. "I suppose proper introductions are in order, aren't they? I am Kelsaz, patriarch of House Moratia. My family has ruled Khor'minos for four generations. I have spent my three decades of rule rebuilding what was lost in the Godswar: reforging alliances, building trade networks, and investing in both infrastructure and education to ensure our citizens' prosperity."
    
    "You're not running for senate!" one of his cohorts laughs.
    
    Kelsaz snorts. "Bah. What else is a man to say? The only thing I am more proud of than my accomplishments are my children, and they're here to speak for themselves!" He sighs. "Well, Varena is, anyway. Vrannus will turn up before long, I'm sure. Hah! Before taking the throne, I was something of a scholar. I enjoyed studying history and philosophy, and spent much time traveling the kingdom and the realms beyond. Now, what precious little free time I have I spend improving my body."
    
    The king flexes, putting his truly impressive musculature on display beneath his bare-chested toga. Several of the attending cowgirls gasp and squeal, just about bouncing out of their skimpy tops. One of them literally does, a bare breast slapping loudly against her tunic. Her friends giggle at her, but she doesn't bother redressing. 
    
    Now that you're thinking about it... "Is that what's behind the new fashion?" you ask, glancing between the muscular king to the nearly-naked cows. "Everyone's proud of their bodies?"
    
    "Hah! And why shouldn't we be?" the king laughs, thumping a fist against a general's rock-hard bare chest. "With everyone packed into the city and locked down, I've been encouraging the kingdom to look to their health — physical and mental — with exercise! Vrannus and some of the ladies that often court him started the fashion trend that followed in its wake. It's certainly... ah, haha, certainly risque, but it's taken off! Everyone's happy with it, aren't they?"
    
    The newly topless cowgirl beside him moos happily and wiggles her shoulders, making her tits quake obscenely until milk dribbles onto the floor. 
    
    Even the king doesn't think it's a little strange, does he?
rows.translation:
对于这个人来说，并没有什么特别政治化的方式可以处理这件事，但你还是出于好奇才问了出来。“请告诉我关于你自己的事情吧，凯尔萨兹国王。”
    
    国王从一位路过的仆从手中拿过一杯新鲜的酒，然后大口喝了起来。我想，我们确实应该进行正式的介绍，不是吗？我是凯尔萨兹，莫拉提亚家族的族长。我的家族已经统治科尔米诺斯四代了。在我三十年的统治期间，我致力于重建在神战期间遭受破坏的一切：重新建立联盟、发展贸易网络，同时投资于基础设施和教育事业，以确保我们公民的繁荣与幸福。"
    
    你居然没有竞选参议员啊！”他的一个同伙笑道。
    
    凯尔萨兹哼了一声：“呸，男人还能说什么呢？比起自己的成就，我最引以为傲的就是我的孩子们，而他们现在就在这里，可以为自己发声！他叹了口气：“嗯，至少瓦蕾娜是这样。我相信弗兰努斯很快就会出现。哈！在登上王位之前，我算是个学者吧。我喜欢研究历史和哲学，还花了很多时间游历这个王国以及更远的地方。现在，我把为数不多的空闲时间都用来锻炼身体了。
    
    国王展示了自己的肌肉力量，他赤裸上身的托加服将他那令人印象深刻的肌肉线条完全展现了出来。在场的几位女牛仔们纷纷倒抽凉气，发出尖叫声，有些甚至差点从自己那紧身的上衣里跳出来。其中有一个女孩真的这样做了，她的裸露的胸部狠狠地撞在了她的外衣上，发出响亮的声响。她的朋友们都嘲笑她，但她却懒得重新整理衣服。 
    
    现在你想起来……你问道：“难道这就是新时尚背后的原因吗？”你的目光在那位肌肉发达的国王和那些几乎赤裸的牛群之间来回扫视。“难道每个人都不为自己的身材感到自豪吗？”
    
    “哈！我们当然应该感到自豪啊！国王大笑着，用拳头猛击那位将军坚硬结实的胸膛：“既然所有人都被关在城里，无法外出活动，我就一直在鼓励全国人民重视自己的身心健康，多进行锻炼！瓦兰纳斯以及那些经常追求他的女士们，率先掀起了这一时尚潮流。当然……哈哈，这个潮流确实有点大胆，但大家都非常喜欢它，不是吗？
    
    他身旁这位新换上裸上装的女牛仔开心地哞哞叫着，还不停地扭动肩膀，导致她的胸部剧烈晃动，牛奶都快滴到地上了。
    
    就连国王也会觉得这有点奇怪吧？

rows.original: King Kelsaz makes a low grumble in the back of his throat, scratching at the back of his neck. "Ah, yes, my boy. He makes a habit of being fashionably late, but when he arrives I'm sure he'll find a way to make up for lost time. He's a whirlwind when he wants to be, and far better than his old father at livening up a party too." A few of the younger men in the group chuckle. One of the lingerie-clad cowgirls squeezes her bull's arm between her breasts and squeals "I can't wait to finally meet the prince!" "Perhaps better with the ladies, too," Kelsaz laughs. "My boy inherited the best of me, and made them better — quick-witted, charismatic, studious, ambitious. If I'd had half his virtues when I was his age, no doubt Khor'minos would be an empire to rival Old Belhar by now!" "Do you think he's that ambitious?" you ask. The old empire ruled over not just the Marches, but most of the continent — hundreds of miles of territory south of here. The king waves a hand. "Ah, a figure of speech. No need to worry about the sovereignty of your homeland, Champion.[party.has etheryn | Nor your own kingdom, Etheryn. ] House Moratia's ambitions lie in commerce and the exchange of loyalty and friendship, not military conquest. Those days are behind us, I should think." "Vrannus is no fighter," one of the generals says, a little dismissively. "But he is a scholar of the military arts," a sage insists. "Crown Prince Vrannus has been crucial in planning the city's defenses! It was he who first realized that the flaws in the outer settlements' walls made them vulnerable to the winged imps, and pleaded with the good king to withdraw our people behind the capital's impregnable defenses!" The general grunts, but nods. "No doubt things would have been worse without his insight." "And now," says the king, "my boy's leading the research into the demons' dark arts and how to counter them, or how to restore those citizens of the kingdom that have been taken under their influence. Countless multitudes of our people's hopes hinge on his success." "Wow," the cowgirl says dreamily. "That sounds so heroic..." "I'm so very proud of the man he's become," the king says fondly. "Now if only he could manage to actually show up anywhere on time, we'd really be getting somewhere!"
rows.translation: 凯尔萨兹国王喉间发出低沉的咕哝，伸手挠了挠后颈。“啊，对，我那孩子。他总喜欢优雅地迟到，不过等他来了，我相信他会设法弥补错过的时间。他想活跃气氛时，整个人就像一阵旋风；论炒热宴会，他也比自己的老父亲强得多。” 人群中几个年轻男子轻声笑了起来。一名只穿着内衣的母牛姑娘把公牛伴侣的手臂夹在双乳之间，尖声说道：“我等不及要见到王子本人了！” “或许他讨女士欢心的本事也更强。”凯尔萨兹笑道，“我那孩子继承了我身上最好的品质，还把它们发扬光大——机敏、富有魅力、勤学、胸怀大志。倘若我在他这个年纪时能有他一半的美德，如今的科尔米诺斯无疑早已成为足以匹敌旧贝尔哈的帝国了！” “你觉得他真有那么大的野心？”你问道。昔日帝国统治的不仅是边境地区，而是大陆的大半疆域——从这里向南绵延数百英里。 国王挥挥手。“啊，只是种修辞。你不必担心故乡的主权，冠军。[party.has etheryn |伊瑟琳，你也不必担心自己的王国。 ]莫拉蒂亚家族的野心在于贸易，以及交换忠诚与友谊，而非军事征服。我想，那些日子已经过去了。” “弗兰努斯不是战士。”一名将军略显轻蔑地说道。 “但他的确是军事艺术的学者。”一名贤者坚持道，“弗兰努斯王储在规划城市防御时发挥了关键作用！正是他率先意识到，外围聚落城墙上的缺陷使其容易受到飞翼小恶魔袭击，并恳请英明的国王将人民撤进首都坚不可摧的防线之后！” 将军哼了一声，但还是点点头。“要是没有他的洞见，情况无疑会更加糟糕。” “而现在，”国王说道，“我那孩子正领导对恶魔黑暗秘术的研究，设法找出克制它们的方法，或者让那些受其影响的王国子民恢复正常。我国无数民众的希望都系于他的成败。” “哇。”母牛姑娘梦幻般地说道，“听起来真是英勇……” “我为他如今成长为这样一个男人而无比骄傲。”国王慈爱地说道，“现在，只要他能设法准时出现在任何一个地方，我们可就真的有进展了！”
rows.raw: ' King Kelsaz makes a low grumble in the back of his throat, scratching at the back of his neck. "Ah, yes, my boy. He makes a habit of being fashionably late, but when he arrives I'm sure he'll find a way to make up for lost time. He's a whirlwind when he wants to be, and far better than his old father at livening up a party too." A few of the younger men in the group chuckle. One of the lingerie-clad cowgirls squeezes her bull's arm between her breasts and squeals "I can't wait to finally meet the prince!" "Perhaps better with the ladies, too," Kelsaz laughs. "My boy inherited the best of me, and made them better — quick-witted, charismatic, studious, ambitious. If I'd had half his virtues when I was his age, no doubt Khor'minos would be an empire to rival Old Belhar by now!" "Do you think he's that ambitious?" you ask. The old empire ruled over not just the Marches, but most of the continent — hundreds of miles of territory south of here. The king waves a hand. "Ah, a figure of speech. No need to worry about the sovereignty of your homeland, Champion.[party.has etheryn | Nor your own kingdom, Etheryn. ] House Moratia's ambitions lie in commerce and the exchange of loyalty and friendship, not military conquest. Those days are behind us, I should think." "Vrannus is no fighter," one of the generals says, a little dismissively. "But he is a scholar of the military arts," a sage insists. "Crown Prince Vrannus has been crucial in planning the city's defenses! It was he who first realized that the flaws in the outer settlements' walls made them vulnerable to the winged imps, and pleaded with the good king to withdraw our people behind the capital's impregnable defenses!" The general grunts, but nods. "No doubt things would have been worse without his insight." "And now," says the king, "my boy's leading the research into the demons' dark arts and how to counter them, or how to restore those citizens of the kingdom that have been taken under their influence. Countless multitudes of our people's hopes hinge on his success." "Wow," the cowgirl says dreamily. "That sounds so heroic..." "I'm so very proud of the man he's become," the king says fondly. "Now if only he could manage to actually show up anywhere on time, we'd really be getting somewhere!" '

rows.original:
"Ah, Varena, my pride and joy," the king says fondly at the mention of her name. "[flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA
        |I thought I saw the two of you chatting already!
        |Between you and me, she's been very excited to meet you, Champion.
    ]"
    
    "Tell me about her?"
    
    Kelsaz laughs. "I'd rather you hear from her herself! She's an eloquent speaker, and never afraid to speak her mind, either. [flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA
        |I'm sure she's talked your ear off already
        |Give her a chance and I'm sure she'd talk your ear off
    ] about her art and studies. Never have I met a woman as passionate and talented as my Varena."
    
    The king sweeps a hand across the halls. "Can you believe all these frescoes are her doing? The work of years, started before she was a grown woman, and all while she was also studying sorcery under Lady Juno, too. 'I want to leave my mark on the palace' she said... well, I say her descendants centuries from now will be able to look on her work with the same pride I do."
    
    You glance over at where the princess is standing amidst a small sea of courtiers vying for her attention. She's looking right back at her dad with burning-red cheeks and tucked ears.
    
    Aww.
rows.translation:
“啊，瓦蕾娜，我引以为傲的人啊，”国王一提到她的名字，就满怀深情地说道。“[flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA
        |我好像看到你们两个已经在聊天了！
        |说实在的，她非常期待能见到你，冠军。
    ]”
    
    “跟我讲讲她吧？”
    
    凯尔萨兹笑了。“我倒希望你能直接听她自己讲！她口才很好，而且从不害怕说出自己的想法。[flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA
        |我敢肯定，她已经跟你聊得停不下来了
        |给她一个机会，我相信她会跟你聊她的艺术与学问聊个没完
    ]我从未遇到过像瓦蕾娜这样充满热情且才华横溢的女性。”
    
    国王挥手示意众人看向大厅。“你们能相信这些壁画都是她创作的吗？这些作品耗费了她多年的时间，甚至在她还未成年时就已经开始了创作，而与此同时，她还在朱诺女士的指导下学习魔法。‘我想在宫殿里留下自己的印记’，她说……嗯，我认为几个世纪后，她的后代们看到她的成就时，也会和我一样感到自豪。”
    
    你瞥了一眼那位公主站立的地方——她站在一群争相吸引她注意的朝臣中间。她正红着脸、耳朵耷拉着，直直地望着她的爸爸。
    
    哎呀，真让人心疼。

rows.original:
"So," you say, glancing back to the small court of young men surrounding the princess, "[pc.isBimbo
        |like, is Varena single?
        |is Varena's hand already spoken for?
    ]"
    
    The king throws his head back and laughs, loud enough to catch the attention of half the room. "A bold question to ask a man the day you meet him! But I suppose I should expect no less of a champion!" The king glances around, and drops his voice back down to a more conversational tone. "[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_VRANNUS_SINGLE
        |Why Champion, I'm starting to think you have some intentions towards my children! 
    ]Varena's always been headstrong about her future, and I don't have the heart to try and force her into a marriage for political benefit. My house is strong enough to let my girl go about her life unchained, if she chooses. Especially when what she does — her art, her works for the city's betterment — brings her and all of our house such esteem!"
    
    "Besides! I don't look forward to the idea of being a doddering old man with embittered children to look after him." He shakes his head. "Though if a certain noble [pc.mf
        |lord
        |lady
    ]-champion were to propose to Varena when this war comes to its end, I would happily give such an endeavor my blessing. But the decision to accept will be hers, not mine."
rows.translation:
“那么，”你回头看向围绕着公主的那一小群年轻男子，问道，“[pc.isBimbo
        |话说，瓦蕾娜还是单身吗？
        |瓦蕾娜已经许配给别人了吗？
    ]”
    
    国王仰头大笑，响亮的笑声引得半个房间的人都看了过来。“初次见面就敢问一个男人这种问题，真是大胆！不过，一位勇士有这样的胆量，倒也不足为奇！”国王环顾四周，将声音压回适合交谈的音量。“[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_VRANNUS_SINGLE
        |勇士啊，我都开始怀疑你是不是对我的孩子们有什么心思了！
    ]瓦蕾娜对自己的未来向来很有主见，我也狠不下心为了政治利益逼她成婚。我的家族足够强盛；只要她愿意，我可以让女儿不受束缚地选择自己的人生。更何况，她的艺术，以及她为了改善这座城市所做的一切，都为自己和整个家族赢得了如此崇高的声望！”
    
    “再说了！我可不想老得糊里糊涂，还得让满腹怨气的孩子照顾我。”他摇摇头。“不过，要是某位贵族[pc.mf
        |领主
        |女士
    ]勇士在这场战争结束后向瓦蕾娜求婚，我会很乐意祝福这桩婚事。但是否答应，要由她决定，而不是我。”

rows.original:
"Can we speak about Calise?" 
    
    "Why, champion, she's right there," the king says, gesturing to the paladin. "It's hardly appropriate to gossip right in a noble lady's face, even if I am the king!"
    
    Calise waves at you.
    
    Fair enough, you suppose. Perhaps when Calise's not around....
rows.translation:
“我们能谈谈卡莉丝吗？” 
    
    “哦，冠军，她就在那儿啊，”国王说着，指向那位圣骑士。“就算我是国王，当着一位贵族女士的面说闲话也确实不太合适吧！”
    
    卡莉丝朝你挥了挥手。
    
    嗯，也有道理。或许等卡莉丝不在场的时候再谈……

rows.original:
"Ah," the king says, awkwardly scratching his chin when you mention the name. "Yes, indeed, the ever-lovely Feronia. I freely admit I have admired her for some time..."
    
    "Vigorously admired," one of his friends sneers, swiping a hand in front of his loins.
    
    Kelsaz smacks one of the bull's horns. "She's one of the canniest women in the city, and one of the most beautiful. Truly, it's one of my great regrets in life that I didn't take her to wed-"
    
    "To bed," another bull laughs. You suppose it's hardly surprising the king's passions are well known at court.
    
    "-when we were younger," the king concludes. "Mallach knows I had every chance as a young prince, but she's proven reticent to give me another as her king. Still, to offer her a place as a royal concubine is a great honor, and I am sure she'll accept eventually. I can't blame her for wanting to be sure of my commitment to her, though it pains me that she's found it necessary."
    
    "So you've known her a long time?"
    
    Kelsaz smiles. "Oh, yes, though I had my encounters with Feronia before the Pasture came about. Before I took my first wife, I was quite the ladies' man, you know! The women of the town swooned where I walked!"
    
    Several of his friends laugh at that. Somehow, you get the feeling that statement's mostly bluster.
    
    "When I became king, and she a business owner, our social circles, ah, drifted. I hope to mend that divide, you see. I was fond of her back then, and am no less so now that she's become a mother and respected mistress."
    
    Another bull opens his mouth to quip, and the king gives his horns a preemptive smack. "Now, let's move on before my wives' — or future wife's — business becomes the talk of the day, shall we?"
rows.translation:
“啊，”你提到这个名字时，国王尴尬地挠了挠下巴。“没错，正是那位永远可爱的费罗妮娅。我承认，我仰慕她已经有一段时间了……”
    
    “热烈地仰慕，”他的一位朋友嗤笑道，一只手在自己的胯前挥了一下。
    
    凯尔萨兹拍了他一只牛角一下。“她是城里最精明的女人之一，也是最美丽的女人之一。说实话，我这一生最大的遗憾之一，就是当初没有娶她为——”
    
    “上床，”另一头公牛笑道。你猜想，国王的风流艳事在宫廷里人尽皆知，这倒也不奇怪。
    
    “——妻，”国王把话说完。“马拉赫知道，我当年轻王子的时候有的是机会，但她已经证明，她并不愿意再给我一次机会，让我以国王的身份得到她。不过，给她一个王室嫔妃的位置是莫大的荣誉，我相信她最终会接受的。我也不能怪她想先确认我对她的承诺，只是她竟然觉得有必要这样做，这让我很难过。”
    
    “这么说，你认识她很久了？”
    
    凯尔萨兹笑了。“哦，是的，早在激情牧场开张之前，我就和费罗妮娅有过几次交往。在我娶第一任妻子之前，我可是个相当讨女人喜欢的男人，你知道的！我走到哪儿，镇上的女人就在哪儿为我神魂颠倒！”
    
    他的几个朋友听了都笑了起来。不知为何，你总觉得他这话多半只是在吹牛。
    
    “我当上国王之后，她成了生意人，我们的社交圈子，呃，就渐渐疏远了。你明白，我希望弥补这道裂痕。那时我就很喜欢她，如今她做了母亲、成了受人尊敬的老板娘，我对她的喜爱也丝毫未减。”
    
    又一头公牛张嘴想说俏皮话，国王抢先拍了他的角一下。“好了，我们还是换个话题吧，免得我妻子们——或者未来妻子——的事成了今天的谈资，好吗？”

rows.original: "Can we talk about the state of the city?" The king sighs. "It's supposed to be a party, Champion, not a strategy meeting! Ah, then again, I suppose you haven't had the privilege yet. We'll have to rectify that." He shoots a glance at one of his scholarly-looking retainers, who nods emphatically. "So," Kelsaz continues, "from the top. The demons attacked in the aftermath of a freak blizzard that blanketed the overworld, taking advantage of the confusion to launch an attack on our outer villages. People fled in droves. Thanks be to Tira, the Legions were able to mount a mighty counterattack and cover their retreat. In the aftermath, I ordered a total evacuation of every settlement not able to protect itself from winged attackers... which, it has proven, is almost all of them. The greater City of Khor'minos has taken on tens of thousands of refugees from the settlements we cannot defend. This has stretched our now-limited supply lines and our ability to house our citizens to the very limit... but, we are holding strong. Our citizens are united as never before, and the Legions' ranks swell with new volunteers." "Has the quarantine helped at all?" you ask. The king just shrugs. "It has kept hapless travelers and valued merchants from wandering into a warzone, which is all I can hope for. The Chargers have caught some demons attempting to infiltrate the Undermountain, but more importantly, they are keeping the hordes of imps bottled up down here in the tunnels where we can deal with them." "You want them to stay down here?" "Oh yes!" one of the generals snorts. "In the tunnels, we can restrict their movements — at least to an extent. These foul creatures aren't engineers, they don't make their own paths through the stone. If they were allowed access to the surface? They could fly their army anywhere they chose, attack from any angle." "Indeed," Kelsaz says with a nod. "Just about the worst thing that could happen would be the imp hordes coming at us from the eastern tunnels, but we've had them locked down tight since the blizzard hit, thank the gods. As things stand, the only way in or out from Undermountain available to the fiends are through the waterways, around which the navy is stepping up patrols, and now the Steps of Sorra. As long as that truth persists, we only need defend a handful of tunnels from their attacks. And as long as we can keep fighting for the waterways, we can keep supplies coming from the overworld to support the city's overburdened population." When he says it, Kelsaz makes the situation sound not all that bad... [pc.isCunning |Which, to be fair, is more or less his job. ] "So what does the Crown plan to do?" you ask. "The demons aren't stopping on their own." "For now? We're on the defensive, until Lady Calise finds where the demons make their base. These... breeding pits... she's told us of. Once we know where the enemy spawns their soulless legions, we can march against it." "So that's why Calise's been sortieing so often, to try and scout the pits out?" The Champion of Velun answers for herself. "To an extent. You and I can talk about our expedition plans later, though."
rows.translation: 我们能谈谈这座城市的现状吗？” 国王叹了口气：“这本该是一场庆祝活动，冠军，而不是战略会议啊！不过，我想你还没有机会体验这样的场合吧……我们得纠正这个错误。” 他瞥了一眼那位看起来颇有学识的随从，那人立刻点了点头表示同意。 所以，”凯尔萨兹继续说道，“从一开始就是这样的。在那场突如其来的暴风雪之后，恶魔趁机发动了攻击。那场暴风雪覆盖了整个外部世界，人们陷入了混乱，而恶魔正是利用了这种混乱，对我们的边远村庄发起了攻击。人们纷纷逃往安全的地方。多亏了蒂拉，军团才能够发起强大的反击并成功撤退。事后，我下令要求所有无法抵御这些有翼攻击者的定居点进行全面撤离……事实证明，几乎所有的定居点都属于这一类别。庞大的科尔米诺斯城接纳了来自那些我们无法防守的定居点的数万名难民。这一情况使我们原本就有限的补给线以及为市民提供住所的能力陷入了极度紧张的状态……但是，我们依然坚守着。我们的公民们比以往任何时候都更加团结，而军团的队伍中也不断有新的志愿者加入其中。 这种隔离措施真的有什么效果吗？”你问道。 国王只是耸了耸肩：“至少它阻止了那些不幸的旅行者和重要的商人误入战区，这也是我所能期望的全部效果了。那些‘冲锋者’部队已经抓住了几个试图潜入地底山脉的恶魔，但更重要的是，他们把那些小恶魔关在了地下的隧道里，这样我们就可以有办法对付它们了。 你希望他们这样做留下就在下面吗？” “没错！”其中一位将军哼道，“在那些隧道里，我们至少可以在一定程度上限制他们的行动。这些肮脏的生物根本不是工程师，他们不可能自己开凿出穿过石墙的通道来。如果他们被允许进入地表的话？他们就可以把军队带到任何他们想要的地方，从任何角度发动攻击。” “确实如此，”凯尔萨兹点头说道，“最糟糕的情况也就是那些兽人从东边的隧道里冲过来攻击我们，但自从暴风雪来袭之后，我们把那些隧道都严密封锁了，谢天谢地。就目前的情况来看，恶魔进入或离开山腹深域的唯一途径就是通过水路，而海军正在这些水路附近加强巡逻；此外，索拉阶梯也是他们可以使用的通道。只要这一情况持续不变，我们只需要防御少数几条隧道，就能阻挡他们的进攻。只要我们能够继续为这些水道而战，就能持续从外界获取补给，从而支持这座城市中负担过重的居民。” 当凯尔萨兹说出这番话时，让整个局势听起来并没有那么糟糕…… [pc.isCunning |公平地说，这差不多就是他的工作内容。 ] 那么王室打算采取什么措施呢？”你问道，“那些恶魔不会自己停下来罢休的。” “目前来说，我们只能采取防御措施，直到卡莉丝女士找到那些恶魔的据点。就是她提到的那些……繁殖场所…… 一旦我们知道了敌人在哪里招募那些没有灵魂的军团，我们就可以向那里进军。” “原来这就是为什么卡莉丝最近频繁出击，试图探查那些地点的原因啊？” 维伦的冠军为自己作出了回答。在某种程度上吧。不过，我们之后可以详细讨论一下我们的探险计划。
rows.raw: ' "Can we talk about the state of the city?" The king sighs. "It's supposed to be a party, Champion, not a strategy meeting! Ah, then again, I suppose you haven't had the privilege yet. We'll have to rectify that." He shoots a glance at one of his scholarly-looking retainers, who nods emphatically. "So," Kelsaz continues, "from the top. The demons attacked in the aftermath of a freak blizzard that blanketed the overworld, taking advantage of the confusion to launch an attack on our outer villages. People fled in droves. Thanks be to Tira, the Legions were able to mount a mighty counterattack and cover their retreat. In the aftermath, I ordered a total evacuation of every settlement not able to protect itself from winged attackers... which, it has proven, is almost all of them. The greater City of Khor'minos has taken on tens of thousands of refugees from the settlements we cannot defend. This has stretched our now-limited supply lines and our ability to house our citizens to the very limit... but, we are holding strong. Our citizens are united as never before, and the Legions' ranks swell with new volunteers." "Has the quarantine helped at all?" you ask. The king just shrugs. "It has kept hapless travelers and valued merchants from wandering into a warzone, which is all I can hope for. The Chargers have caught some demons attempting to infiltrate the Undermountain, but more importantly, they are keeping the hordes of imps bottled up down here in the tunnels where we can deal with them." "You want them to stay down here?" "Oh yes!" one of the generals snorts. "In the tunnels, we can restrict their movements — at least to an extent. These foul creatures aren't engineers, they don't make their own paths through the stone. If they were allowed access to the surface? They could fly their army anywhere they chose, attack from any angle." "Indeed," Kelsaz says with a nod. "Just about the worst thing that could happen would be the imp hordes coming at us from the eastern tunnels, but we've had them locked down tight since the blizzard hit, thank the gods. As things stand, the only way in or out from Undermountain available to the fiends are through the waterways, around which the navy is stepping up patrols, and now the Steps of Sorra. As long as that truth persists, we only need defend a handful of tunnels from their attacks. And as long as we can keep fighting for the waterways, we can keep supplies coming from the overworld to support the city's overburdened population." When he says it, Kelsaz makes the situation sound not all that bad... [pc.isCunning |Which, to be fair, is more or less his job. ] "So what does the Crown plan to do?" you ask. "The demons aren't stopping on their own." "For now? We're on the defensive, until Lady Calise finds where the demons make their base. These... breeding pits... she's told us of. Once we know where the enemy spawns their soulless legions, we can march against it." "So that's why Calise's been sortieing so often, to try and scout the pits out?" The Champion of Velun answers for herself. "To an extent. You and I can talk about our expedition plans later, though." '

rows.original: "What's your take on the demons, King Kelsaz?" The king laughs. "Khaak! Fair enough, then, I did ask you first. Well, I can't say I've had a face to face encounter with one of the wretches yet, but I've seen their handiwork writ large across the kingdom: villages ransacked, people kidnapped and corrupted. For this, I despise them, and would see their kind scoured from the world to the last. However..." Kelsaz pauses, letting that word hang in the air a moment. "So too do I know that some citizens of this kingdom have been, against their will, taken and defiled to their very souls by the enemy. The reports I have heard say that many of those taken return as demons themselves, driven to madness and barbarity by their defilement. For this reason, I have what priests and mages can be spared from battle working to find a way to reverse the changes, or restore a soul taken from its body." "Have they met with any success?" Calise asks. "No," Keslaz says heavily, "they have not. But I remain hopeful that some progress will be made. My heir has been overseeing the research, and he has a mind even sharper than mine. If anyone can discover the demons' secrets, it will be him and those he works with." "He's a brilliant lad, my king," an elderly bull says. "But the soul is the purview of the gods. I fear our hopes of salvation are at their mercy." The king just scoffs. "Tira be my witness, I have heard enough of men telling me to wait for the gods to save us! This war is not a test of faith, gentlemen, and we cannot sit around praying while the walls crumble!" The man who spoke up flinches. "I did not mean to insinuate-" "I know, I know," Kelsaz says, lowering his shoulders. "But let me make myself clear, all of you. If the gods deign to descend from their dreams and save us, I will give unto their churches a fortune unheard of since the old empire. But until then, I will fight this war with every ounce of strength the kingdom has left."
rows.translation: “那 你 对恶魔有什么看法，凯尔萨兹国王？” 国王笑了。“哈啊！那行吧，毕竟是我先问你的。嗯，我还没跟那些东西面对面打过照面，但我已经在王国各处见识过他们干的好事：村庄被洗劫，人们被掳走并已腐化。为此，我憎恨他们，但愿看到他们的种族从这世上被彻底清除干净。不过……” 凯尔萨兹顿了顿，让那个词在空气里悬了片刻。“我也知道，这个王国有一些公民违背自己的意愿，被敌人掳走，连灵魂都遭到玷污。我听到的报告说，许多被掳走的人自己也变成了恶魔，被那种玷污逼得发疯、变得野蛮。正因如此，我已经让所有能从战场上抽身的神父和法师去研究如何逆转这种变化，或者把被抽离身体的灵魂还回去。” “他们有什么成果吗？”卡莉丝问道。 “没有，”凯尔萨兹沉重地说，“他们没有。但我仍然抱着希望，相信总会有进展。我的继承人一直在监督这项研究，他的头脑比我还要敏锐。如果有人能发现恶魔的秘密，那一定是他和他共事的人。” “他是个聪明的孩子，我的国王，”一位年长的公牛说道。“但灵魂归神明管辖。我怕我们得救的希望全在祂们的慈悲。” 国王只是嗤了一声。“以蒂拉为证，劝我等着神来救我们的话我已经听够了！各位，这场战争不是对信仰的考验，我们不能在城墙崩塌的时候还坐在这儿祈祷！” 那个出声的男人缩了一下。“我不是想暗示——” “我知道，我知道，”凯尔萨兹说着，放下了肩膀。“但我要把话说清楚，你们所有人都听好。如果诸神肯从他们的梦境中降临来救我们，我会给祂们的教会一笔自旧帝国以来闻所未闻的财富。但在那之前，我会用这个王国仅剩的每一分力量打这场仗。”

rows.original: "How has the kingdom been faring with its neighbors?" Kelsaz's eyes brighten at the topic. "I'm proud to say the kingdom's never been more connected with the wider world than during my reign — present crisis aside. We've reestablished trade routes with the Heartland not used since the Old Empire's days, and now thanks to you, we'll soon have the chance to reconnect with the realm of the boreal elves. It's an occasion for joy and a sign of hope even amidst these dark days; the return of our great northern neighbors, bowed but unbroken by the same menace now at our doorstep." [party.has etheryn |Ryn manages a little smile at that. "Thank you, King Kelsaz. That means a lot." ] "Indeed," he continues, "Njorhaalt's bountiful lumber will no doubt be crucial to rebuilding the outer villages when the war's done with, and [party.has etheryn |your |their ] game and fish could well make up for the shortfall of produce we're fearing next season. [party.has etheryn |I hope you're ready for your coffers to overflow with Khor'minoan gems and gold, Lady Etheryn! |Lady Etheryn had best expand her palace's vaults in anticipation of all the Khor'minoan gold and gems I intend to drown her in! ]" The king laughs, a genuinely excited smile spreading over his furry features. "[var2 |Speaking of monarchs owing you debts, Champion, I understand you've exchanged vows with Lady Kythie? Prince Evander and I are old friends, you know. I'm deeply sorry I missed seeing his little girl's big day. Damn this war! But I suppose it brought you to the Marches, taal? The prince has been cagey as to what you've done to earn her hand over her prior betrothed, but I trust his judgment. Perhaps soon I'll be cursing him for marrying a child to you first!" |Ah, and then there's the Principality of Tychris, of course, our neighbor beyond the Greyvales and second greatest city in the Marches!" He allows himself a chuckle, joined by the other nobles. "Ah, Prince Evander and I are good friends, you know, and our cities have been close trading partners for generations. Tychrisian glass and magic-works are prized here. It's a shame how little we've heard from the City of Glass since this war began — it's hard to know what's going on in the outer world from down here." ] "Ah, but you asked about all our neighbors, not just our trading partners. Calise's told me you base yourself out of Hawkethorne, so I'm sure you're well enough aware of our closest neighbor. A ghost town on and off these last decades, but slowly growing vibrant again. We do little enough trade with it — nobody there but the baroness has the sort of wealth to tempt merchant caravans to stay there longer than a night — but the village provides much needed shelter to those traveling between the kingdom and Tychris in the west, or Maidenbridge to the south." [flags.CARMEN_KILLED | |[var0 | |You butt in to ask, "Do you know the baroness well?" "Not particularly," Kelsaz says, shaking his head. "I've only met her the once. Every other time I've passed through the village, she's been indisposed somehow or another. From what I have heard, though, it seems her villagers don't know much more than I do. A mysterious woman." ] ] "Now, things to the east, that's a different story," the king says[party.has arona |, giving Arona a withering look ]. "The kingdom's eastern border is that of the continent itself, and beyond it is the Sea of Sapphires — and the Sailgrave islands that lay just beyond the coast. The Sailgrave tribes produce pirates like Hawkethorne produces farmers! Those islanders have been a menace since Old Belhar's collapse, and we've had no choice but to police the archipelago ourselves if we want any hope of maritime trade with the south. The most brazen of them even raid the coastal villages themselves for slaves and plunder." [party.has arona |Your orcish companion grunts. "Not like you don't do the same to us." ] The king plants a hand on his hip. [var1 |"At least now we know the demons have been driven out of the islands!" |"And now we hear the demons are out among the islands, too, squatting on the ruins of Dracia." ] He shakes his head. "Those islands attract tragedy and monstrosity like moths to flame. You would think Old Belhar's magisters could have found a better place to host their great academy than Estelore, back in their day. No surprise they were all eaten by demons before they could contribute a thing to the Godswar, with whatever curses those islands hanging over them." "My king," a berobed bull says, "I must insist that there is no curse on the Sailgraves. We have spent two centuries in research, and-" Kelsaz throws up a hand. "A figure of speech, Magister Tarand. Though I think we can all agree that Estelore Island at least is better left alone. What's left of it, anyway." There's a general murmur of agreement from all present — save Calise, who merely snorts.
rows.translation: 这个王国与邻国的关系近来如何？” 听到这个问题，凯尔萨兹的眼睛亮了起来。“我可以自豪地说，在我的统治期间，这个王国与外界的联系从未像现在这样紧密——当然，目前的危机除外。我们重新建立了自旧帝国时代以来就未曾使用过的与心脏之地的贸易路线，而如今多亏了你的帮助，我们很快就能与极北精灵族重新建立联系。在这个暗影的时代，这一消息无疑带来了喜悦，也象征着希望——我们的这些伟大的北方邻居虽然屈服于同样的威胁，但他们并未被击垮，如今他们又一次站了出来，与我们并肩作战。" [party.has etheryn |听到这话，小琳勉强挤出了一个微笑：“谢谢您，凯尔萨兹国王。这对我来说意义重大。 ] 的确，”他继续说道，“战争结束后，Njorhaalt提供的丰富木材对于重建那些边远村庄来说无疑至关重要。 [party.has etheryn |你的 |他们的 ]游戏和鱼类很可能会弥补我们担心下一季会出现的农产品短缺问题。 [party.has etheryn |希望您的钱包里能装满科尔米诺斯的宝石和黄金，伊瑟琳女士！ |伊瑟琳女士最好赶紧扩建她宫殿的地下金库，因为我有打算用大量的科尔米诺黄金和宝石来“淹没”她呢！ ]国王笑了，他那毛茸茸的脸上露出了真正兴奋的笑容。[var2 |说到那些欠你人情的主君们，冠军，我听说你已经和凯西小姐结为夫妻了？你知道，埃万德王子和我可是老朋友。我真的很遗憾没能参加他女儿的婚礼。该死的战争！不过我想，正是因为这场战争，你才来到了边境地区吧？王子对于你究竟用了什么办法才让凯西小姐放弃了之前的未婚夫，一直保持沉默，但我相信他的判断力。也许不久之后，我就会因为他先让你娶到了这个女孩而责备他了！ |啊，当然还有提克里斯公国，它位于灰谷地带之外，是我们邻近的国家，也是边境地区第二大的城市！”他轻声笑了笑，其他贵族也跟着笑了起来。“嗯，埃万德王子和我可是很好的朋友，我们的城市几代以来一直保持着密切的贸易关系。提克里斯出产的玻璃制品和魔法物品在这里非常受欢迎。可惜自从这场战争爆发以来，我们几乎再也没有收到过来自‘玻璃之城’的任何消息——从这里真的很难了解外界发生了什么。 ] 啊，但你之前问的是我们的所有邻居，而不仅仅是贸易伙伴。卡莉丝告诉我你住在鹰棘镇，所以你肯定很清楚我们最近的邻居是谁。这个地方在过去的几十年里一直是一座鬼城，但如今正在逐渐恢复生机。我们与这个地方的贸易往来其实很少——除了那位女男爵之外，没有其他人拥有足够的财富来吸引商队在那里停留更长时间。不过，这个村庄为那些在王国与西部的提克里斯之间，或是南部与梅登布里奇之间往返旅行的人们提供了必要的庇护所。" [flags.CARMEN_KILLED | |[var0 | |你插话说：“你跟那位女男爵很熟吗？” “其实不太熟，”凯尔萨兹摇着头说，“我只见过她一次。每次我经过那个村庄，她总是身体不适。不过据我所知，村里的其他人应该也知道得不多。她真是个神秘的女人。 ] ] 现在，东边的事情，那就是另一回事了，”国王说道。[party.has arona |，同时向阿罗娜投去一个充满蔑视的眼神 ]这个王国的东边界与大陆本身相连，再往东就是蓝宝石海，以及位于海岸线之外的赛尔格雷夫群岛。赛尔格雷夫群岛上的部落出产海盗，就如同鹰棘镇地区出产农民一样！自从老贝尔哈尔帝国崩溃以来，这些岛民就一直是个威胁，如果我们还想与南方进行海上贸易，就不得不亲自去监管这个群岛。其中最胆大妄为的那些人，甚至会直接袭击沿海的村庄，抢夺奴隶和财物。 [party.has arona |你的兽人同伴哼了一声：“你对我们不也是这么做的吗？ ] 国王将手叉在腰上。 [var1 |至少现在我们知道，那些恶魔已经被赶出了这些岛屿！ |现在我们听说，那些恶魔也出现在了这些岛屿上，它们栖息在达拉西亚的废墟之中。 ]他摇了摇头。“那些岛屿就像吸引飞蛾的火焰一样，总会招来悲剧和怪物。你可能会想，老贝尔哈尔的法师们在他们那个时代，应该能找到比埃斯托洛尔更合适的地点来建立他们的伟大学院吧。难怪他们在为‘神战’做出任何贡献之前，就被那些岛屿带来的诅咒所吞噬了。我的国王，”那位穿着长袍的公牛说道，“我必须坚持认为，帆葬海岸家族并没有受到任何诅咒。我们花费了两个世纪的时间进行研究，结果发现——” 凯尔萨兹抬手示意他停止说话。“这只是个比喻而已，塔兰德大师。不过我想，我们大家都应该认同，至少埃斯托洛尔岛还是最好不要被打扰为妙。不管怎样，现在也就只剩下这些了。” 在场的所有人都发出了赞同的低声，只有卡莉丝只是哼了一声。

It's an occasion for joy and a sign of hope even amidst these dark days; the return of our great northern neighbors, bowed but unbroken by the same menace now at our doorstep." [party.has etheryn |Ryn manages a little smile at that. "Thank you, King Kelsaz. That means a lot." ] "Indeed," he continues, "Njorhaalt's bountiful lumber will no doubt be crucial to rebuilding the outer villages when the war's done with, and [party.has etheryn |your |their ] game and fish could well make up for the shortfall of produce we're fearing next season. [party.has etheryn |I hope you're ready for your coffers to overflow with Khor'minoan gems and gold, Lady Etheryn! |Lady Etheryn had best expand her palace's vaults in anticipation of all the Khor'minoan gold and gems I intend to drown her in! ]" The king laughs, a genuinely excited smile spreading over his furry features. "[var2 |Speaking of monarchs owing you debts, Champion, I understand you've exchanged vows with Lady Kythie? Prince Evander and I are old friends, you know. I'm deeply sorry I missed seeing his little girl's big day. Damn this war! But I suppose it brought you to the Marches, taal? The prince has been cagey as to what you've done to earn her hand over her prior betrothed, but I trust his judgment. Perhaps soon I'll be cursing him for marrying a child to you first!" |Ah, and then there's the Principality of Tychris, of course, our neighbor beyond the Greyvales and second greatest city in the Marches!" He allows himself a chuckle, joined by the other nobles. "Ah, Prince Evander and I are good friends, you know, and our cities have been close trading partners for generations. Tychrisian glass and magic-works are prized here. It's a shame how little we've heard from the City of Glass since this war began — it's hard to know what's going on in the outer world from down here." ] "Ah, but you asked about all our neighbors, not just our trading partners. Calise's told me you base yourself out of Hawkethorne, so I'm sure you're well enough aware of our closest neighbor. A ghost town on and off these last decades, but slowly growing vibrant again. We do little enough trade with it — nobody there but the baroness has the sort of wealth to tempt merchant caravans to stay there longer than a night — but the village provides much needed shelter to those traveling between the kingdom and Tychris in the west, or Maidenbridge to the south." [flags.CARMEN_KILLED | |[var0 | |You butt in to ask, "Do you know the baroness well?" "Not particularly," Kelsaz says, shaking his head. "I've only met her the once. Every other time I've passed through the village, she's been indisposed somehow or another. From what I have heard, though, it seems her villagers don't know much more than I do. A mysterious woman." ] ] "Now, things to the east, that's a different story," the king says[party.has arona |, giving Arona a withering look ]. "The kingdom's eastern border is that of the continent itself, and beyond it is the Sea of Sapphires — and the Sailgrave islands that lay just beyond the coast. The Sailgrave tribes produce pirates like Hawkethorne produces farmers! Those islanders have been a menace since Old Belhar's collapse, and we've had no choice but to police the archipelago ourselves if we want any hope of maritime trade with the south. The most brazen of them even raid the coastal villages themselves for slaves and plunder." [party.has arona |Your orcish companion grunts. "Not like you don't do the same to us." ] The king plants a hand on his hip. [var1 |"At least now we know the demons have been driven out of the islands!" |"And now we hear the demons are out among the islands, too, squatting on the ruins of Dracia." ] He shakes his head. "Those islands attract tragedy and monstrosity like moths to flame. You would think Old Belhar's magisters could have found a better place to host their great academy than Estelore, back in their day. No surprise they were all eaten by demons before they could contribute a thing to the Godswar, with whatever curses those islands hanging over them." "My king," a berobed bull says, "I must insist that there is no curse on the Sailgraves. We have spent two centuries in research, and-" Kelsaz throws up a hand. "A figure of speech, Magister Tarand. Though I think we can all agree that Estelore Island at least is better left alone. What's left of it, anyway." There's a general murmur of agreement from all present — save Calise, who merely snorts. '

rows.original: "Calise and I are putting together what forces we can for the next push against the demons," you tell the nobles. "General Grune wishes to volunteer his men." "Does he?" Kelsaz says, crossing his massive arms. "I see he's tired of darkening my door himself and taken up a champion to further his aims." He snorts, less with derision and more from weariness, and rubs at his face. "I take it you've heard similar requests before?" Kelsaz nods. "Oh, yes, ever since the war began, Grune's been finding new ways to try and browbeat me into letting him kill himself and his men." Calise purses her lips. "That's a little harsh, isn't it?" "It's not!" Kelsaz snaps. "He commands the Siege Corps, not the damned naval troops or city watch. At least those commanders have troops skilled at arms under their command. Grune's men are engineers, sappers, builders; I need them safe, for when this war is over and we mean to rebuild. They're the last members of the legions that should be seeing combat!" "[pc.isDK |They want to fight, damn it, |Respectfully, your majesty, they want to fight, ]" you say. "They're soldiers, and they've been sidelined while their home is under siege." The king growls deep in the back of his throat. "While our lines hold, I will not sacrifice the future of the kingdom for a swifter victory today." "Good king," Calise says gently. "Your kingdom is squeezing painfully into a single overflowing city today. If you don't secure a swift victory, are you sure the kingdom will have a future?" "Khaak. If both champions mean to question me..."
rows.translation: “卡莉丝和我正在集结我们所能抽调的一切力量，准备对恶魔发起下一次进攻，”你对贵族们说道。“格鲁恩将军希望能主动派他的人马参战。” “是吗？”凯尔萨兹抱起粗壮的双臂说道。“我看他是厌倦了亲自来烦我，于是拉上一位冠军来推进他的目的了。”他哼了一声，那声音里更多的是疲惫而非嘲笑，然后揉了揉脸。 “我猜你以前也听过类似的请求吧？” 凯尔萨兹点了点头。“哦，是的。自从战争开始以来，格鲁恩就一直在想各种新办法，想逼我同意让他和他的部下送死。” 卡莉丝抿了抿嘴唇。“这话有点太苛刻了吧？” “才不苛刻！”凯尔萨兹厉声说道。“他指挥的是攻城军团，又不是那些该死的海军部队或城市卫队。至少那些指挥官手底下还有擅长作战的士兵。格鲁恩的人都是工程师、坑道兵和建筑工；我需要他们安然无恙，因为等这场战争结束、我们要重建的时候还用得着他们。他们是最不该上战场的军团成员！” “[pc.isDK |他们想打仗，该死的， |恕我直言，陛下，他们想打仗， ]”你说。“他们是士兵，而如今家园被围，他们却只能被晾在一边。” 国王从喉咙深处发出低吼。“只要我们的防线还在，我就不会为了今天的速胜而牺牲王国的未来。” “好国王，”卡莉丝温和地说道。“如今您的王国正痛苦地挤在一座人满为患的城市里。如果您不能迅速取胜，您确定这个王国还 有 未来吗？” “咳。如果两位冠军都想质疑我……”

rows.original:
"We need his men, your majesty. This isn't a time to be holding back."
        
        "Fine!" the king sighs, running a hand down his muzzle. "Damn you! Fine. I will see the general and his men transferred to Lady Calise's command. Use them sparingly, Champions. We can ill afford to lose so many well-educated patricians' sons. It's not just soldiers I'm giving you, but my city's future. Now, what else do you want of me, hmm?"

rows.original:
You glance behind you, to where Etheryn [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |perpetually clutches timidly to you. After a few moments, you clear your throat and give her a little push forward.
        |is standing. You give her a nod, and she takes a deep steadying breath before stepping up.
    ]
    
    Kelsaz gives her an encouraging smile. "[etheryn.crowned
        |Queen
        |Princess
    ] Etheryn. I understand your coming into your throne was unexpected, and in truly unenviable circumstances. Though it has been more than two centuries since your people and I had meaningful contact, I know well how Njorhaalt and Khor'minos allied together to face down the last horde of demons that threatened our world. If there is anything the Kingdom of Khor'minos can do to aid your people in these dark times, you have but to ask."
    
    "Th-thank you, King Kelsaz. Though I had meant to extend you the same offer. [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |Th-the boer'alvar l-
        |My realm 
    ]lost much due to my sister's folly, but it is yours that suffers the brunt of the demon's attack. And worse, the demons drew their strength from Njorhaalt's weakness."
    
    The king shakes his head. "No one could have predicted, or prevented, the start of this war. If Khor'minos didn't have its tunnels to funnel the demon hordes, we would likely have been hollowed out just as Njorhaalt was. But, together, we will be stronger than we are alone!"
    
    Ryn [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |forces a smile, glancing down at her feet
        |smiles warmly
    ]. "I hope so too. Perhaps over dinner, we could discuss what each kingdom can do best to help the other...?"
    
    "A fine idea, [etheryn.crowned
        |Queen Etheryn
        |princess
    ]."
