rows.original: You give Arona a slap on the back and [arona.isDom |give her a smile. "Why don't you introduce yourself, Arona? |give her a push towards the king. "You should introduce yourself, Arona. ]" "Eh?" she grunts, glancing back at you before craning her neck up at the king — an unusual necessity for a woman of Arona's enormous stature. "Uh. Hey, big man. I'm Arona. Chieftain of the Kervus Tribe. 'Sup?" "Chieftain of the Kervus?" Kelsaz echoes, arching a brow curiously. The military men around him rest hands on the blades at their hips. "I didn't believe my ears when you were announced — thought it was some young bull's idea of a prank. For how many generations have your people raided my kingdom's coast, enslaved its people?" Arona shrugs casually. "About as many as yours have shoved your snouts into our islands, plundered fish and gems from them. And slaves, too. Plenty of [silly |collared greens |orcish slaves ] around your place, huh?" The king's jaw clenches shut, and he snorts loudly through his nose. "Bold words to speak in my palace, barbarian." "They're true, though." Arona crosses her arms. "What, you mad about it? Or are you just grumpy somebody's got the balls to tell you that you ain't some saint for butchering Sailgrave warriors when we come to take what we need from the mainland? It's a fair, good fight. It keeps us all sharp, has done for generations. You all ought to be celebrating it like we do!" "Celebrate such savagery?" the king snorts. If Arona picks up on his incredulity, she doesn't show it. Instead, she grabs a cup of wine from a passing servant and raises it. "Hell yeah! You ask any warrior, and he'll tell you that there's nothing finer in life than a good fight — preferably with a good fuck after!" Arona [arona.fucked |slings an arm around your waist and pulls you in until your face is smooshed into the side of her boob. |slaps the serving girl on the ass and squeezes hard enough to make her squeal. ] "Especially when you know that fight's for your people. For us orcs, it's taking what we can't get ourselves on those barren-ass islands, staving off another day's starvation. For you, it's protecting your homes and all that fertile land — and your fertile cows." Arona laughs and chugs back the mug in one hard draught. Finished, she wipes the back of her hand across her dusky lips, throws the mug over her shoulder, and extends a hand to the king. "So no hard feelings, right?" One of the generals snorts. "Orcs really are insane." "Hold a moment," Kelsaz says, clapping the general's shoulder so hard he staggers forward a step. "Tell me, Chieftain Kervus-" "Arona! Don't get all formal on me, big guy." "Arona," Kelsaz says, glancing down at her outstretched hand. "What would your people do if they had what they needed? If there was no need for them to raid and pillage and enslave?" The amazon's hand falls to her hip, and she scrunches her lips. "I dunno. Get fat and lazy? The Kervus have one thing we're good at. We ain't farmers or builders. We're fighters! What's life without fighting? Sounds boring and pointless." Wow, by Arona's standards she's almost waxing philosophical. "And what if you had good land, coastal land, that could support your needs and would give you more than your share of fights — against other Sailgrave tribes that would be jealous of what's yours, and against the bandit-kings that blight the southern trade routes?" Arona ponders that for a moment. "Sounds alright, I guess. Would still need chattel that actually knew how to farm though." Kelsaz smirks and extends his own meaty paw. "Then you and I should talk at length sometime, Arona. Perhaps things need not be as they've always been, between your folk and mine." "Yeah, you can talk at my length any time," Arona answers proudly, shaking his hand. It's so gods-damned brazen that even the generals can't help but snort-laugh at the audacity of her, and Kelsaz practically howls with mirth. Well that could have gone worse!
rows.translation: 你轻轻拍了拍阿罗娜的背，然后说道[arona.isDom |对她微笑道：“你为什么不介绍一下自己呢，阿罗娜？ |推了她一下，让她走向国王：“你应该自我介绍一下，阿罗娜。 ]嗯？”她哼了一声，回头看了你一眼，然后又仰起脖子看向国王——对于阿罗娜这样身材高大的女性来说，这样的动作确实有些不寻常。“呃，嘿，大块头。我是阿罗娜，凯尔维斯部落的酋长。你好吗？ 克尔瓦斯的族长？”凯尔萨兹好奇地挑了挑眉毛，问道。他周围的士兵们都将手放在腰间的武器上。“当你们宣布这个消息时，我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵——还以为是什么年轻蠢货搞的恶作剧呢。你们的祖先已经侵扰我的王国海岸多少代了？他们奴役了我的子民……” 阿罗娜漫不经心地耸了耸肩：“大概和你们祖先多次闯入我们的岛屿，掠夺我们的鱼和宝石一样多吧。还有奴隶。你们这儿不是也有不少[silly |戴项圈的绿叶菜 |兽人奴隶 ]吗？” 国王的牙关紧闭，通过鼻子大声哼了一声：“在我宫殿里说这种大话，真是大胆。” “不过这些话都是事实。”阿罗娜双臂交叉说道，“怎么，你生气了？还是说，你只是因为有人敢当面指出你并不是什么圣人——当我们从大陆前来夺取我们所需的东西时，你竟然杀害了Sailgrave的战士们，所以才脾气暴躁而已？这是一场公平而正义的战斗。这样的战斗让我们所有人都保持警惕，几代人以来都是如此。你们都应该像我们一样庆祝这件事啊！” “庆祝这种残忍的行为？”国王嗤笑道。 如果阿罗娜注意到了他的怀疑，她并没有表现出来。相反，她从路过的一个仆人手中拿了一杯酒，举了起来。没错！你随便问哪个战士，他都会告诉你，生活中没有什么比一场激烈的战斗更美好的了——当然，如果战斗之后还能来一场美妙的性爱，那就更完美了！”阿罗娜[arona.fucked |他一把搂住你的腰，将你拉向自己，直到你的脸紧紧贴在她的胸脯上。 |拍了拍女服务员的屁股，用力一捏，让她发出了尖叫。 ]尤其是当你知道，那场战斗是为了你们的人民而战的时候。对我们兽人来说，那就是为了在那些荒芜的岛屿上获取我们自己无法得到的东西，为了不让人们再次挨饿。而对于你们来说，那场战斗则是为了保护你们的家园、那些肥沃的土地，以及你们那些能产奶的奶牛。阿罗娜笑了笑，一饮而尽了杯子里的酒。喝完后，她用手背擦了擦自己略带酒色的嘴唇，把杯子甩到肩后，然后伸出手向国王说道：“那么，大家应该没有芥蒂了吧？其中一位将军哼了一声：“兽人果然疯了。” “等一下，”凯尔萨兹说道，他用力拍了拍那位将军的肩膀，以至于对方踉跄着向前迈了一步。“告诉我，克尔维斯首领——” “阿罗娜！别跟我摆这种官腔，大块头。阿罗娜，”凯尔萨兹说道，低头看着她伸出来的手，“如果你的族人遇到这样的情况，他们会怎么做呢？拥有过他们究竟需要什么？如果他们根本不需要进行掠夺、奴役他人，那他们的生活又会是什么样呢？” 亚马逊将手叉在腰上，撇了撇嘴：“我不知道……也许会变得肥胖又懒惰吧？凯尔维斯族有一项我们擅长的事情——战斗！我们既不是农民，也不是建筑者，我们是战士！如果没有战斗，生活还有什么意义呢？听起来既无聊又毫无目标。” 哇，按照阿罗娜的标准来看，她这话简直有点哲学意味了…… “那么，如果不错土地，尤其是能够满足你各种需求的沿海土地。以及这会让你陷入无数争斗之中——既要与那些嫉妒你拥有的一切的赛尔格雷夫部落作战，也要与那些破坏南部贸易路线的强盗国王们抗争。” 阿罗娜沉思了片刻。听起来还不错吧。不过，还是需要一些真正懂得如何进行资源采集的生物才行。” 凯尔萨兹露出微笑，伸出了自己那肉乎乎的爪子。“那么，阿罗娜，我们有必要好好谈一谈。也许，你们族人和我们族人之间的关系，并不一定非得一直保持原来的样子。没错，你随时都可以跟我长篇大论地聊天，”阿罗娜骄傲地回答着，同时与对方握了握手。她的这种厚颜无耻简直令人发指，就连那些将军们也忍不住对她这种大胆的行为嗤之以鼻，而凯尔萨兹更是笑得前仰后合。 嗯，情况本可能更糟的！
rows.raw: ' You give Arona a slap on the back and [arona.isDom |give her a smile. "Why don't you introduce yourself, Arona? |give her a push towards the king. "You should introduce yourself, Arona. ]" "Eh?" she grunts, glancing back at you before craning her neck up at the king — an unusual necessity for a woman of Arona's enormous stature. "Uh. Hey, big man. I'm Arona. Chieftain of the Kervus Tribe. 'Sup?" "Chieftain of the Kervus?" Kelsaz echoes, arching a brow curiously. The military men around him rest hands on the blades at their hips. "I didn't believe my ears when you were announced — thought it was some young bull's idea of a prank. For how many generations have your people raided my kingdom's coast, enslaved its people?" Arona shrugs casually. "About as many as yours have shoved your snouts into our islands, plundered fish and gems from them. And slaves, too. Plenty of [silly |collared greens |orcish slaves ] around your place, huh?" The king's jaw clenches shut, and he snorts loudly through his nose. "Bold words to speak in my palace, barbarian." "They're true, though." Arona crosses her arms. "What, you mad about it? Or are you just grumpy somebody's got the balls to tell you that you ain't some saint for butchering Sailgrave warriors when we come to take what we need from the mainland? It's a fair, good fight. It keeps us all sharp, has done for generations. You all ought to be celebrating it like we do!" "Celebrate such savagery?" the king snorts. If Arona picks up on his incredulity, she doesn't show it. Instead, she grabs a cup of wine from a passing servant and raises it. "Hell yeah! You ask any warrior, and he'll tell you that there's nothing finer in life than a good fight — preferably with a good fuck after!" Arona [arona.fucked |slings an arm around your waist and pulls you in until your face is smooshed into the side of her boob. |slaps the serving girl on the ass and squeezes hard enough to make her squeal. ] "Especially when you know that fight's for your people. For us orcs, it's taking what we can't get ourselves on those barren-ass islands, staving off another day's starvation. For you, it's protecting your homes and all that fertile land — and your fertile cows." Arona laughs and chugs back the mug in one hard draught. Finished, she wipes the back of her hand across her dusky lips, throws the mug over her shoulder, and extends a hand to the king. "So no hard feelings, right?" One of the generals snorts. "Orcs really are insane." "Hold a moment," Kelsaz says, clapping the general's shoulder so hard he staggers forward a step. "Tell me, Chieftain Kervus-" "Arona! Don't get all formal on me, big guy." "Arona," Kelsaz says, glancing down at her outstretched hand. "What would your people do if they had what they needed? If there was no need for them to raid and pillage and enslave?" The amazon's hand falls to her hip, and she scrunches her lips. "I dunno. Get fat and lazy? The Kervus have one thing we're good at. We ain't farmers or builders. We're fighters! What's life without fighting? Sounds boring and pointless." Wow, by Arona's standards she's almost waxing philosophical. "And what if you had good land, coastal land, that could support your needs and would give you more than your share of fights — against other Sailgrave tribes that would be jealous of what's yours, and against the bandit-kings that blight the southern trade routes?" Arona ponders that for a moment. "Sounds alright, I guess. Would still need chattel that actually knew how to farm though." Kelsaz smirks and extends his own meaty paw. "Then you and I should talk at length sometime, Arona. Perhaps things need not be as they've always been, between your folk and mine." "Yeah, you can talk at my length any time," Arona answers proudly, shaking his hand. It's so gods-damned brazen that even the generals can't help but snort-laugh at the audacity of her, and Kelsaz practically howls with mirth. Well that could have gone worse! '

rows.original:
"So, King Kelsaz, is there a queen of Khor'minos?" you ask innocently, [pc.mf
        |sauntering
        |sashaying
    ] a little closer to the city's monarch.
    
    He answers with a good-natured belly laugh. "Ah, no, I don't keep a single consort — though there is a royal harem!"
    
    "One that's been growing of late, I hear," one of the nobles teases. 
    
    The king hardly denies it. "What can I say? The job's become far more stressful these last months. A man's entitled to what comforts he can afford, is he not?"
    
    "So [pc.mf
        |is the harem just women, or is there room for men in there too
        |what does a girl have to do to find herself currying the king's favor
    ]?"
    
    Now he's getting it. Kelsaz coughs and sips his wine, buying a couple of seconds to process your statement in full. "I... prefer to play things by ear, as they say. No two people are exactly alike. And some have... very [pc.mf
        |sharp
        |alluring
    ] advantages over others. But that's hardly a topic for the open floor, mm?"
    
    The king glances at the surrounding noblemen, all of whom are either smirking or covering their mouths entirely.
    
    "Of course. Perhaps over dinner, then?"
    
    Kelsaz makes a valiant, but futile, effort not to smile. "Indeed."
rows.translation:
“那么，凯尔萨兹国王，科尔米诺斯有没有女王呢？”你天真地问道，[pc.mf
        |悠闲地散步
        |摇摆着步伐行走
    ]离这座城市的君主更近一些。
    
    他爽朗地大笑起来：“啊，不，我并没有娶任何妃子——不过确实有一个皇家后宫啊！”
    
    “听说最近那个后宫的人数还在不断增加呢，”其中一位贵族开玩笑地说道。 
    
    国王几乎没有否认：“我还能说什么呢？过去几个月里，我的工作压力确实大了很多。一个人有权享受自己能够负担得起的舒适生活，不是吗？”
    
    “那么[pc.mf
        |后宫里只容纳女性，还是也有男性的一席之地呢
        |一个女孩究竟要怎么做，才能赢得国王的青睐呢
    ]？”
    
    现在他终于明白了。凯尔萨兹轻咳了一声，喝了一口酒，给自己几秒钟的时间来完全理解你的话。“我……更喜欢随机应变，就像人们说的那样。没有两个人是完全一样的。而有些人……确实有着非常[pc.mf
        |敏锐的
        |诱人的
    ]的优势，胜过其他人。不过，这个话题恐怕不太适合在公开场合讨论，嗯？”
    
    国王扫视了一下周围的贵族们，他们要么在偷笑，要么干脆用手捂住了嘴。
    
    “当然可以。或许晚宴的时候再讨论这个话题吧？”
    
    凯尔萨兹努力忍住笑意，但最终还是没能成功。“确实如此。”

rows.original: Go and speak with the First Princess of the kingdom.
rows.translation: 去和这个王国的第一公主谈谈吧。
rows.raw: "Go and speak with the First Princess of the kingdom."

rows.original:
There's a small crowd of young noblemen surrounding the princess, vying for her attention, and you find yourself joining their ranks. There's such a press of towering, furred bodies that you can scarcely see the woman, but you can hear her clear as day. Her voice is soft but warm, carrying over the jostling voices of her courtiers — and you hear your name on her lips clearest of all.
    
    A pair of towering bulls part ways at her command, and you find yourself face to face with the first princess of the kingdom. 
    
    She's well-built for a cowgirl, tall and broad, fertile figure accentuated by a beautiful red gown clinging to her wide hips and large, half-bare bosom. Long gloves reach up light brown, faintly-muscled arms, and a tiara bedecked with diamonds crowns a head of wavy black hair. But above it all, it's her smile that draws your eyes, perfectly encapsulating the softly inviting radiance she exudes.
    
    "I'm so glad to finally meet you, Champion," the princess says, motioning you closer. The courtiers disperse a bit, giving you two space. "You've become the talk of the town so quickly. Thank you for all you've done."
    
    She offers up a gloved hand.
rows.translation:
有一小群年轻的贵族围绕着公主，争相吸引她的注意，你也不自觉地加入了他们的行列。那些高大的、长着毛茸茸身体的贵族们挤得如此紧密，以至于你几乎看不到那位公主，但她的声音却清晰地传入你的耳中。她的声音柔和而温暖，能够在周围侍从们的嘈杂声中清晰地传出来——而当她的嘴唇念出你的名字时，你听到的声音格外清晰。
    
    在她的命令下，两头高大的公牛分开了道路，于是你与这个王国的第一公主面对面地对峙在了那里。 
    
    对于一名女牛仔来说，她的体格相当出众——身材高挑、体态丰满，一件漂亮的红色礼服更突显了她那宽大的臀部与半露的胸部。长长的手套包裹着她那浅棕色的手臂，上面隐约可见肌肉的轮廓；一顶镶嵌着钻石的皇冠戴在她那波浪般的黑发上。但最重要的是，她的笑容真正吸引了你的目光，那笑容完美地诠释了她身上那种温柔而迷人的气质。
    
    “能够终于见到你，冠军，我真是太高兴了。”公主说道，同时示意你靠近一些。周围的朝臣们也稍微散开了一些，为你们俩留下了空间。你这么快就成为了镇上的热门话题，真是多亏了你所做的一切。”
    
    她伸出了戴着手套的手。

rows.original: Kiss the princess's hand, as is tradition.
rows.translation: 按照传统，亲吻公主的手吧。
rows.raw: "Kiss the princess's hand, as is tradition."

rows.original: Don't acknowledge the friendly gesture at all.
rows.translation: 完全不要理会这种友好的举动。
rows.raw: "Don't acknowledge the friendly gesture at all."

rows.original:
You [pc.bg noblescion scholar acolyte courtesan|[pc.mf|bow|curtsey]|give her a smile in return] before taking the princess's hand and brushing your lips across her gloved knuckles. 

    The princess's bovine tail flicks from side to side as you stand, and she rests her chin on her knuckles. "I am Princess Varena Moratia," she says, "but you may just call me Varena, if you please. Let's get to know each other, shall we?"
    
    She gestures away from the now-disappointed courtiers, beckoning you to follow her towards a pair of seats nearby.
rows.translation:
你[pc.bg noblescion scholar acolyte courtesan|[pc.mf|鞠躬|行屈膝礼]|回以微笑]，然后握住公主的手，把嘴唇轻轻拂过她戴着手套的指关节。

    你站起身时，公主那条牛尾巴左右摆动，她将下巴搁在指关节上。“我是瓦蕾娜·莫拉蒂亚公主，”她说道，“不过你愿意的话，直接叫我瓦蕾娜就好。我们彼此认识一下吧，好吗？”
    
    她示意那些此刻显得失望的朝臣们让开，招手让你跟她走向附近的一对座椅。

You keep your hands clasped behind your back, letting the princess's hand hang in the air. The moment only lasts the breadth of a heartbeat before the princess recovers, and takes a step forward. The hand that had been offered comes up and clasps your shoulder, and she gives the bristling crowd a disarming smile. 

    "I am Princess Varena Moratia," she says, "though you may just call me Varena. It's an honor to make your acquaintance, Champion of Frost. No need to be shy, we're all friends here. Speak your mind!"
    
    She gestures away from the now-disappointed courtiers, beckoning you to follow her towards a pair of seats nearby.

    She gestures away from the now-disappointed courtiers, beckoning you to follow her towards a pair of seats nearby.
    '

rows.original: "Tell me about your dad?" Varena chuckles, and nods towards the king. "He's right there, you know. You could just ask him yourself." "True, but I bet his daughter's got [pc.dcb |the real story, not royal bluster. |some fun stories about her dad. |like, the bestest stories about him. ]" "Hah, true enough. I'm afraid you've come to the wrong girl if you want malodorous gossip, though — I'm a bonafide daddy's girl." She gives you a wink. "Daddy — King Kelsaz — is a great man. And even if he wasn't the king, he'd still be a great dad. And on a purely selfish note? That's what matters most. He's the kind of man that never misses a recital or an opening day at the gallery, even if he has to drag his senatorial meeting with him." "Sounds like you're a lucky girl, then." Varena hardly denies it. "Being born a princess is lucky. The first princess? Even luckier. Having an amazing dad isn't luck, though: that's an effort he has to put in, not an accident of birth. He could have just left me and my brother, and all our younger siblings, to nursemaids and tutors, but he doesn't. He makes time, and never for a day in my life have I doubted that he loves me." She smiles fondly. "That's what I'd want anyone to know about my dad." "And what about your mother?" you ask. "Is she still with the king?" "Ah, my mother?" Varena quirks her head, as though the question comes as a surprise. "Of course. My mom, Lunera, was the first, and for many years only, woman in dad's harem. She's a governor's daughter from Khor'hestra, one of the provinces down south in the Undermountain, and she's been spending basically every waking moment since the war started helping refugees from her town. That's why she's not around tonight — though, the king's harem generally doesn't appear in public anyway. It's an old tradition, and while dad's not exactly a [silly |boomer |stickler for the old ways ], we can't exactly afford to alienate the conservative patricians tonight. Not when the city needs unity now more than ever."
rows.translation: “跟我说说你父亲吧？” 瓦蕾娜轻笑一声，朝国王点点头。“他就在那边，你知道的。你大可以亲自去问他。” “没错，但我敢说，他女儿知道[pc.dcb |真正的内情，而不是王室的夸夸其谈。 |不少关于父亲的趣事。 |关于他的、最最精彩的故事。 ]” “哈，确实如此。不过，要是想听什么臭不可闻的八卦，你恐怕找错姑娘了——我是个货真价实的爸爸迷。”她向你眨眨眼。“爸爸——凯尔萨兹国王——是个伟人。即使他不是国王，也仍会是个了不起的父亲。从纯粹自私的角度来说呢？这才是我最在乎的。他从不会错过独奏会或画廊开幕日，哪怕必须把参议院会议一起拖过去也不例外。” “这么说来，你是个幸运的姑娘。” 瓦蕾娜毫不否认。“生而为公主很幸运。成为第一王女？那就更幸运了。但拥有一位了不起的父亲并非出于运气：这是他付出努力的结果，不是出生带来的偶然。他本可以把我、我弟弟以及所有年幼的弟妹都丢给乳母和家庭教师，但他没有。他总会挤出时间；我这一生从未有哪一天怀疑过他爱我。”她深情地笑了笑。“这就是我希望所有人都能了解的父亲。” “那你的母亲呢？”你问道，“她还陪在国王身边吗？” “啊，我母亲？”瓦蕾娜歪了歪头，仿佛这个问题出乎她意料。“当然。我的母亲卢内拉是父亲后宫里第一位女性，也是许多年来唯一的一位。她是霍尔赫斯特拉一位总督的女儿；那里是山腹深域南部的省份之一。战争爆发以来，她基本把醒着的每一刻都用来帮助故乡的难民。因此她今晚不在——不过，国王的后宫通常也不会公开露面。这是项古老传统；父亲虽然算不上什么[silly |老古董 |旧礼教的死忠 ]，可今晚我们实在不能疏远保守派贵族。如今这座城市比任何时候都更需要团结。”

rows.original:
"So, I notice your brother [flags.KM_FEAST_MIDDLE_DOOR|is too tied up to make his appearance|hasn't made his appearance yet]..."
    
    Varena [flags.KM_FEAST_MIDDLE_DOOR|snickers, tail flicking|sighs, though there's a hint of a smirk on her lips]. "Vrannus has never been the kind to show up anywhere on time. Even when we were born, he held the whole proceeding up through the night. I'm told I should thank Lumia that the midwife finally managed to wiggle him out, or I might not have made it. That... sort of set the tenor for the rest of his life!" The princess giggles into the back of a hand. "Perhaps that's unkind. But my brother does love a good bit of drama. There's never a dull day with him around."
    
    "Does that translate well to rulership?"
    
    "Honestly, Vrannus has never shown much interest in civil matters or courtly affairs beyond the parties, but we're both still young, and I think the war's finally getting him to take life a little more seriously. Neither he nor dad are made to be warrior-kings, but Vrannus has started sitting in on strategy meetings, giving advice and analysis — who knew he'd read so many books on war? If you'd asked me a year ago, I'd have said he only filled his head with love poetry!" She shakes her head. "I'm glad he's stepped so admirably up under pressure."
    
    "But he's not a fighter?"
    
    She chokes back a laugh. "Vrannus? Gods, no. I'd make a finer legionary than he would," the princess says, flexing a dusky bicep. She may look soft at a glance, but the girl's got some muscle under there. "But he's smart as a whip, and clever as a fox. If he'd had ambition, he could have made himself the youngest senator in the city's history. But he's helped dad and the generals plot the city's defenses, and he's taken a deep interest in the city's logistics. Managing our food and what's left of our trade has kept him busy — not to mention the countless hours he's spent ensuring the city's water supply continues, despite the waterheads being so far from the city. Now he's even working on research with the priests! I don't know when he even has time to sleep with all the duty he's taken on. So... fighter, no, but a leader? He's getting there."
rows.translation:
“那么，我注意到你弟弟[flags.KM_FEAST_MIDDLE_DOOR|忙得没法露面|还没有露面]……”
    
    瓦蕾娜[flags.KM_FEAST_MIDDLE_DOOR|窃笑起来，尾巴轻轻甩动|叹了口气，嘴角却带着一丝坏笑]。“弗兰努斯从来就不是个会准时到场的人。就连我们出生时，他都把整个过程拖了一整夜。据说我得感谢卢米娅，助产士最后总算把他扭了出来，否则我可能都活不下来。这……差不多为他的余生定下了基调！”公主用手背掩着嘴咯咯笑道。“这么说也许有些刻薄。不过我弟弟确实喜欢制造戏剧效果。有他在，就绝不会有无聊的一天。”
    
    “这对统治国家有帮助吗？”
    
    “坦白说，除了宴会之外，弗兰努斯从没对民政或宫廷事务表现出多少兴趣。不过我们都还年轻，我想这场战争终于让他开始更严肃地看待人生。无论他还是父亲都不是当战士国王的料，可弗兰努斯已经开始列席战略会议，提出建议、分析局势——谁知道他居然读过那么多战争著作？要是一年前问我，我会说他脑子里装的全是情诗！”她摇摇头。“我很高兴看到他在压力下如此出色地挺身而出。”
    
    “但他并不擅长战斗？”
    
    她忍住笑声。“弗兰努斯？诸神在上，当然不。我当军团士兵都比他合格。”公主一边说，一边屈起一条深色的手臂。她乍看之下柔柔弱弱，皮肤下面却确实藏着些肌肉。“但他的头脑敏锐得像鞭子，又狡猾得像狐狸。只要稍有野心，他本可以成为城邦历史上最年轻的参议员。不过，他协助父亲和将军们规划了城市防御，也对城市的后勤产生了浓厚兴趣。管理粮食和仅存的贸易已经让他忙得不可开交——更别提水源离城市那么远，他还花了无数时间确保供水不断。现在他甚至开始和祭司一起研究！承担了这么多职责，我都不知道他哪来的时间睡觉。所以……战士嘛，不是；但领袖呢？他正在成为一个领袖。”

rows.original: "I've not been in the city long," you admit. "Could you catch me up on the political situation?" "Tsk, asking about politics at a party..." Varena rolls her eyes. "Hardly light small talk between new acquaintances, is it?" You [pc.dcb |frown |glance awkwardly aside |huff ]. "Still..." "Alright, alright, since you're new in town. Better you hear it from me than find out the hard way faux pas-ing the wrong senator. So, the short version?" Varena takes a deep breath. "Khor'minos is a kingdom, which means we have one king who has more or less absolute authority. That'd be my dad. He's supported by a senate, elected from the city's patrician families to make laws and manage the kingdom's day to day affairs. Each city in the kingdom, including Khor'minos itself, has a council that manages its day to day, collects taxes, and sees to its prosperity. The councils are almost always made up of women, since we tend to have higher education than the boys, and clearer heads too." She gives you a playful wink. "Not that that stops the councils from being dramatic as all get out. I sit in on the city's council, or at least I used to, and-" "Used to?" "Ah." Varena scrunches her lips up a moment. "Well, there's not much of a city council left. After the war started, my brother and the senate started taking over the city's crisis management directly. The council tried to help as much as it could, of course, but a lot of the girls couldn't take the stress. Now... well, dad's offered most of them a place in his harem. I'm glad they're being looked after, while Vrannus and the senate look after the city in their place." You cant your head. "Is that a normal response, bringing all those women into the royal harem?" The princess answers with an noncommittal shrug. "There's nothing normal about what's going on. Until the war, the harem was small and private. Just my mother and two other patricians' daughters. Now it's ten times the size it was, and made up of the smartest, most driven women in the city. I'm just happy I'm going to have a lot of brilliant little siblings soon." "Do you think the senate's handling things better than the council could have?" "Mm, probably. The council was well educated and had the city running like a marathon champ before the war, but there's a reason we have a senate in the first place: it's made up of strong men, drawn from the most influential families. They can move mountains the council never could — like enforcing the lockdown, or building up the city's defenses like they have." "Strong men, versus the council's women?" Varena chuckles. "Don't read too much into it. It's tradition for city councils to be mostly women, and the senate is mostly a club for patrician men, but it's not exclusive by law. Juno the Storm Witch was part of the senate for several years while she was raising her children, for example, though she's returned to the navy now. It does so happen that the council was all women and the senate all men when the war started, but that's really all down to tradition! And a lot of impassioned speeches by old graybeards on the campaign trail, can't forget that. Yeah, let's end on that note: there's definitely a faction of doddering old bulls that'll get their togas twisted if anything deviates from tradition, or anybody steps out of line, or... you get the idea. The thought of the city owing its ass to a couple of outsiders instead of the legions in this war has them real grumpy. So try and make a good impression on [silly |the boomers |the old men ], okay?"
rows.translation: “我在城里待的时间还不长，”你承认道。“你能给我讲讲现在的政治局势吗？” “啧，在聚会上谈政治……”瓦蕾娜翻了个白眼。“这可算不上新相识之间的轻松闲聊，对吧？” 你[pc.dcb |皱眉 |尴尬地移开视线 |哼了一声 ]。“不过……” “好吧，好吧，既然你刚到城里。与其自己去冒犯不该冒犯的元老、撞得头破血流，不如由我来告诉你。那么，长话短说？”瓦蕾娜深吸一口气。“科尔米诺斯是一个王国，这意味着我们有一位权力几乎是绝对的国王。那就是我父亲。他有一个元老院支持，元老院由城中的贵族家族选举产生，负责制定法律、管理王国的日常事务。王国里的每一座城市，包括科尔米诺斯本身，都有一个议会来管理它的日常事务、收税，并操心它的繁荣。议会几乎总是由女性组成，因为我们的教育程度往往比男性高，头脑也更清醒。” 她俏皮地朝你眨了眨眼。“不过这并不妨碍那些议会闹得鸡飞狗跳。我曾经列席市议会，至少以前是，而且——” “以前是？” “啊。”瓦蕾娜抿了抿嘴唇。“嗯，市议会现在已经剩不下什么了。战争开始后，我哥哥和元老院开始直接接管城市的危机管理。议会当然尽力帮忙，但很多女孩承受不住那种压力。现在……嗯，父亲给她们中的大多数人在他的后宫里安排了位置。我很高兴有人照看她们，而弗兰努斯和元老院则替她们照看这座城市。” 你歪了歪头。“把那么多女人都收进王室后宫，这算正常的做法吗？” 公主不置可否地耸了耸肩。“现在发生的一切都谈不上正常。战争之前，后宫规模很小，也很私密，只有我母亲和另外两位贵族家的女儿。现在它的规模是那时的十倍，聚集了这座城市里最聪明、最有干劲的女性。我只是很高兴，我很快就要有一大堆出色的小弟小妹了。” “你觉得元老院处理事情比议会本可以做到的更好吗？” “嗯，大概吧。战前议会受过良好的教育，把这座城市管理得像个马拉松冠军，但我们设立元老院是有原因的：它由来自最有影响力家族的强势男性组成。他们能做到议会永远做不到的事——比如强制执行封锁，或者像现在这样加固城防。” “强势的男人，对上议会里的女人？” 瓦蕾娜轻笑一声。“别太当真。按照传统，市议会大多是女性，元老院则大多是贵族男性的俱乐部，但法律上并不排他。比如风暴女巫朱诺在抚养孩子的那几年里就曾是元老院的一员，不过她现在已经回到海军了。战争爆发时，议会恰好全是女性、元老院全是男性，但这真的只是传统使然！还有那些老家伙在竞选路上发表的一大堆慷慨激昂的演讲，这也不能忘。对，就用这个收尾吧：确实有一帮老态龙钟的老公牛，只要有任何偏离传统的事，或者有谁越界，或者……你懂的。一想到这座城市能有今天全靠几个外来者，而不是这场战争里的军团，他们就气得连托加袍都拧成一团。所以，尽量给[silly |婴儿潮一代 |那些老人 ]留个好印象，好吗？”

I'm glad they're being looked after, while Vrannus and the senate look after the city in their place." You cant your head. "Is that a normal response, bringing all those women into the royal harem?" The princess answers with an noncommittal shrug. "There's nothing normal about what's going on. Until the war, the harem was small and private. Just my mother and two other patricians' daughters. Now it's ten times the size it was, and made up of the smartest, most driven women in the city. I'm just happy I'm going to have a lot of brilliant little siblings soon." "Do you think the senate's handling things better than the council could have?" "Mm, probably. The council was well educated and had the city running like a marathon champ before the war, but there's a reason we have a senate in the first place: it's made up of strong men, drawn from the most influential families. They can move mountains the council never could — like enforcing the lockdown, or building up the city's defenses like they have." "Strong men, versus the council's women?" Varena chuckles. "Don't read too much into it. It's tradition for city councils to be mostly women, and the senate is mostly a club for patrician men, but it's not exclusive by law. Juno the Storm Witch was part of the senate for several years while she was raising her children, for example, though she's returned to the navy now. It does so happen that the council was all women and the senate all men when the war started, but that's really all down to tradition! And a lot of impassioned speeches by old graybeards on the campaign trail, can't forget that. Yeah, let's end on that note: there's definitely a faction of doddering old bulls that'll get their togas twisted if anything deviates from tradition, or anybody steps out of line, or... you get the idea. The thought of the city owing its ass to a couple of outsiders instead of the legions in this war has them real grumpy. So try and make a good impression on [silly |the boomers |the old men ], okay?" "

rows.translation: 科尔米诺斯的政治体制？

rows.original: "So, what's a princess to do when the city's in crisis?" Varena sighs. "Honestly? A lot of praying to Tira for our troops, a fair bit of fundraising, and a little threatening to join the Legion Auxiliary." You blink. [flags.VIXEN_ARCANE|"You? Join the Auxiliary?"|"Join the what?"] "Well, only minotaur men can fight in the legions! I want to do my part to help, but I'm not exactly of a stature to join the shield wall, am I? The military's Auxiliary Corps contains all the city's war-mages and such, and I've been known to cast a spell or two in my day!" She curls the fingers of her right hand and whispers a few words, causing crackling strands of lightning to corruscate between her digits before she clenches her fist around them. "If my father hadn't forbid it under threat of finding me a tower to be princess of, I'd have liked to be out there with you fighting for the city." She flexes her fingers, blowing a few wisps of smoke from them. "But, Daddy forbids it, and after what Lady Calise has told me of what the fighting's been like... or whatever it is these demons pass for fighting, anyway... I can't exactly blame him." Yeah, you can see the logic in not allowing your daughter to get demonic jizz sprayed on her, sure. "That doesn't mean I've stopped petitioning him every few days. Eventually the tears'll break him down. They always do. Until then, I'll do what I can to help... which is mostly just praying and trying to browbeat more support out of the patricians." "So, what'd you do before all this started?" A faint smile spreads over the princess's lips. "When the kingdom's not threatening to burn down? I do a bit of this and that for the city, help liaise between the city council and the king, studied magic a bit... but mostly? I did that," she says, pointing back towards the intricate murals gracing the palace walls. "If you've ever been to the old Temple of Tira just outside town, I did the murals inside that, too. And between you and me, Champion? I might have done the frescoes in Ember's taphall. Incognito, of course." She gives you a conspiratorial wink. "Don't tell Dad. He'd be mortified I stooped to painting in a tavern, but it was a great opportunity to flex my creative muscles and just... paint heroes and monsters and dragons all of my own invention, or out of raunchy bards' tales." She laughs. "Really, if I wasn't royal, I'd probably be some... weird mage-painter lady living in a tower where no wall's gone uncovered in art. Even now that sounds like a nice retirement."
rows.translation: “那么，城市陷入危机时，公主都要做些什么？” 瓦蕾娜叹了口气。“说实话？经常向蒂拉祈祷，祈求祂庇佑我们的部队；大量筹款；偶尔还要威胁说自己会加入军团辅兵。” 你眨了眨眼。[flags.VIXEN_ARCANE|“你？加入辅兵？”|“加入什么？”] “军团只允许弥诺陶洛斯男性参战！我想尽自己的一份力，但这身材显然进不了盾墙，对吧？军队的辅兵军团汇聚了全城的战斗法师之类，而我偶尔也会施展一两个法术！”她蜷起右手手指，低声念出几个词；噼啪作响的闪电随即在指间跃动，直到她握拳将其攥灭。“如果父亲没有威胁说要给我找座高塔，让我老老实实当里面的公主，我真想和你一起到外面为城市而战。” 她屈伸着手指，吹散指尖冒出的几缕烟。“不过，爸爸禁止我参战；听卡莉丝女士说过外面的战斗是什么模样后……或者说，那些恶魔所谓的‘战斗’是什么模样后……我也不能完全怪他。” 没错，你完全能理解为什么不该让自己的女儿被恶魔精液喷得满身都是。 “但这不代表我不再每隔几天就向他请愿。迟早有一天，我的眼泪会让他心软。每次都管用。在那之前，我会尽力帮忙……虽然大多也只是祈祷，再逼着贵族们拿出更多支持。” “那么，这一切开始前你都在做些什么？” 公主唇边泛起淡淡的微笑。“王国没有眼看就要付之一炬的时候？我会为城市做些杂事，帮城议会和国王联络，学习一点魔法……不过最主要的？我做这个。”她指向装饰宫墙的精美壁画。“如果你去过城外那座古老的蒂拉神殿，里面的壁画也是我画的。说句悄悄话，冠军，我或许还画过余烬酒馆里的湿壁画。当然，我隐瞒了身份。”她同谋般地朝你眨眨眼。“别告诉父亲。我屈尊去酒馆作画，肯定会让他无地自容；但那是个尽情发挥创造力的好机会，我可以画自己想象中的英雄、怪物和巨龙，或者把吟游诗人那些淫秽故事里的东西画出来。” 她笑了起来。“说真的，如果我不是王室成员，大概会变成某个……住在高塔里的古怪法师画家，整座塔没有一面墙不被画作覆盖。即使是现在，这听起来也是很不错的退休生活。”

rows.original:
"So, aside from the demon invasion, how do you reckon the world is doing?"
    
    "Besides the obvious?" Varena chuckles. "Really, if you'd asked me before the war I'd have said this age is a blessed one. There've been good harvests in Hawkethorne, new veins dowsed out in the Undermountain, trade picking up with Jassira and Tronarii. Two hundred years ago and our city was isolated and alone, barely clinging on after the Godswar shattered Old Belhar. A hundred years ago, and the Baroness of Hawkethorne was ruling over an empty barony and we'd only just seen the first explorers venturing from the Valgar tribes and the Heartland trying to reconnect with the wider world. I find the idea rather hopeful, in the face of what we're dealing with now."
    
    You arch a brow. "Oh?"
    
    "Mm. The world not just survived an apocalyptic demon invasion before, but truly recovered from it. There's no great force like Belhar anymore, but Khor'minos has never been grander, and now we've learned the Winter City is alive and well — or was doing well, before these new demons arrived." [party.has etheryn
        |She nods approvingly towards your royal companion. "But I'm sure it'll shine even brighter under new rulership.
        |She sighs. "Though I can only hope new rulership will turn things back around to prosperity for them.
    ] Either way, Khor'minos will do its best to help [etheryn.crowned
        |Queen
        |the future Queen
    ] Etheryn, as we've helped other cities to the south return to prosperity."
    
    "Have you ever been to those cities?"
    
    Varena answers with an enthusiastic nod. "Oh, yes, I've been all over the coast, and some of the old Belharan Heartland — the places that've gotten safe enough for a royal visit, anyway. Dad used to love going to other cities and meeting their leaders — and I gotta admit, even as a little'n I loved watching him tower over just about everyone. Khor'minos is the biggest city in the known world these days, and it's fun to see the biggest king get to make his debut. I swear the vicereine of Thalsport didn't even come up to Daddy's beltline!"
    
    She giggles into the back of a gloved hand. "But yeah, if we discount the demons, I think the world's in a good place. And I think we'll be stronger still when we've defeated these monsters! I for one look forward to a long-lasting alliance with the Winter City, and closer ties with Hawkethorne[pc.isBaron
        | and your own holdings too
    ]! In fact, I think when this is all over I'll do a tour of the Marches and really get to know the land. All my visits outside the kingdom have always been big royal affairs with dad — I'd like to just see the world on my own, now that I've felt what it's like truly being unable to leave home."
rows.translation:
那么，除了恶魔入侵之外，你认为这个世界目前的状况如何？”
    
    “除了那些显而易见的问题之外？”瓦蕾娜轻笑道，“说实话，如果在战争之前你问我这个问题，我会说这个时代是充满希望的。鹰棘镇地区的收成很好，山腹深域也发现了新的矿脉，与贾西拉和特洛纳里的贸易也日益繁荣。两百年前，我们的城市还处于孤立无援的状态，几乎是在“神战”摧毁了古老的贝尔哈尔之后才勉强维持生存。一百年前，鹰棘镇男爵夫人统治着一个荒芜的领地，而那时人们才刚刚看到第一批探险者从瓦尔加部落和心脏地带出发，试图重新与外界建立联系。考虑到我们现在所面临的处境，这个想法确实让人感到充满希望。”
    
    你挑了挑眉毛：“哦？”
    
    “嗯。这个世界不仅曾经成功抵御过恶魔的入侵，而且还真正从那场灾难中恢复了过来。虽然现在再也没有像贝尔哈尔那样的强大力量了，但科尔米诺斯却比以往任何时候都要繁荣昌盛。而且我们现在也知道，冬城依然存在着——至少在这些新的恶魔出现之前，它是繁荣昌盛的。" [party.has etheryn
        |她赞许地点了点头，看向你的王室同伴。“但我相信，在新的统治者领导下，它一定会更加闪耀。
        |她叹了口气：“虽然我只能寄希望于新的统治者能让他们的处境重新恢复繁荣。
    ]无论如何，科尔米诺斯都会尽其所能提供帮助。 [etheryn.crowned
        |女王
        |未来的女王
    ]就像我们帮助南方其他城市重新恢复繁荣一样。”
    
    “你曾经去过那些城市吗？”
    
    瓦蕾娜热情地点了点头：“哦，是的，我走遍了整个海岸线，还去过一些古老的贝拉兰腹地——那些已经安全到足以让王室成员前往访问的地方。爸爸过去总是喜欢去其他城市，与那些城市的领导者会面——我必须承认，即使还是个小孩子，我也喜欢看他站在所有人面前，显得如此高大威严。如今，科尔米诺斯已经是已知世界中最大的城市了，能够看到这位最伟大的国王首次亮相，确实是一件非常有趣的事情。我发誓，塔尔斯波特的副女皇连爸爸的腰带都够不着呢！”
    
    她用手掌捂住嘴，咯咯地笑了起来。“不过，如果我们把那些恶魔忽略不计的话，我觉得这个世界目前处于一个不错的状态。而且我相信，当我们打败这些怪物之后，我们会变得更加强大！就我而言，我非常期待与冬城建立长期稳定的联盟，并加强与鹰棘镇之间的联系。[pc.isBaron
        | 还有你自己的资产也是如此。
    ]事实上，我想等这一切结束后，我会去边境地区旅行，真正了解那些地方的风土人情。以前每次出国旅行，总是和父亲一起作为皇家代表团进行的——现在我终于体会到了那种真正无法离开家乡的感觉，所以我想自己独自去看看这个世界。

"I can see why you're so popular." |I hope you don't mind me saying so, Varena, but you've got an incredible figure." |Wow, you are looking lush princess!" you giggle. ] A huge smile brightens the princess's features, and she immediately flexes. Her biceps tense, showing off surprisingly well-sculpted muscles for such a curvy girl, with arms thicker around than her dad's horns. "It's kind of you to notice," she says, proudly showing off her strength. "I'm the palace's regular gym fiend, but you're the first person who's complimented [silly |the gun show |all the work I put in ] right out of the gate. Wanna feel 'em?"
rows.translation: “[pc.dcb |你的身材真是太迷人了，瓦蕾娜，”你对她说，“我明白为什么你会这么受欢迎了。” |希望你不会介意我这么说，瓦蕾娜，你的身材真的非常迷人。” |哇，你看起来真是丰腴啊，公主！”你咯咯笑着说。 ] 公主脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容，立刻展示起了自己的力量。她的二头肌紧绷起来，对于这样一个身材曲线优美的女孩来说，她的肌肉线条显得格外结实——她的手臂甚至比她父亲的角还要粗壮。“你能注意到这一点，真是太好了，”她自豪地说，“我可是宫廷里经常去健身的人，但你是第一个一上来就夸[silly |这身肌肉 |我所付出的一切努力 ]的人。想感受一下吗？”

rows.original: "I can tell you put a lot of work into them," you say, taking your chance to squeeze a royal bicep. The princess doesn't pull away despite any differences in social standing — if anything, she tenses her arms more, to let you feel the marble-hard strength under this belle of the ball's softness. "You can probably tell, but Daddy used to be really into the gymnasium and the colosseum when he was younger. I guess I inherited the interest — and I won't deny some excellent inheritance. Nobody expects the princess of Khor'minos to be able to mantle walls or do chin-ups with the Chargers, but I swear, I don't know how my brother survives being the heir without the stress outlet. I'd go nuts if I couldn't let loose down in the palace gym." The princess pauses, smirk widening. "[pc.toneRange 75 |Y'know, Champion, as buff as you are I bet you'd enjoy it too. The Royal Chargers use it for training as much as I do. Considering you're the talk of the town, I'm sure I can convince daddy to let you swing by sometime to check it out. |[pc.thicknessRange 70 |Y'know, I bet we could work that muffin top off together if you wanted! The Chargers could turn you into a lean, mean fighting machine[pc.hasBoobs | — and I can show you how to do it without losing any of those curves. Trust me, nothing keeps the balance better than a diet of Khor'minoan milk and sweating your ass off with Drill-Centurion Magnus. | worthy of the legions. Or at least, big enough to impress at a party! ] |You're in pretty good shape, too, you know — I guess you gotta be with all the fighting you do. Maybe you'd like to come by the palace gym some time and work out with me? Considering all you've done for the Marches, I'm sure Daddy'd be okay with it. We could get you so [silly |hench |ripped ] that you could tear the demon queen's head right off! ] ] "Now that's an idea," you say, a little sad that the tomboy princess has gotten so excited that she's stopped flexing. At least she's leaning so far in that your view of her's dominated by the top of her chest. "Then it's settled!" she says with a firm nod. "I'll make sure it happens. Ugh, now I want out of this tight dress more than ever... er, not that I don't love pretty princess clothes! This dress mom got for me is gorgeous, but... gods, I don't think I could run twenty paces in it before I got a face full of marble. And it'd be a fiasco if I tried to lift anything!" Well, it'd certainly be a memorable one.

rows.original:
"Absolutely!" you say, reaching out and grabbing the princess's tremendous rack in both hands and giving her a heft and a squeeze.
        
        There's a gasp from the collected bovine aristocracy around you. Varena herself sucks in a sharp breath, only barely keeping down a squeal of surprise. The front of her dress darkens just a touch; you're hardly surprised Khor'minoan high fashion is a little more absorbent than most. When the surprise wears off, Varena plants her hands on her hips, still flexing those big biceps of hers, though they're mostly hidden behind the sheer girth of her breasts. Despite the public affront, there's a hint of a smile on the corner of her mouth, and her eyes are mirthful. 
        
        "Very funny," she huffs, trying to sound madder than she is. "You're lucky Daddy's not looking. That might be a flogging offense."
        
        You grin at her. "Would you be the one carrying out the sentence?" 
        
        She snickers, and brushes your hands off her chest. You think nothing of the motion, until Varena grips down on your wrist and spins you around and down, bending you double at the waist and squishing your head into her chest under one arm. You're subjected to a vicious noogie before you can squirm out of the headlock, which leaves the both of you laughing. Those muscles aren't just for show, turns out. She's pretty strong! 
        
        "Consider royal justice served," she says, as much to the crowd around you as anything.

当然！”你说道，伸手用双手抓住了公主那傲人的胸脯，轻轻捏了捏。
        
        周围那些肥胖的贵族们都不由得倒抽了一口凉气。就连瓦蕾娜自己也猛地吸了一口气，差点没能压住自己惊讶的叫声。她的连衣裙前部略微变暗了；其实你也并不感到意外——科尔米诺的高档时装确实比大多数普通服装更具吸水性。当这种惊讶感消退后，瓦蕾娜将双手叉腰，那结实的大臂肌肉依然清晰可见，尽管它们大部分都被她那丰满的胸部遮住了。尽管遭到了公众的指责，她的嘴角却带着一丝微笑，眼神中也充满了欢乐。 
        
        真有趣，”她气呼呼地说，试图让自己听起来比实际更生气。“你真幸运，爸爸现在不在旁边，否则你肯定要被揍一顿了。”
        
        你对她笑了笑：“那这个惩罚会由你来执行吗？ 
        
        她轻声笑了起来，同时将你的手从自己的胸前拂开。你本来没把这个动作当回事，直到瓦蕾娜紧紧抓住你的手腕，将你旋转过来，迫使你弯腰屈背，然后用一只手臂将你的头按在自己的胸前。在你设法摆脱那个锁头动作之前，她就已经狠狠地敲了你的后脑勺一下，这让你们俩都笑了起来。原来，那些肌肉可不是用来摆摆样子的——她真的力气很大啊！ 
        
        这就是皇家正义的体现，”她说道，这话既是说给周围的人群听的，也是说给自己听的。

"I have a question or two for you, Champion, if you'll indulge me." You sink back into the divan beside her. "[pc.dcb |What? |Sure, what's on your mind? |Okay! Just don't expect deep answers! ]" "[pc.bgMulti noblescion hunter soldier courtesan scholar barbarian slumrat acolyte arcanist minstrel |You strike me as being blue-blooded too. I can't guess your house, but the way you handle yourself is so very familiar. |You have a ranger's bearing, if I'm not mistaken. You move like a hunter or a tracker. |I understand you were a soldier down south. |I've heard you used to... and pardon me if this is baseless slander, but I've heard that you once were quite popular in a house of pleasure back south? |I understand you're an alumni of one of the great colleges that survived Old Belhar. |You're from one of the nomadic tribes that used to live out west, aren't you? |I recognize your accent. From the Heartland, aren't you — one of the bigger cities? |You were a monastic once, weren't you? An acolyte of the gods? |You strike me as someone trained in the arcane, but not a scholar. "You aren't from the barony, or Njorhaalt, or Khor'minos... but you've made yourself our champion all the same. So I suppose my question is, what in the world's brought you all the way here, fighting an army of demons?"

rows.original: It's The Right Thing To Do

You're barely halfway through your explanation before Varena puts up a hand with a half smile. "Okay, okay. [var0 |I'm not sure I entirely believe you, but it didn't set my hackles rising like |I believe you! More than ] the answer Lady Calise gave me, anyway." "Huh?" Varena curls her fingers, tracing a symbol in the air and murmuring a word that makes your ears ache... or is that the sudden deadening of the sounds all around you? The noises of the party, the words of the other guests, it all sounds like it's miles away. Varena crooks a finger, gesturing for you to sit facing her such that neither of your faces can be seen from elsewhere. "When Lady Calise first came to the city, right after the first demons started attacking... I asked her the same thing. Why a paladin from the southern Valgar tribes, the Champion of Velun, was all the way out here and coming to our defense. The answer she gave, about her god leading her to being in the right place at the right time... ah," Varena shakes her head, glancing away. "I just can't shake the impression that she wasn't being entirely honest with me. Has she let anything slip to you? I can only imagine she's more at ease with a fellow [pc.mf |hero |heroine ] than a princess." "I don't recall Calise going into detail about her own motivations, really — she behaves like a force of nature." "Well, humor me, then," Varena sighs. "Dad and Vrannus have put their faith in her unconditionally, and nobody's going to suggest that Lady Calise hasn't been a buoying force against the tide of demons. Some might say we'd have lost the war already if it wasn't for her. But still... do you trust her, Champion?"

rows.original:
"I trust her," you tell the princess earnestly.
        
        Varena lets out a slow breath. "Then perhaps I'm not as keen a judge of character as I thought I was."
        
        Whether she means you or Calise is left unstated.
        
        "Well, be that as it may, I thank you for your answer, Champion," the princess says, standing. She sweeps a hand to her side, and the sound of conversation comes rushing back to your ears. "And I'm glad to have met you. It's been a pleasure."
rows.translation:
“我相信她，”你诚恳地对公主说道。
        
        瓦蕾娜缓缓吐出一口气。“那么，也许我并不像自己以为的那样擅长判断一个人的品性。”
        
        她指的是你，还是卡莉丝，这一点并没有明说。
        
        “好吧，即便如此，还是感谢你的回答，冠军，”公主说着站起身。她朝身侧一挥手，周围的谈话声又重新涌回你的耳中。“很高兴能遇见你。真是愉快。”

rows.original:
You shake your head. "I don't exactly have proof, but something's definitely off about her."
        
        Varena smiles, though it's a weak, forced thing. "I'm glad I'm not alone in that suspicion. Perhaps, when this party's over, you and I could talk more about it... and perhaps discuss a plan to look more closely into those allies the city has accepted in its desperation."
        
        "Well, be that as it may, I thank you for your answer, Champion," the princess says, standing. She sweeps a hand to her side, and the sound of conversation comes rushing back to your ears. "And I'm glad to have met you. It's been a pleasure."
rows.translation:
你摇了摇头：“我并没有确凿的证据，但她的行为确实有些可疑。”
        
        瓦蕾娜笑了笑，不过那笑容显得很勉强：“很高兴不止我一个人有这种怀疑。也许等这次聚会结束后，我们可以再仔细讨论一下这个问题。或许还可以讨论一下，如何更仔细地调查一下这座城市在绝望之中所接纳的那些盟友。”
        
        “好吧，无论如何，还是感谢你的回答，冠军。”公主说着站了起来。她将手一挥，谈话声立刻又传入了你的耳中。“也很高兴能遇见你，真是非常愉快。”

        "Well, be that as it may, I thank you for your answer, Champion," the princess says, standing. She sweeps a hand to her side, and the sound of conversation comes rushing back to your ears. "And I'm glad to have met you. It's been a pleasure."
        "

rows.original: Something seems off about Calise to you, too.
rows.translation: 你也觉得卡莉丝有些不对劲吧。
rows.raw: "Something seems off about Calise to you, too."

rows.original:
You cross your arms and insist that "In this business, the only safe bet is to trust nobody."
        
        Varena laughs. "[silly
            |Okay, okay, careful you don't cut yourself on all that edge.
            |Wow, what a way to live. Nevermind, forget I asked.
        ]"
        
        She shakes her head and stands. "Well, be that as it may, thank you for your answer — sad as it is." Varena sweeps a hand to her side, and the sound of conversation comes rushing back to your ears. "And I'm glad to have met you, Champion. It's been a unique pleasure."
rows.translation:
你双臂交叉，坚称：“干这一行，唯一稳妥的赌注就是谁都不信。”
        
        瓦蕾娜笑了。“[silly
            |好吧，好吧，小心别被这一身锋芒割伤了自己。
            |哇，这种活法可真行。算了，就当我没问。
        ]”
        
        她摇了摇头，站起身。“好吧，即便如此，还是谢谢你的回答——虽然这答案令人难过。”瓦蕾娜朝身侧一挥手，周围的谈话声立刻又涌回你的耳中。“而且，很高兴能遇见你，冠军。真是难得的愉快。”

rows.original: In your business, and in this war, the best bet is not to trust anybody.
rows.translation: 在你的生意中，以及在这场战争中，最稳妥的做法就是不要信任任何人。
rows.raw: "In your business, and in this war, the best bet is not to trust anybody."

rows.original: You've seen no sign of the Crown Prince out on the main floor. Perhaps he's still in the royal chambers back behind the throne? You could slip away for a moment and check...
rows.translation: 你在大厅里没有看到王储的踪影。也许他还在王座后面的皇家寝室里？你可以悄悄溜过去看看……
rows.raw: "You've seen no sign of the Crown Prince out on the main floor. Perhaps he's still in the royal chambers back behind the throne? You could slip away for a moment and check..."

rows.original: [flags.KM_FEAST_CURTAIN |You turn your attention to the curtain door behind the throne, contemplating your options... |You glance at the drawn curtain over the archway behind the royal throne. The king and princess are both engrossed in conversation with the nobles, and the servants are completely occupied filling their cups. This is your time to slip away and do a little snooping! There is a single guard standing watch over the door, though: a single brawny Charger in full ceremonial armor with a poleaxe in hand and a carefully-curated expression of detached awareness on his face. You'll have to get past him to get into the royal quarters... ]
rows.translation: [flags.KM_FEAST_CURTAIN |你的注意力转向王座后面的那道帘门，思索着自己有哪些选择…… |你瞥了一眼王座后方拱门上拉着的帘子。国王和公主都在全神贯注地与贵族们交谈，而仆人们则完全忙于为众人斟酒。现在正是你悄悄溜走、偷偷打探一番的好时机！ 不过，门口确实只站着一名卫兵：那是一名身强力壮的冲锋者，穿着全套仪典铠甲，手中握着一把长柄战斧，脸上挂着一副精心维持的、事不关己的神情。想要进入王室居所，你必须先过他这一关…… ]
rows.raw: " [flags.KM_FEAST_CURTAIN |You turn your attention to the curtain door behind the throne, contemplating your options... |You glance at the drawn curtain over the archway behind the royal throne. The king and princess are both engrossed in conversation with the nobles, and the servants are completely occupied filling their cups. This is your time to slip away and do a little snooping! There is a single guard standing watch over the door, though: a single brawny Charger in full ceremonial armor with a poleaxe in hand and a carefully-curated expression of detached awareness on his face. You'll have to get past him to get into the royal quarters... ] "

rows.original: You're more than able to just slip past him unnoticed.
rows.translation: 你完全有能力悄悄从他身边经过，而不被他发现。
rows.raw: "You're more than able to just slip past him unnoticed."

rows.original: The man's just standing there, you don't have the skills to slip past unnoticed in these circumstances.
rows.translation: 那个人就站在那里，在这种情况下，你根本没有办法悄无声息地从他身边经过。
rows.raw: "The man's just standing there, you don't have the skills to slip past unnoticed in these circumstances."

rows.original: Ask Brint if he could keep the guard's attention for a moment.
rows.translation: 问问布林特，是否能让守卫暂时分心一会儿。
rows.raw: "Ask Brint if he could keep the guard's attention for a moment."

rows.original: Have the Champion of Velun give this bull some star-shock.
rows.translation: 让维伦的冠军给这头公牛来点星震吧。
rows.raw: "Have the Champion of Velun give this bull some star-shock."

rows.original: Send Cait to do what she does best.
rows.translation: 让凯特去做她最擅长的事情吧。
rows.raw: "Send Cait to do what she does best."

rows.original: Give the trooper a drink that'll rock his world.
rows.translation: 给这位士兵喝一杯能让他的世界为之震撼的酒吧。
rows.raw: "Give the trooper a drink that'll rock his world."

rows.original: "You don't have anything that'd rock this bull's world. Maybe you could find something...?"
rows.translation: “你没有什么东西能够震撼这个家伙的世界。也许你可以找点什么……？”
rows.raw: "\"You don't have anything that'd rock this bull's world. Maybe you could find something...?\""

rows.original: The guard can't keep you out if he's the one taking you back there — and blowing your back out while he's at it! Drain his balls until he's incapable of interrupting your snooping.
rows.translation: 既然是那个卫兵亲自带你进去，他自然拦不住你——而且他还会顺便把你干到腿软！把他的蛋蛋榨干，让他再没力气来打扰你探查。
rows.raw: "The guard can't keep you out if he's the one taking you back there — and blowing your back out while he's at it! Drain his balls until he's incapable of interrupting your snooping."

rows.original: You choose to back off for now, returning to the party.
rows.translation: 你决定暂时退让，回到宴会上。
rows.raw: "\n        You choose to back off for now, returning to the party.\n        "

rows.original: Come back later with a different strategy.
rows.translation: 稍后带着不同的策略再来吧。
rows.raw: "Come back later with a different strategy."

rows.original: You're a long-time adept of the shadows, a consummate rogue, and so slipping into the shadows is second nature to you. The trooper's gaze can only be in one place at a time, and he's huge besides — plenty of blind spots you can exploit to inch closer, and eventually slip through the curtain without anyone being the wiser.
rows.translation: 你长期潜行于阴影之中，是一位登峰造极的游荡者，因此潜入暗处对你来说早已是第二天性。士兵的视线一次只能停留在一处，何况他体型庞大——有大量盲点可供你利用来慢慢靠近，最终神不知鬼不觉地穿过帘幕。
rows.raw: "\n    You're a long-time adept of the shadows, a consummate rogue, and so slipping into the shadows is second nature to you. The trooper's gaze can only be in one place at a time, and he's huge besides — plenty of blind spots you can exploit to inch closer, and eventually slip through the curtain without anyone being the wiser. \n    "

rows.original:
"Hey, Brint, think you could keep that guy busy for me?"
    
    Brint blinks at you. "What do you want me to do, start a fistfight with a [silly
        |cop
        |Charger
    ] in the royal palace?"
    
    "What, no, just... figure something out. Get him looking the other way."
    
    "Khaak," he grumbles, ascending the dais while you slink around towards the other side. When he gets up to the trooper, he's greeted with a friendly nod that actually takes the bull back a moment. "Charan? Is that you under all that armor?"
    
    "Brint! Long time no see," the soldier says, clapping your companion's shoulder. He's a head shorter than Brint but just as broad and burly. The physical impact of their unexpected reunion is audible across the throne. "You're traveling in high company now, I see. Guess you made the right decision not joining the legion."
    
    "Eh, [brint.fucked
        |best decision of my life, what can I say? [pc.name]'s worth every second I've been away from home."
        
        The soldier, Charan, chuckles. "That right? Well, congratulations, ya big stud. The village's gonna be thrilled to hear it."
        |I don't regret a second of it. But you've clearly done well for yourself. From the villages to the palace. I thought you'd be too short to stand in the shield wall."
        
        The trooper snorts. "Hey, I got bigger after you left!"
    ]
    
    Well, the distraction is clearly working. While Charan is engaged in conversation with Brint, you slip behind the trooper and through the curtains.
rows.translation:
嘿，布林特，你能帮我把那家伙弄得忙一点吗？”
    
    布林特眨了眨眼，问道：“你想让我怎么做？去和他打一架吗？ [silly
        |警察
        |冲锋者
    ]在皇宫里吗？”
    
    “什么，不是的，只是……想办法让他别注意到我们吧。”
    
    “哼，”他嘟囔着走上高台，而你则悄悄地溜到另一边。当他走到那个士兵跟前时，对方友好地向他点了点头，这让那个家伙暂时放松了警惕。查兰？原来是你穿着那么多的盔甲啊？”
    
    “布林特！好久不见啊，”那位士兵说着，拍了拍你同伴的肩膀。他虽然比布林特矮一些，但身材同样魁梧结实。他们意外重逢时所产生的那种力量感，甚至在整个王座厅里都能感受到。我看你现在可是和一些了不起的人在一起旅行呢。看来你没有加入那个军团，真是做了个正确的决定。”
    
    “呃， [brint.fucked
        |这是我这辈子做过的最正确的决定，还有什么好说的呢？ [pc.name]这确实值得我离开家所花费的每一秒钟。”
        
        士兵查兰轻笑道：“是吧？那么，恭喜你，真是个了不起的家伙。全村的人听到这个消息肯定都会很高兴的。
        |我一点也不后悔。不过你显然也取得了很大的成功，从那些村庄到皇宫……我原本以为你个子太矮，根本无法站在盾牌墙后面呢。
        
        那名士兵哼了一声：“嘿，你走后我可长高了不少呢！
    ]
    
    嗯，这个分散注意力的方法显然很有效。当查兰正在和布林特交谈时，你悄悄地绕到那个士兵身后，然后穿过窗帘走了进去。

rows.original:
"Calise, think you could distract him for me?"
    
    "Who, the guard?" the paladin asks, arching a brow. "I'm sure I could. Just wait here a moment."
    
    Calise clasps your shoulder and marches up to the trooper. He snaps to a salute the moment it's clear she's heading to him personally. "Hail, Champion. Ay-ah."
    
    "Hello there, Decanus... Charan, isn't it?" Calise grins when he nods his affirmation. "Good to see someone trustworthy protecting the royal family tonight. In fact, you're just the sort of man I'm looking for."
    
    The trooper straightens. "Ma'am?"
    
    "There was someone suspicious poking around near the grand doors. The Chargers guarding it didn't see anything, but I'd like someone I can trust watching my back while I investigate. Come with me."
    
    "Oh, uh, yes ma'am. Lead the way."
    
    Calise waves him on and starts marching towards the front doors. She gives you a wink as she passes, and you quickly take your chance to ascend the royal dais and dip through the curtain while nobody's looking.
rows.translation:
“卡莉丝，你能帮我扰乱一下他的注意力吗？”
    
    “谁？那个卫兵吗？”圣骑士挑了挑眉，问道。“我当然可以。你在这儿稍等片刻。”
    
    卡莉丝按住你的肩膀，大步走向那名士兵。一看她是要亲自过去，那士兵立刻立正敬礼。“致敬，冠军。哎—哈。”
    
    “你好啊，十夫长……应该是查兰吧？”卡莉丝见他点头确认，咧嘴一笑。“很高兴看到今晚有这样可靠的人在保护王室。其实，你正是我要找的那种人。”
    
    那士兵挺直身子。“女士？”
    
    “刚才有个可疑的家伙在宏伟大门附近打探。看守那儿的冲锋者什么都没看见，但我希望在我调查的时候，能有个信得过的人替我盯着背后。跟我来。”
    
    “哦，呃，好的，女士。请带路。”
    
    卡莉丝挥手让他跟上，然后朝前门大步走去。她经过你身边时朝你眨了眨眼，你赶紧抓住机会登上皇家高台，趁没人注意时从帘子后面钻了进去。

rows.original: "Hey, Cait, think you could keep that soldier distracted for a while?" you ask, nodding towards the door guard. Cait's [cait.isLeothran |spotted |pink ] tail swishes. "Say no more, [cait.fucked |babe |boss ]!" The catgirl slinks off towards the lonely soldier, putting an exaggerated sway in her hips and curling her tail up her back just enough to lift her skirt a couple of inches, showing off even more creamy thigh. Even a royal guard's professional detachment falters in the face of all that cleavage quaking up to him, and you catch him shifting his legs together as Cait gets right up in his face and runs a hand up his sculpted breastplate. Her cyan-painted nails tease over bronze abs and all the way up to his collar before he clears his throat and manages to ask her "C-can I help you, ma'am?" Even with all the nearly-naked cowgirls in the palace, Cait knows just how to make herself the most intoxicating thing in the room. A demure smile plays across her lips, and she looks up at the huge soldier with those big blue eyes of hers. "Hi there, hero. I'm Cait, from the Temple of Mallach. My [pc.master], the latest and greatest champion of this city, is doing [pc.hisHer] part to thank the brave soldiers of this city. Do you want to know how much [pc.heShe] appreciates your tireless service?" "Uh, m-ma'am, I'm on-" Cait pushes herself up to him, squishing her [cait.boobs] against his rock-hard breastplate. "I'm more interested in what you're about to be in. Come with me." She hooks one finger through the clasp of the huge, muscular man's crimson cloak and gives him the gentlest of pulls towards the curtain. He makes a dumbfounded noise in the back of his throat and lets himself be dragged. Cait's not even a quarter of his heft, but this bull-man's completely in her sway already. The passion priestess sneaks you a wink, and then the two of them disappear. You quickly take your chance to ascend the royal dais and dip through the curtain while nobody's looking.
rows.translation: “嘿，凯特，你能不能帮忙缠住那个士兵一会儿？”你朝门口的守卫点点头。 凯特[cait.isLeothran |带着斑点的 |粉色的 ]尾巴轻轻摆动。“不用多说，[cait.fucked |宝贝 |老大 ]！” 猫女悄然走向落单的士兵，故意夸张地摇摆臀部，又将尾巴向后卷起，恰好把裙摆掀高几英寸，露出更多乳白色的大腿。面对着那对颤巍巍朝自己逼近的乳沟，就连王家卫兵训练有素的沉着也动摇了。凯特径直凑到他面前，一只手顺着雕塑般的胸甲向上抚摸；你看见士兵不安地并拢双腿。她涂成青色的指甲挑逗般滑过青铜腹甲，一路向上摸到他的衣领；士兵清清嗓子，终于结结巴巴地问道：“我、我能为您效劳吗，女士？” 即使宫殿里到处都是近乎全裸的母牛姑娘，凯特依然知道该如何让自己成为房间里最令人陶醉的存在。矜持的微笑浮现在她唇边，她用那双蓝色大眼睛仰望着魁梧的士兵。“你好啊，英雄。我是马拉克神殿的凯特。我的[pc.master]——这座城市最新、最伟大的冠军——正在尽[pc.hisHer]一份力，向勇敢的士兵们表达谢意。你想知道[pc.heShe]有多感激你不辞辛劳的付出吗？” “呃，女、女士，我正在——” 凯特贴上他的身体，将自己的[cait.boobs]挤在他坚硬的胸甲上。“我更感兴趣的是，你接下来会进入什么地方。跟我来。” 她用一根手指勾住魁梧壮汉深红披风的扣环，朝帘幕方向轻轻一扯。他喉间发出茫然的声音，任凭她把自己拖走。凯特的体重连他四分之一都不到，可这个牛头男人已经完全拜倒在她的魅力下。激情女祭司偷偷朝你眨了眨眼，随后两人的身影一同消失。 你迅速抓住机会登上王室高台，趁无人注意钻进帘幕后面。

rows.original:

You slink to the end of the hall and peer into the furthest of the side rooms. It's a changing room, with a large divan pushed against the far wall and a pair of mirrors set up so whoever's getting ready can see herself from both ends. There's a little table covered in makeup, lip paint, and vials of perfume — beauty products worth a small fortune, not to mention the box of jewelry left open alongside it. You can see strings of pearls, gold earrings, a ruby choker. Gods, what a treasure trove.
    
    No doubt about it, this is the princess's private chambers. 
    
    There's a rack of dresses and togas up on the wall that look about her size, and a pair of stockings and garters are draped over the arm of the divan, along with a pair of cute panties with a little pink bow above the groin. 
    
    Pushed into a corner of the room is an easel and canvas, on which has been dashed half of a portrait of the king. Even unfinished, you can clearly see there's talent behind the brush, capturing the stately bull with a beneficent, fatherly smile that does much to hide weary creases around his eyes and brow. Beside the painting, a six-foot-long wooden staff has been leaned against the wall, bearing a crescent-shaped head painted in the pale argent colors of the moon. The implement of a mage bearing the holy symbol of Tira? The princess clearly practices more than just her artistry, you suppose.

rows.translation: 尽管拿去吧，那些公主的内裤。在整个科尔米诺斯，肯定没有比最年长公主身上的那条更漂亮的内裤了。
rows.raw: "Help yourself to the princess's panties. Surely there's no finer pair in all of Khor'minos than those that grace the cheeks of the eldest princess."

rows.original: Well she should have locked it up if she didn't want it stolen...
rows.translation: 如果她不想让东西被偷的话，就应该把它锁起来才对……
rows.raw: "Well she should have locked it up if she didn't want it stolen..."

rows.original: You gently lift the silky white negligee off the arm of the divan, marveling at how fine and delicate they are. These are truly panties made for a princess, soft as a cloud, adorned with cute little ribbons that just beg any who behold them to caress the nethers below. Almost instinctively, you bring the garment up to your face and take a whiff. They smell almost floral, with just a hint of their last wearer's fragrance still lingering on the airy fabric. There's no way you can just leave such works of art lying around. Surely a woman as wealthy as the princess won't miss them anyway, right? You shake your head to clear the momentary haze that's come over it, and fold away the princess's lingerie.
rows.translation: 你轻轻地将那件丝质洁白的睡裙从长沙发的扶手上拿下来，惊叹于它的精致与柔美——这简直就是为公主量身定做的内裤，柔软如云，还装饰着可爱的小丝带，让人忍不住想要抚摸那些隐藏在里面的部分。几乎是不由自主地，你将这件睡裙举到面前，轻嗅了一下……它们闻起来几乎带着花香，那轻薄布料上还残留着上一位穿着者的一丝余香。 这样的艺术品，怎么可能就这样被随意丢弃呢？像公主这样富有的人，肯定不会忽略它们的，对吧？你摇摇头，驱散了那一瞬间的迷糊，然后将公主的内衣收了起来。
rows.raw: " You gently lift the silky white negligee off the arm of the divan, marveling at how fine and delicate they are. These are truly panties made for a princess, soft as a cloud, adorned with cute little ribbons that just beg any who behold them to caress the nethers below. Almost instinctively, you bring the garment up to your face and take a whiff. They smell almost floral, with just a hint of their last wearer's fragrance still lingering on the airy fabric. There's no way you can just leave such works of art lying around. Surely a woman as wealthy as the princess won't miss them anyway, right? You shake your head to clear the momentary haze that's come over it, and fold away the princess's lingerie. "

rows.original:
It's just sitting there, tempting you. A small fortune, royal jewels, just ripe for the picking. You quietly heft up the royal jewels and stuff them into your pack. Finders keepers and all that, right?
    
    Surely this won't come back to bite you, right?
rows.translation:
它就那么摆在那里，诱惑着你。一笔小小的财富，皇家珠宝，正等人来拿。你悄悄地把那些皇家珠宝收进背包。谁捡到就是谁的，对吧？
    
    这肯定不会反过来咬你一口吧？
rows.raw:
"
    It's just sitting there, tempting you. A small fortune, royal jewels, just ripe for the picking. You quietly heft up the royal jewels and stuff them into your pack. Finders keepers and all that, right?
    
    Surely this won't come back to bite you, right?
    "

rows.original:
It's hard to believe a woman so young could produce such a detailed piece of art. The painting's damnably lifelike, down to the particular splotches of gray in her father's hair and the wrinkles around his eyes. You wonder if she used magic to get the details so accurate[pc.isMage
        |... but when you focus your senses, you don't detect the touch of the arcane on the canvas
    ]. This will certainly be a masterpiece if she ever chooses to finish it.
    
    There's something written at the bottom of the canvas, now that you're looking up close — a few Belharan characters written in the same near-black as half the king's hair still is.
    
    "Time weathers all, but smiles defy the years. I love you, dad."
    
    Aww.
rows.translation:
很难相信这么年轻的一位女性能够创作出如此细致精美的艺术作品。这幅画简直栩栩如生，甚至连她父亲头发中那些细微的灰白色斑点以及他眼角处的皱纹都刻画得一丝不苟。你不禁会想，她是不是用了某种神奇的技巧，才能将这些细节描绘得如此准确呢？[pc.isMage
        |……但当你集中注意力去感知时，却无法察觉到那些神秘力量在画布上产生的影响。
    ]如果她决定完成这个作品，那它肯定会成为一件杰作。
    
    现在你仔细看，画布的下装写着一些字——用那种几乎与国王半截头发颜色相同的深黑色写成的贝拉兰文字。
    
    “时间会侵蚀一切，但笑容能超越岁月。我爱你，爸爸。”
    
    哎呀，真是太感人了。

"
    It's hard to believe a woman so young could produce such a detailed piece of art. The painting's damnably lifelike, down to the particular splotches of gray in her father's hair and the wrinkles around his eyes. You wonder if she used magic to get the details so accurate[pc.isMage
        |... but when you focus your senses, you don't detect the touch of the arcane on the canvas
    ]. This will certainly be a masterpiece if she ever chooses to finish it.
    
    There's something written at the bottom of the canvas, now that you're looking up close — a few Belharan characters written in the same near-black as half the king's hair still is.
    
    "Time weathers all, but smiles defy the years. I love you, dad."
    
    Aww.
    "

rows.original: You slip back out of the dressing room, content in your findings.
rows.translation: 你悄悄地从更衣室里走出来，对自己的发现感到十分满意。
rows.raw: "\n    You slip back out of the dressing room, content in your findings. \n    "

rows.original: Go and speak to the city's beloved bard.
rows.translation: 去和这座城市深受人们喜爱的吟游诗人谈谈吧。
rows.raw: "Go and speak to the city's beloved bard."

rows.original: The bardic beauty [livrea.pregStage 2 |gives you a wave with one hand while the other cradles the baby bump you've given her |waves enthusiastically ] as you come over. [livrea.numKids 1 |Your daughter, [livkid.name], is sat on one knee, and though she's a little too small to really understand what waving's all about, she still waggles her arms and wiggles her tail when she sees you. You scoop your daughter up and rub her nose with your own, getting a stream of giggles and squeals in response. ]Livrea sets her gilded harp down with the utmost care, and then comes in for a quick hug. [flags.RQ2_ALISSA |"Hey, hero!" she smiles, [livrea.fucked |giving you a smooch |bouncing on her heels ]. "You've really earned this feast, haven't you? Defeating a demon queen and all is sure one way to get the king to notice you!" |"Hey, hero," she says, [livrea.fucked |giving you a smooch |bouncing on her heels ]. "I was surprised to get this invitation! I could have sworn I heard from my dad that you're supposed to be up in Njorhaalt for some super special mission. They're not here cuz they're waiting for you there!" Oops. "I'll get to that right after the feast here," you assure her. ] You gesture to the golden harp. "That's a beautiful thing, isn't it?" She grins. "Yeah! The Crown Prince let me borrow this when I got here, said I ought to have an instrument fit for the venue. Mighty nice of him, don't you think? Apparently this harp belonged to the first king from House Moratia, Keldoran, who was something of a warrior-minstrel in his day. Legends say he lulled a whole flock of wyverns to sleep with his songs when they attacked the village of Khor'talosa. It's a huge honor to be trusted with this, even just for a night!" "Have you performed at the palace before?" you ask. "You seem right at home." "Oh, a couple of times!" Livrea says. "[livrea.numKids 1 |Though this'll be [livkid.name]'s first time. I'm so thankful she's being well behaved! But, yeah, not my first time here. ]My mom was a senator for a little while, and I've made a name for myself on my own merits besides. The king and his family have always been generous patrons of the arts, and that includes my craft. I played for the princess's coming-of-age celebration a couple years back, and at a couple of other feasts the king has hosted for foreign dignitaries. Getting to meet the Princess-Consort of Tychris and her daughter was a real treat. [var0 |Though I've heard you've gotten to really meat the Lady Kythie, huh? I am so jealous!" |Lady Kythie is so ripped. Talk about yummy." ] Livrea licks her lips. "Speaking of, have you tried the garlic grilled mushrooms the servants just brought out? Mallach's breath, they're to die for!"
rows.translation: 那如诗如画的美景[livrea.pregStage 2 |她用一只手向你挥手，而另一只手则轻轻托着你为她孕育的胎儿。 |热情地挥手致意 ]当你过来的时候。 [livrea.numKids 1 |你的女儿， [livkid.name]她坐在那里，单膝着地；虽然她还太小，不太明白挥手是什么意思，但每当看到你时，她还是会挥动手臂、摇动尾巴。你把女儿抱起来，用自己的鼻子蹭她的鼻子，于是她就会发出一连串的笑声和尖叫声作为回应。 ]利夫雷娅极其小心地将她那把镀金的竖琴放下来，然后过来给了我一个快速的拥抱。 [flags.RQ2_ALISSA |嘿，英雄！”她微笑着说道， [livrea.fucked |给你一个吻吧 |蹦蹦跳跳地走 ]你确实值得享受这场盛宴，不是吗？击败了一位恶魔女王，这样的成就肯定能让国王注意到你！ |嘿，英雄，”她说。 [livrea.fucked |给你一个吻 |蹦蹦跳跳地走 ]收到这个邀请我真的很惊讶！我当时还以为我爸爸说过，你们应该去Njorhaalt执行一项特别重要的任务呢。他们现在没来这里，是因为他们在那里等着你们呢！” “哦，这个事情等这里的宴会结束后我再告诉你们吧。”你向她保证道。 ]你指向那把金色的竖琴，说道：“真是一件精美的乐器，不是吗？” 她笑了笑：“是啊！我来到这里的时候，王储允许我借用这把竖琴，他说我应该有一件适合这个场合使用的乐器。他真是太好了，你不觉得吗？据说，这把竖琴原本属于莫拉蒂亚家族的第一位国王凯尔多兰。在那个时代，他既是一位战士，也是一位吟游诗人。传说当中，当飞龙群袭击科塔尔osa村庄时，正是他的歌声让那些飞龙们陷入了沉睡。能够得到这样的信任，哪怕只是暂时的，也是我莫大的荣幸！” “你之前在宫殿里表演过吗？”你问道，“你看起来对那里的环境非常熟悉。” “哦，有几次吧！”莉维娅回答道。[livrea.numKids 1 |虽然这样会[livkid.name]这是我第一次来这里。我很庆幸她表现得这么乖！不过，其实这已经不是我第一次来了。 ]我母亲曾经担任过一段时间的参议员，而我也凭借自己的努力取得了成就。国王和他的家族一直都是艺术的慷慨赞助者，我的艺术事业也不例外。几年前，我为公主的成年庆典表演过，还参加过国王为外国贵宾举办的几次宴会。能够见到提克里斯王后和她的女儿，真的是一种荣幸。 [var0 |虽然我听说你最近和凯西小姐相处得相当亲密，是吧？我倒是很感兴趣所以嫉妒啊！ |凯西小姐是所以太棒了，简直美味极了。 ] 莉维娅舔了舔嘴唇，说道：“说起来，你尝过仆人们刚端上来的蒜香烤蘑菇吗？天啊，简直太美味了！

rows.original: A bard always has her ear to the ground. Maybe Livrea's heard something useful at court.
rows.translation: 一位吟游诗人总是能及时获取各种信息。也许莉维娅在宫廷里听到了些什么有用的消息。
rows.raw: "A bard always has her ear to the ground. Maybe Livrea's heard something useful at court."

rows.original: Most of the girls attending the party are pretty scantily clad. Even Livrea's showing more thigh and cleavage than usual. What's the deal?
rows.translation: 参加这次派对的大多数女孩都穿得相当暴露。就连莉维娅也比平时露出了更多的大腿和乳沟。这是怎么回事？
rows.raw: "Most of the girls attending the party are pretty scantily clad. Even Livrea's showing more thigh and cleavage than usual. What's the deal?"

rows.original: What's Livrea's take on the royal family?
rows.translation: 莉维娅对王室有什么看法？
rows.raw: "What's Livrea's take on the royal family?"

rows.original: Livrea mentioned this King Keldoran. What's his story?
rows.translation: 莉维娅提到了这位凯尔多兰国王，他的故事是什么呢？
rows.raw: "Livrea mentioned this King Keldoran. What's his story?"

rows.original: What has Livrea heard about the Champion of Velun herself?
rows.translation: 莉维娅自己又听说过关于维伦冠军的哪些事情呢？
rows.raw: "What has Livrea heard about the Champion of Velun herself?"

rows.original: You're not liable to get any juicy details when Calise is right with you.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝就在你身边时，你不可能打听到什么有趣的细节。
rows.raw: "You're not liable to get any juicy details when Calise is right with you."

rows.translation: 向那位吟游诗人道别吧。

rows.original: "Have you picked up on anything interesting at the palace?" "Oh, loads. Eating up rumors and gossip's half the fun of coming up here!" she giggles. "The other's the free food. And maybe one percent ogling the princess's dresses. You're probably not interested in which senator's banging which's wife, though, or whose son's been caught with someone's daughter. Or son. Honestly most of the rumors I've picked up have been about you and your more salacious exploits. And I've seeded a few heroic ones about you myself, don't you worry!" You shrug. "Anything you think might be useful would be a big help." "Hmm," Livrea sits back and strums her borrowed golden lute. "Alright, I wouldn't share these with just anybody, but [livrea.isLover |you know I'll do anything if it helps you out, my love. |you are the Champion of Frost and all. ]" She drops her voice to barely more than a whisper, forcing you to lean in real close to hear her[livrea.isLover |, which just gives her an excuse to steal a kiss ]. "So, rumor is that the prince has accumulated quite the royal harem of his own, even bigger than the king's own — and Kelsaz has been hollowing out the city council expanding his since the war started!" "King and prince must be pretty damn horny," you muse. "Mmhm, but I talked to a couple of the girls from the prince's. Apparently he's got them in his personal villa, living lavish as you'd expect... but he's never been there himself. Hasn't touched a one of them." [flags.KM_FEAST_MIDDLE_DOOR|"That tracks, yeah."|"Huh."] Liv grins. "I wonder what he's hiding? I know he's a lot smaller than his dad. Maybe a little anxiety about his size?" She laughs. "Or maybe the girls are just for show, and he's got a real paramour hidden away somewhere we don't know about. That'd be my guess. He's barely been seen since the war started, supposedly so busy with work for the city that he couldn't make an appearance. I wouldn't be surprised if he's got somebody supporting him all that while." "[wayfort.hasHaddi||Speaking of somebody who doesn't get any support, apparently General Grune's son already got himself hauled out. Basically as soon as the party started, he hammered back six glasses of wine and then started railing about the way all us girls are dressed and called Senator Gaivran's daughter a whore. Which is deeply unfair; she's the one who lavishes all her boyfriends in gifts for spreading her legs. Really she's the best thing that's ever happened to the poor salamander men of the city. Anyway, the kid's brother bopped him on the noggin and dragged him out before he could completely ruin his daddy's reputation. ]Oh! And one more thing. Right before you got here, the page announced the arrival of Armitia Moongiven, the high priestess of Tira." "And...?" "And I know just about everyone who's anyone in the kingdom, and I don't know her. It's weird, she's a human, too. The old high priestess before the cathedral collapsed was a cowgirl, as were... I think all of the nuns? Maybe she's a mendicant that got trapped down here with the quarantine? Dunno! But I haven't managed to see her yet since she came in." Now that's... strange.
rows.translation: 你在宫殿里有没有发现什么有趣的事情呢？” “哦，当然有了。听那些谣言和八卦，本来就是来这里的主要乐趣之一啊！”她咯咯笑着，“另外，还能免费吃到食物，当然，偶尔看看公主的裙子，也算是一种乐趣吧。不过，你大概对哪位参议员在和谁的妻子偷情，或者谁的儿子被抓到和谁的女儿有染这类事情并不感兴趣吧。说实话，我听到的那些谣言，大多都是关于你以及你那些更加耸人听闻的风流韵事。而且我已经开始四处传播一些关于你的英雄事迹了，你放心吧！” 你耸了耸肩：“只要是你认为可能有用的信息，那就太有帮助了。” “嗯……”莉维娅靠在椅背上，轻轻拨弄着她借来的金色鲁特琴，“好吧，这些消息我也不会随便告诉别人的。有人吗？但是[livrea.isLover |你知道的，只要能帮到你，我什么都愿意做，我的宝贝。 |你是冰霜之王，以及所有与之相关的事物。 ]她压低声音，几乎只发出耳语般的声音，迫使你不得不凑得很近才能听清她在说什么。[livrea.isLover |这简直给了她一个偷吻的借口。 ]据说，那位王子已经组建了自己的庞大后宫，规模甚至比国王的还要大——而自从战争开始以来，凯尔萨兹一直在不断扩充市议会，以此来壮大自己的势力！” “国王和王子肯定都挺欲火中烧的吧……”你心想。 “嗯，确实是这样。但是我和那些公主团里的女孩们聊过。据说他把她们都关在了自己的私人别墅里，让她们过着奢华的生活，正如人们所预料的那样……但他自己却从未去过那里，也没有和其中任何一个女孩发生过关系。 [flags.KM_FEAST_MIDDLE_DOOR|没错，确实如此。|嗯。] 莉芙笑着说：“我倒想知道他到底在隐瞒什么？我知道他比他爸爸矮很多，也许是因为自己的身材而有些焦虑吧？”她继续笑道，“又或者，那些女孩只不过是用来炫耀的，而他其实有个真正的情人藏在某个我们不知道的地方。我猜应该是这样。自从战争开始后，就几乎没人见过他，据说他一直忙于为城市工作，根本没时间露面。如果他这段时间一直有别人在支持他，我一点也不会感到惊讶。[wayfort.hasHaddi||说到有一个人不显然，根本没有人来提供任何帮助——格鲁恩将军的儿子早就被人带走了。基本上，聚会一开始，他就连着喝了六杯葡萄酒，然后就开始抱怨我们这些女孩的穿着方式，还称盖弗兰参议员的女儿是妓女。这实在太不公平了；毕竟正是她那些男朋友们，因为和她发生关系而收到了各种礼物。说真的，对于这座城市里那些可怜的“蝾螈男”们来说，她真的是他们遇到的最幸运的事情了。总之，那个孩子的哥哥及时打了他一下，把他拖了出去，才避免了他彻底毁掉他父亲的声誉。 ]哦！还有一件事。就在你来到这里之前，页面上宣布了蒂拉的大祭司阿米蒂娅·穆恩吉文的到访。” “然后呢？” “我认识这个王国里几乎所有有地位的人，但却不认识她。奇怪的是，她也是人类啊。在大教堂倒塌之前，那位老女祭司其实是个牛仔女郎，还有……我觉得所有的修女都是这样吧？也许她只是个被隔离措施困在这里的乞丐吧？谁知道呢！不过自从她来到这里之后，我还没机会见到她呢。这可真是……奇怪。
