Honestly most of the rumors I've picked up have been about you and your more salacious exploits. And I've seeded a few heroic ones about you myself, don't you worry!" You shrug. "Anything you think might be useful would be a big help." "Hmm," Livrea sits back and strums her borrowed golden lute. "Alright, I wouldn't share these with just anybody, but [livrea.isLover |you know I'll do anything if it helps you out, my love. |you are the Champion of Frost and all. ]" She drops her voice to barely more than a whisper, forcing you to lean in real close to hear her[livrea.isLover |, which just gives her an excuse to steal a kiss ]. "So, rumor is that the prince has accumulated quite the royal harem of his own, even bigger than the king's own — and Kelsaz has been hollowing out the city council expanding his since the war started!" "King and prince must be pretty damn horny," you muse. "Mmhm, but I talked to a couple of the girls from the prince's. Apparently he's got them in his personal villa, living lavish as you'd expect... but he's never been there himself. Hasn't touched a one of them." [flags.KM_FEAST_MIDDLE_DOOR|"That tracks, yeah."|"Huh."] Liv grins. "I wonder what he's hiding? I know he's a lot smaller than his dad. Maybe a little anxiety about his size?" She laughs. "Or maybe the girls are just for show, and he's got a real paramour hidden away somewhere we don't know about. That'd be my guess. He's barely been seen since the war started, supposedly so busy with work for the city that he couldn't make an appearance. I wouldn't be surprised if he's got somebody supporting him all that while." "[wayfort.hasHaddi||Speaking of somebody who doesn't get any support, apparently General Grune's son already got himself hauled out. Basically as soon as the party started, he hammered back six glasses of wine and then started railing about the way all us girls are dressed and called Senator Gaivran's daughter a whore. Which is deeply unfair; she's the one who lavishes all her boyfriends in gifts for spreading her legs. Really she's the best thing that's ever happened to the poor salamander men of the city. Anyway, the kid's brother bopped him on the noggin and dragged him out before he could completely ruin his daddy's reputation. ]Oh! And one more thing. Right before you got here, the page announced the arrival of Armitia Moongiven, the high priestess of Tira." "And...?" "And I know just about everyone who's anyone in the kingdom, and I don't know her. It's weird, she's a human, too. The old high priestess before the cathedral collapsed was a cowgirl, as were... I think all of the nuns? Maybe she's a mendicant that got trapped down here with the quarantine? Dunno! But I haven't managed to see her yet since she came in." Now that's... strange. "

rows.original: "So, do you know what's up with the fashion here?" you ask, gesturing at a passing serving girl wearing nothing but a miniskirt, a pair of bronze plates over her nipples, and a leather collar around her neck. "Oh, yeah, 'less is more' is the big trend here in uptown," Livrea laughs, shifting in her seat to show off even more thigh. "Let me tell you, I'd way rather come to party where half of everyone is in lingerie than the princess's big-eighteen bash where everyone was wearing thirty pounds of fabric. Speaking of, I don't think Varena got the memo — she's still wearing the princess-classic-wear. Not that I'm complaining, it's a feast for the eyes. But you know... it could have been more." You arch a brow. "So you don't have a problem with it?" She shrugs. "It's a trend. We'll all probably be wearing breastplates and tassets in six months. This one's squarely on the prince's shoulder, though — word got out that his personal harem is forbidden to wear anything more than a single short skirt in his estate, and then what do you know, every noble girl's got her boobies out hoping Vrannus will want to squeeze 'em. Of course, the official line is that the king's been sponsoring gyms and stuff and wants everyone to show off their rock-hard bodies — which is true, don't get me wrong — but knowing that the big fashion trend of the day started from the prince wanting to suck titty [livrea.numKids 1 |more desperately than [livkid.name] here ]tickles me." "And nobody thinks this being at the same time as the demon invasion is weird?" Livrea pauses, then scrunches her lips. "I... hmm. I guess, kinda? I heard Prince Vrannus talking about it himself, and he at least said it's a reminder that we can be comfortable and proud of our bodies without falling to demonic temptation. Might've been quoting the Book of Mallach on that one, though." [party.has cait |"The Sayings of Rahman, actually," Cait interjects. "One of Mallach's prophets. 'To be proud and unabashed of your body, unburdened by shame, is to be greater the judgment of others and pure in Mallach's eye.' He had this big nudist colony out in the desert for a while." "Yeah, that's it!" Liv grins. "Maybe the prince is just trying to ease us into all walking around with our boobs and wing-wangs out so he doesn't have to wear anything either." ]
rows.translation: 那么，你知道这里流行的时尚趋势是什么吗？”你问道，同时指向一位只穿着迷你裙、乳头上戴着青铜饰片、脖子上戴着皮制项圈的服务员。 “哦，对了，‘少即是多’才是上城区现在流行的趋势呢。”莉维娅笑着说，同时调整坐姿，以便让更多大腿部位显露出来。我跟你说，我宁愿参加那种有一半人穿着内衣来参加派对的活动，也不愿去参加那种每个人都裹着厚厚布料、穿着像三十磅重衣服一样的公主派对。说起来，我觉得瓦蕾娜好像没收到这个消息——她现在还在穿着那种传统的公主礼服呢。并不是我在抱怨，这确实很赏心悦目。不过你知道……本来可以做得更好的。” 你挑了挑眉毛：“所以你并不反对这个设计？” 她耸了耸肩：“这毕竟是一种潮流。六个月后，我们可能都会开始佩戴胸甲和护腿之类的装备了。不过，这件事确实与那位王子的私生活有关——有消息称，他的私人后宫里禁止的在他的领地上，任何人如果穿着超过一条短裙，就会惹来非议。你知道吗，所有贵族女孩都会故意露出胸部，希望弗兰努斯会想要捏一捏。当然，官方的说法是国王一直在资助各种健身活动，希望大家都能展示自己结实的体魄——这确实是事实，别误会我的意思——但事实上，当时流行的这种时尚潮流，其实都是因为那位王子想要亲吻女孩们的胸部才开始的。 [livrea.numKids 1 |比……更加迫切地[livkid.name]这里 ]这让我觉得挺有意思的。” “而且没人觉得这件事和恶魔入侵同时发生很奇怪吗？” 莉维娅停顿了一下，然后皱了皱嘴唇：“我……嗯，我觉得有点奇怪吧。我听到弗兰努斯王子自己也提到过这件事，他至少说过，这提醒我们可以在不屈服于恶魔诱惑的情况下，为自己的身体感到自豪和自信。不过，他这么说可能是引用了《马拉赫之书》中的内容吧。 [party.has cait |其实是拉赫曼的教诲，”凯特插话道，“他是马拉赫的一位先知。他说：‘以自豪和坦然的态度面对自己的身体，不被羞耻所困扰，这样的人在他人眼中会更加高尚，在马拉赫的眼中也是纯洁的。’他曾在一个沙漠中建立了一个大型裸体主义者社区。” “对，就是这个！”莉芙笑道，“也许那位王子只是想让我们逐渐习惯大家都不穿衣服到处走动，这样他自己也不必再穿任何衣服了。 ]

rows.original: "Have you known the royal family long?" Livrea shrugs. "I wouldn't call it knowing them, not like I do friends and family, but I've had the honor of speaking to the king, his consort-wives, and his children." "So, what's your take on them?" The bard blows her breath out between her lips. "Do you know how hard it is to resist the urge to just strum my lute and sing their praises when you ask? That's usually what I get paid to do. But honestly? Even if it wasn't, I don't really have much bad to say. King Kelsaz is my kind of king: gentle, honest, intellectual, generous. He's spent his entire career bolstering trade and patronizing people like me. When this war is over, I'm hoping he'll commission me to write its history, or make an epic about you and your adventures! Kelsaz has been good for the city, made it wealthy and prestigious again like in the old days before the Godswar. And I have faith he'll pull us right back when this new war's won. Just as long as he leaves the warfighting to his generals — and to you and Lady Calise." Liv sits back and [livrea.numKids 1 |ruffles [livkid.name]'s hair |glances to the royal dais ]. "Now his firstborn, the Crown Prince? He's another story. Vrannus is a real party animal, the kinda guy that goes streaking buck-naked through the colosseum at two in the morning with a bunch of stinking-drunk noble boys. Before the war I was sure he was going to be a wastrel, blowing his life away drinking and cavorting with his friends. He's always been well liked, of course, and he's as generous with his money as his dad, but he never amounted to much. The best I could have said was that he had a voracious appetite for knowledge. But when the demons hit us? He really stepped up. He's the one that organized the evacuation of the outer settlements, and he's the mind behind a lot of the emergency measures that have let us keep so many people bottled up here where it's safe — water and food rationing, supply lines, that kinda thing. He stepped up when everybody else was running around like headless harpies." Livrea laughs. "It's such a huge change from the party boy wandering all over the Marches causing mischief! He's basically the polar opposite of his sister. She's a lifelong sweetheart. My mom used to teach her magic, actually, so I have spent some time with her when I was younger. Varena has a real talent for wizardry, not a prodigy like my mom is, but just a real sharp mind that grasped it easily. I think that, if she wasn't princess, she'd have made for quite the archmage. But the city's better off with her where she is. She's been an advocate for the poor and the displaced throughout the crisis, dragging money out of the patricians' pockets faster than the city's thieves ever could. The Crown Prince has taken care of their basest needs, but it's the princess who's done all she can to make them comfortable despite it all." "So, yeah. That's what I think," Liv smiles. "I'm glad we have the leaders we do."
rows.translation: 你认识王室家族已经很久了吗？” 莉维娅耸了耸肩：“我不敢这么说知道他们啊，虽然我不像对待朋友和家人那样对待他们，但我有幸与国王、王后们以及他的孩子们交谈过。” “那么，你对他们有什么看法呢？” 吟游诗人轻吐一口气，说道：“你知道，当别人这样问我的时候，我有多难克制自己不去弹奏琉特琴、歌颂他们的美德吧？通常情况下，我都会这么做。已支付确实有不足之处。但说实话？即便真有，我也没什么负面的评价可说。凯尔萨兹国王正是我心目中理想的国王：仁慈、诚实、有智慧且慷慨大方。他一生都在致力于促进贸易发展，并资助像我这样的人。等这场战争结束，我希望他能委托我来撰写这场战争的历史，或者创作一部关于你和你的冒险经历的史诗！凯尔萨兹为这座城市带来了许多好处，让它重新恢复了往日神战之前的繁荣与辉煌。我相信，当这场新的战争结束时，他一定会把我们重新带回到正轨上。只要他把作战任务交给他的将领们——还有你和卡莉丝女士。 莉芙靠在椅背上，说道[livrea.numKids 1 |惹恼；惹怒[livkid.name]她的头发 |瞥向王座区域 ]现在来说，他的长子，也就是王储呢？那又是另一回事了。弗兰努斯其实是个非常喜欢热闹的人，那种会在凌晨两点带着一群喝得烂醉如泥的贵族子弟赤条条地在竞技场里横冲直撞的人。在战争之前，我就觉得他肯定会成为一个挥霍无度的人，把一生都浪费在喝酒和跟朋友们寻欢作乐上。当然，他一直都很受大家欢迎，而且他和他父亲一样，也非常慷慨地挥霍金钱，但他从来总计为太过分了。我最多只能说他对知识有着无比强烈的渴望。但当那些恶魔袭击我们时，真正挺身而出的人却是他。正是他组织了外围定居点的疏散工作，也是他策划了许多紧急措施，才让我们能够将这么多人安全地安置在这里——比如实行水和食物配给制度、建立补给渠道等等。当其他人都像无头苍蝇一样四处乱跑时，他却站了出来。” 莉维娅笑了：“和他以前那个在边境地区到处捣乱、惹是生非的派对男孩相比，变化实在太大了！他简直和他姐姐截然相反。她是我一生的挚爱。其实，我妈妈曾经教过她魔法，所以拥有在我年轻的时候，我曾经和她一起度过了不少时光。瓦蕾娜在魔法方面确实有着天赋——虽然不像我妈妈那样是天才，但她的头脑确实非常敏锐，学习魔法时也显得得心应手。我想，如果她不是公主的话，肯定能够成为一名出色的大法师。但对她现在的位置而言，这座城市反而因此受益。在整个危机期间，她一直致力于为穷人和流离失所者发声，从贵族们的口袋里榨取资金的速度，甚至比城里的小偷还要快。王储确实满足了他们的基本需求，但真正为让他们过上舒适的生活而付出最多努力的人，却是这位公主。所以，没错。我就是这么想的，”莉芙微笑着说，“我很高兴我们能有这样的领导者。

rows.original:
"Ah, King Keldoran the Bard!" Livrea grins. "He was my hero growing up. See, after the Godswar, the whole world had burned, and Khor'minos was no exception. It was just a shadow of its former glory, a hollowed-out city under a mountain that had been nearly scoured of life. The kings of the Junia line ruled us back then, and though they led us through the Godswar, they too were hollowed by the experience. The reigning king at the war's end, Martus, confiscated all the land and wealth of those families that had been wiped out or left only with daughters — whom, naturally, he brought into his harem — ostensibly in the name of reconstruction, but it never went anywhere. He died childless, and a pretender, Roal Sacoh, took the throne. He'd been a field commander during the war, and married the king's youngest sister. The soldiers supported his taking over. But Roal ruled with a heavy hand, and squandered the wealth he had inherited from King Martus. Indeed, for more than a hundred years, the city slowly rotted under the House of Sacoh's reign, while they grew fat and rich on the citizens' backs."
    
    [pc.bg minstrel soldier arcanist barbarian scholar slumrat acolyte hunter courtesan
        |"Isn't that just the point of kings?"
        
        Livrea laughs. "Hey, not all kings are that bad. There were even good Sacoh kings before and after the war. But... they were the exception.
        |"I take it they gave nothing back in return."
        
        Livrea shakes her head. "Nothing at all save tyranny. Mind you, there were good Sacoh kings, but they were the exception.
    ] By the time Keldoran Moratia was born, barely anybody lived in the city proper; they'd all fled to live in small villages on the surface. This was, oh, a hundred and twenty years ago now? House Moratia is old patrician blood, but they too had taken to the provinces, and lived humbly on the mountainside. Of course, no hero's story is without it's villain — and it's not House Sacoh, for once in their long career. No, Keldoran's story begins with a warrior from afar arriving in the kingdom: a marefolk ranger hailing from distant Zhenna. She came to beg hospitality from the Moratia estate on her way up the mountain, which, as is tradition, the Keldoran provided to her, and from her heard the reason for her sojourn."
    
    "The ranger's story was one of tragedy, of a Zhennan tribal princess afflicted by a burning curse that ate away at her flesh, a punishment from the Great Witch for surpassing her in beauty. The ranger came to the north in search of the great frost wyverns of our mountains, whose frigid breath she hoped might be distilled into an elixir that would calm the flames writhing within her mistress. Keldoran cautioned her that the wyverns were not to be underestimated despite their dim wits, but the ranger assured him she was peerless in her craft."
    
    "It was a boast the whole kingdom would live to regret. For seven days, the mare ranged up the mountain, scouting nests in search of the most potent wyvern, and for seven nights Keldoran warned her against trifling with the queen of their kind. She refused her host's council, and full of confidence, stalked the mountain's mightiest beast. Nothing less, she claimed, would cure her mistress. With keen arrow and bitter blades, she assailed the Frost Wyvern Queen in the depths of her lair. Alas, Keldoran's wisdom was proved out — though the fight lasted all the night, running across the mountaintops, the ranger was ultimately laid low by the wyvern's frigid breath, turned into naught but a statue of ice to remind all of her hubris. And were that the end of things, it would be a sad tale in its own right... but the ranger had enraged the rime-scaled queen with her attack, and the queen's injuries much aggrieved her. Her howl of fury could be heard throughout the overland, and called to her a horde of her children."
    
    Livrea takes up the golden harp and strums it. "The wyverns descended on House Moratia's lands, breathing great gouts of frost across the mountain stone. Chaos reigned, and much of the village was scoured. By Mallach's own grace, none perished, shielded from the biting cold by their crumbling walls. There were no legions left in those days to respond to such an attack, no great warriors of the kingdom to stand against the wyverns — only Keldoran Moratia and his bardic wiles could protect his besieged people. Struck by this realization, Keldoran took up his harp and rushed out from the safety of his manse to face down the horde — not with blade, but with soothing song. There was no hope of fighting the beasts, so the bard sought to assuage the wrath afflicting the horde, with prayers to the Lord of Song on his lips to grant majesty to his harpistry."
    
    "And, in that moment of desperation, Mallach answered," Livrea chants, now playing the harp in earnest. "The meager wood become radiant gold, and from its strings poured forth such a song at Keldoran's touch as to lull the frost-scaled beasts into a deep, dreaming slumber on the spot. They fell from the very skies, cushioned by the snow, and became so placid in the face of the bard's beautiful playing that nothing would wake them. The villagers, full of wrath at their homes having been laid to ruin, sought to exploit that moment to slay the whole of the pack, Frost Wyvern Queen and all! But Keldoran was wise and commanded them to forestall their blades, for the shedding of cold blood is most displeasing to all the gods. Instead, remembering the words of the fallen mare, the bard bade his people to capture the breath of the slumbering queen. Keldoran vowed to deliver the frigid breath to the cursed princess in distant Zhenna, to finish the headstrong ranger's work."
    
    "Once the wyverns had awoken, free of their fury, and returned to their lairs, Keldoran set forth with his closest band of friends to deliver the captured breath of the Frost Wyvern Queen to the Zhennan princess." Livrea pauses, and smiles. "That journey is an epic in its own right, and I think my own inner bard's gotten away from me as it is. Aha, suffice to say, Keldoran was shocked to find that the tribal princess that he quested to save was a beautiful wyld elf who bore the Mark of the Bovine. He took it as a sign, and once the curse was broken, he married her and brought her and her people back to Khor'minos... where he was equally shocked to find that words of his deeds, his wisdom, and his kindness had spread throughout not just his own land but the kingdom as a whole. It wasn't long before the elderly and ineffectual Sacoh king was replaced, and the House of Moratia took power."
    
    Livrea glances towards the princess. "Of course, as Varena often pouts: Keldoran the Bard's legend will always be about the wyverns, not rebuilding the kingdom and empowering the citizens. Fifty years of wise and prosperous rule is much less exciting than overcoming the Frost Wyvern Queen with a magic harp."

啊，吟游诗人凯尔多兰国王！”莉维娅笑着说，“他是我成长过程中的英雄。你知道，在神战之后，整个世界都陷入了毁灭，科尔米诺斯也不例外。那座城市早已不复往日的辉煌，只是一座被山丘掩埋、几乎失去了所有生命的空壳罢了。那时，朱尼亚家族的国王们统治着我们。虽然他们带领我们度过了那场神战，但这场战争也让他们深受创伤。战争结束时在位的国王马图斯没收了那些家族所有的土地和财富——那些家族要么被消灭，要么只剩下女儿们；而这些女儿们，自然都被他纳入了自己的后宫。他表面上是以重建国家的名义这么做的，但实际上这一切都毫无结果。他去世时没有留下子女，因此一位冒名顶替者——罗阿尔·萨科赫登上了王位。他在战争期间担任过野战指挥官，还娶了国王最小的妹妹。士兵们支持他接管政权。然而，罗阿尔统治得极为专制，还将从马图斯国王那里继承来的财富挥霍一空。事实上，在萨科家族的统治下，这座城市在长达一百多年的时间里逐渐走向衰败，而他们却依靠人民的辛勤劳动变得日益富有。
    
    [pc.bg minstrel soldier arcanist barbarian scholar slumrat acolyte hunter courtesan
        |这不正是君王的本质所在吗？”
        
        莉维娅笑了起来：“嘿，并不是所有的君王都那么糟糕。在战争之前和之后，都有一些善良的萨科国王。但是……他们只是例外罢了。
        |看来他们什么回报都没有给予。”
        
        莉维娅摇了摇头：“除了暴政，什么都没有。当然，也有一些优秀的萨科国王，但他们只是例外罢了。
    ]当凯尔多兰·莫拉蒂亚出生的时候，这座城市里几乎已经没有人居住了——所有人都逃到了地表上的小村庄里生活。那应该是……一百二十年前的事了吧？莫拉蒂亚家族虽然出身于古老的贵族世家，但他们也搬到了乡下，在山间过着简朴的生活。当然，没有哪个英雄的故事是缺少反派的——而在萨科家族漫长的历史中，这一次他们的反派并非萨科家族本身。不，凯尔多兰的故事是从一位远道而来的战士开始的：这位来自遥远赞娜的马人游荡者，就这样踏入了这个王国。在上山的途中，她来到莫拉蒂亚庄园寻求庇护。按照传统，凯尔多兰家族满足了她的请求，并且她还从他们那里了解到了她此行的原因。
    
    这位游荡者的故事充满悲剧色彩——一位贞南部落的公主被一道灼热的诅咒所折磨，那诅咒正在侵蚀她的肉体，这是那位大女巫对她美貌超越自己的惩罚。这位游荡者来到北方，目的是寻找我们山脉中那些巨大的霜冻巨龙，她希望能够从这些巨龙冰冷的吐息中提炼出一种灵药，从而缓解她主人的痛苦。凯尔多兰提醒她，尽管那些翼龙智力不高，但绝不能小看它们；不过，那位游荡者向他表示，她在自己的领域里是无与伦比的。
    
    这是一个整个王国都会后悔的豪言。整整七天，那匹母马在山上四处搜寻，寻找最强大的翼龙；而整整七个夜晚，凯尔多兰都在警告她，不要招惹它们族群中的女王。她拒绝了主人的劝告，满怀信心地前往那座山上最强大的野兽所在之处。她坚信，唯有这样的方法才能治愈她的主人。她用精准的箭矢和锋利的武器，在冰霜巨龙的巢穴深处向它发起了攻击。唉，凯尔多兰的智慧得到了验证——尽管这场战斗持续了整夜，跨越了一座又一座山峰，但最终，这位游荡者还是被那条翼龙的冰冷气息所击败，化作了一座冰雕，以此警示所有人，傲慢终将带来毁灭。如果事情就此结束，那本身就已经是一个令人悲伤的故事了……但是，那位游荡者她的攻击激怒了那位身披霜鳞的女王，而女王所受的伤势更是令她怒火中烧。她的愤怒咆哮在整个大陆上回荡，于是，一大群她的子民应声而来。"
    
    莉维娅拿起那把金色的竖琴，轻轻拨弄起来。“那些翼龙降临在莫拉蒂亚家族的领地上，它们呼出的寒气在山石上留下了厚厚的霜层。混乱随之而来，许多村庄都遭到了破坏。但多亏了马拉赫的恩典，没有人因此丧生——那些摇摇欲坠的墙壁为人们挡住了刺骨的寒风。在那个时候，已经没有军队能够应对这样的攻击，也没有王国的勇士能够对抗那些翼龙——只有凯尔多兰·莫拉蒂亚和他的吟游技巧，才能保护那些被围困的百姓。意识到这一点的凯尔多兰拿起了竖琴，冲出了安全的宅邸，去面对那支庞大的敌军——他使用的不是刀剑，而是抚慰人心的歌声。与那些野兽战斗已毫无希望，因此这位吟游诗人试图通过向歌之主祈祷，祈求他赐予自己更多的音乐才华，以此来平息那群野兽的怒火。
    
    就在那绝望的时刻，马拉克做出了回应，”莉维娅激动地唱道，此时她已经全神贯注地弹奏起竖琴。“那些原本普通的木头在凯尔多兰的触碰下变成了璀璨的金色，从琴弦中流淌出来的旋律如此动听，以至于那些覆盖着霜冻的野兽们当场就陷入了沉沉的梦乡。它们从天而降，落在雪地上，被雪层缓冲着。在吟游诗人美妙的演奏声中，它们变得如此宁静，以至于没有任何东西能够将它们唤醒。那些家园被毁、满腔怒火的村民，趁这个机会想要消灭整个兽群——包括冰霜巨龙女王在内的所有成员！但凯尔多兰很明智，他命令众人暂缓动武，因为流血杀戮会令所有神明极为不悦。相反，这位吟游诗人想起了那位已故女子的遗言，于是他号召自己的族人去捕捉那位沉睡女王的气息。凯尔多兰发誓要将那冰冷的寒气送到遥远的珍娜王国，送到那个被诅咒的公主身边，完成那个固执的游荡者的使命。
    
    当那些翼龙摆脱了狂怒，回到了它们的巢穴之后，凯尔多兰带着他最亲密的朋友们，前往将捕获的霜冻翼龙女王的气息送给珍南公主。”莉维娅停顿了一下，然后微笑了起来。那段旅程本身就堪称一部史诗，而我想，我内心那个吟游诗人也已经离我而去了吧。啊，总之，凯尔多兰当时震惊极了——他千方百计想要拯救的那位部落公主，竟然是一位拥有‘牛之印记’的美丽野精灵。他将这视为一个征兆。一旦那个诅咒被解除，他就娶了她，并将她以及她的族人带回了科尔米诺斯……然而，当他发现自己的事迹、智慧与善良不仅在自己的领地上传开了，而且在整个王国都广为人知时，他同样感到震惊。不久之后，那位年迈无能的萨科国王就被废黜了，莫拉蒂亚家族掌握了政权。
    
    莉维娅瞥了公主一眼，说道：“当然，正如瓦蕾娜经常说的那样：凯尔多兰吟游诗人的传奇故事，永远都与那些翼龙有关，而与重建王国、增强公民的力量无关。五十年的明智与繁荣统治，远没有用一把魔法竖琴战胜霜冻翼龙女王那么令人兴奋。
rows.raw:
"
    "Ah, King Keldoran the Bard!" Livrea grins. "He was my hero growing up. See, after the Godswar, the whole world had burned, and Khor'minos was no exception. It was just a shadow of its former glory, a hollowed-out city under a mountain that had been nearly scoured of life. The kings of the Junia line ruled us back then, and though they led us through the Godswar, they too were hollowed by the experience. The reigning king at the war's end, Martus, confiscated all the land and wealth of those families that had been wiped out or left only with daughters — whom, naturally, he brought into his harem — ostensibly in the name of reconstruction, but it never went anywhere. He died childless, and a pretender, Roal Sacoh, took the throne. He'd been a field commander during the war, and married the king's youngest sister. The soldiers supported his taking over. But Roal ruled with a heavy hand, and squandered the wealth he had inherited from King Martus. Indeed, for more than a hundred years, the city slowly rotted under the House of Sacoh's reign, while they grew fat and rich on the citizens' backs."
    
    [pc.bg minstrel soldier arcanist barbarian scholar slumrat acolyte hunter courtesan
        |"Isn't that just the point of kings?"
        
        Livrea laughs. "Hey, not all kings are that bad. There were even good Sacoh kings before and after the war. But... they were the exception.
        |"I take it they gave nothing back in return."
        
        Livrea shakes her head. "Nothing at all save tyranny. Mind you, there were good Sacoh kings, but they were the exception.
    ] By the time Keldoran Moratia was born, barely anybody lived in the city proper; they'd all fled to live in small villages on the surface. This was, oh, a hundred and twenty years ago now? House Moratia is old patrician blood, but they too had taken to the provinces, and lived humbly on the mountainside. Of course, no hero's story is without it's villain — and it's not House Sacoh, for once in their long career. No, Keldoran's story begins with a warrior from afar arriving in the kingdom: a marefolk ranger hailing from distant Zhenna. She came to beg hospitality from the Moratia estate on her way up the mountain, which, as is tradition, the Keldoran provided to her, and from her heard the reason for her sojourn."
    
    "The ranger's story was one of tragedy, of a Zhennan tribal princess afflicted by a burning curse that ate away at her flesh, a punishment from the Great Witch for surpassing her in beauty. The ranger came to the north in search of the great frost wyverns of our mountains, whose frigid breath she hoped might be distilled into an elixir that would calm the flames writhing within her mistress. Keldoran cautioned her that the wyverns were not to be underestimated despite their dim wits, but the ranger assured him she was peerless in her craft."
    
    "It was a boast the whole kingdom would live to regret. For seven days, the mare ranged up the mountain, scouting nests in search of the most potent wyvern, and for seven nights Keldoran warned her against trifling with the queen of their kind. She refused her host's council, and full of confidence, stalked the mountain's mightiest beast. Nothing less, she claimed, would cure her mistress. With keen arrow and bitter blades, she assailed the Frost Wyvern Queen in the depths of her lair. Alas, Keldoran's wisdom was proved out — though the fight lasted all the night, running across the mountaintops, the ranger was ultimately laid low by the wyvern's frigid breath, turned into naught but a statue of ice to remind all of her hubris. And were that the end of things, it would be a sad tale in its own right... but the ranger had enraged the rime-scaled queen with her attack, and the queen's injuries much aggrieved her. Her howl of fury could be heard throughout the overland, and called to her a horde of her children."
    
    Livrea takes up the golden harp and strums it. "The wyverns descended on House Moratia's lands, breathing great gouts of frost across the mountain stone. Chaos reigned, and much of the village was scoured. By Mallach's own grace, none perished, shielded from the biting cold by their crumbling walls. There were no legions left in those days to respond to such an attack, no great warriors of the kingdom to stand against the wyverns — only Keldoran Moratia and his bardic wiles could protect his besieged people. Struck by this realization, Keldoran took up his harp and rushed out from the safety of his manse to face down the horde — not with blade, but with soothing song. There was no hope of fighting the beasts, so the bard sought to assuage the wrath afflicting the horde, with prayers to the Lord of Song on his lips to grant majesty to his harpistry."
    
    "And, in that moment of desperation, Mallach answered," Livrea chants, now playing the harp in earnest. "The meager wood become radiant gold, and from its strings poured forth such a song at Keldoran's touch as to lull the frost-scaled beasts into a deep, dreaming slumber on the spot. They fell from the very skies, cushioned by the snow, and became so placid in the face of the bard's beautiful playing that nothing would wake them. The villagers, full of wrath at their homes having been laid to ruin, sought to exploit that moment to slay the whole of the pack, Frost Wyvern Queen and all! But Keldoran was wise and commanded them to forestall their blades, for the shedding of cold blood is most displeasing to all the gods. Instead, remembering the words of the fallen mare, the bard bade his people to capture the breath of the slumbering queen. Keldoran vowed to deliver the frigid breath to the cursed princess in distant Zhenna, to finish the headstrong ranger's work."
    
    "Once the wyverns had awoken, free of their fury, and returned to their lairs, Keldoran set forth with his closest band of friends to deliver the captured breath of the Frost Wyvern Queen to the Zhennan princess." Livrea pauses, and smiles. "That journey is an epic in its own right, and I think my own inner bard's gotten away from me as it is. Aha, suffice to say, Keldoran was shocked to find that the tribal princess that he quested to save was a beautiful wyld elf who bore the Mark of the Bovine. He took it as a sign, and once the curse was broken, he married her and brought her and her people back to Khor'minos... where he was equally shocked to find that words of his deeds, his wisdom, and his kindness had spread throughout not just his own land but the kingdom as a whole. It wasn't long before the elderly and ineffectual Sacoh king was replaced, and the House of Moratia took power."
    
    Livrea glances towards the princess. "Of course, as Varena often pouts: Keldoran the Bard's legend will always be about the wyverns, not rebuilding the kingdom and empowering the citizens. Fifty years of wise and prosperous rule is much less exciting than overcoming the Frost Wyvern Queen with a magic harp."
    "

rows.original: You glance towards where Calise is standing beside the king. "So, have you heard anything about her? From before the war, I mean." Livrea whistles under her breath. "She's not what I expected, that's for sure! I've never been so far south as the Valgar tribelands, Calise's homeland, but I've met some other bards from down there and heard their stories. Most of the tribes keep the druidic faiths even today, and they're all clustered around the great Zhenna Mountain, biggest in the known world and bathed in deep forests. Those forests are rife with wyld trees, which are sacred to both the green faith and to Velun. Legend goes, Calise got her start avenging the murder of one such tree by a tribe of heretics that had abandoned their faith. She hewed through them without mercy, until she'd butchered so many that their bodies weighed as much as the great wyld tree they'd destroyed!" "[var0 |I have seen that Calise has quite the temper, but that seems extreme even for her. |That sounds... extreme. ]" "Mmhm. The legends I've heard also paint her as a mountain of a woman with some marefolk blood in her! The kind of huge lady that'd suplex a stallion! I'm glad the Valgar bards were just exaggerating what a beast their new Champion was. Of course, big deeds and bigger boasts are important to the Valgarmen." [party.has atugia |"I guess some things never change," Atugia chuckles." Livrea glances at your redheaded companion. "Oh, are you from the tribes?" Tui nods. "From the coast, near Bel Carn. You've probably never heard of Tieglache!" "I have. It's a shame what happened to that place. I didn't realize anyone still lived there," Liv says, turning her attention back to you. ]"The Valgar lands are a peninsula, with Bel Carn at the south near the sea and Zhenna Mountain at the north. Most of the human tribes are around Bel Carn, the only real city down there — the rest of the folk are marefolk and wyld elves in the forests. From what I understand, Calise's from down around there and walked all the way up the east coast, protecting nature from folks' encroachment and folk from the twisted beasts of nature."
rows.translation: 你瞥向站在国王身边的卡莉丝。“那么，你听说过她的什么事吗？我是说，战争之前的事。” 莉维娅轻声吹了个口哨。“她绝对和我想象得不一样！我从没去过那么南边的瓦尔加尔部族领地，也就是卡莉丝的故乡；不过我遇见过一些来自那里的吟游诗人，也听过他们的故事。直到今天，大多数部族仍然信奉德鲁伊教义，全都聚居在雄伟的詹娜山周围。那是已知世界中最高大的山峰，覆满幽深的森林。森林里遍布野性之树，在苍翠信仰和维伦教义中都被奉为神圣。传说卡莉丝最初正是为了替其中一棵树报仇：一个背弃信仰的异端部族谋杀了它。她毫不留情地一路砍杀，最终屠戮的人如此之多，尸体的总重量甚至赶上了他们毁掉的那棵雄伟野性之树！” “[var0 |我确实见识过卡莉丝火爆的脾气，但即使对她来说，这也太极端了。 |听起来……也太极端了。 ]” “嗯哼。我听过的传说还把她描绘成一个山岳般魁梧、体内流着马人血脉的女人！就是那种能把公马抱起来过肩摔的巨型女人！还好，瓦尔加尔吟游诗人只是在夸张他们的新冠军有多么野蛮。当然，伟大的功业和更加夸张的吹嘘，对瓦尔加尔人都很重要。” [party.has atugia |“看来有些事情永远不会改变。”阿图吉娅轻笑道。 莉维娅看向你的红发同伴。“哦，你也来自那些部族吗？” 阿图点点头。“我来自贝尔卡恩附近的海岸。你大概从没听过提格拉克！” “我听过。那里发生的事真令人遗憾。我没想到如今还有人住在那里。”莉维娅说道，随后重新看向你。 ]“瓦尔加尔领地是一座半岛，南面临海之处是贝尔卡恩，北面则是詹娜山。大多数人类部族聚居在贝尔卡恩周围，那是南方唯一称得上城市的地方——其余居民都是森林里的马人和野精灵。据我所知，卡莉丝来自那一带。她沿着东海岸一路向北，既保护自然免受人类侵占，也保护人类免遭自然孕育出的扭曲野兽袭击。”

rows.original: A large table has been set up beside the fire pit, overseen by a muscular gray orc with a collar around his neck and an apron draped over his shoulders. He's got bowls of fruit, herb-grilled mushrooms, and a dizzying array of cheeses laid out in front of him, not to mention no shortage of different wine bottles displayed on carts beside him.
rows.translation: 在篝火旁摆放着一张巨大的桌子，负责监管这一区域的是一位肌肉结实的灰色兽人——他的脖子上戴着项圈，肩上披着围裙。在他面前，摆放着各种水果碗、用香草烤制的蘑菇，以及令人眼花缭乱的奶酪；而在他身旁的推车上，也陈列着各式各样的葡萄酒瓶。

rows.original: Check in with the food and drink.
rows.translation: 去看看食物和饮料的情况吧。
rows.raw: "Check in with the food and drink."

rows.original:
You saunter up to the food table, drinking in the symphony of scents rising from all that grilling meat and the lush herbs that bathe just about everything — even some of the cheeses — laid out before you. The large-framed gray orc standing behind the table gives you a hint of a nod, resting the tips of his calloused fingers out on the table's edge. "Champion. What can I get you?"
    
    [var0
        |His eyes cut to Arona just as she's throwing an arm around your shoulder and shoving herself into the fore. "Hey! I recognize that mastbreaker brow! You're from the Vrundar tribe, ain'tcha?"
        
        The gray orc grunts. "Yeah, that's right. Kervus, huh? Who'd you plow to get invited here?"
        
        Arona sneers. "You know the bull that likes grabbing the back of that collar when he fucks you? Yeah, his wife." She grabs her package through her [arona.armor]. 
        
        The two orcs glower at each other, and then erupt in laughter. Several nearby cowgirls recoil in disgust, abandoning their snacks to get away from them as quick as possible. 
        
        "What'd you do to get collared?" Arona asks him, giving the man's shoulder a rough clap. "Didn't think the Vrundar fucked around with the minos anymore."
        
        The big man shrugs. "They haven't for, oh, fifteen years now? Doesn't help when my granny took me raiding when I was sixteen, and the chief got us all caught."
        
        "Damn. That's a long stint. Fuckin' cows even teach you how to cook, huh?" Arona says, grabbing a strip of red spiced beef and shoving it into her mouth. "Hey, that's pretty good!"
        
        "My mistress says I have a talent," he shrugs. "Gotta make myself useful somehow, and this sure as hell beats working in the shipyards."
        
        Arona nods. "I hear that. [silly
            |Well, sucks to suck, load up a plate already.
            |Speakin' of which," she says, grabbing a plate. "Load 'er up with meat big guy.
        ]"
    ]
rows.translation:
你慢悠悠地走到食物台前，尽情吸入那一曲香气交响乐——来自所有那些烤着的肉，还有几乎浸润了每样东西（连一些奶酪也是）的鲜香草，全都摆在你面前。站在台子后面、身架高大的灰色兽人朝你微微点头示意，把长满老茧的指尖搭在桌沿上。“冠军，您要点什么？”
    
    [var0
        |他的目光转向阿罗娜，而她正把一条胳膊搭上你的肩膀，挤到前面来。“嘿！我认出那道断桅锤的眉纹了！你是冯达族的，对吧？”
        
        那个灰色兽人哼了一声。“对，没错。凯尔维斯，是吧？你睡了谁才被请到这儿来的？”
        
        阿罗娜嗤笑一声。“你认识那头操你的时候喜欢抓住你项圈后头的公牛吧？对，就是他老婆。”她隔着[arona.armor]抓了抓自己的裆部。
        
        两个兽人互相怒视，接着爆出一阵大笑。旁边几个女牛仔厌恶地往后缩，扔下手里的零食，尽快躲开他们。
        
        “你是干了什么才被戴上项圈的？”阿罗娜问他，在他肩上重重拍了一下。“我还以为冯达族早就不跟米诺斯人乱搞了呢。”
        
        那个大块头耸了耸肩。“大概有十五年没搞了吧？可我十六岁那年我奶奶带我去劫掠，结果头领让我们全被逮住的时候，这也没帮上什么忙。”
        
        “啧。那可够长的。该死的牛还顺便教会你做菜了，是吧？”阿罗娜说着，抓起一条红香料牛肉塞进嘴里。“嘿，还挺好吃！”
        
        “我家女主人说我有这个天分，”他耸了耸肩。“总得想办法让自己有点用，再说这可比在船坞里干活强多了。”
        
        阿罗娜点点头。“我懂。[silly
            |唉，倒霉就倒霉吧，赶紧去装一盘。
            |说到这个，”她说着拿起一个盘子。“给这位大块头多装点肉。
        ]”
    ]

rows.original: Shovel a bunch of tasty noble-chow onto your plate and enjoy a pre-dinner snack.
rows.translation: 在你的盘子里堆满这些美味的高档零食，享受一顿餐前的小点心吧。
rows.raw: "Shovel a bunch of tasty noble-chow onto your plate and enjoy a pre-dinner snack."

rows.original: Chat with the orc a bit. Servants see a little bit of everything, don't they?
rows.translation: 和那个兽人聊一会儿吧。仆从们什么事情都见得多了，不是吗？
rows.raw: "Chat with the orc a bit. Servants see a little bit of everything, don't they?"

rows.original:
You look over the orc's selection of wines and pick one out that looks particularly to your taste. 
    
    "A fine selection," he says, picking the bottle out from the rack, popping its cork, and pouring a taste of it into a silver-chased goblet. "Enjoy."
    
    When he turns to serve another guest, you contemplate your drink...
rows.translation:
你仔细浏览了兽人挑选的那些葡萄酒，最终选出了一款特别符合你口味的。
    
    “真是不错的选择，”他说着，从架子上取下那瓶酒，拔开瓶塞，然后将少许酒倒入一个银边装饰的高脚杯中。“请享用。”
    
    当他转身去为另一位客人服务时，你开始仔细品味手中的酒……

    You look over the orc's selection of wines and pick one out that looks particularly to your taste. 
    
    "A fine selection," he says, picking the bottle out from the rack, popping its cork, and pouring a taste of it into a silver-chased goblet. "Enjoy."
    
    When he turns to serve another guest, you contemplate your drink...
    '

rows.original: What's the point of a drink if not to consume it?
rows.translation: 如果不喝下去，喝酒还有什么意义呢？
rows.raw: "What's the point of a drink if not to consume it?"

rows.original: Take a goblet of the royal family's wine.
rows.translation: 请尝一杯王室的葡萄酒吧。
rows.raw: "Take a goblet of the royal family's wine."

rows.translation: 你没有任何合适的东西可以往饮料里掺。
rows.raw: "You don't have anything appropriate to spike a drink with."

rows.original: You take a little something out of your pack and slip it into the drink while nobody's looking. This should make for an unexpected surprise for someone, if need be.
rows.translation: 你从背包里拿出一小样东西，在没人注意的时候把它放进饮料里。如果有需要的话，这样就能给某人一个意想不到的惊喜了。
rows.raw: "\n    You take a little something out of your pack and slip it into the drink while nobody's looking. This should make for an unexpected surprise for someone, if need be.\n    "

rows.original:
The proper feast is yet to start, but that isn't going to stop you from [pc.bg noblescion
        |enjoying some food that's worthy of your upbringing for once
        |loading up on free high-class food while you have the chance
    ]. There's seasoned beef, lamb, pork, and all manner of fish and mushrooms; the scent of garlic and roasted herbs is positively mouthwatering. You take as much as you think you can fit on one plate, content to munch on that while you mingle.
rows.translation:
真正的盛宴还未开始，但这并不会阻止你[pc.bg noblescion
        |难得有一次，能够品尝到真正符合你出身背景所应享受的食物了。
        |趁现在有机会，尽情享用免费的高档美食吧。
    ]有熟牛肉、羊肉、猪肉，还有各种各样的鱼和蘑菇；大蒜和烤香草的味道实在让人垂涎欲滴。你可以根据自己的想法，取尽可能多的食物放在一个盘子里，边聊天边享用这些美食。
rows.raw:
"
    The proper feast is yet to start, but that isn't going to stop you from [pc.bg noblescion
        |enjoying some food that's worthy of your upbringing for once
        |loading up on free high-class food while you have the chance
    ]. There's seasoned beef, lamb, pork, and all manner of fish and mushrooms; the scent of garlic and roasted herbs is positively mouthwatering. You take as much as you think you can fit on one plate, content to munch on that while you mingle. 
    "

rows.original: "Everything going alright so far?" you ask the orc. "Eh, can't complain," he says by way of answer, slicing off a slender sliver of meat for a passing noblewoman wearing little more than a sling bikini made of silk and stings of pearls. "Never seen eye-candy like this before. Even my mistress has really pulled out the stops tonight." You sip your drink. "That right?" The orc gives you a salacious grin around his tusks. "Yeah. She and her husband used to be real hard-liners on the conservative side, too, but she's bought in hard on that 'proud of your city, proud of your heritage, proud of your body' line Senator Khaius's been spewing. Now it's like the whole family's got milk for brains. Them and their patrician pals." "Sounds familiar," you murmur, thinking back to Njorhaalt. The fate of the boreal nobility. "Have they been seeing anybody new? Someone that might be influencing them?" He shakes his head. "I get the honor of making all their meals at the estate. They've been hosting some of their friends from the provinces, but ain't nobody I've never seen before. Real funny seeing the provincial guests coming to the party in their togas while Mistress and her two pretty daughters are here with their tits in nothing but pearl hammocks. And the twins were talking loud and proud, right in front of their folks, about wearing matching buttplugs to surprise their current crush. Crazy, right? Reminds me of White Week back home." [var0 |"White Week?" "Ruttin' season for us men," he says. "Describes the state of the tribe's women when the lads are through with 'em. |Arona guffaws. "Damn, and considering what the bulls in this city are packing, it's probably more like white month am I right?" The chef snorts. "Don't forget all the white the girls squirt, too. Milk and cream make a hell of a mess. |You snort. "That bad, huh?" The chef shrugs. "I didn't say it was bad. ] I think a lotta slave-men have been enjoying the changes around here. Work's a lot more rewarding when you're tasked with plowing a noblewoman into the bedding." He makes a subtle nod to a pair of pretty red-headed cowgirls, both just shy of twenty and wearing strings of pearls around their bare chests, eying you both up with the subtlety of a Minoan catapult. Yeah, you can see why he's not complaining.
rows.translation: “到目前为止一切都还顺利吗？”你问那个兽人。 “呃，没什么可抱怨的，”他算是回答，同时为一位路过的贵族女士切下一小片肉——她身上只有一件丝绸做的吊带比基尼，缀着一串串珍珠。“从没见过这么多养眼的货色。连我家女主人今晚都真是下了血本。” 你抿了一口酒。“是吗？” 那兽人咧开獠牙，露出淫荡的笑容。“没错。她和她丈夫以前也是保守派里的死硬分子，但凯乌斯参议员鼓吹的那套为城市骄傲、为血统骄傲、为身体骄傲的说辞，她可是全盘买账了。现在他们全家脑子里都像灌了奶似的。还有他们那帮贵族朋友。” “听着有点耳熟，”你低声说道，想起了Njorhaalt。那些北方贵族的命运。“他们最近见过什么新面孔吗？有没有谁可能在影响他们？” 他摇了摇头。“我有幸在庄园里负责他们所有的饭食。他们最近招待了一些外省来的朋友，可那些人我没有一个不认识的。看着外省客人穿着托加长袍来赴宴，而女主人和她两个漂亮女儿只用珍珠吊兜托着奶子站在那儿，可真有意思。那对双胞胎还当着父母的面，又大声又得意地聊着要戴上同款肛塞，给他们现在的心上人一个惊喜。够疯吧？这让我想起老家的白色星期。” [var0 |“白色星期？” “我们男人的发情季，”他说，“说的是小伙子们把部落里的女人干完之后，她们会变成的样子。 |阿罗娜放声大笑。“靠，考虑到这城里那些公牛都带着什么家伙，那大概更像是白色月了吧？” 厨师哼了一声。“也别忘了姑娘们喷出来的那些白东西。奶和奶油能弄得一塌糊涂。 |你哼了一声。“有那么糟？” 厨师耸了耸肩。“我可没说它糟。 ]我觉得不少男奴隶都挺享受这儿的变化。当你的差事是把一位贵族女士操进被褥里时，干活就有意思多了。” 他不动声色地朝一对漂亮的红发牛仔女孩点了点头——她们都还不满二十岁，赤裸的胸前挂着一串串珍珠，正用米诺斯投石机般毫不含蓄的目光打量着你们俩。 是啊，你明白他为什么没什么可抱怨的了。

rows.original: The Captain of the Chargers is standing at the fire pit, a huge leg of turkey held in one hand. The other is wrapped around the shoulders of a diminutive blonde bunnygirl who's cradling a gravidly tummy. He's wearing his military uniform, huge plume on proud display, while the lady under his arm has short pants and a chestwrap on, leaving most of her skin bare.
rows.translation: 冲锋者队的队长站在篝火旁，一只手握着一只巨大的火鸡腿，另一只手搂着一位身材娇小的金发少女——她的肚子明显已经怀孕了。队长穿着军装，那根华丽的羽饰骄傲地展示着；而挽在他臂下的少女则穿着短裤和裹胸布，大部分皮肤都暴露在外。

rows.original: Go and talk to the captain.

[var0
        |"You!" 
        
        Your approach is cut short by an accusatory bellow from the Charger-Captain, one meaty finger pointed at you. His other hand slides from the bunnygirl's shoulder to the short sword at his hip. 
        
        [silly
            |Well well well, if it isn't the consequences of your own actions.
            |Oh, is he still mad about you wiping the floor with him and his boys?
        ] [flags.RANNA_EMP
            |Ranna
            |The bunnygirl
        ] puts a hand on Fenraus's chest, completely unable to hold back a man twice her size with strength... and yet his stills, scowling at you over her head. 
        
        "You [pc.mf
            |motherless bastard
            |wretched whore
        ]," he snarls. "You dare to play the champion here after all you've done?"
        
        "And what did I do," you retort, "other than prove how weak you really are? Your king ought to be thanking me."
        
        The Charger-Captain snarls. "Your attack on my men left them vulnerable. You'd barely pushed into the Undermountain before the demons set upon us!         他一只手护着怀孕的泰勒尔，另一只手则按上剑柄。“我向你发起决斗，‘冠军’！”
        |“哎—哈，冠军！”芬劳斯举起火鸡腿向你致意。他臂弯里的兔女郎用没有托住硕大孕肚的那只手朝你挥了挥。“[party.has calise

        魁梧的弥诺陶洛斯轻轻捏了捏兔妻的肩膀。“[flags.FENRAUS_SMOOCH
            |你见过我的妻子兰娜。”
            
            兔女郎朝你送来一个飞吻。
            |[flags.RANNA_EMP
                |这是我的妻子兰娜。”
                
                “我们见过。”你朝这位药剂师微微点头。
                |这是我的妻子兰娜。”
                
                “很荣幸见到你。”兔女郎说道，尽管肚子硕大，仍尽力行了一礼。
            ]
        ]
        
        “自从我们初次见面，”芬劳斯继续道，“在你的努力以及随后的海上封锁下，肆虐山腹深域的小恶魔大军已遭到重创，我们的任务因此轻松了许多。你赢得了我的感谢。”
        
        “还有我的。”兰娜说道，“只要能让我丈夫安全一点点，都能让我夜里睡得更安稳。”
        
        “[pc.dcb

rows.original:
"How do you think the war's going?" you ask. "You're the one on the front lines, Fenraus."
    
    The minotaur sighs. "I'd call it a stalemate at present," he admits. "We have the demons bottled up in the tunnels, but the Royal Legions have had no luck in purging them entirely. The demons can't attack the city directly while we hold the tunnels, but their numbers are too overwhelming for us to attack them in return. If nothing changes, it'll be a protracted siege indeed." 
    
    [party.has calise
        |"I wouldn't worry about that!" Calise smiles. "This war will be won soon enough. [pc.name] and I will make sure of it!"
        |"Hopefully not," you assure him. "Not if I have anything to do about it."
    ]
    
    Fenraus inclines his head. "I pray for your success. I would like my children to be born into a world untroubled by demonkind, as I was."
    
    He sighs, making a Tiran sign over his brow. "The king's quarantine, at least, is sparing the rest of the Marches from the worst of what we Khor'minoans have been forced to deal with. Few demons escape, save through the dangerous waterways, and we believe it has served to greatly disrupt their communications. The demons' leadership, their queen, has only been seen once or twice in the depths; we suspect she must keep her court on the surface, and thus, the demons in the Undermountain are largely leaderless beyond the black-armored axe-wielder we have seen at their vanguard."
    
    [party.has calise
        |"I wouldn't be so sure," Calise says. "The blockade is effective, but our enemies include powerful mages. They may be breaking through in unexpected ways."
        |"Are you sure about that?" you ask. "I wouldn't count out Kasyrra that easily..."
    ]
    
    Fenraus shrugs. "I can only fight a war against forces I understand. This strategy should work conventionally; countering the enemy's supernatural abilities falls in the hands of our priests and scholars, not I."
    
    Ranna smiles and pats his arm. "You are the sword of the kingdom, my love. Don't complain that you can't be its staff, too."
    
    The minotaur chuckles. "Aye, love."
rows.translation:
你觉得这场战争会如何发展？”你问道，“毕竟你是前线作战的人，芬劳斯。”
    
    弥诺陶洛斯叹了口气，承认道：“目前来看，应该算是僵局吧。我们把那些恶魔困在了隧道里，但皇家军团始终无法将它们彻底消灭。只要我们控制着这些隧道，恶魔就无法直接进攻城市；但它们的数量实在太多，我们也不可能发起反攻。如果这种情况持续下去，这场围城战确实会拖得非常漫长。 
    
    [party.has calise
        |不用担心那个！”卡莉丝微笑着说，“这场战争很快就会结束的。 [pc.name]我一定会确保这一点的！
        |希望不会吧，”你向他保证道，“只要我能插手的话，肯定不会发生这种事。
    ]
    
    芬劳斯低下了头：“我祈愿你能取得成功。我希望我的孩子们能够生活在一个没有恶魔侵扰的世界里，就像我当年那样。”
    
    他叹了口气，在额头上画了一个蒂拉教会的符号：“至少，国王实施的隔离措施让其他地区免于遭受我们霍尔米诺人一直以来不得不面对的那些灾难。几乎没有恶魔能够逃脱，除非通过那些危险的水路。我们认为，这些水路在很大程度上扰乱了它们的通讯联系。恶魔的首领——也就是它们的女王——只在深渊中被见到过一两次；我们怀疑她必须将自己的宫廷维持在地表，因此，在山腹深域中的恶魔，除了我们在他们前锋线上看到的那个身穿黑色铠甲、手持巨斧的战士之外，基本上都没有领袖了。"
    
    [party.has calise
        |我不敢这么肯定，”卡莉丝说道，“这种封锁措施确实有效，但我们的敌人当中也有强大的法师。他们可能会用一些意想不到的方法来突破封锁。
        |你确定吗？”你问道，“我可不会那么轻易地排除卡希拉……
    ]
    
    芬劳斯耸了耸肩：“我只能与那些我能够理解的力量进行战斗。这种策略在常规情况下应该是有效的；对付敌人的超自然能力，应该由我们的祭司和学者来处理，而不是我。”
    
    兰娜微笑着拍了拍他的手臂：“你可是王国的利剑，我的爱人。别抱怨自己不能同时也成为它的支柱啊。”
    
    弥诺陶洛斯轻笑着说道：“是啊，亲爱的。

rows.original:
"How are you holding up, Ranna?" you ask[flags.FENRAUS_SMOOCH
        |, putting a gentle hand on her titanic baby bump
    ]. 
    
    She giggles. "As well as I can be, under the circumstances. My work at the store keeps me so busy I barely have time to notice the days passing. These little ones are so close to being born, though! I'm so afraid my husband will miss the big day because of this awful war."
    
    Fenraus puts a reassuring hand on her shoulder. "I will cut my way through all of Undermountain to be there with you for your greatest battle, love. I swear it."
    
    "Is this your first time, Ranna?"
    
    The tiny bunny nods. "Yep! And it's all this big hunk's fault," she says, giving Fenraus's chiseled gut a playful punch. She's so small, it probably feels like a tickle to him. The captain just smiles and rubs one of her ears. "You'd never know it these days, but I used to be a real tomboy. I never thought I'd have kids at all, before I met my husband."
    
    "That's how we met, you know," Fenraus adds. "We bumped into each other while she was out scouring the foothills for rare herbs for her mother's shop. All by herself, with just her cute little dagger and buckler to ward off harpies and wyverns. What's a man to do, seeing that, but try and keep her safe?"
    
    "And now look at me, barefoot and pregnant like my mom. Just... so, so much bigger!" Ranna giggles, patting her belly. "I wouldn't trade it for the world, even with the war! I feel like I finally have something to live for."
    
    "And I've got something to fight for," Fenraus says. "Khaak, something more personal than just king and country, anyway."
    
    Ranna smiles and leans against her husband. "[var0
        |Until this war's done with," she says, giving you a little smirk, "I'll just have to rely on you to keep my husband happy while he's away. You don't mind, do you?"
        
        You return the smile, though your eyes are on the captain's shifting tassets. "It's my pleasure."
        
        "Mostly mine," Fenraus says. "Thank the gods I didn't marry a jealous girl."
        
        "I'd be doing the world a disservice, keeping you all to myself," Ranna laughs. "And there's so, so much of you to go around."
        |Just try and end this war quickly, for my babies' sakes."
    ]
rows.translation:
“你还好吗，兰娜？”你问道[flags.FENRAUS_SMOOCH
        |，同时将一只手轻柔地覆在她硕大的孕肚上
    ]。
    
    她咯咯笑道。“这种情况下，能有多好就有多好吧。店里的工作让我忙得几乎感觉不到日子流逝。不过，这些小家伙马上就要出生了！我好怕丈夫会因为这场可怕的战争错过那个重要的日子。”
    
    芬劳斯将一只令人安心的大手放在她肩上。“亲爱的，为了在你最伟大的战斗中陪伴你，我会一路杀穿整个山腹深域。我发誓。”
    
    “兰娜，这是你的第一次吗？”
    
    小巧的兔女郎点点头。“没错！而且全都怪这个大块头。”她说着，开玩笑地捶了芬劳斯轮廓分明的腹部一拳。她的身形如此娇小，这一拳对他来说大概跟挠痒痒差不多。队长只是微笑着揉了揉她的一只耳朵。“你现在肯定看不出来，不过我以前可是个十足的假小子。遇见丈夫以前，我从没想过自己会生孩子。”
    
    “你知道吗，我们就是这样相遇的。”芬劳斯补充道，“那时她正独自在山脚寻找稀有药草，供母亲的店铺使用，我们偶然碰在了一起。她孤身一人，只带着一把可爱的小匕首和小圆盾，用来抵御女妖和飞龙。男人看到这种情形，除了保护她，还能怎么办呢？”
    
    “现在看看我，和妈妈一样赤着脚、怀着孕。只不过……肚子大了太多太多！”兰娜咯咯笑着拍了拍肚皮。“即使正在打仗，我也绝不会拿现在的生活去换任何东西！我终于觉得，自己有了活下去的目标。”
    
    “我也有了为之战斗的目标。”芬劳斯说道，“哈，总之，是比国王和国家更加私人的目标。”
    
    兰娜微笑着靠上丈夫。“[var0
        |在这场战争结束之前，”她朝你坏笑道，“我只能靠你在丈夫离家时让他过得开心了。你不介意吧？”
        
        你回以微笑，目光却落在队长不断挪动的腿裙上。“乐意效劳。”
        
        “主要是让我开心。”芬劳斯说道，“谢天谢地，我娶的不是个善妒的姑娘。”
        
        “要是把你独占，我可就对不起全世界了。”兰娜笑道，“毕竟你的分量这么足，完全够大家分享。”
        |只求你尽快结束这场战争，看在我的孩子们份上。”
    ]

rows.original:
"So what's the difference between the Chargers and the Royal Legion?" you ask their captain.
    
    "Try not to talk [pc.hisHer] ear off," Ranna teases.
    
    Fenraus laughs. "To you outlanders, I imagine there doesn't seem to be much of a difference. The Chargers are the kingdom's fighting elite, hand-picked from among the Legions for our skill and dedication to the throne. Like our brothers on the shield wall, we're professional soldiers, well equipped and well armed, but the Chargers undergo much more training and are directly, and solely, under the king's personal command. We have no generals or senators to answer to: just our sovereign."
    
    "So you aren't so locked into your assignments in the tunnels, either?" you ask.
    
    He shakes his head. "No, but nor are we at liberty to do as we like. Kelsaz is a good man, and he gave us more leeway than perhaps he should have before the war, but there is not a Charger alive that would not give his life for the king without hesitation. His word is our law, and we obey unfailingly."
    
    Ranna puts a hand over her mouth and stage whispers, "He really likes the king."
    
    Fenraus snorts. "Aye, love, I do. Even were I not a Charger, I would still gladly serve him in any way I could. He has led the kingdom as a wise sage in peace, and I have no doubt about his leadership in true war, now that it has found our walls." 
    
    "So there's no chance you could get away? Even if it was to help win the war?"
    
    "None," he says, with a firm shake of his head. "I would aid you if I could, Champion[party.has calise
        |s
    ], but my orders are to guard the entrances of the mountain and enforce the king's quarantine. I am only here in the city at all by his mercy — a short break from my long duties to see my wife and bring her to the feast. I am afraid there will be no aid for you from the Chargers, for whatever it is you're planning."
rows.translation:
“那么，‘冲锋者’和‘皇家军团’之间有什么区别呢？”你问他们的队长。
    
    “尽量别把[pc.hisHer]耳朵说掉，”兰娜开玩笑地说。
    
    芬劳斯笑了。“对你们这些外来者来说，我想确实看不出有什么区别。‘冲锋者’是王国的战斗精英，是从各军团中根据我们的技艺和对王座的忠诚亲手挑选出来的。就像护墙上我们的兄弟们一样，我们是职业军人，装备精良、武器充足，但‘冲锋者’要接受多得多的训练，并且直接且只听从国王本人的指挥。我们不需要向任何将军或参议员汇报：只向我们的君主负责。”
    
    “这么说，你们在隧道里的任务也不是那么固定了？”你问道。
    
    他摇了摇头。“不，但我们也不能随心所欲地行动。凯尔萨兹是个好人，战前他给我们的自由也许超出了他该给的，但活着的‘冲锋者’里没有一个会犹豫着不为国王献出生命。他的话就是我们的法律，我们无条件服从。”
    
    兰娜用手捂住嘴，故意大声地悄悄说：“他真的很喜欢国王。”
    
    芬劳斯哼了一声。“没错，亲爱的，我确实喜欢。即使我不是‘冲锋者’，我依然愿意以任何方式为他效劳。他在和平时期以智者的身份带领王国，而如今战争已经来到我们的城墙下，我毫不怀疑他在真正的战争中同样有领导之能。”
    
    “所以你根本没有机会脱身？即使是为了帮忙赢得战争？”
    
    “没有，”他坚定地摇了摇头，说道。“如果可以，我会帮你们，冠军[party.has calise
        |
    ]，但我的命令是守卫这座山的入口，并执行国王的隔离措施。我能来到城里，完全是靠他的恩准——这是我长期职责中短暂的休假，好来见我的妻子并带她参加宴会。恐怕无论你在策划什么，都得不到‘冲锋者’的任何帮助。”

rows.original:
"Have you two seen anything... unusual... here today?" you ask the couple. 
    
    They exchange a look, which involves poor Ranna craning her neck up quite a bit. After a moment, the bunnygirl says, "Well... of a sort, I suppose." 
    
    "Oh?"
    
    Fenraus ruffles Ranna's hair. "Mm, just as we arrived, there was a scuffle outside. Crown Prince Vrannus's butler was letting a few other slaves have a piece of his mind. Apparently they dropped something they were bringing in. I've only met the man a few times, but I'd never imagine even a salamander man could be so fiery over a mere crate."
    
    "It was a little frightening," Ranna says, shaking her head. "I thought he was going to start a fistfight right in front of the palace. Luckily my man here stepped in."
    
    "Sent him back into the palace with a shout, and got the workers moving again," he says, with just a hint of smugness. "The lad may tower over a few cowgirls, but my size cowed him well enough!"
rows.translation:
“你们两位今天在这里有没有看到什么……不寻常的东西？”你问这对夫妇。 
    
    他们交换了一个眼神，这需要可怜的兰娜把脖子抬得老高。过了一会儿，那个兔女郎说：“嗯……勉强算有吧。” 
    
    “哦？”
    
    芬劳斯揉了揉兰娜的头发。“嗯，我们刚到的时候，外面有一场争执。弗兰努斯王储的管家正在训斥另外几个奴隶。显然他们把要搬进去的东西弄掉了。我只见过那人几面，但我想象不到，就连一个火蜥蜴人也会为了一只普通箱子发那么大的火。”
    
    “当时有点吓人，”兰娜摇着头说。“我以为他要在宫殿门前打起架来。幸好我男人出面了。”
    
    “他一声呵斥把那小子赶回了宫里，也让工人们重新动了起来，”他说，语气里带着一丝得意。“那小子也许比几个女牛仔都高，但我的块头足够镇住他！”

rows.original:
"I'll see you both later," you say.
    
    "Vay-ahn! Tira watch over you," Fenraus says.
    
    Ranna gives you a pretty smile. "Enjoy the rest of the evening."
rows.translation:
“回头见，你们俩，”你说。
    
    “瓦扬！愿蒂拉看顾你，”芬劳斯说道。
    
    兰娜对你露出了一个美丽的微笑：“祝你今晚过得愉快。”

rows.original: You spread your hands and look around at the crowd starting to gather around you. "Why would I? Are you that desperate to get thrashed in front of your wife this time?" You can see the veins bulging on the bull's neck; watch his pupils becoming pinpoints in his eyes. Ranna gasps, putting a hand on his chest, but towering bull steps past her and balls his fists. "You're no better than a demon," he growls. "Honorless cur!" Fenraus takes a threatening step forward, inching his sword from its sheath... and then pauses, no, feezes mid-step. His wife gasps, trying to steady him but far too small and weak to keep her husband from planting his face in the floor. You glance back to see Calise [party.has calise |behind you |glancing down from her place beside the king ], motes of magic swirling around her hand. "Don't you dare lay a hand on [pc.name], cow." There's a flurry of concerned, frightened whispering among the nearby partygoers, and you can feel the king's eye finally on you — perhaps luckily, Fenraus's accusations were only growls, not shouted for others to hear. The bunny waddles over to where her husband's collapsed, chirping at him in Minoan until Calise releases the spell. One of the other Chargers in attendance grabs him under the arm and pulls him back to his feet — and away from you, before he can make more of a fool of himself. You wonder how many people heard your exchange in full. The captain and his wife give you a dirty look as they're whisked away, and you can feel the eye of the king on you...
rows.translation: 你摊开双手，环顾四周，看到人群已经开始聚集在你周围。“我为什么要那么做？你们是真的那么急切，想要这次在妻子面前出丑吗？” 你可以看到公牛脖子上的静脉都凸了出来；也能看到它的眼睛里，瞳孔已经缩成了一点点。兰娜倒吸一口凉气，把手放在胸口，但那个高大的公牛从她身边走过，同时握紧了双拳。 “你和恶魔没什么两样，”他低吼道，“无耻的混蛋！” 芬劳斯威胁地向前迈了一步，将剑从剑鞘中拔了出来。然后停顿了一下，不，feezes就在这时，他的妻子倒抽了一口气，试图扶住他，但她实在太弱小了，根本无力阻止丈夫将脸重重地砸在地板上。 你回头望去，看到了卡莉丝。 [party.has calise |在你身后 |从她站在国王身旁的位置向下望去 ]魔法的纹路在她手中旋转。“你绝对不敢对她动手[pc.name]，牛啊……” 周围的派对参与者们开始慌张地低声议论起来，而你也感觉到国王的目光终于落在了你身上——或许幸运的是，芬劳斯的那些指责只不过是低声咆哮，并没有被人听到。 那只兔子摇摇摆摆地走到她丈夫倒下的地方，用米诺斯语对他吱吱叫个不停，直到卡莉丝解除了那个咒语。在场的其他“冲锋者”成员中有一个抓住他的胳膊，把他拉了起来——同时把他从你身边拉开，免得他再出洋相。你不禁想知道，究竟有多少人听到了你们完整的对话。 船长和他的妻子恶狠狠地看了你一眼，然后就被带走了，而你能感觉到国王的目光正紧紧地盯着你……

rows.original:
"Fine," you say. "If you're that eager to be embarrassed in front of your king."
    
    Fenraus looks to the dais. "My king! For the glory of the Royal Chargers, I demand satisfaction from the Champion of Frost!"
    
    Kelsaz glances down, frowning. "In the middle of the feast, Fenraus? What's this all about?"
    
    Did the king really not hear about what you did? Hard to believe, if when Fenraus said happened to his men was true. Or was he too ashamed to report it?
    
    "Vengeance, my king, and sullied honor." 
    
    "If the Champion assents," the king says, glancing at you. You nod. "Then keep it clean."
    
    Fenraus draws his sword.
rows.translation:
“好吧，”你说，“如果你这么渴望在国王面前出丑的话。”
    
    芬劳斯望向高台：“我的国王！为了皇家冲锋者的荣耀，我要向冰霜冠军讨个说法！”
    
    凯尔萨兹低头看了看，皱起了眉头。“在宴会进行到一半的时候，芬劳斯？这到底是怎么回事？”
    
    国王真的没有听说过你做的事情吗？如果芬劳斯所说的关于他手下发生的事情是真的，那就很难相信了。还是说他太羞于启齿，所以没有上报这件事呢？
    
    “复仇，我的国王，还有被玷污的荣誉。”
    
    “如果冠军同意的话，”国王说道，同时瞥了你一眼。你点了点头。“那就打得干净些。”
    
    芬劳斯拔出了他的剑。

rows.original: Just like last time, the over-muscled bull crumples before you. His wife gasps, covering her mouth while you follow her man down, pressing a blade into his throat. "Enough!" the king shouts, showing you a thumbs down — the royal refusal to allow execution. The bunnygirl squeaks in fear, slumping down on her knees and cradling her man's head. Calise's hands come to rest on your shoulders. You sigh and stand, stowing your [pc.weapon]. "Happy?" you ask him. Fenraus scowls, the rage in his eyes unabated, but he retains his honor enough to not lunge at you. He struggles back to his feet, [pc.isChamp |slapping your hand away when offered, ]and his wife wraps her arms around one of his massive biceps. "I yield," he grumbles, turning away. More quietly, he adds, "But this isn't the end of this, Champion." He pulls his cloak around himself and stalks away, wife in hand. "Well done, [pc.name]! An excellent display of a Champion's prowess!" Calise says, squeezing your shoulder. There's a sporadic clapping from some of the assembled nobles, clueless as to why you fought in the first place. The princess at her father's side seems concerned, and turns away. Soon enough the other nobles' attention begins drifting back from the spectacle. With no grand victory speech forthcoming, or even an explanation anyone beyond the two of you can hear, they're quickly engrossed in other pleasures — literally, in the case of a few military men sneaking off with serving girls and patricians' daughters.
rows.translation: 就像上次一样，肌肉过度发达的公牛倒在你面前。他的妻子倒抽一口气，掩住嘴巴；你紧跟着她的男人俯身下去，将刀刃抵上他的喉咙。 “够了！”国王大喊一声，拇指向下——这是王室拒绝处决的手势。 兔女郎恐惧地尖叫一声，跪倒在地，将男人的头抱进怀里。卡莉丝的双手落在你肩上。你叹口气，站起身收好[pc.weapon]。 “满意了吗？”你问他。 芬劳斯怒视着你，眼中怒火丝毫未消，但他尚且顾及荣誉，没有扑上来攻击。他挣扎着重新站起，[pc.isChamp |还在你伸手搀扶时将手拍开； ]他的妻子则用双臂抱住他一条粗壮的肱二头肌。 “我认输。”他咕哝着转过身。随后又压低声音补充道：“但这事还没完，冠军。” 他将披风裹在身上，牵着妻子的手大步离开。 “干得漂亮，[pc.name]！冠军的实力展现得淋漓尽致！”卡莉丝捏着你的肩膀说道。 聚集的贵族中响起零星掌声；他们完全不明白你们为何开打。国王身边的公主显得忧心忡忡，转身移开视线。很快，其他贵族的注意力也从这场表演上逐渐散开。既然没有慷慨激昂的胜利演说，甚至没有一句能让你们之外任何人听见的解释，他们很快便重新沉浸在其他享乐里——有几个军人偷偷带着侍女和贵族女儿离席，甚至是字面意义上的“沉浸”。

rows.original:
You're knocked to the ground by the force of Fenraus's sword hilt crashing into your jaw, and the world spins painfully. 
    
    "Yield!" he bellows, pressing the blade into your throat. For a moment, you doubt that anything you say will stay his hand, but when you groan that you concede, the minotaur stands up straight and slides his blade into its sheath. You glance up to the dais to see King Kelsaz holding a thumb down at the captain — the royal refusal to allow execution. Fenraus clearly isn't happy about it, but he pulls his cape around himself, puts an arm around his wife, and saunters away with a curse.
    
    Calise offers you a hand. "Are you alright?" 
    
    "Fine," you groan, [pc.dcb
        |standing up on your own
        |taking her hand and letting her pull you up
        |letting your bestie pick you up
    ]. You look to the king and his entourage, feeling heavy gazes falling on you from the elite of the city. 
    
    "I'll smooth that out," Calise assures you with a wink. "Taking the captain's challenge helped your image, even if you lost. By accepting, you both keep your honor."
    
    That doesn't help your aching jaw much, but you nod both to Calise and the king. The nobles' attention begins drifting back from the spectacle. With no grand victory speech from the bull, or even an explanation anyone beyond the two of you can hear, they're quickly engrossed in other pleasures — literally, in the case of a few military men sneaking off with serving girls and patricians' daughters. 
    
    You shake the bitter taste of defeat off and grab a drink.
rows.translation:
芬劳斯的剑柄猛地撞击你的下巴，将你击倒在地，整个世界都在剧烈地旋转，让你感到一阵剧痛。
    
    “投降吧！”他怒吼着，将剑刃抵在你的喉咙上。有那么一瞬间，你怀疑自己无论说什么都无法让他罢手，但当你低声表示投降时，那个弥诺陶洛斯立刻直起身来，将剑收进了鞘中。你抬头望去，看到凯尔萨兹国王正用拇指向下指着那位队长——国王明确表示不允许执行死刑。费纳乌斯显然对此很不满意，但他只是裹紧了自己的斗篷，搂着妻子，然后骂了几句便走开了。
    
    卡莉丝伸出手来：“你没事吧？”
    
    “没事，”你呻吟道。 [pc.dcb
        |自立自强
        |牵着她的手，让她拉你上去。
        |让你的好朋友来接你吧。
    ]你望着国王和他的随从，感受到城中精英们投来的重型目光。
    
    “我会把这件事处理好，”卡莉丝眨了眨眼，向你保证道，“接受船长的挑战其实有助于提升你的形象，即使你最终输了。通过接受这个提议，你们双方都能保住自己的尊严。”
    
    虽然这句话并不能缓解你疼痛的下巴，但你还是向卡莉丝和国王点了点头。贵族们们的注意力也开始从这一幕上转移开去了。公牛并没有发表什么宏大的胜利宣言，甚至连你们两人以外的人能够听懂的解释也没有——于是他们很快就被其他事情吸引了注意力：对于那些军人来说，就是偷偷带着侍女和贵族的女儿们离开现场罢了。 
    
    你甩掉失败带来的苦涩滋味，然后拿了一杯饮料喝下去。

    "Yield!" he bellows, pressing the blade into your throat. You glance up to the dais to see King Kelsaz holding a thumb down at the captain — the royal refusal to allow execution. Fenraus clearly isn't happy about it, but he pulls his cape around himself, puts an arm around his wife, and saunters away with a curse.
    
    Calise offers you a hand. "Are you alright?" 
    
    "Fine," you groan, [pc.dcb
        |standing up on your own
        |taking her hand and letting her pull you up
        |letting your bestie pick you up
    ]. You look to the king and his entourage, feeling heavy gazes falling on you from the elite of the city. 
    
    "I'll smooth that out," Calise assures you with a wink. "Taking the captain's challenge helped your image, even if you lost. By accepting, you both keep your honor."
    
    That doesn't help your aching jaw much, but you nod both to Calise and the king. The nobles' attention begins drifting back from the spectacle. With no grand victory speech from the bull, or even an explanation anyone beyond the two of you can hear, they're quickly engrossed in other pleasures — literally, in the case of a few military men sneaking off with serving girls and patricians' daughters. 
    
    You shake the bitter taste of defeat off and grab a drink.
    '

rows.original: "Well, now that you mention it, I don't mind taking a break." Tricia smiles, and the undertones of her voice make it clear that she knows full well what this %"break" entails. "The feast's going to go on for a while, and I won't be needed to announce the commencement of the dance for some time yet." Besides, it's the [pc.mascFem |dashing |pretty ] newcomer to the city, sponsored by Calise no less. Surely no one will fault her for wanting to get to know such an enigmatic figure better. "Oh trust me, many people will fault me. But it shouldn't be a problem. Some of the old feasts used to last days to a week. Even if we go missing for a day, all they'll do is retire, sleep off the meal, then come back for more without even thinking anything's amiss." "Or they'll just find a replacement for the missing royal page and declare the dance anyway." "Mmh, maybe." Tricia's smile widens, and she pushes herself a little closer such that her face's but inches from yours. That you're both in the full view of just about anyone at the feast who cares to look doesn't bother her in the least — if anything, it's exactly what she wants. "But free food, wine and sex at the king's expense? They've gotten more... intent about it of late. Don't worry about it, we have time; you were kind enough to get me a drink, so I'll give you the time of day." [pc.isDK |"Really? A drink's all that it takes? You're selling yourself short here." A smirk on your face, you step to the side so that Tricia's back is turned to the party at large, then [silly |grab one of her cow tits and give it a firm squeeze. Honk, honk |slide your fingers under one of her cow tits and give it a firm grope, pushing upward to really get a feel for its weight ]. Tricia's breath hitches in the back of her throat a moment, then a shade of pink rises into her cheeks. Gods, she's more sensitive than the average cowgirl if the slightest touch has her wound up like that. "Just look at these. You're worth more than that." "Oh, for anyone else I'd be asking for a ring before so much as a fling. But for you, oh giver of drinks? I'll let you have the milk for free just this once. It's nice that someone's direct instead of all these clumsy attempts at courtly flirting from the usual crowd. Shall we?" |"Wow, is that so?" You say. "A drink's all it takes? I was under the impression that dinner and a date would also be a requirement." Tricia chuckles and gestures at the feast. "Well, there's dinner, and here's the date. That proper enough for you, oh champion?" "Hey, I was just worried about you selling yourself short. You're better than that." "Were I to price myself at what I thought I ought to be worth, I'd be asking for a ring. Of course, I'm a bit more of a realist when it comes to a fling. Shall we?" ] But of course. With that, you take Tricia's hand in yours, and gladly lead her away from the ball and down the east hall. The corridor branches out into a multitude of small, identical, and above all private rooms, old stone quickly drowning out the buzz of the party; lamps burn dimly with an aromatic oil that not just helps set the mood, but subtly warms your body with every breath you draw. With the way things are, you'd be surprised if there wasn't an aphrodisiac in the lamp oil to boot, not that such measures would be needed in Khor'minos. It quickly becomes clear that trysts of the kind you're about to partake of are well-accommodated for in Minoan high society. Tricia has to try a full four rooms and find them already occupied before finally snagging a vacancy, whereupon the both of you slide in and you lock the door behind the both of you. "There's no need to rush," Tricia sighs as you reach for her tunic. "Remember, we have time." It's not about the feast, it's about her. Dragging your feet when faced with such a fetching beauty? Gods forbid. "So many people all in one place, it creates a certain atmosphere," Tricia mumbles as she sees to your [pc.armor]. "The old kings knew what they were doing when they made the ballroom. The nobles would let all their youngsters mingle at dances, and then when the inevitable happened they'd barge in to catch their kids in the act and demand that they get married; sometimes they'd even sneak in aphrodisiacs to hurry things along. Not that the kids minded that much, because you don't fuck someone that you don't like, right?" You chuckle. "Does that mean if we're caught in the act here, you have to marry me? You mentioned something about a ring earlier, didn't you?" "Oh no, how terrible. Being forced to marry the latest talk of the town and touted savior of the city? I could think of worse fates. I only have so long before my pretty face isn't so pretty — as glitzy as it is, royal page isn't a job that you do for the rest of your life." "Mhm." With your [pc.armor] off, Tricia plants her hands on your shoulders — she's much heavier than her stature would suggest, and plenty of said weight is on her chest. The cowgirl's milky tits press into your [pc.chest] as she leans in for a quick peck on your lips, her body gradually but inevitably pressing you into the bed and its perfumed sheets. You return the favor by reaching around and squeezing her rear just to the sides of her tail, really feeling the weight that [silly |a cut of prime a5 wagyu beef |a fine-figured cowgirl ] can have. Tricia seems content to let you lead here, which you do...
rows.translation: 嗯，既然你这么说了，我倒也不介意休息一下。”特里西亚微笑着，她语气中的意味很明显，她很清楚这个“休息”到底意味着什么。“这场盛宴还会持续一段时间，短时间内也还不需要我来宣布舞蹈开始的时间。” 而且，这也是[pc.mascFem |潇洒的 |相当漂亮 ]作为这个城市的新来者，而且还是得到了卡莉丝的资助。想必没有人会因为她想要更深入地了解这样一个神秘的人物而责备她吧。 “哦，相信我，很多人肯定会责备我。但那应该不是什么问题。有些传统的庆典活动过去会持续好几天甚至一周呢。就算我们失踪一天，他们也不会多想，只会休息一天，然后继续之前的活动，根本不会觉得有什么不对劲。” “或者，他们干脆会找个人来代替那个失踪的皇家侍从，然后照样举行这场舞会。嗯，也许吧。”特里西亚的笑容变得更加灿烂，她稍微靠近了一些，让自己的脸距离你的脸只有几英寸远。对于那些愿意看的人来说，你们俩完全处于众人的视线范围内，这一点丝毫没有困扰她——事实上，这正是她所希望的。但是免费的美食、美酒，还有国王提供的性服务？他们得到的可真多了…… 意图最近确实有点忙。别担心，我们还有时间；你之前还特意请我喝了酒，所以这次我一定会抽时间陪你的。 [pc.isDK |真的吗？只需要喝一杯酒就能搞定吗？你这样太低估自己了。”你脸上带着一丝笑意，走到一边，让特里西亚背对着整个派对，然后[silly |抓住她那对丰满的胸部，用力捏一下。哼，哼…… |将手指滑到她那饱满的胸部下面，仔细地摸索一番，然后向上按压，真正感受一下它的重量。 ]特里西亚的喉咙突然发紧，脸颊上也浮现出一抹红晕。天啊，她可比普通的牛仔女孩敏感多了，哪怕只是轻轻一触，就会让她这样激动起来。“看看这些吧。你值得的远比那更多。” “哦，对于其他人来说，我甚至在刚开始交往之前就会要求对方送我一枚戒指。但对你来说……哦，这位总是为我提供酒水的人啊？这一次，我就免费把牛奶让你拿去吧。真好，有人能够直截了当地表达自己的想法，而不像那些平常的人那样，总是用那些笨拙的、虚伪的调情方式来试图接近我。我们走吧？ |哇，真是这样吗？”你说道，“只需要喝一杯酒就可以了？我原本还以为需要一起吃晚餐、一起约会呢。” 特里西亚轻笑了一声，然后指向摆在那里的美食说道：“嗯，晚餐已经准备好了，而约会……就在这里啊。这样对你来说已经够好了，哦，冠军。” “嘿，我只是担心你会低估自己的价值。你其实比这更有价值。” “如果我按照自己认为应该得到的价值来定价，那我要求的应该是一枚戒指了。当然，在对待短暂的风流韵事时，我还是比较现实一点的。我们开始吧？ ] 当然可以。于是，你握住特里西亚的手部，愉快地带着她离开舞会，沿着东侧走廊走去。走廊分出了许多小巧、外观相同且完全私密的房间，古老的石墙迅速隔绝了舞会上的喧闹声；灯光在芳香的油灯油中昏暗地燃烧着，这种气味不仅营造出了舒适的氛围，而且每当你呼吸时，还会让身体感到一丝温暖。照目前的情况来看，如果灯油里没有添加催情剂，那你反而会感到惊讶——不过在科尔米诺斯，这样的措施其实并没有必要。 很快就会发现，在米诺斯的上流社会中，你们即将进行的这种私会活动是完全可以被接受的。特里西亚不得不尝试四间房间，结果发现它们都已经被别人占了，直到最后才找到一间空房。然后你们俩一起进去，把门锁上。 “没必要着急，”当你伸手去拿她的束腰外衣时，特里西亚叹了口气说道。记住，我们还有时间。” 重要的不是这场盛宴，而是她。面对如此迷人的美女，你还犹豫不决？那可不行。 “这么多人聚集在同一个地方，确实会营造出一种特别的氛围。”特里西亚边说边看着你。 [pc.armor]那些古老的国王在建造舞厅时肯定是经过深思熟虑的。贵族们会让自己的子女们在舞会上相互交往，而当不可避免的事情发生时，他们就会突然介入，当场抓住自己的孩子，要求他们立刻结婚；有时他们甚至会偷偷在酒水或食物中加入催情剂，以便加快事情的发展。孩子们倒也没太在意，因为毕竟你不会去和自己不喜欢的人做那种事，对吧？” 你轻笑起来：“这么说来，如果我们在这里被抓个正着，你就得嫁给我了？你之前不是提到过戒指的事吗？哦不，太可怕了。竟然被迫嫁给城里最近最热门的话题人物，还有那个被吹捧为城市的救星？我想还有更糟糕的命运呢。我的漂亮脸蛋也维持不了太久——虽然看起来光彩照人，但担任王室的侍从并不是可以一辈子从事的工作啊。嗯。”用你的[pc.armor]这时，特里西亚将双手搭在你的肩上——她的体重其实比她的体型所显示的要重得多，而其中相当一部分重量都集中在她的胸部。这位牛仔姑娘那丰满的胸部紧紧压在你的身上[pc.chest]当她凑过来轻吻你的嘴唇时，她的身体会逐渐但不可避免地把你压倒在床上，那些散发着香气的床单也紧贴着你的身体。 你也不甘示弱，伸手捏了捏她尾巴两侧的肉肉，真切地感受到了那份重量[silly |一块上等的A5级和牛牛肉 |一位身材窈窕的牛仔姑娘 ]特里西亚似乎很乐意让你来主导这件事，而你也确实这么做了……

rows.original: Tricia might be solid, but the very same weight that keeps her in place also means that she's hard to stop once she gets moving. She makes the mistake of pressing a bit too intently than is for her own good, and you're able to redirect her momentum to the side in a roll, diverting her path instead of directly countering it. She kicks and squeals in surprised delight, but you hold on firmly, and after a short tussle she's the one on her back in the perfumed sheets. "Here, I've got something you've probably never tasted before," you say, producing a bottle of Ice Wine, fresh from the Frostwood. "Would this suit you?"
    
    Tricia's eyes go wide. "I've only ever heard of such a thing before," she murmurs, taking the bottle. "Princess Varena read about it in a book from before the Godswar. I never imagined... I, uh, th-thank you. It more than suits me. In fact... After you break bread with the king, come and find me. I'll be allowed to take a break to eat while the other guests are, and... we can get away, if you're serious about it."
rows.translation:
“来，我这儿有点你大概从没尝过的东西，”你说道，拿出一瓶刚从霜木林带来的冰酒。“这个合你意吗？”
    
    特里西亚瞪大了眼睛。“这种东西我以前只听说过，”她接过瓶子，低声说道。“瓦蕾娜公主在一本神战之前的书里读到过它。我从没想过……我，呃，谢、谢谢你。它对我来说再合适不过了。其实……等你和国王一起用过餐之后，来找我吧。其他宾客用餐的时候，会允许我休息一会儿吃点东西，而且……如果你是认真的，我们可以溜出去。”

rows.original:
"I suppose dinner's next on the agenda?" you ask.
    
    [flags.KM_FEAST_HERALD_ABOUT_HER
        |Tricia
        |The herald
    ] gives a crisp nod. "It should be served about now, actually. I believe you [party.som
        |
        |two 
        |and your companions 
    ]have been given pride of place at the king's own table." She gestures to the high table just off the side of the great hearthfire, where you can see a number of servants hurriedly bussing huge trays of meat, fruit, and roasted veg to it. The king and his coterie of patricians are very slowly migrating in that direction, laughing and slapping each other on the back like it's the good old days.
    
    Calise [party.has calise
        |takes your hand. "Come, let us join them! I for one am positively famished."
        |waves you over from among them.
    ]
    
    You head on over to the high table, and one of the servants seats you at the king's left hand, with Calise at his right.[flags.KM_FEAST_MIMI_DINNER| Mimi is, as promised, sat beside you.][party.hasCompanions| Your own companion[party.som|| is|s are] seated at the high table as well.] Across the table are the city's noteworthies: [flags.KM_FEAST_KHAIUS|Senator Khaius|a senator], [flags.HADRED_MET|General Grune|a general], and the princess. A pair of seats remain pointedly open between them. 
    
    [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED
        |"Champion," the king says cooly as you sit.
        |"Ah, Champion [pc.name], join us!" the king says as you sit. You're given a friendly slap on the back, and a glass finds its way into your hand.
    ]
    
    "My friends, countrymen, champions!" the king says, voice carrying across the great hall. Other guests take their seats. He raises a glass, sweeping his other hand across an entire roast pig set out on his table, mirroring those on the others. "Thank you again for joining me. I hope you can forgive the meagerness of our feast tonight."
    
    He's answered with chuckles and returned salutes. 
    
    "Though conflict comes to the doors of our kingdom, let us take tonight to remember that we hold strong, united as one against a common enemy. Our foe is most monstrous, the likes of which have not been seen since the Living Gods revealed themselves to us, but Khor'minos has never suffered defeat in war. We shall not buck that trend now! As the city's patricians, it is on our shoulders that the fate of thousands rest. And so I invite you all to dine with me tonight, to celebrate our champions and our generals, those whose courage and sacrifice has kept the city safe from the claws of monsters most foul; to whose swords the demon queen and all her minions will soon fall!"
    
    "To the death of Master Tollus," Calise adds, raising her glass. "And all those who have betrayed us to the demons."
    
    The king and champion are answered with claps and cheers, and a great deal of drinking. 
    
    All around you, beautiful cowgirls sit on the laps of huge, barrel-chested bulls; wine vanishes by the gallon down parched throats. The party's beginning in earnest now! [livrea.met
        |Livrea
        |A red-headed bard
    ] begins to play a beautiful melody, a soft undercurrent to the building chorus of chatting voices and clattering silverware. Beside you, the king slices off a particularly succulent slab of pork and deposits it on his daughter's plate, and then does the same for the rest of his guests at the high table. He serves himself last, loading a plate with slices of fatty pork and mushrooms glazed her herbs and butter.
rows.translation:
我想接下来该吃晚餐了吧？”你问道。
    
    [flags.KM_FEAST_HERALD_ABOUT_HER
        |特里西亚
        |传令官
    ]点了点头，说道：“其实现在应该就可以上菜了。我相信你[party.som
        |
        |两个 
        |以及你的同伴们 
    ]这些美食被特意安排在国王的餐桌上。”她指向那位于巨大壁炉旁的高桌——在那里，你可以看到许多仆人正匆忙地将装满肉类、水果和烤蔬菜的大托盘端往那里。国王和他的贵族朋友们正缓缓地向那个方向移动，他们一边笑着，一边互相拍打后背，仿佛回到了那些美好的旧日时光。
    
    卡莉丝[party.has calise
        |牵着你的手说：“来吧，我们加入他们吧！我可真是饿坏了。
        |从人群中向你招手。
    ]
    
    你走向高桌，其中一名仆从将你安排在国王的左侧，而卡莉丝则坐在国王的右侧。[flags.KM_FEAST_MIMI_DINNER| 咪咪果然如约坐在了你身边。][party.hasCompanions| 你自己的伙伴[party.som|| 是|这些就是。]也坐在高桌旁。]坐在桌子对面的，是这座城市中那些值得关注的人物们： [flags.KM_FEAST_KHAIUS|凯厄斯参议员|一位参议员]， [flags.HADRED_MET|格鲁纳将军|将军]还有那位公主。在他们中间，特意留着两把空椅子。 
    
    [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED
        |冠军，”国王在你坐下时冷静地说道。
        |啊，冠军[pc.name]，过来，和我们一起喝吧！”国王说道，当你坐下时，他友好地拍了拍你的背，然后一杯酒就被递到了你手中。
    ]
    
    我的朋友们，同胞们，勇士们！”国王的声音在大厅中回荡。其他宾客纷纷入座。他举起酒杯，同时用另一只手扫过自己桌上摆放的整头烤猪——这些烤猪与其他宾客桌上的摆设一模一样。“再次感谢大家能前来与我共庆。希望你们能原谅我们今晚宴席的简陋。
    
    他只是轻笑着回应，然后也回以敬礼。
    
    “尽管冲突已经降临到我们的王国门口，但让我们借着今晚的时刻，铭记我们都是团结一致的，共同面对共同的敌人。我们的敌人极其凶残，这样的敌人自从‘现世神祇’向我们显现以来，就已经很久没有出现了……但是，科尔米诺斯在战争中从未遭受过失败。我们现在绝不能违背这一趋势！作为这座城市的贵族，成千上万人的命运都寄托在我们的肩上。因此，我邀请大家今晚与我共进晚餐，庆祝我们的英雄和将军们——正是他们的勇气与牺牲，才使这座城市免受那些邪恶怪物的侵害；不久之后，恶魔女王和她的所有爪牙都将败在他们的剑下！"
    
    为托勒斯大师的英灵干杯！”卡莉丝举起酒杯说道，“也为了所有那些把我们出卖给恶魔的人。”
    
    国王和冠军的发言引发了阵阵掌声和欢呼，人们也开始大量饮酒。
    
    周围，美丽的牛仔姑娘们坐在那些胸膛宽厚的公牛腿上；葡萄酒如流水般被人们灌进干渴的喉咙。这场派对，真正开始了！ [livrea.met
        |莉维娅
        |一位红发吟游诗人
    ]一段美妙的旋律开始流淌，这轻柔的音乐为人们交谈的声音以及银器碰撞发出的声响增添了别样的韵味。在你身旁，国王切下一块格外多汁的猪肉，将其放在女儿的盘子里，然后也为高桌上的其他宾客做了同样的事。最后，他才为自己服务，将一些裹着香草和黄油的肥肉片和蘑菇盛到自己的盘子里。

rows.original:
Just as you're all starting to dig in, another warrior ascends the stairs to the high table, removing his helm to reveal a completely human face. A half-minotaur!
    
    "Ah, the horse-lord finally deigns to join us!" the king says, beckoning the man to sit. "Join us, general, please."
    
    "My king," the man says, nodding crisply. "My apologies for my delay. The Crown Prince-"
    
    [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED
        |"Yes, how is my son?" the king says, casting a momentary glance in your direction. 
        
        The soldier pauses. "He should be joining us shortly."
        |"Is my son finally joining us?" Kelsaz laughs. 
        
        The soldier pauses. "He should be here shortly."
    ] The soldier extends a hand to you as he takes his place. "My apologies that I missed introductions earlier, Champion. I am Raqian Ignafaerus."
    
    "[pc.name]," you say, though you suppose introductions on your end are unnecessary. 
    
    As you clasp wrists with Raqian, you notice that he's not wearing the usual panoply of a Minoan soldier: his armor is gold-burnished and intricate, patterned with veins of crystal, and the only iconography he wears is a horseshoe amulet around his neck. He's got a number of geometric white tattoos across his rich brown skin,[var0| reminding you of a certain [var1|pair of horse-girls|horse-girl] and] giving him a shamanic air. Though he's not quite as tall as most of the full-blooded minotaurs, his grip is just as strong as the biggest of them.
    
    "Raq here commands the palace's defenses," the king says. "He has been charged with my safety since we were boys, above even the Royal Chargers."
    
    "You're not a Charger?" you ask. 
    
    Raqian shakes his head. "No, no. Though my wife commands the Royal Auxiliary Corps. Close enough, taal?"
    
    Princess Varena pats one of the half-mino's biceps. "And she still won't even accept my letters of application!"
    
    "You will have to take that up with your father, princess," Raqian laughs. "Though the Corps would benefit greatly from your magic, I am sure."
    
    The king squints at him across the table, then takes a long swig of wine.
rows.translation:
正当众人开始大快朵颐时，另一名战士登上通往主桌的阶梯。他摘下头盔，露出一张完全属于人类的脸。是个半弥诺陶洛斯！
    
    “啊，马之领主终于肯赏光加入我们了！”国王招呼男子落座，“将军，请坐。”
    
    “陛下。”男子干脆利落地点头，“请原谅我来迟了。王储——”
    
    [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED
        |“对了，我儿子怎么样了？”国王说道，目光短暂地扫过你。
        
        士兵停顿了一下。“他很快就会过来。”
        |“我儿子终于肯来了吗？”凯尔萨兹笑道。
        
        士兵停顿了一下。“他很快就会到。”
    ]士兵一边落座，一边向你伸出手。“抱歉，先前没能参加介绍，冠军。我是拉奇安·伊格纳法鲁斯。”
    
    “我叫[pc.name]。”你说道，尽管想来自己并不需要介绍。
    
    你与拉奇安握住彼此的手腕时，注意到他并未穿着米诺斯士兵惯用的全套军装：他的铠甲被打磨成金色，工艺精巧，上面织有水晶般的纹路；身上唯一的标志，是颈间一枚马蹄护符。他浓郁的棕色皮肤上遍布几何形状的白色纹身，[var0|让你想起某[var1|一对马女|一位马女]，也]赋予他一种萨满般的气质。虽然他不如大多数纯血弥诺陶洛斯高大，握力却丝毫不逊于其中最魁梧的战士。
    
    “拉奇负责王宫防务。”国王说道，“自从我们还是男孩时起，他便受命保护我的安全，地位甚至高于王家冲锋者。”
    
    “你不是冲锋者？”你问道。
    
    拉奇安摇摇头。“不，不是。不过，我的妻子统领王家辅兵军团。也差不多了，对吧？”
    
    瓦蕾娜公主拍了拍这位半弥诺陶洛斯的肱二头肌。“可她到现在还是不肯接受我的入队申请！”
    
    “这件事您得去找您的父亲商量，公主。”拉奇安笑道，“不过，我确信您的魔法会让军团受益匪浅。”
    
    国王隔着桌子眯眼看向他，随后灌下一大口葡萄酒。
