rows.original:
"Well," Calise says, pushing her chair back. "With the horse-lord and my fellow Champion here, I think the king is safe enough that I can excuse myself for a bit."
    
    "You've hardly eaten, Calise!" the king says, gesturing to the food, and then pausing to blink when he realizes that in the time Raqian took to introduce himself, the paladin has completely cleared her plate. 
    
    She gives him a smug grin and stands. "[pc.name], come and find me when you're done with dinner. There's something I'd like to show you here in the palace while we have the chance."
    
    "Ah, the gardens, I imagine!" the king says. "They are a wonder of your god's own work, Calise."
    
    "Do not put your ancestors' magewrights down, King Kelsaz," she says in answer. "They are owed as much credit as any god for the wonders of the city."
    
    Kelsaz chuckles. "You do us much honor, Champion. Very well, go, but I expect you back when the dancing begins!"
    
    "Of course, good king. I would not miss it," Calise says, bowing to the royal bull[calise.fucked
        | so deep that you're given a good look at her breasts beneath her loose toga
    ]. "Especially given that [pc.name] and I have the dance of honor tonight."
    
    "I think there'll be a queue for both of you," Princess Varena says. "[var0
        |I know I'm eager to borrow [pc.name] from you!
        |[pc.mf
            |Perhaps I'll have the honor of dancing with [pc.name] myself!
            |I'm sure my brother will be hungry for a chance to dance with you, [pc.name]!
        ]
    ]"
    
    Calise gives you a wink and slips away, heading towards the gallery hall.
rows.translation:
“嗯，”卡莉丝说着，把椅子往后推。“有这位马王和我的冠军同僚在这里，我想国王已经足够安全，我可以失陪一会儿了。”
    
    “你几乎什么都没吃啊，卡莉丝！”国王指着食物说道，随后却眨了眨眼停住了——他意识到在拉奇安自我介绍的工夫里，这位圣骑士已经把盘子吃得干干净净。 
    
    她朝他得意地一笑，站了起来。“[pc.name]，等你吃完晚饭就来找我。趁我们还有机会，我想让你看看宫殿里的某样东西。”
    
    “啊，我猜是那些花园吧！”国王说道。“它们可是你们那位神明亲手造就的奇观，卡莉丝。”
    
    “别贬低您祖先的魔法工匠，凯尔萨兹国王，”她回答道。“这座城市的种种奇观，也该和任何神明一样归功于他们。”
    
    凯尔萨兹轻笑了一声。“你真是让我们倍感荣幸，冠军。好吧，你去吧，不过舞会开始的时候，我希望你已经回来了！”
    
    “当然，好国王。我不会错过的，”卡莉丝说着，向那头皇家公牛鞠了一躬[calise.fucked
        | 弯得那么深，让你顺着她宽松的托加衫好好看清了她的胸部
    ]。“尤其是考虑到今晚[pc.name]和我要跳荣誉之舞。”
    
    “我看想和你们二位跳舞的人得排长队了，”瓦蕾娜公主说道。“[var0
        |我知道我早就想从你那儿把[pc.name]借走了！
        |[pc.mf
            |或许我能有幸亲自和[pc.name]共舞！
            |我相信我弟弟一定很渴望有机会和你共舞，[pc.name]！

rows.original:
"Calise and I are putting together what forces we can for the next push against the demons," you tell the nobles. "General Grune wishes to volunteer his men."
    
    "Does he?" Kelsaz says, glancing across the table at the general. He snorts, less with derision and more from weariness, and rubs at his face. "Ever since the war began, you've been finding new ways to try and browbeat me into letting you kill yourself and your men."
    
    "My king," Grune rumbles, "we are fighting a war, and we aren't winning. Neither are the demons, but it's our people who are losing. Fighting with a hand tied behind your back is-"
    
    "Enough!" Kelsaz snorts. "I have given you my answer more times than I should be required to, general. This is crossing into the realm of insubordination. Your men are engineers, sappers, builders; I need them safe, for when this war is over and we mean to rebuild. They're the last members of the Royal Legions that should be seeing combat!"
    
    "[pc.isDK
        |They want to fight, damn it,
        |Respectfully, your majesty, they want to fight,
    
    ]" you say. "They're soldiers, and they've been sidelined while their home is under siege."
    
    The king growls deep in the back of his throat. "While our lines hold, I will not sacrifice the future of the kingdom for a swifter victory today."
    
    "Dad..." Varena says softly. "I understand why you don't want them to fight, but Hadred's right. We're not going to win this war if you keep holding so much of your strength back."
    
    "Now my own daughter, too!" Kelsaz says, clearly pained. "[flags.KM_FEAST_AUXILIARY_RECRUITED
        |I have already given you Raq and his men just now! Have you not taken enough? No more!"
        |[var0
            |You've caused enough mischief today, Champion! There will be no more men for you to take from right in front of me!"
            |[var1
                |A little early to be taking [pc.hisHer] side in arguments, isn't it, Rena?"
                
                Varena flutters her lashes at her father, and he sighs. "Damn it all, I'm outnumbered at my own table! Fine, fine. Take them, Champion. But use them gently: I send with you not fighters, but scholars and engineers. The future of our city."
                |[pc.isCunning
                    |I can see I am outnumbered!"
                    
                    "Just like your city, King Kelsaz," you observe. "Let me and General Grune work to even the odds a little."
                    
                    Kelsaz groans. "Fine! Fine, you win, Hadred. Take them, Champion. But use them gently: I send with you not fighters, but scholars and engineers. The future of our city."
                    |I've heard enough of this before the party, and I'll hear no more of it now or I'll start sending people to the stockades! My word is final: Grune, you will stay in the city!" 
                ] 
            ] 
        ] 
    ]
    
    The king slumps back and takes up a goblet of wine. "Now that's the end of it!"

卡莉丝和我正在集结我们所能动用的一切力量，为下一次对抗恶魔的行动做准备，”你对贵族们说道，“格鲁恩将军也表示愿意自愿派出他的部队。”

“是吗？”凯尔萨兹一边说，一边瞥了一眼桌对面的那位将军。他哼了一声，那声音里更多的是疲惫，而非嘲笑，然后揉了揉脸。“自从战争开始以来，你们就一直在想各种办法，试图胁迫我允许你们去送命。”

“我的国王，”格鲁恩沉声道，“我们正在打仗，但却没有取得任何胜利。恶魔也不是这样的，真正失败的是我们自己的人。在双手被束缚的情况下战斗，那简直就是——”

“够了！”凯尔萨兹厉声说道，“将军，我已经回答了你太多次了。这种行为已经属于违抗命令了。你的手下都是工程师、工兵和建筑工人；我必须保证他们的安全，因为等到这场战争结束，我们就要开始重建了。他们可是皇家军团中最后一批应该上战场的成员啊！[pc.isDK
        |他们就是想打架，真是的。
        |恭敬地禀告陛下，他们想要战斗。
    
    ]你说得对。他们是士兵，而他们的家园正在遭受围攻，他们却只能被搁在一边。”

国王从喉咙深处发出低沉的声音：“只要我们的防线能够坚守，我就不会为了今天的短暂胜利而牺牲王国的未来。”

“爸爸……”瓦蕾娜轻声说道，“我理解你为什么不想让他们参战，但哈德雷说得对。如果你继续压抑自己的力量，我们是无法赢得这场战争的。”

“现在连我自己的女儿也这么说了……”凯尔萨兹明显感到痛苦。[flags.KM_FEAST_AUXILIARY_RECRUITED
        |我刚才已经把拉奇和他的手下们都交给你了！难道还不够吗？不要再要了！
        |[var0
            |冠军，你今天已经惹够了麻烦了！在我眼前，再也没有男人可以让你抓走了！
            |[var1
                |现在就拿走有点早吧。 [pc.hisHer]总是在争论中插手，不是吗，蕾娜？”

瓦蕾娜轻轻眨了眨眼，她的父亲叹了口气：“该死，就连在自己的家里我也处于劣势！好吧，随你吧，冠军。但一定要小心使用他们：我派去的是学者和工程师，而不是战士——他们可是我们城市的未来啊。
                |[pc.isCunning
                    |我看我的人数确实处于劣势啊！”

“就像你的城市一样，凯尔萨兹国王，”你说道，“让我和格鲁恩将军想办法扭转这个局面吧。”

凯尔萨兹叹了口气：“好吧！随你的便，哈德雷德，把这些人都交给你吧，冠军。但一定要小心使用他们：我派去的不是战士，而是学者和工程师——他们可是我们城市的未来啊。
                    |在聚会之前我就已经听够了这些话，现在我不会再听下去了，否则我就把这些人关进栅栏里！我的决定是不可更改的：格鲁恩，你必须留在城里！ 
                ] 
            ] 
        ] 
    ]
    
    国王向后一靠，拿起一杯酒说道：“就这样，一切都结束了！

rows.original: "How did you first meet Calise?" you ask the king. "Ah! It feels like an age ago now," he says, taking another drink. "But it was only just after the demons began their attacks, in the aftermath of that terrible blizzard. The Second Legion's prime cohort was nearly overrun in Khor'varna, taken completely off-guard by the demons. They fought well, sacrificing much to evacuate the townsfolk, but the city's walls only came up halfway to the cavern ceiling; they had no defense against hordes of flying monstrosities except their own armor and shields! Their centurion went down in the opening volleys, carried off by a horde of imps, and his second was afflicted by magic that left him writing incoherently on the ground. Calise appeared in the confusion — I am told she came running out of an inn wearing nothing but her smallclothes — and rallied the troops still standing. She brought order to chaos and saved countless lives. Or souls, at any rate." Varena rests her chin in her hands. "Our soldiers were very lucky that the Champion of the Treelord happened to be staying in that inn, just as the war broke out." Raqian nods gravely. "Fortunate, or blessed. Velun saw to our protection in our day of need. May his roots grow ever-outward." "Velun and his Champion!" Kelsaz says. "Indeed, Calise sent the demon's general, that black-armored fiend leading the horde of imps to Khor'varna, to flight that day. What a clash of axe and spell that must have been!" Black-armored fiend? That sounds like the bloody-handed demonic warrior you saw down at the docks. "But she didn't kill the demon's general?" "Alas not," Varena says. "It would have saved us a lot of headache if she had. Thus far,[flags.RQ2_ALISSA | [alissa.alive |aside from your capture of Queen Alissa, |aside from your dispatch of Queen Alissa, ] ] the entirety of the demons' leadership has evaded us." Raqian steeples his fingers. "I worry about this demon queen of theirs, Kasyrra. We have yet to face her on the field of battle. Only the forces of her subordinate, Master Tollus, have revealed themselves." "Clearly she quakes in fear at the prospect of facing down the city's defenses," [flags.HADRED_MET |General Grune |the other soldier at the table ] snorts. [flags.KHAIUS_MET |Khaius |The senator sitting with you ] laughs. "Oh, yes, I'm sure. More likely she's too balls-deep in captive cows to be bothered." The king glowers. "Watch your tongue, Khaius. My daughter's sitting right there." "And your daughter understands what this war means for the kingdom," Varena says. "And the people the demons take captive. Vrannus hasn't held back in describing to me where imps come from." You clear your throat. "So, you met Calise..." "Ah!" the king nods. "After her victory at Khor'varna, the legion withdrew to the city and presented their champion — their words, in fact, without knowing who she was. I was prepared to offer a simple traveler a heap of gold and a title for what she had done — imagine my shock when she revealed that she was the divine champion of Velun himself, here at her god's behest. It was cause for celebration! But Calise is a humble woman indeed; she refused coin and feasting, and asked only that I give her some of my soldiers to lead in her own campaign." "Gods know there's enough of us sitting around," [flags.HADRED_MET |General Grune |the general ] grumbles. Varena pats his shoulder. "Calise's been waging a private war against the demons ever since. The legions are all locked defending the tunnels, but we do have a lot of fighting men and women outside their ordered ranks who have been able to contribute. And more still that would like to." "Do you know anything about her, from before she came to the city?" you ask. "Only that she's young, and of the Valgar tribes," Kelsaz says. "Our neighbors to the far south produce stout folk indeed." "I had heard she had marefolk blood," Raqian says. Kelsaz laughs. "Ah, yes, my friend. I remember the disappointment in your face when that rumor proved untrue." The king leans in conspiratorially. "You see, my dear friend here loves horse-women." Raqian rolls his eyes. "Forgive a man for having patrician tastes." Khaius says, "Well I heard Calise's axe is a holy artifact, and her armor's proofed against dragonsfire. The story around the bath house is that her ancestors were wyrmriders. Apparently her clan in the forest was known for it, back when dragons were real. Can you imagine it? Riding through the heavens on the back of a beast that could shake the mountains? The power!" "With that kind of power, we could end the war overnight," Varena says. "Unfortunately, the only dragon any of us are likely to see is the skull in Daddy's gallery." "[pc.ra dragon |I think [pc.name] will do just fine," the king says, giving your wings a pat. |Perhaps," the king agrees, "but the power to slay them is impressive enough. Calise certainly carries herself with the confidence of a dragonslayer!" ] "No argument there," the princess says.
rows.translation: 你最初是怎么遇到卡莉丝的？”你问国王。 “啊！那感觉仿佛已经是很久以前的事了，”他一边说，一边又喝了一口酒。“但那是在恶魔开始发动攻击之后，就在那场可怕的暴风雪过后不久。在第二军团的主力部队在科尔瓦纳遭到袭击时，他们完全陷入了恶魔的突然袭击之中。尽管他们英勇奋战，付出了巨大的牺牲才成功疏散了城中的居民，但那座城市的城墙仅仅建到了洞穴天花板的一半高度；除了自身的盔甲和盾牌之外，他们根本没有任何手段来抵御那些成群结队的飞行怪物！他们的百夫长在最初的交火中阵亡，被一群小恶魔拖走了；而他的副官则中了魔法，导致他无法正常思考，只能在地上胡乱写字。在这片混乱中，卡莉丝出现了——据有人说，她当时只穿着内衣从一家旅馆里跑了出来——她重新整顿了那些还坚守阵地的士兵。她将混乱重新带入秩序，拯救了无数生命。或者说，拯救了无数灵魂。 瓦蕾娜将下巴搁在双手上，说道：“我们的士兵真是太幸运了——就在战争爆发的时候，树王冠军恰好住在那家客栈里。” 拉基安严肃地点了点头：“可以说是幸运，也可以说是天佑。在我们最需要的时候，维伦给予了我们保护。愿他的根基越发壮大。 维伦和他的勇士！”凯尔萨兹说道，“的确，卡莉丝派出了那个恶魔将军——那个身穿黑色铠甲、率领着一群小恶魔的凶魔，让他们在那天逃离了霍尔瓦纳。那场斧头与法术的交锋，一定十分激烈吧！” 黑色铠甲的凶魔？听起来不就是你在码头看到的那个双手沾满鲜血的恶魔战士吗？“但她并没有那么做杀死那个恶魔的将军吗？” “唉，并不是，”瓦蕾娜说道，“如果她是的话，就能让我们省去很多麻烦了。到目前为止[flags.RQ2_ALISSA | [alissa.alive |除了你们俘虏了艾莉莎女王之外， |除了你派遣艾莉莎女王这件事之外， ] ]所有恶魔的首领们都已经躲开了我们的追击。” 拉基安双手交叉抱胸：“我真的很担心他们那位恶魔女王卡希拉。我们至今还没有在战场上与她正面交锋过，只有她手下的托勒斯大师的军队露过面。” “显然，一想到要面对这座城市的防御力量，她就吓得不敢轻易出手了。 [flags.HADRED_MET |格鲁纳将军 |桌旁的另一名士兵 ]哼了一声。 [flags.KHAIUS_MET |凯乌斯 |那位与您坐在一起的参议员 ]笑着说道：“哦，当然，我敢肯定。更有可能的是，她现在正忙于照顾那些被圈起来的牛，根本无暇顾及这些事情。” 国王怒目而视：“注意你的言辞，凯乌斯。我的女儿就在旁边坐着呢。” “而且你的女儿也明白这场战争对王国意味着什么，”瓦蕾娜说道。还有那些被恶魔抓走的人们。弗兰努斯毫不保留地向我描述了那些小妖怪的来历。” 你清了清嗓子，问道：“那么，你见过卡莉丝了……” “啊！”国王点了点头，“在她在Khor’varna取得胜利之后，军团便回到了城里，并将他们的冠军带了回来——事实上，他们当时并不知道那个人的真实身份。我本来准备用大量的黄金和一个头衔来奖励这位普通的旅人，以表彰她的所作所为——可当她告诉我，她是维伦神的使者，是受神之旨意来到这里的神圣勇士时，我简直惊呆了！这真是值得庆祝的事情啊！但是卡莉丝确实是个谦逊的女性；她拒绝了金钱和宴席，只要求我派一些士兵给她，让她自己带领军队去作战。 “天知道，像我们这样的士兵多得是。 [flags.HADRED_MET |格鲁纳将军 |将军 ]哼哼。” 瓦蕾娜轻拍着他的肩膀：“从那以后，卡莉丝就一直在暗中与那些恶魔作斗争。所有的军团都被派去防守那些隧道了，但我们确实在他们正式的编制之外，也有许多男女战士愿意为团队做出贡献。而且，还有更多的人渴望这样做。 “你对她来这座城市之前的事情了解些什么吗？”你问道。 只是她年纪还小，而且属于瓦尔加尔部落，”凯尔萨兹说道，“我们南边的邻居们确实生养出了强壮的子民。” “我听说过她身上流淌着马人的血液，”拉基安说道。 凯尔萨兹笑了：“啊，没错，我的朋友。我还记得当那个谣言被证明是虚假的时候，你脸上流露出的失望之情。”国王凑近了一些，神秘兮兮地说道，“你知道的，我亲爱的朋友喜爱女骑兵。” 拉基安翻了个白眼：“请原谅一个男人有着贵族般的品味吧。” 凯乌斯说道：“嗯我听说卡莉丝的斧头是一件神圣的神器，而她的盔甲也能抵御龙火。关于那座浴场，有传言称她的祖先曾是驾驭巨龙的骑士。显然，在巨龙还真实存在的时代，她所在的森林部落就以这种传统而闻名。你能想象吗？骑在那种能够撼动山岳的巨兽背上，在天空中翱翔……那种力量啊！ “拥有这样的力量，我们可以在一夜之间结束这场战争，”瓦蕾娜说道，“可惜，我们当中任何人很可能永远都见不到真正的龙了，只能通过爸爸收藏的那些龙骨来想象它们的存在罢了。" "[pc.ra dragon |我想是这样。 [pc.name]这样就可以了，”国王一边说，一边轻拍着你的翅膀。 |也许吧，”国王同意道，“但那种能够杀死它们的力量确实令人印象深刻。卡莉丝表现得确实像一个真正的屠龙者一样自信！ ] 这一点没什么好争论的，”公主说道。

They fought well, sacrificing much to evacuate the townsfolk, but the city's walls only came up halfway to the cavern ceiling; they had no defense against hordes of flying monstrosities except their own armor and shields! Their centurion went down in the opening volleys, carried off by a horde of imps, and his second was afflicted by magic that left him writing incoherently on the ground. Calise appeared in the confusion — I am told she came running out of an inn wearing nothing but her smallclothes — and rallied the troops still standing. She brought order to chaos and saved countless lives. Or souls, at any rate." Varena rests her chin in her hands. "Our soldiers were very lucky that the Champion of the Treelord happened to be staying in that inn, just as the war broke out." Raqian nods gravely. "Fortunate, or blessed. Velun saw to our protection in our day of need. May his roots grow ever-outward." "Velun and his Champion!" Kelsaz says. "Indeed, Calise sent the demon's general, that black-armored fiend leading the horde of imps to Khor'varna, to flight that day. What a clash of axe and spell that must have been!" Black-armored fiend? That sounds like the bloody-handed demonic warrior you saw down at the docks. "But she didn't kill the demon's general?" "Alas not," Varena says. "It would have saved us a lot of headache if she had. Thus far,[flags.RQ2_ALISSA | [alissa.alive |aside from your capture of Queen Alissa, |aside from your dispatch of Queen Alissa, ] ] the entirety of the demons' leadership has evaded us." Raqian steeples his fingers. "I worry about this demon queen of theirs, Kasyrra. We have yet to face her on the field of battle. Only the forces of her subordinate, Master Tollus, have revealed themselves." "Clearly she quakes in fear at the prospect of facing down the city's defenses," [flags.HADRED_MET |General Grune |the other soldier at the table ] snorts. [flags.KHAIUS_MET |Khaius |The senator sitting with you ] laughs. "Oh, yes, I'm sure. More likely she's too balls-deep in captive cows to be bothered." The king glowers. "Watch your tongue, Khaius. My daughter's sitting right there." "And your daughter understands what this war means for the kingdom," Varena says. "And the people the demons take captive. Vrannus hasn't held back in describing to me where imps come from." You clear your throat. "So, you met Calise..." "Ah!" the king nods. "After her victory at Khor'varna, the legion withdrew to the city and presented their champion — their words, in fact, without knowing who she was. I was prepared to offer a simple traveler a heap of gold and a title for what she had done — imagine my shock when she revealed that she was the divine champion of Velun himself, here at her god's behest. It was cause for celebration! But Calise is a humble woman indeed; she refused coin and feasting, and asked only that I give her some of my soldiers to lead in her own campaign." "Gods know there's enough of us sitting around," [flags.HADRED_MET |General Grune |the general ] grumbles. Varena pats his shoulder. "Calise's been waging a private war against the demons ever since. The legions are all locked defending the tunnels, but we do have a lot of fighting men and women outside their ordered ranks who have been able to contribute. And more still that would like to." "Do you know anything about her, from before she came to the city?" you ask. "Only that she's young, and of the Valgar tribes," Kelsaz says. "Our neighbors to the far south produce stout folk indeed." "I had heard she had marefolk blood," Raqian says. Kelsaz laughs. "Ah, yes, my friend. I remember the disappointment in your face when that rumor proved untrue." The king leans in conspiratorially. "You see, my dear friend here loves horse-women." Raqian rolls his eyes. "Forgive a man for having patrician tastes." Khaius says, "Well I heard Calise's axe is a holy artifact, and her armor's proofed against dragonsfire. The story around the bath house is that her ancestors were wyrmriders. Apparently her clan in the forest was known for it, back when dragons were real. Can you imagine it? Riding through the heavens on the back of a beast that could shake the mountains? The power!" "With that kind of power, we could end the war overnight," Varena says. "Unfortunately, the only dragon any of us are likely to see is the skull in Daddy's gallery." "[pc.ra dragon |I think [pc.name] will do just fine," the king says, giving your wings a pat. |Perhaps," the king agrees, "but the power to slay them is impressive enough. Calise certainly carries herself with the confidence of a dragonslayer!" ] "No argument there," the princess says. '

rows.original: "So, you're the king's bodyguard?" you ask, turning towards Raqian. "That's a lot of responsibility." "For a half-minotaur, right?" he says, with a hint of a smirk. "Don't worry, I get that question a lot. My father was the prefect of Khor'talosa, and fought with the legions during the campaigns against the bandit-kings in the south. He was the legate-commander of the Fighting Fifth for three years." "Already the horse-lord sells himself short," the king laughs. "The town of Khor'talosa is my family's ancestral holding. The House of Ignafaerus and my own have been closely allied since the shamans lead our ancestors to the stone in the age of myth! It is to their family that we turned to govern our lands when Keldoran the Bard become Keldoran the King!" Raqian nods. "True, every word of it. Still, to the point, during the last campaign he oversaw my father captured a reaver stronghold and from its depths liberated a Velunite priestess they had enslaved. A human, as you might guess. Hence, me." He spreads his hands. "Then how," you ask, "does a half-minotaur half-human get the title of horse-lord?" "He loves horses," Kelsaz grins. His bodyguard thumbs his horseshoe amulet. "I do, very much so. On my own campaigns as a young officer, I diverted my troops from their march to protect a village of marefolk from a horde of Wraithspawn that had crawled up from old Imperial ruins near to Maidenbridge. The chieftain gifted me her youngest daughter as thanks, and-" "Don't you mean daughters?" Varena teases. Raqian puts up a hand. "No, just the one. Her cousins joined us later, after we'd moved back to the city. But yes, I love them, and I love my daughters. Any moniker that earns me, I wear proudly." Varena stage-whispers, "His daughter made that pendant for him." "Hashat's had a talent for shaping stone and metal since she was a child," Raqian says, holding the amulet up. It appears to be made of crude unalloyed iron, but the workmanship in its shaping is undeniable. You'd only recognize it as anything but a horseshoe up close by the geometric lines that make up its arch, much like its owner's tattoos, rather than a true curve. "I wish she had taken that apprenticeship with Master Vitruvius, but wanderlust runs in the heart of every marefolk in her youth." [flags.HASHAT_FUCKED |You blink. "Wait, Hashat? I know that she-stallion!" Raqian laughs. "Yes, you do! I wasn't sure you were the [pc.name] she mentioned in her letters, but she sung your praises. I'm glad she's meeting people of good caliber out there." |[flags.HASHAT_MET |You blink. "Wait, Hashat? I know her!" Raqian raises a brow. "You do? Good to know my youngest is meeting people of your caliber out on her grand adventure, at least!" | ] ] "Does she get that talent from you?" you ask. Raqian is certainly muscled like a smith. He shakes his head, though. "Her mother's side. My wife has a powerful lineage of earth-shamans behind her. Though she's been kind enough to teach me what of her talents she can," he says, running two fingers along the tattoos covering his mighty bicep. His muscles flex, and you can see the flesh of his arm hardening until it takes on a granite-like hue and heft. Princess Varena gives his arm a squeeze, and there's not even a hint of give to him. "You've got to teach me that spell, Raqian!" the princess says. The general nods, releasing the spell. His flesh slowly softens in her grasp. "Next time we hit the gym, we'll work that in."
rows.translation: 所以，你是国王的保镖？”你转向拉奇安问道，“责任可不小啊。” “对于一个半弥诺陶洛斯来说，确实是这样吧？”他带着一丝笑意说道，“别担心，这个问题我经常被问到。我的父亲曾经是Khor'talosa的省长，在南方与那些土匪国王作战时，也率领军队参与过战斗。他担任第五战队的指挥官长达三年之久。” “这个马夫未免太低估自己了，”国王笑道，“科塔尔osa小镇是我们家族世代拥有的领地。自从远古时代萨满们引导我们的祖先找到那块神秘石碑以来，伊格纳法鲁斯家族与我们家族就一直保持着密切的联系！正是他们的家族，让我们在吟游诗人凯尔多兰成为国王之后，得以依靠他们来管理我们的土地！” 拉克安点了点头。“确实，每一句话都是事实。不过，值得一提的是，在上次战役中，他亲自指挥，让我的父亲攻占了掠夺者的据点，并从那里解救出了一名被他们奴役的维伦信徒女祭司。一个人类，你大概也能猜到吧。所以，就是我。”他摊开了双手。 “那么，”你问道，“这个半牛半人的生物是如何获得这个称号的马主他非常喜欢马，”凯尔萨兹笑着说。 他的保镖摸了摸自己佩戴的马蹄形护身符，继续说道：“我确实很喜欢。在我年轻时担任军官期间，有一次我让部队暂时停止行军，去保护一个马人村庄，让它们免受一群从梅登布里奇附近的古老帝国遗迹中涌出来的幽灵生物的侵袭。那位部落首领为了表示感谢，把她最小的女儿送给了我……” “你的意思是女儿们？”瓦蕾娜戏弄道。 拉基安举手道：“不，就那个。她的。表亲们在我们搬回城市之后，他们才加入我们的行列。不过，我确实爱他们，也爱我的女儿们。任何能让我获得这些称呼的方式，我都引以为豪。” 瓦蕾娜小声说道：“是他女儿为他制作了那个吊坠。” “从小时候起，哈莎特就具备塑造金属和石头的天赋，”拉基安一边说着，一边举起那个护身符。它看起来是由纯铁制成的，但制作工艺确实非常精良——只有专业人士才能看出它的价值。但是那马蹄的形状，在构成其弧度的几何线条附近，更像是它的主人身上的纹身，而非真正的曲线。“我真希望她能去跟随维特鲁维乌斯大师学习，但每个年轻的女马人心中都怀有游历天下的渴望。 [flags.HASHAT_FUCKED |你眨了眨眼，说道：“等等，哈莎特？我认识那头母马！” 拉基安笑了起来：“没错，你确实认识！我之前还不确定你是否记得呢。那个 [pc.name]在信中提到了你，而且对她赞不绝口。我很高兴她能遇到一些品行高尚的人。 |[flags.HASHAT_MET |你眨了眨眼，说道：“等等，哈莎特？我认识她！” 拉克安挑了挑眉毛：“你认识她？那真是太好了，至少我的小女儿在她的这段冒险旅程中，能够遇到像你这样的人！ | ] ] 她的这种天赋是遗传自你的吗？”你问道。拉基安的确有着铁匠般强健的肌肉。 但他摇了摇头：“是她母亲那一方的遗传。我的妻子拥有强大的地灵萨满血脉。虽然她也很慷慨地把我能学会的她那些能力传授给了我，”他说着，用两根手指轻轻抚过自己结实二头肌上的纹身。他的肌肉开始收缩，你可以看到他手臂上的肌肉逐渐变得坚硬，甚至呈现出类似花岗岩般的质地和重量。瓦蕾娜公主捏了捏他的手臂，但他的手臂丝毫没有丝毫松动。 “你一定要教我这个咒语，拉基安！公主说道。” 将军点了点头，解除了咒语。在他的手中，自己的身体逐渐变得柔软起来。“下次我们去健身房的时候，一定要好好锻炼这个部位。

rows.translation: 询问关于拉奇安的事宜

rows.original: "Tell me about your wife's Royal Auxiliaries, General?" The king grunts. "Oh, no, don't start! Varena'll start asking to join it again." "I have every right to!" Varena huffs. "You had no problem with my younger brothers joining the legions, while I'm the one that knows magic!" "You're not your brothers," the king says grimly. Varena crosses her arms under her chest and pouts, looking pointedly away from her father. Raqian clears his throat. "To your question, Champion... the Royal Auxiliary Corp is the third branch of our military, beside the legions and the navy. It is a force of volunteers, both citizens and foreigners, who provide supporting forces to the legion's heavy infantry: skirmishers, scouts, mages, and warrior-priests. It is a way for citizens that cannot fight in the legion's shield wall, or who have skills that are more valuable than their sword arm, to serve the kingdom — and for those born outside the kingdom to prove their loyalty, and earn citizenship upon their honorable discharge." "And is the corps engaged with the legions now?" you ask. "I understand they're all tied up in the tunnels." "Some of them — my wife's deployed most of our mages and clerics, but there are many good soldiers that don't have a place in tight tunnel-fighting: archers, artillery-mages, cavalrymen... they are unfortunately of little use when the shield wall marches through the dark." Perhaps you could recruit them, then, if they're not otherwise occupied... "I wish," Varena says, "that we could fight these demons aboveground! Away from our homes! The legions own the tunnels, sure, but the battlegrounds are our towns and farms. Your auxiliaries are hardly the only ones cooped up in the city, Uncle Raq. Er, General Raqian." Raqian puts a gentle hand on her shoulder. "Don't we all, little princess. Unfortunately, our enemies have the advantage of numbers and their dark sorcery. Only by using the tunnels to our advantage have we secured what victories we have." "But how can you hope to win the war just fighting on the defensive?" you ask him. He shakes his head. "Winning the war, I leave to the king's wisdom and Calise's skill at arms." The king knocks back the rest of his wine and grabs another goblet from a servant girl. "The king's wisdom is to leave the war-fighting to his generals and his champions. Tell me, Champion of Frost, what would you do, if you walked with my hooves? What is your winning strategy to put an end to this war?"
rows.translation: “将军，跟我说说你妻子统领的王家辅兵吧？” 国王哼了一声。“哦，不，别起这个头！瓦蕾娜又要申请加入了。” “我完全有权这么做！”瓦蕾娜气呼呼地说，“你让几个弟弟加入军团时可一点意见都没有，可明明是我懂得魔法！” “你和弟弟们不一样。”国王严厉地说道。 瓦蕾娜双臂抱在胸下，撅起嘴，故意把脸转向远离父亲的方向。 拉奇安清了清嗓子。“回答你的问题，冠军……王家辅兵军团是我军继军团和海军之后的第三个兵种。这支志愿部队由本国公民和外国人共同组成，为军团重装步兵提供支援力量：散兵、斥候、法师以及战斗祭司。无法在军团盾墙里战斗的公民，或者才能比剑术更有价值的人，可以通过这种方式为王国效力；出生在国外的人则可以借此证明忠诚，并在光荣退役时获得公民身份。” “辅兵军团现在和正规军一同参战吗？”你问道，“我听说他们全都被牵制在隧道里。” “一部分——我妻子部署了我们的大多数法师和祭司，但还有许多优秀士兵在狭窄的隧道战中无处发挥：弓箭手、炮兵法师、骑兵……盾墙在黑暗中推进时，他们很遗憾地派不上多少用场。” 这么说来，要是他们没有其他任务，也许你可以招募他们…… “我真希望，”瓦蕾娜说道，“我们能在地面上与这些恶魔作战！远离自己的家园！军团确实控制着隧道，可战场却是我们的城镇和农场。被困在城里的可不只有你的辅兵，拉奇叔叔。呃，拉奇安将军。” 拉奇安轻柔地将手放在她肩上。“小公主，我们谁不希望如此呢。可惜，敌人在数量和黑暗巫术上占据优势。正因为利用了隧道的地利，我们才取得了现有的胜利。” “但只靠防守，你怎么可能赢得战争？”你问他。 他摇摇头。“如何赢得战争，就交给国王的智慧和卡莉丝的武艺吧。” 国王一口喝光剩下的葡萄酒，又从侍女手中接过另一只高脚杯。“国王的智慧，就是把打仗交给将军和冠军。霜之冠军，告诉我，如果你站在我的立场上，会怎么做？你会采用什么必胜策略终结这场战争？”

rows.original: You have to deal with the demons' leaders if you want to beat the horde.
rows.translation: 如果你想击溃这支恶魔大军，就必须先解决掉它们的首领。
rows.raw: "You have to deal with the demons' leaders if you want to beat the horde."

rows.original: The Kingdom must draw the demons into a pitched confrontation on the surface, where the full might of its army can be brought to bear decisively.
rows.translation: 王国必须将那些恶魔引诱到地表进行一场决定性的决战，在那里，它的全军力量能够得到充分发挥，从而取得决定性的胜利。
rows.raw: "The Kingdom must draw the demons into a pitched confrontation on the surface, where the full might of its army can be brought to bear decisively."

rows.original: There's no hope of victory while the demon's tendrils are sunk into the underbelly of Khor'minos. This party is degenerate, and it's time the king came to realize it.
rows.translation: 只要恶魔的触手还深入科尔米诺斯的腹地，就没有任何获胜的希望。这个政党已经堕落了，是时候让国王认清这一事实了。
rows.raw: "There's no hope of victory while the demon's tendrils are sunk into the underbelly of Khor'minos. This party is degenerate, and it's time the king came to realize it."

rows.original: Draw the demons in, and shatter their armies against the walls of Khor'minos. Damn the costs.
rows.translation: 把那些恶魔吸引进来，让他们的军队在科尔米诺斯的城墙前溃败吧。管他什么代价呢。
rows.raw: "Draw the demons in, and shatter their armies against the walls of Khor'minos. Damn the costs."

rows.original: The Legions have a massive disadvantage in battle against demons: imps. You've got to root out and destroy their breeding pits, or any victory will be meaningless a week later!
rows.translation: 在与恶魔的战斗中，军团面临着一个巨大的劣势——那些小恶魔。你必须彻底消灭它们的繁殖地，否则哪怕现在取得了胜利，一周后也将会毫无意义！
rows.raw: "The Legions have a massive disadvantage in battle against demons: imps. You've got to root out and destroy their breeding pits, or any victory will be meaningless a week later!"

rows.original: Deciding where and how the Legions fight isn't your business.
rows.translation: 决定军团该在何处以及如何作战，这并不属于你的职责范围。
rows.raw: "Deciding where and how the Legions fight isn't your business."

rows.original:
"We have to take out their leaders," you tell the table. "We'll never win while the imps and demons are united behind strong leaders. Take them out, and the horde will break."
    
    The king grunts. "Assassination leaves a poor taste, but you aren't wrong. The enemy seems a poorly organized rabble; without their queen and master to hold them together with a firm hand..."
    
    Kelsaz steeples his fingers under his chin, falling into silent rumination. Varena cuts a glance at you and frowns.
rows.translation:
“我们必须除掉他们的领袖，”你对在场的众人说道，“只要那些小恶魔和恶魔还团结在强大的领袖身后，我们就永远无法取胜。把他们干掉，那支大军就会分崩离析。”
    
    国王哼了一声。“暗杀这种事让人心里不太舒服，但你说得没错。敌人看起来就是一群组织松散的乌合之众；要是没有他们的女王和主子用铁腕把他们拢在一起……”
    
    凯尔萨兹十指交叉抵在下巴下，陷入了沉默的沉思。瓦蕾娜瞥了你一眼，皱起了眉头。

rows.original: "The tunnel fighting only postpones the inevitable," you tell the table. "If you want victory, you must draw the demons in a decisive battle. A battle on the surface, where the full might of your army can be brought to bear." The king frowns. "And leave the city exposed in the process. What is to stop the demons from declining the battle, and scampering back into the tunnels? They'll fly faster than the legions can march." "Hammer and anvil, then," Raqian says, clenching a fist. "Clear the demons from the tunnels, into the waiting arms of the Champions' forces. Kelsaz, give the word and I would join them with the full might of the Auxiliary. We'll darken the skies with arrows and run down whatever survives with our cavalry." "Let me join them, father!" Varena pleads. "Please, [pc.name] can keep me safe if we take the field together!" Kelsaz smacks a hand down on the table. "No!" He grimaces at the sight of his daughter recoiling. "Varena. No. You are too precious to risk, no matter-" "Every life is precious!" she counters. "Why should mine matter more than any soldier's?" "Don't be childish, Varena. You know why." Kelsaz runs his hands across his face. "Raqian, when the time comes, you have my permission to mobilize the Auxiliary. Every fighter not already committed to supporting the legions. If it comes to a hammer and anvil, you, your wife, and her soldiers will go with Lady Calise to the surface." Raqian bows his head. "So it shall be."
rows.translation: “隧道战只能推迟不可避免的结局。”你对桌边众人说道，“如果想获胜，就必须把恶魔引入一场决战。一场在地面进行、能让军队全部力量得以施展的战斗。” 国王皱起眉头。“这样会让城市暴露在危险中。要是恶魔拒绝交战，又溜回隧道怎么办？它们飞得比军团行军快。” “那就用锤砧战术。”拉奇安攥紧拳头，“把恶魔从隧道里赶出来，送到冠军部队张开的怀抱。凯尔萨兹，只要你一声令下，我便会率辅兵军团全军加入他们。我们会用箭矢遮蔽天空，再让骑兵追杀所有幸存者。” “父亲，让我和他们一起去吧！”瓦蕾娜恳求道，“求你了，只要[pc.name]和我并肩上阵，就能保护好我！” 凯尔萨兹一掌拍在桌上。“不行！” 看见女儿畏缩，他露出痛苦的表情。“瓦蕾娜，不行。你太宝贵了，不能拿来冒险，无论——” “每条生命都很宝贵！”她反驳道，“我的命凭什么比士兵的命更重要？” “别耍孩子气，瓦蕾娜。你知道为什么。”凯尔萨兹双手抹过脸庞。“拉奇安，时机到来时，我准许你动员辅兵军团。召集所有尚未被派去支援正规军的战士。如果我们真要采用锤砧战术，你、你的妻子和她麾下的士兵就跟随卡莉丝女士前往地面。” 拉奇安低下头。“谨遵旨意。”

rows.original: "If you want to win, you can't let your kingdom continue to be undermined by the demons. Look at this party," you say, sweeping a hand around the half-naked women and bare-chested men at the feasting tables. "Your city's nobility have slid into corruption and degeneracy, ripe for the demons to take control." The king snarls. "You dare?" "Daddy! [pc.HeShe]'s right," Varena says. "Open your eyes for half a minute and look at the people in the palace. I have more clothes on than half a dozen of the patricians' daughters put together, and I've got so much cleavage even then!" She really does. [flags.KHAIUS_MET|Senator Khaius|The senator at her side] frowns. "Princess, don't be so judgemental! Your own father and brother have both encouraged the people of the city to take pride in themselves in these trying times. Let them show a little skin, what's the harm? Only a [pc.mf |man |woman ] with something to hide would say that's akin to submitting to the demons." "Khaius is right," the king says. "Varena, I respect your desire to keep to the old fashions, but don't blame girls for following the current trend. And [pc.name], such accusations are out of place. This war has put pressure on my people that you cannot imagine..." Varena groans. "Daddy, come on! [pc.name] isn't just being a stick in the mud. There is something wrong in the city. The demons aren't just being kept outside the walls." "What do you expect me to do? Start an inquisition?" "If that's what it takes," you say. "The war outside is only part of the demons' game. You've heard the story of what happened to Njorhaalt. Even if you yourself are untouched, your court clearly hasn't been." Khaius snorts. "You're out of line, Champion." The king puts up a hand. "No, no, [pc.name] is correct. I dislike it, but it's true — this has happened before; the subversion of our northern neighbor's aristocracy. Raqian, my friend, when the party's done... I'd like you to form a council to start looking into this. Bring in Lady Juno and Captain Fenraus; their soundness of mind are beyond reproach." Raqian nods. "It shall be done, my king." "And [pc.name]," the king says. "I apologize for my outburst. It can be difficult to remember that I am not always the wisest man in the room."

rows.original: "You're ignoring the biggest advantage you have," you tell the table. "Khor'minos itself. I've seen the huge cavern out there, and the city's titanic walls. Keeping the demons from bringing the fight to the city just delays their defeat. Smash them against the walls!" The king snorts. "You forget, Champion — demons fly." "And I've seen nets all over the noble quarter," you counter. "See to the rest of the city. You just need to delay them long enough to snipe them down!" [flags.HADRED_MET |General Grune |The general across from Raqian ] scowls. "That's not how that works, Champion. Our city's defenses are rock-solid against an attack from the ground, but if a swarm of imps gets into the city-cavern, we're going to struggle to pick them out of the sky. The nets will stop a few that manage to evade our scorpions and archers, not a concentrated attack by thousands of monsters. The sheer weight of bodies will bring the whole thing down." "General Grune has it right," the king says glumly. "Perhaps," Raqian says, "if we could fashion a done of stone above the walls..." Grune groans. "That is also not how that works, Raq. The walls couldn't bear the weight." "Hmm..."

rows.original: "No victory is going to outlive the week as long as the demons are still breeding imps [silly |on an industrial scale |faster than you can train up new soldiers ]. We know the demons are putting a concentrated effort into making their imps; we have to find where they are and smash them there before we can think about anything else." The king frowns, brow furrowing. "Yes, that's the issue we've been butting our horns against. The demons replace their numbers endlessly." "And our soldiers take months to train," Raqian says. "So long as we have grown men to replace those we lose." You nod. "So we have to do something to stop their numbers growing so quickly! Calise doesn't have the soldiers to do it, and the legions are backed up in the tunnels." "But the Auxiliary is only half-deployed," Raqian finishes. "Perhaps my wife and I could aid the champions in their quest, my king?" Kelsaz steeples his fingers. "Very well. If the Champion means to go after the, ech, breeding grounds, [pc.heShe] will need all the help [pc.heShe] can get. The Auxiliary is well suited to the offense. Ride the fiends down where they live, Raq." Raqian thumps a fist against his breastplate. "It will be done, my king. Give the word, [pc.name], and my wife and I will marshal the Auxiliary to join you in the field."

There've been attacks on my character from all sides practically since I was born, painting me as some degenerate party animal or shameless womanizer. I've got no shortage of cousins, and a few younger brothers, who I'm sure would love to see their path to the throne cleared at my expense."
        
        Vrannus lifts a hand to silence the conciliations about to pour forth from his lady-suitors. "It's not as though I was helping myself much in my youth. There's certainly a grain of truth in any rumor you may hear about my misadventures... but only a grain, I assure you. Little was expected of me save my continued existence as a youth. I'll admit to being a bit of a rapscallion at times!"
        
        The girls around him giggle. Several voices assure him that he was the model of a gentleman.
        
        "You're certainly popular with the ladies," you observe. 
        
        The Crown Prince's lips twitch. "Ah, well, what beautiful maiden of the mountains does not yearn to be a princess — and some day, a queen? I've no doubt that Father will choose someone in this very room to be my consort someday. But truthfully," he says, looking amongst the scantily-dressed noble cowgirls around him, "I prefer the friendship of a fine lady who can hold a conversation about more than just the happenings of the legions and the Senate. Patrician men are either dreadfully boring or incorrigibly exciting, and there's hardly any middle ground between them!"
        
        "I'm afraid," he says, "beyond that, I'm not sure what else to say! I'm hardly half as interesting as a vaunted champion!"
    ]

rows.original: "Are you and the king very close?" you ask him. Vrannus thumps a hand on one of his tiny biceps. "You have to ask, since we don't exactly look like gym partners, right? Ha! [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |Don't worry, just about everyone's had their giggle about that at some point. |I'm sure you don't think much of me, do you? ] I don't know what god I pissed off to be stuck with this figure rather than Father's. The man's got the stature of a hill troll, and here I am so skinny..." "No, you're beautiful!" one of the cowgirls protests. "We love you just the way you are," another insists. The Crown Prince ruffles the hair of the latter. "I'm just lucky that Father scooped up all the noble ladies that love muscle into his harem already. I'm left with the lean-beef-enjoyers to fawn over me!" He gives the lass a wink and pats her cheek. "No, I'm happy enough being different from the rest of my family. My dear twin, Varena, got enough strength for the both of us! She and Father are regular fixtures at the palace gym. Me? I'd prefer to lounge in the library and enrich my most powerful muscle!" [pc.isBimbo |"Your dick?" you ask innocently. Vrannus giggles so hard he has to hide his face behind his hands. Several of the cows around you look positively scandalized, but the majority join the prince in laughing — no doubt they've been thinking about the princely scepter for a long time now. "I meant my brain," Vrannus finally manages to say. |"Your brain?" you venture, resisting the urge to boop the prettyboy on the noggin. He answers with a smirk. ] "It is the best part of me, I'm told. I've always been a scholar of sorts, though where my sister delved into the mysteries arcane, I have a penchant for history and philosophy... and a bit of poetry, but just don't ask for an impromptu composition." "But you're so good at those!" a cowgirl says. Vrannus grimaces. "There's entirely too much pressure with the Champion here! Ah! But you asked about my father, no? What's there to say, you met the man: he's brilliant and wise and very, very strong. Everyone loves him, from the generals to the priests to the common man. rows.translation: “你和国王关系很亲密吗？”你问他。 弗兰努斯用一只手拍了拍自己那细小的二头肌。“你非得问这个，毕竟我们看起来可不像一起健身的搭档，对吧？哈！[flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |别担心，几乎每个人在某个时候都拿这件事笑过。 |我敢肯定，你对我没什么好印象，对吧？ ]真不知道我得罪了哪位神明，才落得这么一副身板，而不是父亲那样的。那男人有着山丘巨魔般的身量，而我却这么瘦弱……” “不，你很美！”一位女牛仔反驳道。 “我们就喜欢你现在的样子，”另一位坚持道。 王储拨了拨后者的头发。“我只是运气好，父亲早就把所有喜欢肌肉的贵族小姐都收进了后宫。留给我的只有那些喜欢精瘦款的女人来追捧我了！”他朝那姑娘眨了眨眼，拍了拍她的脸颊。“不，能和家里其他人不一样，我已经很满足了。我亲爱的双胞胎妹妹瓦蕾娜，她的力气够我们俩一起用！她和父亲是王宫健身房的常客。我呢？我更愿意窝在图书馆里，充实我最强大的那块肌肉！” [pc.isBimbo |“你的鸡巴？”你天真地问道。 弗兰努斯笑得直不起腰，只好用双手捂住脸。你周围的几名牛仔女孩一脸震惊，但大多数都跟着王子一起笑了起来——毫无疑问，她们惦记那根王储的权杖已经很久了。 “我是说我的脑子，”弗兰努斯终于说出话来。 |“你的脑子？”你试探道，强忍住想戳一下这个帅哥脑门的冲动。 他咧嘴一笑，算是回答。 ] “据说它确实是我身上最棒的部分。我一直算是个学者，只不过我姐姐钻研的是奥术的奥秘，而我偏爱历史和哲学……还有一点点诗歌，但千万别让我即兴作诗。” “可你明明很擅长这些啊！”一位牛仔女孩说道。 弗兰努斯苦着脸。“有冠军在这儿，压力实在太大了！啊！不过你问的是我父亲，对吧？有什么好说的呢，你也见过他了：他英明睿智，而且非常、非常强壮。从将军到祭司再到平民百姓，人人都爱戴他。更难得的是，他本身还是个相当善良的人！毫无疑问，在这场风暴中能有父亲掌舵，我们都很幸运。”

rows.original:
"Can we talk about your sister?" you venture.
    
    [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED
        |The Crown Prince curls his nose. "You've butted into my family's affairs more than enough, haven't you? I certainly won't be gossiping about my twin!"
        |"Ah, my dear twin," Vrannus says fondly, idly playing with the hair of one of the cowgirls beside him as if it were Varena's. "She's the royal family's greatest treasure, nevermind golden harps and enchanted laurels. Brilliant, talented, strong... just like Father. I couldn't be more proud of her." 
        
        "I take it you're close?"
        
        Vrannus glances away. "As much as we can be, but Varena and I move in different circles. She's ever the tomboy, spending her time either in the gym or learning her spells, while I deal with scholars and civil leaders... and spend entirely too much time massaging the egos of patricians' sons." He laughs, leaning against the throne. "The Crown Prince snubbing the companionship of a noble's heir is a social deathblow to any house, you know, so I'm always being dragged out here and there."
        
        The cowgirls make reassuring noises at him, but you get the feeling from his overdramatic sighing that he probably doesn't mind half as much as he lets on.
        
        "So, why do you ask?" Vrannus counters. "[pc.mf
            |Hoping I can help you win the first princess's hand, perhaps?
            |Looking to become friends with the first princess, are you?
        ] Ha, I only jest, Champion. Though I'm sure you can imagine, there's no shortage of [pc.mf
            |young men that lust for poor Varena's hand, though she's never given even one her favor. It's practically scandalous.
            |ladies in the court that seek her companionship, but in this, too, she's the opposite of me — always reclusive when she can be.
        ]"
        
        "You make her sound like a hermit."
        
        Vrannus waves a hand. "Nothing so drastic! She handles herself just as well as I do in public — and unlike me, she actually shows up on time!" The cows giggle at his expense. "But I know her better than anybody, and that means I know she'd rather be anywhere else than a huge party full of strangers, whereas I'm in my element."
        
        "Aw, she looks so happy," one of the cowgirls protests.
        
        The Crown Prince pats her head. "No, no. Trust me, she'd prefer to be somewhere alone with her art, no matter how good a face she puts on about this sort of thing. Really, I wonder if we'll keep seeing her at these events..."
    ]
rows.translation:
“我们能聊聊你妹妹吗？”你试探着开口。
    
    [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED
        |王储皱了皱鼻子。“你插手我家的事已经够多了，不是吗？我才不会去嚼我双胞胎妹妹的舌根！”
        |“啊，我亲爱的双胞胎妹妹，”弗兰努斯深情地说道，随手拨弄着身旁一位牛仔女孩的头发，仿佛那是瓦蕾娜的头发。“她才是王室最珍贵的宝物，比什么金色竖琴和被施了魔法的月桂冠都重要。聪明、有才华、强壮……就像父亲一样。我为她骄傲得无以复加。” 
        
        “我猜你们关系很亲近？”
        
        弗兰努斯把目光移开。“也就只能亲近到这个程度吧，瓦蕾娜和我身处不同的圈子。她一向像个假小子，时间不是花在健身房里，就是用来学法术，而我则要和学者、民政领袖打交道……还要花多得离谱的时间去哄那些贵族子弟的自尊心。”他笑着靠在王座上。“你知道，王储要是冷落了某位贵族继承人的结交，对那个家族来说就是社交上的致命打击，所以我总被拖着到处应酬。”
        
        那些牛仔女孩纷纷出声安慰他，但从他那夸张的叹气里你感觉到，他大概远没有表现出来的那么在意。
        
        “那么，你为什么问这个？”弗兰努斯反问道。“[pc.mf
            |是希望我能帮你赢得第一公主的芳心吗？
            |是想和第一公主交个朋友，对吧？
        ]哈，我只是开个玩笑，冠军。不过你肯定能想象得到，从来不缺[pc.mf
            |觊觎可怜的瓦蕾娜的年轻男子，可她连一个人都没看上过。这简直成了丑闻。
            |想和她结交的宫廷贵妇，但在这件事上她也和我正相反——只要有机会就总是躲着不见人。
        ]”
        
        “你把她说得像个隐士。”
        
        弗兰努斯摆了摆手。“哪有那么夸张！她在公众场合应付得和我一样好——而且不像我，她还真会准时到场！”那些牛仔女孩都笑他。“但我比谁都了解她，所以我知道，比起满是陌生人的大型宴会，她宁愿待在别处，而我却在这种场合如鱼得水。”
        
        “哎呀，她看起来多开心啊，”一位牛仔女孩反驳道。
        
        王储拍了拍她的头。“不，不。相信我，比起这种场合，她更愿意一个人待着搞她的艺术，不管她在这种事上装得多若无其事。说真的，我在想以后这些活动还能不能见到她……”
    ]

rows.original: "What've you been up to during this war?" you ask him. "[pc.isDK |You don't have the build for fighting. |No offense, but you don't strike me as a warrior. ]" "No, and I'm glad for it," Vrannus snorts. "If I was a meat head like my sister, I'd probably have been charging off to fight the demons the moment they sprang up. Luckily for the kingdom, I'm [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |more than just a pretty face |a lover and a thinker ]. Father can take credit for the national quarantine, but bringing everyone into Khor'minos City — the only place with walls and soldiery enough to withstand the monsters — was my quick thinking. The rest of the kingdom was built to stand impregnable in the face of Belharan hoplites or Jassiran slave-soldiers... hordes of winged demons slinging sex magic everywhere bypassed our defenses easily." Several of the cowgirls start chirping about how clever and smart he is, but Vrannus waves them off. "Of course, the brave soldiers of the kingdom deserve moooost of the credit. After all, they're the ones who got everyone safely into the city despite constant danger and dreadful carnal temptations. And let's not forget, they're still doing the same thing today. [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |I know you have been buddy-buddy with Lady Calise, but while she's been leading her own strike force, the bulk of the legions have been fighting tooth and horn to plug the tunnels leading to the city proper. Even more than your no-doubt tremendous prowess, it's their tenacity that has kept us all safe. |Not to downplay your own accomplishments, nor Lady Calise's, but the legions have been fighting tooth and horn to plug the tunnels leading to the city proper. Their tenacity has been the difference between this city remaining a bastion of purity and falling to the horde. ]" "I'm sure," you say. "The soldiers aren't the only ones keeping busy, of course. I've had my hands full ensuring the city can withstand all these extra mouths flooding in. Khor'minos City wasn't built to hold this many people, and our supply lines have been squished down thinner than vellum. Somebody's got to make sure people have food to eat, and that there's enough water to go around for everyone. Lucky us, there were new aqueducts built just recently to supply the bath houses..." Vrannus pauses. [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |"I think that about sums things up." |"And that's not all I've done, of course. Father asked me to lead a conclave of our scholars and priests, looking into the nature of these demons. I'm sure you've noticed, but the succubi and imps we fight today aren't the shadowy blobs of obliteration that demons are described as in the legends. And they don't produce Wraith-touched creatures when they take victims, but rather twist folk into more of themselves. Perverse reproduction. In order to defeat our enemy, we must understand our enemy. That grim task has fallen to me." ]
rows.translation: 在这场战争期间，你都干了些什么？”你问他。[pc.isDK |你的身体条件并不适合进行战斗。 |无意冒犯，但在我看来，你并不像是个战士。 ]不，我反而为此感到高兴，”弗兰努斯哼道。“如果我像我姐姐那样是个头脑简单的家伙，那么那些恶魔一出现，我可能就会冲上去与它们战斗了。对王国来说，幸好我不是那样的人。 [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |不仅仅是一张漂亮的脸庞 |情人以及一个思考者 ]国家实施隔离措施确实要归功于父亲，但将所有人转移到科尔米诺斯城——这座拥有足够城墙和军队来抵御怪物的唯一城市——这个决定确实是我迅速做出的。王国的其他地区也是为了在面对贝拉兰重装步兵或贾西兰奴隶士兵时能够坚守不落而建造的。……成群结队的有翼恶魔四处释放性魔法，我们的防御措施根本无法阻挡它们。” 几位女牛仔开始夸赞他多么聪明机智，但弗兰努斯摆了摆手：“当然了，王国的勇敢士兵们才应该是受到最多赞誉的人。毕竟，正是他们们在充满危险和种种诱惑的情况下，确保了所有人都能安全地进入这座城市。而且，我们千万不要忘记，直到今天，他们仍在继续做着同样的事情。 [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |我知道你一直和卡莉丝女士关系很好，但在她率领自己的突击队行动的同时，大部分军团成员都在拼命奋战，封锁通往城市中心的隧道。比起你无疑拥有的强大实力，正是他们的坚韧不拔才让我们所有人都得以安全。 |我并不是要贬低你自己的成就，也不是要贬低卡莉丝女士的功劳，但是那些军团一直在拼命战斗，试图封锁通往城市中心的隧道。正是他们的坚韧不拔，才使得这座城市得以继续成为纯洁的堡垒，而没有落入那些敌人的手中。 ]我当然相信，”你说道。 “当然，忙碌的并不只是士兵们。我一直在忙于确保这座城市能够承受这些新增人口带来的压力。科尔米诺斯城本来就不是为容纳这么多人而建造的，我们的补给线也已经被压得薄得像羊皮纸一样了。总得有人确保人们有食物吃，也必须保证每个人都有足够的水喝。幸运的是，最近刚刚修建了新的引水渠，用来为浴场供水…… 弗兰努斯停顿了一下。 [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |我想，这句话已经把一切都概括得淋漓尽致了。 |当然，我做的还不止这些。父亲让我召集我们的学者和牧师们，共同研究这些恶魔的本质。你们应该已经注意到了，今天与我们战斗的那些女妖和小恶魔，并不是传说中那种会吞噬一切的黑暗存在。当它们捕食人类时，并不会产生那些被‘怨灵影响’的生物，而是会将人类变成与它们一样的存在。这是一种扭曲的繁殖方式。要想战胜我们的敌人，我们必须明白我们的敌人。这个艰巨的任务落在了我的肩上。 ]

In order to defeat our enemy, we must understand our enemy. That grim task has fallen to me." ] "

rows.original: "You're quite charming, prince," you tell him. "I'd love to get to know you even better." "[pc.mf |Oh, I'm sure you would... and luckily, the feeling's more than mutual, Champion. I'm sure we'll be fast friends, you and I. I'll be hosting my own little soiree in a couple of days, you know, though it will be gentlemen only." He cuts a glance to the herd of cowgirls ogling him from beneath the dais. "I'll make sure you get an invitation. We'll have a few drinks, swap some stories... you can tell me all about your heroics. I've heard the bard's stories, but I'd love to hear all the saucy details from the man himself." "I'd like that," you say. |Oh, I'm sure, darling. I'll make sure you get an invitation next time I host a tea, and we'll have plenty of time to get to know each other. it might be... after this war is over, though. My time's quite tight these days, you know. As is your own, I'm sure." That... definitely felt like a gentle rejection. ]
rows.translation: “你真有魅力，王子殿下，”你对他说，“我真的很想更深入地了解你。” “[pc.mf |哦，我相信你也会这么做的……而且幸运的是，这种感觉是相互的，冠军。我敢肯定，我们很快就会成为好朋友的。不过，过几天我打算举办一个小型的聚会，只不过只邀请男士参加而已。”他瞥了一眼那些从高台下方注视着他的女牛仔们。“我会确保你们都能收到邀请的。我们会一起喝几杯酒，分享一些故事……你们可以把自己那些英勇事迹都讲给我听。虽然我听过吟游诗人的讲述，但我真的很想亲自听听当事人讲述那些有趣的故事细节。” “我想要那个，”你说道。 |哦，我肯定会的，亲爱的。下次我举办茶会的时候，一定会邀请你来的，这样我们就有足够的时间来互相了解。不过，也许会…… 之后 等这场战争结束以后吧。你知道，这些天我的时间相当紧张，你也是吧。” 那……显然是一种委婉的拒绝。 ]

rows.original: [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED | "Farewell, Champion. I'm sure you'll enjoy the rest of your evening." Vrannus says as you start to leave, cooly turning a shoulder to you and returning to his conversation with the cowgirls. | "A moment, Champion," Vrannus says, brushing a delicate hand across your bicep as you start to turn. "The ladies here have been asking for days now, and I find myself curious as well, if you'd indulge us..." "Asking what?" "Why," Vrannus smiles, "when this nasty little war is finally done with, and if you defeat that damnable demon queen... a hero like you will surely be offered the keys of the city. The hand of any [pc.mf |noble maiden |nobleman ] you might choose, if you wanted it. Everyone's wondering what it is you might ask of Father as your reward once victory is yours." "A little premature, isn't it?" Vrannus grins. "Ah, that's half the fun! Speculating, I mean. While I'd never take part in such a thing myself, there's a little betting pool going on among some of my fellow noblemen that the up-and-coming outlander hero will even dare to ask Father [pc.mf |for my twin sister's hand |to take her as a consort ]! Since none of us are in on the bet," he says, giving the cowgirls around him a wink, "let us in on the answer early, won't you? I promise we won't tell!" Now that's a question. What would you ask of the king, given the chance? ]
rows.translation: [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED | 再见了，冠军。我相信你会享受剩下的晚上的时光的。”当你准备离开时，弗兰努斯如此说道。他冷淡地转过身去，继续与那些女牛仔们交谈。 | 稍等片刻，冠军，”弗兰努斯说道，当你开始转身时，他轻轻地将手放在你的二头肌上。“这里的各位女士已经请求了好几天了，我也感到很好奇……你能否满足我们的请求呢？” “请求什么？” “为什么，”弗兰努斯微笑着回答，“等这场该死的战争终于结束，等你打败了那个可恶的恶魔女王之后……像你这样的英雄，肯定会被授予这座城市的统治权。任何[pc.mf |高贵的少女 |贵族 ]如果你愿意的话，你可以选择任何你想要的东西。大家都在猜测，当胜利属于你之后，你会向父亲请求什么作为奖励。” “现在讨论这个似乎还为时过早吧？” 弗兰努斯笑了：“啊，这才是乐趣所在啊！就是这种猜测嘛。虽然我自己永远不会参与这样的活动，但我的一些贵族朋友们正在打赌，看看这位崭露头角的异乡英雄是否真的会有勇气向父亲提出请求。 [pc.mf |为了娶我的双胞胎妹妹 |娶她为妻 ]因为没有一个我们你们也参与了这个赌注，对吧？”他说着，朝周围的女牛仔们眨了眨眼，“能不能早点告诉我们答案呢？我保证我们不会告诉别人的！” 这问题可真有意思……到底是什么呢？会如果你给国王这个机会，他会怎么做呢？ ]

rows.original: What hero could pass up the opportunity to marry a princess?
rows.translation: 哪个英雄会错过娶公主这样的机会呢？
rows.raw: "What hero could pass up the opportunity to marry a princess?"

rows.original: What hero could pass up the opportunity to marry a prince?
rows.translation: 哪个英雄会错过嫁给王子的机会呢？
rows.raw: "What hero could pass up the opportunity to marry a prince?"

rows.original: Could you really become a royal consort to the king? That has a certain appeal...
rows.translation: 你真的能成为国王的王后吗？这个想法还挺有吸引力的……
rows.raw: "Could you really become a royal consort to the king? That has a certain appeal..."

rows.original: Claiming an estate and the citizenship that comes with it in the greatest kingdom on the continent would be an excellent reward.
rows.translation: 在这个大陆上最强大的王国中认领一处庄园以及随之而来的公民身份，无疑是一份绝佳的回报。
rows.raw: "Claiming an estate and the citizenship that comes with it in the greatest kingdom on the continent would be an excellent reward."

rows.original: All you'd like in return for victory is a sack of cash so big you can barely lift it.
rows.translation: 作为胜利的回报，你所想要的只是一袋多得几乎拿不起来的现金而已。
rows.raw: "All you'd like in return for victory is a sack of cash so big you can barely lift it."

rows.original: You've got your eyes on that golden harp...
rows.translation: 你一直盯着那把金色的竖琴……
rows.raw: "You've got your eyes on that golden harp..."

rows.original: You're on your way to carving out a domain of your own, and recognition as a Marcher-Baron from the largest and most powerful state in the region would go a long way.
rows.translation: 你正在努力开辟属于自己的领域，而获得该地区最大、最强大国家授予的边境男爵头衔，无疑会为你带来巨大的帮助。
rows.raw: "You're on your way to carving out a domain of your own, and recognition as a Marcher-Baron from the largest and most powerful state in the region would go a long way."

rows.original: Financial, and more importantly, civic aid from the Kingdom of Khor'minos to the Barony of Hawkstone could help your adopted homeland regain its fallen glory.
rows.translation: 来自科尔米诺斯王国的财政援助，更重要的是公民援助，能够帮助你们这片被接纳的家园重获昔日的辉煌。
rows.raw: "Financial, and more importantly, civic aid from the Kingdom of Khor'minos to the Barony of Hawkstone could help your adopted homeland regain its fallen glory."

rows.original: You don't want or need anything, thanks.
rows.translation: 你什么都不想要，也不需要，谢谢。
rows.raw: "You don't want or need anything, thanks."

rows.original: The Crown Prince's eyes twinkle. "I had a feeling you'd say that. Not that I secretly bet a thousand hawks on it, mind you, but if I had, I'd be quite pleased with my investment." He grins. "For what it's worth, [pc.mf |I think she'd be quite pleased if you asked |I've long suspected she preferred a woman's company anyway ], though Varena's a prize even Father can't give you. She's one you'll have to earn from the source, such as she is." Vrannus grins. "My sister's always been strong willed. Strong enough to make Father, the king of the greatest realm in all the world, swear to her that she could pick her own partner. Still, I'm sure having his blessing to pursue my sister would give you a great big head start over the competition — and there's a lot of competition. So good luck, Champion. You'll need it!" One of the cowgirls tugs on Vrannus's sleeve, whispering something into the prince's ear. He sighs, and gives you an apologetic look. "My thanks for sating my curiosity, Champion. I'm sure we'll talk again soon, no?" No doubt.
rows.translation: 王储的眼睛闪烁着光芒。“我就知道你会这么说。当然，我并没有偷偷下注一千只鹰作为赌注，但要是真的下了注的话，我肯定会为自己的‘投资’感到非常满意。”他笑着说，“不管怎样[pc.mf |我觉得如果你去问她，她一定会非常高兴的。 |我一直怀疑，她其实更喜欢和女性在一起。 ]不过，瓦蕾娜可不是连父亲都能赐予你的东西。你必须亲自从她手中赢得她，就像她现在这样。” 弗兰努斯笑了：“我妹妹向来意志坚定。她的决心甚至让世界上最大王国的国王——我们的父亲，也答应让她自己选择伴侣。不过，我相信，有了父亲的祝福，你在追求我妹妹的过程中，肯定能比其他竞争者拥有巨大的优势——而且很多竞争将会非常激烈。所以，祝你好运，冠军。你确实需要运气！” 其中一位女牛仔拉了拉弗兰努斯的袖子，在他耳边低语了些什么。他叹了口气，然后向你投来一个歉意的眼神：“感谢你满足了我的好奇心，冠军。我相信我们很快还会再见的，对吧？” 毫无疑问。

rows.original:
The Crown Prince's eyes twinkle mischievously. "[silly
        |Ara ara
        |My, my!
    ] You'd really choose me over my father? [pc.mf
        |Even though we're both boys?
        |Even though I'm so small and dainty compared to most minotaurs?
    ]"
    
    You nod, and the cowgirls around you [silly
        |moo
        |crow
    ] jealously. You're definitely stepping on what every last one of them thinks is potentially her territory.
    
    Vrannus gives you a demure smile and swishes his tail. "Well, you know how to make a boy feel desired, I'll give you that! I look forward to hearing Father's answer when he inevitably asks. [pc.mf
        |Perhaps you and I can arrange a preview of things after this party, hmm? We would need to present a united front, after all, to convince Father to let a man carry off his eldest son! It would be quite the talk of the town, you know. Of course you know... and I'm sure you'd revel in the attention, hmm?"
        |Don't worry about me, though, I long ago told Father he can arrange my marriages however he wants. I'm sure the Champion of Frost will be a heroine he'd not deny.
    ]"
    
    Vrannus giggles. "Thank you for the answer, Champion. I look forward to seeing how things play out."
    
    One of the cowgirls tugs on Vrannus's sleeve, whispering something into the prince's ear. He sighs, and gives you an apologetic look. "My thanks for sating my curiosity, Champion. I'm sure we'll talk again soon, no?"
    
    No doubt.

王储眼中闪烁着顽皮的光芒。“[silly
        |啊啦啊啦
        |哎呀，哎呀！
    ]你真的会选择我，而不是我父亲？[pc.mf
        |哪怕我们都是男孩？
        |哪怕和大多数弥诺陶洛斯相比，我如此娇小纤细？
    ]”
    
    你点点头，周围的母牛姑娘顿时嫉妒地[silly
        |哞哞叫
        |喧嚷起来
    ]。你显然踏进了她们每个人都自认有机会占有的领地。
    
    弗兰努斯矜持地微笑，轻轻甩动尾巴。“不得不说，你很懂得如何让男孩子感到自己被人渴望！父亲最后肯定会来问我，我很期待听见他的回答。[pc.mf
        |也许宴会结束后，你和我可以提前预演一下，嗯？毕竟，要说服父亲同意一个男人把长子带走，我们得统一阵线才行！你知道，这肯定会成为全城的话题。当然，你肯定明白……而且一定会很享受那些关注，对吧？
        |不过别担心我，我早就告诉父亲，他想怎样安排我的婚事都可以。我相信霜之冠军正是一位他不会拒绝的女英雄。
    ]”
    
    弗兰努斯咯咯一笑。“谢谢你的回答，冠军。我很期待看看事情会如何发展。”
    
    一名母牛姑娘拉了拉弗兰努斯的衣袖，贴在王子耳边低语了几句。他叹口气，歉意地看向你。“谢谢你满足我的好奇心，冠军。我们很快还会再谈，对吧？”
    
    这是当然。

rows.original:
"Aha! I knew it," Vrannus grins, tail swishing. "[pc.mf|I've never known Father to take an interest in boys before, but if there's ever one to change his mind, I'm sure it would be you.|A beautiful Champion buoyed by victory and the king who lead the realm through war... you two would make for a couple beloved by all the people. It's enough to make a boy jealous, you know.] Not that you need my approval to chase Father's hand — Tira knows, there's a hundred cows that have sought it recently, and most have gotten it — but you have my approval regardless. I wish you the best in your quest, Champion. I've no doubt you'll make Father very happy."
    
    One of the cowgirls tugs on Vrannus's sleeve, whispering something into the prince's ear. He sighs, and gives you an apologetic look. "My thanks for sating my curiosity, Champion. I'm sure we'll talk again soon, no?"

    No doubt.

“啊哈！我就知道，”弗兰努斯咧嘴一笑，尾巴摆动着。“[pc.mf|我以前从不知道父亲会对男孩感兴趣，但如果真有谁能让他改变主意，我相信那一定是你。|一位因胜利而意气风发的俊美冠军，加上一位带领王国度过战争的国王……你们俩会成为一对受万民爱戴的伴侣。这足以让一个男孩嫉妒了，你知道吗。]你追求父亲的手并不需要我的认可——蒂拉知道，最近有一百头母牛都在追求他，而且大多数都成功了——但无论如何，你都有我的认可。祝你追求顺利，冠军。我毫不怀疑你会让父亲非常幸福。”

    毫无疑问。

rows.original:
"Oh? That's a humble request, all things considered," Vrannus says, almost rolling his eyes. "But I suppose it's very politic, isn't it? Saving the kingdom, then making yourself a new [pc.mf
        |patrician
        |lady of the court
    ]... if you have a mind for such things, I'm sure you'll go far. And even if not, there are plenty of excellent estates now left abandoned by their owners' disappearance. You'll no doubt have your pick of any settlement in the kingdom you might want to settle in. Perhaps that charming little village just outside the walls?" 
    
    [party.has brint
        |Vrannus glances at Brint and wiggles his eyebrows.
    ]
    
    [party.has brienne
        |Vrannus glances between you and Brienne and smirks.
    ]

    No doubt.

rows.original: "For Hawkethorne? Ah, I suppose the barony has fallen quite far from its old glory, hasn't it? Ruins strewn around everywhere, orcs and marauders plaguing the land, to say nothing of demons in the valley... well, I can't speak for Father, but when the immediate emergency here in the city is done with I'll be happy to help however I can. At the very least, I can write a letter to the village alderman after the party and see what it is he thinks he needs to start rebuilding those old Belharan ruins. Our engineers here are quite good at that sort of thing, if he'd accept more direct help." One of the cowgirls tugs on Vrannus's sleeve, whispering something into the prince's ear. He sighs, and gives you an apologetic look. "My thanks for sating my curiosity, Champion. I'm sure we'll talk again soon, no?" No doubt.
rows.translation: “为了鹰棘镇？啊，我想那片男爵领确实已经远不如昔日辉煌了，对吧？到处散落着废墟，兽人和掠夺者肆虐大地，更别提山谷里的恶魔……我不能代父亲作出承诺，不过等城里的燃眉之急解决后，我很乐意尽己所能提供帮助。至少宴会结束后，我可以给村里的长老写封信，问问他认为重建那些古老的贝尔哈遗迹需要什么。要是他愿意接受更直接的援助，我们这里的工程师很擅长做这种事。” 一位牛女拉了拉弗兰努斯的衣袖，在王子耳边低声说了些什么。他叹了口气，歉意地看向你。“感谢你满足了我的好奇心，勇士。我相信我们很快还会再谈，对吧？” 毫无疑问。

rows.original:
"What?" Vrannus blinks. Several of the cows around him moo curiously. "You're risking life and limb — and soul, too — for not just Khor'minos but the Marches as a whole, and you don't want a damn thing for it? Oh, what a bleeding heart you must have, dear Champion. [pc.isDK
        |Or are you just too proud and aloof to take a reward, hmm?
        |Too kind for your own good, I say.
    ]"
    
    He clicks his tongue. "Well, I'm sure... oh, what's that Machan saying? Karma? Karma will reward you in its own way eventually. As will, I'm sure, no shortage of available young [pc.mf
        |ladies
        |gentlemen
    ] throughout the kingdom..."
    
    He titters, covering his mouth behind a hand.
    
    One of the cowgirls tugs on Vrannus's sleeve, whispering something into the prince's ear. He sighs, and gives you an apologetic look. "My thanks for sating my curiosity, Champion. I'm sure we'll talk again soon, no?"
    
    No doubt.

“什么？”弗兰努斯眨了眨眼。他周围的几头母牛好奇地哞哞叫着。“你为了科尔米诺斯，乃至整个边境地区，不惜冒着生命和肢体——还有灵魂——的危险，却什么回报都不想要？哦，你可得有多慈悲啊，亲爱的冠军。[pc.isDK
        |还是说你只是太骄傲、太清高，不肯接受奖赏，嗯？

    ]”
    
    他咂了咂舌头。“好吧，我敢肯定……哦，马昌那句话怎么说来着？因果报应？因果报应最终会以它自己的方式回报你。我相信，王国各地也少不了愿意奉陪的年轻[pc.mf

    他咯咯地笑着，用手捂住了嘴。

rows.original: A strikingly beautiful human woman, raven-haired and remarkably pale, is standing alone among the collection of weapons on display. Her hands are clasped behind her back, and she seems engrossed in examining a pair of war-axes each taller than she is, crossed over an Imperial-era bronze breastplate. You recognize her dark vestments as that of a priestess, though she's baring a bit more skin than most clergy save Mallach's. You suppose courtly fashion strikes even the priestly class.
rows.translation: 一位容貌出众的女性站在陈列着的各类武器之中——她有着乌黑的头发，皮肤异常苍白。双手背在身后，她似乎正在仔细观察那一对比她还要高的战斧，这两把战斧被交叉放在一块帝国时代的青铜胸甲上。你立刻认出她那深色的服饰，那是祭司的装束，不过与大多数神职人员不同，她的衣着暴露得更多。你心想，即使是祭司阶层，也依然会受到宫廷时尚的影响吧。

rows.original:
"[pc.isBimbo
        |Hi hi!
        |Greetings,
    ]" you say, approaching the starkly pale woman in the black robes. 
    
    The priestess glances up, straightening from her examination of the royal weapons display. "Greetings to you, Champion. I'm surprised — shouldn't you be rubbing elbows with the royal family? What has a lowly cleric done to earn a conversation with the [pc.mf
        |man
        |woman
    ] of the hour?"
    
    You shrug. "Something about you caught my eye."
    
    "Odd. I often walk unnoticed in these sorts of events," she says, giving you an easygoing smile and extending a hand. "You may call me Armitia. I represent the Tiran priesthood in the city."
    
    "[pc.name]," you say, not that you need introductions you suppose, taking her hand. 
    
    "[pc.name]," Armitia echoes. "A shame that it takes a war for us to meet."
    
    You nod towards the greataxes she was inspecting a moment ago. "You seem to [pc.isBimbo
        |like big choppers, at least!
        |have an interest in its implements, at least.
    ]"
    
    She chuckles softly. "Oh, yes. The axe is a Tiran's sacred weapon and badge of office. An executioner's implement, a tool, a weapon... though the two-headed Minoan labrys is better suited to ceremony than to war, as the priests of the cathedral outside town found to their detriment. Still, there is no dishonor in defeat when facing a foe of such... otherworldly power as the demon queen herself."
    
    Armitia reaches out and runs her fingers along the long-dulled edge of one of the axes and shakes her head. "Some call Tira the goddess of war, though she herself despises the title. It was her heavy, merciless hand that won the Godswar in the end, when all the kings and wizards and prophets — even the mighty dragons — had been laid low by the demons that ravaged the world." She turns, looking up at the titanic dragon skull behind you. "Who but a god can stand up to a power that can slay a dragon without fear?"
    
    She shakes her head. "Apologies. [silly
        |That was a strange thing to ask. 
    ]I wax philosophical after I've had a few glasses of wine."
rows.translation:
“[pc.isBimbo
        |嗨嗨！
        |你好，
    ]”你一边说，一边走向那个身披黑袍、皮肤苍白得惊人的女人。
    
    女祭司抬起头，不再端详王室兵器陈列，直起了身体。“向你问好，冠军。我很意外——你不是应该和王室成员们交际吗？一介卑微的牧师做了什么，竟有幸和今天的风云[pc.mf
        |人物
        |人物
    ]交谈？”
    
    你耸耸肩。“你身上的某些东西吸引了我。”
    
    “真奇怪。在这种场合，我通常不会引人注意。”她随和地笑着，伸出一只手。“你可以叫我阿米蒂娅。我代表城里的蒂拉祭司团。”
    
    “我叫[pc.name]。”你握住她的手，尽管觉得自己大概没必要自我介绍。
    
    “[pc.name]。”阿米蒂娅重复道，“真遗憾，我们要等到战争爆发才得以相识。”
    
    你朝她片刻前端详的巨斧点点头。“至少你看起来[pc.isBimbo
        |挺喜欢大砍刀！
        |对战争使用的器具颇感兴趣。
    ]”
    
    她轻声笑了起来。“哦，没错。斧头是蒂拉信徒的神圣武器，也是身份象征。它既是刽子手的刑具，也是工具与武器……不过，米诺斯的双刃拉布里斯斧比起作战更适合仪式；城外大教堂的祭司们已经为此付出了代价。尽管如此，面对像恶魔女王本人那样拥有……异世力量的敌人，战败也并不可耻。”
    
    阿米蒂娅伸出手，手指沿着其中一把早已钝化的斧刃滑过，随后摇摇头。“有人称蒂拉为战争女神，尽管祂本人厌恶这个称号。神战末期，国王、巫师与先知，甚至强大的巨龙，都已被肆虐世界的恶魔击倒；最终正是祂沉重而无情的手赢得了战争。”她转过身，仰望你身后的巨大龙首骨。“面对足以毫无畏惧地屠龙的力量，除了神祇，还有谁能挺身抗衡？”
    
    她摇了摇头。“抱歉。[silly
        |这个问题问得有些奇怪。
    ]喝过几杯葡萄酒后，我就容易谈起这些哲理。”

rows.original: Bid farewell to the Tiran cleric.
rows.translation: 向蒂拉教会的牧师道别吧。

rows.original:
"So you're the head of the Tirans in the city?" you ask. "[flags.KM_FEAST_LIVREA_INTERESTING
        |Livrea said all the nuns were cowgirls. So how'd somebody from out of town get put in charge?"
        
        "Ah, Juno's daughter," Armitia says with a fond smile. "A fair question. When the cathedral fell, all those of the faith who survived gathered in the Pantheon of Khor'minos, and a conclave was held to determine who would lead the Tiran church for the duration of the war. I was in the city at the time by pure happenstance, but presented a convincing enough case to my brothers and sisters that I was chosen to lead."
        |You don't look like you're a native."
        
        "Very astute," the human woman says with a hint of a laugh. "I was only in the city by chance when the war began, and the grand cathedral fell. My brothers and sisters in faith gathered here in Khor'minos, and held a conclave to determine who would lead for the duration of this crisis. I was chosen."
    ]
    
    "Where are you from?" you ask.
    
    Armitia considers the question a moment, as though it were difficult. "I was born far, far to the south, across the sea and beyond the sands of Tronarii. I don't know that I would call any one place home. I have always had a wanderer's heart, and choose to spend my days traveling the world... which brought me here, where perhaps I can do some good for the people of this city. The royal family venerate Tira most of all the gods, so it seems only right that I lend them my aid where I am able."
    
    [flags.KM_FEAST_STATUE_CLEANED
        |Considering the state of the statue you found in the royal chapel, perhaps somebody's either strayed from their faith, or become a little too ardent in it.
    ]
    
    "So... are you alone here?"
    
    "Is a priestess ever truly alone, when she has her faith?" Armitia says, giving you a wink. "I suppose I am. I've never been much of one for long-lasting attachments. Such things have a tendency to slip through the fingers like so much sand... so yes, I'm playing lone wolf today, as I usually do."
    
    [party.som
        |"I know the feeling," you say. "I travel light, too."
        
        Armitia nods. "Brave of you, but perhaps a little foolish when you have so many enemies. I'll pray for your success, Champion. Someone ought to."
        |"Sounds lonely," you tell her, glancing back at [comp.name].
        
        Armitia smirks. "Perhaps. Still, Tira is the goddess of entropy and inevitability. And if there is one thing that is, truly, inevitable, it's a parting of ways. I just don't fancy the heartbreak."
        |"Sounds lonely," you tell her, glancing back at [party.compNames].
        
        Armitia smirks. "Perhaps. Still, Tira is the goddess of entropy and inevitability. And if there is one thing that is, truly, inevitable, it's a parting of ways. I just don't fancy the heartbreak."
    ]
rows.translation:
“这么说，你是城里蒂拉信徒的领袖？”你问道，“[flags.KM_FEAST_LIVREA_INTERESTING
        |莉维娅说修女们全都是母牛姑娘。那么，一个外地人怎么会被选为领袖？”
        
        “啊，朱诺的女儿。”阿米蒂娅露出亲切的微笑，“问得很合理。大教堂陷落后，所有幸存的信徒都聚集在科尔米诺斯万神殿，召开会议，决定由谁在战争期间领导蒂拉教会。当时我纯属偶然地身在城中，不过我提出的理由足以说服兄弟姐妹们，因此被选为领袖。
        |你看起来不像本地人。”
        
        “观察得很敏锐。”人类女子带着一丝笑意说道，“战争爆发、大教堂陷落时，我只是碰巧身在城中。我的信仰兄弟姐妹聚集在科尔米诺斯，召开会议，决定在这场危机期间由谁领导大家。最后，他们选择了我。
    ]”
    
    “你来自哪里？”你问道。
    
    阿米蒂娅思索片刻，仿佛这是个很难回答的问题。“我出生在遥远的南方，越过大海，再穿过特洛纳里的沙漠。我不会把任何一个地方称为家乡。我一直拥有一颗流浪者的心，选择终日周游世界……于是来到这里，或许还能为这座城市的人民做些好事。王室成员最为尊崇的神祇就是蒂拉，因此我理应尽己所能向他们伸出援手。”
    
    [flags.KM_FEAST_STATUE_CLEANED
        |想起你在王室礼拜堂发现的雕像，或许有人背离了信仰，也可能有人对信仰过于狂热。
    ]
    
    “那么……你独自一人来到这里？”
    
    “拥有信仰的女祭司，真的会孤身一人吗？”阿米蒂娅说着，朝你眨眨眼。“不过，我想确实如此。我一向不太喜欢维持长久的关系。那种东西往往像一捧沙子般从指缝间溜走……所以，是的，今天我依然像往常一样独来独往。”
    
    [party.som
        |“我懂这种感觉。”你说道，“我也喜欢轻装旅行。”
        
        阿米蒂娅点点头。“很勇敢，不过考虑到你树敌众多，也许有点鲁莽。我会为你的胜利祈祷，冠军。总该有人为你祈祷。”
        |“听起来很孤独。”你回头看了看[comp.name]，对她说道。
        
        阿米蒂娅得意一笑。“也许吧。不过，蒂拉是熵与必然的女神。如果世上真有什么不可避免，那就是分道扬镳。我只是不喜欢心碎的滋味。”
        |“听起来很孤独。”你回头看了看[party.compNames]，对她说道。
        
        阿米蒂娅得意一笑。“也许吧。不过，蒂拉是熵与必然的女神。如果世上真有什么不可避免，那就是分道扬镳。我只是不喜欢心碎的滋味。”
    ]

rows.original:
"You say the royal family keeps your faith, but I found the statue of Tira in their private chapel pretty thoroughly defiled," you whisper to her. "Sexually."
    
    The revelation doesn't seem to shock her. "Sexual defilement seems to be running rampant in this kingdom. In the city. Now, the palace. The minotaurs are indomitable on the field of battle, but they've grown blinded to the fractures in their own society. It's let a corruption sink in, down to the marrow. I'm sure you've noticed it," she says, gesturing to a pair of senators standing a stone's throw away with their chests bare and their togas pulled tight to show off prodigious bulges. 
    
    "You don't exactly seem immune to it yourself," you say, pointing to her nearly-bare hips. 
    
    Armitia laughs. "What, a girl can't show off a little skin? Some even call Tira the Moonlit Seductress, you know. She bids her followers to live life to its fullest, and she herself likes to set an example. Though I'm sure everyone here has their own excuse which sounds just as reasonable in their minds. Embracing sexuality is natural, and there's nothing wrong with it... but to take a page from Mallach's book: going to such blatant excesses is where the problems begin."
    
    "And yet you don't sound all that concerned."
    
    She shrugs. " The people of the city will make their choice... or have it made for them, and be none the wiser. My intervention would only complicate your own investigations. That the royal chapel is defiled is hardly surprising. I've long suspected a member of the royal family has been touched by the darkness creeping in from beyond our world... though I fear his fall began long before the demon queen arrived."
    
    You quirk a brow. "Who do you think it is?"
    
    Armitia looks at you a long moment, analyzing, before finally answering in a whisper. "The Crown Prince. You've seen how he pales in comparison to his father, both in his physique and the esteem of his peers. Even the city's women only lust after him for his position. He yearns for a quick and easy cure to his insecurities — one that does not involve self-reflection and the hard work on oneself true change requires. Hard times give rise to good, strong men... just as good times give rise to weak ones, and it was into a time of prosperity unseen for centuries that Prince Vrannus was born. Why should he not insult the very gods whose blessings have given his kingdom such prosperity, when he's too blinded by his own vanity and weakness to see that truth?"
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |Wow, harsh.
        |Harsh words indeed.
    ]" Not to mention dangerous, in the prince's own house.
    
    Armitia gives you a sad, weary look. "I have said nothing but the truth as I see it. Believe me or don't, the choice is yours."
rows.translation:
你说王室维护着你的信仰，但我发现他们私人礼拜堂里的蒂拉雕像被严重亵渎了，”你轻声对她说，“而且是被人用于淫秽目的。”
    
    这个事实似乎并没有让她感到震惊。“在这个王国里，这种亵渎行为似乎已经变得非常普遍了。在这座城市里，现在，还有那座宫殿……弥诺陶洛斯们在战场上确实勇不可摧，但他们却对自己社会内部存在的问题视而不见。腐败已经深入他们的骨髓，渗透到他们社会的每一个角落。我相信你们一定注意到了这一点，”她说道，同时指向不远处站着的那对参议员——他们的胸膛袒露着，托加袍被紧紧拉紧，以此来凸显他们那突出的肌肉。 
    
    你自己似乎也并不是对此免疫啊，”你指着她几乎裸露的臀部说道。
    
    阿米蒂娅笑了：“怎么，一个女孩就不能展示一点皮肤吗？你知道的，有些人甚至称蒂拉为‘月光诱惑者’。她鼓励她的追随者们尽情享受生活，而她自己也很喜欢以身作则。虽然我敢肯定，在座的每个人都有自己的理由，而这些理由在他们自己看来都是合理的。接受自己的性取向是自然而然的事情，这其中并没有什么错……但借鉴马拉克的观点来说，正是这种过分的行为才引发了问题。"
    
    然而你听起来并不太担心。”
    
    她耸了耸肩：“这座城市里的人们会做出自己的选择……或者让别人替他们做出选择，而他们自己却丝毫不会察觉。如果我插手的话，只会让你的调查变得更加复杂。皇家礼拜堂被亵渎了，这并不奇怪。我早就怀疑，王室中有人已经被从我们的世界之外渗入来的黑暗势力影响了……不过我担心，他的堕落其实早在恶魔女王出现之前就已经开始了。
    
    你挑了挑眉毛：“你认为会是谁呢？”
    
    阿米蒂娅凝视了你好一会儿，似乎在仔细思考，最终低声回答道：“是王储。你应该已经看到了，无论是在体格上，还是在同龄人眼中的地位上，他都远远比不上他的父亲。就连这座城市的女人们，也只是看中他的地位才对他感兴趣。他渴望找到一种简单快捷的方法来消除自己的不安全感——那种不需要自我反思，也不需要付出努力去实现真正改变的方法。然而，只有经历过艰难困苦，才能造就出真正坚强、优秀的人。正如美好的时光总会带来艰难的时刻一样，弗兰努斯王子正是诞生在这样一个数百年来未曾有过的繁荣时代。当他被自己的虚荣与软弱蒙蔽了双眼，无法看清这一事实时，他为什么不去侮辱那些赐予他的王国如此繁荣的神明呢？"
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |哇，太严厉了。
        |这话确实有些刺耳。
    ]更不用说这有多危险了——而且还是在王子自己的家里。”
    
    阿米蒂娅用一种既悲伤又疲惫的眼神看着你：“我所说的一切都只是我亲眼所见的事实。信不信由你，这个选择权在你手中。
