rows.original: "This Tiran cathedral, what can you tell me about it?" Armitia taps a finger to her chin, pondering the question. "Normally I would suggest asking a local, but there's precious few Tirans who escaped that cathedral with their souls intact. Hm, where to begin? Long ago, the minotaurs followed an animist faith, as did many cultures in Savarra. When they converted to the faith of the Seven, the minotaurs repurposed the grand temple of their stone-worshiping ancestors, and would go on to construct a great cathedral to Tira in the Belharan style over where it stood, for they gave her credit with ending a plague of madness that engulfed their society. That cathedral became a cultural icon, and a center for the Tiran faith throughout the Frost Marches. Indeed, pilgrims from all throughout the world came to worship there... and holy relics from all over were stored there." "And then the demons attacked," you say. Armitia clicks her tongue. "Not the demons. No, a demon. The most powerful of their race assailed the cathedral personally. She meant to loot its reliquary, and none of the priests and paladins there had the strength to stand in her way. They had no idea a demon invasion was underway yet, and they were taken completely unawares. In the process of looting the divine reliquary under the cathedral, the demoness unleashed powers beyond her comprehension — even now, the cathedral is overrun with the residue of that battle, and many demons are marked by an inky darkness that had long been contained beneath the stones there." "What was it?" you ask. Armitia gives you a look, but no answer. "Do you know what she was after?" "Oh? I'd have thought your fellow Champion would have mentioned — the Ring of Fate. One of, no, the holiest of Tira's relics. The silly demon thought it was in the cathedral, but what was there was a facsimile, a hollow attempt by later generations of priests to duplicate the ring's effects. One of many leftovers from the Godswar contained down there." Understanding falls into place. "You're the one that told Calise the real ring's location, aren't you?" "Mm. That's right," Armitia admits. "I was surprised she was the first of Khor'minos's defenders to seek it out, given its properties. Still, I'm ever so curious what it is that the demon wanted with it. What could a corrupted, soulless being want with a ring that safeguards souls from corruption? I wonder what she's done with it now that she has it..." Armitia smirks, clasping her hands behind her back. [kasyrra.romantic |"Perhaps she means to protect someone she loves. In her own way, at least. If so, I pray Tira will surreptitiously touch that false ring and give it a little divine boost. It's her relic after all. Perhaps it can be used to course correct the demon, help her find her best self." |"Who knows? But perhaps it's for the best that the demon has the false ring. It, too, is touched by Tira herself. And its blessing is far more recent. I believe the goddess might just use it to do a little course correction on that demoness, help her better herself whether she wants to or not." ] "Would Tira do that?" "Why wouldn't she?" Armitia laughs. "By compact, the gods rarely take a direct hand in the world, but a little subtle nudge here and there, especially on what's already one of her own holy relics? Why not! Tira is the gods' executioner, but even still... she, too, believes in redemption. We all have to. And, more importantly... I, at least, hold out hope that a demon whose corruption is reigned in might do a little less damage."
rows.translation: 这座蒂拉大教堂，你能告诉我些什么关于它的事情吗？” 阿米蒂娅用手指轻敲着下巴，仔细思考着这个问题。“通常我会建议去问当地人，但是能够从那座大教堂中活着逃出来的人，已经所剩无几了。嗯，该从哪里说起呢？很久以前，弥诺陶洛斯人与萨瓦拉地区的许多其他文化一样，信奉万物有灵的信仰。当他们转而信仰“七神”的教义后，弥诺陶洛斯人便将他们那些崇拜石头的祖先所建造的宏伟神庙重新利用起来，并在原来的位置上按照贝尔哈兰的风格建造了一座巨大的教堂来纪念蒂拉——因为他们认为正是蒂拉终结了那场席卷他们社会的疯狂之灾。那座大教堂成为了文化象征，也成为整个霜冻边境地区蒂拉教会的信仰的中心。的确，来自世界各地的朝圣者都会前来那里虔诚地祈祷……而且，来自各地的圣物也都被保存在那里。然后恶魔发起了攻击，”你说。 阿米蒂娅吐了吐舌头：“才不是呢。那些恶魔不，a恶魔。他们种族中最强大的那头恶魔亲自出动了，袭击了那座大教堂。它的目的就是抢走那里的圣物，而那里的牧师和圣骑士们根本没有力量阻挡它。他们根本不知道恶魔入侵已经开始了，因此完全措手不及。在大教堂下方抢夺神圣圣物的过程中，那位女恶魔释放出了超出她理解范围的强大力量——直到如今，大教堂内仍残留着那场战斗的痕迹，许多恶魔身上都带着那种长久被封存在石头之下的漆黑印记。那是什么？”你问道。 阿米蒂娅看了你一眼，但没有回答。 “你知道她想要什么吗？” “哦？我本以为你的那位冠军同伴会提到的—— 命运之环。 其中之一，不，那个提拉最神圣的遗物。那个愚蠢的恶魔以为它就在大教堂里，但实际上那里只有一份复制品——后来的一代代牧师们试图复制这枚戒指的功效，但却只是徒劳而已。那些遗留物中，就有这一件，它们都是神战时期留下的。一切都明白了。‘是你告诉卡莉丝真正戒指的位置的，对吧？’” “嗯，没错，”阿米蒂娅承认道，“考虑到那枚戒指的特殊性质，她竟是科尔米诺斯防御者中第一个找到它的人，这确实让我感到惊讶。不过，我实在很好奇那个恶魔究竟想用它来做什么。一个已经被腐蚀、失去了灵魂的存在，究竟会想要一枚能够保护灵魂免受腐蚀的戒指呢？我想知道，现在她得到了这枚戒指，会用它来做什么…… 阿米蒂娅得意地笑了起来，双手背在身后。 [kasyrra.romantic |也许她的意思是想要保护某个她关心的人。喜爱至少是以她自己的方式吧。如果真是这样，我希望蒂拉能偷偷地触碰那枚假戒指，让它获得一点神圣的力量。毕竟那可是她的遗物，或许它能帮助她纠正错误的道路，帮助她找到真正的自我。 |谁知道呢？但也许那个恶魔拥有那枚假戒指反而是件好事。毕竟这枚戒指也是蒂拉亲自触碰过的，它的庇佑也是最近才降临的。我相信，女神可能会利用它来对那个恶魔女做一些必要的引导，帮助她更好地掌控自己，无论她是否愿意。 ] 蒂拉会那么做吗？” “她为什么不呢？”阿米蒂娅笑道，“根据约定，众神很少会直接干预人间事务，但偶尔给予一些暗示或引导，尤其是对于那些本来就是他们自己的圣物来说，为什么不呢？蒂拉虽然是众神的执行者，但她同样相信救赎的意义。我们所有人都必须相信这一点。更重要的是……至少我仍然抱有这样的希望：一个被控制住了邪恶力量的恶魔，应该会减少一些破坏吧。
rows.raw: ' "This Tiran cathedral, what can you tell me about it?" Armitia taps a finger to her chin, pondering the question. "Normally I would suggest asking a local, but there's precious few Tirans who escaped that cathedral with their souls intact. Hm, where to begin? Long ago, the minotaurs followed an animist faith, as did many cultures in Savarra. When they converted to the faith of the Seven, the minotaurs repurposed the grand temple of their stone-worshiping ancestors, and would go on to construct a great cathedral to Tira in the Belharan style over where it stood, for they gave her credit with ending a plague of madness that engulfed their society. That cathedral became a cultural icon, and a center for the Tiran faith throughout the Frost Marches. Indeed, pilgrims from all throughout the world came to worship there... and holy relics from all over were stored there." "And then the demons attacked," you say. Armitia clicks her tongue. "Not the demons. No, a demon. The most powerful of their race assailed the cathedral personally. She meant to loot its reliquary, and none of the priests and paladins there had the strength to stand in her way. They had no idea a demon invasion was underway yet, and they were taken completely unawares. In the process of looting the divine reliquary under the cathedral, the demoness unleashed powers beyond her comprehension — even now, the cathedral is overrun with the residue of that battle, and many demons are marked by an inky darkness that had long been contained beneath the stones there." "What was it?" you ask. Armitia gives you a look, but no answer. "Do you know what she was after?" "Oh? I'd have thought your fellow Champion would have mentioned — the Ring of Fate. One of, no, the holiest of Tira's relics. The silly demon thought it was in the cathedral, but what was there was a facsimile, a hollow attempt by later generations of priests to duplicate the ring's effects. One of many leftovers from the Godswar contained down there." Understanding falls into place. "You're the one that told Calise the real ring's location, aren't you?" "Mm. That's right," Armitia admits. "I was surprised she was the first of Khor'minos's defenders to seek it out, given its properties. Still, I'm ever so curious what it is that the demon wanted with it. What could a corrupted, soulless being want with a ring that safeguards souls from corruption? I wonder what she's done with it now that she has it..." Armitia smirks, clasping her hands behind her back. [kasyrra.romantic |"Perhaps she means to protect someone she loves. In her own way, at least. If so, I pray Tira will surreptitiously touch that false ring and give it a little divine boost. It's her relic after all. Perhaps it can be used to course correct the demon, help her find her best self." |"Who knows? But perhaps it's for the best that the demon has the false ring. It, too, is touched by Tira herself. And its blessing is far more recent. I believe the goddess might just use it to do a little course correction on that demoness, help her better herself whether she wants to or not." ] "Would Tira do that?" "Why wouldn't she?" Armitia laughs. "By compact, the gods rarely take a direct hand in the world, but a little subtle nudge here and there, especially on what's already one of her own holy relics? Why not! Tira is the gods' executioner, but even still... she, too, believes in redemption. We all have to. And, more importantly... I, at least, hold out hope that a demon whose corruption is reigned in might do a little less damage." '

rows.original: "You said Tira doesn't like her mantle as the war goddess? The city could really use a goddess of battle about now!" Armitia chuckles, glancing at the axes. "Tira is certainly a goddess of soldiers, and of kings, and of all those whose lives are fraught with peril. But she does not love war, and does not approve of seeking glory or plunder through unrighteous violence. Mortal life, so short and fragile, should be celebrated, and lived to its fullest in every moment... but not at the expense of others. There are certainly those among her worshippers who err in this, thinking her teachings give free reign to do whatever they please so long as it brings them joy. Tsk. But to your point: war is an inevitability in this world. That much I have come to know as inviolate truth, and in that way I suppose the goddess of inevitability ought to take responsibility for it, hmm?" You [pc.dcb |snort |shake your head |frown ]. "You sound so morose about it." "A bit," the priestess says. "I don't love war, but it has come to this city regardless, and you're right that the people of Khor'minos have kept my own faith since before the days of the Godswar. That is why I am here, after all." "So why does Tira have the reputation of a war goddess?" She shakes her head. "Of all the Living Gods, Tira was the last to reveal herself, and did so in the darkest days of calamity. The Wraiths, the demons of those days, were ascendant, reaping their way across all the world. Nareva and Lumia had done much, fought hard, to hold back the tide but even with their empowered godsworn at their side, the great war for all life on Savarra was nearly lost. The rise of Velun, Sorra, Keros, and Mallach did little to change the trajectory, only further delay the inevitable extinction. "There was little left of civilization by the time Tira arrived, brought low in the face of unstoppable monsters and soulless abominations beyond counting. Into that world, Tira thrust herself with axe held high." Armitia glances to the twin labrys she had been examining when you arrived. "Where the other gods had sought to shield mortals, to protect what was left of their societies and what few cowering strongholds remained, Tira went on the offense! She gathered the most fearless and deadly beast-slayers to her side, and gave them the power to cleave through the demons that plagued the land, heedless of the risk to themselves. It is from that tradition that the Belharan saying 'seize the day' comes from; the urge to live each day as though it could be your last, for in the face of such horror, each new dawn was an unexpected gift!" The priestess's hands curl up in fists before her, and her eyes close. "Those were the days of true glory, of selfless sacrifice to hold back the inevitable end of all things, of all life! And it was by those courageous heroes' actions, their shed blood and broken blades, that the whole world's end was rewritten — inevitable destruction held back day after day, until the Wraiths broke and the gods tore the last of the mindless monstrosities apart amidst the thunder of clashing swords and screams of dying fiends! That was true and righteous war, unbothered by morals and politics: just slaughter and fire and blood!" The exaltation hangs in the air a moment before she sighs, relaxing herself. "That is why mortals to this day call Tira their warrior-goddess, even if they have forgotten what true horrors she stood against. I suppose it should come as no shock when her name is invoked for the petty squabbles of princes, but this... this conflict that now brews in Khor'minos is the first time in centuries that, I fear, perhaps may be worthy of divine intervention. I pray it is not so, that mortal hands can win the day, for if it comes time for Tira's axe to fall again, this city will face a grim reminder that hers is an indiscriminate arm of slaughter and destruction." Your brow arches. "Are you saying we shouldn't want divine intervention? Even with demons running rampant in the Marches?" "Not... not overt intervention. Not like the old days," she says softly, that righteous passion fading from her voice. "But I think you'll find the gods are watching, and thumbing the scales in their own ways. For now, at least, this remains a conflict that mortal heroes can overcome. And so you have my sincerest congratulations in your efforts so far, Champion, and my prayers for your future success. I truly mean that."
rows.translation: 你说蒂拉不喜欢自己作为战神的身份？但这座城市其实使用现在她应该已经是一位战斗女神了吧！” 阿米蒂娅轻笑着，瞥了一眼那些斧头。“蒂拉确实是一位守护士兵、国王，以及所有那些生活充满危险的人的女神。但她并不热爱战争，也不赞同通过不正义的暴力来追求荣耀或掠夺财富。人类的生命如此短暂而脆弱，我们应该珍惜它，尽情享受每一刻……但绝不能以牺牲他人的利益为代价。在她的信徒中，确实有人误解了她的教诲，认为只要能给自己带来快乐，就可以为所欲为。啧。不过你说得有道理：在这个世界上，战争是不可避免的。这一点，我已经将其视为不可动摇的真理。因此，我想，那位象征着“不可避免”这一概念的女神，应该为战争负责吧，嗯？ [pc.dcb |哼了一声 |摇摇头 |皱眉 ]你听起来对此事显得非常沮丧。” “确实有点，”女祭司说道，“我并不喜欢战争，但它还是降临到了这座城市。你说得对，自从神战时代之前，科尔米诺斯的人民就一直坚守着我的信仰。毕竟，我来到这里也正是为了这个原因。” “那么，为什么确实提拉被誉为战争女神吗？” 她摇了摇头：“在所有现存的神明中，提拉是最后一个现身的。她出现在灾难最为严重的时刻。那时候，那些幽灵、那些恶魔正在肆虐，他们的破坏势力遍布整个世界。娜瑞瓦和卢米娅付出了巨大努力，进行了艰苦的斗争，试图阻挡这场灾难的蔓延。然而，即便有他们那位被神明赋予力量的盟友站在他们身边，萨瓦拉上所有生命的这场浩劫依然几乎无法避免。维伦、索拉、凯罗斯以及马拉克的崛起，并未能改变这一命运，只不过暂时延缓了那不可避免的灭绝。 当蒂拉抵达时，那里已经所剩无几的文明痕迹了——那些无法阻挡的怪物以及数不胜数的无魂怪物已经将人类文明彻底摧毁。而蒂拉，就是带着高高举起的斧头，走进了那个充满灾难的世界。”阿米蒂娅瞥了一眼你到来时她正在研究的那些双刃斧。当其他神明都在试图保护凡人，试图守护他们残存的社会以及那些为数不多的据点时，蒂拉却选择了主动出击！她集结了那些最无畏、最擅长猎杀魔兽的勇士们，赋予他们力量，让他们能够消灭那些肆虐大地的恶魔，而全然不顾这些行动会给自己带来多大的危险。它来源于那个这种“珍惜每一天”的观念，其实源自贝尔哈兰人的传统；人们之所以会如此渴望把每一天都当作生命的最后一天来度过，是因为面对如此可怕的灾难，每一个新的黎明都仿佛是一份意外的礼物！ 女祭司将双手握成拳头，闭上了眼睛。那些真是辉煌的时代，人们无私地奉献自己，试图延缓万物、乃至所有生命的必然终结！正是那些勇敢的英雄们的行动，他们流下的鲜血以及折断的武器，才让整个世界的命运被改写——那不可避免的毁灭一次次被推迟，直到那些邪灵最终被消灭，众神在剑鸣与恶魔的哀嚎中，将那些没有理智的怪物彻底消灭！那确实是一场正义的战争，完全不受道德和政治因素的束缚：只有杀戮、火焰与鲜血而已！ 那种崇高的气息在空气中萦绕了片刻，随后她叹了口气，放松了下来。“这就是为什么直到今天，凡人们仍然称蒂拉为他们的战神女神，即使他们已经忘记了她曾经对抗过哪些真正的恐怖势力。我想，当王公贵族们为了一些琐碎的争端而呼唤她的名字时，这也不足为奇……但这次的情况，却确实不同。……如今在科尔米诺斯酝酿的这场冲突，恐怕是几个世纪以来第一次真正值得神明介入的时刻。我祈祷事实并非如此，愿人类自己的力量能够赢得胜利。因为如果蒂拉的战斧再次降临，这座城市将会再次面对一个残酷的现实：她的力量是毫无区别地带来杀戮与毁灭的。" 你的眉头微微蹙起。“你是说我们不应该希望得到神明的帮助吗？即使现在恶魔在边境地区肆虐不已……” “不……并不是这个意思明显的干预。已经不像过去那样了，”她轻声说道，那股正义的热忱已经从她的声音中消退。“但我相信，众神正在注视着这一切，并以他们自己的方式影响着事态的发展。至少目前来说，这场冲突仍然是凡人英雄能够战胜的。因此，对于你迄今为止所做出的努力，我衷心地表示祝贺，冠军；我也为你未来的成功祈祷。我是真心这么说的。

rows.original:
"So what does a Tiran make of these demons?" you ask.
    
    Armitia's lips draw tight. "They are monsters, like any other, no matter that they wear the facade of intelligence. Some might find their perverse powers fascinating, their manipulation of the soul a tempting font of knowledge... and those that do are fools. These creatures are less dangerous than the Wraiths that nearly destroyed the world. They don't compare. But these new demons are still dangerous, and it is my duty and pleasure to lend my strength to those who would smite them down."
    
    The priestess puts a hand on one of the two-bladed axes displayed on the wall, a zealous glimmer in her eyes. "It's been entirely too long since I took to the hunt myself... but these days I find myself better suited to playing patron to younger blades, granting them Tira's blessing. You've no idea how long I spend blessing the swords of the legions each day."
    
    "Younger blades?" you say. "I'd have said you look young to be a high priestess yourself."
    
    She laughs. "Tira is goddess of time, you know. Her followers are blessed by a particularly light weight of the years."
    
    Armitia's hand closes around the axe, as if to take it up. "But so too is she the goddess of inevitability, and it is the monster's inevitable place to be slain. The demons concern me only in how much damage they can do, and how deeply they will tax the Frost Marches, before they are put to the sword. What form they take, what powers they possess... all is ephemera in the end. Like the Wraiths before them, all that makes these demons seem such a dire threat will soon be lost to time."
    
    "Even for a priest, that's a lot of faith in us."
    
    Her had relaxes around the axe. "What can I say? I have seen the champions of this city for who they really are. [pc.dcb
        |You have a darkness in your heart, but you have a strength that this city needs. I hope that you can channel that power to rise above your nature.
        |You're a good-hearted hero, and you've proven your prowess. I should hope the city will be safe with you.
        |Though you're a little air-headed, your heart's also overflowing with passion. I pray you can channel that into doing deeds worthy of your title.
    ] I will be watching with great interest."
    
    "Only watching?"
    
    She favors you with a thin but pretty smile. "You may not see me on the field of battle, but my aegis is upon this city, never doubt it."
rows.translation:

"What about your church's paladins?" you ask. "Are there many of them left in the city?"
    
    "Oh, yes," Armitia laughs. "While the kingdom embraces all faiths, Tira's runs strongest, and there are many paladins and warrior-priests here in the city. The royal pantheon is practically overflowing with clergy from across the kingdom, sheltering on its very steps. But don't discount the other gods' servants as well: Velun, Nareva, and Sorra have substantial priesthoods congregating here, and the other three gods have a few dozen apiece. Really there's quite a divine host within the city's walls, waiting for the day they're needed."
    
    The thought brings a smile. "And if I called them up? We could certainly use a divine hand in the upcoming battles."
    
    "I'm sure you could! But the leader of every divine order was asked by the king personally to contribute her paladins to the city's last line of defense... and I'm inclined to agree with him. The Royal Legions are the most elite fighting force in all the world, but no soldier is fool enough to believe himself, or his brothers, unbreakable. Should even one of the five legions buckle in the face of the enemy, demons will come flooding through the tunnels, and this city will need every blade it can muster to protect it."
    
    Before you can look too crestfallen, Armitia grasps your shoulder. "But I would be a poor Tiran to resign myself to the status quo. The gods have many paladins in the city, but the martial orders make up only a fraction of the kingdom's clergy. Most are healers and counselors, servicing a flock displaced and terrified by the war. They may not be fighters, but they would nonetheless volunteer to serve if asked. I am sure any future battles would benefit from their gentle prayers, don't you think?"
    
    "Having someone to patch our soldiers up would be handy, yeah."
    
    Armitia smirks. "I'm sure. In that case, I will see your suggestion brought before the pantheonic conclave. I'm sure that the other high priests will agree that we have sat idle long enough."

rows.original: She wanted to see you about something, didn't she?
rows.translation: 她想找你谈点事情，对吧？
rows.raw: "She wanted to see you about something, didn't she?"

rows.original: "Ah, [pc.name], there you are!" the paladin smiles, setting her nearly-full glass aside and giving you [calise.fucked |a passionate lip-kiss |a clap on the shoulder ]. "What do you say you and I get away from the party a little while? I've got something I want to show you." Going with Calise will bring the party to its conclusion.
rows.translation: “啊，[pc.name]，你在这儿！”圣骑士微笑着，把手里那杯几乎没动过的酒放到一边，然后给了你[calise.fucked |一个充满激情的深吻 |拍拍你的肩膀 ]。“我们两个暂时离开派对一会儿，你说怎么样？我有东西想给你看。” 与卡莉丝同行将会让这场派对就此结束。

rows.original: You're ready to leave the socializing behind, and sum things up with Calise.
rows.translation: 你已经准备好放下那些社交活动，与卡莉丝一起总结一下这一切了。
rows.raw: "You're ready to leave the socializing behind, and sum things up with Calise."

rows.original:
"Give me a little time," you say. "I've still got some people I need to talk to."
    
    Calise nods, and picks up her drink again. "Very well, don't let me rush you. We need all the support we can get for what comes next."
rows.translation:
“给我一点时间，”你说，“我还有些人需要跟他们谈谈。”
    
    卡莉丝点了点头，然后继续喝她的饮料。“好吧，我不会催你的。在接下来的行动中，我们确实需要尽可能多的支持。”
rows.raw:
'
    "Give me a little time," you say. "I've still got some people I need to talk to."
    
    Calise nods, and picks up her drink again. "Very well, don't let me rush you. We need all the support we can get for what comes next."
    '

rows.original:
"Alright, let's go."
    
    "Excellent," the paladin says. She takes your hand [party.hasCompanions
        |and turns to [party.compNames true]. "Excuse us, will you? I need to borrow [pc.name] alone for a bit. Now, follow me, my Champion."
        |and gives it a squeeze. "Follow me, my Champion."
    ]
    
    She leads you to a small door hidden in the wall, made small and nondescript as though just for the palace's servants, and slips through it without a second thought. There's a short corridor beyond it, which leads into a winding maze of passages and small rooms that your companion navigates as though she were a native, confidently taking each turn until you've completely lost your own sense of direction in the torchlit halls. 
    
    "Where are we even going?" you ask.
    
    "You'll see. Trust me, it's worth it," Calise says, giving you a wink over her shoulder.
    
    Another minute or so of walking proves her true. Calise draws open a curtain door, and ushers you out from the dark into a well-lit garden, overflowing with the fragrance of its countless blooming flowers. You've barely ever seen so much green, so many colors of petals, ever in your life. That such verdance can grow so deep under the mountain is as breathtaking as it is puzzling.
    
    "Magnificent, isn't it?" Calise says with a smile. "And so very isolated. Look!" She sweeps her hand across the garden, given solitude by hedge four hedge walls taller than even the biggest of minotaurs. Above you is the open air of the great cavern in which the city sits, as black and sunless as ever. Calise's right: there's no one around, and from up here at the top of the palace, the sounds of the city seem so very far away.
    
    "Surprising that nobody's up here," you muse, leaning down to inspect some of the flowers. They seem real enough, sweet-scented and vibrant. 
    
    "Isn't it?" Calise giggles. "I suppose with all that skin on display downstairs, this little slice of nature's lost its appeal — artificial as it is." 
    
    She guides your gaze up, to the tops of the guideposts around which the hedge walls have grown. Each is topped with a granite-gray stone engraved with runes, aimed down into the garden and pulsing gently with arcane luminescence. Calise reaches up, though she's too small by half to reach them, and points to a small mark on the side of one stone: a pair of crossed crook-staves, surrounded by a blazing circle. "A maker's mark," she says. "I didn't recognize it when I first came here, but I've since discovered it belongs to an ancient academy of wizards that once served some old empire or another. Estelore, it's called — or was, I suppose. It's long gone now. Do you know the story of it?"
    
    [pc.bg scholar arcanist noblescion minstrel
        |"Of course," you say. "They were the greatest conclave of minds in Old Belhar. It's said that Nareva herself founded the school[var0
            |, though from what we saw on Dracia, that might have been a dragon in reality
        ]. Every wizard and scholar craved to study there. They pushed the boundaries of possibility like no one else."
        |You shake your head. "Just that they were old Belharan wizards. Tell me?"
        
        "Near as I can surmise," Calise says, "the academy of Estelore was a great conclave of wizards that studied the very foundations of the world, of magic and its possibilities."
    ]
    
    The paladin gives a weary sigh. "Of course, if there's one constant truth no matter where you look, it's that wizards never can leave well enough alone. They're always grasping for more and more power, without heed to the consequences. Get enough mages gathered together, and tragedy's inevitable."
    
    [pc.isMage
        |You frown. "Hey."
        |"What do you mean?"
    ]
rows.translation:
好吧，我们走吧。”
    
    “太好了，”圣骑士说道。她握住了你的手。 [party.hasCompanions
        |然后转向[party.compNames true]打扰一下，可以吗？我需要借一下[pc.name]独自待一会儿吧。现在，跟我来，我的勇士。
        |然后轻轻捏了捏它：“跟我来，我的勇士。
    ]
    
    她带你来到一扇隐藏在墙里的小门，那门做得如此小巧且不起眼，仿佛只是为宫殿里的仆人们准备的。她毫不犹豫地走了进去。门后是一条短短的走廊，而这条走廊通向一个由曲折的通道和小房间组成的迷宫。你的同伴仿佛对这里了如指掌，自信地引领着你前行，每一次转弯都显得那么自然，直到你在那些被火把照亮的走廊里彻底迷失了方向。 
    
    我们到底要去哪里？”你问道。
    
    “你会看到的。相信我，这一切都是值得的。”卡莉丝一边说，一边侧过身来朝你眨了眨眼。
    
    又走了一分钟左右，她的话果然应验了。卡莉丝推开了帘门，将你从暗影中引领到一个灯火通明的花园里，那里到处都是盛开的鲜花，散发着浓郁的芳香。你这一生中，几乎从未见过如此繁茂的绿意，也从未见过如此多色彩缤纷的花瓣。这种生机勃勃的景象能够在山腹深处生长出来，既令人惊叹，也让人感到困惑。
    
    真是美极了，不是吗？”卡莉丝微笑着说道，“而且这里如此与世隔绝。看吧！”她将手伸向花园，那些比最大的弥诺陶洛斯还要高的树篱将这里完全与外界隔开了。头顶上是那座城市所在的大型洞穴，那里依然一片漆黑，没有一丝阳光。卡莉丝说得对——周围确实没有人，而从宫殿的最高处望去，城市里的各种声响似乎也都远得仿佛来自另一个世界。
    
    真奇怪，这里竟然没有人，”你边想边弯下腰仔细观察那些花朵。它们看起来非常真实，散发着甜美的香气，也显得格外鲜艳。
    
    “不是吗？”卡莉丝轻声笑了起来，“我想，楼下有那么多裸露的肌肤，这片小小的自然景观也就失去了它的吸引力吧——尽管它其实是人造的。 
    
    她引导你的视线向上，看向那些被树篱环绕的指示牌的顶部。每个指示牌的顶端都镶嵌着一块花岗岩灰色的石头，上面刻着符文，这些符文指向花园的方向，会发出微弱的神秘光芒。卡莉丝伸出手去，尽管她的个子太矮，根本够不到那些东西，但她还是指出了其中一块石头侧面有一个小标记：一对交叉的权杖，周围环绕着一个燃烧的圆圈。“这是制造者的标记，”她说，“我第一次来到这里的时候并没有认出来，但后来我发现，这个标记属于一个古老的巫师学院，那个学院曾经为某个古老的帝国服务过。埃斯托洛尔，它就是这么叫的——或者应该说是曾经这么叫。不过现在它已经消失很久了。你知道它的来历吗？
    
    [pc.bg scholar arcanist noblescion minstrel
        |当然，”你说，“他们是古贝尔哈尔地区最杰出的智者聚集地。据说，娜瑞瓦本人就是这所学校的创始人。[var0
            |不过，从我们在达拉西亚看到的情况来看，实际上那可能是一条龙。
        ]每一位巫师和学者都渴望能够在那里学习，他们以无人能及的方式不断拓展着可能的边界。
        |你摇了摇头：“只是那些都是古老的贝尔哈兰巫师而已。你能告诉我更多吗？”
        
        “据我推测，”卡莉丝说道，“埃斯特洛尔学院其实是那些研究世界本质、魔法原理及其各种可能性的巫师们的聚集地。
    ]
    
    那位圣骑士疲惫地叹了口气：“当然，如果说有什么亘古不变的真理的话，那就是巫师们永远都不会满足于现状。他们总是贪得无厌，不断追求更多的权力，却从不考虑由此带来的后果。只要让足够的法师聚集在一起，悲剧就不可避免了。
    
    [pc.isMage
        |你皱起了眉头。“嘿。
        |你是什么意思？
    ]

rows.original: "I only mean that the world's monsters are often enough the works of men," Calise says. "Today, Estelore is a crater, and its mages' legacy is a war that nearly wiped out all life in this world, and forced the gods' hands to intervene directly. You're all so very lucky, you know. It could just as easily have been that your gods failed you. That the demons would have won, and crushed them to the ground." "Interesting take from a paladin," you say. Calise grins. "What is a paladin but an instrument of the gods? When they cannot, or will not, act, is it not the duty of their mortal servants to do so in their stead? Which reminds me of why I asked you up here, [pc.name]." She gestures to a stone bench, beckoning you to sit beside her. "You've had plenty of time to talk to the palace's guests. Do a little snooping, a little schmoozing. I still believe that someone in attendance has been turned by Master Tollus into a pawn of the enemy, and is subverting my efforts to protect this city. Our efforts. Tell me who you believe it is, or at least who you most suspect, and we'll see if our suspicions line up." "And if they don't?" Calise shrugs. "There could be more than one person corrupted. Or we could both be wrong. But we can cross that bridge if we come to it. Regardless, I trust your judgment. Tell me who you suspect, and I'll ensure they're unable to further impact the war."
rows.translation: “我只是想说，世上的怪物往往正是人类亲手造就的。”卡莉丝说道，“如今，埃斯托洛尔只剩下一个巨坑；那里的法师留下的遗产，则是一场几乎灭绝世间所有生命、迫使诸神亲自介入的战争。你们真的非常幸运，知道吗？你们的神也完全可能没能救下你们；恶魔本可能取得胜利，将他们碾落尘埃。” “这可不像圣骑士会有的见解。”你说道。 卡莉丝咧嘴一笑。“圣骑士不正是诸神的工具吗？当他们无法或不愿行动时，凡间仆从代其行事，难道不是职责所在？说到这里，我也该谈谈为什么叫你上来了，[pc.name]。” 她指向一张石凳，招呼你坐在身边。“你已经有充足的时间与宫殿里的宾客交谈，也该暗中调查一番、与他们套套近乎了。我仍然相信，在场的某个人已经被托勒斯大师变成敌人的棋子，正在破坏我保护这座城市的努力——是我们的努力。告诉我你认为是谁，或者至少你最怀疑谁；然后我们看看彼此的猜测是否一致。” “要是不一致呢？” 卡莉丝耸耸肩。“遭到腐化的也许不止一人，也可能我们两个都猜错了。不过真走到那一步，再设法应对也不迟。无论如何，我相信你的判断。说出你怀疑的人，我会确保他们再也无法干扰这场战争。”

rows.original: The person you suspect most of being a threat to Khor'minos's future is none other than its king.
rows.translation: 你最怀疑会对科尔米诺斯的未来构成威胁的人，其实就是它的国王。
rows.raw: "The person you suspect most of being a threat to Khor'minos's future is none other than its king."

rows.original: The hard-partying prettyboy prince is definitely rubbing you the wrong way.
rows.translation: 这个喜欢彻夜狂欢、外表英俊的王子，确实让你们感到很不爽吧。
rows.raw: "The hard-partying prettyboy prince is definitely rubbing you the wrong way."

rows.original: The princess is too damn nice! She's clearly hiding something.
rows.translation: 这位公主实在太善良了！她肯定在隐瞒什么。
rows.raw: "The princess is too damn nice! She's clearly hiding something."

rows.original: The lustful patron of the baths does little to disguise his depravity.
rows.translation: 那位对浴场充满贪欲的顾客，丝毫没有试图掩饰自己的堕落行为。
rows.raw: "The lustful patron of the baths does little to disguise his depravity."

rows.original: The general's son is a notable piece of shit, and the general's clearly chafing under the king's restrictions on his men.
rows.translation: 那位将军的儿子真是个十足的混蛋，而将军本人显然也对国王对他部下的种种限制感到极为不满。
rows.raw: "The general's son is a notable piece of shit, and the general's clearly chafing under the king's restrictions on his men."

rows.original: The Tiran arch-priestess is clearly hiding something...
rows.translation: 蒂拉的大祭司显然在隐瞒什么……
rows.raw: "The Tiran arch-priestess is clearly hiding something..."

rows.original: The most suspect person at this party is Calise herself.
rows.translation: 在这场聚会上，最值得怀疑的人其实就是卡莉丝本人。
rows.raw: "The most suspect person at this party is Calise herself."

rows.original: You aren't kidding: Calise herself is the person you most suspect of treason, and you aren't going to let her squirm out of this.
rows.translation: 你没开玩笑：卡莉丝本身就是你最怀疑会背叛的人，而你绝对不会让她逃脱这个责任。
rows.raw: "You aren't kidding: Calise herself is the person you most suspect of treason, and you aren't going to let her squirm out of this."

rows.original: You can't conclusively finger anybody at this time.
rows.translation: 目前还不能确定是哪个人干的。
rows.raw: "You can't conclusively finger anybody at this time."

rows.original: Calise quirks her brow as you make your case for the king's treachery, arms crossing beneath her bust. "The king himself? Madness... but it makes a certain kind of sense, I suppose. The way his harem has grown so huge could cover his growing lusts. Ah, I don't know. What could we do if he were?" "Replace him?" you venture. Calise cringes. "We tread dangerous ground, [pc.name], especially in the man's own home. I will think on what, if anything, can be done if Kelsaz has been corrupted." "And who did you think the traitor was?" you ask. Calise sets her lips. "Senator Khaius. The loud-mouthed lustful braggart is a menace to the palace's slave girls, and he's had the king's ear for a long, long while now. I fear he's gone beyond just groping servant girls now... but at least he has no influence over the military! Speaking of which..."
rows.translation: 当你为国王的背叛行为陈述理由时，卡莉丝挑了挑眉，双臂交叉在胸前。 “国王本人？疯了……不过我想，这倒也说得通。他的后宫膨胀得如此之大，或许正是为了掩盖他日益增长的欲望。唉，我不知道。如果真是他，我们又能做什么呢？” “换掉他？”你试探道。 卡莉丝畏缩了一下。“我们正走在危险的地面上，[pc.name]，尤其是在这个男人的家里。我会想一想，如果凯尔萨兹真的被腐化了，我们能做些什么。” “那你本来以为叛徒是谁？”你问。 卡莉丝抿紧了嘴唇。“凯乌斯参议员。那个口无遮拦、好色成性的吹牛大王对宫里的女奴来说是个祸害，而且他得到国王的耳朵已经很久很久了。我担心他现在已经不只是对侍女动手动脚了……但至少他对军队没有影响力！说到这个……”
rows.raw: ' Calise quirks her brow as you make your case for the king's treachery, arms crossing beneath her bust. "The king himself? Madness... but it makes a certain kind of sense, I suppose. The way his harem has grown so huge could cover his growing lusts. Ah, I don't know. What could we do if he were?" "Replace him?" you venture. Calise cringes. "We tread dangerous ground, [pc.name], especially in the man's own home. I will think on what, if anything, can be done if Kelsaz has been corrupted." "And who did you think the traitor was?" you ask. Calise sets her lips. "Senator Khaius. The loud-mouthed lustful braggart is a menace to the palace's slave girls, and he's had the king's ear for a long, long while now. I fear he's gone beyond just groping servant girls now... but at least he has no influence over the military! Speaking of which..." '

rows.original:
Calise steeples her fingers as you lay out your suspicions of the Crown Prince, nodding along as your reasoning comes together. 
    
    "I hate to admit it, but it makes sense. Even setting aside Vrannus's flirtatiousness, he stands the most to gain from corruption: he's so small and frail compared to his father, and lacks the temperament of a good ruler. He has spent a life in pursuit of banal pleasure; that he would fall under Tollus's sway before this war began is hardly a surprise."
    
    "His family seems oblivious," you note.
    
    Calise shakes her head. "That is the way of families, ignoring the worst sides of themselves until it's too late. It's easier than confronting the truth. By the same token, I am unsure how well I can convince the king to keep Vrannus out of the loop of military affairs... but I will try. And I'll start investigating what it really is he and his research group have been doing. Somehow, I doubt it's the cure for demonhood his father claims."
    
    "And who did you think the traitor was?" you ask.
    
    Calise sets her lips. "Senator Khaius. The loud-mouthed lustful braggart is a menace to the palace's slave girls, and he's had the king's ear for a long, long while now. I fear he's gone beyond just groping servant girls now... but at least he has no influence over the military! Speaking of which..."
rows.translation:
卡莉丝将手指交叉在一起，而你则逐一陈述了自己对王储的怀疑，她的点头表示她正在认真倾听你的推理过程。 
    
    “我实在不愿承认这一点，但你的说法确实有道理。就算撇开弗兰努斯的轻浮行为不谈，他也是从腐化中获益最多的人：与他的父亲相比，他身材瘦小、体质孱弱，也缺乏成为一位好统治者所必需的品格。他一生都在追求那些平庸的快乐；在这场战争开始之前，他就落入了托勒斯的掌控之下，这其实并不令人意外。”
    
    “他的家人似乎对此毫无察觉，”你说道。
    
    卡莉丝摇了摇头：“家庭就是这样的，总是会忽视自己最糟糕的一面，直到为时已晚。这总比面对真相要容易些。同样地，我也不确定自己能否说服国王不让弗兰努斯参与军事事务……但我会试试的。首先，我会调查他和他的研究小组究竟在从事什么活动。我实在怀疑，这所谓的治愈恶魔之身的方法是否真如他父亲所说的那样有效。”
    
    “那你认为那个叛徒是谁呢？”你问道。
    
    卡莉丝紧抿着嘴唇：“是凯乌斯参议员。那个口无遮拦、好色成性的吹牛者对宫中的女奴们来说简直是个祸害，而且他长期以来一直深受国王的宠信。我担心他现在已经不仅仅是随便调戏侍女那么简单了……不过至少他在军事方面没有任何影响力！说起来……”

当你摆出对第一公主的怀疑时，卡莉丝十指交叉抵在一起，听你说话时眉头皱得越来越深。“那位公主……自我们相识以来就一直对我冷淡，而且我不止一次发现她想让她父亲与我为敌。我原以为她只是嫉妒，但如果你怀疑她别有用心……”
    
    圣骑士叹了口气。 
    
    “她的家人似乎毫无察觉，”你指出。
    
    卡莉丝摇了摇头。“家人就是这样，总是无视自己最糟糕的那一面，直到为时已晚。这总比直面真相要容易。同样地，我也不确定能说服国王到什么程度，让他对我们的事瞒着他的女儿。不过，我还是可以试试。”
    
    “那你觉得叛徒会是谁？”你问道。
    
    卡莉丝抿紧了嘴唇。“凯乌斯参议员。那个口无遮拦、好色成性的家伙是宫里女奴的祸害，而且他长年累月都能在国王耳边说话。我担心他现在已经不只是对女仆们动手动脚了……但至少他影响不了军方！说到这个……”

rows.original:
Calise nods firmly. "He was my suspect as well! I'm glad we're agreed. The man rubs me the wrong way, and has done ever since he shamelessly groped a slave girl right in front of me. As though she weren't even human — or, well, a cow-girl — worthy of even the barest shred of respect. And then I heard him talk!"
    
    "That tracks with my experience, yeah."
    
    "Very well. I will consult with the king, and see what can be done about the man. He is a patrician, and thus enjoys a measure of protection... but in the short term, I expect he can be placed under house arrest! I'll see it done."
    
    You smirk. "I'm sure the women of the palace will sleep easier."
    
    "I'm glad," Calise says. "And I'll sleep easier knowing the traitor is out of the way. Speaking of which, let's talk of military matters..."

卡莉丝坚定地点了点头。“他也是我的嫌疑对象！很高兴我们意见一致。那个男人让我很反感，从他当着我的面无耻地猥亵一个奴隶女孩那一刻起，我就一直这么觉得。就好像她根本算不上人类——或者说，嗯，一头牛女——连最微不足道的尊重都不配得到。然后我还听到他说的话了！”
    
    “这和我的经历对得上，没错。”
    
    “很好。我会去和国王商议，看看能对这个男人做些什么。他是个贵族，因此享有一定的保护……但短期内，我想可以把他软禁起来！我会促成此事的。”
    
    你微微一笑。“我敢肯定，宫里的女人们会睡得更安稳些。”
    
    “我很高兴，”卡莉丝说。“而且知道那个叛徒被清理掉了，我也会睡得更安稳。说到这个，我们来谈谈军事方面的事吧……”

"General Grune, really?" Calise blinks. "He seemed like one of the most reliable men left in the court to me. Though I suppose the apple never falls far from the tree. Perhaps the general is merely better at hiding his inner cretin than his son."
    
    "That's what I was thinking," you say. 
    
    Calise nods. "He's a general, which certainly gives him a great deal of insight into the kingdom's military movements, and influence over them as well — though not as much as he'd like. He's constantly been whinging for a position of combat command. To what end? Would he have lead his troops into the demons' clutches, or sabotaged the legions' maneuvers?" She shakes her head. "I'll make sure he's not given the position to do either. The king and I can feed him false information while he's stewing in the rear lines, and we'll see if the enemy reacts!"
    
    "And who did you think the traitor was?" you ask.
    
    Calise sets her lips. "Senator Khaius. The loud-mouthed lustful braggart is a menace to the palace's slave girls, and he's had the king's ear for a long, long while now. I fear he's gone beyond just groping servant girls now... but at least he has no influence over the military! Speaking of which..."

rows.original: The accusation seems to take Calise off-guard. "Lady Moongiven? I've only met her once, but I agree, something was off about her. She struck me as being far, far older than she appears, and she seemed to know more than she should. I attributed that to her being a priestess of the time goddess, but her being a demon, or drawing on their powers, makes just as much sense. Tollus has been drawing on the fiends' power for decades, as far as I can tell. It could explain someone seeming much younger than they are." "Is that right?" "Mm. Moreover, the royal family are devout Tirans. It makes sense that Armitia has the king's ear, and influence over affairs at court — though I admit, I haven't seen as much myself. I wouldn't have suspected..." Calise runs a hand through her hhair. "If you're sure, then I'll speak to the king's men about making sure she's held in custody. The Tiran church will be furious, but I suppose that can't be helped. Better safe than sorry." "And who did you think the traitor was?" you ask. Calise sets her lips. "Senator Khaius. rows.original: Calise frowns as you refuse to yield, but she doesn't rebuke your concerns again. Instead, she folds her hands in her lap, toying with the black ring on her finger until you're done listing out your myriad causes for suspicion. "Fine," she says when you finally fall silent. "You're right to be suspect of me. I have more secrets to my name, and skeletons in my closet, than most of this city put together." "Then tell me the truth," you urge her. The paladin's jaw tightens, fingers worrying her ring. "I have kept my truth from you for my own sake, [pc.name], for I am well aware you would have no reason to trust me if you knew it. [calise.fucked |And... and because of how much I have treasured our intimacy. I did not want to lose it. Though now I cannot blame you if you despise me for my deception. ]I really am a knight, oathed to protect all that is good and wholesome, but... before I came to this city, I was seized by a demon witch and tortured, violently and intimately, until I lost my mind... and my very soul. What you see now is how I appeared in my past life, as a human, before my humanity was stripped away." "So you are a demon!" Calise nods glumly. "I am, though not by choice. At least not at first. I would be lying if I said I found the power I have gained entirely repulsive. I have torn through hordes of demons that my old self would never have been able to stand up against. It has given me the strength to protect this city." "Why would a demon care?" you ask. "Because I despise those other demons! Those feckless imps! Seeing them fills me with utter revulsion and contempt, the same as it ever did! And Tollus worst of all, the damnable traitor!" She pauses, faltering. "And... perhaps I truly do want to protect this city. I don't... I don't rightly know anymore. My thoughts and feelings are confused these days." She holds up a hand, showing you her blackened ring. "When I sought out the Ring of Fate, I first found a lesser cousin of it, a pale imitation created by the Tiran church. It helps me to keep my sanity, my sense of self... my knightly passions compete with demonic lusts on an even playing field for the first time since I was mutilated. It cannot save my soul, but with it... I have found enough inner peace to function incognito. To avoid spreading my corruption to others." [flags.KM_FEAST_ARMITIA_CATHEDRAL |"The head Tiran said that her goddess touched that ring," you say. "To reign in one very powerful demon that sacked her cathedral." Calise smirks. "Then perhaps I owe Tira thanks. I swore my oath before a god of nature and bounty, but there is an... appealing intimacy to her faith, I have come to realize. The cold caress of the moon cooling my demonic fervor is... not entirely unwelcome, if true. I would not have thought to have the personal attention of a goddess." "Perhaps you ought to apologize for the priests you corrupted, too." "I... yes, that too. |" ]I did a lot of damage to this world, [pc.name], when I was fully in the grasp of vainglorious demonhood. I won't pretend that I am somehow able to assure you I won't do more in the future. I ask only that you believe my sincerity in my desire to protect this city, and you as well. If you believe it best to speak to the king, you may do so — though I doubt he will believe you. I can only ask that you refrain, and that you help me finger who the real traitor is. Someone other than me is working with Master Tollus to overthrow this city. You must have some clue who it is by now?"

        ]

            “太好了！他们的战斗法师和散兵会为我们的军队增添一股强大的神秘力量，还能让我们对敌军的调动做出快速反应。宝贵的补充！”
        ]

rows.original:
"So," Calise says, crossing her legs on the stone bench. "Whether we are right or wrong about the traitor in the court won't matter much if we're doomed to lose the war fair and square. We need more muscle than just my elites if we're to launch an attack on the demon stronghold, and put and end to their imp-breeding. Let's go over who we've managed to recruit tonight..."
    
    [var0
        |You grimace. "Nobody on my end."
        
        "N-nobody!?" Calise balks. "Surely there must have been somebody..."
        
        You shake your head. She frowns.
        
        "We... are going to have some real problems, then," Calise murmurs.
        |[var1
            |"General Grune's Siege Corps has been released to our command."
            
            Calise nods. "They aren't fighters by trade, but the Siege Corps are master sappers and skilled at ranged warfare. Heavy bowmen and engineers will serve well in any battle that may come!"
        ]
        
        [flags.KM_FEAST_AUXILIARY_RECRUITED
            |"Raqian Ignafaerus and his wife will be joining us, along with part of the Royal Auxiliary."
            
            "Good! Their battlemages and skirmishers will add a mighty mystical punch to our forces, and give us some rapid-reaction to enemy movements. A valuable addition!"
        ]
        
        [flags.KM_FEAST_ALANTE_GLADIATORS
            |"Alante said she's help convince the city's gladiators to volunteer. She said they're eager for action."
            
            Calise taps her chin. "They're an unexpected but not unwelcome addition. They won't be an ordered military force, but we'd be fools to treat them like one! No, they'll fill the role of skirmishers, harassing enemy movement."
        ]
        
        [flags.KM_FEAST_ARMITIA_RECRUIT
            |"High Priestess Moongiven has said she'll bring our case before the city's clergy. She believes a number of priests, mostly healers, will join us."
            
            "They will? That's fantastic news. Mystics and medicae will save lives on the battlefield in their own ways."
        ]
    ]
    
    [var2
        |Calise sighs, rubbing her temples. "That's it, then? Ah, we'll have to find help elsewhere then. I shouldn't have put such a burden on you in a single day, but still, I'll need your help recruiting allies throughout the Marches. What happens here in Khor'minos affects everyone. The leaders of the other settlements will surely see that."
        
        "And if not?"
        
        "Then we'll have to improvise. I would prefer to demolish our enemies on the field of battle, but if you were able to infiltrate the Palace of Ice, perhaps you can do so again to the breeding grounds..."

    ]

“所以，”卡莉丝说道，她把双腿交叉放在石凳上，“无论我们关于宫廷里那个叛徒的判断是对还是错，如果我们注定会在这场战争中彻底失败，那么这些其实都无关紧要了。如果我们想要进攻恶魔的据点，彻底终结他们的邪恶行径，仅仅依靠我的精英部队是远远不够的。让我们来看看今晚我们成功招募到了哪些人吧……”
    
    [var0
        |你皱起了眉头：“我这边确实没有人。”
        
        “没、没人吗？！”卡莉丝惊愕地问道，“肯定有人吧……”
        
        你摇了摇头，她也皱起了眉头。
        
        “那么，我们真的要遇到大麻烦了……”卡莉丝低声说道。
        |[var1
            |“格鲁恩将军的攻城部队已经归我们指挥了。”
            
            卡莉丝点了点头：“他们并非以战斗为职业，但这支攻城部队由经验丰富的工兵组成，擅长远程作战。重弓手和工程师们在任何即将到来的战斗中都会发挥重要作用！”
        ]
        
        [flags.KM_FEAST_AUXILIARY_RECRUITED
            |“拉奇安·伊格纳法鲁斯和他的妻子将会加入我们，同时还会有一部分皇家辅助部队一同前来。”
            
            “太好了！他们的战斗法师和散兵部队将为我们的军队增添强大的神秘力量，使我们能够更迅速地应对敌人的行动。真是非常宝贵的补充！”
        ]
        
        [flags.KM_FEAST_ALANTE_GLADIATORS
            |“阿兰特说她已经成功说服了城里的角斗士们自愿加入。她说这些角斗士们都非常渴望参与行动。”
            
            卡莉丝轻敲着下巴思考道：“他们的加入虽然有些意外，但并不是坏事。他们不会成为一支有组织的军事力量，但如果我们把他们当作军队来对待，那可就太愚蠢了！不，他们的作用更像是散兵游勇，负责扰乱敌人的行动节奏。”
        ]
        
        [flags.KM_FEAST_ARMITIA_RECRUIT
            |“大祭司穆恩吉文表示，她会将我们的请求提交给城中的神职人员。她相信，许多祭司，尤其是那些擅长治疗的祭司，会加入我们的行列。”
            
            “他们真的会这么做吗？这真是太好的消息了。神秘学家和医疗专家们会以他们自己的方式，在战场上拯救生命。”
        ]
    ]
    
    [var2
        |卡莉丝叹了口气，揉了揉太阳穴。“就这样了吗？啊，那我们只能另寻他法了。我不该在一天之内就给你带来这么大的负担，不过还是需要你帮忙在各个边境地区招募盟友。在科尔米诺斯发生的一切都会影响到每一个人。其他定居点的领导者肯定也会注意到这一点。”
        
        “如果他们没有注意到呢？”
        
        “那么我们就只能随机应变了。我更愿意在战场上消灭我们的敌人，但如果你能够潜入寒冰宫殿，或许也能再次做到这一点——也就是侵入那些繁殖基地……”
        |“我们应该有足够的兵力来与那些恶魔交战，至少能够进行一场小规模的冲突。不过，如果在边境地区的领袖们中找到更多的盟友，那肯定能增加我们的胜算。不过这个决定，就交给你来做了。”
    ]

[pc.isMage |You and [pc.name] are practically two peas in a pod, the way you pick up spellcraft so naturally! |The way [pc.name] picks up on talents so easily, you'd think [pc.heShe] would have the same potential. ]" You and Cait exchange a look. ]"So what's holding Varena back?" Barney ponders that a moment, consulting the bottom of his goblet. "She's lacked a push towards mastery, I would say. Her talents are pulled in too many directions — the duties of a princess, her artistry, scholarship, and magic all compete for her attention. [party.has cait |Much like you, my girl. |She's like my dear Caitriss in that regard, divided between her potential as a mage, her devotion to Mallach, and now our efforts to rescue poor Calladona. My daughters both were blessed with superb magical attunement, but alas, [cait.isNarevan |only Cait ever embraced it. |Cait is a dilettant and Calla preferred the blade! ] ] I suppose I have little room to complain, I have spent my life doing much the same!"
rows.translation: “你认识公主吗？”你问道。 “哦，只能算初次见面后应有的了解。”巴尼回答道，发出一阵和善的轻笑。“宴会开始前，我有幸与她结识；我们愉快地谈论了巫术与古代埃斯托洛尔人。你知道吗，她是个相当聪明的姑娘。读书非常多，而且好奇心永不满足。简直让我想起年轻时的自己！更别提她的施法技巧了！我只看过一小段演示，但可以肯定，只要她用心钻研，就有成为大法师的资质——记住我的话。” 你回头看向与父亲同坐的瓦蕾娜。身材丰润，充满女人味，还稍微有些肌肉……和人们想象中的奥术强者实在不太一样。“你觉得她真有那么大潜力？” 巴尼热情地点头。“哦，没错，绝对没错。瓦蕾娜的训练只触及了皮毛，勉强够她施展一两个戏法……可要是专心研习魔法，我相信她有能力与女王宫廷里的任何一位大术士匹敌。”[party.has cait |他转向凯特，又补充道：“亲爱的，她几乎已经和你不相上下了。” 凯特红着脸，顺着你的目光看向主桌。“[cait.isNarevan |我不知道该怎么评价自己被拿来和真正的公主比较，不过我确实能感受到她的潜力。她散发出的气场像蓄满电的闪电。 |你在说什么呀，爸爸？我也不是大法师，更绝对没有科尔米诺斯公主那么厉害。 ]” “你太小看自己了，凯特丽丝。你对各类魔法的掌握一向非同寻常；从你小时候开始就是这样，那时我只用一个下午教了你一点戏法。[pc.isMage |你和[pc.name]简直像一个豆荚里的两颗豆子，学习法术都如此自然！ |[pc.name]掌握各种才能都如此轻松，让人以为[pc.heShe]也有同样的潜力。 ]” 你和凯特交换了一个眼神。 ]“那是什么阻碍了瓦蕾娜？” 巴尼思索片刻，又看了看高脚杯底。“要我说，她缺少一种推动自己精益求精的动力。她的才华被分散到了太多方向——公主的职责、艺术创作、学术和魔法都在争夺她的注意力。[party.has cait |很像你，我的姑娘。 |这方面，她和我亲爱的凯特丽丝很像：既有成为法师的潜力，又要投身马拉克的信仰，如今还得和我们一起营救可怜的卡拉多娜。我的两个女儿都拥有极其出色的魔法亲和力，可惜，[cait.isNarevan |只有凯特真正接受了这份天赋。 |凯特只是浅尝辄止，卡拉则更喜欢刀剑！ ] ]不过我想，自己没有多少资格抱怨；毕竟我一生都在做同样的事！”
rows.raw: ' "Do you know the princess?" you ask. "Oh, just as well as one can from a first meeting," Barney answers, accompanied by a good-natured chuckle. "I had the privilege of making her acquaintance just before the party, and we had a lovely chat about wizardry and the old Esteloreans. She's quite the bright girl, you know. Very well read, and she's got an insatiable curiosity. Reminds me of myself when I was young! And to say nothing of her spellcraft! I only saw a small demonstration, but I can tell you she's got the making of an archmage if she put her mind to it, mark my words." You glance over your shoulder, to where Varena's sitting with her father. Plush, feminine, a bit muscular... not exactly the archetype of arcane power. "You think she's that much potential?" Barney nods enthusiastically. "Oh, yes, yes indeed. Varena's only scratched the surface with her training, enough to sling a cantrip or two around... but if she dedicated herself to the craft, I believe she has what it takes to rival any of the great sorcerers of my queen's court." She's got an air to her like charged lightning." |What're you talking about, dad? I'm not an archmage either. My daughters both were blessed with superb magical attunement, but alas, [cait.isNarevan |only Cait ever embraced it. |Cait is a dilettant and Calla preferred the blade! ] ] I suppose I have little room to complain, I have spent my life doing much the same!" rows.original: "How did you manage to make the journey all the way here, anyway? The Undermountain's a warzone." "You may not believe me, dear [pc.boyGirl], but I'm stealthy as a cat even at my age!" Barney laughs. "A little magic to cloak my steps, and the demons never saw a thing. Neither did the legions of Khor'minos, for that matter, though I walked straight through the encampment of the Third Legion and a whole host of the Royal Auxiliary." "How in the world..." you start, then pause. If a plump old tomcat can sneak through the army's blockade, that doesn't give you a lot of confidence in their ability to stop any demons from slipping through the same way. "Barney, you didn't see anybody else trying the same thing, did you?" The older man's brow furrows, and his tail thwacks against the tapestry behind him. "I must say, seeing anyone would be quite against the point of the whole thing, don't you think? Still... I did get the feeling I wasn't the first to slip through that way. It was all too easy, as though a path had been left open for those with the cunning to see it, a certain gap in patrols and barricades just loose enough to pass through unnoticed by oneself. I'd thought I was just particularly clever, but if you think something else might be at play, why, I'd say you might just be right! Right, indeed." [party.has cait |Cait sighs. "Dad... I can't believe you just snuck through an army base. Do you know how dangerous that is?" "Not at all, for a master magician such as myself!" he insists, adjusting his fez. ] [pc.isCunning |If Barney's not just blustering blindly, that means someone with a fair bit of authority must have arranged for that path he took to be open. But who, and for what purpose... ]
rows.translation: “话说回来，你到底是怎么一路来到这里的？山腹深域可是战区。” “亲爱的[pc.boyGirl]，你也许不会相信，但我到了这个年纪，行动起来仍然像猫一样隐秘！”巴尼笑道，“施点小魔法遮掩脚步，恶魔们便什么都看不见。其实科尔米诺斯军团也什么都没发现，尽管我径直穿过了第三军团的营地，以及王家辅兵的一整支大部队。” “这到底是怎么……”你开口问道，随即停了下来。要是一个胖乎乎的老猫人都能偷偷穿过军队的封锁，你实在没法相信他们能阻止恶魔以同样的方式渗透。“巴尼，你没看见还有其他人尝试这么做吧？” 老人皱起眉头，尾巴啪的一声抽在身后的挂毯上。“不得不说，看见任何人都会彻底违背整件事的要义，你不觉得吗？不过……我确实感觉自己不是第一个从那里溜过去的人。一切都太简单了，就像有人特意为足够机敏、能发现它的人留出了一条路：巡逻队与路障之间有一道恰好足以让人不被发现地通过的缺口。我原以为只是自己格外聪明，可如果你认为还有别的事情在背后起作用，哎呀，我觉得你恐怕真的猜对了！千真万确。” [party.has cait |凯特叹了口气。“爸爸……我不敢相信你居然偷偷穿过了军事基地。你知道那有多危险吗？” “对于我这样的魔法大师来说，毫无危险！”他一边坚持，一边调整头上的菲斯帽。 ] [pc.isCunning |如果巴尼不是在信口吹嘘，就意味着有个地位不低的人特意安排那条路线保持畅通。但会是谁，又有什么目的…… ]

rows.original: "[pc.isBimbo |So, um, is Jassira really close to Khor'minos, or what? |Tell me, does Jassira have any political ties to the kingdom here? ]" "Oh, nothing so much as that," Barney says. "But Sultana Nadia and King Kelsaz have exchanged gifts of gold and gems and precious things for many years, as their ancestors did before them. During the days of Old Belhar, many of Khor'minos's slaves came to the kingdom by way of Jassiran traders, and even today the two are as strong a pair of trading partners as two countries so far apart can be. When you think about it, the northernmost parts of the Sultanate are roughly equidistant to the southernmost parts of Old Belhar." "I've never been beyond the sea," you admit. "Was it difficult for you and your girls to get here?" Barney nods, pausing only to pluck a skewer of roasted lamb from a passing servant's tray. "Ah, yes, it's hardly the most unpleasant of journeys — that honor, my [pc.boyGirl], would go to crossing the Gildune to reach Xenaspa. You'd not believe how vast the sea of sand can truly be... nor how ornery a camel can be! They spit and bite!" He shudders. "I wish that expedition had reached its destination, but the desert is a cruel mistress indeed. Man was not meant to walk beyond the beautiful spires of Crocodopolis, mark my words. By comparison, a short boat trip between Arkacia and the Valgar lands is a pleasant diversion. Even though, as it happens, my family is... less than entirely welcome in Arkacia." You quirk a brow. "Ah, you see, what is now the Amirate of Arkacia was once ruled by the great house of Arkannion, whence my dear Caitriss and Calladona can trace their bloodline. I had thought that, surely, just passing through on our way to the port would not have provoked so much hostility from the Amira, but she was quick to detain us. A suspicious woman, her, and of dubious character. But there is no situation I cannot charm my way out of, never fear!" [party.has cait |Cait giggles. "What he means is, it's very lucky for us that Calla knows how to pick locks." "Oh is that how you two got out of the tower?" Barney says, scratching his beard. "The Amira did tell me while we were dining that she'd release you two." "I don't think she was going to. And besides, we're the ones that broke you out of her residence." "Why, I had everything under control, my dear girl," Barney huffs. "Everything, indeed." ] Barney takes a deep bite of his skewer, and closes his eyes as he relishes the flavor. "Ah, but yes, it's not a terribly long journey across the Sea of Kacia between Arkacia and the Valgar lands, certainly a shorter one than that between Jassira City and Callathia, in Old Belhar. Much of the trade between the Sultanate and Kingdom of Khor'minos, though, ride the east coast of the Valgar lands up to the Sailgraves, which sit just off the coast here. The Minoan navy is quite adept at protecting merchantmen from the islanders and coastal peoples!" [party.has arona |Arona snorts. "Yeah, right." ]
rows.translation: "[pc.isBimbo |那么，嗯，贾西拉真的和科尔米诺斯关系很密切吗？还是怎么回事？ |告诉我，贾西拉与这个王国有任何政治上的联系吗？ ]哦，并没有那么严重，”巴尼说，“但是苏丹娜·纳迪亚和国王凯尔萨兹多年来一直互相赠送黄金、宝石和各种珍贵的礼物，他们的祖先也是这么做的。在古老的贝尔哈尔时代，许多来自科尔米诺斯的奴隶都是通过贾西兰商人来到这个王国的，直到今天，这两国依然是关系最为紧密的贸易伙伴。仔细想想，苏丹国的最北部地区与老贝尔哈尔的最南部地区之间的距离大致是相等的。 “我从未去过海的另一边，”你承认道，“对你和你的女儿们来说，来到这里是不是很困难呢？巴尼点了点头，只是中途停了一下，从一位路过的仆从托盘上拿了一根烤羊肉串。“啊，没错，这确实算不上是最糟糕的旅程……这个荣誉，我的[pc.boyGirl]他们不得不穿越吉尔德恩沙漠才能到达塞纳斯帕。你绝对无法想象那片沙海究竟有多广阔……也绝对想象不到骆驼会有多难伺候！它们会吐口水、还会咬人！”他颤抖着说道，“真希望那次探险能够成功到达目的地，但沙漠确实是一个残酷的女主人。我的话你们要记住：人类本就不该走到克罗科多波利斯那些美丽的尖塔之外。相比之下，从阿尔卡西亚乘船前往瓦尔加尔地区，反而是一种惬意的消遣方式。不过，事实上，我的家人却偏偏喜欢这么做。在阿尔卡西亚，这样的人并不受欢迎。” 你微微挑了挑眉毛。 “啊，你知道的，现在的阿尔卡西亚酋长国曾经由阿尔卡尼恩家族统治，我亲爱的凯特和卡拉多娜的血统也源自那个家族。我原本以为，我们在前往港口的途中顺道经过那里，应该不会引起阿米拉的如此敌意，但她却立刻拦住了我们。她是个充满疑虑的女人，性格也相当可疑。不过，没有什么情况是我无法用我的魅力摆脱的，别担心！" [party.has cait |凯特轻声笑了起来：“他的意思是，卡拉会开锁，对我们来说真是太幸运了。” “哦，原来你们是这么从塔里逃出来的？”巴尼挠着胡子说道，“我们在吃饭的时候，阿米拉确实告诉我她会放你们俩出来的。” “不过我觉得她本来并不打算那么做。而且，其实是我们自己把锁弄坏了的。你为什么，我本来把一切都控制得很好啊，我亲爱的姑娘，”巴尼气愤地说，“真的，一切都在我的掌控之中。 ] 巴尼深深地咬了一口烤肉串，闭上眼睛尽情享受其中的味道。“啊，确实如此，从阿尔卡西亚到瓦尔加尔地区，穿越卡西亚海的距离并不算太长，肯定比从贾西拉城到老贝尔哈尔的卡拉西亚要短得多。然而，苏丹国与科尔米诺斯王国之间的大部分贸易活动都是通过瓦尔加尔地区的东海岸进行的，这些贸易路线一直延伸到位于海岸线附近的塞尔格雷夫斯地区。米诺斯海军在保护商船免受岛民及沿海居民的侵扰方面表现得相当出色！" [party.has arona |阿罗娜哼了一声：“是啊，当然。 ]

rows.original: "Anything caught your eye in the palace, Barney?" The elder catfolk beams excitedly. "Oh, my, just about everything! The art and tapestries that adorn the wall are all truly magnificent, a testament to the centuries this palace has weathered through war and chaos, prosperity and plenty. And the galleries! To see the skull of a great dragon is truly a marvel. I have only seen the remains of a dragon once before, dug up from the wastelands west of Tronarii, and now I can say with some surety it must have been a young one. Its skull was barely half the size of the great wyrm's on display here." [ashe.around |You can feel Ashe shuddering. ] "How about the people?" you prompt. "Meet anybody interesting?" "Several! The princess, of course, but I've also had the pleasure of meeting several senators tonight. I had a wonderful conversation earlier with Senator Dacius, in fact — the fellow in charge of the kingdom's treasury. He was quite delighted when he learned my wife fills his place in the Sultanate, and we got on like old chums. The man's quite the miracle worker, working with the Crown Prince to keep food and military supplies coming into the kingdom despite the demon onslaught. Without their dedicated efforts, this war of their would long since have been lost! Oh, and let's not forget[var0| the lady Juno and lord-captain Livernon. We had a lovely conversation just when they arrived. What an honor to meet one of Sorra's favorite daughters! And also] High Priestess Armitia. That lady has a frightful presence, doesn't she? Like a dervish waiting to be unleashed. She's stronger than she looks, no doubt." [party.has cait |"Did you get to meet Lady Calise, dad?" Cait asks. |"Have you met Calise?" you ask. ] Barney shakes his head. "Oh, I haven't had the pleasure. I would love to ask her about her axe. I understand she carries the Ancient Hewer, blessed by Velun himself — an artifact of nature's wrath incarnate. I have seen many a mystical trinket in my day, but never one given its power by the hand of the Treefather." [party.has cait |"Soooo," Cait purrs, rocking on her heels. "Are you gonna go talk to her?" "Oh! No, no, she's much too busy I'm sure. And besides, I didn't see any of her wargear on her! Perhaps after the party I shall look her up. I understand she has a dwelling here in the city." ]
rows.translation: 巴尼，在宫殿里有没有什么让你特别感兴趣的东西？” 那位年长的猫族兴奋地回答道：“哦，天哪，几乎所有的东西都让我印象深刻！那些装饰在墙上的艺术品和挂毯真是美得令人惊叹，它们见证了这座宫殿历经了数个世纪的风雨变迁，见证了它在战争与混乱、繁荣与富足中的存续与发展。还有那些展馆！能够看到一条巨龙的头骨，实在是一件令人惊叹的事情。我之前只见过一次龙的遗骸，那是从特洛纳里伊西部的荒原中挖掘出来的，而现在我可以肯定地说，那一定是一条幼龙。它的头骨大小仅是这里展出的那条巨型巨龙的半分之一而已。 [ashe.around |你能感觉到艾什在颤抖。 ] 那些人怎么样？”你问道，“有没有遇到什么有趣的人？” “有几个呢！当然有公主，而且今晚我还有幸见了几位参议员。事实上，我早些时候还和负责王国财政的达修斯参议员进行了一次非常愉快的交谈。当他得知我的妻子在苏丹国中承担了他的职责，而我们也能像老朋友一样相处时，他显得非常高兴。这个人确实是个了不起的人——他在王储的协助下，即便面对恶魔的袭击，也确保了王国能够持续获得食物和军用物资的供应。如果没有他们的无私奉献，这场战争早就失败了！哦，对了，我们可千万不能忘记这一点。[var0| 朱诺女士和利弗诺恩上尉。他们刚到的时候，我们进行了一次非常愉快的交谈。能够见到索拉最宠爱的女儿之一，真是莫大的荣幸！而且……]大祭司阿尔米蒂亚。那位女士给人的感觉实在非常强大，不是吗？就像一个随时准备爆发的苦行僧。毫无疑问，她的实力远比外表看上去要强。 [party.has cait |爸爸，你见到卡莉丝女士了吗？”凯特问道。 |你见过卡莉丝吗？”你问道。 ] 巴尼摇了摇头。“哦，我还没这个荣幸呢。我很想问问她关于那把斧头的事。我听说她一直带着它…… 古代赫威尔这物件得到了维伦本人的赐福——它是大自然愤怒的化身。这些年来，我见过许多神秘的饰品，但从来没有哪一件是像这件一样，其力量源自“树之父”的亲自赐予。 [party.has cait |所以啊，”凯特摇着脚跟说道，“你打算去和她谈谈吗？” “哦！不，不，她肯定忙得不可开交。而且，我也没看到她身上有任何战斗装备！也许等派对结束后，我会去找她。我知道她在这座城市里有住处。 ]
rows.raw: ' "Anything caught your eye in the palace, Barney?" The elder catfolk beams excitedly. "Oh, my, just about everything! The art and tapestries that adorn the wall are all truly magnificent, a testament to the centuries this palace has weathered through war and chaos, prosperity and plenty. And the galleries! To see the skull of a great dragon is truly a marvel. I have only seen the remains of a dragon once before, dug up from the wastelands west of Tronarii, and now I can say with some surety it must have been a young one. Its skull was barely half the size of the great wyrm's on display here." [ashe.around |You can feel Ashe shuddering. ] "How about the people?" you prompt. "Meet anybody interesting?" "Several! The princess, of course, but I've also had the pleasure of meeting several senators tonight. I had a wonderful conversation earlier with Senator Dacius, in fact — the fellow in charge of the kingdom's treasury. He was quite delighted when he learned my wife fills his place in the Sultanate, and we got on like old chums. The man's quite the miracle worker, working with the Crown Prince to keep food and military supplies coming into the kingdom despite the demon onslaught. Without their dedicated efforts, this war of their would long since have been lost! Oh, and let's not forget[var0| the lady Juno and lord-captain Livernon. We had a lovely conversation just when they arrived. What an honor to meet one of Sorra's favorite daughters! And also] High Priestess Armitia. That lady has a frightful presence, doesn't she? Like a dervish waiting to be unleashed. She's stronger than she looks, no doubt." [party.has cait |"Did you get to meet Lady Calise, dad?" Cait asks. |"Have you met Calise?" you ask. ] Barney shakes his head. "Oh, I haven't had the pleasure. I would love to ask her about her axe. I understand she carries the Ancient Hewer, blessed by Velun himself — an artifact of nature's wrath incarnate. I have seen many a mystical trinket in my day, but never one given its power by the hand of the Treefather." [party.has cait |"Soooo," Cait purrs, rocking on her heels. "Are you gonna go talk to her?" "Oh! No, no, she's much too busy I'm sure. And besides, I didn't see any of her wargear on her! Perhaps after the party I shall look her up. I understand she has a dwelling here in the city." ] '

rows.original:
When you and Calise finally make your way back downstairs, it's to the sound of harp music and the rhythmic clatter of hooves on stone — the dancing's already underway! The partygoers have made two lines facing each other, swinging between each others' ranks with practiced precision. Noble girls are swung around by bulls half again their size, skimpy dresses twirling colorfully around them each time they pass by the boys. 
    
    Calise gives you an apologetic look. "Seems like we missed the start of things. We'd best find the king — I'm sure he'll want the honor of a dance with one of us."
    
    Kelsaz isn't hard to find, of course. The royal bull towers over all but the biggest of minotaurs[party.has brint
        |, such as Brint
    ], but at the moment he's got his trunk-like arms wrapped around the comparatively tiny first princess, both smiling jovially as they dance around each other. When they see the two of you approaching, Kelsaz hefts Varena up and gives her a spin that leaves her squealing and giggling. 
    
    The king plants his daughter down in front of him and rubs her horns, while giving you and Calise a nod. "Welcome back, Champions. I hope all is well on the rooftops...?"
    
    Calise inclines her head. "Oh, yes. No assassins or thieves getting in that way, my king, never fear." 
    
    "I'm sure we all feel safer knowing you're on the job, Lady Calise," Varena says. 
    
    "Indeed!" her father booms, ignoring the suspicious tone in his daughter's voice. "What matters is that you're here, Champions, and we've still two dances left to go before the night is out!"
    
    The princess [flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA_FLIRT|flashes you a hopeful smile|glances at you with a demure smile]. 
    
    You have a chance to ask someone to dance before things get underway.
rows.translation:
你和卡莉丝终于回到楼下时，耳边响起竖琴的乐声，以及蹄子有节奏地敲击石面的声响——舞会已经开始了！宾客们面对面排成两列，以训练有素的精准舞步在彼此的队列间穿梭。贵族姑娘们被体型大上足足一半的公牛带着旋转；每次经过男伴身边，身上轻薄的礼服都会缤纷地飞舞起来。
    
    卡莉丝歉意地看了你一眼。“看来我们错过了开场。最好去找国王——我相信他会希望有幸和我们中的一人共舞。”
    
    当然，凯尔萨兹并不难找。这位王族公牛比几乎所有弥诺陶洛斯都高大[party.has brint
        |，布琳特这般巨汉除外
    ]。不过此时此刻，他用树干般粗壮的双臂抱着相形之下格外娇小的第一王女；两人相对起舞，笑得十分愉快。看见你们走近，凯尔萨兹将瓦蕾娜高高举起，带着她旋转一圈，惹得她又是尖叫又是咯咯发笑。
    
    国王把女儿放回面前，揉了揉她的牛角，同时朝你和卡莉丝点头。“欢迎回来，两位冠军。屋顶上一切安好……？”
    
    卡莉丝微微颔首。“哦，当然。没有刺客或小偷从那里闯进来，陛下，请放心。”
    
    “知道卡莉丝女士亲自把守，我们肯定都安心多了。”瓦蕾娜说道。
    
    “确实如此！”她父亲洪亮地应道，完全没注意女儿语气里的怀疑。“重要的是你们回来了，两位冠军；在今晚结束前，我们还有两支舞要跳！”
    
    公主[flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA_FLIRT|满怀希望地朝你微笑|带着矜持的微笑看了你一眼]。
    
    在舞蹈开始之前，你还有机会邀请某个人共舞。

rows.translation: 邀请凯尔萨兹国王跳舞吧。

rows.original: Ask the First Princess of the realm to dance with you.
rows.translation: 邀请王国的第一公主与你共舞。
rows.raw: "Ask the First Princess of the realm to dance with you."

rows.original: Ask the Crown Prince of Khor'minos to dance. It's not every day you can get this close to the heir to the kingdom.
rows.translation: 邀请科尔米诺斯的王储跳舞吧。能有机会如此接近这个王国的继承人，可不是每天都能遇到的。
rows.raw: "Ask the Crown Prince of Khor'minos to dance. It's not every day you can get this close to the heir to the kingdom."

rows.original:
"King Kelsaz," you say, stepping up to the towering bull. "May I have the honor of this dance?"
    
    The king [flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_FLIRT
        |gives you a warm smile and takes your hand
        |gives you a surprised look, but doesn't hesitate more than moment to take your hand
    ]. [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED
        |"I suppose it would appear untoward to refuse you in front of the palace," he grumbles. "
        |[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_FLIRT
            |"I was hoping you would ask, Champion!
            |After a parting glance at Calise, he grins at you. "Well this is unexpected, but not unwelcome.
        ]
    ] Let us show the city what we are capable of."
    
    The king leads you out onto the dance floor. The other guests part around you two like a sea of fur and horns, and [livrea.met|Livrea adjusts her golden harp over in the gallery|the minstrel in the gallery adjusts her golden harp] before starting up a new song, slow and stately as befitting the king and Champion taking center stage. The king laces his large, furry fingers through yours and pulls you close against his chest. "Do you know how to dance, Champion?" he whispers.
    
    [pc.canDance
        |"Let me show you," you reply, starting to move to the beat. The king gives a hint of a smile and lets you lead, taking special care not to step on your [pc.feet]. He's not bad himself, but you detect a touch of shyness to his movements beyond the simple care for your smaller stature; it's hard to tell if he's just unsure about your skill, or if he's genuinely a little on edge with all eyes on you both.
        |"Nope!" you reply blithely, "You'll have to take the lead."
        
        "Ah. Of course," the king says. "Hold onto me, then." 
        
        You do so, trying to follow the much bigger man's moves while he takes special care not to step on you by accident. It's more of a gentle sway this way and that, but you're able to keep up pretty well despite your unsteady foot. The hands on yours are strong and firm, but the man himself seems oddly gentle now despite his titanic size and physique. His touch on you is feather-light, and his movements deliberately give you space.
    ]

凯尔萨兹国王，”你说道，走上前，面对着那头高大的公牛，“能否有幸与您共跳这支舞？”
    
    国王[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_FLIRT
        |对你露出温暖的微笑，然后握住你的手
        |他们会露出惊讶的表情，但丝毫不会迟疑，立刻就会握住你的手
    ]。 [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED
        |我想，在宫殿面前拒绝你，似乎会显得不太妥当，”他嘟囔道。
        |[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_FLIRT
            |我就盼着你会这么问呢，冠军！
            |在向卡莉丝投去最后一瞥后，他对你露出了微笑：“嗯，这确实有些出乎意料，但也不错啊。
        ]
    ]让我们向这座城市证明我们的实力吧。”
    
    国王引领你走进舞池。其他宾客像一片由毛皮与角构成的海洋般，纷纷为你们让开道路[livrea.met|莉维娅在楼上的画廊里调整着她那把金色的竖琴。|画廊里的吟游诗人调整着她那金色的竖琴。]在开始演奏新曲之前，他的动作缓慢而庄严，完全符合一位国王兼冠军应有的风范。他将自己那粗大而毛茸茸的手指与你的手牵在了一起，然后将你紧紧拉到自己的胸前。“你会跳舞吗，冠军？”他轻声问道。
    
    [pc.canDance
        |让我来给你演示吧，”你说道，然后开始随着节奏移动起来。国王微微一笑，让你先带路，同时格外小心，生怕踩到你的脚。 [pc.feet]他本人倒也不差，但你能察觉到，在他对待你的举动中，除了出于对你身材较矮的关心之外，还隐含着一丝羞涩。很难判断他是真的不确定你的能力，还是因为在这么多人的注视下，他确实感到有些紧张。
        |不行！”你轻松地回答道，“你得自己带头才行。”
        
        “啊，当然。”国王说，“那你就抓紧我吧。”
        
        你照做了，努力跟随这个身材高大的男人的动作，而他也格外小心，生怕不小心踩到你。他的动作更像是轻轻地左右摇摆，但尽管你的脚步不太稳，你还是能够很好地跟上他的节奏。握住你的那些手非常有力、非常稳重，然而这个男人本身，尽管体型庞大、体格强壮，此刻却显得出奇地温柔。他对待你的方式轻柔得像羽毛一般，他的动作也总是刻意给你留出空间。
    ]

rows.original: Really give the city's noblewomen something to be jealous about — and give the king a show to remember you by.
rows.translation: 这确实能让城里的贵族女性们感到嫉妒，同时也能为国王留下一个值得纪念的表演。
rows.raw: "Really give the city's noblewomen something to be jealous about — and give the king a show to remember you by."

rows.original: The king's not impressed enough to let you get away with this.
rows.translation: 国王可不会因为这件事就放你一马。
rows.raw: "The king's not impressed enough to let you get away with this."

rows.original: Let the King lead, and just enjoy yourself.
rows.translation: 让国王来带领大家，你们只需尽情享受就好。
rows.raw: "Let the King lead, and just enjoy yourself."

rows.original: This is probably your last and only chance to privately warn the king about the demon in his court.
rows.translation: 这可能是你最后一次，也是唯一一次机会，可以私下提醒国王关于他宫廷里那个恶魔了。
rows.raw: "This is probably your last and only chance to privately warn the king about the demon in his court."

rows.original:
You press yourself tight against the royal bull's broad, muscular chest, sucking in deep lungfuls of his earthy, slightly musky scent.[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE
        | You can still smell a hint of masculine aroma wafting up from his loins, lingering evidence of your misdeeds.
    ] His fur is so soft and silky, so warm to the touch, you can't help but bury your face into it as you dance. Kelsaz chuckles, a touch awkwardly, but he puts a hand into the small of your back and continues the dance. 
    
    Is that a bit more sensuality in his moves you detect? You glance up to find a hint of a smile on the king's lips, and his big, strong hand slides down your back. Oh, my. With a shift of your own stance, you ensure that the next time the king steps around you, one of your hands slips between his mighty thighs and through his toga, fingers brushing against the horsecock hidden beneath. The king draws in a sharp breath, but he doesn't pull away.
    
    [flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE
        |"Once not enough for you?" the king whispers in your ear. "Insatiable!"
        |[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_FLIRT
            |The king snorts softly. "You don't waste any time, do you?"
        ]
    ]
    
    You just give him a hungry look and let your dirty dancing do the talking for you, grinding against the king whenever the music gives you an excuse. His pride stiffens at your repeated touch, though he does an admirable — if taxing — job of hiding it from the crowd, but the way you're moving, there's no avoiding some attention. There's a small chorus of jealous noises from nearby noblewomen, and an embarrassed gasp from Princess Varena. Crown Prince Vrannus snorts a laugh, quickly hiding his face in the long hair of the noble heiress fortunate enough to have his attention for the moment. 
    
    "My court is going to be tittering about this for weeks," Kelsaz says, though he doesn't sound all that put out. If anything, his breath's hot and heavy against your neck, and his fingers are tightening their grip in your [pc.armor]. 
    
    "Good. That should keep me on your mind," you smile. 
    
    The king snorts, and something heavy thumps against your thigh from beneath his toga. "Oh, yes. You've made for an... unforgettable evening, [pc.name]. I hope that, when this war is done, we can... continue what we've started here."
    
    "I look forward to it," you tell him as the music begins to wind down.
rows.translation:
你紧贴王族公牛宽阔而肌肉发达的胸膛，深深吸入他那充满泥土气息、略带麝香的味道。[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE
        |你仍能嗅到一丝从他胯间飘来的雄性气味，那是你们刚才胡作非为留下的证据。
    ]他的毛发如此柔软丝滑，触感如此温暖；共舞时，你忍不住把脸深深埋了进去。凯尔萨兹略显尴尬地轻笑，却仍将一只手放到你腰背处，继续跳舞。
    
    你是不是从他的舞步中察觉到了更多情欲？你抬头看去，发现国王唇边浮现一丝笑意；他强壮的大手则顺着你的后背向下滑去。哎呀。你也变换姿势，确保国王下一次绕到身边时，自己的一只手能穿过他的双腿之间，探进托加长袍，手指轻轻擦过下面隐藏的马根。国王猛吸一口气，却没有退开。
    
    [flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE
        |“一次还不够吗？”国王在你耳边低语道，“真是贪得无厌！”
        |[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_FLIRT
            |国王轻哼一声。“你真是一刻也不肯浪费，对吧？”
        ]
    ]
    
    你只向他投去饥渴的眼神，让这场色情舞蹈替自己开口；每当音乐提供机会，你便紧贴国王扭磨身体。反复的触碰让他的雄风逐渐挺立；他努力将其隐藏在人群的视线之外，表现得令人钦佩，却也颇为辛苦。只是以你这番舞姿，想不引人注意根本不可能。附近几位贵妇发出一小片嫉妒的抱怨，瓦蕾娜公主也尴尬地倒抽一口气。弗兰努斯王储嗤笑出声，很快便把脸藏进一位幸运获得他青睐的贵族女继承人那头长发里。

'
    You press yourself tight against the royal bull's broad, muscular chest, sucking in deep lungfuls of his earthy, slightly musky scent.[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE
        | You can still smell a hint of masculine aroma wafting up from his loins, lingering evidence of your misdeeds.
    ] His fur is so soft and silky, so warm to the touch, you can't help but bury your face into it as you dance. Kelsaz chuckles, a touch awkwardly, but he puts a hand into the small of your back and continues the dance. 
    
    Is that a bit more sensuality in his moves you detect? You glance up to find a hint of a smile on the king's lips, and his big, strong hand slides down your back. Oh, my. With a shift of your own stance, you ensure that the next time the king steps around you, one of your hands slips between his mighty thighs and through his toga, fingers brushing against the horsecock hidden beneath. The king draws in a sharp breath, but he doesn't pull away.
    
    [flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE
        |"Once not enough for you?" the king whispers in your ear. "Insatiable!"
        |[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_FLIRT
            |The king snorts softly. "You don't waste any time, do you?"
        ]
    ]
    
    You just give him a hungry look and let your dirty dancing do the talking for you, grinding against the king whenever the music gives you an excuse. His pride stiffens at your repeated touch, though he does an admirable — if taxing — job of hiding it from the crowd, but the way you're moving, there's no avoiding some attention. There's a small chorus of jealous noises from nearby noblewomen, and an embarrassed gasp from Princess Varena. Crown Prince Vrannus snorts a laugh, quickly hiding his face in the long hair of the noble heiress fortunate enough to have his attention for the moment. 
    
    "My court is going to be tittering about this for weeks," Kelsaz says, though he doesn't sound all that put out. If anything, his breath's hot and heavy against your neck, and his fingers are tightening their grip in your [pc.armor]. 
    
    "Good. That should keep me on your mind," you smile. 
    
    The king snorts, and something heavy thumps against your thigh from beneath his toga. "Oh, yes. You've made for an... unforgettable evening, [pc.name]. I hope that, when this war is done, we can... continue what we've started here."
    
    "I look forward to it," you tell him as the music begins to wind down. 
    '

rows.original: You rest your head against the king's broad, muscular chest and let the royal bull set the pace, swaying you around the dancefloor while dozens of noblewomen look on jealously. "You're gentle for such a big man, aren't you?" you muse quietly. The king chuckles. "I'm a scholar at heart. When I was young, I was nearly as scrawny as my son. I owe my current physique to Varena, you know. We made a pact when she was younger, to help her lose weight — a father and daughter commitment to the [silly |church of gains |gymnasium ]." You glance at the gorgeous princess a few paces away, currently in the arms of [party.has brint |Brint, guiding the awkward bull along in the dance despite his bashful protestations |one of the city's younger generals, elegantly swaying along to the music despite her partner having two left feet ]. From where you're standing, the thick muscles of her back and shoulders are on full display. "It's hard to imagine her needing it." "Aha! Her mother always spoiled her at the dinner table," Kelsaz says. "Her brother eats like a bird, pecking at fruits and beans, but Varena will eat anything you put in front of her. And her mother loves to bake. Our estate is always full of cakes and sweetbread, and nothing will keep my daughter's sticky fingers from them for long." Kelsaz smiles at her fondly. "If you think me gentle, [pc.name], it's because I am. I'm ill-suited for war. This tragedy... I want it to end as quick as it can, so I can go back to building this city up. I want Khor'minos to be a metropolis the whole world will envy: the home of its greatest scholars and philosophers and artists. Glory in war is for other men." [pc.dcb |"That sounds dangerously weak," you say. "War can always come to you." |You give him a sad look. "War's found you all the same, King Kelsaz." |You give him a pat on the chest. "We all gotta make the best of it till the war's over." ] "Khaak, you're not wrong," he says. "Though I wish more than anything that you were." The music's reached its crescendo now, and the king's movements slow, his grasp around you relaxing.
rows.translation: 你把头靠在国王宽阔结实的胸膛上，任由这位皇家公牛掌控节奏，带着你在舞池里摇摆，几十位贵族女性羡慕地看着。 “你这么高大的男人，动作倒是很温柔，不是吗？”你轻声说道。 国王轻笑。“我骨子里是个学者。年轻时，我几乎和我儿子一样瘦弱。我如今这副体格要归功于瓦蕾娜，你知道吗。她小一些的时候我们立了个约定，要帮她减重——这是父女俩对[silly |增肌圣殿 |健身房 ]。” 你瞥了一眼几步之外那位美艳的公主，她此刻正在[party.has brint |布林特的怀里，尽管这头笨拙的公牛羞怯地连声抗议，他还是领着它跳舞 |城里一位较年轻的将军怀里，尽管舞伴脚步笨拙，她依然随着音乐优雅地摇摆 ]。从你站的位置看，她背部和肩部厚实的肌肉一览无余。“很难想象她需要这个。” “啊哈！她母亲在餐桌上总是惯着她，”凯尔萨兹说。“她哥哥吃得像只鸟，啄几口水果和豆子就够了，可瓦蕾娜不管你端上什么都会吃光。而她母亲酷爱烘焙。我们家里总是堆满蛋糕和甜面包，什么也挡不住我女儿那双黏糊糊的手伸过去太久。” 凯尔萨兹疼爱地朝她笑了笑。“如果你觉得我温柔，[pc.name]，那是因为我确实如此。我不适合打仗。这场悲剧……我希望它能尽快结束，这样我就能回去继续建设这座城市。我希望科尔米诺斯成为全世界都羡慕的大都市：最伟大的学者、哲学家和艺术家的家园。战争中的荣耀，留给别人吧。” [pc.dcb |“这话听着软弱得危险，”你说。“战争随时可能找上你。” |你悲伤地看了他一眼。“战争还是找上了你们，凯尔萨兹国王。” |你拍了拍他的胸膛。“战争结束之前，我们都只能尽力而为。” ] “哈克，你说得没错，”他说。“但我比什么都希望你说错了。” 音乐此刻达到了高潮，国王的动作慢了下来，环着你的手也放松了。

rows.original:
You lean in close to Kelsaz, dropping your voice to a whisper only he could possibly hear. "I need to warn you about Calise..."
    
    "Hmm?" the king grunts. He doesn't miss a beat in the dance, at least, though his ears do flick at your words. "What do you mean? Is she finally scheming for my hand, [pc.name]?"
    
    "No," you say. "She's [calise.hdk
        |
        |a demon. I suspected it for a while, and now she's confessed the truth to me
        |a demon. And not just any demon — she's Kasyrra
    ]!"
    
    King Kelsaz just lets out a low belly laugh and gives your hands a squeeze. "That's a joke in deeply poor taste, [pc.name]. I'm glad I'm the only one to hear it."
    
    "It's not a joke," you insist, but you can see already the king isn't going to believe you.
    
    He shakes his head and continues the dance unperturbed. "You must be mistaken, Champion. Calise has been this city's savior since long before you arrived. She has lead our soldiers to victory against the demons. There are countless among the Legions that can attest to her laying low fiends with her axe and spells before their eyes." His voice drifts off a moment, but it comes back with another laugh, his voice raised so that those around you can hear. "No matter her origins, Calise has been an invaluable ally to this city. As, I hope, you shall be."
    
    Well that got you nowhere. Even if he believes you, and you're not sure he does... does he just not care? [pc.dcb
        |What a fool.
        |You suppose the demon has made herself indispensable to him after all...
        |It's pretty heartwarming to know nothing can break his friendship, you guess!
    ]
    
    You sigh, and find yourself thankful when the music stops, and the king's grip on you relaxes.
rows.translation:
你靠近凯尔萨兹，将声音压成只有他能听见的低语。“我必须提醒你提防卡莉丝……”
    
    “嗯？”国王哼了一声。至少他的舞步丝毫没有中断，只是耳朵因你的话动了动。“你是什么意思？她终于开始图谋我的婚事了吗，[pc.name]？”
    
    “不是。”你说道，“她[calise.hdk
        |
        |是个恶魔。我已经怀疑了一段时间，而现在她亲口向我坦白了真相
        |是个恶魔。还不是普通恶魔——她就是卡希拉
    ]！”
    
    凯尔萨兹国王只是发出一阵低沉的大笑，捏了捏你的双手。“这个玩笑实在恶劣，[pc.name]。幸好只有我听见。”
    
    “这不是玩笑。”你坚持道，可已经看得出来，国王不会相信你。
    
    他摇摇头，毫不动摇地继续跳舞。“你一定弄错了，冠军。早在你抵达以前，卡莉丝就已经是这座城市的救星。她带领士兵战胜过恶魔。军团里有无数人可以作证，亲眼看见她用斧头与法术击倒魔物。”他的声音短暂地低沉下去，但很快又伴随笑声恢复洪亮，让周围众人都能听见。“无论出身如何，卡莉丝一直都是这座城市无可估量的盟友。我也希望你同样如此。”
    
    好吧，这完全没有用。就算他相信你——而你并不确定他是否相信——难道他根本不在乎吗？[pc.dcb
        |真是个蠢货。
        |你想，那个恶魔终究还是让自己成为了他不可或缺的助力……
        |知道没有任何事情能破坏他的友谊，感觉还挺暖心的！
    ]
    
    你叹了口气。音乐停止，国王放松对你的搂抱时，你不由得感到庆幸。
