rows.original:
"May I have this dance, Princess?" you ask, giving Varena a exaggeratedly formal [pc.mf
        |bow
        |curtsey
    ]. 
    
    Varena [flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE
        |gives you a surprised look. "Not my dad? You're playing for the family, aren't you?"
        |[flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA_FLIRT
            |gives you a broad smile. "I'd be delighted, Champion!"
            |gasps with surprise. "Me?"
            
            "You."
            
            She glances to her father, who gives her a slight nod. "Then I'm happy to oblige!"
        ]
    ]
    
    The princess takes your hand, and you lead her out onto the dance floor. The palace's ginger minstrel launches into a new song as the pair of you take center stage, shortly followed by Calise in the king's arms. Father and daughter end up back to back, and you[calise.kfn
        |'re blown a kiss from Calise around the king's massive bicep
        |'re blown a kiss from Calise around the king's massive bicep
        | get a wink from Calise around the king's massive bicep
    ]. But your attention is quickly swept-up by the voluptuous ravenette before you. [var0|You notice she's cleaned up the mess you made of her bust... and when she notices where you're glancing, you get an unceremonious stomp on the foot as you're starting to dance.|Her bust sways delightfully despite her dress's best attempts to contain it, drawing the eye despite her pretty smile and plentiful jewelry... and when she sees where you're looking, her care to not step on your feet falters just long enough to catch your attention again.]
    
    "Eyes up here," she teases, even as she pulls you a little closer so that [pc.hasBoobs
        |your tits are squishing against hers
        |her massive rack squishes against your [pc.chest]
    ]. 
    
    "I can't say I'm sorry," you answer back.
    
    Varena rolls her eyes, but doesn't skip a beat. [pc.canDance
        |She's a damned skilled dancer, more than able to keep up with you as the music beings to build
        |She catches on quick that you aren't much of a dancer, and slows her pace to compensate — and murmurs something almost unintelligible under her breath about stepping on you
    ]. Her arms squeeze around you, reminding you of that prodigious strength hidden under all those curves, before you spin apart to either side of the line dance. 
    
    When you come back together, she hooks one arm through yours and giggles. "Come on, Champion! Show me what you can do!"

        |鞠躬
        |屈膝礼
    ]。 
    
    瓦蕾娜[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE
        |惊讶地看了你一眼。“不是我爸爸？你这是想把全家都拿下，对吧？”
        |[flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA_FLIRT
            |绽开灿烂的笑容。“我很乐意，冠军！”
            |惊讶地倒吸一口气。“我？”
            
            “就是你。”
            
            她瞥了一眼父亲，父亲微微点头。“那我就恭敬不如从命了！”
        ]
    ]
    
    公主牵起你的手，你带她走进舞池。当你们俩站到中央时，宫里的那位姜黄色头发的吟游诗人奏起一支新曲，紧接着卡莉丝也被国王拥着入了场。父女俩最后背靠着背，而你[calise.kfn
        |被卡莉丝隔着国王粗壮的二头肌抛了个飞吻
        |被卡莉丝隔着国王粗壮的二头肌抛了个飞吻
        | 得到卡莉丝隔着国王粗壮的二头肌抛来的一个媚眼
    ]。但你的注意力很快就被眼前这位丰腴的黑发美人勾走了。[var0|你发现她已经把被你弄乱的那片胸口整理好了……而当她注意到你在往哪儿看时，你刚跳起来就毫不客气地挨了一脚。|尽管她的礼服竭力想裹住那对胸脯，它们依旧诱人地晃荡着，纵使她笑容甜美、珠宝满身，也还是勾走了目光……而当她发现你在看哪里时，她那份小心别踩到你脚的用心短暂一松，就又把你的注意力勾了回去。]
    
    “眼睛往上看，”她打趣道，同时把你拉近了些，于是[pc.hasBoobs
        |你的胸部贴着她的胸挤在一起
        |她那对巨乳挤在你的[pc.chest]上
    ]。 
    
    “我可不能说抱歉，”你回嘴道。
    
    瓦蕾娜翻了个白眼，但舞步一点没乱。[pc.canDance
        |她舞技了得，音乐渐入高潮时完全跟得上你的节奏
        |她很快看出你不太会跳舞，便放慢脚步配合你——还低声嘟囔了句几乎听不清的话，好像是说会踩到你
    ]。她双臂环住你，让你感受到那身曲线下隐藏的惊人力量，随后你们旋身分开，各站到队列舞的一边。 
    
    当你们重新聚到一起时，她一条手臂勾住你的手臂，咯咯笑着说：“来吧，冠军！让我看看你的本事！”

rows.translation: 这可能是你最后一次，也是唯一一次机会，可以私下提醒那些掌权者注意宫廷中的那个危险人物了。
rows.raw: "This is probably your last and only chance to privately warn someone in power about the demon in the court."

rows.original: When the line dance splits off into couples, you twirl the princess around and bring her in close so that your [pc.chest] is in her back, and both her hands are in yours at her sides. Her perfume is honey-sweet, and you're able to nestle your [pc.face] into her rich, black hair. Varena giggles, and starts dancing from the hips, pushing back against you. "How jealous do you plan on making the court?" she whispers. You smirk, starting to match her movements. "Incredibly." Luckily the king's got his back to you, but you're keenly aware of every young bull in the room glancing your way as you and Varena move sensually around each other. Let them watch, you suppose — this is your last moment with Khor'minos's blue-blooded beauty for the night, and damned if you aren't going to make the most of every second. You spin the princess around, pulling her right back against you with her bountiful [silly |udders |boobs ] squished against your [pc.chest]. A little wetly, too. Varena's cheeks color, and she glances away... but doesn't pull back. [var0 |"Doesn't take anything to get you going, does it?" you whisper, surreptitiously taking a second honk on the royal titty between spins. |"Oops," you say, mostly sincerely. ] "I'm a little more sensitive than other girls," Varena pouts, hiding her face in your shoulder. "Don't make fun!" You can't decide if that's a sincere request or not, but either way she doesn't seem mad about the messy mishap. Whatever highly absorbent material her dress is made out of must do wonders, because when the dance next calls for Varena to twirl away from you, there's hardly a dark spot to be seen. She gives you a wink and lets you spin her around once again, sending those bright red skirts flying until she's in your arms again, all smiles and swaying hips. "You're great at this," you tell her, "even for a princess!" [pc.canDance |"You're not bad yourself. We should do this again, I'm having fun!" |"That's good," she giggles, "because you're terrible. I'm having so much fun. I'm gonna have to take you somewhere and teach you to dance if you keep this up." ] You smile at her and settle your arms around her soft tummy, squeezing just enough to feel the rock-hard muscles under her squishable middle. "I wouldn't miss it." "Don't tell my dad," she whispers conspiratorially, "but I sneak out of the palace every now and again. I'll make sure we bump into each other in town." "Can't wait." She gives you a wink as the music begins to wind down again.
rows.translation: 当队列舞分成双人组合时，你可以带着公主旋转，让她靠近你，这样你们就可以[pc.chest]她靠在你的背后，双手放在你的腰间。她的香水散发着甜如蜂蜜的气息，你能够将她紧紧拥入怀中[pc.face]她的黑发随风飘动。瓦蕾娜轻声笑着，开始用臀部为支点跳舞，同时轻轻推着你。 “你打算让宫廷里的人有多嫉妒呢？”她低声说道。 你露出微笑，也开始跟着她的动作跳舞。真是难以置信。” 幸运的是，国王站在你这一边，但当你和瓦蕾娜彼此亲密地互动时，你清楚地感觉到房间里每一个年轻男子都在注视着你。让他们看吧——今晚是你与这位科尔米诺斯王室的贵族美女共度的最后时刻，你绝对要充分利用每一分每一秒。 你轻轻旋转公主的身体，将她紧紧拉向自己，让她那丰盈的身姿完全贴在你的身上[silly |乳房 |胸部 ]紧贴着你的身体[pc.chest]一点点湿润地瓦蕾娜的脸颊也泛起了红晕，她移开了视线……但并没有退缩。 [var0 |似乎只要有一点刺激就能让你开始行动了，对吧？”你低声说道，然后在旋转的过程中偷偷又按了一次那个“皇家奶酪”按钮。 |哎呀，”你说道，语气多半是真诚的。 ] 我比其他女孩更敏感一些，”瓦蕾娜撅着嘴，把脸埋在你的肩膀上。“别取笑我！” 你不确定这是否是一个真诚的请求，但无论如何，她似乎并没有因为那次尴尬的意外而生气。无论她的裙子是用哪种高吸水材料制成的，效果肯定非常显著——因为当接下来舞蹈要求瓦蕾娜从你身边旋转离开时，几乎看不到任何被汗水浸湿的痕迹。她向你眨了眨眼，又让你把她转一圈，那条亮红色的裙子在空中飞舞着，直到她再次回到你怀里，脸上洋溢着笑容，臀部也随着节奏轻轻摇摆。 你在这方面做得真棒，”你对她说，“就连身为公主也是如此！ [pc.canDance |你本身也挺不错的。我们应该再做一次，我玩得很开心！ |那太好了，”她咯咯笑着说，“因为你是太糟糕了。我遇到了麻烦太多了真有趣。如果你继续这样，我就得带你去某个地方，教你跳舞了。 ] 你对她笑了笑，然后将手臂环绕在她柔软的腹部上，轻轻一按，就能感受到她那柔软身体下方坚硬的肌肉。“我绝对不会错过这样的时刻。” “别告诉我爸爸，”她低声说道，语气中带着一丝狡黠，“但我偶尔会偷偷离开宫殿，我会确保我们在城里偶遇的。” “真是迫不及待了。” 随着音乐再次渐渐减弱，她朝你眨了眨眼。

rows.original:
You give the princess a sly grin and put your soul into your [pc.feet]. [pc.canDance
        |The two of you spin 'round each other, royal skirts twirling as you spread apart, then come back close together.
        |You're not as quick on them as the princess, but she goes out of her way to help you along, compensating your unsteadiness with her own movements.
    ] Varena's an energetic dancer, smiling ear to ear as the two of you tear it up together. The music grows more intense as the dance continues, though it's nearly drowned out by the clatter of hooves over the stone. While you and Varena have pride of place beside the king and Calise, there's a whole crowd of noble cowfolk surrounding you — and more than few patrician bulls are giving you rather jealous looks. But Varena's happy to ignore the lot of them, attention entirely focused on you. 
    
    You give the princess [pc.canDance
        |a smile as you two steal the show together
        |your best attempt as a smile as she leads you through the dance
    ]. It's not the most complex ballroom dance by any means, but it's loud and kinetic, enough that pretty soon you're able to forget that there's a thousand pairs of eyes on you two, just like Varena does. 
    
    "You're [pc.canDance
        |not bad at this!" Varena says. "We've got to do this again sometime, [pc.name]!"
        |absolutely terrible. This is so much fun!" Varena giggles. "You've got to let me take you dancing again sometime. Let me show you the ropes one on one."
    ] 
    
    [var0|"I'd love that,"|"Sounds like fun,"] you tell her. 
    
    "Don't tell my dad," she whispers conspiratorially, "but I sneak out of the palace every now and again. I'll make sure we bump into each other in town."
    
    "I can't wait."
    
    She gives you a wink as the music begins to wind down again.
rows.translation:
你对着公主露出狡黠的笑容，把灵魂都倾注到你的[pc.feet]上。 [pc.canDance
        |你们俩绕着彼此旋转，华丽的裙摆随动作飞旋，先是分开，然后又贴近彼此。
        |你在舞步上不如公主那么敏捷，但她总会特意帮你一把，用自己的动作来弥补你的不稳。
    ]瓦蕾娜是个充满活力的舞者，你们俩一起尽情舞动时，她笑得合不拢嘴。随着舞蹈继续，音乐变得更加激昂，尽管几乎被石板上方的马蹄声淹没。你和瓦蕾娜虽然在国王与卡莉丝身旁占据了尊贵的位置，但你们周围围着一整群贵族牛人——还有不少贵族公牛正用相当嫉妒的目光看着你。可瓦蕾娜乐意无视他们所有人，注意力完全集中在你身上。
    
    你给公主[pc.canDance
        |一个笑容，你们俩一起抢尽风头
        |你尽力挤出的一个笑容，由她带着你跳完这支舞
    ]。这绝不是最复杂的舞厅舞蹈，但它喧闹而富有动感，很快就让你能够像瓦蕾娜一样，忘掉有上千双眼睛正盯着你们俩。
    
    “你[pc.canDance
        |跳得还不错！”瓦蕾娜说。“我们以后一定得再来一次，[pc.name]！”
        |简直糟透了。这真是太有趣了！”瓦蕾娜咯咯一笑。“你以后一定得再让我带你去跳舞。让我一对一地教你怎么跳。”
    ] 
    
    [var0|“我很乐意，”|“听起来很有趣，”]你告诉她。
    
    “别告诉我爸爸，”她神秘兮兮地低声说，“但我偶尔会溜出宫殿。我会确保我们在镇上碰面。”
    
    “我等不及了。”
    
    随着音乐再次渐弱，她朝你眨了眨眼。

rows.original: "Varena!" you whisper urgently, pulling the cowgirl close again. "I need to tell you something. It's about Calise." The princess's eyes go wide for a split second, but she recovers her composure quick enough to keep anyone around you from noticing. "[flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA |You were right. Calise's not who she says she is. She's [calise.hdk | |a demon |not just a demon, but Kasyrra ]!" The princess draws in a sharp, low breath. "Gods preserve us. Are you sure?" |She's not who she says she is. She's [calise.hdk | |a demon in disguise |not only a demon, but the demon. Kasyrra ]!" The princess gasps softly. "It's worse than I feared." "You feared? You suspected something too?" She nods. "I've long harbored suspicions that she wasn't what she appeared. Everything about her was too convenient, too perfectly timed. But a demon is far worse than a charlatan or a spy. Are you sure about this?" ] "She admitted it to me on the roof," you tell her. Even as you're conversing, you're still obligated to keep dancing, to keep up appearances lest the demoness know something is amiss. "I believe you," Varena assures you, making the same effort to seem at-ease despite the revelation. "I'll do what I can to protect Father from her. You and I should talk more, later, in private. I'll find you after the party's over." You nod. "I'd like that." Varena manages to snicker despite the gravity of the topic. "I'm sure we can find more pleasant things to converse about after we deal with the immediate threat. Our city will always need a champion, you know." The music begins to slow around you, and Varena pulls you close. "Thank you for the warning. And for trusting me. I mean that. I don't know if I can convince the king, but I'll do what I can to keep her from damning our city. I'm glad I can count on you to do the same."
rows.translation: “瓦蕾娜！”你急切地低声说，又把这位女牛仔拉近。“有件事我得告诉你。是关于卡莉丝的。” 公主的眼睛有一瞬间睁大了，但她很快恢复镇定，没让周围任何人察觉。“[flags.KM_FEAST_VARENA |你说得对。卡莉丝不是她自称的那个人。她是[calise.hdk | |一个恶魔 |不只是恶魔，而是卡希拉 ]！” 公主又低又急地吸了口气。“诸神保佑我们。你确定吗？” |她不是她自称的那个人。她是[calise.hdk | |一个伪装起来的恶魔 |不只是恶魔，而是 那个 恶魔。卡希拉 ]！” 公主轻轻抽了口气。“这比我担心的还要糟。” “你担心过？你也怀疑过什么？” 她点点头。“我早就怀疑她不是她表现出来的样子。她的一切都太巧了，时机也精准得过分。但恶魔远比江湖骗子或间谍糟糕。这件事你确定吗？” ] “她在屋顶上向我承认了，”你告诉她。即便在交谈时，你仍然不得不继续跳舞、维持体面，以免那个女恶魔察觉到有什么不对。 “我相信你，”瓦蕾娜向你保证，尽管刚得知这个真相，她也同样努力装出从容的样子。“我会尽力保护父王不受她伤害。你我之后应该再私下谈谈。宴会结束后我会来找你。” 你点点头。“我很乐意。” 尽管话题如此沉重，瓦蕾娜还是忍不住笑了一声。“等我们解决了眼前的威胁，我敢肯定我们能找到更愉快的话题来聊。你知道的，我们的城市永远需要一位冠军。” 周围的音乐开始放慢，瓦蕾娜把你拉近。“谢谢你的提醒。也谢谢你信任我。这话是真心的。我不知道自己能不能说服国王，但我会尽力阻止她毁掉我们的城市。我很高兴能指望你做同样的事。”

rows.original: You pivot from the king and princess to where the Crown Prince is standing just a few paces away, surrounded by a growing herd of noblewomen. Sketching your most formal [pc.mf |bow |curtsey ], you ask him "May I have this dance, my prince?" The crown prince [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |gives you a derisive snort, though his hangers-on don't seem to notice it past his thin smile. "I suppose I can't refuse the [pc.mf |man |woman ] of the hour." |gives you a genial smile. "It would be my pleasure, Champion. I'm eager to see what you can do." ] The prince [pc.mf |daintily accepts your hand and lets you lead him out onto the dance floor |gently takes your hand in his, and leads you out onto the dance floor ]. "[flags.KM_FEAST_VRANNUS_FLIRT |I'm glad you asked me, Champion. It saved me the trouble of asking you," he says, accompanied by a light, airy laugh. |I'm a little surprised you asked me," he says as you walk. "I'm sure my father would have made a more fitting partner for a [pc.mf |man |woman ] of your prestige." ] There's a chorus of jealous moos from the city's most eligible bachelorettes behind you, but you pay them no mind as the music begins again, and the prince wraps his slender arms around you. He's about as tall as the other minotaurs here, but so much more slender and delicately built, almost girly in physique; he's light as a feather, and his silky toga twirls almost as well as his sister's skirts when you two go spinning around each other. Still, the boy's got moves, you have to give him credit — he [pc.canDance |more than keeps up with you |leaves you in the dust ], shaking his hips and whirling around you with all the skill and pazazz of a professional dancer. Even if he wasn't the Crown Prince of the kingdom, you can see why every girl in the court would be jockeying for Vrannus's attention. He knows it, too, giving you a smug smile as you [pc.canDance |struggle to keep up with him |get danced at as much as with. At least it's a damn fine show ].
rows.translation: 你将视线从国王和公主身上移开，看向几步之外站在那里的皇太子——他周围聚集着越来越多的贵族女性。你迅速勾勒出他最正式的形象[pc.mf |鞠躬 |行屈膝礼 ]你问他：“我的王子，能让我跳这支舞吗？” 王储[flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |他发出一声嘲弄性的哼声，不过那些依附在他身边的人似乎并没有注意到这一点，只是看到了他那淡淡的微笑而已。“我想，我也没法拒绝吧[pc.mf |男人 |女性 ]恰逢其时。 |对你露出了亲切的微笑。“能为您效劳是我的荣幸，冠军。我很期待看看您能有什么表现。 ] 王子[pc.mf |她优雅地握住你的手，让你带着她走向舞池 |他轻轻握住你的手，带你走进舞池 ]。 "[flags.KM_FEAST_VRANNUS_FLIRT |很高兴你问我这个问题，冠军。这样我就不用自己去问你了，”他边说边发出轻快而爽朗的笑声。 |你问我这个问题，让我有点惊讶，”他在你走动时说道，“我敢肯定，我的父亲会是一个更合适的伴侣人选。 [pc.mf |男人 |女性 ]这关乎你的声誉。 ]你身后，这座城市里那些最抢手的单身女性们正发出一阵阵充满嫉妒的哞声，但你根本没有理会她们。因为音乐再次响起，那位王子用他那纤细的手臂紧紧抱住了你。他的身高和其他那些弥诺陶洛斯差不多，但身材要苗条得多，也显得更加精致，甚至有点像女孩子；他轻得像一片羽毛，而当他和你一起旋转时，他那丝滑的托加裙摆摆动得几乎和他姐姐的裙子一样好看。不过，这个男孩动作/移动你确实得承认他的功劳——他确实做得很好。 [pc.canDance |远远跟得上你的发展速度 |将你远远甩在后面 ]他摇动臀部，以专业舞者所拥有的技巧与魅力围绕着你旋转。即便他不是这个王国的王储，由此可见为什么宫廷里的每个女孩都会争相吸引弗兰努斯的注意了。 他心里也清楚这一点，所以当你看到他时，他会露出那种得意的笑容。 [pc.canDance |努力跟上他的步伐 |被人跳着舞戏弄，不过至少这也是一场相当精彩的表演 ]。

rows.original: You take the prince's hands in yours as the music takes a slower pace, and draw him closer — but not so close as to be uncomfortable. You've only just met, after all. Vrannus gives you a [flags.VRANNUS_SNITCHED |cool |warm ] smile and eases up a little, matching your pace. "Getting tired already, Champion?" "Just don't want to give anyone the wrong impression," you say, casting a glance toward a cow behind the prince who's giving you the stink-eye, even while her dance partner's got his hands just under her bare breasts. The prince chuckles, shimmying around you effortlessly. "Don't worry, misdirection and misrepresentation are the lifesblood of life at court. Nobody ever knows the real you — how can they? I can't remember the last time I had a heart to heart with a peer. What even is a peer, hm? Ah, don't worry about appearances, [pc.name]. We both have our roles to play." "And which role are you playing?" you ask, raising your arm while the prince ducks beneath it. The poof on the end of his tail flicks against your cheek. "A beautiful playboy prince, adored by all the city, of course." Vrannus laughs gaily. "Just as you're a [pc.background] playing Champion." You frown, but the prince just dances around you with a smirk. "I mean no offense," he says. "Quite the opposite. [flags.KM_FEAST_VRANNUS_FLIRT |I look forward to getting to see the real you someday. |I just enjoy a bit of teasing. ]" The music swells, and Vrannus takes the opportunity to put his arms around your waist from behind, holding you close enough that you can feel his breath [flags.KM_FEAST_VRANNUS_FLIRT |and something quite hot and hard beneath his toga, pressing into your rear |hot against your neck ]. "It's been a pleasure, [pc.name]. I'm sure we'll have an excuse to dance again soon — perhaps when this war is finally over." "I'm sure..." you say, as the music crescendos, men and woman all around you spin and smile, and then a thunderous crash of hooves signals the end of the song.

rows.original:
You pull the prince close, hard enough to make him gasp. "I need to talk to you, Vrannus. It's about Calise..."
    
    He chortles. "Bad form bringing someone else up while we're dancing, you know. This is supposed to be just about you, me, and making every girl in the kingdom swoon with envy."
    
    "It's important," you insist.
    
    "Tsk. Fine, what is it?"
    
    You take a breath, and whisper what you've learned: that Calise [calise.hdk
        |
        |is a demon in disguise, and has been this entire time
        |is Kasyrra in disguise, and likely has been since the war began
    ]. You have no actual proof other than your word that she confessed the truth to you, but surely that must mean something when you've been fighting the demons tooth and nail for so long!
    
    The prince takes in what you say with an even keel, expression unchanging from the smugness of his superior dancing. When you finish, the prince sighs softly and whispers back, "That's quite a tale, Champion. [var0
        |
        |I can see why your charisma is so highly spoken of
        |You're more a storyteller than I'd have expected
    ]."
    
    "You don't believe me, do you?"
    
    Vrannus shrugs lightly. "I don't think that it matters. If you're right, that just means that my long-standing hypothesis is correct — that demons can be brought to heel. That they aren't intrinsically, irreversibly evil. Lady Calise has been helping us fight this war since its early days, and I have seen no sign of treachery from her. I don't believe she means to betray us." 
    
    He's got to be kidding you. "Vrannus, you don't understand-"
    
    "Oh, I understand the dangers of demons. And I do appreciate the warning. But I'm not that worried, not at this stage."
    
    Shit. 
    
    "Lighten up," the prince says, reading the crestfallen look on your face. "We're here to have fun, aren't we? Banish those thoughts of doom and gloom — you've got nothing to worry about."
    
    Somehow, you don't manage to believe him...

    Vrannus shrugs lightly. "I don't think that it matters. If you're right, that just means that my long-standing hypothesis is correct — that demons can be brought to heel. That they aren't intrinsically, irreversibly evil. Lady Calise has been helping us fight this war since its early days, and I have seen no sign of treachery from her. I don't believe she means to betray us." 
    
    He's got to be kidding you. "Vrannus, you don't understand-"
    
    "Oh, I understand the dangers of demons. And I do appreciate the warning. But I'm not that worried, not at this stage."
    
    Shit. 
    
    "Lighten up," the prince says, reading the crestfallen look on your face. "We're here to have fun, aren't we? Banish those thoughts of doom and gloom — you've got nothing to worry about."

rows.original:
"[pc.canDance
        |Wow, our newest Champion really can dance, huh?
        |That was... certainly a show, Champion!
    ] But I think that brings us to the last dance of the night," [livrea.met|Livrea|the redheaded bard] says, resting her golden harp on her knee[livrea.numKids 1
        | and giving [livkid.name] a kiss on the top of the head. Your daughter coos and waves her hands at the crowd
    ]. "This is a special one, too."
    
    You're separated from your royal partner as the other guests clear the floor. The king gives Calise a gentle push towards you. "We gathered here tonight to honor our city's defenders, and those who crusade against the demon hordes. None among them have done more than the Champions of Frost and of Velun! Let them close out the night together, what do you say?" 
    
    There's a resounding chorus of cheers and stomping hooves. Calise puts up a hand to try and calm them, the but the nobles go on for several more seconds. Patrician men that tower over her clap her back and muss her hair; cowgirls with their breasts out bounce on their hooves and scream your name. 
    
    "Awfully popular, aren't we?" Calise says over the noise, giving you a wink. "What do you say we show these people what we can do? They've been waiting all night for this... and so have I."
    
    King Kelsaz sweeps his hand across the palace hall. "The champions have the floor!"

"[pc.canDance
        |哇，我们最新的冠军角色真的会跳舞，真是厉害吧？
        |那可真是一场精彩的表演，冠军！
    ]但我想，这就引出了今晚的最后一支舞曲了。 [livrea.met|莉维娅|红发吟游诗人]说着，她将那把金色的竖琴放在膝盖上。[livrea.numKids 1
        | 并提供帮助[livkid.name]轻轻亲了亲她的头顶。你的女儿对着人群温柔地笑着，还不时挥动着手部。
    ]这个也是特别的。”
    
    当其他宾客都离开后，你与你的王室伴侣被分开了。国王轻轻地将卡莉丝推向你，说道：“我们今晚聚集在这里，是为了纪念我们城市的守护者们，以及那些与恶魔军团抗争的人们。在他们当中，没有人比霜之冠军和维伦的冠军做得更多！让他们一起为这个夜晚画上句号吧，你们觉得怎么样？
    
    一阵热烈的欢呼声和马蹄的敲击声响起。卡莉丝举起手试图让他们安静下来，但那些贵族们还是继续欢呼了好几秒钟。那些比她高大的贵族们会拍拍她的背，弄乱她的头发；而那些穿着牛仔装、露出胸部的女牛仔们则会骑在马背上跳跃，同时大声呼喊你的名字。
    
    “真是非常受欢迎啊，不是吗？”卡莉丝在喧闹声中说道，同时向你眨了眨眼。你觉得我们该让这些人看看我们的实力怎么样？他们已经等了一整晚……我也是。”
    
    凯尔萨兹国王挥手示意，说道：“冠军们，现在轮到你们了！

rows.original:
You extend a hand, which Calise takes, and the two of you walk together to the center of the dance floor. The crowd of nobles part like water, giving you two plenty of space. From her perch above you, [livrea.met
        |Livrea
        |the bard
    ] begins to strum her harp, filling the hall with the sweet sounds of slow, ethereal string. Calise puts one hand on your waist and keeps the other locked around your hand, and you follow her lead, stepping back as she advances, turning as she guides you around.
    
    "This is nice," she whispers, pulling you close. You can feel the warmth radiating off her, forge-like in its intensify, but it's nothing compared to the softness of her hair brushing your cheek. Calise gives you a wink and, as the dance's pace accelerates, twirls you around under her arm. She catches you again on the other side, leaning you back with a deep sweep of her arms. Her smile's infectious, and when she brings you back up to your feet, you can see the rest of the crowd's begun to dance around you too, spurred on to follow their champions's examples. Even still, you can feel the weight of gazes on the pair of you — but it doesn't bother Calise a bit. She seems entirely in her element, so much grace and strength wrapped up in on slender package. 
    
    "You're a natural at this sort of thing, aren't you?"
    
    She laughs. "I was raised noble, but it's been a... a long, long time since I had an excuse to dance like this. I'd almost forgotten what it felt like."
    
    "Happy to be of service," you tell her, before you're flung around on your heels, held by the tips of your fingers. You quickly follow Calise's lead, curling your other arm up and gripping her hand tight. Calise pulls you back in, whirling around you and then dipping you again, [calise.kfn
        |punctuating it with a darting kiss on your lips. The cows around you erupt with applause
        |punctuating it with a deep, long kiss that sets your heart aflutter. The cows around you erupt with applause
        |to a flurry of applause from the cows around you
    ]. 
    
    "I think they're impressed."
    
    "[calise.kfn
        |They're not the only ones," you admit.
        |They're not the only ones," you murmur, giving her a sultry wink.
        |We make a good team," you grin back.
    ]
    
    Calise smiles, and pulls you back to your feet as the music reaches its crescendo. "You make for a fine partner, [pc.name]. [pc.canDance
        |Even if you have two left feet!
        |As much on the dance floor as the battlefield!
    ]" She squeezes your [calise.fucked
        |ass
        |hand
    ] and kisses your knuckles. Her lips are so, so warm... 
    
    The king appears beside the pair of you, resting a hand on each of your shoulders. "The champions, ladies and gentlemen!"
rows.translation:
你伸出手，卡莉丝将其握住；你们一同走向舞池中央。贵族人群如水般分开，为两人留出充足空间。在你们上方的台子上，[livrea.met
        |莉维娅
        |吟游诗人
    ]开始拨动竖琴琴弦；舒缓空灵的甜美乐音充满大厅。卡莉丝一手扶住你的腰，另一只手紧握你的手。你跟随她的引导：她前进时，你便后退；她引领你绕场时，你便随之转身。
    
    “感觉真好。”她低声说道，将你拉近。她散发出的热量如熔炉般炽烈，可与你脸颊上拂过的柔软发丝相比，那根本算不了什么。卡莉丝朝你眨眨眼；随着舞曲加速，她牵着你从手臂下方旋转而过，又在另一侧重新接住你，张开双臂大幅度地将你向后压低。她的笑容极具感染力。当她再次把你拉起来时，你看见人群中的其他人也开始围着你们跳舞，纷纷受到鼓舞，效仿冠军的榜样。即便如此，你仍能感受到无数目光的重量落在你们身上——卡莉丝却丝毫不在意。她似乎完全如鱼得水，纤细的身体里同时蕴含着优雅与力量。
    
    “你天生就擅长这种事，对吧？”
    
    她笑了起来。“我在贵族家庭长大，但已经……很久很久没有理由这样跳舞了。我几乎忘记了这是什么感觉。”
    
    “很高兴能为你效劳。”你说道。下一刻，她只牵着你的指尖，便带你用脚跟旋转出去。你迅速跟随卡莉丝的引导，抬起另一只手臂，紧紧握住她的手。卡莉丝将你拉回身边，绕着你旋转，随后再次把你向后压低，[calise.kfn
        |用一个迅速落在你唇上的吻作为结尾。周围的母牛纷纷鼓掌
        |又以一个深沉而漫长、令你心跳加速的吻作为结尾。周围的母牛纷纷鼓掌
        |引来周围母牛如潮的掌声
    ]。
    
    “看来她们很佩服我们。”
    
    “[calise.kfn
        |佩服你的可不只有她们。”你坦言道。
        |佩服你的可不只有她们。”你低声说着，妩媚地向她眨眼。
        |我们配合得很好。”你咧嘴笑道。
    ]
    
    卡莉丝微笑着，在音乐达到高潮时将你重新拉起。“你是位出色的舞伴，[pc.name]。[pc.canDance
        |哪怕你的舞步笨拙得要命！
        |无论在舞池还是战场上都是如此！
    ]”她捏了捏你的[calise.fucked
        |屁股
        |手
    ]，又吻了吻你的指节。她的双唇如此、如此温暖……
    
    国王来到你们身边，将一只手分别放在你们肩上。“女士们、先生们，向两位冠军致敬！”

rows.original: You take Calise's hand. "Let's do it." She smiles warmly and squeezes your hand, letting you lead her out into the center of the hall. The crowd of nobles part like water, giving you two plenty of space. From her perch above you, [livrea.met|Livrea|the bard] begins to strum her harp, filling the hall with the sweet sounds of slow, ethereal string. You put a hand on Calise's waist and pull her close, enjoying the little gasp of surprise it elicits. She's so, so warm, and her hair is so soft and sweet-smelling... You step forward, and Calise is quick to follow your lead, light on her feet and graceful as can be. "Oh, my, you really can dance!" "Surprised?" you ask. "No. Delighted." Calise gives you a wink as you spin her 'round under your arm, making that green and white dress twirl around her bare feet. You catch her at the end of it and dip her back, carefully supporting her weight as the pair of you lean into each other. There's a chorus of cheers and stomping hooves from the surrounding cowfolk, and soon enough the crowd's following your example, pairing off and whirling around you and Calise as [livrea.met|Livrea|the bard] intensifies her playing. When you bring Calise back up, she has the warmest smile you've ever seen from her on her lips. The lady-knight [calise.kfn |cups your cheek, pressing her forehead to yours |cups your cheek, pressing her forehead to yours |squeezes your hand ]. "You're pretty good at this yourself," you tell her, advancing a few steps with her. She laughs. "I was raised noble, but it's been a... a long, long time since I had an excuse to dance like this. I'd almost forgotten what it felt like." "Happy to be of service," you tell her, giving her another twirl around. Calise giggles, dancing around you in a blur of streaming hair and rippling fabric. Your hands manage to latch onto her hips, drawing her back against you with your [pc.chest] against her back and the scent of her hair close to hand. The two of you step sideways together, perfectly in sync, arms held out as if to drive apart the crowd of cows surrounding you. [livrea.met|Livrea|The bard] accelerates the tempo of her harping, more keeping pace with you two than the other way around. Your partner's smile is infectious, spurring you to move with the same energy she's wielding. [silly |Damn [pc.boyGirl], you two tearin' in up! |The pair of you are [pc.mf |king and queen |queens ] of the dance floor tonight ], and the eyes of the court watch you with envy and approval. None but the best of them can keep up with you — Varena and Vrannus and their father — but even their performances seem to pale compared to the woman in front of you. "I don't think the court'll be forgetting us any time soon," she whispers to you. "We make an impressive team." [calise.kfn |"An impressive couple," you agree. |"An impressive couple," you agree. |"Yeah, we do," you say. ] You return the paladin's smile, and dip her back again as the music reaches its climax, taking the opportunity to [calise.kfn |lean in and deliver a kiss to the paladin's rosy lips |lean in and thrust your tongue between her lips, catching her into a deep, passionate kiss |give the spectating royals a wink ] before you bring her back up to thunderous applause. [calise.kfn |You can feel Calise swooning in your arms, that deep heat of her body burning so, so much hotter than before. |You can feel Calise swooning in your arms, that deep heat of her body burning so, so much hotter than before. | ] The king appears beside the pair of you, resting a hand on each of your shoulders. "The champions, ladies and gentlemen!"

rows.translation: 贵族们为你欢呼时，你面带微笑，抬起卡莉丝的手，一同鞠躬致意。在北方最伟大城市的王宫里，伴随雷鸣般的掌声听见众人高呼你的名字，实在是非同寻常的体验——足以让你的心脏在胸腔里怦怦作响。卡莉丝捏了捏你的手，朝人群鞠躬。你效仿她的动作，同时感觉到国王巨大的手掌拍了拍你的后背。 “感谢两位冠军加入我们。”国王说道，“也感谢你们用[flags.KM_FEAST_DANCE_DIRTY |那场，呃，令人兴奋的表演 |那支精彩绝伦的舞蹈 ]为今晚画下句点。能够招待你们，还有王国各地的朋友，是我的荣幸！” 更多掌声与欢呼随之响起，大群公牛贵族拥上前，试图与你握手或拍拍你的肩膀。母牛姑娘们则拥抱你，亲吻你的脸颊。 在你彻底被人群淹没以前，卡莉丝将你从牛群中拉了出来，你们终于一同溜走。她笑着捏紧你的手，领你走向大门。离开时，你得到了[flags.KM_FEAST_HERALD_HEAT |欲火灼灼地眨了眨眼 |微微鞠了一躬 ]，来自[flags.KM_FEAST_HERALD_ABOUT_HER |特莉西亚 |传令官 ]；随后你再次回到洞窟城市温暖的空气中。 “真有趣！”卡莉丝笑道，[calise.kfn |凑近又吻了你一次 |捏了捏你的屁股，又亲吻你的嘴唇 |向你眨了眨眼 ]。“我已经记不清上次参加宴会是什么时候了。[flags.CALISE_PARTY |尤其这次还有如此可爱的伴侣 |而且与我同行的人也很棒 ]。” 她停在阶梯顶端，眼中燃烧着火焰般的翠绿光芒，俯瞰整座城市。“我们会一起结束这场战争，[pc.name]。我有一个计划。准备好以后就来我家……或者只是想聊聊天的时候也可以。我同样不会介意。”棕发美人双手拂过头发，开始走下阶梯。“既然宴会结束了，我还有些事情要处理，不过很快会再见到你的，[pc.name]。” “下次见，卡莉丝。”她离开时，你挥手说道。
rows.raw: ' You smile, lifting Calise's hand and taking a bow as the nobles cheer for you. It's a hell of a thing, having your name shouted to thunderous applause in the palace of the greatest city in the north — enough to make your heart thunder in your chest. Calise squeezes your hand and bows to the crowd. You follow her lead, and feel the king's massive hand patting your back. "Thank you for joining us, Champions," the king says, "and for that[flags.KM_FEAST_DANCE_DIRTY |, ah, stimulating display | marvelous dance ] to end the evening. It's been an honor to host you, and all my friends from the kingdom!" There's more clapping and cheering, and a press of noble bulls come in to try and shake your hand or pat your shoulder. Cowgirls hug you and kiss your cheeks. Before you can be entirely overwhelmed, Calise pulls you away from the herd, and the two of you are able to slip away together. She laughs and squeezes your hand, leading you towards the doors. You're given a [flags.KM_FEAST_HERALD_HEAT |lusty wink |slight bow ] from [flags.KM_FEAST_HERALD_ABOUT_HER |Tricia |the herald ] on your way out, and then you're back into the warm air of the cavern-city. "That was fun!" Calise smiles, [calise.kfn |leaning in a giving you another kiss |giving your ass a squeeze and your lips a kiss |giving you a wink ]. "I can't remember the last time I was at a party. [flags.CALISE_PARTY |Especially with such a lovely date |And the company was excellent too ]." She stops at the top of the stairs, looking over the city with a fire in those emerald eyes of hers. "You and I are going to stop this war, [pc.name]. I have a plan. Come around my house when you're ready... or when you just want to chat. I wouldn't mind that, either." The brunette beauty runs her hands through her hair, and begins to descend the steps. "I have something to take care of now that we've finished, but I'll see you soon, [pc.name]." "Until next time, Calise," you say, waving as she departs. '

rows.original:
You run the back of your hand over your forehead, suddenly realizing that you're quite flushed. Gods, is it hot in here or is it just you? You glance around, fanning yourself, but you seem to be alone in your discomfort. Deep breaths...
    
    And then your stomach lurches, hard enough to double you over. Ugh! You just hold it in, vision swimming.
    
    [party.has cait
        |"You okay, cutie?" Cait asks, putting a hand on your shoulder.
    ]
    
    [party.has ryn
        |You reach over and grab Etheryn, pulling the frosty elf-girl over into a hug. Her cool flesh is sweet relief against the heat burning inside you.
        
        "O-oh! Hi..." she [ryn.lnhConfidence
            |squeaks
            |murmurs
            |giggles
        ].
    ]
    
    Deep breaths...

你用手背轻轻擦了擦额头，突然发现自己满脸通红。天啊，是这里太热了，还是只有你一个人这样觉得？你环顾四周，试图给自己扇风，但似乎只有你一个人感到不适。深呼吸……
    
    然后，你的胃猛地一阵翻搅，疼得你差点弯下腰来。唉！你只能强忍着，眼前一片模糊。
    
    [party.has cait
        |“你没事吧，宝贝？”凯特把手搭在你的肩上问道。
    ]
    
    [party.has ryn
        |你伸手把伊瑟琳拉过来，将这冷冰冰的精灵女孩抱进怀里。她冰凉的肌肤正好缓解了你体内燃烧的燥热。
        
        “哦……嗨……”她[ryn.lnhConfidence
            |尖声说道
            |低声说道
            |咯咯笑着
        ]。
    ]
    
    深呼吸……

rows.original: Okay, there's no denying it — your belly's growing. You feel bloated and unsteady, and you're constantly flushed with heat. It feels like you're adventuring in the Jassiran dunes, not the Frost Marches, lately. If you weren't in this part of the world you've probably be drenched in sweat all day. There's no point in denying it anymore: you're pregnant, and you're definitely carrying a particularly warm child. A salamander. Seems you'll be bringing a little heat to the northlands soon...
rows.translation: 好吧，这没法否认——你的肚子在变大。你感到腹胀、脚步发虚，而且总是浑身燥热。最近，你觉得自己是在贾西拉的沙丘间冒险，而不是在霜冻边境。要不是身处这片地区，你大概一整天都会汗如雨下。再否认也没有意义了：你怀孕了，而且你怀的肯定是个特别温暖的孩子。一个火蜥蜴人。看来不久之后，你就要给北方之地带来一点热度了……

rows.original:
The heat that was assailing your body earlier has largely abated... or rather, concentrated entirely in your stomach. If there was any doubt as to your child's parentage before, they can be dispelled by the ember-like heat radiant in your womb. You don't have the natural resilience of a [pc.ra salamander
        |native 
    ]'mander, but it's become bearable at least. Even pleasant, sometimes... 
    
    You often find yourself holding your growing tummy, cradling the blazing-hot life growing inside you as much to comfort yourself as your child. He or she is starting to get a little active, stretching muscles that will some day glisten in the summer sun. You can't wait to see for yourself.
rows.translation:
刚才侵袭你身体的那种热感已经大大减弱了……或者说，全都聚集在了你的腹部。如果说之前你对孩子的血统还有任何怀疑，那么你子宫里散发出的余烬般的热度足以将其打消。你并没有[pc.ra salamander
        |土生土长的 
    ]火蜥蜴人那样天生的耐受力，不过至少已经可以忍受了。有时候，甚至还会觉得挺愉快的……
    
    你经常会忍不住用手抚摸自己逐渐隆起的腹部，仿佛在安抚腹中的胎儿，也在安慰自己。那个小生命正在逐渐变得活跃起来，它的肌肉正在不断地伸展，有朝一日，在夏日的阳光下，那些肌肉一定会闪闪发光。你迫不及待地想要亲眼看到那一天的到来。

A sudden contraction hits you like a load of bricks, following by a rush of wetness down your thighs. "Oh gods! It's coming!" you grunt aloud, putting your hands around your middle. [atFH
        |Aided by [party.solo
            |the occupants of the inn
            |your friends
        ], you head into the nursery accompanied by Gwyn and Cait, the two of them stroking your hair and comforting you as it begins.
        |You rush back to town[party.solo
            | as best you can
            | guided and guarded by [party.compNames]
        ]. You make your way to the nursery where Gwyn [party.has cait
            |is
            |and Cait are
        ] already getting things ready for you. [party.has cait
            |Cait comes barreling in with you, quickly assuming her role as Gwyn's helper.
        ]
    ]
    
    "Could hear you coming from the other side of the walls," Gwyn laughs, guiding you to a bed and stroking your [pc.hair]. "Lay down and breathe. Everything's gonna be fine."
    
    It is, but your newborn makes you fight for it. An hour of heaving, pushing, and screaming is rewarded with a mewling cry and a glowing light visible between your sweat-sheened thighs. 
    
    "Ohhh, [var0
        |he
        |she
    ]'s so cute!" Cait croons, hoisting up a bundle of towels. A red-scaled tail doops out from the back end of it, wiggling this way and that with an ember of flame at its tip, growing stronger with every wailing breath. Cait hands the bundle to you, grinning like a cheshire as you accept your newborn, name [var0
        |him
        |her
    ], and bring the pale little 'mander up to your breast. [var0
        |He
        |She
    ]'s hungry already.
    
    "Get some rest now," Gwyn says, taking Cait's hand and giving her a tug towards the door. "We'll give you two some space."
    
    "We wi— we will!" Cait nods. "Just shout if you need anything."
    
    You pass out almost as soon as they're out the door, cradling your tiny 'mander in your arms until a new day dawns...

    我甚至能听到你从墙的另一边走来的声音呢，”格温笑着说，一边带你走到一张床前，一边轻抚着你的[pc.hair]躺下来，深呼吸。一切都会好起来的。”
    
    确实会，但你的新生儿却让你不得不为这一切而努力。一个小时的用力拉扯、推挤和尖叫，最终换来的只是婴儿的一声呜咽，以及在你汗流浃背的双腿间看到的那一道微弱的光芒。
    
    “哦[var0
        |他

    ]太可爱了！”凯特轻声说道，同时举起一捆毛巾。在那捆毛巾的尾部，有一条红色鳞片的尾巴探了出来，它不断地扭来扭去，尾巴的尖端还闪烁着微弱的火焰，而且随着尾巴的摆动，那些火焰似乎变得越来越旺盛。凯特把那捆毛巾递给你，脸上露出了灿烂的笑容。你接过这个“新成员”，给它起了个名字[var0
        |他
        |她
    ]然后将那颗苍白的小“曼德尔”贴在胸前。 [var0
        |他
        |她
    ]已经饿了吧。”
    
    “现在去休息吧，”格温说着，握住凯特的手部，将她拉向门口。“我们会给你们俩一些空间的。”
    
    “我们一定会的！”凯特点头说道。“如果需要什么，就大声呼喊吧。”
    
    他们一离开房间，你便立刻昏了过去，将那个小小的“曼德尔”紧紧抱在怀里，直到新的一天来临……

rows.original: Stepping into the chapel of Velun, you're greeted by Brother Sanders calling out to you. "[pc.name]? A moment, if you would?" You shrug and step forward to the circular altar, wondering what the older priest wants. He's not usually one to speak first, but there's an underlying sharpness to his words that cuts through the stillness of the chapel. What's all the excitement about? "I was hoping to see you, [pc.name]. Word's gotten around town that the Old Forest is relatively calmer these days, thanks to your efforts." It's still far from being actually safe, but the most pressing problem has been dealt with, yes. There're still several outstanding issues which need to be resolved, but at least they're more of a level that the townsfolk could conceivably handle themselves. Now then, you're sure he didn't call you over to heap praise upon you, right? Sanders chuckles. "Well, a little flattery doesn't hurt with most people. All right, then — there's something I'd like you to get for me outside of town. You're shaping up to be quite the budding problem-solver around these parts. "With dark times approaching, many of the locals have discovered a renewed interest in faith and the gods. Not entirely unsurprising, for one who studies the arc of history; but as the local man of the cloth I should see to their needs, no matter what their motivations for their sudden surge of piety. To those ends, I've put together some plans to add to this chapel. A cloister, to be precise." Right, [pc.isDK|if that'll help them rest better at night|sounds like a worthy cause]. And he no doubt expects your aid in some fashion, doesn't he? Sanders' smile just widens. "Like I said, you're shaping up to be an excellent problem solver. You're even developing the instincts of such without even thinking about it! But yes, I do need your help, if you don't mind. It's for your own benefit, too — once the cloister is completed, you'll be able to use it for your own purposes. A few days' worth of shut-in and deep meditation do wonders for the soul, and it's made all the better to have surroundings that're conducive to such." You look Sanders up and down, and sigh. All right, what does he need? Money? Or maybe for you to go out and lug back [silly|twenty bear asses|a bunch of stone and wood]? "Oh no! Velun forbid, nothing as dreary and banal as that. I've already got all of the mundane matters sorted out — the money to pay the work crew Garth's hiring, the materials for the construction, all that's been settled thanks to some very lovely donations and the baroness's generosity, of course. If you're willing, I have something more special in mind for you."
rows.translation: 一走进维伦的小教堂，桑德斯修士就迎了上来，向你喊道。"[pc.name]请稍等片刻，好吗？ 你耸了耸肩，走向那个圆形祭坛，心里琢磨着那位年长的神父到底想要什么。他平时并不爱主动说话，但这次他的话语中带着一种尖锐的气息，这种气息打破了教堂里的寂静。 “大家这么激动是为了什么事呢？ 我本来希望能见到你[pc.name]镇上的人都传开了，说多亏了你们的努力，古林这些天变得安静多了。 它距离真正实现还有很长的路要走。安全不过，最紧迫的问题已经得到了解决，没错。虽然还有几项未解决的问题需要处理，但至少这些问题的难度都在镇民们能够自行处理的范围内。那么，你确定他叫你过来并不是为了表扬你吧？ 桑德斯轻笑了一声。嗯，对大多数人来说，一点奉承话并不会有什么坏处。好吧，那么——有件事我想让你去镇外帮我办一下。看来你在这附近还真是个挺能解决问题的家伙呢。 随着暗影时代的临近，许多当地人重新燃起了对信仰和神明的热情。对于研究历史进程的人来说，这并不奇怪；但作为一位当地的宗教领袖，我有责任满足他们的需求，无论他们这种突然表现出的虔诚背后究竟隐藏着什么动机。为此，我制定了一些计划，打算为这座小教堂增添一些设施——具体来说，就是建造一座修道院。 好的。 [pc.isDK|如果这样能帮助他们晚上睡得更好的话……|听起来是个值得支持的事业。]他无疑期待你能以某种方式帮助他，对吧？ 桑德斯的笑容变得更加灿烂了。正如我所说，你正在逐渐成为一个出色的问题解决者。甚至在不经意间，你就已经具备了这种能力！不过，如果你不介意的话，我确实需要你的帮助。这对你自己也有好处——一旦那处静修之所建成，你就可以将其用于自己的目的了。几天的闭关与深度冥想对心灵有着极大的益处，而如果周围的环境也能促进这种修行，效果就会更加显著了。 你上下打量着桑德斯，然后叹了口气。好吧，他到底需要什么？钱吗？还是需要你出去帮他把东西搬回来？ [silly|二十个蠢货|一堆石头和木头]？ 哦不！ 维伦不会允许这种无聊而平庸的事情发生的。我已经把所有琐碎的事情都处理妥当了——支付加斯雇佣工人的费用、购买施工所需的材料，所有这些费用都多亏了一些慷慨的捐赠以及女男爵的支援才得以解决。如果你愿意的话，我还有更特别的事情打算安排给你。"
rows.raw: " Stepping into the chapel of Velun, you're greeted by Brother Sanders calling out to you. "[pc.name]? A moment, if you would?" You shrug and step forward to the circular altar, wondering what the older priest wants. He's not usually one to speak first, but there's an underlying sharpness to his words that cuts through the stillness of the chapel. What's all the excitement about? "I was hoping to see you, [pc.name]. Word's gotten around town that the Old Forest is relatively calmer these days, thanks to your efforts." It's still far from being actually safe, but the most pressing problem has been dealt with, yes. There're still several outstanding issues which need to be resolved, but at least they're more of a level that the townsfolk could conceivably handle themselves. Now then, you're sure he didn't call you over to heap praise upon you, right? Sanders chuckles. "Well, a little flattery doesn't hurt with most people. All right, then — there's something I'd like you to get for me outside of town. You're shaping up to be quite the budding problem-solver around these parts. "With dark times approaching, many of the locals have discovered a renewed interest in faith and the gods. Not entirely unsurprising, for one who studies the arc of history; but as the local man of the cloth I should see to their needs, no matter what their motivations for their sudden surge of piety. To those ends, I've put together some plans to add to this chapel. A cloister, to be precise." Right, [pc.isDK|if that'll help them rest better at night|sounds like a worthy cause]. And he no doubt expects your aid in some fashion, doesn't he? Sanders' smile just widens. "Like I said, you're shaping up to be an excellent problem solver. You're even developing the instincts of such without even thinking about it! But yes, I do need your help, if you don't mind. It's for your own benefit, too — once the cloister is completed, you'll be able to use it for your own purposes. A few days' worth of shut-in and deep meditation do wonders for the soul, and it's made all the better to have surroundings that're conducive to such." You look Sanders up and down, and sigh. All right, what does he need? Money? Or maybe for you to go out and lug back [silly|twenty bear asses|a bunch of stone and wood]? "Oh no! Velun forbid, nothing as dreary and banal as that. I've already got all of the mundane matters sorted out — the money to pay the work crew Garth's hiring, the materials for the construction, all that's been settled thanks to some very lovely donations and the baroness's generosity, of course. If you're willing, I have something more special in mind for you.""

rows.original: "Despite its remote nature, [pc.name], this part of the world was quite the hotspot for several conflicts in the Godswar all those centuries ago. Several cataclysmic events happened during that period, and all manner of different factions were drawn into the conflict... I only have the records which the baroness's family has kept, which she has been so kind as to lend me, but the picture that they and the local legends paint isn't pretty." War's like that. It never changes. Nothing's ever truly new on the face of Savarra, is it? "Mm. Nevertheless, it explains why ruins and the like are so plentiful in this small corner of the world. If not for the cold and remote nature of the Marches, we'd see more fortune-seekers. "But what caught my attention is mention of a Sorran altar on the western mountains of the Greyvale Ranges, [pc.name]. You know, the mountains that ring Harvest Valley to our south. You must've seen them coming into Hawkethorne. Thing is, I've been here longer than anyone, yet not a single traveler that's come that way has ever made mention of such. According to the baroness's records, a rather interesting artifact was kept there... a spear bearing the regal name of Sorra's Succor. Details are scarce, but I think I've pieced together enough to figure out exactly why no one's ever come across that altar in all these years. "Long story short, [pc.name], I'd like you to examine my hunch and see if the place exists, and if it does, if the artifact is still there. A cloister on its own is a tranquil place, but a prominent artifact on open display can do wonders for mind, body, and spirit alike. "Well then, [pc.name], think yourself up to the task? I'd go myself, but I do have to oversee the construction and I'm not as young as I once used to be; it's time to pass the torch to the next generation, as it were. I'm afraid I don't have anything extra to compensate you with, but you'll be free to use the finished cloister any time you like — and of course, the artifact aside, I'm sure no one will begrudge you anything you find along the way. The harpies who once served the goddess of flight and storms have all but abandoned Harvest Valley over the generations, off seeking higher purchase in the hills." You don't see any reason to deny him, no. "Wonderful. Here, come in the back with me and I'll show you how to get there." With that, Sanders leads you past the altar and up a flight of stairs into a small well-aired study. Stacks of old tomes sit on a trolley by the table, [pc.ra lupine fox|reeking something terrible|musty as can be]; these must be the records the baroness lent Sanders. The old priest unfurls a map of Harvest Valley on the table, giving you a quick but thorough explanation of where exactly he'd like you to search for this Sorran altar. "...There. The beginning of the trail's hidden behind a waterfall grotto. It'll be a hard climb, but then again most of those aligned with Sorra's faction back then were harpies, I'm told. Not much reason to worry about the trek when you can fly. If you follow the trail up until where it turns westward, you should find the spot where it's supposed to be. Off the beaten path, but not up on the peaks, either. It might be a wild goose chase, but I'd be very much obliged if you could take a look anyway." Any trouble you should be expecting? Sanders ponders the question. "Not from the harpies at any rate. With all that's going down in the valley... could be centaurs, could be gnolls, could be any manner of those robed madmen who've moved in since the blizzard. I'm sorry, but without anyone having scouted the area of late, I can't give you much information. Some camping gear might help, since you're expecting to traverse treacherous ground — there's more than one way to use canvas, rope and stakes than just for shelter, after all. Other than that, keep your eyes and ears open, that's all I can say. If you're lucky, the worst you'll run into might be the odd rockfall." Very well, then. You thank Sanders for his help, but he waves you off. "Oh no, [pc.name]. You're the one helping me; I should be the one thanking you. If nothing else, I'm excited to see what you're able to find." "Now then, perhaps there's something I could do for you to make the task easier? Some healing, perhaps, or a blessing to expedite the journey?"
rows.translation: 尽管地处偏远地区， [pc.name]，几个世纪前，在神战期间，这个地区确实是许多冲突的热点地带。那段时期发生了许多灾难性的事件，各种各样的派系都被卷入了这些冲突之中……我只有女男爵家族保存的记录，她也非常慷慨地将这些记录借给了我，但根据这些记录以及当地的传说所描绘出的情景，实在不是什么美好的画面。 战争就是这样的。它永远不会改变。在萨瓦拉这片土地上，从来没有什么真正新鲜的事物出现，不是吗？ 嗯，不过这也解释了为什么在这个世界的角落里会有这么多废墟之类的东西。要不是边境地区环境寒冷且偏远，肯定会有更多寻宝者来到这里。 但真正引起我注意的是，文中提到了位于灰谷山脉西侧的一座索拉祭坛[pc.name]你知道的，就是我们南方环绕着丰收谷的那些山脉。你肯定见过它们延伸到鹰棘镇境内。问题是，我在这里待的时间比任何人都长，然而却从来没有一个从那个方向过来的旅行者提到过这些山脉。根据女男爵的记录，那里曾经保存着一件相当有趣的文物……一支刻有“索拉的救赎”这一庄严名称的长矛。虽然相关细节并不多，但我认为我已经拼凑出了足够的线索，从而弄清楚了为什么这些年来从来没有人找到过那座祭坛。 长话短说， [pc.name]，我希望你能验证一下我的直觉，看看那个地方是否存在，如果存在的话，那件文物是否还在那里。单独一座修道院本身就是一个宁静的地方，但一件被公开展示的珍贵文物，对人的身心和精神都会产生极大的积极影响。 那么， [pc.name]，你认为自己有能力完成这项任务吗？我本来想亲自去做的，但我现在必须负责监督整个施工过程，而且我也不再像以前那么年轻了；可以说，是时候把这项任务交给下一代人了。恐怕我没有什么额外的东西可以补偿你，但你可以随时使用完工后的修道院——当然，除了那件神器之外，我相信你在施工过程中发现的任何东西，都不会有人向你索取。那些曾经侍奉过飞行与风暴女神的哈比们，经过世代的变迁，早已放弃了丰收谷，转而去山丘中寻找更广阔的生存空间了。 你没有任何理由拒绝他，不是吗？ 太好了。来，跟我一起从后面进去，我会告诉你怎么去那里的。 就这样，桑德斯引领你穿过祭坛，走上一段楼梯，来到一间通风良好的小书房。桌子旁边，手推车上堆放着一摞摞古老的典籍。 [pc.ra lupine fox|散发着令人作呕的气味|霉味十足]这些肯定就是女男爵借给桑德斯的那些记录。老牧师在桌上展开了一张丰收谷的地图，然后快速而详细地说明了你应该在哪些地方寻找那个索拉祭坛。 就在那里。小路的起点隐藏在一片瀑布形成的洞穴后面。攀登起来会相当困难，不过据说，当时与索拉派系结盟的人大多都是鹰身女妖，所以其实没什么好担心的。如果你会飞的话，这段路程根本不是问题。只要沿着小路一直走，直到它转向西边，你应该就能找到那个地方。它不在常人走动的路线上，但也不在山顶上。虽然这个任务可能没什么结果，但如果你能帮忙去看看的话，我会非常感激的。 你会遇到什么麻烦吗？”桑德斯仔细思考着这个问题。至少不是那些女妖干的。鉴于山谷里发生的那些事情……有可能是半人马，也可能是地精，甚至可能是那些在大雪过后出现的、穿着长袍的疯子们。很抱歉，由于最近没有人去那个地区侦察过，所以我无法提供太多信息。有些露营装备这些工具可能会派上用场，因为你们即将穿越那些危险的地带——毕竟，使用帆布、绳索和木桩的方法并不仅仅局限于搭建庇护所。除此之外，就是要注意观察周围的环境，注意倾听任何异常的声音，我想说的就是这些。如果运气好的话，你们遇到的最糟糕的情况可能也就是偶尔会有岩石掉落而已。 那好吧。你感谢桑德斯的帮助，但他只是摆了摆手表示不用谢。哦不， [pc.name]是你一直在帮助我，应该是我向你道谢才对。无论如何，能看看你能够找到什么，我感到非常兴奋。 那么，或许我能做些什么来帮助你完成这项任务，让它变得更容易一些呢？比如提供一些治愈效果，或者赐予一些祝福，来加速你的旅程吧？

rows.original:
The moment you step past the chapel's threshold, you're greeted by the smell of wet plaster, setting mortar and stone dust. The source of such is readily apparent — a good chunk of the western wall has been knocked out to create an impromptu doorway while an additional room is being built around it. Some kind of renovation going on?
    
    "Welcome. Do watch your step — though there haven't been any accidents so far, the masonry is heavy. Wouldn't want to take any chances with how quickly they're working."
    
    Completely unperturbed by the construction going on to the side, Sanders comes up to you at his ever unhurried pace. The priest ushers you inside with a nod, being careful to keep well away from the ongoing construction.
    
    What's going on here?
    
    "Oh, it's a bit of a story. Some time ago, a party of adventurers passing through were digging through some old Sorran ruins, and came across an artifact — a spear, to be precise. They felt it wasn't something they should have, what with it being a ceremonial weapon than a practical one, and decided to donate it to the chapel. I've been thinking of building a cloister for a while now, you see, and this has to be a sign from the gods, for them to provide a centerpiece at such an opportune time."
    
    Ah. From the way Hawkethorne is built, you're well aware that Garth has at his beck and call some of the best workmen in the Marches. That means it's got to have cost something, right?
    
    "Oh well. A bit here, a bit there. The villagers have been generous. As I've mentioned before, trying times often rekindle faith in people. Hopefully, the cloister will help bring some peace to the hearts of the troubled. It is, after all, meant for the public.
    
    "Now then, we'll have the cloister ready in a little while; with how well the construction has been gong, it may be as soon as you next visit. I'll be sure to put the relic up prominently, too; do come whenever you need a little solace and solitude. Everyone could benefit from a little every now and then."
    
    You'll keep it in mind.
    
    "Don't be a stranger, now, and watch your step. You're putting yourself in danger out there more and more often, [pc.name] — I'd be glad to have you come and put your mind at ease any time you like."
rows.translation:
你一踏入小教堂的门槛，立刻就会被湿石膏、砂浆以及石粉的气息所包围。这些气味的来源显而易见——西墙的很大一部分已经被拆掉，以便临时搭建一个门道，同时还在那里建造另一个房间。看来这里正在进行某种翻修工作吧？
    
    欢迎来到这里。请小心行走——虽然到目前为止还没有发生任何事故，但这些砖石结构确实相当沉重。考虑到他们工作的速度，我们确实不能冒任何风险。”
    
    桑德斯依旧以他那从容不迫的速度走向你，完全没有受到旁边施工活动的干扰。那位神父也点了点头，示意你进去，同时注意避开正在进行的施工区域。
    
    这里发生了什么？
    
    “哦，这其实是个有点复杂的故事。不久前，有一群冒险者路过这里，他们在探索一些古老的索拉遗迹时，发现了一件文物——准确来说，是一支长矛。他们觉得这件武器并不适合自己使用，因为它更像是一件仪式用武器，而非实战工具，于是决定将其捐赠给教堂。我其实已经考虑建造一座修道院有一段时间了。你看，这肯定上是神灵的旨意——他们在如此恰当的时刻为我们提供了这个核心元素。
    
    啊，从鹰棘镇的建筑风格来看，你们应该很清楚，加斯手底下召集了一些边境地区最优秀的工匠。这意味着建造这座修道院肯定花费了不少资金，对吧？
    
    “嗯，其实费用也只是一点点而已。村民们也都非常慷慨。正如我之前所说，艰难的时刻往往会让人们重新燃起对信仰的渴望。希望这座修道院能为那些心灵受到创伤的人们带来一些平静。毕竟，它是为大众服务的嘛。
    
    那么，过一会儿我们就能把那个静修处准备好了；由于施工进行得非常顺利，下次你来访的时候可能就已经准备好了。我一定会把那件圣物放在显眼的位置，所以无论什么时候你需要一些宁静与独处，都欢迎随时前来。其实，每个人偶尔都需要这样的时光。
    
    你会记住这个提醒的。
    
    “现在可别表现得像个陌生人，走路也要小心。你越来越经常让自己处于危险之中了[pc.name]无论您什么时候想来，我都非常乐意接待您，让您放心。

    Completely unperturbed by the construction going on to the side, Sanders comes up to you at his ever unhurried pace. The priest ushers you inside with a nod, being careful to keep well away from the ongoing construction.
    
    What's going on here?
    
    "Oh, it's a bit of a story. Some time ago, a party of adventurers passing through were digging through some old Sorran ruins, and came across an artifact — a spear, to be precise. They felt it wasn't something they should have, what with it being a ceremonial weapon than a practical one, and decided to donate it to the chapel. I've been thinking of building a cloister for a while now, you see, and this has to be a sign from the gods, for them to provide a centerpiece at such an opportune time."
    
    Ah. From the way Hawkethorne is built, you're well aware that Garth has at his beck and call some of the best workmen in the Marches. That means it's got to have cost something, right?
    
    "Oh well. A bit here, a bit there. The villagers have been generous. As I've mentioned before, trying times often rekindle faith in people. Hopefully, the cloister will help bring some peace to the hearts of the troubled. It is, after all, meant for the public.
    
    "Now then, we'll have the cloister ready in a little while; with how well the construction has been gong, it may be as soon as you next visit. I'll be sure to put the relic up prominently, too; do come whenever you need a little solace and solitude. Everyone could benefit from a little every now and then."
    
    You'll keep it in mind.
    
    "Don't be a stranger, now, and watch your step. You're putting yourself in danger out there more and more often, [pc.name] — I'd be glad to have you come and put your mind at ease any time you like.""

rows.original: There's nothing left for it; you're as prepared as you can be for anything the mountain can throw at you. Time to be off. Careful not to slip and fall into the plunge pool below, you edge your way across the damp ledge that rings the inside of the cliff wall. [party.comp brint arona einin | It's a bit of a squeeze for Brint, the minotaur having to resort to grabbing onto nearby roots and branches to steady himself while on the narrow pathway. More than once you wonder if he'll lose his footing or have the ledge outright crumble under him, but eventually he makes it across no problem. | Arona herself picks her way along carefully, hunched over and with her hands on the ground. The ledge's certainly cramping her style for a big girl like her, but at least she's got enough sense to take her time where it counts. | On her part, Einin has no problem picking her way across the ledge, nimble feet and small stature working together to guide her safely across to the other side of the path. ] Once [party.hasCompanions|everyone's|you're] safely over, though, something catches your attention as you peer into the grotto: voices. With the roar of the waterfall muted in the darkness, someone's definitely speaking from somewhere above you, perhaps lulled into a false sense of security by the ambient noise. "...Lookout duty... boring as get-out." "If the little bastard... watching the skies would be more productive. Them harpies are willing to nick anything shiny..." [party.has cait |"Do you hear that?" Cait whispers, her ears twitching. "It's them, more of those creeps back from the temple! I'd recognize them anywhere!" You nod and hold up a hand for her to be silent lest she give the game away. |[party.has einin |"Hey, you hear that?" Einin whispers, learning in while her large, mousey ears swivel this way and that. "It's more of those robed people from the valley..." You shrug and hold up a hand for her to be silent. Be as things may, you don't want to give yourselves away so soon. ] ] Getting down on all fours, you creep forward across the damp, slimy rock and into the darkness, trying to catch more of the conversation that's going on above you. They can't be that high up if you're able to catch their conversation like this; one story, perhaps? Or maybe the cavern's shape is focusing the sound towards you? "...Better than working on the dig site. My hands are all chafed." "You should've brought a better pair of gloves." "Oh, I can think of something else that's chafed, all right." The sound of footsteps, and they're gone, perhaps swapping out with the next watch; you let out the breath that you'd been holding, and move forward with purpose into the damp darkness. Much of what lies ahead of you is unknown thanks to Sanders' sparse instructions, but one thing is sure, though: Tollus's goons are here on the mountain, and given what you've overheard, it's very possible that they're after the same thing you're here for — and are pretty close to getting their hands on it to boot. While you're not entirely sure why Tollus wants his hands on a Sorran relic or whether it's something Kasyrra ordered him to do or if he came up with the notion himself, keeping it out of his grubby hands is almost certainly the right thing to do. [party.has quin|Yet after all this time, Quin hasn't spoken once; the taeleer's eyes glaring at the pathway ahead barely keep his magical fires bottled, squeezing the grip of his sword. "If we find Tollus, I call dibs."|There's no backing out now. You've got to move, and quickly at that.]
rows.translation: 已经没有什么可做的了；你已经为山可能会带来的任何情况做好了充分的准备。是时候离开了。小心别滑倒掉进下面的深坑里，你小心翼翼地沿着悬崖内壁那潮湿的岩架行走。 [party.comp brint arona einin | 对于布林特来说，这确实是一段相当艰难的旅程。作为一只弥诺陶洛斯，他不得不抓住附近的树根和树枝来保持平衡，才能在狭窄的小路上继续前进。有好几处，你都会担心他会失去平衡，或者那些岩石架会突然在他脚下坍塌，但最终，他还是顺利地走过了这段路。 | 阿罗娜自己小心翼翼地摸索着前进，她弯下腰，双手撑在地上。对于她这样一个身材高大的女孩来说，这样的行走方式确实有些不便，但至少她还算有足够的理智，在关键时刻放慢速度。 | 对于艾宁来说，在岩架上行走根本不是问题——她灵活的脚步和娇小的身躯让她能够轻松安全地穿过那段狭窄的小路，到达路的对面。 ] 曾经[party.hasCompanions|每个人的|你是]然而，当你凝视着洞穴内部时，有东西吸引了你的注意：声音。在黑暗中，瀑布的轰鸣声已经变得微弱，但显然有人在你头顶的某个地方说话——或许正是这种环境噪音让你产生了一种虚假的安全感。 ……站岗任务……无聊透了。 要是那个小混蛋能多看看天空该多好……那些秃鹫之类的东西，只要看到闪亮的东西就会立刻扑上去…… [party.has cait |你听到吗？凯特轻声说道，她的耳朵微微抽动着。就是他们，又是那些从寺庙里跑出来的怪物！我在哪里都能认出他们来！ 你点了点头，同时抬手示意她保持安静，以免泄露游戏的关键信息。 |[party.has einin |嘿，你听到吗？艾宁一边低声说着，一边用她那对大大的、像老鼠耳朵一样的耳朵不停地转动着，似乎在认真地聆听着什么。应该是那些来自山谷、穿着长袍的人…… 你耸了耸肩，举手示意她安静下来。无论如何，你都不想这么快就暴露自己的计划。 ] ] 你四肢着地，小心翼翼地爬过那些潮湿、黏腻的岩石，进入黑暗之中，试图捕捉到上方正在进行的对话。如果你能听到他们的谈话，那么他们应该不会在那么高的地方；也许只是一个故事而已？又或者，这个洞穴的构造使得声音被集中到了你的所在位置？ ……总比在挖掘现场干活强。我的手都磨破了。 你本应该带一副更好的手套来。 哦，我想到了另一件让人感到不适的事情。 脚步声渐渐远去，或许他们已经去寻找下一个目标了；你长舒一口气，然后坚定地朝着潮湿的黑暗中走去。由于桑德斯提供的信息十分有限，前方很多情况都还不清楚，但有一件事是肯定的：托勒斯的打手们确实来到了这座山上。根据你刚才听到的那些话，他们很可能会在寻找与你目标相同的东西——而且他们已经离得到手部不远了。虽然你并不完全清楚为什么托勒斯非要得到那件索拉信徒的遗物，也不清楚这是卡希拉命令他去做的，还是他自己想出来的主意，但无论如何，阻止他得到这件遗物，几乎肯定是正确的做法。 [party.has quin|然而，经过了这么长的时间，昆因仍然一言不发；那位泰勒尔紧盯着前方的道路，强忍着体内激发的魔法力量，双手紧紧握住剑柄。“如果我们找到了托勒斯，那把剑就归我。|现在没有退路了。你必须采取行动，而且要尽快行动。]

rows.original: The moment you step past the chapel's threshold, you're greeted by the smell of wet plaster, setting mortar and stone dust. The source of such is readily apparent — a good chunk of the western wall has been knocked out to create an impromptu doorway while an additional room is being built around it. That must be the cloister Sanders spoke of — while you're well aware of the fact that Garth has at his beck and call some of the best workmen in the Marches, you didn't expect that they'd already be able to get it almost completed from the absolute nothing that was there when Sanders sent you on this little task. And speaking of Sanders, here's the man himself, coming up to you at his ever unhurried pace. He inclines his head towards you and ushers you inside, being careful to keep well away from the ongoing construction. "Welcome. Do watch your step — though there haven't been any accidents so far, the masonry is heavy. Wouldn't want to take any chances with how quickly they're working." Hmm. The work's going quickly, and it looks to be quite good, from what you can tell. That means it's got to have cost something, right? "Oh well. A bit here, a bit there. The villagers have been generous. As I've mentioned before, trying times often rekindle faith in people. Hopefully, the cloister will help bring some peace to the hearts of the troubled. Is that why you're here today, [pc.name]?" Uh, actually, no. He remembers that relic he asked you to go and get, right? You went and fetched it for him. Sanders' eyes widen slightly as you pull out the ceremonial shortspear and hand it over to him. He brings it over to the lectern where the chapel is better lit, and examines it from tip to base, humming to himself as he conducts the appraisal. "Fascinating," he mutters. "As far as I can tell, this looks to be the genuine article from every description I've been able to obtain. Yet I can't feel the tiniest trace of divine power on it — as far as magical power goes, it's no different from a piece Ogrish could have made. I can only wonder..." Considering what you had to go through in order to get it, all this has been a bit of a downer. "Oh? Tell me, what did you have to go through in order to acquire Sorra's Succor for me?" You give Sanders a brief run-down of what happened at the Greyvale Ranges, how Master Tollus appears to be gathering relics of the Godswar for study and sent his minions to excavate the mountains in search of them. Covering the salient points and adding detail when Sanders requests such, you explain how you fought through all of Tollus's goons to get it for him. "To say this is worrying is an understatement," Sanders says at last. "I'm afraid I can't shed any light on what these miscreants might hope to gain out of this, but it can't bode well for anyone." What was Sorra's Succor used for, anyway? "The texts state it was charged with ending the miserable existences of those who had been hollowed out by the Wraiths. Since there was no way to restore what had been lost, an ending for the shell that remained was the least of the mercies that could be bestowed. Succor, as it were." Right. Then there's the matter of this prism Whisper mentioned... "I'm afraid this is the first time I've ever heard of such a thing. I'm sure you can understand that records from that era of upheaval are spotty at best, even with the baroness's help." So, another dead end? "I'll keep looking, but I won't make any promises. In the meantime, we can finish the cloister. If you'll let me have the relic, I'll have your reward ready for you in a bit." Of course. Sanders nods, and heads into the back of the chapel with the shortspear. He returns a little while later with a small wooden box and a purse. "Here. You went through far more than I expected you would, so I've got to increase your reward proportionately. Money is always welcome, of course, but I'd also like you to have something from my more active days. While I fortunately never had reason to use it, I get the feeling that you'll be running into these cultists more and more the closer you get to confronting that demoness. Please take it — as it is, it's gathering dust on my shelves." Acquired 500 EC. Acquired 1x Kaelirra's Tears. "Now then, we'll have the cloister ready in a little while, perhaps as soon as your next visit. I'll be sure to put the relic up prominently, too; do come whenever you need a little solace and solitude. Everyone could benefit from a little every now and then."
rows.translation: 一当你跨过小教堂的门槛，立刻就会闻到湿石膏、砂浆以及石粉的味道。这些气味的来源显而易见：西墙的很大一部分已经被拆掉，以便临时搭建一个门道，同时还在那里建造另一个房间。那肯定就是桑德斯提到的那个隐修院吧——你明明知道加斯手底下有一些边境地区最优秀的工匠，但你肯定没想到，在桑德斯派你去做这个任务的时候，那些工匠们已经能够从一片空白的基础上几乎完成整个工程了。 说到桑德斯，这位先生本人正以他那永远不急不躁的速度朝您走来。他微微低头，邀请您进去，同时注意避开正在进行的施工区域。 欢迎来到这里。请小心行走——虽然到目前为止还没有发生任何事故，但这些砖石结构确实相当沉重。考虑到他们工作的速度，我们确实不能冒任何风险。 嗯，这项工作进展得相当快，从你描述的情况来看，成果也应该很不错。那么，这肯定花费了不少成本吧？ 好吧，这里添一点，那里改一点。村民们都非常慷慨。正如我之前所说，艰难的时刻往往会让人们重新燃起信念。希望这座修道院能够帮助那些陷入困境的人们找回内心的平静。你们今天来这里，也是为了这个原因吧？ [pc.name]？” 呃，其实并没有。他应该还记得你当时被他派去取的那件遗物吧？是你帮他去取回来的。” 当你拿出那支仪式用短矛递给桑德斯时，他的眼睛微微睁大了。他将矛拿到教堂里光线更充足的讲坛前，从矛尖一直检查到矛尾，一边仔细观察一边自言自语地进行鉴定。 真是太吸引人了。他低声嘟囔着。据我所知，从我得到的所有描述来看，这确实是一件真正的神器。然而，我却感觉不到它身上有一丝神力——从魔法力量的角度来看，它和奥格里斯人制造的普通物品并没有什么区别。我实在想不通…… 考虑到你为了得到它所经历的一切，这一切确实让人感到有些沮丧。 哦？快告诉我，为了获得索拉的援助，你究竟必须先完成什么？ 你向桑德斯简要介绍了在格雷维尔山脉发生的事情：托勒斯大师似乎正在收集与“神战”有关的遗物进行研究，因此他派出了手下在山区进行挖掘工作。你重点说明了事情的来龙去脉，并在桑德斯要求时补充了一些细节，同时告诉了他自己是如何突破托勒斯那些手下重重阻挠，最终取得那些遗物的。 说这令人担忧，其实还是轻描淡写了。桑德斯终于开口了。恐怕我无法说明这些恶作剧者究竟想从中获得什么，但这对任何人来说都不是什么好事。 索拉的救助技能到底是用来做什么的呢？ 这些文字指出，它的存在意义就在于终结那些被‘幽灵’吞噬后所遭受的悲惨命运。既然已经无法恢复失去的一切，那么为这些残存的‘空壳’提供一个终结，也算是最起码的仁慈之举了——可以说，这是一种救助。 对了，还有这个叫做“Whisper”的棱镜的问题…… 恐怕这是我第一次听说这种事情。我相信您也能理解，在那个动荡的年代，即使有男爵夫人的帮助，相关记录也极其零散、不完整。 又是一个死路吗？ 我会继续寻找的，但无法保证一定能找到。不过在此期间，我们可以完成修道院的建设。如果你能把那件遗物交给我，过一会儿我就会把你的奖励准备好给你。 当然可以。 桑德斯点了点头，然后拿着那支短矛走向小教堂的后部。过了一会儿，他回来了，手里拿着一个小木箱和一个钱包。 拿着吧。你所经历的一切远远超出了我的预期，因此我必须相应地增加你的奖励。当然，金钱总是受欢迎的，但我也希望你能得到一些在我活跃时期留下的东西。虽然幸运的是，我从未有机会使用它们，但我感觉，当你越来越接近与那个女恶魔对峙的时候，你会越来越频繁地遇到这些邪教徒。请收下吧——这些东西现在只是在我的架子上积灰而已。 获得了500点EC。 获得了1份凯莉拉之泪。 那么，过一会儿我们就能把那个静修处准备好了，也许就在你下次来访的时候。我一定会把那件圣物放在显眼的位置；无论什么时候你需要一些宁静与独处，都欢迎随时前来。其实，每个人偶尔都需要这样的时刻。

The moment you step past the chapel's threshold, you're greeted by the smell of wet plaster, setting mortar and stone dust. The source of such is readily apparent — a good chunk of the western wall has been knocked out to create an impromptu doorway while an additional room is being built around it. That must be the cloister Sanders spoke of — while you're well aware of the fact that Garth has at his beck and call some of the best workmen in the Marches, you didn't expect that they'd already be able to get it almost completed from the absolute nothing that was there when Sanders sent you on this little task.
    
    And speaking of Sanders, here's the man himself, coming up to you at his ever unhurried pace. He inclines his head towards you and ushers you inside, being careful to keep well away from the ongoing construction.
    
    "Welcome. Do watch your step — though there haven't been any accidents so far, the masonry is heavy. Wouldn't want to take any chances with how quickly they're working."
    
    Hmm. The work's going quickly, and it looks to be quite good, from what you can tell. That means it's got to have cost something, right?
    
    "Oh well. A bit here, a bit there. The villagers have been generous. As I've mentioned before, trying times often rekindle faith in people. Hopefully, the cloister will help bring some peace to the hearts of the troubled. Is that why you're here today, [pc.name]?"
    
    Uh, actually, no. He remembers that relic he asked you to go and get, right? You went and fetched it for him, although it wasn't quite in the fashion that he instructed you to.
    
    Sanders' eyes widen slightly as you pull out the ceremonial shortspear and hand it over to him. He brings it over to the later where the chapel is better lit, and examines it from tip to base, humming to himself as he conducts the appraisal.
    
    "Oh dear. The relic has been quite thoroughly corrupted — its sanctity hasn't been lost, but rather, turned towards less wholesome ends."
    
    Less wholesome ends — that's one way of putting it, you suppose.
    
    "How exactly did you come by this? You said you didn't quite find it in the fashion that you expected — what happened?"
    
    You briefly sum up the events that happened in the sunken jotun castle for Sanders, leading up to Whisper's defeat and your retrieval of the not-so ceremonial spear from the spiteful little mouse-man. Sanders listens to your story intently, rubbing his chin intermittently, then gives you a nod as you finish the tale.
    
    "I see. If you'd gone there as instructed, chances are you'd have found nothing."
    
    Judging by Whisper's boasting, the implication was that he had it in his possession for some time.
    
    "That does leave the question, though — if Tollus thought it unimportant enough to not be the main object of his search, then what was?" Sanders shakes his head. "At this point, I can't stand back any longer. You know the truth... you know the danger Tollus represented twenty years ago, and that's only grown since then. I'm afraid I can't shed any light on what these miscreants might hope to gain out of this, but it can't bode well for anyone."
rows.translation:
当你跨入小教堂的门槛的那一刻，迎面扑来的是湿灰泥、砂浆以及石粉的气息。这些气味的来源一目了然——西墙的很大一部分已经被拆掉，以便临时搭建一个门口，同时还在那里建造另一个房间。那肯定就是桑德斯提到的那个隐修院吧——你明明知道加斯手底下有一些边境地区最优秀的工匠，但你肯定没想到，在桑德斯派你去做这个任务的时候，这些工匠竟然已经能够从一片空白的基础上几乎完成整个工程了。
    
    说到桑德斯，这位先生本人正以他那永远不急不躁的速度朝您走来。他微微低头向您示意，然后引领您进入室内，同时特别注意避开正在进行的施工区域。

“欢迎来到这里。请小心脚步——虽然到目前为止还没有发生任何事故，但这些砖石结构确实很重。考虑到他们工作的速度，我们确实不能冒任何风险。
    
    嗯，工作进展得挺快，从你说的情况来看，成果也应该相当不错。那么，这肯定花费了不少成本吧？

“唉，也没办法。这里花点钱，那里花点钱。村民们都很慷慨。就像我之前说过，艰难的时刻往往会让人们重新燃起信念。希望这座修道院能够帮助那些陷入困境的人们找回内心的平静。你今天来，也是为了这个原因吧？ [pc.name]嗯，其实并不是这样。他记得你之前被他派去取的那件遗物吧？你确实去把它拿来了，不过方式可能并不完全符合他的要求。”

当你拿出那支仪式用短矛递给桑德斯时，他的眼睛微微睁大了。他将矛拿到光线更充足的教堂角落，仔细地检查它的每一处，一边检查一边自言自语地评价着这件物品。
    
    哦，天哪。这件遗物已经严重腐化了——它的神圣性并没有消失，只不过被用在了一些不那么正当的地方。”

“不那么正当的地方……这么说也挺恰当的。”

“你究竟是怎么得到这件遗物的？你说你并不是以预期的方式找到它的，那么到底发生了什么？
    
    你向桑德斯简要叙述了发生在那座沉没的约顿城堡里的事件，从 Whisper 的失败，到你从那个心怀怨恨的小老鼠人手中夺回了那支原本并不那么“正式”的长矛。桑德斯全神贯注地听着你讲述，不时地摩挲着下巴，等到你讲完，他点了点头表示赞同。
    
    我明白了。如果你按照指示去了那里，很可能什么也不会找到。”

从Whisper的言辞来看，这意味着他已经拥有那东西有一段时间了。

“不过，这还是留下了一个问题——如果托勒斯认为那东西不够重要，因此没有将其作为主要搜寻目标，那么他真正在寻找的是什么呢？桑德斯摇了摇头：“在这种情况下，我再也不能坐视不理了。你们都知道真相……你们知道二十年前托勒斯代表着多大的危险，而从那以后，这种危险只会有所加剧。恐怕我无法弄清楚这些恶棍想从中获得什么，但可以肯定的是，这对任何人来说都不是什么好事。"

rows.original: So what will he do now? "Despite its appearances, I don't think the corruption in the relic is too deeply entrenched — thick, yes, but not sunk in. It may still be possible to cleanse it for the purposes of the cloister, and that is the first matter to tend to — give weary souls a place of respite." What was Sorra's Succor used for, anyway? "The texts state it was charged with ending the miserable existences of those who had been hollowed out by the Wraiths. Since there was no way to restore what had been lost, an ending for the shell that remained was the least of the mercies that could be bestowed. Succor, as it were; records from that era of upheaval are spotty at best. As you describe it, this Whisper creature had inverted it from its original purpose, using it to harm and kill the innocent. That's likely what triggered the corruption." And after the cloister's done with? "I don't know. I'll have to think about it. One thing's for certain — I'm not taking to the field any more, not unless truly pressed. The torch's been passed onto younger folks like you. That being said, there are some things I can do for you, [pc.name]. If you'll let me have the relic, I'll have your reward ready for you in a bit." Of course. Sanders nods, and heads into the back of the chapel with the shortspear, returning a little while later with a small wooden box and a purse. "Here. You went through far more than I expected you would, so I've got to increase your reward proportionately. Money is always welcome, of course, but I'd also like you to have something from my more active days. While I fortunately never had reason to use it, I get the feeling that you'll be running into Tollus and his underlings more and more the closer you get to confronting that demoness. Please take it — as it is, it's gathering dust on my shelves." Acquired 500 EC. Acquired 1x Kaelirra's Tears. "Now then, we'll have the cloister ready in a little while, perhaps as soon as you next visit. I'll be sure to put the relic up prominently, too; do come whenever you need a little solace and solitude. Everyone could benefit from a little every now and then. "And [pc.name]... be careful out there. From everything you've told me, Tollus is shaping up to be the real threat here if he thinks he can overthrow the demoness. He's devious and insane enough to attempt it, and knowledgeable enough that he might actually succeed. I know you've managed to overcome him twice now, but it doesn't pay to get complacent."
rows.translation: 那么，他接下来会怎么做？ “别看它表面如此，我认为腐化在圣物上扎根得并不太深——积累得很厚，却没有沉入内部。或许仍有可能将其净化，用于修道院；而眼下第一件要做的事，就是为疲惫的灵魂提供一个休憩之所。” 话说回来，索拉之慰原本有什么用途？ “文献记载，它被赋予了终结那些遭怨灵掏空之人的悲惨生命的力量。既然已经无法恢复失去的部分，至少可以慈悲地让残存的躯壳获得解脱。所谓慰藉，正是如此；那个动荡时代留下的记录充其量也只是残篇断简。根据你的描述，那个名叫低语的生物逆转了它原本的用途，用它伤害、杀戮无辜者。这很可能正是腐化的诱因。” 那修道院修复之后呢？ “我不知道。必须好好想一想。有一件事可以肯定——除非真的被逼到绝境，否则我不会再踏上战场。火炬已经传到你们这些年轻人手中。不过，[pc.name]，我还是能为你做些事情。要是你愿意把圣物交给我，过一会儿我就会准备好给你的报酬。” 当然可以。 桑德斯点点头，带着短矛走进礼拜堂后方。过了一会儿，他拿着一只小木盒和一个钱袋回来。 “拿着。你经历的磨难远远超出我的预期，因此我也得相应提高报酬。钱当然总是受人欢迎，不过我还想把自己活跃在战场时的一件东西送给你。幸好我从来没有理由使用它；不过有种感觉告诉我，越接近那个女恶魔，你就会越来越频繁地遇上托勒斯和他的手下。请收下吧——反正它留在我这里也只是在架子上积灰。” 获得500枚琥珀金币。 获得1份凯莉拉之泪。 “好了，修道院很快就能准备妥当，或许你下次来访时就可以使用。我也会把圣物摆在显眼的位置；需要片刻慰藉与独处时，随时欢迎你前来。每个人偶尔都需要一点安宁。 “还有，[pc.name]……在外面一定要小心。按照你告诉我的一切来看，如果托勒斯认为自己能够推翻那个女恶魔，他恐怕才是这里真正的威胁。他既狡诈又疯狂，足以尝试这件事；掌握的知识也足够丰富，甚至真有可能成功。我知道你已经两次战胜他，但绝不能因此放松警惕。”

rows.original:
You're forced back by the sheer weight of the cultists' offensive, ceding ground on the narrow trail as Tollus's black-robed goons press in. More and more of them are flowing in from up ahead, emerging from side ravines and behind boulders to join the fray, clearly hoping to overwhelm you with their numbers. 

    The last thing you recall is [party.hasCompanions
    |shouting for [party.compNames] to get out of here
    |raising your [pc.weapon] for one final desperate defense
    ], then something hard and heavy hits you in the back of the head.
rows.translation:
邪教徒们的攻势势不可挡，你被逼得不断后退，在狭窄的小径上节节失守，托勒斯那些黑袍打手步步紧逼。越来越多的人从前方涌来，从两侧的沟壑里、巨石后方钻出来加入战团，显然是想靠人多势众压垮你。 

    你最后记得的，是[party.hasCompanions
    |大喊着让[party.compNames]快离开这里
    |举起你的[pc.weapon]做最后一次绝望的抵挡
    ]然后，某个又硬又沉的东西砸中了你的后脑。
