rows.original: The lock on Garret's cage catches your eye, and you start to wonder. The metal does look pretty old, it's a little flimsy, and it's designed to keep in animals, not people. Whoever made it clearly favored strength over finesse, which might work to your advantage here... Hmm... [party.has etheryn| Seeing you examine the lock, Etheryn steps up and gives you a small, timid tap on the shoulder. "I can open the lock if you'd like. It shouldn't be too hard." You turn to her and smile. Why, you were just thinking the same thing. You step aside to give Etheryn some space, and she gets to work. Drawing out a slim pouch from her possessions, the elf busies herself with a number of slender and flexible thieves' tools, studying each one in turn while glancing at the lock on the cage. At last, she settles on two of their number, a strip of wire with several protrusions on its tip, and slides both into the lock. "Mind moving back?" Garret shrugs and ambles over to the other side of the cage. "Sure. Don't let me get in your way." Etheryn fiddles with the lock, beads of sweat forming on her forehead. There's a faint scraping noise from within the mechanism; she purses her lips, adds a little oil to the silvered lockpick, then tries again. This time the tumblers shift a little, and she steadily applies more pressure to the thieves' tool, mumbling under her breath. For a moment, you wonder if the tool's going to snap in the lock — it looks so delicate — but at last the tumblers click, and the lock pops open. "All done!" Garret springs to his feet, knocking over his doggy dish and trampling it underfoot in his haste to be out of his prison; the barred door clangs loudly as he throws it open and lets out a heaving sigh. "Ye gods, that was better out than in! And good thing you finished the job quickly, too!" "Oh? Were you in a hurry?" Garret's face turns grim, and he points over Etheryn's shoulder at the hall's entrance doorway. "Yeah. We've got company." | [pc.cl thief| Yes, indeed. This shouldn't be too hard — compared to some of the locks you've cracked in the past, the old thing on Garret's cage shouldn't pose any problem. With that thought in mind, you reach into your [pc.isBimbo|[pc.underwear], taking the opportunity to give yourself a grope for luck,|[pc.armor]] and draw out a small set of thieves' tools. A few moments to study the problem at hand, and you select one of the numerous bent lengths of wire to deal with the problem. There's a little trouble at first due to the rusted mechanisms, but with enough ingenuity and determination, you manage to slide the tumblers out of the way and hear a click as the lock pops open. It wobbles, heaves, and falls to the floor in a large cloud of dust. There! | [pc.cunningRange 70| While you aren't exactly trained in this sort of stuff, you feel confident enough in your cunning and ingenuity that you should be able to jimmy the lock open given the right tools. Given the right tools, that's the key phrase... Hey, does Garret know where the loggers kept their tools and things? Something small and slender might do the trick. It'll be harder with an improvised pick, but you think you might be able to crack the lock on his cage. "Hmm... um... there's the toolshed out back in the work yard, but that's the heavy equipment. I don't think a hacksaw is what you're looking for..." No, definitely not. That'd take too long and make far too much noise. C'mon, can't he jog his memory? His freedom is at stake here! Garret's brow furrows, and you can see the gears turning in his mind as it works away furiously. "Huh... yes, come to think of it, I might've caught sight of a few bits and pieces in the back of the hall. A workbench." Is he sure? "Dunno. I haven't had the chance to roam around of late, if you haven't noticed; things might've changed since I was on the other side of these bars. What I know is what I know." He sure has a thick skull. Still, you dig around in the darkened corner which Garret's pointed out, and sure enough, there's a workbench — judging by the trash lying about, this was more for quality of life projects, rather than actual logging works. Whatever, it'll do — most of the stuff is tarnished from neglect, but you do find a spool of wire that's reasonably stiff. Hopefully this will do. One to depress the tumblers, and another to provide the requisite torque... "Found anything?" Garret asks when you return. You wave the spool of wire in his face, along with the pliers you found. He'd better hope this works, you tell him as you clip off two lengths of wire and start bending them into shape. Every now and then, you give the lock another look-over to make sure you're getting both as close to the needed shape as possible — there are bar tales aplenty of people using hairpins, needles and any assortment of slender metal objects as lockpicks, but you soon find out it's much easier said than done. Garret watches you intently throughout the whole process, catching his breath as you slide the stiff wires into the lock and get to work. The entire process is an uphill battle against your nerves. Your hands get sweaty, and once or twice you hit a snag and worry that the wires will snap off in the lock, but eventually the rusted tumblers creak and the bolt slides out of place. With nothing holding it up, the lock falls to the ground with a thump and large cloud of dust. "Finally." Flexing his arms, Garret storms up to the cage door and hurls it open with a resounding clang. He gives you a smile — or more correctly, shows his teeth — and makes a show of stretching from head to toe. "Gods above. That was far better out than in. I wouldn't rest just yet, though." What? He jabs over your shoulder at the door. "Look lively. Seems like we've got company!" | You spend a minute giving the lock a look-over, but it becomes apparent that this is above your pay grade. One, you don't know anything about coaxing open locks, and two, you have to admit that you're not going to be figuring this one out in any reasonable time frame, either. Garret eyes you. "Well?" You shrug. "Hmp. Can't blame you for not doing what I can't, either. Guess you're off to look for the key, aren't you?" That's one possibility, yes. Garret makes a growling noise in the back of his throat and curls up next to the doggy dish in his cage. "Just get me out of here, it's starting to wear on my nerves. Now, if you don't mind, I'm going to have a bit of a lie-down." ] ] ]
rows.translation: 加雷特的笼子上的锁引起了你的注意，你开始思考起来。那金属看起来确实很老旧，有些脆弱，而且这种锁显然是为关住动物而不是人类而设计的。制造这个锁的人显然更注重坚固性而非精致性，而这反而可能对你有利…… 嗯…… [party.has etheryn| 看到你正在检查那把锁，伊瑟琳走上前，轻轻、胆怯地拍了拍你的肩膀。如果您愿意，我可以帮您打开锁。应该不会太难吧。 你转向她，微笑着说道：“哦，你刚才也在想同样的事情呢。” 你退到一边，给伊瑟琳一些空间，让她开始行动。这位精灵从自己的物品中取出一个细长的小袋子，然后拿出几件细长而灵活的偷窃工具，逐一仔细研究它们，同时不时地瞥一眼笼子上的锁。最后，她选定了其中两件工具——一根末端带有几个突起的金属丝，然后将它们插入锁中。 能往后退一点吗？ 加雷特耸了耸肩，然后慢悠悠地走到了笼子的另一边。当然。别让我妨碍你。 伊瑟琳摆弄着锁具，额头上开始冒出细汗。锁的内部传来微弱的刮擦声；她抿紧嘴唇，在那把银色的开锁工具上滴了些油，然后再次尝试。这次，锁芯终于微微移动了，她逐渐加大用力，嘴里不停地喃喃自语。有那么一刻，你甚至担心这个工具会在锁里折断——它看起来实在太脆弱了——但最终，锁芯终于“咔嗒”一声打开了。 全部完成了！ 加雷特猛地站了起来，慌忙中撞翻了自己的狗碗，还踩在了它上面；当他用力推开那扇铁栅门时，门发出巨大的声响，而他则长舒了一口气。 天啊，这样反而更好了！还好你也能迅速完成工作！ 哦？你是赶时间吗？ 加雷特的脸色变得阴沉，他指着伊瑟琳肩膀后面的大厅入口说道。是啊，我们有人来了。 | [pc.cl thief| 确实如此。这应该不会太难——与你过去破解过的一些锁相比，加雷特笼子上的那把旧锁应该不会给你带来任何麻烦。 想到这里，你伸手进了口袋[pc.isBimbo|[pc.underwear]趁这个机会，给自己一点运气吧。|[pc.armor]]然后，你拿出一小套小偷用的工具。花了几秒钟分析当前的情况，从那些弯曲的金属丝中选出了一根用来解决问题。起初，由于机械部件生锈了，操作起来有些困难，但凭借足够的智慧和决心，你终于把锁芯拨开了，锁“咔嗒”一声打开了。锁在摇晃了几下后，最终掉在了地上，扬起了一片尘土。 好了！ | [pc.cunningRange 70| 虽然你并没有接受过这方面的专门训练，但你对自己的聪明才智充满信心，相信只要有合适的工具，你应该能够打开那把锁。 “有合适的工具”，这才是关键所在…… 嘿，加雷特知道伐木工们把工具放在哪里吗？那种小巧纤细的工具可能会派上用场。用自制的撬棍可能会更困难一些，但你觉得应该还是能够打开他笼子上的锁的。 嗯……那个……工作场地的后面有工具棚，但里面都是重型设备。我觉得你需要的应该不是钢锯…… 不，绝对不行。那样会花费太长时间，还会产生太多噪音。拜托，他总该努力回想一下吧？他的自由可就在此一举了！ 加雷特的眉头紧锁，你可以看到他正在拼命地思考着。嗯……对，仔细想起来，我好像在走廊的尽头看到了一些东西。一个工作台。 他确定吗？ 不知道。最近我也没机会到处走动，如果你没注意到的话；自从我被关在这些铁栏之后，情况可能已经变了。我所知道的，就是这些而已。 他的脑袋确实够硬的。不过，按照加雷特指出的那个昏暗角落去寻找，果然发现了一张工作台——从周围散落的杂物来看，这张工作台更多是用来做一些提升生活品质的小项目，而不是用来进行真正的伐木工作的。不过也凑合吧，大多数工具都因为长期无人使用而生锈了，不过你还是找到了一卷还算结实的金属线。希望这能派上用场……一根线用来压下那些开关，另一根线则能提供所需的扭矩…… 找到什么了吗？加雷特问你什么时候回来。 你把那一卷电线以及你找到的钳子在他面前晃了晃。你告诉他，希望这些东西能派上用场，然后你剪下了两段电线，开始把它们弯成所需的形状。每隔一段时间，你就会再仔细检查一下那把锁，确保自己正在用各种方法将其形状调整得尽可能接近所需的状态——关于人们用发夹、针头以及各种细长的金属物件来当开锁工具的故事比比皆是，但很快你就会发现，说起来容易做起来难得多。在整个过程中，加雷特都在密切注视着你。当你将那些坚硬的金属线插入锁孔并开始操作时，他也不禁屏住了呼吸。 整个过程简直是对你神经意志的严峻考验。你的手开始出汗，有一两次你甚至遇到了障碍，担心那些金属线会在锁孔里折断，但最终，那些生锈的锁芯终于发出了嘎吱声，螺栓也被成功拔了出来。没有任何东西阻挡它，锁重重地掉在地上，扬起了大片尘土。 终于。加雷特活动着手臂，冲向笼子的门，用力将其推开，发出一声清脆的响声。他朝你笑了笑——或者更准确地说，是露出了牙齿——然后故意做出从头到脚伸展身体的动作。天啊，效果比预期的要好多了。不过，我还是不会现在就休息的。 什么？ 他从你肩后指向那扇门。快点，看来我们有客人来了！ | 你花了一分钟时间观察那把锁，但很快便意识到，这超出了你的能力范围。首先，你根本不知道如何用技巧打开锁；其次，你也必须承认，在合理的时间内，你根本不可能解决这个问题。 加雷特注视着你。那么？ 你耸了耸肩。 哼，你做不到的事情，我也确实无能为力。看来你得去寻找那把钥匙了，对吧？ 这确实是一种可能性，没错。 加雷特在喉咙深处发出低吼声，然后蜷缩在笼子里的狗食盘旁边。快把我从这里弄出去，这真的让我越来越烦躁了。现在，如果你们不介意的话，我想躺下休息一会儿。 ] ] ]
rows.raw: " The lock on Garret's cage catches your eye, and you start to wonder. The metal does look pretty old, it's a little flimsy, and it's designed to keep in animals, not people. Whoever made it clearly favored strength over finesse, which might work to your advantage here... Hmm... [party.has etheryn| Seeing you examine the lock, Etheryn steps up and gives you a small, timid tap on the shoulder. "I can open the lock if you'd like. It shouldn't be too hard." You turn to her and smile. Why, you were just thinking the same thing. You step aside to give Etheryn some space, and she gets to work. Drawing out a slim pouch from her possessions, the elf busies herself with a number of slender and flexible thieves' tools, studying each one in turn while glancing at the lock on the cage. At last, she settles on two of their number, a strip of wire with several protrusions on its tip, and slides both into the lock. "Mind moving back?" Garret shrugs and ambles over to the other side of the cage. "Sure. Don't let me get in your way." Etheryn fiddles with the lock, beads of sweat forming on her forehead. There's a faint scraping noise from within the mechanism; she purses her lips, adds a little oil to the silvered lockpick, then tries again. This time the tumblers shift a little, and she steadily applies more pressure to the thieves' tool, mumbling under her breath. For a moment, you wonder if the tool's going to snap in the lock — it looks so delicate — but at last the tumblers click, and the lock pops open. "All done!" Garret springs to his feet, knocking over his doggy dish and trampling it underfoot in his haste to be out of his prison; the barred door clangs loudly as he throws it open and lets out a heaving sigh. "Ye gods, that was better out than in! And good thing you finished the job quickly, too!" "Oh? Were you in a hurry?" Garret's face turns grim, and he points over Etheryn's shoulder at the hall's entrance doorway. "Yeah. We've got company." | [pc.cl thief| Yes, indeed. This shouldn't be too hard — compared to some of the locks you've cracked in the past, the old thing on Garret's cage shouldn't pose any problem. With that thought in mind, you reach into your [pc.isBimbo|[pc.underwear], taking the opportunity to give yourself a grope for luck,|[pc.armor]] and draw out a small set of thieves' tools. A few moments to study the problem at hand, and you select one of the numerous bent lengths of wire to deal with the problem. There's a little trouble at first due to the rusted mechanisms, but with enough ingenuity and determination, you manage to slide the tumblers out of the way and hear a click as the lock pops open. It wobbles, heaves, and falls to the floor in a large cloud of dust. There! | [pc.cunningRange 70| While you aren't exactly trained in this sort of stuff, you feel confident enough in your cunning and ingenuity that you should be able to jimmy the lock open given the right tools. Given the right tools, that's the key phrase... Hey, does Garret know where the loggers kept their tools and things? Something small and slender might do the trick. It'll be harder with an improvised pick, but you think you might be able to crack the lock on his cage. "Hmm... um... there's the toolshed out back in the work yard, but that's the heavy equipment. I don't think a hacksaw is what you're looking for..." No, definitely not. That'd take too long and make far too much noise. C'mon, can't he jog his memory? His freedom is at stake here! Garret's brow furrows, and you can see the gears turning in his mind as it works away furiously. "Huh... yes, come to think of it, I might've caught sight of a few bits and pieces in the back of the hall. A workbench." Is he sure? "Dunno. I haven't had the chance to roam around of late, if you haven't noticed; things might've changed since I was on the other side of these bars. What I know is what I know." He sure has a thick skull. Still, you dig around in the darkened corner which Garret's pointed out, and sure enough, there's a workbench — judging by the trash lying about, this was more for quality of life projects, rather than actual logging works. Whatever, it'll do — most of the stuff is tarnished from neglect, but you do find a spool of wire that's reasonably stiff. Hopefully this will do. One to depress the tumblers, and another to provide the requisite torque... "Found anything?" Garret asks when you return. You wave the spool of wire in his face, along with the pliers you found. He'd better hope this works, you tell him as you clip off two lengths of wire and start bending them into shape. Every now and then, you give the lock another look-over to make sure you're getting both as close to the needed shape as possible — there are bar tales aplenty of people using hairpins, needles and any assortment of slender metal objects as lockpicks, but you soon find out it's much easier said than done. Garret watches you intently throughout the whole process, catching his breath as you slide the stiff wires into the lock and get to work. The entire process is an uphill battle against your nerves. Your hands get sweaty, and once or twice you hit a snag and worry that the wires will snap off in the lock, but eventually the rusted tumblers creak and the bolt slides out of place. With nothing holding it up, the lock falls to the ground with a thump and large cloud of dust. "Finally." Flexing his arms, Garret storms up to the cage door and hurls it open with a resounding clang. He gives you a smile — or more correctly, shows his teeth — and makes a show of stretching from head to toe. "Gods above. That was far better out than in. I wouldn't rest just yet, though." What? He jabs over your shoulder at the door. "Look lively. Seems like we've got company!" | You spend a minute giving the lock a look-over, but it becomes apparent that this is above your pay grade. One, you don't know anything about coaxing open locks, and two, you have to admit that you're not going to be figuring this one out in any reasonable time frame, either. Garret eyes you. "Well?" You shrug. "Hmp. Can't blame you for not doing what I can't, either. Guess you're off to look for the key, aren't you?" That's one possibility, yes. Garret makes a growling noise in the back of his throat and curls up next to the doggy dish in his cage. "Just get me out of here, it's starting to wear on my nerves. Now, if you don't mind, I'm going to have a bit of a lie-down." ] ] ]"

rows.original: Upon closer examination, the bars on Garret's cage are considerably weakened, although it's not readily apparent. As things stand, Garret's done enough damage that one could conceivably finish what he started — although the attempt would certainly create a lot of noise. [pc.strengthRange 60|You think you'd stand a fair chance at bending apart the damaged bars, if you so chose. Of course, as with anything there's no guarantee of your success, but you're feeling good about your odds.|It must be said, though, that maybe you aren't quite the person for the job given your, uh, physical inclinations. You could still try, of course; the damage could be more extensive than it looks, but you guess your chances of success aren't going to be great.] [party.has brint|As you continue studying the bars, you hear a low, rumbling cough from behind you. Even when he's trying, it's hard for Brint to be discreet. Guess it just isn't in his nature. "Yes?" "I can make short work of those, if you like." He flexes a big, literally beefy arm. "It's good to have these muscles come in useful for something other than fighting sometimes." Oh, they're useful for many things, he can be sure of that. [brint.fucked|You know that from personal experience, after all.] "Hm. Well, just say the word, and I'll have our doggy friend out in no time." Garret scowls again, but says nothing.] What now? Are you going to try and break Garret out with brute force?
rows.translation: 仔细观察就会发现，加雷特笼子上的铁条其实已经严重锈蚀、变得十分脆弱，只不过这一点并不容易被察觉。目前来看，加雷特已经造成了足够的破坏，因此完全有可能有人能够完成他开始的那项行动——不过，这样的尝试肯定会引发一系列严重的后果。很多充满噪音的环境。 [pc.strengthRange 60|你认为自己如果有意为之的话，应该有相当大的机会把那些损坏的铁条弄断。当然，就像所有事情一样，也没有绝对的把握。保证虽然你不确定自己能否取得成功，但你对自己的机会还是感到很有信心的。|不过，必须得说，考虑到你的身体状况，你可能并不太适合这份工作。当然，你仍然可以尝试；实际情况可能会比看上去更糟糕，但我想你成功的几率应该不会很大。] [party.has brint|当你继续研究那些条状物时，突然听到身后传来一声低沉的咳嗽声。尽管布林特在努力保持低调，但他似乎就是做不到——这种性格特点似乎根本就与他不符。 “怎么了？ 如果你愿意，我可以很快解决那些问题。他展示着自己那条粗壮有力的手臂。有时候，能够让这些肌肉在战斗之外也能发挥作用，确实是一件好事。 哦，这些工具确实能用于很多方面，这一点他可以放心。 [brint.fucked|毕竟，这是你根据个人经验得出的结论。] 嗯，只要你说一声，我们的狗狗朋友马上就会出来。 加雷特又皱起了眉头，但什么也没说。] 现在该怎么办？你是打算用武力把加雷特救出来吗？
rows.raw: " Upon closer examination, the bars on Garret's cage are considerably weakened, although it's not readily apparent. As things stand, Garret's done enough damage that one could conceivably finish what he started — although the attempt would certainly create a lot of noise. [pc.strengthRange 60|You think you'd stand a fair chance at bending apart the damaged bars, if you so chose. Of course, as with anything there's no guarantee of your success, but you're feeling good about your odds.|It must be said, though, that maybe you aren't quite the person for the job given your, uh, physical inclinations. You could still try, of course; the damage could be more extensive than it looks, but you guess your chances of success aren't going to be great.] [party.has brint|As you continue studying the bars, you hear a low, rumbling cough from behind you. Even when he's trying, it's hard for Brint to be discreet. Guess it just isn't in his nature. "Yes?" "I can make short work of those, if you like." He flexes a big, literally beefy arm. "It's good to have these muscles come in useful for something other than fighting sometimes." Oh, they're useful for many things, he can be sure of that. [brint.fucked|You know that from personal experience, after all.] "Hm. Well, just say the word, and I'll have our doggy friend out in no time." Garret scowls again, but says nothing.] What now? Are you going to try and break Garret out with brute force?"

rows.original: Yeah, you think you'll go for it. While it's true that forcing Garret's prison open is going to be risky, it's less so than trying to steal the key off the druidess. Placing your hands on the rusty iron bars, you test them a few times, feeling to get a good grip that won't chafe your palms. [party.has brint|It's then that you feel a heavy hand on your shoulder, and turn to find Brint standing just behind you, a big smile on his face. "Like I said, [pc.name], please allow me." Seems like he's not going to take no for an answer, [pc.cunningRange 50|and as you step away and he approaches the cage, you think you see something pass between Brint and Garret again. A flash of animosity, of rivalry, perhaps? Hmm... [pc.isBimbo|wonder which one is better in bed? Or maybe you could have them both at the same time? Would they even fit together?]|although you're not exactly sure why he's so insistent. Well, if he wants it, he's more than welcome to have it — you step aside, and Brint lumbers up until he's practically pressed against the bars.] Taking a deep breath, Brint sets his massive hammer-hands on the weak spot Garret's created, the minotaur taking a moment or two to steel himself. A deep rumble starts up in the pits of his chest, culminating in a loud snort, and then you see his muscles ripple and flex beneath his taut hide as he begins pulling the cage apart, exploiting the weakness Garret created. The cage stands absolutely no chance whatsoever. It puts up a bit of token resistance, which rapidly melts away as Brint focuses his strength and pulls, an unstoppable hunk of beef bent on constructive destruction. A scream of twisted metal rings through the air as the tortured bars finally give way, creating an opening large enough for Garret to slip through. Job complete, Brint steps back, dusts flecks of rust off his hands, and gives a small clumsy bow. "All done." Garret's been watching all this time, and his ears perk up at the sight. "Show-off. You're a show-off, but a good one at that." Brint grins. "Come on out, doggy. There's still work to be done." "Oh yes." Without further ado, Garret hoists himself up and through the hole Brint's made, then cracks his knuckles. "There's still a lot of work to be done — starting with that witch and her pet." "Speaking of which." Brint jerks a thumb over his shoulder at the door. "We have company, friends." |[pc.strengthRange 60|Alright, time to do this. You take a deep breath, steel yourself, and start prying the bars apart with every last ounce of strength you can muster. Your palms press heavily against the metal, your joints strain and shoulders burn, but through it all you can feel the old, worn iron give a little. That's it. The more they're twisted out of shape, the easier they'll be to bend further. Your breathing becomes labored and beads of sweat gather on your forehead, yet you don't let up the pressure as the bars begin to groan while you force them apart. Finally, with a concerted burst of strength, you wrench apart the rusted old iron far enough for Garret to slip through, a loud screech of agonized metal accompanying the feat. Garret looks up at you, and something approaching a smile forms on his muzzle. You step back, staggering a bit, and rub your burning arms as he hoists himself up and through the hole. He looks you up and down, then touches his forehead in respect. "Thanks." He's... he's very welcome. Garret nods, and cracks his knuckles. "Our work's still not done yet, friend. There's still plenty to do — starting with that witch and her pet." Fine, fine. But can you have a moment to catch your breath first? "Don't mean to be a killjoy, but we may not have time for that." |No point dithering any further — it's time to get this done. You take a moment to steady yourself, affirm your stance, and put everything you have into prying apart the bars of Garret's cage. You'd expected it to be hard, but not this hard — despite all your strength going into worrying the weak spot Garret's created, it doesn't budge at all. All you manage to create is a small hole, perhaps wide enough for him to stick his arm through, but nowhere near enough for him to escape his prison. "Harder than it looks, huh?" Garret remarks dryly. "Yeah, I should know." He's not helping here. Look, you'll just rest a bit and make another attempt later — Suddenly, Garret's ears pull back against his head, and a sharp edge of urgency enters his voice. "Behind you! Look alive!"]]
rows.translation: 是啊，你觉得自己应该试试看。虽然强行打开加雷特的监狱确实有风险，但这个风险总比从那位女德鲁伊那里偷走钥匙要小吧。你将双手放在那些生锈的铁栏杆上，反复试了试，确保自己的手能够牢牢抓住它们，而不会被刮伤。 [party.has brint|就在这时，你感到有人轻轻拍了拍你的肩膀，转过头，发现布林特就站在你身后，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。就像我之前说的， [pc.name]，请允许我这样做。 看来他是不会接受拒绝的。 [pc.cunningRange 50|当你后退一步，而他走向笼子的时候，你似乎再次看到布林特和加雷特之间有某种东西闪过——那是敌意，还是竞争心理呢？ 嗯…… [pc.isBimbo|不知道在床上哪个表现更好呢？或者，也许你可以同时拥有他们两个？他们真的适合在一起吗？]|虽然你并不完全明白他为什么如此坚持。不过，如果他真的想要的话，那就随他去吧——你只要退到一边，布林特就会大步走过来，直到几乎贴到铁栅栏上为止。] 布林特深吸一口气，将他那巨大的锤状手按在了加雷特制造的那个薄弱点上。那头弥诺陶洛斯花了一两秒钟的时间来调整自己的状态。他的胸腔里传来低沉的震动声，最终化作一声响亮的喷鼻声，随后你可以看到，在他紧绷的皮肤下，肌肉开始一颤一动，他开始利用加雷特制造的这个弱点，将笼子拆开。 那个笼子根本没有任何反抗的机会。它虽然进行了一些象征性的抗性，但当布林特集中力量拉扯时，这些抗性立刻就被粉碎了——那股力量就像是一块决心进行破坏的巨石，没有任何东西能够阻挡它。随着金属条在剧烈的拉力下最终断裂，空气中回荡着金属扭曲断裂的刺耳声响，一个足以让加雷特钻通过的缝隙终于出现了。任务完成，布林特后退了几步，拍掉手上的铁锈颗粒，然后笨拙地鞠了一个躬。 全部完成了。 加雷特一直都在观察这一切，看到这一幕，他的耳朵立刻竖了起来。爱炫耀的人啊。你确实是个爱炫耀的人，不过还挺在行的。 布林特咧嘴笑了。出来吧，小狗。还有事情要做呢。 哦，是的。毫不迟疑，加雷特爬进了布林特挖好的洞里，然后活动了一下手指关节。还有很多工作要做——首先得处理那个女巫和她的宠物。 说到这个……布林特用拇指朝门口的方向一指。我们有同伴了，朋友们。 |[pc.strengthRange 60|好了，是时候行动了。你深吸一口气，鼓起全部力气，开始用力撬开那些铁栅栏。你的手掌紧紧压在金属上，关节感到剧痛，肩膀也酸得难受，但就在这时，你感觉到那些老旧、锈迹斑斑的铁栅栏终于开始松动了一些。 就是这样。它们被扭曲得越厉害，就越容易进一步弯曲。你的呼吸变得急促，额头上也冒出了汗珠，但你依然没有放松压力——当那些铁条开始发出嘎吱声时，你依然用力将它们分开。终于，你使出全部力气，用力将那块生锈的旧铁拉开，让加雷特得以从缝隙中钻过去。在这一过程中，金属发出了刺耳的摩擦声。 加雷特抬头看着你，他的脸上浮现出一丝类似于微笑的表情。你向后退了几步，踉跄了一下，同时揉着被烧伤的胳膊。而他则爬了起来，从那个洞里钻了出去。他上下打量了你一番，然后出于尊敬，摸了摸自己的额头。 谢谢。 他……他非常受欢迎。 加雷特点了点头，然后活动了一下手指关节。朋友，我们的工作还没完成呢。还有很多事情要做——首先就得处理那个女巫和她的宠物。 好吧好吧。但你能先花点时间喘口气吗？ 我并不是想扫大家的兴，但我们可能没有时间去做那件事。 |再犹豫也没用了——是时候行动了。你花了一点时间让自己平静下来，明确自己的决心，然后全力以赴去拆开加雷特笼子的栅栏。你本来以为这会很困难，但没想到会这么容易。这个尽管你使出了全部力气去攻击加雷特制造的那个弱点，但它却丝毫没有松动。你所能做的，只不过是弄出一个小洞——也许那个洞足够大，让他能够把手臂伸进去，但远远不够让他逃脱这个“监狱”。 比看起来要难吧？加雷特干巴巴地说道。是啊，我应该知道的。 他在这里根本帮不上忙。听着，你先休息一会儿，等会儿再试一次吧—— 突然，加雷特的耳朵向后贴在脑袋上，他的声音中也充满了紧迫感。在你身后！快躲开！]]
rows.raw: " Yeah, you think you'll go for it. While it's true that forcing Garret's prison open is going to be risky, it's less so than trying to steal the key off the druidess. Placing your hands on the rusty iron bars, you test them a few times, feeling to get a good grip that won't chafe your palms. [party.has brint|It's then that you feel a heavy hand on your shoulder, and turn to find Brint standing just behind you, a big smile on his face. "Like I said, [pc.name], please allow me." Seems like he's not going to take no for an answer, [pc.cunningRange 50|and as you step away and he approaches the cage, you think you see something pass between Brint and Garret again. A flash of animosity, of rivalry, perhaps? Hmm... [pc.isBimbo|wonder which one is better in bed? Or maybe you could have them both at the same time? Would they even fit together?]|although you're not exactly sure why he's so insistent. Well, if he wants it, he's more than welcome to have it — you step aside, and Brint lumbers up until he's practically pressed against the bars.] Taking a deep breath, Brint sets his massive hammer-hands on the weak spot Garret's created, the minotaur taking a moment or two to steel himself. A deep rumble starts up in the pits of his chest, culminating in a loud snort, and then you see his muscles ripple and flex beneath his taut hide as he begins pulling the cage apart, exploiting the weakness Garret created. The cage stands absolutely no chance whatsoever. It puts up a bit of token resistance, which rapidly melts away as Brint focuses his strength and pulls, an unstoppable hunk of beef bent on constructive destruction. A scream of twisted metal rings through the air as the tortured bars finally give way, creating an opening large enough for Garret to slip through. Job complete, Brint steps back, dusts flecks of rust off his hands, and gives a small clumsy bow. "All done." Garret's been watching all this time, and his ears perk up at the sight. "Show-off. You're a show-off, but a good one at that." Brint grins. "Come on out, doggy. There's still work to be done." "Oh yes." Without further ado, Garret hoists himself up and through the hole Brint's made, then cracks his knuckles. "There's still a lot of work to be done — starting with that witch and her pet." "Speaking of which." Brint jerks a thumb over his shoulder at the door. "We have company, friends." |[pc.strengthRange 60|Alright, time to do this. You take a deep breath, steel yourself, and start prying the bars apart with every last ounce of strength you can muster. Your palms press heavily against the metal, your joints strain and shoulders burn, but through it all you can feel the old, worn iron give a little. That's it. The more they're twisted out of shape, the easier they'll be to bend further. Your breathing becomes labored and beads of sweat gather on your forehead, yet you don't let up the pressure as the bars begin to groan while you force them apart. Finally, with a concerted burst of strength, you wrench apart the rusted old iron far enough for Garret to slip through, a loud screech of agonized metal accompanying the feat. Garret looks up at you, and something approaching a smile forms on his muzzle. You step back, staggering a bit, and rub your burning arms as he hoists himself up and through the hole. He looks you up and down, then touches his forehead in respect. "Thanks." He's... he's very welcome. Garret nods, and cracks his knuckles. "Our work's still not done yet, friend. There's still plenty to do — starting with that witch and her pet." Fine, fine. But can you have a moment to catch your breath first? "Don't mean to be a killjoy, but we may not have time for that." |No point dithering any further — it's time to get this done. You take a moment to steady yourself, affirm your stance, and put everything you have into prying apart the bars of Garret's cage. You'd expected it to be hard, but not this hard — despite all your strength going into worrying the weak spot Garret's created, it doesn't budge at all. All you manage to create is a small hole, perhaps wide enough for him to stick his arm through, but nowhere near enough for him to escape his prison. "Harder than it looks, huh?" Garret remarks dryly. "Yeah, I should know." He's not helping here. Look, you'll just rest a bit and make another attempt later — Suddenly, Garret's ears pull back against his head, and a sharp edge of urgency enters his voice. "Behind you! Look alive!"]]"

rows.original: You look at the cage again, and reconsider. Maybe it's the amount of noise that you'd make while trying, maybe it's because you don't feel too confident that you'd be able to bend the bars sufficiently for Garret to slip through. He is a big dog, after all. Well. If you're not going to try this, what are you going to do now?
rows.translation: 你再次看着那个笼子，开始重新考虑。也许问题在于你在尝试打开笼子时会产生太多的噪音，又或许是因为你对自己是否有能力将笼子的栅栏弯到足够程度，让加雷特能够从里面钻出来，并没有太大的信心。他是毕竟，它可是一只大狗啊。 那么，如果你不打算尝试这个办法，你现在打算做什么呢？
rows.raw: " You look at the cage again, and reconsider. Maybe it's the amount of noise that you'd make while trying, maybe it's because you don't feel too confident that you'd be able to bend the bars sufficiently for Garret to slip through. He is a big dog, after all. Well. If you're not going to try this, what are you going to do now?"

rows.original: "Leaving again?" Garret mutters. "Take your time, do what you need to do. No one's going anywhere in a hurry, after all." Hey, it's not as if you're abandoning him to become a doggy dildo for all eternity. And even if you were, you're sure Garth will eventually show up to get him. "Thanks. That's really reassuring." It is, isn't it? Garret is silent, but you notice his eyelid twitch ever so slightly. "Just go, okay?"
rows.translation: 又要离开吗？加雷特低声嘟囔着。慢慢来，做你需要做的事情。毕竟，没有人会急着离开的。 嘿，又不是说你抛弃了他之后就要永远变成他的“替代品”了。而且就算你真的这么做了，加斯肯定最终会来把他的东西拿走的。 谢谢，这真的让我感到安心。 是这样吧？ 加雷特没有说话，但你注意到他的眼皮微微颤动了一下。去吧，好吗？
rows.raw: ' "Leaving again?" Garret mutters. "Take your time, do what you need to do. No one's going anywhere in a hurry, after all." Hey, it's not as if you're abandoning him to become a doggy dildo for all eternity. And even if you were, you're sure Garth will eventually show up to get him. "Thanks. That's really reassuring." It is, isn't it? Garret is silent, but you notice his eyelid twitch ever so slightly. "Just go, okay?"'

rows.original: What? Garret points, and your eyes follow his outstretched hand to the entrance doorway; as you turn, a flicker of movement passes by one of the shuttered windows. Rolling his shoulders and loosening up his knotted muscles, Garret hunches down, widening his stance, and goes on the prowl. You get what he's trying to tell you, and take up position on the opposite side of the doorway, [pc.weapon] drawn and at the ready. No sooner have you readied yourself that the door bursts open and in storms the elven druidess, tall, pale and haughty. Sitting astride her warg like a war mount — well, it is one — she scans the room, her longbow at the ready with an arrow nocked between her fingers. Her gaze lingers on the empty cage for a few moments, her eyes narrowing as her attention is fully drawn by the sight and its implications. That's when Garret decides to strike. A blur of white, Garret leaps out of his hiding place in the shadows and catches the druidess' winter warg in a flying tackle, letting out a bestial roar just as the two of them collide in a mess of fur and fury. A loud yelp echoes throughout the hall as the warg rounds on Garret, raking at his shoulder with its foreclaws and drawing blood from deep gashes. Garret doesn't care, and plants his knuckles with deadly force straight into the warg's muzzle. There's a satisfying crack, the warg's head snaps back, and Garret draws his fist back for another blow. Goodness, his fists must be made of steel. Out of the corner of your eye, you spy the druidess — she's scrambling to retrieve her magic bow and right herself, leaving the warg to fend off Garret while she makes to cast a spell. [pc.cl blackmage whitemage|You may know a counterspell or two, but there's a much simpler way to spoil someone's magic|While you may not be schooled in the arcane arts, you know of one tried and true way to spoil any magician's spell]: leaping forward, you bring your [pc.weapon] down on her, forcing her to dart away without finishing the incantation. It's a close blow — your [pc.weapon] comes away with scraps of torn robes clinging to it — and the druidess recognizes as much, her eyes narrowing and lips thin as she makes to do battle. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 什么？ 加雷特指了指方向，你的目光顺着他伸出的手指看向入口处；当你转身时，你看到一道快速移动的身影从其中一扇紧闭的窗户前掠过。加雷特耸了耸肩，放松了一下僵硬的肌肉，然后蹲下身子，调整好姿势，开始四处搜寻。你明白了他的意思，于是站在入口的对面位置等待时机。 [pc.weapon]已经准备就绪，随时可以行动。 你刚准备好，门就猛地被推开了——走进来的是那位高挑、苍白、傲慢的精灵德鲁伊。她像骑战马一样骑着那只狼兽——嗯，那确实就是战兽——环顾着房间，长弓已拉满，箭矢搭在指间。她的目光在那个空荡荡的笼子上停留了片刻，眼睛逐渐眯了起来，因为这一幕及其背后的含义完全吸引了她的注意力。 就在这时，加雷特决定发动攻击。 一道白色的身影闪过，加雷特从阴影中的藏身之处冲了出来，以一记飞扑抓住了那位女德鲁伊的冬季战兽。就在他们两人激烈碰撞、毛发飞溅、怒火中烧的瞬间，加雷特发出了一声野性的咆哮。一声尖锐的惨叫在大厅中回荡——那只魔兽猛地扑向加雷特，用前爪抓他的肩膀，划出了几道深深的伤口，鲜血顿时涌了出来。但加雷特毫不在意，他用力用指关节猛击那只魔兽的嘴部。随着一声清脆的断裂声，那个兽人的头颅猛地向后甩去，加雷特立刻收回拳头，准备再次出击。 天啊，他的拳头简直像钢铁铸成的一样坚硬。你眼角余光瞥见那位女德鲁伊——她正慌忙地去取她的魔法弓，试图站稳身体，而那个兽人则继续与加雷特搏斗，直到她准备好施法为止。 [pc.cl blackmage whitemage|你或许知道一两种反制法术，但其实还有更简单的方法来破坏别人的魔法效果。|虽然你可能没有接受过复杂的魔法训练，但你知道有一种屡试不爽的方法，能够破坏任何魔法师的咒语效果。]你向前一跃，挥下[pc.weapon]攻向她，迫使她在咒语完成前匆忙闪开。这一击真是太接近目标了——你真是运气好。 [pc.weapon]它身上沾满了撕碎的长袍碎片——女德鲁伊也注意到了这一点，她的眼睛眯了起来，嘴唇紧抿，准备迎战。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

It's a close blow — your [pc.weapon] comes away with scraps of torn robes clinging to it — and the druidess recognizes as much, her eyes narrowing and lips thin as she makes to do battle. It's a fight!"

rows.original: You spin around just in time to see the door burst open, almost torn off its hinges by the force of the druidess' entrance. She's sitting astride her warg on a thick leather saddle, bow in one hand with an arrow nocked in the other and ready to loose. Her gaze quickly alights on you, and her face grows grim. "Another do-gooder, is it? Trying to break him out of his cage?" [pc.isChamp|So what if you are? You're here to bring everyone home.|You don't know about do-gooding, but you're getting all these people home like you were asked to.] Why, does she intend to stop you? "I don't know who you are, but by all means take those annoying loggers off my hands, if you can get them through the forest. I'll even thank you for it — then I'll be able to leave. This doggy in the cage, though..." She seems to make a chewing motion. "I think I'd like to keep him for a little while longer. He's got a nice big bone that I'd like to play with still — elf men are so pitiful in that regard. It's only fair recompense for what you lot have put me through — I'll release him back into the wild when I get tired of him, don't you worry." No way. You're taking Garret, too, and by force, if need be. "I'd rather hoped it wouldn't come to this. But if you're insistent on being a pet right alongside him, who am I to say no?" The warg growls in agreement, and bounds towards you. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 你刚转过身，就看到门被猛地推开了——那股力量几乎把门从门框上扯下来。那位女德鲁伊骑在她的战兽背上，坐在厚厚的皮鞍上，一手握着弓，另一手搭着已上弦的箭，随时准备射出。她的目光迅速落在了你身上，脸色顿时变得阴沉起来。 又是一个好心人吧？想把他从笼子里救出来？ [pc.isChamp|那又怎样？你在这里的目的就是让所有人都能回家。|你可能并不懂什么“做好事”的概念，但你却把所有这些人安全地带回了家，仿佛这是别人委托你去做的事情一样。]她为什么要阻止你呢？ 我不知道你是谁，但如果你能把这些讨厌的伐木工从我身边弄走的话，那就太好了。我还会感谢你的——这样我就能离开了。不过，这个被关在笼子里的狗……她似乎在做出咀嚼的动作。我想我还会再留他一段时间。他有一根很好用的骨头，我还想继续玩弄它呢——在这方面，精灵们实在太可怜了。作为对你们让我遭受的一切的补偿，这应该算是公平的吧？等我玩腻了他，自然会把他放回野外，你们放心吧。 不可能。你甚至会强行带走加雷特，如果有必要的话。 我其实更希望事情不会发展到这一步。但如果你坚持要和他一起成为宠物，我又有什么资格拒绝你呢？ 那些战争机器发出低吼，纷纷表示同意，然后朝你的方向冲了过来。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

She's sitting astride her warg on a thick leather saddle, bow in one hand with an arrow nocked in the other and ready to loose. Her gaze quickly alights on you, and her face grows grim. "Another do-gooder, is it? Trying to break him out of his cage?" [pc.isChamp|So what if you are? You're here to bring everyone home.|You don't know about do-gooding, but you're getting all these people home like you were asked to.] Why, does she intend to stop you? "I don't know who you are, but by all means take those annoying loggers off my hands, if you can get them through the forest. I'll even thank you for it — then I'll be able to leave. This doggy in the cage, though..." She seems to make a chewing motion. "I think I'd like to keep him for a little while longer. He's got a nice big bone that I'd like to play with still — elf men are so pitiful in that regard. It's only fair recompense for what you lot have put me through — I'll release him back into the wild when I get tired of him, don't you worry." No way. You're taking Garret, too, and by force, if need be. "I'd rather hoped it wouldn't come to this. But if you're insistent on being a pet right alongside him, who am I to say no?" The warg growls in agreement, and bounds towards you. It's a fight!"

rows.original: "I'll see you at the gates in a few. Come on now, there's no time to waste. I don't want to spend one more night in this place." Right, right. Garret moves off at a brisk pace, making for the work yard; you take a turn towards the longhouses and step up to them. The loggers visibly cheer up when you tell them they're free to go, but aren't too enthused about moving through the Old Forest while it's dark. Still, they agree to follow your lead, so long as you and Garret stick close to them on the forest trails. Filing out of the longhouse and numbering ten in total, the loggers look decidedly ragged, ruffled and in need of a good wash; all the more reason for you to get them home posthaste. You tell them to collect their belongings, as Westbank is condemned for the foreseeable future. They hear you out, nod, then quickly set to work. So it comes to pass that you end up with a motley crew of lupines assembled at the gates — Garret meets you as promised, having managed to find his clothes but not much else. The loggers have armed themselves with axes and machetes, although they look decidedly unnerved; no doubt they've heard things about what's been going on in the forest since the night of the blizzard. Garret does his best to rally the rabble to some semblance of courage with uncertain success, and you set off before it gets too dark. Surprisingly, the trip back is peaceful. Once or twice, you hear rustling in the bushes and branches as you traverse the thin forest trail, but with you leading the front and Garret taking the rear, nothing seems intent on worrying a group of this size. Sometime about just after midnight, the lot of you end up out of the forest and by Hawkethorne's gates — the guards are surprised to see such a large group show up out of the darkness, but quickly stand down and let you in once they realize who it is. "That seems to be about it," Garret mutters as the rest of the loggers passes through the gates. "Bah." What's he going to do now? "I guess I'll have to head home. Eventually." Eventually? "I'd rather not face my old man as I am right now." He has to sometime, though. It's not something which can be avoided. Unless he intends to turn around right now and live a life as a wandering swordsman, fighting injustice wherever he finds it — and let's face it, that's just stupid. Garret takes a deep breath and rubs his face. "Yeah, I know, I know. Still, that doesn't mean I have to deal with it immediately. I just need a couple hours to compose myself. That, and make sure Gwyn's in earshot before talking to him." Good luck, then. "I'll need it." With that, Garret smooths out his fur, then turns and tromps off into town. Well, that seems to be that. There's probably a little more aftermath to be dealt with, but for now, maybe you should just head in and get a good night's sleep...
rows.translation: 过一会儿我们在大门那里见吧。快走吧，没有时间可以浪费了。我可不想再在这个地方多待一个晚上。 好的，好的。加雷特快步朝工作区走去，而你则转向那些长屋，走了过去。当你告诉那些伐木工人他们可以离开了时，他们明显显得很高兴，但想到要在天黑的时候穿过古林，他们还是有些犹豫。不过，只要你和加雷特在森林小路上紧跟着他们，他们还是同意跟随着你的引导。 这些伐木工总共十个人，从长屋里走出来时，看上去确实衣衫褴褛、蓬头垢面，急需洗个澡；因此，你更有理由尽快把他们送回家。你让他们收拾好自己的东西，因为从目前的情况来看，西岸这个地方已经无法继续使用了。他们听完你的话，点了点头，然后迅速开始行动起来。 结果，一群形形色色的人聚集在了大门前——加雷特如约与你会面，他虽然找到了自己的衣服，但其他东西几乎一无所有。那些伐木工们都拿着斧头和砍刀，不过他们看起来显然非常紧张；毫无疑问，他们一定听说了自暴风雪那个夜晚以来森林里发生的一切。加雷特竭力鼓动这群人，让他们重新鼓起勇气，不过效果并不明显。在天色完全变暗之前，你们便出发了。 令人惊讶的是，回程的过程十分平静。在穿过那条狭窄的森林小径时，有一两次你会听到灌木丛和树枝间传来的沙沙声，但既然你走在前面，而加雷特则跟在后面，似乎没有什么生物会敢来打扰这么一大群人。 午夜刚过不久，你们所有人终于走出了森林，来到了鹰棘镇的大门前。守卫们看到这么一大群人从暗影中出现，都感到十分惊讶，但当他们认出来人是谁之后，很快就放你们进去了。 看起来就是这样的情况了。当其他伐木工人们都通过大门时，加雷特低声嘟囔着什么。呸。 他现在打算做什么呢？ 我想我最终还是得回家吧。 最终吗？ 我目前这种状态，实在不想面对我的父亲。 不过，他总得在某个时候去做这件事。这是无法避免的。除非他现在就决定改过自新，过上漂泊剑客的生活，无论在哪里遇到不公都挺身而出为之抗争——但说实话，那样做简直太愚蠢了。 加勒深吸一口气，然后揉了揉脸。是啊，我知道，我知道。不过，这并不意味着我必须立刻处理这件事。我只需要几个小时来冷静一下。另外，在和他谈话之前，我得确保格温在附近，这样他才能听到我们的谈话。 祝你好运。 我需要它。说完，加雷特整理了一下自己的毛发，然后转身大步走向了城镇。 好吧，事情似乎就这样结束了。可能还有一些后续的事情需要处理，但眼下，你或许应该去休息一下，好好睡一觉……

rows.original: As Garret disappears under the town gates, there's a rustle from a bush off to the side of the forest path, one loud enough to clearly be unnatural and designed to catch your attention. You tense, [pc.weapon] at the ready, but leaves fall off the branch as Hethia emerges from hiding. Her companion warg pads along silently at her side, and she's got a hand out in what might be construed as a gesture of peaceful intent. Might be. "No need to be so tense, [pc.ra elf |wyld kin |[pc.race] ]," she says. "You lot were making so much noise along the forest paths that if I'd any ill-intent towards any of you I'd have seized the opportunity long before you reached the edge of the wyld's domain." [pc.isDK |Call you distrustful, but after just having humiliated her back at the logging camp, you're perfectly within your rights to be cautious. Not everyone's rational when angered and spiteful, so you'll be taking a rain check on just about everything pertaining to her, if she doesn't mind. Hethia clicks her tongue. "So distrustful." In general? Maybe, maybe not. Of her? Oh, certainly. |She does have a point... when it comes to Garret and the loggers. Maybe she was just waiting for you to be all alone before making her move. "Possibly. But I wouldn't have known that you'd be standing out here all alone instead of heading into your little village with the rest of them." She'll excuse you if you're still a little tense over your stand-off. What's she trying to do here anyway? Is she still trying to convince herself that she really wasn't the one in the wrong here? ] The druidess waves off your words. "Think whatever you want, then. I'm not here to — well, I suppose I am, but not in the way you imagine." Well, what does she suppose she's here to do, then?[silly | Stall you with all this talking while her pet gets up to no good? You've got your eye on that warg, that's for sure. ] "Make it up to you in some small measure." You raise an eyebrow at that. Come again? Hethia thins her lips and turns her glance from you, down to her warg snuffling about at her side. "I'll be blunt about it, then. Want to have sex?" Hmph. When she puts it that way... why should you? And more importantly, why should she? "I'll continue being blunt, then. You showed me more courtesy than I expected. Anyone coming to the logging camp with the intent of looking for those people would have resorted to simple violence if he or she had been convinced that I was a miserable hostage-taker. The latter was true of you, but not the former; you went to great lengths to at least try and work things out peacefully with me and I have to give you credit for that. Even if I don't wholly agree with the whys and wherefores, the extra effort you went to is appreciated." All right, if that's how she perceives it — anything that leaves her less inclined to feel bitter about how this all ended. But why sex, though? Hethia spreads her empty palms. "Do I look like I have anything else to give you, [pc.ra elf |wyld kin |[pc.race] ]?" [pc.isDK |Well, there is that bow she has... but fine. You get where she's coming from. |She does have a point there. ] "Take it or leave it. It's certainly no skin off my nose if you don't want what I'm offering." She sighs. "I'd have thought that a willingness to get naked and put myself into a vulnerable position with you would've proven my intentions well enough, but apparently I made another error in assuming the way you people think." Of course, if you do agree to have sex with Hethia, you'd be exposing your proverbial soft underbelly to her just as much, too, but it's all pointless quibble at this juncture. The only real question remains is: do you want to take her up on her offer, or not? [party.som | |[comp1.name] has gone on ahead with the loggers back to the Frost Hound, so you're all alone here and won't be missed if you linger for a bit. There's always time to have a bit of fun, isn't there? |[comp1.name] and [comp2.name] have gone on ahead with Garret and the loggers back to the Frost Hound, so you won't be missed if you linger with the druidess for a bit. ]
rows.translation: 当加雷特消失在城镇的城门下时，森林小路旁的一丛灌木丛中突然传来一阵沙沙声，那声音大得明显不像是自然发出的，显然是有人故意制造出来以吸引你的注意。你立刻紧张了起来。 [pc.weapon]一切准备就绪，然而当赫希娅从藏身之处现身时，树枝上的树叶纷纷掉落。她的同伴安静地跟在她身边，而她伸出手，这个动作或许可以被理解为一种表示和平意图的举动。或许没必要这么紧张， [pc.ra elf |野性族群 |[pc.race] ]就是这么回事，”她说，“你们在森林小路上吵闹得那么厉害，要是我真对你们中的任何一个怀有恶意，早就趁你们还没到达这片森林边缘的时候采取行动了。 [pc.isDK |说你多疑有点过分，但既然你在伐木营地狠狠地羞辱了她一次，你保持警惕也是完全合理的。人在愤怒和怨恨的时候，并不总是会理智行事，所以如果她不介意的话，你对她提出的几乎所有事情都会采取谨慎的态度。 赫希娅啧了啧舌头：“真是个多疑的人啊。” 总体来说？也许吧，也许也不一定。但说到她本人？哦，那绝对是多疑的。 |她的话确实有道理……尤其是在谈到加雷特和那些伐木工人的时候。也许她只是在等待你独自一人的时候再采取行动。 “有可能。但我没想到你会独自站在这里，而不是和其他人一起回到你的小村庄里。” 如果你因为那次对峙而仍然感到有些紧张，她应该会理解你的。她到底想在这里做什么呢？她是不是还在试图说服自己真的在这里，错的不应该是他吧？ ] 那位女德鲁伊对你的话置之不理，说道：“你想怎么想都行吧。我来这里并不是为了……嗯，我想我并不是为了这个目的而来的。是但并不是以你想象中的那种方式。” 那么，她究竟认为自己来这里是为了做什么呢？[silly | 你一直在说这些废话，耽误时间，而她的宠物却在干些不好的事情……你肯定在注意着那只战斗犬吧？ ] 我会以某种方式补偿你。” 你闻言挑了挑眉毛。什么？ 赫希娅抿了抿嘴唇，将目光从你身上移开，看向她身边正在嗅来嗅去的战犬。“那我就直说了吧。想做爱吗？” 哼，她这么一说……为什么不想呢？更重要的是，为什么不应该呢？她那我就直说了吧。你给我的尊重超出了我的预期。任何来到这个伐木营地、意图寻找那些人的人，如果认为我是一个可恶的劫持者，都会选择使用暴力手段的。对于你来说，后者确实成立，但前者并非如此；你确实付出了很多努力，至少试图与我和平地解决问题，这一点我必须予以认可。即使我并不完全认同你这样做的原因和方式，但我还是很感激你所付出的这些额外努力。好吧，如果她确实是这么看待这件事的，那么任何能够让她不对这件事的结局感到愤懑的事情都值得尝试。但为什么呢？性别不过呢？ 赫希娅摊开了空荡荡的双手：“我看起来像是有别的东西可以给你吗？ [pc.ra elf |野性族群 |[pc.race] ]？" [pc.isDK |嗯，她倒是还有那把弓……不过没关系，你应该能理解她的用意。 |她的说法确实有一定道理。 ] 要么接受，要么拒绝。如果你不想要我提供的东西，那对我来说确实没有任何损失。”她叹了口气，“我本以为，愿意脱掉衣服、让自己处于一种脆弱的位置，这样就能充分证明我的诚意了，但显然，我又一次错误地揣测了你们的思维方式。当然，如果你真的同意与赫希娅发生性关系，那么你同样也会将自己的“软肋”暴露在她面前，但在这个节骨眼上，这些争论都已经毫无意义了。唯一真正需要考虑的问题是：你是否愿意接受她的提议？ [party.som | |[comp1.name]那些伐木工已经先行返回了寒霜猎犬号，所以你现在一个人在这里，就算多待一会儿也不会有人注意到。反正总有时间可以享受一下乐趣的，对吧？ |[comp1.name]以及[comp2.name]加雷特和那些伐木工已经先回去了，他们乘坐的是“霜犬酒馆”号，所以如果你想和那位德鲁伊多待一会儿，也不会有人注意到你的。 ]

rows.original: Sure, why not. You'll get to pick exactly what you want to do with the druidess after you've agreed.
rows.translation: 当然，为什么不呢。等你们达成协议后，你可以完全自由地决定如何使用这位女德鲁伊。
rows.raw: "Sure, why not. You'll get to pick exactly what you want to do with the druidess after you've agreed."

rows.original: "Suit yourself," Hethia replies with a derisive sniff. "You don't know what you're missing out on." She looks aggrieved, doesn't she? Well, it's not that you don't trust her, or that there's any lingering resentment; but this day has been quite exhausting and you're in no mood to get up to any funny business. The sex would be outright dry and bland, and wouldn't do her justice in the least. The druidess snorts at your words — goes to show how little this whole incident's moved her at heart, even when she's trying to be nice. [pc.isDK |What was the saying again? As a dog to his vomit and a fool's finger to the fire? Something about leothrans and their spots? Well, you know what you mean anyway. Seeing her like this, it's a good thing that you turned her down. |Sure, you may have moved her with your approach to this whole stand-off, but it looks like you've got a long way to go before penetrating her icy exterior. Baby steps, as they are, baby steps. She's willing to listen to reason and be convinced, and that's the important thing. ] Whirling around, Hethia steps lightly, her warg at her heels — she's disappeared into the trees in the blink of an eye. Wait. Come to think of it, you should've asked how she plans to return to the deeper parts of the forest given the barrier that's been set up ahead of the bridge... presumably she's a druid and could do something about it, but... [party.hasCompanions |"Nice character, that," [companion1.name] says, eyeing the darkness where Hethia was a moment ago. "You were far more patient with someone as stuck-up as that than I would've been." [pc.isDK |She wasn't worth the trouble that dealing with her properly would've been, however satisfying it might be to [pc.hasCock |split her on your shaft |grind and finger the chilly bitch into submission ] |Facing down hostility with hostility is sometimes necessary, but when you reach for it as the go-to solution the situation's never going to get better ]. ]Well, she's gone now, and with it the opportunity to ask further questions. Now it's really time to head back to town and maybe get a good night's rest...
rows.translation: 随你便吧，”赫希娅带着一丝讥讽的语气回答道，“你根本不知道自己错过了什么。” 她看起来很恼火，对吧？其实并不是因为你不信任她，也不是因为还有什么怨恨未了；只是今天实在太累了，你实在没有心情再去应付那些烦人的事情了。这样的性爱体验只会显得枯燥无味，根本无法体现她的魅力。 那位女德鲁伊听了你的话后嗤之以鼻——这恰恰说明，即使她试图表现得友善，这件事也丝毫没有触动她的内心。 [pc.isDK |那句话是怎么说的来着？“狗回到自己吐出来的东西身边，傻瓜则把手指伸向火源”？应该是关于豹纹皮和它们身上的斑点之类的吧？总之，你大概明白我的意思。看到她现在的样子，你当初拒绝她真是做对了。 |当然，你采取的这种方式或许已经让她有所松动，但看起来要突破她那冰冷的外表，你还有很长的路要走。得一步一步来，慢慢来。重要的是，她还是愿意听取道理并被说服的。 ] 赫希娅旋转着轻盈地迈步，她的战犬紧随其后——转眼间，她就消失在了树林之中。等等，仔细想想，既然桥前设置了障碍，你本应该问问她究竟该如何回到森林的深处去……大概她是个德鲁伊，应该能想出办法来吧，不过…… [party.hasCompanions |这个角色设计得真不错。 [companion1.name]说着，目光投向刚才赫希娅还在的那个黑暗角落，“对于那种傲慢自大的人，你展现出的耐心远超过我所能做到的。 [pc.isDK |然而，处理她所带来的麻烦根本不值得，即便这样做能带来多大的满足感也好。 [pc.hasCock |和她发生关系 |不懈努力，最终让那个冷酷无情的人屈服。 ] |有时候，以敌对的态度回应敌对的行为确实是必要的，但如果你总是将其作为首选解决方案，那么情况永远不会有所改善 ]。 ]嗯，她现在已经走了，也因此失去了进一步提问的机会。现在只能真的是时候回城里去了，或许可以好好睡一觉……
rows.raw: " "Suit yourself," Hethia replies with a derisive sniff. "You don't know what you're missing out on." She looks aggrieved, doesn't she? Well, it's not that you don't trust her, or that there's any lingering resentment; but this day has been quite exhausting and you're in no mood to get up to any funny business. The sex would be outright dry and bland, and wouldn't do her justice in the least. The druidess snorts at your words — goes to show how little this whole incident's moved her at heart, even when she's trying to be nice. [pc.isDK |What was the saying again? As a dog to his vomit and a fool's finger to the fire? Something about leothrans and their spots? Well, you know what you mean anyway. Seeing her like this, it's a good thing that you turned her down. |Sure, you may have moved her with your approach to this whole stand-off, but it looks like you've got a long way to go before penetrating her icy exterior. Baby steps, as they are, baby steps. She's willing to listen to reason and be convinced, and that's the important thing. ] Whirling around, Hethia steps lightly, her warg at her heels — she's disappeared into the trees in the blink of an eye. Wait. Come to think of it, you should've asked how she plans to return to the deeper parts of the forest given the barrier that's been set up ahead of the bridge... presumably she's a druid and could do something about it, but... [party.hasCompanions |"Nice character, that," [companion1.name] says, eyeing the darkness where Hethia was a moment ago. "You were far more patient with someone as stuck-up as that than I would've been." [pc.isDK |She wasn't worth the trouble that dealing with her properly would've been, however satisfying it might be to [pc.hasCock |split her on your shaft |grind and finger the chilly bitch into submission ] |Facing down hostility with hostility is sometimes necessary, but when you reach for it as the go-to solution the situation's never going to get better ]. ]Well, she's gone now, and with it the opportunity to ask further questions. Now it's really time to head back to town and maybe get a good night's rest..."

rows.original: You don't have the time or inclination for this right now.
rows.translation: 你现在没有时间也没有兴趣去做这件事。
rows.raw: "You don't have the time or inclination for this right now."

rows.original: Watch the druidess for a moment and assess the situation.
rows.translation: 观察一下那位女德鲁伊，然后评估一下当前的情况。
rows.raw: "Watch the druidess for a moment and assess the situation."

rows.original: Go in and put an end to this!
rows.translation: 进去把这件事解决掉吧！
rows.raw: "Go in and put an end to this!"

rows.original: This doesn't have to get violent. Try and talk her down.
rows.translation: 没必要动粗的。试着跟她好好谈谈吧。
rows.raw: "This doesn't have to get violent. Try and talk her down."

rows.original: See whether you can slip past the warg and get the key to Garret's cage.
rows.translation: 看看你能否绕过那些战士，拿到加雷特笼子的钥匙。
rows.raw: "See whether you can slip past the warg and get the key to Garret's cage."

rows.original: You're not ready to face this obstacle yet. Retreat and reconsider your options.
rows.translation: 你目前还没有准备好面对这个障碍。先退一步，重新考虑一下你的选择吧。
rows.raw: "You're not ready to face this obstacle yet. Retreat and reconsider your options."

rows.original:
Slowly, cautiously, you use the undergrowth to sneak up upon the water's edge, keeping a healthy distance between you and any blind spots where someone or something might surprise you. Thankfully, the riverbank is open enough that you can see most of it from where you're crouched — two silhouettes make themselves known to you, one humanoid halfway out into the river, and a quadruped one by the rocky shore.

        This, you surmise, must be the druidess and her pet warg.
        
        What do you do now?
rows.translation:
你缓慢而谨慎地借着灌木丛摸到水边，与任何可能有人或什么东西突然冒出来的死角保持着安全的距离。所幸河岸足够开阔，你蹲伏的位置就能看清大部分区域——两个身影映入你的眼帘：一个类人型的身影半身探在河里，另一个四足的身影待在多石的岸边。

        你推测，这一定就是那位女德鲁伊和她的宠物座狼。
        
        现在你该怎么做？
rows.raw:
"
        Slowly, cautiously, you use the undergrowth to sneak up upon the water's edge, keeping a healthy distance between you and any blind spots where someone or something might surprise you. Thankfully, the riverbank is open enough that you can see most of it from where you're crouched — two silhouettes make themselves known to you, one humanoid halfway out into the river, and a quadruped one by the rocky shore.

        This, you surmise, must be the druidess and her pet warg.
        
        What do you do now?"

rows.original:
Hiding your approach by using the nearby undergrowth for cover, you scan the riverbank for any sign of movement. There doesn't seem to be anyone there at the moment, though — save for the gushing of the ice-cold water, the riverbank is perfectly calm and still.

        Garret said that the druidess usually comes in the evenings to commune — you should return then.
rows.translation:
你利用附近的灌木丛作为掩护，隐藏自己的行踪，同时仔细观察河岸上是否有任何动静。不过目前看来，那里似乎没有人——除了冰凉的水流声外，河岸一片寂静，毫无波澜。

        加雷特说过，那位女德鲁伊通常会在晚上前来进行仪式交流——你应该在那个时候回去。
rows.raw:
"
        Hiding your approach by using the nearby undergrowth for cover, you scan the riverbank for any sign of movement. There doesn't seem to be anyone there at the moment, though — save for the gushing of the ice-cold water, the riverbank is perfectly calm and still.

        Garret said that the druidess usually comes in the evenings to commune — you should return then."

rows.original: Remaining in the cover of the undergrowth, you creep a little closer to the water's edge to assess the situation. Neither druidess nor beast appear to have noticed you, and emboldened, you get close enough such that you can make out most of the details. Apparently this %"communing" thing is taking up much of her focus... Speaking with Garret has given you an idea of what to expect, but hearing about someone and seeing her in the flesh are two different things. The druidess is submerged up to just above the waist in the icy river, but if your sense of proportion isn't off, then you'd guess her to be about six feet in height, just a bit under Garret's measure when he's standing. Frost-silver hair clings to bluish-white skin, pouring down her shoulders and back in a glimmering waterfall before it passes the small of her back and dips into the water. Her breasts are small, her figure lithe and finely cut; not an excess of power like Garth, Gwyn or Garret, but what strength is present is poised to be used to maximum effect. Long, elfin ears just out from her hair, a little more exaggerated than that of a wyld elf, and as you watch, she brings her cupped hands up from the river's surface, anointing herself with fresh, freezing snowmelt. She's not beautiful — one would imagine living as a wildling puts a crimp in any attempts to pretty oneself up — but there is a raw, primal grace to the druidess. You instinctively get the feeling that she's definitely not to be trifled with, that's for sure. [party.has etheryn|A faint whimper at your side draws your attention, and you half-turn to find Etheryn cringing behind an old, moldy tree stump. Shuffling over to the elf, you give her a reassuring pat on the shoulder, and she calms down a little. "Sorry. I don't know what came over me. Or I do, but..." So long as she doesn't give the lot of you away... "I-I just..." Etheryn takes a deep breath, and clenches her fists so hard her knuckles whiten. "Right. She reminded me of Alissa. Not that much, but enough to trigger old... um, reflexes." You understand. It may be that you'll have to face the druidess in combat — if it does come to that, will she be able to rally herself? "Do I have a choice?" No. "Then I must." Etheryn doesn't sound too convinced of her own words, but it's probably counterproductive to bruise her ego right now. ] Your inspection of the druidess over, you turn your attention to the lakeshore. There, you spot the warg that Garret mentioned — a misshapen mound of muscle, maw and matted fur. Clearly the druidess picked the strongest, most beastly animal she could find in order to complement her — snaggletoothed and with a most vicious visage, the warg lounges by the riverside on its belly. The beast is clearly restless and twitchy as it watches its mistress bathe — ah, commune — in the river, but whatever otherworldly loyalty she commands from it keeps the animal from bolting off. Instead, it contents itself with endlessly grooming its dirty white fur, staving off boredom as best as it can. One wonders how she manages to feed it adequately... unless it's eating the camp's rations, it has to leave to hunt for itself, and that might create an opening... Hm. Such a large beast would need quite a lot of food, wouldn't it? Laid out on a large rock a little distance away from the warg are what you suppose are the druidess' possessions: an intricately carved bow of the sort you've never seen before, flowing armored robes of silver and green, a leather saddle big enough to fit on the warg's back, and tossed carelessly to one side, a large metal keyring on which a single key rests. She must be quite comfortable in the loggers' fear of her or her warg's ability to protect her possessions while she can't watch them. [party.has etheryn|"That's a whitewood bow," Etheryn notes. "Impressive." You can tell the quality of its make, you suppose, but is there anything special about it? It's rare, you take it? "The only other one I've seen belonged to my mother. It was a gift from the druids of the Old Wyld to my great-grandmother, back before the Godswar. Most others have been lost or otherwise gone missing..." Not a big surprise that a druidess would have it, then. Where are the bowstring and arrows? "It produces them on its own. You'll see if it ever gets turned on us." She doesn't relish the prospect, does she? "No." You give Etheryn another pat on the shoulder, but she doesn't look very reassured.] Back to the point, though. The key... while it's supposedly being watched over by the warg, it's a little distance away and the hulking beast isn't the most attentive of animals. Peace and overconfidence lull one into complacency, one supposes. It might be possible for one to sneak across and try to filch it, but there's little doubt that things won't go well for you if you fail and are spotted. That seems to wrap things up. Would you like to linger around and watch the priestess some more, or do something else?
rows.translation: 你依然隐藏在灌木丛中，慢慢靠近水边以观察情况。看起来无论是那位女德鲁伊还是那只野兽都没有注意到你，于是你鼓起勇气，进一步靠近，终于能够看清大部分细节了。显然，这种“与神灵交流”的行为占据了她大部分的注意力…… 与加勒特的交谈已经让你对会遇到什么有所了解，但仅仅听别人描述与亲眼见到其实是两回事。那位德鲁伊女祭司站在冰冷的河水中，水只没到她的腰部以上，但如果你的视觉判断没有问题的话，你会觉得她的身高大概有六英尺左右，这稍微低于加勒特站立时的身高。银霜般的头发紧贴着蓝白色的肌肤，从她的肩头垂落下来，宛如一道闪烁的瀑布，一直延伸到后腰，然后没入水中。 她的胸部小巧，身形柔美而曲线优美；她并没有像加斯、格温或加雷特那样拥有过强的力量，但所拥有的那点力量，已经被她运用得恰到好处。她的长发中露出一对精灵般的耳朵，这种耳朵的形状比荒野精灵的还要夸张一些。当你注视着她时，你会看到她将双手拢成杯状，从河面上取来新鲜的融雪，用来涂抹自己的身体。 她不是。美丽 — 人们可能会认为，过著野人的生活，肯定会让任何人想要打扮得漂漂亮亮的想法都化为泡影 — 但事实并非如此。是这位女德鲁伊身上散发着一种原始而纯粹的魅力。你本能地感觉到，她绝对不是个可以轻易招惹的人。这一点毫无疑问。 [party.has etheryn|你耳边传来一阵微弱的呜咽声，于是你转过头去，发现伊瑟琳正躲在一棵发霉的旧树桩后面瑟瑟发抖。你走到她身边，轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀，让她稍微平静了一些。 对不起，我不知道自己当时是怎么了。或者说，我其实知道……但是…… 只要她不把你们这些人暴露出来…… 我、我只是……伊瑟琳深吸一口气，然后将拳头握得如此紧，以至于指关节都变成了白色。没错。她让我想起了艾莉莎。虽然不是非常相似，但足以唤起一些……嗯，旧日的回忆。 你明白的。也许你将不得不与那位女德鲁伊进行战斗——如果真的到了那一步，她能够振作起来吗？ 我还有别的选择吗？ 不。 那我就必须这么做。伊瑟琳对自己所说的话似乎并不是很确信，但现在伤害她的自尊心反而可能适得其反。 ] 检查完那位女德鲁伊之后，你将注意力转向湖岸。在那里，你看到了加勒特提到的那头魔兽——一个由肌肉、血盆大口和杂乱毛发构成的畸形怪物。显然，这位女德鲁伊挑选了当时能找到的最强壮、最凶猛的野兽来辅助自己。这只长着参差不齐的牙齿、面容凶残的魔兽正趴在河岸边休息。它显得十分焦躁不安，不停地抽动着身体，同时注视着自己的女主人正在沐浴……啊，社区 ——它在河里生活，但那种超自然的忠诚让它始终不会逃跑。相反，它只是不停地舔洗自己那脏白的毛皮，尽力打发无聊的时间。人们不禁会想，她究竟是怎么让它得到足够的食物来维持生存的。……除非它正在吃掉营地的口粮，否则它就必须出去自己觅食，而这个时候就可能会出现机会…… 嗯，这么大的野兽肯定需要大量的食物，对吧？ 在距离那些魔兽不远的一块大石头上，放着那些你认为应该是女德鲁伊的物品：一把你从未见过的、雕刻精美的弓；银色和绿色的流苏铠甲；一个大得足以放在那些魔兽背上的皮制马鞍；还有被随意扔在一边的一個大金属钥匙扣，上面只插着一把钥匙。当她无法照看自己的财物时，那些伐木工人对她的恐惧，以及她的战兽保护这些财物的能力，肯定让她感到非常安心。 [party.has etheryn|那是一把白木弓。伊瑟琳笔记。真是令人印象深刻。 你可以从它的制作质量上看出它的品质，但它究竟有什么特别之处吗？它确实很稀有，你不觉得吗？ 我见过的另一件这样的物品属于我的母亲。那是远古森林中的德鲁伊们送给我的曾祖母的礼物，那还是在神战之前的事。其他的那些物品，大多都已经丢失或者不知去向了…… 那么，一位女德鲁伊拥有这样的东西也就不足为奇了。那么，弓弦和箭呢？它们在哪里？ 它是自行生成这些内容的。看看它什么时候会反过来对付我们吧。 她并不喜欢这个想法，对吧？ 不。 你又轻轻拍了拍伊瑟琳的肩膀，但她看起来仍然没有感到安心。] 不过，还是回到正题上来。关键在于……虽然据说有那头战争巨兽在看守着，但它其实距离这里还有一段距离，而那种庞大的野兽也并不是最善于保持警觉的动物。想必，和平与过度自信会让人产生麻痹大意的想法吧。或许有人能够偷偷溜过去试图偷走它，但如果你失败了并被发现，那么后果肯定不会好受。 看来事情已经说清楚了。你是想再留下来看看那位女祭司，还是想做点别的事情呢？

rows.original: Well, what could it hurt? Things have been so tense up to now; you certainly deserve a little time for yourself. [party.hasCompanions|Lowering your voice to a whisper, you tell [party.compNames] to head back into the thicker undergrowth and scout around for a bit while you continue monitoring the druidess. Once you're certain that you're alone, you settle in, find a reasonably comfortable spot with a clear, unobstructed view, then proceed to enjoy the show.|Since you're all alone, who's going to be the wiser, anyway? You're at a safe enough distance that neither the druidess nor her pet can spot you, so there's probably not going to be any danger in taking a little breather. rows.original:
You cast another glance at the druidess in the river. With her away from her equipment and off-guard, now would be the perfect time to strike if you wished to do so. If you got as close as possible before pressing the attack, you might be able to get in the first strike before she has time to react.

    Still, are you sure you're prepared to do this? Once you commit yourself to doing battle, there'll be no turning back.
rows.translation:
你再次瞥了一眼河中的那位女德鲁伊。她此刻远离自己的装备，又毫无防备，如果你想动手，现在正是最佳时机。如果你能在发起攻击之前尽可能地靠近她，或许就能在她来得及反应之前抢先出手。

    Still, are you sure you're prepared to do this? Once you commit yourself to doing battle, there'll be no turning back."

rows.original: Your mind is made up. Whether she intended to harm anyone or not, the druidess definitely did foul everything up by her decision to teach the loggers a lesson. Well, time to show her how it's like when the shoe's on the other foot — perhaps she's the one who needs to be taught a lesson. Creeping as close as you can to the riverbank, you stop just shy of where the undergrowth peters out and break out into view with your [pc.weapon] drawn and at the ready. The warg is instantly up and on its feet, growling and snapping in a frenzy of fury as it lunges straight for you; the druidess is already halfway out of the river and to her things. You backhand the warg, the satisfying feel of your [pc.weapon] connecting with the mountain of muscle and sinew, and manage to reach the druidess just as she slips on the armored robes and dances off to the side. It's not much of an advantage, but it's more than what you'd have had if you hadn't caught her off guard. To battle!

rows.original: If a peaceful solution to this is possible, there's no reason why you shouldn't give it a try. Swallowing hard, you step out of the undergrowth and walk towards the riverbank, holding out your empty hands and careful to make no sudden moves. The warg notices you almost instantly and starts bounding towards you, but a sharp whistle from the druidess stops it dead in its tracks and it slinks back to her side, its bloodlust evaporating into nothingness. As you watch, the elf emerges from the river, icy water cascading off her alabaster skin, then steps over to her belongings and picks out a small towel to dry herself off with. "Another one?" Her voice is of the sort that'd be perfectly suited to a haughty noblewoman's laugh. Another one? Oh, she means Garret, right? No, you're not here to take names and kick ass, you're here to talk. Maybe introductions are in order; you're [pc.name]. She nods, sets down the towel, and begins donning her armored robes. "And my name is Hethia. At least you've more sense and less impulsiveness than he does. So, you wanted to talk?" Yes. About the situation here. You've heard some of the story already, but you'd like hear her version of events. That, and come up with some kind of solution which involves everyone getting home safely.
rows.translation: 如果这件事能够和平解决，就没有理由不试一试。你艰难地咽了口唾沫，从灌木丛中走出，朝河岸靠近；你摊开空无一物的双手，小心不做任何突然的动作。座狼几乎立刻发现了你，迈开四肢向你猛冲而来；女德鲁伊一声尖锐的口哨却让它骤然停步。它悻悻退回她身旁，嗜血欲顷刻消散。你注视着精灵走出河流；冰冷的水从她雪白的肌肤上倾泻而下。她随后走到自己的物品旁，挑出一条小毛巾擦干身体。 “又来一个？”她的嗓音非常适合发出高傲贵妇般的笑声。 又一个？哦，她指的是加雷特，对吧？不，你不是来报上名号大打出手的，而是来谈话的。也许该先自我介绍：你叫[pc.name]。 她点点头，放下毛巾，开始穿上带甲长袍。“我叫赫希娅。至少你比他理智，也没那么冲动。那么，你想谈谈？” 没错。你想谈谈这里的情况。你已经听过部分经过，但还想听她讲述自己所知的版本；同时，也要想出一个让所有人都能安全回家的解决办法。
rows.raw: " If a peaceful solution to this is possible, there's no reason why you shouldn't give it a try. Swallowing hard, you step out of the undergrowth and walk towards the riverbank, holding out your empty hands and careful to make no sudden moves. The warg notices you almost instantly and starts bounding towards you, but a sharp whistle from the druidess stops it dead in its tracks and it slinks back to her side, its bloodlust evaporating into nothingness. As you watch, the elf emerges from the river, icy water cascading off her alabaster skin, then steps over to her belongings and picks out a small towel to dry herself off with. "Another one?" Her voice is of the sort that'd be perfectly suited to a haughty noblewoman's laugh. Another one? Oh, she means Garret, right? No, you're not here to take names and kick ass, you're here to talk. Maybe introductions are in order; you're [pc.name]. She nods, sets down the towel, and begins donning her armored robes. "And my name is Hethia. At least you've more sense and less impulsiveness than he does. So, you wanted to talk?" Yes. About the situation here. You've heard some of the story already, but you'd like hear her version of events. That, and come up with some kind of solution which involves everyone getting home safely."

rows.original: Try and talk down the druidess.
rows.translation: 试着说服那位女德鲁伊吧。

rows.original: You give Etheryn a nod. If she's confident that she can pull some weight over on the druidess, she's more than welcome to have a go at it. Stepping back, you let Etheryn take the spotlight as she emerges from the undergrowth. [etheryn.highConfidence||She looks back at you for reassurance and confirmation, and you wave her on. You've got her back if something happens; while you can understand her having qualms, there's no need to be as afraid of the situation as she is.] The moment she even starts approaching the riverbank, the warg perks up and leaps to its feet, making a vicious half-growl, half-barking noise. The beast seems about fit to barrel straight for Etheryn, but the druidess lets out a high, sharp whistle and it settles back down to the ground, although not without great reluctance and plenty of whining. Etheryn continues to approach, her empty hands held palms out in front of her — if this isn't non-threatening, you don't know what is. The druidess regards her for a moment, then slips out of the river and makes a beeline for her things. "Well, what do we have here?" Her voice is hoarse and harsh, like mountain wind against window panes. "I wasn't expecting to see one of you so far from the Winter City. And traveling in the company of other peoples, too." "These are... uncertain times. There's trouble in the Winter City, which is why I've come this far south to seek help." A disdainful sniff. "Not from those who still follow the Old Wyld, I hope. Are times so desperate that the Winter City cannot spare a single woman as a messenger, and has to send a male instead? Pray to your new gods for your deliverance, instead of —" Etheryn clears her throat loudly, garnering a raised eyebrow from the druidess. "I'm not here to speak about that! I'm here about the matter of the loggers in this camp!" "Oh? So you're here to play hero?" "If I were, I wouldn't be parlaying! Can you please listen to me before acting all contemptuous? I understand there's been no love lost between the Winter City and those who follow the Old Wyld, but —" The druidess sniffs as she slips into her armored robes, although her gaze doesn't leave Etheryn for a moment. "Very well. I'll listen. At least you have better manners than that brute who came barging in here."
rows.translation: 你向伊瑟琳点了点头。如果她有信心能够对那位德鲁伊女巫产生一些影响，那她大可以试试看。 你退后一步，让伊瑟琳走到前台，当她从灌木丛中走出来时。 [etheryn.highConfidence||她回头看着你，希望得到你的安慰和确认，而你则向她示意继续前进。如果你在身边，什么事情都不会发生；虽然你能理解她内心的担忧，但其实没有必要像她那样害怕这种情况。]就在她刚开始走向河岸的那一刻，那只野兽立刻警觉起来，猛地站了起来，发出既像低吼又像吠叫的凶狠声音。这只野兽似乎准备直接冲向伊瑟琳，但女德鲁伊突然发出一声尖锐的哨声，它才勉强又躺回了地上，尽管它还不停地抱怨着，显得非常不情愿。 伊瑟琳继续朝她走去，双手空空地伸在身前——如果这都不算是一种表示无害的举动，那你就真不知道什么才算了。这位德鲁伊少女注视了她片刻，然后从河里爬上来，径直朝自己的东西走去。 那么，我们这里到底有什么呢？她的声音嘶哑而刺耳，就像山风吹打在窗玻璃上发出的声音。真没想到会在离冬城这么远的地方见到你们中的某个人，而且还是和其他人一起旅行的。 现在是…一个充满不确定性的时期。冬城发生了麻烦，因此我才远道南下寻求帮助。 轻蔑地哼了一声。但愿不是那些仍然遵循古老传统的人干的。难道现在的情况已经如此危急，以至于冬城连一个女性使者都派不出来，非得派一个男性去吗？不如向你们新信仰的神明祈祷，祈求他们的拯救吧……而不是…… 伊瑟琳大声清了清嗓子，这让那位女德鲁伊微微挑起了眉毛。我来这里并不是为了谈论那个事情！我是来讨论这个营地里的伐木工人们的问题的！ 哦？原来你是来当英雄的啊？ 如果我是那样的话，我就不会在这里争辩了！请你先听我把话说完，再表现出那种轻蔑的态度好吗？我知道冬城与那些追随古老荒野的人之间确实存在着隔阂，但是—— 女德鲁伊一边穿上她的铠甲长袍，一边轻嗅着空气，但她的目光始终没有离开过伊瑟琳。好吧，我会听的。至少你比那个闯进来的粗人要有礼貌些。

rows.original: On second thought, now might not be the best time. Perhaps you need to prepare a little more... either way, if you're not going to try and parley with the druidess right now, what are you going to do?
rows.translation: 再仔细想想，现在可能并不是最好的时机。或许你还需要再做些准备……不管怎样，如果你现在不打算尝试与那位女德鲁伊进行谈判，那你还打算做什么呢？
rows.raw: "\n        On second thought, now might not be the best time. Perhaps you need to prepare a little more... either way, if you're not going to try and parley with the druidess right now, what are you going to do?"

rows.original:
Keeping Garret's words in mind, you look between the Warg and the druidess' belongings, considering your chances. There's no doubt that filching her robes or bow would immediately attract the warg's attention — they would be instantly missed — but the key to Garret's cage is small enough that you could possibly nick it and free Garret before the druidess notices it's gone.

    As for the warg itself, it's grown bored to the point of dozing off. Slightly out of place, perhaps, for a hulking mound of meat and fur to be lounging around with its head between its forepaws, but you aren't going to overlook an opportunity when given one. While you're not sure how powerful its sense of smell is, perhaps it's not as good as you think it might be... 
    
    Hm.
    
    It must be noted, though, that if you do try to steal the key and are caught, it's certain that druidess and warg alike will take this poorly and attack you immediately. Knowing that, do you still want to go ahead?
rows.translation:
牢记加雷特的话，你环顾了一下那头狼人以及女德鲁伊的物品，仔细考虑着自己的机会。毫无疑问，如果偷走她的长袍或弓，肯定会立刻引起那头狼人的注意——那些东西很快就会被它发现不见了。但是，加雷特锁住的笼子的钥匙尺寸很小，你或许能够偷偷拿走它，在女德鲁伊察觉之前就把加雷特解救出来。

    至于那只战争兽，它已经无聊到快要睡着了。或许，对于这样一只庞大的肉块和毛皮组成的生物来说，把头放在前爪之间休息，确实有点不太像它的风格，但一旦有机会，你肯定不会放过它。虽然你不确定它的嗅觉有多灵敏，但也许并没有你想象中那么好……
    
    嗯。
    
    不过，必须提醒你，如果你真的试图偷走那把钥匙并被抓到，无论是女德鲁伊还是战争兽，都会非常生气，并立即对你发动攻击。知道了这些，你还是想继续下去吗？

    As for the warg itself, it's grown bored to the point of dozing off. Slightly out of place, perhaps, for a hulking mound of meat and fur to be lounging around with its head between its forepaws, but you aren't going to overlook an opportunity when given one. While you're not sure how powerful its sense of smell is, perhaps it's not as good as you think it might be... 
    
    Hm.
    
    It must be noted, though, that if you do try to steal the key and are caught, it's certain that druidess and warg alike will take this poorly and attack you immediately. Knowing that, do you still want to go ahead?"

rows.original: Well, this seems like as good an opening as any. If Garret can wrestle down a beast like that with his bare hands, then having him at your side when you face down the druidess is going to be a help. [party.hasCompanions|Signaling for [party.compNames] to stay back,|After one final look around to make sure that you're in the clear,] you step out from the undergrowth and begin working your way towards the druidess' things, sticking to what meager cover the riverbank affords — a fallen tree trunk here, a water-worn boulder there. [pc.cl thief|This is no problem for someone with your training and experience. Your feet are light, your passage a mere flicker of shadows at the edges of the twilight scene. Strong as the druidess' mutt may be, it's definitely lacking perceptiveness — either that, or it's suffering from an acute case of couldn't-be-bothered syndrome. Either way, this works in your favor. Heart pounding, you inch closer to the warg and the items it's been charged with guarding. Light and nimble, your fingers close around the iron keyring and the single key looped on it, lifting both up and away with nary a sound. The warg grunts and mutters, shifting on its belly before sniffing the air, but it remains oblivious to your presence. Great — time to get out of here. Step after precarious step, eyes never leaving the warg, you back up over the rocky riverbank until you're safely in the bushes, key in hand. No time to lose — once you're sure you're in the clear, you take off for the hall at a sprint, hoping to any of the gods who'll hear you that the druidess doesn't discover the theft until you've freed Garret. |[pc.cunningRange 60|[pc.agilityRange 60|While you may not have been trained in thievery, you're comfortable enough in your natural agility and cunning that you feel you have a good chance of pulling this off. Slowly, stealthily, you creep towards the warg and the treasure it guards, breath catching in your throat every now and then when it raises its head and looks around. While the beast certainly doesn't look as lazy and restful as it was when you started, it clearly hasn't found sufficient reason to stop lounging around. Right. By now, you've practically worked your way right up to within reach of the warg, and reaching out with trembling fingers, you grab the iron keyring between thumb and forefinger. Good. Nothing. Its back still turned to you, the warg scratches itself and huffs, its eyes trained on its mistress. Biting your lip, you slide the keyring out and away from the armored robes, then begin the painful, slow process of crawling away. You can't quite believe you did it — you're no trained sneak or seasoned footpad — but results speak for themselves. The moment you're safely back in the cover of the undergrowth, you take off at a sprint, making a beeline for the hall and Garret's cage. It won't be long before the druidess realizes someone's stolen the key, and you want to make the most of this advantage. |However, you aren't quite as stealthy as you'd have liked to be. While you don't think you've made any noise, the warg must have nevertheless sensed you; the moment you get within reach of the druidess' things, it turns its head straight at your skulking form and barrels into action. Yapping and snarling like a rabid creature, it lunges for your throat; you have barely enough time to draw your [pc.weapon] to defend yourself even as the druidess emerges from the water. It's a fight! ]|However, you aren't quite as stealthy as you'd have liked to be. While you don't think you've made any noise, the warg must have nevertheless sensed you; the moment you get within reach of the druidess' things, it turns its head straight at your skulking form and barrels into action. Yapping and snarling like a rabid creature, it lunges for your throat; you have barely enough time to draw your [pc.weapon] to defend yourself even as the druidess emerges from the water. It's a fight!]]
rows.translation: 嗯，这个机会似乎不错。如果加雷特能够徒手制服那样的怪物，那么在你们面对那位女德鲁伊时，他有你在身边肯定会有所帮助。 [party.hasCompanions|用于信号传递[party.compNames]留在后面。|最后再环顾四周，确保自己确实没有留下任何痕迹后，]你从灌木丛中走出来，开始朝着女德鲁伊的营地方向前进，尽量利用河岸边稀少的掩护物——这里有一根倒下的树干，那里有一块被水侵蚀过的巨石。 [pc.cl thief|对于拥有你这样的训练经历和能力的人来说，这根本不是问题。你的动作轻巧敏捷，你的移动就像暮色中阴影的闪烁一样悄无声息。尽管那位德鲁伊的女仆狗力气很大，但它显然缺乏敏锐的感知能力——要么就是它根本懒得去注意这些细节。 无论如何，这种情况都对你有利。你的心跳加速，小心翼翼地靠近那只战兽以及它被指派守护的物品。动作轻巧敏捷，你的手指迅速抓住了铁制钥匙扣以及上面那把钥匙，然后悄无声息地将它们拿了起来。那只战争兽发出低沉的咕哝声，匍匐着移动，然后开始嗅探周围的空气，但它仍然没有察觉到你的存在。 太好了——是时候离开这里了。你小心翼翼地一步步后退，目光始终紧盯着那只战争兽，直到安全地躲进了灌木丛中，手中还紧握着钥匙。没有时间可以浪费了——一旦确定自己没有危险，你就立刻全速冲向大厅，真心希望那些能听到你声音的神明们，能帮助你在救出加雷特之前，让那位女德鲁伊无法发现这次盗窃行为。 |[pc.cunningRange 60|[pc.agilityRange 60|虽然你并没有接受过偷窃方面的训练，但凭借你与生俱来的敏捷与机智，你觉得自己很有机会成功完成这个任务。你悄悄地、隐秘地靠近那头守卫着财宝的野兽，每当它抬起头四处张望时，你的呼吸都会不由自主地变得急促起来。虽然这只野兽看起来已经不再像刚开始时那么懒散、喜欢休息了，但显然它还没有找到足够的理由来停止闲逛。 没错。到现在为止，你已经几乎接近那只战争野兽了，你伸出颤抖的手指，用拇指和食指抓住了那个铁制钥匙扣。 很好。什么都没有发生。那只战兽仍然背对着你，它挠着身体，发出哼哼声，它的目光始终紧盯着它的主人。你咬着嘴唇，将钥匙扣从那身铠甲中取出来，然后开始缓慢而艰难地爬开。你简直不敢相信自己真的做到了——你既没有接受过专门的潜行训练，也不是经验丰富的窃贼——但结果已经证明了一切。当你安全地躲回到灌木丛的掩护下后，你立刻开始全速奔跑，径直朝着大厅和加雷特的笼子跑去。用不了多久，那位女德鲁伊就会发现有人偷走了钥匙，而你正好要充分利用这个机会。 |然而，你的行动并没有你期望的那么隐秘。虽然你认为自己没有发出任何声响，但那只野兽肯定察觉到了你的存在；一旦你靠近那位女德鲁伊的物品，它就会立刻转向你的藏身之处，然后猛然发起攻击。它发出狂怒的叫声，像一只疯兽一样扑向你的喉咙；你几乎来不及拔出武器[pc.weapon]即使女德鲁伊从水中浮现出来，你也必须设法保护自己。 这是一场激烈的战斗！ ]|然而，你的隐秘行动并没有达到你期望的效果。虽然你认为自己没有发出任何声响，但那只野兽肯定察觉到了你的存在；一旦你靠近那位女德鲁伊的物品，它就会立刻转向你的藏身之处，猛然发起攻击。这只野兽发出狂怒的叫声，像一只疯掉的动物一样扑向你的喉咙；你几乎来不及拔出武器[pc.weapon]即使女德鲁伊从水中浮现出来，你也必须设法保护自己。 这是一场激烈的战斗！]]
