Brint joins you a moment later, and by the time you drag yourself to your knees the doors have slammed shut behind you. The only light in here is heavily filtered through stained-glass windows, dappling rays of miscolored sunlight streaming through one side. "Oh," you moan, grabbing a pew for support and trying to get to your [pc.hasToes|feet|hooves]. "What- what is this place?" "My throne room," a familiar voice intones from the other end of the room. "One of many, of course." "K-Kasyrra!" you gasp, clawing your way to a standing position and craning your head to look at her. "You-" Your voice dies in your throat, your brain unable to comprehend what your eyes are seeing. It's Kasyrra. It's Kasyrra, but... Perhaps it's the way she's sat astride her throne, legs crossed and gaze cast imperiously down upon you. But the longer you look at her, the longer you take her in... the more convinced you are. This isn't the Kasyrra you knew. "Wh-who... are you?" you say, sinking back to your knees as she stands up, spreading her wings as if to air them out. "Ha," she murmurs. "So disrespectful." She looks divine. The Kasyrra you once fought — so dangerous but so full of life, so vibrant and colorful — is gone. In her place stands a creature so far above you that the eyes she regards you with don't even seem to register your presence. There's no interest there. No relation. Just pure, unyielding disinterest. "What happened to you?" you ask despite yourself. You can't possibly read her intentions. For all you know, you're a second away from having your head removed from your neck. She looks down at you unspeaking, her impassive eyes boring through your own. "Nothing," she says finally. "What... did you do to the gods?" you ask. "Your gods are dead," the thing that looks like Kasyrra tells you. "I stand in their place. Astride this world." "The people?" you press. "Swept away," she says. You sit back on your haunches, turning the situation over in your head. "How long was I in that tower?" you mutter, half to yourself. "I do not know," she says. "Time slips through my fingers like sand. But you... I remember you." "Do you?" you challenge her, but even your galling arrogance doesn't move her. "From before the pantheon was lain to rest," she utters. "And with every one..." "You became less like yourself," you say. She stays silent, then turns and walks back to her throne. Divinity radiates from her like a shield and yet, all you can see in her silhouette is someone lost and alone, having clutched defeat from the jaws of victory. She glances at you sitting next to Brint where he lies unconscious. Vague annoyance flickers across her face before she looks away, half-lidded eyes gazing at the light patterns dancing among the colored windows. She mutters something under her breath — you only just catch it from where you are. "It wasn't meant to be like this..."
rows.translation: 你被拖上了一座高耸入云的建筑的台阶——嗯，如果它不是如此世俗的话，几乎可以被称为一座大教堂——然后被推进那扇巨大的门，扔到了那片褪色的红色地毯上，就这样被丢在那里，蜷缩成一团。过了一会儿，布林特才来到你身边。而当你勉强爬到膝盖的位置时，那扇门已经紧紧地关在了你的身后。这里唯一的光线是通过彩绘玻璃窗过滤后的微弱光线，那些色彩斑驳的阳光从一侧照射进来。 “哦，”你呻吟着，抓住一根长凳作为支撑，试图站起来。 [pc.hasToes|脚|蹄子]这、这是什么地方？” “这是我的王座厅，”一个熟悉的声音从房间的另一端传来，“当然，这只是众多王座厅中的一个而已。” “卡希拉！”你惊呼道，挣扎着站了起来，然后伸长脖子试图看清她的样子。你——” 你的声音在喉咙里戛然而止，大脑根本无法理解自己的眼睛所看到的一切。那是卡希拉……那是卡希拉，但…… 或许是因为她坐在王座上的姿势——双腿交叉，居高临下地注视着你。但是，你越是注视她，越是仔细观察她……你就越会相信这一点。真的。不是那个你熟悉的卡希拉…… “你、你是谁？”你问道，当她站起身来、展开双翼仿佛要活动一下时，你整个人都瘫软在了地上。 “哈，”她轻声说道，“真是太不尊重人了。” 她看起来神圣的；神一般的你曾经与之战斗过的卡希拉——那个如此危险，却又充满生机与活力的存在——已经消失了。取而代之的，是一个远远超越你的存在；她注视你的眼神，甚至似乎没有注意到你的存在。她对你毫无兴趣，没有任何情感上的联系，只有纯粹的、冷淡的漠视。 “什么发生了这是对你说的吗？”你不由自主地问道。你根本无法理解她的意图。说不定下一刻，你的头就会被砍下来。 她低头看着你，没有说话，那双冷漠的眼神直直地盯着你。 什么都没有，”她最终说道。 “你……你对那些神明做了什么？”你问道。 “你们的神明已经死了，”那个看起来像卡希拉的东西告诉你，“我现在取代了他们的位置，统治着这个世界。 那些人呢？”你问道。 “他们都被带走了，”她回答。 你重新盘腿坐下，开始仔细思考这个情况。 “我在那座塔里待了多久呢？”你喃喃自语道，半是自问。 我不知道，”她说，“时间就像沙子一样从我的指缝中溜走。但是你……我记得你。” “真的吗？”你挑衅地问道，但即便是你那令人恼火的傲慢，也未能打动她。 “从众神安息之前就记得了，”她缓缓说道，“每一个神明…… 你变得不再像原来的自己了，”你说。她沉默不语，然后转身走回了她的王座。 她的身上散发着如同盾牌般的神圣光芒，然而，在她的轮廓中，你看到的却只是一个迷失了方向、孤独无助的人——一个在胜利的边缘却最终抓住了失败的人。她瞥了一眼坐在布林特旁边的你，而布林特此时正处于昏迷状态。她脸上闪过一丝烦躁，但很快又将视线移开，半闭着的眼睛望着彩色玻璃窗上闪烁的轻型影。她低声说了些什么——你只能从你的位置勉强听清那些话语。 本来不该是这样的……

rows.original: Lust, need, and just plain girly airheadedness all swirl together in your mind. A mind that seems really, like, super overworked lately. Gods, what've you been doing lately? The sharpness and clarity granted by your circlet... that all seems so far away now. Silly. Goofy. A chore, and a bore! You giggle, bouncing on your heels. What was that all about anyway? You're so much better off not thinking too hard about things like that. You just need to relax, take a breath, maybe smooch some hotties and show off a little more skin. That'll get you through like waaaaay easier than being a stuffy, no-fun nerd. Yeah, it's time to party. Time to fuck!
rows.translation: 欲望、需求，还有那种纯粹的女生特有的傻气，全都在你脑海中交织在一起。最近，你的头脑似乎真的负担过重了……天啊，你最近都在忙些什么呢？ 而在你的环饰赋予你的敏锐与清晰……如今这一切都显得如此遥远。真是愚蠢又无聊，简直就是一件烦人的差事！ 你咯咯笑着，蹦来蹦去。不过这一切到底是为了什么呢？其实，最好不要太去思考这类事情。你只需要放松下来，深呼吸，或许还可以和一些漂亮的女孩亲热一下，多展示一些自己的肌肤……这样才会更好吧。这样你会比做一个闷闷不乐、毫无乐趣的书呆子容易得多地度过这段时光。 没错，是时候去狂欢了。是时候开干了！

rows.original:
Over a few moments, a remarkable clarity washes away the bimbo haze clouding your mind. The world seems sharp again... but also a little colder, a little more threatening. You take a deep breath and let it go, wondering how much you missed. 

    You've got to laugh at yourself for this one. How did you let this happen?
    
    You're smart enough not to let it happen again, right?
    
    Even though it was kind of fun...
rows.translation:
不一会儿，一种惊人的清晰感驱散了那些困扰你的杂念。世界重新变得清晰起来……但同时也显得更加寒冷，更加充满威胁。你深吸一口气，又缓缓呼出，不禁思索着自己究竟错过了多少。

    你真得为自己这种行为笑一笑——究竟是怎么让这种事情发生的呢？
    
    你应该足够聪明，不会再让这种事情再次发生吧？
    
    尽管那种感觉还挺有趣的……

rows.original: Something happens as you're walking through the forest, ducking away from a hanging branch. Your foot crosses what you could only call an invisible line; energy tingles sharply up your heel before settling into a soothing tickle. [party.som|When you look over your shoulder you can see that there's a soft indentation in the grass and dirt as though it were being pressed flat by invisible bricks, but your hand can cross that threshold with nothing more than a repeat tingle... what if you're about to walk into a trap?|[companion.name] pauses in confusion when you come to a sudden halt, about to ask before you watch them comically flatten against an invisible wall. "Hey, what gives?" [companion.heShe] grumbles, rubbing their nose. "That hurt..." "What?" you ask, suddenly feeling panic settle in. Luckily when you return to that invisible wall you prove just as able to pass through it as before... unfortunately, no matter what you try, it proves impossible to get them beyond this unseeable border. When you sigh and look in the direction you were headed, it seems like a pretty straight path. "That could be a trap," [companion.name] grunts, trying to peer through the foliage too. "We could go around, but are you going to check it out instead?" A good question. Maybe it is a trap specially made for you...|Your companions only look confused for as long as it takes to collide with an invisible wall, staggering back and rubbing their noses. "What the fuck?" [companion1.name] grunts, blinking a few times. "A trap?" "What?" you ask, feeling panic begin to settle in. Luckily trying to cross the invisible threshold again seems to work just fine for you... but no matter how much you try, it seems impossible to get your friends to cross this unseen border. When you sigh and look in the direction you were headed, it seems like a pretty straight path. "That could be a trap," [companion2.name] grumbles, trying to peer through the foliage too. "We could go around, but are you going to check it out instead?" A good question. Maybe it is a trap specially made for you...]
rows.translation: 当你正在森林中行走，躲避着一根悬垂的树枝时，突然发生了一些事情。 你的脚跨过了那条几乎看不见的界限；一股能量从你的脚后跟开始剧烈地向上蔓延，随后又转化为一种令人感到舒适的痒意。 [party.som|当你回头看时，会发现草地和泥土上有一处轻微的凹陷，仿佛被某种无形的重物压得平平的。但当你把手伸过去时，只会感到一阵轻微的刺痛……要是你正走进一个陷阱里呢？|[companion.name]当你突然停了下来，正准备询问时，却看到他们滑稽地撞上了一面无形的墙，顿时困惑地停住了脚步。“嘿，这是怎么回事？ [companion.heShe]们嘟囔着，揉着鼻子：“好疼啊……” “什么？”你问道，突然感到一阵恐慌袭来。幸运的是，当你再次尝试穿过那面无形的墙时，发现自己仍然可以像之前一样穿过它……但不幸的是，无论你怎么努力，都无法让他们越过这道看不见的边界。你叹了口气，朝自己原本前进的方向望去，发现那条路看起来其实非常笔直。 “那可能是个陷阱[companion.name]哼哼，我也试着想透过这些树叶看看里面是什么。”“我们可以绕道过去，但你们还是打算去检查一下吗？” 这是个好问题。也许我们应该去看看是一个专门为你设计的陷阱……|你的同伴只是愣了一下，然后就撞上了那面无形的墙，踉跄着后退，还揉着鼻子。“搞什么鬼？ [companion1.name]哼，”你眨了几下眼睛，“陷阱？” “什么？”你问道，心中开始感到恐慌。幸运的是，再次尝试穿越那道无形的界限似乎并没有问题……但无论你如何努力，似乎都无法让你的朋友们穿过这道看不见的边界。当你叹了口气，看向你原本前进的方向时，发现那其实是一条相当笔直的道路。 “那很可能是个陷阱。 [companion2.name]嘟囔着，也试图透过树叶往里面看。“我们可以绕过去，但你们到底要不要去看看呢？” 这是个好问题。也许我们应该去看看是一个专门为你设计的陷阱……]

rows.original:
Sweet smells entice you on your journey; spices and floral notes are a gentle waft on a barely-existent breeze. There's a definitive path through the trees though; the grass is even cut short here and the dirt is dry. Despite the smell it seems to be an entirely normal... wait.

    There are pumpkins resting on the sides of the path, carved in the shapes of leering faces by delicate knifework. Some are lit from within by rose candles... you would guess that's the source of the pleasant smell. A few of the pumpkins also seem to contain flowers, tied into little bouquets by pink ribbons. They look harmless enough — lovely in fact — blends of roses and lilies in blacks, purples, reds, and oranges. Considering they're all tied up and ready, you could probably claim a couple of them...
rows.translation:
甜美的香气在你的旅途中吸引着你；香料与花香随一丝几乎不存在的微风轻柔飘来。不过，穿过这些树木有一条明确的道路——这里的草被修剪得很短，泥土也显得很干燥。尽管充满了这些香气，但这一切看起来却显得格外平常……等等。

    小路两旁摆放着一些南瓜，那些南瓜被用娴熟的刀工雕刻成了面带诡异笑容的形状。其中一些南瓜内部还点着玫瑰色的蜡烛……你猜那股怡人的香气就是从这些蜡烛散发出来的。有几个南瓜里似乎还插着花，那些花朵被粉红色的丝带扎成了小花束。它们看起来十分无害，甚至非常漂亮——那些由玫瑰和百合组成的花束，呈现出黑色、紫色、红色和橙色等多种色彩。既然它们都已经扎好、准备好了，你或许可以顺手带走几束……

rows.original: Eh, fair enough. You've got plenty of pumpkins to choose from, so you pluck up the nicest bouquet you can find. It smells sweet to your nose, and the stalks still gently drip moisture. With a shrug you couch the flowers under your arm and continue on your journey.
rows.translation: 嗯，也确实如此。你有的是南瓜可以挑，于是你摘下能找到的最漂亮的一束花。它闻起来香气甜美，花茎上还在缓缓渗出水分。你耸了耸肩，把花夹在腋下，继续你的旅程。
rows.raw: "\n        Eh, fair enough. You've got plenty of pumpkins to choose from, so you pluck up the nicest bouquet you can find. It smells sweet to your nose, and the stalks still gently drip moisture. With a shrug you couch the flowers under your arm and continue on your journey."

rows.original: Honestly you're already taking extra risks by walking alone into some magical zone, carrying around what may well be magically-conjured flowers seems like a pointless endeavor.
rows.translation: 说实话，你独自走进那些充满魔力的区域，就已经在承担额外的风险了；而带着那些很可能是由魔法力量创造出来的花朵，似乎更是一种毫无意义的行为。
rows.raw: "\n        Honestly you're already taking extra risks by walking alone into some magical zone, carrying around what may well be magically-conjured flowers seems like a pointless endeavor."

rows.original: Nah, this is weird enough without any extra risks.
rows.translation: 算了，这样已经够奇怪了，再增加额外的风险就太不合适了。
rows.raw: "Nah, this is weird enough without any extra risks."

rows.original: Eventually the smell of flowers fades, although pumpkins continue to line the pathway you're walking along. You reach a tiny bend after a few more minutes, before your eyes are drawn to yet another oddity; a wooden crate, covered in dust and cracked part-way open. Even from a few feet away you can see the glint of bottles within, and approach. Huh. Now we're talking; wine. Dusty bottles of wine. You cautiously retrieve one, turning it gently in your hand. The label is unfamiliar... looks like a great big buxom cow-girl, but her skin is painted red. Guess that means a red wine? It's hardly a coincidence then, somebody has set you up on this path rather intentionally; flowers and wine?
rows.translation: 最终，花香逐渐消失了，尽管你走过的小路上依然排列着南瓜。又过了几分钟，你来到一个小小的转弯处，这时你的目光被另一个奇怪的东西吸引了——一个布满灰尘、裂开了一条缝的木箱。即使站在几英尺之外，你也能看到里面瓶子闪烁的微光，于是你走了过去。 嗯，这才对嘛——葡萄酒。那些积满灰尘的葡萄酒瓶。你小心翼翼地取出一瓶，轻轻地在手中转动着它。这标签你很陌生……上面画着一个身材丰满的牛仔女孩，只不过她的皮肤被涂成了红色。我猜那意味着这是红葡萄酒？那这就绝不是巧合了——有人相当刻意地把你引上了这条路；鲜花和葡萄酒？
rows.raw: " Eventually the smell of flowers fades, although pumpkins continue to line the pathway you're walking along. You reach a tiny bend after a few more minutes, before your eyes are drawn to yet another oddity; a wooden crate, covered in dust and cracked part-way open. Even from a few feet away you can see the glint of bottles within, and approach. Huh. Now we're talking; wine. Dusty bottles of wine. You cautiously retrieve one, turning it gently in your hand. The label is unfamiliar... looks like a great big buxom cow-girl, but her skin is painted red. Guess that means a red wine? It's hardly a coincidence then, somebody has set you up on this path rather intentionally; flowers and wine?"

rows.original: Eh. What could one bottle hurt? It seems like it's a good gift for who or whatever is waiting for you down here. Your fingers leave dusty prints, and you make sure to brush it gently clean first. Hmm... now that you think about it, that cowgirl looks kind of familiar
rows.translation: 呃，一瓶酒能有什么危害呢？看来，这对那些在下面等着你的人来说，应该是个不错的礼物吧。你的手指在瓶子上留下了灰尘痕迹，你得先轻轻把它擦干净才行。嗯……现在想来，那个牛仔女孩看起来还挺面熟的……
rows.raw: "\n        Eh. What could one bottle hurt? It seems like it's a good gift for who or whatever is waiting for you down here. Your fingers leave dusty prints, and you make sure to brush it gently clean first. Hmm... now that you think about it, that cowgirl looks kind of familiar"

rows.translation: 只是个礼貌的表示而已。

rows.original:
Heck, if you're taking a wine bottle, it's probably going to whoever's responsible for this as a gift for show... what's the harm in grabbing an extra one for yourself? You brush the dust off of the bottle and take a closer look at the cowgirl on the label.
        
        Why does she look familiar?
rows.translation:
哎呀，既然你要拿一瓶酒，那把它作为礼物送给负责这件事的人吧……多拿一瓶给自己又有什么坏处呢？你把瓶子上的灰尘擦掉，仔细看了看标签上的女牛仔图案。
        
        为什么她看起来这么眼熟呢？
rows.raw:
"
        Heck, if you're taking a wine bottle, it's probably going to whoever's responsible for this as a gift for show... what's the harm in grabbing an extra one for yourself? You brush the dust off of the bottle and take a closer look at the cowgirl on the label.
        
        Why does she look familiar?"

rows.original: You're not sure why, but something about that cowgirl on the label... You pluck out one of the bottles and brush some of the dust away with a thumb. She looks so familiar... Nah. It couldn't be, could it?
rows.translation: 你并不清楚为什么，但标签上的那个女牛仔形象…… 你拿出一瓶酒，用拇指轻轻拂去上面的灰尘。她看起来真是太熟悉……不，不可能吧？
rows.raw: " You're not sure why, but something about that cowgirl on the label... You pluck out one of the bottles and brush some of the dust away with a thumb. She looks so familiar... Nah. It couldn't be, could it?"

rows.original: Wait, you aren't taking the booze?
rows.translation: 等等，你不要把酒拿走吗？

rows.original:
Well, only a little bit further to go. And now there's something else tickling the edges of your nose, setting you to salivating: food. Cooked meats, to be specific. At last, you reach the clearing...

    And you're not quite sure what you expected.
    
    There's a large pile of picnic blankets off to the side, surrounded by candles. At the center of the clearing, however, is a figure stirring a thick black iron cauldron, right beside a table and a pair of chairs. A long black candle burns merrily on the table, painting a rather romantic glow to the arrangement of tableware. Once you're close enough, the woman — and it's definitely a woman — looks up at you. A large, wide-brimmed witch hat hides her features, but you can just make out long messy locks of glossy black hair. A dress of shimmering black silk clings to massive pillowy tits, and the cleavage runs deep. A slit runs down the side of it to allow her legs easy movement, and her broad breeder's hips sway from side-to-side as she stirs her cauldron of stew.
    
    You're being treated to a witch of sinful proportions, with deep... red flesh, and... minotaur leg—
    
    Wait just a fucking second.
    
    It's possible to make all the 'witch's details out now; the slight shift beneath her dress, revealing a long, lizardine tail that had barely been obscured. heart-shaped spurs run down its spine, while the tip of her tail ends in a thick spade. That deep shade of her red skin is one you could never forget; it inhabits your dreams and nightmares both. The witch tips her giant hat ever so slightly, and you catch a glimpse of perfect obsidian lips curling up into a sweet smile. Her voice, that luscious, sibilant purr, rolls out towards you like a cat who got the cream. "[var0|Oh dear... you've even brought gifts! ]Welcome, weary traveler, to the abode of an innocent little witch."
    
    Trying to talk doesn't work at first, and you're maybe a little bit in shock when you approach. [kasyrra.bouquet|Without thinking, you hold out the carefully gathered bouquet of flowers. There's a delightful little giggle from the 'witch' and she accepts them with a smile you can just about see beneath the rim of her hat. "How lovely! You brought flowers?" She gently places them in an empty glass vase on the dinner table (Was that vase there? You can't remember...) [kasyrra.bottle|She grins again and gently plucks the bottle from your other hand. "Wine too... oh you are just the most charming stranger, aren't you?" 
    
    "Uh... yeah," you mutter, shaking your head out of the fugue that had been settling into it. Awareness returns to you just in time for her to whisper a soft 'thank you' before tugging you into a slow, sweet kiss. Her lips are wonderfully soft things, and a long snake-like tongue sinks into your mouth a moment later. It's just about possible to feel her satisfied hum of pleasure before she draws herself away, still smiling. Suddenly you're feeling altogether lightheaded; you aren't sure there's a living being in the world who knows how to kiss like Kass.|"No wine though? A shame, I think you would have enjoyed it."]] 
    
    It becomes readily apparent that this mystery witch is Kasyrra, antagonist sex demon of a far off land. She tilts her head curiously at you, tipping the rim of her hat up again. "What's the matter there, [pc.name]— I mean, uh... stranger? Trick or treat?"
    
    Trick or what?
rows.translation:
嗯，还差一点点就能到了。现在，还有另一样东西正在刺激你的嗅觉，让你垂涎欲滴——食物，更确切地说，是煮熟的肉类。终于，你来到了那片空地……

    不过，你其实不太确定自己原本期待的是什么。
    
    旁边有一大堆野餐毯子，周围点着蜡烛。然而，在空地的中央，有一个人正在一张桌子和一把椅子旁边，搅拌着一个厚厚的黑色铁锅。桌子上燃着一支长长的黑色蜡烛，为这些餐具营造出一种颇为浪漫的氛围。当你靠近到足够近的距离时，那个女人——毫无疑问，她确实是个女人——会抬头看着你。一顶宽边的大巫婆帽遮住了她的面容，但你可以隐约看到她那一头长长的、凌乱而闪亮的黑色头发。她穿着一件闪闪发光的黑色丝绸连衣裙，这件裙子紧紧贴着她那丰满的胸部，将她的乳沟凸显得十分明显。它的侧面有一条裂缝，这样她的双腿就可以自由活动；当她搅拌着那锅炖菜时，她那宽大的臀部会左右摇晃。
    
    你现在看到的是一位邪恶至极的女巫，她拥有深红色的肌肤，以及……弥诺陶洛斯的腿……
    
    等一下，他妈的！
    
    其实现在就可以把这位女巫的所有特征都描述清楚了：她的裙子下面藏着一条长长的、像蜥蜴尾巴一样的东西，几乎完全被裙子遮住了。她的身背上生着心形的尖刺，而尾巴的末端则是一块厚实的尖状物。她那深红色的皮肤颜色令人难以忘怀——这种颜色会同时出现在你的梦境与噩梦中。女巫微微歪了歪她那巨大的帽子，你得以看到她那如黑曜石般光亮的嘴唇正绽放出甜美的微笑。她的声音，那种柔和而带有丝丝颤音的低语，就像一只得到了奶油的猫一样，缓缓地向你传来。[var0|哦天啊……你甚至还带来了礼物！ ]欢迎来到这位天真无邪的小女巫的居所，疲惫的旅人。”
    
    起初，试图与她交谈是徒劳的，当你靠近她时，或许会感到一阵震惊。 [kasyrra.bouquet|你不假思索地递出了那束精心挑选的花朵。那个“女巫”发出了一声愉悦的轻笑，她微笑着接过了花，她的笑容几乎要从帽子的边缘露出来。“多可爱啊！你竟然带来了花？”她轻轻地将花插在餐桌上的一个空玻璃花瓶里（那个花瓶之前就在那里吗？你已经想不起来了……） [kasyrra.bottle|她又露出了笑容，轻轻从你另一只手中拿走了那个酒瓶。“酒也是……哦，你真是个最迷人的陌生人，不是吗？”
    
    “呃……是啊，”你喃喃道，同时摇了摇头，试图摆脱那种恍惚的状态。就在这时，你的意识重新清醒过来，只见她轻声说了句“谢谢”，然后牵着你的手，开始了一个温柔而缓慢的吻。她的嘴唇柔软得令人惊叹，不一会儿，她那条长长的舌头就像一条蛇一样滑进了你的口中。在她离开之前，你几乎能够感受到她那满足而愉悦的低语声，她依然面带微笑。突然间，你感到一阵头晕目眩，甚至不确定这个世界上是否还有其他人能够像卡丝那样吻人。|不过没有酒吗？真遗憾，我觉得你一定会喜欢的。]] 
    
    很快就可以看出，这位神秘的女巫其实就是卡希拉——一个来自遥远国度的邪恶女妖。她好奇地歪着头看着你，帽檐再次微微上扬：“你怎么了？ [pc.name]— 我是说，呃……陌生人？要来点糖果吗？
    
    要糖果还是怎么着？

rows.original: You sigh and cross your arms, taking a step back. It doesn't look like you've got any actual escape routes, but for the path you've come down though... She may be playing a strange game with you, but it probably wouldn't take much for her to literally wishbone you when you're unprepared. Kasyrra sighs, bringing her hands gently together. There's a soft 'crack' sound before your vision swims, but before there's a chance for real fear to settle in you realize it's actually the objects in your vision swimming. When you blink again, the both of you are stood in the middle of a much less decorated forest clearing. [kasyrra.bouquet|The demon still holds a bouquet in one hand, turning it around between her fingers. Not to mention she's still got her large witchy hat on... although the dress appears to have disappeared; deep red flesh shines every, and although her expansive equine boner is soft there's still precum gently drooling from her.] It's... hard to tell what her expression is beneath the hat, but the sigh sounds genuine enough. "You know, [pc.name]. It's very rude for you to barge into such a treat and spoil the magic. I had but expected just a little fun..." When her hands come apart again, there's nothing in her grasp but shattered pieces of crystal which become glittering sand before they even touch the floor. "I suppose you have no idea of the true novelty, do you?" She takes a step closer to you, although her face isn't facing you. There's an idle shifting from her wings, but there's nothing particularly threatening in her stance. "You see, where I come from we were used to a great deal of different heroes — Champions, sorry — falling through the shredded skein of realities. They brought with them customs. The holiday of Hallow's Eve, where all the good and bad little boys and girls dress up as something they're not. Monsters and men, all to get sweet treats or fun tricks." Kasyrra tips her hat up, showing you smoldering eyes of glowing yellow. "Although you aren't playing along with my delightful little trick — and that is a shame, I cook a delicious beef stew — I suppose there's still a treat you could indulge me in for ruining the moment, hm?" She grins wickedly and gestures to her package, already beginning to surge to full mast.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，抱起双臂，向后退了一步。除了来时的路，看起来根本没有真正的逃生路线……她或许只是在和你玩什么古怪游戏，可趁你毫无准备时，她大概不费吹灰之力就能把你像叉骨一样生生撕开。 卡希拉叹了口气，将双手轻轻合拢。随着一声轻柔的“喀嚓”，眼前的景象开始晃动；还没等真正的恐惧在心中滋生，你便意识到，其实是视野中的物体正在游移。再次眨眼时，你们已经站在一片装饰简朴得多的林间空地中央。[kasyrra.bouquet|恶魔手里仍握着一束花，让它在指间不断旋转。更别提她头上还戴着那顶巨大的女巫帽……不过礼服似乎已经消失，深红色肌肤处处裸露。她那硕大的马根虽然仍然疲软，却已经在缓缓流淌先液。] 她的表情……藏在帽檐下，很难看清，但那声叹息听起来足够真诚。“你知道吗，[pc.name]。你这样闯进一场盛宴、破坏其中的魔法，实在很无礼。我不过是想找一点乐趣……”她再次分开双手，掌中只剩破碎的水晶残片；还没碰到地面，它们就化成闪闪发光的细沙。“我猜你完全不明白，这种体验究竟有多么新奇，对吧？” 她向你走近一步，脸却没有朝向你。双翼漫不经心地挪动着，姿态中并没有特别明显的威胁。“你瞧，在我的故乡，我们早已习惯各种各样的英雄——抱歉，是冠军——从现实破碎的经纬间坠落。他们也带来了自己的习俗，比如万圣夜：那一天，所有听话和调皮的小男孩、小女孩都会装扮成并非自己的模样。无论怪物还是人类，都为了得到甜美的奖励，或者有趣的恶作剧。” 卡希拉抬起帽檐，露出一双散发余烬般光芒的黄色眼眸。“虽然你不肯配合我这场愉快的小把戏——真可惜，我炖的牛肉非常美味——但既然你毁了气氛，总该还有一份可以让我享用的奖励，对吧？”她邪恶地咧嘴笑着，指向自己的胯间；那里已经开始迅速挺立到完全勃起。

rows.original: You've got a mouth, and hands.

rows.translation: 舔弄她的后庭并用手指取悦她

rows.original: Fuck this, you didn't sign up to deal with totally-not-Kasyrra's traps today. You turn heel and run. You run because absolutely fuck everything to do with this woman, and her corruption. You're a good [pc.mf|boy|girl] damnit.
rows.translation: 去他的，你当初注册加入这个游戏的时候，可没打算今天要来应付这些根本与卡希拉无关的陷阱啊。干脆转身逃跑吧……你。运行因为这个女人以及她的腐败行为彻底毁了一切。你真是个不错 [pc.mf|男孩|女孩]该死。

rows.original: Look, you really aren't an idiot here.
rows.translation: 听着，你在这里绝对不是个傻瓜。
rows.raw: "Look, you really aren't an idiot here."

rows.original:
"Treat?" you respond, unsure. The witch — who totally isn't the red-skinned antagonistic demonic cow-girl who's been toying with you — smiles and claps gently, waving you towards a chair.

rows.original: Sara stands up slowly, holding up a pausing hand. "I believe dinner should be ready. I hope you enjoy it... Back in the day I used to make just the finest stews. So rare that I get to indulge in the opportunity." Honestly, you're kind of glad that it's not just a bowl of cum. It certainly smells like the herbacious combination of meat and potato you've come to recognize as stew, but there's no way of knowing when you're alone in the woods with a spooky 'witch.' She doesn't appear to be finished with the surprises however; she reaches into the cauldron with her bare hands before pulling out two already-filled bowls of stew, placing them down on the table. After that, she fetches a couple of loaves of still-warm bread and some tiny plates of pumpkin pie. "There! Isn't magic delightful?" It sure smells delightful... and the look on her face that you catch from beneath her large witchy hat is innocent enough that you don't even put a second thought to straight up spooning a large portion into your mouth. It's... It's... Delicious. The beef all but melts in your mouth, and you've gotten a thick dumpling to bite into that's spongy from soaking up liquids. Swallowing treats you to a delightful aftertaste of ale and black pepper, and your [pc.feet] kick with instinctive joy. You hungrily devour a couple more bites, only slowing at the sudden bright, bubbly giggle from across the table. Looking over at the flickering candlelight reveals Ka— Sara to be smiling warmly, hat tipped up. "You know, no matter how well I cook, normal food doesn't taste the same to me as it... used to. I worried that I might have lost my touch." Wait, she really did cook this? You swallow slowly, feeling your cheeks heat up a little. "It's really good, thanks..." "My pleasure, darling!" The witch claps, picking up her own spoon and taking a mouthful. Indeed, her own expression doesn't seem to shift much. She might as well be eating unflavored porridge for all of the flavor she's getting out of it. Instead of allowing an uncomfortable silence to settle over your conversation, you opt for a question of your own. "So, Sara... would you be willing to tell me about yourself?" She pauses mid-chew before giving a slow swallow of her own. There's a little smugness in her voice when she asks "Interested in little old me?" while she tosses her luscious black hair back. "I suppose I could spin you a tale... it's a tale about a far younger woman than I. An orphaned little cow-girl. A sweet, innocent thing. She practiced magic, in a house of wood and stone made by a loving father. One day, a squirrel spooked her. Just a moment's lapse in concentration was all it took to see that magic become a... rush. It tickled her, deeply, to feel such untapped chaos at her fingertips. It was enough to see her potential... before that rush became a fire." Sara clicks her tongue, turning her spoon between finger and thumb. "She lost everything that day, the house of her father, her father. But still, that rush was something she chased, even though it had already cost her so much. Magic turned from the simple taming of frost..." her free hand's fingers glitter with unshed ice. That ice turns to a trickle of water between her digits, and the smell of ash tickles your nose. "And flame..." "Her tastes became complex, in chasing that rush. To illusion, to enchantment to... summoning and teleportation." 'Sara' takes a deep breath that threatens to burst her dress open. "Oh, but I would be spoiling the tale to tell more of it. If it's even true, it may well not be. Afterall, how many powerful de— witches can say their origin story is a fluffy red squirrel?" She manages to make surprisingly good small talk over the course of your meal, asking polite questions about your exploits... any girls or boys you might be interested in. [pc.hasKids|She takes great pleasure in hearing about your children, before confessing her own seem to grow up just oh-so-fast. They aren't very interested in hanging around her anymore. "Do you wish they did?" you ask, curious. Sara laughs softly, shaking her head. "No, a mother is proud of children. No matter what they accomplish... and most will accomplish very little. If they want to go off and try to make their own way, they have my blessing. Maybe you'll meet a few of the... nicer ones, some day." How ominous, coming from her. ]Eventually your conversation touches the tantalizing subject of sex, and just in time for you to finish the divine pumpkin pie she's baked. Your stomach is full, and you're starting to feel a little sleepiness creep into the back of your mind. "Oh my... [pc.name]. Getting a little sluggish? But the night is so... young." The soft bite at her bottom lip is visible just barely beneath her hat, and with a gentle gesture the plates and dishes at the table float their way into the cauldron. "Perhaps I could... tempt you into a little fun before this rare, wonderful moment ends?" She's sure 'asking', but the idea of turning her down doesn't seem... right. That chocolate-and-silk purr of her voice tickles at you, and instinctively your gaze turns towards the soft, fluffy-looking picnic blankets that rest nearby. When you snap back to her, you see that the only article of clothing that actually remains on your pretend-witch date is a witch's hat. Although you can't make out her jewelry-laden horns or the glow of her monstrous yellow eyes, the rest is a feast for the eyes. Her ruby flesh shines in the remaining candlelight, broken up only by the way stray flickers are captured by her loose, shaggy black hair. Her endlessly plush tits are unrestrained by a dress now, and milk drools slowly from the golden hoops that pierce her dark nipples. While her foursome of wings must have been hidden by some magic — there is no way those large draconic things could have otherwise been stuffed beneath her sheer dress — her long, thick tail flicks side-to-side. Looking at her waist proves to be your undoing at the sight of her giant horse-cock, broad breeder hips, and taut sack that's already glistening with the juices trickling from her unseen slit. She gives you an alluring little hip-wiggle, but much to your surprise there's no... pouncing. It looks like Sar— okay, fuck it, Kasyrra, really is waiting for you to make the first move...

rows.original:
Noticing your approach, Katya grows excited as you seat yourself across from her.
    
    "You're back! But... alone. Did you find anything?" Katya inquires, concern in her eyes. 
    
    You did, but... you're not sure how to put this. Handing her the journal, you tell her to read it for herself. Her eyes rove over the pages, clearly recognizing the handwriting, even if she can't make sense of the jargon throughout the first part of it. You can see her expression turn from one of surprise, to apprehension, until she stumbles upon the sudden shift partway through. Vexation gives way to horror, then to concern, before finally, hope. She looks up at you, a mix of optimism and trepidation writ across her face, before asking you: "Where did you find this?"
    
    You tell her that you found it in a destroyed campsite near the Steps of Sorra. The state of the camp suggested an attack by demons, rather than the imps her brother's team had encountered earlier; they didn't fare too well. The elemental they'd been controlling was in a pretty sorry state, too; her brother's lingering magic in the bracers was the only thing keeping it stable[flags.KATYA_QUEST_ELEMENTAL
        |, until you put the wrecked thing out of its misery
        |
    ].
    
    Katya's ears perk up at the mention of his bracers, and she turns to look at you. "You found his bracers? Where were they? What happened?"
    
    [var0
        |They're right here; you took down the earth elemental that reawakened when you removed them,
        |[flags.KATYA_QUEST_ELEMENTAL
            |You don't have them with you,
            |You left them where they were,
        ]
    ] but they were resting near the core of the damaged elemental, keeping it stable. [pc.isMage
        |Given the repeating enchantment that was cast on them, combined with
        |Given
    ] the fact that they appeared to have been left there deliberately, it seems her brother probably set it up without being in much of a rush. [pc.isDK
        |Pretty stupid of him
        |You can't help but wonder why
    ].
    
    [var0
        |Katya examines the bracers, turning them over in her hands for a bit before handing them back to you
        |Katya thinks for a moment, before looking back at you
    ] and responding. "Maybe it means he did that before whatever fight happened? Or... maybe after. Maybe he's still out there, but... well, who am I kidding. I never understood that mind of his... and I guess it looks like I never will. Thanks for the effort, [pc.name]." With that, Katya returns sullenly to her drink, holding onto the journal.
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Hey, what about a reward?
        |You're glad you could help, but you just wish you could have done more.
    ]
    
    Katya returns her attention to you at that, momentarily surprised. "Shit! I'd almost forgotten, I ought to give you something..."
    
    Katya puzzles over something in her mind for a moment, before reaching a conclusion. Opening the journal, she tears out the pages containing the notes her brother wrote about the spell he came up with, before handing them to you.
    
    "I uh... I don't exactly have much I can offer you, but this is at least something. I was never good at magic, so you'd get more use out of this than me... so, thanks again, [pc.name].[flags.KATYA_QUEST_ELEMENTAL
        | You can keep the bracers, too.
    ]"

        |直到你把那个坏掉的东西从它的“痛苦”中解救出来……
        |
    ]一听到提到他的护手，卡蒂亚立刻竖起了耳朵，然后转过头看着你：“你找到他的护手了？它们在哪里？发生了什么？
    
    [var0

        |[flags.KATYA_QUEST_ELEMENTAL
            |你没有把它们带在身上。
            |你把它们留在了原来的地方。
        ]
    ]但它们正位于那颗受损元素的核心附近，保持着它的稳定性。 [pc.isMage
        |考虑到施加在他们身上的那种重复性魔法效果，再加上……
        |鉴于
    ]看起来这些东西是被人故意放在那里的，因此她的哥哥很可能是在不急于完成这件事的情况下安排了这一切的。 [pc.isDK
        |他真蠢
        |你不禁会想，为什么会是这样呢
    ]。
    
    [var0
        |卡蒂亚仔细地端详着那些护腕，在手中把它们翻来覆去地查看了一会儿，然后才把它们还给了你。
        |卡蒂亚思考了一会儿，然后才再次看向你。
    ]也许这意味着在那场争斗发生之前他就已经那么做了？又或者……也许是在那场争斗之后。也许他现在还在那里，但是……唉，我也在自欺欺人罢了。我从来都不理解他的想法……我想，看来我也永远无法理解了。谢谢你的努力。 [pc.name]说完这句话，卡蒂亚闷闷不乐地回到自己的座位，继续喝着酒，手里还紧握着那本日记。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |嘿，给点奖励怎么样？
        |你很高兴自己能够提供帮助，但同时也希望自己能做得更多。
    ]
    
    这时，卡蒂亚又将注意力转向了你，脸上露出了一丝惊讶：“糟了！我差点忘了，我应该给你些什么的……”

卡蒂亚在心中思考了一会儿，终于得出了一个结论。她打开笔记本，撕下了那些记录着她哥哥所创造的那个咒语的页面，然后把它们交给了你。

“我呃……其实我并没有什么可以给你的，但至少这些东西总归是有些用的。我从来都不擅长魔法，所以这个东西对你来说会更有用……所以，再次感谢你。 [pc.name]。[flags.KATYA_QUEST_ELEMENTAL
        | 你也可以留下这些护腕。
    ]"

rows.original: You haven't forgotten that Katya was clearly deep in thought over something earlier. What was all that about? Katya winces at your probing, clearly not wanting to engage with the subject. You've clearly struck a nerve... but instead of exploding at you, she sighs and looks up at you. "Guess I might as well just tell you. I got... news. I'm not sure if it's good or bad, though. It's about my brother." The surveyor, right? "Yeah, him. A few days back, one of the miners crazy enough to still be going out came back. I grilled him a little, and he said that he saw some folks making a break for it towards Waystation Stenn a few weeks ago. It's a little north of the old Tiran temple, by the crossroads. I asked around more, but the waystation's been abandoned for a while — apparently the contingency plan for if that fell was to make a break for the peaks and hope the harpies are feeling merciful." She's right, that is a pretty mixed bag. "Yeah, I know. Now, I'd love to be able to charge through the tunnels to check on my little brother myself, but if I go out, they won't let me back in. And even if they did, the way I hear it, I might not even make it back. But, now that I think about it..." [silly |Alright, alright, you can already see the 'Check on the mining team' quest marker above her head. Just get to it. |[pc.isDK |Let's guess. She wants you to run an errand through what's practically a war zone? |...Does she want you to go check on the situation? ] ] "Yeah, that's pretty much what I had in mind. If you find him, please just bring him back. He's a citizen, so he shouldn't have too much trouble between that and you accompanying him. And, if you don't... well, please just tell me. That's all I ask."

rows.original: Continuing along the unpaved path towards the Steps, you notice an abandoned stone building off to the side. Approaching the barricaded building, you notice the masonry is engraved with the words "Waystation Stenn." This is the waystation Katya was telling you about! Getting closer, you notice the walls have been gouged by the claws of imps, and some parts of the stone are blackened and pockmarked from magic. It seems this place was being used to make a stand for some time; while there are no signs of life from within, a faint trail can be seen headed north. It looks as if a small group of people may have gone that way.

The size of kobolds, but with bat wings, blood-red skin and horrible, cackling laughs. And there were so many. It was like they were coming out of the fucking walls. [silly |It was game over man, game over! |It was terrifying. ] They kept lunging at us, laughing and cackling... I must have shot down at least half a dozen before I shouted to pull back. Lucius told the men to hold steady, called me a coward... And then Aetius got dragged off into the dark. We booked it after that, made for Waystation Stenn. The crossroads plaza was abandoned, ransacked, but the waystation was open. We've barricaded ourselves in, and are figuring out what to do. I never signed up for this..." This must be the journal you were looking for! It seems like the prospecting crew were attacked by imps, before retreating to the waystation! Continuing on, you flip to the next page. The next entry looks to be written with a steadier hand, but the composed style from the technical report remains gone. "It's been four days since we fortified the waystation. Supplies remain steady, but morale is low. We've been able to make limited trips out from the waystation, but every time we venture too far out, the winged abominations attack. I got a good look at one under the light– as if they weren't putrid enough, these vile things have pricks half the size of a minotaur's. What fell magic could have produced these things, let alone in such numbers? I got lucky yesterday, though. Some time ago, I had worked out an incantation to manipulate a wild earth elemental, but never had the opportunity to test it– Marcus and Pontius were willing to take the chance to acquire some more firepower, though. We subdued one and I was able to control it; it's been a godsend whenever the aberrations have attacked. We can't keep this up forever, though. Puppeting that thing is draining, and the time between the attacks gets shorter each day... we may find ourselves forced to plead with the harpies for passage to the Steps. We're too far from the city to make it, and the tunnels are in utter chaos. We catch echoes of screams, explosions, and, most distressingly... moans. I don't know what's going on out there, and I'm frightened. We'll endure longer yet, but I don't know how long we can hold out." Continuing to the final entry of the journal, you note that almost all of the remaining pages appear blank. Scanning around the desolate campsite for danger, you return to your reading after finding nothing.
rows.translation: 你决定去看看被毁的营地里是否有什么值得注意的东西。[party.isJustPC | | 告诉你的同伴[party.oneCompanion | | ]保持警惕，留意周围环境。 ]你开始四处翻找。你来到那些被毁帐篷中保存最为完好的那一顶，仔细地在废墟中搜寻，希望能找到任何能够证明身份的物品或个人物件。你的努力很快得到了回报——你在一个睡袋里发现了一本厚厚的皮革装书籍。翻开书页，你看到上面写着“测量员报告——Bronzeheart矿业公司所有”。这可能会很有帮助！你翻开书页，立刻[pc.bg scholar |关于山腹深域各条采矿隧道中预计可开采的矿石量以及实际已开采出的矿石量，这些详尽的技术数据数量之多，实在令人震惊。这份记录显然是一位该地区地质学专家的作品。 |这些关于采矿作业的、完全无法理解的文字多得离谱。这本日志肯定是一个精神错乱的人写的……而且这个人肯定对岩石有着某种执念。 ]无论如何，你继续翻阅着那些技术术语，直到在日记的中间部分，内容突然停止了，变成了慌乱无章的涂鸦。 “……这可能表明在轴向剪切带附近存在侧向分泌物，值得进一步研究。注意到绿岩中这种物质的存在量明显增加了——天啊，他们终于找到了病因！我们遭到了某种可怕的带翼生物的攻击。我们成功将它们击退了，但是把他拖进了隧道里。在我们还能阻止它们之前，那些东西就已经出现了。我以前从未见过这样的生物——它们的体型和狗头人差不多，但却长着蝙蝠般的翅膀，皮肤呈血红色，还会发出令人毛骨悚然的咯咯笑声。而且它们的数量多得惊人，仿佛是从墙壁里钻出来的一样。 [silly |游戏结束了，真的结束了！ |那真是太可怕了。 ]他们不停地朝我们冲过来，边笑边嘲弄……我大概开了至少半打枪，才大声命令大家撤退。卢修斯让士兵们保持阵型，还骂我是个胆小鬼……然后艾提乌斯就被拖进了暗影中。之后我们赶紧逃走了，朝着斯坦尼斯中转站方向奔去。那个十字路口的广场已经被废弃，遭到了洗劫，但中转站仍然开着。我们把自己关在里面，正在想办法应对接下来的事情。我当初根本就没想过会陷入这种境地…… 这一定就是你在寻找的日志！看起来，那些勘探队人在撤退到中转站之前，遭到了小妖怪的袭击！你继续翻到下一页，接下来的记录字迹似乎更加稳定了，但那份技术报告中特有的条理清晰的风格依然不见了。 自从我们加固了那个中转站以来，已经过去了四天。物资供应还算稳定，但大家的士气却很低。我们虽然能够从中转站出发进行一些有限的行动，但每次我们走得太远，那些有翼的怪物就会发动攻击。在灯光的照射下，我仔细观察了其中一个——这些可恶的东西，似乎还不够腐烂似的，它们身上长着比弥诺陶洛斯还要小的刺。究竟是什么邪恶的魔法制造出了这些东西，而且数量还这么多？不过，昨天我运气还算不错。不久前，我研究出了一种咒语，可以操控狂野的自然元素，但一直没有机会进行测试——不过，马库斯和庞提乌斯愿意冒险尝试，以此获得更多的战斗力。我们成功制服了一个这样的元素，我也成功控制了它；每当那些异常生物发动攻击时，它真的成了我们的救星。不过，我们不可能永远这样下去。操控那个东西实在太耗费精力了，而且攻击之间的间隔时间也在一天天缩短……我们可能会被迫向那些女妖们恳求，请求她们允许我们通过通道继续前进。我们距离城市太远了，根本无法到达那里，而那些隧道也早已陷入了一片混乱之中。我们能听到尖叫声、爆炸声，还有最令人不安的……呻吟声。我不知道外面发生了什么，我非常害怕。我们还能再坚持一段时间，但我不知道自己还能撑多久。 继续翻阅日记的最后几页，你会发现几乎所有的剩余页面都空空如也。你在荒凉的营地周围仔细搜寻可能存在的危险，但什么也没有发现，于是便继续继续阅读日记。

rows.original: "We made our break for it. Some of the men wanted to make a last stand, go out like heroes... but they aren't fighters, they're miners. I convinced them that we had to leave sooner, rather than later– our windows for escape grow shorter each time. I'm not the foreman, but I am the most educated person here, and I suspect the men value my strategy. It's nice, being relied on... and terrifying. We made a mad dash for the Peaks, hoping to negotiate passage with the harpies, but were attacked on sight. Somehow, we managed to get them to lay down their arms, and convince them to talk... but it was a hell of a fight. After we spent some time pleading, they agreed we could set up a camp near the old Belharan cargo elevator, at least until someone can come to pick us up. Servius insisted that he could make it to the city, that he would rally for help... but I doubt he made it. If anyone could have made the run back, it was probably me... and the men need me here. We're down to four, most of us injured. Five if you count the elemental. He's probably the worst-off out of all of us, though. One of the harpies struck his core, and I've been struggling to stabilize it since. He starts to destabilize if I get too far away from him; the magic in my bracers is all that keeps him together. The situation is poor, but I think we've made it. There's a village nearby, I think we may contact them tomorrow. Whatever those wretched things in the tunnel were, I doubt they'll get past the harpies. I had the time to come up with a new spell while we were holed up at the waystation, it worked wonders against the things. I'll have to jot down the details before I forget them. With luck, we should be able to hold out here until things settle down..." The remainder of the entry is a series of incantations and instructions, detailing [pc.isMage |a clever spell involving the use of shattered stone chips as a weapon |some sort of magic involving a blast of stone chips ]. That might be useful... Regardless, this journal definitely belonged to Katya's brother. You'll have to bring it back to her, even if the picture it paints is... grim, to say the least.
rows.translation: 我们立刻动身离开了。有些人想要进行最后的抵抗，像英雄一样壮烈牺牲……但他们并不是战士，他们只是矿工。我说服了他们，我们必须尽快离开——我们的逃生机会正在一点点减少。虽然我不是工头，但我是这里最有见识的人，而且我猜那些男人也认可我的策略。被人信赖的感觉很好……但同时也让人感到害怕。我们拼命地向那些山峰奔去，希望能与那些女妖谈判取得通行权，但一被看到就遭到了攻击。我们最终设法让他们放下武器，说服他们进行谈判……但这一过程实在充满艰辛。经过一番恳切的劝说，他们同意让我们在老贝尔哈兰货物电梯附近搭建营地，至少等到有人来接我们为止。塞维乌斯坚称自己能够赶到城里，他会去寻求帮助……但我怀疑他是否真的做到了。如果真有人能够完成这段艰难的返回路程，那大概就是我吧……不过现在这里还需要我。我们只剩下四个人了，而且大多数人都受了伤。如果把元素力量也算上的话，那就是五个。不过，在我们所有人当中，他的处境可能最为糟糕。有一只女妖攻击了他的核心部位，从那以后我就一直在努力稳定他的状态。只要我离他太远，他的身体就会开始变得不稳定；而我手上的护腕所蕴含的魔法，才是维持他身体稳定的唯一力量。情况很糟糕，但我觉得我们还是成功了。附近有个村庄，我想明天我们应该能联系上他们。不管隧道里那些该死的东西是什么，我怀疑它们不可能逃过那些“女妖”的追击。在我们躲在路标站的时候，我还有时间发明了一个新的法术，那个法术对那些东西来说简直就是天赐之物。我得把这些细节记下来，免得以后忘记。运气好的话，我们应该能够在这里坚持下去，直到局势稳定下来…… 条目的其余部分是一系列咒语和说明，详细介绍了[pc.isMage |一个巧妙的法术，利用碎石片作为武器来发动攻击。 |某种需要利用石屑爆发的魔法 ]那或许会派上用场……无论如何，这本日记肯定属于卡蒂亚的哥哥。你必须把它还给她，即使它所描绘的内容……至少可以说是相当令人不快的。

rows.original:
[flags.KATYA_QUEST_ROCKS
        |Returning to the rock pile, you find that the bracers are where you left them, continuing to keep the compromised core of the earth elemental in check. 
        |Continuing to look over the campsite, you make your way to the pile of blackened stone by the edge of the site. Looking around, your eyes catch a faint metallic gleam under one rock. Moving it aside reveals a pair of metal bracers and gloves resting by a pulsating, pink sphere. A jagged crack has spread across the orb, thrumming with energy. [pc.isMage
            |Ebbing in time with a faint arcane pulse from the arm-guards, you realize these must be the bracers mentioned in the journal
            |The crackle of energy from within the orb waxes and wanes seemingly at random. However, the bracers seem like a match for the ones in the journal
        ]. Connecting the dots, you understand that these bracers are likely the only thing regulating the damaged core of an earth elemental... one that was being puppeteered against its will before being damaged. The straps of the bracers appear torn, but easy to fix; they were likely left here deliberately. There's no telling what may happen if you take them.
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.KATYA_QUEST_ROCKS
        |回到那堆岩石旁，你发现那些护腕还在原来的地方，它们依然发挥着作用，继续抑制着那受到破坏的大地元素核心。 
        |继续巡视着露营地，你来到了场地边缘那堆烧焦的石头旁。环顾四周，你的目光被一块石头下发出的微弱金属光泽吸引了。将那块石头挪开后，你看到了一副金属护腕和手套，它们就放在一个正在闪烁着粉红色光芒的球体旁边。那个球体表面布满了裂痕，但却不断地散发着能量。 [pc.isMage
            |随着护臂上散发出的微弱神秘脉冲逐渐减弱，你意识到这些应该就是日记中提到的护腕了。
            |那个球体内部散发出的能量波动似乎毫无规律地时强时弱。不过，这些护腕看起来与日记中描述的那些护腕十分相配。
        ]将这些线索联系起来，你就会明白：这些护腕很可能是唯一能够调节那颗受到损伤的大地元素核心的东西……在它受到损伤之前，它其实一直被他人操控着，无法自由行动。这些护腕的带子看起来有些破损，但应该很容易修复；它们很可能是被人故意留在这里的。如果你把它们拿走，后果会怎样，谁也说不准。
    ]

rows.translation: 机遇总是偏爱那些敢于冒险的人。

rows.original: Deciding that you can likely handle whatever a badly-damaged, grouchy elemental can throw at you, you grab the bracers and step back. The ground itself begins to shake as the core instantly begins to violently glow a furious shade of pink, nearby rocks accreting themselves into a vaguely bipedal mass. As the furious elemental reconstructs itself, a shuddering roar echoes forth from it, the damaged core humming with rage! ÜÜÜRRRRRR ZUT ZUT! It's a fight!
rows.translation: 你认为自己完全有能力应对那个受到严重损伤、脾气暴躁的元素生物所发动的一切攻击，于是你抓起护腕，向后退了几步。地面开始震动，那个受损的元素核心立刻发出了剧烈的粉红色光芒，附近的岩石也逐渐聚集在一起，形成了一个形状类似两足生物的怪物。当这个愤怒的元素生物重新凝聚成形时，一声震耳欲聋的咆哮从它口中迸发出来，那个受损的核心正在愤怒地震动着！ 呜呜呜呜呜呜嘟嘟嘟！ 这是一场激烈的战斗！

The ground itself begins to shake as the core instantly begins to violently glow a furious shade of pink, nearby rocks accreting themselves into a vaguely bipedal mass. As the furious elemental reconstructs itself, a shuddering roar echoes forth from it, the damaged core humming with rage! ÜÜÜRRRRRR ZUT ZUT! It's a fight! "

rows.original: Further damaged by your attacks, the Destabilized Earth Elemental explodes in a fiery blast! Among the wreckage of its body and shattered core, little remains, save for the bracers which you grabbed previously.
rows.translation: 在你的攻击下，这个已经失去稳定的大地元素最终爆发出了熊熊火焰！在它残破的躯体与破碎的核心中，几乎什么也没有留下，只有你之前抢走的那些护腕。
rows.raw:
"
    Further damaged by your attacks, the Destabilized Earth Elemental explodes in a fiery blast! Among the wreckage of its body and shattered core, little remains, save for the bracers which you grabbed previously.
    
    "

rows.original: You are knocked to your knees by the vicious assault of the enraged elemental. Looking up at the cracked, pulsating core, your last thoughts are those of panic before an enormous explosion consumes both you and the elemental.
rows.translation: 你被那愤怒的元素生物的猛烈攻击击倒在地。当你抬头望着那裂开、不断脉动的核心时，你脑海中最后的念头只有恐惧——紧接着，一场巨大的爆炸将你和那个元素生物一同吞噬了。
rows.raw: "\n    You are knocked to your knees by the vicious assault of the enraged elemental. Looking up at the cracked, pulsating core, your last thoughts are those of panic before an enormous explosion consumes both you and the elemental.\n    "

rows.original: Unable to brace yourself properly, the elemental's detonation sends you hurtling off of the clifftop! Your last thoughts are those of regret as you hurtle towards the ground, your adventure brought to an untimely end.
rows.translation: 由于没有及时做好防护，那股元素力量的爆炸力将你从悬崖顶端抛了下去！在坠向地面的过程中，你心中充满懊悔，你的冒险就这样过早地结束了。
rows.raw: "\n    Unable to brace yourself properly, the elemental's detonation sends you hurtling off of the clifftop! Your last thoughts are those of regret as you hurtle towards the ground, your adventure brought to an untimely end.\n    "

rows.original: Removing the only thing keeping a highly unstable and likely very upset earth elemental from doing who-knows-what doesn't strike you as a very good idea. Leaving the bracers be, you return to the edge of the campsite.
rows.translation: 移除那唯一能阻止一个极其不稳定、而且很可能非常恼火的大地元素做出什么难以预料之事的东西，在你看来可算不上什么好主意。你决定不去动那些护腕，回到了营地边缘。
rows.raw:
"
    Removing the only thing keeping a highly unstable and likely very upset earth elemental from doing who-knows-what doesn't strike you as a very good idea. Leaving the bracers be, you return to the edge of the campsite.
    
    "

rows.original: As you continue up the peaks, you notice several pieces of debris left atop the wind-blasted stone west of the old elevator. Getting closer, you're able to discern what appears to be a campsite. This must be where the miners had been taking shelter!
rows.translation: 当你继续向山顶攀登时，你会注意到在旧电梯西侧、那些被风侵蚀过的岩石上，散落着一些碎片。靠近一些后，你能够辨认出那些碎片似乎构成了一个营地。这里肯定就是矿工们曾经避难的地方！
rows.raw: "\n    As you continue up the peaks, you notice several pieces of debris left atop the wind-blasted stone west of the old elevator. Getting closer, you're able to discern what appears to be a campsite. This must be where the miners had been taking shelter!\n    "

rows.original: Hmm. This bump to your belly is, despite your curious inspections in the morning before breakfast, not caused by food. It's much more likely that you're pregnant, and it doesn't come as much of a surprise given how long you spent impaled and gasping on throbbing leothran cocks in Vari's village. It looks like you'll be delivering some fuzzy kittens in the future...
rows.translation: 嗯，你肚子上的这个凸起，尽管你早上在吃早餐之前仔细检查过了，但它并不是由食物引起的。更有可能的是你怀孕了。考虑到你在瓦里的村庄里花了那么长时间被那些震动的莱奥特兰雄性生物刺穿、喘不过气来，这一点也不足为奇。看来将来你可能会生下一群毛茸茸的小猫呢……
rows.raw: "\n Hmm. This bump to your belly is, despite your curious inspections in the morning before breakfast, not caused by food. It's much more likely that you're pregnant, and it doesn't come as much of a surprise given how long you spent impaled and gasping on throbbing leothran cocks in Vari's village. It looks like you'll be delivering some fuzzy kittens in the future...\n "

rows.original:
Oof. This is either one adventurous kitten, or a couple of siblings — you can feel little paws inquisitively pressing down on things inside you, and while it might be endearing it's also uncomfortable. Sighing, you rub your bulging tummy affectionately until the ruckus calms down and your child — or children — go back to resting, their need for movement sated.
    
    "You can run around and play when you're born, thank you very much," you murmur.
rows.translation:
哎哟。肚子里要么是一只特别爱冒险的小猫，要么是一对兄弟姐妹——你能感觉到那些小爪子好奇地按压着你体内的东西，虽然这挺可爱的，但也让人不太舒服。你叹了口气，温柔地揉了揉自己鼓起的肚子，直到那阵闹腾平息下来，你的孩子——或者孩子们——重新安分地休息，它们的活动欲望得到了满足。
    
    “等你出生以后再去到处跑着玩吧，真是多谢你了。”你喃喃自语道。

rows.original: Your tummy is [var0 |so outwardly swollen now that your pregnancy is blatantly obvious to anyone around you, though strangely the closer you get to birth and the more inconvenient movement becomes, the less you mind. Rather, you're happy to be giving birth to what seems like — if the constant movement and prodding is any indication — a healthy child, or maybe two. Delivery can't be that far away by now. |so large now that you're sure you must be having at least triplets, and maybe even quadruplets. The thought of having four furry little terrors is a little intimidating but you've come to love them all already, even if they do constantly bug you with their movement and prodding. Delivery can't be far away at this point. |absurdly swollen at this point, bulging outwards to a degree usually only seen in human women bearing the child of minotaurs. You must be having quintuplets or even sextuplets, and the daily poking and prodding from inside all but confirms it. Nevertheless, you already love each one of them and can't wait to see them born — which can't be far away by now. ]

rows.original: Oh! You strain to stay standing as a contraction strikes you, setting your legs aquiver. Looks like it's time to head to the nursery...
rows.translation: 哦！当你突然感到一阵肌肉痉挛时，你拼命地想要站稳，但双腿却开始颤抖起来。看来，是时候去婴儿房了……
rows.raw: "\n Oh! You strain to stay standing as a contraction strikes you, setting your legs aquiver. Looks like it's time to head to the nursery...\n "

rows.original: Your labor is, thankfully, relatively easy. [pc.heightRange 0 71 86 |Though the intensity of delivering [var0 |a larger-than-average child for someone of your size takes a serious amount of energy out of you and leaves your body covered in sweat, you're both safe and that's what matters. |a couple of larger-than-average children for someone of your size takes a serious amount of energy out of you and leaves your body covered in sweat, you're all safe and that's what matters. |several larger-than-average children for someone of your size takes a serious amount of energy out of you and leaves your body covered in sweat, you're all safe and that's all that matters. ] |You're about the size of a leothran woman as it is and delivery proves painless, though it does leave your body covered in sweat with the effort of birthing [var0 |the child |the children |several children ]. |As large as you are delivering leothran babies is simple, though you find yourself covered in sweat after birthing [var0 |the child |the children |several children ] regardless. ] Gwyn swaddles [var1 |the children |your child ] in towels and presents [var1 |them |it ] to you, beaming in delight. [var2 |[var1 |"They are adorable," she fusses, petting their heads. "Oh, so delightful! Leothrans are so cute!" |"What an adorable baby," she fusses, petting its head. "Oh, so delightful! Leothrans are just so cute." ] "Aren't they?" you say, smiling down at your child[var1 |ren ]. "I'll have to take [var1 |them |[rand |him |her ] ] to mommy two over at the village, but for now I think we need some rest." "Now there's a good idea," Gwyn says, now patting your head. "Get some sleep, [pc.name]. You'll need it for tomorrow." You lay your head back and fall into unconsciousness the moment you shut your eyes, dreamless sleep taking you by surprise. |[var1 |"They are adorable," she fusses, petting their heads. "Oh, so delightful! Are they leothran?" |"What an adorable baby," she fusses, petting its head. "Oh, so delightful! Is it leothran?" ] "Yes," you say, smiling down at your child[var1 |ren ]. "From a village not too far from here... I met a gatherer from the tribe and one thing led to another." "A village!" Gwyn says excitedly. "I'd heard tales that they lived north of here but I'd never thought they'd be, well, this close. Oh, [var1 |they're |it's ] so cute! Do they grow up large?" "Oh, yeah," you say, nodding. "Most of the men are around seven or eight feet tall, and the women aren't far behind." "Gosh! Your little [var1 |kittens are |kitten is ] going to be huge," she exclaims. "I'll take care of them with lots of food, don't worry." "Actually..." you say, thinking it over. You look down at your newborn child[var1 |ren ], all fur and fluff. You're not sure that it's quite right to keep a leothran baby here... the tribe has their own culture, and you remember hearing from Vari that their population isn't particularly high. It's not like you're taking babies away from them —[var1 |they're your babies |it's your baby ]— but you'd feel sorry for any child that had grow up on its lonesome without proper support. Besides, Vari mentioned they fed special herbs to their children, and they only grow around the village as far as you know. Or they build the villages near them. In any case, the more you think about keeping leothran children here, the less you like the idea. They do say it takes a village to raise a child... and it's not like their village is that far. You could visit whenever you liked. "I think I'm going to let the village raise [var1 |them |it ]," you murmur, a slight melancholy taking you. "Okay, okay," Gwyn soothes you, bending over and stroking your head. "It's okay, [pc.name]. You're making the right decision. Right now, though, you need to sleep. Rest with your bab[var1 |ies |y ], why don't you." She's right — you do need sleep. You lay your head back and fall into unconsciousness the moment you shut your eyes, dreamless sleep taking you by surprise. ]

rows.original: [var0 |Despite Gwyn's chiding, you travel to the outskirts of the leothran village once more the very next day. It's there that you hand your newly-born child[var1 |ren | ] to Vari, watching her coddle [var1 |them |the baby ] before talking it over with you. She seems happy to be a mom again, and as an adventurer you just don't have the time to commit to it. Maybe when all this blows over you can retire, but until then... You find yourself back in Hawkethorne between mid-afternoon and evening, seeking a bed. The moment you re-enter the inn you [bedmateFH. |[bedmateFH.isMulti brint brienne quin kiyoko |pull Brint into bed and fall to sleep between his arms |tug Brienne into bed and fall asleep in her arms |pull a somewhat surprised Quin into bed and fall asleep with your head laid against his chest |take Kiyoko to bed and fall asleep hugging her |go to bed with [bedmateFH.name] and fall asleep ] |toss yourself into bed and fall asleep ] almost immediately, the fatigue of your exertions catching up to you. When you awaken, you're hungry. Luckily, Garth has some food for you already cooked, hot and just waiting to be eaten. It fills at least one of the voids inside you right now, and the other will fade with time. Speaking of, you should go looking for Vari sometime to see how your kitten[var1 |s are | is ] doing. For now, it's business as usual. |Though Gwyn tells you to get some rest the next day, you're not to be deterred. You set out [party.solo |alone |with [party.compNames] ] towards the leothran village, your kittens carefully tucked away with some furs, and run across Vari out picking herbs. Straightening up, she gives you a warm smile and approaches you. "Hello, [pc.name]," Vari says, looking you over. "Is everything okay? You look tired." "I am a little tired," you admit. "I just gave birth yesterday." "What!" she gasps, clapping her hands to her face. "[pc.name], you need to be at home! Resting!" "I wanted to..." you say, bending down and loosening your backpack. "Here." Vari leans over and takes a curious peek inside your backpack, a slight intake of breath escaping her lips. "Oh... oh, you're adorable." You lift [var1 | a kitten out and present it |the leothran kitten out and present it ] to Vari, smiling a little sadly as you watch their embrace. Yeah... that looks about right. "I thought that [var1 |leothran children |a leothran child ] might do better with the tribe, rather than being brought up in Hawkethorne," you say, watching your kitten stretch as Vari murmurs to it. "I thought maybe you could be their mother while I'm not there." "Oh," Vari says, sounding like she's been stuck by an arrow as her eyes fill with tears. "Oh, [pc.name]." She pulls you into a fierce hug and squeezes, enveloping you with the fur of her body and tail while you hug her back. Your kitten gives a meow when the two of you separate, and you [var1 |hand Vari the others. |can't help but smile. ] "I'm sorry to put this on you, Vari," you say, but she's already shaking her head. "Don't be," she says. "I'm so happy, [pc.name]. Both that our tribe is growing and that I'll have children to take care of again" Vari smiles warmly. "They're going to have the nicest childhood I can give them. They'll make you proud, I promise." "Thanks, Vari," you say. "I'm going to get back home and take some rest... but I'll come see the kittens soon, okay?" "Of course," Vari says, nodding. "Come see them whenever you like, [pc.name]. I'll be taking care of them." With a wave you turn and start trudging back towards Hawkethorne, leaving your kitten[var1 |s ] behind. It feels like the journey back takes a lot longer. rows.raw: ' [var0 |Despite Gwyn's chiding, you travel to the outskirts of the leothran village once more the very next day. It's there that you hand your newly-born child[var1 |ren | ] to Vari, watching her coddle [var1 |them |the baby ] before talking it over with you. She seems happy to be a mom again, and as an adventurer you just don't have the time to commit to it. Maybe when all this blows over you can retire, but until then... You find yourself back in Hawkethorne between mid-afternoon and evening, seeking a bed. The moment you re-enter the inn you [bedmateFH. |[bedmateFH.isMulti brint brienne quin kiyoko |pull Brint into bed and fall to sleep between his arms |tug Brienne into bed and fall asleep in her arms |pull a somewhat surprised Quin into bed and fall asleep with your head laid against his chest |take Kiyoko to bed and fall asleep hugging her |go to bed with [bedmateFH.name] and fall asleep ] |toss yourself into bed and fall asleep ] almost immediately, the fatigue of your exertions catching up to you. When you awaken, you're hungry. Luckily, Garth has some food for you already cooked, hot and just waiting to be eaten. It fills at least one of the voids inside you right now, and the other will fade with time. Speaking of, you should go looking for Vari sometime to see how your kitten[var1 |s are | is ] doing. You set out [party.solo |alone |with [party.compNames] ] towards the leothran village, your kittens carefully tucked away with some furs, and run across Vari out picking herbs. Straightening up, she gives you a warm smile and approaches you. "Hello, [pc.name]," Vari says, looking you over. "Is everything okay? You look tired." "I am a little tired," you admit. "I just gave birth yesterday." "What!" she gasps, clapping her hands to her face. "[pc.name], you need to be at home! Resting!" "I wanted to..." you say, bending down and loosening your backpack. "Here." Vari leans over and takes a curious peek inside your backpack, a slight intake of breath escaping her lips. "Oh... oh, you're adorable." You lift [var1 | a kitten out and present it |the leothran kitten out and present it ] to Vari, smiling a little sadly as you watch their embrace. Yeah... that looks about right. "I thought that [var1 |leothran children |a leothran child ] might do better with the tribe, rather than being brought up in Hawkethorne," you say, watching your kitten stretch as Vari murmurs to it. "I thought maybe you could be their mother while I'm not there." "Oh," Vari says, sounding like she's been stuck by an arrow as her eyes fill with tears. "Oh, [pc.name]." She pulls you into a fierce hug and squeezes, enveloping you with the fur of her body and tail while you hug her back. Your kitten gives a meow when the two of you separate, and you [var1 |hand Vari the others. |can't help but smile. ] "I'm sorry to put this on you, Vari," you say, but she's already shaking her head. It is a few days... but it's also just a few days, you know? |Dad keeps on telling me how much you're working not just for Hawkethorne, but for the people of the Marches as a whole — even if it's just a couple of days, I know how valuable your time is." [pc.isDK |Well then, if she knows the value of your time, she'd be best served to make the trip worthwhile |You may have your qualms with how Sanders behaved back in the day, but she doesn't share in any of that sordid story ]. Like she said, it'll be two or three days. ] ] "Even two or three days is a lot when it comes to your time," she laughs. Okay, enough flattery, or you'll never get started. What's this tip that she's procured while you were out? "Right, right. I was asking around, and obviously Dad wasn't lying when he said that he didn't tell anyone at all about where he hid the Dawnsword. That being said, River recounted something interesting that happened about a decade back." Oh? A nod. "He tells me that part of the mountainside by the eastern end of the River Tarahugan collapsed into a massive sinkhole and the tremors reached all the way to Hawkethorne; the centaurs were naturally jittery about it and it was on the border with lands occupied by the gnolls, so it took some time to get around to it. When they did, all they found was a big pit that led straight into the earth — when nothin' horrible came out of it like they do in old Belhar, everyone simply heaved a sigh of relief and pretended it'd always been there. If anything, it was a good thing now that there was another obstacle on the border with gnoll lands. "It wouldn't've caught my attention if not for the detail River added: that when the tremor was happenin', some people — him included — saw a beam of brilliant golden light shoot up into the sky from the epicenter of the quake. It lasted for maybe five seconds, but enough eyes saw it that everyone agreed there's no way it was a trick of the light. When people finally found the nerve to investigate, all that was left was that big sinkhole in the ground." Interesting. And what does Sanders think of this? "He says that while he remembers this happenin', it was the middle of the night and by the time he'd roused himself and gone to the chapel window there wasn't any beam of light, if it'd ever been there." So, you take it that this trip is going to be down into the sinkhole, then? "That's the plan. Given that it's far out enough that I haven't had the opportunity to scout out the locale, I don't know what we'll find at the bottom or even how deep it really goes, but we'll figure that out when we get there. It's a bit of a stretch, but it's all we've got to go on as opposed to Dad's 'you'll know it when you see it' shtick." All right, then. Let's be off.

“没错，就是这个计划。由于那个地方距离太远了，我还没有机会去实地考察，所以我不知道那里到底有什么，也不知道那个天坑到底有多深。不过等我们到了那里，自然就会知道答案了。这有点牵强，但这也是我们目前所掌握的唯一线索了，总比爸爸那句“见到就知道了”之类的说法强吧。 好吧，那我们出发吧。

rows.original: River gives you a wary look, then nods slowly. "Right, that artifact. I remember seeing it with him when we were riding north to settle Hawkethorne — Sanders didn't wave it around, but he wasn't ashamed of it, either. As far as he was concerned, it was just a backup weapon like the Minoan legions have, no more, no less. I'm sorry to say that I don't know where he secreted it away after that whole ugly business with Gweyr, but I do have a lead you'll want to check out." He does? "Oh, yes. Thing is, once I spill the beans, you're going to want to act on that information immediately, so you'd better be prepared for a trip out to Harvest Valley before asking me for the details. Could take two or three days, if I'm not wrong, and you'll want to be adequately supplied for rough terrain. If you don't think you're prepared, it's better to hold back — I'd rather wait a bit longer and let you get yourself sorted out than have you run into a hitch mid-adventure because you weren't adequately prepared. After all you've done for our village, I'd feel bad sending you a whole handbasket of trouble. "Now... are you ready?"
rows.translation: 瑞弗警惕地看了你一眼，然后缓缓点了点头。“好吧，那个那件神器。我记得当我们一起向北前往鹰棘镇定居时，看到他带着它。桑德斯并没有刻意炫耀它，但也不觉得羞于拥有它。在他看来，那只不过是一件像米诺斯军团所使用的那种备用武器而已，没有更多意义。很遗憾，关于他在与格维尔那场闹剧之后把东西藏在了哪里，我确实不知道。不过，我有一个线索，你肯定想了解一下。 他真的有线索？ “哦，没错。问题是，一旦我把这个线索告诉你，你就必须立刻采取行动，所以在你向我询问详细情况之前，最好先准备好去丰收谷一趟。如果我没弄错的话，这个过程可能需要两三天的时间。在面对崎岖的地形时，你们需要做好充分的准备。如果你觉得自己还没有准备好，最好暂时推迟行动——我宁愿再等一段时间，确保你们一切都准备妥当，也不想让你们在冒险过程中因为准备不足而遇到麻烦。既然你为我们村庄做了这么多，如果再给你带来一堆麻烦，我会感到内疚的。 “那么……你准备好了吗？

rows.original: All right, since he's so sure that you'll want to head off running once you hear his tip, you're all ready to set off at a moment's notice. Now, out with it. "It's true that Sanders didn't tell me where he buried the Dawnsword, but something interesting happened ten years ago. It was just a peaceful evening in Hawkethorne when we had a powerful set of tremors come from down south in Harvest Valley — for all the volcanic activity down beneath the minotaur kingdom, actual quakes are pretty rare. This one was strong enough to knock me off my seat, so I remember it quite well. That, and the beam of light that shot up into the sky." A beam of light, he says. "Oh yes. Brilliant, thin and golden as it threaded the heavens — a dazzling needle that lit up the night sky for all of three breaths before everything was dark again. The marefolk and centaurs came up to the village before dawn, saying they wanted to go and see but didn't want to go it alone; it took a little convincing, but all three parties sent out a joint force at dawn to have a look-see." What happened? "Part of the mountain range had collapsed into a massive sinkhole, right by the eastern flow of the Tarahugan." River strikes out a dolorous chord on his instrument. "Garth and I were scared shitless, pardon my language, but when nothing horrible and wretched crawled out of the earth to devour us all like what happens in old Belhar we breathed a collective sigh of relief." Sanders buried it twenty years ago, and this happened ten? No, this doesn't add up. "I'm just telling you what happened, [pc.name]. Maybe something happened after it lay dormant for a decade. Maybe it isn't even related to the Dawnsword at all. But it's better than wandering around the mountains blindly, isn't it? Sanders came out to investigate with us, but didn't have anything to say about the light; he said he'd been sleeping when the tremors happened and by the time he'd been roused and went to the chapel window to take a look-see, it was all over." What of the sinkhole, anyway? "Nothing. After a bit of discussion, the marefolk and centaurs agreed to pretend it'd always been there. If anything, it was a good thing now that there was another obstacle on the border with gnoll lands so those savages would find it harder to ravage the western half of the valley past the lake." You see. All right, you get what he's trying to tell you — someone ought to rappel down into this sinkhole and finally figure out what's at the bottom? River coughs. "I didn't say anything of the sort, that's on you, my dear friend. And if Sanders asks, I certainly didn't tell you anything, and this conversation never happened. Seriously, though, I can't promise you that you'll find what you're looking for at the end of this road... but it's a road as opposed to meandering mindlessly." All right, then, thanks for the tip. You'll be heading off, then.
rows.translation: 好吧，既然他这么确信你听到他的提示后就会立刻动身离开，那么你们现在也已经随时准备出发了。那么，快说吧。 “的确，桑德斯没有告诉我他把晨曦剑埋在了哪里，但是十年前发生了一件有趣的事情。在鹰棘镇这个宁静的夜晚，我们突然感受到了来自哈维斯特谷地南部的强烈震动——尽管米诺陶尔王国的地下蕴藏着大量的火山活动，但真正的地震其实相当罕见。那次地震的震力大到足以把我从座位上震下来，因此我对此记忆十分清晰。还有那道射向天空的光芒。 一束轻型，”他说。 “哦，没错。那光束璀璨夺目，细如金线，划过夜空——就像一根耀眼的针，将夜空点亮了整整三秒钟，之后一切又重新陷入暗影。马人族和半人马们在黎明前来到了村庄，说他们想去看看，但又不想独自前往；经过一番劝说，最终这三方在黎明时分联合起来，一起去一探究竟。 发生了什么事？ “那片山脉有一部分塌陷了，形成了一个巨大的天坑，正好位于塔拉胡甘河的东岸。”瑞弗用他的乐器奏出了一段充满悲伤的旋律，“加斯和我当时吓得要死，恕我言辞粗俗，但当没有什么可怕的东西从地里爬出来吞噬我们所有人时——就像在古老的贝尔哈尔发生的那样——我们才终于松了一口气。 桑德斯在二十年前就把这件事掩盖了，而现在这种事情又发生了？不，这根本说不通啊。 “我只是在告诉你当时发生了什么而已。 [pc.name]也许在它沉寂了十年之后，发生了什么。也许它甚至与“晨曦剑”毫无关系。但总比在山里盲目地四处游荡要好吧？桑德斯也和我们一起出来调查，但他对那道光束一无所知；他说地震发生时他正在睡觉，等他醒来走到小教堂的窗前去看时，一切都已经结束了。那么那个天坑呢？” “没什么。经过一番讨论，马人族和半人马族一致同意假装它本来就存在于那里。事实上，它不错现在，由于与兽人领地的边界上又出现了新的障碍，那些野蛮人想要袭击湖边山谷的西半部分就会变得更加困难了。 你明白我的意思吧？总之，总得有人爬进这个天坑，弄清楚下装到底有什么吧？ 瑞弗轻咳了一声，说道：“我根本没有说过那样的话，这是你自己的想法，我亲爱的朋友。如果桑德斯问起的话，我肯定会说根本没跟你说过什么，这段对话也从未发生过。不过说真的，我无法保证你在这条路上最终能找到你想要的东西。……但这是一条笔直的道路，而不是那些毫无方向、蜿蜒曲折的小路。” 好吧，那么，谢谢你的建议。那你应该准备出发了。
