        The little kitten boy smiles and pulls his poncho over his brow. "Sure, take your time. I'm not going anywhere, and if the Dawnsword's still wherever old man Sanders left it after two decades, a little longer in all likelihood isn't going to make the slightest bit of difference. Ask me again afterwards when you're ready, okay?"
        
        You'll do that.
        
        "You know where to find me when you're ready to set off, [pc.name]. No need to be a stranger, now."
        "

rows.original: The trip out of Hawkethorne is uneventful — following [var0 |Liaden's lead |River's directions ], you head south into Harvest Valley and stick to the Tarahugan's course. Perhaps thanks to the urgency of your quest, you make it down to the southeastern portion of the valley unmolested, and go around the lake's edge to the east. [var0 |"This is supposed to be gnoll territory," Liaden mutters as the lake's western shore gradually vanishes from view. "I've never been here before, and for good reason; everyone I asked in town said it was a good idea to stay away from 'em. The marefolk and centaurs have been at loggerheads with them forever, but never managed to drive the gnolls from the valley altogether, just keep 'em penned up on the eastern side. Things may appear peaceful, but nevertheless... we oughta be on our guard." [party.has azyrran |[azyrran.kdb |"Hey, don't worry," Azzy offers. "We got this! Lance and polearm, you and me[flags.LIAZZY_3SUM | and [pc.name] ] together against them — mmm..." Lia blushes. "[azzy.liaden |C'mon, Azzy, there're people around |Yeah ]..." |"Tch, don't you worry," Azyrran purrs soothingly, reaching over and tousling Liaden's hair. "Is my precious pet afraid to confront a couple of bandits?" "Azzy, we're in public..." [liaden.poly |"[pc.name] doesn't count as public," the hornet ripostes. "The three of us get very private together, don't we?" [party.comp agnimitra arona atugia brienne brint cait etheryn kiyoko quintillus viviane |"I count as public!" Agnimitra points out. |"How is it," Arona says sourly, "that I'm the only one in this group that's not gettin' laid?" |Tui, too embarrassed to actually butt in, attempts to hold in a cough. |"Hee hee hee." Brienne tries to stifle her giggle and fails utterly. "You three are the worst." |Brint chuckles. "Hey, if you three need a break, I can take a hike 'til you're done." |Cait bats her eyelashes at you. "Is that privacy just for Lumians, or do Mallachites get invited too?" |Furiously blushing, Etheryn stares off in another direction, whistles out of tune, and tries to busy herself with her bird. |The silence coming from Kiyoko is absolutely deafening. |"Don't mind me," Quin laughs. |"Bandits!" Viviane hums. "I'll go... make sure that there aren't any of those around." ] |[azyrran.fucked |"[pc.name] isn't public," she chuckles. "You're both my lovely cute bottoms. I've plenty of love for each of you, but that means you must learn to share — and not be quite so self-conscious." |Azzy gestures theatrically at the open skies and rolling grasslands of the vast valley. "Public with not another soul in sight for ages. You're cute when you're self-conscious like this, Liaden." ] ] |"It'll be fiiiiine," Azyrran insists. The bubbly bug flutters her eyelashes. "But I do feel super grateful that I've got a brave paladin to protect me..." "Azzy, we're in public!" The hornet gestures theatrically at the open skies and rolling grasslands of the vast valley. "C'mon, cutie! [liaden.poly |Our [pc.name] is here, so it's not even |[azyrran.fucked |[pc.name] is just as important to me as you are — [pc.heShe] |I ]t's not ] really public. Live a little!" ] [liaden.poly |Hey now. Let's... let's stay focused. At least for now. Besides, look: |[azyrran.fucked |That's right; she's got to own it. |Oh, really. The two of them need to get a tent already. ] And look, there it is — ] the sinkhole [liaden.poly |we've |she's ] been looking for. That's it, right? |[liaden.poly |Sure, yeah. But still, it's the two of you together. You've got this. Besides — that's the sinkhole we're looking for right up there, isn't it? |But of course — you're on an important task, and given your experience with this whole adventuring thing that means that existence itself is liable to throw troubles in your way. But look, there's the sinkhole that she's looking for right there, isn't it? ] ] |As the western lakeshore disappears from view, you go over what people have said about the eastern side of Harvest Valley — namely, that it's gnoll country. Raiders slip over every so often to harass the occasional farmstead, not to destroy but simply to take whatever's easily purloinable. The marefolk and centaurs have been at loggerheads with them forever, but have never managed to drive the gnolls from the valley altogether, just hold them in the eastern side; things may appear peaceful, but you nevertheless ought to be on your guard. After all, you're on an important task, and given your experience with this whole adventuring thing that means that existence itself is liable to throw troubles in your way. But look, you've already come this far without being harassed, and there's the sinkhole that River mentioned right there, isn't it? ] And so it is. The land starts to slope downwards a couple dozen paces from the water's edge where it would have met the feet of the hills, slowly at first, but rapidly growing steeper and steeper until soil gives way to a dusty rock face, cleanly vertical as it disappears into the darkness beneath. No, [dayNight |even though the sun's beating down on you from above, ]there's no sign of a bottom to this pit; on a whim, you pick up a stone and toss it down into the sinkhole. Yep, no sound whatsoever returns from the emptiness that yawns under. It's a good thing that these two dozen paces of earth exist, otherwise the Tarahugan would be draining into the abyss instead of out to sea. [var0 |"Wow," Liaden murmurs, peeking cautiously over the edge of the sinkhole, careful not to fall in. "To think this used to be part of the mountains' base. I brought a lot of rope, but I'm starting to wonder if it'll be enough..." Well, you'll be finding out soon enough, right? "Yeah. C'mon, [pc.name], we've got our work cut out for u-" Liaden's words cut into a sharp gasp as her foot catches on something in the long grass. [party.has azyrran |Azzy wastes no time in tackling you both, knocking you out of the way |You waste no time in tackling her, pushing the both of you out of the way ] |[party.hasCompanions |"Wow," [comp1.name] murmurs, peering cautiously over the edge of the sinkhole, careful not to accidentally fall in. "And this used to be part of the mountains' feet? We brought a lot of rope, but I can't help but wonder if it's sufficient..." Well, you'll be finding out soon enough, yes? "We will. Looks like we've got our work cut out for us, [pc.name]. I thi-" [companion1.name] suddenly gasps as [companion1.hisHer] foot catches on something in the long grass, and you waste no time in tackling [companion1.himHer] out of the way |As you're contemplating your next move, your foot catches on something in the long grass, and you barely manage to leap out of the way in time ] ] as sharp stakes hidden in the ground suddenly arc upwards, their pointed wooden tips alive with malicious intent. This isn't right... you've never seen gnolls build traps like these, even if they're little more than sharpened stakes and tense rope. You have barely enough time to steady yourself and get your hands on your [pc.weapon] when the tall grass rustles and golden-brown spotted shapes erupt from the underbrush. How they'd managed to conceal themselves so thoroughly amongst stalks no higher than your waist and get within a dozen paces of [party.combatNames] in the bargain would have been impressive, if it weren't the one thing gnolls weren't notoriously good at. Quickly forming a circle to surround you, the hyena-people lower the business ends of their flint spears at you, clearly meaning business. [var0 |"How in all the gods' names do they manage to hide in grass that's only waist-high?" Liaden exclaims as she readies her halberd. "I just walked over that spot moments ago!" [silly |Look at it this way: if a massive iconic handheld game monsters weighing over a ton can remain completely invisible in waist-high grass up until one steps on the damned thing, something a little smaller than the size of an average person can damn well remain hidden until it's time to pounce. |Well, you guess there has to be a benefit to being that hunched and looking half-starved all the time. The less gnoll there is, the easier it is to hide, isn't that right? ] Liaden just makes an exasperated noise in the back of her throat and focuses her attention on the nearest gnoll. ] Despite having the advantage of surprise, though, the gnolls don't press the attack, instead continuing to surround you, the weight of many hungry, beady eyes setting your [pc.skinFurScales] alight with sheer ravening hysteria. Their yipping, hooting and guttural laughter fills the air as they hold their position, preventing you from making a break for it; although most of their words are gibberish to you, there's at least one you understand: "Prey! Prey!" [party.has azyrran |[azzy.isBimbo |"Ugh," Azzy groans. "They're so stinky. I wish I could do a magic hand thing and make them go away. [liaden.poly|Lia? [pc.name]?|[var0 |Lia? |[pc.name]? ]] Can you do a magic hand thing?" |"Gnoll bandits," Azyrran spits. "You'll never find a more wretched hive of scum and villainy in all of the Marches." ] ] [var0 |"What's up with them?" Liaden wonders aloud. "Why aren't they engaging?" [party.has azyrran |[azzy.isBimbo |Azzy shrugs helplessly. "I dunno! It's weird, right?" |"Maybe they're trying to demoralize us," Azzy replies, not taking her eyes off the gnoll leering at her. "Don't think it's working, though." ] ] |[party.hasCompanions |"What's up with them?" [companion1.name] wonders aloud. "Why aren't they engaging?" |They certainly seem worked up for the hunt, but they haven't moved to engage you yet. Wonder what's up with that? ] ] The question's answered when two of the gnolls part to admit another of their number, a female — at a first glance, she appears to be taller than her kin, but that's quickly revealed to not be the case. If anything, she's actually shorter than the other gnolls, only she stands up straight instead of hunching over like all the others. That alone gives her an air of authority by gnoll standards, a presence that the others lack; the others clearly revere her as they fall over themselves to genuflect before her passage in their own way. "Queen! Queen!" "Princess," the newcomer gently corrects her subjects as they shower her with their slavish adoration. She's got a crude gladius in hand — perhaps a cast-off from some minotaur legionnaire — and does a fancy little twirl with it before leveling the pointy end at you. "And who might you be to walk within my lands?" [pc.isDK |Her lands? Why, you were under the impression that in order to claim land, one was expected to work it and make it productive, be the claimant the highest royalty or the basest peasant settler. From the looks of the east end of Harvest Valley, it's certainly pretty wild. To your mild surprise, the self-proclaimed gnoll princess doesn't react with anger, but rather exasperation. "You don't need to tell me, I'm reminded of the state of my affairs every. Single. Day." |Her lands? By whose or what authority does she actually claim these lands, especially so close to the lakeside border? The gnoll princess' only answer to that is to slice the heads off several tall grasses, sending them scattering to the winds — for all its tarnish, the blade actually still holds an edge. "Why, they're spear-won lands, of course... or sword-won, in my case. If you can take and hold it, it's yours. Same rules as everybody else has." ] [var0 |Meanwhile, Liaden's caught onto something you've taken for granted — she hasn't spoken up throughout this entire exchange, but when she does it's with wide eyes. "Wait. Did you take... elocution lessons or somethin'? You're downright articulate in Belharan." |[party.hasCompanions |Meanwhile, [companion1.name] has caught onto something you've taken for granted — [companion1.heShe] hasn't spoken up throughout this entire exchange, but when [companion1.heShe] does it's with wide eyes. "You speak. You're actually articulate, and in Belharan, no less." |Suddenly, it strikes you. The so-called gnoll princess — you've been holding a conversation with her, an actual coherent articulate Belharan-language conversation instead of the usual broken words, snarls, and yips that gnolls resort to. What's going on here? ] ] The gnoll princess sneers, half-bitter, half- sour. "Surprised? In the land of the blind, the one-eyed man is king... which I guess, considering my circumstances, makes me some kind of amazing genius. And since I'm so gifted, that means the burden of rulership falls upon me." She calls herself princess. That means there's a queen, right? A scowl. "Princess sounds more euphonious, thank you very much. Queen would be more accurate, but I'd prefer to imagine myself with fewer of the duties and more of the privileges that being who I am entails. Now then, back to the point. What are you doing here?" Oh, you're just examining the sinkhole, that's all. There might be something interesting down there, and you're going to rappel down for the thrill of it, even if in all likelihood there's nothing at the lightless, forbidding bottom. If these are her lands and the hole has been here forever, surely she's interested in knowing what's beneath her feet? The gnoll princess looks conflicted at that — for a ruler, one supposes that she hasn't had many opportunities to practice statecraft, especially hiding one's actual thoughts during negotiations. It's as plain as day that she doesn't actually care about the sinkhole as-is, but for all that, she's no more inclined to give something away for free than any other southlands despot; the fact that you want access to the sinkhole makes her instinctively want to not let you have it. Eventually, she mulls it over for all of a minute while tension hangs palpably in the air, then bares her teeth at you in her eerie version of a smile. "I don't really care about a hole in the ground that's never been a problem for us, especially when it's on poor land that's bordering the mountains. On the other hand, I can't quite let you do as you please here without some kind of obsequiecense from you — if nothing else, my subjects will think less of me if we trap prey and don't wring something out of your sorry hides." [var0 |"Hey, the fact that you're willing to talk terms and accept tribute already makes this whole encounter better than I was expectin'," Liaden says, not loosening her grip on her halberd. "I was sure that [pc.name][party.has azyrran |, Azzy ] and I were going to have to fight our way through this crowd." |Hey, she's actually able to talk terms — she knows full well that if it'd been any other roving band of her subjects you'd run into, the only option would have been to fight. That there's the opportunity to resolve this in another perhaps more peaceful manner is a plus. ] Now then, what are her terms? "Good, good, you're coming around to my position on the matter." Leering at you, the gnoll princess brandishes her old gladius as if it were some kind of royal scepter — and under these circumstances, it might very well be. "First off, you adventurers can pay my royal person appropriate tribute for traipsing about in my land. I'm given to understand that a monarch is supposed to possess ownership of all land in his or her purview... which means you're to pay me for the privilege of using it." So, a shakedown. "You're not wrong. But a civilized one. That makes all the difference, doesn't it? Your tribute can be in coin or goods, I don't really care, so long as you show me the respect I deserve in front of my subjects." What would she even do with money, anyway? Where would she spend it? She ignores your question and continues, keeping her blade levelled at you. "Or, if you're the penniless vagabond type... [pc.isImpotent |I could always use you for a while. Show my subjects who's really on top here — even they would be satisfied by seeing who's boss." Hah, are her own subjects so poor at fucking that they can't get her off? "Hardly. But you see, rulers of all peoples and nations have traditionally developed tastes for exotic meat, as it were, and familiarity does indeed breed contempt, as the Belharan saying goes. The stresses of having to manage not just one pack of gnolls, but more than a dozen of them all at once are really wearing on poor old me; it would be lovely to have someone who is capable of resisting to some extent to take out my aggression on. Having my subjects slavishly worship the ground I walk upon is fun at first but gets boring after a while, and doubly so when fucking. "So yes, my dear. If you can't or won't pay with your material possessions, you can pay with your dignity. How does that sound?" [var0 | "I could go," Liaden ventures warily. "If you're not up for it, [pc.name], I'm ready to entertain this princess for a bit. The way I see it, it's a small price to pay for the Dawnsword. It's not like Lumia teaches chastity, after all." [party.has azyrran |[azyrran.kdb |"Are you sure this is what you want, [azzy.liaden |my flower |Lia ]? I know the blade is important, but..." Azzy sighs. "You shouldn't do something you're uncomfortable with." "Well, that's my decision. Or rather, it's my decision to leave the decision with [pc.name]. I'm just statin' that I'm willing. [pc.heShe]'s by far the more experienced adventurer here, Azzy, and I trust [pc.hisHer] judgment." |Azyrran tilts her head to the side and frowns a little before sighing. "If that's what you want. [liaden.poly |We're |I'm ] keeping a sharp eye on you, though. The last thing we want is her absconding with [azzy.liaden |my precious little flower |you ]."[azyrran.fucked | Then she turns to you. "That goes for you too, [pc.swornGod lumia |angel |sunshine ]. She's not taking advantage of us." ] Lia nods bravely. "Okay. I... I guess it's up to [pc.name], though. I trust [pc.hisHer] judgment and I'm willing to do what we need." |Azzy huffs and bounces on her heels hard enough to make them click together. "It is super mean to pressure you into it and stuff. But, um, I guess if you're okay with it — the world could use a little more love!" "Yeah," the paladin says, swallowing. "Anyway, it's up to [pc.name]. But I'm ready to do what we need to do." ] |Is she sure? This decision is clearly made under duress, when she's got a dozen pointy sticks aimed at her — if she'd rather just fight than hold her nose and submit to something she's only doing reluctantly, you're more than okay with that. "Reluctant? Sure. But it ain't duress, not exactly; I know we could wipe the floor with these barbarians easy as you please. But I'm willing to put myself on the line to protect you if you aren't as confident... or don't want to resort to arms.[liaden.poly | Especially —" and here she smiles "because it's you. | So it's my decision to, ah, leave the decision with you, [pc.name]. ] You're by far the most experienced adventurer of us all, and I trust your judgment. If you think it'll save us time and get us closer to the Dawnsword all that quicker — assuming it really is at the bottom of that pit — I'm perfectly fine with doing what needs to be done." ] ] |you can always fuck a pup into me." W-what? "Are you so surprised? Did I stutter or lapse into incoherent yipping and laughing? I can smell it rising from your crotch at this distance, [pc.race] — go ahead and fuck a pup or two inside of me, and you can dig around this hole all you want." Wait, she's the self-declared gnoll queen, princess, whatever. Doesn't she have a long line of suitors willing to sire the royal heir given the chance? The gnoll princess chuckles bitterly. "You have no idea how alone it is to be me, [pc.name]. No idea at all. All these thoughts and ideas buzzing around in my head, but I can't even try to explain them to anyone. Yes, one of my children will have to at least try and lead them into some kind of future. But having my own son or daughter grow up more like them than me, and then for me to try to get him or her to understand things the way I do, no matter how rudimentary... no, it would break both my mind and heart. "I don't want to roll the dice like that. Every half-gnoll I've ever heard of has been more like me, able to think and work and act in both worlds. That's what I want. That kind of child. So yes, to summarize: you have a prick, your seed is potent, and you're the first non-gnoll to stick [pc.hisHer] head into this neck of the woods in a long time. Give me a pup, and I'll give you leave to poke at this hole in the dirt as much as you like." This is... "This is looking to the future, my dear [pc.race]. Much more of a prize for me than money, for certain. And even if it doesn't take, I still get a bit of fun that's a rare treat for the likes of me. Well, what do you say? Quick and easy, isn't it?" ] Hrrrmph. She forgot to mention one thing in all of that. How much does she want for her toll? "Let's see... how about ten thousand hawks? Yes, that sounds reasonable, a fine sum to show the appropriate deference to my royal blood. So: ten thousand, all in advance[silly |; none of this 'two thousand now and fifteen on your way back' nonsense ]. Or if you have practical items that're useful to me and mine, I'm willing to accept alternative tribute that's worth less in monetary value." How much less? "Guess." The gnoll princess bares her fangs at you, sending a wave of hooting and cheering rippling through her massed subjects. "If you insult royalty by giving too little... well, there are other forms of redress, aren't there?" It looks like it's your play here. How do you intend to resolve the situation?

“我不想以那种方式去冒险。我听过的每一个半兽人，都更像我一样，能够在两个世界中思考、行动。这才是我想要的。就是那种孩子。总之，概括来说：你有个厉害的家伙，你的种子的力量很强，而且你是第一个成功做到这一点的非地精。 [pc.hisHer]很久以来，没有人再来到这个偏远的地方了。给我一只小狗，我就允许你随心所欲地研究这个土坑。” “这……” “亲爱的，这其实是在为未来做准备啊。 The land starts to slope downwards a couple dozen paces from the water's edge where it would have met the feet of the hills, slowly at first, but rapidly growing steeper and steeper until soil gives way to a dusty rock face, cleanly vertical as it disappears into the darkness beneath. No, [dayNight |even though the sun's beating down on you from above, ]there's no sign of a bottom to this pit; on a whim, you pick up a stone and toss it down into the sinkhole. Yep, no sound whatsoever returns from the emptiness that yawns under. It's a good thing that these two dozen paces of earth exist, otherwise the Tarahugan would be draining into the abyss instead of out to sea. This isn't right... you've never seen gnolls build traps like these, even if they're little more than sharpened stakes and tense rope. You have barely enough time to steady yourself and get your hands on your [pc.weapon] when the tall grass rustles and golden-brown spotted shapes erupt from the underbrush. How they'd managed to conceal themselves so thoroughly amongst stalks no higher than your waist and get within a dozen paces of [party.combatNames] in the bargain would have been impressive, if it weren't the one thing gnolls weren't notoriously good at. Quickly forming a circle to surround you, the hyena-people lower the business ends of their flint spears at you, clearly meaning business. Wonder what's up with that? ] ] The question's answered when two of the gnolls part to admit another of their number, a female — at a first glance, she appears to be taller than her kin, but that's quickly revealed to not be the case. If anything, she's actually shorter than the other gnolls, only she stands up straight instead of hunching over like all the others. That alone gives her an air of authority by gnoll standards, a presence that the others lack; the others clearly revere her as they fall over themselves to genuflect before her passage in their own way. "Queen! Queen!" "Princess," the newcomer gently corrects her subjects as they shower her with their slavish adoration. She's got a crude gladius in hand — perhaps a cast-off from some minotaur legionnaire — and does a fancy little twirl with it before leveling the pointy end at you. "And who might you be to walk within my lands?" [pc.isDK |Her lands? Why, you were under the impression that in order to claim land, one was expected to work it and make it productive, be the claimant the highest royalty or the basest peasant settler. From the looks of the east end of Harvest Valley, it's certainly pretty wild. To your mild surprise, the self-proclaimed gnoll princess doesn't react with anger, but rather exasperation. "You don't need to tell me, I'm reminded of the state of my affairs every. Single. Day." |Her lands? By whose or what authority does she actually claim these lands, especially so close to the lakeside border? The gnoll princess' only answer to that is to slice the heads off several tall grasses, sending them scattering to the winds — for all its tarnish, the blade actually still holds an edge. In the land of the blind, the one-eyed man is king... which I guess, considering my circumstances, makes me some kind of amazing genius. And since I'm so gifted, that means the burden of rulership falls upon me." She calls herself princess. That means there's a queen, right? A scowl. "Princess sounds more euphonious, thank you very much. Queen would be more accurate, but I'd prefer to imagine myself with fewer of the duties and more of the privileges that being who I am entails. Now then, back to the point. What are you doing here?" Oh, you're just examining the sinkhole, that's all. There might be something interesting down there, and you're going to rappel down for the thrill of it, even if in all likelihood there's nothing at the lightless, forbidding bottom. If these are her lands and the hole has been here forever, surely she's interested in knowing what's beneath her feet? The gnoll princess looks conflicted at that — for a ruler, one supposes that she hasn't had many opportunities to practice statecraft, especially hiding one's actual thoughts during negotiations. It's as plain as day that she doesn't actually care about the sinkhole as-is, but for all that, she's no more inclined to give something away for free than any other southlands despot; the fact that you want access to the sinkhole makes her instinctively want to not let you have it. Eventually, she mulls it over for all of a minute while tension hangs palpably in the air, then bares her teeth at you in her eerie version of a smile. "I don't really care about a hole in the ground that's never been a problem for us, especially when it's on poor land that's bordering the mountains. On the other hand, I can't quite let you do as you please here without some kind of obsequiecense from you — if nothing else, my subjects will think less of me if we trap prey and don't wring something out of your sorry hides." Leering at you, the gnoll princess brandishes her old gladius as if it were some kind of royal scepter — and under these circumstances, it might very well be. "You're not wrong. But a civilized one. That makes all the difference, doesn't it? The stresses of having to manage not just one pack of gnolls, but more than a dozen of them all at once are really wearing on poor old me; it would be lovely to have someone who is capable of resisting to some extent to take out my aggression on. rows.original: Fuck that, you're having none of this. For all this princess might claim to rule, her so-called lands are by and large wilderness, and her subjects a pack of bandits. You're not going to allow yourself to be extorted, let alone bullied, by a self-important bitch. The gnoll princess clicks her tongue. "And here I was, thinking a [pc.race] was supposed to be more civilized than us savage gnolls. To resort to violence so readily!" Yeah, she's got a really funny notion of what civilization is. For one, it damn well doesn't mean weakness, nor does it mean rolling over and giving in to every demand made of oneself. If she thinks that's what it is to be civilized, then she'll be getting a personal taste of civilized violence up front. At this, the gnoll princess throws her head back and laughs, setting her pack to whooping and laughing hysterically with her. Grinning broadly, she levels her blade at you and steps forward, the other gnolls mirroring her movements as they close in on you as well. [var0 |"I had a feeling it'd come to this," Liaden mutters as she tightens her grip on her halberd. "She talked the talk, and... well, I guess she walked the same walk as any other local ruler does." [party.has azyrran |[azyrran.kdb |Azzy takes a deep breath and readies her [azyrran.weapon] — just in time to turn a gnoll's spear away. "It's okay. If they weren't ready to fight, they wouldn't have threatened us. It's just bad luck for them that we're more ready to protect ourselves." |"It's all right, Lia," Azyrran replies, not looking away as she turns a gnoll's spear with her [azyrran.weapon]. "This so-called princess has no idea what it means to rule — and we have every idea about what it means to be adventuring paladins. We're not even going to break a sweat." |"I mean," Azzy grumbles, "words are hard. Hey!" She raises her [azyrran.weapon] just in time to bat away a gnoll's spear. "I was talking! Gosh. Meanies. Let's do this, Lia!" ] |It's all right. rows.translation: 说完，那个半兽人公主转身离开你，朝着她的子民们走去，一边擦去自己大腿上的精液，一边用一系列低吼和精准的脚踢结束了这场即兴的狂欢。“我在这里的事已经办完了。大家排好队，准备出发吧，记住敢想趁我不在的时候偷偷偷懒、敷衍了事吗？我可是训练过你们，让你们具备更好的纪律性。至于你[pc.race]这笔交易只适用于一次性交易。如果你知道什么对自己有利，就别他妈再踏进我的领地了，尤其是当你能给我的只有快乐的时候。如果你有足够的能力让我怀孕，我们或许还可以再谈条件，否则就别浪费时间了。你可能会认为这些地精至少会试着为自己争取一些利益，但无论是出于自觉的纪律性还是纯粹的恐吓，它们都没有这么做。这些毛发蓬乱的生物忠实地跟在它们的“公主”身后，拖着脚步沿着湖边走去，只留下你独自站在那片长满草的泥土上。 [var0 |等她确定那些地精已经消失在视线之外，莉娅登便跑过来，挽住你的胳膊，尽管你的全身都疼得厉害，还是把你拉了起来。 “天啊，看看你都变成什么样了！”她一边说，一边把你的衣服披在你的身上。“那…… 贱人真的把你累坏了吧——你需要帮忙吗？” “不，你并不需要任何安慰。说实话，你在这里受到的真正伤害，其实是那些她无能为力的事情所造成的。那只蛤蜊撞击那个地精公主的行为或许让你的髋部受了伤，但真正让你痛苦的，其实是你的心灵。” “哦……好吧，我本来是想知道你是否需要什么帮助而已。帮助当然，这不仅仅是指你的伤痛和淤青，只要你这么说的话。” 你向莉娅登露出了一个淡淡的微笑。她显然很尊重你，也很快就退缩了。 至少，这一点她是理解并且尊重的。“好吧，我想在她那么强势地向你做了自我介绍之后，你应该也不会愿意让自己在违背意愿的情况下被强迫做些什么吧。”说完，她又对你露出了微笑。来吧，我们先帮你清洗干净、让你舒服些，然后再继续调查那个天坑吧。你真的为我们承担了这么多，让我免于去做那些事，我真的很感激。虽然我之前也提出过要帮忙，但看到她对你做了那些事…………" [pc.isDK |你总比她强。在那个所谓的“地精公主”面前，她肯定会像一片叶子一样轻易折断。 莉娅登皱了皱眉：“我……确实有这种可能性，艾兹对我可要比她温柔多了。 |你为她挡下了这一击，真是太好了。在冒险这方面，她毕竟还相当缺乏经验……你知道，桑德斯肯定希望她能慢慢适应现实世界，而不是一下子就投入其中。 莉娅登微笑着说道：“我知道你都是出于好意，所以……谢谢你。 ]快点，趁还没遇到更糟糕的事情，我们赶紧出发吧。 |[party.hasCompanions |终于，你感觉到有人拉了拉你的手臂，从你的肩膀下方抓住你，帮助你站了起来。当你眨了眨眼睛，驱散眼中的朦胧视线后，你发现[companion1.name]始终陪伴在你身边，即使你的全身都充满了疼痛，也依然拉着你站了起来。 “你看起来吓坏了[companion1.heShe]一边说着，一边把衣服披在你的肩上：“你肯定累坏了吧——现在感觉好些了吗？” “好了一点，多亏了[companion1.himHer]谢谢你的帮助，但在进一步调查这个天坑之前，你还是应该先清理一下自己，让自己舒服一些。你现在还是有点站不稳…… [companion1.name]点头表示同意，然后帮你离开。 |过了好一会儿，你的四肢终于恢复了足够的力气，你费了些劲才勉强站了起来。你眨了眨眼睛，驱散眼中的朦胧感，然后踉跄着向前走了几步，试图缓解身上的疼痛[pc.hips]等情况稍微稳定一些，再尝试几次吧。 呼……那个女人用她那种粗暴的手段确实把你折腾得够呛……不过说实话，你当初自愿屈从于她的要求，还能指望什么呢？那些地精只尊重蛮力，而你根本没有展现出任何力量……她或许本可以表达得更委婉一些，但在那种情况下，每当她想发泄情绪时，她确实会完全屈服于自己的本性。 ]最好你在比那些兽人公主更可怕的东西找到你之前，赶紧离开这里…… ]
rows.raw: " With that, the gnoll princess turns from you and starts back towards her subjects, wiping the girlcum from her thighs and breaking up the impromptu orgy with a series of snarls and well-placed kicks. "I'm done here. Form up and get ready to go, and don't you dare try sneak in sloppy seconds on this one behind my back; I trained you lot to have better discipline than that. And as for you, [pc.race], this deal is only good for one visit. Don't fucking set foot in my kingdom ever again if you know what's good for you, especially if all you can offer me is pleasure. Grow a dick capable of putting a pup or two inside of me and we might be able to negotiate, but don't even bother asking otherwise." You'd imagine the gnolls would at least try to cop a feel for themselves, but whether it's through actual discipline or sheer intimidation, they don't. Dutifully, the mangy furballs step into line behind their princess and shuffle off across the lakeside, leaving you on the grassy dirt. [var0 |Once she's sure the gnolls are out of sight, Liaden comes running up to you, hooking an arm under your shoulder and dragging you to your feet despite the soreness that fills your body from head to toe. "Goddess, look at you!" she says, draping your clothes about your shoulders. "That... bitch really ran you ragged — do you need any help?" No, you don't need any healing. To be perfectly frank, the real wounds you received here are those which she can't do anything about. The clam slamming the gnoll princess inflicted upon you might've shattered your hips, but it's really your heart that hurts the most here. "Oh. Well, I asked if you wanted any help, and that's not limited to just your aches and bruises, but if you say so." You give Liaden a thin smile. She certainly seemed to respect you and back off quickly enough. That, at least, she understands and respects. "Okay. I guess after she, uh, introduced herself to you so forcefully, I don't think you're in any mood to have things done to you against your will." Then returns your smile. "Come on, let's get you cleaned up and comfortable before we investigate the sinkhole any further — I really appreciate it that you took one for us so I didn't have to. I know that I offered, but even still, seein' what she did to you..." [pc.isDK |Better you than her. She'd just have folded like a leaf under the so-called gnoll princess. Liaden winces. "I... that's a distinct possibility, Azzy's far gentler with me than she could be. |You're glad to have taken the blow for her. She's still relatively inexperienced when it comes to the adventuring thing... you know Sanders would have wanted her to be eased into the real world instead of plunging headfirst all at once. Liaden smiles. "I know you mean well by that, so... thanks. ] Come on, let's get goin' before something nastier finds us." |[party.hasCompanions |At length, you feel someone tugging at your arm, getting a grip on you by under your shoulder and helping you to your feet. When you blink the bleariness from your eyes, you find [companion1.name] by your side, dragging you to your feet despite the soreness that pervades your body. "You look like a fright," [companion1.heShe] says, draping your clothes about your shoulders. "You certainly got run ragged — are you feeling better?" A little, thanks to [companion1.himHer]. Thanks for the help, but you ought to get cleaned up and comfortable before any further investigation of the sinkhole. It's still a little hard for you to stand straight... [companion1.name] nods, and helps you off. |After a long while, enough strength returns to your limbs that you're able to pull yourself haphazardly to your feet with some effort. Blinking the bleariness from your eyes, you take a few stumbling steps forward, waiting for the aching in your [pc.hips] to subside before attempting a couple more. Phew. That bitch certainly ran you ragged with her brutal clam slamming... although frankly, what did you expect from willingly submitting to her demands? The gnolls respect only brutish strength, and you showed them none... she may have had been more articulate, but under all that she was certainly more than willing to give in to her base nature when she felt like it. ] It's probably best that you clear out before something nastier than the gnoll princess finds you... ] "

It's not as if Lumians are bound to remain celibate or anything — quite the opposite, in fact. ] [party.has cait |Cait whistles. "Wow. Normally this is the sort of thing that gets fobbed off on me! "Lia, are you sure you want to do this on your own[liaden.poly | without us in there to help ]?"] "It wouldn'ta been my first choice," she admits. No harm in doin' the thing that keeps 'em from, uh... from comin' to harm, y'know?" ] She turns to the gnoll princess with the same brave smile. By comparison, the gnoll's expression is nothing snort of lascivious. As soon as Lia gets close enough to touch, the princess reaches for her chin — but Lia slaps away her wrist before they make contact. "Watch it," she growls. "I agreed to some fun: no more, no less. Nothin' in that said anything about treatin' me like shit. That up to your standards?" "Oh, you're such a refreshing change from the usual submissive slavishness of my actual subjects. We're going to have so much fun together." She shows Lia her teeth. "Come along now, then. Don't want to keep your friend[party.hasCompanions |s ] waiting too long, hmm?" With that, they disappear behind the bodies of the other gnolls. [liaden.poly |[party.has azyrran |You and Azzy exchange worried glances and a few hand-squeezes; she's clearly having a hard enough time listening, but you can tell she doesn't want to let the princess get away with anything beyond the terms of the agreement. To be honest, neither do you. |And now it's time to keep a weather ear out to make sure the princess doesn't go beyond the terms of the agreement. ] |[party.has azyrran |Azzy grimaces again, then strains to listen. Her dissatisfaction is written all over her face — but so's her worry that the princess will renege and try to hurt Lia.[azyrran.fucked | She looks over to you for reassurance from time to time, and at one point whispers, "This is tougher than I thought. Please, [pc.name]... don't do anything like this, okay?" ] |And then you wait. ] ] You can't see what's going on behind their bodies, other than movement, glanced periodically between legs, but you can definitely hear the growls and moans that soon ensue. But they don't sound pointed enough to intervene, and Lia never raises the alarm. Instead, you sit there in a silent, simultaneous stare-down with the gnolls, and wait for the lewd and loud affair behind them to die down. Between the grass-rustles and the thuds and slaps of impact, you hear both women's voices, and at least one thing is clear: Lia's giving as good as she's getting. And as time wears on, that impression deepens until the only sounds that emanate from the impromptu fucknest are the guttural yawps and cries of a desperately horny gnoll. Perhaps half an hour passes before the gnolls abruptly part once more, allowing their princess to step through. She's much more unkempt than she was before, if such a thing is possible. Her hair's a mess, dirt's smeared all over her fur, and you note several spots on her body where Lia's nails dug scratches into her flesh. Lia, on the other hand, holds her head high with some genuine dignity as she steps past the princess and her entourage. In fact, as soon as Lia returns to your side, the princess gives her a wink and a slightly messy smile. [pc.isDK |Well? |Is she okay? ] "I discharged my duty honorably and did nothing that the Lady of Light would disapprove of," she says. [pc.isDK |She swallows, and then, a little quieter: "So, um... 'well.' |Then her face softens a little, and her answer goes sotto voce. "Yeah. I'm okay. ] Actually, she... she'd definitely never done it before, at least not with a woman. Would you believe she tried to scissor first? Yikes. I, uh, showed her a better way." From across the way, the princess, still disheveled and visibly loopy, attempts to flutter her eyelashes at the paladin. "All right! I got what I wanted. By my royal leave, mess around with that hole however you like — so long as you don't do something brainless like drain the lake into it. Trust me: I won't be the only one thoroughly unhappy about that." "Much obliged," Lia mumbles. "C'mon, [pc.name]. Let's not linger any longer, yeah?" That's the signal for the princess to snap her fingers and direct the column of gnolls away from you and off over the next rise. From the expressions on everybody's faces, seems like you're not the only ones relieved that things stayed relatively civil, and that you and the gnolls can now put a safe amount of distance between yourselves. For your part, you turn to Lia. Now that [pc.isDK |that's done, she's good to go, right |she's not in front of the gnolls, is she sure she's okay ]? "Yeah. No harm in doin' the thing that keeps 'em from, uh... from comin' to harm, y'know?" ] She turns to the gnoll princess with the same brave smile. By comparison, the gnoll's expression is nothing snort of lascivious. As soon as Lia gets close enough to touch, the princess reaches for her chin — but Lia slaps away her wrist before they make contact. "Watch it," she growls. "I agreed to some fun: no more, no less. Nothin' in that said anything about treatin' me like shit. That up to your standards?" "Oh, you're such a refreshing change from the usual submissive slavishness of my actual subjects. We're going to have so much fun together." She shows Lia her teeth. "Come along now, then. Don't want to keep your friend[party.hasCompanions |s ] waiting too long, hmm?" With that, they disappear behind the bodies of the other gnolls. [liaden.poly |[party.has azyrran |You and Azzy exchange worried glances and a few hand-squeezes; she's clearly having a hard enough time listening, but you can tell she doesn't want to let the princess get away with anything beyond the terms of the agreement. To be honest, neither do you. |And now it's time to keep a weather ear out to make sure the princess doesn't go beyond the terms of the agreement. ] |[party.has azyrran |Azzy grimaces again, then strains to listen. Her dissatisfaction is written all over her face — but so's her worry that the princess will renege and try to hurt Lia.[azyrran.fucked | She looks over to you for reassurance from time to time, and at one point whispers, "This is tougher than I thought. Please, [pc.name]... don't do anything like this, okay?" ] |And then you wait. ] ] You can't see what's going on behind their bodies, other than movement, glanced periodically between legs, but you can definitely hear the growls and moans that soon ensue. But they don't sound pointed enough to intervene, and Lia never raises the alarm. Instead, you sit there in a silent, simultaneous stare-down with the gnolls, and wait for the lewd and loud affair behind them to die down. Between the grass-rustles and the thuds and slaps of impact, you hear both women's voices, and at least one thing is clear: Lia's giving as good as she's getting. And as time wears on, that impression deepens until the only sounds that emanate from the impromptu fucknest are the guttural yawps and cries of a desperately horny gnoll. Perhaps half an hour passes before the gnolls abruptly part once more, allowing their princess to step through. She's much more unkempt than she was before, if such a thing is possible. Her hair's a mess, dirt's smeared all over her fur, and you note several spots on her body where Lia's nails dug scratches into her flesh. Lia, on the other hand, holds her head high with some genuine dignity as she steps past the princess and her entourage. In fact, as soon as Lia returns to your side, the princess gives her a wink and a slightly messy smile. [pc.isDK |Well? |Is she okay? ] "I discharged my duty honorably and did nothing that the Lady of Light would disapprove of," she says. [pc.isDK |She swallows, and then, a little quieter: "So, um... 'well.' |Then her face softens a little, and her answer goes sotto voce. "Yeah. I'm okay. ] Actually, she... she'd definitely never done it before, at least not with a woman. Would you believe she tried to scissor first? Yikes. I, uh, showed her a better way." From across the way, the princess, still disheveled and visibly loopy, attempts to flutter her eyelashes at the paladin. "All right! I got what I wanted. By my royal leave, mess around with that hole however you like — so long as you don't do something brainless like drain the lake into it. Trust me: I won't be the only one thoroughly unhappy about that." "Much obliged," Lia mumbles. "C'mon, [pc.name]. Let's not linger any longer, yeah?" That's the signal for the princess to snap her fingers and direct the column of gnolls away from you and off over the next rise. From the expressions on everybody's faces, seems like you're not the only ones relieved that things stayed relatively civil, and that you and the gnolls can now put a safe amount of distance between yourselves. For your part, you turn to Lia. Now that [pc.isDK |that's done, she's good to go, right |she's not in front of the gnolls, is she sure she's okay ]? "Yeah. I'm gonna wash my hands off in the lake real quick, but other than that, it was... well, it wasn't as bad as I expected, an' I guess it was worth it to not have to fight 'em, but I don't think I'm ever gonna actually like doing anythin' like that[liaden.poly | with anyone other than you an' Azzy ]. Yeesh. Anyway, I'll rinse off, and then let's take a look at this hole." Her face twists. "I mean the one in the... ugh." "

rows.original: Since Liaden's offering herself up, there's no reason you shouldn't let her have her moment.
rows.translation: 既然莉娅登主动提出了这个请求，你没有理由不让她拥有属于她的这一刻。
rows.raw: "Since Liaden's offering herself up, there's no reason you shouldn't let her have her moment."

rows.original: Fine. She wants to ask for an exorbitant sum, thinking that no one in their right mind would pay it? She really, really needs to adjust her expectations if she's going to be dealing with anyone who isn't a gnoll. As you pull out the ten thousand hawks from your person, the gnoll princess' eyes widen — you've indeed called her bluff, and she clearly wasn't expecting some random adventurer out in the wilds to have that much money on [pc.himHer]. [silly |Fuck, even you're surprised yourself — you have no idea how you manage to hold that much money on your person, but you manage it one way or another. With the amount you've just dumped right in front of this so-called princess, by all rights you should be required to hire at least two people to hold up your pants, or maybe a whole palanquin. Really now, where do you keep all this money on your person? The world may never know. ] "I — " she starts, and then quickly moves to compose herself with middling success. "We accept your tribute, [pc.race], and hereby grant you the, uh, right to investigate this sinkhole for whatever purpose it is you're about." Yeah, sure, okay. Very kind of her. [pc.isDK |Really, you just chose to pay her off because she's not worth the bother fighting. If she's going to be pressing her luck, then it might just devolve to that. The gnoll princess sneers, if a little forcedly. "And lose your money for it?" You've just demonstrated that what she thought an impossible sum for someone like you to pay is merely chump change to you. Now, if she wouldn't mind getting the fuck out of your way before you change your mind and consider the money a fair price to see that tryhard smile wiped off her face, you'll be moving onto matters of actual importance |Now if she wouldn't mind getting out of your way since you upheld your side of the deal... or does she really want to demonstrate in front of her subjects that her word isn't good for anything and the implications that might have for her rule down the line? The gnoll princess makes a face, and you can see the gears turning in her mind. "All right, fine, whatever. Do as you please." Of course, you neglected to mention to her that odds are her subjects aren't likely to make that connection themselves and would slavishly worship her no matter her actions, but there's no point in ruining a good thing ]. "Fine, [pc.race]. Have it your way. By my royal leave, mess around with the hole all you want, so long as you don't do something idiotic like drain the lake into it or the like. Trust me, I won't be the only one thoroughly unhappy about that." Pointing at her nearest two underlings, the gnoll princess waves her other hand at the pile of filthy lucre in the grass, affecting disinterest in the whole matter now that negotiations are concluded. "You two. Gather all this up and bring it with us." "Shinies?" "Yes. Shinies." "Shinies!" Without further hesitation, the two gnolls drop their spears and leap into the pile of coin, the tinkling noise of metal on metal ringing through the air as they try to scoop the lot up in their arms and find it pouring through their grasp and back to the ground. At this point, any threat the gnoll princess could make vis-a-vis her subjects has fallen flat with this absolutely humiliating display. She knows it full well, and you're perfectly fine with turning your back on her[var0 |, gathering up Liaden, ] and simply striding out of the ring of gnolls, all of which are transfixed by the sight of so-called shinies. [var0 |Once you're a safe distance from the gnoll princess and her royal entourage, Liaden heaves a sigh and lets her shoulders slump. "Well. That was... unexpected." Hey, you've got to be flexible and think of creative ways to deal with obstacles. Given the gnoll princess' tenuous hold on her subjects, making them more of a liability to her than you were was the best was to go about things without resorting to bloodshed. [party.has azyrran |"I know you were brought up to crusade, Lia, but sometimes it's better to think outside the box." Winking, Azyrran elbows Liaden in the side. "If [pc.name] here had just waltzed into the hive and tried to fight [pc.hisHer] way through each and every hive knight, I wouldn't be here with you today.[azzy.isBimbo| Maybe sexytimes would've been more fun, but I guess this is okay too!]" ] "All right. I guess that makes sense... a shame about the ten thousand, though. That's more money than most people see in a year, maybe even a decade." |[party.hasCompanions |Once you're a safe distance from the gnoll princess and her royal entourage, [comp1.name] heaves a sigh of relief and lets [comp1.hisHer] shoulders slump. "Well. That was... unexpected." Hey, you've got to be flexible and think of creative ways to deal with obstacles. Given the gnoll princess' tenuous hold on her subjects, making them more of a liability to her than you were was the best was to go about things without resorting to bloodshed. "All right. I guess that makes sense... a shame about the ten thousand, though. That's more money than most people see in a year, maybe even a decade." |Once you're a safe distance from the gnoll princess and her royal entourage, you chance a final look back at the mess of a scene. Given all the yipping and caterwauling, it looks like she's caught her subjects trying to embezzle from the recent addition to the crown's coffers, and is dealing out some on-the-spot justice... ] ] You just smile and shrug. After all this time, you're really getting into the adventurer mindset — ten thousand hawks might've been a considerable sum to anyone else, but to you? Ah, the sight of the gnoll princess exasperated at her underlings while they scrabbled on the ground was absolutely priceless, the satisfaction of seeing her despair after all that pretentious puffing up of her self-declared royal title. Not exactly something to lord over people, is it? Now then, you've got a sinkhole to attend to...
rows.translation: 好吧。她想开出一个高得离谱的价码，还以为没有哪个神志清醒的人会付这笔钱？她真是真的需要调整一下期望——如果她打交道的人不是豺狼人的话。当你从身上掏出一万枚鹰币时，那位豺狼人公主的眼睛瞪得大大的——你确实戳穿了她虚张声势的把戏，而她显然没想到荒野里随便一个冒险者身上会带着这么多钱。 [pc.himHer]。 [silly |见鬼，连你自己都吃了一惊——你根本搞不懂自己是怎么把这么多钱带在身上的，可你总有办法做到。你刚把这么一大笔钱扔在这个所谓的公主面前，按理说，你至少得雇两个人来帮你提着裤子，或者干脆雇一顶大轿子。说真的，你到底把这些钱藏在身上的哪儿？这世界恐怕永远不会知道。 ] “我——”她开口说道，然后很快试着让自己镇定下来，成效一般。“我们接受你的贡品，[pc.race]，并特此授予你……呃，调查这个天坑的权利，不管你想干什么。” 嗯，好啊，行吧。她可真好心。 [pc.isDK |说真的，你选择花钱打发她，只是因为她不值得你费劲去打架。如果她非要得寸进尺，事情最后可能就真会变成那样。 豺狼人公主冷笑了一声，虽然笑得有点勉强。“就这样白白损失你的钱？” 你刚刚已经证明了，她以为像你这样的人绝不可能付得起的巨款，对你来说不过是点零头。现在，如果她不介意赶紧滚开你的路——免得你改主意，觉得这笔钱换来那张逞强的笑脸被打掉也挺值的——那你就要去处理真正重要的事了 |现在，既然你已经履行了自己那一半约定，她是不是该让开路了……还是说，她真想在子民面前证明自己的话一文不值，以及这会对她日后的统治带来什么影响？ 豺狼人公主做了个鬼脸，你能看出她脑子里正在盘算。“行吧，好吧，随便你。你爱怎么着就怎么着。” 当然，你没跟她提：她的子民多半不会自己想到这一层，无论她做什么都会盲目崇拜她；不过，戳破这种好事也没什么意义 ]。 “好吧，[pc.race]。随你的便。以我的王室特许，那个洞你想怎么折腾就怎么折腾，只要别干出把湖水都灌进去之类的蠢事。相信我，为那件事恼火的绝不止我一个。”豺狼人公主指着身边最近的两个手下，另一只手朝草丛里那堆脏兮兮的臭钱一挥，摆出谈判既已结束、她对整件事再无兴趣的样子。“你们两个。把这些全都收起来，跟我们走。” “亮闪闪？” “对。亮闪闪。” “亮闪闪！” 两个豺狼人没有再多犹豫，立刻扔掉手中的长矛，跳进了那堆硬币中。金属相互碰撞发出的叮当声在空气中回荡，他们试图把所有的硬币都抓起来，却发现硬币不断从他们手中滑落，又落回了地面。在这种情况下，这位豺狼人公主对她的臣民们可能发出的任何威胁，都在这场极其羞辱性的表演面前彻底失效了。她自己也心知肚明，而你完全不介意转身背对她[var0 |，顺带叫上莉娅登， ]就这么径直走出那群豺狼人的包围——他们全都看那些所谓的亮闪闪看呆了。 [var0 |等你和豺狼人公主及其王室随从拉开足够安全的距离后，莉娅登长叹一声，肩膀也垮了下来。“唉，这可真是……出乎意料。” 嘿，遇到障碍你就得灵活点，想些有创意的办法。豺狼人公主对她子民的掌控本来就摇摇欲坠，让这些子民对她来说比你更像累赘，这就是不动刀兵解决问题的最好办法。 [party.has azyrran |“我知道你从小就被教导要征战四方，莉娅，但有时候跳出框框想问题更好。”阿兹兰眨了眨眼，用胳膊肘碰了碰莉娅登的腰侧。“要是[pc.name]当初就这么闯进蜂巢，想凭[pc.hisHer]本事一路打穿每一个蜂群骑士，我今天就不会和你们站在这儿了。[azzy.isBimbo| 也许来点性爱会更有意思，不过我觉得这样也不错！]” ] “好吧。我想这说得通……不过那一万枚鹰币确实可惜。那笔钱比大多数人一年、甚至十年见到的都多。” |[party.hasCompanions |等你和豺狼人公主及其王室随从拉开足够安全的距离后，[comp1.name]松了一口气，肩膀也[comp1.hisHer]耷拉了下来。“唉，这可真是……出乎意料。” 嘿，遇到障碍你就得灵活点，想些有创意的办法。豺狼人公主对她子民的掌控本来就摇摇欲坠，让这些子民对她来说比你更像累赘，这就是不动刀兵解决问题的最好办法。 “好吧。我想这说得通……不过那一万枚鹰币确实可惜。那笔钱比大多数人一年、甚至十年见到的都多。” |等你和豺狼人公主及其王室随从拉开足够安全的距离后，你回头最后看了一眼那片狼藉。听着那一片尖啸嚎叫，看来她抓到子民们正想从王室金库新添的进项里揩油，正在当场执法…… ] ] 你只是笑了笑，耸耸肩。过了这么久，你真是越来越有冒险者的心态了——一万枚鹰币对别人来说或许是笔可观的数目，但对你来说？啊，看着豺狼人公主在下属们满地乱爬时气急败坏的样子，那场面简直无价；看着她在那样煞有介事地吹嘘自封的王室头衔之后终于陷入绝望，那份满足感更是如此。这倒不是什么能拿来压人的事，对吧？ 那么，你还有个天坑要去处理……

rows.original: Pay the 10,000 EC the princess wants.
rows.translation: 支付公主要求的10,000枚琥珀金币吧。

rows.original: You don't have the exorbitant sum that the gnoll princess is demanding on you.
rows.translation: 你拿不出那个豺狼人公主向你索要的那笔巨款。
rows.raw: "You don't have the exorbitant sum that the gnoll princess is demanding on you."

rows.original: "Oh?" The pink-haired kitten arches an eyebrow, her tail starting to sway from side to side. "I guess I am, at that! Sure, it's not every day I get to keep you safe and share Mallach's gift at the same time. Just, like, every other day. Alright, princess fuzzybutts, what do you say I show you a whole new world of pleasures." [var0 |Liaden's cheeks color. "Are you sure, Caitriss? Like I said, I-" "And like [pc.name] said — I'm the professional. I'll leave making a mess of you to [azzy.liaden |our Hive Knight |someone who'd be better at it ]." ] The gnoll princess scoffs dismissively, sauntering up to Cait and grabbing the catgirl's chin as if to examine a horse. Cait just smirks and claps both hands around the princess's silky-furred ass, squeezing hard enough to make her fingers disappear. "Oh, you do have some meat on those bones!" "And you've got a pretty mouth, pink cat. Have you ever had a clit the size of most men's cocks between those painted lips?" "Have you ever slid your clit between tits this big?" Cait retorts, shrugging out of her top. "C'mon, princess. Let me show you what a figure like mine's really capable of." The gnoll barks with a cackling laugh, hooking an arm around Cait's. "I look forward to it." The both of them disappear into the tall grasses, and the gnolls close up the space in their wake, forming a screen of bodies to afford them some privacy. You may not be able to see what's going on behind there, but you can definitely hear the guttural yawps and cries that start echoing out from their love nest. The gnoll boys guarding their princess exchange concerned glances as the princess howls something in their native language; a few of them plant their spears in the ground and disappear into the reeds. Minutes pass, before a couple more of the paltry band go to help, and then soon enough nearly the entire party has vanished into the tall grass. The whole affair takes perhaps half an hour before Cait finally emerges once again, flicking some gooey white off the top of her cleavage. She's changed clothes entirely, but even her fastidious attentions haven't entirely removed the occassional strand of cum stubbornly hiding in her hair, or the faint streaks down her thigh. You arch your brows and ask if she had fun — it certainly looks like the entire tribe did. "Princess had to call for backup," Cait giggles. "She'd never been with a woman before, I don't think. Didn't know what to do when I titfucked her super-sensitive clit till she nearly passed out. Of course when her boys saw her like that... well, chances are she won't be bothering anybody for a while, what with how pregnant she probably is now. Anyway, let's all poke our heads into a different set of holes, huh?"
rows.translation: 哦？”那只粉发的小猫挑了挑眉毛，尾巴也开始左右摇摆起来。“嗯，算是吧！当然，能每天保护你的安全，这种事情也不是每天都会发生的。以及同时分享马拉克的礼物吧。就像平常每天一样。好了，毛茸茸的公主，你觉得我该不该带你去体验一个全新的快乐世界呢？ [var0 |莉娅登的脸颊顿时红了。“你确定吗，凯特？就像我之前说的，我——” “还有，就像[pc.name]我说过——我是专业人士。把把事情搞砸的事情就交给我吧。 [azzy.liaden |我们的蜂群骑士 |一个更擅长这件事的人 ]。" ] 那个地精公主不屑地嗤笑一声，大步走到凯特面前，抓住猫女的下巴，仿佛在检查一匹马一样。凯特只是咧嘴一笑，然后双手紧紧抓住公主那柔软如丝的臀部，用力一捏，以至于她的手指都快被捏进去了。“哦，你这身骨头上确实有不少肉！” “还有，你的嘴巴真漂亮，粉红色的小猫。那些涂了颜色的嘴唇中间，有没有容纳过和大多数男人阴茎差不多大小的阴蒂呢？” “你有没有试过把你的阴蒂夹在这么大的胸脯中间呢？凯特耸了耸肩，脱掉了上衣，反驳道：‘来吧，公主。让我让你看看像我这样的身材到底能做出什么。’” 那个地精发出咯咯的笑声，挽着凯特的胳膊说：“我很期待呢。他们俩消失在了高高的草丛中，那些地精们迅速跟了上去，用他们的身体围成了一道屏障，为他们提供了些许隐私。你可能看不清他们后面发生了什么，但可以肯定的是听到那些从他们的“爱巢”中传出来的低沉嚎叫与哭声……那些守护着公主的半兽人男孩们相互交换着担忧的目光，因为公主正在用他们的语言大声呼喊着什么；其中几个人将长矛插在地面，然后消失在了芦苇丛中。几分钟过去了，又有几个同伴前来帮忙，不久之后，几乎整个团队都消失在了高高的草丛中。整个过程大概持续了半个小时，直到凯特终于再次出现了，她还在自己的胸前拍掉了一些黏糊糊的白色物质。她已经彻底换了衣服，但即使她如此细心地打理自己，那些偶尔藏在头发中的精液痕迹，以及她大腿上那些淡淡的痕迹，依然无法被完全消除。 你挑了挑眉毛，问她是否玩得开心——看她的样子，整个部落的人应该都玩得很开心吧。 公主只好叫人来帮忙了，”凯特咯咯笑着说，“我想她以前从来没和女人在一起过，根本不知道该怎么做。当我轻轻触碰她那极其敏感的阴蒂时，她差点昏过去……当然，当她的那些‘男朋友’看到她那个样子时……嗯，考虑到她现在应该已经怀孕了吧，很可能有一段时间她不会再打扰任何人了。总之，我们还是各自去做点别的事情吧，好吗？

rows.raw: "You know someone in your party's generally amenable to using her body to pay her way."

rows.original: Look, the both of you know that if you give her a toll in money, she'll be hard-pressed to find someone who can actually turn that into something that's actually useful. Beads and baubles, gems and gewgaws are all nice and shiny, but that's about the extent of their use for a people like hers. How about you pony up some tribute that's actually useful? The gnoll princess folds her arms and cocks an ear at you, although her expression doesn't change in the slightest. "Yes, do go on. Remember, though, I don't have to suffer any insult. If you think us gnolls easily bought over by cheap, shiny junk... at least make it expensive, shiny junk." Or? "Or I have to demand satisfaction for the slight, of course. Isn't that the way your oh-so-civilized monarchs work? Now then, let's see what you're offering in the hopes of appeasing me..." Pick out items from your inventory to offer the gnoll princess; you can select more than one and she will consider the combined value of the items to her.
rows.translation: 听着，你们俩都清楚，要是你们拿钱当作给她的过路费，她很难找到能把钱真正变成有用之物的人。珠子与小玩意儿、宝石与华而不实的饰品，看上去都漂亮又闪亮，但对像她那样的族群来说，用处也就仅止于此。你们不如拿出点真正有用的贡品来，怎么样？ 豺狼人公主双臂交叉，侧耳等着你开口，虽然她的表情丝毫未变。“好啊，继续说。不过记住，我可不必忍受任何侮辱。如果你以为我们豺狼人会轻易被廉价闪亮的破烂收买……那至少也拿点昂贵的闪亮破烂来。” 不然呢？ “不然我当然要为这番轻慢讨个说法。你们那些所谓文明的君主不都是这么办事的吗？那么，让我看看你打算献上什么来平息我的怒气……” 从你的库存中挑选物品献给豺狼人公主；你可以选择多件，她会综合考量这些物品对她的价值。

rows.translation: 向那些豺狼人缴纳贡品时，不要用金币，而应该用他们真正能够利用的物品。需要凑够的价值会比用金币支付低，但你不知道公主究竟要满意到什么程度……
rows.raw: "Pay the gnolls tribute not in coin, but in items that they actually can make use of. The value to meet will be less than if you paid coin, but you don't know just how much the princess will be satisfied with... "

rows.raw: " [var0 |Fine, fine. You pony up the items you intend to offer to the nearest gnoll, who receives the lot and reverently presents the tribute to the gnoll princess. The poor furball is really trying very hard, going so far as to bow, scrape and genuflect in the most overblown manner possible, a mockery of courtly etiquette; the gnoll princess casts an eye over your offerings, looking positively disinterested. For a moment you think she's going to refuse and take offense, but at last she nods and dismisses her underling. "Take that away and put it somewhere safe." Turning to you, the gnoll princess tents her clawed fingers and shows you her teeth. "All right then, we are satisfied with your offering, [pc.race]. At least you took me seriously and didn't try to lowball me." Now are you free to go and poke about the sinkhole? "Sure, sure. Since I'm such a magnanimous monarch, you have my leave to mess around with the hole all you want, so long as you don't do something idiotic like drain the lake into it or the like. Trust me, I won't be the only one thoroughly unhappy about that. If you could find some way to safely fill it in I'd like that, but those thick skulls on the western side of the valley probably wouldn't, huh?" Maybe if she corraled her subjects better and didn't resort to an existence of stealing what other people have, they might not mind it so much. A shrug. "Just think of it as protection money. Too much fun to give up, alas — and don't tell me your own rulers don't participate in such, only they dress it up with fancy names. Now then, go and mess with your hole or whatever, [pc.race]. We've got to deal with the business of survival." [var1 |"Was it wise to give in to their demands like that?" Liaden asks as the gnolls depart with their shiny new loot in tow. "I haven't been up here for too long, but Dad's introduced me to a whole host of local sayings bandied about the Marches, and 'if you pay the orcgeld, you'll never be rid of the orc' stuck with me. The princess now believes even more deeply that banditry and extortion pays off." [party.has arona |"Hey!" Arona growls. "That's my income you're talking about." ] [pc.isDK |Yes, but by the time they roll around again they'll be someone else's problem |Yes, but while you're not short of time there's no point in needlessly wasting it, either ]. Besides, the difference between that and any other toll is a hop, skip, and a jump. The princess wasn't wrong; extracting their share is kind of what monarchs do. Liaden clicks her tongue and gazes in the direction of the retreating gnoll host. "I still don't like it. Letting oneself be held hostage by demands made at spearpoint..." [pc.isDK |What, does the Order of the Oriflamme never have to get their hands dirty? Or is that just something left to sellswords and other disposable manpower? "The point is that we aren't supposed to fight dirty wars in the first place." She sighs. "Look, you know I'm right about knucklin' under to their demands." And she is, but one has got to be practical sometimes. Now then, the sinkhole. |A velvet glove, like the ones the more established warlords and princes of the south employ, would've been nice, but in the end, the gnolls weren't all that different. Besides, there's no way the Order can do what it does in the south without having to deal with diplomatic demands, royal or otherwise. There's value in manners, but they don't change what the demands are like underneath. "You're right," she sighs. "Still, I like to think that the people who rule the south use at least some of that money to do for their subjects, not just rob the people around there like this princess. Knucklin' under to her ultimatum just doesn't feel the same." There is a line, for sure. But it didn't seem like a particularly good time to bring up [silly |the social contract |reciprocal obligations between ruler and ruled ]. The important thing is that you gave up very little, and gained the opportunity to investigate the sinkhole without violence. And, now that you've done that... ] |[party.hasCompanions |"Was that smart?" [comp1.name] asks as the gnolls depart with their shiny new loot in tow. "I think there's a local saying along the lines of 'if you pay the orcgeld, you'll never be rid of the orc.' Now that they've learned banditry pays, they'll be back for more." [pc.isDK |Yes, but by the time they roll around again they'll be someone else's problem |Yes, but while you're not short of time there's no point in needlessly wasting it, either ]. Besides, the difference between that and any other toll is a hop, skip, and a jump. The princess wasn't wrong; extracting their share is kind of what monarchs do. That being said... [pc.isDK |by the time they roll around again they'll be someone else's problem |while you're not short of time there's no point in needlessly wasting it, either ]. Well, you've made your choice and will have to stick with it — whether it comes around later to bite you in the backside is something you'll just have to take in stride. rows.original: [var0 |Know what? All of the princess' offers don't strike your fancy — it's time for you to make an offer of your own. Taking the ale cask out of your things, you tap it a bit, let a little of the lovely liquid spill out and its scent carry into the breeze. It's a bit of a gamble and the gnolls are beginning to move in when they see you act, but then the smell of alcohol strikes their noses and you see their tails start to wag and tongues start lolling out from open jaws. Now, now. There's enough for everyone. Probably. Maybe. The gnoll princess, seeing her hold on her subjects slipping, angrily barks several orders in the gnolls' guttural tongue, but they aren't listening to her — what little discipline born of the temptation of loot completely collapses in the face of the open ale cask and fear of not getting one's share of this rare treat. Barely have you stepped back from the ale that the ring of gnolls dissolves, the mangy fuzzballs dropping their spears in their haste to break ranks and get to the booze. You won't deny it, seeing the princess' haughtiness dissolve into anger and then desperation at the complete lack of discipline in her subjects feels very, very satisfying, especially after she's puffed herself up like some kind of big shot. Sure, she may have gone out of her way to learn Belharan ways, but a different language and elocution didn't help her discipline her followers much. With the gnolls fighting each other over the ale and their princess screaming at them in exasperation, it feels like a good time to beat a quick retreat. You do just that, nipping over to the rim of the sinkhole where you can at least stay hidden from the princess and her entourage until they finish their impromptu party and give up searching for you... if they even have the mind to begin after they've guzzled down all your ale, that is. [var1 |"Well, if that isn't a sight," Liaden mutters as she glances over her shoulder at the drunken party. "Then again, I guess they were bound to be undisciplined with a leader like her. That was pretty good thinking, [pc.name] — I was afraid we were going to have to fight them." She probably would have, wouldn't she? "I probably would, but that's why you're here. Good work, [pc.name], I mean it. Now let's see what we can do about this hole..." ] |Know what? All of the princess' offers don't strike your fancy — it's time for you to make an offer of your own. Before the gnolls can close the distance, you've already got the jug in hand and a lit rag stuffed in the mouth; the mere sight gives the gnolls pause. Everybody can understand what's at stake here.[silly | As the ancient saying goes, fire bad. ] Now then, all she has to do is to call off her minions, and you won't throw this at them. "You wouldn't dare," the gnoll princess snarls. "The entire grassland is fit for tinder — you'd burn yourself up in the bargain." You don't know about that, there's an entire lake not too far away. "We'll kill you if you try to make it for the lake." On the contrary, you think her ragtag mob of mangy furballs is going to break ranks and flee in the face of raging flames. So, which is it going to be? "You're bluffing." Call it, then. She does. Pointing straight at you with a clawed finger, the gnoll princess barks several short sentences in her guttural tongue, and her underlings close in the circle with clear violent intent. With her calling your bluff, the only response is to raise the stakes — with a swift flick of your wrist, you send the fragile vessel of flammable oil arcing towards the feet of the nearest gnoll. It's as the princess said: while gnolls aren't very flammable despite having all that fuzz on them, the grasslands of Harvest Valley are akin to tinder, even this close to the lake. The jellied oil explodes out and forward in a cone towards one section of the circle of gnolls, and the grasses erupt into hot-burning flame. The gnolls were never very disciplined to begin with, and seeing their princess leap back swearing and screaming is all the impetus they need to break ranks and fall back from the raging flames, some even dropping their spears in their haste to get away from the incipient conflagration. That's your impetus to[var1| grab Liaden by the hand and] book it, [party.hasCompanions |[party.compNames true] hot on your heels |not even looking back at the scattering gnolls ]. You won't deny that the gamble was almost too hot to handle, and the flames lick at your retreating form as they start spreading aggressively, but you manage to make it to the edges of the sinkhole where the grasses quickly peter out. It's only then that you chance a glance back at the so-called gnoll princess and her entourage — they've fled in the opposite direction as you, towards the safety of the lake. You can still hear the gnoll princess growling and snapping orders as she desperately tries to corral her subjects and prevent them from panicking, and given the desperation in her voice she's fighting a losing battle. You won't deny it, seeing the princess' haughtiness dissolve into anger and then desperation at the complete lack of discipline in her subjects feels very, very satisfying, especially after she's puffed herself up like some kind of big shot. Sure, she may have gone out of her way to learn Belharan ways, but a different language and elocution didn't help her discipline her followers much. [var1 |"Gods, [pc.name]," Liaden huffs as she stops to catch her breath. "You... you really..." Did she doubt you? Paladin [pc.name], the great negotiator? "I thought you were bluffing, too!" [party.has azyrran |[azzy.isBimbo |"Thaa-aat's not a good idea, sweetie," Azzy says carefully. She flits over and tousles Lia's hair, then: "If you wanna talk talk, you gotta back it up. No matter where you say it — or what kind of talk it is!" |"See, that's one thing about making threats, Lia," Azzy says as she sidles over and pats a breathless Liaden on the shoulder. "You never do it if you're not willing to follow through should it come down to that." ] She's right, and that's exactly what you did. |There's this thing about making threats she needs to know — you never do it if you're not willing to follow through should your bluff be called. ] "This — I was — " How long has it been since she left her fellow Lumian cohorts to mix with the world at large? No, there's no need to answer that. But it worked out just fine in the end, didn't it? ] All in all, it looks like while the fire's got a lot of fuel to burn through, the prevailing wind's driving the flames away from you and towards the lakeshore. Hopefully, it ought to peter out with time — let the princess and her minions handle the matter, you've got bigger fish to fry. |Considering all the options that the gnoll princess' offered, you can only come to one conclusion: they[pc.isDK |'re all fucking terrible. Not surprising given that you might've done the same were you deluded of being at an advantage the way she thinks she is, but that doesn't change the fact that every option she's presented is a pile of gods-forsaken terrible. | all suck. While it's not surprising that she's more than willing to press her perceived advantage, but there's something to be said about leaving an enemy a plausible escape route in a fight. ] Guess you'll just have to create your own way out of this, then. Pulling the little explosive trinket out of your belongings, you test its weight in your palm before drawing your arm back in preparation to toss it. [var1 |"What — " She'd better cover her eyes right about now. ] The gnoll princess sees you winding back your arm and screams for her underlings to charge, but the instinctive fear and lack of discipline in the gnolls now that there's actual credible danger to be had gives them pause. That's enough of an opening for your plan to succeed — although no larger than a fist, the stone sails in a beautiful arc and detonates mid-flight with a brilliant flash of light and deafening roar that shakes you to the bones. Time to move! As the circle of spears collapses completely and the gnolls run howling in all directions, that's your chance to[var1| grab Liaden by the hand and] book it, [party.hasCompanions |[party.compNames true] hot on your heels |not even looking back at the scattering gnolls ]. The gnoll princess screams and yips in her own tongue, trying to marshal her subjects against you, but now that the mangy furballs have been thoroughly spooked corralling them back into any semblance of sanity is impossible. A few words, however strongly spoken, rapidly dissolve before the sheer terror ingrained into the gnolls' minds. Then again, that kind of explosion doesn't sit well with anybody. As for you, you book it, legs pumping and ears ringing as you blink back tears and spots in your vision. That was really too close for comfort, even if you didn't have much of a choice; at least you manage to stop yourself by the sinkhole's circumference before you wind up plunging headlong in like an idiot. It's only when you're sure you've shaken off the gnolls that you chance a glance back at the so-called gnoll princess and her entourage — they've fled in the opposite direction as you, towards the safety of the lake. You can still hear the gnoll princess growling and snapping orders as she desperately tries to corral her subjects and prevent them from panicking, and given the desperation in her voice she's fighting a losing battle. You won't deny it, seeing the princess' haughtiness dissolve into anger and then desperation at the complete lack of discipline in her subjects feels very, very satisfying, especially after she's puffed herself up like some kind of big shot. Sure, she may have gone out of her way to learn Belharan ways, but a different language and elocution didn't help her discipline her followers much... and even lockstep discipline wouldn't have done much in the face of that explosion. [var1 |"Gods, [pc.name]," Liaden huffs as she stops to catch her breath. "I'd have liked more warning on that — I'm still seeing spots." [pc.isDK |She should've been glad she got any warning at all. If not for the fact that she'd have been a hindrance stumbling about blindly and apt to fall into either the lake or sinkhole, you wouldn't even have bothered. |Sorry about that, but if you'd given her more warning the gnolls would also have had time to react, too. So long as she could see well enough to not be a hindrance and wind up in the lake or worse, the sinkhole, you'll call that a win. ] "I know it was necessary, but still...!" [party.has azyrran |"Like it or not, [pc.names] right, Lia," Azzy says as she sidles over and pats a breathless Liaden on the shoulder. "Sure, I'd liked to have had more warning too, but it was close enough with the gnolls as it was." She's right. One has to make these decisions on the spur of the moment, and it worked out for the best. What's a little discomfort as opposed to a ring of sharp sticks aimed your way? |Yeah, well, you'll take watering eyes and ringing ears over sharp sticks pointed your way any day, if she gets your drift. Sometimes you have to decide which of the two evils is lesser. ] "This — I was — " How long has it been since she left her fellow Lumian cohorts to mix with the world at large? No, there's no need to answer that. But it worked out just fine in the end, didn't it? That's you — paladin [pc.name], the great negotiator. ] Now then — you eye the direction the barks and snarls are coming from, but as far as you can tell they aren't coming for you. Sounds like the gnoll princess is more concerned with administering discipline and morale in the troops than pursuing you, which suits you just fine. Time to deal with the matter of this big hole in the ground, then... |Considering all the options that the gnoll princess' offered, you can only come to one conclusion: they[pc.isDK |'re all fucking terrible. Not surprising given that you might've done the same were you deluded of being at an advantage the way she thinks she is, but that doesn't change the fact that every option she's presented is a pile of gods-forsaken terrible. | all suck. While it's not surprising that she's more than willing to press her perceived advantage, but there's something to be said about leaving an enemy a plausible line of retreat instead of cornering them and forcing a fight. ] Well then, you have other ideas of your own — if there isn't an option that pleases you amongst this lot, you'll just have to make one. Pulling the vial of wyvern venom, you test its weight in your palm before whipping your arm around and hurling it straight at the disgusting gnolls. [var1 |"What — " If she doesn't want to get debilitatingly horny, you'd suggest holding her breath, starting now. ] The gnoll princess sees you winding back your arm and screams for her underlings to charge, but the sight of the pink, viscous goop flying through the air pokes at their instinct enough for them to freeze and try to assess the threat.
