rows.original: As the fight drags on, you gradually gain the upper hand — the incubus blackguard might be good, but the Dawnsword has a mind of its own and you gradually realize that it's not always in agreement with its wielder. For all its power, the blackguard isn't harnessing it as he was at the opening of the duel; he misses a couple swings that by all rights should have struck you, and appears distracted more often than what should make sense for someone in a life-or-death struggle. The decisive moment, though, comes when you make another pass at the blackguard. It comes at some risk — did he just aim to sever your hand at the wrist with that slice? — but your gambit pays off as your [pc.weapon] lands a solid blow on the Dawnsword's hilt, sending the magical relic sailing out of his grasp and through the air. The sudden shock on the incubus' face is plain for all to see, his attention obsessively focused on retrieving the fallen relic, and that's enough of an opening for you to sweep his legs out from under him and step up on a small mound, [pc.weapon] pointed down at him. It's over, demon.[silly | You have the... well, both of you know how this goes. ] Shakily, the incubus blackguard pulls himself to his feet — you didn't imagine him to be the type to yield while there's still breath in his body. He reaches out to the Dawnsword, clearly expecting the corrupted relic to return to his hand, but what happens next surprises even you: instead of returning to the blackguard, the Dawnsword flies through the air, knocking your [pc.weapon] free of your grasp and forcing itself into your hand. For a split second, you feel as if you're being disintegrated in the heat of a thousand blazing suns, and then you hear a distinct voice in your mind: You are worthy. [pc.isDK |And so you are. That knowledge, that proud confidence — it swells in your breast, as irrational as it is. The relic has chosen you, and you feel its heady, intoxicating power surging along your arm into the rest of your body; your blood burns, and your being feels alight with radiance overwhelming. It would be so easy to accept this power, to allow the relic to guide you in your desires and endeavors, whatever they may be. It's marvelous, beautiful, its blade of burning crimson light so true to its nature you could weep... It would be so easy to give in and do what you — and the sword — both want. It's recognized your strength, and summarily abandoned the last weak fool who thought to use its power for their purposes; the Dawnsword is a noble weapon, and will not suffer to allow itself to be held by anyone but the most powerful. |The moment your fingers close about the hilt, a change comes over the relic. For a fraction of a second, you feel the sword hilt try to push something from itself into your wrist, and then the flow reverses, pulling something out of you instead. In that moment, a sudden wave of hate and pain crashes into you, but it's soon replaced by a sensation of calm surety that washes away your worries like a clean spring shower. And the relic itself, it changes. Whatever it's drawing from you, the Dawnsword is clearly reacting to it, the blade of burning crimson light turning a hue of brilliant gold as it assumes a form more fitting to its new wielder. Or perhaps, if you look at it from another point of view, you're the one causing it to change... There it is. Soon both you and it are imbued with a placid calm. Whatever was within the blade is... changed? Laid to rest? You're not sure, and you don't know if you want to know. But now it feels like the weapon Sanders[var0| and Liaden] described to you: the tool of a holy warrior. Beneath that calm, certainly, you can still feel a swirl of feelings — intoxication at the power you now wield, righteousness burning within you to destroy the truly evil. It would be so easy to give in and do what you — and the sword — both want. No wonder Sanders kept it at arm's length. You can channel those feelings, though. You can resist the temptation to let go. You will wield this blade as what it is intended to be. ] "It's mine," the incubus blackguard breathes, his voice shaking. His dark eyes are wide, as if he'd just awoken from a fever dream, and unsurprisingly so — you know for sure that so long as he wielded the fallen relic, it had no small amount of influence on an obsessive like one of Kasyrra's ilk stereotypically would be. "It's mine!" [pc.isDK |Doesn't look like it. |Not anymore. ] The incubus blackguard doesn't quite seem to believe it, but the sight of the [pc.isDK |sword having recognized your superior strength in beating him one-on-one |now-purified blade in your hand ] is perhaps too much for him to bear. Certainly you'd only just arrived after he'd picked it up... and yet he looks as if he's missing a long-lost friend, a presence he always had with him and always assumed would be there until it was suddenly and unexpectedly ripped from him. Maybe it's providence, maybe it's fortune, maybe the loss of the Dawnsword is truly too much for an impassioned obsessive like a demon to bear. You see his legs tense for a last leap. With the Dawnsword still level, you tell him not to try it. He does. Demonic legs propel him upward, perfect position for you to slash at him, and his attack ends as soon as it starts, crumpling into the ash and dust below you with a howl. Somehow, the blackguard manages to rise to his knees again, [silly |G |g ]rievously wounded but still not dead, but he's already dangerously close to the spire's edge. As you watch, he collapses backwards and down into the searing upcurrents rushing out from the lava that rings the spire.
rows.translation: 随着战斗的持续，你逐渐占据了上风——那个卑鄙的催眠者或许实力不俗，但“晨曦剑”似乎有着自己的意志，你渐渐意识到，这把剑并不总是听从使用者的指挥。尽管它拥有强大的力量，但这个卑鄙之徒却无法像决斗开始时那样充分地运用它；他几次本该击中你的攻击都落空了，而且他的注意力也经常分散，这对于一个正在进行生死搏斗的人来说，实在是不太正常。 然而，决定性的时刻出现在你再次攻击那个卑鄙之徒的时候。这个行动确实伴随着一定的风险——他当初那一刀是不是就是为了砍断你的手腕？——但你的冒险最终得到了回报，因为你[pc.weapon]这一记重击直接击中了晨曦剑的剑柄，使得这件魔法遗物从他的手中飞了出去，悬在半空中。那个吸血鬼脸上的震惊之情显而易见，他的全部注意力都集中在重新夺回那件掉落的遗物上，而正是这个时机，让你有机会将他绊倒，然后踏上那个小土堆。 [pc.weapon]指向了他。 结束了，恶魔。[silly | 你们都有……嗯，你们俩都明白该怎么做吧。 ] 那个卑鄙的吸血鬼摇摇晃晃地站了起来——你绝对想不到，只要他还有一口气在胸口，就绝不会轻易认输。他伸出手去想要抓住那把被腐蚀的晨曦剑，显然期望这把神器能重新回到他的手中。然而，接下来发生的事情连你都感到意外：晨曦剑并没有回到那个卑鄙之人的手中，而是飞过了空中，直接击中了你[pc.weapon]从你的手中逃脱，自行进入了你的手。有那么一瞬间，你仿佛正在上千道炽热太阳的炙烤下逐渐分解，而随后，你脑海中清晰地响起了一个声音： 你值得拥有这一切。 [pc.isDK |的确如此。那种知识，那种令人自豪的自信——尽管它毫无理性依据，却会在你心中激荡。这件遗物选择了你，你能感受到它那令人陶醉的力量正沿着你的手臂流淌，遍布全身；你的血液仿佛在燃烧，整个身体仿佛都被一种强烈的光芒所照亮。接受这种力量是如此容易的事——让这件遗物引导你去追求任何你想要的东西、去做任何你想做的事情。这真是太奇妙了，太美妙了！它那燃烧着深红色光芒的刀刃，如此真实地体现了它的本质，以至于让人不禁为之落泪。放弃吧，做你和这把剑都想要的事情，其实非常简单。它已经认可了你的实力，也早已抛弃了那些试图利用它的力量来达到自己目的的弱者；晨曦之剑是一件高贵的武器，它绝不会容忍被除最强大之人之外的任何人所拥有。 |当你的手指握住剑柄的那一刻，这件遗物就会发生变化。有那么一瞬间，你会感觉到剑柄仿佛在试图将你推开某个东西从自身开始，流向你的手腕，然后流动方向逆转，将某物拉回上来。出局而是你们中的某一个人。在那一刻，一股突如其来的仇恨与痛苦会袭向你，但很快，一种平静而坚定的感觉会取代这一切，这种感觉就像一场清新的春日淋浴，将你的忧虑全部冲刷 away。 至于那件遗物本身变更无论这把晨曦剑从你身上汲取了什么，它显然都在对此作出反应——那燃烧着深红色光芒的剑刃会逐渐变成灿烂的金色，同时其形态也会变得更加适合它的新主人。或者，从另一个角度来看，或许正是你在促使它发生这些变化。就在那里。不久之后，你和这件武器都会陷入一种宁静的状态。那把剑里面原本的东西……发生了变化？还是得到了安息？你并不确定，也不清楚自己是否想知道答案。但此刻，这种武器给你的感觉，确实就像是桑德斯所说的那样[var0| 还有李亚登]让我来为您描述：这是一把神圣战士的工具。 在那种平静外表之下，你依然能够感受到内心涌动的种种情绪——对自己如今所拥有的力量的狂热，以及内心深处那份渴望摧毁真正邪恶的正义感。放弃这些冲动，去做你和这把剑都想要做的事情，其实是一件非常容易的事。难怪桑德斯总是将它放在手边却从不轻易使用。不过，你完全可以控制这些情绪，抵制那种放任自流的诱惑。你会将这把剑用在它原本该被使用的道路上。 ] 这是我的，”那个卑鄙的男妖颤抖着声音说道。他那双漆黑的眼睛瞪得大大的，仿佛刚刚从一场噩梦中惊醒——其实也难怪，因为只要他持有那件失落的神器，对于像卡希拉这类有着强迫症倾向的人来说，这种影响无疑是巨大的。“这是我的！ [pc.isDK |看起来不太可能。 |不再如此了。 ] 那个卑鄙的催眠者似乎并不太相信这一点，但眼前的景象[pc.isDK |那把剑早已认出了你在一对一对决中展现出的强大实力。 |你现在手中握着的，是一把已经经过净化处理的刀刃。 ]这对他来说或许太过难以承受了。毕竟，在他捡到它之后，你才刚刚赶到……然而他的神情却仿佛在思念一位失散已久的挚友，一个一直陪伴在他身边、他一直以为会永远留在他身边的存在，却突然之间、出人意料地从他生活中消失了。也许这是命运的安排，也许只是运气使然，但失去晨曦剑，对于这样一个痴迷于此的人来说，确实太过难以承受。你可以看到，他的双腿正在紧张地准备进行最后的冲刺。 而晨曦剑仍然竖立在那里，你劝他不要尝试。 他确实如此。那双恶魔般的双腿让他不断向上跃起，正好让你有机会攻击他；而他的攻击往往在刚开始就结束了——他会发出惨叫，然后化作灰烬坠落到你脚下。然而，这个卑鄙的家伙总能再次跪直身体。 [silly |G |g ]他身负重伤，却仍未死去，但他已经危险地接近了尖塔的边缘。就在你注视着他的时候，他向后倒下，坠入了从尖塔周围的熔岩中喷涌而出的灼热气流中。
rows.raw: " As the fight drags on, you gradually gain the upper hand — the incubus blackguard might be good, but the Dawnsword has a mind of its own and you gradually realize that it's not always in agreement with its wielder. For all its power, the blackguard isn't harnessing it as he was at the opening of the duel; he misses a couple swings that by all rights should have struck you, and appears distracted more often than what should make sense for someone in a life-or-death struggle. The decisive moment, though, comes when you make another pass at the blackguard. It comes at some risk — did he just aim to sever your hand at the wrist with that slice? — but your gambit pays off as your [pc.weapon] lands a solid blow on the Dawnsword's hilt, sending the magical relic sailing out of his grasp and through the air. The sudden shock on the incubus' face is plain for all to see, his attention obsessively focused on retrieving the fallen relic, and that's enough of an opening for you to sweep his legs out from under him and step up on a small mound, [pc.weapon] pointed down at him. It's over, demon.[silly | You have the... well, both of you know how this goes. ] Shakily, the incubus blackguard pulls himself to his feet — you didn't imagine him to be the type to yield while there's still breath in his body. He reaches out to the Dawnsword, clearly expecting the corrupted relic to return to his hand, but what happens next surprises even you: instead of returning to the blackguard, the Dawnsword flies through the air, knocking your [pc.weapon] free of your grasp and forcing itself into your hand. For a split second, you feel as if you're being disintegrated in the heat of a thousand blazing suns, and then you hear a distinct voice in your mind: You are worthy. [pc.isDK |And so you are. That knowledge, that proud confidence — it swells in your breast, as irrational as it is. The relic has chosen you, and you feel its heady, intoxicating power surging along your arm into the rest of your body; your blood burns, and your being feels alight with radiance overwhelming. It would be so easy to accept this power, to allow the relic to guide you in your desires and endeavors, whatever they may be. It's marvelous, beautiful, its blade of burning crimson light so true to its nature you could weep... It would be so easy to give in and do what you — and the sword — both want. It's recognized your strength, and summarily abandoned the last weak fool who thought to use its power for their purposes; the Dawnsword is a noble weapon, and will not suffer to allow itself to be held by anyone but the most powerful. |The moment your fingers close about the hilt, a change comes over the relic. For a fraction of a second, you feel the sword hilt try to push something from itself into your wrist, and then the flow reverses, pulling something out of you instead. In that moment, a sudden wave of hate and pain crashes into you, but it's soon replaced by a sensation of calm surety that washes away your worries like a clean spring shower. And the relic itself, it changes. Whatever it's drawing from you, the Dawnsword is clearly reacting to it, the blade of burning crimson light turning a hue of brilliant gold as it assumes a form more fitting to its new wielder. Or perhaps, if you look at it from another point of view, you're the one causing it to change... There it is. Soon both you and it are imbued with a placid calm. Whatever was within the blade is... changed? Laid to rest? You're not sure, and you don't know if you want to know. But now it feels like the weapon Sanders[var0| and Liaden] described to you: the tool of a holy warrior. Beneath that calm, certainly, you can still feel a swirl of feelings — intoxication at the power you now wield, righteousness burning within you to destroy the truly evil. It would be so easy to give in and do what you — and the sword — both want. No wonder Sanders kept it at arm's length. You can channel those feelings, though. You can resist the temptation to let go. You will wield this blade as what it is intended to be. ] "It's mine," the incubus blackguard breathes, his voice shaking. His dark eyes are wide, as if he'd just awoken from a fever dream, and unsurprisingly so — you know for sure that so long as he wielded the fallen relic, it had no small amount of influence on an obsessive like one of Kasyrra's ilk stereotypically would be. "It's mine!" [pc.isDK |Doesn't look like it. |Not anymore. ] The incubus blackguard doesn't quite seem to believe it, but the sight of the [pc.isDK |sword having recognized your superior strength in beating him one-on-one |now-purified blade in your hand ] is perhaps too much for him to bear. Certainly you'd only just arrived after he'd picked it up... and yet he looks as if he's missing a long-lost friend, a presence he always had with him and always assumed would be there until it was suddenly and unexpectedly ripped from him. Maybe it's providence, maybe it's fortune, maybe the loss of the Dawnsword is truly too much for an impassioned obsessive like a demon to bear. You see his legs tense for a last leap. With the Dawnsword still level, you tell him not to try it. He does. Demonic legs propel him upward, perfect position for you to slash at him, and his attack ends as soon as it starts, crumpling into the ash and dust below you with a howl. Somehow, the blackguard manages to rise to his knees again, [silly |G |g ]rievously wounded but still not dead, but he's already dangerously close to the spire's edge. As you watch, he collapses backwards and down into the searing upcurrents rushing out from the lava that rings the spire. "

rows.original: [var0 |Liaden gasps and jogs forward, but it's too late for her to do anything about it; the blackguard has fallen before she's closed even half the distance. Together, the both of you creep close to the edge, shielding yourselves from the blasts of hot, sulfurous air rising from below, and watch the demon fall. A little dark dot recedes into the field of red and orange far below, growing ever more distant until it vanishes with a faint splash. She shakes her head at the sight. "Could he have survived that?" Well... who knows? Certainly the demons didn't need protection against the cold and pressure like you did when diving down into the sunken jotun castle... does the same apply for lava? The only thing you can be sure of is that so long as there's no body, you can't be sure. And given Gweyr's experience with Leold, sometimes even that isn't enough. Liaden nods slowly. "I... I think I understand. It's strange. He was a demon and was absolutely insufferable, but after seeing how he changed after the relic was parted from him, I'm not so sure how much of his behavior was actually him. And speaking of that..." You look down at the Dawnsword in your hand, its blade [pc.isDK |pulsing with menacing red light. You still feel like yourself, for what it's worth.[pc.ra mothfolk | But... gosh, as you move it around you can't keep your eyes off it... it's soooooo shiny... ] "Please be careful with it, [pc.name]. I don't know whether the demon did something to it or if it was already this twisted to begin with and it simply was looking for a like-minded wielder, but I can feel its malignancy even from here." [pc.ra mothfolk |Oh! Right. Um. You sheepishly deactivate the blade and make all the shiny go away for now. ]Someone's got to carry it back to Sanders. Does she want to hold it? "N-no. You don't know about that; all this feels perfectly natural, as if the relic was made for you. But you aren't about to tell Liaden that to her face, and accept it with a nod. Is this supposed to be normal, though? |shimmering with a faint golden sheen. I told you you had a pretty good shot at provin' worthy." You accept the praise with a smile, then ask: is she okay with this? No hard feelings or anything? "I wasn't gonna be able to solo a demon," she laughs. "Helpin' you get to where you needed to go in order to do that... that's fine by me. [liaden.poly |Besides, like I said — this way it still stays in the family." Without warning, she squeezes you into a big, heartfelt hug, and gives you a passionate kiss. Oh my. If you'd known adventuring with your paladin girlfriend[party.has azyrran |s ] was going to be so... "I think this is the start of a beautiful relationship," she giggles, giving you one final squeeze before releasing you. Aw. Thanks. By the way — and here you hold up the sword — you're not sure about how this all went down. |You earned it, and that's that." Fair enough; you thank her for that, too. Is this supposed to be normal, though? ] ] Like, is it in the legends that the Dawnsword can be corrupted, that it changes itself to suit its wielder, that it actually has a mind and will of its own? Sanders certainly didn't tell you anything about that when he was briefing the both of you; something like that would certainly have been pertinent information. "It... it wasn't. Naturally, there were plenty of stories about the Dawnsword back in the keep that took its name from it, and while it had always been a powerful artifact and it was known to only work for the worthy, I don't think it ever showed this much of a mind of its own. I'm way in over my head, [pc.name] — let's see what Dad makes of all this." [pc.isDK |It's true. It's certainly a trend that Sanders has answers for questions — you can only hope that he hasn't been deliberately withholding them from you and Liaden all this time yet again. |She's right: he's the best person to ask about it all. You can't imagine that he left anything out of the story on purpose... ] [party.has etheryn |[pc.isDK |From your side, you hear Etheryn sigh. "[etheryn.lowConfidence |I d-don't think so," she stammers |I don't think so," she says cautiously ]. "Maybe he has some guesses, though. At least we got it out of that d[etheryn.lowConfidence |-d ]emon's hands — I hate the idea of Princess Iveryn's sword, if that's what this really is, belonging to them." Far better for it to be in yours, yes; you've certainly proved as much. |[etheryn.highConfidence |"I don't know if he'll be able to say," Etheryn says from beside you. Even if he doesn't know, though, you saved the sword — and got it back to normal again. If this really is Princess Iveryn's blade, I think she'd be proud." Does that go for her, too? rows.translation: [var0 |莉娅登倒吸一口冷气，急忙向前冲去，但为时已晚——那个卑鄙的家伙在她甚至还没跑过半程之前就已经倒下了。你们俩一起悄悄靠近边缘，躲避着从下方升腾而来的炽热硫磺气体，注视着那个恶魔坠落的情景。一个微小的黑点渐渐消失在下方那片红橙色的区域中，距离越来越远，最终在一声微弱的溅水声中彻底消失了。 看到这一幕，她摇了摇头：“他真的能活下来吗？嗯……谁知道呢？当然，那些恶魔并不像你在潜入那座沉没的巨人之堡时那样，需要抵御寒冷和压力……那么熔岩也是如此吗？唯一可以确定的是：只要没有生物存在，就永远无法确定会发生什么。考虑到格维尔与莱奥德的相处经历，有时候，即便这样也不够。 莉娅登缓缓点了点头：“我……我想我明白了。这真的很奇怪。他原本是个恶魔，行为举止令人难以忍受，但看到那件遗物与他分离后他的变化，我就不再那么确定他的那些行为，究竟有多少是真正的他说到这个……” 你低头看了看手中的晨曦剑，它的剑刃[pc.isDK |闪烁着令人不寒而栗的红光。至少，你仍然觉得自己还是原来的自己。[pc.ra mothfolk | The transformation when it leapt from his hand to yours was so sudden and total that you can't help but instinctively be leery of what's just happened, even if the relic doesn't reek of malignancy like it did a moment ago. Either way, someone's got to carry it back to Sanders, see what he makes of all this. As far as you can tell, the Dawnsword seems to really like you; maybe beating it in single combat must've made an impression on the thing, insofar as it could think. ] Is this supposed to be normal, though? Like, is it in the legends that the Dawnsword can fall, that it changes itself to suit its wielder, that it actually has[pc.isDK | | — or had? — ] a mind and will of its own? Sanders certainly didn't tell you anything about that when he was briefing you; something like that would certainly have been pertinent information you'd really liked to have known before being sent out on this treasure hunt. [pc.isDK |It's certainly a trend that Sanders has answers for questions — you can only hope that he hasn't been deliberately withholding them from you all this time yet again. |You have to wonder... did he know? Has the sword changed? You and he definitely have a lot to talk about. [party.has etheryn |Next to you, Ryn chews her lip dubiously. "I d[etheryn.lowConfidence |-d ]on't think he knew. Or, at least, I don't think the sword was like that when he had it." She [etheryn.highConfidence |gazes at the restored relic on your belt with something very close to awe |looks meaningfully at the restored relic on your belt ]. "I think you made it go back to the way it used to be." Maybe — and maybe not. There's still so many questions: was it the demon that corrupted it? Was it something else? Where did the will within the sword come from? [etheryn.lowConfidence |She swallows hard. ]"I think he'll have to [etheryn.lowConfidence |h- ]help us come up with the answers... but no matter what, think of what you just did. You saved P[etheryn.lowConfidence |-P ]rincess Iveryn's blade — if that's what this actually was. If she were here now, I think she'd be proud.[etheryn.highConfidence | I can't think of anyone more deserving than you!" [etheryn.fucked |Grinning, you plant a kiss on your elven lover's cheek. ]Is that an official grant from the Winter City's ruler? "It's not mine to give!" she giggles. "It's the sword that chooses. But I'm happy that it chose you." |" Hah. Does that make the sword officially yours, then? "I c[etheryn.lowConfidence |-c ]an't do that!" she stammers. "I mean... the sword did it itself. I'm just... I'm glad it did." ] ] ] With nothing left for you in this chamber, you turn back and prepare to make the long trek back to Hawkethorne. ] "

rows.original: Empowered by the relic, the incubus blackguard fights faster and harder than any single person should be able to — at some points in the fight, you swear that the Dawnsword moves of its own accord, simply dragging his arm and body along with its movements. Not that the demon resists the desires of the corrupted relic any: if anything, they're simply extensions of each other. But [party.combatNames] manage to overcome him anyway. You're a team, forged in battle against many a foe. And as a team, you drive him and the sword back, cut off the angles and chivvy him closer to the edge of the pit. Soon, he's got nowhere to go. Then it happens. With the demon backed up against the edge of the chasm, with no escape, you feel a tension in the back of your mind. A scant second later, the blade pulses, knocking you back, nearly taking you off your feet. While [party.combatNames] shake your heads, your opponent, just as dazedly as you, stares at the weapon in his hand. Shocked, confused, he looks back at you with wild eyes. "What?" You are not worthy. A second pulse comes, and this time it slams into you. You lose your feet, fly into the air for several heart-stopping seconds, and skid into the dirt. [comp1.name] sails in the opposite direction, nearly falling off the cliff in the process[party.som | | |, and [comp2.name] soars away too, sliding into the ash near the cavern entrance ]. Spitting soot and dirt from your mouth, you look for the sword — and you find it. Your demon opponent is clinging to the lip of the steep drop, the blade no longer in his hand but teetering quite precariously right next to him. You and [comp1.name] scramble to your feet and rush for the sword, but the demon's even quicker. He levers himself back up onto the cavern floor, sneering as his hand closes around the hilt... but the blade does nothing. No crimson light. His eyes widen, then he glares at you. "It won't let me," he snarls, and in an instant you know: he's going to try to kill you and regain control over the sword. It's too late, though — [comp1.name]'s not there yet, but you are. In fact, you're close enough to charge the weakened incubus. A final burst of speed strains your [pc.hasWings |wings |legs ]; your shoulder lowers for the impact. But the demon's still got enough left in him to meet you with a head-on leap that closes the gap terrifyingly quickly and slams him into you with a chuff. You both fall to the charred earth, all the while battling intensely for leverage and position. Through sheer weight and bulk and rage he manages to get on top, but you can feel the enervation in his limbs and sense [party.compNames] pounding the dirt as [party.som | |[comp1.heShe] rushes |they rush ] toward you. He's not going to win this, both you and he know it, you can see it in his black eyes... and you can see that he doesn't care. "[pc.name]!" [comp1.name] shouts, not too far away but not close enough. "The sword!" Huh? You don't have time to take a glance as the demon redoubles his efforts, trying to crush you before help arrives. Even though you batter back both his attempts to close his talons around your throat, even though his effort is doomed from the start, you still need both hands to hold him off... but after that, you can spare a look at the blade. What you see makes your blood run cold. The Dawnsword is teetering on the very lip of the chasm. If the demon can't have the blade, he'll keep you occupied while it falls off the edge so nobody gets the thing!
rows.translation: 在这件遗物的力量驱使下，这个恶魔战士的战斗速度和力量远远超出了常人的极限——在某些战斗场景中，你甚至会觉得那把“晨曦剑”仿佛在自主行动，它 simplement 牵引着他的手臂和身体一起移动。事实上，这个恶魔根本没有任何反抗这种被腐蚀的遗物所施加的影响；相反，它们简直就是彼此的延伸罢了。 [party.combatNames]无论如何，你们都成功击败了他。你们是一个团队，是在与无数敌人的战斗中共同成长起来的。作为一支团队，你们合力将他以及他的剑逼退，切断他的退路，逐渐将他逼向深渊的边缘。很快，他就再无退路可走了。 然后，那一刻到来了。当那个恶魔被逼到深渊的边缘，无处可逃时，你感到内心突然涌起一股紧张的情绪。几乎在一秒钟之后，那把剑突然挥动起来，将你击退，差点让你失去平衡。而此时[party.combatNames]你们都摇着头，你们的对手，也和你一样茫然地盯着他手中的武器。他震惊不已，满脸困惑，用充满惊愕的眼神看着你。“什么？ 你不配。 第二次脉冲出现了，而这一次猛烈撞击直直撞上了你。你会失去平衡，在空中悬停几秒钟，然后滑倒在地上。 [comp1.name]却朝着相反的方向航行，甚至在这个过程中差点从悬崖上掉下去。[party.som | | |，以及[comp2.name]也飞向了远方，滑落在洞穴入口附近的灰烬中。 ]你嘴里吐着烟灰和污垢，四处寻找那把剑——终于找到了它。你的恶魔对手正紧抓着那处陡峭悬崖的边缘，剑已经不在他手中，而是摇摇欲坠地悬在他旁边。 你和[comp1.name]你慌忙站起身，冲向那把剑，但那个恶魔的动作更快。他重新站回到洞穴的地面上，冷笑着握住了剑柄……然而，剑刃没有任何反应，也没有发出任何红色的光芒。他的眼睛瞪得大大的，然后凶狠地盯着你：“它不让我使用！”他低吼道，此刻你立刻明白了：他打算杀了你，重新掌控那把剑。 不过，已经太晚了[comp1.name]它还没有到达那里，但你已经接近了。事实上，你已经离攻击那个虚弱了的孵化兽足够近了。最后一次加速会让你感到体力透支[pc.hasWings |翅膀 |腿部 ]你的肩膀会向下弯曲以缓冲冲击力。但那个恶魔依然拥有足够的力量，他会迎面跃来，以惊人的速度缩短距离，然后将你猛地撞向自己哼了一声。你们俩都倒在了烧焦的地上，整个过程中都在激烈地争夺优势位置。凭借着自身的体重、力量以及愤怒，他终于占据了上风，但你可以感觉到他的四肢已经失去了力量[party.compNames]拼命奔跑[party.som | |[comp1.heShe]匆忙行事 |他们冲了上去。 ]他对你来说，这场战斗他赢不了，你和他都明白这一点，从他那双黑色的眼睛里就能看出来……而且你也看得出来，他根本不在乎。[pc.name]！” [comp1.name]喊声从不远的地方传来，但也不算太近。“那把剑！” 嗯？你甚至没有时间去看一眼，因为恶魔正在加紧攻势，试图在救援到来之前将你碾碎。尽管你拼命抵抗它试图用利爪扼住你喉咙的每一次攻击，尽管它的努力从一开始就注定失败，但你仍然需要用双手才能将它挡住。……但之后，你不妨看看那把剑。你所看到的一切会让你不寒而栗——晨曦剑正处于悬崖的边缘之上。如果那个恶魔无法得到那把剑，他就会拖住你的注意力，直到它从悬崖上掉下去，这样就没人能得到它了！

rows.original: Dammit, you don't have a choice. With a single hand, you try to hold him back, even though the demon's in mid-frenzy, even though his talons are slashing the air just inches from your throat. With the other, you reach for the sword. It's just barely too far away. You can't get a finger on it; it wobbles dangerously every time you get close. And now the incubus' full weight is on you. You can feel the greenstick fractures as your forearm bends in ways it's not supposed to bend. The demon's black eyes glitter victoriously as he presses down on you, talons inching closer and closer to your throat, and even the sound of a wordless shout from somewhere else in the cavern doesn't still his purpose. [comp1.isMulti etheryn arona brint brienne cait viv kiyoko agni tui quin |A winter storm does, though. Even the heat of the magma below fades away in the face of Ryn's boreal onslaught. The snow elf shouts in furious Alvarin as she conjures magical ice and frost from nothingness, buffeting the incubus with a northern wind that reaches hurricane force. His hands freeze, grow ice crystals, come close to shattering, and he recoils from you in panic. But that panic turns swiftly to rage. Clenching his fists, he manages to shatter the ice crystals and extend his talons once again. But now he's focused on your elven companion instead |"Hey! Dipshit!" That makes the incubus turn. He's met with a malicious, tusk-filled grin. "[arona.isDom |That's my bottom bitch. Go find your own. |[silly |[pc.name] can't come to the phone right now. So you get me. |Shitty demon bitch-ass says what? ] ]" Before he can even finish his "what", a meaty green hand yanks him bodily off of you and reverses him in midair. His head catches right between her knees. Then Arona [silly |piledrives the demon's head straight into the ground at Mach 2 |drops both of them down at blazing speed, hard enough to make the top of his head crack against the cavern floor ]. You can breathe again, and now Arona's keeping him busy |A minotaur fist does, though. Brint's blow knocks the demon clean off your body, almost over the edge into the chasm. To his credit, your foe recovers quickly, rolling quickly to his feet and missing the drop by inches, but Brint's just as quick to step between him and you. He meet the demon strength to strength, hand to hand, hooves digging into the cavern's ashy floor, pushing furiously into the grapple — and your mino-[brint.married |husband |[brint.fucked |lover |buddy ] ]'s winning. The raw test of muscle and might isn't over yet, but at the very least he's focused on Brint instead |A minotaur fist does, though. Brienne's blow knocks the demon clean off your body, almost over the edge into the chasm. To his credit, your foe recovers quickly, rolling quickly to his feet and missing the drop by inches, but Brie's just as quick to step between him and you. She meets him strength to strength, hand to hand, hooves digging into the cavern's ashy floor, pushing furiously against her demonic foe — and your mino[brienne.married |-wife |[brint.fucked |-lover |taur companion ] ]'s winning. The raw test of muscle and might isn't over yet, but at the very least he's focused on Brienne instead |A shout with actual words does, though. "Hey!" Cait yells. "[silly |Stinky |Jerkface ]!" He turns to the side, not knowing what's about to come, but you do — and you screw your eyes shut just in time. The demon doesn't, which means he gets a flash of the sun of Jassira right in the face. Howling, clawing at his eyes, temporarily blind, he releases the pressure on you, while turning a stream of barely-intelligible invective on Cait. Even if he could see, he'd be focused on her instead |A wolf spirit does, though. Viviane's spectral [silly |doggo |pet ] sets on the demon with fangs and claws, barking, snarling, scratching at him in a whirlwind of fur and fury. Somehow the demon takes the brunt of the blow and even throws the wolf off, but it leaps on him once more. Unfettered by his [viv.isDemon |demonic |magical ] mistress, the [silly |Very Good Boy |loyal wolf ] ravages the armored demon, snapping at his neck — and missing by less than an inch — but now the demon needs both hands merely to try to hold the ghost wolf's jaw away from his neck... and you can feel Viv feeding magical energy into her pet to make him even stronger. The demon's full attention is on your ghostly, furry friend |A flurry of foxfire does, though. Kiyoko's magical barrage knocks the demon back, singeing his already-leathery skin. It does more than singe, too. Soon, your foe's yelping in pain as flames lick at his body. Your fox[kiyoko.married |-wife |en lover ]'s too clever to come within range of his talons, too accurate with her magic to need to get any closer, so all the demon can do is try to protect his face with his hands and ward off the magical energy with less-essential body parts. Does it work? It doesn't really matter. What's important is that she's given you an opening by distracting his attention |What does distract him, though, is a piercing bottom-lip whistle. You and he both turn to see Agnimitra standing over you, gittern in hand. "I hope your head isn't as hard as this thing is," she sighs, and cracks him right in the face with it. Somehow, the instrument stays in one piece — but so does the incubus' head. He slashes away at Agni, who dodges with all her consummate avian skill. Now that she's got his attention, her hands weave into a loop, then set off a series of magical fireworks, all flame and spiral and light, right in the demon's face so he can barely see. Despite his murderous intent, she's got his attention in her own inimical way, at least for a few seconds |[silly |What does, though, is when you see something out of the corner of your eye, smile, and shout, "End him rightly, Tui!" The demon turns just in time to see a red blur streak toward him. With a tremendous crack, Atugia's head slams right into the demon's head and knocks him for a loop. The rest of her body comes charging in a few seconds later, scooping up the head and conjuring a spectral halberd all in a single motion to slash away at the still-confused demon. |Even if that doesn't, Tui's fist, encased in her spectral magic, does. The blow knocks the demon back, and the dullahan follows it up, raining enough blows on his armor to dent it. He swipes blindly at her with his claws, but she steps out of reach with a well-practiced rhythm, then summons her halberd out of nowhere to slash away at him in turn. ] The crimson-haired warrior's caught the demon off guard, and now she's got his full attention |What does is a whipcrack of bright pink magic that lashes across his nose. "Wha—?" The incubus turns just in time to see Quin, alight with his firewalk's brilliant glow, bound in from the side. A magical blaze wreathes his [quin.weapon] as he slashes at the demon... indeed, wreathes his whole body, and makes his demonic foe howl when he tries to counterattack. And it works. The cries of pain, the flames licking at the demon's body: they're a lot, too much for most mortals to bear, and even give someone like this corruption-augmented blackguard pause. Even if he doesn't fall, though, the important thing now is that he's fighting Quin. The valiant taeleer's keeping your foe's attention well away from you ] — — which means you're finally free to close your eyes, focus your entire being into [pc.isDK |smoldering rage |preternatural calm ], and reach out for the hilt once again. Pushed the rest of the way by its own magical force, it rolls right into your hand, safe from the drop and the magma below. But that's where the easy part ends. As soon as your fingers close around it, you gasp from the pressure wave traveling up your arm and into your [silly |golden core |being ]. Another pulse hammers you, just like the ones before, and this time it feels like it's concentrated inside your skull. Maybe the blade's fighting you, maybe it's testing your worthiness, but either way the pain it forces into you is overwhelming. You can feel want, desire, something inside the sword, something that animated it and the incubus in battle against you. You don't know where it came from, but you fight its will every step of the way. You will have the last say here. You are worthy. And as an echo in your mind, you hear that last again: You... you are worthy. [pc.isDK |There it is. The knowledge, the proud confidence of your victory swells in your breast, irrational as it is. You've subjugated the relic, and now you feel its heady, intoxicating power surging along your arm into the rest of your body; your blood burns and your being feels alight with radiance overwhelming. It would be so easy to accept its power, to let the relic guide you in your desires, whatever they may be... but no. You've taught this recalcitrant hunk of junk just who's in charge. It's recognized your strength, and now it has no other choice. The last fool who held it was weak, but you: you can impose yourself on it. The surety of your supremacy flows through you as you grasp the blade anew, and soon the angry crimson blade snaps into existence once more, now a bloody extension of your will, not the demon's, and it feels glorious. Your first command to the blade: murderous intent. |Even though the demon still sits on top of you, even though he and [comp1.name] rain blows on each other, even though the cavern shakes with volcanic instability, all you feel is a preternatural calm. All your worries drain away. The sword's pressure fades, and as you gaze at it, you watch it change. You watch its ornamentation glow brighter; you see the gem shine with the power of the sun, and then you feel the divine golden blade snap into glowing existence along its full length. There are still feelings within the blade, righteous anger and pride and intoxicating power all swirling beneath the placid calm that imbues you, but no longer does it push against you. The will within it fades, is laid to rest, joins with you — you're not sure, and right now it doesn't matter. It flows into you and you into it, all alight with radiance overwhelming, and now you have an inkling of what Sanders was talking about. This is once more a weapon for heroes, and it's chosen you. Now, whether the blade guides you or you guide it is an academic question. ] What that translates into is a movement, slow enough to avoid triggering the demon's defensive instincts, fast enough to keep him from noticing in time. From where it lies on the ground, your hand and the sword slash quickly but deliberately, and the demon doesn't even have time to blink before impact. He screams as the [pc.isDK |crimson |golden ] blade cuts through his chest armor, and you try to catch him again on the backswing. But he just barely manages to get out of the way, stumbling back from you and [comp1.name] despite his [silly |G |g ]rievous wound. That scream turns to a quick, panicky pant as [party.compNames] advance on him, forcing him back toward a precarious ledge above the chasm. He pays his surroundings no mind, instead focusing all his attention, his rage, his pain, his disbelief on you. "Not you. Not you." You brandish the Dawnsword at the demon. It's over.[silly | You have the... well, he knows what comes next. ] None of it penetrates the demon's head. You can see his black eyes rolling wildly, then fixating on you. Then his legs tense for the leap. "Don't try it." [comp1.name]'s voice stays level and true. He does. The demon, wobbling on unsteady legs, makes another lunge for you, but with a flicker of will — your will — the Dawnsword flashes once again and he crumples to the ground with yet another shriek. It's the last sound he makes. The impact jolts you all as it happens, and more importantly, jolts the ground, and in the blink of an eye, the outcropping that he was on separates from the rest of the ledge to plummet into the abyss. [party.CombatNames] edge forward cautiously, alert for any further collapse, and manage to peer over the edge... just in time to see his black dot merge with the rest of the magma below and disappear.
rows.translation: He swipes blindly at her with his claws, but she steps out of reach with a well-practiced rhythm, then summons her halberd out of nowhere to slash away at him in turn. ] The crimson-haired warrior's caught the demon off guard, and now she's got his full attention |What does is a whipcrack of bright pink magic that lashes across his nose. "Wha—?" The incubus turns just in time to see Quin, alight with his firewalk's brilliant glow, bound in from the side. A magical blaze wreathes his [quin.weapon] as he slashes at the demon... indeed, wreathes his whole body, and makes his demonic foe howl when he tries to counterattack. And it works. The cries of pain, the flames licking at the demon's body: they're a lot, too much for most mortals to bear, and even give someone like this corruption-augmented blackguard pause. Even if he doesn't fall, though, the important thing now is that he's fighting Quin. The valiant taeleer's keeping your foe's attention well away from you ] — — which means you're finally free to close your eyes, focus your entire being into [pc.isDK |smoldering rage |preternatural calm ], and reach out for the hilt once again. Pushed the rest of the way by its own magical force, it rolls right into your hand, safe from the drop and the magma below. But that's where the easy part ends. As soon as your fingers close around it, you gasp from the pressure wave traveling up your arm and into your [silly |golden core |being ]. Another pulse hammers you, just like the ones before, and this time it feels like it's concentrated inside your skull. Maybe the blade's fighting you, maybe it's testing your worthiness, but either way the pain it forces into you is overwhelming. You can feel want, desire, something inside the sword, something that animated it and the incubus in battle against you. You don't know where it came from, but you fight its will every step of the way. You will have the last say here. You are worthy. And as an echo in your mind, you hear that last again: You... you are worthy. [pc.isDK |There it is. The knowledge, the proud confidence of your victory swells in your breast, irrational as it is. You've subjugated the relic, and now you feel its heady, intoxicating power surging along your arm into the rest of your body; your blood burns and your being feels alight with radiance overwhelming. It would be so easy to accept its power, to let the relic guide you in your desires, whatever they may be... but no. You've taught this recalcitrant hunk of junk just who's in charge. It's recognized your strength, and now it has no other choice. The last fool who held it was weak, but you: you can impose yourself on it. The surety of your supremacy flows through you as you grasp the blade anew, and soon the angry crimson blade snaps into existence once more, now a bloody extension of your will, not the demon's, and it feels glorious. Your first command to the blade: murderous intent. |Even though the demon still sits on top of you, even though he and [comp1.name] rain blows on each other, even though the cavern shakes with volcanic instability, all you feel is a preternatural calm. All your worries drain away. The sword's pressure fades, and as you gaze at it, you watch it change. You watch its ornamentation glow brighter; you see the gem shine with the power of the sun, and then you feel the divine golden blade snap into glowing existence along its full length. There are still feelings within the blade, righteous anger and pride and intoxicating power all swirling beneath the placid calm that imbues you, but no longer does it push against you. The will within it fades, is laid to rest, joins with you — you're not sure, and right now it doesn't matter. It flows into you and you into it, all alight with radiance overwhelming, and now you have an inkling of what Sanders was talking about. This is once more a weapon for heroes, and it's chosen you. Now, whether the blade guides you or you guide it is an academic question. ] What that translates into is a movement, slow enough to avoid triggering the demon's defensive instincts, fast enough to keep him from noticing in time. From where it lies on the ground, your hand and the sword slash quickly but deliberately, and the demon doesn't even have time to blink before impact. He screams as the [pc.isDK |crimson |golden ] blade cuts through his chest armor, and you try to catch him again on the backswing. But he just barely manages to get out of the way, stumbling back from you and [comp1.name] despite his [silly |G |g ]rievous wound. That scream turns to a quick, panicky pant as [party.compNames] advance on him, forcing him back toward a precarious ledge above the chasm. He pays his surroundings no mind, instead focusing all his attention, his rage, his pain, his disbelief on you. "Not you. Not you." You brandish the Dawnsword at the demon. It's over.[silly | You have the... well, he knows what comes next. ] None of it penetrates the demon's head. You can see his black eyes rolling wildly, then fixating on you. Then his legs tense for the leap. "Don't try it." [comp1.name]'s voice stays level and true. He does. The demon, wobbling on unsteady legs, makes another lunge for you, but with a flicker of will — your will — the Dawnsword flashes once again and he crumples to the ground with yet another shriek. It's the last sound he makes. The impact jolts you all as it happens, and more importantly, jolts the ground, and in the blink of an eye, the outcropping that he was on separates from the rest of the ledge to plummet into the abyss. [party.CombatNames] edge forward cautiously, alert for any further collapse, and manage to peer over the edge... just in time to see his black dot merge with the rest of the magma below and disappear. "

rows.original: [pc.isDK |Truly worthless. He didn't even have the mental fortitude to stomach a loss — how did he even imagine he was fit to wield the blade you now do? Throwing oneself off and into death... truly the coward's way out instead of facing up to the reality of the matter |You pace forward off the little rock mound, perhaps hoping to save him before he falls, but it's too late to attempt a rescue even if you wanted to; even with the Dawnsword's power mingling with yours as it runs through your veins, the blackguard has fallen before you close even half the distance ]. Peering over the lip of the spire, you see a little dark dot plummet into the inferno below, lit by the orange glow of the magma before finally disappearing into the molten rock. Could he survive that? Certainly the demons didn't need protection against the cold and pressure like you did when diving down into the sunken jotun castle... does the same apply for lava? Aaah, who knows? All you do know is the old mercenary's adage... so long as there's no body, it's not a confirmed kill. And given Gweyr's experience with Leold, sometimes even that isn't enough. Slowly, the rush of battle begins to fade, and your blood cools with it; the Dawnsword's weight becomes palpable in your hand, and you look down at it. Whatever it did to the incubus blackguard, it doesn't seem to be affecting you any... or maybe your heart is so much in alignment with its will that it doesn't need to provoke you into doing anything you weren't already about to. |shimmers with a faint golden sheen. It's certainly a trend that Sanders has answers for questions — you can only hope that he hasn't been deliberately withholding them from you all this time yet again. ] With nothing left for you in this chamber, you turn back and prepare to make the long trek back to Hawkethorne. "

rows.original: Empowered by the relic, the incubus blackguard fights faster and harder than any single person should be able to — at some points in the fight, you swear that the Dawnsword moves of its own accord, simply dragging his arm and body along with its movements. Not that the demon resists the desires of the corrupted relic any: if anything, they're simply extensions of each other. But [party.combatNames] manage to overcome him anyway. You're a team, forged in battle against many a foe. And as a team, you drive him and the sword back, cut off the angles and chivvy him closer to the edge of the pit. Soon, he's got nowhere to go. And then it happens. With the demon backed up against the edge of the chasm, with no escape, you feel a tension in the back of your mind. A scant second later, the blade pulses, knocking you back, nearly taking you off your feet. While [party.combatNames] shake your heads, your opponent, just as dazedly as you, stares at the weapon in his hand. Shocked, confused, he looks back at you with wild eyes. "What?" You are not worthy. A second pulse comes, and this time it slams into you. You lose your feet, fly into the air for several heart-stopping seconds, and skid into the dirt. Lia sails in the opposite direction, nearly falling off the cliff in the process[party.hasCompanions |, and [party.compNames true] soar[party.som | |s ] even further back, sliding into the ash near the cavern entrance ]. Spitting soot and dirt from your mouth, you look for the sword — and you find it. Your demon opponent is clinging to the lip of the steep drop, the blade no longer in his hand but teetering quite precariously right next to him. You and Lia scramble to your feet and rush for the sword, but the demon's much closer. He levers himself back up onto the cavern floor, sneering as his hand closes around the hilt... but the blade does nothing. No crimson light. His eyes widen. "It won't let me," he snarls, and then he glares at you. In an instant you know: he's going to try to kill you to regain control over the sword. It's too late, though. Lia's not there yet, but you've been [pc.hasWings |wing |runn ]ing toward him this whole time; you're close enough to bull-rush the weakened incubus, picking up speed, lowering your shoulder for the impact. But he's still got enough left in him to meet you with a head-on leap that closes the gap terrifyingly quickly and slams him into you with a chuff. You both end up on the charred earth, battling intensely for leverage and position. Through sheer weight and bulk and rage he manages to get on top, but you can feel the enervation in his limbs and sense [party.compNames] pounding the dirt as [party.hasCompanions|they rush|she rushes] toward you. He's not going to win this, both you and he know it, you can see it in his black eyes... and you can see that he doesn't care. "[pc.name]!" Liaden shouts, not too far away. "The sword!" Huh? You don't have time to take a glance as the demon redoubles his efforts, trying to crush you before help arrives. Even though you batter back both his attempts to close his talons around your throat, even though his effort is doomed from the start, you still need both hands to hold him off... but once you're both stuck in the grapple, you can spare a look at the blade. What you see makes your blood run cold. The Dawnsword is teetering on the very lip of the chasm. If the demon can't have the blade, he'll keep [party.hasCompanions |all of you |you and Liaden ] from getting it instead!
rows.translation: 在这件遗物的力量驱使下，这个恶魔战士的战斗速度和力度远远超出了常人的极限——在某些战斗场景中，你甚至会怀疑那把“晨曦剑”是在自己主动移动，而它的每一次挥动都在无形中牵引着他的手臂和身体。事实上，这个恶魔根本没有任何反抗这种被腐蚀的遗物所施加的影响；相反，它们简直就是彼此的延伸部分。 但是[party.combatNames]无论如何，你们都成功战胜了他。你们是一个团队，是在与无数敌人的战斗中共同成长起来的。作为一支团队，你们合力将他以及他的剑逼退，切断他的退路，逐渐将他逼向深渊的边缘。很快，他就再无退路可走了。 然后，那一刻到来了。当那个恶魔被逼到深渊的边缘，无处可逃时，你感到内心突然涌起一股紧张的情绪。几乎在一秒钟之后，那把剑突然挥动起来，将你击退，差点让你失去平衡。而此时[party.combatNames]你们都摇着头，你们的对手，也和你一样茫然地盯着他手中的武器。他震惊不已，满脸困惑，用充满惊愕的眼神看着你。“什么？ 你不配。 第二次脉冲出现了，而这一次猛烈撞击你整个人都被抛了出去。在那些令人心悬一线的几秒钟里，你飞向空中，最后滑落在泥土中。而莉亚却朝相反的方向冲去，甚至差点从悬崖上掉下去。[party.hasCompanions |，以及[party.compNames true]翱翔[party.som | | ]再往更远的地方，滑落到洞穴入口附近的灰烬中 ]你嘴里吐着烟灰和污垢，四处寻找那把剑——终于找到了。你的恶魔对手正紧抓着那处陡峭边缘，剑已经不在他手中，而是摇摇欲坠地悬在他旁边。 你和莉亚急忙站起身来，冲向那把剑，但恶魔的距离已经近了很多。它重新站回了洞穴的地面上，冷笑着将手伸向剑柄……然而，剑刃没有任何反应，也没有发出任何猩红色的光芒。他的眼睛瞪得大大的。“它不让我这么做，”他咆哮道，然后恶狠狠地盯着你。瞬间你就明白了：他一定会试图杀死你，以便重新掌控那把剑。 然而，已经太晚了。莉亚还没有到那里，而你已经[pc.hasWings |翅膀 |运行 ]整个过程中你都在朝他冲去；你已经足够接近了，可以冲向那个体力衰弱的梦魔，加快速度，低下肩膀准备迎接撞击。但他仍然有足够的力气，突然向前一跃，迅速缩短了距离，然后将你猛地撞了上去哼了一声。最终，你们两人都落在了焦土之上，为争夺优势地位而激烈搏斗。凭借着巨大的体重、强大的体魄以及满腔的怒火，他终于占据了上风，但你能感受到他四肢所承受的沉重负担，也能体会到他的疲惫与无力[party.compNames]拼命奔跑着[party.hasCompanions|他们冲了上去。|她冲了出去。]他对你来说，这场战斗他赢不了，你和他都明白这一点，从他那双黑色的眼睛里就能看出来……而且你也看得出来，他根本不在乎。[pc.name]快！莉娅登在不远的地方喊道：‘那把剑！’” 哈？你甚至没有时间去看一眼，因为恶魔正在加紧攻势，试图在救援到来之前将你碾碎。尽管你拼命抵抗它试图抓住你喉咙的举动，尽管它的努力从一开始就注定失败，但你仍然需要用双手来抵挡它……但当你们俩都陷入这场搏斗时，你们会有机会看到那把剑。你所看到的一切会让你不寒而栗——晨曦剑剑正处于深渊的边缘。如果那个恶魔无法得到这把剑，他一定会继续[party.hasCompanions |你们所有人 |你和莉娅登 ]而是去获得它！

rows.original: There's nothing else to do here: you have to grab it before it's lost for good, even if it is an insane risk. Despite the demon's frenzy, you try to hold him off with a single hand and stretch out for the sword with the other. It's just barely too far away. You can't get a finger on it; it wobbles dangerously every time you get close. And now the incubus' full weight is on you. You can feel the greenstick fractures as your forearm starts to bend in ways it's not supposed to bend. The demon's black eyes glitter victoriously as he presses down on you, talons inching closer and closer to your throat. Even the sound of a wordless shout from somewhere else in the cavern doesn't still his purpose. The impact of a halberd does, though. All the pressure from above disappears as Liaden slams into the incubus at full tilt. Her polearm catches in his armor, keeping her attack from being a killing blow, but the sheer force of it is still enough to push him sideways off your arm. More than that, it distracts him. With a howl, he raises his fist against the fresh onslaught, spitting fire and fury in the Lumian paladin's face. He's down, but definitely not out, and now it's Lia who's left to take the full brunt of what remains of his rage — — but you don't see any of it. Instead you close your eyes, focus your whole being into [pc.isDK |smoldering rage |preternatural calm ], and reach out for the hilt once again. Pushed the rest of the way by its own magical force, it rolls right into your hand, safe from the drop and the magma below. But that's where the easy part ends. As soon as your fingers close around it, you gasp from the pressure wave traveling up your arm and into your [silly |golden core |being ]. Another pulse hammers you, just like the ones before, and this time it feels like it's concentrated inside your skull. Maybe the blade's fighting you, maybe it's testing your worthiness, but either way the pain it forces into you is overwhelming. You can feel want, desire, something inside the sword, something that animated it and the incubus in battle against you. You don't know where it came from, but you fight its will every step of the way. You will have the last say here. You are worthy. And as an echo in your mind, you hear that last again: You... you are worthy. [pc.isDK |There it is. The knowledge, the proud confidence of your victory swells in your breast, irrational as it is. You've subjugated the relic, and now you feel its heady, intoxicating power surging along your arm into the rest of your body; your blood burns and your being feels alight with radiance overwhelming. It would be so easy to accept its power, to let the relic guide you in your desires, whatever they may be... but no. You've taught this recalcitrant hunk of junk just who's in charge. It's recognized your strength, and now it has no other choice. The last fool who held it was weak, but you: you can impose yourself on it. The surety of your supremacy flows through you as you grasp the blade anew, and soon the angry crimson blade snaps into existence once more, now a bloody extension of your will, not the demon's, and it feels glorious. Your first command to the blade: murderous intent. |Even though the demon still sits on top of you, even though he and Liaden rain blows on each other, even though the cavern shakes with volcanic instability, all you feel is a preternatural calm. All your worries drain away. The sword's pressure fades, and as you gaze at it, you watch it change. You watch its ornamentation glow brighter; you see the gem shine with the power of the sun, and then you feel the divine golden blade snap into glowing existence along its full length. There are still feelings within the blade, righteous anger and pride and intoxicating power all swirling beneath the placid calm that imbues you, but no longer does it push against you. The will within it fades, is laid to rest, joins with you — you're not sure, and right now it doesn't matter. It flows into you and you into it, all alight with radiance overwhelming, and now you have an inkling of what Sanders and Lia were talking about. This is once more a weapon for heroes, and it's chosen you. Whether the blade guides you or you guide it is an academic question. ] What that translates into is a movement, slow enough to avoid triggering the demon's defensive instincts, fast enough to keep him from noticing in time. From where it lies on the ground, your hand and the sword slash quickly but deliberately, and the demon doesn't even have time to blink before impact. He screams as the [pc.isDK |crimson |golden ] blade cuts through his chest armor, stumbling back just in time to avoid another one on the backswing. That scream turns to a quick, panicky pant as [party.compNames] advance on him, forcing him to scrabble back toward a precarious ledge above the chasm. He pays his surroundings no mind, instead focusing all his attention, his rage, his pain, his disbelief on you. "Not you. Not you." You brandish the Dawnsword at the demon. It's over.[silly | You have the... well, he knows what comes next. ] None of it penetrates the demon's head. You can see his black eyes rolling wildly, then fixating on you. Then his legs tense for the leap. "Don't try it." Lia's halberd stays level and true. He does. The demon, wobbling on unsteady legs, makes another lunge for you, but with a flicker of will — your will — the Dawnsword flashes once again and he crumples to the ground with yet another shriek. It's the last sound he makes. The impact jolts you all as it happens, and more importantly, jolts the ground. His eyes widen in disbelieving rage, but that's all that they have time to do before the outcropping that he was on separates from the rest of the ledge to plummet into the abyss. [party.CombatNames] edge forward cautiously, alert for any further collapse, and manage to peer over the edge... just in time to see his black dot merge with the rest of the magma below and disappear.
rows.translation: 这里已经没有什么别的办法了：你必须尽快抓住它，否则它就会永远消失不见了，即使这需要承担巨大的风险。尽管恶魔正在疯狂地攻击你，你还是试图用一只手挡住它的攻击，同时用另一只手去抓住那把剑。它确实距离太远了，根本够不着；每次你靠近时，它都会危险地摇晃起来。而现在，那个恶魔的全部重量都压在了你身上，你能感觉到前臂正在以不应该的方式弯曲，甚至出现了骨折的征兆。恶魔那双漆黑的眼睛闪烁着胜利的光芒，它压向你，爪子逐渐逼近你的喉咙。即使洞穴的某个角落传来一声无声的惊叫，也无法阻止它的行动。 然而，长柄战斧的冲击力确实不容小觑。 当莉娅登全速冲向那个恶魔化身时，来自上方的所有压力都消失了。她的长柄武器刺入了他的盔甲，使得这一攻击未能致其死亡，但那巨大的冲击力仍然足以将他推向一旁。不仅如此，这一切还在分散他的注意力。他发出一声怒吼，举起拳头迎向这新一轮的攻击，将满腔的愤怒与火势喷射向那位卢米安圣骑士的脸庞。他虽然倒下了，但绝对还没有被击败，现在，承受他剩余怒火的，就只剩下莉亚了…… — 但你却什么都没有看到。相反，你闭上了眼睛，将全部注意力都集中起来[pc.isDK |郁积的愤怒 |超乎常人的冷静 ]再次伸手去抓住剑柄。 在它自身的魔力推动下，剑会直接滚落到你的手中，既不会掉落，也不会被下方的岩浆伤害到。但这时，轻松的部分也就结束了。当你的手指握住剑柄的瞬间，你会因为那股从手臂传向全身的压力波而倒吸一口凉气[silly |黄金核心 |存在 ]又一次，那种剧烈的疼痛袭来，与之前的每一次一样，只不过这一次，这种疼痛似乎集中在你的头骨内部。也许那把刀正在与你对抗，也许它在考验你的价值，但无论如何，这种疼痛所带来的折磨都是难以忍受的。你能感受到那种渴望、那种强烈的欲望某个东西在那把剑的内部，存在着某种力量，正是这种力量赋予了剑生命，也让那个恶魔在与你战斗时充满活力。你不知道这种力量从何而来，但在每一步战斗中，你都在与它的意志抗争。最终，决定权就在你手中——你确实值得拥有它。 而在你的脑海中，那句话又一次回荡起来：你……你是值得的。 [pc.isDK |就是这种感觉。那种关于自己必将获胜的自信，那种令人骄傲的情绪，在你心中激荡着，尽管这种感觉有些不合常理。你已经征服了那件遗物，现在你能感受到它那令人陶醉的力量正沿着你的手臂流淌到全身；你的血液仿佛在燃烧，你的整个存在仿佛都被一种强烈的光芒所照亮。接受它的力量本来是如此容易的事，让这件遗物引导你实现任何愿望……但不，你已经让这个倔强的“废品”明白了谁才是真正的主人。它认识到了你的力量，现在它别无选择。上一个持有它的人很弱小，但你……你却可以。强加当你再次握住那把剑时，你对自己充满了信心。你的霸主地位已然融入你的身体之中，很快，那把充满怒意的深红色剑刃便再次诞生了——如今，它已成为你意志的延伸，而非恶魔的工具，这种感觉简直美妙至极。 你对这把剑下达的第一个指令，就是：充满杀意的攻击。 |尽管恶魔依然盘踞在你的身上，尽管它与莉娅登的风相互交织，尽管洞穴因火山活动而不断震动，你却感受到一种超自然的平静。所有的忧虑都烟消云散了，剑的压力也逐渐消失。当你凝视着那把剑时，你会看到它正在发生变化——它的装饰图案变得更加明亮，宝石也仿佛被太阳的光芒照亮，然后感受到那把神圣的金色宝剑在整个长度上瞬间焕发出耀眼的光芒。 剑身之中依然蕴藏着那些情感——正义的愤怒、自豪感，以及那令人陶醉的力量，它们都在那表面看似平静的状态下暗流涌动，但它们不再对你产生压迫感了。其中蕴含的意志逐渐消逝，安息下来，与你融为一体——你并不确定这一点，但此刻这也并不重要。那种意志融入了你，你也融入了它，两者共同迸发出令人震撼的光芒，此刻你终于开始理解桑德斯和莉亚所谈论的东西了。这又是一件属于英雄们的武器，而它选择了你。 至于是刀刃引导你，还是你引导刀刃，这只是一个理论上的问题罢了。 ]这种动作的速度既慢到足以避免触发恶魔的防御本能，又快到让恶魔没有时间察觉。从地面上抬起手，迅速而精准地挥动剑刃，恶魔甚至来不及眨眼，攻击就已经发生了。 他发出了惨叫声[pc.isDK |深红色 |金色 ]刀刃划破了他的胸甲，他踉跄着后退，刚好躲过了下一击的攻击。那声尖叫立刻变成了急促而慌乱的喘息声[party.compNames]向他发起攻击，迫使他拼命地向峡谷上方那处岌岌可危的岩架爬去。他完全无视周围的环境，将所有的注意力、所有的愤怒、所有的痛苦，以及所有的难以置信都集中在了你身上。“不是你不是你。你挥舞着晨曦剑向恶魔砍去。一切都结束了。[silly | 接下来会发生什么……嗯，他心里很清楚。 ] 没有任何东西能够穿透那恶魔的头部。你可以看到它的黑色眼睛疯狂地转动，然后紧紧地盯着你。接着，它的双腿开始绷紧，准备跳跃。 “别试了。”莉亚的长柄斧依然稳稳地指向前方。 但它还是尝试了。那个恶魔摇摇晃晃地用不稳定的双腿再次向你扑来，但就在这一瞬间，凭借你的意志力——正是你的意志——晨曦剑再次闪耀，它将恶魔重重击倒在地，恶魔发出最后的惨叫，随后便再没有任何声音了。这一撞击发生的瞬间，所有人都感到剧烈的震动，更重要的是，地面也跟着震动起来。他双眼因难以置信的愤怒而瞪得大大的，但就在这时，他所在的岩架与其余部分分离了，随即坠入了深渊。 [party.CombatNames]小心翼翼地向前探出身体，警惕着是否还会发生进一步的坍塌，终于设法从边缘处看到了下面的一幕……就在那一刻，他看到那个黑色的点与下方的岩浆融为一体，消失不见了。
rows.raw: " There's nothing else to do here: you have to grab it before it's lost for good, even if it is an insane risk. Despite the demon's frenzy, you try to hold him off with a single hand and stretch out for the sword with the other. It's just barely too far away. You can't get a finger on it; it wobbles dangerously every time you get close. And now the incubus' full weight is on you. You can feel the greenstick fractures as your forearm starts to bend in ways it's not supposed to bend. The demon's black eyes glitter victoriously as he presses down on you, talons inching closer and closer to your throat. Even the sound of a wordless shout from somewhere else in the cavern doesn't still his purpose. The impact of a halberd does, though. All the pressure from above disappears as Liaden slams into the incubus at full tilt. Her polearm catches in his armor, keeping her attack from being a killing blow, but the sheer force of it is still enough to push him sideways off your arm. More than that, it distracts him. With a howl, he raises his fist against the fresh onslaught, spitting fire and fury in the Lumian paladin's face. He's down, but definitely not out, and now it's Lia who's left to take the full brunt of what remains of his rage — — but you don't see any of it. Instead you close your eyes, focus your whole being into [pc.isDK |smoldering rage |preternatural calm ], and reach out for the hilt once again. Pushed the rest of the way by its own magical force, it rolls right into your hand, safe from the drop and the magma below. But that's where the easy part ends. As soon as your fingers close around it, you gasp from the pressure wave traveling up your arm and into your [silly |golden core |being ]. Another pulse hammers you, just like the ones before, and this time it feels like it's concentrated inside your skull. Maybe the blade's fighting you, maybe it's testing your worthiness, but either way the pain it forces into you is overwhelming. You can feel want, desire, something inside the sword, something that animated it and the incubus in battle against you. You don't know where it came from, but you fight its will every step of the way. You will have the last say here. You are worthy. And as an echo in your mind, you hear that last again: You... you are worthy. [pc.isDK |There it is. The knowledge, the proud confidence of your victory swells in your breast, irrational as it is. You've subjugated the relic, and now you feel its heady, intoxicating power surging along your arm into the rest of your body; your blood burns and your being feels alight with radiance overwhelming. It would be so easy to accept its power, to let the relic guide you in your desires, whatever they may be... but no. You've taught this recalcitrant hunk of junk just who's in charge. It's recognized your strength, and now it has no other choice. The last fool who held it was weak, but you: you can impose yourself on it. The surety of your supremacy flows through you as you grasp the blade anew, and soon the angry crimson blade snaps into existence once more, now a bloody extension of your will, not the demon's, and it feels glorious. Your first command to the blade: murderous intent. |Even though the demon still sits on top of you, even though he and Liaden rain blows on each other, even though the cavern shakes with volcanic instability, all you feel is a preternatural calm. All your worries drain away. The sword's pressure fades, and as you gaze at it, you watch it change. You watch its ornamentation glow brighter; you see the gem shine with the power of the sun, and then you feel the divine golden blade snap into glowing existence along its full length. There are still feelings within the blade, righteous anger and pride and intoxicating power all swirling beneath the placid calm that imbues you, but no longer does it push against you. The will within it fades, is laid to rest, joins with you — you're not sure, and right now it doesn't matter. It flows into you and you into it, all alight with radiance overwhelming, and now you have an inkling of what Sanders and Lia were talking about. This is once more a weapon for heroes, and it's chosen you. Whether the blade guides you or you guide it is an academic question. ] What that translates into is a movement, slow enough to avoid triggering the demon's defensive instincts, fast enough to keep him from noticing in time. From where it lies on the ground, your hand and the sword slash quickly but deliberately, and the demon doesn't even have time to blink before impact. He screams as the [pc.isDK |crimson |golden ] blade cuts through his chest armor, stumbling back just in time to avoid another one on the backswing. That scream turns to a quick, panicky pant as [party.compNames] advance on him, forcing him to scrabble back toward a precarious ledge above the chasm. He pays his surroundings no mind, instead focusing all his attention, his rage, his pain, his disbelief on you. "Not you. Not you." You brandish the Dawnsword at the demon. It's over.[silly | You have the... well, he knows what comes next. ] None of it penetrates the demon's head. You can see his black eyes rolling wildly, then fixating on you. Then his legs tense for the leap. "Don't try it." Lia's halberd stays level and true. He does. The demon, wobbling on unsteady legs, makes another lunge for you, but with a flicker of will — your will — the Dawnsword flashes once again and he crumples to the ground with yet another shriek. It's the last sound he makes. The impact jolts you all as it happens, and more importantly, jolts the ground. His eyes widen in disbelieving rage, but that's all that they have time to do before the outcropping that he was on separates from the rest of the ledge to plummet into the abyss. [party.CombatNames] edge forward cautiously, alert for any further collapse, and manage to peer over the edge... just in time to see his black dot merge with the rest of the magma below and disappear. "

rows.original: "Goddess," Lia gasps. "Is he... there's no way he could've survived that, right?" Well, in your experience, especially given everything that happened in the Rift, demons can take real punishment. They can survive an awful lot of cold, after all; maybe that goes for lava, too. They can shapeshift, they can transform, and as far as you're concerned, unless you see a body, you can't be sure. Actually, given what happened with Gweyr and Leold, maybe you can't even be sure with a body. "Ugh. I think I get it." She nods slowly. "It's strange. He was a demon, he was absolutely insufferable, but... after seeing how he changed after the relic was parted from him, I'm not sure how much of his behavior was actually him. Even without the relic affecting his mind, someone as obsessive as he was having power of the likes that we saw slip from his grasp would have been a terrible blow. And speaking of that —" You look down at the Dawnsword in your hand, its blade [pc.isDK |pulsing with menacing red light. You still feel like yourself, for what it's worth. On a whim, you make an experimental swing through the air, and the blade of light makes a distinctive keening noise as it moves in a blurred arc of crimson.[var0| Oooooh! Pretty.] "Please be careful with it, [pc.name]. I don't know whether the demon did something to it or if it was already this twisted to begin with and it simply was seeking a like-minded wielder, but I can feel its malignancy even from here." [var0|Aww. It's really bright and shiny though... fiiiine. ]Someone's got to carry it back to Sanders. Does she want to hold it? "N-no. Not yet, at least. But you're right — we need to get the relic back to Dad and see if anything can be done about... about what's happened to it." You don't know about that; all this feels perfectly natural, as if the relic was made for you. But you aren't about to tell Liaden that to her face, and accept it with a nod. |shimmering with a faint golden sheen. Lia gazes at it in wonder. "Wow. Are you okay, [pc.name]? You sounded... well..." It was rough for a little bit, but you think you're fine. You don't feel an invasive presence in your mind, good or bad — if anything, the Dawnsword now appears far more placid in your hand than it did the incubus', content to rest until it's needed. On a whim, you make an experimental swing through the air, and the blade of light makes a distinctive keening noise as it moves in a blurred arc of radiance.[var0| Oooooh! Pretty.] She blows out a breath you hadn't realized she was holding. "I'm glad you're okay. Just — please be careful with it. Even if it doesn't reek of... malignancy like it did a moment ago, it[liaden.poly |'s still dangerous — it could maim you if you're not extra-attentive | deserves just a bit more respect than that ]." [var0|Aww. It's really bright and shiny though... fiiiine.|Fair enough.] With another little impulse of will, you close down the blade, then hold it up to her. Someone's got to carry it back to Sanders, see what he makes of all this. Does she want to hold it? "N-no. I don't think so. You're the one who saved it; it chose you. But you're right — we need to get the relic back to Dad and see about the next step. I... you know, after all this, after hearing you [pc.mascFem |yell |cry out ] when you purified it, I'm not sure whether I want to have been the one to claim it after all." You understand. It's not as though she spent the quest on the sidelines, though; she's the one who warned you to grab the sword before it fell over the edge — and who bull-rushed the demon instead of going for it herself. You're not sure whether you'd have been able to rescue the sword without that. "And you're the one who went for it even with a demon sitting on top of you," she laughs. "Maybe you've got to be a little crazy to be worthy, and if that's the case, I don't mind being the person who kept you safe long enough to purify the thing instead.[liaden.poly | Besides," she says, her eyes twinkling, "if the sword's with you, it's still staying in the family, isn't it?" Oooh. That's one way to think of it... She throws her arms around you in a fierce hug, holds your gaze for a heartbeat, and then brings you in close for a kiss. Even after smooching, she doesn't let go of the hug. "It's the only way." Wow. Y'know, if you'd known earlier that going on adventures with your girlfriend[party.has azyrran |s ] would be this fun... "We'll have to make more time to do more of 'em, right? Though I don't have any other swords that need savin'... ]" ] And speaking of which, is this supposed to be normal? Like, is it in the legends that the Dawnsword can fall, that it changes itself to suit its wielder, that it actually has — or at least had — a mind and will of its own? Sanders certainly didn't tell you anything about that when he was briefing the both of you; something like that would certainly have been pertinent information. "It... it wasn't. I mean, there were plenty of stories about the Dawnsword back in the keep that took its name from it, and while it had always been a powerful artifact that would only work for those worthy, it'd never had a true animus of its own." She shakes her head. "I'm way in over my head, [pc.name] — let's just see what Dad makes of all this." [pc.isDK |It's true. It's certainly a trend that Sanders has answers for questions — you can only hope that he hasn't been deliberately withholding them from you and Liaden all this time yet again. |She's right: he's the best person to ask about it all. You can't imagine that he left anything out of the story on purpose... ] [party.has etheryn |[pc.isDK |From your side, you hear Etheryn sigh. "[etheryn.lowConfidence |I d-don't think so," she stammers |I don't think so," she says cautiously ]. "Maybe he has some guesses, though. At least we got it out of that d[etheryn.lowConfidence |-d ]emon's hands — I hate the idea of Princess Iveryn's sword, if that's what this really is, belonging to them." Far better for it to be in yours, yes; you've certainly proved as much. |[etheryn.highConfidence |"I don't know if he'll be able to say," Etheryn says from beside you. She gazes at the hilt with the same kind of reverence that Liaden did. "It doesn't sound like he had the experience you just did. Even if he doesn't know, though, you saved the sword — and got it back to normal again. If this really is Princess Iveryn's blade, I think she'd be proud." Does that go for her, too? "Of course!" Lia's grin is genuine: "Yeah[liaden.poly |. It's a great story, isn't it? The Champion of Frost rescuing the Dawnsword |, if it had to be somebody else, the Champion of Frost rescuing the Dawnsword isn't too bad ]. Kind of like you're bringing it back to the Winter City in a way." [etheryn.fucked |You wink at your royal [etheryn.married |spouse |lover ]: that's happening in more than just 'a way'. "Oh, Goddess." She swallows hard, in the best of ways. Heh. Romantically teasing your Ryn is one of the more fun things you get to do on a regular basis, and it works every time. |Kind of, yeah. Does that mean you have the royal assent? "The sword makes the choice, not me... but I'm happy it chose you as worthy." She gives you a cheerful, wobbly-eared grin. ] |"M[etheryn.lowConfidence |-m ]aybe he won't know," Etheryn says quietly. The elf hovers by your side, gazing at the hilt with genuine awe. "I don't... I don't think it matters that much, does it? The sword's [etheryn.lowConfidence |s- ]safe. If it really did belong to Princess Iveryn, maybe she'd be happy knowing you rescued it." Lia pats her on the shoulder and nods. "You're right. [liaden.poly |Who's a better person to rescue the Dawnsword than the woman who saved the Winter City? |If it had to be anybody other than me, I'm glad the [pc.manWoman] who saved the Winter City is also the one who saved the Dawnsword, too. ]" "Y-Yeah. You've done a lot for m[etheryn.fucked |e and m ]y people. I guess this is one more thing, right?" Ryn's smile is one of the broader ones you've seen on her. ] "Anyway. I'm sorry for interrupting. We're good to go, right?" ] ] With nothing left for you in this chamber, you turn back and prepare to make the long trek back to Hawkethorne.
