rows.raw: " | — especially odd given the time of night ]. Something must be up for just about everyone in the village to be here and, well, that something becomes quite apparent soon: a pair of horse-riding paladins in literal shining armor. Their breastplates gleam [dayNight |with the brilliance of the reflected sun, resplendent in all its glory |even in the wan light of the moon, turning silver into gold ], and emblazoned upon their tabards is the symbol of a radiant flame, a sunflame, and once you see that... well, it doesn't take you long to figure out who they are. If your memory wasn't up to the task, though, River comes bounding up to remind you; the wide-eyed, excited kitten nimbly grabs you by the arm before you've even got time to react. "Hey! Hey! [pc.name], I don't think it's just me singing your praises anymore, not with big shots like these two showing up! Paladins of the Oriflamme the both of them, and they said they rode hard to get here. They've been all over town looking for you[silly| — well, not really, but c'mon, there's only so many places we can use to trigger these events]. They were with Sanders[liaden.atChapel | and Liaden ], up to the castle, you name it... and when they came back here, they seemed antsy that they hadn't managed to locate you yet. I tried to reassure them that you'd be around eventually and, well, here you are!" You tell the kitten to slow down and take a breath. [pc.isDK |That's a lot of fuckin' words, and you want a little time to digest them first — and get a look at these paladins. Once you've given them the old once-over, you ask him whether they've been getting uppity or anything. |Even for someone like him who sings for a living and has pipes to spare, that's a lot of words in a very short time. While he does that, you cast a weather eye over the paladins, then follow up with a question: that antsiness hasn't caused any problems, right? ] "No," he says bemusedly. "Does it look like it? They've been pretty restrained with their questions, and once they realized they'd have to wait for you to show up, they mostly just settled down to take care of their horses. As for the crowd, well, we're just here to get a decent look. Other than you and your friends and maybe those Tronarii folk, nobody this interesting's been to town in years." [flags.DARK_LIGHTSABER |Ah. Order of the Oriflamme, eh? They must be here to take a look at your sweet glowstick. Well, you don't mind showing it off for them. |Oh, okay. Well, if they're from the Order of the Oriflamme, you can only imagine that they're here to talk about the Dawnsword. Might as well, right? ] You [pc.hasWings |haven't got much of a chance of pushing through the crowd quickly, not when they're goggling at the Lumian warriors, but that's not a concern for someone like you. With the aid of your [pc.wings], you swoop over the onlookers, do a brief flourish in the air, and alight before |push through the throng — everybody's staring at the warriors, so they don't exactly think to part for you when you approach from behind — then come up to ] the pair of them with confidence and an easy smile. You're [pc.name], [pc.title]. They're here to see you, right? The paladins look at each other, then turn to you. One of them approaches, acknowledging you with a small nod, then removes his helmet — huh. A[pc.ra sheepfolk | fellow ] sheepfolk, as it turns out. "My name is Brother Bastille Shen[pc.swornGod lumia |, my lady ]. Over there is Sister Joan Blanchet. We both hail from the Order of the Oriflamme, and we've ridden hard from the Baranian chapter to meet you." [pc.swornGod lumia |He pauses, then solemnly genuflects before you, as does the still-helmeted sister further back. "It's an honor to meet the Champion of Lumia herself. |He offers you a faint, but quite real, smile, and a nod of respect. " ]We must offer an apology; we would have liked to have been here sooner, but it has been some time since any of us has ventured up here to the roof of the world, as we call it. Even though there is no closer chapter than Barania[liaden.atChapel | — save the one Sister Liaden has established here, of course — |, ] we're not exactly familiar with the area." [flags.DARK_LIGHTSABER |It's no skin off your nose if they think they're late. You certainly weren't expecting them. What exactly do they think they're late for, anyway? The paladin grimaces and rubs his nose. "We've had many tidings from this land of late. One of them is that the Dawnsword, lost these twenty years, has finally been found. Rescued from a... well, what [liaden.atChapel |Sister Liaden |Brother Riordan ] names a 'demon', even if apparently different from the Wraithkin I and my sworn brothers and sisters are used to. We came here to see for ourselves that the sword was safe and to congratulate its new bearer. Apparently, that [pc.manWoman] is you." Damn straight it is. Without waiting for the paladin to request proof, you provide it: the still-corrupted blade, Lumian engravings dark and glowing crimson. Casually, you activate it, and Hawkethorne's streets glow red. You bask in the shocked gasps from the onlookers as the powerful sword twists and twirls through the air, then as abruptly as you brought it to life, you close down the blade, presenting it to Bastille fully inert. "Well." He breathes in sharply. "That is not the way the Dawnsword was when it was last with our Order, but it is the same sword. Of that I have no doubt. It was corrupted by this demon, then?" Seems that way. You can still use it just fine — better than fine, actually. He's not going to start something about that, is he? Bastille's brow furrows. "No, certainly not. The sword, even in this condition, chose you, and that is simply that. Brother Riordan, I am sure, has already described how important it will be to cleanse it, and how one might go about doing so. Until then, though, if it is usable..." Despite the worried look on his face, he musters a shrug. "This land seems overrun by more demons than the one that crossed blades with you, and a wounded blade does as much against them as does a whole one." So people outside the Marches have finally noticed the demons, huh? "Slowly. Too slowly. I'm sure you've figured out that Sister Joan and I are some of the advance scouts, so to speak. In part, of course, we are here to congratulate you, but confirming the nature of the threat, what it means... those were some of our other purposes. That part, though, we have already done. How long it will take to set everything in motion, I cannot say, but thanks to us and a few others serving other codes and other gods, our Order and a dozen others have learned of the demons here." He can't say how long it'll take? "Marshaling warriors takes time. Settling affairs, marching... it will be many months before a host from the south can reach up here." This time Sister Joan speaks up, metallic behind her helmet. "We're getting here as fast as we can. But by the time we arrive, if there are still demons to fight, things are going to be grim." "Hence," Bastille adds, "why it's a good thing that you have the Dawnsword. Even in that state, it will serve well against those demons — certainly far better than it would have served in their hands." Huh. Okay then. Well, you don't mind if they hang around fucking the Cult up, but they'd better not get in your way. The ovine paladin opens his mouth as if to say something else, then thinks better of it, closing it again and cocking his head in a gesture of supreme self-control. Good for him. "Very well," he finally manages. "Just — do be careful, [pc.name]. Warrior's luck to you, and Lumia's light too, if you seek it." With that, the two paladins and their horses depart, and gradually, so too do the townsfolk. You're left in Hawkethorne's square with your sword and fewer questions than when you arrived. Right, then: time to stop wasting time and get back into the swing of things. |That's all right. You weren't exactly waiting for them or anything, so they've got nothing to apologize for. The paladin grins. "That's very gracious of you[pc.swornGod lumia |, my lady ]. Then to business, I suppose. We've had many tidings from this land of late. Some of them are disturbing, but to hear that the Dawnsword had been found — rescued from what [liaden.atChapel|Sister Liaden|Brother Riordan] names a 'demon', no less — was quite the bright light in the gloom. [pc.swornGod lumia |We should perhaps have expected that the woman Lumia named her Chosen would have been the one to do |You're quite the [pc.manWoman] to have done ] something so heroic." Now it's your turn to tell them that they're being gracious. Would they like to see the sword? "If we might — and at your convenience," Bastille says. Not a problem. You show them the hilt, to an audible gasp from the paladins, then, clearing a space in the middle of the crowd, you tease a little bit of your will into the blade. With its usual actinic flash, it ignites, and the broken hilt extends into a full golden blade to the oohs and aahs of all the collected onlookers — and then, after a brief pause, the square erupts in cheers. [var1 |It's just... it's sooo pretty that you just can't stop staring at it for a long, long time, but eventually you remember that (oops!) you actually were just showing it off, and reluctantly turn the super sparkly sunny sword into just a regular ol' hilt again. |A few careful moves through the air, without seeking to harm paladins or horses or people, suffice to prove the point and then, with a fresh exertion of will, you close the blade down and hold it up in your open palm. ] "There it is," breathes Sister Joan, sounding rather metallic through her helmet. "Indeed." Bastille bows again. "You truly are the worthy bearer of the Dawnsword. We can return to our fellows with good news — and leave you with our congratulations." You return the sword to your "

rows.original: and accept his firm, two-handed handshake. So, it's all right that the Dawnsword is with you, rather than with the Order? "It certainly is," he says amiably. "You weren't responsible for the circumstances surrounding the sword's disappearance, and we've already visited the chapel and made our peace with Brother Riordan about that. The important thing is this: it chose [pc.swornGod lumia |you, the same woman Lumia herself did. It's not difficult to see why. |you and we can hardly gainsay it. ] In fact, we're quite impressed, as is the grandmaster of our Order. She'll probably ask you to visit our brothers and sisters in the south someday — as an example of what a true warrior of light should be like, though, not to ask for the sword back.[var2 | And I think she will want Sister Liaden to come with you, if she might. We're quite proud of her for living up to the high standards of selflessness and skill we try to imbue in our warriors." He grins. "You are, of course, the star of the show, so to speak, but Liaden does seem to have a bright future ahead of her too. Our chapter's commander insisted that we offer her a token of our esteem, too." Lia was a great help, for sure.[flags.LIGHTSABER_DUEL | | In fact, you probably couldn't have saved the sword without her. ] "You've already given her more credit than she's claimed for herself," he chuckles. "You must have made an excellent team. ] But such a congratulatory visit[var2 | with the two of you ] will have to wait for some time, I suspect." Sister Joan speaks up again from behind her helmet: "Unfortunately, we're not just here to check on the sword." "Too true. Some of the rest of our mission is peaceful. We are here to catch up with Brother Riordan[liaden.atChapel | and Sister Liaden ], of course, and then continue north. It would be a true shame to venture so close to the true roof of the world and not visit the realm of[party.has etheryn | —" and here he nods respectfully at Ryn "— ] our long-lost brothers and sisters in faith at the Winter City. [var0 |And beyond that, we understand that the Lady of Light's own Keep can now be reached thanks to your efforts. It would be an honor to attempt the same pilgrimage you made |It has been many years since any southern eyes were laid on the holy temple that Queen Atheldred Sunbringer raised in the Lady's honor ]." [party.has etheryn |Ryn [etheryn.lowConfidence |manages a tentative smile. "Th-that would be amazing..." |smiles excitedly. "It would be a pleasure for our city to host you for a time!" ] |You suspect that [var0 |neither the elves nor the[pc.swornGod lumia | other ] valkyries will |Ryn and her people won't ] mind if they do... but in the remote event that there is trouble, the two of them are naturally free to drop your name. It's got a fair amount of weight in elven lands, to say the least. ] Warmly, he says, "We would be in your debt once again. After that, though? There have been grim tidings from these lands, and it is probably no surprise to you that we have orders to investigate their veracity. Too many rumors have already proven true. More warriors than we may need to ride north from Barania... and from lands farther afield." Reconnoitering the demon threat? You're holding your own, but you wouldn't mind the help. This time, it's Sister Joan that answers. "After what we've seen, we'll try to find as much help as we can. We've already sent dispatches back south. But it'll still take time — time to marshal warriors, to settle affairs in the south, to march north.[silly | Remember, this game's plot canonically takes place over the course of a few months, not years and years of breeding. A few months is a very reasonable time to need to gather armies and march north. ] And in that time..." She sighs, dipping her helmet. "If you need the assistance that we can give by the time we can give it, it'll be too late for too many. But we are coming, and we're coming as quickly as possible." Bastille grins again. "But that bodes fair to be no problem at all. I'm sure that the hero[pc.mf | |ine ] who saved the Lady of Light's blade will simply add saving these lands to [pc.hisHer] string of legendary accomplishments. All you'll need us for are the celebrations." [silly |'Bodes fair', he says. Okay, that was a little Ivanhoe for you, but you appreciate the sentiment |You appreciate the vote of confidence ]... and yeah, you hope they aren't necessary, either. Just knowing that you've got more help coming, though, takes a weight off your shoulders. Right. Now that you've sorted all that out, you don't want to keep them from their pilgrimage. [wayfort.controlled |They'll probably want to leave their horses at your Wayfort, halfway to the Winter City, though. The Frostwood isn't good land for horses[var0 |, to say nothing of the Glacial Rift ]. |Might be best for them to make the rest of the journey on foot, though, leaving their horses stabled here. There's no good ground for horses on the way north. ] "Thank you for the warning," the brother says with a final nod. "May the Dawn Maiden continue to light your path." He and the sister both depart, and after a while so too do the townsfolk. You're left in Hawkethorne's square with the Dawnsword and many fewer questions than you had coming in — along with the reassuring note that eventually, backup will be here. All in all, not a bad chat. Time to figure out more ways to put the sword to good use! ]

It's not difficult to see why. |you and we can hardly gainsay it. ] In fact, we're quite impressed, as is the grandmaster of our Order. She'll probably ask you to visit our brothers and sisters in the south someday — as an example of what a true warrior of light should be like, though, not to ask for the sword back.[var2 | And I think she will want Sister Liaden to come with you, if she might. We're quite proud of her for living up to the high standards of selflessness and skill we try to imbue in our warriors." He grins. "You are, of course, the star of the show, so to speak, but Liaden does seem to have a bright future ahead of her too. Our chapter's commander insisted that we offer her a token of our esteem, too." Lia was a great help, for sure.[flags.LIGHTSABER_DUEL | | In fact, you probably couldn't have saved the sword without her. ] "You've already given her more credit than she's claimed for herself," he chuckles. "You must have made an excellent team. ] But such a congratulatory visit[var2 | with the two of you ] will have to wait for some time, I suspect." Sister Joan speaks up again from behind her helmet: "Unfortunately, we're not just here to check on the sword." "Too true. Some of the rest of our mission is peaceful. We are here to catch up with Brother Riordan[liaden.atChapel | and Sister Liaden ], of course, and then continue north. It would be a true shame to venture so close to the true roof of the world and not visit the realm of[party.has etheryn | —" and here he nods respectfully at Ryn "— ] our long-lost brothers and sisters in faith at the Winter City. [var0 |And beyond that, we understand that the Lady of Light's own Keep can now be reached thanks to your efforts. It would be an honor to attempt the same pilgrimage you made |It has been many years since any southern eyes were laid on the holy temple that Queen Atheldred Sunbringer raised in the Lady's honor ]." [party.has etheryn |Ryn [etheryn.lowConfidence |manages a tentative smile. "Th-that would be amazing..." |smiles excitedly. "It would be a pleasure for our city to host you for a time!" ] |You suspect that [var0 |neither the elves nor the[pc.swornGod lumia | other ] valkyries will |Ryn and her people won't ] mind if they do... but in the remote event that there is trouble, the two of them are naturally free to drop your name. It's got a fair amount of weight in elven lands, to say the least. ] Warmly, he says, "We would be in your debt once again. After that, though? There have been grim tidings from these lands, and it is probably no surprise to you that we have orders to investigate their veracity. Too many rumors have already proven true. More warriors than we may need to ride north from Barania... and from lands farther afield." Reconnoitering the demon threat? You're holding your own, but you wouldn't mind the help. This time, it's Sister Joan that answers. "After what we've seen, we'll try to find as much help as we can. We've already sent dispatches back south. But it'll still take time — time to marshal warriors, to settle affairs in the south, to march north.[silly | Remember, this game's plot canonically takes place over the course of a few months, not years and years of breeding. A few months is a very reasonable time to need to gather armies and march north. ] And in that time..." She sighs, dipping her helmet. "If you need the assistance that we can give by the time we can give it, it'll be too late for too many. But we are coming, and we're coming as quickly as possible." Bastille grins again. "But that bodes fair to be no problem at all. I'm sure that the hero[pc.mf | |ine ] who saved the Lady of Light's blade will simply add saving these lands to [pc.hisHer] string of legendary accomplishments. All you'll need us for are the celebrations." [silly |'Bodes fair', he says. Okay, that was a little Ivanhoe for you, but you appreciate the sentiment |You appreciate the vote of confidence ]... and yeah, you hope they aren't necessary, either. Just knowing that you've got more help coming, though, takes a weight off your shoulders. Right. Now that you've sorted all that out, you don't want to keep them from their pilgrimage. [wayfort.controlled |They'll probably want to leave their horses at your Wayfort, halfway to the Winter City, though. The Frostwood isn't good land for horses[var0 |, to say nothing of the Glacial Rift ]. |Might be best for them to make the rest of the journey on foot, though, leaving their horses stabled here. There's no good ground for horses on the way north. ] "Thank you for the warning," the brother says with a final nod. "May the Dawn Maiden continue to light your path." He and the sister both depart, and after a while so too do the townsfolk. You're left in Hawkethorne's square with the Dawnsword and many fewer questions than you had coming in — along with the reassuring note that eventually, backup will be here. All in all, not a bad chat. Time to figure out more ways to put the sword to good use! ] "

rows.raw: ", and nobody here can use the Waystones except you"

rows.original: There's not much open space in the yard behind the Frost Hound, but it does at least have some straw-stuffed training mannequins — and, now that Lia, Azzy, and Gwyn are here, it has some wooden fighting implements too. 'Not much open space', though, still means enough for several people to swing Dawnswords around safely, and the only way to do better would be taking a hike out of town. And why would you do that right after a journey out to the mountains and back? As you join the effort to organize everything, Gwyn takes a critical look at [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |Lia's |your ] belt. Lupines can't quite mimic a human's thoughtful grimace, but the way her tail moves back and forth is all you need to figure out what she's thinking. "So... how do you want to use that thing? Thrusting, slashing...?" [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |Lia purses her lips. "I dunno, really. I'm used to pokin' — thrustin' — with what I've already got." She coughs. "The, uh, halberd, I mean. But with this... what do you think, Gwyn?" |Well, what does she think? [pc.bg soldier barbarian noblescion |You've used plenty of swords, but an outside opinion can't hurt. |You've picked up some things here and there, but you're hardly an expert, whereas Garth trained her from a pup. ] ] "Could you... turn it on?" When the courtyard fills with a bright golden glow, her eyes widen a bit, but she recovers quickly enough. "Oh! Yes, I think... I think I can help you through some basic forms that will help with this." And so it begins. It's a lot less physical and a lot more tiring than you'd expected. [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |Lia holds |You hold ] the Dawnsword itself, eschewing the wooden implements — "the balance is all wrong anyway," Gwyn assures you — as [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |she works |you work ] through form after form. [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |You and Azzy get conscripted into demonstrating the forms with the wooden swords while Lia follows along. |Lia and Azzy demonstrate for you, per Gwyn's instructions, and you mimic them. ] Hold the sword in this position. Now hold it in a different position. Now... It's really not as boring as all that, of course. Gwyn works through the reasoning behind each form, why one should hold a sword in this position, what it's best at, and so on. She points out that [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |Lia |you ] probably won't be parrying the same way as most swordbearers, because the Dawnsword can slice through many of those, and instead the four of you try to figure out how best to slice at an enemy to make their weapon break the way you want it to. [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |This is the time for you and Azzy to shine, as you're the ones who can safely demonstrate the right moves to Lia with your wooden swords. So you serve as the guinea pigs while Lia studies your moves, laughing every time one or the other of you manages to land an actual strike. |This is where Lia and Azzy really get into their roles, demonstrating possible cuts to you using the wooden swords and Gwyn's amused directions — and giggling every time they land little strikes. ] From there, it's more work to figure out just how much reach the blade has and adjust to it, and enough practice to make all that work stick. [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |And, of course, plenty of mooning over Lia [azyrran.kdb |by both you and Azzy |to Azzy's gentle amusement |by both you and Azzy ]. After all, her eyes are tight with determination, her face is wet with sweat, her jaw set, her arms working over and over again — go[pc.swornGod lumia |ddess |sh ], her arms are really something, aren't they? Uh... heh heh. Anyway! It also means being there for her when she nicks herself with the blade; nothing too deep, but the way you and Azzy are almost immediately all over her to help soothe the pain is... well, it feels nice to be this kind of girlfriend to your girlfriend. |And, of course, plenty of mooning over you by [azyrran.kdb |Azzy and Lia |Lia, along with the gently-amused approval of your mutual vesparan top |Azzy and Lia ] as they watch you train. But since this is the part where you work with the full blade, you do manage to nick yourself a few times — and both girlfriends leap to your aid as soon as you do. While it hurts like all hell, having them fawn over you like this is pretty nice. You could get used to this kind of treatment... ] It's a lot of work over several hours, but eventually [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |Gwyn pronounces herself-satisfied with Lia's progress. "That should be fine for now! It's tricky to unlearn old habits, but it looks like you're getting the hang of it. Just make sure you keep practicing, okay? Actual practice, not just using this on demons or whatever." You and Azzy can help make sure of that. |you feel like you're getting off on the right foot. Gwyn does, too: "That should probably be fine for now! You're a pretty fast learner. Just make sure you practice, okay? And not just on demons, either." "We'll make sure she stays in good shape," chirps Lia. ] [azyrran.kdb |The Hive Knight nods. "Yeah! But... definitely later." One antenna twitches shyly. "Um, how do you two feel about sharing some drinks inside? You know, to celebrate and everything?" |"We certainly shall." Azzy's wings buzz a bit, then settle. "But until then, I think you two deserve some celebratory drinks indoors. It's been hard work, and you must be very thirsty..." |"Yipyup!" Azzy sweeps in behind both you and Lia and drags you into a warm, honey-soaked hug. "Buuuut I think we should do some celebrating first! It's been a long day and we all need to sit down by the fire and cuddle and drink some drinks and cuddle some more and then maybe do a li'l cuddling after that..." ] You follow Azzy's advice. Drinks, warmth, and becoming a[silly |s ] big gay cuddle pile. And then you continue to follow it, going from casual conversation to mildly drunken flirting to sleepy dozing and back again. You relax in the warmth, run your fingers through Lia's hair, feel Azzy nuzzle against you, and simply bask in all of it.
rows.translation: 在“寒霜猎犬”背后的院子里，可用的空地并不多，但至少有一些塞满稻草的训练假人——而现在有了莉亚、阿齐和格温，这里还添置了一些木制格斗器械。不过，“可用的空地不多”，其实也足够几个人安全地挥舞着“晨曦剑”进行训练了；要想有更好的训练环境，唯一的办法就是到城外去。那为什么在刚从山区回来之后就要做这件事呢？ 当你参与到整理这些事情的过程中时，格温仔细地观察着这一切。 [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |莉亚的 |你的 ]好吧……你想用那个东西怎么攻击呢？是刺击还是挥砍……？ [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |莉亚抿了抿嘴唇：“说实话，我也不太清楚。我习惯于利用自己已有的东西来战斗……我是说，用那些武器来战斗。但是面对这个……你觉得呢，格温？ |那么，她是怎么想的呢？ [pc.bg soldier barbarian noblescion |你用过很多把剑，但听听别人的意见也没坏处。 |你虽然零零星星地学到了一些东西，但远远算不上专家；而加斯则是从她还是幼犬的时候就开始训练她的。 ] ] 你能……把它打开吗？”当庭院被明亮的金色光芒笼罩时，她的双眼微微睁大了，但很快就恢复了平静。“哦！可以，我想……我想我能帮你完成一些基础操作，这些应该会对你有帮助。” 就这样开始了。这个过程其实并不需要太多的体力，但却比你想象中要耗费更多的精力。 [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |莉亚握住了它。 |由你掌控 ]格温向你保证，晨曦剑本身根本不会使用那些木制武器——“反正那种平衡性完全不对。”所以，它根本不会选择使用那些木制武器。 [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |她在工作。 |你干活吧。 ]经过一道又一道程序。 [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |你和阿齐被征召去用木剑演示这些动作，而莉亚则在一旁协助。 |按照格温的指示，莉亚和阿齐为你做了示范，你接着模仿他们的动作。 ]将剑保持在这个位置。现在，把它调整到另一个位置。再这样…… 当然，其实并没有那么无聊。格温会详细解释每种持剑姿势背后的原理，说明为什么应该把剑保持在这个位置，这种姿势有什么优点等等。她会指出[flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |莉亚 |你 ]很可能不会像大多数持剑者那样进行格挡，因为“晨曦剑”的锋利程度足以让大多数武器都无法有效格挡它。因此，你们四个人需要共同研究如何以最有效的方式攻击敌人，迫使他们的武器断裂。你希望如此。 [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |现在正是你和阿齐大显身手的时候了，因为只有你们才能够做到这一点。安全地用你的木剑向莉亚演示正确的动作。这样，你就成了实验对象，让莉亚观察你的动作；而每当你们中有一个人真正击中目标时，莉亚就会哈哈大笑。 |在这里，莉娅和阿齐真正进入了角色扮演的状态，他们用木剑进行模拟战斗，同时格温也会给出有趣的指导，每当他们成功击中目标时，两人都会忍不住咯咯笑起来。这些表演其实就是在向你们展示一些可能的战斗场景剪辑方式。 ] 从那之后，就需要进一步努力来弄清楚这把刀的实际攻击范围，并根据这个范围进行调整；同时，还需要通过大量的练习来让这些调整真正发挥作用。 [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |当然，也会有人为莉亚而倾倒。 [azyrran.kdb |你和阿齐一起 |这让阿齐感到十分好笑。 |你和阿齐一起 ]毕竟，她的眼中充满了坚定的决心，脸上布满了汗水，下巴紧绷着，双臂不断地重复着同样的动作——加油吧！[pc.swornGod lumia |ddess | ]她的手臂，真的挺吸引人的，不是吗？呃……呵呵。总之！这也意味着在她被刀划伤的时候，要在她身边陪伴她；伤势并不严重，但你们和阿齐立刻跑过来帮她缓解疼痛，这种举动……嗯，能够成为你女朋友这样的男朋友，确实感觉很棒。 |当然，还有很多人在为你倾心呢。 [azyrran.kdb |阿齐和莉亚 |莉亚，再加上你们彼此之间那种带着淡淡笑意的认可…… |阿齐和莉亚 ]当他们看着你进行训练的时候。不过因为这一阶段你需要使用完整的刀刃来进行练习，所以你确实不小心划伤了自己好几次——而每次你受伤时，你的两位女朋友都会立刻赶来帮助你。虽然疼得要命，但看到她们这样关心你，其实也挺让人开心的。你或许会逐渐习惯这种对待方式吧…… ] 这需要花费几个小时的时间来完成，但最终还是可以做到的。 [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |格温对自己在莉亚身上的进步感到满意。“目前来说，这样已经很不错了！改变旧有的习惯确实很困难，但看起来你正在逐渐掌握方法。只要继续坚持练习就行，好吗？真正的练习，而不仅仅是用这个来对付恶魔之类的东西。” 你和阿齐可以帮忙监督她是否真的在坚持练习。 |你感觉自己正顺利地开始这段旅程。格温也是这么认为的：“目前来说，应该没什么问题吧！你学习能力相当强，只要坚持练习就行，好吗？而且练习的对象也不应该只限于恶魔。” “我们会确保她保持良好的状态，”莉亚高兴地说道。 ] [azyrran.kdb |蜂群骑士点了点头。“嗯！不过……肯定要等晚些时候。”它的一根触角羞涩地动了一下。“呃，你们俩觉得在屋里一起喝点东西怎么样？也算是庆祝一下吧？ |我们当然会这么做。”阿齐的翅膀微微振动了一下，然后又恢复了平静。“但在那之前，我觉得你们俩应该去室内喝些庆祝用的饮料。这些天你们确实辛苦了，肯定很渴吧…… |咿呀呀！”阿齐从你们俩和莉亚身后冲过来，将你们紧紧抱在怀里，温暖的气息中带着一丝蜂蜜的甜味。“但是我觉得我们应该先庆祝一下吧！今天真是漫长的一天，我们都需要坐在火堆旁，依偎在一起，喝点东西，再继续依偎一会儿，之后或许还可以再……再依偎一会儿…… ] 你听从了阿齐的建议。喝着酒、烤着火，然后挤成[silly |一大 ]团，紧紧依偎在一起。然后你们继续这样的相处，从随意的交谈，到微醺的调情，再到昏昏欲睡的休息，再重新开始。你们在温暖中放松下来，用手指轻轻梳理莉亚的头发，感受阿齐依偎在你们身边的感觉，就这样尽情享受这一切。

rows.original: When you struggle awake, a curtain of lush blonde hair curtains the hesitant rays of the sun through the window. Lia is stretched out overtop of you, softly cooing as she dozes. And Azzy... Azzy's legs and giant bug-butt are right in front of you, and her hands are wrapped around your ankles. Must be a hornet thing. Still, they're cozy and peaceful, and you find yourself half-drifting off again before you truly wake up, buried in girlfriend and all the happier for it. It can't last forever, of course. Dawn turns to morning, and with morning Lia's eyes open and she pulls the hair away from your face. "Mmm. Mornin', [pc.swornGod lumia |angel |sunshine ]. Were ya waitin' for me?" You couldn't bring yourself to wake her up when she was so peaceful... From the other end of the bed, Azzy says sleepily: "I know the feeling." "Heh." Lia smooches you on the cheek and slowly rolls off. "Well, thanks. Hopefully your adventurin' today ain't as rough as that demon fight was. I'm bushed even after gettin' a good night's sleep surrounded by cuties. How's about I help you get ready for your day?" Many minutes later, after cleaning and dressing and eating and[silly | crab rangoon and ] things of that nature, you and Lia bid goodbye to each other at the Frost Hound's door. "Chapel stuff to get back to," she apologizes. "Still, if [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |my girlfriend needs some Dawnswording, just give me a call. |the bearer of the Dawnsword ever needs my help... well, you've got girlfriend privileges and all that. ]" Mmm. You'll be sure to. One last kiss for you, and another for Azzy, and she heads out to the street, leaving [party.combatNames] to face your next adventure.
rows.translation: 你挣扎着醒来时，一帘浓密的金发遮住了透过窗户犹疑洒入的晨光。莉娅伸展身体趴在你身上，在睡梦中轻轻咕哝。至于阿齐……阿齐的双腿和硕大的虫臀就在你面前，她的双手还环着你的脚踝。大概是黄蜂的习性吧。不过，她们温暖又安宁；真正醒来之前，你又迷迷糊糊地睡了过去，整个人埋在女友怀中，心里也因此格外幸福。 当然，这一刻不可能永远持续。黎明化作清晨；晨光中，莉娅睁开眼，把头发从你脸上拨开。“嗯。早上好，[pc.swornGod lumia |小天使 |小太阳 ]。你一直在等我吗？” 她睡得那么安稳，你实在不忍心叫醒她…… 床铺另一头，阿齐睡意朦胧地说道：“我懂这种感觉。” “嘿。”莉娅在你脸颊上亲了一口，缓缓翻身离开。“嗯，谢谢。希望你今天的冒险不会像那场恶魔之战一样辛苦。就算已经被可爱的人儿们围着好好睡了一夜，我还是累坏了。要不要让我帮你为今天做好准备？” 许多分钟后，你们洗漱、穿衣、吃饭，还做了[silly | 蟹角，以及 ]诸如此类的事情；随后你与莉娅在霜犬酒馆门口道别。“我得回去处理礼拜堂的事情，”她歉然说道。“不过，如果[flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |我的女友需要我带上晨曦剑，尽管叫我。 |晨曦剑的持有者需要我的帮助……嗯，你可是享有女友特权的。 ]” 嗯。你一定会的。 她最后吻了你一下，又吻了阿齐一下，随后走上街道，留下[party.combatNames]去面对你们的下一场冒险。
rows.raw: " When you struggle awake, a curtain of lush blonde hair curtains the hesitant rays of the sun through the window. Lia is stretched out overtop of you, softly cooing as she dozes. And Azzy... Azzy's legs and giant bug-butt are right in front of you, and her hands are wrapped around your ankles. Must be a hornet thing. Still, they're cozy and peaceful, and you find yourself half-drifting off again before you truly wake up, buried in girlfriend and all the happier for it. It can't last forever, of course. Dawn turns to morning, and with morning Lia's eyes open and she pulls the hair away from your face. "Mmm. Mornin', [pc.swornGod lumia |angel |sunshine ]. Were ya waitin' for me?" You couldn't bring yourself to wake her up when she was so peaceful... From the other end of the bed, Azzy says sleepily: "I know the feeling." "Heh." Lia smooches you on the cheek and slowly rolls off. "Well, thanks. Hopefully your adventurin' today ain't as rough as that demon fight was. I'm bushed even after gettin' a good night's sleep surrounded by cuties. How's about I help you get ready for your day?" Many minutes later, after cleaning and dressing and eating and[silly | crab rangoon and ] things of that nature, you and Lia bid goodbye to each other at the Frost Hound's door. "Chapel stuff to get back to," she apologizes. "Still, if [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER |my girlfriend needs some Dawnswording, just give me a call. |the bearer of the Dawnsword ever needs my help... well, you've got girlfriend privileges and all that. ]" Mmm. You'll be sure to. One last kiss for you, and another for Azzy, and she heads out to the street, leaving [party.combatNames] to face your next adventure. "

rows.original: Something seems off when you enter the Hawkethorne square. It's a minor thing, as the people there move about in their normal rhythms, [dayNight |buying, selling, chatting |quietly chatting with friends under the stars ], but definitely noticeable, and it takes a few moments to nail it down: River's usual melody is absent. Instead of strumming for an audience of a dozen, he's chatting with an audience of one: Sanders, outside the chapel, sitting on a stool while the catboy lounges against the building's sturdy walls. They're talking animatedly, but not angrily, and River is casually emphasizing some of the words with strums on his instrument. Well, Sanders being out and about is unusual enough for you to at least casually wander over and see what's up. You slide past a few handcarts and angle for the Waystone[party.hasCompanions |, with [party.compNames] in tow ]. [var2 |The old priest looks up from his chat long before you get there. His eyes widen a bit, and he and River murmur a few things to each other, then he smiles — one of those amiable, genuine, even fatherly smiles he's so good at. Slowly, he rises from his stool, and by the time you reach him he's calmly bowing his head. "Congratulations." [pc.isCunning |You have a pretty good idea what he's talking about, too. "Thank you." [var0 |With a shower of light, your ethereal valkyrie's wings emerge and stretch to their full length before folding back behind you. |You stretch your wings to their full length before letting them return to their usual rest position behind you. ] "Being a valkyrie feels... right. I don't know how to explain it. Like I'm meant to be here." "I've heard that that's what it's like," he says, smiling. You look back at [var0 |your wings — the wings that had not been out and about when you were walking over here |your wings — which, unlike most of your sisters', are quite physical, even normal ]. "How could you tell?" "There's a bearing and aura among valkyries that are unmistakable, especially for someone late of Lumia's own service." He cocks his head to the side, and that fatherly smile turns just a little bit gently mischievous. "Also, River was happy to confirm it for me. He's heard a few stories, albeit without many details." |"[pc.isBimbo |Oooh! Thank you! But, um... |Hey there. Uh, thanks. ]" You turn your head to the side quizzically. "Congratulations on...?" "On becoming one of Lumia's Chosen," he supplies. "You may not [var0 |be showing your wings at the moment |have the kind of wings that most associate with valkyries ], but the bearing and the aura are unmistakable nonetheless. Also," he continues, eyes twinkling, "River was happy to confirm it for me. He's heard a few stories, albeit without many details." ] The catboy in question tips you a jaunty wink, then straightens up his face before executing a bow — and instead of the showy performer's bow he normally does at the end of a particularly well-received piece, it's a respectful and genuine one. You can't keep a smile off your face as you return the greeting. "[pc.isBimbo |Oooh! I get it. Thanks, you two! |Oh, right. That makes sense. Thank you both. ]" "It's well deserved," Sanders assures you. "By the way, how is the holy keep? It's one of those journeys I always thought about making, but never quite did before I left Lumia's service for Velun's. Not least because no one save your own sisters had made the journey in two hundred years. Once upon a time, I did harbor thoughts of being the first, but... well." "[pc.isBimbo |Um. It's kinda a long story. |About that... ]" Quickly, you sketch the outlines of your journey in the north — your battle alongside Annika, your subsequent meeting with Lumia herself, the confrontation in Lumia's palace, and the valkyries' return from battling the Wraith-touched. When you finish, Sanders looks like he's about ready to genuflect. "Goodness," he murmurs. "It seems we all owe you thanks, not merely congratulations." "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. You're too nice! Besides, didn't you fight some stinky Wraith beans yourself before? |You've fought Wraith-touched before, right? ]" "Of course. In younger days, I'd sometimes even say[silly | to the Chancellor ] that they were my special[silly |i ]ty. A whole Wraith, though..." He shakes his head. "I can't even imagine." "A dead Wraith now, though," River points out. He punctuates the comment with a low, appreciative whistle. "Yes. A dead Wraith, and valkyries flying south to battle demons — including our very own [pc.name] in their ranks." Sanders grins. "I came out here to chat with an old friend because I was feeling unsettled[var1 | and couldn't sleep ]. I didn't get the reassurance I was looking for... I got something much better and more powerful." "Glad to help[pc.isBimbo |! |, ]" you say, smiling right back. "I'm doing my best." "It's more than enough," he says warmly. "I've met a few of your sworn sisters in my time, and I know even more by reputation — a uniformly positive one, I might add. It makes me wonder... perhaps when all this is over, now that you've cleared the way, I'll be able to journey to Ljosgard myself. Genuflect in the light, speak with old friends... explain myself." About what happened in Hawkethorne? About becoming a priest of Velun instead of Lumia?[var6 | About the Dawnsword? ] For a moment, you think about asking him to clarify. But if he'd wanted to say, he would have. Some things remain between us and our gods. Instead, you tell him, "[pc.isBimbo |We'd love to have you visit! You would probably get lots and lots of sun mommy hugs. |I think we'd be happy to have you there. ]" "Thank you." He closes his eyes for a moment, lets his smile grow, breathes in, then out again. "At any rate, I think all of us will sleep a little more soundly with a Lumian valkyrie here." With hands on your hips, you look [pc.heightRange 66 |down |over ] at River. "And [pc.isBimbo |you're probably gonna tell everybody in Hawkethorne that they can, right |thanks to you, everybody in town is going to know about it, hmm ]?" "That's the idea," he says easily. "Benefits and drawbacks of being a public figure, right?" [liaden.atChapel |A voice comes from the door: "Hey, Dad. I didn't know you were... wait, [pc.name]? Is that you?" You turn and smile. "[pc.isBimbo |Oooh! Hiiii |Hey ], Lia." "Uh—" The young paladin's mouth hangs open. So do her hands, which is unfortunate, because the wooden water cup she was holding slips out and spills its contents all over the chapel steps. "H-hey there." She swallows, ignoring the dropped cup, and looks hesitantly at her dad. "I feel like I should bow? Should I bow? I should totally bow." "From what I remember of the Order's protocol, you don't have to," Sanders chuckles, "especially since this isn't a ceremony." [pc.isBimbo |"Yipyup! It's okay not to do anything like that," you assure her. "It is really sweet that you asked, though. |You nod respectfully. "It's very flattering of you to ask, though. ]" "Wow. You look amazin'. It's such an honor. I still kinda feel like I should bow." Again she breathes, in and out, trying to calm herself down. "Did I say it was an honor yet?" "You did." Her dad laughs, then bends down with some effort to pick up the abandoned cup. "We'll let you two talk. Congratulations, [pc.name], and may you continue to walk in the Dawn Maiden's light." Once Sanders and River have given you some space, Lia swallows again. "So. I, uh. I've never met a valkyrie before. [flags.LIAZZY_3SUM |Now it turns out I'm datin' one. Goddess. I don't know if this means anythin' to you, but I'm so proud." "It means a lot to me, Lia," you say quietly. Then you give her a warm, friendly, valkyrie hug. "Thank you." "This might be the best hug I've ever gotten." Still with arms folded around her, you smile. "[pc.isBimbo |Girlfriends get hugs whenever they want, you knowwww... |Rule One of being my girlfriend with Azzy is that you two get valkyrie hugs whenever you want them. ]" "I think I'm in love." She squeezes you back. "Hey... can I call you angel? 'Cause, well..." "I'd like that." "Mmm." She sinks into your hug a bit, then slowly separates. "Wow. Well, congrats, angel. If Your Holiness ever wants to instruct your Lumian harem in, uh, worship liturgy, let me an' Azzy know." |Now it turns out I'm friends with one. I... wow. An' you feel okay and everythin'?" "I do." You cock your head, still smiling. "You look like you could use a hug[pc.isBimbo |, cutie! |. ]" "I — wow, I — thanks —" As she stammers, you sweep her into a friendly embrace and give her a gentle squeeze. "There. [pc.isBimbo |I'm so happy we're friendos |It's a pleasure to be your friend ], Lia[pc.isBimbo |! |. ] [pc.isBimbo |We both get to serve Lumia together! |I'm honored to serve Lumia alongside you. ]" "I think," she says from somewhere [pc.heightRange 60 70 |against your neck |deep in your chest |above your head ], "this is the best hug anyone's ever given me." "Thank you." You release her from it and grin. "Walk in Lumia's light, sister[pc.isBimbo |! |. ]" "Yes, ma'am!" She turns back to the chapel door with a skip in her step. ] And as she leaves, |"I [pc.isBimbo |guess so! |suppose so, ]" you laugh. "Thank you both." And as they leave, ] you turn back to the rest of the town. Lumia's servants are meant to defend the innocent and keep hearth and home safe. You're glad to see Hawkethorne and its people enjoying the benefits of the work you've already done. |The old priest notices the commotion, smiles, and beckons you over. "Ah, [pc.name]. It's a pleasure to see you again. I don't suppose you have time to chat?" [pc.dcb |"It was on the way." You shrug. "What's up? You don't normally come out of the chapel." |"I don't mind," you say easily. "I was on my way over anyway. What's up? What brings you out of the chapel to talk with River?" |"Sure, I can chat!" You beam. It's always so much fun to talk to friendos! "What's up?" ] His smile gets just that little bit wider. "You, actually. River was just telling me about a remarkable series of events that happened up in the north. So, you actually met Lady Lumia incarnate, did you?" Your gaze shifts to the eyebrow-waggling, very self-satisfied-looking catboy. [pc.dcb |"You found out quick." |"Word travels fast," you chuckle. |"Did you figure that out? Already? Gosh!" ] "You know how things are with town criers and[pc.bg minstrel | fellow ] bards," he says modestly. "River's good at what he does, but unfortunately we're still a little light on details. Will the valkyries be joining the fight against the demons?" Sanders opens his palms earnestly. "I'd been worried about their, mmm, non-appearance." You nod in the affirmative, then sketch out the lines of your travels in the north: the battle alongside Annika, your personal meeting with Lumia, the confrontation with the Wraith, and the valkyries' return. When you finish, Sanders lets out a breath he hadn't seemed to be holding. "Sun and stars. Thank goodness you all came out of that okay. Wraith-touched were always a menace in the south during my adventuring days, but even though we all knew it was worse up north, we didn't know how much worse. Another thing to thank the valkyries for." He cocks his head and lets his smile return. "And you, of course. Doing battle in dreams now? Slaying Wraiths at the side of the gods? You're a rare talent, [pc.name]." You accept the compliment with a nod. "[pc.dcb |Damn straight. |Means a lot, coming from you. |Thank you! That's super sweet of you to say! ]" "[pc.isDK |I wonder," he muses. " |You earned it, of course," he assures you. "Now that you've done that, though, it brings back old dreams. ]Long ago, I had thoughts of journeying up to Ljosgard myself. Other than the valkyries themselves, no one has — ah, had — visited since the Godswar, and I wanted to be the first as much as any of the faithful. That never happened, but now that we know we can reach it, perhaps... perhaps I'll try to make my own journey there. I've known valkyries in my time, and they were remarkable women and good friends[pc.isDK | |[pc.mf | |, much like yourself ] ]. It would be good to catch up with them, genuflect in the light, and perhaps even explain myself to Lumia." For a moment, you think of asking him what he'd want to explain. But then you decide that if [pc.isDK |the old coot |he ] wanted to tell you, he would. Some things stay between a man and his gods. "I think they'd welcome you there." He smiles again. "Something to look forward to. At any rate, thank you, [pc.name], and well done. I'm sure you'll relax a little now that you have yet more strong allies against the demons." |The old priest notices the commotion, smiles, and beckons you over. "Ah, [pc.name]. It's a pleasure to see you again. I don't suppose you have time to chat?" [pc.dcb |"It was on the way." You shrug. "What's up? You don't normally come out of the chapel." |"I don't mind," you say easily. "I was on my way over anyway. What's up? What brings you out of the chapel to talk with River?" |"Sure, I can chat!" You beam. It's always so much fun to talk to friendos! "What's up?" ] He purses his lips. "I've been feeling unsettled, and was trying to take solace in conversation with an old friend. The source of my discomfort is relevant to you, too." "Thinking about demons?" "Not exactly. More about what they imply. I was in Lumia's service for a long time, and her warriors remain the most talented and valiant of all those who battle evil. From what word we have received from the south, I know they are mustering in response to what is happening here, but they are months, if not a year, away. But the greatest of Lumia's warriors are much closer to home, yet we have heard... nothing." [pc.isBimbo |"Oooh! I've heard a thing! Listen to this. |"Well..." You cough. When you've finished, Sanders' brow furrows. "Wraith-touched. I should've known. Numerous as they sometimes are in the south, all paladins know that one of the greatest threats is up here." "Could be worth looking into," River murmurs. "Or could be the kind of thing to save for after you've dealt with this demon stuff. If the valkyries are holding the line for now, you might have time." The priest looks distinctly uncomfortable about that. "Maybe it's the Lumian in me talking, but I think it's actually intuition. If it's at all possible, I think it would be better to deal with this Wraith business now, rather than later." With some effort, he marshals his features into a smile, then claps you on the shoulder. "At any rate, I trust you to do the right thing. Thank you for taking the time out. And whatever you choose to do... good luck." |The old priest notices the commotion, smiles, and beckons you over. You don't normally come out of the chapel." |"I don't mind," you say easily. "I was on my way over anyway. What's up? What brings you out of the chapel to talk with River?" |"Sure, I can chat!" The source of my discomfort is relevant to you, too." "Thinking about demons?" "Not exactly. More about what they imply. I was in Lumia's service for a long time, and her warriors remain the most talented and valiant of all those who battle evil. From what word we have received from the south, I know they are mustering in response to what is happening here, but they are months, if not a year, away. But the greatest of Lumia's warriors are much closer to home, yet we have heard... nothing." You [pc.isBimbo |gasp |cock your head ]. Lumia's valiant are many, but by 'the greatest' he can only mean the amazonian winged warrior-women themselves. "The valkyries?[pc.isBimbo | Oooh! Valkyries are so cool! They're, like, sun mommies and stuff. ]" "The very same," he confirms. "The valkyries' keep is supposed to be in the glacierland beyond the city of the frost elves, so of course no southerners have visited since the Godswar — save the valkyries themselves, who recruit not merely from the northern peoples but all the lands of the south as well. Once upon a time, I harbored fantasies of making that pilgrimage myself, but... well, time has passed that by. Still, they must know of what has happened among the elves[var4| and minotaurs]." [pc.isBimbo |"Sooo what you wanna know is," you put in, "why the sun mommies aren't there to help!" |"So the question is," you put in, "why haven't they shown up?" ] "Worse." He grimaces. "I've met valkyries, [pc.name]. The only reason they would not be joining the fight already is if they were already fighting... either the demons, or something else. And that is what is worrying me so much." [var3 |"[pc.isBimbo |Hmm. And we didn't see them when the stinky cultists were around either! |Especially since they weren't around to fight the cultists up there, ]" you muse. "[pc.isBimbo |Where else could they even be |I mean, it's their backyard. Where could they be, if not there ]?" "Exactly." |[flags.GLACIAL_WELCOME |"[pc.isBimbo |Plus, there are stinky |There are ] cultists up there, too," you muse, "and we could really use their help against them[pc.isBimbo |! Where could they all be? It's such a mystery. |. It's the valkyries' backyard. Where could they be, if not there? ]" "Exactly." |"[pc.isBimbo |Ryn-Ryn really wanted me to visit the Rift! I guess this way I could do two things at the same time! Which is super hard normally." |So I guess I should visit the Rift," you muse. At any rate, I just wanted to bring it up. I think it'd be an excellent idea if you were to journey into the Rift[flags.GLACIAL_WELCOME | once again ]. You [pc.isBimbo |bob your head up and down a few times. "Okie! Thanks for telling me! |nod. "I'll see what I can do. ]" ]
rows.translation: 当你走进鹰棘镇广场时，会感觉到有些不对劲。不过这种感觉并不明显，因为那里的人们依然按照他们平时的习惯活动着。 [dayNight |买卖、聊天 |在星空下，与朋友们安静地聊天 ]这一变化确实很明显，不过需要花一些时间才能真正理解其中的原因：瑞弗平时使用的旋律不见了。他不再为十几名听众弹奏音乐，而是在与仅有的一个听众聊天——那就是坐在小教堂外的桑德斯，而那个猫人男孩则靠在建筑物的坚固墙壁上休息。他们交谈得十分热烈，但并没有生气；而瑞弗则不时用拨弄乐器的动作来强调某些词语。 嗯，对你们来说，桑德斯能出门走动本身就已经很不寻常了，所以你们至少应该走过去看看发生了什么吧。你滑过几辆手推车，然后拐了个弯，朝着路标方向前进。[party.hasCompanions |，与[party.compNames]一同跟随在后面 ]。 [var2 |那位老牧师在你到达之前就已经从聊天中抬起头来。他的眼睛微微睁大了，然后他和瑞弗互相低声说了几句话，随后露出了笑容——那种亲切、真诚、甚至带有父亲般温情的笑容，他是那么擅长展现这种表情。他缓缓地从凳子上站了起来，当你走到他跟前时，他已经在平静地低头致意了：“恭喜你。 [pc.isCunning |你也应该很清楚他在说什么。“谢谢。 [var0 |在一阵光芒的照耀下，你那轻盈的英灵女武神的翅膀展开，伸展到最大幅度，然后又重新折叠在你的身后。 |你将翅膀完全展开，然后让它们恢复到平时位于你背后的位置。 ]成为一位女武神，这种感觉……很对。我不知道该如何形容。就好像我生来就应该在这里。” “我听说过，就是这种感觉。”他微笑着说。 你回头看了看[var0 |你的翅膀——那些在你走到这里时还未展开、还未飞动的翅膀 rows.raw: ' Something seems off when you enter the Hawkethorne square. It's a minor thing, as the people there move about in their normal rhythms, [dayNight |buying, selling, chatting |quietly chatting with friends under the stars ], but definitely noticeable, and it takes a few moments to nail it down: River's usual melody is absent. Instead of strumming for an audience of a dozen, he's chatting with an audience of one: Sanders, outside the chapel, sitting on a stool while the catboy lounges against the building's sturdy walls. They're talking animatedly, but not angrily, and River is casually emphasizing some of the words with strums on his instrument. Well, Sanders being out and about is unusual enough for you to at least casually wander over and see what's up. You slide past a few handcarts and angle for the Waystone[party.hasCompanions |, with [party.compNames] in tow ]. [var2 |The old priest looks up from his chat long before you get there. His eyes widen a bit, and he and River murmur a few things to each other, then he smiles — one of those amiable, genuine, even fatherly smiles he's so good at. Slowly, he rises from his stool, and by the time you reach him he's calmly bowing his head. "Congratulations." [pc.isCunning |You have a pretty good idea what he's talking about, too. "Thank you." [var0 |With a shower of light, your ethereal valkyrie's wings emerge and stretch to their full length before folding back behind you. |You stretch your wings to their full length before letting them return to their usual rest position behind you. ] "Being a valkyrie feels... right. I don't know how to explain it. Like I'm meant to be here." "I've heard that that's what it's like," he says, smiling. You look back at [var0 |your wings — the wings that had not been out and about when you were walking over here |your wings — which, unlike most of your sisters', are quite physical, even normal ]. "How could you tell?" "There's a bearing and aura among valkyries that are unmistakable, especially for someone late of Lumia's own service." He cocks his head to the side, and that fatherly smile turns just a little bit gently mischievous. "Also, River was happy to confirm it for me. He's heard a few stories, albeit without many details." |"[pc.isBimbo |Oooh! Thank you! But, um... |Hey there. Uh, thanks. ]" You turn your head to the side quizzically. "Congratulations on...?" "On becoming one of Lumia's Chosen," he supplies. "You may not [var0 |be showing your wings at the moment |have the kind of wings that most associate with valkyries ], but the bearing and the aura are unmistakable nonetheless. Also," he continues, eyes twinkling, "River was happy to confirm it for me. He's heard a few stories, albeit without many details." ] The catboy in question tips you a jaunty wink, then straightens up his face before executing a bow — and instead of the showy performer's bow he normally does at the end of a particularly well-received piece, it's a respectful and genuine one. You can't keep a smile off your face as you return the greeting. "[pc.isBimbo |Oooh! I get it. Thanks, you two! |Oh, right. That makes sense. Thank you both. ]" "It's well deserved," Sanders assures you. "By the way, how is the holy keep? It's one of those journeys I always thought about making, but never quite did before I left Lumia's service for Velun's. Not least because no one save your own sisters had made the journey in two hundred years. Once upon a time, I did harbor thoughts of being the first, but... well." "[pc.isBimbo |Um. It's kinda a long story. |About that... ]" Quickly, you sketch the outlines of your journey in the north — your battle alongside Annika, your subsequent meeting with Lumia herself, the confrontation in Lumia's palace, and the valkyries' return from battling the Wraith-touched. When you finish, Sanders looks like he's about ready to genuflect. "Goodness," he murmurs. "It seems we all owe you thanks, not merely congratulations." "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. You're too nice! rows.original:
As you wander the Rift, something makes your [pc.ears] prick up enough for you to [party.hasCompanions
        |call a quick halt
        |take a quick breather and try to hear it properly
    ]. Something big is moving around out there[var0
        | — bigger than a jotun, even, from the vibrations of its footfalls
        |, and whatever it is, it's so huge that it's making the ground vibrate from its footfalls
    ]. You're curious now. Maybe it would be a good idea to investigate; worst comes to worst, you can probably run away.
    
    Turning from the path, you strike out toward the footfalls and immediately almost blind yourself by leaving your eyes open long enough for a gust of boreal chill to blow right into them. Unfortunately, you're walking into the wind, and as you press on, arm now in front of your face for protection, it rises. White stuff sleets down from the slate-gray sky, and the sun, of course, [dayNight
        |is nowhere in sight behind the stormy clouds
        |has long since set
    ]. Between the darkness and the wind, you can barely see the next snowdrift in front of you. You might have to rely on your [pc.ears] and the vibrations in the ground for this, but with the wind this high, you'll still need to be closer for that to work anyway.
    
    Wading up one snowy hill in the midst of this snowstorm is bad enough, but the next one is even tougher. But the sounds of movement are even nearer now, and the ground is rumbling louder than ever. And then, suddenly, those sounds are joined by a bright yellow-white glow from over the rise, a wordless shout, and the roar of magical fire. There's a fight going on over there, and somebody's using holy magic!
    
    Should you continue up the hill to take a look, or back off?
rows.translation:
当你在裂谷中漫步时，有什么东西让你的[pc.ears]竖了起来，让你[party.hasCompanions
        |迅速叫停队伍
        |稍作歇息，好好听一听
    ]。外面有什么庞然大物在移动[var0
        | ——从它脚步的震动来看，甚至比女性约顿巨人还要大
        |，而且不管它是什么，它都大到让地面因它的脚步而震动
    ]。你现在好奇起来了。也许去调查一下是个好主意；最坏的情况，你大概也能逃跑。
    
    你偏离了小路，朝着那脚步声的方向走去，结果因为睁着眼睛太久，一阵凛冽的寒风直直吹进眼里，差点把自己弄瞎。不幸的是，你正迎着风走，当你把手臂挡在脸前继续前进时，风势更大了。白色的东西从板岩灰色的天空中簌簌落下，而太阳当然[dayNight
        |在暴风云后完全不见踪影
        |早已落下
    ]。在黑暗与狂风之间，你几乎看不清前方最近的那个雪堆。也许这段路你得靠自己的[pc.ears]和地面的震动，但在风这么大的情况下，你终究还是得离得更近才能起作用。
    
    在这场暴风雪中，蹚过一座积雪的小山已经够糟了，而下一座还要更难走。但那移动的声音现在更近了，地面也比以往任何时候都震得更响。接着，突然间，那些声音中又加入了从坡上传来的一道明亮的黄白色光芒、一声无言的呼喊，以及魔法火焰的咆哮。那边正在打斗，而且有人在用神圣魔法！
    
    你是该继续爬上山去看个究竟，还是退回去？

rows.original: [party.CombatNames] rush up the rest of the snowy hill, spread out and ready for a fight, and you're not disappointed. Just a hundred feet away in a gentle trough between two ridges, three fully naked monstrosities lumber effortlessly through the snow, claws out and bellowing with rage; a further two are slumped over in the snow, unconscious or worse. [var0 |The musclebound creatures are as tall as any jotun you've ever seen, but height and power are where the similarities end. |These muscular beasts are huge, easily fifteen feet tall — almost tall enough to see you if they turn their heads. ] They're covered in white hair, and lumpy, gray, bone-like growths protrude from the scraggly mass at what seem like random intervals. Their three red eyes glow unnaturally[flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |, like those of the elves and dragons enthralled by the Wraith at the Ice Palace ], and their slavering, betusked maws are full of razor-sharp teeth. Immense, meaty hands with thick, sharp, bony claws swing at their opponent every time she comes close to their range. And the wounds she's already dealt them mat their stringy fur and give them an even more terrifying appearance. [silly |You can tell that this is a gynophile-oriented porn game in silly mode, though, because the horrifying monsters aren't using their normal art. Instead, they're surprisingly feminine and curvy! Moira strikes again. ] Their blue-skinned opponent glows with the light of the sun, flitting around just out of their reach on glowing ethereal wings. [flags.CAT_ATHEL_RES |You remember warriors like her from the Ice Palace crypt: this is definitely a Lumian valkyrie, albeit rather less ghostly than the ones you saw before. |You've heard the stories, just like everyone else in Savarra, but seeing one up close is something else entirely. She's got to be one of Lumia's valkyries. ] [pc.ra mothfolk |She zips through a series of warrior's moves that look amazing, and you're sure she's, like, fighting incredibly well, but all you can really think about is how she glows. G-gosh. She's so... w-wow. A moth like you could stare at her all day! Only the flash of a divine thunderbolt smashing into one of the creatures she's fighting shakes you from your glow-obsessed reverie to pay closer attention. Oh. Oh goodness. She's kicking butt, too, not just glowing! |Her martial prowess easily lives up to expectation; she zips close enough from time to time to jab at one beast with the glowing tip of her bronze spear, then zips back out of range again to avoid the retaliatory swing. Then, using her spear as a twirling, flashing channeling staff, she summons up a divine thunderbolt from the clouds to throw at another creature before diving in right behind it for more stabs. ] The monsters aren't simply letting themselves get beaten up, though. They might not be able to swipe very effectively at the warmaiden with their hands and claws, but they've got other weapons in their own arsenal. One's red eyes glow even brighter, and a thick black-purple ball of rage appears around its meaty paws, and then, with remarkable accuracy, it tosses the blighted orb right at the valkyrie. She barely manages to bring her shield up in time, angling it so that the magic caroms up and away from her, but the sheer force of it is enough to send her flying back toward you. It's a trajectory that makes it look like she's about to land right next to you, but before [party.yall] can react, she manages to stabilize in midair with the help of her wings. Apparently that's the last straw. Her eyes glow brighter, and the spearpoint becomes white-hot. A second ticks by as the monster snorts, paws, then charges, and the tip of her polearm burns hotter until the snowy air around it swims with heat. Then, with a warrior's yell, she points it at the charging creature, and all the energy building up in the spear releases at once in a beam of concentrated sunfire that strikes the beast on its chest, flowers up against its torso, and sends it skidding into one of the other two, knocking both to the ground. Panting, injured, with patches of its fur singed and burning, the beast is badly hurt... but very much alive. Another blighted orb coalesces into reality around the remaining beast's hand, but this time, it's not looking at the valkyrie. It's looking at you. [pc.agilityRange 66 |[party.hasCompanions |Shouting to [party.compNames] |With a muttered oath ], you hustle out of the way as soon as you realize it, [pc.hasWings |wings straining against the wet snow to shift you out of the way. rows.translation: [party.CombatNames]冲上那座被积雪覆盖的山丘，散开阵型准备战斗，你们绝对不会失望的。就在一百英尺外，两座山脊之间的低洼地带，有三只全身赤裸的怪物正笨拙地在雪地里爬行，它们伸出爪子，发出愤怒的吼声；另外两只则倒在地上，不知是失去了意识，还是遭遇了更糟的事情。 [var0 |这些肌肉虬结的生物，其身高与你们见过的任何巨魔都相当，但身高与力量之外，它们的其他特征却截然不同。 |这些肌肉发达的巨兽体型庞大，身高至少有十五英尺——如果它们转过头来，几乎足以看到你。 ]它们的身上覆盖着白色的毛发，那些粗糙的、灰色的、类似骨头的突起物以看似随意的方式分布在那些杂乱无章的毛发中。它们那三只红色的眼睛散发着不自然的光芒。[flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |就像那些被冰宫中的幽灵所吸引的精灵和巨龙一样…… ]它们的下颚布满锋利的牙齿，每当敌人靠近时，它们就会用那些巨大的、布满粗硬尖爪的肉手部攻击敌人。而那些伤口会让它们那缠结的毛发显得更加狰狞可怖。 [silly |不过，从这些设定就可以看出，这是一款以女性玩家为目标的、采用搞笑风格的色情游戏——因为那些恐怖的怪物并没有使用它们通常的造型设计，反而显得格外女性化，线条也格外柔美动人！莫伊拉又出手了…… ] 他们那些皮肤呈蓝色的对手在阳光下闪闪发光，它们用那发光的、仿佛虚无缥缈的翅膀在他们触手可及的地方飞来飞去。 [flags.CAT_ATHEL_RES |你肯定还记得冰宫地牢里那些这样的战士吧？她绝对是一名卢米安女武神，只不过比起你之前见过的那些，她显得没那么“幽灵般”罢了。 |你和其他所有萨瓦拉的人一样，都听说过这些故事，但亲眼见到这一幕，却是完全不一样的体验。她肯定就是卢米娅的那些女武神之一。 ] [pc.ra mothfolk |她熟练地施展了一系列看起来非常精彩的战士动作，你肯定会觉得她的战斗技巧高超得惊人，但事实上，你满脑子想的却只是……她到底是怎么做到的？发光天啊，她太……太迷人了！这样的美女，让人根本想一整天都盯着看呢！只有当那道神圣的闪电击中她正在战斗的敌人时，你才会从这种痴迷的凝视中回过神来，仔细观察她的动作。哦，天哪，她不仅长得漂亮，战斗能力也超强啊！ |她的武艺果然名不虚传；她时而迅速靠近，用青铜长矛发光的矛头刺向某只怪物，随即又迅速撤退以避免遭到反击。接着，她将长矛当作一根旋转闪动的法杖，从云层中召唤出神圣的雷电攻击另一只怪物，随后立刻追了上去继续发动攻击。 ] 不过，这些怪物可不会轻易让自己被击败。虽然它们用双手和爪子可能无法有效地攻击那位女武神，但它们自己的武器库里还有其他手段。其中一只怪物的红色眼睛亮得更加炽烈了，它那肉乎乎的爪子周围出现了一个浓稠的黑色紫色怒火球，然后，它以惊人的精准度将这个怒火球直接抛向了那位女武神。她勉强及时举起了盾牌，调整了盾牌的角度，使得那道魔法力量偏离了她，但那股巨大的冲击力还是让她向后飞去，朝你的方向飞去。从轨迹上看，她似乎马上就要落在你旁边了，但在那之前[party.yall]她能够做出反应，在翅膀的帮助下，她在半空中成功稳住了身体。 显然，这已经成为了压垮她的最后一根稻草。她的眼睛亮得更加炽烈，手中的长矛尖端也变得通红发热。时间一分一秒地过去，那只怪物发出怒吼，用爪子抓挠地面，然后冲了上来——而她手中的长矛尖端燃烧得更加厉害了，周围的积雪都被热气烘得融化了。随后，她发出战士般的呐喊，将长矛指向那头冲过来的怪物。储存在长矛中的所有能量瞬间释放出来，形成一道炽热的火焰光束，直击怪物的胸膛。火焰在它的躯干上燃烧开来，迫使它滑向另外两头怪物，将它们也都撞倒在地。喘着粗气，身负重伤，身上的毛发也有部分被烧焦了，这只野兽伤势严重……但它依然活着。 另一个被腐蚀的球体在这只野兽剩下的那只手上凝聚成了现实，但这一次，它并没有看向那位女武神。说的就是你。 [pc.agilityRange 66 |[party.hasCompanions |向……大声呼喊[party.compNames] |伴随着一声低声的咒骂 ]你一意识到这一点，就立刻赶紧躲开了。 [pc.hasWings |你的翅膀在湿雪中奋力挣扎，试图将你从那片雪中拨开。与那些女武神不同，你的翅膀是实实在在的，被积雪重重压住，但那一瞬间的快速反应应该足以救你一命。 |在厚厚的积雪中尽力挣扎前行。这可能会很困难，但多那一丝反应时间应该足以让你避开危险——当然，也希望那只怪物射击技术不太准。 ] 然而，这位女武神并不会等待你摆脱危险。甚至在那只怪物释放出那股致命的能量之前，她就已经振翅飞去拦截它了。黑紫色的魔法在她盾牌上闪烁着光芒，随后在空气中消散，而这位长着翅膀的战士也被震得向后倒去，朝你的方向飞来……不过并没有人受到伤害。当她落在雪地上时，她的翅膀立刻恢复了控制力，她成功地稳住了身体，轻柔地降落在你身旁，没有再次飞走。 |[pc.hasWings |你拼命扇动自己的翅膀，试图升空并避开那次攻击，但与那些女武神不同，你的翅膀并没有魔力；在如此高的风速和如此密集的雪中，你根本无法及时起飞。 |如果没有翅膀，你就根本不可能及时避开那一击。 ] [pc.isMage |你开始用双手编织出某种神秘的防护结界。 |[pc.hasShield |你举起盾牌进行阻挡。 |你绷紧双腿，将它们像弹簧一样蜷曲起来，试图跳开去避开那个障碍物。 ] ]但是，那个生物已经开始释放它的魔法了—— 幸运的是，即使你的行动能力还没有完全恢复，这位女武神却依然可以正常行动。她在你和那道致命的魔法之间穿梭，用盾牌挡住了它，又一次成功地将它偏转开来，不过也因此被击退，倒向你这边来了。不过她又一次稳住了身体，然后轻轻地在雪地上落在你旁边，没有再次飞走。 ]她紧接着又释放了一连串法术。[pc.isMage | ——一个你需要用自己的能量冲击来参与其中的游戏—— ]这一下又让那只怪物向后滑行，暂时脱离了攻击范围，和它的两个同伴一样，但显然仍然处于战斗状态中。

rows.original: With a wry smile and an apologetic shrug, the valkyrie turns to you. Eyes glow and shoulder-length white hair floats on the wind as she plants the haft of her spear in the snow; then, she stretches her hand out to you. "[silly |Be not afraid |Well met ], adventurer[party.hasCompanions |s ].[silly |" She coughs. "And before you ask, no, this is my actual form, although I do have a sworn sister or two who's closer to the way Ezekiel saw things. It'd be really nice if people who didn't really know much about history stopped talking about 'biblically accurate an—' er, 'valkyries.' At any rate, ] I'm sorry — I should've been better about leading the trolls away. I didn't mean to get you involved." [pc.ra mothfolk |As if from far away, you hear yourself say, "You're glowing." "I — yes, I suppose I am." The smile doesn't waver as she casts a quick glance in the direction of the trolls, then turns back to you with an open hand. "I'm glad you like it, although I hope it isn't too distracting. I know valkyries can be quite popular with mothfolk..." You try to reply, but it comes out all a-babble. Gosh, you could lose yourself in those wings. "No — I mean — well — we're good. I'm good. It's all... it's all good." |[pc.dcb |You shrug. "What's done is done. Looks like we're in the thick of it now." |"[party.hasCompanions |We got ourselves |I got myself ] involved," you say amiably. "In fact, I was coming to [var0 |lend my blade to your cause, so to speak |give you a little help ]." |"That's okay, cutie!" you chirp. "[party.hasCompanions |We were |I was ] actually just coming over to help anyway!" ] ] "Ha. Well, then. Thank you very much." There's a little emphasis on the 'ch' sound at the end of 'much' when she says it, like it's not part of her normal repertoire. And she has a slightly singsongy way of enunciating her vowels — come to think of it, you've noticed a similar accent among some other frost elves[var1 |, like the ones at Festivus ]. It's a little heavier, a little more exotic than Ryn's accent, but still very understandable... and kind of cute. Your brief conversation's interrupted, though, when the valkyrie notices the beast stirring in the snow a hundred feet away... and the other two struggling to their own feet. In a flash, her smile disappears, and she begins to speak very quickly. "Okay, if you've never done this before, here's the short and sweet version. Ice trolls are bad enough, but these beasts are Wraith-touched. Their magic is blighted, along with the rest of their bodies, so if you can draw on the power of the Seven, that's the best way to put them down. [pc.weaponMRT |Or you could just wade into a melee — close-gripped fights against trolls can make for wonderful war stories if you survive. |Stick and move at range with your [pc.weapon]; you don't want to get in clawing distance. |Try to work your way around to the side, and stay at distance; you've already got the right tools to fight out of clawing range. ] I'll try to keep their attention, turn them away from [party.som |you |the two of you |the three of you ].[silly | After all, a good tank's always got to face bosses away from the rest of the party to keep you from getting cleaved! ]" [party.oneComp etheryn arona azyrran viviane agnimitra brint brienne atugia kiyoko cait quin |[etheryn.lowConfidence |"I — I'll d-do my best," stammers Ryn. "I d-don't want to let a v-valkyrie down..." |"Fighting side by side with a valkyrie..." Ryn breathes. The [etheryn.crowned |elvenqueen |ice princess ] readies her [etheryn.weapon], her face full of determination. "We won't let you down!" ] The taller elf smiles reassuringly. "I know you won't, Your [etheryn.crowned |Majesty |Highness ]. It's been too long since I stood shield-to-shield with a var Ridell [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess ]... I'm looking forward to it." |Arona hefts her [arona.weapon] and cackles. "Oh-ho-ho, yes. This is what I'm fuckin' talkin' about! [pc.name] gave me a taste for fighting trolls, even fucked-up weird ones with too many eyes. Let's wreck their shit!" "Hold onto that enthusiasm — we're going to need it." |[azyrran.kdb |Azyrran lifts her lance in a proud vesparan salute. "Hive Knights and valkyries, together in battle. They won't stand a chance against us!" "That's the spirit!" the other Lumian warmaiden cheers. |"Oh, going lance-to-claw against these things is going to be fun." Azzy flashes the Lumian warrior a confident draconic grin. "I've missed fighting alongside true vesparan warriors. We can bring them down together!" |"Okie-doke! I'm definitely gonna do my best to help a Lumian cutie like you out," giggles your bubbly hornet-knight. "Do pheromones work on them, too?" "I don't know," admits the valkyrie. "Want to find out?" "Sure!" "All right, then." ] |[viv.isDemon |"Yes, you do that," says Viviane absently. Nonchalant as the witch is, she still holds her [viviane.weapon] at the ready. "Just so long as I can have a piece of one of the beasts to study later." "I... huh. Okay, then." The valkyrie frowns, but doesn't question Viv further. |"Excellent, dear. That way I'll have a clear shot." Viviane's hands sweep through the air as she gathers a little reality-bending energy of her own. "Warriors who aren't complete meatheads make for such pleasant surprises.[pc.cl warrior |[pc.isCunning | First [pc.name], now you; we're breaking stereotypes left and right. ] ]" "Compliment received on this end," laughs the valkyrie. ] |Agnimitra's flames get even brighter than they normally do, and she pulls out her instrument, ready to play a deadly tune. "Another tale to add to the legend. Let's do this!" The valkyrie beams. "I'm proud to fight alongside the immortal legendary phoenix." |"All right by me. I don't care how tall these things are; they're getting it right between the eyes," rumbles Brint. "All three of 'em." "That's right, big guy." |"I like it!" Brienne enthusiastically raises her [brienne.weapon]. "Let's put 'em down, [pc.name]!" "Wow. If you southern minos are anything like my northern mino sworn sisters, this is going to be a piece of cake!" |The air around Atugia crackles as her ethereal blade takes shape. "And I'll be right there with you." "Together, then!" |"A sound mind is our deadliest weapon against such brutes," murmurs Kiyoko approvingly. Her foxfire makes the air around her shimmer, just like the Lumian warrior's sunlight. "Exactly." |"Well, if it's magic we need, I've got us covered!" Cait chirps. "We'll need plenty," says the valkyrie, smiling. |"Sounds good," Quin chuckles. "I like someone who knows how to fight smart." "Smart and hard — that's the goal, anyway!" |You grin[pc.isDK | fiercely ]. "Sounds like a plan to me." rows.original: A big fight up here in the Rift isn't something you can easily ignore. If you investigate, you probably won't be able to avoid getting into a battle!
rows.translation: 在裂谷地区发生这样一场大规模的战斗，绝对是不可忽视的。如果你深入调查的话，很可能就会卷入一场争斗之中！
rows.raw: "A big fight up here in the Rift isn't something you can easily ignore. If you investigate, you probably won't be able to avoid getting into a battle!"

rows.original: Whoever's locked in combat ahead can probably handle this on their own. You've certainly got no interest in getting tangled up in it right now. With that in mind, it doesn't take long for [party.yall] to leave the sounds of battle behind and return to the main path.
rows.translation: 前面正在交战的那个人应该能自己应付。你现在肯定没兴趣卷进去。这么一想，没过多久，[party.yall]就把厮杀声抛在身后，回到了主路上。
rows.raw: "\n        Whoever's locked in combat ahead can probably handle this on their own. You've certainly got no interest in getting tangled up in it right now. With that in mind, it doesn't take long for [party.yall] to leave the sounds of battle behind and return to the main path.\n        "

rows.original: Discretion is the better part of valor[silly|, in which better part you have, um... okay, Falstaff, go ahead and run away from the scary noises]. Something like this probably won't go away forever, so you can probably investigate later when you're ready.
rows.translation: 谨慎是勇气中更重要的那一部分[silly|，而你恰好拥有这更重要的部分，呃……好吧，法斯塔夫，那就尽管逃离那些可怕的声音吧]。 像这样的情况大概不会永远消失，所以等你准备好之后，大概可以再来调查。
rows.raw: "Discretion is the better part of valor[silly|, in which better part you have, um... okay, Falstaff, go ahead and run away from the scary noises]. Something like this probably won't go away forever, so you can probably investigate later when you're ready."

rows.original: [var0 |With a last, elephantine bellow, the third beast finally falls, slamming into the ground with an impact that itself almost knocks you off your feet. [silly |But the valkyrie still isn't done. Eyes bright with Lumian fury, she points her spear at the mountains to the east and snarls, "You know where to go." From where it lies on the ground, the troll's three eyes flutter in confusion. "Go on, bad girl. Get! We might need you for more silly mode encounters later." Thoroughly defeated, the troll nods submissively, then nudges its companions awake. A few hesitant backward glances later, they slowly trudge off toward the mountain passes, almost immediately swallowed up by the flurrying snow. For long seconds after that, all that you can do is stand with a hand on your [pc.weapon] and stare as they disappear in the distance. Once the enormous shaggy things get far enough away, though, |For long seconds after that, all that you can do is stand with a hand on your [pc.weapon] and stare at the defeated trolls. Only when the valkyrie[var1 | picks herself up off the ground and ] moves close enough to confirm the creatures' incapacitation do ] you let yourself fully relax. So does [silly |the valkyrie |she ]; her eyes lose their glow, returning to the sort of ice-blue orbs you've seen on plenty of other frost elves before. Her jaw relaxes, and the glowing holy spearpoint lowers toward the ground. "And there it is. Thank you again, brave one[party.hasCompanions |s ]." |A final blow from the[silly | bizarrely sexy silly-mode ] troll sends you skidding back into a snowdrift, tossing clumps of snow high into the air and covering you with powder. The deep snow cushions the impact, but not by enough. You try to stand on unsteady legs, but you can't manage it; out of the fight, you sink to your knees, and, accompanied by the other two, the hulking beast looms over you. And then something slams into the back of its head and it falls forward, narrowly missing you as it too faceplants into the snow. Furious, confused, the troll is quick to lift itself back up and turn around, but by then, it's too late. From behind the monster, [party.som |the valkyrie streaks in again, brandishing her spear and shouting with divine fury |[comp1.name] rushes in, with the valkyrie right beside [comp1.himHer] |[party.compNames true] barrel in, with the valkyrie close behind ]. The trolls neglected to finish the rest of the party off after laying them low, and they quickly pay the price. Weapons flash, whitefire flares against fur, and while the trolls are quick to regain their feet, turn around, and meet the renewed onslaught, they've lost any hope of regaining the advantage. The battle's over; the beasts just don't know it yet. It takes a minute or so for the [silly |spear ]point to be driven home[silly | — and the valkyrie drives it home over and over again — |, ] but at long last, a final blast of whitefire blossoms against the final troll's torso and the horrendously-wounded monster topples with an immense, earth-shattering crash. [party.som |The valkyrie stands there for several seconds after the last beast falls, breathing hard and pointing her spear at it worriedly, but eventually the glow in her eyes subsides. Then she lowers her spear and shield, flashes a reassuring smile, and offers you a hand that from the feel of it could lift you to your feet all on its own if she so chose. |[party.compNames true] helps you to your feet while the valkyrie glares at the fallen monster with spear in hand. Once she's satisfied that the beast is down, she lowers her weapon, turns to you, and with eyes no longer aglow she offers her hand. |[party.compNames true] help you to your feet while the valkyrie glares at the fallen troll, pointing her spear at it so as not to be caught off guard. Once she's satisfied that the beast is defeated, she lowers her weapon, turns to you, and with eyes no longer aglow she offers her hand. ] "You fought well, [pc.mf |warrior |sister ]. Thank you for standing at my side." [silly |"Watch out!" She whirls back to the trolls to see them rise to their feet... but instead of trying conclusions again, they submissively kneel before her, with not a glimmer of fight in their eyes. "Ah. Of course. Now, you know you've been bad girls. Go back to where you're supposed to be." One of the trolls manages a sad little pout. "But..." "Go on, get! We might need you for more silly mode content later." Dejectedly but obediently, they rise from their knees and turn toward the east, lumbering slowly toward the mountains whence they came. "And that settles that," the valkyrie declares. "Right. Okay. I was thanking you for how brave you were." ] [pc.dcb |"Yeah, okay," you grouse. "You can just say that they handed me my ass. No need to be nice about it." |You smile wryly. "That's awfully gracious of you, but I kinda got my butt kicked." |"You're super sweet, but, um," you admit, "I didn't do so great there!" ] "After all that I've seen in war, I know this: when Tira rolls her dice, sometimes even the greatest fighters can come up short through no fault of their own," she says philosophically. "You did look like you knew what you were doing, and there's no shame in a run of bad luck. I'm sure that if we fought them again, you'd have no problem.[var1 | Besides, I had to sit out part of that fight, too. ] So again," she continues, still smiling and offering her hand, "thank you." ] [pc.dcbc |"[var0 |Sure |Fine ], whatever." |"Hey, no problem." |"Gosh, you're nice. And I love your energy!" You offer her your bestest, most winsome smile. "You're welcome!" ] Now that you have a moment to breathe, you can take a closer look at the blue-skinned elven warrior in front of you.
