You don't move far — just enough to get away from the battlefield and over a rise to help shield you from some of the icy boreal wind. That doesn't do the whole job, though, so Annika helps[party.hasCompanions
            | the [party.sizeText] of
        ] you build a makeshift wall of snow to handle the rest of it. Behind that snow-wall, she creates a warm, glowing ball of magical sunlight in lieu of a campfire and produces bacon, jerky, berries, and other good polar food for you to munch on while her[pc.isMage
            | and your
        ] healing magic tends to any wounds with its usual efficiency. As for the valkyrie herself, she sets aside her shield, spear, and winged headpiece, then sits to the side in the path of the winter wind, unconcerned by the cold; being born a frost elf has its advantages. With wings spread wide and a gentle, knowing smile — to say nothing of the snacks and warmth — she goes a long way toward making this corner of the Rift feel downright inviting. 
        
        Fit warrior women who project friendly confidence? [pc.dcb
            |Where the hell have the valkyries been this whole time?
            |It's a damn shame the valkyries haven't shown up before now.
            |Gosh. You wish there were more cutie valkies around. Where've they all been?
        ]
        
        [pc.dcb
            |"All right, enough lollygagging. You were about to tell your story."
            |Let that go for now, though. "All right. You had a tale to tell?"
            |Anyway! You chirp, "[party.hasCompanions
                |I'm
                |We're
            ] ready for musclemommy story time now!"
        ]
        
        "Right." The valkyrie nods. "Here's the short version: for years, we valkyries have been trapped in a war we can't retreat from — one that's distracting our attention, sucking in all our warriors, and keeping us from our usual divine mission. Normally, our Order crisscrosses the world, fighting bandits and marauders, destroying cults, protecting villagers, and ensuring the fertility of people, animals, and soil. But that's been less and less common for years — decades, even. We've barely been able to spare anyone from the main front against the Wraith-touched. They're growing more powerful, and all the valiant fighters in our Order are struggling to stop it."
        
        Wow. Okay, you definitely have some questions.

rows.raw: "What's life like for Lumia's warmaidens, anyway?"

rows.original: "We very badly want to help." A hard edge cuts into the valkyrie's normally singsongy voice. "The demon [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS|and the Wraith she unleashed were|was] bad enough. In [party.has etheryn |your mother's day, Etheryn |Queen Alraince's day ], valkyries were a welcome sight at the palace, and many of the Winter City's best warriors joined our ranks. But Alissa said that what made the Order stronger weakened the crown. When she became queen, she only let warriors she'd fallen out with join our Order while keeping others for herself, and she barred us from the palace, only allowing sisters into the city to visit family or attend festivals." [pc.dcb |"And you just let that happen?" |"How did she manage to get away with something like that?" |You pout. "Stupid meanie[silly | blueberry cunt ]. How come you said yes to that?" ] "We're not in the habit of unseating a ruler purely because she doesn't worship in the way we do and because she wanted to place some breathing space between the crown and the Order," Annika says wearily. "That's all it seemed like she was doing. And we all thought that a strong crown would be a fine thing, if it continued to help us fight the Wraithslaves. But as a result, we didn't know what Alissa was truly up to in the palace, and we didn't find out she had abandoned Lumia to consort with a monster until the rest of the city did. "I don't know how we would've been able to know. But even if we couldn't have been there, we should have been there." A shadow haunts her ice-eyes for several moments until she closes them and banishes it back to the realm of doubt and guilt. "Thank you for saving those you could." [pc.dcb |"Someone had to. |"You're very welcome. |"Sure thing! ]" You cock your head. "But then, what about the Cult here in the Rift?" A long sigh: "That hurts almost as badly. We rarely fly over the Rift anymore, with the war against the Wraithslaves so pressing, but we still had a little warning when some of the Rift people had their own schism, with tribes of avanai, siorcanna, jotuns, and selkies split down the middle about whether to keep trading with us or fight us. We heard about it early enough to negotiate with the people who formed an alliance against elves, Lumians, and our own allies... but that went poorly, so we did what we could to keep our friends safe and otherwise withdrew even further, trying to give this Rift Alliance's rage time to cool while we dealt instead with an enemy that we actually wanted to fight. So we missed every sign of the demons until someone — I'm guessing it was you — blew up their supply dump." You can't help but flash a coy smile. "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee hee. Maaaaybe. |Guilty as charged. ]" "It was spectacular." The approval in her voice is as clear as a bell. "Well done. We could only spare a few warriors, but once we investigated the wreckage and found that the demons were there, we attacked their groups on sight. But we had little to spare for scouting, so when you destroyed that cavern we were still a long way away from your trail. A day late and a hawk short. Again." Her eyes burn with white-hot Lumian fury. "We need to hunt down every last one of them. But right now, we're locked in a death-grip with the Wraithslaves, and if we take too many warriors away from the main front, these demons won't be the only problem the Marches have. "That doesn't mean we're ignoring them. I tracked some groups trying to return to the underwater hideout you destroyed. Some of the selkies that escaped from down there... they didn't even know their own names anymore. A grown woman I knew when she was small enough for me to hold her in my arms stared at me like she'd never seen me in her life. The demons that were with them... well. We did what we had to do." You share a moment of commiseration with her, but then think back on your journey beneath the waves: "I thought we made sure that they — the selkies — could get out." There's more than a little [pc.isDK |irritation |worry ] in your voice. "Most of them did, we think. We know that they made their way into the frozen sea and that many have come home. But even the selkies who're friendly to us haven't counted out everybody who's returned, to say nothing of the Rift Alliance folk. The cultists that went back to try to find something amid the wreckage must've gotten some stragglers. At least the stragglers we did find hadn't been transformed. Yet." Bleak cold worms into the pause that follows that last word, and it's not just from the weather. After a few moments, the valkyrie picks up her tale again: "So we dealt with a few of those demons, but I know some others were able to disappear into Wraith-thick territory on their way to gods know where. South, maybe.[var0| That'd be my bet, since they don't lair on Dracia anymore, thanks to you.]" She gazes off in the general direction of the Hornpeak Mountains. "Finding them again will have to wait until after we've dealt with this problem in the north."
rows.translation: 我们真的很想提供帮助。”这位女武神的嗓音原本总是轻快悠扬的，此刻却带着一丝坚毅。“那个恶魔[flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS|而她释放出来的那些幽灵……|是]已经够糟糕了。再这样下去[party.has etheryn |你的母亲节快乐，伊瑟琳。 |阿尔兰斯女王的诞辰日 ]在宫殿里，女武神们的出现确实令人欣喜，许多冬城的顶尖战士也都加入了我们的行列。但艾莉莎指出，正是那些使骑士团变得更强大的因素，反而削弱了王权。当她成为女王后，只有那些与她发生矛盾的战士才被允许加入我们的骑士团，而其他战士则被她留在自己身边；同时，她还禁止我们进入宫殿，只允许姐妹们进城探亲或参加节日活动。 [pc.dcb |你就这么任由这件事发生了？ |她究竟是怎么逃脱这种惩罚的？ |你撅起嘴来：“真是个愚蠢又刻薄的家伙[silly | 蓝莓阴道 ]你怎么会答应那么做的呢？ ] 我们并没有因为某位统治者并不按照我们的方式信仰，或者因为她想要在王权与某个组织之间建立一些缓冲空间，就刻意去推翻她，”安妮卡疲惫地说道，“看起来她所做的也确实只是这些而已。我们都认为，如果那顶强大的王冠能继续帮助我们对抗那些幽灵奴仆，那将会是一件好事。然而，结果却是我们根本不知道艾莉莎在宫殿里究竟在策划什么，直到整个城市的其他人都发现了她抛弃了卢米娅，去与一个怪物为伴，我们才终于明白真相。 我不知道我们当时是怎么会知道那些情况的。但即便我们当时不在场，我们本应该在那里的。一道阴影在她冰冷的双眼中徘徊了片刻，直到她闭上眼睛，将那阴影重新驱赶到怀疑与愧疚的领域中去。‘谢谢你尽力拯救了那些你能够拯救的人。 [pc.dcb |总得有人来做这件事。 |不客气。 |当然可以！ ]你歪了歪头……但那么，裂谷地区的那些部落呢？” 长叹一声：“那同样让人非常苦恼。由于与‘幽灵奴隶’的战争十分紧迫，我们已经很少飞越裂谷地区了。不过，当裂谷地区的那些部落内部出现了分裂——比如阿瓦奈族族、希奥卡纳、约顿约顿巨人以及海豹精族之间就是否应该继续与我们贸易还是与我们交战产生了分歧时，我们还是得到了一些预警的。我们很早就得知了这件事，因此有机会与那些联合起来对抗精灵、卢米安人以及我们自己的盟友的势力进行谈判……但谈判进展得很不顺利，所以我们尽了自己所能来保护我们的朋友，随后进一步撤退，试图让这个“裂隙联盟”的怒火平息一些，而我们则转而去对付另一个真正的敌人。通缉中为了战斗。所以我们根本没有注意到那些恶魔的任何踪迹，直到有人——我猜是你——炸毁了他们的补给仓库。” 你不禁露出一个狡黠的微笑。[pc.isBimbo |嘿嘿嘿，也许吧。 |确实如指控的那样有罪。 ]太精彩了。”她语气中的赞许之情显而易见。“干得漂亮。我们本来只能派出少数战士，但当我们在残骸中发现那些恶魔后，就立刻对他们发起了攻击。不过我们没有多余的兵力用于侦察，所以当你摧毁那个洞穴时，我们仍然距离你的行踪有很远的距离。真是差一点就错过了……”她的眼中燃烧着炽热的愤怒。“再次感谢你。需要我们必须将他们全部消灭。但目前，我们正与那些“幽灵奴仆”陷入激烈的战斗中；如果从主战场抽调太多战士，这些恶魔就不会成为边境地区面临的唯一威胁了。 这并不意味着我们在忽视他们。我追踪到了一些试图返回你们摧毁过的海底藏身处的人群。那些从那里逃出来的海豹精中，有些甚至已经忘记了自己的名字。有个我小时候还抱在怀里的成年女性，她看着我的眼神，就像从来没见过我一样。那些与他们在一起的恶魔……嗯，我们做了我们必须做的事情。 你和她一起感同身受地叹了口气，但随后又回想起自己在海底的旅程：“我以为我们已经确保那些海豹精能够逃脱了。这其中的意义远不止表面看上去的那么简单。 [pc.isDK |恼火 |担心 ]我们认为，他们中的大多数人都回来了。我们知道他们已经进入了冰封的海域，也有很多人都成功回到了家乡。但是，就连那些对我们友好的海妖们，也没有统计出所有返回的人的数量，更不用说裂隙联盟的成员了。那些回到废墟中试图寻找什么的人，肯定也遇到了一些落单者。至少我们发现的那些落单者还没有被转化。至少现在还没有。 在最后一个词之后，一阵刺骨的寒意笼罩了四周，而这寒意并非仅仅来自天气。 过了一会儿，这位女武神继续她的故事：“我们确实消灭了其中一些恶魔，但我知道还有其他的恶魔在逃往不知何处的途中，消失在了那些被怨灵笼罩的区域里。也许是在南方吧。[var0| 我敢打赌，因为多亏了你，它们再也不会在达拉西亚地区安营了。]她望着霍恩峰山脉的方向。“要再次找到他们，就得等到我们解决了北方的这个麻烦之后。
rows.raw: ' "We very badly want to help." A hard edge cuts into the valkyrie's normally singsongy voice. "The demon [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS|and the Wraith she unleashed were|was] bad enough. In [party.has etheryn |your mother's day, Etheryn |Queen Alraince's day ], valkyries were a welcome sight at the palace, and many of the Winter City's best warriors joined our ranks. But Alissa said that what made the Order stronger weakened the crown. When she became queen, she only let warriors she'd fallen out with join our Order while keeping others for herself, and she barred us from the palace, only allowing sisters into the city to visit family or attend festivals." [pc.dcb |"And you just let that happen?" |"How did she manage to get away with something like that?" |You pout. "Stupid meanie[silly | blueberry cunt ]. How come you said yes to that?" ] "We're not in the habit of unseating a ruler purely because she doesn't worship in the way we do and because she wanted to place some breathing space between the crown and the Order," Annika says wearily. "That's all it seemed like she was doing. And we all thought that a strong crown would be a fine thing, if it continued to help us fight the Wraithslaves. But as a result, we didn't know what Alissa was truly up to in the palace, and we didn't find out she had abandoned Lumia to consort with a monster until the rest of the city did. "I don't know how we would've been able to know. But even if we couldn't have been there, we should have been there." A shadow haunts her ice-eyes for several moments until she closes them and banishes it back to the realm of doubt and guilt. "Thank you for saving those you could." [pc.dcb |"Someone had to. |"You're very welcome. |"Sure thing! ]" You cock your head. "But then, what about the Cult here in the Rift?" A long sigh: "That hurts almost as badly. We rarely fly over the Rift anymore, with the war against the Wraithslaves so pressing, but we still had a little warning when some of the Rift people had their own schism, with tribes of avanai, siorcanna, jotuns, and selkies split down the middle about whether to keep trading with us or fight us. We heard about it early enough to negotiate with the people who formed an alliance against elves, Lumians, and our own allies... but that went poorly, so we did what we could to keep our friends safe and otherwise withdrew even further, trying to give this Rift Alliance's rage time to cool while we dealt instead with an enemy that we actually wanted to fight. So we missed every sign of the demons until someone — I'm guessing it was you — blew up their supply dump." You can't help but flash a coy smile. "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee hee. Maaaaybe. |Guilty as charged. ]" "It was spectacular." The approval in her voice is as clear as a bell. "Well done. We could only spare a few warriors, but once we investigated the wreckage and found that the demons were there, we attacked their groups on sight. But we had little to spare for scouting, so when you destroyed that cavern we were still a long way away from your trail. A day late and a hawk short. Again." Her eyes burn with white-hot Lumian fury. "We need to hunt down every last one of them. But right now, we're locked in a death-grip with the Wraithslaves, and if we take too many warriors away from the main front, these demons won't be the only problem the Marches have. "That doesn't mean we're ignoring them. I tracked some groups trying to return to the underwater hideout you destroyed. Some of the selkies that escaped from down there... they didn't even know their own names anymore. A grown woman I knew when she was small enough for me to hold her in my arms stared at me like she'd never seen me in her life. The demons that were with them... well. We did what we had to do." You share a moment of commiseration with her, but then think back on your journey beneath the waves: "I thought we made sure that they — the selkies — could get out." There's more than a little [pc.isDK |irritation |worry ] in your voice. "Most of them did, we think. We know that they made their way into the frozen sea and that many have come home. But even the selkies who're friendly to us haven't counted out everybody who's returned, to say nothing of the Rift Alliance folk. The cultists that went back to try to find something amid the wreckage must've gotten some stragglers. At least the stragglers we did find hadn't been transformed. Yet." Bleak cold worms into the pause that follows that last word, and it's not just from the weather. After a few moments, the valkyrie picks up her tale again: "So we dealt with a few of those demons, but I know some others were able to disappear into Wraith-thick territory on their way to gods know where. South, maybe.[var0| That'd be my bet, since they don't lair on Dracia anymore, thanks to you.]" She gazes off in the general direction of the Hornpeak Mountains. "Finding them again will have to wait until after we've dealt with this problem in the north." '

rows.original: [var0 |"I remember Daliza talking about how tough a fight the Wraith-touched were." You grimace before continuing: "Then they showed that in person on our way to Dracia. They're who you're fighting?" "Exactly," Annika says grimly. |"So, these Wraith-touched. [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |I've seen them, but I don't really know much about them. What are they like? |What exactly are they? ]" "A different, older kind of corruption than your new demons. Wraith-touched are tainted, often hollowed-out servants of the Void; even those poor souls that don't become the Wraiths' thralls after being touched by their power still end up twisted and driven mad." Annika's brows knit together grimly. ] "They never fully went away, even after the Godswar. They're why our Keep was placed here, as a bulwark to protect Njorhaalt and the Rift from the monsters and thralls massing in the east. Many of the thralls are recognizable as something that was once... normal. A minotaur, an elf, a lupine, a troll. Others, though, not so much. Horrific spiny-backed three-legged monsters, masses of misshapen clawed tentacles, waddling horrors that seem to consist solely of legs and teeth.[silly | You know: the kinds of things that remain relatively niche porn interests. Do you know how little tentacle content exists in this game right now? Nobody seems to want to write it, my own author least of all. But anyway. Wraith-touched. ] "Some Wraith-touched beings aren't... as violent or predatory as the others. They're simply lost souls — and yes, those particular ones do have souls; even if they don't always play well with others during their mating season, they're intelligent and have a mind of their own, and they can mostly live in a sort of peace with everybody else who lives here. But they're a very small minority. The ones who can't mostly live in peace with the rest of us are the ones we worry about. In place of a soul, they seem to share a will, something that animates them and compels them to attack the living." Her eyes defocus and drift off somewhere into the snowy distance. "It's an open question whether that 'will' belongs to a hidden living Wraith or a dead one. Even a dead god can still dream, no? At any rate, even in the best times, the Wraithslaves would always muster their forces to attack the living. Now it's worse. Now there are more of them every day, and over the last few decades we've had to throw nearly all of our sisters against the monsters here in the north." "[pc.dcb |What, are you too weak to destroy them? |What's keeping you from destroying them? |How come you haven't been able to win yet? ]" [party.has azyrran |Your Hive Knight companion coughs. "[azyrran.kdb |Hey, don't count them out. These are the warriors of Lumian legend, some of the best fighters on the planet. They know more about tactics than anyone else, and they can flatten enemies in a straight-up fight, too." |Take it from me, [pc.name] — nobody outfights valkyries. I was brought up on their legends. If there's a tactic to try or a way to outmuscle the foe, they've used it already." |Hey, wait a second! Lumian valkies are, like, the absolute bestest fighters in aaaaall of the stories. They probably did all the things that anyone could!" ] ] The valkyrie pats [party.has azyrran |Azzy on the shoulder. "Thank you, sweetie... although I'd say that Hive Knights don't yield much to valkyries in terms of war! Yes |her trusty sunspear. "Oh ], we've pulled out all the stops. [silly |Literal f |F ]lying columns, extermination expeditions, you name it. We've won enough battles against these monsters to fill a dozen scrolls. We don't win every battle against them, but we win most of them, so the problem isn't the fighting, exactly. The problem is holding ground. There aren't enough people yet to resettle the cities, rebuild the defenses, and make our victories permanent. So we kill what we can and then the Wraiths' slaves slowly return. With their growth in power of late, they reoccupy the ruined places that they've taken faster and faster. "We still mostly win our battles... but we can't just 'win.' We have to annihilate them. And unless we can hold our mothers' homes, annihilating them isn't in the cards. So at this point, we hold the line as best we can and launch preemptive strikes and raids to keep them off balance. But there are just too many of them. They're starting to leak through our defenses."
rows.translation: [var0 |我记得达莉莎说过，那些被‘幽灵’影响的人是多么难对付。”你皱了皱眉头，继续说道：“在我们去达拉西亚的路上，他们确实证明了这一点。你们现在正在与他们战斗，对吧？” “没错，”安妮卡面带阴沉地说。 |所以，这些被怨灵影响的人[flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |我见过它们，但对它们其实了解不多。它们到底是什么样的呢？ |它们到底是什么呢？ ]这种腐败与你们新出现的恶魔截然不同，也是一种更为古老、更为邪恶的形式。那些被‘幽灵之力’侵蚀的人，往往会沦为虚无的傀儡；即使那些没有完全沦为幽灵奴仆的人，也会被这种力量扭曲心灵，最终陷入疯狂。”安妮卡紧锁着眉头，语气中充满了沉重与忧虑。 ]即使在神战之后，那些怪物也从未真正消失。正是由于它们的存在，我们的要塞才被建在这里——作为一道屏障，保护Njorhaalt和裂谷地区免受东部聚集的怪物和奴仆的侵袭。许多这些奴仆，其实曾经也是……普通的生物。比如弥诺陶洛斯、精灵、狼族、巨魔……但还有些，就很难辨认了。那些可怕的、长满尖刺的三足怪物，那些由畸形的爪子和触手构成的怪物，还有那些看起来只由腿和牙齿组成的、摇摇摆摆的恐怖生物[silly | 你知道的，就是那些属于小众色情内容的题材。你知道现在这个游戏里关于触手相关的内容有多少吗？似乎没人愿意去创作这类内容，尤其是我的作者。不过，不管怎样……被怨灵影响的内容，还是挺有意思的。 ] 有些被怨灵影响的存在，并不像其他那些生物一样暴力或富有掠夺性。它们只不过是一些迷失了方向的灵魂罢了——没错，那些特定的个体确实有灵魂；虽然在交配季节时它们并不总是能与其他生物和睦相处，但它们确实很聪明，也有自己的思想，而且大多数情况下，它们能够与这里的其他生物和平共处。不过，这样的生物数量非常少。那些无法与我们其他人和平共处的人，才是我们真正需要担忧的对象。他们似乎没有自己的灵魂，而是拥有某种共同的意志，这种意志驱使他们行动，迫使他们去攻击活生生的人类。”她的目光渐渐变得茫远，仿佛投向了那片被雪覆盖的远方。那个‘意志’究竟属于某个隐藏在黑暗中的活着的幽灵，还是属于一个已经死去的幽灵，目前仍然是个未解之谜。即便是死去的神明，也依然会做梦，不是吗？无论如何，即使在最平静的时期，那些被幽灵控制的奴隶们也总会集结力量去攻击那些活着的生物。现在情况更糟了。每天出现的怪物数量都在增加，而在过去的几十年里，我们几乎不得不让所有的姐妹们都来对抗北方这些怪物。[pc.dcb |什么，你连消灭它们都做不到吗？ |是什么阻碍了你摧毁它们呢？ |你怎么到现在还没能赢呢？ ]" [party.has azyrran |你的蜂巢骑士同伴咳嗽了一声。[azyrran.kdb |嘿，别小看他们。这些可是卢米安传说中的勇士，是这个星球上最出色的战士们。他们在战术运用方面比任何人都精通，而且在正面交锋中也能将敌人彻底击败。 |相信我吧。 [pc.name] — 没有人与女武神们交战……我是听着关于她们的传说长大的。如果有什么战术可以尝试，或者有什么办法能够凭借体力优势战胜敌人，她们肯定早就用过了。 |嘿，等一下！ 卢米娅n Valkies绝对是所有故事中最强大的战士了。他们肯定完成了所有别人能够完成的任务！ ] ] 女武神轻拍着[party.has azyrran |阿齐轻拍着我的肩膀说：“谢谢你，亲爱的……不过我得说，在战争方面，蜂群骑士其实并不比女武神差多少呢！ |她那可靠的太阳之矛。“哦 ]我们已经竭尽全力了。 [silly |真是太离谱了。 |F ]埋伏袭击、歼灭行动，各种各样的战斗方式我们都用过了。我们与这些怪物进行的战斗多到足以写满十几卷卷轴。虽然并非每场战斗都能获胜，但绝大多数情况下我们都是赢家，所以问题其实并不在于战斗本身。问题在于我们目前的力量还不够。还没有足够的人手来重新安置城市居民、重建防御设施，从而让我们的胜利变得持久。所以我们只能尽可能地消灭敌人，然而那些被幽魂控制的奴隶们却会慢慢重新回来。由于他们最近实力不断增强，他们重新占领那些被他们占领过的废墟的速度也越来越快了。 我们仍然在大多数战斗中取得胜利……但仅仅‘获胜’是不够的。我们必须彻底消灭他们。除非我们能够守住母亲的家园，否则消灭他们是根本不可能的。所以目前，我们正在尽最大努力坚守防线，并发动先发制人的攻击和突袭，以扰乱他们的部署。但是他们的数量实在太多了，他们已经开始突破我们的防御防线了。

If there's a tactic to try or a way to outmuscle the foe, they've used it already." |Hey, wait a second! Lumian valkies are, like, the absolute bestest fighters in aaaaall of the stories. They probably did all the things that anyone could!" ] ] The valkyrie pats [party.has azyrran |Azzy on the shoulder. "Thank you, sweetie... although I'd say that Hive Knights don't yield much to valkyries in terms of war! Yes |her trusty sunspear. "Oh ], we've pulled out all the stops. [silly |Literal f |F ]lying columns, extermination expeditions, you name it. We've won enough battles against these monsters to fill a dozen scrolls. We don't win every battle against them, but we win most of them, so the problem isn't the fighting, exactly. The problem is holding ground. There aren't enough people yet to resettle the cities, rebuild the defenses, and make our victories permanent. So we kill what we can and then the Wraiths' slaves slowly return. With their growth in power of late, they reoccupy the ruined places that they've taken faster and faster. "We still mostly win our battles... but we can't just 'win.' We have to annihilate them. And unless we can hold our mothers' homes, annihilating them isn't in the cards. So at this point, we hold the line as best we can and launch preemptive strikes and raids to keep them off balance. But there are just too many of them. They're starting to leak through our defenses." "

rows.original: "Few of our sisters now walk the Keep's halls," Annika admits. "This isn't by choice. Normally, it's our home, but with the greater pressure coming from our foes in the east, more and more of us have moved into war camps guarding the passes through the mountains. That's where we need to be in order to keep the monsters from debouching through the mountain passes into the Rift itself or, goddess forbid, the lands to the south. As a result, halls that once echoed with infants' cries, holy hymns, and proud warriors' tales are now nearly empty. "But there are other reasons we avoid the Keep. There's a... presence there. Maybe a geas. It makes those who walk the Keep's halls angry, combative, frustrated, preying on their minds and consuming their thoughts." "Have you tried —" The valkyrie holds up a hand. "Whatever you're about to ask: yes. We have. It's not corporeal, so we can't kill it with a blade or a spell. It's not even a ghost or spirit; we know how to handle those, too. There's no form, physical or otherwise, on this plane at all. It might be a Nightmare, like the one that turned the Khushkan warriors into a ravenous horde a few decades back. It might be a Wraith or part of one. Or it could be some other monster we've never encountered before. Whatever the case, the only one of us who can fight it is Lumia herself. And until she destroys it, every warrior in the Order is committed to a holding action against the Wraithslaves... against the physical enemy that we can fight. Better that than staying in the Keep to argue with each other while the world falls to pieces." [var0 |[pc.dcb |"I don't remember that being a problem with the cleansing of the druid temple," you point out sourly. "They rate, huh?" |"That does sound rough," you admit. "Still, things can't be that bad. You were able to help with the druid fungus, weren't you?" |"Oh no! That does sound bad." You frown. "It could be worse! What if you hadn't been able to help with the, um, sporey fungy thingies in that old temple we found?" ] "All we could spare was three maidens for a relatively short task — all the shorter thanks to your good work, no less, and I thank you for it. For what it is worth, now that we're aware of the demons and cultists, we have those three now searching the lands around Hawkethorne and Khor'minos for demons and all manner of other dangerous creatures. I imagine, though, that you'd appreciate the balance of our strength all the more. Right now, we are hard pressed. If we [silly |economize on force any more |shortchange the war against the Wraiths any more ], we will start losing more and more ground, and if we lose enough of it, this whole part of the world and the people who live here get screwed[silly |, and not in the fun way ]." She gazes at you bleakly. "And yes, I know all too well that the demons are the same kind of problem." |[flags.WC_BALL |[pc.isBimbo |"Oooh! I remember how Ellywelly was super tired of ranking valkyries or something at the big winter party." Frowning, you try to place the word: "Rankling? Wrangling! That. Is that what that was?" |"Ah," you muse. "So that's what Elthara meant when she talked about 'wrangling valkyries' at the midwinter ball." ] "Yes. Our visit was supposed to be a little show of confidence in our people's new leadership and a signal of approval for [party.has etheryn |your bringing the druids' descendants back into the fold, Ryn |the new [etheryn.crowned |queen's |regent's ] bringing the druids' descendants back into the fold ]. After all the druids did to sun-worshipers, it was a lot to ask, but many of my sisters felt that we needed to join in the ceremony for the unity of our people." Another sigh. "From what I hear, the party was lovely, but behind the scenes, the members of our Order argued bitterly over the most minor things. Elthara must have had the patience of the Dawn Maiden herself to have dealt with them." [pc.dcb |"Shit," you laugh, "if you can't even enjoy a party, you must feel pretty fucked, huh? |Sympathetically, you observe, "If they couldn't even enjoy a party, things must feel grim. |"Oh no." That sounds awful! "Not being able to even enjoy a party? That's, like, one of the saddest things. ]" For the first time, Annika's voice gets downright bleak. "You're not wrong." ] ]
rows.translation: 现在，我们姐妹中已经很少有人还在城堡的走廊里走动了，”安妮卡承认道，“这并不是我们自己的选择。通常来说，这里应该是我们的家，但由于东边敌人带来的压力越来越大，越来越多的姐妹们不得不搬去驻扎在山间要道旁的军营里，参与守卫工作。我们必须驻扎在那里，才能阻止那些怪物从山隘中冲出来，进入裂谷本身，或者——但愿女神不会允许这种事情发生——进入南方的土地。因此，那些曾经回荡着婴儿的啼哭声、神圣的颂歌以及勇士们豪迈的故事的厅堂，如今已经几乎空无一人了。 但我们避开那座城堡，还有其他原因。那里有一种……存在。或许是一种禁锢力量。它会让那些走进城堡大厅的人变得愤怒、好斗、沮丧，这种力量会侵蚀他们的思想，占据他们的思绪。” “你试过…… 女武神举起一只手：“无论你接下来要问什么：我们都有答案。但它并没有实体形态，所以我们无法用刀刃或法术来杀死它。它甚至既不是鬼魂也不是灵体；对于这类存在，我们也知道该如何应对。在这个维度里，它根本没有任何形式，无论是物理形态还是其他形式的。这可能是一场噩梦，就像几十年前将库什坎战士们变成了一群嗜血狂徒的那样。也可能是一个幽灵，或者幽灵的一部分。又或者，这是某种我们从未遇到过的怪物。无论如何，我们当中唯一能够与它战斗的人，就是卢米娅本人。直到她摧毁它之前，骑士团中的每一位战士都会继续采取牵制行动，来对抗那些被邪灵控制的奴隶……也就是那些我们面临的真正敌人。可以战斗吧。总比待在城堡里互相争吵，而让世界陷入毁灭要好。 [var0 |[pc.dcb |我不记得这在净化德鲁伊神庙的过程中是个问题啊，”你酸溜溜地说道，“他们居然还给这事儿打分，是吧？ |听起来确实挺糟糕的，”你承认道，“不过事情应该不会那么糟吧？你总该能帮忙解决那些德鲁伊真菌的问题吧？ |哦不！那听起来确实很糟糕。”你皱起了眉头，“情况本可能更糟！要是你当时没能帮我们解决在那个古老寺庙里遇到的那些孢子菌类问题，会怎么样呢？ ] 我们所能抽调出来的，只有三名少女去执行这项相对简单的任务——而这项任务之所以会变得如此简单，很大程度上要归功于你们的出色表现，对此我表示感谢。既然我们现在已经了解了那些恶魔和邪教徒的存在，那么这三名少女目前正在鹰棘镇和科尔米诺斯周边地区搜寻恶魔以及各种其他危险生物。不过，我想你们应该会更理解我们目前的力量分配情况吧。目前，我们的处境确实十分紧张。如果[silly |不要再在兵力上节省了。 |再也不能在对抗那些幽灵的战斗中偷工减料了。 ]那样，我们就会逐渐失去更多的优势，而如果失去的太多，那么整个地区以及生活在这里的人民就会陷入困境。[silly |，而且这种感觉一点也不有趣。 ]她黯淡地注视着你，说道：“没错，我太清楚了——那些恶魔其实就是同样的问题根源。 |[flags.WC_BALL |[pc.isBimbo |哦哦！我记得在那个盛大的冬季派对上，艾莉薇莉是多么讨厌去给那些女武神们排名之类的任务啊。”你皱着眉头，努力回想那个词应该叫什么：“是‘排名’吗？还是‘整理名单’？到底应该用什么词来形容呢？ |啊，”你若有所思地说道，“原来这就是艾尔萨拉在冬至舞会上提到‘驯服女武神’时所指的意思。 ] 是的。我们的访问本来就是为了表达对我们人民新领导力的信任，同时也是对他们的认可的一种象征。 [party.has etheryn |你正在将德鲁伊的后代们重新纳入这个大家庭之中，小琳。 |新的[etheryn.crowned |女王的 |摄政王的 ]让德鲁伊的后代重新回归这个大家庭之中 ]考虑到德鲁伊们对那些崇拜太阳的神明们所做的一切，要求我们参加这场仪式确实有些过分。但我的许多姐妹们都认为，为了我们民族的团结，我们必须参与其中。”她又叹了口气，“据我所知，这场庆典进行得很愉快，但在幕后，我们教派的成员们却为一些鸡毛蒜皮的事情争论得不可开交。艾尔萨拉一定拥有黎明少女那样的耐心，才能应对他们。 [pc.dcb |靠，”你笑着说，“如果连参加派对都享受不起来，那你肯定觉得糟透了吧？ |你同情地观察到：“如果他们连一场派对都享受不了，情况肯定很糟糕。 |哦不，”那听起来太糟糕了。“连参加派对的乐趣都无法享受，这真的是最让人难过的的事情之一了。 ]这是安妮卡第一次用如此沮丧的语气说道：“你没有错。 ] ]

rows.original: From what she's said, something's going wrong at Lumia's Keep.
rows.translation: 从她的话来看，卢米娅的据点里似乎出了什么问题。
rows.raw: "From what she's said, something's going wrong at Lumia's Keep."

rows.original: "Our goddess is doing what she always does." No small amount of reverence seeps into Annika's voice. "She leads our warriors in battle, protects the helpless, and tends to the needs of a continent of worshipers, all while struggling to hold back whatever thing is trying to lair within the Keep. And like us, whenever she does draw her blade, she wins[flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS| — most recently against the Wraith that that demon let into this world]. "But the fighting is taking a toll. Whatever is inside the Keep is consuming most of her attention now. She still has all her powers; prayers are answered, miracles occur, and as far as most ordinary folk are concerned, there's little difference between a prayer Lumia answers now and one she answered a hundred years ago. Most of my sisters can't see what it does to her. But for our goddess personally... she's become withdrawn, exhausted. She rarely has the time to spare to help guide new warmaidens. Every struggle against whatever lies within the Keep only makes sure it stays contained, not defeated, and every time she needs to go into seclusion to rest and recuperate. In fact, she's doing that now. Our goddess is somewhere in the Rift in absolute secret, hidden from most of the other sisters of the Order." [pc.dcb |"Okay, yeah," you admit, "as much shit as I talk, something that's giving a goddess trouble is actually pretty serious." |"Something that can give even a goddess a run for her money is suddenly much, much scarier." |"Uh oh." ] "[pc.swornGod nareva |Your other Astrida sisters |The Astrida ] weren't sure how to handle it, either." The valkyrie grits her teeth before continuing. "Among the Seven, Lumia is the greatest warrior; even Tira would struggle against a foe like this.[party.has arona |" Arona chuckles. "Damn straight she is. Queen of fuckin' shit up! You ask me, she doesn't really need our help. Just a rough patch, y'know?" A nod of acknowledgment, a smile: "Maybe so. ] If anyone can best it, our goddess can. Everything that my sisters and I are doing right now is fighting a delaying action for her."
rows.translation: “我们的女神一直在做她一贯做的事。”安妮卡的声音里渗进浓浓的敬意。“她率领我们的战士冲锋陷阵，庇护无助之人，照料着一整块大陆信徒的需求，同时还要竭力压制那个正试图在城堡里筑巢的东西。和我们一样，每当她拔出剑来，她都会获胜[flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS| ——最近一次，是对付那个恶魔放进这个世界的幽魂]。 “但这场战斗正在消耗她。如今城堡里的那个东西占去了她大部分心神。她的力量依然完好；祈祷得到回应，奇迹照常发生，在大多数普通人看来，卢米娅现在回应的祈祷和她一百年前回应的祈祷没什么两样。我的大多数姐妹都看不出这对她造成了什么影响。但就我们的女神本人而言……她变得沉默寡言、精疲力竭。她很少还有余暇去引导新加入的女战士。每一次与城堡里那个东西的较量，都只能让它被压制住，而非被击败，而每一次她都需要闭关休养、恢复元气。事实上，她现在就在这么做。我们的女神正秘密地待在裂谷的某处，对教团中大多数姐妹都隐瞒了行踪。” [pc.dcb |“好吧，确实，”你承认道，“我嘴上再不饶人，但能让一位女神头疼的东西，确实相当严重。” |“能让一位女神都吃不消的东西，一下子就变得可怕得多、多得多了。” |“哦不。” ] “[pc.swornGod nareva |你其他的阿斯特里达姐妹们 |阿斯特里达 ]也不知道该如何应对。”这位女武神咬紧牙关，继续说道。“在七神之中，卢米娅是最伟大的战士；即便是蒂拉，面对这样的敌人也会苦战。[party.has arona |“ 阿罗娜咯咯笑道。“她说得一点没错。简直是搞砸一切的女王！要我说，她其实并不需要我们的帮助。只是遇到了一道难关，你懂的。” 她点头会意，微微一笑：“也许吧。 ]如果有人能战胜它，那我们的女神一定能。我和姐妹们现在所做的一切，都是在为她拖延时间。”

rows.original: And the Dawn Maiden herself has been doing what exactly?
rows.translation: 那么，黎明少女自己究竟一直在做些什么呢？
rows.raw: "And the Dawn Maiden herself has been doing what exactly?"

rows.original: Annika's eyes harden again. "We will fight until we're all used up. That's not an outcome we fear. But the cost has long since gotten too high — not just for us, but for everybody else. What we really need to do is change the battlefield... which is the reason I'm so glad I found you. "I don't think assistance on the front lines against the Wraiths' spawn would help very much. What I would like you to do instead is seek out Lumia herself. She might be able to explain things to you better than I could... and if you'd be going to the Keep to help her solve the problems that lie within, you'll need her personal intervention to pass through the wards that protect it. I'd rather not test if you can avoid being immolated by the divine power of the sun." [pc.dcb |"Of course," you grouse. "Go here, talk to this person, go there, [silly |yada yada yada |so on and so forth ], and eventually it comes to the part where I have to fix everything anyway." "You don't have to do anything," Annika says patiently. "I'm simply asking you, if you have any interest in helping to resolve this, to visit Lumia. That's all. And if you do have any interest, this is how you'd go about it. |You smile ruefully. "It's a shame she doesn't let you and your sisters give out the key to her place yourselves. Understandable, but a shame." "I think she wouldn't mind under most circumstances. House parties are fun. But guests getting attacked by a horrific eldritch intelligence would put a damper on the festivities." Wry as it is, Annika's grin matches your own. "So you'll have to get permission to drop by first. |"Wait, so I get to visit the sun mommy in charge of all the other sun mommies?" you gasp. "If you're interested," Annika says. Then she winks. "It sounds to me like you might be interested. ] "Lumia's like the other Six, a living goddess with a presence in the world; she can hear the petitions of those who pray to her, and see through the eyes of servants like myself, but I already mentioned how sometimes, after particularly serious battles, she needs to go into seclusion and shut herself off from much of the outside. She's doing that right now at a place elsewhere in the Rift. If you want to speak to her, you'll have to do so in person. That's tricky, because she doesn't let just anyone drop by — there are powerful magics that prevent almost anyone from knowing where she is. But I can show you how to find her." [pc.dcbc |You [pc.breastRange E |[silly |hoist your tits aggressively |put your hands on your hips ] |fold your arms ] and frown. "And how's that? Were you going to keep me in suspense?" |"I guess it's lucky I found you up here, then," you say amiably. "What's the trick?" |"Oooh! That's a relief. It's a good thing we met, huh? Do you know the special trick or something? Is it a hand motion? Oooh! Or a dance?" |"That's very impressive. In fact," you say knowingly, "it doesn't even sound like something every valkyrie can do." "I've been in Lumia's service for a long time." She shrugs, but her smile conveys plenty of pride. "I guess she's happy with the way I do things." "No small thing, to be beloved of the gods. So: what's the trick?" ] "There's no real trick to it.[pc.isBimbo | And a dance would be fun, but we don't do that either. ] I just have to do something to let you in. So... if you've spent much time around the cliff's edge, you've probably noticed some crevasses leading back into the snow and the permafrost. Count off the third to the west from the path to the Keep and follow that route back inland." "Would you just be waiting there for [party.hasCompanions |us |me ] to get there?" rows.original: "Okay!" Annika blows out a breath, equal parts tired and relieved. "Okay. I'm glad I was able to get in touch with you. Like I said, whenever you're ready, I'll be around. Until then, I'll keep dealing with any Wraith-touched that sneak through the mountains. And if I come across any of those cultists that might've gotten knocked loose from the main group thanks to your big scrap earlier, well, I'll deal with them too. There might be two or three of my other sisters that I can round up to help as well. I wish I could do more to help against the cult, but... well, there's only one way to get the rest of the Order off the front line." [pc.dcbc |"Yeah, yeah." You can't resist the opportunity for an extravagant, edgy, world-weary eye-roll. "Solve someone else's problem, then get help. Shit, I need to get paid up front one of these days." |"It's a little disappointing," you admit, "but I understand. Besides, [party.hasCompanions |we |I ]'ve gotten this far on our own! [party.hasCompanions |We |I ] can handle it a little longer." |"That's okay! I just love helping anyway," you giggle. "[party.hasCompanions |We're |I'm ] gonna do [party.hasCompanions |our |my ] best!" |"Hey, it's cool. These things happen. Just be aware, if you're hunting Tollus and his goons, you'll probably smell 'em before you see 'em. It's nice — means they really suck at hiding." You wrinkle your nose. "I mean, the smell isn't nice, but you get what I mean." ] [var0 |"Thanks for the tip," she laughs. |"Thank you," she says gratefully. ] "Again, I am sorry. If it makes anything better, I know that once we sort all this mess out, I'll have more help to bring you. Call it —" and here she offers her classic reassuring smile "— warrior's intuition." [pc.dcb |Partially mollified, you say, "Fine. I suppose I'll take an IOU." |"Hey." You favor Annika with a lopsided grin. "I'll take it." |"Even better!" you cheer. "Gosh, you're so sweet." ] "[pc.isBimbo |Aw, thank you |Great ]! Also, before you go, take some more of this food! You look like you [var1 |could use a resupply |need it more than I do ]. Never travel the Rift on an empty stomach!" Several minutes later, with a few fresh helpings of trail rations in your pack, [party.yall] trek back over the snowy rise toward further adventures in the glacial wastes. Annika soars overhead, still glowing with the sun's light, then hovers in the air two dozen feet above you to offer a shieldmaiden's salute. "Lumia's love and strength be with you[party.som |, Champion | both | all ]! And until we see each other again... be careful out there!" Then she flies off again into the wintry haze.
rows.translation: 好吧！”安妮卡长叹一口气，既疲惫又如释重负。“好吧，我很高兴能够联系到你。就像我之前说的，只要你准备好了，我就会一直在你身边。在那之前，我会继续处理那些从山区悄悄溜过来的、被‘怨灵’影响的人。如果我遇到了那些因为你们之前的那场激烈冲突而从主队伍中分离出来的狂热信徒，那么我也会对付他们。或许我还能召集两三个我的姐妹来帮忙。我真希望能为对抗那个邪教组织做出更多贡献，但是……嗯，要想让其他成员脱离前线，只有一种办法。 [pc.dcbc |是啊，是啊。”你实在忍不住要翻一个夸张的、充满厌世情绪的白眼。“先帮别人解决问题，然后再来寻求帮助。该死，我什么时候也能预支工资啊。 |有点令人失望，”你承认道，“但我能理解。不过， [party.hasCompanions |我们 |我 ]我们完全是靠自己的努力才走到这一步的！ [party.hasCompanions |我们 |我 ]还能再坚持一会儿。 |没关系！我本来就喜欢帮忙的，”你笑着说。[party.hasCompanions |我们正在…… |我是 ]打算去做[party.hasCompanions |我们的 |我的 ]太棒了！ |嘿，这也没什么。这种事情难免会发生。不过要注意，如果你在追捕托勒斯和他的手下们，你很可能会在看到他们之前就闻到他们的气味。这说明他们真的很不擅长隐藏自己。”你皱了皱鼻子，“我的意思是，他们气味虽然不是很好，但你应该明白我的意思。 ] [var0 |谢谢你的建议，”她笑着说。 |谢谢你们，”她满怀感激地说道。 ]再一次，我是抱歉。如果这能让你好受一些的话，我知道等我们把这一切都解决掉之后，我就能为你带来更多的帮助。就把它叫做——“战士的直觉”吧。说着，她露出了那标志性的、让人感到安心的微笑。 [pc.dcb |你稍微缓和了语气，说道：“好吧，我想我只能接受一张欠条了。 |嘿。”你带着一丝不自然的笑容看向安妮卡，“这个我收下吧。 |太好了！”你欢呼道，“天哪，你真是太贴心了。 ] "[pc.isBimbo |啊，谢谢您。 |太棒了 ]另外，在你离开之前，再拿一些这种食物吧！你看起来好像[var1 |需要补充物资。 |我比任何人都更需要它。 ]千万不要在空腹的时候穿越裂隙地带！” 几分钟后，当你背包里装上了几份新鲜的野战口粮后， [party.yall]踏着积雪覆盖的小路，继续向着冰原荒野中的更多冒险前进。安妮卡在头顶翱翔，身上依然散发着太阳的光芒，然后停在离你二十多英尺高的空中，向你行了一个盾女式的敬礼。“愿卢米娅的爱与力量与你同在。[party.som |冠军 | 两者都 | 所有 ]那么，在我们再次相见之前……在外边一定要注意安全哦！”说完，她便再次飞入了那冬日的迷雾之中。
rows.raw: ' "Okay!" Annika blows out a breath, equal parts tired and relieved. "Okay. I'm glad I was able to get in touch with you. Like I said, whenever you're ready, I'll be around. Until then, I'll keep dealing with any Wraith-touched that sneak through the mountains. And if I come across any of those cultists that might've gotten knocked loose from the main group thanks to your big scrap earlier, well, I'll deal with them too. There might be two or three of my other sisters that I can round up to help as well. I wish I could do more to help against the cult, but... well, there's only one way to get the rest of the Order off the front line." [pc.dcbc |"Yeah, yeah." You can't resist the opportunity for an extravagant, edgy, world-weary eye-roll. "Solve someone else's problem, then get help. Shit, I need to get paid up front one of these days." |"It's a little disappointing," you admit, "but I understand. Besides, [party.hasCompanions |we |I ]'ve gotten this far on our own! [party.hasCompanions |We |I ] can handle it a little longer." |"That's okay! I just love helping anyway," you giggle. "[party.hasCompanions |We're |I'm ] gonna do [party.hasCompanions |our |my ] best!" |"Hey, it's cool. These things happen. Just be aware, if you're hunting Tollus and his goons, you'll probably smell 'em before you see 'em. It's nice — means they really suck at hiding." You wrinkle your nose. "I mean, the smell isn't nice, but you get what I mean." ] [var0 |"Thanks for the tip," she laughs. |"Thank you," she says gratefully. ] "Again, I am sorry. If it makes anything better, I know that once we sort all this mess out, I'll have more help to bring you. Call it —" and here she offers her classic reassuring smile "— warrior's intuition." [pc.dcb |Partially mollified, you say, "Fine. I suppose I'll take an IOU." |"Hey." You favor Annika with a lopsided grin. "I'll take it." |"Even better!" you cheer. "Gosh, you're so sweet." ] "[pc.isBimbo |Aw, thank you |Great ]! Also, before you go, take some more of this food! You look like you [var1 |could use a resupply |need it more than I do ]. Never travel the Rift on an empty stomach!" Several minutes later, with a few fresh helpings of trail rations in your pack, [party.yall] trek back over the snowy rise toward further adventures in the glacial wastes. Annika soars overhead, still glowing with the sun's light, then hovers in the air two dozen feet above you to offer a shieldmaiden's salute. "Lumia's love and strength be with you[party.som |, Champion | both | all ]! And until we see each other again... be careful out there!" Then she flies off again into the wintry haze. '

rows.original: As you trudge through the deep snow of the ice shelf, searching for the landmarks Annika described, you stop to get your bearings and survey the land. You can see several of the indicators she mentioned, as well as the carcasses of several Wraith-corrupted beasts, but where is she? You wipe some frost from your eyes while searching for the winged crusader, and have to double take. What you're seeing, or what you think you're seeing, can't actually be there. Can it? Slapped obnoxiously onto the empty white snowscape, where you're sure there was nothing before, is an oasis-like copse of exotic jungle trees. This can't be anything good, but the next time you blink the mysterious mini forest is closer than it was moments ago. It seems whatever it is already has a hold on you, because you can't bring yourself to turn away. Somehow you feel, despite your trepidation, that this isn't something to be missed. You begin moving consciously in that direction, waving to the armored valkyrie standing beside the grove. You can see her tending her wounds with healing magic. Each footfall seems to carry you twice as far as you expect, till you're standing at the edge of the wood after what feels like a handful of steps. You [party.som |take one last look at the glacial ice behind you |glance back at [comp1.name] to make sure they're still there |glance back at your companions to make sure they're still there ] before making yourself known. "What is this place? It can't be natural," you ask, still bewildered. "No," she replies, gently amused; Annika's singsong accent lends itself well to that. "But it's not an illusion, either... I think it's best if you experience it yourself. Lumia should still be inside. I don't know if she'll speak with you here, but at the very least it's good to be noticed. Good luck!" She takes up a post at the spot where the snow meets fresh foliage, standing alert and just shy of full military attention. "I'll be here when you return." "Ok. I'll try to find her quick, I guess," you say, working up enough courage to step over the dividing line. The second you step through the first wreath of vines, there's an instant change in temperature. Rather than the bone-chilling cold of the rift, there's a sweltering heat, thick with a humidity that makes you feel like you're swimming through the plantlife. Every tree is covered in vibrant flowers, and in fact every plant you can see is teeming with life. There's such a variety of colors that it looks surreal in the jungle haze. [pc.bgMulti hunter arcanist |In fact, half of these plants look like they don't belong in the same biome, let alone a jungle. You spot some local plants among them, but most are foreign blooms you can't even begin to identify. |In fact, you know they don't belong. Some of these plants are from the southern jungles, while others are rare desert blooms, and more still are local march plants. All of them grow impossibly from the same vine. |If they weren't right there to touch you'd think some kind of illusion was afoot. Sure enough they're completely solid, but that only makes it more fantastic. ][lyric.around | "Wow, this feels just like home!" Lyric says, popping her head out of your bag and letting it rest on the edge. ] [party.comp agnimitra arona atugia azyrran cait kiyoko quin viviane |"Wow! There are so many! It's like this place wants to welcome everybody! Makes me want to sing just looking at them all," Agni says, gingerly brushing at the flowers with her fingertips. The song should probably wait till after you've explored, but you do note the welcoming atmosphere. | You look back to see Arona fanning herself with a fern she's plucked from the ground. "Holy shit it's hot! Can we tell the goddess to turn it down a little? Wait what the fuck?" she asks, brushing herself off as the fern she picked dissolves into colorful dust.. Thanks Arona. | "Th-those plants are from Bel Carn! And those ones are from Teiglache! Some of these flowers are extinct! I've seen them in books and have some pressed samples from traders," Atugia says. She gawks at the plants, looking from place to place with abject wonder. That confirms [pc.bgMulti hunter arcanist |what you saw |what you were thinking |your suspicions about the area ], but not how all this is happening. "I wonder if, oh!" Tui plucks a flower from one of the vines, but it near instantly dissolves into a fine colorful dust when deprived of its home. Curious. | "There's something off about these plants. I don't know if it's dangerous, but it's not right," Azyrran says. Her countenance is guarded, but she still looks around with noticeable curiosity. What does she mean, off? Is it something she can spell out, or just a feeling. "Hmm, they don't smell as nice. Like something's missing," she says. Well, if they're realistic fakes, that would explain the variety... | "That flower is from Jassira! And so is that one! Some of these are really rare. I remember the temple matron being so happy when she was able to get one to grow," Cait says, touching a blossom that looks like a sunburst. "What is this place?" You don't know, but you plan to find out. | "Those are sakura blossoms, but that's definitely not the right kind of tree. Whatever magic is at work here doesn't seem to be malevolent, but I would still be careful, beloved. It seems familiar, somehow," Kiyoko says, looking around the grove with her eyes narrowed. You planned to be careful anyway, but it's good to know she feels the same way. | "Some of these plants are from Tronarii. I've been told they only grow in Tronarii. I can only assume the same is true for other plants here. No clue what's making them grow like this, though," Quin says, staring around at the nearby plants and staying close by. Whatever it is, you'll find out. | "These plants are incredibly realistic, but I think, ah!" Viv says, plucking one of the plants and gasping as it disintegrates into colorful dust. "They're like simulacrums! Just a hint of realness without the filling and substance of life. Fascinating." All the more reason to find who made it and ask them how. ] Another glance around shows that the cold expanse of the glacier is still visible behind you, and putting your hand back through exposes it to the chill once again. If this is a trap it's at least not all encompassing. Besides, you can hear running water just through the thickest set of trees. You set off in that direction, wondering if the water will somehow be as spectacular as the flowers. What you find, however, is quite a bit more than you could have imagined. Beyond the knot of wood is a pristine pool, surrounded on all sides by a treeline thick enough to block any hope of seeing through without being directly against its boughs. A waterfall pours, seemingly from nothingness, into the clear water of the pool from a distance of about eight feet. It's hard to gauge the exact height with how clear the water is, but nothing visible appears to replenish the water that falls. You hardly have time to process this before your attention is captured by the pool's sole inhabitant. Bathing in the central pool is an absolutely deific and absolutely naked figure. Though she's up to her knees in the water, you estimate her to be a good six feet and change. Her figure embodies voluptuousness, and pure white hair cascades all the way down into the pond. Skin the color of smooth milk chocolate glistens in the sunlight as she washes herself slowly and methodically. At this angle you can't see between her legs, but her thighs and ass would make the most accomplished breeder jealous. She's currently in the middle of brushing that starlight hair, running through it with a fine silver comb. The water from the sky cascades over her body in an endless shower, but somehow it's hard to comprehend her ever having been dirty in the first place. The entirety of her: hair, skin, everything, looks pristine. Not a blemish or marking in sight, let alone dirt. You're still staring, probably with a slack jaw, when she turns to face you. There's no hint of surprise on her face, but you're surprised to see that her eyes glisten like the sun itself. Both iris and pupil glow the same, but they're discernable nonetheless. Additionally, you can now see that each of her full and glorious breasts is capped by a nipple bigger than your thumb, and saucer-like areola even darker than the rest of her. [flags.LUMIA_SEEN |You've seen her before, but seeing her naked is something different entirely! |[pc.bg acolyte noblescion courtesan |She's even more stunning than the depictions of her you've seen! |Between the sunlit eyes and the woman's figure, there's no doubt this is the goddess Annika told you about. ] ] You've found [flags.LUMIA_SEEN |the goddess Lumia |[pc.bg acolyte noblescion courtesan |the goddess Lumia |[silly |Nancy's husband!? The famed adventurer from Mareth!??? |the goddess Lumia ] ] ]! "I feel you back there. You must be quite the individual to stumble past my wards by accident, or did you have a guide?" she muses. There's no anger in her voice, and in fact she turns to give you an even better view of her front with her hands on her hips and a motherly smile on her face. "Hold on, I'm just about done here." She steps one foot out of the pool and onto the jungle floor, and then in the next moment she stands before you, bedecked in her godly regalia and mostly dry. The only evidence of her bathing are the pool itself and a slight damp in her alabaster hair. All you saw was a flash of light while she was moving! She rings her hair one last time and then regards you more closely. "[flags.LUMIA_SEEN |Oh! It's you! You're the one who handled [pc.himHer]self so admirably against that horror from the beyond, |[silly |[var0 |You seem familiar... I wonder if you've knocked me up before, |[flags.HRETHA_MET |You seem familiar. It's like I've felt your presence, but not with my eyes, |You seem familiar. Like I've seen you through someone else's eyes, ] ]|You seem familiar. Like I've seen you through someone else's eyes, ] ]" she says. The goddess looks you over as if in thought, and for a second you see her wince and spin her head in the direction of her castle. She concentrates for a moment, gritting her teeth and clenching her eyes shut, before turning back to you with a little more weariness in her expression. "Sorry about that. I have some pressing matters to attend to in the keep. I had hoped to get a moment to relax, but it looks like things cannot wait," she says. It looks like she's about ready to leave you there without another thought, but then she pauses. "[flags.LUMIA_SEEN |You know... You might be just the thing I'm looking for. |It's odd, but I can't help but feel you're a capable [pc.manWoman]. ] You've done me a great service already, but If you can find the time would you please stop by the palace? It would mean the world, maybe even to more than just me." With that, she steps back, pushing off the ground and floating into the sky. As she begins to leave, the scenery starts to dissolve into dust. [party.has ryn azyrran |[party.comp ryn azyrran |[etheryn.lnhConfidence |"W-wait, p-please," Ryn begs, holding out her hand as if it would be able to reach through the air to grab the hem of the goddess' battle-skirt. Despite the quiet nature of her call, Lumia stops mid-air and turns to face her. When the nervous elf flinches, the deity's stern countenance softens to a motherly smile. "Don't fret, dear. What is it you wanted?" she asks, floating back down to the ground and getting closer. "Can... Can we really help you? Is there really anything people like us can do for a goddess?" Ryn asks in return, fidgeting and not looking her in the eyes. The sunlit lady doesn't waste a moment in taking the nervous woman in her arms, hugging her tight and brushing her hair with a thumb. "People like you are precisely who I need right now. I wouldn't have asked if I didn't mean it. If you still have doubts, you'll have to come to the palace to bring them up in person," she says, giving Ryn some reassurance before backing away. She holds the shorter woman's hands in hers for as long as she can, and then takes off into the sky when the connection is broken. |"Wait! My goddess!" Ryn shouts, reaching out for Lumia before she can get too far away. The goddess turns at her call, and your elven companion suffers from a sudden bout of nerves. "Yes, dear? What is it you need?" Lumia asks, her stern gaze melting into a motherly smile as she lowers herself to the ground and walks the short distance to your group. "I just... Are you sure it's us? Can we really help?" Ryn asks, meeting the goddess' eyes with some difficulty. Lumia lets her reach the limits of her confidence before pulling her into a squeezing hug. Etheryn grows even more tense at first, but as the sunlit lady rubs her back it all drains out of her. "Of course you can. I wouldn't have asked if I didn't know it was you I needed. If you still think you aren't worthy, then you can try to convince me at the palace," she says, giving Etheryn some reassurance before backing away. Ryn lets her go with a relieved sigh, watching her take off into the sky with a look of solid determination. |"My goddess! Are you sure it's us you need?" Ryn shouts before Lumia can get too far away. The goddess turns, and her stern gaze melts into an amused smile. "Of course I am! If, for whatever reason, you consider yourself unworthy to help me, then you'll have to come convince me in person!" she shouts back, winking at the smaller woman before she takes off into the sky. Ryn gives you a look that's rife with confidence and determination, obviously ready to do the latter if not the former. ] |[azzy.kdb |Azyrran looks after the goddess as she goes with a crimson flush to her cheeks. She turns to you after Lumia is out of earshot. "To think, there is a problem we can assist the goddess herself with. We should hurry to her aid," she says. |Azyrran watches Lumia go with a proud smile. She turns to you when the goddess is out of earshot. "A problem the war goddess can't solve on her own sounds like the challenge of a lifetime. We should rise to meet it," she says. |"W-wait, my goddess!" Azzy shouts before Lumia can get too far into the sky. The goddess stops, an eyebrow raised as she appraises the buzzy bimbo. "M-may I have a hug before you go?" The sunlit lady's stern countenance dissolves into a motherly smile in an instant. "Of course you can, dear. Come here," she says, opening her arms and returning to the ground. Azzy [silly |squees |giggles ] excitedly and jumps into a squeezing embrace. She gets her fill of reassuring attention as the goddess rubs the less chitinous portions of her back. When she's done, she lets go, and Lumia returns to the sky to resume her path back to her palace. ] ] ] [party.has Arona |Arona watches the goddess fly away with her jaw practically touching the ground. She makes sure there is a decent distance between you before turning to you with a giddy smile. "Holy shit, [pc.name]. She's thicker than any of the statues back home! Bigger tits, too... Damn, we picked the right fuckin' goddess. I almost wish I was blind like Hretha so I could 'see' that body with my hands," she says. Based on the raging boner doing its best to tear her loincloth in half, she'd like to do more than just see it. ] [party.hasAll azyrran ryn |Azzy gives you a proud smile as you turn to leave. "[azzy.kdb |I still can't believe we met the goddess in person. If she needs us so greatly, then we must help her, |It feels like a dream, meeting a true goddess. I must see her again, so that I may offer my aid personally, |Awww, she left before I could ask if I could have a hug too! We have to help her, [pc.name]! I'll ask for one the next time we meet her, ]" she says, looking off in the direction she flew. ] Rather than a sudden transition like you had when you walked into the magical grove, the transition back to cold is more gradual. The temperature lowers slowly but surely till you're left in the same freezing cold you started the trek on. [party.som |Still, you feel a little warmer than before. At the very least that citadel might be worth checking out. |[companion1.name] is still standing next to you when all is said and done. You share a look as you look in the citadel's direction. |You share a look with your companions before looking off in the direction of the citadel. ] Whatever's going on there, it can't be good if it's keeping a god occupied. You find Annika still waiting right where you left her. "So what did you talk about?" she asks, full of genuine curiosity. "[pc.dcb |There's a problem she wants my help with. |It sounds like things at the palace are grim, but she asked for my help. |It sounds like things are kinda sucky for you guys, but she asked for my help! ]" "Good," she says, breathing a sigh of relief. "I can try to meet you at the door, then." Annika flies off in the same direction, lagging slightly to give you time to follow if you so desire.
rows.translation: 当你艰难地穿过冰架上的厚厚积雪，寻找安妮卡描述过的那些地标时，你停下来确定方向，环顾四周。你看到了她提到的几处标志物，还有几只被“幽灵”侵蚀而死亡的野兽的尸体，但她到底在哪里呢？你在寻找那位有翅膀的十字军战士时，擦去眼中的霜花，却不得不重新看一眼——你所看到的，或者你以为自己看到的东西，根本不可能存在于那里，对吧？ 在原本一片空白的雪原上，突然出现了一片由异国丛林树木组成的绿洲般的小树林，而你确信之前那里什么都没有。这肯定没什么好事，但下次你眨眼的时候，那片神秘的迷你森林似乎又比刚才更近了一些。看起来，无论那是什么，它已经牢牢吸引了你的注意力，因为你根本无法移开视线。尽管心中充满忐忑，你却觉得，这次绝对不能错过这个机会。 你开始有意识地朝那个方向移动，同时向站在小树林旁的装甲女武神挥了挥手。你可以看到她正在用治愈魔法处理自己的伤口。每一步似乎都能让你前进比预期远得多的距离，就这样，短短几步之后，你就已经站在了树林的边缘。你[party.som |最后再回头看看你身后那些冰川吧。 |回顾一下[comp1.name]为了确保它们仍然在那里。 |回头看看你的同伴，确保他们还在那里。 ]在表明自己的身份之前。 “这个地方是什么？不可能是自然形成的，”你仍然困惑地问道。 “不是的，”她轻声回答，语气中带着一丝笑意；安妮卡的那种抑扬顿挫的口音非常适合表达这种感觉。“但这也不是幻觉。我觉得你亲自体验一下会更好。卢米娅应该还在里面。我不知道她会不会在这里和你说话，但至少这样能引起她的注意。祝你好运！”她站在雪地与新鲜树叶交汇的地方，保持着警惕的态度，虽然还没有达到完全军事化的戒备程度，但已经相当谨慎了。你回来的时候我会在这里。” “好的，我想我会尽快找到她的。”你说道，鼓起足够的勇气跨过了那道分界线。 就在你穿过第一丛藤蔓的那一刻，气温立刻发生了变化。与裂隙中令人不寒而栗的严寒截然不同，这里是一片酷热难耐的环境，浓重的湿气让人感觉仿佛正在植物丛中游动。每一棵树上都开满了鲜艳的花朵，实际上，你能看到的每一株植物都充满了生机。在丛林的迷雾中，这些色彩呈现出如此丰富的层次，看起来简直像是在梦幻世界中。 [pc.bgMulti rows.raw: " As you trudge through the deep snow of the ice shelf, searching for the landmarks Annika described, you stop to get your bearings and survey the land. You can see several of the indicators she mentioned, as well as the carcasses of several Wraith-corrupted beasts, but where is she? You wipe some frost from your eyes while searching for the winged crusader, and have to double take. What you're seeing, or what you think you're seeing, can't actually be there. Can it? Slapped obnoxiously onto the empty white snowscape, where you're sure there was nothing before, is an oasis-like copse of exotic jungle trees. This can't be anything good, but the next time you blink the mysterious mini forest is closer than it was moments ago. It seems whatever it is already has a hold on you, because you can't bring yourself to turn away. Somehow you feel, despite your trepidation, that this isn't something to be missed. You begin moving consciously in that direction, waving to the armored valkyrie standing beside the grove. You can see her tending her wounds with healing magic. Each footfall seems to carry you twice as far as you expect, till you're standing at the edge of the wood after what feels like a handful of steps. You [party.som |take one last look at the glacial ice behind you |glance back at [comp1.name] to make sure they're still there |glance back at your companions to make sure they're still there ] before making yourself known. "What is this place? It can't be natural," you ask, still bewildered. "No," she replies, gently amused; Annika's singsong accent lends itself well to that. "But it's not an illusion, either... I think it's best if you experience it yourself. Lumia should still be inside. I don't know if she'll speak with you here, but at the very least it's good to be noticed. Good luck!" She takes up a post at the spot where the snow meets fresh foliage, standing alert and just shy of full military attention. "I'll be here when you return." "Ok. I'll try to find her quick, I guess," you say, working up enough courage to step over the dividing line. The second you step through the first wreath of vines, there's an instant change in temperature. Rather than the bone-chilling cold of the rift, there's a sweltering heat, thick with a humidity that makes you feel like you're swimming through the plantlife. Every tree is covered in vibrant flowers, and in fact every plant you can see is teeming with life. There's such a variety of colors that it looks surreal in the jungle haze. [pc.bgMulti hunter arcanist |In fact, half of these plants look like they don't belong in the same biome, let alone a jungle.         ]
    ]

rows.translation: 一名体型魁梧、覆盖黑色毛发的弥诺陶洛斯正岌岌可危地坐在加思的一张吧凳上，四周尽是空酒杯和洒出的啤酒。你一进门便不可能忽略这张新面孔；原因不仅是他的体型和那对气势惊人的犄角，更在于他身上那套招摇的盔甲：锁子甲与硬革覆在肌肉健硕的身体上，外加一件血红色旅行斗篷，肩头还别着一颗青铜星——那是黎明女神卢米娅的圣徽。 身后的门砰然关上，这名新来客低吼一声转过身；他呼出的气息如咆哮般雄浑，震得鼻吻上硕大的金环上下弹动。 [party.has brint|你身边的弥诺陶洛斯懊恼地呻吟一声。“哦，天啊，是这个混蛋。别理他，[pc.name]。我们见面的半年前，他从我的村子里横冲直撞而过；因为想偷走村里几头刚长成女人的小母牛，他最后被赶了出去。”] “那边的！”弥诺陶洛斯用那对细小的黑眼睛凝视着你，大声喊道。“你是个冒险者，我从你的眼睛里看得出来。那么，你必定知道我就是希鲁德·格鲁恩，声名远扬的佣兵和竞技场冠军……而我需要你的帮助，夺回我被偷走的女人！” 哦，天啊。 “我找遍了所有地方，翻过了每一块石头。但掳走我心爱后宫的家伙认识我，每当我靠近便会逃走。我需要一张新面孔，一张那些懦夫尚且不知畏惧的面孔！像你这样的人可以接近他们，把他们打倒，带我的女人回家——让她们完好无损地回家！” 你不得不问：他确信自己的……伴侣……是被绑架的吗？她们就不能只是自行离开了？ 单是这个说法便令希鲁德勃然大怒。“她们是我的！只属于我！我独自持剑闯荡世界时，她们负责清理我的伤口、满足我的欲望。我就是一支军队！我是整个边境地区都声名赫赫、无人能挡的重装战车……而我的女人竟然会离开？不！她们是被人掳走的！” [party.has brint|布林特看了看你，耸耸肩。“架当然得打，但我还是要说，他就是个混蛋。”] [party.has cait|“失踪的后宫姑娘？嗯，如果她们真的身陷险境，我们就这么放任不管，我会很过意不去的，”凯特挠着一只耳朵说道。] “怎么样？你会挺身接受挑战，还是说你是个肮脏的懦夫？”身披盔甲的弥诺陶洛斯厉声质问。
rows.raw: ' A huge, black-furred minotaur is sitting precariously on one of Garth's barstools, surrounded by empty mugs and pools of spilled beer. It's impossible not to notice the new figure as soon as you enter, not just because of his size or his impressive mantle of horns, but because of the audacious armor he's wearing: mail and hard leather cover his muscular body, along with a traveling cloak colored blood-red and pinned at the shoulder with a bronze star — a holy symbol of Lumia, goddess of the dawn. As the door snaps closed behind you, the new denizen turns with a grunt, the bellow of his breath mighty enough to make the big golden ring through his snout bounce. [party.has brint|Your own minotaur groans with dismay. "Oh boy, this asshole. Just ignore him, [pc.name]. He blew through my village half a year before we met, got himself run out for trying to rustle some of our heifers that had just come into their womanhood."] "You there!" the minotaur shouts, staring at you with tiny, black eyes. "You are an adventurer. I see it in your eyes. Then you must know that I am Hirrud Grune, famed mercenary and champion of the arena... and I require your aid to recover my stolen women!" Oh boy. "I have looked everywhere, turned every stone. But whoever took my beloved harem knows me, flees when I approach. I need a new face, one that the cravens don't yet know to fear! Someone like you could get close enough to strike them down and bring my women home — bring them home unspoiled!" You have to ask: is he sure his... companions... were kidnapped? Could they not have just left? Hirrud bristles at the mere suggestion. "They were mine! Mine alone, to clean my wounds and slake my lusts as I ply my lone blade across the world. I am an army! An unstoppable juggernaut famed throughout the Marches... and yet my women, they leave? No! They have been taken!" [party.has brint|Brint gives you a look and shrugs. "Fight's a fight, but I still say he's a cunt."] [party.has cait|"Missing harem-girls? Well, I'd feel bad if we just left them to their fate if they really are in trouble," Cait says, scratching at an ear.] "Well? Will you rise to the challenge, or are you a filthy craven?" the armored minotaur demands.'

rows.original:
"Okay, okay," you say, sitting down beside him[party.has brint|, despite Brint's protestations]. "Do you have any idea where they might have been taken?"

        The armored minotaur shrugs. "I am not an oracle! If I knew who took them and where I would take my blade and charge them myself. No quarter! No prisoners! Only blood for those who defile my women!"
        
        It takes him a moment to calm down, letting the veins bulging in his temples start to deflate. He finally grunts, a gravelly noise in the back of his throat, and leans back against the bar. "I don't know. I lost them in the Foothills east of here. They can't have gone far, trapped between mountains and my blade in this town. Look there!"
        
        Fine. "Can you describe the women?"
        
        He grunts, "What? So you can rub your meat to fantasies of them!?"
        
        "No, so I can find them."
        
        Hirrud blinks, slowly. "Hrmmm, fine! Three catfolk, all fertile-figured and ripe for breeding, with collars and bells around their necks so I can find them if they get themselves lost! Hmm, one has blue hair, another ash-colored, and the third, golden — gold like the metal, not blonde. They all dye it, catfolk. Their names are... hrm... well, they come when I shout 'Harem attend me!' or 'Get on your knees and present.' Easy to spot."
        
        Right, that looks like the most help you're going to get out of this guy. Time to start looking.
rows.translation:
好吧，好吧，”你说道，然后坐在他旁边。[party.has brint|尽管布林特一再抗议，情况依然如此。]你知道他们可能被带到了哪里吗？”

        那个披甲的弥诺陶洛斯耸了耸肩：“我又不是先知！如果我知道是谁把他们带走的，我早就带着我的刀去把他们全部杀掉了。绝不留情！绝不放俘虏！那些玷污我的女人的人，只有死路一条！”
        
        他花了好一会儿才平静下来，额头上凸起的青筋也逐渐消退。最终，他发出一声低沉的咕哝声，然后靠在吧台上。我不知道。我把它们丢在了这里东边的山脚下。它们应该不会走得太远，被群山和我的刀挡住了，肯定就在这个镇子里。看那边！”
        
        “好吧，你能描述一下那些女人的样子吗？”
        
        他哼了一声：“什么？所以你可以通过这些想象来满足自己的欲望啊！？”
        
        “不，我是想找到它们。”
        
        希鲁德缓缓地眨了眨眼：“嗯，好吧！有三只猫族，个个身材匀称、正值生育期，脖子上还戴着项圈和铃铛，这样就算它们走丢了，我也能找到它们！嗯，一个有着蓝色的头发，另一个是灰白色的，而第三个则是金色的——那种像金属一样的金色，而不是金发。他们都会自己染头发，这些猫族族。他们的名字是……嗯……当我喊“后宫成员们，快来见我！”或者“跪下来行礼吧”时，他们才会出现。很容易就能找到。”
        
        好吧，看样子从这家伙那里我们得到的帮助也就仅此而已了。是时候开始寻找了。

        他愤怒地吼叫着，一拳猛击在加斯的吧台上，力度之大以至于那些杯子都被震得掉了下来。他动作快得惊人，简直让人[pc.isDK|拿上你的武器吧|我觉得他会试图对付你。]就在他迈出一步，结果摇摇晃晃地摔了个四足部朝天之前，希鲁德的眼睛翻了上去，随后便失去了意识。

rows.original:
Continuing further up into the foothills, the air seems to get warmer; after all, it's closer to the sun, but not so high up the air begins to thin and chill. Nestled in one of the hillside grottos is a small cave; from within it, you can hear the sounds of laughing and... yes, you're sure of it: the jingling of bells, a soft tinkling that echoes from within.

    You step into the cave, following the noise. Female voices, at least two or three of them, and the constant ringing of bells. Could this be that muscle-headed minotaur's lost harem? The walls of the cavern catch your note: rough stone near the entrance transitions to smoother work — a construction, old and forgotten. Decorative petroglyphs mark carefully smoothed surfaces — this place was evidently well taken care of once, creating as much of a natural feel as possible while retaining the comforts of the civilized world. Against a wall, you spy a crumbling brick bench, clearly for sitting on; on another, an ancient, corroded sconce has been affixed.
    
    And there's a torch in it, flickering as it presides over a larger chamber. A hotspring, wreathed in steam that sticks to your [pc.skinFurScales] as you tread closer.
    
    The spring itself has been smoothed and shaped to easy perfection — water continually pours from the roof, clinging to stalactites before dripping into the spring in several steady trickles. The spring itself is in turn drained through several cracks in its sides, and the resultant circulation of water has kept the pool itself largely clean. Something that the women bathing in it are clearly happy to take advantage of.
    
    The steam's too thick to make out fine details, but you make out three distinct figures — women all, with the perfectly-molded goddess bodies that Hirrud had described; soft and curvaceous and jiggling with every step and every girlish giggle sends breasts quivering. And the collars on their necks jingle gaily, drowning out their hushed conversation.
    
    You can see the three harem-girls, but no kidnappers. Maybe they're hiding somewhere.
    
    The women are quite absorbed in their bathing, and it doesn't look like they've seen you yet. Seems like you have the initiative here.
rows.translation:
继续向山脚深处前进，空气似乎变得温暖起来——毕竟这里离太阳更近了。然而，当高度继续增加时，空气变得稀薄而寒冷。在山坡上的一个洞穴里，有一个小小的洞窟；从里面传出来阵阵笑声………是的，你确定吗？那种铃声，那种从洞穴内部传来的轻柔回响……

    你顺着声音走进洞穴。那里有女性的声音，至少有两三个女性的声音，还有持续不断的铃声。这会不会就是那个固执的弥诺陶洛斯丢失的后宫呢？洞穴的墙壁上留下了痕迹：入口附近的粗糙石壁逐渐变成了更为光滑的石面——这些遗迹显然已经存在了很久，而且早已被人们遗忘。装饰性的岩画点缀在那些被精心打磨过的表面上，由此可见，这个地方曾经被人精心照料过，人们在尽力营造出自然的气息的同时，也确保了这里具备文明世界应有的便利设施。靠在墙边，你看到一张摇摇欲坠的砖砌长凳，显然是用来坐人的；而在另一处，有一个古老的、已经生锈的壁灯被固定在那里。
    
    灯里点着一支火炬，火光摇曳着，照亮了那个更大的房间。那里还有一个温泉，蒸汽缭绕着，雾气粘在你的身上[pc.skinFurScales]随着你逐渐靠近，
    
    这个泉水本身已经被精心修饰得完美无瑕——水不断地从屋顶流下来，先附着在钟乳石上，然后缓缓滴落入泉水中。而这些水流又会通过泉水侧面的几处裂缝流走，这种循环系统使得水池本身始终保持着清洁。那些在蒸汽中沐浴的女性显然非常乐意利用这一条件。
    
    蒸汽太过浓密，无法看清细节，但你可以分辨出三个清晰的身影——全部都是女性，她们拥有希鲁德所描述的那种完美曲线、女神般的身材；柔软而富有弹性，每走一步、每发出一声少女般的笑声，她们的胸部都会随之轻轻颤动。他们脖子上的项圈叮当作响，声声悦耳，盖过了他们低声的交谈声。
    
    你可以看到那三个后宫女子，但却看不到任何绑架者。也许他们躲在什么地方。
    
    那些女人正全神贯注地洗澡，看起来他们还没有注意到你的存在。看来这次是你占了主动权。

rows.original: You roll your shoulders back and stand tall, shouting into the cavern with your most commanding voice: "Get on your knees and present!" The tittering stops. All three women stop what they were doing, staring out of the baths towards where you [party.som||and [companion.name] |and your companions ]are standing in the entrance. The mist thins for a moment, letting you see large water-sheened breasts and perky feline ears as the women come out of the water. "Who's this now?" one of them asks, her voice throaty and seductive. "Not that awful brute, I don't think." [party.has brint|"What about that one?" another slave asks, pointing towards Brint. "Did Hirrud find a partner?" The third laughs. "No, this one's too young and studly to be Hirrud!" Brint grins. "I am pretty studly." "See? And who's your friend with the bellowing voice?"] They sure don't seem to be kneeling or presenting themselves. Instead they approach, hips swaying and bare chests openly displayed for your devouring eyes as they leave the steaming baths. "You're not Hirrud," the first of the women, a tall matron with cobalt hair. "So why the shouting? What's that old man been filling your head with?" Well, for starters, that they'd been kidnapped and dragged off to be violated or worse. They break out laughing before you've even finished the idea, doubling over and grabbing their knees or leaning against each other — all motions that draw your eyes to soft, wet boobflesh or naked sexes, each flawlessly trimmed. It takes you aback, how hilarious they find it, until one of the girls, a golden-haired young woman of about Cait's age, wipes the tears from her eyes and laughs "Of course he thinks that!" The third, an ashen-haired catfolk a few years older than the blonde, adds, "We're just mindless property to him. Of course we couldn't just want to leave! Even if we say it every day, we can't possibly have a will of our own!" The eldest of the three, the cobalt-haired matron, sighs and puts her arms around the girls. rows.original: The matron rolls her eyes and continues: "Each of us has a litany of complaints against Hirrud, least of all that each one of us was captured by that wretched old bull and forced into slavery. We are his property, neglected and mistreated though we have been! I was a sorceress, the mayor of a little town until bandits burned it all down..." The ashen-haired girl adds, "Those would be my bandits. He beat us down and enslaved me, but when Calill couldn't pay his fees..." "He was happy to do the same to me," the matron, Calill, huffs. "And the poor Lumian priestess that dared to try and free us also got the same treatment a year later." The golden-haired slave crosses her arms under her ample chest. "Bastard cold-cocked me when I was trying to undo their bonds." [party.has cait|"Another kitty of the cloth!" Cait exclaims happily. "I'm glad we found you safe and sound!" The Lumian smiles and gives Cait a little bow. "And I'm glad to be found, sister! I couldn't have stood another night of that bastard bull's rancid breath."] After a weary sigh, the priestess adds, "He was an awful captor. Being treated like a yard dog is bad enough, but he could barely even get it up when he demanded service. And if we so much as looked at each other while we dressed or bathed..." "Even another woman's touch was too much for him to stomach," the bandit-cat hisses. "One grope or eye-fuck and we're 'cumrags' and 'dirty socks' that are just here to swallow his moldy loads when he gets a chub. Pathetic!" Whew, that sure is some spite. So what was their plan here; hide in a cave until the bull wandered off to find new playthings? Calill shrugs heavily. "I don't know. It was a nice reprieve but we had no illusions of really escaping. As much as we may like to talk down on him, Hirrud really is an able swordsman. Our recapture is inevitable... but we're intent on enjoying our freedom as much as possible before we're put back in his chains. This, being together, enjoying each other... this is as much vengeance as we can manage, isn't it?" Maybe...
rows.translation: 女族长翻了个白眼，继续说道：“我们每个人都有一长串对希鲁德的不满，其中还不止是我们每一个人都被那头可恶的老公牛抓来、强迫沦为奴隶。我们的确是他的财产，哪怕我们一直遭受冷落与虐待！我曾是名女术士，还是一座小镇的镇长，直到强盗把那里彻底烧毁……” 灰发女孩补充道：“那就是我的强盗团。他击败我们，把我变成了奴隶；而当卡利尔付不起他的费用时……” “他也很乐意对我做同样的事，”女族长卡利尔愤愤地说道。“一年后，那名胆敢尝试解救我们的可怜卢米亚女祭司也落得相同下场。” 金发奴隶在丰满的胸脯下交叉双臂。“我试图解开她们的束缚时，那个混蛋从旁偷袭，一拳把我打晕了。” [party.has cait|“又一位侍奉神明的小猫！”凯特高兴地惊呼。“很高兴找到你的时候，你还安然无恙！” 卢米亚女祭司微笑着向凯特轻轻鞠躬。“我也很高兴被你找到，姐妹！要是再闻一晚那头混蛋公牛腐臭的口气，我可受不了。”] 女祭司疲惫地叹了口气，又补充道：“他是个糟透了的囚禁者。被当成院子里的狗已经够糟糕了，可他要求服侍时甚至几乎硬不起来。而且，只要我们穿衣或洗澡时看彼此一眼……” “就连另一个女人的触碰，他都无法忍受，”强盗猫嘶声说道。“摸上一把，或者用眼神意淫一下，我们就成了‘精液抹布’和‘脏袜子’，存在的意义只是在他稍微硬起来时吞掉那发霉的精液。真可悲！” 呼，这怨气可真够大的。那么，她们原本的计划是什么？躲在洞里，直到那头公牛离开去找新的玩物？ 卡利尔沉重地耸耸肩。“我不知道。这的确让我们得到片刻喘息，可我们从未幻想自己真的能够逃走。不管嘴上怎么贬低他，希鲁德确实是一名出色的剑士。我们被重新抓回去是必然的……但在重新戴上他的锁链之前，我们打算尽可能享受自由。像这样待在一起、享受彼此……这就是我们所能做到的最大报复了，对吧？” 也许吧……

rows.original: ...A few hours later... You return to Frost Hound and find Hirrud Grune exactly where you left him, looming over the bar surrounded by a growing pile of Garth's empty mugs. He looks up with a grunt of surprise when you enter, then his eyes narrow. "Where're my women, eh? What happened out there?" You tell him simply that there was no sign of his women anywhere in the Foothills. They could be anywhere in the world now. Maybe off north somewhere. The dark minotaur snorts and staggers up to his feet. "Damned woman-stealers! Probably making a cuckold of me at this very minute. I must hurry before all three are spoiled forever!" Without so much as a 'thank you,' Hirrud stomps right out the door in search of his harem. Well, at least you probably bought them a few extra days.

rows.original: "Alright. How can I help?" The question seems to take the cat-women by surprise, leaving them gawking for a moment before Calill blinks and says, "You want to... to help us? I don't mean to question your good will, but you realize that Hirrud won't take this lying down? We're his prized property and he will not let us go without a fight." [pc.bg soldier barbarian|Well, if there's one thing you're good at, it's fighting.|You'll be facing a lot worse than him before you take down Kasyrra.] "Don't make [pc.himHer] regret it already!" the ashen-haired bandit says, swatting Calill's naked ass. "We aren't going to get another chance like this." The elder feline nods firmly. "Of course. I'm sorry, we welcome your help with open arms. I would hesitate to send you back to town to fight Hirrud alone, however. As much as we disparage our would-be master, he is a capable swordsman." "What she means," the blonde adds, "is that we'd like to help you drive him off. Each of us was once a capable fighter, priestess, or sorceress. Only by sending the dastard running with his tail between his legs can we ensure our freedom, and for that, we need overwhelming power." "We want to help!" the young thief cheers. "But to do so," Calill says, "We need weapons and armor. He'll not find us a threat if we show up naked and disarmed as we are." Easily done. "What exactly do you need?" Calill thinks a moment, tapping her chin. "A dagger and two staves. Two magician's robes and a leather coat. That will be enough to at least contribute to a fight. I'm sure the townsfolk sell all of that cheaply enough." "We'll do whatever we can to repay you... somehow," the bandit offers. Her comrades nod in agreement.
