rows.original: You return to Hawkethorne some time later with the three sex-kittens in tow, armed and armored for a fight. Considering you'd rather not have a raging bull flinging chairs around your temporary home, you plant your feet in the street just outside the tavern and bellow at the top of your lungs, "HIRRUD GRUNE! I'm calling you out!" A moment goes by. Then another. The harem-girls look amongst themselves, a nervous quiet falling over your party. Then the Frost Hound's door slams open, and the towering hulk of minotaur muscle drags himself out. A tower shield is strapped to his left arm, and in his right, he carries a battle-worn axe flecked with old, dried blood. His cape billows behind him in the cool mountain winds, held on by a bronze Lumian pin you now know must have once been Selima's. His heavy armor creaks and rattles as his broad body finally comes to rest ten paces before you. "Ah, you return with my property..." he begins, though his dark little eyes narrow as he drinks in the catgirls' armored bodies. "Though not unmolested. What filthy lies have you fed their empty heads, worm? Why are my slaves dressed for battle!?" "Because we are here for battle, Hirrud," Calill says sharply, levelling her staff with the minotaur's chest. A crackle of energy surges around the staff-head, burning the air beside you. "[pc.name] has agreed to champion us! We demand freedom." "Freedom!?" the huge minotaur bellows, raking a hoof over the street. Around you, common folk are starting to withdraw into their homes or businesses, though you see Garth just staring out the Frost Hound's window with a big grin on his grizzled old mug. Hirrud bristles, fist tightening around his sword. "What can a woman know of freedom? What would you do with it other than whore yourselves out? All you're good for is sheathing my cock and mothering calves. Yet you dare to take up arms against me... I see you've been corrupted. Defiled. This [pc.mascFem|bitch|bastard] must have fucked you, like the filthy [silly|used socks|cumrags] you are. Well then, I'll just have to kill you all if you won't fall back in line. Last chance." Yset twirls her blade in hand and gives you a cocky grin. "Not happening, old beef. We've got a real [pc.mf|man|woman] now!" "One who hasn't taken us by force to be slaves," Selima adds as a ball of white fire sparks to life in her hands. "I will not be property any longer." The minotaur snarls, baring his teeth. "Twisted beyond redemption. You'd make common whores of my slaves! They're mine! MINE!" He bellows like a beast and lowers his head, charging at you with goring horns... and immediately is greeted by a bolt of whitefire searing his fur, sending him crumpling to the ground. Calill releases a bolt of lightning that dances over his armor, eliciting a scream of agony from the bull-man as he struggles back to his cloven feet. Before he can recover his footing, Yset leaps forward and delivers a dirty kick that puts him right back down, sputtering and groaning. "Your turn, [pc.name]!" the thief giggles as the minotaur slowly rises. "Teach him a lesson!"

rows.original: You're fighting Hirrud Grune, an infamous minotaur mercenary. He bears an impressive mantle of horns and a king's ransom of armor: mail and hard leather cover his muscular body, along with a traveling cloak colored blood-red and pinned at the shoulder with a bronze star — a holy symbol of Lumia, goddess of the dawn. Hirrud bears a tower shield and Minothan war-sword, ready to fight.
rows.translation: 你正在与臭名昭著的弥诺陶洛斯雇佣兵希鲁德·格鲁恩交战。他那令人印象深刻的角状头饰，以及那些价值连城的盔甲，都凸显出他的强大实力：他的肌肉发达的身体被锁子甲和硬皮甲覆盖，身上还披着一件血红色的旅行斗篷，斗篷的肩部用一颗青铜星星固定着——那可是黎明女神卢米娅的神圣象征。希鲁德手持巨型盾牌和米诺坦战剑，随时准备投入战斗。
rows.raw: "\n    You're fighting Hirrud Grune, an infamous minotaur mercenary. He bears an impressive mantle of horns and a king's ransom of armor: mail and hard leather cover his muscular body, along with a traveling cloak colored blood-red and pinned at the shoulder with a bronze star — a holy symbol of Lumia, goddess of the dawn. Hirrud bears a tower shield and Minothan war-sword, ready to fight."

rows.original:
When the smoke clears, there's no sign of Hirrud Grune. 

    You wave the last of the oily black smog out of your face and walk back into the street, surveying for any lingering danger. But the minotaur is long gone, leaving nothing behind but his blood-red cloak. It must have come off in his hurry to save himself.
    
    "W-we did it?" Yset murmurs, glancing around the streets. "He's gone?"
    
    "He's gone, kittens," Calill confirms, letting her staff fall by the wayside. "He's neither stupid enough nor resolved enough to die for our blood. For now, at least... I believe [pc.name] has earned our freedom."
    
    The younger cat-girls cheer[party.has cait|, joined by an exuberant Cait as well]. Calill, though, turns her attentions to you with a serene smile on her face. "I can't say 'thank you' enough, [pc.name]... but thank you all the same. I have no idea what comes next for us, but that's a reward in and of itself, isn't it? Uncertainty and adventure are far preferable to the years of routine bondage we have endured."
    
    She sighs and takes a few steps past you, gazing upon the stone steeple of Velun's church. "Gods be good, but we're really free..."
rows.translation:
烟雾散去后，希鲁德·格鲁恩已经不见踪影。

    你挥手驱散脸前最后一缕油黑烟雾，重新走上街道，查看是否还有危险潜伏。然而，那个弥诺陶洛斯早已逃之夭夭，只留下血红色的斗篷。那一定是他急着保命时掉下来的。
    
    “我、我们成功了？”伊塞特低声问道，环顾街道，“他走了？”
    
    “他走了，小猫咪们。”卡利尔确认道，任由长杖掉落在一旁，“他没蠢到为了我们的血送命，也没有那份决心。至少现在……我相信[pc.name]已经替我们赢得了自由。”
    
    年轻的猫女们欢呼起来[party.has cait|，兴高采烈的凯特也加入了她们]。卡利尔却带着安详的微笑，将注意力转向你。“无论说多少声‘谢谢’都不够，[pc.name]……但我还是要感谢你。我不知道接下来等待我们的是什么，不过这本身就是一种奖赏，不是吗？未知与冒险，远胜过我们多年忍受的、一成不变的奴役生活。”
    
    她叹了口气，从你身旁走出几步，凝望维伦教堂的石制尖塔。“诸神保佑，我们真的自由了……”

Inevitably, though, Calill tells the girls that it's time to decide their next step. "Armed as we are, we can certainly survive some travel. Perhaps we should make our way to the Belharan Heartland, or-" "And do what there?" Selima asks, putting her hands on her sizable hips. "Become whores? I have no wish to rejoin the priesthood after so long abandoned by my goddess, and Yset's cohort of thieves is long disbanded. Even you yourself have said that your children have doubtless taken up your mantle back home. And no men would take to wife three women so thorough used by another..." "Selly!" Yset pouts. "Don't talk like that. We aren't... aren't ruined! That's Hirrud speaking, not you." The cleric casts her gaze down. "I-if you say so. I'm not so sure, however..." I know that I, at least, would give myself willingly to you if you would have me..."

rows.translation: 你点了点头：“我会的。” “我也一样！”伊塞特笑着跑过来，说道：“你人很好，也很安全！ [var0 |塞利玛思考了一会儿，然后说道：“我的一生始终都在为他人服务。先是作为一位黄金女神，后来又变成了一头邪恶的弥诺陶洛斯……我真的无法想象。 [pc.name]这根本算不上是一种改进。我赞成这个想法。 |塞利玛眯起眼睛看着他们：“你们俩真的只是……在我们获得自由后这么短的时间内就……” “是啊，但是[pc.heShe]的热得难受但是，伊塞特坚持说道。 “……你说得有道理，”塞利玛承认道，她用手遮住了自己泛红的脸颊。“我必须承认，重新回到自愿服务的状态确实会……更轻松一些。先是一个黄金女神，然后又是一个邪恶的弥诺陶洛斯……我真的无法想象[pc.name]这根本算不上是一种改进。 ] 那就这么定了，”你说道，将那三个后宫少女拥入怀中，“你们会和我一起留在这里。” “至少这项服务是我自愿选择的，”塞利玛叹息道，不过她的手仍在你的胸前轻轻抚弄。 伊塞特开心地笑了起来：“太好了！有一个温馨舒适的家、[pc.name]，还有我最好的朋友们，能整日整夜地做爱……当然，是在我们没有全都缠着[pc.name]，的时候。不管怎样，一个女孩还能想要什么呢？” 卡利尔轻笑道：“问得好。我们进去吧，找些事情做，等到有人需要我们的时候再出现，怎么样？” 另外两个人也急切地点了点头，跟着卡利尔走进了霜犬酒馆号。 [party.has arona|"不错这就是阿罗娜唯一的评论，当时她正在看着那三个人离开。] [party.has cait|嗯，我觉得这样挺好的，”凯特微笑着说，“马拉克说过，自愿服从本身就是一种奖励。而且，还能交到新的猫朋友呢！] 好了，是时候看看你在这里为自己赢得了什么了……

"A-are you two really just... and mere moments after we win our freedom." "Yeah, but [pc.heShe]'s really hot," Yset insists. "... You make a fair point," Selima admits, hiding her flushing cheeks behind a hand. "I admit, it would be... easier... to fall back into willing service. First a golden goddess, then an evil minotaur... I can't imagine [pc.name] would be anything but an improvement." ] "Then it's settled," you say, taking the three harem-girls into your arms. "You'll stay here with me." "At least this service I choose willingly," Selima sighs, though her hand plays up your chest as she does. Yset grins from ear to ear. "Great! A nice, comfy home with [pc.name] and my best friends to fuck all day and night... when we aren't all over [pc.name], anyway. What more could a girl want?" Calill chuckles, "A good question. Let's get inside and find some way to be useful until we're needed, hmm?" The other two nod eagerly and follow Calill into the Frost Hound. [party.has arona|"Nice" is Arona's only comment, watching the three go.] [party.has cait|"Well, I feel good about that," Cait says with a smile. "Willing submission is its own reward, Mallach says. Besides, new cat-friends!"] Right. Time to see what you've earned yourself here... '

rows.original: Accept the harem-kitties into your charge. They may still be playthings, but they'll find you a much more pleasurable [pc.master] to serve...
rows.translation: 收下这些后宫小猫吧。它们可能仍然是玩物，但它们会发现，伺候你这位[pc.master]要愉快得多……
rows.raw: "Accept the harem-kitties into your charge. They may still be playthings, but they'll find you a much more pleasurable [pc.master] to serve..."

rows.original: "I have a better idea," you say, reaching into your pack. You take out a satchel of coin and press it into Calill's hands. "Take this. Go south. Make a new life for yourselves." Yset's ears twitch. "That's... that's a lotta coins in there!" "A-are you sure about this?" Calill gasps, staring at the pouch in her hands. "I can't... we've already asked so much of you..." Selima steps forward and puts a hand on the matron's, closing her fingers around the bag. "Calill, I very rarely tell you what to do, but this time... I was a priestess for many years. Charity is a beautiful thing. Don't refuse it." Calill glances at the priestess. "And you aren't being selfish, just a little?" "It's okay to be selfish, when what you need is freely given." Yset grabs the pouch straight out of Calill's hands. "Yeah, yeah, morality. Look at all this coin though! Let's get outta here and spend this!" "Fine, fine," Calill sighs. "You two win. Thank you, [pc.name], we humbly accept." Yset and Selima cheer, hugging Calill as she pockets the coin. "We'll go and find someone to take us south. Perhaps to the village I once governed... they may have moved on, but there will always be a home for us there. I am sure of it." So be it. You wish the girls good luck on the road, and watch as the three feline beauties start the long journey to the rest of their lives. "See you around, [pc.name]," Selima says as she passes you. "May the Golden Mother shield you always." [party.has cait|"And may Mallach put a spring in your step!" Cait says, waving as the kitties leave.]
rows.translation: “我有个更好的主意，”你一边说，一边伸手探入背包。你取出一袋钱币，塞进卡利尔手里。“拿着。向南走。为自己开创新生活。” 伊塞特的耳朵抖了抖。“那……那里面有好多钱！” “你、你确定要这样做吗？”卡利尔盯着手里的钱袋，倒吸一口气。“我不能……我们已经向你索求太多了……” 塞利玛走上前，把一只手放在女族长的手上，让她的手指攥紧钱袋。“卡利尔，我极少告诉你该怎么做，但这一次……我当了许多年女祭司。慈善是一件美好的事。不要拒绝它。” 卡利尔看了女祭司一眼。“你就没有一点私心吗？” “当你需要的东西是别人自愿赠予的，怀有私心也没关系。” 伊塞特直接从卡利尔手中抢走钱袋。“好啦，好啦，先别说道德了。看看这里有多少钱！我们走吧，把它花个痛快！” “好吧，好吧，”卡利尔叹了口气。“你们两个赢了。谢谢你，[pc.name]，我们就谦恭地收下了。” 伊塞特和塞利玛欢呼起来，拥抱着把钱袋收进口袋的卡利尔。“我们会去找一个能带我们南下的人。或许可以去我曾经治理的村庄……他们或许已经继续前行，但那里永远会有我们的家。我对此深信不疑。” 那就这么办吧。你祝姑娘们一路顺风，目送三名猫族美人踏上通往余生的漫长旅途。 “回头见，[pc.name]，”塞利玛经过你身边时说道。“愿黄金之母永远庇佑你。” [party.has cait|“也愿马拉克让你步履轻快！”猫女们离开时，凯特挥着手说道。]

rows.original: Give the catgirls 1,000 electrum pieces — more than enough to book safe passage south and set up a new life for themselves.
rows.translation: 给这些猫女1000枚琥珀金币——这笔钱绝对足够让她们安全地前往南方，开始新的生活。
rows.raw: "Give the catgirls 1,000 electrum pieces — more than enough to book safe passage south and set up a new life for themselves."

rows.original: You don't have 1,000 electrum pieces to give them.
rows.translation: 你并没有1,000枚琥珀金币可以给他们。
rows.raw: "You don't have 1,000 electrum pieces to give them."

rows.original:
"You should go south," you say, indicating the road down the farming valley below Hawkethorne. You came that way before Kasyrra's blizzard; the roads are dangerous and the going's tough, but it's doable. The girls are armed and armored, so they should be fine.

        Calill nods slowly. "I see... very well. Ladies, come along. We've a new life to find."
        
        Yset gives you a forlorn look and sighs. "Well, one adventure's as good as another. Let's go, Selly."
        
        "Let's," Selima says. She gives you a thankful nod and follows Calill. "See you around, [pc.name]. May the Golden Mother shield you always."
        
        [party.has cait|"And may Mallach put a spring in your step!" Cait says, waving as the kitties leave.]
rows.translation:
你应该往南走，”你说道，同时指向鹰棘镇下方那条穿过农田山谷的道路。在卡希拉的暴风雪来临之前，你就是从那条路过来的；虽然这条路很危险，行进也会很艰难，但总归是可以走到的。那些女孩们都配备了武器和护甲，所以应该不会有问题。

        卡利尔缓缓点了点头。“我明白了……很好。女士们，我们走吧，去寻找属于我们的新生活。”
        
        伊塞特向你投来一种无奈的目光，然后叹了口气：“好吧，反正一次冒险和另一次冒险没什么两样。我们走吧，塞莉。”
        
        “走吧，”塞利玛说道。她向你感激地点了点头，然后跟着卡利尔走了。“回头见吧。 [pc.name]愿黄金之母永远保护着你。
        
        [party.has cait|愿玛拉克让你的步伐充满活力！”凯特边说边挥手，目送那些小猫们离开。]

rows.original: Send the girls south to Belhar. Hope for the best, ladies.
rows.translation: 把姑娘们送到南边的贝尔哈尔去吧。祝各位一切顺利。
rows.raw: "Send the girls south to Belhar. Hope for the best, ladies."

rows.original:
"What do the three of you actually want to do?" you ask them. "The world's your oyster."
        
        Selima's brow furrows. "I don't know. My goddess hasn't answered my prayers in a long, long time. I don't think I could stomach to show my face back in Dawnsword as I am now. Truth be told, I'd rather just... stay here, with you. [flags.MEOW_JOIN
            |You were far, far better to us — in all the ways that matter — than any [pc.mf
                |man has ever been
                |woman should, by rights
            ], given our position. The only skill I have left is warming a bed, so I'd gladly stay and warm yours if you would have me. The goddess may have stricken me of my paladin's powers, but I can still at least serve the queen of fertility in her most primal fashion.
            |You're a good [pc.mf
                |man
                |woman
            ]. If you wished, I would happily... warm your bed at night. [pc.hasRealCock
                |The goddess has stricken me of my paladin's powers, but I can still at least serve the queen of fertility in her most primal fashion, if that is what you want of me. I can think of no better partner.
            ]
        ]"
        
        "I agree with that, certainly," Calill says. "I would like to return home, of course, and see my children all grown up... but to do so safely would require far more coin that I fear I can earn in a lifetime! If I stay here, at least I'll be able to send a letter south, and let them know I'm alright... and that I've found good company after all."
        
        Yset chews her plump lip, looking between you and the other kittens. After a long moment, she grins and laces her fingers behind her head. "I can survive anywhere after this. But wherever I go, I want to stay with the girls. They're the only family I have. And hey — being your bed-warmer would be a lot easier, and maybe even more fun, than thieving.[pc.hasRealCock
            | Plus... you know, I've kinda always wanted a family of my own, but being a rogue's not exactly conducive for getting knocked up and popping out kits. A safe little burg like this, though? And with a [pc.mf
                |guy
                |gal
            ] like you... Hmm?
        ]"
        
        "Together, yes," Selima nods. "I've gone through too much with the two of you to ever want to part. I love you both dearly, so... whatever decision [pc.name] makes, I will stay with you."
        
        Calill smiles. "Oh, Sel, we love you too. So: in [pc.name]'s bed or settling down in a village, here or back home, as long as we're all together..."
        
        "Together!" Yset cheers.
rows.translation:
“你们三个究竟想做什么？”你问道。“世界任你们遨游。”
        
        塞利玛皱起眉头。“我不知道。我的女神已经很久很久没有回应祈祷了。以现在这副模样，我想自己根本没脸回到晨曦剑城。说实话，我更愿意……留在这里，和你在一起。[flags.MEOW_JOIN
            |你待我们远比任何[pc.mf
                |男人曾经做过的
                |女人理应做到的
            ]都要好——至少在真正重要的方面是如此——尤其考虑到我们的处境。我如今仅剩的本事就是暖床；如果你肯收留我，我很愿意留下来为你暖床。女神或许已经剥夺了我的圣骑士之力，但我至少还能以最原始的方式侍奉丰饶女王。
            |你是个好[pc.mf
                |男人
                |女人
            ]。只要你愿意，我很乐意……在夜里为你暖床。[pc.hasRealCock
                |女神或许已经剥夺了我的圣骑士之力，但只要你想要，我至少还能以最原始的方式侍奉丰饶女王。我想不到比你更好的伴侣。
            ]
        ]”
        
        “我当然赞同，”卡利尔说道。“我自然想要回家，看看已经长大成人的孩子们……但想安全回去，需要的钱恐怕远超我一生所能赚到的数目！如果留在这里，我至少可以寄信到南方，让他们知道我平安无事……而且终究还是找到了好伙伴。”
        
        伊塞特咬着丰满的嘴唇，目光在你和其他猫女之间来回游移。许久之后，她咧嘴一笑，将十指交扣在脑后。“经历这些以后，我走到哪里都能活下来。但无论去哪里，我都想和姑娘们待在一起。她们是我唯一的家人。而且，嘿——当你的暖床人可比偷东西轻松多了，说不定还更有趣。[pc.hasRealCock
            | 再说……你知道，我一直有点想要自己的家庭，但当盗贼可不利于怀孕生下小猫。可像这样一座安全的小镇呢？再加上一个像你这样的[pc.mf
                |男人
                |女人
            ]……嗯？
        ]”
        
        “没错，我们要在一起，”塞利玛点点头。“我和你们两个共同经历了太多，永远都不想分开。我深爱着你们，所以……不论[pc.name]作出什么决定，我都会和你们待在一起。”
        
        卡利尔笑了。“哦，塞尔，我们也爱你。所以，无论是待在[pc.name]的床上，还是在村庄里安顿下来；无论留在这里，还是回到故乡，只要我们都在一起……”
        
        “永远在一起！”伊塞特欢呼道。

rows.original: What do the girls actually want?
rows.translation: 这些女孩们到底想要什么？

rows.original:
You thought you had every advantage, but still, you find yourself crumpling face-first into the packed dirt of Hawkethorne's streets. Hirrud looms darkly over you, sword in hand. 

    "Filth," he proclaims coldly. A moment later, you feel a hot, searing pain in the back of your neck, and then blackness takes you.
    
    You've died at the hands of Hirrud Grune. Only the gods know what fate awaits your companions at his mercy...
rows.translation:
你原以为自己拥有所有优势，但最终还是重重地跌倒在鹰棘镇街道的尘土之中。希鲁德手持宝剑，阴沉地站在你面前。

    “肮脏的东西，”他冷冷地说道。片刻之后，你感到后颈传来一阵剧烈的灼烧痛，随后便陷入了黑暗。
    
    你死在了希鲁德·格鲁恩的手下。只有神明才知道，你的同伴将会面临怎样的命运……

rows.original: [var0 |[var1 |In the late stages of pregnancy, Calill, Selima, and Yset are practically helpless on their own. No amount of physical fitness would help these kitties carry the immense sizes of their bellies. Some wish them happiness and health in long congratulations as they near the end of their collective term. Calill and Selima have finished their meals, but Yset seems to be struggling with this the most. Before sitting down, you pat the little once-thief on the head, scratch behind her ears, tell her you're here. It has the desired effect. Comforted by your tenderness, Yset calms down and sits up straight. They all seem to be in a half-vacant daydream as you look them over from your chair, idly caressing their bellies. Hormones lap at their combined consciences. The looks on their smiling faces aren't what they usually wear. From their points of view, you must have become someone... more than you are. Whatever you're sensing, you know they're madly, inescapably attracted to you. And you quite like that. "[pc.name]," Selima whispers, scooting closer. "Would you like to rub my belly?" "Me too," Yset asks politely. "And me!" Calill interjects, her vision cleared up. You could do that. But you could do... more than that. |Draped in colorful blankets and never far from glasses of sparkling water, Calill, Selima, and Yset have become less talkative, more... weary, you would say. Fully pregnant and progressing well, the harem-kitties seem to spend all their time relaxing and feasting on nutrient-rich meals laid in front of them. Grilled fish, dry meats, and ripe fruits are arranged on small platters for the child-bearing catfolk to pick at. They all bat their eyelashes when you sit down, eyes fixed on yours. They're all eager to greet you. "[pc.Master]," Selima smiles, leaning closer. "Thank you for visiting us. It's hard to move around like this..." Calill's foot touches your [pc.thigh]. "I hope this visit is more than a simple social call, ehe..." Yset huffs, completely flushed. "It's good to see you, [pc.name]..." Horny and exhausted. Just how could a harem-[pc.Master] take advantage of this? |Calill, Yset, and Selima are huddled around the table. The loquacious felines have altered their diet to maximize nutrition for their babies. Gwen comes by every so often to check up on them, ensuring they get all the creature comforts they need. Working in a tavern isn't easy nor, typically, low-stress, but spirits are high. For the time being, the three seem able to work. But in the future, they'll definitely be sitting most of the time. "Welcome back, [pc.name]!" Selima beams. "Hey," Yset winks. Calill bows her head. "We're happy to see you in good health." [var0 |While giving Hirrud Grune a good smack on the snout might be satisfying, it's probably not worth it with him like this. [silly|If he were in any more foul a mood, he'd have thunderclouds orbiting his brow. ]As you peek out from your hiding place, the minotaur gate guard rise and attend to their posts, the plume-helmed leader taking his position in the middle of the path. "Ay-ah. King Kelsaz —" he begins, then clears his throat and drops the formal accent as he realizes who's approaching, assuming a much more conversational tone. "Oh. It's you. The gate is closed by order of the king. Go away." The Charger captain's refusal just serves to incense Hirrud even further, and the mercenary raises his voice to a bellow. "I am a citizen of Khor'minos, with all its privileges! You would deny me entry to my homeland, pitiful sentry?" There's a moment's tension, a spark in the air between the two, then one of the guards comes up and whispers something to his captain, who nods. "Very well. My subordinate has just reminded me that citizens are permitted re-entry, subject to a quarantine duration of two weeks. We will prepare a tent for you off to one side of our encampment, and you will stay there in isolation until this time is up. One of the high womenfolk will also be summoned to see to you and determine if you have been infected by the corruption that is said to be spreading on the surface. Are these acceptable terms?" "This is outrageous!" Hirrud roars, already reaching for his weapon. "You can't do this! I am a citizen! I have rights, rights that I served six years in the legion for!" The captain meets Hirrud's gaze levelly. "I can and I am, under that same authority that you claim to derive such rights from. I suggest that you do no violence here; the odds are against you. We are many, and you are but one." "I need no companions! I am an army of one, as opposed to you, who cowers behind his underlings!" The captain sighs, looking absolutely disgusted as he pinches the bridge of his muzzle. Then in one swift blow, he sinks his knuckles into Hirrud's face, the resultant crack echoing along the rocky walls of the foothills. Hirrud reels, and two of the Charger guards come up, grab him from under the shoulders, and firmly whisk him away down the path. The last you see of the vexatious mercenary is him clutching his bloodied snout, roaring invective at the captain. "You cannot do this, whoreson! I have rights! I know you derive pleasure from watching other men mate with your wife! My father will hear of this! I —" The sound abruptly fades, leaving blessed silence rushing in to fill the void. [party.has brint| "Well, what do you make of all of that?" you ask Brint. Your minotaur companion scratches the back of his neck. "Khaak. On one hand, I can't say I don't see where he's coming from. Two weeks in a small tent doing nothing is torture for a hot-blooded minotaur. If the king doesn't want anyone returning, it's a good way of doing it without actually saying no. "On the other hand, the Chargers are the king's personal guard; if he's sent them up here as sentries, he seriously means to keep the gates closed. Anyone — let alone a minotaur who should know better — who raises a hand against them deserves what's coming their way." ] Either way, one thing's for sure: considering how they took out an experienced mercenary like Hirrud with ease, these minotaurs are pretty tough for gate guards. rows.translation: [flags.GATEGUARD_ENCOUNTERED |当国王之门那高耸的黑色城墙再次映入眼帘时…… |随着山脚逐渐临近…… ]你身后，那座绳桥上传来了重型而缓慢的脚步声。你转过身，看到一个暗影而蓬乱的身影正从你的后方冲了过来，每一步都让这座坚固的桥在横跨峡谷的道路上发出吱嘎的声响。 哦，天哪……是它来了。他。 [var0 |虽然狠狠地拍一下希鲁德·格鲁恩的鼻子可能会让人感到解气，但以他现在的状态来看，这样做可能并不值得。毕竟，你可不想给他任何借口来逃避承认自己被你打败的事实——战胜一个已经弱化的对手，可没有什么乐趣可言的。 |考虑到上一次见面时发生的事情，你肯定想尽一切办法避开那个讨厌的家伙。 ]幸运的是，那里有一块足够大的、圆润的巨石，正好适合你。[party.som|| 以及[party.compNames]|， [party.compNames]]躲开他的视线。 希尔鲁德根本没有注意到你。那个弥诺陶洛斯雇佣兵似乎陷入了沉思，他大步从你身边走过，沿着小路一直走向前方那扇巍峨的黑门。 [silly|如果他的心情再糟糕一些，他的额头上恐怕就会聚集起乌云了。 ]当你从藏身之处探出头来时，那些弥诺陶洛斯守卫们纷纷站了起来，回到了自己的岗位上。那个头戴羽冠的领导者则站在小路的中央。 哎呀。凯尔萨兹国王——他开始说话，然后清了清嗓子，当意识到是谁正在靠近时，便放下了那种正式的肌肉度，转而采用了更加随意、亲切的交谈方式。哦，是吗。你大门是根据国王的命令关闭的，请离开吧。 冲锋者队的队长拒绝合作，这一举动反而让希鲁德更加愤怒，这个雇佣兵于是提高了音量，开始大声咆哮。我是科尔米诺斯的公民，享有该城赋予的一切权利！你们竟然要拒绝我回到自己的故乡，这些可悲的守卫们？ 空气中弥漫着一丝紧张的气氛，两人之间似乎有火花在闪烁，这时其中一名守卫走上前，低声对队长说了些什么，队长点了点头。 很好。我的下属刚刚提醒我，市民是可以重新进入的，不过需要接受两周的隔离。我们会在营地的一边为你们准备帐篷，你们需要在那里隔离直到这段时间结束。我们还会派一位地位较高的女性来照顾你们，确认你们是否感染了据说正在蔓延的那种‘腐败病毒’。这些条件你们能接受吗？ 这太离谱了！希鲁德发出怒吼，同时伸手去拿他的武器。你不能这样做！我是公民啊！我拥有权利，那些权利正是我因为在军团中服役了六年才换来的！ 船长平静地与希鲁德的目光对视。我完全可以，而且确实是在你们所声称的那种权威的支撑下这样做的。我建议你们不要在这里使用暴力；你们的胜算微乎其微。我们人数众多，而你们只不过是其中的一个而已。 我不需要任何同伴！我是一个独来独往的人，而你呢，总是躲在下属的背后！ 队长叹了口气，显得极为厌恶，他捏了捏自己的鼻梁。然后，他猛地一拳击中了希鲁德的面部，那清脆的声响在山脚的岩石墙壁间回荡。希鲁德踉跄了一下，两名“冲锋者”卫兵立刻上前，抓住他的肩膀，将他强行拖走了。当你最后一次看到这个烦人的雇佣兵时，他正捂着流血的鼻子，对着队长怒吼着咒骂声。 你不能这样，混蛋！我是有权利的！我知道你看着别的男人和你妻子发生关系会感到兴奋！我父亲一定会知道这件事的！我—— 声音突然消失了，取而代之的是一片宁静，这种宁静仿佛填补了原本的空虚。 [party.has brint| 那么，你对这一切有什么看法？你可以去问布林特。 你的弥诺陶洛斯伙伴正在挠自己的后颈。"喀。一方面，我必须承认，我完全理解他的处境。对于一个热血沸腾的弥诺陶洛斯来说，在一个小帐篷里无所事事地待上两周，简直就是一种折磨。如果国王真的不希望有人回来，那么这种方式未尝不是一种既不直接拒绝他人，又能达到目的好办法。 另一方面，冲锋者队就像是国王的亲卫队；如果他派他们来这里担任守卫，那一定是打算严防死守，不让任何人进入。任何敢于对他们动手的人——更别说那些本应明白事理的弥诺陶洛斯了——都必将自食其果。 ] 无论如何，有一点是肯定的：考虑到他们能够如此轻易地击败像希鲁德这样经验丰富的雇佣兵，这些弥诺陶洛斯对于守门卫兵来说确实是个相当棘手的对手。除非你对自己的剑术非常有信心，否则挑战他们可能并不是一个明智的选择。现在，轮到你上前了。
rows.raw: " [flags.GATEGUARD_ENCOUNTERED |As the high black ramparts of the King's Gate come into view once more |As the mountain's base draws near ], a most unsubtle plodding echoes from the rope bridge behind you. Turning, you see a dark, shaggy shape storming up from your rear, each heavy footstep sending the stout bridge to creaking along its chasm-spanning length. Oh boy. It's him. [var0 |While giving Hirrud Grune a good smack on the snout might be satisfying, it's probably not worth it with him like this. After all, you don't want to give him any excuses to avoid admitting his defeat at your hands — there's no fun in claiming victory over weakened prey. |Given what happened the last time you met, you just want to avoid the shaggy bastard as much as possible. ] As luck would have it, there's a nice, fat boulder big enough for you[party.som|| and [party.compNames]|, [party.compNames]] to keep out of his view. Hirrud doesn't notice you at all. The minotaur mercenary seems lost in his own dark thoughts as he storms past you, up the path and right up to the looming black gates ahead. [silly|If he were in any more foul a mood, he'd have thunderclouds orbiting his brow. ]As you peek out from your hiding place, the minotaur gate guard rise and attend to their posts, the plume-helmed leader taking his position in the middle of the path. "Ay-ah. King Kelsaz —" he begins, then clears his throat and drops the formal accent as he realizes who's approaching, assuming a much more conversational tone. "Oh. It's you. The gate is closed by order of the king. Go away." The Charger captain's refusal just serves to incense Hirrud even further, and the mercenary raises his voice to a bellow. "I am a citizen of Khor'minos, with all its privileges! You would deny me entry to my homeland, pitiful sentry?" There's a moment's tension, a spark in the air between the two, then one of the guards comes up and whispers something to his captain, who nods. "Very well. My subordinate has just reminded me that citizens are permitted re-entry, subject to a quarantine duration of two weeks. We will prepare a tent for you off to one side of our encampment, and you will stay there in isolation until this time is up. One of the high womenfolk will also be summoned to see to you and determine if you have been infected by the corruption that is said to be spreading on the surface. Are these acceptable terms?" "This is outrageous!" Hirrud roars, already reaching for his weapon. "You can't do this! I am a citizen! I have rights, rights that I served six years in the legion for!" The captain meets Hirrud's gaze levelly. "I can and I am, under that same authority that you claim to derive such rights from. I suggest that you do no violence here; the odds are against you. We are many, and you are but one." "I need no companions! I am an army of one, as opposed to you, who cowers behind his underlings!" The captain sighs, looking absolutely disgusted as he pinches the bridge of his muzzle. Then in one swift blow, he sinks his knuckles into Hirrud's face, the resultant crack echoing along the rocky walls of the foothills. Hirrud reels, and two of the Charger guards come up, grab him from under the shoulders, and firmly whisk him away down the path. The last you see of the vexatious mercenary is him clutching his bloodied snout, roaring invective at the captain. "You cannot do this, whoreson! I have rights! I know you derive pleasure from watching other men mate with your wife! My father will hear of this! I —" The sound abruptly fades, leaving blessed silence rushing in to fill the void. [party.has brint| "Well, what do you make of all of that?" you ask Brint. Your minotaur companion scratches the back of his neck. "Khaak. On one hand, I can't say I don't see where he's coming from. Two weeks in a small tent doing nothing is torture for a hot-blooded minotaur. If the king doesn't want anyone returning, it's a good way of doing it without actually saying no. "On the other hand, the Chargers are the king's personal guard; if he's sent them up here as sentries, he seriously means to keep the gates closed. Anyone — let alone a minotaur who should know better — who raises a hand against them deserves what's coming their way." ] Either way, one thing's for sure: considering how they took out an experienced mercenary like Hirrud with ease, these minotaurs are pretty tough for gate guards. Challenging them probably isn't going to be a smart idea unless you're really confident in your sword arm. Now, it's your turn to approach. "

rows.original:
A whisk of the [pc.hand] is all it takes to get your harem's attention. "[pc.dcb|Answer me this... say I'm ready to settle down. What would you three like to do? What should we do with our children?|When my tasks are complete... should we go anywhere? Where do you think our children would be best raised?|Y'know, I was thinking. I think it's too cold to raise kids up here. Where should we go when we've got a big happy family?]"

    Calill, Selima, and Yset all blurt something and pause, realizing they'd have all spoken over each other. Magnetic glances are exchanged, and Selima seems to draw the imaginary straw that allows her to talk first.
    
    "I would love to go south. Away from the deserts, and the cold. Somewhere in the center of where Belhar stood," she replies, wistfully. "Where there are trees that change color in the Autumn. Where the grass is deep green and the wind brushes over it. Perhaps a home for all of us there."
    
    You can imagine it. A lovely little hamlet, bordering a lush forest. Safe, secure. Perhaps a babbling brook nearby to complete the image. [silly|Everyone — especially Lumia — knows how many fucking wombs you'll be impregnating over the course of this game anyway. That space would help.]
    
    Calill talks next. "I would actually like to go home to Jassira. The desert isn't bad, really. But if you'd prefer to avoid it, I've always thought it would be..." She pauses, green eyes swimming in contemplation. "Somewhere... on a coast. Every day we could wake up to the sounds of the sea nearby. There's nothing like that in the Frost Marches. That would be my ideal home. Still..." Calill giggles, staring pointedly. "As long as I'm — we're with you, that's all that matters."
    
    Yset folds her arms. "That's what I was gonna say, but not so embarrassingly. Jeez, Cally..." 
    
    Come on. You're to believe Yset doesn't have an ideal home?
    
    "Love the mountains; high places, living in hills, but there's usually no space for living, y'know? Or growing stuff. And it makes trading a pain." She shrugs. "Feels good being perched above people, is all..."
    
    You laugh. How like a catfolk thief.
    
    Nevertheless, those are some of the options available to you, once you finish your quests. Hopefully, you will. You have so many (currently tiny) reasons to fight on, now.

    卡利尔、塞利玛和伊塞特同时脱口说了些什么，又在意识到彼此会盖过声音后一起停住。三道目光仿佛受到磁力吸引般交汇；塞利玛似乎抽中了看不见的签，可以第一个开口。
    
    “我很想去南方。远离沙漠，也远离严寒。去贝尔哈昔日疆域的中心某处，”她向往地答道。“那里有在秋日变换色彩的树木，有深绿色的青草，微风从草浪上轻轻拂过。或许我们所有人都能在那里拥有一个家。”
    
    你可以想象那幅画面。一座可爱的村庄，坐落在葱郁森林边缘。安全，安稳。附近或许还有一条潺潺小溪，为景色画上最后一笔。[silly|所有人——尤其是卢米娅——都知道，在这场游戏中，你究竟要让多少该死的子宫怀上孩子。宽敞一点总有好处。]
    
    接着轮到卡利尔。“其实我想回贾西拉。沙漠并没有那么糟，真的。但如果你不想去那里，我一直觉得……”她停了下来，绿色眼眸中思绪翻涌。“某个……海岸边的地方。每天醒来，我们都能听见近处的海浪声。霜冻边境没有这样的地方。那会是我理想的家。不过……”卡利尔咯咯笑着，意味深长地凝视着你。“只要我——只要我们和你在一起，其他都不重要。”
    
    伊塞特抱起双臂。“我本来也想这么说，只是不会说得那么难为情。真是的，卡莉……”
    
    拜托。你才不信伊塞特没有理想中的家。
    
    “我喜欢山地；喜欢高处，喜欢住在山丘上，可那里通常没什么地方居住，明白吗？也没地方种东西。而且做生意还很麻烦。”她耸耸肩。“我只是喜欢高高待在人们头顶上的感觉……”
    
    你笑了。真像一名猫族盗贼。
    
    无论如何，等你完成自己的使命，这些都是可供选择的去处。希望你能够做到。如今，你已经有太多（目前还很小的）理由继续战斗。

As for Selima: she was morose upon our arrival, and was difficult to coax out of the house for several days. Just as I first sat down to write this letter, however, a brace of Lumian paladins from Barania came through town, and I quietly arranged for Selima to have no choice but to bump into them. They've been talking for six hours now, straight into the depths of night. From the good-hearted laughs I hear from the porch outside, I have high hopes they've done the poor girl some good. I doubt the Narevan chapel in town will have any competition for a while, but perhaps there will once more be a spark of light in our dear Selima's eyes! None of this would have been possible without you. I lack the words for proper thanks, but rest assured: if you're ever in Taelrysa, there shall always be a warm bed, a hot meal, and many, many hugs waiting for you! Your friend, Calill Gerridan
rows.translation: “哦，[pc.name]！” 你朝镇广场的英雄雕像望去；那位雪发猫女吟游诗人正从那里挥舞着一小片羊皮纸。“有信使给你送了东西。他让我等你下次进城时把它交给你。” 你[pc.bg scholar noblescion |认出了蜡封上压印的纹章：它属于一个小贵族家庭——格里丹家族；他们曾在少女河下游约两周船程处拥有一片男爵领。你原以为他们已在神战中全数覆灭；不过至少看来，有人继承了他们的徽记。 |认不出蜡封上压印的纹章。 ] 打开蜡封后，信纸舒展开来，露出一页纤细而连贯的笔迹： 我最亲爱的[pc.name]： 多亏了你的英勇和慷慨，塞利玛、伊塞特和我已经回到了我曾任镇议员的小镇。格鲁恩绑架我以后，我的长女接下了这个职位；她张开双臂欢迎我们，还在村庄中心与我们共享一间房屋。 我们都同意，我主持事务的岁月早已过去；不过，我找到了远比自己所需更加充足的事务，那就是溺爱刚出生的小外孙。 伊塞特已经很好地适应了定居生活，还将自己的匕首献给了一队猎人；他们负责清除森林和河道间的强盗与怪物。我敢说，小队首领已经对她颇有好感，还声称她拥有成为优秀猎兽人的资质。至于我，我只是很高兴她找到了一个施展本领、又不会伤害善良正直之人的去处。 至于塞利玛：我们抵达时，她郁郁寡欢，有好几天都很难劝出家门。不过，就在我第一次坐下准备写这封信时，两名来自巴拉尼亚的卢米亚圣骑士路过小镇；我悄悄安排了一番，让塞利玛除了与她们相遇以外别无选择。她们已经连续谈了六小时，直至深夜。从外面门廊传来的真诚笑声判断，我非常期待她们已经让这个可怜的姑娘好受了一些。我想镇上的娜瑞瓦教派礼拜堂暂时还不会遇上竞争对手；但或许，我们亲爱的塞利玛眼中会再次燃起一缕光芒！ 没有你，这一切都不可能实现。我找不到合适的语言表达谢意，不过请放心：如果你来到泰尔瑞萨，永远会有一张温暖的床、一顿热腾腾的饭，还有许许多多拥抱等着你！ 你的朋友， 卡利尔·格里丹
rows.raw: " "Oh, [pc.name]!" You glance towards the heroic statue in the town square, whence comes the snow-haired kitten bard waving a scrap of parchment. "Courier came through for you. Asked that I hand this off the next time you came through town." You [pc.bg scholar noblescion |recognize the crest imprinted in the wax seal: it belonged to a minor noble family, the Gerridans, that held a barony about two weeks' sail down the Maiden River from here. You'd thought they were all wiped out in the Godswar, but if nothing else, it seems someone's adopted their sigil. |don't recognize the crest imprinted into the wax seal. ] Once broken, the letter unfolds to reveal a page of delicate, folding script: My dearest [pc.name], Thanks to your heroism and generosity, Selima, Yset, and myself have returned to the town over which I was once alderman. My eldest daughter has assumed the post since Grune kidnapped me, and welcomed us with open arms — and a shared house in the heart of the village. We both agreed that my days of leadership were long past, but I have found more than ample occupation in doting over my newborn grandson. Yset has taken well to settled life, and has already pledged her knives to the band of hunters that keep the forest and riverway clear of bandits and monsters. I dare say the leader of the cadre has already taken quite a shine to her, and claims she has the making of a fine beast-slayer. I for one am just glad she's found an outlet for her skills that don't hurt good, honest folk. As for Selima: she was morose upon our arrival, and was difficult to coax out of the house for several days. Just as I first sat down to write this letter, however, a brace of Lumian paladins from Barania came through town, and I quietly arranged for Selima to have no choice but to bump into them. They've been talking for six hours now, straight into the depths of night. From the good-hearted laughs I hear from the porch outside, I have high hopes they've done the poor girl some good. I doubt the Narevan chapel in town will have any competition for a while, but perhaps there will once more be a spark of light in our dear Selima's eyes! None of this would have been possible without you. I lack the words for proper thanks, but rest assured: if you're ever in Taelrysa, there shall always be a warm bed, a hot meal, and many, many hugs waiting for you! Your friend, Calill Gerridan "

rows.original: [oma.isFree |In your possession is an amulet, and set inside its metal is a ruby. An nondescript power flits through the gemstone as it lays in your hand, inviting you to make use of it. It was given to you by Oma the genie when you wished for her freedom; she told you that if you ever wanted to speak with her again, all you needed to do was touch it and think of her. So, that’s exactly what you do: you touch the ruby with your left index finger and rub your fingertip across its smooth surface once, while keeping Oma’s name in your ears and her face in your mind’s eye. That ought to be enough. You feel a light gust of wind pass by your body as you lower your hand, and a silver ball of smoke, no larger than a marble, fires from the jewel you had just rubbed. It floats in place a few feet in front of you, hovering above the ground at around your chest height, before suddenly, and violently, expanding: the smoke billows outward in every direction, maintaining its shape as an orb. The inside layers of the smoke spin to the left, while the poles spin to the right – before the smoke begins to recede into itself from the top down. Standing within the orb of silver smoke is a tall elven woman with dark-tan skin and shimmering hair that’s rotating through every color of the rainbow, from her scalp to her hair’s tips, before eventually settling on slate silver. The smoke continues to implode in on itself, the bottom of the orb falling out and the smoke dispersing in every direction the longer the whole display continues, until Oma, in all of her glory, is left fully uncovered, standing before you. "It’s good to see you again, [pc.name]," she says to you, her hands folding into each other in front of herself as she eyes you like a girl gathering up the courage to talk to her crush.[flags.|| You ask her if the whole display is necessary. You always thought that the whole show with the lamp was just theatrics; couldn’t she just appear and disappear as she likes? "Yes, I could," she laughs, "but I figured that a whole, seven-foot-tall genie woman blinking into existence over and over might be a more jarring and startling sight than the whole light-and-smoke routine." She crosses her arms and hums in thought. "Funny enough, it’s not as startling when I disappear...." You suppose that makes sense.] |You pull the golden oil lamp from your pack. You want to speak with Oma, the genie within it, again. First, in order to summon her, you need to light the lamp’s wick: the tiny rope sticking from the lamp’s spout. Simple enough – all you have to do there is stick the spout of the lamp into the campfire until it lights. The lamp is empty, but you don’t need oil, and you only need the wick to light for a few seconds. Once it’s alight, you lay the flat of your palm against the bulge of the lamp’s cauldron, and you give it a rub. That’s all it takes for you to summon her: the lamp, recognizing the sequence, begins to bounce and pull in your grip, wanting to get away from you. Your fingers release the lamp’s handle, and the lamp hovers in the air – and soon, shimmering-silver smoke begins to pour from the oil’s spout as the lamp itself begins spinning in place, spewing it in every direction. The smoke stacks on top of itself as it falls, forming a cylinder wide enough for a person to step inside. The column rises up into the air, maintaining its form and staying packed together, until it’s roughly eight feet tall – as tall as Oma with some overhang. After another moment of whirling, tightly-packed white smoke, it, just as quickly as it started, begins to get sucked back into the lamp. And there stands Oma, her eyes trained straight ahead and her back kept stiff. The lamp comes to rest on her upturned palm, held just above her navel, with a new, massive golden chain with thick rings connecting it to a golden choker wrapped around her neck. "[pc.Master]," Oma says once, getting down on one knee reverently as her greeting before standing back up. "Your [oma.wishesLeftRange 1 2 3|wish is|two wishes are|three wishes are] my command." ]
rows.translation: [oma.isFree |你手中握着一件护身符，其金属外壳内部镶嵌着一颗红宝石。当这颗宝石位于你手中时，一种神秘的力量会在其中流动，仿佛在邀请你使用它。这件护身符是精灵奥玛在你为她争取自由时送给你的；她告诉你，如果你以后还想与她通话，只需要触摸这件护身符，然后想着她即可。 所以，你只需要这样做：用左食指轻轻触碰那颗红宝石，然后将指尖在它的光滑表面上滑过一次，同时将奥玛的名字记在心里，她的面容也浮现在你的脑海中。这样应该就足够了。 当你放下手时，感觉到一阵轻风从身体旁掠过，而你刚刚摩擦过的那颗宝石中，突然冒出了一个大小不超过弹珠的银色烟雾球。这个烟雾球在你前方几英尺的地方悬停着，高度大约与你的胸部持平。随后，它突然剧烈地膨胀起来——烟雾向四面八方扩散，但仍然保持着球状的形态。烟雾的内层向左旋转，而烟柱则向右旋转——随后，烟雾开始从上往下逐渐收缩、重新凝聚在一起。 站在那团银色烟雾之中的是一位高个子的精灵女子。她拥有深棕色的皮肤，一头闪烁着光芒的头发从发根到发梢仿佛跃过了彩虹中的所有颜色，最终定格在银灰色之上。随着这场奇妙的视觉表演的持续进行，烟雾不断向内收缩，烟雾球的底部逐渐暴露出来，烟雾也向四面八方散开，直到最终，这位奥玛以她全部的美丽姿态完全展现在你的面前。 再次见到你真是太好了， [pc.name]，她说着，双手在身前交叠在一起，目光注视着你，就像一个女孩正在鼓起勇气去和自己喜欢的人说话一样。[flags.|| 你问她，是否真的有必要进行这样的表演。你一直觉得，那些灯光效果只不过是些花招而已；她难道不能随心所欲地出现或消失吗？ “嗯，我当然是可以的，”她笑着说，“但我觉得，一个七英尺高的精灵女子反复地出现或消失，这种场景可能会比那些灯光和烟雾的效果更加震撼、更加引人注目。”她双臂交叉，若有所思地哼着小曲。“说来也怪，当我真正这么做的时候，反而没有那么令人惊讶了消失……” “你认为这样挺合理的吧。] |你从背包中取出了那盏金色的油灯，想要再次与其中的精灵奥玛交谈。 首先，为了召唤她，你需要点燃灯芯——那根从灯口伸出来的细绳。其实很简单，只需将灯口插入营火中，直到灯芯被点燃即可。虽然灯里没有油，但点燃灯芯只需要几秒钟的时间，因此你并不需要添加油。 一旦灯被点燃，你只需将手掌平放在灯盏的凸起部分上，轻轻揉搓一下。 就这样，你就能召唤到她了：灯会识别到这个动作，开始在手中跳动、挣扎，仿佛想要摆脱你的控制。你的手指松开灯柄，灯便悬停在半空中——很快，银色的烟雾就会从灯嘴中喷出，而灯本身也会开始旋转，将烟雾向四面八方喷射开来。 这些烟雾在下落的过程中不断堆积，最终形成了一根足够宽大、可以让人走进去的圆柱形烟柱。这根烟柱不断向上延伸，始终保持着原有的形态且紧密地凝聚在一起，直到它的高度达到大约八英尺——这个高度差不多和奥玛一样高，而且还稍微有些突出。在继续旋转了一会儿之后，这些紧密堆积的白色烟雾又迅速被吸回了灯笼里。 奥玛就站在那里，目光直视前方，背部僵硬地挺立着。一盏灯悬在她微微仰起的掌心之上，掌心位置略高于她的肚脐。一条由粗大的金环组成的新链条将这盏灯与她脖子上佩戴的金项圈连接在一起。 "[pc.Master]您的，”奥玛一边恭敬地单膝跪地行礼，一边说道，随后便站了起来。 [oma.wishesLeftRange 1 2 3|愿望就是……|两个愿望|三个愿望]我的命令。 ]

rows.original: You pull out the old oil lamp that you [flags.KQUEEN_BROWSE |had taken from the Kobold Queen's gold stash |bought from the street peddler in Khor'minos ]. It’s been taking up space in your pack up until this point, but you also have some oil handy; it couldn’t hurt to put it to use now that you’ve set up camp. [pc.isBimbo |Imagine how happy the lamp will be to finally be used again! |It’ll give you a few hours of some gentle light – good to read something by, perhaps. ] Before you put the oil in, you fashion a simple wick from woven hemp grass to feed into the spout, and you give the lamp a quick, not-particularly-thorough cleaning along the inside and the outside; enough to be confident that the dirt won’t affect the quality of the oil and that it won’t be uncomfortable to place your hand on its side. As you do, you’re distracted by the etchings on the side of the lamp again, so you give that spot in particular a thorough cleaning. Once you’re done, you recognize what the etchings are: lettering. Instructions on how to work the lamp? But they aren’t written in Belharan, or, in fact, any language that you immediately recognize. [party.has Atugia |You call Atugia to your side – maybe she can recognize it? Atugia gently lifts the lamp to her eyes, her face scrunching up as she studies the text on its side. "This is Jotun lettering," she announces after a few moments. "At least, I’m pretty sure." You clarify: she doesn’t know for absolute certain? "This lamp’s been so badly weathered that all the lines and squiggles that could tell me for sure have been sanded off," she explains. "But there’s still a few letters that I can make out." If there’s so little to go by, then she probably couldn’t tell you what it said. "Yeah, sorry," she says with a shrug, handing the lamp back to you. "There’s enough here for a sentence, maybe two, but even if the letters weren’t so faded, it’s been a hell of an age since I last studied my Jotun. But hey!" she continues, bounding on her feet, "that means that this lamp is ancient! You’ve got yourself a real artifact, [pc.name] – there’s history to learn with it! If you decide you don’t want it, I’ll take it off your hands." You tell her that you’ll keep that in mind, and you excuse yourself. |A mystery that’ll go unsolved for now, unfortunately. ] Once you’re satisfied with how clean the lamp is, you lift the lid and pour in the oil before closing it again. All that’s left is to set the wick aflame.[party.has Agnimitra | Before you do, you call out for Agnimitra – perhaps she’d like to do the honors? "You need something on fire?" she asks with a bright smile. She snaps her fingers, and when she does, her index finger lights up, wreathed in a gentle flame. "I’m your gal!" She takes the oil lamp from your hands, holding it by its wide base... and then stops. Her finger stays lifted into the air, the fire dancing in the light breeze of the camp, but she doesn’t light the wick. Instead, she stares at the lamp, like she had just found a piece of art that truly spoke to her. You ask her if she’s alright. She’s a million miles away. "Uh," she says with a start, blinking her eyes a few times and shaking her head, causing the fiery red plumes on her scalp to flare up. "Yeah. Yeah... I’m fine, just... I’m getting such a wicked case of déjà vu right now." Oh, does she recognize the lamp? It’s pretty old, and she’s been reborn who knows how many times by now. It’s reasonable to think she might know where it’s from, or who made it. At first, Agnimitra doesn’t answer. Her eyes are firmly trained on the lamp. "Mmmmmaybe?" she grunts, her face eventually scrunching up and tilting to one side as she desperately tries to remember. "Gods, this looks so familiar. Everything about this. I feel like I remember lighting an oil lamp like this before, and it was a big deal back then." Well, you reassure her that, as far as you know, it’s just an ordinary oil lamp. You cleaned it out and put in the oil yourself just now. Maybe it was important because she was around when oil lamps were first invented. "Right, maybe," she says under her breath, her brow furrowing in frustration. After another moment, she blinks a few more times, and her expression resets. "Well, whatever. I’m sure it’ll come to me later." Without further ado, Agnimitra brings her light finger to the wick and sets it alight. She holds the lamp by the base for another moment, her arm outstretched, keeping it pointed away from herself... And nothing happens. She turns the lamp around so that the handle is facing you. "Enjoy!" she says, and then she leaves. | Gently holding the lamp by its handle, you step towards the campfire, bringing the spout to the flame’s edge. The oil swishes inside the lamp’s cauldron, making it feel heavier, somehow – like the lamp is anticipating the fire. You can feel its metal getting warmer the closer you bring it to the blaze. When the spout enters the campfire’s flame, there’s a quick spark and a light 'pop!’ as the wick alights. The lamp jumps in your grip, started by the sudden ignition inside it... And then nothing else. Well, now your lamp is lit! So that’s nice. ] You lift the oil lamp into the sky, testing its weight and how far the light of the gentle flame at its spout can reach. Not very far, but it’s not a powerful flame: all it’s meant to do is give you a bit of low light to help navigate your way around your nearest surroundings. Or the words on a page, perhaps. This is nice. Just you and your lamp. You bring your free hand to the lamp’s side, resting your palm against the metal, to see how well the cauldron insulates the heat. Your earlier cleaning job was insufficient, however: when you bring your hand to the lamp’s side, you feel the dirt and grime that you missed more than you feel the metal or the heat inside it. Maybe it just needs a bit more rubbing. You grind your palm across the surface of the lamp a few times....
rows.translation: 你拿出了那盏旧油灯[flags.KQUEEN_BROWSE |从狗头人女王的黄金藏匿处拿走的那些东西 |是从科尔米诺斯的街头小贩那里买来的。 ]直到现在，它还一直占着你背包里的空间，不过你手头也有一些油；既然你已经扎营了，利用这些油也没什么坏处。 [pc.isBimbo |想象一下，那盏灯终于又能被使用了，它该有多开心啊！ |它能够为你提供几小时的柔和光线——这样你就可以在光线下阅读一些东西了。 ] 在倒入油之前，你需要用编织好的麻草制作一个简单的灯芯，将其插入灯嘴中。然后，你需要仔细清洗灯的内部和外部，确保没有污垢残留——这样就能保证油的质量不会受到影响，同时也不会让你在握住灯身时感到不适。就在你准备继续工作的时候，灯身侧面的那些雕刻图案又一次吸引了你的注意力，于是你专门花了一些时间把那个地方彻底清理干净。 清理完毕后，你才意识到那些雕刻图案其实就是文字——应该是关于如何使用这盏灯的说明吧？但这些文字并不是用贝尔哈兰语写的，事实上，也不是用任何你能立刻认出来的语言写的。 [party.has Atugia |你把阿图吉娅叫到身边——也许她能认出这个文字来？ 阿图吉娅轻轻地将灯举到眼前，仔细观察着灯罩上刻着的文字，她的脸微微皱了起来。“这是乔顿族的文字，”过了一会儿，她说道。至少，我相当确定。” 你追问：她并不是百分之百确定？ “这盏灯经过长时间的风吹日晒，那些本可以让我确定真相的痕迹都已经被打磨掉了，”她解释道。不过还是有几个字母我能辨认出来。” 如果可依据的信息这么少，那么她很可能也无法告诉你上面写了什么。 “嗯，抱歉，”她耸了耸肩，把灯递还给你。这里的文字足够写上一两句话了，不过就算这些字母没有那么褪色，自从我上次研究我的‘约顿’文字以来，也已经过去很长时间了。不过，嘿！”她继续说道，突然站了起来，“这说明这盏灯古老的你真的得到了一件珍贵的文物啊。 [pc.name]这件事背后有一段值得了解的历史！如果你决定不想要它了，我愿意帮你处理掉。” 你告诉她你会记住这一点，然后便告辞离开了。 |遗憾的是，这个谜团目前还无法得到解答。 ] 当你确认灯芯已经足够干净时，就可以打开盖子倒入油，然后再盖上盖子。接下来要做的就是点燃灯芯了。[party.has Agnimitra | 在你动手之前，你叫来了阿格尼米特拉——也许她愿意来承担这个任务呢？ “你需要什么东西来点燃吗？”她带着灿烂的笑容问道。她打了个响指，随即她的食指上便燃起了轻轻的火焰。我是你的女人！” 她从你手中接过油灯，握住它宽大的灯座……然后停住了。她的手指还悬在半空中，火焰在营地的微风中闪烁，但她并没有点燃灯芯。相反，她凝视着那盏灯，仿佛刚刚发现了一件真正能触动她心灵的艺术品。 你问她是否没事，但她似乎完全沉浸在自己的思绪之中，仿佛与世隔绝。 “呃，”她突然回过神来，眨了几下眼睛，然后摇了摇头，这一动作使得她头皮上那些火红色的毛发更加显眼了。是的，是的……我没事，只是……此刻有种强烈得要命的似曾相识感。” “哦，她认出这盏灯了吗？它已经很老了，而她也已经重生过不知道多少次了。因此，她应该知道这盏灯是从哪里来的，或者是谁制作的，这也是情理之中的事。 起初，阿格尼米特拉没有回答。她的目光紧紧地盯着那盏灯。“嗯……也许吧？”她低声说道，脸上逐渐浮现出困惑的表情，身体也微微歪向了一侧，拼命地试图回忆起来。“天啊，这个看起来这么熟悉…… 关于这一切，我总觉得自己以前曾经这样点燃过油灯，而在那个时候，那确实是一件非常重要的事情。 你安慰她，据你所知，那只是一个普通的油灯而已。你刚才自己把它清理干净，也加了油。也许它确实有些特别之处，因为她在油灯被发明的时候就在场。 “嗯，也许吧，”她沮丧地低声说道，眉头紧锁。过了一会儿，她又眨了几下眼睛，表情恢复了平静。“算了，反正迟早会知道的。 毫不迟疑，阿格尼米特拉用她那纤细的手指触碰灯芯，点燃了它。她将灯握在底座处，手臂伸直，确保灯光不会朝向自己…… 然而，什么也没有发生。她将灯转过来，让把手朝向你，说道：“请享用吧！”说完便离开了。 | 你轻轻握住灯的把手，朝着营火走去，将灯口靠近火焰边缘。灯内的油在锅里晃动，使得灯看起来似乎变得更重了——就好像这盏灯正在期待着火焰的温度。当你把金属制品靠近火焰时，会感觉到它逐渐变热。 当灯嘴进入营火中时，会瞬间产生火花，伴随着“啪”的一声，灯芯被点燃了。灯在你的手中突然亮了起来，这一切都是因为内部发生了突然的燃烧反应。然后就再也没有别的了。 好了，现在你的灯亮了！真是太好了。 ] 你将那盏油灯举到空中，测试它的重量，以及灯口处那微弱火焰的光芒能照射多远。其实光线并不是很远，但这种火焰的力量本来也就有限——它的作用仅仅是提供一点微弱的光线，帮助你在周围的环境中辨别方向罢了。或许，也可能是页面上的文字吧。 这真是太好了。只有你和你的灯，而已。 你把空闲的手放在灯的侧面，手掌贴在金属上，想看看这个容器到底能将热量隔离得有多好。不过，你之前的清洁工作显然还不够彻底：当你把手放在灯的侧面时，你感受到的更多的是污垢和灰尘，而不是金属本身或里面的热量。也许只需要再擦几下就可以了。 你将手掌在灯的表面上摩擦了几下……
rows.raw: ' You pull out the old oil lamp that you [flags.KQUEEN_BROWSE |had taken from the Kobold Queen's gold stash |bought from the street peddler in Khor'minos ]. It’s been taking up space in your pack up until this point, but you also have some oil handy; it couldn’t hurt to put it to use now that you’ve set up camp. [pc.isBimbo |Imagine how happy the lamp will be to finally be used again! |It’ll give you a few hours of some gentle light – good to read something by, perhaps. ] Before you put the oil in, you fashion a simple wick from woven hemp grass to feed into the spout, and you give the lamp a quick, not-particularly-thorough cleaning along the inside and the outside; enough to be confident that the dirt won’t affect the quality of the oil and that it won’t be uncomfortable to place your hand on its side. As you do, you’re distracted by the etchings on the side of the lamp again, so you give that spot in particular a thorough cleaning. Once you’re done, you recognize what the etchings are: lettering. Instructions on how to work the lamp? But they aren’t written in Belharan, or, in fact, any language that you immediately recognize. [party.has Atugia |You call Atugia to your side – maybe she can recognize it? Atugia gently lifts the lamp to her eyes, her face scrunching up as she studies the text on its side. "This is Jotun lettering," she announces after a few moments. "At least, I’m pretty sure." You clarify: she doesn’t know for absolute certain? "This lamp’s been so badly weathered that all the lines and squiggles that could tell me for sure have been sanded off," she explains. "But there’s still a few letters that I can make out." If there’s so little to go by, then she probably couldn’t tell you what it said. "Yeah, sorry," she says with a shrug, handing the lamp back to you. "There’s enough here for a sentence, maybe two, but even if the letters weren’t so faded, it’s been a hell of an age since I last studied my Jotun. But hey!" she continues, bounding on her feet, "that means that this lamp is ancient! You’ve got yourself a real artifact, [pc.name] – there’s history to learn with it! If you decide you don’t want it, I’ll take it off your hands." You tell her that you’ll keep that in mind, and you excuse yourself. |A mystery that’ll go unsolved for now, unfortunately. ] Once you’re satisfied with how clean the lamp is, you lift the lid and pour in the oil before closing it again. All that’s left is to set the wick aflame.[party.has Agnimitra | Before you do, you call out for Agnimitra – perhaps she’d like to do the honors? "You need something on fire?" she asks with a bright smile. She snaps her fingers, and when she does, her index finger lights up, wreathed in a gentle flame. "I’m your gal!" She takes the oil lamp from your hands, holding it by its wide base... and then stops. Her finger stays lifted into the air, the fire dancing in the light breeze of the camp, but she doesn’t light the wick. Instead, she stares at the lamp, like she had just found a piece of art that truly spoke to her. You ask her if she’s alright. She’s a million miles away. "Uh," she says with a start, blinking her eyes a few times and shaking her head, causing the fiery red plumes on her scalp to flare up. "Yeah. Yeah... I’m fine, just... I’m getting such a wicked case of déjà vu right now." Oh, does she recognize the lamp? It’s pretty old, and she’s been reborn who knows how many times by now. It’s reasonable to think she might know where it’s from, or who made it. At first, Agnimitra doesn’t answer. Her eyes are firmly trained on the lamp. "Mmmmmaybe?" she grunts, her face eventually scrunching up and tilting to one side as she desperately tries to remember. "Gods, this looks so familiar. Everything about this. I feel like I remember lighting an oil lamp like this before, and it was a big deal back then." Well, you reassure her that, as far as you know, it’s just an ordinary oil lamp. You cleaned it out and put in the oil yourself just now. Maybe it was important because she was around when oil lamps were first invented. "Right, maybe," she says under her breath, her brow furrowing in frustration. After another moment, she blinks a few more times, and her expression resets. "Well, whatever. I’m sure it’ll come to me later." Without further ado, Agnimitra brings her light finger to the wick and sets it alight. She holds the lamp by the base for another moment, her arm outstretched, keeping it pointed away from herself... And nothing happens. She turns the lamp around so that the handle is facing you. "Enjoy!" she says, and then she leaves. | Gently holding the lamp by its handle, you step towards the campfire, bringing the spout to the flame’s edge. The oil swishes inside the lamp’s cauldron, making it feel heavier, somehow – like the lamp is anticipating the fire. You can feel its metal getting warmer the closer you bring it to the blaze. When the spout enters the campfire’s flame, there’s a quick spark and a light 'pop!’ as the wick alights. The lamp jumps in your grip, started by the sudden ignition inside it... And then nothing else. Well, now your lamp is lit! So that’s nice. ] You lift the oil lamp into the sky, testing its weight and how far the light of the gentle flame at its spout can reach. Not very far, but it’s not a powerful flame: all it’s meant to do is give you a bit of low light to help navigate your way around your nearest surroundings. Or the words on a page, perhaps. This is nice. Just you and your lamp. You bring your free hand to the lamp’s side, resting your palm against the metal, to see how well the cauldron insulates the heat. Your earlier cleaning job was insufficient, however: when you bring your hand to the lamp’s side, you feel the dirt and grime that you missed more than you feel the metal or the heat inside it. Maybe it just needs a bit more rubbing. You grind your palm across the surface of the lamp a few times.... '

rows.original: After a moment, you’ve brushed off enough of the dirt and grime that you feel the heat that you were looking for radiate from the lamp’s metal cauldron. It’s pretty warm – warmer than you had expected. And getting hotter. You stop rubbing, resting your fingers against the lamp’s surface... but the lamp itself continues to bounce and jostle, like you hadn’t stopped. You pull your whole hand away from it, and the[pc.isDK | damn ] thing keeps moving on its own, like a rat was caught inside it and was fighting to escape. It pulls and yanks on the fingers looped through its handle, fighting to get away from you, and as it does, the flame on its wick suddenly extinguishes – and out from its spout billows a thick, silvery smoke that doesn’t light into the sky: it sinks to the ground.[pc.isBimbo | Wow, you must have been more right than you thought: this lamp is really happy to be used! ] You don’t want to just toss the oil lamp away – you might cause a fire. But the decision is made for you: with a particularly strong yank, the oil lamp pulls itself free from your fingers, but rather than drop to the ground, it floats in the air, suspended on nothing. The silvery smoke continues to spill from its spout at an incredible rate: already it’s blown more smoke than you feel like the little lamp should have been able to hold. The lamp spins in a circle as clouds of smoke pour from its spout, spewing the smoke in every direction as it goes. But similarly to how the smoke doesn’t rise, it also doesn’t spread out: it falls in a neat circular pile to the ground, piling up and up on top of itself, forming a tight cylinder until the smoke obscures the lamp. And even then, the smoke continues to pile up, slowly reaching higher into the sky. A part of you realizes that this is very much not normal, and perhaps you should start running: who knows what you might have just unleashed? But another, larger part of you is curious – terribly curious. Wielding magic isn’t uncommon in Savarra, and [pc.isMage |even you don’t have any idea what could be causing this |you very much doubt any mage in Savarra could tell you what’s happening. All you did was light some oil ]! The smoke clouds spin and rotate with the lamp inside its cylinder, the layers of the smoke spinning in opposite directions – before suddenly picking up speed, a lot of it. In front of you is a whirling pillar of whitish smoke... until, just as suddenly, all of the smoke begins to get sucked back into the cylinder’s center, as if the oil lamp was inhaling it all back in. The pillar shrinks from the top down, vanishing back into the lamp and dropping the cylinder. After a few inches of smoke disappears, you see the curve of someone’s head, adorned by long, flowing silver hair. Someone’s in there! More and more of the person inside the cloud is revealed to you as the smoke disappears back into the lamp. Where there was nobody before, there’s now an elven woman with a flawless, dark-tan complexion, standing maybe seven feet tall, and with two of the brightest, fiercest gray irises you’ve ever seen. Her shimmering-silver hair is fashioned into a ponytail as thick around as your arm and reaches down to her ankles. And as the smoke continues to vanish, you see that she’s not wearing a lot of clothes: a simple, functional, but largely inelegant white cloth with gold trimmings covers her shoulders and chest, and a pair of expansive harem pants with a similar color style make her legs look four times thicker than they probably are. With one final puff, the last of the smoke is sucked back into the lamp, which is now resting flatly on the woman’s upturned right palm, with her left hand held behind her back. You’re pretty sure it’s the same lamp, but the one she’s holding is polished to a mirror shine, its metal flawless all around without a single chink anywhere to be found. Although... there’s another chain on it, this one much larger, thicker, and heavier, and rather than connecting to itself, it instead connects to a large, thick, solid-gold choker surrounding the woman’s neck. The woman [pc.heightRange 0 80 86 |looks down at you |looks across at you |looks up at you ], regarding you with an expression that’s difficult to judge[pc.cunningRange 0 75 |. |, although from the way her lips subtly curl downwards and her eyes lock fiercely onto yours, you’d best describe it as 'muted disdain.’ ] Her back is straight and stiff: her posture is immaculate, as if she’s been trained to stand this way all her life. After a tense moment – with you mostly still reeling from what you’ve seen, and from what you are seeing – the tall woman lowers herself, getting on one knee and bowing her head to you in reverence. "I am at your command, [pc.Master]," she says.
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，你擦去了足够的灰尘和污垢，这时你感觉到，那盏灯的金属灯罩确实散发出你一直在寻找的温暖热量。温度相当高——比你预想的还要高。 而且温度还在继续上升。 你停止了擦拭，将手指放在灯的表面上……但那盏灯它自己它继续弹来弹去，仿佛你从未停止过操作。你把手完全从它上面拿开，然后[pc.isDK | 该死 ]那个东西会自己不停地移动，就好像里面有一只老鼠正在拼命试图逃脱。它会拉扯那些缠在把手上的手指，拼命想要摆脱你的控制。而就在它这样挣扎的时候，灯芯上的火焰突然熄灭了——从它的喷嘴中冒出了浓浓的银色烟雾，这些烟雾并没有升向天空，而是沉向了地面。[pc.isBimbo | 哇，你猜对了，这个灯确实非常棒。真的很高兴能被使用！ ] 你肯定不想把油灯随便扔掉，否则可能会引发火灾。但这个决定已经为你做好了：当你用力一拉时，油灯竟然从你的手指间脱离出来，却没有掉落到地上，而是悬在了半空中，仿佛没有任何东西在支撑它一样。银色的烟雾以惊人的速度不断从灯口喷出：已经产生了比你想象中这盏小灯应该能够容纳的还要多的烟雾。 随着烟雾层层弥漫，灯体开始旋转，那些烟雾则向四面八方喷射开来。但就像烟雾不会向上扩散一样，它也不会向四周散开：它会整齐地呈圆形堆积在地面上，一层层叠加在一起，最终形成一个紧密的圆柱体，直到烟雾完全遮住了那盏灯。即便到了这个时候，烟雾依然会继续堆积，缓缓地向天空升高。 你内心有一部分意识到，这种情况绝对不正常，或许你应该立刻逃跑：谁知道你刚刚释放了什么危险的东西呢？但另一部分、更为强烈的欲望却在驱使着你——你充满了好奇心。非常糟糕地真是奇怪。在萨瓦拉，使用魔法其实并不罕见[pc.isMage |就连你也不知道究竟是什么导致了这种情况。 |你绝对怀疑萨瓦拉的任何法师都能告诉你到底发生了什么。你所做的，只不过是点燃了一些油而已。 ]烟雾在灯管内部旋转、翻腾，不同层次的烟雾以相反的方向运动——然后突然加速，开始剧烈地旋转起来。很多就在你眼前，一柱白色的烟雾开始旋转上升……然而突然间，所有的烟雾都仿佛被吸回了油灯的中心，整个柱状烟雾从上到下逐渐消失，重新回到了油灯内部，同时那个圆柱体也掉落了下来。当几英寸的烟雾散去后，你看到了某人头部的轮廓，那头长发飘逸而银轻型闪闪——里面确实有人！ 随着烟雾重新被吸入灯内，那个人的身影也逐渐变得清晰起来。在原本空无一人的地方，现在站着一位精灵女子。她拥有完美无瑕的深褐色肌肤，身高约有七英尺，那双灰色的眼眸更是璀璨夺目，是你见过的最明亮、最凶烈的眼睛。她那闪闪发光的银色长发被扎成马尾辫，其粗细几乎与你的手臂相当，一直垂到她的脚踝处。随着烟雾逐渐散去，你看到她身上并没有穿太多衣服：一件简单实用、但略显笨重的白色布料衣物，上面带有金色装饰，覆盖着她的肩膀和胸部；而一条颜色相近的宽大哈伦裤则让她的双腿看起来比实际粗壮了许多。 随着最后一口烟的吸入，剩下的烟雾都被重新吸回了灯里。此时，那盏灯平放在女子翻过来的右手上，而她的左手则背在身后。你漂亮确实，那是同一盏灯，但她手中的那盏已经被打磨得光亮如镜，它的金属部分毫无瑕疵，到处都看不到任何裂痕。不过……灯上还挂着另一条链子，这条链子要大得多、粗得多，也重得多。它并不是连接在灯上，而是连接在一条由纯金制成的粗大项链上，这条项链紧紧地环绕在那个女人的脖子上。 那个女人[pc.heightRange 0 80 86 |看不起你 |正注视着你 |抬头看着你 ]用一种让人难以判断的表情看着你[pc.cunningRange 0 75 |。 |不过，从她嘴唇微微下垂、目光紧紧锁定在你身上的那副神情来看，这种情绪更应该被描述为“隐忍的轻蔑”。 ]她的背部笔直而僵硬：她的姿势堪称完美，仿佛她一生都接受过这样的训练，才得以保持这样的站立姿态。 在那一紧张的时刻之后——而你此时仍然沉浸在刚才所看到的一切之中，无法回过神来是看到这一幕——那位高个女子低下身子，单膝跪地，低头向你表示敬意。 “我听从您的命令。 [pc.Master]她是这么说的。

All you did was light some oil ]! The smoke clouds spin and rotate with the lamp inside its cylinder, the layers of the smoke spinning in opposite directions – before suddenly picking up speed, a lot of it. In front of you is a whirling pillar of whitish smoke... until, just as suddenly, all of the smoke begins to get sucked back into the cylinder’s center, as if the oil lamp was inhaling it all back in. The pillar shrinks from the top down, vanishing back into the lamp and dropping the cylinder. After a few inches of smoke disappears, you see the curve of someone’s head, adorned by long, flowing silver hair. Someone’s in there! More and more of the person inside the cloud is revealed to you as the smoke disappears back into the lamp. Where there was nobody before, there’s now an elven woman with a flawless, dark-tan complexion, standing maybe seven feet tall, and with two of the brightest, fiercest gray irises you’ve ever seen. Her shimmering-silver hair is fashioned into a ponytail as thick around as your arm and reaches down to her ankles. And as the smoke continues to vanish, you see that she’s not wearing a lot of clothes: a simple, functional, but largely inelegant white cloth with gold trimmings covers her shoulders and chest, and a pair of expansive harem pants with a similar color style make her legs look four times thicker than they probably are. With one final puff, the last of the smoke is sucked back into the lamp, which is now resting flatly on the woman’s upturned right palm, with her left hand held behind her back. You’re pretty sure it’s the same lamp, but the one she’s holding is polished to a mirror shine, its metal flawless all around without a single chink anywhere to be found. Although... there’s another chain on it, this one much larger, thicker, and heavier, and rather than connecting to itself, it instead connects to a large, thick, solid-gold choker surrounding the woman’s neck. The woman [pc.heightRange 0 80 86 |looks down at you |looks across at you |looks up at you ], regarding you with an expression that’s difficult to judge[pc.cunningRange 0 75 |. |, although from the way her lips subtly curl downwards and her eyes lock fiercely onto yours, you’d best describe it as 'muted disdain.’ ] Her back is straight and stiff: her posture is immaculate, as if she’s been trained to stand this way all her life. After a tense moment – with you mostly still reeling from what you’ve seen, and from what you are seeing – the tall woman lowers herself, getting on one knee and bowing her head to you in reverence. "I am at your command, [pc.Master]," she says. '

rows.original: You stay on your back foot, your arms up defensively, still shocked by everything that’s happened. You have a million and one questions going through your head but your mouth can’t grasp onto any of them. After a moment, the woman stands, returning to her previous stance. "I am Oma," she says, her eyes locking onto yours. "I am a denizen of the lamp. Whomsoever possesses the lamp and summons me from within it is entitled to any three wishes that their heart desires." [pc.isBimbo |Her words go in through one ear and out the other. You’re too distracted from... current events. "That was awesome!" you eventually say, bounding on your [pc.feet] in excitement. "Did you see that? All that smoke came from the lamp; then it went all 'fwoosh!’ as it got all piled up; and then it got sucked all back into the lamp, and now–" You pause, realizing that you’re speaking to someone new. "Gosh, you’re pretty! Have we met?" |Your eyes keep traveling from her and her admittedly-striking-beauty, to the lamp. You didn’t imagine all of that. Whatever just happened, this is real – you lit the wick; you gave the lamp a rub; and now, here’s a woman claiming that she can grant you any three wishes that you want. ] Oma takes a deep breath in through her nose. Her nostrils flare as she does so[pc.cunningRange 0 75 |: it’s the practiced restraint of someone having had to deal with idiots all her life ]. "There are, however, three rules," she continues. Her left hand comes out from behind her back, holding one index finger straight up. "First: I cannot directly harm any individual that does not wish for it." Her middle finger rises up. "Second: my powers cannot impress upon any individual’s person, either mentally or physically." Her ring finger rises up. "And third: I cannot grant or bestow life." [pc.isBimbo |Wait, what? Oh, right! She said something about wishes. She can grant wishes? ]You tentatively ask her if answering questions is something she can do for free, without needing to use one of your wishes. "Ask, and I will answer," she says sternly. Okay, that’s good. You start with the first one that comes to mind: what[pc.isBimbo |? | the hell is she? ] Oma hums to herself as she considers how to answer the question. "It seems you still speak Belharan," she answers. "In your language, I would be what you would call a ‘genie.’ I reside within this lamp," she continues, hefting it for emphasis, "and I am at the mercy of any individual that lights the wick and rubs the lamp. You are the latest in a long line of Masters and Mistresses to possess it; ergo, you are the newest [pc.Master]." She... lives in the lamp? But it was empty when you got it! You’ve seen and done a lot of weird things in your life, but for a person to pop out of an oil lamp is... among the more surprising events. Was she that silver smoke that you saw earlier? [pc.isBimbo |And how the heck does a whole person fit in a space that teeny? ] She sighs. "In order: yes; I do not literally, physically reside inside the lamp; [pc.isBimbo |yes; and, I’m sure for an actual [pc.race], with much pain and effort |and yes ]."[party.has Agnimitra | Your phoenix companion Agnimitra stands beside you, but... she’s not nearly as agape as you are about the situation. From the look on her face, she seems more perplexed than anything: her head tilts to one side and her chin rests on her hand as she tries to figure something out. "This is so bizarrely familiar to me," she sighs under her breath. "Hey, Oma. Was I ever your Master once before?" Oma turns her head towards Agnimitra. Her eyes narrow as if Agnimitra had just asked the stupidest question she could have. "Impossible," she says flatly. "Not for me," Agnimitra says back, puffing out her chest and flaring her plume proudly. "I’m a phoenix. You might have heard–" "Impossible," Oma says again, with much more force and finality than before. "Oh, well, guess I’ll go fuck myself, then," Agnimitra says snappily before turning away. ] Then, Oma stands still as a statue, resuming her earlier posture. Her right hand carries the lamp at her navel, and her eyes stay firmly trained on yours. She’s totally at your command. All you have to do is make a wish, and she’ll grant it....
rows.translation: 你仍旧保持着后退的架势，双臂抬起作防御状，仍被刚才发生的一切惊得发懵。成千上万个问题在你脑中翻涌，可你的嘴却一个也抓不住。 过了一会儿，那女人站起身，恢复了先前的姿态。“我是奥玛，”她说，目光锁定在你身上。“我是灯中之灵。无论谁拥有这盏灯，并把我从灯中召唤出来，都有权得到他心中渴望的任何三个愿望。” [pc.isBimbo |她的话左耳进右耳出。你实在被……眼前这些事分心太多。“刚才那太棒了！”你终于说道，兴奋地踩着你的[pc.feet]蹦跳。“你看到了吗？那些烟全都是从那盏灯里冒出来的；然后它们聚成一团，‘呼’地一下；接着又全被吸回灯里，现在——”你顿住了，意识到自己在跟一个陌生人说话。“天哪，你真漂亮！我们见过吗？” |你的目光不断在她——以及她那份不得不承认相当出众的美貌——和那盏灯之间来回移动。刚才的一切并不是你的幻觉。无论发生了什么，这都是真的：你点燃了灯芯，你擦亮了油灯；而现在，有个女人声称她能满足你想要的任何三个愿望。 ] 奥玛用鼻子深吸了一口气，鼻孔随之张开[pc.cunningRange 0 75 |：那是一辈子都在应付蠢货的人练就出来的克制 ]。“不过，有三条规矩，”她继续说道。她的左手从背后伸出来，竖起一根食指。“第一：我不能直接伤害任何不希望受到伤害的人。”她的中指竖起。“第二：我的力量不能在精神或肉体上作用于任何人的身体。”她的无名指竖起。“第三：我无法赐予或赋予生命。” [pc.isBimbo |等等，什么？哦，对了！她说过关于愿望的事。她能实现愿望？ ]你试探着问她，回答问题是不是可以免费进行，不需要动用你的一个愿望。 “问吧，我会回答的。”她严肃地说。 好，那还不错。 你先问出脑中冒出的第一个问题：什么[pc.isBimbo |？ |她到底是什么东西？ ] 奥玛轻声哼着，思考该如何回答这个问题。“看来你还会说贝尔哈兰语，”她答道。“用你们的语言来说，我大概就是你们所说的‘灯神’。我就住在这盏灯里，”她说着，把灯提起来强调，“任何一个点燃灯芯、擦拭油灯的人都能支配我。你是一长串拥有过它的主人和女主人中最新的一个；因此，你就是最新的一任[pc.Master]。” 她……住在灯里？可你拿到它的时候，里面明明是空的！你这辈子见过、做过不少怪事，但一个人从油灯里冒出来……算是其中比较令人吃惊的了。她就是之前你看到的那团银色烟雾吗？ [pc.isBimbo |再说了，一个完整的人到底是怎么塞进那么点大的空间里的？ ] 她叹了口气。“按顺序回答：是的；我并不是真的、物理意义上住在灯里； [pc.isBimbo |是的；而且我敢肯定，对一个真正的[pc.race]来说，那需要极大的痛苦和努力 |是的 ]。”[party.has Agnimitra | 你的凤凰伙伴阿格尼米特拉站在你身边，可是……她对眼前的情况远没有你那么目瞪口呆。从她的表情来看，她更像是困惑：她歪着头，下巴搁在手上，似乎想弄清什么。 “这一切对我来说熟悉得莫名其妙，”她低声叹道。“嘿，奥玛。我以前曾经是你的主人吗？” 奥玛把头转向阿格尼米特拉，眼睛眯了起来，仿佛阿格尼米特拉刚问出了世上最蠢的问题。“不可能，”她干脆地说。 “对我来说可不一定，”阿格尼米特拉挺起胸膛，骄傲地展开羽冠回敬道。“我可是凤凰。你也许听说过——” “不可能，”奥玛又说了一遍，语气比之前更重、更不容置疑。 “哦，那我只好去操自己了，”阿格尼米特拉没好气地说完，转身走开。 ] 随后，奥玛像雕像一样静静站着，恢复了先前的姿态。她的右手把灯端在肚脐处，目光始终牢牢锁定在你身上。 她完全听从你的指挥。你只需许下一个愿望，她就会实现它……

rows.original: Oma claims that she’s a magical genie. Give her a once over to judge for yourself if she looks the part.
rows.translation: 奥玛声称自己是一位魔法灯神。不妨仔细打量她一番，自己判断她看起来像不像灯神。
rows.raw: "Oma claims that she’s a magical genie. Give her a once over to judge for yourself if she looks the part."

rows.original: Ever since you wished for her freedom, Oma’s been rather receptive towards you. She’d probably love to have a chat over absolutely anything.
rows.translation: 自从你表达了希望她获得自由的愿望之后，奥玛对你变得格外友善。她应该会很乐意就任何话题与你聊天。
rows.raw: "Ever since you wished for her freedom, Oma’s been rather receptive towards you. She’d probably love to have a chat over absolutely anything."

rows.original: Oma said that talking with her and asking questions were ‘free.’ There’s certainly a handful of things you’d like to ask a genie!
rows.translation: 奥玛说，和她聊天、向她提问是完全免费的。当然，肯定有很多问题你想问一位精灵吧！
rows.raw: "Oma said that talking with her and asking questions were ‘free.’ There’s certainly a handful of things you’d like to ask a genie!"

rows.original: You still have [oma.wishesLeftRange 1 2 3|one wish|two wishes|three wishes] remaining. Perhaps now is the time to make a wish from Oma.
rows.translation: 你还剩下[oma.wishesLeftRange 1 2 3|一个愿望|两个愿望|三个愿望]。也许现在是时候向奥玛许愿了。
rows.raw: "You still have [oma.wishesLeftRange 1 2 3|one wish|two wishes|three wishes] remaining. Perhaps now is the time to make a wish from Oma."

rows.original: Oma is free to enjoy her life as she likes, but she still has the powers of the genie at her disposal. If you asked nicely, sex with her could be an adventure every time.
rows.translation: 奥玛可以随心所欲地享受她的生活，但她仍然可以随意运用灯神的力量。只要你好好开口请求，和她做爱每次都能成为一场冒险。
rows.raw: "Oma is free to enjoy her life as she likes, but she still has the powers of the genie at her disposal. If you asked nicely, sex with her could be an adventure every time."

rows.original: Tell Oma that it was good to see her, and you’ll be wanting her again soon, but there are other things that need your attention.
rows.translation: 告诉奥玛，见到她真是太高兴了，你很快就会想再见到她的，不过现在还有其他事情需要你去处理。
rows.raw: "Tell Oma that it was good to see her, and you’ll be wanting her again soon, but there are other things that need your attention."

rows.original: Tell Oma that that will be all for now, and that she’s dismissed.
rows.translation: 告诉奥玛，目前就到这里，她可以退下了。
rows.raw: "Tell Oma that that will be all for now, and that she’s dismissed."

rows.original: [oma.isFree |You tell Oma that you enjoy her company, and that it’s good to see her in such high spirits after you had given her your freedom – but as much as you enjoy spending time with your genie, there are other things that need your attention. Those ‘life experiences’ that she said she wanted to follow you around for aren’t going to happen on their own! "I understand," she says, stepping into your personal space. Her left hand goes to your [pc.hips], her fingers coyly playing at the waistband of your [pc.lowerGarments], while her right hand goes to your cheek; her palm gently cups it as she pulls herself closer to you, looking as though she’s going to go in for a kiss but stopping less than an inch from making contact. "Call me again when you can, [pc.name]. I won’t be too far away." When she pulls back, her lips are spread widely enough that her cheeks rise to meet her eyes – and when you blink, she’s vanished so completely, it’s as if she wasn’t ever there. But you can still feel the warmth of her hand on your cheek, and the way her thumb crooked into your waistband, and the wisp of her breath against your neck. All you need is to touch the ruby in the pendant and think of her, and she’ll be right back with you. |[pc.isBimbo |Well... as fun as it’s been talking with Oma, you’re also getting bored. You don’t know what you want to wish for, and while you could think about it, thinking is kinda hard? And there’s other stuff you could be doing instead. |You tell Oma that you still need a bit more time to think about what you want to wish for, and that she’s dismissed for now. You’ll summon her again when you need her. ] "As you say," she says with a deep sigh through her nose. She closes her eyes and bows her head as she gets on one knee – and the silver smoke from the lamp bursts from its spout, fountaining from its tip, enveloping Oma as it had when she appeared. The smoke wraps tightly around herself, forming a thick column that doesn’t reach nearly as high as it did when you summoned her. Once the smoke completely obscures your sight of her, the clouds begin to swirl clockwise, spinning around her kneeling form at a high speed, before, just as quickly as they came out, the clouds are sucked back into the lamp until there aren’t any left. All that remains is a golden oil lamp, standing upright on the ground where Oma was kneeling. If you want to summon her again, all you need is to light the lamp and give it a rub. And, in the meantime, you have a perfectly functional oil lamp, to boot. ]
rows.translation: [oma.isFree |你告诉奥玛，你很享受和她在一起的时光，看到她在你给予她自由之后如此开心，你也很欣慰——不过，尽管你非常喜欢和这位灯神共度时光，但还有其他事情需要你去关注。她说过想跟着你一起去体验那些‘人生经历’，但这些事情不会自动发生啊！ “我明白的，”她说着，走进了你的私人空间。她的左手伸向了你[pc.hips]，她的手指俏皮地拨弄着你的腰带[pc.lowerGarments]，而她的右手轻触你的脸颊，手掌轻轻托住你的脸庞，同时她慢慢靠近你，看起来似乎就要吻你了，却在距离只有不到一英寸的地方停了下来。“有空的时候再给我打电话吧。 [pc.name]我不会离你太远的。” 当她拉开距离时，她的嘴唇张得如此之大，以至于她的脸颊都仿佛升到了眼睛的位置；而当你眨眼时，她就已经彻底消失了，仿佛从来就没有出现过一样。但你仍然能够感受到她手触你脸颊时的温暖，感受到她的拇指是如何勾住你的腰带的，也能感受到她呼出的气息轻拂着你的脖子。 你只需要触摸一下吊坠上的红宝石，然后想着她，她就会立刻回到你身边。 |[pc.isBimbo |嗯……虽然和奥玛聊天确实很有趣，但你也开始感到无聊了。你不知道自己到底想要许什么愿，而且可以想一想，思考其实是一件挺费劲的事情吧？而且你还可以做其他事情来打发时间。 |你告诉奥玛，你还需要一些时间来思考自己究竟想要许什么愿，所以暂时先让她离开吧。等你需要她的时候，会再叫她回来的。 ] “正如你所说，”她从鼻子里深深地叹了口气，闭上眼睛，低下头，单膝跪地——这时，灯盏里的银色烟雾从灯口喷涌而出，如同当初奥玛出现时那样，将她整个人笼罩在了其中。烟雾紧紧地环绕着她，形成了一股浓密的烟柱，其高度远不及你召唤她时那股烟柱那么高。 当烟雾完全遮住了你的视线，那些云雾便开始顺时针方向旋转，以极高的速度围绕着她跪着的身体旋转。而就在它们出现得如此迅速之后，这些云雾又立刻被吸回了灯内，直到再也看不到任何烟雾为止。唯一剩下的，是一盏金色的油灯，它依然竖立在奥玛曾经跪过的那片土地上。 如果你想再次召唤她，只需要点燃这盏灯，然后轻轻擦拭它就可以了。 而且，这样你还会得到一盏完全可以正常使用的油灯呢。 ]

rows.translation: 从外表上看，鉴于那些熟悉的特征——无瑕的肌肤、深棕色的皮肤，以及从头骨上水平伸出的、形状像刀一样的三角形耳朵——你很可能会认为奥玛是一个精灵。但实际上，她远不止于此：她是一位拥有魔力的精灵，只要有人拥有她的灯，她就能满足那个人提出的任意三个愿望。如果你没有亲眼看到她的能力，恐怕很难相信这些。 奥玛的个子足有七英尺高，从脚底到头顶都是如此。她的头上披着一头保养得非常好、闪闪发亮的银色长发，从不同角度观察，这些头发的光泽似乎还会发生变化。她的头发被扎成一个粗得像你的手臂一样的马尾辫，一直垂到她的臀部下方。她的发际线下有一双眼睛，其银色程度甚至更为显著：无论有多少光线照射在它们的瞳孔上，每只眼睛的虹膜似乎都会闪烁着光芒。她的颧骨很高，鼻子细长如纽扣，而嘴唇虽然饱满却很平坦——她确实非常美丽。[oma.isCollared |尽管它往往只是以一种冷淡的表情被隐藏起来罢了。 |从你希望她获得自由的那刻起，她就开始更加经常地露出笑容了，而这样的笑容更是让她的美丽更加动人。 ]她的身体线条相当紧致，但即使在静止状态下也看不出她的肌肉轮廓。在她裸露的腹部，只能隐约看到一些腹肌的痕迹，而她的腰部逐渐过渡到一对臀部，这样的身材对于一位经验丰富的肚皮舞者来说，简直再合适不过了。虽然你无法透过她的哈伦裤看到她的双腿，但那些裤子的轮廓已经足以让你想象出她身上隐藏着的魅力与力量。 奥玛的服装十分优雅，但却简洁大方，她更注重服装的功能性而非外观装饰。她穿着一件薄上衣，这件上衣能够遮住她的肩膀和胸部，但却无法覆盖她的脖子、二头肌或腹部。在腰部，她穿了一条及踝的哈伦裤——这种宽松度极大的裤子极大地突出了她的胯部轮廓，为她的双腿提供了充足的活动空间，同时完全遮挡了人们对她双腿的视线，使得她腰部以下的所有部位都成为了读者的想象对象。她所穿的每一件衣物都是由纯白色的丝绸制成，并配有金色的装饰边，这些细节都体现了她的高贵地位。她的双臂从肩膀处开始便完全裸露，脚踝和双脚也同样没有穿戴任何衣物。 [oma.isCollared |她从不在没有手电筒在身边的情况下行动：那手电筒通常被她放在右手中，底座搁在平坦的手掌上。手电筒本身也被擦拭得光亮无比，看起来就像是在那天早上刚刚被制造出来的一样，就连盖子顶端的透明钻石也完美无瑕，能够将光线放大得更加明亮。 |如今，虽然奥玛可以自由地去任何她想去的地方、做任何她想做的事情，但她现在是以护身符的形式存在。只要你说一句话或挥动一下手，她就会立刻出现在你身边。过去，每当被召唤时，她都必须随身携带一盏魔法油灯，但你现在已经解除了她的这个负担，因此她现在是自愿地与你在一起度过的。 ] [oma.isCollared |然而，奥玛最引人注目的特征就是她戴在脖子上的那条厚重的金色项圈，而从这条项圈上垂下的一组六枚厚实沉重的戒指，构成了一条链条，将项圈与灯架连接在一起。这也正是为什么人们从未见过她不戴这条项圈的原因——她真的离不开它。 |在你希望她获得自由之前，奥玛被迫佩戴一条巨大的金色项圈，那条项圈厚得足以用它击毙一个人，而且它本身还被链在灯上。然而，现在那条项圈已经不见了，她的脖子上也没有留下任何难看的痕迹——就好像那些链条从来就不存在过一样。 ] 奥玛的胸前是一对紧实、饱满的C罩杯乳房，而她的臀部则显得结实而紧致，想必是长期保持各种僵硬的姿势所锻炼出来的。[oma.fucked| 而且，尽管你对她有所怀疑需求她的屁股中间确实有一个属于那里的位置。]
