Although wishing for a whole cookbook[azzy.kdb |, as you had suggested, ] would be logistically challenging – a book of that size would be impossible to open, much less move." [azzy.kdb |"Ah, I understand," Azyrran says. "All things in moderation, as it were." "That’s right," Oma says with a smile. Azyrran hesitates before leaving. "So," she says drolly, "can I have that, or...?" ] Oma’s smile wilts as she turns her head sympathetically. "You’re a sweet girl, Azyrran," she says, "but I won’t. I am nobody’s slave anymore." [azzy.kdb |"No, I get it," Azyrran replies, her mouth lifting into her own sympathetic grin. "I overstepped by asking. Never mind me." And with that, Azyrran turns to leave for the camp’s fire. | |"Aww," Azyrran pouts again, her shoulders slumping as she turns towards the camp’s fire once again. ] |"That is a wish I could grant, yes," Oma says curtly and stoically, but says nothing more. |没什么，”她思考了片刻后回答道，双臂交叉在胸前。她直视着奥玛，仔细端详着她的身体，鼻子微微动了一下，似乎在考虑是否还要再说些什么。“我拥有的已经足够了，甚至还有更多。你知道，当阿兹兰以那凶猛的形象出现时，她有时会显得过于自信……但如果你再问一次：真的吗？一点都没有吗？奥玛拥有近乎无限的力量，她竟然会愿意放弃这些力量吗？ |像那个家伙那样，如此傲慢地认为可以得到精灵的力量，这样的主人实在为数不多，”奥玛说道。从她的语气中可以听出，阿兹兰的这种性格并没有让她感到意外。“其实我反倒觉得这样挺好。比起那些自私、什么都要索取的主人，我宁愿和一个固执己见、什么都不要求的主人共处。这样我就可以安心地待在我的灯笼里了。 对[berwyn.himHer]而言，能许下这样深思熟虑的愿望着实令人意外。你承认，原本还以为[berwyn.himHer]会许愿得到某些……呃，别的东西。可能是物质上的东西，也可能是知识。但事实是[berwyn.heShe]我只是希望能拥有片刻的宁静而已。 [berwyn.himHer]自我确实能让人们正确地看待各种事情。 “嗯， [berwyn.heShe]继续说着，带着一丝苦笑斜眼看着你：“如果你希望我许一个更‘符合我个性’的愿望，那么我希望自己永远都不用洗澡了。这样就不会有油腻腻的头发，也不会有身体散发难闻的气味。就算我一整天一整夜都在运动、满身是汗，到最后我也会散发出玫瑰般的香气。 rows.raw: '[berwyn.name] is sitting next to the campfire, [berwyn.hisHer] nose buried in the cleft of two pages of some leatherbound book. [berwyn.HeShe] keeps glancing towards [berwyn.hisHer] tent, and although [berwyn.heShe]’s trying to keep [berwyn.hisHer] focus on [berwyn.hisHer] reading, [berwyn.heShe] looks anxious – if you had to guess, [berwyn.hisHer] libido is kicking in and [berwyn.heShe]’s thinking about retiring for some personal time. You call [berwyn.himHer] to your side, and at first, [berwyn.heShe] jumps in [berwyn.hisHer] seat, startled that you’d call to [berwyn.himHer] so suddenly. But, once [berwyn.heShe]’s more comfortable with the fact that it’s you, [berwyn.heShe] flips the silk bookmark in the tome’s spine into [berwyn.hisHer] page, and [berwyn.heShe] sets it down behind [berwyn.hisHer] seat before heading towards you. You ask [berwyn.himHer] plain and simple: [oma.isFree|if Oma were still beholden to you – or, better yet, if Oma was beholden to [berwyn.himHer] – what would [berwyn.heShe] wish for? You’re curious.|you’re strongly considering your options for what to wish for from Oma, and you were looking for second opinions. If it were up to [berwyn.himHer], what would [berwyn.heShe] wish for?] "‘Wishes?’" [berwyn.name] repeats, [berwyn.hisHer] head crooking to one side and [berwyn.hisHer] eye narrowing in thought. "I’m a mage, [pc.name]; if I wanted to wish for something, I could research it and learn how to conjure it myself. I don’t need a genie for stuff like that." You know for a fact that there are significant limits to what a magician can accomplish versus the nigh-infinite powers of the genie. Oma [oma.isFree|could|can] turn herself into smoke and then stuff herself into a lamp – that sort of power is beyond the type of magic that a magician of Savarra is capable of. "Give me time and I’ll figure out how to do that someday," [berwyn.heShe] says with a wink and a laugh. "But," [berwyn.heShe] continues, [berwyn.hisHer] expression hardening as [berwyn.heShe] rests [berwyn.hisHer] chin on [berwyn.hisHer] palm and [berwyn.heShe] takes the question more seriously. [berwyn.HeShe] hums in thought as [berwyn.heShe] looks Oma's body up and down. "How many wishes would I get?" [berwyn.heShe] asks, and you tell [berwyn.himHer] that [berwyn.heShe]’d only get one. [berwyn.HeShe] hums again as [berwyn.heShe] considers it. "My life has been so hectic and crazy ever since we met that it’s hard for me to pin down just one thing that I could want. There are the easy answers – arcane knowledge; infinite mana; hell, I’d even take having a weaker libido. An insatiable sex drive isn’t all it’s cracked up to be, you know." [oma.isFree|Oma starts, sitting upright at that sentence, her eyes wide with surprise. "I have had many masters," she says, "but... that would be a first. I have never had one that asked for a weaker sex drive. They always ask for larger assets; or the skills to be a better lover; or for an enhanced libido." She sheepishly laughs once, more to herself than to you or [berwyn.name]. "And here I thought I’ve heard it all."|Oma’s normally stiff and stoic posture breaks: her gaze lowers from yours and her brow furrows in thought. "Huh," she hums once to herself, looking and sounding like she’s trying to process something she’s never heard before.] [berwyn.name] gives it some more thought, [berwyn.hisHer] eyes rolling from you, to Oma, to nothing, to the ground in front of [berwyn.himHer], back up to you as [berwyn.heShe] goes through every possibility in [berwyn.hisHer] head. "Okay, I think I got one," [berwyn.heShe] says after another moment. "It’s... been a long time since I really feel like I could relax. Ever since my business with Mistress Matiha started, it’s always been one thing after another – I can’t even get a good night’s sleep with how overdriven my libido is. And busting a nut doesn’t really buy me any time; if anything, it only makes things worse a little later down the line." "So... my wish would be to relax. For these knots in my shoulders to unwind." That’s a surprisingly considered wish for [berwyn.himHer] to have. You admit that you were expecting [berwyn.himHer] to wish for something... well, something else. Something material, or maybe knowledge. But the fact that [berwyn.heShe]’d wish to just have some peace to [berwyn.himHer]self really puts things into perspective. "Well," [berwyn.heShe] continues, side-eyeing you with a wry grin, "if you want me to wish for something more ‘me,’ then I’d wish that I’d never have to bathe again. No greasy hair; no smelly body. I could get all sweaty from fucking all day and all night and I’d smell like roses by the end." [berwyn.HeShe] runs a hand through [berwyn.hisHer] long, luxurious hair. "Do you have any idea how much time and effort it takes to wash all of this?" That sounds more like [berwyn.name].'

rows.original: Brienne sits next to the campfire, her eyes alternating between watching the flames dance and turning her eyes towards the sky to watch the [dayNight |clouds pass by |stars twinkle in the distance ]. Lying beside her is her poleaxe, the head resting against the dirt by her feet and the pole leaning against the log she’s sitting on. And beside that is a recently-used whetstone, worn thin from recent use. You call Brienne to your side, and when she stands, it’s with a sort of relaxed, languid ease of a woman that knows that she has all the time in the world. Her gait has a particular swish to her hips as she approaches you, her tail whipping behind herself with each step; a sultry, relaxed smile spreads across her face as she approaches you. "Yes, lover?" she asks[pc.heightRange 0 90 |, bending at the hips to bring herself to your eye level ]. You ask her plain and simple: [oma.isCollared |you’re strongly considering your options for what to wish for from Oma, and you were looking for second opinions. If it were up to her, what would she wish for? |if Oma were still beholden to you – or, better yet, if Oma was beholden to her – what would she wish for? You’re curious. ] At the question, Brienne stands upright, her eyes widening and her eyebrows arching. Her eyes go from you to Oma; her mouth stays shut as she processes the question and the implications. There’s a lot of power – and responsibilities and consequences – in a question like that. "I’m not sure," she answers after a moment. She cups her chin with her hand as she considers the options laid out to her. "I’ve never really given it a thought. Everything that I could want in life is already here with me." That’s a sweet thought for her to have and all, but you ask her to confirm, just in case: she really wouldn’t wish for anything? Oma is a genie and her powers are near-infinite – Brienne could have anything she asked for. "Yes, I understand," she responds, "but all of my needs and wants are met. I’m with people I love; I’m eating good food; I’m seeing the world and going on adventures that I could never go on by myself. I’m really thinking about it, [pc.name], but... I even just finished sharpening my axe. I really can’t think of anything more that I could ask for. Anything else would just be excessive." ... Maybe that was the perspective that you needed when you asked for her input. You asked her to give you some ideas on what to wish for – maybe you don’t need to wish for anything. Maybe you’re just fine with where you are right now. [oma.freedomWishedFor |"It takes a very special kind of strength of character to know that absolute power is right in front of you, and you walk away from it because you have everything you could ask for already," Oma says, her smile spreading across her face and her eyes glinting in the distant firelight. "Even the most devout of my previous masters would often just make up something that they thought they needed or wanted. A man with enough wealth to last him a hundred times over would suddenly realize that he needed more." |Oma’s posture remains unchanged, and her expression is as stone-faced and stoic as ever – but she sighs through her nose, her nostrils flaring, as she listens to Brienne’s reasoning. "It’s often the poorest that find they have want for nothing," she quips, but doesn’t elaborate. ] You thank Brienne for her input – you know you asked her for suggestions, but what she gave you was insight. "My pleasure," she says, [pc.heightRange 0 90 |leaning forward |stepping toward you ] to give you a kiss on the cheek before turning back to her seat by the campfire.
rows.translation: 布蕾妮坐在篝火旁，她的目光时而注视着跳跃的火焰，时而望向天空。 [dayNight |云朵飘过 |远处的星星闪烁着光芒。 ]躺在她身旁的是她的战斧，斧头柄靠在她脚边的泥土上，斧头本身则倚靠在她所坐的木头上。而旁边那个这是一块最近才被频繁使用的磨刀石，由于过度使用已经变得相当磨损了。 你将布蕾妮叫到身边，当她站起来的时候，那动作带着一种悠闲、慵懒的神情——一个深知自己拥有无限时间的女人的姿态。她走向你的时候，臀部会有一种特有的摆动节奏，每走一步，她的尾巴都会在身后甩动；当她靠近你时，一张性感而放松的微笑会浮现在她的脸上。“怎么了，亲爱的？”她问道。[pc.heightRange 0 90 |她弯下腰，使自己的视线与你的视线处于同一水平。 ]你就直截了当地问她吧： [oma.isCollared |你正在认真考虑自己应该向奶奶许什么愿，因此想要听听别人的意见。如果由她来决定，她会许什么愿呢？ |如果奥玛仍然欠你人情……或者，更确切地说，如果奥玛确实处于欠你人情的状态的话她 – 她会许什么愿呢？你真好奇。 ] 听到这个问题，布蕾妮站直了身体，眼睛瞪得大大的，眉毛也微微扬起。她的目光在你和奥玛之间来回扫视，嘴巴紧闭着，正在仔细思考这个问题的含义以及可能带来的后果。这样的一个问题，蕴含着巨大的权力——同时也意味着沉重的责任和潜在的后果。 我不太确定，”她过了片刻才回答。她用手托着下巴，仔细思考着摆在她面前的这些选择。“我其实从未认真考虑过这个问题。我生活中想要的一切，都已经在我身边了。她能有这样的想法确实很贴心，但为了保险起见，你还是应该再确认一下：她真的不希望得到那个东西。任何东西奥玛其实是个精灵，她的力量几乎无穷无尽——布蕾妮本可以利用这些力量的。任何东西是的，我明白，”她回答道，“但我的所有需求和愿望都得到了满足。我和我爱的人在一起；我吃着美味的食物；我正在环游世界，体验那些独自一人永远无法实现的冒险。我真的在认真考虑这个事情[pc.name]，但是……我刚才才把我的斧头磨好呢。真的。不能我想不出还有什么我还能要求的了。再要些什么的话，就太过分了。” ……也许当你征求她的意见时，正是需要这种视角。你让她给你一些关于该许什么愿的想法——也许你正是需要这样的建议。不要其实并不需要渴望什么。也许你现在的处境就已经让你很满足了。 [oma.freedomWishedFor |要拥有一种非常特别的品格力量，才能在绝对的权力就在眼前时，因为自己已经拥有了所有想要的东西，而选择放弃它，”奥玛说道。她的脸上洋溢着笑容，目光在远处的火光中闪烁着。“就连我以前那些最虔诚的导师们，也常常会编造出他们认为自己需要或想要的东西。而一个拥有足以让他享用一百年的财富的人，却会突然意识到自己还需要更多。 |奥玛的姿势依旧没有改变，她的表情也像往常一样冷峻而坚毅——但在听布蕾妮的辩解时，她还是通过鼻子叹了口气，鼻孔微微张开。“往往是最贫穷的人才会发现自己其实什么都不缺，”她调侃道，但并没有进一步解释。 ] 你感谢布蕾妮给出的建议——你知道你只是请她提些意见，但她所提供的其实是对问题的深刻洞察。 “这是我的荣幸，”她说道。 [pc.heightRange 0 90 |身体前倾 |正向你走来 ]在回到篝火旁的座位之前，她先吻了吻你的脸颊。

Occasionally, he lifts the spit out of the fire to inspect the meat, and, not satisfied just yet, he puts it back in and twists his wrist to make sure the meat cooks evenly. You call Brint to your side; he huffs through his nose once, then looks around his seat for some place to set his food down without getting it dirty. He eventually settles with setting it across the head of his mace and the crook of the blade of his poleaxe – a tenuous balance, but it works for the time. "Yeah?" he asks when he approaches you. You ask him plain and simple: [oma.isCollared |you’re strongly considering your options for what to wish for from Oma, and you were looking for second opinions. If it were up to him, what would he wish for? |if Oma were still beholden to you – or, better yet, if Oma was beholden to him – what would he wish for? You’re curious. ] At the question, Brint crooks one eyebrow and tilts his head, his eyes narrowing in thought. His eyes go from you to Oma; his mouth stays shut as he processes the question and the implications. There’s a lot of power – and responsibilities and consequences – in a question like that. "I’m not sure," he answers after a moment. He cups his chin with his hand as he considers the options laid out to him. "I’ve never really given it a thought. Everything that I could want in life is already here with me." That’s a sweet thought for him to have and all, but you ask him to confirm, just in case: he really wouldn’t wish for anything? Oma is a genie and her powers are near-infinite – Brint could have anything he asked for. "Yeah, I understand," he responds, "but all of my needs and wants are met. I’m with good company; I get to test my skills and flex some muscle; I’m seeing the world and going on adventures that I could never go on by myself. I’m really thinking about it, [pc.name], but... I even have some good food waiting for me when we’re done here. I really can’t think of anything more that I could ask for. Anything else would just be excessive." ... A man with enough wealth to last him a hundred times over would suddenly realize that he needed more." |Oma’s posture remains unchanged, and her expression is as stone-faced and stoic as ever – but she sighs through her nose, her nostrils flaring, as she listens to Brint’s reasoning. rows.translation: 布林特坐在篝火旁，坐在他的长柄战斧和钉头锤之间；他的右手拿着一根削好的长棍，上面叉着一大块肉，他正仔细地在篝火上烤着。偶尔，他会把烤肉叉从火里拿出来检查一下肉，觉得还不到火候，就把它放回去，再转动手腕，确保肉烤得均匀。 你把布林特叫到身边；他从鼻子里哼了一声，然后环顾自己的座位四周，想找个不会把食物弄脏的地方放下它。最后他决定把肉横搁在钉头锤的锤头和长柄战斧刀刃的弯处——这平衡很勉强，但暂时还凑合。“咋了？”他走近你时问道。 你直截了当地问他： [oma.isCollared |你正在认真考虑该向奥玛许什么愿，想听听别人的意见。如果由他来决定，他会许什么愿？ |如果奥玛仍然听命于你——或者，更好的是，如果奥玛听命于他——他会许什么愿？你很好奇。 ] 听到这个问题，布林特挑起一边眉毛，歪了歪头，眼睛眯起来思索着。他的目光从你移到奥玛；他闭着嘴，消化着这个问题及其含义。这样的问题里蕴含着巨大的权力——还有责任与后果。 “我不太确定，”他过了片刻才回答。他用手托着下巴，掂量着摆在他面前的这些选择。“我从没真正想过这个问题。我在生活中想要的一切，都已经在我身边了。” 他有这样的想法固然很暖心，但为了保险起见，你还是让他确认一下：他真的什么都不想许愿吗？奥玛是精灵，她的力量近乎无限——布林特想要什么都能得到。 “是啊，我明白，”他回答道，“但我所有的需求和欲望都得到了满足。我有好伙伴相伴；我能检验自己的本事、活动活动筋骨；我能看看这个世界，经历那些我一个人永远无法经历的冒险。我确实在认真考虑， [pc.name]，但是……等我们在这里的事情办完，还有一顿好饭在等着我呢。我真的想不出还能再要什么了。再多要什么，就太过分了。” ……也许你去征求他意见时，需要的正是这种视角。你让他给你一些该许什么愿的想法——也许你并不需要许任何愿。也许你现在的处境就已经让你很满足了。 [oma.freedomWishedFor |“要拥有一种非常特别的品格力量，才能在绝对的权力就在眼前时，因为自己已经拥有了所有想要的东西而选择放弃它，”奥玛说道，她的笑容在脸上绽开，双眼在远处的火光中闪烁。“就连我以前那些最虔诚的主人们，也常常会编造出一些他们自以为需要或想要的东西。一个拥有足以让他享用一百辈子的财富的人，会突然意识到自己还需要更多。” |奥玛的姿势依旧没有改变，表情也像往常一样冷峻坚毅——但听着布林特的理由，她从鼻子里叹了口气，鼻孔微微张开。“往往是最贫穷的人才会发现自己什么都不缺，”她调侃道，但没有进一步解释。 ] 你感谢布林特提供的建议——你知道自己只是向他讨要主意，但他给你的却是洞见。 “随时都行，”他说着，伸出拳头跟你的碰了一下，然后转身回到篝火旁的座位上。
rows.raw: 'Brint sits next to the campfire, sitting in between both his poleaxe and his mace; in his right hand is a long, shaved stick, and split onto it is a fat chunk of meat that he’s carefully roasting over the campfire. Occasionally, he lifts the spit out of the fire to inspect the meat, and, not satisfied just yet, he puts it back in and twists his wrist to make sure the meat cooks evenly. You call Brint to your side; he huffs through his nose once, then looks around his seat for some place to set his food down without getting it dirty. He eventually settles with setting it across the head of his mace and the crook of the blade of his poleaxe – a tenuous balance, but it works for the time. "Yeah?" he asks when he approaches you. You ask him plain and simple: [oma.isCollared |you’re strongly considering your options for what to wish for from Oma, and you were looking for second opinions. If it were up to him, what would he wish for? |if Oma were still beholden to you – or, better yet, if Oma was beholden to him – what would he wish for? You’re curious. ] At the question, Brint crooks one eyebrow and tilts his head, his eyes narrowing in thought. His eyes go from you to Oma; his mouth stays shut as he processes the question and the implications. There’s a lot of power – and responsibilities and consequences – in a question like that. "I’m not sure," he answers after a moment. He cups his chin with his hand as he considers the options laid out to him. "I’ve never really given it a thought. Everything that I could want in life is already here with me." That’s a sweet thought for him to have and all, but you ask him to confirm, just in case: he really wouldn’t wish for anything? Oma is a genie and her powers are near-infinite – Brint could have anything he asked for. "Yeah, I understand," he responds, "but all of my needs and wants are met. I’m with good company; I get to test my skills and flex some muscle; I’m seeing the world and going on adventures that I could never go on by myself. I’m really thinking about it, [pc.name], but... I even have some good food waiting for me when we’re done here. I really can’t think of anything more that I could ask for. Anything else would just be excessive." ... Maybe that was the perspective that you needed when you asked for his input. You asked him to give you some ideas on what to wish for – maybe you don’t need to wish for anything. Maybe you’re just fine with where you are right now. [oma.freedomWishedFor |"It takes a very special kind of strength of character to know that absolute power is right in front of you, and you walk away from it because you have everything you could ask for already," Oma says, her smile spreading across her face and her eyes glinting in the distant firelight. "Even the most devout of my previous masters would often just make up something that they thought they needed or wanted. A man with enough wealth to last him a hundred times over would suddenly realize that he needed more." |Oma’s posture remains unchanged, and her expression is as stone-faced and stoic as ever – but she sighs through her nose, her nostrils flaring, as she listens to Brint’s reasoning. "It’s often the poorest that find they have want for nothing," she quips, but doesn’t elaborate. ] You thank Brint for his input – you know you asked him for suggestions, but what he gave you was insight. "Any time," he says, reaching his fist forward to bump yours before turning back to his seat by the campfire.'

rows.original: Cait sits with her back to the campfire, her tail wagging slightly behind herself in content. She taps her right foot against the ground, going to a tune you can’t hear, while her hands busy themselves with her hair and a comb, brushing all the dirt and knots out. After one particular pass, she whips her head around a bit to get the newly-straightened hair into place before starting again. You call her to your side; she looks in your direction, smiles, and stands, placing the comb into a pocket at her hip before heading towards you. The swish of her hips and the sway of her tail suggest that she thinks this might be more than a social call – but it’s just as likely that that’s how she walks. "What’s up, [pc.name]?" she asks, her cheeks rising into a warm smile. You ask her plain and simple: [oma.isCollared |you’re strongly considering your options for what to wish for from Oma, and you were looking for second opinions. If it were up to her, what would she wish for? |if Oma were still beholden to you – or, better yet, if Oma was beholden to her – what would she wish for? You’re curious. ] Cait’s expression falls. "I want my sister back," she answers. That’s... Frankly, you should have seen that coming. "There’s nothing else in this world that I want more than to have Calla back," she continues. "What else am I going to wish for? Better clothes? I’m naked most of the hours of the day. A bigger house? We’ve been on the road more often than not." Her expression falls further, although as downcast as she is, she doesn’t look like she’s about to cry – if anything, all this time together with you has hardened her resolve towards getting her sister back. "I think about her all the time. My prayers are with her before I go to sleep. Calla is all I want." You turn to Oma. You feel as though you don’t need to ask the obvious. [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma’s own expression has faltered, seeing Cait so obviously distraught over having lost her sister. "What happened to her?" she asks. "The last time we saw Calla, she was kidnapped by cultists and thrown into a portal somewhere. She’s not in the Ways Between, but I don’t know much else." She lifts her eyes to Oma, hopeful that she could at least give Cait some good news. "Is that a thing you could do? Could you give me back my sister?" Oma tilts her head and bites into her thumbnail as she considers her options. "My near-infinite powers don’t allow me to infringe upon a person’s autonomy, mentally or physically, which means that, no, I could not move a person through time and space to a different location. I’m sorry." Cait continues, undeterred. "Then... could you at least tell us where she is?" "I would need to know who I’m searching for," Oma answers sadly. "And, you said she was thrown into a portal? Interdimensional travel isn’t something I’ve ever attempted before, in my many hundreds of years of being a genie. I don’t even know if it’s possible for me." She frowns. "I’m sorry, Cait." |Oma stands still and stoic as ever – but she hesitates on her response. Her mouth opens, then shuts, then opens again. "Is your sister dead?" she asks callously. "Gods, I hope not!" Cait answers indignantly, her voice raising slightly. Oma hums, her brow furrowing ever-so-slightly as she considers her options. "I cannot infringe upon a person’s physical or mental autonomy – meaning I cannot move a person through time and space, even if I knew who I was looking for. But if you have more information to give me, I may be able to tell you where she is." Cait’s back stiffens and her eyes widen as Oma’s words reach her. Even the tiniest lead could be everything. "Um... the last time we saw her, she was kidnapped by cultists and thrown into a portal leading to another dimension. We don’t know where. We do know she’s not in the Ways Between." Oma’s normally stiff, professional stance breaks: her shoulder slump and her eyes roll in exasperation. "‘Another dimension’ is, quite literally, an infinite number of possibilities." Her eyes settle back onto yours. "I could grant this wish, if you’d have me, [pc.master], but the amount of time it’d take to grant could range between one minute to infinity." ] Cait’s expression remains stoic – but, after a moment, she takes a deep breath through her nose, and, like lighting up a candle, her expression returns to normal, all smiles and sunshine. "That just means we’ll have to do it ourselves," she says to you before giving you a friendly nudge in the shoulder and returning to the campfire.
rows.translation: 凯特背对着篝火坐着，尾巴开心地微微摇动着。她用右脚轻敲地面，发出一种听不见的节奏，同时双手忙着整理自己的头发，用梳子把所有的灰尘和打结都梳掉。在完成某一次梳理动作后，她稍微转动头部，将刚刚整理整齐的头发调整到合适的位置，然后继续开始下一步操作。 你把她叫到身边；她朝你的方向看去，微笑着站了起来，把梳子放进腰间的口袋里，然后朝你走来。她摆动臀部的动作以及尾巴的摇动，似乎在暗示她认为这次见面可能不仅仅是简单的社交活动——但也很有可能这只是她平时的行走方式罢了。“怎么了， [pc.name]？”她问道，脸颊上浮现出温暖的笑容。 你就直截了当地问她吧： [oma.isCollared |你正在认真考虑自己应该向奥玛祈求什么，因此想要听听别人的意见。如果由她来决定，她会祈求什么呢？ |如果奥玛仍然欠你人情……或者，更确切地说，如果奥玛确实处于欠你人情的状态的话她 – 她会许什么愿呢？你真好奇。 ] 凯特的表情变得黯淡下来。“我想要回我的妹妹，”她说道。 这真是…… 说实话，你早该预料到这一点的。 “在这个世界上，没有什么比让卡拉回到我身边更让我渴望的了，”她继续说道。我还能再许什么愿呢？更好的衣服吗？但我一天中有好大一部分时间都是光着身的。更大的房子吗？我们其实大部分时间都在路上奔波。”她的表情更加黯淡了，不过尽管如此，她看起来并不像是要哭出来——相反，这些与你共同度过的时光反而让她更加坚定了要找回妹妹的决心。我无时无刻不在想着她。每晚睡觉前，我都会为她祈祷。卡拉，就是我全部的一切。” 你转向奥玛，觉得有些显而易见的事情根本不需要问出口。 [oma.freedomWishedFor |奥玛自己的表情也变得有些动摇，看到凯特因为失去妹妹而如此痛苦。“她发生了什么事？”她问道。 “我们最后一次见到卡拉时，她被一些邪教徒绑架了，然后被扔进了某个传送门里。她现在不在‘中间之路’上，但我也不太清楚其他情况了。”她抬起头看着奥玛，希望能得到一些能让凯特感到安慰的消息。“您难道能帮上什么忙吗？可以吗？你把我的妹妹还给我吧？” 老奶奶歪着头，咬着拇指指甲思考着该怎么办。“我那近乎无限的力量不允许我侵犯任何人的自主权，无论是精神上还是身体上。所以，不行，我无法将一个人穿越时空带到另一个地方去。对不起。” 凯特没有气馁，继续说道：“那么……至少你能告诉我们她现在在哪里吗？” “我需要知道我在寻找谁，”奥玛悲伤地回答，“而且，你说她被扔进了一个传送门里？在我作为精灵的数百年生涯中，我从未尝试过跨维度旅行。我甚至不确定这是否有可能做到。“对不起，凯特。”她皱着眉头说道。 |奥玛像往常一样站在那里，面无表情——但她迟迟没有回答。她的嘴张开又闭上，然后又重新张开。“你妹妹死了吗？”她冷冷地问道。 “天啊，但愿没有！”凯特愤慨地回答，声音略微提高了些。 奥玛轻声哼着，眉头微微蹙起，正在思考着各种选择。“我不能侵犯一个人的身体自主权或精神自主权——也就是说，即使我知道自己在寻找谁，我也不能将那个人转移到不同的时空中去。但如果你能提供更多信息，我或许就能告诉你她在哪里了。” 听到奥玛的话，凯特的身体一下子僵硬了起来，眼睛也瞪得大大的。哪怕是最微小的线索，也可能意味着一切。“嗯……我们最后一次见到她时，她被一些邪教徒绑架了，然后被扔进了一个通往另一个维度的传送门里。我们不知道那个维度在哪里，但我们确实知道她不在界间之路。” 通常表现得严肃、专业的奥玛这次打破了惯例：她的肩膀耷了下来，眼中流露出无奈与烦躁。“‘另一个维度’，从字面上来说，其实就是无限有太多可能性了。”她的目光再次与你相遇。“如果你愿意接受我，我完全可以实现这个愿望。 [pc.master]不过，完成这一过程所需的时间可能在一分钟到无限之间不等。" ] 凯特的表情依然保持着冷静，但过了一会儿，她通过鼻子深吸了一口气，仿佛点燃了一支蜡烛，她的表情立刻恢复了正常，脸上重新洋溢着笑容。“这意味着我们只能自己动手了，”她对你说着，然后友好地推了推你的肩膀，便回到了篝火旁。

rows.original: Etheryn sits on a log by the campfire; her right arm is raised to give her war hawk Harrick a perch, and her left hand is raised and open, holding feed so that Harrick can eat out of her palm. Considering the beak on that bird, she either has a lot of practice feeding him, or a lot of trust that he’s not going to rip her palm open by accident. You call Etheryn to your side. She and Harrick both look up at you; she nods to you, mouthing that she just needs a minute, and she lets Harrick finish eating before she lifts her arm with a thrust and has him fly off somewhere else for the moment. "Yes?" she asks once she’s within arm’s reach of you. You ask her plain and simple: [oma.isCollared |you’re strongly considering your options for what to wish for from Oma, and you were looking for second opinions. If it were up to her, what would she wish for? |if Oma were still beholden to you – or, better yet, if Oma was beholden to her – what would she wish for? You’re curious. ] [etheryn.isCaged |At the question, Etheryn blushes and looks away, her lips curling inward with shyness as she considers the question. You get the feeling that she knows exactly what she would wish for, and you bet you know what it is, but you understand that it’s not exactly something that she can just talk about with a total stranger like Oma. "Y-Yes," she manages to stutter out, "there... there is one thing." [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma lifts her nose and smiles, patiently waiting for Etheryn to gather up the courage. "Take your time," she implores. "If it makes you more comfortable, I’m not a stranger to more... personal wishes." |Oma, as usual, stands perfectly still and silent. She blinks once, but that’s all the expression you’re going to get out of her. ] Etheryn looks to her left, then to her right, to ensure that it’s just you and Oma with her. With nervous, shaking hands, she grips onto the hem of her skirt and lifts, pulling its bottom rim up and over the swell of her crotch – revealing to Oma the cage made of gold surrounding her penis, clung to her body with a thin strap around her hips. "It’s[etheryn.lowConfidence |... i-it’s ] this," she says, [etheryn.lowConfidence |blushing fiercely and closing her eyes tightly, unable to look at anyone at all while she bares herself to Oma |a light blush spreading across her face as she bares herself to Oma ]. "It’s an enchanted cage. I can’t remove it. Nothing I’ve tried has worked." [etheryn.lowConfidence |She doesn’t say anything more; her upper lip trembles with trepidation at the fact that she’s flashing Oma like this. Hopefully Oma understands what Etheryn’s asking for. |Etheryn’s gotten a major confidence boost over her time with you, to the point where she has no qualms about flashing Oma with her predicament – but even still, she can’t help but turn her eyes away with some embarrassment. ] Oma steps forward. She’s significantly taller than the boreal elf; she [oma.freedomWishedFor |puts herself on both of her knees to bring herself down low enough to investigate the cock cage more closely |bends at the waist, keeping the lamp on her palm steady as she goes, but doesn’t bring herself down any lower ]. She hums in thought and narrows her eyes; without permission, she reaches forward with her left hand, placing her index finger on the edge of the bell-like cage on Etheryn’s penis[etheryn.lowConfidence |, causing her to flinch ]. As soon as she touches it, she yanks her finger away, as if the cage had just burnt her. "My goodness," she says lowly to herself, turning her hand over to investigate her finger. [etheryn.lowConfidence |Oma’s reaction does not inspire confidence in Etheryn. When Oma jolts backward, so does she, and she drops her skirt to make herself decent again. |Etheryn flinches from Oma’s sudden jolt backwards, but she stands her ground – and sighs with some resignation. She can guess how this conversation is going to end. ] "The enchantment on this accessory was placed there via soul magic," Oma says, [oma.freedomWishedFor |looking up at Etheryn from her kneeling position with her eyebrows crooked into sad arches |flicking her whole hand once to shake off the shock, then resuming her earlier posture ]. "The person that put this enchantment on it used a piece of themselves in order to do so – and therefore, I cannot break it, as it would be infringing upon a person’s autonomy." [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma stands, brushing off her pants with her hands as she takes a step back |Oma takes a step back ]. rows.original: Kiyoko is by the campfire, with a small bowl of liquid by her foot and a long, elegant brush in her hand, running it through the strands of her hair. She watches the camp’s bonfire dance as she runs the brush through her hair. The fur on her tail is already straightened and glossy in the fire’s light – she must have done those first. You call her to your side. She looks up from the fire towards you, a smile spreading across her face; she sets down the brush and gives her head a flick, feeling her long, wavy red hair a swish to test its body and how many knots it has before she stands. She makes her way towards you with an exaggerated swish in her hips – but with a knowing, already-convinced look on her face. "This is about Oma and [oma.isCollared |what I would wish for if she were beholden to me, right? |what I would wish for, had I the opportunity, right? ]" she asks. You ask her if she figured that out through one of her divinations. "No," she says with a well-meaning laugh. "What else would you call me over for while Oma was present? It doesn’t take a seer to realize what it is you’d like from me." [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma’s own mouth curls into a wry smile, her eyes rolling. "A diviner, and a kitsune, no less. I suppose that makes you beholden to Keros of the Seven?" "Indeed," Kiyoko replies. "Then, if I may... I would suppose I know what it is you’d wish for." Kiyoko tilts her head, an eyebrow cocking, and she crosses her arms. She neither accepts nor declines Oma’s invitation. "Perhaps you do," she says, a playful smile creeping across her face. She and Oma are playing some form of game, but you can’t begin to guess what their thoughts and intentions are. "Go ahead, then." "Well, if I knew what you likely know," Oma says slowly, her words droning as she chooses them carefully, "I would wish for nothing. My hubris is how I became a genie in the first place. A diviner kitsune of Keros would understand that even the smallest word or the slightest incorrect tone could mean a disastrous departure from your intentions. So it’d be better to not bother." Kiyoko stands still for a moment, absorbing Oma’s words and logic – and eventually turns her eyes toward you. "She’s right." |Oma’s expression remains stiff – but her nose crinkles as Kiyoko approaches her. She clears her throat, takes a deep sigh through her nose, and averts her gaze, turning her whole head to one side dismissively. "Seems I don’t have a fan," Kiyoko notes, nodding towards Oma. "I’m not sure what I did to deserve that sort of reception." "You have the stink of Keros on you," Oma says venomously, her eyes opening and settling on Kiyoko, but not turning her head towards her. Oma isn’t normally one to emote, but this is the angriest – or, perhaps, the most disgusted – you’ve seen her. "And here I try my best to keep up with my grooming," Kiyoko laughs. "[pc.name], beloved, I wouldn’t wish for a thing from Oma." Is it because you two apparently aren’t friends? "It’s because I know better," she replies. "Dealing with near-infinite, godlike powers like Oma’s is just asking for something to go wrong. The slightest slip up, and whatever intentions I might have had would be willfully misinterpreted, and would result in disaster. Especially since Oma would sooner have nothing to do with me." Oma says nothing. rows.translation: 清子站在篝火旁，脚边放着一个小碗液体，手中拿着一支修长而优雅的刷子，正用它梳理着自己的头发。一边梳理头发，一边欣赏着营地里人们围绕篝火跳动的舞蹈。在火光中，她尾巴上的毛发已经变得笔直而富有光泽——看来她之前一定先整理过那些毛发。 你把她叫到身边。她从火堆旁抬起头看着你，脸上露出了笑容；她放下刷子，轻轻甩了甩头，让那头长长的、波浪形的红发飘动起来，检查一下它的状态，看看还有多少打结，然后才站了起来。她迈着步伐向你走来，臀部摆动得有些夸张——但她的脸上却带着一种心照不宣、早已确信的表情。 “这件事和奥玛有关[oma.isCollared |如果她真的属于我，我就会希望得到这些，对吧？ |如果有机会的话，我肯定也会希望得到这样的东西，对吧？ ]她问道。 你便问她，是不是通过某种占卜手段才弄清楚这个答案的。 “不是的，”她带着善意的笑容说道，“在奥玛也在场的情况下，你还会叫我过来做什么呢？其实，你想要我做什么，根本不需要什么占卜能力就能猜到。 [oma.freedomWishedFor |奥玛的嘴角勾起一丝苦笑，眼睛也转了转。“一个占卜师，而且还是只狐狸妖。我想，这意味着你得欠七神之一的凯罗斯一个人情吧？” “确实如此，”清子回答道。 “那么，如果我可以的话……我想，我应该知道你想要什么吧。” 清子歪了歪头，挑起一根眉毛，双臂交叉在胸前。她既没有接受也没有拒绝老奶奶的邀请。“也许你确实知道吧，”她说道，脸上浮现出一丝顽皮的微笑。她和奶奶正在玩某种游戏，但你根本无法猜出她们在想什么、有什么意图。“那你就继续吧。” “嗯，如果我知道你可能知道的事情，”奶奶缓缓说道，她一字一句地斟酌着用词，“我应该什么都不会希望得到的。正是我的傲慢让我最初变成了一个“精灵”。作为凯罗斯的一只占卜狐，我深知：哪怕是最微不足道的一句话，或者最轻微的用词不当，都可能导致结果与初衷大相径庭。因此，最好还是省去这些麻烦吧。清子静静地站了一会儿，仔细思考着父亲的话语和逻辑——最终，她将目光转向了你。“她说得对。 |当清子靠近时，奥玛的表情依然僵硬——但她的鼻子却微微动了动。她清了清嗓子，通过鼻子深深地吸了一口气，然后移开了视线，整个头部都转向了一边，显得很不屑一顾。 看来我没有什么粉丝啊，”清子说着，朝奥玛点了点头，“真不明白自己做了什么，才会得到这样的对待。” “你身上有一股煤油的味道，” 奥玛恶毒地说道，她的目光终于落在了清子身上，但却没有转头看向她。通常情况下，奥玛并不是一个容易表达情绪的人，但这一次，你看到她的表情是迄今为止最愤怒的——或者，也许应该说是最厌恶的。 “看吧，我明明一直在努力保持自己的仪容整洁，”清子笑着说。[pc.name]，亲爱的，我其实并不希望从奥玛那里得到任何东西。” “是因为你们俩显然并不是朋友吗？” “因为我知道该怎么做才对，”她回答道，“与像奥玛这样拥有近乎无限、近乎神一般的力量的人打交道，确实需要特别的策略。询问总有些事情会出错。只要有一点点疏忽，我所有的意图都可能会被恶意误解，从而导致灾难。尤其是考虑到，奥玛宁愿与我断绝一切关系也不愿帮助我。 奥玛没有说话。你可以把这理解为她默许了这一点——没错，她确实会不遗余力地让清子的生活变得更加艰难。 ] 那么，我想确认一下：如果有机会，清子她真的什么都不想要吗？ “在这个世界上，我其实没什么特别想要的。”她回答道。[kiyoko.isPregnant |她用柔软的手掌轻轻揉着肚子。 ]你已经给了我所能请求的最珍贵的礼物了——根本不需要什么精灵帮忙。”她倾身靠近你，在你的脸颊上轻轻一吻。 [oma.freedomWishedFor |她转向营火的方向——但在离开之前又转了回来。“哦，还有奥玛？”她回头喊道，“现在你这样的样子，我反而更喜欢你了。 [oma.isCollared |几乎免费 |获得自由 ]你可比之前好说话多了。” 老奶奶自言自语地哼着，嘴角微微上扬。 |她转身朝篝火走去，没有再说一句话就离开了。而你听到奥玛在她离开时，粗声地通过鼻子呼了口气。 ]
rows.raw: 'Kiyoko is by the campfire, with a small bowl of liquid by her foot and a long, elegant brush in her hand, running it through the strands of her hair. She watches the camp’s bonfire dance as she runs the brush through her hair. The fur on her tail is already straightened and glossy in the fire’s light – she must have done those first. You call her to your side. She looks up from the fire towards you, a smile spreading across her face; she sets down the brush and gives her head a flick, feeling her long, wavy red hair a swish to test its body and how many knots it has before she stands. She makes her way towards you with an exaggerated swish in her hips – but with a knowing, already-convinced look on her face. "This is about Oma and [oma.isCollared |what I would wish for if she were beholden to me, right? |what I would wish for, had I the opportunity, right? ]" she asks. You ask her if she figured that out through one of her divinations. "No," she says with a well-meaning laugh. "What else would you call me over for while Oma was present? It doesn’t take a seer to realize what it is you’d like from me." [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma’s own mouth curls into a wry smile, her eyes rolling. "A diviner, and a kitsune, no less. I suppose that makes you beholden to Keros of the Seven?" "Indeed," Kiyoko replies. "Then, if I may... I would suppose I know what it is you’d wish for." Kiyoko tilts her head, an eyebrow cocking, and she crosses her arms. She neither accepts nor declines Oma’s invitation. "Perhaps you do," she says, a playful smile creeping across her face. She and Oma are playing some form of game, but you can’t begin to guess what their thoughts and intentions are. "Go ahead, then." "Well, if I knew what you likely know," Oma says slowly, her words droning as she chooses them carefully, "I would wish for nothing. My hubris is how I became a genie in the first place. A diviner kitsune of Keros would understand that even the smallest word or the slightest incorrect tone could mean a disastrous departure from your intentions. So it’d be better to not bother." Kiyoko stands still for a moment, absorbing Oma’s words and logic – and eventually turns her eyes toward you. "She’s right." |Oma’s expression remains stiff – but her nose crinkles as Kiyoko approaches her. She clears her throat, takes a deep sigh through her nose, and averts her gaze, turning her whole head to one side dismissively. "Seems I don’t have a fan," Kiyoko notes, nodding towards Oma. "I’m not sure what I did to deserve that sort of reception." "You have the stink of Keros on you," Oma says venomously, her eyes opening and settling on Kiyoko, but not turning her head towards her. Oma isn’t normally one to emote, but this is the angriest – or, perhaps, the most disgusted – you’ve seen her. "And here I try my best to keep up with my grooming," Kiyoko laughs. rows.original: Standing next to the fire is Quintillus – the flames map out the curves of his silhouette well enough, but the ears would give him away in the dark with how tall they are. In his left hand is an open book, his eyes scanning along the words written on the pages, and in his right hand is a tankard of mead. Perhaps he should be sitting. When you call Quintillus’ name, his large ears perk and stretch before his head turns towards you. With a flex of his hand, the book snaps shut with a heavy ‘flump,’ and he sets it onto the ground by his feet, a fair distance from the fire. He does not set down the tankard – that’d be irresponsible of him, after all. "Yeah, what’s up?" he asks when he approaches you. You ask him plain and simple: [oma.isCollared |you’re strongly considering your options for what to wish for from Oma, and you were looking for second opinions. If it were up to him, what would he wish for? |if Oma were still beholden to you – or, better yet, if Oma was beholden to him – what would he wish for? You’re curious. ] "Anything I want, huh?" he asks. He looks down into his tankard and swirls the mead still inside it, watching the liquids move and making sure none of it spills off the side. "That’s a big ask. It’s hard to think of anything right off the top of my head." Maybe if he talked through it, he could help himself decide on what his wish would be. "Well, I can think of a bunch of things, but they’d either be too big or too small, you know? Like, I could ask for power – more than I have. Like, I could ask to be the most powerful mage in all of Savarra. I don’t know how that’d bite me in the ass, but I’m sure it would. And on the other hand," he continues, lifting his tankard up and toasting it to you before throwing it back and chugging it, but not all of it. "I could ask for a refill." Quintillus crosses his arms, awkwardly keeping his tankard upright. His eyes go to Oma, scanning her from her scalp to her feet – and his brow furrows as an idea comes across his mind. "There’s one thing, now that I think about it," he says. "Us taeleer... we’re pretty predictable when it comes to our preferred body types. We’ve been on the road together for a while now, and I haven’t had the chance to, you know, settle down and start a family. My one wish would be for a partner: one that’s about as tall as Oma, and she’d have big boobs, and she’d want to cuddle for hours, and we’d have a big family. Like, eight kids, minimum." That’s a bit of a leap, going from not knowing what he wanted to wish for to something as specific as that. "I guess I just needed some inspiration," he says, winking at you and toasting you again before he finishes off the rest of his drink. You turn to Oma and ask her if that sort of wish could be granted. Although you don’t mention that you realize that it might be asking a lot from her, personally. [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma’s brow furrows and her mouth curls downward, as if she has bad news to share and she’s working up the courage to tell it. "Let me tell you some short stories," she begins sadly. "Previous masters have asked for long-term partnerships before, but it never ends well. I’ve been asked to be ‘the perfect wife:’ someone that never disagrees with their partner and is willing to do whatever they want. A slave by another name. And that sort of relationship degrades when they realize that they don’t have a wife – they have a sock puppet that provides no personality or challenge, and although they are ‘beholden’ to me, it’s usually not half a decade before their eyes begin to wander." "Other masters have asked for me to be their wife, with no other stipulations, with the intent that they want me to stay as I am, with no obligations – but the fact that they use their wish, something I am bound by the machinations of the lamp to grant, for my hand in matrimony, is fundamentally paradoxical. I was their wife in name only, and remained as a slave to them and the lamp both. I could never love them the way they wanted. They wished for the caged bird to fly free, but only if it never flew away from them." Oma looks straight ahead at Quintillus, her expression unchanged. "I could grant you your wish, of being your buxom wife and giving you your cuddles and your loving – but ‘love’ is not something that can be manufactured or granted. You’d eventually realize that the life you wanted was fake." She pauses and swallows. "And I could not give you your eight children. Life is not something within my power." Quintillus stands stock-still, absorbing everything Oma says. He breaks eye contact to look into his empty tankard; despite its vacancy, he swishes it around as if stirring some leftover ale within it. "So, yeah," he eventually replies. "I wouldn’t know what else." |Oma pauses. She blinks once, and takes a long, deep sigh through her nose, waiting until she’s exhaled it all before opening her mouth. "That... is a wish I could grant, yes," she eventually answers, although her tone is low and quiet. Quintillus laughs, and raises his empty tankard to her in toast. "I’ve been rejected enough times to know that that’s not the ‘yes’ I was looking for," he says, winking at her. "And I’m not drunk enough to think I should start pushing my luck with a genie." Quintillus nudges you with his elbow as he turns back towards the campfire. "Guess I’ll need to put some more thought into it." And with that, he makes his way back towards the campfire once again. ]
rows.translation: 站在火堆旁的是昆蒂卢斯——火焰清晰地勾勒出了他的轮廓，但那过长的耳朵在暗影中还是会暴露他的身份。他的左手拿着一本打开的书，目光正扫过书页上的文字，而右手则握着一只装满蜂蜜酒的酒壶。也许他应该坐下来。 当你呼唤昆蒂卢斯的名字时，他那一对大耳朵会立刻竖起来，然后他的头才会转向你。他轻轻一弹手指，书便“啪”的一声合上了，他被放在离火堆相当远的地方，就在自己的脚边。他并没有把酒壶放下——毕竟，那样做未免太不负责任了。“嗯，怎么了？”当他走近你时，你问道。 你直接而坦率地问他： [oma.isCollared |你正在认真考虑自己应该向奥玛许什么愿，因此想要听听别人的意见。如果由他来决定，他会许什么愿呢？ |如果奥玛仍然欠你人情……或者，更确切地说，如果奥玛确实处于欠你人情的状态的话他 – 他会许什么愿呢？你真好奇。 ] 我想得到的任何东西，都是我的吗？”他问道。他低头看着自己的酒杯，轻轻搅动杯中剩下的蜂蜜酒，观察着酒液的运动，确保没有一滴酒溢出来。“这个要求有点太高了……一下子实在想不出什么来。也许如果他能仔细思考一下，就能自己决定到底想要什么愿望。” “嗯，我能想到很多愿望，但它们要么要求太高，要么太不切实际，你懂我的意思吧？比如，我可以请求获得更多的力量——比我现在拥有的还要多。比如说，我可以要求成为整个萨瓦拉最强大的法师。虽然我不知道这样做会给我带来什么麻烦，但我敢肯定肯定会有问题。而另一方面，”他继续说道，举起酒杯向你敬酒，然后又把酒杯放下，大口喝了起来，却没有全都喝完。“我还可以再要一杯。” 昆蒂卢斯双臂交叉，费力地让他的酒壶保持直立。他的目光落在奥玛身上，从她的头顶扫到脚尖——突然，一个想法浮现在他的脑海中，他的眉头紧锁了起来。现在想来，有件事挺有意思的，”他说，“我们这些泰勒族……在选择自己喜欢的体型方面，其实都挺有规律的。我们已经一起走了这么久，而我至今还没有机会安定下来，组建家庭。我唯一的愿望就是找到一个伴侣：一个身高和奥玛差不多的女人，她要有丰满的胸部，而且她也很喜欢依偎在一起，这样我们就能拥有一个大家庭，至少要有八个孩子。 从一开始不知道自己想要什么愿望，到突然想到这样一个具体的要求，也算是有点突然吧。 我想我只是需要一些灵感罢了，”他说着，朝你眨了眨眼，又为你干了一杯，然后才喝完了剩下的酒。 你转向奥玛，询问她这样的愿望是否能够实现。虽然你没有直接说你意识到这对她来说可能要求太高了。 [oma.freedomWishedFor |奥玛的眉头紧锁，嘴角向下撇，仿佛有什么坏消息要告诉大家，而她正在努力鼓起勇气来说出这番话。 “让我给你们讲几个小故事吧，”她悲伤地开始说道，“以前的主人也曾提出过长期合作的请求，但结果从来都不好。人们总要求我成为“完美的妻子”：那种从不与伴侣意见相左、愿意做他们想要的一切的人。其实，这就是另一种形式的奴役。而当他们意识到自己拥有的并不是一个有独立思想、能带来挑战的妻子，而只是一个毫无个性、毫无反抗力的“木偶”时，这种关系就会开始变质。尽管他们在表面上“依赖”着我，但通常不到五年，他们的目光就会开始移向别处。其他几位大师也曾向我提出过结婚的请求，他们没有提出任何其他要求，只是希望我能够保持现在的样子，不承担任何义务……但事实上，他们之所以提出这样的请求，正是因为看中了我这样的性格。限定范围由于那盏灯的安排，我被迫嫁给了他们，但这本身就充满了矛盾。名义上，我是他们的妻子，但实际上，我依然既是他们的奴隶，也是那盏灯的奴隶。我永远无法以他们所期望的方式去爱他们。他们希望那只被关在笼子里的鸟能够自由飞翔，但前提是它永远不要离开他们。 奥玛直视着昆蒂卢斯，她的表情没有任何变化：“我可以实现你的愿望，成为你那温柔的妻子，给你拥抱和关爱——但‘爱’并不是可以人为制造或赐予的东西。最终你会意识到，你梦寐以求的生活其实是虚假的。”她停顿了一下，然后继续说道，“而我也无法给你八个孩子……生命并不是我能够掌控的东西。” 昆蒂卢斯一动不动地站在那里，认真地听着奥玛说的一切。他移开了目光，望向自己空荡荡的酒壶；尽管里面什么也没有，他还是晃了晃酒壶，仿佛在搅拌里面残留的麦芽酒似的。“所以，嗯，”他最终说道，“我也想不出还能说什么了。 |奥玛停顿了一下。她眨了眨眼，然后通过鼻子深深地吸了一口气，等到气息完全呼出后，才开口说道：“那个……我确实可以实现这个愿望，”她最终这样回答道，不过她的声音很低，也很轻柔。 昆蒂卢斯笑了起来，举起他空荡荡的酒杯向她敬酒：“我已经被拒绝过太多次了，所以我知道那并不是我想要的‘同意’。”他说着，还朝她眨了眨眼，“而且我也还没喝到那种会让我以为应该去冒险向精灵讨要东西的地步。昆蒂卢斯用肘子轻轻碰了碰你，然后转身朝营火走去。“看来我还需要再仔细考虑一下。”说完，他又朝着营火的方向走了回去。 ]

Quintillus crosses his arms, awkwardly keeping his tankard upright. His eyes go to Oma, scanning her from her scalp to her feet – and his brow furrows as an idea comes across his mind. "There’s one thing, now that I think about it," he says. "Us taeleer... we’re pretty predictable when it comes to our preferred body types. We’ve been on the road together for a while now, and I haven’t had the chance to, you know, settle down and start a family. My one wish would be for a partner: one that’s about as tall as Oma, and she’d have big boobs, and she’d want to cuddle for hours, and we’d have a big family. Like, eight kids, minimum." That’s a bit of a leap, going from not knowing what he wanted to wish for to something as specific as that. "I guess I just needed some inspiration," he says, winking at you and toasting you again before he finishes off the rest of his drink. You turn to Oma and ask her if that sort of wish could be granted. Although you don’t mention that you realize that it might be asking a lot from her, personally. [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma’s brow furrows and her mouth curls downward, as if she has bad news to share and she’s working up the courage to tell it. "Let me tell you some short stories," she begins sadly. "Previous masters have asked for long-term partnerships before, but it never ends well. I’ve been asked to be ‘the perfect wife:’ someone that never disagrees with their partner and is willing to do whatever they want. A slave by another name. And that sort of relationship degrades when they realize that they don’t have a wife – they have a sock puppet that provides no personality or challenge, and although they are ‘beholden’ to me, it’s usually not half a decade before their eyes begin to wander." "Other masters have asked for me to be their wife, with no other stipulations, with the intent that they want me to stay as I am, with no obligations – but the fact that they use their wish, something I am bound by the machinations of the lamp to grant, for my hand in matrimony, is fundamentally paradoxical. I was their wife in name only, and remained as a slave to them and the lamp both. I could never love them the way they wanted. They wished for the caged bird to fly free, but only if it never flew away from them." Oma looks straight ahead at Quintillus, her expression unchanged. "I could grant you your wish, of being your buxom wife and giving you your cuddles and your loving – but ‘love’ is not something that can be manufactured or granted. You’d eventually realize that the life you wanted was fake." She pauses and swallows. "And I could not give you your eight children. Life is not something within my power." Quintillus stands stock-still, absorbing everything Oma says. He breaks eye contact to look into his empty tankard; despite its vacancy, he swishes it around as if stirring some leftover ale within it. "So, yeah," he eventually replies. "I wouldn’t know what else." |Oma pauses. She blinks once, and takes a long, deep sigh through her nose, waiting until she’s exhaled it all before opening her mouth. "That... is a wish I could grant, yes," she eventually answers, although her tone is low and quiet. Quintillus laughs, and raises his empty tankard to her in toast. "I’ve been rejected enough times to know that that’s not the ‘yes’ I was looking for," he says, winking at her. "And I’m not drunk enough to think I should start pushing my luck with a genie." Quintillus nudges you with his elbow as he turns back towards the campfire. "Guess I’ll need to put some more thought into it." And with that, he makes his way back towards the campfire once again. ]'

rows.original: Sitting next to the camp’s fire is Viviane; in her right hand is an open tome, flipped to some page somewhat closer to the beginning of the book, and her left hand weaves designs and patterns in the air with twists and motions of her wrist and fingers. With every motion she makes, the fire in front of her moves and sways just slightly, and the licks of flame that approach her fingers twist unnaturally as their colors shift from orange to blue to green and back again. When you call her name, her focus on the fire drops, and she uses her now-free hand to dog-ear the book in her hand before snapping it shut. When she stands, she brushes the dirt from the seat of her robe, and she walks towards you with a confident swish in her hips. "Yes, [pc.name]?" she asks. You ask her plain and simple: [oma.isCollared |you’re strongly considering your options for what to wish for from Oma, and you were looking for second opinions. If it were up to her, what would she wish for? |if Oma were still beholden to you – or, better yet, if Oma was beholden to her – what would she wish for? You’re curious. ] "I’d been considering that myself for a while, now," she replies. A smirk crosses her face as she leans backward, her hand cupping her chin while she regards Oma. "That’s not the easiest question to answer. On the one hand, I could have anything... but I feel like I’d need to be especially careful with my word choice. I wouldn’t want to wish for something and have my intentions backfire on me." [oma.isCollared |Oma, as usual, stands totally still and expressionless. Whether Viviane is right or wrong, she’s not saying. |"Well, that just depends on what it is you’d wish for," Oma replies, her tongue snaking out from the corner of her lips. But, you note, she doesn’t explicitly try to assuage Viviane and her concerns. ] So, she wouldn’t wish for anything? She’d rather work to obtain the level of magical expertise to be able to conjure anything she’d wish on her own? She hums, her eyes squinting and her nose scrunching as she puts a bit more thought into it. "You know what? I think it’d depend on how many wishes I got." She turns her eyes towards you. "For the sake of argument, how many do I get? I know you [oma.isCollared |started with |had ] three." Let’s say she only gets one. What would she wish for with just one? "Nothing," she answers. "One wish isn’t enough for me to get what it is that I truly want without risking being turned inside-out by semantics or whatever.[viv.isDemon | | Well, aside from Oma’s freedom. I could do that with one wish. ]" Okay... what if she had two? That’s your final offer. "With two, I would use my first wish for Oma’s freedom, but only on the stipulation that it’s granted after my second wish, and on the understanding that she doesn’t try to twist my words into something I didn’t want on the second wish. She would grant my second wish based on my intent, not on my wording." She pauses and hums to herself as she considers her second wish. "And as for my second wish... I’m not sure. Knowledge is the obvious one, but studying magic is more the journey than the destination. There’s a lot of learning to be had on your way to mastering any given school — and, to be honest, it’s just more fun," she laughs. You turn to Oma and ask her if she would grant those wishes, if Viviane were her master. [oma.isCollared |As usual, Oma’s expression remains stiff and stonelike – but her eyes flit between yours and Viviane’s again and again. When presented with the opportunity for her freedom, she’d have to agree to not try and twist Viviane’s words around with her second wish. All she’d have to do is agree to that, and she’d be a free woman. After a tense moment, Oma sighs, in and out through her nose. "Those are wishes that I would grant, yes," she answers. "Ah, ah," Viviane starts, lifting a finger and wagging it at Oma. "That wasn’t the important question, and you know it. Would you agree to grant my second wish by my intent rather than by my wording?" At that, Oma’s expression finally breaks: her brow furrows and she turns towards Viviane, her steely eyes like fire in her direction. "You are not the [pc.master], wench," she barks loudly. "I don’t need to elaborate myself to you." Viviane [viv.isDemon |snorts through her nose divisively at Oma’s outburst, and she holds her ground. |flinches slightly, taking one step backward, before remembering herself and resuming her earlier posture. ] "Well, then," she says, clearing her throat as she turns to you, "that would be my answer. [viv.isDemon |I would wish for nothing." She gives Oma one last look, crinkling her nose at her, before turning back to the campfire. "Not until someone learns to start behaving." |Oma’s freedom — assuming she’d be willing to listen to wench like me. ] Oma watches you, her back still stiff and straight, but when your eyes meet, she casts them towards the ground, unable to meet you eye-to-eye. |Oma’s mouth twists with uncertainty. Her eyes wander between you and Viviane’s, then up towards the sky, then back to yours. "I," she starts, her mouth chewing her words carefully. "Well... I’d be obligated to grant whatever wish my master would have of me. It’s not a matter of whether I ‘would.’ I would grant her wish for my freedom, and then I would grant whatever her second wish might be." "Ah, ah," Viviane starts, lifting a finger and wagging it at Oma. "You skipped over the important part! I would only wish for your freedom if you agreed to not try and twist my second wish around my words. That’s what I’m curious about." "And that’s why I’m having difficulty answering [pc.name]’s question," Oma shoots back. "I was made into a genie because of my hubris. I’m a living example of how reaching for power without consequences can turn on a person and, in some way, I feel it was my purpose to try and teach others of that lesson. That you’d knowingly try to circumvent that... gives me pause. It speaks to the heights of imagination that the greed of the races of Savarra can achieve." Oma’s eyes cast towards the ground, her expression pained and confused. "But it’d be my freedom," she says. "To be rid of that damn lamp for good. I would never have to serve another master again. Would I agree to something so transparently greedy in exchange for my own freedom?" [viv.isDemon |Viviane smirks as she waits for Oma to come to her decision. She’s enjoying this; she’s enjoying watching Oma struggle with her own morals, despite the fact that you had already wished for her freedom. |Viviane doesn’t say anything; she patiently waits for Oma to come to her own decision about whether her principles and learned morals are more important to her than her own freedom, and that’s not something she can offer insight into. ] "I think I would," she answers after a time. Viviane laughs once. [viv.isDemon |"Did you have such a difficult time answering that same question when [pc.name] wished for your freedom?" "The difference, Viviane, is that [pc.name] did not ask for strings to be attached." Viviane smiles as she turns back towards the campfire. "A missed opportunity, perhaps," she says. |"Well, if ‘punishing greed’ is something that you’re worried about, I could just as easily wish for something like a box of enchanted materials. Something easy and simple that I could do myself, but wishing for it would take out a lot of the legwork. That way, we both come out ahead, and I don’t ask you to break your morals about hubris and reaching for power. We both win!" Oma doesn’t answer, though. Her eyes are focused on her own feet as she considers what she had just said — that some part of her is still mortal enough to pine for her personal freedom and would willingly go against the morals she had been taught to achieve it. "I’ll take it that this conversation is over," Viviane says to you. "So, there’s my answer. I hope it helped!" ] ]
rows.translation: 坐在营火旁的是薇薇安；她的右手拿着一本翻开的书，翻到了靠近书首的某一页，而她的左手则通过手腕和手指的灵活动作，在空气中绘制出各种图案和花纹。每当她做出某个动作时，她面前的火焰就会微微晃动，那些逼近她手指的火焰也会发生异常的变化——它们的颜色会从橙色变成蓝色，再变成绿色，然后又重新变回橙色。 当你呼唤她的名字时，她对火焰的注意力就会分散，于是她会用那只现在空闲下来的手把手中的书折起角，然后迅速将其合上。当她站起来的时候，她轻轻拍掉了长袍座位上的灰尘，然后以一种充满自信的步伐走向你，她的臀部随着步伐有节奏地摆动。“是的，”她说。 [pc.name]？”她问道。 你就直截了当地问她吧： [oma.isCollared |你正在认真考虑自己应该向奶奶许什么愿，因此想要听听别人的意见。如果由她来决定，她会许什么愿呢？ |如果奥玛仍然欠你人情……或者，更确切地说，如果奥玛确实处于欠你人情的状态的话她 – 她会许什么愿呢？你真好奇。 ] 其实我自己也考虑过这个问题有一段时间了，”她回答道。她微微一笑，向后仰靠在椅背上，手托着下巴，凝视着奥玛。“这个问题的答案并不容易给出。一方面，我本来是可以任何东西……但我觉得自己在选择用词时必须格外谨慎。我可不想因为自己的愿望而反而带来不好的后果。 [oma.isCollared |奥玛像往常一样，一动不动，面无表情。无论是薇薇安说得对还是错，她都没有发表任何意见。 |嗯，这其实取决于你究竟想要什么，”奥玛说道，她的舌头从嘴唇的角落伸了出来。不过，你注意到了，她并没有试图刻意安抚薇薇安以及她的担忧。 ] 所以，她什么都不想要吗？她宁愿通过自己的努力去获得足够的魔法能力，从而能够自己实现任何愿望？ 她沉思着，眯起眼睛，皱起鼻子，继续思考道：“你知道吗？我觉得这其实取决于我能得到多少个愿望……”她把目光转向你，“为了便于讨论，假设我能得到多少个愿望呢？我知道你[oma.isCollared |始于…… |拥有过 ]三个。” 那么，假设她只能许一个愿，她会许什么愿呢？ “什么都不愿。”她回答道，“一个愿望根本不够让我得到我真正想要的东西，否则我就可能会因为语义上的种种问题而陷入麻烦。[viv.isDemon | | 嗯，除了让奥玛获得自由之外，用一个愿望的话，我应该能够做到那件事。 ]好吧……如果她有两个会怎么样？这就是你的最终报价了。 “带着两个我会用我的第一个愿望来换取奥玛的自由，但前提是这个愿望必须在我的第二个愿望之后才能实现。以及前提是，她不能在实现我的第二个愿望时曲解我的意思，不能把我的话解释成我并不想要的意思。她应该根据我的真实意图来实现我的第二个愿望，而不是根据我表达的方式。”她停顿了一下，一边思考着自己的第二个愿望，一边轻声哼着小曲。至于我的第二个愿望……我还不太确定。知识当然是一个不错的选择，但学习魔法更像是一场旅程，而非终点。在掌握任何一种魔法体系的过程中，都有很多东西需要学习——而且，说实话，这个过程本身就非常有趣。”她笑着说。 你转向奥玛，询问如果薇薇安是她的主人，她是否会实现那些愿望。 [oma.isCollared |像往常一样，奥玛的表情依然僵硬得像石头一样——但她的眼睛却一次又一次地在你和薇薇安之间来回移动。当被给予获得自由的机会时，她必须同意不在自己的第二个愿望中试图歪曲薇薇安的话。她只需要同意这一点，就能成为自由的人了。 在经历了那一阵紧张的时刻之后，奥玛通过鼻子缓缓地叹了口气，说道：“这些愿望，我确实会满足的。 啊，啊，”薇薇安开始说道，她抬起一根手指，朝奥玛晃了晃。“那个并不是关键问题，你心里明白的。你愿意根据我的真实意图，而不是我使用的措辞，来满足我的第二个愿望吗？” 听到这里，奥玛的表情终于发生了变化：她的眉头紧锁，转身看向薇薇安，那双钢铁般的眼睛里仿佛燃起了火焰。你并不是那个[pc.master]贱人，”她大声吼道，“我根本不需要向你解释什么。 [viv.isDemon |她通过鼻子哼了一声，对奥玛的爆发表示不满，但她依然坚持自己的立场。 |她微微一愣，向后退了一步，但很快回过神来，又恢复了之前的姿势。 ]那么，”她清了清嗓子，然后转向你说，“这就是我的答案了。 [viv.isDemon |我什么都不想要。”她最后看了一眼奥玛，皱了皱鼻子，然后又转回篝火旁。“直到有人学会好好表现为止。 |奥玛的自由——前提是她愿意听像我这样的女人的话。 ] 奥玛注视着你，她的背部依然挺得笔直，但当你的目光与她相遇时，她立刻将视线移向地面，无法与你对视。 |奥玛的嘴唇因犹豫而微微扭曲。她的目光在你和薇薇安之间游移，然后望向天空，又重新回到你的脸上。“我，”她开始说道，字句仿佛经过仔细斟酌后才从口中吐出，“嗯……如果我的主人有什么要求，我都有义务满足。这不是我是否愿意的问题。我会满足她关于我自由的愿望，然后也会满足她的第二个任何愿望。” “啊，啊，”薇薇安说着，抬起手指朝奥玛晃了晃。你跳过了最重要的部分！只有在你答应不试图曲解我的第二个愿望的意思时，我才会真心希望你获得自由。那就是。这就是我之所以难以回答的原因。 [pc.name]你的问题，”奥玛反问道，“正是因为我的傲慢，我才会变成一个精灵。我就是一个活生生的例子，说明了不考虑后果地追求权力会如何改变一个人。在某种程度上，我觉得自己的使命就是让其他人认识到这个道理。而你却故意试图绕过这个道理……这让我感到非常困惑。这也充分说明了萨瓦拉那些种族的贪婪究竟能达到何种地步。” 奥玛的目光落在地上，她的表情中充满了痛苦与困惑。“但那本来应该是我的自由就是这样，”她说，“彻底摆脱那该死的灯。这样我就再也不用为别的主人效力了。为了换取自己的自由，我难道会同意接受这样明目张胆的贪婪要求吗？ [viv.isDemon |薇薇安露出得意的笑容，等待着奥玛做出决定。她乐在其中——她喜欢看着奥玛在自己的道德观中陷入挣扎，尽管你们早就希望她获得自由。 |薇薇安没有说任何话，她耐心地等待着奥玛自己做出决定——究竟对她来说，自己的原则和所学到的道德准则，是否比自己的自由更为重要。而这一点，她也无能为力去给出建议或见解。 ] 我想我会的，”她过了一会儿才回答。 薇薇安轻笑了一声。 [viv.isDemon |当初回答那个问题时，你也遇到了这么大的困难吗？ [pc.name]是渴望获得自由吗？” “区别在于，薇薇安，关键在于[pc.name]并没有要求附上那些字符串。” 薇薇安微笑着，转身走向篝火。“或许，这是一个错失的机会吧，”她说。 |嗯，如果你担心‘惩罚贪婪’这样的问题，那我完全也可以选择许愿得到一箱附魔材料之类的东西。这样既简单又方便，我可以自己动手去获取，而且许愿这种方式也能省去很多麻烦。这样一来，我们双方都能从中受益。以及我并不是要求你违背自己关于傲慢与追求权力的道德准则。这样我们双方都能得到好处。” 然而，奥玛并没有回答。她的目光紧紧盯着自己的足部，正在思考自己刚才所说的话——其实她内心深处仍然渴望个人自由，甚至愿意为了追求这种自由而违背自己一直以来被教导的道德准则。 那么，这次谈话就到此结束吧，”薇薇安对你说，“这就是我的答案。希望它能对你有所帮助！ ] ]

"Not until someone learns to start behaving." |Oma’s freedom — assuming she’d be willing to listen to wench like me. ] Oma watches you, her back still stiff and straight, but when your eyes meet, she casts them towards the ground, unable to meet you eye-to-eye. |Oma’s mouth twists with uncertainty. Her eyes wander between you and Viviane’s, then up towards the sky, then back to yours. "I," she starts, her mouth chewing her words carefully. "Well... I’d be obligated to grant whatever wish my master would have of me. It’s not a matter of whether I ‘would.’ I would grant her wish for my freedom, and then I would grant whatever her second wish might be." "Ah, ah," Viviane starts, lifting a finger and wagging it at Oma. "You skipped over the important part! I would only wish for your freedom if you agreed to not try and twist my second wish around my words. That’s what I’m curious about." "And that’s why I’m having difficulty answering [pc.name]’s question," Oma shoots back. "I was made into a genie because of my hubris. I’m a living example of how reaching for power without consequences can turn on a person and, in some way, I feel it was my purpose to try and teach others of that lesson. That you’d knowingly try to circumvent that... gives me pause. It speaks to the heights of imagination that the greed of the races of Savarra can achieve." Oma’s eyes cast towards the ground, her expression pained and confused. "But it’d be my freedom," she says. "To be rid of that damn lamp for good. I would never have to serve another master again. Would I agree to something so transparently greedy in exchange for my own freedom?" [viv.isDemon |Viviane smirks as she waits for Oma to come to her decision. She’s enjoying this; she’s enjoying watching Oma struggle with her own morals, despite the fact that you had already wished for her freedom. |Viviane doesn’t say anything; she patiently waits for Oma to come to her own decision about whether her principles and learned morals are more important to her than her own freedom, and that’s not something she can offer insight into. ] "I think I would," she answers after a time. Viviane laughs once. [viv.isDemon |"Did you have such a difficult time answering that same question when [pc.name] wished for your freedom?" "The difference, Viviane, is that [pc.name] did not ask for strings to be attached." Viviane smiles as she turns back towards the campfire. "A missed opportunity, perhaps," she says. |"Well, if ‘punishing greed’ is something that you’re worried about, I could just as easily wish for something like a box of enchanted materials. Something easy and simple that I could do myself, but wishing for it would take out a lot of the legwork. That way, we both come out ahead, and I don’t ask you to break your morals about hubris and reaching for power. We both win!" Oma doesn’t answer, though. Her eyes are focused on her own feet as she considers what she had just said — that some part of her is still mortal enough to pine for her personal freedom and would willingly go against the morals she had been taught to achieve it. "I’ll take it that this conversation is over," Viviane says to you. "So, there’s my answer. I hope it helped!" ] ]'

rows.original: Plopped next to your camp’s fire is your pack, with the backrest leaning up against a log that’s been rolled into place. You know that Lyric’s in there; you don’t know what [lyric.heShe]’s doing, but you imagine that, given how compact it is in there and how toasty it must be, that [lyric.heShe]’s quite comfortable. Maybe [lyric.heShe]’s taking a nap. When you call [lyric.hisHer] name, the pack starts to bounce and jostle, fidgeting again and again as Lyric struggles to find the mouth of the bag. You see a green, scaly finger jut up through the bag’s opening, then another to make it wider, and with a push, the mouth of the pack opens up, and out pops your kobold. [lyric.HeShe]’s less than graceful in pulling [lyric.himHer]self free from the pack, but, with a bit of effort, [lyric.heShe] is out and quickly skitters towards you. "Yes, [pc.name], I’m here!" [lyric.heShe] says, standing upright and at attention when [lyric.heShe] reaches you. You ask [lyric.himHer] plain and simple: [oma.isCollared |you’re strongly considering your options for what to wish for from Oma, and you were looking for second opinions. If it were up to [lyric.himHer], what would [lyric.heShe] wish for? |if Oma were still beholden to you – or, better yet, if Oma was beholden to [lyric.himHer] – what would [lyric.heShe] wish for? You’re curious. ] The question makes Lyric pause; [lyric.hisHer] eyes narrow and [lyric.hisHer] nose scrunches up in thought as [lyric.heShe] considers the possibilities. "There’s a lot of things I could wish for," [lyric.heShe] admits. "I feel like the sciences of Savarra are really only starting to be understood, and I’d love nothing more than to be the one to facilitate a breakthrough of some kind in them. I could wish for equipment. Could I wish for equipment? Like, coils; alembics; copper that’s been stripped into long wire strings; things like that?" You confirm with [lyric.himHer] that [lyric.heShe] could wish for anything. Although, [lyric.heShe] will probably need to be more specific than that; there’s lots of room for error with ‘I wish for coils.’ Lyric hums again. "I’m not as good with my words as I am with my experiments," [lyric.heShe] admits, "so... I’d need to wish for something easy, or I’d need to put the time into really defining the specifics of my wish. So that I’d get exactly what I wanted." [lyric.HisHer] thick tail swishes behind [lyric.himHer]self, swaying the entire expanse of [lyric.hisHer] [lyric.electrumRange 0 100 200 |thick |fat |rotund ] kobold ass with it. "Could I wish for gold?" [lyric.heShe] asks with a totally innocent inflection, apparently apropos of nothing. "Like, not even gold coins; I’d just want a huge chunk of solid gold to snack on for months on end." [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma laughs once, loudly. "I like this one," she says to you. "I’ve never had a kobold master. If they’re all like Lyric, then they’d be easy to please." |Oma’s stiff, unbending posture and expression cracks. "Heh," she chuckles, exactly once, to herself, before going right back to her usual indifferent frown. ] "Oh!" Lyric says with a sudden start, jumping up on [lyric.hisHer] ankles. [lyric.HisHer] eyes light up like [dayNight |the sun in the day sky |the stars in the night sky ]... but just as quickly, [lyric.heShe] settles down. "Oh," [lyric.heShe] says again, as if [lyric.heShe] just realized that [lyric.heShe] had done something wrong. [lyric.HisHer] expression falters and [lyric.hisHer] tail hangs limp at [lyric.hisHer] waist, lying against the dirt beneath [lyric.himHer]. You tell [lyric.himHer] to speak [lyric.hisHer] mind. You invited [lyric.himHer] for [lyric.hisHer] opinion, after all; it’s not like you’re going to get mad for whatever it is [lyric.heShe] wishes for. Lyric looks away from you, not in embarrassment, but in shame. "Please don’t take this the wrong way," [lyric.heShe] says. "Being with you is some of the most exciting and fulfilling moments of my life, [pc.name]. I know I nearly froze to death in the snow when you found me, but I still look back on that day fondly because I met you, and I’ll follow you to the ends of the world and back for it." [lyric.HeShe] stops, lowering [lyric.hisHer] nose to the ground sadly. "I," [lyric.heShe] stutters. "I want to go home. Back to the south. Back to my village." [lyric.HeShe] blinks once, hard, and takes a deep sigh. "I guess it’d be empty, now, though. I’m the only one that managed to escape slavery. I guess... a more apt wish would be to live in a different time, where my village was never raided." You tell Lyric that [lyric.heShe] doesn’t need to justify [lyric.hisHer] wish to you. [lyric.HeShe] was a slave; wanting to correct that time in [lyric.hisHer] life is something you understand completely. "Not even just me, though," [lyric.heShe] continues. "My whole village was raided and kidnapped by orcs. Not even our Village Mother stood a chance. I love you, [pc.name], but... I’d... want that undone. It’s not just for my sake. I can’t begin to imagine what the others are going through right now." You turn to Oma. Is that a wish that she could grant? To go back in time and prevent something terrible from happening? [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma’s brow furrows in sympathy; the corners of her eyes moisten as she sees Lyric beat [lyric.himHer]self up over wanting to go back in time, even if it meant never meeting you. "I’m sorry," she says. "Time travel isn’t among the abilities I have as a genie." |Oma takes a long sigh through [lyric.hisHer] nose – and then kneels down to meet Lyric eye-to-eye. An unusually friendly gesture for someone as stiff and unforgiving as herself. "I understand full well the pain and suffering that a slave must endure," she says, her free hand going to the chain connecting her choker to her lamp and giving it a tug. "Believe me when I say that, if that were within my power, I’d grant it. But I’m afraid we both must make do with what we have." ] "I didn’t think so," Lyric responds. You soon feel [lyric.hisHer] hand in yours, squeezing you affectionately. "But... at least, in this timeline, I still have you, [pc.name]." [lyric.HeShe] smiles widely enough that it reaches [lyric.hisHer] eyes, but it doesn’t disguise the pain within them. [pc.isDK |It makes you feel like a consolation prize. |No matter how good you are to [lyric.himHer], there are scars that you won’t be able to heal, it seems. ] [oma.isCollared |[oma.freedomWishedFor |"But hey," [lyric.heShe] laughs, squeezing your hand once more before letting go. "That just means that my wish for a fat block of gold is still on the table, right?" You laugh – you’ll think about it. Lyric’s expression hangs on [lyric.hisHer] face as [lyric.hisHer] tail starts to wag hard enough to sway [lyric.hisHer] lower body. "Well, don’t think too long!" [lyric.heShe] says. |"Actually, she brings up a good point," Lyric says, squeezing your hand and giving it a tug. "[pc.name], why don’t you wish for Oma’s freedom, then? We’re both slaves, but I managed to give my slavers the slip – if I hated having chains on my wrists, then Oma would love to have that chain off her neck, I bet." Oma doesn’t respond. Her eyes stay on Lyric’s before hovering back up to yours. Her expression is as stony and stiff as ever... but you can just barely see her nostrils flare and her upper lip tremble at the thought of having her freedom granted to her. Something to think about. ] |"But hey," [lyric.heShe] laughs, squeezing your hand once more before letting go. "That just means that my wish for a fat block of gold is still on the table, right?" You laugh – it would be if you still had wishes for Oma to grant. Lyric’s expression drops again, but it’s more of a playful pout than what it was before. "Dang it," [lyric.heShe] grunts. ]
rows.translation: 你的背包被放在营火旁边，靠背靠在一根事先摆好的木棍上。你知道里面装着莉里克，但具体里面有什么，你却不清楚。 [lyric.heShe]虽然不清楚它具体在做什么，但你可以想象，考虑到它的体积那么小，而且内部肯定非常温暖，那么[lyric.heShe]相当舒适。也许吧。 [lyric.heShe]正在小睡呢。 当你打电话过去的时候[lyric.hisHer]当莉莉克努力寻找袋子的开口时，整个包裹开始不停地晃动、颠簸，她不停地扭动身体。这时，你看到一根绿色的、长满鳞片的手指从袋子的开口处伸了出来，紧接着又有一根手指把开口撑得更大了一些。随着最后一推，包裹的开口终于被完全打开了，你的狗头人伙伴也从里面钻了出来。 [lyric.HeShe]这种拉扯的方式实在不够优雅。 [lyric.himHer]虽然能够摆脱群体的束缚，但也需要付出一些努力。 [lyric.heShe]冲了出来，迅速朝你飞奔而来。“是的， [pc.name]，我在这里！ [lyric.heShe]说道，同时站得笔直，保持着敬立姿势。 [lyric.heShe]会找到你。 你会问[lyric.himHer]简单来说： [oma.isCollared |你正在认真考虑自己应该向欧玛许什么愿，因此才想听听别人的意见。如果由你来决定的话[lyric.himHer]那会怎么样呢？ [lyric.heShe]渴望得到什么？ |如果奥玛仍然欠你人情……或者，更确切地说，如果奥玛确实处于欠你人情的状态的话[lyric.himHer] – 会是什么样子呢[lyric.heShe]想要什么？你真是太好奇了。 ] 这个问题让莉里克停下了脚步； [lyric.hisHer]眼睛眯了起来[lyric.hisHer]皱着鼻子，陷入沉思[lyric.heShe]正在考虑各种可能性。“有很多事情我可以渴望得到[lyric.heShe]承认道：“我觉得萨瓦拉的那些科学理论其实才刚刚开始被人们理解，而我最渴望做的就是能够促成这些领域的某种突破。我真希望能有一些相应的设备……像线圈、蒸馏器，还有被拉成细长金属丝的铜线之类的东西，这些我都很需要。” 你向[lyric.himHer]确认，[lyric.heShe]确实可以许愿得到任何东西。不过，[lyric.heShe]恐怕还得说得更具体些；仅仅说“我希望得到一些线圈”的话，其实有很大的犯错空间。 莉莉克又轻声哼起了曲子：“比起用语言表达，我使用实验来表达自己的想法要更在行。 [lyric.heShe]承认道：“所以……我得许一个比较简单的愿望，否则就需要花时间仔细明确愿望的具体内容，这样才能确保得到自己真正想要的东西。 [lyric.HisHer]尾巴在身后甩来甩去[lyric.himHer]自我，影响着整个广阔的世界[lyric.hisHer] [lyric.electrumRange 0 100 200 |厚实的 |胖的 |圆润的 ]该死的狗头人，‘我能许个愿得到黄金吗？ [lyric.heShe]用一种完全天真的语气问道，似乎是在问一些无关紧要的事情：“比如说，甚至不需要金币；我只需要一大块纯金，这样就可以连续几个月当零食吃了。 [oma.freedomWishedFor |奥玛突然大笑起来，声音很大。“我喜欢这个，”她对你说，“我从来都没有遇到过像莉莉克这样的地精首领。如果所有的地精首领都像他那样，那就太容易取悦了。 |奥玛那僵硬、毫无表情的神情终于出现了裂痕。“呵呵，”她轻声笑了笑，只是自己笑了笑而已，随后又立刻恢复了那副惯常的冷漠表情。 ] 哦！”莉莉克突然惊叫起来，跳了起来。 [lyric.hisHer]脚踝。 [lyric.HisHer]眼睛亮了起来，仿佛[dayNight |白昼的太阳 |夜空中的星星 ]……但很快，情况又发生了变化。 [lyric.heShe]安定下来。“哦， [lyric.heShe]又重复说道，仿佛是在强调什么。 [lyric.heShe]刚刚才意识到[lyric.heShe]一定是做错了什么。 [lyric.HisHer]话语有些支支吾吾，显得有些不自然。 [lyric.hisHer]尾巴无精打采地耷拉着[lyric.hisHer]腰部紧贴着地面的泥土[lyric.himHer]你说吧。 [lyric.himHer]可以说[lyric.hisHer]注意，是你邀请了我。 [lyric.himHer]为了[lyric.hisHer]毕竟这只是个人意见而已，反正无论是什么意见，你也不会因此而生气吧。 [lyric.heShe]莉里克将目光移开，不是因为尴尬，而是因为羞愧。“请不要误解我的意思。 [lyric.heShe]说：“与你在一起，是我生命中最令人兴奋、最充满意义的时刻。 [pc.name]我知道，当你找到我的时候，我几乎在雪中冻死了，但每当我回想起那一天，我依然会感到无比欣慰，因为那就是我遇见你的日子。为了你，我愿意追随你到世界的尽头，然后再回来。 [lyric.HeShe]停下，降低[lyric.hisHer]沮丧地低下了头。“我， [lyric.heShe]结结巴巴地说：“我想回家。回到南方，回到我的村庄。 [lyric.HeShe]猛地眨了一下眼，深深地叹了口气，说道：“不过，现在那里应该已经空无一人了吧。我是唯一一个成功逃离奴役的人……或许，更恰当的愿望应该是活在一个不同的时代，一个我的村庄永远不会遭到袭击的时代。” 你把这句话告诉了莉里克。 [lyric.heShe]无需解释或证明[lyric.hisHer]祝你好运。 [lyric.HeShe]曾经是个奴隶；想要改变那段时候[lyric.hisHer]生命，是那种你能够完全理解的东西。 “不过，不仅仅是我这样认为。 [lyric.heShe]继续说道：“我的整个村庄都被兽人洗劫了，所有人都被绑架了。就连我们的村长也毫无反抗之力。我爱你[pc.name]，但是……我希望能撤销那个决定。这不仅仅是为了我自己。我根本无法想象其他人现在正在经历什么。” 你转向了奥玛。是吗？这是一个她能够实现的愿望吧？回到过去，阻止一些可怕的事情发生？ [oma.freedomWishedFor |奥玛看到莉莉克被打，眉头紧锁，眼中也泛起了泪光。 [lyric.himHer]我甚至愿意放弃回到过去的机会，哪怕这意味着永远无法与你相见。“对不起，”她说，“时候旅行并不是我作为精灵所拥有的能力之一。 |奥玛长叹一声。 [lyric.hisHer]首先低下头，然后跪下来，与莉里克平视相对。对于一个像她这样冷漠无情的人来说，这样的举动实在显得格外友好。“我完全理解奴隶所必须承受的痛苦与折磨，”她说，同时用自由的手拉了拉连接她项圈和灯笼的链条。“相信我，如果我有能力改变这种状况，我一定会这么做的。但恐怕我们俩都只能接受现状罢了。 ] 我可不这么认为，”莉莉克回答道。很快，你就会明白这个道理的。 [lyric.hisHer]把你的手交出来，我轻轻地捏捏你……但是……至少，在这个时间线，我依然在你身边。 [pc.name]。” [lyric.HeShe]笑容灿烂到仿佛能延伸到[lyric.hisHer]那双眼睛虽然看起来平静，但却无法掩盖其中的痛苦。 [pc.isDK |这会让你觉得自己就像是个安慰奖而已。 |无论你多么优秀[lyric.himHer]看来，有些伤痕是永远无法愈合的。 ] [oma.isCollared |[oma.freedomWishedFor |不过，嘿， [lyric.heShe]笑了笑，又握了握你的手，然后才松开。“这说明我想要一大块金子的愿望仍然有效，对吧？” 你笑了，决定再考虑考虑这个想法。 莉莉克仍把那副表情挂在[lyric.hisHer]脸上，而[lyric.hisHer]尾巴开始剧烈摇动，甚至足以产生摆动的效果。 [lyric.hisHer]嗯，别想太久了！ [lyric.heShe]说。 |其实，她提了一个很好的观点，”莉莉克说着，握了握你的手，轻轻拉了拉。[pc.name]，为什么不呢你那么，是不是也希望能让奶奶获得自由呢？我们都是奴隶，但我成功摆脱了那些奴役我的人——如果我讨厌手腕上戴着锁链，那么奶奶也一定一样吧爱我敢打赌，她肯定很希望有一条链子挂在脖子上。” 奥玛没有回答。她的目光始终停留在莉莉克身上，然后才慢慢移到你的身上。她的表情依旧僵硬冰冷……但你可以隐约看到，每当想到自己能够重获自由时，她的鼻孔会微微张开，上唇也会微微颤抖。 这确实是个值得思考的问题。 ] |不过，嘿， [lyric.heShe]笑了，又握了握你的手，然后才松开。“这说明我想要一大块金子的愿望还是有效的，对吧？” 你也笑了——如果你还希望欧玛能实现你的愿望的话，确实还是有效的。 莉莉克的表情又黯了下来，但这次更多是一种调皮的表情，而不是之前的那种沮丧。“真讨厌[lyric.heShe]哼哼声。 ]

"Heh," she chuckles, exactly once, to herself, before going right back to her usual indifferent frown. ] "Oh!" Lyric says with a sudden start, jumping up on [lyric.hisHer] ankles. [lyric.HisHer] eyes light up like [dayNight |the sun in the day sky |the stars in the night sky ]... but just as quickly, [lyric.heShe] settles down. "Oh," [lyric.heShe] says again, as if [lyric.heShe] just realized that [lyric.heShe] had done something wrong. [lyric.HisHer] expression falters and [lyric.hisHer] tail hangs limp at [lyric.hisHer] waist, lying against the dirt beneath [lyric.himHer]. You tell [lyric.himHer] to speak [lyric.hisHer] mind. You invited [lyric.himHer] for [lyric.hisHer] opinion, after all; it’s not like you’re going to get mad for whatever it is [lyric.heShe] wishes for. Lyric looks away from you, not in embarrassment, but in shame. "Please don’t take this the wrong way," [lyric.heShe] says. "Being with you is some of the most exciting and fulfilling moments of my life, [pc.name]. I know I nearly froze to death in the snow when you found me, but I still look back on that day fondly because I met you, and I’ll follow you to the ends of the world and back for it." [lyric.HeShe] stops, lowering [lyric.hisHer] nose to the ground sadly. "I," [lyric.heShe] stutters. "I want to go home. Back to the south. Back to my village." [lyric.HeShe] blinks once, hard, and takes a deep sigh. "I guess it’d be empty, now, though. I’m the only one that managed to escape slavery. I guess... a more apt wish would be to live in a different time, where my village was never raided." You tell Lyric that [lyric.heShe] doesn’t need to justify [lyric.hisHer] wish to you. [lyric.HeShe] was a slave; wanting to correct that time in [lyric.hisHer] life is something you understand completely. "Not even just me, though," [lyric.heShe] continues. "My whole village was raided and kidnapped by orcs. Not even our Village Mother stood a chance. I love you, [pc.name], but... I’d... want that undone. It’s not just for my sake. I can’t begin to imagine what the others are going through right now." You turn to Oma. Is that a wish that she could grant? To go back in time and prevent something terrible from happening? [oma.freedomWishedFor |Oma’s brow furrows in sympathy; the corners of her eyes moisten as she sees Lyric beat [lyric.himHer]self up over wanting to go back in time, even if it meant never meeting you. "I’m sorry," she says. "Time travel isn’t among the abilities I have as a genie." |Oma takes a long sigh through [lyric.hisHer] nose – and then kneels down to meet Lyric eye-to-eye. An unusually friendly gesture for someone as stiff and unforgiving as herself. "I understand full well the pain and suffering that a slave must endure," she says, her free hand going to the chain connecting her choker to her lamp and giving it a tug. "Believe me when I say that, if that were within my power, I’d grant it. But I’m afraid we both must make do with what we have." ] "I didn’t think so," Lyric responds. You soon feel [lyric.hisHer] hand in yours, squeezing you affectionately. "But... at least, in this timeline, I still have you, [pc.name]." [lyric.HeShe] smiles widely enough that it reaches [lyric.hisHer] eyes, but it doesn’t disguise the pain within them. [pc.isDK |It makes you feel like a consolation prize. |No matter how good you are to [lyric.himHer], there are scars that you won’t be able to heal, it seems. ] [oma.isCollared |[oma.freedomWishedFor |"But hey," [lyric.heShe] laughs, squeezing your hand once more before letting go. "That just means that my wish for a fat block of gold is still on the table, right?" You laugh – you’ll think about it. Lyric’s expression hangs on [lyric.hisHer] face as [lyric.hisHer] tail starts to wag hard enough to sway [lyric.hisHer] lower body. "Well, don’t think too long!" [lyric.heShe] says. |"Actually, she brings up a good point," Lyric says, squeezing your hand and giving it a tug. "[pc.name], why don’t you wish for Oma’s freedom, then? We’re both slaves, but I managed to give my slavers the slip – if I hated having chains on my wrists, then Oma would love to have that chain off her neck, I bet." Oma doesn’t respond. Her eyes stay on Lyric’s before hovering back up to yours. Her expression is as stony and stiff as ever... but you can just barely see her nostrils flare and her upper lip tremble at the thought of having her freedom granted to her. Something to think about. ] |"But hey," [lyric.heShe] laughs, squeezing your hand once more before letting go. "That just means that my wish for a fat block of gold is still on the table, right?" You laugh – it would be if you still had wishes for Oma to grant. Lyric’s expression drops again, but it’s more of a playful pout than what it was before. "Dang it," [lyric.heShe] grunts. ]'
