rows.raw: ' [oma.freedomWishedFor |You have the near-infinite powers of the genie at your disposal, and you could use it to wish for anything you want. You could use that wish on something immediately pragmatic[pc.isBimbo | or awesome ], like a weapon of some kind. You could try wishing for something more altruistic, like ending world hunger. But you need to look after yourself: the world is a dangerous and unforgiving place, and even something as mundane as the elements can be dangerous if you’re not prepared. Every time you leave a safe haven like Hawkethorne, you’re putting a lot of trust in the fact that you’ve adequately prepared yourself for whatever trial lies ahead of you. It’s not enough to have a sturdy shield, a strong sword, and some warm clothes: even something like not packing your lunch adequately could have disastrous effects down the line. How could you wish for something like ending world hunger if you can’t even feed yourself? If there’s any one thing that you’ve learned since you’ve started this journey, it’s that having a properly prepared pack can make the difference between life and death. And even with a large pack and proper knowledge on how to make the most efficient use of your pack space, it’s often all too easy to run out of room for anything long before you’re prepared for that. Having more space in your pack would be a godsend – you ask Oma if she could give you a larger pack to store your items in. In response, she frowns in confusion, tilting her head to one side and raising an eyebrow. "You could simply purchase a larger pack," she offers. That’s true, you could. But that’s not what you asked. Oma clicks her tongue as she considers your question. "I mean, yes, granting you a larger pack is obviously within my power," she continues, "but that seems like a terrible use of a wish. A larger pack is something that you could purchase. You could make one yourself with some materials, skill, and time." Oma crosses her arms and rests her chin on her free hand as she considers the wish. "And there’s the logistics. A larger pack would allow you to store more items – but a larger pack would also sag down closer to the ground, reducing your mobility. And more items mean more weight, and a heavier pack could be a death trap for harsher environments and terrains." It sounds to you like she’s trying to talk you out of making this wish. "Not at all," she answers. "I’m trying to help you not waste a wish. Like I said, a larger pack is within my power, but there are practical challenges to overcome – all of which are also within my power; they simply need to be addressed and specified in the wish." Okay, so: you need to wish for a pack that is larger– Oma interrupts you before you can even get your first thought out. "I don’t think a ‘larger’ pack is the correct route to take." Then... what? Can she somehow make the space inside of your pack larger without making the pack itself any bigger? "Yes, actually." ... Wow. You weren’t serious. Is there a limit? Can she only double the ‘space’ within your pack? "No, there is no limit," she answers. "Imagine a house that’s small on the outside, but is larger on the inside. I can do that to an infinite degree: there would be an entire dimension of limitless space within the pockets of your pack, all without making the pack itself any larger." [pc.cunningRange 0 50 |That sounds incredible! There’s no limit to what a pack like that could achieve – you could put yourself into that pack and live a warm, comfortable life. You could assemble an entire house in there[lyric.around |! You’d know just what it’d be like for Lyric living in your pack, too ]! "You don’t want that," Oma cautions. |That’s– Wait, that sounds like a bad thing. Oma smiles a toothy, genuine smile. "You’re quick," she congratulates. ]"Having a pack with infinite space means you’d never be able to find anything you place inside of it. If you dropped a rock into the pack’s pocket, it’d simply fall forever; there would be no ground for it to hit. There needs to be some form of moderation." So... what you want is more space, but not an infinite amount. You want space in your pack that you can reach within arm’s length. And you want your pack to remain the same weight as it is now. Oma hums, her eyes wandering as she runs the scenario through her head again and again. "I think that should work," she eventually says. "I can’t think of any other reasons why that could fail." In that case, you make it official: you wish for double the amount of space within your pack, and for your pack to not gain any additional weight when you place things in it. Oma’s eyes blink, and her irises, and the entirety of her long, flowing ponytail, go from slate silver to a radiant rainbow of colors. She snaps her fingers on her left hand, itself glowing a pale blue from her fingers to her wrist, before everything settles back down and her body returns to the way it was. "Your wish has been granted." You set down your pack. Sure enough, it doesn’t look any different, nor does it weigh any more than it just did. When you open up its main pocket, though, you see that its inner lining doesn’t match with its outer lining: the space within the pack has been increased, the dimensions of the interior being mismatched with the exterior.[lyric.around | Inside your pack is a very surprised kobold, laying flat on [lyric.hisHer] back now that there’s so much space inside. "What just happened?" [lyric.heShe] asks in bewilderment. You tell it to [lyric.himHer] honestly: you wished for Oma the genie to make the inside of your pack bigger so that– "So that I could have more living space?!" [lyric.heShe] interrupts, [lyric.hisHer] eyes wide with joy. ... Yep. [lyric.HeShe]’s got it. Lyric sits up, [lyric.hisHer] hands reaching up through the mouth of the pack, and [lyric.heShe] gently grips onto your cheeks. Pulling [lyric.himHer]self to [lyric.hisHer] knees, [lyric.heShe] closes the gap between you two and leans in, kissing you on the mouth. It’s a quick peck, but the appreciation is apparent. "You’re the best," [lyric.heShe] says, nuzzling [lyric.hisHer] nose against yours, before settling back down into the pack’s main pocket, appreciating just how roomier it is in there. ] You can now hold twice as many stackable items. |You try and rack your mind on things that you could use the near-infinite powers of the genie to make your life easier. Life is full of little inconveniences that you have to put up with, but you’ve gotten so used to it that it’s difficult to think of them on the spot. Sure, your feet get tired when you walk for a long time, but is wishing for ‘no pain when you walk’ a waste? Can you not think of something better? If you can’t, would wishing for something like that even be wise? When you cross your arms, you heft your pack so that you can get your hand into a more comfortable position against its strap. It’s a small action that you do unconsciously, and you almost ignore it completely – when, suddenly, inspiration strikes. Having a pack to keep all of your adventuring gear in is an absolute necessity for your survival. It carries everything from food, to temporary shelters, to survival gear[lyric.around |, and even living creatures ]. You’d have been dead a few times over without your pack by now... which only serves to remind you of how limited it can be sometimes. There are times when you wish you had more space for more items. You’ve already convinced yourself, given how naturally you just thought of the word ‘wish’ for your inventory space. You ask Oma if it’d be possible to somehow grant you more space in your pack; if it’d be possible to store more things with you while you travel. "You could simply obtain a larger pack," Oma offers humorlessly. Sure, you could – but that’s not what you asked. "Manipulating the space within your pack to grant you more space than it can outwardly carry is within my power, yes." Is there a limit? Can she only, say, double the ‘space’ within your pack? "There is no limit, no." ... Wow. You have to be careful about this, though: there are lots of logistical challenges that go into having a pack with infinite space. Infinite space would also mean infinite weight. [etheryn.around |Just as you start to put some real thought into how to phrase the question, though, your train of thought is interrupted by the sound of wings flapping through the air – it’s a quiet sound, and you barely picked it up, but it contrasts against the quiet ambience just enough to stand out. And before you have a chance to turn your head and see what it is, something large lands on the pack you had set down nearby. It’s Harrick, Etheryn’s hunting hawk – and he’s got something in his talons. A [rand |lizard |rabbit ], its body having been gored through with his sharp claws and beak, the blood dripping off different parts of his body. Harrick gives you one look before he starts trying to hide his fresh kill in the open main pocket of your pack[lyric.around | – and causing Lyric, still inside, to shriek in surprise and kick [lyric.hisHer] legs to try and get Harrick to leave before dropping a dead animal onto [lyric.himHer] ]. "Harrick, no, not in there!" Etheryn shouts, running up to the pack to retrieve Harrick. He fusses, his wings spreading and flapping, and he makes a loud ‘caw’ in indignation that Etheryn is interrupting his meal, but, ultimately and begrudgingly, he concedes to letting her pick him up – but not to dropping his kill. "I’m sorry about that," Etheryn says sheepishly as she sets Harrick down on the ground, standing between him and your pack. "He gets all fussy and independent if I take too long to feed him, and he can be a bit of a hoarder over food. I hope we’re not interrupting anything." rows.raw: ' Oma is cursed to abide by the whims and fancies of whomsoever possesses the lamp, and now, that happens to be you. You are entitled to [oma.wishesLeftRange 1 2 3 |just one wish left |two remaining wishes |three whole wishes ]; you could wish for anything at all. Anything. The near-endless powers of the genie are at your fingertips; all you’d need is to say the specific word, and Oma would grant it to you. You ask Oma if you wi – if you asked for her freedom. That’s a thing that she could grant, right? Oma sighs through her nose, taking in a deep lungful of air and exhaling it all before entertaining the question. "Yes," she eventually answers, but it’s with an annoyed downward lilt in her voice, like she’s answered this question thousands of times to someone that refuses to listen. [oma.wishesLeftRange 2 |W |You know that you don’t, but, w ]hat if you had more wishes left after that? Would she still be [pc.cunningRange 0 40 |forced to grant |beholden to granting ] them? "The words ‘freedom’ and '[pc.cunningRange 0 40 |forced |beholden ]’ are oxymoronic," she says, her voice coming out louder and gravelly. Her brow furrows in frustration – this is clearly a touchy topic for her. With every master, her freedom is dangled in front of her like a treat that pulls away whenever she reaches for it, and the generations of jaded experience is starting to show.[pc.cunningRange 0 40 | So... that means ‘no,’ you’re guessing. Oma just sighs again. ] [pc.isBimbo |Okay, but, like... [oma.wishesLeftRange 2 |you still have [oma.wishesLeftRange 3 |three |two ] wishes left, and you still want to use them. Seeing Oma wrapped up in those golden chains is a kinky accessory and all, but she’s clearly not into it, and if one of you isn’t into it, then it’s not a kink; it’s torture. Which can also be kinky, but – wait, no, you’re trying to focus on something else, here. Like, but there’s gotta be a way, though, right? You could just make [oma.wishesLeftRange 1 2 |one more wish |two wishes ], and then use your last one on her freedom, but, like, can’t you do it now? You have a hard time focusing and remembering stuff sometimes. Couldn’t you say something like, ‘Oma, I wish for your freedom, but only after I die or you grant my [oma.wishesLeftRange 1 2 |last wish |next two wishes | ], whatever happens first,’ or something? |you’ve used two of your three wishes, so... you could use your last wish on something else, but seeing Oma wrapped up in those golden chains makes you think that maybe she’d enjoy it if she didn’t have to. And you could get into the whole master/slave thing, if whoever held the lamp asked nicely – but you can tell when someone isn’t okay with a kink, and Oma is not okay with this kink. Um... you have just about everything that you could want. At least, off the top of your head. Something is going to come up later and you’re going to want a thing and you’re going to wish Oma was here – oh, but then, if Oma was there, then wishing for her to be there would be a waste of a wish, wouldn’t it? Wait, you’ve gotten yourself all tangled up. It’s better to skip straight to the end: you wish for Oma to be free! ] |[pc.cunningRange 0 40 |You’re not... a particularly smart [pc.manWoman]. You’re just barely smart enough to know how smart you aren’t. But in a way, that’s kind of its own blessing: the life that you have now is good for you. Sure, sometimes, things can be tough, but you never really had any want for anything, and even though you have a genie here that says she can grant any wish that you can think of, that just opens up way too many doors for you to keep track of. If you have the ability to wish for anything you can think of, how can you possibly think of anything? There’s nothing in this world that you can think that you’d both want, and you’d ask a genie for. Sometimes you get hungry, but you don’t need a genie to scavenge, hunt, or prepare your own meals for you. But standing in front of you is a woman that’s literally wrapped up in chains, forced to hold an object in her hands at all times against her will, and cursed to answer to your every beck and call. It doesn’t matter if you have [oma.wishesLeftRange 1 2 3 |a wish |two wishes |three wishes ] left to spend on yourself; what matters is that you can help her. So, then... you tell Oma that you wish for her to be free. |[oma.wishesLeftRange 2 |The thing is, you still have [oma.wishesLeftRange 3 |three wishes |two wishes ] left, but [pc.isDK |[oma.wishesLeftRange 3 |from the look on Oma’s face |from the way Oma granted your first wish ], you kind of figure that she’s going to be an absolute bitch to do what you want her to do. If you were a thirsty [pc.manWoman] wishing for some water, she’d sooner drown you before giving you what you meant |you’re not an evil person: Oma may be a genie, but she’s also a person, and she’s being held against her will to perform actions she is compelled by a curse to perform. She’s a slave, and as long as you hold the lamp, you are her slaver ]. [pc.isDK |But you’re also not a fool |But you’re also... well... you’re the master to a genie here. You’re not an evil person – or so you like to think you aren’t – but absolutely everybody would hesitate as willfully throwing away that sort of absolute power ]. You still have [oma.wishesLeftRange 2 |two wishes |all three wishes ] left, and you’re not going to just waste them. All it requires is a bit of clever wordplay. After a moment of deliberation, you think you have the perfect sentence to [pc.isDK |get Oma to cooperate – and, bonus, even give her something she wants – without wasting your every remaining wish |give Oma her freedom, but only after you get what you want first – that way, you won’t succumb to temptation on your third wish ]. You turn to Oma and you say to her that you wish for her freedom, on the condition that she grants your [oma.wishesLeftRange 2 |other two wishes |last remaining wish ] first. Or you die. Whichever happens first. |When Oma first appeared out of that lamp, she said that you were her [pc.master] and that she was obligated to grant you three wishes. Since then, she’s granted you two, and... they haven’t exactly gone the way you had expected them to. A part of you is indignant, of course. You wanted your wishes granted and Oma willfully twisted your words to result in something literally correct, but against your intent. But you can also empathize with what she’s going through: [pc.isDK |if you were consigned to living in a lamp for all of eternity and to be the slave of anyone that put their hands on it, you’d be fucking pissed all the time and difficult to work with, too. |she is, after all, a slave, and although she may be literally forced to do whatever you want, you can’t make her want to do anything you ask of her. You’d probably be cranky, for lack of a better term, if you had to do what she has had to do for generations upon generations, too. ] [pc.isDK |You openly admit that you can be an asshole during the best of times, but... well, rather than think of it as you being altruistic, you decide to think of it as not allowing anyone in the future the opportunity to use Oma for whatever they want, instead. If Oma won’t cooperate with you, then nobody gets wishes. |You’re not an evil person. The idea of near-infinite power to grant whatever it is you wanted had gotten the best of you, and it took Oma being spiteful and indignant for you to realize just how far your hubris went. She’s a slave, and you tried to take advantage of that; it’s only proper that you didn’t get what you wanted. And it’s only proper that you set things right. ] You turn to Oma and tell her that, for your final wish, you wish for her to be free. ] ] ] [var0 |Oma’s normally stone-still, hardened expression immediately cracks: her brow lifts, her eyes widen, and her triangular ears perk upward, as if she was trying to listen for something in the air. "What?" she asks, her voice higher in pitch than usual. Suddenly, the lamp in her hand, as well as the choker around her neck and the massive golden chain connecting the two, starts to glow: the polished gold illuminates itself, shining its luster on everything from Oma’s skin to the ground around her. She recoils as she looks down at her lamp, caught by surprise by the light – the light emanating from the metal is clearly magical in nature, but she didn’t do that. A few seconds later, the light calms down, and the lamp, the choker, and the chain return to the polish that they had before. And yet Oma continues to stare at the lamp in her hand, her eyes wide with bewilderment, like she had never seen it before. When she manages to tear her eyes away from it to you, she looks at you like... like she’s a slave, and you, a person she had only just met, had opened her cage. [pc.isBimbo |You ask Oma what that was all about. All you did was– Wait. Fuck! You used a wish, didn’t you? Shit, that’s not what you meant to do at all! All you meant to do was ask a question! Did you just lose that wish? Can you undo that? You don’t want to use any wishes until you’re absolutely sure of what you want to use them on. Oma ignores your rambling; she stares at her lamp, dumbfounded, her mouth ajar. You’re pretty sure she hasn’t heard a word you said. "[pc.Master]," Oma says just as you start your rant over from the beginning. Her mouth still hangs open, but the corners of her lips start to lift, and she lets out a single, soft, shuddering exhale. Oma doesn’t answer; her eyes stare at the lamp in her hand, her mouth agape, totally dumbfounded by what had just happened. You aren’t positive that she heard you. After a moment of awkward silence between you two, Oma’s eyes lift from the lamp to yours. rows.original: You’ve already wished for Oma’s freedom on the stipulation that it’s only granted after she grants your [oma.wishesLeftRange 2|next two wishes|last remaining wish]. For a lot of people – pointedly, for every other master that she’s ever had – you’ve already done more than what they would do when given the opportunity of near-limitless potential. There are few people in the world that would look at the possibilities that the powers of the genie would have and willingly turn it away. [pc.isDK |But still, you’re curious. You could have just wished for her freedom and been done with it. You’re not about to waste your [oma.wishesLeftRange 2|two wishes|last wish] on nothing just to move things along, but... could you wish for nothing? Is that somehow an option? Could you wish for, say, more air to breathe? |But even still, you’re... well... Oma is a slave. There’s a part of you that feels guilty every time you look at the choker around her neck and you expect her to keep granting wishes. Sure, you could have just wished for her freedom up-front, but... well, in the face of ultimate power, you flinched. You couldn’t just give it all up right then and there. ] "You’ve already wished for the one thing that I want more than anything else in the world, and even now, you’re still considered with me and my wants," Oma says, tilting her head and smiling at you. "You’re a different breed of [pc.master], I hope you know that." She rights her position, standing upright and straightening her back. It’s a familiar posture that she’s taken ever since she first came out of that lamp... but there’s something different about it. Something more... alert. More excited and willing. "[pc.Master], before I met you, and before you wished for my freedom, I was a vindictive, spiteful woman, forced to obey the literal whims of my masters by the curse of the lamp. I would fulfill every wish to my master’s exact specifications; I would deliberately go out of my way to misinterpret the intent of the wish in order to punish them for their hubris." She smiles again, wide enough to show you her teeth; it’s a true, genuine smile, of a woman that’s happy to be where she is, and she’s ready to get to work. "You are my fifty-seventh [pc.master], yet you are the first to put me ahead of yourself – the first to consider me a person and not a tool. My freedom is guaranteed. You’ve already done so much more than all fifty-six of my other masters had done, and I’d like to reward your generosity by granting you your wishes – as you intend them." She reaches toward you, cupping your cheek with her free hand. "No trickery; no specificities. You deserve better than that. Let me reward you as a genie that’s glad to be a genie for the first time in hundreds of years." [pc.isDK |Hell yeah, that’s what you like to hear! |You still have that niggling little guilty thought in the back of your head that you shouldn’t be doing this... but Oma telling you that it’s alright definitely helps a lot. All she wants is to grant your wishes, and she’s willing to do it honestly. Maybe you can let yourself splurge a bit. ]
rows.translation: 你已经许愿让奥玛获得自由，条件是只有在她实现你的[oma.wishesLeftRange 2|接下来两个愿望|最后一个愿望]之后，这份自由才会被赐予。对很多人来说——尤其是对她拥有过的每一位其他主人来说——你已经比他们在面对近乎无限的可能性时会做的更多了。这世上很少有人会看清精灵之力所带来的一切可能，却仍然主动把它推开。 [pc.isDK |但你还是好奇。你本来可以直接许愿让她自由，然后就此了事。你并不打算只为了让事情往前走，就把你的[oma.wishesLeftRange 2|两个愿望|最后一个愿望]白白浪费在毫无意义的东西上，但是……可以你许一个什么都不求的愿望吗？那真的算是一种选择吗？比如说，你能不能许愿要有更多可以呼吸的空气呢？ |但即便如此，你还是……嗯……奥玛是个奴隶。每次看到脖子上的项圈、想到你还指望她继续实现愿望时，你心里总有一部分感到愧疚。当然，你本可以一上来就许愿给她自由，但是……嗯，面对那至高的力量，你退缩了。你没法在那一刻就把它全部放弃。 ] “你已经许下了我在这个世界上最想要的那件事，而即便如此，你现在依然会顾念我和我的需求，”奥玛歪着头，对你微笑。“你真是另一种[pc.master]，我希望你明白这一点。” 她重新端正姿势，站直身体，挺起背脊。这是她第一次从那盏灯里出来后便一直保持的熟悉姿态……但这一次有些不同。某种更加……警觉的东西。更加兴奋，也更加心甘情愿。 “[pc.Master]，在我遇见你之前，在你为我许愿自由之前，我是一个心怀怨恨、充满恶意的女人，因为那盏灯的诅咒，不得不服从主人们字面意义上的任性。我会把每一个愿望都按主人字面上的规格实现；我会刻意去曲解愿望的意图，以此惩罚他们的傲慢。” 她又笑了，笑得露出牙齿；那是一个真实的、发自内心的笑容，属于一个满足于自己处境、并且准备好开始干活的女人。“你是我的第五十七个[pc.master]，可你是第一个把我放在你自己之前的人——第一个把我当成人而不是工具的人。我的自由已经有保障了。你为我做的，已经比我另外五十六位主人做过的多得多，所以我想以赐予你愿望来回报你的慷慨——按你真正的意愿来赐予。”她向你伸出手，用空着的那只手捧住你的脸颊。“没有诡计，没有钻字眼。你值得比那更好的对待。就让我以一个几百年来第一次乐于成为精灵的精灵来回报你吧。” [pc.isDK |太棒了，这正是你想听到的！ |你心里还是隐隐有一丝愧疚，觉得自己不该这么做……但奥玛告诉你这没什么关系，确实让你好受了许多。她只是想实现你的愿望，而且她愿意诚实地去做。也许，你可以允许自己稍微放纵一下。 ]

Sure, you could have just wished for her freedom up-front, but... well, in the face of ultimate power, you flinched. You couldn’t just give it all up right then and there. ] "You’ve already wished for the one thing that I want more than anything else in the world, and even now, you’re still considered with me and my wants," Oma says, tilting her head and smiling at you. "You’re a different breed of [pc.master], I hope you know that." She rights her position, standing upright and straightening her back. It’s a familiar posture that she’s taken ever since she first came out of that lamp... but there’s something different about it. Something more... alert. More excited and willing. "[pc.Master], before I met you, and before you wished for my freedom, I was a vindictive, spiteful woman, forced to obey the literal whims of my masters by the curse of the lamp. I would fulfill every wish to my master’s exact specifications; I would deliberately go out of my way to misinterpret the intent of the wish in order to punish them for their hubris." She smiles again, wide enough to show you her teeth; it’s a true, genuine smile, of a woman that’s happy to be where she is, and she’s ready to get to work. "You are my fifty-seventh [pc.master], yet you are the first to put me ahead of yourself – the first to consider me a person and not a tool. My freedom is guaranteed. You’ve already done so much more than all fifty-six of my other masters had done, and I’d like to reward your generosity by granting you your wishes – as you intend them." She reaches toward you, cupping your cheek with her free hand. "No trickery; no specificities. You deserve better than that. Let me reward you as a genie that’s glad to be a genie for the first time in hundreds of years." [pc.isDK |Hell yeah, that’s what you like to hear! |You still have that niggling little guilty thought in the back of your head that you shouldn’t be doing this... but Oma telling you that it’s alright definitely helps a lot. All she wants is to grant your wishes, and she’s willing to do it honestly. Maybe you can let yourself splurge a bit. ] '

[flags.OMA_FREEDOM_WISH_LAST
        |Before the luster of the lamp becomes too much to handle, Oma frantically starts weaving her free hand about, trying to cast some other form of magic. It’s too difficult to make out from the brightness of the lamp, but you happen to catch her index finger moving in a circular motion, and you see something being created out of thin air just above her palm, but you don’t catch anything more than that.
        |Oma’s normally stone-still, hardened expression immediately cracks: her brow lifts, her eyes widen, and her triangular ears perk upward, as if she was trying to listen for something in the air. "What?" she asks, her voice higher in pitch than usual.
        
        Suddenly, the lamp in her hand, as well as the choker around her neck and the massive golden chain connecting the two, starts to glow: the polished gold illuminates itself, shining its luster on everything from Oma’s skin to the ground around her. She recoils as she looks down at her lamp, caught by surprise by the light – the light emanating from the metal is clearly magical in nature, but she didn’t do that.
    ]
    
    Just as the luster starts to become difficult to look at, it fades, the lamp, chain, and choker all returning to their former sheen. Oma stares at the lamp in her hand with a combination of surprise and trepidation – and then, suddenly, there’s a ‘click!’ loud enough to make her flinch. And when she does, the choker around her neck comes undone from behind her neck: it snaps open, then it falls, left dangling to the lamp by the chain. Just like that, Oma is no longer bound to the lamp.
    
    When the choker hangs limp from the chain, the shining gleam of its gold fades further, going from a brilliant gold to a shiny orange to a dull brown before rusting through in the space of a few seconds. The choker and the six thick, heavy chain links all age by thousands of years in a moment before flaking apart and turning to dust, wisping away with the next light breeze. All that remains is the lamp in her hand, unchanged.
    
    Oma stands, her eyes wide and her mouth agape in shock. Tears start to well in their corners as she reaches up with her trembling left hand and gently presses her palm along the circumference of her newly-exposed neck, rubbing at skin she likely hasn’t felt in hundreds of generations. She falls to her knees, and as she does, her right hand twists, and the lamp falls from her palm, hitting the ground with a hard ‘flump’ and rolling over itself a few feet away from her body.
    
    Both of her hands go to her neck, gently rubbing it. Her tears start to openly stream down her raised cheeks; her lips are curled upwards in a smile that you wouldn’t describe as ‘big,’ but given what she’s going through, it’s probably all the strength she has to show. She stares at the ground ahead of herself, just short of your feet where you stand.
    
    "I’m free," she whispers to herself.
    
    Just as you start to think that maybe you should excuse yourself, or clear your throat or something, Oma lifts her head towards you. Her eyes are bloodshot and her cheeks are soaked with her tears, but from her quickened breathing, the occasional nasally laugh, and the smile on her face, she’s never been better.[party.hasCompanions
        |
        
        She spots the lamp next to herself and, with a sudden burst of energy, grabs onto it by its cauldron and rushes to the nearby campfire, towards [comp1.name]. "You!" she says, catching [comp1.himHer] by surprise; she reaches out and grips onto [comp1.hisHer] wrist, placing the lamp into [comp1.hisHer] palm. "You possess the lamp now! Wish for something, anything! Wish for something stupid, like... like water that’s dry!"
        
        [comp1.name] dumbly stares at Oma, glancing occasionally to the lamp she’s thrust into [comp1.hisHer] hand. "Uh," [comp1.name] starts. "I wish for–"
        
        "No," Oma blurts suddenly, not even letting [comp1.name] finish the thought. Her eyebrows arch upward, surprised at herself – it’s been an eternity since she could deny the wish of whomsoever possessed the lamp. "No!" she shouts again, her mouth spreading into a wider smile. "No! Hahaha, no! No!"
        
        Oma slaps the lamp out of [comp1.name]’s hand, sending the lamp hurling through the air and back towards you. She chases after it, her arms swinging, her legs lifting into such a high gait that you’d describe it as more of a prance.
    ]
    
    Suddenly, Oma lunges into you, wrapping her arms around your body, hugging you so tightly that she squeezes the air out of your lungs. [pc.heightRange 0 72 96
        |With the difference in size between you two, she easily picks you up
        |You’re not very small, particularly compared to her, but she nonetheless has the strength to pick you up
        |Despite you being so much larger than she is, she nonetheless has the strength to pick you up
    ] and start spinning you around, your [pc.feet] lifting off the ground and kicking out behind yourself with the momentum. "I’m free!" Oma shouts repeatedly as she spins. "I’m free! I’m finally free!"
    
    When she finally lets you go, it’s with a bit more preserved momentum than she likely meant, you’re sent tripping over your own two feet before managing to right yourself. Oma simply can’t sit still: her arms wrap around her own body, giving herself a hug, while her legs pump up and down on the spot, thumping in place with so much energy that she can’t contain it all.
    
    Not content to just hug herself, her arms are back on you again, holding you close to her body, but this time, she’s holding you less like a child squeezing a toy and more like a lover that you’ve been separated from for years. "Thank you," she says before kissing your right cheek. "Thank you," she says again, kissing your cheek again, and repeating that pattern again and again and again until every part of the right side of your head down to your shoulder is covered in hickeys.

[flags.OMA_FREEDOM_WISH_LAST
        |在灯光的光芒变得过于刺眼之前，奥玛疯狂地挥动着她空闲的双手，试图施展另一种形式的魔法。由于灯光太亮，根本看不清楚她在做什么，但你注意到她的食指正在做圆周运动，然后你看到在她手掌上方，似乎有什么东西从虚无中诞生了出来，不过除此之外，你什么也没看清楚。
        |奥玛平时总是面无表情、神情坚毅，但此刻她的表情立刻发生了变化：她的眉头微微扬起，眼睛瞪得大大的，那对三角形的耳朵也竖了起来，仿佛在试图聆听空气中的某种声音。“什么？”她问道，声音的音调比平时高了许多。
        
        突然，她手中的灯笼，以及她脖子上的项圈，还有连接这两者的那条沉重的金链，全都开始发光：经过打磨的金子散发着光芒，其光泽照亮了从奥玛的皮肤到她脚下的地面，一切都被这光芒所笼罩。当她低头看着自己的灯时，她不由得退缩了——那光芒让她感到十分惊讶。从金属中散发出来的这种光显然具有魔力，但明明并不是她自己造成的。
    ]
    
    就在那种光泽变得难以直视、逐渐黯淡下去的时候，灯、链条以及项圈都重新恢复了原有的光泽。老奶奶惊讶而又忐忑地盯着手中的灯看——突然，“咔嗒”一声，声音大得让她不禁一惊。就在这一瞬间，她脖子上的项圈从背后松开了：它突然打开，然后掉下来，通过链条悬挂在灯的旁边。就这样，老奶奶再也不用被那盏灯束缚住了。
    
    当那条项链上的项圈无力地悬挂在链子上时，它那金色的光泽也会逐渐黯淡下去——从耀眼的金色变成闪亮的橙色，再变成暗淡的棕色，最终在短短几秒钟内完全生锈腐烂。那条项圈以及那六颗粗重、重型的链环，都在瞬间仿佛经历了数千年的岁月流逝，随后纷纷剥落成碎片，化作尘埃，随着下一阵微风飘散而去。而她手中那盏灯，却依然完好无损，丝毫没有发生变化。
    
    奥玛站在那里，双眼圆睁，嘴巴大张，满脸震惊。泪水开始在她的眼角打转。她用颤抖的左手轻轻抚摸着自己新暴露出来的脖子，触碰着那些可能已经有数百代人未曾触碰过的皮肤。她跪了下来，就在这时，她的右手突然一扭，手中的灯笼掉了下来，重重地摔在地上，然后在离她几英尺远的地方滚开了。
    
    她的双手抚上自己的脖子，轻轻揉着。泪水开始从她涨红的脸颊上肆意流淌；她的嘴唇微微上扬，露出一个或许不能被称为“灿烂”的微笑，但考虑到她正在经历的一切，这已经是她所能展现出的全部力量了。她的目光紧紧盯着你站立处前方的地面，就在你脚边的位置。
    
    我自由了，”她轻声对自己说道。
    
    就在你开始考虑是否应该找个借口离开，或者清清嗓子什么的时，奥玛抬起头看着你。她的眼睛布满血丝，脸颊上也沾满了泪水，但从她急促的呼吸、偶尔发出的鼻音笑声，以及她脸上的笑容来看，她此刻的心情简直好极了。[party.hasCompanions
        |
        
        她看到了自己身边的那盏灯，突然充满了力量，抓住灯的把手，冲向附近的营火。 [comp1.name]你！”她说道，突然抓住了对方。 [comp1.himHer]出乎意料地，她伸出手抓住了它。 [comp1.hisHer]将灯放在手腕上[comp1.hisHer]帕姆：“你现在拥有这盏灯了！许个愿吧，任何愿望都行！哪怕是个愚蠢的愿望，比如……比如‘希望干涸的水重新变湿’吧！
        
        [comp1.name]呆呆地望着奥玛，偶尔还会瞥一眼她手中紧握的灯。 [comp1.hisHer]呃， [comp1.name]我希望能——”
        
        “不行，”奥玛突然打断道，甚至没有给对方继续说的机会。 [comp1.name]把话说完吧。她的眉毛向上扬起，对自己感到惊讶——毕竟，自从有了这盏灯之后，她就再也没办法拒绝过任何人的愿望。“不！”她再次喊道，嘴角的笑容变得更加灿烂。“不！哈哈哈，不！不！”
        
        奥玛猛地拍掉了那盏灯[comp1.name]她的手一松，灯笼便在空中飞出去，又朝你的方向飞了回来。她追着灯笼跑，双臂挥动，双腿迈出的步子大得简直可以称之为“蹦跳”了。
    ]
    
    突然，奥玛冲向你，双臂紧紧地环绕着你的身体，将你抱得如此紧实，以至于你几乎无法呼吸。 [pc.heightRange 0 72 96
        |由于你们两个在体型上存在差异，她可以轻松地将你抱起来。
        |你其实并不算很小，尤其是和她相比的话；不过她依然有足够的力气把你举起来。
        |尽管你比她大很多，但她仍然有足够的力气把你举起来。
    ]然后开始让你旋转起来，你的[pc.feet]她从地面腾空而起，借助惯性向后踢去。“我自由了！”奥玛一边旋转一边不断喊道，“我自由了！我终于自由了！”
    
    当她终于放开你的时候，她留给你的惯性其实比她原本打算的还要大一些。你被这惯性绊得踉跄了一下，才好不容易稳住身体。奥玛根本坐不住：她双臂环抱住自己的身体，给自己一个拥抱，同时双腿在原地不停地上下跳动，那股充满力量的动作让她根本无法抑制自己的情绪。
    
    她并不满足于只是拥抱自己，她的双臂又一次伸向你，将你紧紧地搂在怀里。但这一次，她抱着你的方式，更像是一个与恋人多年分离后终于重逢的人，而不是一个抱着玩具的孩子。谢谢你，”她说着，亲了亲你的右脸颊。“谢谢你，”她又重复了一遍，再次亲了亲你的脸颊，然后这一动作不断重复，直到你头部的右侧，一直到肩膀，都被亲痕覆盖。

rows.original: Moments pass with Oma hugging you close to her, her arms wrapped so tightly around you that you’d think she’s afraid that you’d float away if she let go. Her breathing is heavy and occasionally interrupted with either a throaty hiccup or sob, or her taking a deep breath in or out through her nose – or, more often than those, a girlish laugh, sounding more like she was a child frolicking in a flowery field than an ageless genie hugging her final master. After a while, Oma, without letting you go, falls backward, sitting herself on her rump and bringing you down with her. Her grip around your torso relaxes slightly, but she has no plans to let you go. With those two actions, the energy and ‘tone’ of her hugging you changes drastically: she’s holding you not because she’s trying to express her gratitude or something, but because she wants to. She wants you to be close to her. She wants to sit in the dirt with you and just enjoy a soft, intimate moment together. It's tough to know when the ‘right’ time is to break the mood, but still, you have a question that’s burning a hole in the back of your mind, and once Oma’s breathing has calmed down and her laughing has subsided, you ask her: what does she intend to do now? She’s free. She could do anything her heart desires. She takes a long moment to answer. Eventually, she pulls away from you, her hands shaking like she just learned how good a hug could feel and isn’t ready for it to end. Her cheeks are thoroughly stained with tears and her eyes are totally bloodshot, but her smile, while slight, has been so adamant that you’d think her cheeks might get bruised from being lifted for so long. "I often fantasized about this moment," she admits. "Or... perhaps not this moment, but my future. What I would do with my freedom now that I have it. The options that would be available to me." With her right hand, she reaches up to her eyes and wipes away the tears with the back of her knuckle. "I’m still... processing it, I think." She doesn’t know? "There are just so many things, [pc.name]! I could see the world; I could use my magic for myself! I could... I could wear plain clothes and wander the streets of the world’s cities as a mortal once again! I could make a wage for myself as a jester or minstrel – imagine the reputation I would gain! Sleight-of-hand is perhaps a step down from the near-unlimited powers of the genie, but there are plenty of techniques I had learned that even a mortal could perform that could sensationalize and mesmerize any audience." You laugh well-meaningly – her idea of freedom is getting paid to perform parlor tricks? "My idea of ‘freedom’ is whatever I want it to be. That’s the whole point! [pc.name], I’ve gone hundreds of generations beholden to whomsoever possessed the lamp. I know it might sound silly, but having the freedom to live my life however I want it to be is a gift, and if being free means being mortal, with all the ugliness and unpleasantries that being a mortal includes, I would love nothing more!" Her nose scrunches inward in thought. "Although, in hindsight, maybe not as an entertainer. I’d be going from being beholden to the lamp to being beholden to whoever I was performing to. I lived countless lifetimes as a slave." Her right hand goes to her neck, rubbing at it; from the look on her face, she’s doing it unconsciously. "I’ll never be a slave again." Another pause. "Although I guess I wouldn’t be against entertainment if I could perform my own shows, on my own time, under my own rules. I don’t know! That’s what’s beautiful about it; the future is uncertain and it is what I make it to be. Before I met you and you wished for my freedom, my world began and ended with the lamp; now, there’s a world out there waiting for me!" That just brings you back to your initial question, though: she’s free now. She can do whatever she wants. What will she do now? What is the first thing that Oma, the Free Woman, is going to do with her life? She breathes through her slightly-parted mouth as she regards you, her eyes staying on yours. The corner of her mouth lifts upward very subtly; she’s thinking about her answer to the question very carefully, but it looks like she’s already got it. "After all that I said, I think...," she starts, "I think I’d like to stay with you, [pc.name]." ... Really? After all of that talk about living her life the way she wants and being able to do anything, she’s going to stay with you? Not that you’re about to say no.... "You were my fifty-seventh master, [pc.name]. I had fifty-six masters before you, with many of them promising me that they would find a way to break my shackles and give me my freedom – without costing them their one-of-three opportunities to utilize the full powers of the genie. You are the first, last, and only master to show such strength of character in the face of ultimate power that you would grant me the thing I was always promised, but never given." Her hands reach up, gently cupping your cheeks, her thumbs lightly grazing your cheekbones. From the look in her eyes, you’d think she was about to confess her feelings for you. "I want to be with you," she says. "I want to know what sort of life experiences are involved in making a person like you. You’ve given me my freedom; we may both be mortal now, but the least I can do with the gift you’ve given me is stay with you until our lives go down different paths – if they do at all." That’s a beautiful thing for her to say, and you’re honored that she’d want to spend that sort of time with you... but you still feel like you need to ask if she’s sure. She’s spent many, many lifetimes in that lamp; you’d think, after such a huge show about being released from it, she’d turn out to be more of a free spirit, wanting to wander. "I’ve never been more sure of anything," she answers deftly. "You’re right in that I want to go and see the world – but I want to see it with you." [flags.OMA_FREEDOM_WISH_LAST |In Oma’s right hand is something circular and large enough to fit into her palm snugly, and it has a bronze chain feeding through it, itself with a clasp on both ends so a person could wear it around their neck. She looks down at the thing with something of a disappointed, downtrodden stare, like she knew that this thing had the potential to be something greater, but it came up short. "I have a gift, but..." she starts, "it didn’t quite come out the way I had hoped. I didn’t have a lot of time to establish the specifics." She reaches forward with her free hand to grasp onto your left, pulling your hand forward, and she places the thing into your open palm. It’s a circular amulet, perfectly shaped and sized to snugly fit your hand – but it lacks features and aesthetics. The amulet is made of bronze; placed in its center is a recessed ruby about the size of your fingernail; and... that’s it. Given how plain the amulet is, the ruby appears badly out-of-place for something so beautiful. "This pendant is enchanted with my powers – or, whatever powers I had in the time I was trying to craft it. This world can be a dangerous place, [pc.name], and I wanted to help protect you from some of its dangers. This pendant may help you with that." |Her hand reaches within the folds of her harem pants, and you hear the jingling of metal as her fingers reach something within them. "With that said, I have a gift." From her pocket, she withdraws a thin, golden chain, hooked around something hidden within her closed fingers. With her free hand, she reaches for your left and places it onto your palm. "My gift is this pendant," she says. When she pulls away, you open your fingers to see what it is. It’s a circular amulet, the size perfectly shaped to fit your palm: the outermost layer is lined with gold, with the next layer inward lined with silver. Placed in the center of the amulet is a flawlessly cut ruby, its sheen shining ambient light across your face as you rotate it in your palm. "This pendant is enchanted with my powers as a genie. I know that this world is a dangerous place; this amulet will protect you from some of its dangers when you find yourself in need." ] With her right hand again, she closes her fingers around the amulet. "Though, the amulet contains a second secret as well," she continues, her mouth crooking into a wry smile. "It is true that I do not have many of the powers of the genie at my disposal anymore... but I had the foresight to craft myself a... home, of sorts, within the amulet. Within my home, I am as powerful as I was in reality: capable of shaping the world as I like." What does that mean, exactly? "It means that, as long as you carry the amulet with you, I will be with you as well. Whenever you have want of me, [pc.name], touch the amulet and think of me, and I will appear before you. And, as a bonus," she says as her smile rises symmetrically, "it’s highly fashionable." You ask her what the difference is between the amulet and the lamp. The amulet is a lot smaller than the lamp; it seems like she’s downsizing for your sake. "If you want to be literal, there is none," she answers. "Within the lamp was a housing space of nondescript size and make that could be made into anything I want, and the same holds true for this pendant. Just as I did not actually reside inside the lamp, I am not actually inside a piece of jewelry. But...." She tilts her head and smiles at you. "With this, I am closer to you than I ever would be with that lamp. And, honestly, the less I see of that lamp, the better." She leans back, her hand trailing from your ear to your neck and down your arms until her hands land in yours. You feel her fingers curl into your palms, squeezing you in them, her thumbs crooking around your own as she holds you tightly. [flags.OMA_WISH_SEX |Then, suddenly, she leans back in, her eyes closed, her lips softly pressing against your own, her body pressing tightly enough against you that you can feel her heart beat through her chest. The motion is quick and insistent – but she lingers, holding herself to you, enjoying her moment with the person that gave her the thing she wanted most in her many eternities as a genie. |Then, suddenly, she leans back in, her arms wrapping around your shoulders one more time. The action is somewhat less energetic than the hug she had given you before: she embraces you less like she’s just so full of excitement that she can barely contain it, and more like... she’s trying to thank you, and she can’t adequately express that with words. ] You blink – and suddenly, she’s gone, leaving you [flags.OMA_WISH_SEX |kissing |hugging ] nothing at all. You can still feel her warmth against your body and her [flags.OMA_WISH_SEX |lips against yours |arms around your shoulders ]; she was there, you didn’t imagine her. But she’s vanished completely, leaving no trace behind. And yet, you can feel that she’s close by. Her presence wraps around you like a warm blanket on a cool night. When you look down towards the amulet, you feel it more obviously: she’s gone into the jewel she’s just given you, just as she said she would. If you ever want to see her again, all you need to do is touch it and think of her.... You stand. All of this just leaves one more thing: her lamp, still sitting listlessly on the ground a short distance away from you. Oma just said that she never wanted to see it again... but the fact remains that the lamp is sturdy; it’s ergonomically designed; you aren’t sure if the lamp itself is made of gold, but the gem atop it is indisputably a real ruby. The lamp could fetch a decent price if you sold it. Or, if not, then it’d still make for a great night light with a wick and some oil.
rows.translation: 那些时刻，奥玛会将你紧紧抱在怀里，她的双臂紧紧地环绕着你，仿佛生怕一松手你就会飘走似的。她的呼吸显得有些急促，偶尔会伴随着一声喉间的抽噎或呜咽，或是通过鼻子深深地吸一口气或呼出一口气——而更常见的，则是她那如同少女般的笑声，那笑声听起来，更像是一个在鲜花丛中嬉戏的孩子，而不是一个永葆青春的精灵在拥抱她最后的主人。 过了一会儿，奥玛没有松开你的手，而是向后仰去，自己坐在地上，同时也将你拉了下来。她握着你腰部的力道稍微松了一些，但显然并没有打算放开你。通过这两个动作，她拥抱你的方式以及那种“力度”发生了巨大的变化：她现在抱着你，并不是因为想要表达感激之情，而是因为想要致她想要你想要靠近她，对吧？她想要愿意和你一起坐在泥土中，共同享受那些温馨而亲密的时光。 很难判断什么时候才是打破这种氛围的“最佳”时机，但当你心中有个问题一直萦绕不去时，等到奶奶的呼吸变得平稳，笑声也渐渐停止后，你便问了她：她现在打算做什么？她现在是自由的。她可以去做任何自己想做的事情。 她过了好一会儿才回答。最终，她从你身边拉开距离，双手一直在颤抖——仿佛她刚刚才意识到拥抱是多么美好的感觉，还不愿意让这种感觉结束。她的脸颊被泪水浸得通红，双眼也布满了血丝，但她的笑容虽然很淡，却显得如此坚定，仿佛长时间保持着这个笑容会让她的脸颊受伤一样。 “我曾经经常幻想这一刻的到来，”她承认道。或者……也许并不是这样。瞬间但这是我的未来。现在我获得了自由，我不知道该用它来做什么。有哪些选择摆在我面前……”她用右手捂住眼睛，用指关节的背面擦去泪水，“我想，我还在努力接受这一切。” 她还不知道吗？ “有太多的事情需要考虑了[pc.name]我能够看到这个世界；我能够将自己的魔法用于自己的目的！我能够……我能够穿上普通的衣服，再次以凡人的身份在世界各地的城市里游荡！我能够通过担任小丑或吟游诗人来赚取收入——想象一下，我会因此获得怎样的名声吧！虽然手法技巧或许比不上精灵那近乎无限的力量，但我所学的许多技巧，即便是凡人也能运用它们，而这些技巧绝对足以吸引并迷住任何观众。 你出于好意地笑了起来——在她看来，自由就是靠表演一些小把戏来赚钱吗？ “我心目中的‘自由’，就是我想让它成为什么样子。这才是自由的意义所在啊！ [pc.name]，我已经经历了数百代，始终依附于那些拥有那盏灯的人。我知道这听起来可能很愚蠢，但能够按照自己的意愿自由地生活，这才是真正的自由。礼物如果自由意味着必须面对死亡，意味着要承受作为凡人所必须承受的一切丑陋与不愉快，那么我没有什么比这更想要的了！” 她若有所思地皱起了鼻子。“不过，现在回想起来，或许对于一名艺人来说，情况会有所不同。我曾经依赖那盏灯生存，后来则开始依赖我所表演的对象来获得生存的动力。我经历了无数次作为奴隶的生活。” 她的右手摸向自己的脖子，不停地揉搓着；从她的表情来看，她是在无意识地做这个动作。我再也不会成为奴隶了。” 又是一阵沉默。“不过，如果我能在自己方便的时间、按照自己的规则来举办自己的表演，我想我也不会反对这种娱乐形式。我也不确定呢！恰恰因为这种不确定性，它才如此美妙——未来是未知的，而它就由我自己来塑造。在遇到你之前，也在你渴望我获得自由之前，我的世界始终围绕着那盏灯转；而现在，外面有一个全新的世界在等待着我！” 不过，这又回到了你最初的问题上：她现在自由了，她可以去做任何她想做的事情了。无论什么她想要。现在她该怎么做呢？这位自由的女性，奥玛，会首先用自己的人生去做什么呢？ 她微微张开双唇呼吸，目光紧紧地注视着你。她的嘴角微微上扬，显然她正在仔细思考这个问题的答案，但看起来她已经有了答案。 “经历了这一切之后，我想……”她开始说道，“我想，我愿意留在你身边。 [pc.name]……真的吗？毕竟她之前一直都说要按照自己的方式生活，想做什么就做什么，现在却要和你在一起？当然，你也不会拒绝她吧……” “你曾是我的第五十七位导师， [pc.name]在你之前，我曾经有过五十六位主人。他们中的许多人都向我承诺，一定会找到办法解除我的束缚，让我获得自由——而这样做也不会让他们失去那三次利用精灵全部力量的机会。你是第一个，也是最后一个，唯一一个在面对如此强大的力量时，依然展现出如此坚定的品格的主人，你终于给了我那些我一直被承诺却从未真正得到过的东西。 她抬起双手，轻轻捧住你的脸颊，拇指轻轻触碰着你的颧骨。从她的眼神中，你仿佛能感觉到她即将向你表白自己的感情。 “我想和你在一起，”她说，“我想了解究竟是什么样的生活经历，才能造就出一个像你这样的人。你给了我自由；虽然我们终究都是凡人，但至少，作为对你这份礼物的回报，我会留在你身边，直到我们的生命走向不同的道路——如果真的会分开的话。 她能说出这样的话，真是太美好了，你能得到她的陪伴，也是一件荣幸的事……但你还是觉得有必要确认一下，她是否真的确定自己想要这样做。她在那盏灯里度过了无数个生命周期；按照常理来说，经历了那样一次“解脱”之后，她应该会变得更加自由，想要去四处游历才对。 我从来没有对任何事情如此确定过，”她干脆地回答道，“你说得对，我确实想去看看这个世界——但我希望能和你一起去看。 [flags.OMA_FREEDOM_WISH_LAST |奥玛的右手拿着一个圆形物体，它的大小正好能舒适地放在她的手掌中。一条青铜链子穿过这个物体，链子的两端都装有扣环，因此人们可以将其戴在脖子上。她低头看着这个物体，眼神中流露出些许失望和沮丧，仿佛她知道这个物体本有可能拥有更重要的意义，但它最终还是未能达到预期。 我有一份礼物，但是……”她开始说道，“结果并没有像我期望的那样。我并没有太多时间来详细准备这些细节。” 她用空着的那一只手伸过来，握住你的左手，将你的手拉向自己，然后把那份礼物放在你张开的手掌中。这是一个圆形护身符，其形状和大小都经过精心设计，可以完美地贴合你的手掌——但它缺乏任何装饰性元素或美观设计。这个护身符是由青铜制成的，在其中心位置镶嵌着一颗大小与你的指甲相当的红色宝石。就这样。考虑到这个护身符的设计如此简单朴素，那颗红宝石放在上面实在显得格格不入，显得太过华丽了。 “这个吊坠被赋予了我的力量——或者说，是在我尝试制作它的那个时候我所拥有的那些力量。这个世界可能是个危险的地方。 [pc.name]，我想帮助你们远离其中的一些危险。这个吊坠或许能在这方面帮上忙。 |她的手伸进哈伦裤的褶皱中，手指触碰到里面的某物时，金属碰撞发出的叮当声传了出来。“话虽如此，我有一份礼物。”她从口袋里拿出一条细长的金色链条，链条的末端钩住了她紧握在手指间的某样东西。她用空着的那一只手，握住了你的左手，将它放在自己的手掌上。 “我的礼物就是这个吊坠，”她说。当她松开手后，你张开手指，看到了那个礼物。那是一个圆形的护身符，大小正好适合放在你的手掌中：最外层镀着黄金，内层则镀着银色。护身符的正中央镶嵌着一颗切割得极为完美的红宝石，当你将其在手掌中旋转时，它的光泽会将周围的光线反射到你的脸上。“这个吊坠蕴含着我作为精灵的力量。我知道这个世界充满危险，而当你遇到困境时，这个护身符会保护你免受一些威胁。" ] 她再次用右手握住了那枚护身符。“不过，这枚护身符还藏着第二个秘密，”她继续说道，嘴角露出一丝苦笑，“事实上，我现在确实已经无法再使用精灵赋予我的那些力量了。但是我有先见之明，在那个护身符里为自己营造了一个……某种意义上的家。在这个家里，我拥有与现实世界中相同的力量：能够按照自己的意愿来塑造这个世界。” 这到底意味着什么呢？ 这意味着，只要你随身携带这个护身符，我就会一直陪伴在你身边。无论何时你需要我， [pc.name]，触摸这个护身符，想着我，我就会出现在你面前。而且，作为额外的好处，”她笑着说，嘴角的微笑显得十分对称，“这个护身符还非常时尚呢。” 你问她，这个护身符和那盏灯有什么区别。这个护身符比那盏灯小多了；看来她是为了你才选择缩小它的尺寸的。 “如果你非要字面理解的话，其实根本没有什么特别的成分，”她回答道，“那盏灯内部有一个大小和材质都普通的空腔，我可以把它做成任何我想做的东西，这个吊坠也是如此。就像我其实并不住在那盏灯里一样，我也并不真正存在于某件珠宝之中。但是……”她歪着头，对你微笑道，“有了这件珠宝，我与你之间的距离，比拥有那盏灯时要近得多。说实话，我越少看到那盏灯，反而越好。她向后靠去，手部从你的耳朵滑到你的脖子，再沿着你的手臂向下，直到她的手与你的手紧紧相握。你能感觉到她的手指紧紧地缠住你的手掌，将你紧紧地搂在怀里，而她的拇指也环绕着你的拇指，将你牢牢地固定在她的身边。 [flags.OMA_WISH_SEX |然后，她突然向后仰去，闭上双眼，轻轻地将嘴唇贴在你的嘴唇上，她的身体紧紧地依偎着你，让你能够感受到她胸腔中心脏的跳动。这个动作迅速而坚定——但她却停留了下来，紧紧地抱着你，尽情享受着与这个在她作为精灵的漫长岁月里给予她最渴望的东西的人共度的这一刻。 |然后，突然间，她向后仰去，再次将双臂环绕在你的肩上。这个动作相比之前那个拥抱来说，显得没那么热情洋溢：她拥抱你的方式，更像是在试图表达感谢，但却无法用言语完全表达出来。 ] 你眨了眨眼——转眼间，她就消失了，留下了你一个人[flags.OMA_WISH_SEX |亲吻 |拥抱 ]完全没有。你仍然能感受到她的体温，以及她带给你的温暖。 [flags.OMA_WISH_SEX |嘴唇贴着你的嘴唇 |将手臂搭在对方的肩上 ]她是看吧，你根本想象不到她会这样。但她真的彻底消失了，没有留下任何痕迹。 然而，你却能感觉到她就在附近。她的存在就像一条温暖的毯子，在寒冷的夜晚陪伴着你。当你低头看着那枚护身符时，这种感觉会更加明显：她确实进入了那颗她刚刚送给你的宝石之中，正如她所说过的那样。如果你想再次见到她，你所需要做的就是触摸它，然后想着她…… 你站了起来。 然而，还有一件事没有解决：她的灯，仍然静静地躺在离你不远的地方。奥玛刚才说她再也不想看到那个东西了……但事实依然是，这个灯非常结实，设计也非常符合人体工程学；虽然你不确定这个灯本身是否是由黄金制成的，但顶端的那颗宝石绝对是真正的红宝石。如果你把那盏灯卖掉，应该能卖个不错的价钱。 或者，就算不卖，只要装上灯芯和一些油，它仍然可以当作一盏很好的夜灯使用。
rows.raw: ' Moments pass with Oma hugging you close to her, her arms wrapped so tightly around you that you’d think she’s afraid that you’d float away if she let go. Her breathing is heavy and occasionally interrupted with either a throaty hiccup or sob, or her taking a deep breath in or out through her nose – or, more often than those, a girlish laugh, sounding more like she was a child frolicking in a flowery field than an ageless genie hugging her final master. After a while, Oma, without letting you go, falls backward, sitting herself on her rump and bringing you down with her. Her grip around your torso relaxes slightly, but she has no plans to let you go. With those two actions, the energy and ‘tone’ of her hugging you changes drastically: she’s holding you not because she’s trying to express her gratitude or something, but because she wants to. She wants you to be close to her. She wants to sit in the dirt with you and just enjoy a soft, intimate moment together. It's tough to know when the ‘right’ time is to break the mood, but still, you have a question that’s burning a hole in the back of your mind, and once Oma’s breathing has calmed down and her laughing has subsided, you ask her: what does she intend to do now? She’s free. She could do anything her heart desires. She takes a long moment to answer. Eventually, she pulls away from you, her hands shaking like she just learned how good a hug could feel and isn’t ready for it to end. Her cheeks are thoroughly stained with tears and her eyes are totally bloodshot, but her smile, while slight, has been so adamant that you’d think her cheeks might get bruised from being lifted for so long. "I often fantasized about this moment," she admits. "Or... perhaps not this moment, but my future. What I would do with my freedom now that I have it. The options that would be available to me." With her right hand, she reaches up to her eyes and wipes away the tears with the back of her knuckle. "I’m still... processing it, I think." She doesn’t know? "There are just so many things, [pc.name]! I could see the world; I could use my magic for myself! I could... I could wear plain clothes and wander the streets of the world’s cities as a mortal once again! I could make a wage for myself as a jester or minstrel – imagine the reputation I would gain! Sleight-of-hand is perhaps a step down from the near-unlimited powers of the genie, but there are plenty of techniques I had learned that even a mortal could perform that could sensationalize and mesmerize any audience." You laugh well-meaningly – her idea of freedom is getting paid to perform parlor tricks? "My idea of ‘freedom’ is whatever I want it to be. That’s the whole point! [pc.name], I’ve gone hundreds of generations beholden to whomsoever possessed the lamp. I know it might sound silly, but having the freedom to live my life however I want it to be is a gift, and if being free means being mortal, with all the ugliness and unpleasantries that being a mortal includes, I would love nothing more!" Her nose scrunches inward in thought. "Although, in hindsight, maybe not as an entertainer. I’d be going from being beholden to the lamp to being beholden to whoever I was performing to. I lived countless lifetimes as a slave." Her right hand goes to her neck, rubbing at it; from the look on her face, she’s doing it unconsciously. "I’ll never be a slave again." Another pause. "Although I guess I wouldn’t be against entertainment if I could perform my own shows, on my own time, under my own rules. I don’t know! That’s what’s beautiful about it; the future is uncertain and it is what I make it to be. Before I met you and you wished for my freedom, my world began and ended with the lamp; now, there’s a world out there waiting for me!" That just brings you back to your initial question, though: she’s free now. She can do whatever she wants. What will she do now? What is the first thing that Oma, the Free Woman, is going to do with her life? She breathes through her slightly-parted mouth as she regards you, her eyes staying on yours. The corner of her mouth lifts upward very subtly; she’s thinking about her answer to the question very carefully, but it looks like she’s already got it. "After all that I said, I think...," she starts, "I think I’d like to stay with you, [pc.name]." ... Really?         Although the transformation of the world is difficult to bear on the senses, it lasts for only a few seconds. When it all stops again, you’re in a setting that’s vaguely familiar.

Her eyes narrow and she rocks on her feet. She knows that you want something particularly... fantastic, but she doesn't quite know what. Something that you're hesitant to ask for. Something that she might judge you for. "You know," she muses, scratching at her chin as her eyes wander playfully. "Some of my previous masters had particularly wild imaginations when it came to their wishes." Like? "You often had the usual, blustery types that wished for something fantastical. Reality-warping powers. Imbuing the mundane with the fantastic. Infinite life; unlimited wealth; '

rows.original: ." Her eyes don't meet yours as she speaks. "But some of them would take the opportunity to experience something. Something they could never, ever have otherwise." ... Like? "Well, some," she says as her eyes finally meet yours. While bright enough for you to see the twinkle of [dayNight|the sun|the night sky's stars] in them, you also see, unmistakably, something mischievous and deviant. Something knowing. "Some would ask for the comfort of a woman's touch. And I'd give it, albeit I was..." She pauses, then, her left hand scratches at her neck, pulling at something invisible. The golden collar that she had, up until recently, worn for whole lifetimes. "Bound by the lamp to accede. I took no real pleasure or entertainment in granting wishes like those." "But still others," she'd continue, "would wish for something a bit more exotic. You might be surprised by how... exploratory people get when human[pc.ra human||-like] inhibitions no longer apply." Her eyes narrow. "To put it plainly, they wish to know what it's like to lay with a wolf. A horse. An anaconda. People's inhibitions no longer apply when the wolf before them is, in fact, a person; something capable of thinking like them." The heat rushes to your cheeks and your eyes widen. She knew. She knew the whole time that you were struggling to put your request into words. You don't bother trying to deny it; you ask her how she knew that you were... thinking of something like that. "You're not the first, the second, or even the dozenth former master to have made a request like that, [pc.name]," she says. "You all have similar tells." "Now, that said," she continues, moving her hands behind her back and rocking on her heels once more. "While I was previously bound by the machinations of the lamp to grant these wishes, I was never forced to enjoy them. Despite the unique scenarios and opportunities these wishes provided, I was nonetheless a slave to the whims of my previous masters. 'Wanting' to do something new and exotic provides a much different experience than 'being forced' to do something new and exotic." "All of this is to say, [pc.name]," she finishes, her eyes narrowing as they make contact with yours. Her expression remains mischievous and deviant, but there's a distinct layer of affection to them – like she wants to be mischievous and deviant with you. "There are few things you could ask me to do that would surprise me." ... There is one thing. "Name it." You want to know what it's like to... be with a dragon[pc.ra dragon|. And not like a person like you – a real, proper dragon. The ones of myth and legend]. The fearsome, powerful beasts that made entire mountains their home; that hoarded material goods amounting to fortunes greater than entire countries; the scaled, winged rulers that could cause storms with a flap of their wings. "My, you've really thought this through," she laughs. There's something very... appealing about dragons. What can you say? Oma stands there, unmoving. She blinks. The air between you two grows stale and awkward as the time passes just long enough to be uncomfortable. "I can grant this wish," she finally says. "And for the record – you're not the first, or second, person to ask for this scenario, either." But are you the dozenth? "Less than that," she laughs.
rows.translation: 她说话时并没有看着你的眼睛。‘但其中有些人会抓住这个机会体验某些东西。一些他们永远也不可能得到的东西。” “……比如什么？” “嗯，一些东西吧，”她说道，终于将目光投向你。她的眼睛明亮得足以映出[dayNight|太阳|夜空中的星星]，而你也清楚看见其中那抹顽皮、放荡而心照不宣的神色。“有些人会渴望得到女性的触碰带来的慰藉，而我也会给予他们这种慰藉，尽管我……”她停顿了一下，然后用左手挠了挠脖子，似乎在试图抓挠某个看不见的东西。那条金项圈，直到最近，她还一直戴着它，仿佛它象征着她一生的使命。“被那盏灯所束缚，才能实现这些愿望。其实，满足这样的愿望并没有给我带来任何真正的快乐或乐趣。” “不过，也有些人，”她会继续说道，“会希望得到一些更加奇特的东西。你可能会惊讶于，当涉及到人类探索行为时，人们会表现出多么强烈的探索欲望。[pc.ra human||-般的]所有的束缚都不再存在了。” 她的目光眯了起来。“说白了，他们想知道和狼、马、水蟒同床共枕是什么感觉。当眼前的‘狼’实际上是一个人——一个能够像他们一样思考的人时，人们的所有束缚都不再存在了。你的脸颊顿时发热，眼睛也睁得更大了一些。她知道了。她从一开始就明白，你一直在努力寻找合适的词语来表达自己的请求。你甚至都没有费心去否认；你直接问她，她是怎么知道你的想法的。你并不是第一个，也不是第二个，甚至不是第十个提出这样的要求的前主人。 [pc.name]，是的，”她说，“你们每个人的反应都差不多。” “不过，”她继续说道，双手背在身后，再次用脚跟轻轻摇晃着身体，“虽然之前我确实受到那盏灯的操控，不得不实现这些愿望，但从来没有人强迫过我。享受吧他们。尽管这些愿望带来了独特的情境与机会，但我依然受制于之前那些“主人”的任性意志。“想要”去做一些新鲜、与众不同的事情，与“被迫”去做这些事情，体验是完全不同的。 总之，我的意思是[pc.name]，她说完后，目光与你的视线相遇，她的双眼微微眯起。她的表情依然带着顽皮和叛逆，但其中明显流露出一丝深情——仿佛她其实很想和你一起顽皮、叛逆：“你让我做的那些事，几乎没有哪一件会让我感到意外。” ……但有一件事除外。 “说出来吧。” 你想知道……和一条龙在一起是什么感觉。[pc.ra dragon|而且，它可不是像你这样的人——而是一条真正的、货真价实的龙。那种存在于神话和传说中的龙。]那些将整座山脉作为家园的凶猛巨兽；那些囤积的财物价值足以相当于整个国家的财富；那些长满鳞片、拥有翅膀的统治者，它们只需轻轻扇动翅膀，就能引发风暴。 哎呀，你真的想得很周全啊，”她笑着说。 龙，确实有一种非常……吸引人的魅力，你怎么看？ 奥玛站在那里，一动不动。她眨了眨眼。随着时间一点点流逝，你们之间的气氛变得越来越尴尬、越来越不自在。 我可以实现这个愿望，”她最终说道，“需要说明的是，你也不是第一个，也不是第二个提出这个要求的人。” 但你是第十个吗？ “还不到呢，”她笑着说。

"Beyond my being a proper dragon – one fit for a proper nest in a mountain – do you have any requests for the scenario? Or would you rather I handle the details?"

rows.original: At that, Oma smiles wider – although, from the way her eyes widen and her cheeks rise, it's an expression that's as sweet as it is teasing. rows.original:
Oma's expression falters: her brow rises, and her jaw straightens at the name. "Goodness," she says under her breath. She maintains eye contact with you as she mouths the name to herself a few times, testing its weight on her tongue. "What a... beautiful name. Imaginative. Distinct, yet... subtly feminine. It sounds almost regal. Fit for a queen." She tilts her head and narrows her lips in thought. "Is it from something? A story I'm unfamiliar with, perhaps?"

        You tell her that, as far as you're aware, no. It just... came to you.

        She exhales sharply through her nose. "What a strike of inspiration, then."

听到这个名字，奥玛的表情一滞：她扬起眉毛，下颌也绷直了。“天哪，”她低声说道。她一边与你保持着目光接触，一边把这个名字在嘴里默念了几遍，用舌头掂量它的分量。“多么……美妙的名字啊。富有想象力。独特，却又……带着一丝女性的柔美。听起来几乎称得上尊贵。配得上一位女王。”她歪着头，若有所思地抿起嘴唇。“它是出自什么地方吗？也许是我没听过的某个故事？”

        你告诉她，据你所知，并没有。它只是……突然出现在你脑海里。

        她从鼻子里猛地呼出一口气。“那可真是灵感的杰作啊。”

rows.original:
You tell Oma that that's all correct – and that you're ready.

        Her smile remains – and her silvery eyes shimmer. With a blink, they turn from the featureless gray that they were, to red, then blue, then green, then every color in the rainbow in quick succession. Her silver hair, likewise, follows suit, with every single strand on her head rotating from one color to the next, slowly at first, then rapidly. The wind between you and around you stirs: at first, an errant breeze that could be mistaken for natural wind, but, soon, it spins and whirls, surrounding you both in a swirling tempest, picking up blades of grass, loose gravel and dirt, and other detritus as the intensity of the winds pick up.

        Soon, the tornado swallows you both, sealing you away from the world. The winds howl to near-deafening levels, ensuring that no part of the outside world reaches either you or Oma. And yet, despite the wind's intensity, it's nonetheless gentle and soothing on your [pc.skinFurScales]. It's almost as if the wind is avoiding you both.

        "I'll see you soon, [pc.name]," Oma says, her voice piercing cleanly through the howling wind. And then, the tornado lurches, the twisting winds cocooning Oma first and stealing her from your sight before it does the same to you.
rows.translation:
你告诉奥玛，那都没错——你已经准备好了。

        她的笑容依然挂在脸上，那双银色的眼睛闪烁着光芒。眨眼间，她的眼睛颜色从原本毫无特色的灰色，迅速变成了红色、蓝色、绿色，接着又变成了彩虹中的所有颜色。她的银发也随之发生了变化，头顶的每一根头发都在逐渐改变颜色——起初变化得很慢，随后速度逐渐加快。你周围的风开始搅动起来：起初只是一阵看似自然的风，但很快，这些风就开始旋转、翻腾，将你们两人笼罩在一片狂风之中。随着风势的增强，风还卷起了草叶、碎石、尘土等各种杂物。

        不久，龙卷风将你们俩卷入其中，将你们与外界彻底隔离开来。狂风呼啸，声浪几乎震得人耳聋，使得外界的一切都无法传达到你和奥玛这里。然而，尽管风势凶猛，它却依然温柔地抚慰着你的[pc.skinFurScales]。简直就像风在避开你们两个人。

        “我们很快就能再见了，[pc.name]，”奥玛说道，她的声音清晰地穿透了呼啸的风声。然后，龙卷风猛地一晃，那些扭曲的风首先将奥玛包裹起来，使你再也看不见她，接着，同样的事情也发生在你身上。

rows.original: You find yourself deep inside a hollowed-out mountain. Above you, a hole in the mountain's surface has been worn through, allowing sunlight to stream in from the outside. The hole has worn edges and deliberate, softened curves. It's far above you, with no rock wall or column for you to climb to reach it. There are no other entrances into, or exits out of, the cave. You might have fallen in from the hole, but it's easily forty, maybe fifty feet straight up, and yet, you've sustained no injury. The cave's walls have been worn smooth from something other than time and the elements, to the point of being nearly glossy. The air is hot and humid; it rushes occasionally through the single room, but the wind is neither cool nor refreshing, merely cycling the hot, stymied air about. The floor has been not only stamped smooth, but swept clean – at least, the floor that you can see. Despite the cave's spacious depth and width, nearly all of it is submerged in a rolling layer of gold. But not gold coins. Not in fabrics wreathed in gold; not in kitchenware plated with gold; not with decorative suits and armor of gold; not even with gold bullion. You bend down and extend your hand, running your fingers through with appears to be gold chips – gold that had been filed down finer than nuggets, akin to gravel. You scoop a handful of the stuff straight from the ground, letting the chips bounce along your open palm. Some are rounded and stumpy; some are more jagged and sharp. All of them have had some layer of polish applied, though some of them are due for another layer. You look into the divot of gold you had just dug out, and spot something discolored among the glittering pieces. Bronze, thick, with a rougher texture, but you can't quite make out what it is. You dig some more, pushing the gold nuggets aside, cleaning the bronze thing of the mess. Whatever it is, it's about the size of your chest. You tap at it with your knuckles. It's solid like stone and warm to the touch, but it has a different, granular texture to the walls around you. The room grumbles. The gold mountain beneath your feet shifts, causing loose pebbles of gravel to tumble and timber out of place, cascading like raindrops off the side of the building. The hot, stale air suddenly whooshes around you, billowing through your hair and around your effects. You look down. The bronze thing flexes, with one edge bunching up against itself like folds of fat. It slides in one direction suddenly, and, beneath the bronze, there's a single, silvery eye. Its dilated, unfocused pupil scans the cave's ceiling before it spots you, and it narrows. The mountain shifts; the gold pile heaves, breathing like a massive lung. You're knocked off balance, forced onto your rump as you slide down the pile towards the base. The gold clinks and clanks against itself as chips fall away, gliding off the scales of a massive beast that had been roused from its slumber, like snow off a hiding wolf's winter coat. A rush of wind surges from the mountain and out of the hole in the ceiling, only for the vacuum to cause howling, cold winds to rush back in. From the gold pile, a creature's head, the skull [pc.heightRange 0 60|easily ]the size of your entire body, rises imperiously. It shakes its head back and forth, flinging the bits of gold still lingering on its scalp and nose every which way. The beast's snout is elongated, similar to a horse's, with small-for-it's-frame teeth jutting from both the upper and lower lips. Adorned on its head are a pair of bone-white horns, curving once before their sharpened tips end at backwards-facing points. It yawns, still drowsy, revealing hidden rows upon rows of razor-sharp teeth that could rend brick and metal, let alone flesh and bone, with a tongue long and wide enough to occupy the whole jaw. When it snaps its mouth shut, it turns its head to the side, sizing you up with its one silver eye. Its mouth opens, and a melodic, almost musical sound comes from its throat as it heaves and undulates, but it's not what you understand as language. And yet, simultaneously, you feel a light pressure in the back of your head. A visitor, you hear a voice – [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|masculine, resonant, and baritone|feminine, canorous, and soprano] – echo from somewhere around you. You whip your head around, but there is nobody else here. Just you and the beast. They are so uncommon in the modern year. The gold pile shivers, then bursts like a disturbed pastry as the rest of the beast unveils itself from its golden blanket. First, on the opposite end, a long, thick tail whips from the lower levels of the pile, slinking through the chips close to your own feet, revealing a limb covered in bronze scales and capped with white plates along its spine. It thrashes languidly the way you would stretch out a limb after waking from your own sleep. Next, one leg, then another, then another, then another: each of them erupting from the pile of gold chips in sequential order, stamping down onto the gold with casual force, yet the mountain booms and quakes with the sheer weight of the beast. Each enormous leg is wider than you are, taller than you are, and is capped with sharp white claws, each every bit as dangerous as its teeth. As it stands and the gold chips drip from the barrel of its torso, it unfurls a pair of wings: their membranes thick as your palm, but, compared to the rest of its muscular and plated body, thin as paper. With one flex, a single wing easily extends to cover the mouth of the hole in the ceiling, blotting the sun's light and casting the cave into bronze shadow. It gives each wing a flap, shaking out the stiffness, yet it causes such a billow of wind that you're pushed along the cave's floor, still in your sitting position. You're forced to bring your arms to your face to protect it from the flinging gold. Now fully emerged from the pile, the beast flexes each limb once more in turn – tail, legs, wings – before settling its gargantuan body atop the pile, utterly relaxed. It turns its head toward you, facing you down the length of its muzzle. Its body language is relaxed and eased, and its expression is curious, having already deemed you not a threat[pc.strengthRange 0 80|, and appropriately so. Even if you had your [pc.weapon] in hand, you would not pose so much as a challenge to this thing, let alone a threat|. If you had your [pc.weapon] in hand, perhaps you could have posed an exciting challenge – but you're disarmed. Its assessment is warranted]. Before you is what is indisputably the regent of the mountain. Here, the beast is as a [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|king|queen], and you are, at best, a guest in [oma.hisHer] court. That you haven't been immediately devoured is [oma.hisHer] implicit permission to remain as you are. You are in the presence of a proper dragon.
rows.translation: 你发现自己身处一座被掏空的山脉之中。 头顶上，山体表面有一个被侵蚀出的洞口，阳光从外面照射进来。这个洞口的边缘已经变得圆滑，仿佛是经过人为加工而成。它位于你的正上方，周围没有任何岩石墙壁或柱子可供你攀爬才能到达。这个洞穴没有其他入口或出口。你可能是从那个洞口掉进来的，但洞口的高度至少有四十到五十英尺，然而你却丝毫没有受伤。 这个洞穴的墙壁被某种力量磨得异常光滑，这种力量显然不仅仅是时间和自然环境的作用，以至于墙壁几乎呈现出光泽。洞内的空气又热又潮湿，偶尔会有空气流过这个狭窄的空间，但这种风既不凉爽，也不能让人感到神清气爽，只是让闷热空气在洞内循环而已。地面也被踩得平平整整，而且还被清扫得干干净净——至少是你能看到的那部分地面。尽管这个洞穴空间广阔、纵深很大，但几乎它的全部区域都被一层金子覆盖住了。 但不是金币。不是那些用黄金包裹的织物，也不是镀金的厨房用具，更不是那些装饰性的黄金套装或盔甲，甚至也不是黄金条。你弯下腰，伸出手，用手指将这些看似黄金碎屑的东西拨开——那些被磨得比金块还要细小的黄金颗粒，简直就像碎石一样。你直接从地上抓起一把那些东西，让碎屑在张开的手掌中跳动。有些碎片呈圆形且末端粗短，而有些则更加参差不齐、边缘锋利。所有这些碎片都经过了一层打磨处理，不过其中有些显然还需要再打磨一遍。 你仔细观察着自己刚刚挖出来的那块金子，发现在那闪闪发光的金粒中有一块颜色有些不同的东西。那是一块青铜，质地较厚，表面也比较粗糙，但你一时无法分辨出它到底是什么。你继续挖掘，把那些金粒拨到一边，把那块青铜清理干净。不管它到底是什么，它的大小大概和你的胸膛差不多。你用指关节轻轻敲了敲它，发现它像石头一样坚硬，触感也很温暖，不过它的质地与你周围的金子截然不同，显得更加颗粒感强一些。 房间里传来一阵闷响。你脚下的金山开始移动，导致一些松动的碎石和木块掉落下来，就像雨滴一样从建筑物的侧面滑落。炽热而浑浊的空气突然在你周围流动起来，卷起你的头发，也弄乱了你携带的物品。 你低头望去。那个青铜制成的物体开始活动，其中一边仿佛脂肪堆积般皱缩在一起，然后突然朝某个方向滑动。在青铜之下，有一只银色的眼睛——它的瞳孔放大后茫然地扫视着洞穴的天花板，直到发现了你，瞳孔立刻收缩了起来。 山体开始移动，那堆黄金也随之颤动，仿佛拥有巨大的肺脏般在呼吸。你失去了平衡，只能趴在屁股上，顺着那堆黄金滑向底部。黄金相互碰撞发出叮当声，一些碎块从中掉落，就像从沉睡中苏醒的巨兽身上滑落的雪片，亦或是隐藏在狼毛下的积雪。一阵狂风从山上呼啸着冲出天花板上的那个洞，然而由于形成的真空效应，那些呼啸的寒风又立刻被吸了回去。从那堆金子中，露出了一个生物的头颅——一个骷髅头。 [pc.heightRange 0 60|很容易 ]那东西有着与你的整个身体差不多大的体积，傲慢地耸立着。它不断地来回摇晃着头，将那些还残留在它头皮和鼻子上的金屑甩得到处都是。这种野兽的鼻子很长，类似于马的鼻子，上下嘴唇上长着一排相对于它庞大的身躯来说显得有些过小的牙齿。它的头顶长着一对骨白色的角，角身在接近尖端的地方弯曲一次，最终形成向后方延伸的形状。它打着哈欠，依然显得昏昏欲睡，此时露出了那一排排锋利得足以撕裂砖块和金属的牙齿——更不用说血肉之躯了。它的舌头又长又宽，几乎占据了整个下颌的空间。当它闭上嘴巴时，会将头部转向一侧，用它那只银色的眼睛打量着你。 然后它的嘴巴张开，从喉咙中发出一种富有旋律感、几乎像音乐一样的声音，但这些声音并不是我们理解中的语言。然而，与此同时，你会感觉到后脑勺有轻微的压力感。一位访客你听到一个声音—— [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|雄浑、回荡有力，且带有男中音的特色|女性化、音色优美、属于女高音范畴] – 一个声音从你周围某处传来。你猛地转过头，却发现这里除了你和那只野兽之外，根本没有其他人。在现代社会，这类事物已经变得极为罕见了。 那堆黄金开始颤抖，随后就像一块被惊扰的糕点一样炸开了——那只野兽的其他部分也从它的金色“毯子”下暴露了出来。首先，从堆的金币的另一端，一条又长又粗的尾巴从金币堆的下方抽了出来，它在你脚边的金币碎片间蜿蜒游动，露出一截覆盖着青铜鳞片、脊椎上还镶嵌着白色鳞片的肢体。它懒洋洋地摆动着这条尾巴，就像你睡醒后伸伸胳膊一样自然。 接下来，一条腿，然后是另一条腿，再是一条腿，再是一条腿：它们依次从那堆金块中伸出，以毫不费力的力量踩在金子上，然而，仅仅因为这头巨兽的体重，整个地面都在震动。每一条巨大的腿都比你宽，比你高，末端还长着锋利的白色爪子，每一只爪子都和它的牙齿一样危险。 就目前的情况来看，当那些金色的碎片从它躯干的“桶口”中不断掉落时，它会展开一对翅膀：这些翅膀的膜状结构厚如你的手掌，但与它那肌肉发达、覆盖着坚硬鳞片的身体相比，却薄如纸张。只要它轻轻一屈伸，其中一只翅膀就能轻易地遮住天花板上的那个洞口，阻挡住阳光的照射，使整个洞穴陷入一片昏暗的阴影之中。这种结构让每一片翅膀都能自由摆动，从而消除僵硬感，但同时也会引发强烈的气流，使得你即使仍保持坐姿，也会被这股气流推得在洞穴的地面上滑动。为了保护自己的脸部不被飞溅而来的金粒砸到，你不得不将双臂举到面前。 现在，这只巨兽已经完全从那堆东西中爬了出来，它依次活动着自己的每一条肢体——尾巴、腿、翅膀——然后将自己庞大的身躯稳稳地放在那堆东西上面，整个人都显得非常放松。它将头部转向你，它的吻部正对着你。它的肢体语言透露出一种轻松自在的神情，而它的表情也充满了好奇，因为它已经认定你并不会对它构成任何威胁。[pc.strengthRange 0 80|确实如此，这也是理所应当的。即使你拥有[pc.weapon]以你的能力，根本不可能对这种东西构成任何威胁，更别说构成挑战了。|要是你当初[pc.weapon]如果这种情况发生在游戏过程中，或许你可以设置一个令人兴奋的挑战来吸引玩家参与——但你现在却失去了这个机会。这样的评估确实是必要的。]展现在你眼前的是这座山脉当之无愧的统治者。在这里，这种野兽简直就像[flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|国王|女王]而你，充其量也只是一个客人而已。 [oma.hisHer]天啊，你居然没有立刻被吞噬掉，真是奇迹。 [oma.hisHer]这其实是一种默许，允许你保持现状。 你现在所处的环境是合适的龙。
