The floor has been not only stamped smooth, but swept clean – at least, the floor that you can see. Despite the cave's spacious depth and width, nearly all of it is submerged in a rolling layer of gold. But not gold coins. Not in fabrics wreathed in gold; not in kitchenware plated with gold; not with decorative suits and armor of gold; not even with gold bullion. You bend down and extend your hand, running your fingers through with appears to be gold chips – gold that had been filed down finer than nuggets, akin to gravel. You scoop a handful of the stuff straight from the ground, letting the chips bounce along your open palm. Some are rounded and stumpy; some are more jagged and sharp. All of them have had some layer of polish applied, though some of them are due for another layer. You look into the divot of gold you had just dug out, and spot something discolored among the glittering pieces. Bronze, thick, with a rougher texture, but you can't quite make out what it is. You dig some more, pushing the gold nuggets aside, cleaning the bronze thing of the mess. Whatever it is, it's about the size of your chest. You tap at it with your knuckles. It's solid like stone and warm to the touch, but it has a different, granular texture to the walls around you. The room grumbles. The gold mountain beneath your feet shifts, causing loose pebbles of gravel to tumble and timber out of place, cascading like raindrops off the side of the building. The hot, stale air suddenly whooshes around you, billowing through your hair and around your effects. You look down. The bronze thing flexes, with one edge bunching up against itself like folds of fat. It slides in one direction suddenly, and, beneath the bronze, there's a single, silvery eye. Its dilated, unfocused pupil scans the cave's ceiling before it spots you, and it narrows. The mountain shifts; the gold pile heaves, breathing like a massive lung. You're knocked off balance, forced onto your rump as you slide down the pile towards the base. The gold clinks and clanks against itself as chips fall away, gliding off the scales of a massive beast that had been roused from its slumber, like snow off a hiding wolf's winter coat. A rush of wind surges from the mountain and out of the hole in the ceiling, only for the vacuum to cause howling, cold winds to rush back in. From the gold pile, a creature's head, the skull [pc.heightRange 0 60|easily ]the size of your entire body, rises imperiously. It shakes its head back and forth, flinging the bits of gold still lingering on its scalp and nose every which way. The beast's snout is elongated, similar to a horse's, with small-for-it's-frame teeth jutting from both the upper and lower lips. Adorned on its head are a pair of bone-white horns, curving once before their sharpened tips end at backwards-facing points. It yawns, still drowsy, revealing hidden rows upon rows of razor-sharp teeth that could rend brick and metal, let alone flesh and bone, with a tongue long and wide enough to occupy the whole jaw. When it snaps its mouth shut, it turns its head to the side, sizing you up with its one silver eye. Its mouth opens, and a melodic, almost musical sound comes from its throat as it heaves and undulates, but it's not what you understand as language. And yet, simultaneously, you feel a light pressure in the back of your head. A visitor, you hear a voice – [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|masculine, resonant, and baritone|feminine, canorous, and soprano] – echo from somewhere around you. You whip your head around, but there is nobody else here. Just you and the beast. They are so uncommon in the modern year. The gold pile shivers, then bursts like a disturbed pastry as the rest of the beast unveils itself from its golden blanket. First, on the opposite end, a long, thick tail whips from the lower levels of the pile, slinking through the chips close to your own feet, revealing a limb covered in bronze scales and capped with white plates along its spine. It thrashes languidly the way you would stretch out a limb after waking from your own sleep. Next, one leg, then another, then another, then another: each of them erupting from the pile of gold chips in sequential order, stamping down onto the gold with casual force, yet the mountain booms and quakes with the sheer weight of the beast. Each enormous leg is wider than you are, taller than you are, and is capped with sharp white claws, each every bit as dangerous as its teeth. As it stands and the gold chips drip from the barrel of its torso, it unfurls a pair of wings: their membranes thick as your palm, but, compared to the rest of its muscular and plated body, thin as paper. With one flex, a single wing easily extends to cover the mouth of the hole in the ceiling, blotting the sun's light and casting the cave into bronze shadow. It gives each wing a flap, shaking out the stiffness, yet it causes such a billow of wind that you're pushed along the cave's floor, still in your sitting position. You're forced to bring your arms to your face to protect it from the flinging gold. Now fully emerged from the pile, the beast flexes each limb once more in turn – tail, legs, wings – before settling its gargantuan body atop the pile, utterly relaxed. It turns its head toward you, facing you down the length of its muzzle. Its body language is relaxed and eased, and its expression is curious, having already deemed you not a threat[pc.strengthRange 0 80|, and appropriately so. Even if you had your [pc.weapon] in hand, you would not pose so much as a challenge to this thing, let alone a threat|. If you had your [pc.weapon] in hand, perhaps you could have posed an exciting challenge – but you're disarmed. Its assessment is warranted]. Before you is what is indisputably the regent of the mountain. Here, the beast is as a [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|king|queen], and you are, at best, a guest in [oma.hisHer] court. That you haven't been immediately devoured is [oma.hisHer] implicit permission to remain as you are. You are in the presence of a proper dragon. "

rows.original: The tip of [oma.hisHer] tail wags lazily, and yet, such a casual motion is met with the unceremonious sound of scales slapping against golden metal. [oma.HisHer] nostrils flare as [oma.heShe] sighs, still working out the post-sleep dreariness. [oma.HeShe] tilts [oma.hisHer] head to one side curiously, then the other, trying to get a better look at you with one eye, then the other. Again, its throat undulates, and a smooth, musical sound echoes off the cave's smooth walls. Again, it's accompanied by a proper voice, coming from both everywhere and nowhere, resonating directly into your head from some other place. You bask in the presence of [oma.dragName], [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|King|Queen] of the Northern Shield, [oma.heShe] announces. You will inaugurate yourself and state your intention. [pc.isBimbo|... Holy shit, this is so fucking cool! That's a whole-ass dragon right in front of you! You can barely contain your giddy excitement at the very idea of being in a dragon's lair, sitting on a dragon's hoard, 'basking' in a dragon's presence! You don't say any of that, though. You try and keep your composure measured and restrained, if only because the roleplay is fun and will lead to more 'in-depth' entertainment later. That said: you ask [oma.himHer] what 'inaugurate' means. [oma.dragName] huffs once. Whether in amusement or frustration, it's hard to tell. I am asking for your name, [oma.heShe] says. Oh! That's easy.|You try to keep your hammering pulse at a more measured level, despite being in the presence of what is a real, actual dragon. A real dragon, in a real dragon's lair, standing at the foot of a real dragon's hoard. In the back of your mind, the word 'real' is doing a lot of heavy lifting. You haven't forgotten that this is all roleplay. But the moisture in the air; the gold chips at your feet; the sheer presence that [oma.dragName] exudes before you – it's real enough. And so, when a dragon asks you for something, you probably shouldn't keep it waiting.] You introduce yourself as [pc.name]. And, truth be told, you don't know what it is you're doing here. You... seem to have lost your way, and when you gained your bearings, you were in this cave.
rows.translation: [oma.hisHer]的尾尖懒洋洋地摆动；可就是如此随意的动作，也伴随着鳞片拍上黄金时毫不优雅的声响。[oma.HisHer]的鼻孔随着[oma.heShe]一声叹息而张开，仍在排解睡醒后的昏沉。[oma.HeShe]好奇地把[oma.hisHer]脑袋先向一边偏，再向另一边偏，试图轮流用两只眼睛更好地打量你。 那巨龙的喉咙再次起伏，流畅悦耳的声音在洞穴光滑的墙壁间回荡。随后，那道真正的声音也再度响起；它来自四面八方，却又无处可寻，从另一个地方直接在你脑海中共鸣。你正沐浴在[oma.dragName]——北方之盾[flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|国王|女王]——的威仪之中，[oma.heShe]宣告道。你要报上名号，说明来意。 [pc.isBimbo|……天啊，这他妈也太酷了！你面前可是完整的一大条龙！一想到自己身处龙巢、坐在巨龙的宝藏上，还“沐浴”在巨龙的威仪里，你便几乎压抑不住雀跃的兴奋！ 不过，你没有把这些说出口。你努力保持镇定与克制，哪怕只是因为这场角色扮演非常有趣，而且稍后会带来更加“深入”的娱乐。话虽如此，你还是问[oma.himHer]“报上名号”是什么意思。 [oma.dragName]喷了一下鼻息。究竟是因为好笑还是因为挫败，很难判断。我是在询问你的名字，[oma.heShe]说道。 哦！这很简单。|尽管面对的是一条真真正正的巨龙，你仍努力让剧烈跳动的脉搏保持平稳。真正的巨龙，身处真正的龙巢，守在真正的龙族宝藏脚下。 在你脑海深处，“真正”这个词承担了太多意义。你并未忘记，这一切都是角色扮演。可空气中的湿气、脚下的金屑，以及[oma.dragName]在你面前散发出的磅礴威仪——这些已经足够真实。 所以，当一条龙向你索要什么时，你大概不该让它久等。]你报上了[pc.name]这个名字。说实话，你也不知道自己为什么会来到这里。你……似乎迷了路；等回过神来，自己已经身处这座洞穴之中。

rows.original: [oma.dragName] tilts [oma.hisHer] head upward, looking down at you along the length of [oma.hisHer] nose. [oma.HisHer] eyes narrow suspiciously. That I make my nest among these mountains is not some local legend, [oma.heShe] says. These ranges – this very cave – is known to all as belonging under my purview. Perhaps you truly are a wandering traveler that had gotten lost in the mountains, having fallen, without injury, the height of a mountain and into my hoard. [oma.HeShe] leans forward; a heavy wash of air steams from [oma.hisHer] nostrils, billowing hotly against your body as [oma.heShe] stares you down. And perhaps I am merely a garden variety lizard that never missed a breakfast. Okay, so, [oma.heShe] is clearly not all that happy about having some stranger inside [oma.hisHer] cave. But[pc.isBimbo|, in a rare flash of not-stupid-having], you counter that, if you were here to steal [oma.hisHer] gold... how are you meant to escape? You left yourself no rope or ladder from the hole in the ceiling[pc.hasWings|, and your [pc.wings] wouldn't be able to generate enough lift for yourself and enough gold to have made the risk worth it]. [oma.dragName] remains in place, [oma.hisHer] eyes narrowed on you, studying your body for any flinch, any crack in your expression that might give [oma.himHer] a tell. You don't give [oma.himHer] one. Inarguable points, [oma.heShe] admits. [oma.HeShe] leans backward, rising [oma.hisHer] neck to its full length as [oma.heShe] studies [oma.hisHer] hoard from the higher vantage point. You stand within the hollowed out vein of golden ore, [pc.race] [pc.name]. Every fleck you see – [oma.heShe] pauses, racking [oma.hisHer] right-front leg across the surface of the gold pile, letting every stone [oma.hisHer] claws dig through bunch up against [oma.hisHer] claws as [oma.heShe] strokes a gouge through it – I had personally excavated. Separated from the chaff. [oma.HisHer] nostrils flare once more, but this time, it's not steam erupting from [oma.hisHer] nose, but smoke. Clearly, [oma.heShe] knew where to get the heat to smelt the ore. And added to my collection. Every. Fleck. The air hangs heavy with that exclamation. [oma.dragName] maintains [oma.hisHer] imperialist stance, making it clear, purely through [oma.hisHer] [silly|aura|posture] and in no uncertain terms, who here has all of the power. If, after our meeting is adjourned, that even one is missing, there is no corner of this earth that a [pc.race] named [pc.name] could escape me. You gulp.
rows.translation: [oma.dragName]倾斜[oma.hisHer]头部朝上，沿着[oma.hisHer]鼻梁俯视着你。 [oma.HisHer]眼睛怀疑地眯了起来。我选择在这些山脉中筑巢，并非什么当地的传说罢了。， [oma.heShe]说。这些区域——就是这个洞穴——大家都知道都属于我的管辖范围。或许你确实是一个在山中迷路的旅人，不慎从山顶跌落下来，却毫发无伤，就这样落入了我的藏宝之处。 [oma.HeShe]身体前倾，一股浓重的热气从中散发出来[oma.hisHer]你的鼻孔剧烈地呼吸着，热气不断地扑向你的身体[oma.heShe]直视着你的眼睛。或许我只不过是一只从不会错过早餐的普通蜥蜴罢了。 好的，那么， [oma.heShe]显然，对于有陌生人闯入自己的领地，它并不是那么高兴。 [oma.hisHer]洞穴。但是[pc.isBimbo|在一次难得的、没有表现出愚蠢行为的时刻……]你反驳道，如果你是来偷东西的，应该直接行动才对。 [oma.hisHer]黄金……你究竟要怎么逃脱呢？你连从天花板上的那个洞里爬出去的绳子或梯子都没有留下啊。[pc.hasWings|以及你的[pc.wings]将无法产生足够的升力来支撑自己。以及足够的黄金，使得这种风险变得值得承担]。 [oma.dragName]保持原位。 [oma.hisHer]们紧盯着你，仔细观察你的每一个动作，试图发现你是否有任何闪避的迹象，或是你表情中任何可能暴露真相的细微变化。 [oma.himHer]一看就知道了。你根本藏不住。 [oma.himHer]一。无可争议的事实， [oma.heShe]承认。 [oma.HeShe]向后倾斜，逐渐升高[oma.hisHer]完全伸展开来[oma.heShe]研究[oma.hisHer]从更高的位置进行囤积。你站在那条被开采出来的金矿矿脉之中， [pc.race] [pc.name]你所能看到的每一粒尘埃 – [oma.heShe]停顿着，苦苦思索着[oma.hisHer]将右前腿搭在金堆的表面上，让每一颗石头都能被看到[oma.hisHer]爪子用力抓挠，将它们聚集到一起[oma.hisHer]像爪子一样[oma.heShe]在上面划了一道深深的切口—— 这些是我亲自挖掘出来的，是从杂质中筛选出来的。 [oma.HisHer]鼻孔再次张开，但这一次，从中喷出的并不是蒸汽[oma.hisHer]鼻子，但却闻到了烟味。显然， [oma.heShe]知道该去哪里寻找能够用来熔炼矿石的高温。然后被添加到了我的收藏列表中。每一片碎片，无一遗漏。 空气中弥漫着那声呼喊所带来的重型气息。 [oma.dragName]维持[oma.hisHer]采取帝国主义立场，明确表示，完全是通过[oma.hisHer] [silly|气场|姿态]而且，毫无疑问，这个人拥有所有的权力。如果在我们会议结束之后，哪怕只少了一个人，那么这个地球上就没有任何一个地方是安全的[pc.race]被命名为[pc.name]我竟然没能注意到。 你咽了口唾沫。

rows.original: At the sound of your name, [oma.dragName] chuffs once, [oma.hisHer] cheeks billowing. A good name, [oma.heShe] says, with just the barest hint of amusement in both its lyrical throat and the voice in your head. [pc.ra dragon|A proper, fitting name for a dragon|Your rearers were raised well, and raised a well [pc.race] in turn].
rows.translation: 听到你的名字时， [oma.dragName]轻哼了一声， [oma.hisHer]双颊随之鼓起。真是个好名字， [oma.heShe]说道——它那如歌的喉咙和你脑海中的声音里，都只带着一丝极淡的愉悦。[pc.ra dragon|对一条龙来说，这是个恰当而贴切的名字|你的养育者被教养得很好，他们又反过来养育出了一个出色的[pc.race]]。

rows.original: [oma.HisHer] tail thumps once, almost jovially, causing more gold flakes to fling every which way from the impact. However, until such time arrives, [oma.heShe] says, I will ere on the side of clemency and assume that you are, indeed, here without ill intentions. The [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|King|Queen] of the Northern Shield is not known for being an ungracious host. Does [oma.heShe] get that many visitors? I do not, [oma.heShe] answers. My kingdom is rich in material, but socially barren. The company of one such as myself is not one that the mortal races willingly seek out. From the tone in [oma.hisHer] voice, [oma.heShe] doesn't seem too bothered by that, at least. Many of my days are spent sleeping. If not sleeping, then excavating – adding to my endlessly-growing material wealth. And if not excavating, [pc.race] [pc.name]... [oma.HeShe] leans forward, [oma.hisHer] great, long neck stretching outward and casting [oma.hisHer] eyes downward onto you from [oma.hisHer] mountain of gold. [oma.HisHer] silver eyes, their pupils tightening into vertical slits. With a great heave of its chest, a wash of white, hot steam billows from its flared nostrils. Then I am mating. You break contact for just a moment, a split second, your eyes darting from [oma.hisHers], to look down the length of its gargantuan body. [oma.HeShe]'s the size of a building. Your eyes rest on [oma.hisHer] rear flanks, where, between its heavy limbs, would rest its genitals. It was only a quick lapse in attention, but [oma.dragName] lets out another, animalistic snort, amused. You might as well have ogled [oma.himHer]. Nervously, you clear your throat and ask if there's a [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|Queen|King] of the Northern Shield. At that, it's [oma.hisHer] turn to break eye contact. [oma.HeShe] lets out another sigh, this one far more dramatic as [oma.heShe] tilts [oma.hisHer] head to the side and stares off, gazing at the hole in the ceiling. Alas, there is not, [oma.heShe] answers. The melodic thrumming in [oma.hisHer] throat takes a more melancholic downturn. That alone is enough to sway your emotions, the way an instrument played a certain way could make you feel a certain way. My claim that I spend my waking hours mating was... poetic. None are entitled to my land, materials, or self. Without turning [oma.hisHer] head, [oma.hisHer] eyes turn back to yours, looking down at you smugly. And I have such land, materials, and self to entitle others to. ... Having a dragon so nakedly flirt with you is a bit of a new one. [pc.isDK|But it's not entirely out of the question. You do exude an aura of such sexual potency that even a dragon would acknowledge it.|It's a little bit intimidating – but, more than that, it's exciting. You? With a dragon?] Still, from the language of [oma.hisHer] body, [oma.heShe]'s not looking to jump straight into it just yet. [oma.HeShe] wants to play the game a little bit longer. You rock on your seat and lift your eyes to the hole in the ceiling, where warm sunlight streaks in, bathing the mountain of gold and causing the flakes to glitter. You vocally wonder how it is you're meant to get out. A trivial matter, [oma.heShe] answers, flexing [oma.hisHer] massive, right wing and settling it back into place. It is soon time for my bi-annual feeding. Providing an esteemed guest such as yourself safe exit would be a matter of your weight upon my back. Or my claws. Or in my jaws. Whichever you prefer. [oma.HisHer] massive right claws rake idle, lazy circles in the gold mountain between you once more. Though, is your exit truly such an expedient matter? [oma.heShe] asks. I am not a malevolent [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|king|queen]. I demand no tribute; no taxes; my mere presence provides security for the mountains and its surrounding ranges. I had said, sentences ago, that I am bereft of both a mate and social interactions. The [flags.OMA_DRAG_MALE|King|Queen] of the Northern Shield is in dire, dire need for– [oma.HeShe] pauses, a little too long, letting the tension build ever so slightly as you await the end of [oma.hisHer] sentence. Thankfully the town fixed up that old field. We can use the gym to really speed up his weight trainin' and get him all adapted in no-time to wearin' somethin' heavier than that leather."
    
    It's not a no, but she does raise a good point. "I guess I'll have to broach the topic with him. I'll get back to you once we talk about it some more, okay?"
    
    The redhead smiles, letting the momentary seriousness fade. [pc.isCunning
        |Although she doesn't say it, you can tell from the look on her face that Atugia is already imagining just how hard she can work the rabbitboy over with your blessing.
        |It's nothing as pleasant as the familiar smile she puts on next.
    ]
    
    "Aye. Anythin' else you wanna talk about?"

    ]。
    
    她露出微笑[silly
        |，也朝你比回指枪手势
    ]。“怎么了？”
    
    “先听我说完，”你继续说道，抬起一只手[quin.around
        |，用拇指朝身后的昆因指了指
    ]。“你觉得帮忙训练昆因使用盔甲和盾牌怎么样？”
    
    “盔甲和盾牌，嗯？”[silly
        |她停下动作，当场摆出思考表情
        |她[quin.around
            |朝那名塔利尔的背影瞥了一眼
            |若有所思地抬头望去
        ]
    ]。这个想法又在她脑中打转片刻；随后她抱起双臂，摩挲几下，又清了清喉咙。
    
    “我……并不反对。昆蒂卢斯不对那根响指打什么古怪主意时，我和他相处得还算不错，可是……他真的会答应吗？我无意冒犯他，但那家伙虽然长着满腹肌肉，做事却谈不上勤奋。他那种体格是靠健康饮食养出来的，而不太像穿着结实盔甲练出来的。幸好镇上修好了那片旧训练场。我们可以利用健身房大幅加快他的负重训练，让他很快适应比身上皮革更重的东西。”

        |虽然她没有说出口，但从阿图吉娅的表情，你能看出她已经在想象得到你的允许后，可以怎样狠狠操练那个兔男孩。
        |这远不如她随后露出的熟悉笑容那般令人愉快。
    ]
    
    “好啊。还有什么想聊的吗？”

rows.original:
Atugia laughs, punching you lightly in the shoulder.
    
    "Good one! You know he's good enough now!"
    
    Well, you still wanted to ask. If she could teach him her magic-
    
    "Even if I wanted to, he would want to have to learn it. You heard him the other day: the way he fights uses his own magic. Quin ain't gonna change how he fights that easily, especially if he found what's comfortable for him now."
    
    The dullahan gives you a reassuring smile, tilting her head over toward your taeleer companion's booth. "So uh... unless you can make him somehow feel like asking for more and have some grand ideas, let's keep it simple? What else ya got on your mind?"
rows.translation:
阿图吉娅笑着，轻轻拍了拍你的肩膀。
    
    “干得不错！你现在知道他已经足够优秀了。”
    
    不过，你还是想问吧——如果她能把自己的魔法传授给他……
    
    “就算我想这么做，他也必须自己去学习才行。你前几天应该听说过：他的战斗方式就是运用自己的魔法。昆因不会轻易改变自己的战斗方式，尤其是当他已经找到了让自己感觉最舒服的战斗方式之后。
    
    那个女孩向你露出了一个安心的微笑，然后把头偏向了你那位泰勒尔族同伴的摊位。所以啊……除非你能想办法让他产生想要更多东西的欲望，或者想出一些绝妙的点子，否则我们就简单点吧。你还有其他什么想法吗？

rows.original: "Quintillus," you start. "We work together well, right? I mean, I rescued you from the cult-" The taeleer taps his book against his mug. "For which I am grateful." "Right," you respond, pointing a finger at him. The energy of the taeleer threatens to derail you, but you're not going to just back down now that you've got him right where you want him. "But the way you fight right now, as great as it is, isn't that helpful." Quin furrows his brow, but remains silent long enough for you to keep going and make a point. [pc.isBimbo |That mix of anger and patience is exactly what makes him so hot. ]You shift in the booth just enough to reach out and touch his small shield. "Quin, why don't you work with Atugia so you can wear heavier armor and use a better shield? [pc.isCunning |Be our shield. |[pc.isBimbo |You're a strong stud and can keep me safe and stuff! |You have a shield, but we could get a bigger one. Something to help you- ] ]" [pc.isCunning |Your words stir the curious nature out of the ex-cultist, baiting him into a more tempered attitude. He leans forward, raising a brow and lifting three fingers. "Can you give me three reasons?" "You're strong, capable, and probably the one with the most to prove, right?" Although you hardly get much chance to gauge the party's entire personality, the fact is that Quin's behavior is drastically restrained compared to the cult he abandoned. Both of your interests align when it comes to Tollus and survival... and so long as you have a common enemy that he hates, why wouldn't he stick by you? |Although your scattered wording does little to play into his nature, the effort and your prior interest in him seems to do the trick. Quintillus sighs, leaning back into his seat. "I don't know... I mean, as novel as it is to protect all of you... how do I even gauge if you're serious?" "I'm here. Asking you now," you reply. The answer hardly sways him from his doubtful staring, but your signature [pc.isDK |scowl |smile ] at last breaks down the excuse for resistance in him. His ears twitch and Quin reaches up to carefully scratch at the base and back of his right furry appendage. ] "Okay, if you're serious... then I've got an idea of armor that should do the trick. I'm not exactly going to be able to bulk up like [flags.BRINT_MET |Brint |a minotaur ] or [arona.recruited |Arona |an orc ], so I'll focus on getting a larger shield. The blacksmith in town should be able to make the armor for us." "Atugia will be in charge of training you; that's not a problem, right?" Your question makes him pause, but the taeleer doesn't grow uncomfortable. [atugia.around |The look he gives her says it all before he even looks back at you. |In fact, you're pretty sure it's one of the biggest grins you've seen him sport. ] "Atugia and I talk about books all the time and now she's going to help me learn to wear armor and play like I'm some sort of professional soldier? This'll be a good story to drink over next time I get some privacy with her." Quintillus does, however, return to the more pressing matter. "[quin.relationshipRange 0 10 |It'll cost about 500 hawks to get this done. Bring that back and we'll head over to his place together." Well, that settles that. "We'll head over there once I have everything ready, then." "Good," Quin laughs, relaxing and taking a small drink before tilting his head toward you. "What else is on the menu? |Given you and I are good friends... I'll cover the cost of the armor. Once you're good to go, just grab me and we'll swing over to visit that orc's smithy." "Sounds good," you reply, finishing the topic with a nice clean bow. It's nice that he's willing to foot the bill for armor just because you brought it up. It's a moment that shows just how good his attitude can be when he's not too distracted with sex, at least. ]
rows.translation: 昆蒂卢斯，”你开口说道，“我们合作得很好，对吧？我的意思是，我把你从那个邪教组织中救了出来——” 泰勒族用书轻敲着杯子，说道：“对此我非常感激。” “没错，”你回应道，同时用手指了指他。泰勒尔释放出的能量足以让你陷入困境，但既然你已经将他控制在了自己想要的位置，现在绝不可能退缩。“不过，你现在的战斗方式，虽然很厉害，但实际上并没有起到什么帮助。” 昆因皱起了眉头，但始终没有出声，让你有机会继续把话说完。 [pc.isBimbo |正是这种愤怒与耐心的结合，才使他成为了这样的一个人。性感。 ]你在操作台里稍微调整了一下位置，以便能够伸手触碰到他的小盾牌。 “昆因，你为什么不和阿图吉娅合作呢？这样你就可以穿戴更重的盔甲，使用更强大的盾牌了。 [pc.isCunning |成为我们的护盾。 |[pc.isBimbo |你可真是个强壮的家伙，能保护我的安全呢！ |你有一个护盾，但我们可以弄一个更大的。某个能真正帮助你的东西…… ] ]" [pc.isCunning |你的话激起了那个前邪教成员内心好奇的天性，促使他采取了更为冷静的态度。他向前倾了倾身子，挑了挑眉毛，同时举起了三根手指：“你能给我举三个理由吗？” “你很强大，有能力，而且很可能也是最需要证明自己价值的人，对吧？虽然你很难真正了解这个团队的整体性格，但事实上，与他曾经所属的那个邪教组织相比，昆因的行为已经变得克制了许多。在对待托卢斯以及生存这个问题上，你们的立场是一致的。只要你们有一个他共同憎恨的敌人，他为什么不会站在你这一边呢？ |虽然你这些零散的话语并没有真正反映出他的性格特点，但你的这份用心以及你之前对他的关心，似乎已经起到了作用。昆蒂卢斯叹了口气，靠在椅背上说道：“我不知道……我的意思是，保护你们所有人这样的举动虽然很新颖……但我该怎么判断你是不是认真的呢？” “我就在这里，现在就在问你。”你回答道。 这个回答并没有让他改变那怀疑的眼神，但你的这种态度，确实很特别[pc.isDK |皱眉 |微笑 ]终于，他再也无法找到任何借口来抗拒了。他的耳朵微微抽动，昆因便伸手轻轻挠了挠他右耳根部及后方的毛茸茸部位。 ] 好吧，如果你是认真的……那么我有一个关于护甲的想法，应该能解决问题。不过我不太可能像某些人那样变得肌肉发达[flags.BRINT_MET |布林特 |弥诺陶洛斯 ]或者[arona.recruited |阿罗娜 |一个兽人 ]所以，我会想办法弄一块更大的盾牌。镇上的铁匠应该能够为我们制作这种护甲。” “阿图吉娅会负责你的训练工作，这个应该没有问题吧？” 你的问题让他停顿了一下，但这位泰勒尔并没有感到不自在。 [atugia.around |他看她的那个眼神，就已经说明了一切，甚至在他再回头看你的时候也是如此。 |事实上，你敢肯定，这是你见过他露出过的最灿烂的笑容之一。 ]我和阿图吉娅总是谈论书籍，现在她还要帮助我学习如何穿戴盔甲，让我像职业军人一样战斗？下次有机会单独和她相处时，这个故事肯定很适合边喝酒边讲。” 不过，昆蒂卢斯还是回到了更紧迫的事情上。[quin.relationshipRange 0 10 |完成这件事大概需要500只霍克。把那个带回来，我们就一起去他家吧。” “好吧，那就这么定了。等我把所有东西都准备妥当后，我们就去那里。” “很好，”昆因笑着说，放松下来，喝了一小口饮料，然后把头转向你：“还有其他安排吗？ |既然我们都是好朋友……我就来承担这套盔甲的费用吧。等你准备好了，直接来找我，我们一起去那个兽人的铁匠铺看看。” “听起来不错，”你回答道，然后愉快地结束了这个话题。他愿意为你支付盔甲的费用，只因为你是提了这个要求，这真的说明他的心胸有多宽广。至少，在他没有被性事分散注意力的时候，他的态度确实是很好的。 ]

rows.original:
Given he was open to paying for it, is he ready to go and have Ogrish fit him now?

    "Sure," he chuckles, setting his mug down. Although Quin is cozy in his usual booth, it looks like the ex-cultist is eager to get the ball rolling on this for you; he gets up and sets his things down, tossing a knowing wave to Garth to keep an eye on it before patting your back.
    
    "Let's get going, shall we?"
rows.translation:
既然他愿意为此付费，那么现在他是否准备去让奥格里什为他量身定制这些东西了呢？

    “当然，”他笑着放下杯子。虽然昆因在他常坐的座位上很惬意，但这个前邪教徒似乎很急于为你促成这件事；他站起身来，把东西放下，还向加斯示意让他帮忙照看一下，然后拍了拍你的背。
    
    “我们走吧，好吗？”

rows.original: The two of you make your way through town without any issue[flags.OGRISH_MET | | with Quin leading the way there ]; a few folks look at the two of you since your companion's reputation still hasn't entirely subsided, but otherwise no one sees fit to harass you or him for once. [flags.OGRISH_MET |Ogrish's |The man's ] smithy, too, is breathtakingly free of business: he's working at his forge when the two of you approach and doesn't turn right away. [flags.OGRISH_MET |Ogrish is busy at work even now, but spots the two of you in the corner of his eye: he sets his hammer down and walks over with a grin. "[pc.name]. Quintillus. What do I owe for the pleasure?" "We're here to have you help us with a job," Quintillus starts. He looks at you and smirks. "Right?" You nod, making Ogrish laugh and cross his arms. |The orc looks over at the two of you and raises a brow, though, when Quin taps the counter approaching the burning hot forge. His long black hair sways when he rights himself, the tell-tale tusks of the orc shifting as he seems to try and recall who he is. "Quintillus," he finally arrives there, nodding toward the shield. The graveled and deep voice of the orc makes his tusks rattle whenever his syllables land. "What are you doing here? "This is [pc.name]," the taeleer answers. He goes another step further and pats your back again, this time leaving the hand there and shooting you a grin. "[pc.name], this is Ogrish." The blacksmith sets his hammer down beside a mostly shaped ingot, approaching the counter with a small grin. "Ogrish. Yes, it's my shop and no, I didn't kill the last owner for it." He extends his hand, the muscles in his arm all but impossible to miss: it was the arm of someone who could probably bend metal instead of just hammer at it. You take his hand and give a quick shake, letting go and finally speaking for yourself. "[pc.dcb |Not bad. He'll do the job. |Nice to meet you. |Whoa, you're like... totally strong huh? ]" Ogrish looks at Quintillus at that, then settles his attention over the pair of you and rights himself. ] "So, what kind of work do you need, then?" You reach over and set your hand on Quin's shoulder. "We need to get Quintillus fitted for new gear. Not to mention see if we can't get him something to go with it." "Oh yeah?" Ogrish looks the taeleer over, particularly settling his gaze on the now-absent equipment normally carried by the man. "So that's why you asked me to work on that shield, huh?" You shoot him a look but the quickness of his step is already heading into the smithy; Quintillus shoots a look back over his shoulder with a grin. "Ogrish, where are your clothes for trying out armor? Still where you left them, right?" With Quin moving so fast and leaving the two of you alone, you finally look at the orc with the biggest question: when did Quintillus have the chance to do all this? That question, though, isn't going to be answered straight away: Ogrish moves to follow him and you in-turn follow the orc, approaching the doorway of his smithy's dressing room. Various leather straps with numbers etched into them litter the area around a stool and mirror, some carrying simple and smoothed weights of iron. Ogrish kneels down and grabs the first bunches of them, leaving you standing around and waiting. The graveled and deep voice of the orc makes his tusks rattle whenever his syllables land. "What are you doing here? "This is [pc.name]," the taeleer answers. He goes another step further and pats your back again, this time leaving the hand there and shooting you a grin. "[pc.name], this is Ogrish." Ogrish kneels down and grabs the first bunches of them, leaving you standing around and waiting. rows.original:
You set a hefty-sized bag of coins down on the table between you and Quintillus' ears perk up. The taeleer isn't being greedy but rather seems surprised.
    
    "Remember what we talked about before?"
    
    That makes his pink gaze shift from the bag to you, leaning back in his chair and smirking.
    
    "So you got it, huh? Well, if you're paying for the armor, who am I to turn you down?"
    
    Quin sets his things down and gets up from his usual spot, tossing a wave at Garth to keep an eye on his things before looking at you.
    
    "Let's get moving then, shall we?"
    
    You nod and grab the bag, the two of you heading out together.
rows.translation:
你把一袋沉甸甸的硬币放在你们中间的桌子上，昆蒂卢斯的耳朵立刻竖了起来。这个泰勒人并不是贪心，而是显得有些惊讶。
    
    “还记得我们之前谈过的事情吗？”
    
    听到这话，他那粉红色的眼睛从硬币袋上移开了，靠在椅背上，露出了得意的笑容。
    
    所以你明白了，是吧？既然你是来付钱买这件盔甲的，我当然不会拒绝你。”
    
    昆因放下手中的东西，从他常坐的位置站了起来，朝加斯挥了挥手，让他帮忙照看一下自己的东西，然后才看着你。
    
    那我们出发吧，好吗？”
    
    你点了点头，抓起背包，两人一起离开了。

rows.original:
[flags.OGRISH_MET
            |
            |Quin leads the way through town and clearly seems to know exactly where to go. 
        ]You reach the smithy without anyone on the way trying to stop you and nothing unusual happening. [flags.OGRISH_MET
            |Ogrish is working here like usual but looks up from shaping an ingot as he hears you approach between swings of his hammer. He gets up and sets the tool down, approaching the counter and wiping at his brow with one of his rags.
            
            "[pc.name]! It's good to see you. Quintillus is here, too? What do I owe this visit to?"
            
            It looks like your companion comes here too: Quintillus carries a shield and a sword, so he probably has good reason for getting regular gear repairs from the orc. For now, though, you need to stay focused on the task at hand.
            |An orc works at the forge of the smithy with a somber smile. It looks like he truly enjoys his work, hammering a bronze blade into shape with skilled control of his strikes.
            
            Although you don't know him, though, Quin is quick to approach the counter and give it a knock. "Ogrish? It's Quintillus: I mentioned I might come by?"
            
            The orc looks over at him at the same time you do, albeit the two of you have different reasons since you're the one who was going to pay. He sets his hammer and tongs down to let the blade cool, getting up and approaching the two of you without a word. Up close, you can see the long black hair of the smith is deceptively well-maintained; his red eyes look between both of you before his smile settles on you.
            
            "Name's Ogrish. Yes it is my shop... and no, I didn't kill the last owner of it."
            
            His way of speaking is unusually fluent for someone up north, especially when you consider he's an orc; his tusks click every time he finishes a syllable and would normally present a challenge, but not for this man. When he extends his hand a moment later, you can see that this smith may just have it all: strength and mind in perfect balance. It's the right kind of person for this kind of job.
            
            "[pc.dcb
                |[pc.Name].
                |I'm [pc.name].
                |Hi Ogrish! I'm [pc.name]!
            ]"
        ]
        
        You briefly shake hands, only taking a second to unstring the bag of electrum from your waist before you speak again. "We'd like to buy a fine suit of heavy armor and need to get Quintillus fitted. Can you help us?"
        
        Ogrish looks at the pouch and then back to Quintillus. The taeleer smiles, setting his hands on his hips and giving a tilt of his head towards you.
        
        "It was their idea, not mine: but you got that shield in working order for me, too, right?"
        
        "Yeah." He nods. "It should be in the back where you left it."
        
        You raise a brow, but Quin is already moving before you can even ask, moving past the counter and towards one of the smithy's closets. Ogrish takes the bag and tosses it beneath his counter, waving you to follow as he moves over to an odd collection of garb: measuring straps. Piles of cut and marked leathers litter the foot of a stool and a piece of mirror, some of the pieces of leather bound with metal weighted ingots to represent the weight of armor. It's the sort of set-up that one would expect from someone crafting equipment.
        
        You're certain of just how good for the job Ogrish is now, but you also notice something else: the door leading into the room Quin vanished into is slightly ajar. Maybe you can use the chance to spy on the taeleer while he changes. Or just wait. It shouldn't be too long for him to get dressed or whatever, right?

[flags.OGRISH_MET
            |
            |昆因在前面带路穿过城镇，显然她非常清楚该往哪里走。 
        ]你顺利地来到了铁匠铺，途中没有任何人试图阻止你，也没有发生任何异常情况。 [flags.OGRISH_MET
            |奥格里什像往常一样在这里工作，当他正在锻造一块金属锭时，听到你走近的声音，便停下了手中的动作，抬头看了过来。他站起身来，放下工具，走向柜台，用一块抹布擦了擦额头。[pc.name]真高兴见到你。昆蒂卢斯也在这里吗？我这次来访究竟是有什么原因呢？

看来你的同伴也经常来这里：昆蒂卢斯带着盾牌和剑，所以他应该有正当理由需要经常让兽人修理这些装备。不过现在，你还是需要专心完成手头的任务。
            |一个兽人面带忧郁的微笑，在铁匠铺的炉火旁工作。看来他真的很享受自己的工作，熟练地控制着每一次敲击，将青铜刀刃锻造成所需的形状。

不过，虽然你并不认识他，但昆因还是迅速走过去，敲了敲柜台。奥格瑞什？是我，昆蒂卢斯：我之前说过可能会过来吧？”

那个兽人也在同一时刻看向了你，不过你们俩这么做的原因不同——毕竟是要你来付钱的。他放下手中的锤子和钳子，让刀刃冷却下来，然后一言不发地走过来，站在你们俩面前。近距离看，你会发现这位铁匠那长长的黑色头发其实保养得相当好；他的红色眼睛在你们两人之间扫视了一番，随后才露出了微笑。

“我叫奥格瑞什。没错，这是我的店铺……而且，我并没有杀死前主人。对于一个来自北方的人来说，他的说话方式已经相当流利了，尤其是考虑到他其实是一个兽人；每当他说完一个音节时，他的獠牙都会发出咔嗒声，这种声音通常会让人感到不适，但对这个男人来说却并非如此。片刻之后，当他伸出手来时，你会发现，这位铁匠似乎拥有一切必要的条件：力量与智慧达到了完美的平衡。他正是从事这份工作的人选。[pc.dcb
                |[pc.Name]。
                |我是[pc.name]。
                |嗨，奥格瑞什！我是[pc.name]！
            ]"
        ]
        
        你们简短地握了握手，他只用了一秒钟就从腰间取下那袋电银，然后才继续说道：“我们想买一套质量上乘的重型盔甲，需要让昆蒂卢斯来试穿。你能帮我们吗？”

奥格里什看了看那个袋子，然后又看向昆蒂卢斯。那个泰勒尔微笑着，双手叉腰，微微歪着头看着你。
        
        这是他们的主意，不是我的；不过你还是把那个盾牌修好了，让我也能使用，对吧？”

“是的。”他点了点头，“应该放在你之前放置它的那个地方。”

你挑了挑眉毛，但还没等你开口询问，昆因就已经走了过去，穿过柜台，朝着铁匠铺的一个储藏室走去。奥格里什接过那个袋子，把它扔到自己的柜台下面，然后示意你跟过去。他走到一堆奇怪的物品旁——那些都是用于测量尺寸的带子。一堆切割好并做了标记的皮革散落在凳子脚下，还有一面镜子；其中一些皮革上还绑着金属重块，用来模拟盔甲的重量。这种设置正是人们会期待从一个负责制作装备的人那里看到的。
        
        你现在已经确信奥格里什确实非常适合这项任务了，但你也注意到了另一件事：通往昆因消失的那个房间的门微微敞开着。或许你可以利用这个机会，在泰勒换衣服的时候偷看他一番。或者干脆等着看吧，他应该不会花太长时间来穿好衣服或做其他事情，对吧？

rows.original: It takes a minute or two of waiting, but the door finally opens and an unusually over-dressed Quintillus comes out. A paired shirt and pants of red cover much of his body with their long sleeves and hems, making him look... weirdly professional. The ex-cultist sees your eyes and seems to pick-up on your opinion, stepping over to the mirror with a grumble. "Yeah, yeah. A lot of clothes, right? Trust me, I haven't put on this much since I was back at home." "Back at home?" Quintillus nods, looking at you through the reflection while Ogrish wraps one of the straps around his shoulders. "You heard me right. The shield I had Ogrish work on is one my family has had since our days serving the ancient legions, back when my people were still mostly enslaved. I asked for it before I left the cult, but that was because I had no idea what they were and thought I might need it. Thankfully I never did because that thing is fucking heavy." Is a shield really that heavy? You're glad that you're only paying for armor and that he did get the shield... but will he really be alright with all this gear? Ogrish sees you and smirks. "Don't worry: I'm not going to fit him in real plate: I plan on giving Quintillus armor that's styled like what they wear down south in the Heartlands. It was his idea, actually." You raise a brow at him. However, much to your curiosity's thanks, Ogrish quickly points to a collection of armor on display for his shop. On one of his stands, you can see the mix of leather and metal in a segmented fashion; tiny plates of bronze attached to a thick leather chestplate. Quin looks over at it and smirks, albeit only for a moment before grimacing as Ogrish sets some of the weights onto the belts currently wrapping his upper torso. "T-That stuff over there is good," he grunts, taking a few seconds to adjust each time a weight gets put on. "I had friends who became mercenaries swear by it. And the mercenaries in this part of the north wear it too: armor like that'll be perfect for me... especially once I get some extra leather and gambeson padding to go with it." As Ogrish works his way down to his feet, though, Quin sways his foot and looks at the orc with a scowl. "Not my feet. I don't wear stuff on my feet." To his credit, the blacksmith is quick to move on and instead bind the weights around his shin. "It's a thing with taeleer about their feet, I guess." "Quin, you were talking about that shield?" The ex-cultist sets his foot down and lets Ogrish work in peace, this time looking back over his now-weight-covered shoulder with a grin. "Right: it's from my family. The symbol on it is two olive branches since we're minor nobility. My father earned it back when he was a soldier for the Alliance, but I never needed it since I wanted to help our country in different ways. Recognition only hindered me." You at least can understand that part: his part in the cult alone had left a bad reputation, but it would have destroyed his family if news of him being in a cult like Tollus's got back. The more you hear about it, the more you're confused on why he joined them in the first place. But talking about something that heavy may not- "I joined them because I had lost everything." Quin grumbles and doesn't keep going. Instead, he waits until you meet his gaze. "[pc.name]... I wouldn't have joined them if I wasn't acting before thinking. And I didn't know what they were doing the entire time I worked with them because I was just a messenger. I had sex, but... I was one of the only ones who they couldn't properly brainwash. When everything started going down, though, I used that to run away. You gave me a second chance and I still haven't thanked you for that." One of the straps gets pulled tighter around his chest and Ogrish starts adding more weights. It looks like he's preparing for the uppermost range of what the fit can fit and hold, but the taeleer doesn't break his sight on you. "When you asked me if I would step in for you, I knew it was a way to repay you. [quin.statueCountRange 1 |You helped me collect one of the ones who started this, too. |I still need to stop those responsible for this, though, and that means fighting beside you. ] As long as you have the need for me, I plan to repay that mercy and trust." Ogrish sits him down on the stool and starts lightly moving him around, testing his range. Despite the large amount of weight, Quintillus seems aptly adjusting already; if the armor is properly made and he has time to train, his physique is more than enough to carry all the gear just like he said. "Once he finishes this stuff, bring it to me. Atugia and I'll start talking over the plans... and once you're free for a few days, the three of us will make sure I'm up to your standards." You [pc.isDK |nod |smile, nodding and giving him a thumbs up ]. "You got it." The ex-cultist doesn't look happy about having to wear something so heavy over his head, but a quick glance at you is enough to remind him that this isn't a choice just for him: this is his act of repaying you. That lets him power through the rest of the fitting... and as the two of you finish and part from Ogrish, you both return to the Frost Hound and Quin's booth just like before. Garth, of course, immediately shoots him a look as you enter. "Don't leave your stuff sitting around next time, Quintillus! You cost me a customer!" The taeleer grumbles and rolls his eyes, but inevitably waves back at him. He retrieves all his gear and you... well, you're free again. You just need to remember to visit Ogrish tomorrow so you can pick up the armor.
rows.translation: 等待了一两分钟之后，门终于打开了，一个穿着异常正式的昆蒂卢斯走了出来。他穿着红色长袖衬衫和长裤，这些衣服将他的身体大部分部位都遮住了，使得他看起来……有点奇怪地正式。这位前邪教成员注意到了你的目光，似乎察觉到了你的想法，于是嘟囔着走到了镜子前。 是啊，是啊。好多衣服啊，对吧？相信我，自从回家之后，我就没穿过这么多衣服了。” “回家之后？” 昆蒂卢斯点了点头，透过镜子的反光看着你，而奥格里什则把其中一条肩带搭在了自己的肩上。 你没听错。那个让奥格里斯人制作的盾牌，是我们家族从为古代军团服务的时代就开始拥有的传家之宝。那时，我的族人还大多处于被奴役的状态。我在离开那个邪教组织之前请求得到了它，因为当时我根本不知道他们到底在搞什么，以为自己可能会用到它。幸好我从来没试过，因为那东西实在太他妈重了。 盾牌真的有那么重吗？你庆幸自己只需要支付护甲的费用，而且他也确实得到了那面盾牌……但穿上所有这些装备，他真的能适应吗？ 食人魔看到了你，露出了阴险的笑容。“别担心：我不会给他穿上真正的板甲。我打算给他准备一些类似于南方腹地人们所穿的护甲。其实，这是他的主意。 你向他挑了挑眉。然而，令你感到好奇的是，奥格里什很快便指向他店里展示的一系列盔甲。在他的一个展台上，你可以看到皮革与金属的巧妙结合：一些薄薄的青铜片被固定在厚实的皮革胸甲上。昆因看了一眼，不禁露出微笑，但这个笑容很快就消失了，因为奥格里什开始在他身上那些已经系好的腰带上添加一些重物。 那边的装备确实不错，”他哼了一声，每次有重物加在身上时，他都需要花几秒钟来适应。“我有些朋友后来成了雇佣兵，他们都非常推崇这种装备。而且北方这一带的雇佣兵也都使用这种盔甲：这样的装备对我来说再合适不过了……等我再弄一些皮革和棉絮来加固它的话，就更加完美了。 当奥格里什慢慢站起来的时候，昆因却摇动着足部，皱着眉头看着那个兽人：“我的足部才不会穿什么东西呢。” 值得称赞的是，这位铁匠很快便改变了主意，而是把重物绑在了他的胫骨上。“我想，这和泰勒人对于他们足部的习惯有关吧。 昆因，你刚才是在说那面盾牌吧？” 这位前教徒站定脚步，让奥格里什安静地工作着，这次他回头看了看自己如今已被伤痕覆盖的肩膀，脸上露出了笑容。 “没错，那面盾牌属于我的家族。上面的图案是两根橄榄枝，因为我们是小贵族。我父亲在为联盟效力当兵时获得了那面盾牌，但我从来都不需要它——因为我想要用其他方式来为我们的国家做出贡献。获得这些荣誉只会束缚我。 你至少应该能理解这一点：仅仅是他参与那个邪教组织这一事实，就已经让他名声受损了；而如果有人知道他加入了像托卢斯这样的邪教组织，他的家庭也会因此遭到毁灭。你越了解这件事，就越会困惑他当初为什么会选择加入他们。不过，谈论这样重型的话题……可能并不容易吧。 我加入他们，是因为我失去了一切。” 昆因低声抱怨了几句，然后没有再继续说下去。他只是等待着你与他的目光相遇。[pc.name]…如果我不先行动后思考的话，我是不会加入他们的。在与他们共事的整个过程中，我其实并不知道他们在做什么，因为我只不过是个传声筒而已。虽然我和他们发生了关系，但……我是为数不多他们无法成功洗脑的人之一。然而，当一切开始变得糟糕时，我就是利用那个机会逃走了。你给了我第二次机会，而我至今还没有为此感谢你。 其中一根背带被拉得更紧了，奥格里什也开始添加更多的重物。看起来他正在努力达到那个装备所能承受的最大负荷范围，但泰勒的目光始终没有从你身上移开。 “当你问我是否愿意替你出面时，我就知道这是报答你的一种方式。 [quin.statueCountRange 1 |你也帮助我抓到了那些挑起这场事的人中的一个。 |不过，我仍然必须阻止那些应对此负责的人，而这意味着要与你并肩作战。 ]只要您还需要我的帮助，我就一定会报答这份恩情与信任。” 奥格里什让他坐在凳子上，然后开始轻轻移动他，测试他的活动范围。尽管体重相当沉重，但昆蒂卢斯似乎已经能够很好地适应这种移动方式了；如果这套盔甲制作得当，而且他有足够的时间进行训练，那么他的体格完全足以支撑所有这些装备，正如他所说的一样。 等他把这些事情处理完毕，就把它们拿给我。我和阿图吉娅会一起讨论这些计划……等你有几天的空闲时间，我们三个人会一起确保我的表现能达到你的标准。 [pc.isDK |点头表示同意。 |微笑着点头，还向他竖起了大拇指。 ]你做到了。” 虽然他很想这么做，但你可以看出，穿着那么多盔甲的昆因根本动弹不得，也没有办法回应这个动作。他只是向你眨了眨眼，然后静静地站在那里，等待那个男人的下一步行动。 值得称赞的是，奥格里什并没有花费太长时间就完成了所有事情：其中最耗时的环节就是为他为昆蒂卢斯量尺寸制作头盔。这位前邪教徒显然不太乐意头上戴着这么重的东西，但当你瞥了他一眼后，他立刻就会意识到：这并不是他个人可以决定的事情——这是他用来报答你的方式。这样他就能顺利完成剩下的试穿环节了……等你们俩完成试穿并与奥格瑞什道别后，就可以像之前一样回到霜犬酒馆号和昆因的摊位了。 当然，当你们走进去的时候，加斯立刻朝他投去了一个目光。 下次别把你的东西乱扔在旁边，昆蒂卢斯！你让我失去了一位顾客呢！” 那个泰勒尔嘟囔了几句，翻了个白眼，但最终还是向他挥了挥手。他拿回了自己的所有装备，而你……嗯，你就可以自由行动了。你只需要记得明天去奥格瑞什那里领取那套盔甲就行了。
rows.raw: " It takes a minute or two of waiting, but the door finally opens and an unusually over-dressed Quintillus comes out. A paired shirt and pants of red cover much of his body with their long sleeves and hems, making him look... weirdly professional. The ex-cultist sees your eyes and seems to pick-up on your opinion, stepping over to the mirror with a grumble. "Yeah, yeah. A lot of clothes, right? Trust me, I haven't put on this much since I was back at home." "Back at home?" Quintillus nods, looking at you through the reflection while Ogrish wraps one of the straps around his shoulders. "You heard me right. The shield I had Ogrish work on is one my family has had since our days serving the ancient legions, back when my people were still mostly enslaved. I asked for it before I left the cult, but that was because I had no idea what they were and thought I might need it. Thankfully I never did because that thing is fucking heavy." Is a shield really that heavy? You're glad that you're only paying for armor and that he did get the shield... but will he really be alright with all this gear? Ogrish sees you and smirks. "Don't worry: I'm not going to fit him in real plate: I plan on giving Quintillus armor that's styled like what they wear down south in the Heartlands. It was his idea, actually." You raise a brow at him. However, much to your curiosity's thanks, Ogrish quickly points to a collection of armor on display for his shop. On one of his stands, you can see the mix of leather and metal in a segmented fashion; tiny plates of bronze attached to a thick leather chestplate. Quin looks over at it and smirks, albeit only for a moment before grimacing as Ogrish sets some of the weights onto the belts currently wrapping his upper torso. "T-That stuff over there is good," he grunts, taking a few seconds to adjust each time a weight gets put on. "I had friends who became mercenaries swear by it. And the mercenaries in this part of the north wear it too: armor like that'll be perfect for me... especially once I get some extra leather and gambeson padding to go with it." As Ogrish works his way down to his feet, though, Quin sways his foot and looks at the orc with a scowl. "Not my feet. I don't wear stuff on my feet." To his credit, the blacksmith is quick to move on and instead bind the weights around his shin. "It's a thing with taeleer about their feet, I guess." "Quin, you were talking about that shield?" The ex-cultist sets his foot down and lets Ogrish work in peace, this time looking back over his now-weight-covered shoulder with a grin. "Right: it's from my family. The symbol on it is two olive branches since we're minor nobility. My father earned it back when he was a soldier for the Alliance, but I never needed it since I wanted to help our country in different ways. Recognition only hindered me." You at least can understand that part: his part in the cult alone had left a bad reputation, but it would have destroyed his family if news of him being in a cult like Tollus's got back. The more you hear about it, the more you're confused on why he joined them in the first place. But talking about something that heavy may not- "I joined them because I had lost everything." Quin grumbles and doesn't keep going. Instead, he waits until you meet his gaze. "[pc.name]... I wouldn't have joined them if I wasn't acting before thinking. And I didn't know what they were doing the entire time I worked with them because I was just a messenger. I had sex, but... I was one of the only ones who they couldn't properly brainwash. When everything started going down, though, I used that to run away. You gave me a second chance and I still haven't thanked you for that." One of the straps gets pulled tighter around his chest and Ogrish starts adding more weights. It looks like he's preparing for the uppermost range of what the fit can fit and hold, but the taeleer doesn't break his sight on you. "When you asked me if I would step in for you, I knew it was a way to repay you. [quin.statueCountRange 1 |You helped me collect one of the ones who started this, too. |I still need to stop those responsible for this, though, and that means fighting beside you. ] As long as you have the need for me, I plan to repay that mercy and trust." Ogrish sits him down on the stool and starts lightly moving him around, testing his range. Despite the large amount of weight, Quintillus seems aptly adjusting already; if the armor is properly made and he has time to train, his physique is more than enough to carry all the gear just like he said. "Once he finishes this stuff, bring it to me. Atugia and I'll start talking over the plans... and once you're free for a few days, the three of us will make sure I'm up to your standards." You [pc.isDK |nod |smile, nodding and giving him a thumbs up ]. "You got it." The ex-cultist doesn't look happy about having to wear something so heavy over his head, but a quick glance at you is enough to remind him that this isn't a choice just for him: this is his act of repaying you. That lets him power through the rest of the fitting... and as the two of you finish and part from Ogrish, you both return to the Frost Hound and Quin's booth just like before. Garth, of course, immediately shoots him a look as you enter. "Don't leave your stuff sitting around next time, Quintillus! You cost me a customer!" The taeleer grumbles and rolls his eyes, but inevitably waves back at him. He retrieves all his gear and you... well, you're free again. You just need to remember to visit Ogrish tomorrow so you can pick up the armor. "

Properly balancing yourself as best you can to avoid any mishaps if you get surprised, you slip the door just wide enough to peek inside. [var0] "Damn," Quintillus grumbles to himself. "I hate this kind of stuffy clothing. I'll have to wear heavier when I get my armor though, right?" Inside the room is a wardrobe and a few bundles of supplies, but you can't make out its exact nature in the low light. What you can see, though, is the mostly-naked figure of Quin between dressing. A nearby sword of similar make to his usual blade can be seen, but in the other corner of the room is a shield almost half the size of the taeleer. The white paint and bronze are easy to see in the darkness, accenting the sole marking of olive branches. It must be the shield Ogrish mentioned. You feel a bit jealous that Ogrish's giving your friend some space to keep things like this, but the sight of your friend's nice ass and physique definitely help make you a little happier. He's wearing a loincloth or something, but you can see his prick poking up from this angle, so he must not have it on properly. It's unusual to think the taeleer might wear underwear for someone who was in a sex cult, but it's just more proof that he's not like them, you guess. His right ear twitches as you watch, his hands working themselves into a stuffy-looking shirt and his anger from before vanishing. "Enjoying the view?" You [pc.mf |laugh |giggle ], tapping the door. "Having trouble getting it on?" "Of course not," he says, turning his head towards you but not fully turning around. He knows you're already seeing everything so it looks like any sense of hiding some of it doesn't matter to him. "It's just putting on clothes, right? What do I look like, a Mallachite? It just reminds me of being back home." He pulls the shirt on a moment later, perhaps calmed down slightly now that he's not all nerves. rows.translation: 你尽可能悄无声息地靠近那扇门。奥格里斯确实朝你的方向瞥了一眼，但除此之外，他一直在忙着整理各种物品，为后续的试穿做准备。你尽力保持身体平衡，以免受到惊吓而发生意外，然后把门打开一条小缝，往里面偷看。 [var0] 该死，”昆蒂卢斯自言自语道，“我讨厌这种闷热的衣服。不过等我穿上盔甲后，就不得不穿更厚实的衣服了，对吧？” 房间里有一件衣柜和几捆补给品，但在昏暗的光线下，你无法看清它们的具体内容。然而，你所能看到的，是昆因在更衣时的半裸身躯。在他附近，可以看到一把与他平时使用的剑款式相似的武器，而房间的另一个角落里，则放着一块面积几乎是泰勒尔剑一半的盾牌。在黑暗中，白色的油漆和青铜色非常显眼，橄榄枝的图案也因此更加突出。这肯定就是奥格里什提到的那个盾牌了。 当你注视着他时，他的右耳开始抽搐，他的双手正在将一件看起来皱巴巴的衬衫穿在身上，而他之前表现出的愤怒也早已消失了。 “欣赏这景色吗？” 你[pc.mf |笑 |轻笑 ]在穿衣服上遇到麻烦了吗？”他一边说着，一边轻敲着门。 “当然没有，”他回答道，头转向你，但并没有完全转过来。他知道你已经看到了所有的一切，所以对他来说，试图隐藏些什么似乎并没有意义。“只是穿衣服而已，对吧？我看起来像马拉克信徒吗？这让我觉得仿佛又回到了家乡。 片刻之后，他穿上了衬衫，或许因为不再那么紧张了，心情也稍微平静了一些。昆因迅速收起了自己的东西，然后拉起了裤子，确保它们被系得牢固之后，才转身走了出来。 现在穿戴整齐的他走到镜子前，奥格里什迅速让他站在了合适的位置。他看着镜中的自己，笑了起来：“回家了吗？ 昆蒂卢斯点了点头，用同样的眼神看着你，而奥格里什则把其中一条带子搭在了自己的肩上。 “你看到那面盾牌了吧？我之前就派人把它送到了这里。当然，那是在我还不了解那个邪教组织的真正目的之前……不过，把它送到附近来对大家来说都是件好事。你救我的那一刻，我就立刻派人去取来了它。不过因为那面盾牌实在太重了，我还得多付一些钱呢。 盾牌真的有那么重吗？你庆幸自己只需要支付护甲的费用，而且他也确实得到了那面盾牌……但穿上所有这些装备，他真的能适应吗？ 食人魔看到了你，露出了阴险的笑容。“别担心，我不会给他配备真正的板甲。我打算给昆蒂卢斯准备一些类似于南方腹地人们所穿的护甲。其实，这是他的主意。 你挑了挑眉看着他。然而，令你感到好奇的是，奥格里什很快便指向了他店里陈列的一套盔甲。在其中一个展示架上，你可以看到皮革与金属的巧妙结合——那些薄薄的青铜片被固定在厚实的皮革胸甲上。昆因看了一眼，不禁露出微笑，但这个笑容很快就消失了，因为奥格里什开始在那些缠绕在他上半身的腰带上添加重物。 那边的装备确实不错，”他哼了一声，每次有重物加在身上时，他都需要花几秒钟来适应。“我有些朋友后来成了雇佣兵，他们都非常推崇这种装备。而且这个北方地区的雇佣兵们也都在使用这种盔甲：这样的装备对我来说再合适不过了……尤其是等我再弄一些皮革和棉絮来加固它之后。 当奥格里斯慢慢站起身来时，昆因却摇动着足部，皱着眉头看着那个兽人：“我的足部不行。我从不穿鞋或靴子，所以别想让我这么做。” 值得称赞的是，这个铁匠很快改变了主意，而是把重物绑在了他的胫骨上。“我想，这跟泰勒尔人对待他们足部的习惯有关吧。 昆因，你刚才是在说那个盾牌吗？” 这位前邪教徒站定脚步，让奥格瑞什安静地工作着，这次他回头看了看自己如今已被伤痕覆盖的肩膀，脸上露出了笑容。 “没错，那是我家传下来的东西。上面的图案是两根橄榄枝，因为我们是小贵族。我父亲在为联盟效力当兵的时候获得了这个盾牌，但我从来都不需要它——因为我想要用其他方式来为我们的国家做出贡献。那些荣誉和认可反而会束缚我。 你至少应该能理解这一点：仅仅是他参与那个邪教组织这一事实，就已经让他名声受损了；而如果有人知道他加入了像托卢斯这样的邪教组织，他的家庭也会因此遭到毁灭。你越了解这件事，就越会困惑他当初为什么会选择加入他们。不过，谈论这样重型的话题……可能并不容易吧。 我加入他们，是因为我失去了一切。” 昆因低声抱怨了几句，然后没有再继续说下去。他只是等待着你与他的目光相遇。[pc.name]…如果我不是先行动后思考的话，我也不会加入他们。在与他们共事的整个过程中，我其实并不知道他们在做什么，因为我只不过是个传声筒而已。虽然我和他们发生了关系，但……我是为数不多的几个他们无法成功洗脑的人之一。然而，当一切开始变得糟糕时，我正是利用那个机会逃走了。你给了我第二次机会，而我至今仍未为此向你道谢。 其中一根背带被拉得更紧了，奥格里什也开始添加更多的重物。看起来他正在努力达到那个装备所能承受的最大负荷范围，但泰勒的目光始终没有从你身上移开。 “当你问我是否愿意替你出面时，我就知道这是报答你的一种方式。 [quin.statueCountRange 1 |你也帮助我抓到了那些挑起这场事的人中的一个。 |不过，我仍然必须阻止那些应对此负责的人，而这意味着要与你并肩作战。 ]只要你们还需要我，我就一定会报答这份恩情与信任。” 奥格里什让他坐在凳子上，然后开始轻轻移动他，测试他的活动范围。尽管体重相当沉重，但昆蒂卢斯似乎已经能够很好地适应这种移动；如果这套盔甲制作得当，而且他有足够的时间进行训练，那么他的体格完全足以支撑所有这些装备，正如他所说的一样。 等他把这些事情处理完毕，就把它们拿给我。我和阿图吉娅会一起讨论这些计划……等你有几天的空闲时间，我们三个人会确保我达到你的要求。 [pc.isDK |点头 |微笑着点头，还向他竖起了大拇指。 ]你做到了。” 虽然他很想这么做，但你可以看出，穿着这么多盔甲的昆因根本动弹不得，也没有办法回应这个动作。他只是向你眨了眨眼，然后继续站在那里等待那个男人。 值得称赞的是，奥格里什并没有花费太长时间就完成了所有事情：其中最耗时的环节就是为他测量头围以制作头盔。这位前邪教徒显然不太乐意头上戴着这么重的东西，但当你瞥了他一眼后，他立刻就会意识到：这并不是他个人可以决定的事——这是他为了感谢你救了他而必须做的事情。这样他就能顺利完成剩下的试穿环节了……等你们俩完成试穿并离开奥格瑞什后，就可以像之前一样回到霜犬酒馆号和昆因的摊位了。 当然，当你们进去的时候，加斯立刻朝他投去了一个目光。 下次别把你的东西乱扔在旁边，昆蒂卢斯！你让我失去了一位顾客呢！” 那个泰勒尔嘟囔了几句，翻了个白眼，但最终还是向他挥了挥手。他拿回了自己的所有装备，而你……嗯，你就可以继续自由行动了。你只需要记得明天去奥格瑞什，这样才能取到那套盔甲。
rows.raw: " You approach the door as quietly as you can. Ogrish does cast a look your way but otherwise is busy gathering everything and arranging it so he can do the fitting properly. Properly balancing yourself as best you can to avoid any mishaps if you get surprised, you slip the door just wide enough to peek inside. [var0] "Damn," Quintillus grumbles to himself. "I hate this kind of stuffy clothing. I'll have to wear heavier when I get my armor though, right?" Inside the room is a wardrobe and a few bundles of supplies, but you can't make out its exact nature in the low light. What you can see, though, is the mostly-naked figure of Quin between dressing. A nearby sword of similar make to his usual blade can be seen, but in the other corner of the room is a shield almost half the size of the taeleer. The white paint and bronze are easy to see in the darkness, accenting the sole marking of olive branches. It must be the shield Ogrish mentioned. You feel a bit jealous that Ogrish's giving your friend some space to keep things like this, but the sight of your friend's nice ass and physique definitely help make you a little happier. He's wearing a loincloth or something, but you can see his prick poking up from this angle, so he must not have it on properly. It's unusual to think the taeleer might wear underwear for someone who was in a sex cult, but it's just more proof that he's not like them, you guess. His right ear twitches as you watch, his hands working themselves into a stuffy-looking shirt and his anger from before vanishing. "Enjoying the view?" You [pc.mf |laugh |giggle ], tapping the door. "Having trouble getting it on?" "Of course not," he says, turning his head towards you but not fully turning around. He knows you're already seeing everything so it looks like any sense of hiding some of it doesn't matter to him. "It's just putting on clothes, right? What do I look like, a Mallachite? It just reminds me of being back home." He pulls the shirt on a moment later, perhaps calmed down slightly now that he's not all nerves. Quin quickly puts his prick away next, tugging the pair of pants up and ensuring they're properly strapped into place before turning and coming out. Now dressed, he makes his way over to the mirror and Ogrish quickly gets him to stand right where he needs. You look at him in the reflection and smile. "Back home?" Quintillus nods, looking at you the same way while Ogrish wraps one of the straps around his shoulders. "You saw the shield, didn't you? I sent a message back home a while back to have it sent here. Of course, that was back before I knew what the cult really was... but it worked out for everyone that I had it sent nearby. The moment you rescued me I had a messenger run and retrieve it. Had to pay extra, too, since it's so damn heavy." Is a shield really that heavy? You're glad that you're only paying for armor and that he did get the shield... but will he really be alright with all this gear? Ogrish sees you and smirks. "Don't worry: I'm not going to fit him in real plate: I plan on giving Quintillus armor that's styled like what they wear down south in the Heartlands. It was his idea, actually." You raise a brow at him. However, much to your curiosity's thanks, Ogrish quickly points to a collection of armor on display for his shop. On one of his stands, you can see the mix of leather and metal in a segmented fashion; tiny plates of bronze attached to a thick leather chestplate. Quin looks over at it and smirks, albeit only for a moment before grimacing as Ogrish sets some of the weights onto the belts currently wrapping his upper torso. "T-That stuff over there is good," he grunts, taking a few seconds to adjust each time a weight gets put on. "I had friends who became mercenaries swear by it. And the mercenaries in this part of the north wear it too: armor like that'll be perfect for me... especially once I get some extra leather and gambeson padding to go with it." As Ogrish works his way down to his feet, though, Quin sways his foot and looks at the orc with a scowl. "Not my feet. I don't wear shoes or boots, so don't even think about." To his credit, the blacksmith is quick to move on and instead bind the weights around his shin. "It's a thing with taeleer about their feet, I guess." "Quin, you were talking about that shield?" The ex-cultist sets his foot down and lets Ogrish work in peace, this time looking back over his now-weight-covered shoulder with a grin. "Right: it's from my family. The symbol on it is two olive branches since we're minor nobility. My father earned it back when he was a soldier for the Alliance, but I never needed it since I wanted to help our country in different ways. Recognition only hindered me." You at least can understand that part: his part in the cult alone had left a bad reputation, but it would have destroyed his family if news of him being in a cult like Tollus's got back. The more you hear about it, the more you're confused on why he joined them in the first place. But talking about something that heavy may not- "I joined them because I had lost everything." Quin grumbles and doesn't keep going. Instead, he waits until you meet his gaze. "[pc.name]... I wouldn't have joined them if I wasn't acting before thinking. And I didn't know what they were doing the entire time I worked with them because I was just a messenger. I had sex, but... I was one of the only ones who they couldn't properly brainwash. When everything started going down, though, I used that to run away. You gave me a second chance and I still haven't thanked you for that." One of the straps gets pulled tighter around his chest and Ogrish starts adding more weights. It looks like he's preparing for the uppermost range of what the fit can fit and hold, but the taeleer doesn't break his sight on you. "When you asked me if I would step in for you, I knew it was a way to repay you. [quin.statueCountRange 1 |You helped me collect one of the ones who started this, too. |I still need to stop those responsible for this, though, and that means fighting beside you. ] As long as you have the need for me, I plan to repay that mercy and trust." Ogrish sits him down on the stool and starts lightly moving him around, testing his range. Despite the large amount of weight, Quintillus seems aptly adjusting already; if the armor is properly made and he has time to train, his physique is more than enough to carry all the gear just like he said. "Once he finishes this stuff, bring it to me. Atugia and I'll start talking over the plans... and once you're free for a few days, the three of us will make sure I'm up to your standards." You [pc.isDK |nod |smile, nodding and giving him a thumbs up ]. "You got it." Although he wants to, you can see that Quin isn't going anywhere with all the armor nor does he have the freedom to return the gesture. Instead, he just winks back at you and stays still for the man. Much to his credit, it doesn't take Ogrish much longer to get everything done: the longest part of the fitting is when he starts trying to measure Quintillus for a helmet. The ex-cultist doesn't look happy about having to wear something so heavy over his head, but a quick glance at you is enough to remind him that this isn't a choice just for him: this is his act of repaying you for saving him. That lets him power through the rest of the fitting... and as the two of you finish and part from Ogrish, you both return to the Frost Hound and Quin's booth just like before. Garth, of course, immediately shoots him a look as you enter. "Don't leave your stuff sitting around next time, Quintillus! You cost me a customer!" The taeleer grumbles and rolls his eyes, but inevitably waves back at him. He retrieves all his gear and you... well, you're free again. You just need to remember to visit Ogrish tomorrow so you can pick up the armor. "

rows.original:
"Actually, I came to get the armor for Quin."
    
    [party.has quin
        |The taeleer chuckles behind you but Ogrish doesn't look over at him; instead, t
        |Ogrish gives a small nod. "You got it."
        
        T
    ]he orcish man moves over to the closet Quin changed in. You see the glint of bronze from within as the lights of his smithy reach inside, yet it's nothing already on display that he prepares. Instead, he grabs a carefully-wrapped and already-prepared bundle of equipment over to you, rattling with every step.
    
    He sets it down on the counter of his smithy and smirks.
    
    "It turned out well," he says, sliding it over to you. "You two should be happy with how it performs. I think the color will be good, too... but try to keep it a surprise for him, won't you?"
    
    "No promises," you smile back, hoisting it off the counter. "But I'll see what I can do.[pc.isDK
        |
        | Thank you, Ogrish.
    ]"
    
    Quin will have to eventually wear it once he starts training, but you're sure he won't get to see the whole thing any sooner than you and Atugia do. You shift all the gear into your bag and give Ogrish a wave farewell, heading back out to the street and letting him get back to his work.

    [party.has quin

    “不敢保证。”你笑着回答，将它从柜台上提起，“不过我会尽量。[pc.isDK

rows.raw: "\n You feel the weight of his armor bundle still in your pack. Quintillus and Atugia will have to train for a few days to make sure he can properly fight with this new armor and you can tell you'll be drawn up into the whole thing. It will take a few days to finish his training once it starts. Are you sure you want to give it to him?"

rows.original: "I think it's time for that training." You set your things down and pull his bundled gear out, setting it on the table of his booth. Quintillus sets his mug and book down, smiling and reaching over to set one hand on the piled up armor and garb. "Jeez, he really did get me a lot. But if you're carrying it around, it must be properly weighted. If that's the case, I got a lot of training ahead of me, huh?" Atugia moves to the side of the booth and quickly grabs one of the straps keeping it all bound together, hoisting it up and over her shoulder. The girl is wearing less armor than usual: in fact, she's wearing nothing more than her chest bindings and a pair of shorts. She punches Quin in the shoulder, making him half fall-over into the seat before she looks between the two of you. "Well then, what are we waitin' for? We gotta get him used to this stuff, right?" You nod and watch her take the lead, waiting for the taeleer to get up with all his things and follow. The short walk to the gym, though, does earn a bit of curious looks; others in the tavern and on the road are watching you most of the way there, particularly the fact the three of you have such varying attire. But once you enter the gym, a lot of those eyes are off you and Atugia finally has the chance to turn around again. She drops the bundle beside her and grabs Quin by the collar of his robes. [atugia.isBimbo |"Alright hottie," she giggles |"First off," she speaks flatly ]. "The only rules durin' the training are to not use magic. You can use it once you're comfortable with the armor on, but until then you need to get the hang of all the balancing issues. So startin' now, take this off and get ready. It's gonna get really rough." Quintillus smiles and shrugs, waiting for her to let go before he starts removing his gear. It's only a matter of moments before he's left standing in just his shorts and shirt, but when he kneels down, she quickly pushes him over towards the nearby racks. "Not so fast! You gotta start working out first before you put that on!" He looks back over his shoulder. "Huh? But I'm already strong enough to-" "To wear it," she sighs, rolling her eyes. "But you're not just wearin' it: you're gonna fight with it. So the first day is gettin' you used to the most important part: movin' with weight. Find the biggest weight you can: [pc.name] and I are gonna be chasin' you around startin' now." That part makes you both blink. Of course, Atugia is quick to send him off to the weights to find adequate ones before she looks at you with a grin. "Alright... hope you're ready to get this softie all ready to be in the front. He's got the right build for it, but we need to make him realize just how desperate it can get. So-" She stops just for a moment, hustling over to one of the gym's walls and grabbing one of two sticks. She tosses it to you [pc.isAgile |and you catch it |but you aren't quick enough to catch it ]. "Remember: don't hit him too hard. Just hard enough so he remembers not to make the same mistake twice." [pc.isDK |Your sadistic side grins at that idea. ]This is going to be fun in its own way, too.
rows.translation: 我觉得是时候进行那次训练了。” 你放下自己的东西，把他收拾好的装备取出来，放在他的展位桌上。昆蒂卢斯也放下自己的杯子和书，微笑着伸手，将一只手放在那堆盔甲和服装上。 天啊，他确实给了我很多东西。不过，如果要背着这些东西到处走，它们的重量必须得到合理的分配。这样的话，我看来还有不少训练要做了，嗯？” 阿图吉娅走到展台旁边，迅速抓起了固定所有物品的带子，将它们挂在肩上。这个女孩穿的护甲比平时少了很多：实际上，她身上只穿着胸前的护具和一条短裤。她一拳打在昆因的肩膀上，让他差点摔倒在座位上，然后她将目光转向你们两个人。 那我们还等什么？我们得让他习惯这些东西，对吧？” 你点了点头，看着她带头走，等待着那个名叫泰勒族的人收拾好他的东西跟上来。 不过，这段短途的路程确实引来了不少好奇的目光；在酒馆里和路上的其他人，大部分时间都在注视着你们，尤其是注意到你们三个人的穿着如此迥异。但一旦你走进健身房，那些目光就会从你身上移开，这时阿图吉娅终于又有了转身继续前进的机会。她把包裹扔在旁边，然后抓住昆因长袍的领子。 [atugia.isBimbo |好吧，辣妹，”她咯咯笑着说。 |首先，”她平静地说道。 ]在训练期间，唯一的规则就是不能使用魔法。等到你熟悉这套盔甲之后，就可以使用魔法了，但在那之前，你必须先掌握所有的平衡技巧。所以，现在就开始吧，把这套盔甲脱下来，准备好迎接接下来的挑战吧。真的有点粗糙。” 昆蒂卢斯微笑着耸了耸肩，等着她松开手，然后才开始脱掉装备。不一会儿，他就只穿着短裤和衬衫站在那里了。但当他跪下来的时候，她迅速把他推到了附近的架子旁边。 别急！你得先开始锻炼身体，才能穿那东西！” 他回头看了一眼：“哈？但我已经强壮到可以……” “可以穿它了，”她叹了口气，翻了个白眼。但你不仅仅是要戴上它，还要用它来战斗。所以第一天的训练就是让你熟悉最重要的部分——如何带着重量进行移动。找你能找到的最重的重量来练习吧： [pc.name]从现在开始，我就要追着你跑了。” 这句话让你们俩都愣住了。当然，阿图吉娅很快就让他去拿合适的重量器材，然后她才笑着看着你。 好吧……希望你们已经准备好让这个家伙站到最前面了。他的体格确实适合这个角色，但我们得让他明白情况到底有多紧急。所以——” 她停了一下，快步走到健身房的墙壁旁，拿起了两根棍子中的一根。她把它扔给了你。 [pc.isAgile |然后你就抓到了它 |但是你的反应速度不够快，无法抓住它。 ]记住：不要打得太重。只要让他知道不能犯同样的错误就行了。 [pc.isDK |你那施虐倾向的那一面，看到这个想法时会露出笑容来。 ]这种方式也会带来不少乐趣的。
rows.raw: " "I think it's time for that training." You set your things down and pull his bundled gear out, setting it on the table of his booth. Quintillus sets his mug and book down, smiling and reaching over to set one hand on the piled up armor and garb. "Jeez, he really did get me a lot. But if you're carrying it around, it must be properly weighted. If that's the case, I got a lot of training ahead of me, huh?" Atugia moves to the side of the booth and quickly grabs one of the straps keeping it all bound together, hoisting it up and over her shoulder. The girl is wearing less armor than usual: in fact, she's wearing nothing more than her chest bindings and a pair of shorts. She punches Quin in the shoulder, making him half fall-over into the seat before she looks between the two of you. "Well then, what are we waitin' for? We gotta get him used to this stuff, right?" You nod and watch her take the lead, waiting for the taeleer to get up with all his things and follow. The short walk to the gym, though, does earn a bit of curious looks; others in the tavern and on the road are watching you most of the way there, particularly the fact the three of you have such varying attire. But once you enter the gym, a lot of those eyes are off you and Atugia finally has the chance to turn around again. She drops the bundle beside her and grabs Quin by the collar of his robes. [atugia.isBimbo |"Alright hottie," she giggles |"First off," she speaks flatly ]. "The only rules durin' the training are to not use magic. You can use it once you're comfortable with the armor on, but until then you need to get the hang of all the balancing issues. So startin' now, take this off and get ready. It's gonna get really rough." Quintillus smiles and shrugs, waiting for her to let go before he starts removing his gear. It's only a matter of moments before he's left standing in just his shorts and shirt, but when he kneels down, she quickly pushes him over towards the nearby racks. "Not so fast! You gotta start working out first before you put that on!" He looks back over his shoulder. "Huh? But I'm already strong enough to-" "To wear it," she sighs, rolling her eyes. "But you're not just wearin' it: you're gonna fight with it. So the first day is gettin' you used to the most important part: movin' with weight. Find the biggest weight you can: [pc.name] and I are gonna be chasin' you around startin' now." That part makes you both blink. Of course, Atugia is quick to send him off to the weights to find adequate ones before she looks at you with a grin. "Alright... hope you're ready to get this softie all ready to be in the front. He's got the right build for it, but we need to make him realize just how desperate it can get. So-" She stops just for a moment, hustling over to one of the gym's walls and grabbing one of two sticks. She tosses it to you [pc.isAgile |and you catch it |but you aren't quick enough to catch it ]. "Remember: don't hit him too hard. Just hard enough so he remembers not to make the same mistake twice." [pc.isDK |Your sadistic side grins at that idea. ]This is going to be fun in its own way, too."

rows.original: "Ow! Ow! ATUGIA, STOP-OW!" Quintillus runs around the track, sweat beading the man's brow. He ducks and jumps when Atugia swings her branch at him, but he can't outrun her with the awkwardness of all the weight. You follow along but mostly just let Atugia chase him; your part is more to set traps when he completes a lap to give him another good smack. Most of the day has been like this: he runs, she chases, and you both give him smacks whenever he isn't paying attention. Compared to the first hour of it, though, Quin has vastly improved; he's already starting to duck and dodge around Atugia without breaking much of his stride despite the weights in his hands and over his shoulders. He's even been allowed to put on some of the armor: a gambeson and leather coat. Even without the plated sectioned vest, it's easily thick enough to be on par with some of the best armor around. Padded jackets would also normally help pad the strike of a branch, but the gambeson's sleeves and pantlegs are pulled up so she can still smack at his furred forearms and ankles. All the red on his new outfit looks nice with the black coat, it's kept him exhausting himself faster in the sun. Layering the attire in this way tests his endurance further, ultimately aiding in the goal of training him to be comfortable and adapt to the weight. It also means that when she gives him breaks, he immediately drops his gear and hits the deck. She keeps pushing him as long as possible so that the gaps in his new gear are minimal. Speaking of which: Quintillus rounds the bend and you swat at his head, the taeleer ducking beneath it and even slinking his ears backwards to ensure you didn't even connect at all. Atugia laughs and smacks his rear at that exact moment though, sending him tumbling down past the two of you and taking a slow stride herself over to his side. "That's more like it," she laughs. She swats him one more time on the butt, trotting back over to you. "So: think he's earned his break?" "Well-" "Fuck, I definitely earned one!" Quintillus pushes himself back onto his hands and knees, then plops backwards. He's still catching his breath but looks at the two of you like you're brigands. "Not another inch! I've run enough! I get it! I can move with this stuff on! So let me finally put on the rest of my gear and show it!" Atugia frowns and rests both hands on the top of her stick like it was a sword, thinking but ultimately sighing and turning that frown upside down into the smallest of grin. "Alright. I agree. You did pretty good over the last hour, too: you only got hit ten or so times, so you gotta be around the right point to put it on." "Thank you!" He sighs in relief, finally getting up and moving back into the main part of the gym. Atugia watches him go but you don't say a word until he's safely out of ear shot. "Atugia, you... you're not trying to break him, are you?" She scoffs, but looks at you with that same grin. "Only a little. But that's how the best trainin' sessions go. You may not realize it, but the size of the shield he mentioned he'll be carryin' around is considered a great shield. Somethin' that large means he won't be able to strike with his sword very often... but when he does, he has to be quick. This trainin' isn't just to make his reflexes sharp for defense: if he can move fast while in danger, he'll be able to have more time to attack when it matters." It sounds like she really thought this out and planned it from top to bottom. Whether or not they'd had this talk before you started preparing this armor or not may not be clear, but Quintillus did have that shield sitting around getting repaired before all of this. If he had been preparing to use it, it's likely that he wanted to do so as a surprise... but that much weight could've been disastrous so Atugia most likely stopped him from getting in over his head. Of course, he's also pretty nimble, so it may have just been the two talking about fighting styles that's led him to think it better to keep to his usual skillset. Quintillus emerges from the gym's inside at last, the full arrangement of bronze and leather in place for the first time; a pair of large pauldrons, bronze-studded gauntlets, greaves and kneeguards that'd make any warrior jealous, and the familiar segmented armor Ogrish showed you before overtop it all. Sections of metal had even been strapped to his coat, further amplifying just how much protection he had. If not for his bare feet, he'd be almost impossible to harm. He carried the shield by a strap over his shoulder in one hand, but a helmet in the other. He swings the shield around and sets it down, holding it with a single hand before he lifts his helmet and puts it on; both of his ears poke free with only a single wiggle of the thing atop his head, the open-faced bronze metal opening just enough to let him see and speak. And the grin on his face is bigger than ever. "Well? How do I look?"
rows.translation: 哎哟！哎哟！阿图吉娅，停下来——哎哟！昆蒂卢斯在跑道上奔跑，额头上冒出了汗珠。当阿图吉娅用她的树枝朝他挥来时，他连忙躲闪、跳跃，但由于身上负着重物，他根本无法摆脱她的追击。你跟在后面，但大部分时间只是让阿图吉娅去追他；你的任务主要是在他跑完一圈后设下陷阱，好让他再次受到痛击。 一天中的大部分时间都是这样：他跑，她追，每当他分心不注意的时候，你们就会一起拍打他。不过，与刚开始的那一小时相比，昆因已经进步了很多；他已经开始在阿图吉娅的追赶下灵活地躲闪避让，尽管手上和肩上还背着那些重物，但他的步伐依然没有受到太大影响。他甚至被允许穿上一些护甲：一件 gambeson 和一件皮外套。即使没有那层镀铁的护甲，这些装备也已经足够厚实，足以与一些最精良的护甲相媲美。通常来说，加垫的夹克也能有效减轻树枝击打带来的冲击力，但这次 gambeson 的袖子和裤腿都被拉上了，因此她仍然可以击中他那长满毛发的前臂和脚踝。 他新穿的那套服装中的红色元素与黑色外套搭配得非常好看，不过在阳光下，这种穿着方式会让他更快地感到疲劳。通过这种多层次的着装方式，进一步考验了他的耐力，而这一切最终都是为了帮助他适应这种负重训练，让他能够逐渐习惯并适应这种训练强度。这也意味着，每当她让他休息时，他都会立刻卸下装备，躺到地上休息。她会尽可能地让他持续训练，这样他新装备上出现的磨损情况就能降到最低。 说到这个：当昆蒂卢斯转过弯来时，你试图击中他的头部，但那只泰勒尔兽却迅速低下头，甚至把耳朵向后缩，确保你根本打不到它。然而就在这时，阿图吉娅突然笑了起来，一巴掌拍在了它的屁股上，导致它翻滚着从你们身边滚了过去，而阿图吉娅自己则慢悠悠地走到了它的旁边。 这样才对嘛，”她笑着说。 她又轻轻拍了他一下屁股，然后快步走回来，站在你身边。 “那么，你觉得他应该得到这个机会了吧？” “嗯……” “该死，我当然真是受够了！” 昆蒂卢斯用双手和膝盖支撑身体，然后重重地坐了下来。他还在喘着气，但看着你们两个的眼神，简直就像在看着两个强盗。 “再让我动半寸都不行！我已经跑够了！我明白了！穿上这些装备后，我确实能够移动了！所以请让我终于把剩下的装备都穿上，让你们看看吧！ 阿图吉娅皱了皱眉头，将双手放在她那根被当作剑使用的棍子上，似乎在思考着什么，但最终还是叹了口气，将那皱眉的表情转变成了一个微小的微笑。 “好吧，我同意。你在过去的一个小时里表现得也相当不错：你只被击中了大概十次左右，所以你的实力应该已经达到了可以使用它的程度。 谢谢！”他如释重负地叹了口气，终于站起身，走回了健身房的主体区域。阿图吉娅注视着他离开，但直到他完全消失在视线之外，她才开口说道： “阿图吉娅，你……你并不是想伤害他吧？ 她嗤之以鼻，但看着你的时候，脸上依然挂着同样的笑容。 “只是有点而已。但最好的训练就是这样的。你可能没有意识到，但他说的那种尺寸的盾牌，已经算是非常出色的盾牌了。这么庞大的体型意味着他无法频繁地使用剑进行攻击……但每当他决定出手时，就必须动作迅速。这种训练不仅仅是为了提升他的防御反应速度：如果他在危险时刻能够迅速移动，那么在关键时刻，他就会有更多的时间来发动攻击。" 听起来她确实是经过深思熟虑，从始至终都做了周全的计划。在你开始制作这件盔甲之前，他们是否已经讨论过这个问题，现在可能已经不清楚了，但昆蒂卢斯 确实在这之前，他一直把那面盾牌拿去修理。如果他本来打算使用它的话，很可能是想作为一个惊喜来使用……但那么重的盾牌使用起来肯定会很危险，所以阿图吉娅很可能阻止了他继续使用它，以免他陷入麻烦。 当然，他也相当灵活，所以可能只是因为他们讨论了战斗技巧，才让他觉得继续使用自己惯用的技能组合会更好。 昆蒂卢斯终于从健身房的内部走了出来，此时青铜与皮革制成的装备已经全部准备就绪：一对巨大的护肩、镶满青铜钉的护手、护腿以及护膝，任何战士看到都会感到嫉妒；而在这些装备的外面，还穿着奥格里什之前给你展示过的那种熟悉的分段式盔甲。他的外套上甚至绑着一些金属片，这些装置进一步增强了他的防护能力。要不是他赤脚，几乎不可能有人能够伤害到他。他一只手将盾牌挂在肩上，另一只手则拿着头盔。 他挥动盾牌，将其放下，用一只手握住它，然后摘下头盔戴上；他头顶上的头盔只需轻轻一动，他的两只耳朵就能露出来，那面开口的青铜金属结构刚好能让他的眼睛看见东西，也能让他说话。 他脸上的笑容比以往任何时候都要灿烂。 “怎么样？我看起来怎么样？
