rows.original: Atugia yells, crashing her spectral axe against Quintillus' shield. The impact makes him slip across the graveled ground, but his bare feet aren't any more hurt or damaged; true to his word, the tough soles the taeleer has from his sheer amount of running are as resilient as any pair of boot treads. You're behind Quin, ready to catch him just in case Atugia hits hard enough to topple him again, but thankfully she hasn't done so today. Yesterday had been spent focusing on adapting him to the weight of the armor... but now she's giving him a crash course in actually wielding a shield this big. So far he isn't doing that great, but the taeleer man has held his ground against the smaller human. The baroness's runic knight shows calculation in every single one of her attempts to break his defense; whenever Quin starts picking up the pace or properly deflecting her blows, she presses her attack with a strike either too fast or stronger than he expects, and sets him back to where he was seconds prior. Right now, the training is showing that Quin's lack of magic means he is very normal in terms of physique... but his runner's stamina gives him the ability to endure this storm better than most. Perhaps Atugia sees just how potent this potential to weather attacks can be, and wants him to see just how much he can accomplish without magic being his sole crux... or maybe she simply enjoys getting to pummel him. Either way, the amount he learns every few combination strikes makes the movement of the shield more effective. "Ragh!" Atugia's axe shifts into her normal halberd, arcing in a magnificent overhead strike. Quintillus grits his teeth and raises his shield, the metal-and-wood shield blocking the massive swing. Despite how many blows it's taken, his family's shield isn't breaking: the ex-cultist's bulwark is sturdy enough to not even buckle under Atugia's assault, but his own ability behind it falters at last as he finally collapses to one knee. Atugia pants, letting her weapon flicker away before walking over and offering him her free hand with a smile. The shield clunks down onto the ground as he lets his arm go limp, reaching up with exhaustion clear on his face. "Still... not enough?" "It is," she answers, patting his shoulder and letting him lean over. You slip around the side and she shifts her grin towards you. "He's definitely got it down now, and all it took was two days! But I have to admit, his potential for this is makin' it obvious he'll need his magic. It feels satisfyin' beatin' on that shield, though!" "Yeah," he groans. "Definitely... something. You looked... far happier in this training... than yesterday." "Atugia did say the plan was to break you." Quin quickly looks at you in disbelief, but the dullahan pats him on the back with a [atugia.isBimbo |giggle |chuckle ]. "Aw, don't make that face! It was a joke! Besides, you passed my test! You're in shape and can use the armor and shield all together properly... so startin' tomorrow, we'll polish this little gem we got into a real diamond!" The ex-cultist looks at her distrustfully, but that quickly melts away beneath her non-stop grinning and he sighs in defeat. "Okay, and how do we do that?' "Startin' tomorrow, you're gonna use magic!"
rows.translation: 阿图吉娅大喊着，将她那把幽灵之斧猛烈地砸在昆蒂卢斯的盾牌上。这一击使他滑倒在碎石铺就的地面上，但他的赤脚并没有受到任何伤害；正如他所说，由于长期奔跑，泰勒族人脚底的皮肤已经变得异常坚韧，其弹性丝毫不亚于任何一双靴子的鞋底。你紧跟在昆因身后，随时准备抓住他，以防阿图吉娅再次使出强力攻击将他击倒——不过幸运的是，今天她并没有这么做。昨天你一直在帮助昆因适应这套盔甲的重量……而现在，你正在教他如何正确使用这么大的盾牌。 到目前为止，他的表现并不是很理想，但那个身材矮小的人类依然顽强地抵抗着他的攻击。女男爵的符文骑士在每一次试图突破他的防御时都表现得十分谨慎；每当昆因开始加快攻击速度或成功挡住她的攻击时，她就会发动速度更快、力量更大的攻击，让他再次回到最初的位置。 目前的训练结果显示，由于昆因没有魔法能力，他的体格其实非常普通……但他的耐力使他能够比大多数人更好地抵御这场风暴。或许阿图吉娅看中了这种抵御攻击的潜力，因此希望他能看到：即使没有魔法作为唯一的依靠，他依然能够取得巨大的成就。……或者，也许她只是单纯地喜欢痛击他。无论如何，每次尝试新的组合招式后，他所学到的东西都能让盾牌的运用更加得心应手。 "拉格阿图吉娅的斧头瞬间变回了她常用的长柄斧，然后她高高举臂，使斧头划出一道壮丽的弧线，朝下方猛力挥下。 昆蒂卢斯咬紧牙关，举起了他的盾牌——那面由金属和木材制成的盾牌成功挡住了这一猛烈的攻击。尽管已经承受了多次撞击，他家族世代传下来的盾牌依然坚不可摧：这位前邪教徒制造的盾牌足够坚固，甚至没有在阿图吉娅的攻击下出现丝毫裂痕。然而，站在盾牌后面的昆蒂卢斯自己，却终于支撑不住了，他跪倒在了地上。 阿图吉娅穿上了那条裤子，让她的武器在走过去之前微微一闪，然后微笑着向他伸出了援手。 盾牌重重地落在地上，他的手臂也无力地垂了下去，脸上明显写满了疲惫。“还是……还不够吗？ 是的，”她回答道，轻拍着他的肩膀，让他靠过来。你从旁边绕过去，她便把笑容转向了你。 “他现在确实已经掌握了这个技能，而且只用了两天时间！不过我必须承认，他在这个方面的潜力确实表明，他将来肯定需要运用魔法。不过，击打那个盾牌的感觉还是让人感到很满足的！ 是啊，”他呻吟道，“肯定是有什么原因……你参加这次训练的时候，看起来比昨天开心多了。” “阿图吉娅确实说过，这个计划的目的就是让你崩溃。” 昆因难以置信地迅速看了你一眼，但无头骑士却拍了拍他的背，[atugia.isBimbo |咯咯笑着 |轻笑着 ]说道：“哎呀，别这么生气嘛！只是开个玩笑而已！而且你已经通过了我的测试——你的身体状况很好，完全能够正确使用那些盔甲和盾牌……所以从明天开始，我们就把这块‘小宝石’打磨成真正的‘钻石’吧！那位曾经加入邪教的人不信任地看着她，但在她不停的微笑之下，这种不信任很快消失了，他最终无奈地叹了口气。 “好吧，那我们该怎么做呢？从明天开始，你们就要使用魔法了！
rows.raw: " Atugia yells, crashing her spectral axe against Quintillus' shield. The impact makes him slip across the graveled ground, but his bare feet aren't any more hurt or damaged; true to his word, the tough soles the taeleer has from his sheer amount of running are as resilient as any pair of boot treads. You're behind Quin, ready to catch him just in case Atugia hits hard enough to topple him again, but thankfully she hasn't done so today. Yesterday had been spent focusing on adapting him to the weight of the armor... but now she's giving him a crash course in actually wielding a shield this big. So far he isn't doing that great, but the taeleer man has held his ground against the smaller human. The baroness's runic knight shows calculation in every single one of her attempts to break his defense; whenever Quin starts picking up the pace or properly deflecting her blows, she presses her attack with a strike either too fast or stronger than he expects, and sets him back to where he was seconds prior. Right now, the training is showing that Quin's lack of magic means he is very normal in terms of physique... but his runner's stamina gives him the ability to endure this storm better than most. Perhaps Atugia sees just how potent this potential to weather attacks can be, and wants him to see just how much he can accomplish without magic being his sole crux... or maybe she simply enjoys getting to pummel him. Either way, the amount he learns every few combination strikes makes the movement of the shield more effective. "Ragh!" Atugia's axe shifts into her normal halberd, arcing in a magnificent overhead strike. Quintillus grits his teeth and raises his shield, the metal-and-wood shield blocking the massive swing. Despite how many blows it's taken, his family's shield isn't breaking: the ex-cultist's bulwark is sturdy enough to not even buckle under Atugia's assault, but his own ability behind it falters at last as he finally collapses to one knee. Atugia pants, letting her weapon flicker away before walking over and offering him her free hand with a smile. The shield clunks down onto the ground as he lets his arm go limp, reaching up with exhaustion clear on his face. "Still... not enough?" "It is," she answers, patting his shoulder and letting him lean over. You slip around the side and she shifts her grin towards you. "He's definitely got it down now, and all it took was two days! But I have to admit, his potential for this is makin' it obvious he'll need his magic. It feels satisfyin' beatin' on that shield, though!" "Yeah," he groans. "Definitely... something. You looked... far happier in this training... than yesterday." "Atugia did say the plan was to break you." Quin quickly looks at you in disbelief, but the dullahan pats him on the back with a [atugia.isBimbo |giggle |chuckle ]. "Aw, don't make that face! It was a joke! Besides, you passed my test! You're in shape and can use the armor and shield all together properly... so startin' tomorrow, we'll polish this little gem we got into a real diamond!" The ex-cultist looks at her distrustfully, but that quickly melts away beneath her non-stop grinning and he sighs in defeat. "Okay, and how do we do that?' "Startin' tomorrow, you're gonna use magic!""

rows.original: "He's not runnin' late, is he?" Atugia and you sit on one of the benches of the gym, waiting and watching the doorway for Quin. He's running a few minutes late already, not to mention neither of you had seen him after you got up. It's worrying that he's taking so long to get here. What if he's bailing? "Maybe he's still sore from yesterday's training. You did go at him a lot with that shield. Cait saw him and even she was worried despite healing him. [flags.RUNE_MET |Rune |Some catgirl ] was even giving him a massage later, but he was so exhausted he didn't even seem to notice." Atugia frowns; she isn't worried about his sex life, of course, but the fact that so many people noticed Quintillus is suffering from just two days of training. It implies she may have exceeded his limits as his trainer. "Perhaps I did take it a little hard, but-" "I'm here!" [var0] Quintillus calls out seconds before he passes through the doorway in his full gear. Unlike yesterday, though, he's carrying the shield almost effortlessly, and on his hip is the familiar sight of his sword. The two of you get up and Quin turns to face you, quickly raising his free hand to stop both of you there. "Hold on," he chuckles. "I want you guys to see what I can do! I spent all morning trying to figure it out and I just got the magic working properly!" "Magic?" You're curious now. "What'd you-" In a flash of brilliant pink light, Quin's ears and eyes ignite with the glow of a spell you've seen him use before: Firewalk. But something is different. Unlike the usual uses of Firewalk, his fur on his legs and arms aren't visibly glowing but right now you can't see any of it, but you can see the gaps in his gear steaming, tongues of flame bursting freely from the small holes in his studs. All that magical heat isn't washing outward over the two of you or any potential targets: right now, his Firewalk is perfectly contained. He grabs his shield and widens his grin, the glow growing more intense as the flaming fur of his ears dances in the air. "Now... watch!" He lowers his pose and raises the shield away from the two of you. The flames explode out of his armor all at once; all that compressed lustful magical fire roars across the gym opening and splinters a stray tile in its path as it floods the other half of the room. Thankfully you guys cleared the place out today to have space to test ideas, or it may have made someone too horny to think straight. Atugia watches the whole thing with a confident grin. "You can use that weird magic like that?" "I guess so," he chuckles back. Quin turns his head and lets the flames die down, smoke pouring out of the gaps in his armor. "But I'll admit I only got one good shot, compared to when I normally use it. I'd end up ruining my armor if I did it anymore than that... but if I get all the enemies to come after me, that's just fine. I know a bit of healing magic, too, so if I use my magic and the shield and can get all their eyes on me, I can endure it. After that, it's just a simple matter of giving all of you guys openings to attack." You have to admit this is an awesome surprise. A toolset like this isn't something the party really has: he can fully focus on defense. The more the enemy falls into his baited defense, though, the more likely he can turn the fight on its head with his magic, whether from attacking with that special Firewalk or empowering his bulwark further. It's also a sign of just how committed to this he really is: if the taeleer didn't want to do it, then his efforts to find something that needs the enemy to get close to him and let down their guard wouldn't be so evident. "Quin, you really aren't that bad when you try to be." Your statement is enough to make him freeze... and awkwardly laugh it off with a blush and shake of his head. "Whatever. We should get to training now, though, right? Even if I know how I wanna fight, I still need to properly train to use it the right way!"
rows.translation: 他应该不会迟到吧？” 阿图吉娅和你坐在体育馆的长椅上，等待着昆因的出现。他已经迟到了几分钟，更何况自从你们起床后，就再也没看到他的踪影。他迟迟没有到，这确实让人有些担心——难道他是打算放弃这次约会吗？ “也许他是还在为昨天的训练而感到酸痛吧确实用那个盾牌不断地攻击他。凯特看到了他，即便已经为他治疗过，她还是感到很担心。 [flags.RUNE_MET |符文 |某些猫娘角色 ]后来她甚至还给他做了按摩，但他实在太疲惫了，似乎根本没有注意到这些。 阿图吉娅皱起了眉头；她当然并不担心他的性生活，但这么多人都能看出昆蒂卢斯仅仅经过两天的训练就已经不堪重负，这说明她作为他的训练师，可能确实让他超出了所能承受的极限。 “也许我的要求确实有点太严格了，但是——” “我在这里！ [var0] 昆蒂卢斯在穿戴好全部装备后，提前几秒钟就冲过了门口。不过与昨天不同，这次他携带盾牌时几乎毫不费力，而他的腰间也别着他那把熟悉的剑。 你们两个人立刻站了起来，昆蒂卢斯转过身来面对你们，迅速抬起空着的那只手，示意你们俩停下来。 等一下，”他笑着说，“我想让你们看看我到底能做什么！我花了一整个早上试图解决这个问题，终于让这个魔法正常发挥了作用！” “魔法？”你们现在都好奇起来了吧。“你到底做了什么……” 就在这一瞬间，一道绚丽的粉红色光芒闪过，昆因的耳朵和眼睛发出了你们之前见过他使用过的那种光芒——那就是“火行术”在起作用。 但有些地方有所不同。与通常使用“火步”技能时的情况不同，他腿部和手臂上的毛皮并没有发出可见的光芒——此刻你确实看不到任何光芒——不过你可以看到他装备上的缝隙中正冒着蒸汽，而那些装饰物上的小孔中则不断地有火焰喷射出来。所有那些神奇的热量并没有向你们两人或任何潜在的目标扩散：目前，他的“火步”技巧已经被完美地控制住了。他抓起盾牌，笑容更加灿烂了，而他耳朵上燃烧着的火焰在空气中舞动，那种光芒也变得愈发强烈。 现在…… 观看他调整了自己的姿势，将盾牌举离了你们两人。火焰突然从他的盔甲中迸发出来；那些被压缩后的、充满欲望的魔法火焰在体育馆中肆意蔓延，冲破了通道的障碍，将沿途的瓷砖都炸得粉碎，随后淹没了房间的另一半。幸好你们今天已经清空了这个地方，才有足够的空间来测试各种想法——否则，那些火焰可能会让某些人变得过于兴奋，从而无法冷静思考了。 阿图吉娅带着自信的笑容观看着这一切。“原来你可以那样使用那种奇怪的魔法啊？” “应该是吧，”他笑着回答。昆因转过头，让火焰渐渐熄灭，烟雾从他盔甲的缝隙中弥漫出来。但我必须承认，这次我只成功发动了一次有效的攻击，而平时使用这个技能时，我可以发动更多次。如果再这样继续下去，我的护甲肯定会被破坏……不过，如果能让所有敌人都追上来攻击我，那也没关系。我还会一些治疗魔法，所以只要我运用魔法和盾牌，把所有敌人的注意力都引到自己身上，我就能够坚持下去。之后，只需要给你们所有人创造进攻的机会就可以了。 你不得不承认，这真是个惊人的惊喜。这样的工具集确实是团队目前所缺乏的：它能让玩家完全专注于防御。然而，当敌人越是中计陷入他的防御圈时，玩家就越有可能用魔法扭转战局——无论是使用那个特殊的“火行术”进行攻击，还是进一步增强自己的防御屏障。 这也恰恰说明了他对此事的认真程度：如果泰勒真的不想这么做，那么他那些设法诱使敌人靠近自己、让他们放松警惕的举动，就不会如此明显了。 “昆因，当你真正努力的时候，其实并没有那么差。 你的话足以让他愣住……然后尴尬地笑着岔开话题，同时脸上泛起红晕，摇摇头表示罢了。 “不管怎样，我们现在应该去训练了，对吧？虽然我知道自己想要如何战斗，但仍然需要通过适当的训练来掌握正确的战斗方式！

rows.original:
The day wraps up with Atugia heading off to relax and you and Quin settling in at his booth. He offers to buy drinks multiple times, keeping you talking for almost an hour longer before the atmosphere dies and all his energy finally relents. He looks good in his new gear: compared to the cultist colors, his red and black are almost comparable to stories of ancient soldiers and lords. He keeps the shield propped up against the side of the booth for now but he's ready to get back to adventuring whenever you are.

                        But the look on his face says it before he does, smirking at you across the table.
                        
                        "You know, [pc.name], I have to admit that I knew Atugia said I could do it... but it wasn't until you said you thought I could that I took it seriously. It feels so refreshing not relying on my old magic and the cult's teachings to fight! I mean, it can be effective to use that stuff but my magic is better on its own than theirs. You helped me see that these last few days and I wanted to thank you for that."
                        
                        Quin sets his hands on the table and bows his head. It's a very humble gesture for someone who brags so often, especially if he is some distant noble's son. Even if it's minor nobility, he should be careful about who he bows to at the bare minimum[pc.isDK
                            |. Of course, bowing to you is perfectly acceptable.
                            |.
                        ]
                        
                        "Well then, with that said," he pauses, raising his head so he can smirk across at you. "How about we celebrate with some good, old-fashioned sex?"
rows.translation:
一天就这样结束了，阿图吉娅去休息了，而你和昆因则在他所在的摊位旁休息。他多次主动提出请客喝东西，让你们聊了将近一个小时，直到气氛变得轻松下来，他的精力也终于耗尽了。他穿上这套新装备后看起来非常帅气：与那些邪教徒常用的色彩相比，他的红黑配色简直就像古代士兵和领主们常用的服饰一样。目前他只是把盾牌靠在摊位的边上，但只要你一声令下，他随时都准备再次踏上冒险之旅。

                        但他的表情在他说出口之前就已经把意思表达出来了，他正隔着桌子冲你 smirk 着。
                        
                        “你知道， [pc.name]，我必须承认，我之前就知道阿图吉娅说过我能做到……但直到你也表示相信我，我才真正开始认真对待这件事。不用再依赖我以前的魔法以及那个教派的教义来战斗，这种感觉真是太令人耳目一新了！我的意思是，使用那些方法确实也能发挥作用，但就我个人而言，我的魔法本身就比他们的那些方法更有效。你帮助我意识到了这些过去几天的变化，为此我想感谢你。”
                        
                        昆因将双手放在桌子上，低下了头。对于一个总是爱夸夸其谈的人来说，这个举动显得格外谦逊——尤其是当他只是一个远房贵族的儿子时。即使是低阶贵族，他至少也应该谨慎选择向谁鞠躬致敬。[pc.isDK
                            |。 当然，向您鞠躬是完全可以接受的。
                            |。
                        ]
                        
                        那么，既然如此……”他停顿了一下，抬起头，朝你露出一丝狡黠的笑容，“我们为什么不通过一些传统而美好的性爱来庆祝一下呢？

rows.original:
The paladin grins wide as you proclaim that you're ready to head to Dracia. "Good, good. I've already talked to King Kelsaz, and he's already dispatched a trireme for you and your companions. You've been given a great honor: she's to be commanded by Captain Livernon, a hero of a hundred battles against the coastal orcs."

    [party.has arona|Your own orc snorts. "That old cow? Damn, what reliquary did they dig him out of? My folks fought him when they were just starting out. He pushed the Kervus hard, but never broke us."]
    
    Calise claps your shoulder. "Go then, back to the Winter City. The Captain's been instructed to liaise with the city's seneschal, Elthara I think her name is, so you ought to be able to find him in the palace's temple or thereabouts. Good luck, my Champion. I shall ensure the city remains standing in your absence."
rows.translation:
当你宣布已经准备好前往达拉西亚时，那位圣骑士露出了灿烂的笑容。“太好了，太好了。我早就和凯尔萨兹国王谈过了，他已经为你和你的同伴派了一艘三列桨船。你们获得了无上的荣誉——这艘船将由利弗农船长指挥，他可是与沿海兽人作战过上百次的英雄啊。

    [party.has arona|你自己的兽人哼了一声：“那个老家伙？该死，他们是从哪个宝库里挖出他的？我父母刚开始创业的时候就和他交过手。他曾经给凯尔维斯族带来了很大的压力，但从来没能打败我们。]
    
    卡莉丝轻拍着你的肩膀：“那你就去吧，回到冬城吧。队长已经接到指示，要与该城的城务官联系，我记得她的名字是艾尔萨拉，所以你应该能在宫殿的神殿附近找到她。祝你好运，我的勇士。在你离开期间，我会确保这座城市的安全与稳定。

rows.original:
"How about a kiss for good luck, my lady?" you ask, giving the green-clad paladin your most charming smile. 

        "[calise.fucked
            |But of course, my Champion,
            |Oh? You hardly need it, Champion, but you more than deserve my blessing,
        ]" she says, drawing down her facemask. She takes a dainty step forward and rests her hands upon your cheeks. "For you who would risk [pc.hisHer] life for the safety of this world, all my prayers go with you."
        
        Calise leans in, eyes closing, and presses those lush, rose-red lips of hers to yours. She's so incredibly warm, like the arms you wrap around her waist are holding onto a roiling ember, and her passions run just as hotly. Her lips lock with yours once, twice, hands keeping your [pc.face] steady as she paints you with divine wardings writ in lipstick marks. 
        
        "[calise.fucked
            |Come back to me in one piece, darling.
            |Be safe, [pc.name].
        ] And show that wretch Alissa what fate befalls those who would throw their souls away for nothing but ill-gotten power."
        
        "I will," you tell her, finally letting your arms relax from around her.
        
        She gives you one final kiss on the lips. "Then go. Captain Livernon is waiting for you."
rows.translation:
“小姐，可以给我一个带来好运的吻吗？”你向身披绿甲的圣骑士露出最迷人的微笑。

        “[calise.fucked
            |当然可以，我的勇士。
            |哦？勇士，你几乎用不着它，但你绝对配得上我的祝福。
        ]”她说着拉下面罩，轻盈地走上前，双手捧住你的脸颊。“你愿意冒着[pc.hisHer]生命危险守护这个世界，我所有的祈祷都会与你同在。”
        
        卡莉丝闭上双眼俯身靠近，将丰润玫红的双唇贴上你的嘴唇。她温暖得不可思议，仿佛你环住她腰肢的双臂正拥抱一块翻涌的余烬；她的激情也同样炽热。她一次、两次地与你唇齿相接，双手稳住你的[pc.face]，以口红印记写下神圣守护，将它们涂画在你身上。
        
        “[calise.fucked
            |亲爱的，一定要完好无损地回来见我。
            |注意安全，[pc.name]。
        ]让那个恶毒的艾莉莎亲眼看看，只为不义之力抛弃灵魂的人会落得什么下场。”
        
        “我会的。”你告诉她，终于放松环抱她的双臂。
        
        她最后在你唇上吻了一下。“那就出发吧。利弗农船长正在等你。”

rows.original: A few paces away from Elthara, a barrel-chested bullman is talking quietly with a few palace servants. He's holding a plumed Khor'minoan helm under one arm, exposing a mane of messy red hair spilling down his shoulders. His body armor's been polished to a mirror shine, catching the chapel's light in a dazzling way

rows.original:
"What happened on your way here?" you ask the captain. "You said it was a hard journey?"
        
        "Oh, aye," the bull grunts. "There's a reason even the navy stopped plying the boreal fjords, to say nothing of our merchantmen. The deep forests between Njorhaalt and the coastlands are still lousy with Wraith-touched monsters, and they're not shy about attacking boats. The fjords are narrow and rocky along the sides; it's not difficult sailing, but it forces you to sail slow and straight. Easy pickings for raiders that want to get aboard, or pepper your decks with arrows."
        
        Daliza nods. "Meaning we had best be ready to face both new demons and old on this expedition. My rangers and I led a lengthy expedition through that forest several months ago now, and the captain is correct: the abominations still haunt the woods, and their numbers grow ever more dire the closer to the coast you travel. If you have access to holy arms and allies talented in the priestly arts, both will likely find their use."
        
        [party.has arona
            |"And don't even think of leaving me behind!" Arona insists, throwing an arm around your shoulder. "I don't wanna miss a chance to go sailing. And fighting on a ship's deck? Practically my specialty!"
        ]
rows.translation:
你们来这里的路上发生了什么？”你问船长，“你们不是说这是一段艰难的旅程吗？”
        
        “哦，确实如此，”船长低沉地回答，“甚至海军都不再航行这些北方的峡湾了，更不用说我们的商船了。在尼奥哈尔特与海岸地区之间的茂密森林中，仍然栖息着许多受到怨灵影响的怪物，它们毫不畏惧地攻击船只。这些峡湾两侧岩石嶙峋、狭窄难行，虽然航行并不困难，但必须保持缓慢且笔直的速度前进。对于那些想要登上船的劫掠者来说，这些都是很容易捕获的目标；或者，他们也可以用箭矢攻击你们的船队。
        
        达莉莎点了点头。“这意味着我们在这次远征中必须准备好面对新旧的各种危险。几个月前，我和我的游骑兵们曾在那片森林里进行过一次漫长的远征，船长说得对：那些可怕的生物仍然出没在森林里，而且越靠近海岸，它们的数量就越多，情况也就越危险。如果你能够获得神圣的武器，以及那些擅长祭司职业的盟友，那么这两样东西都很可能派上用场。
        
        [party.has arona
            |绝对不要想把我丢下！”阿罗娜紧紧搂住你的肩膀说道，“我可不想错过这次航海的机会。而在船甲板上战斗？那简直就是我的强项！
        ]
rows.raw:
'
        "What happened on your way here?" you ask the captain. "You said it was a hard journey?"
        
        "Oh, aye," the bull grunts. "There's a reason even the navy stopped plying the boreal fjords, to say nothing of our merchantmen. The deep forests between Njorhaalt and the coastlands are still lousy with Wraith-touched monsters, and they're not shy about attacking boats. The fjords are narrow and rocky along the sides; it's not difficult sailing, but it forces you to sail slow and straight. Easy pickings for raiders that want to get aboard, or pepper your decks with arrows."
        
        Daliza nods. "Meaning we had best be ready to face both new demons and old on this expedition. My rangers and I led a lengthy expedition through that forest several months ago now, and the captain is correct: the abominations still haunt the woods, and their numbers grow ever more dire the closer to the coast you travel. If you have access to holy arms and allies talented in the priestly arts, both will likely find their use."
        
        [party.has arona
            |"And don't even think of leaving me behind!" Arona insists, throwing an arm around your shoulder. "I don't wanna miss a chance to go sailing. And fighting on a ship's deck? Practically my specialty!"
        ]'

rows.original: What made the trip here so difficult? Anything you need to be concerned about?
rows.translation: 是什么让这次旅行变得如此艰难？有没有什么你需要担心的事情？
rows.raw: "What made the trip here so difficult? Anything you need to be concerned about?"

rows.original: Etheryn and Daliza, a two-handed swordfighter, are coming with you on this adventure. You can select one other Companion of your choice to join you.
rows.translation: 伊瑟琳和达莉莎，这位擅长使用双手剑的战士，将会与你一同踏上这段冒险之旅。你还可以再选择一位你喜欢的同伴来加入你们。
rows.raw: "\n        Etheryn and Daliza, a two-handed swordfighter, are coming with you on this adventure. You can select one other Companion of your choice to join you."

rows.original: You're as ready as you'll ever be!
rows.translation: 你已经为这次行动做好了充分的准备！
rows.raw: "You're as ready as you'll ever be!"

rows.original:
"I'll need to get some things ready first, myself," you say.

        Livernon nods. "Aye, make sure you're well prepared, all of you. The journey will be long and hard[silly
            |, heh
        ], and we've no idea what we'll face in the Sailgraves. They say the demons first made land there, centuries ago, so no doubt the Wraith-touched and this new breed of demon alike will seek to tear our sails."
        
        Etheryn nods, idly thumbing her bowstring. "We will be ready. Won't we, [pc.name]?"
        
        You nod. Best start preparing for a challenging expedition...
rows.translation:
“我自己也得先准备些东西。”你说道。

        利弗农点点头。“没错，你们所有人都要做好万全准备。旅途会漫长而艰难[silly
            |，嘿嘿
        ]，而我们根本不知道在帆葬海岸会遇上什么。据说恶魔几个世纪前就是在那里首次登陆，因此无论受幽魂侵染之物，还是这个新品种的恶魔，肯定都会试图撕裂我们的船帆。”
        
        伊瑟琳点点头，心不在焉地拨弄着弓弦。“我们会准备好的，对吧，[pc.name]？”
        
        你点点头。最好开始为这场艰难的远征做准备……

rows.original: You're not quite ready to embark on an adventure of this magnitude yet.
rows.translation: 你目前还没有完全准备好去迎接这样一场大规模的冒险。
rows.raw: "You're not quite ready to embark on an adventure of this magnitude yet."

rows.original:
[pc.dcb
        |"The fuck are we waiting for, then?" you say. "Let's go kill a demon queen."
        |"I'm ready, Captain. Let's go put an end to these weapon shipments, and to Alissa's terror."
        |"Aye-aye, cap'n, I'm wet'n'ready!"
    ]
    
    Etheryn gulps. "A-alright. I'm as ready as I'll ever be. Oh, goddess. We're really doing this."
    
    [var0
        |You put a hand on the princess' shoulder
        |Daliza hesitates a moment before reaching a hand out to the princess's shoulder.
    ] Ryn's ears wiggle, and she forces a smile. "I'm not... I don't think I'll ever be ready to face her. Not really. [ryn.lnhConfidence
        |I c-could never stand up to her before. And now she's a monster outside, too. B-but I have to. For all the people of Njorhaalt.
        |I was never strong enough t-to stand up to her before, and that was before she was a monster on the outside too. But I've got to try. So many people are counting on us.
        |I didn't have the strength to stand up to Alissa when she was the tyrant of this city, but now... now I don't have a choice. For all of Njorhaalt's sake, I've got to try.
    ] I'm just glad I have you at my side, [pc.name]. And that I'll have your sword, Lady Daliza."
    
    [pc.isDK
        |"Cut the mushy shit. We're wasting daylight," you sigh.
        |"We're here for you, Ryn," you say.
    ] "Come on."
    
    Elthara sweeps over from the altar and takes your hand and Ryn's. "Good luck, you two. I've sent all the supplies your expedition should need ahead of you, as well as what few soldiers we can spare. I shall pray for your success. Visit the sun's justice upon Alissa for all that she has done."
    
    "We will," Ryn says. "I swear."
    
    Captain Livernon dons his helm. "Aye, let's make haste then. Lady Elthara, it's been a pleasure. Lady-Regent, Jarlessa, Champion — follow me."
rows.translation:
[pc.dcb
        |那我们还在等什么？”你说道，“赶紧去干掉那个恶魔女王吧。
        |我已经准备好了，队长。让我们一起去阻止这些武器的运输，也终结艾莉莎带来的恐怖吧。
        |遵命，船长，我已经准备好了！
    ]
    
    伊瑟琳咽了口唾沫，说道：“好吧，我已经做好了充分的准备。哦，女神啊，我们真的要这么做了。
    
    [var0
        |你将手放在公主的肩上
        |达莉莎犹豫了片刻，才伸手触碰了公主的肩膀。
    ]小琳的耳朵微微动了一下，她强挤出一丝笑容：“我还没准备好……我觉得我永远都不会准备好面对她。真的没有。 [ryn.lnhConfidence
        |我以前从来都不敢反抗她。现在她在外面也变成了一个怪物。但我必须这么做。为了恩乔哈尔特的所有人民。
        |以前，我从来都没有足够的勇气去反抗她，更何况那时她的外表也已经变得凶恶可怖了。但我必须尝试。有太多人在期待着我们。
        |当阿莉莎还是这座城市的暴君时，我没有勇气反抗她，但现在……现在我别无选择。为了恩乔哈尔特的缘故，我必须试一试。
    ]能有你在我身边，我就感到无比幸福。 [pc.name]那么，达莉莎女士，你的剑就归我了。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |别再废话了。我们在浪费时间啊，”你叹道。
        |我们会支持你的，小琳。”你说道。
    ]加油吧。”
    
    艾尔萨拉从祭坛上走过来，握住了你和小琳的手。“祝你们俩好运。我已经把你们远征所需的所有物资都提前送到了你们那里，同时还派去了我们能抽调出来的少数士兵。我会为你们的成功祈祷。对于艾莉莎所做的一切，就让太阳的正义来裁决她吧。”
    
    “我们一定会成功的，”小琳说，“我发誓。”
    
    利弗农上尉戴上了头盔：“好吧，那我们就赶快出发吧。艾尔萨拉女士，能与您共事真是我的荣幸。摄政夫人、贾勒萨、冠军——跟我来吧。

rows.original: It's not a far journey from the palace to the fjord, but it isn't an easy one — the cliffside path that once connected the elvenrealm to the docks below hasn't been maintained in generations, overgrown and half-collapsed such that your party has to move single-file, and the larger among you often have to shuffle sideways along narrowed paths. "When this war is over... I should make repairing all of this a priority, shouldn't I?" Ryn says, as much to herself as to the rest of you. "I'd like to see trade coming north again..." "As would we, Lady-Regent," Livernon says. "Certainly that ice wine Elthara plied me with alone would make the transit worthwhile." [party.has arona |Arona grins. "More trade along the coast sounds good to me. Will sure keep the Kervus occupied!" "I thought I recognized those tribal markings," the captain says. "Didn't I sink your chieftain?" "My dad, yeah. Don't worry, he swam to shore and ordered a faster longboat built to replace the Wavefucker." Daliza blinks. "Your father named his ship the Wavefucker? Really?" "Yeah, had a giant dick for a ram, was the funniest shit I ever saw. Well, the painting of it anyway." Livernon snorts a laugh. "That it did. The first time we gave battle to it, the ship rammed one of my escorts, cracked her in half. Then the whole crew chanted 'Wave! Fucked! Wave! Fucked!' so loud we could hear it over the stormwinds." "That was probably them introducing themselves to the crew they fished out," Arona leers. "I'm aware. After all, half the Wavefucker's crew ended up lashed to building triremes at the royal shipyards in the end." Arona takes that in good stride, mumbling something about how the minotaur ship's crew built her several cousins once Livernon's out of earshot. ] [party.has cait |"Wow, look at all those leothrans," Cait says, drawing your attention up the cliffside across the water. Dozens of snow-patterned furry felines are staring in unabashed curiosity from small caves and cliffs as your party descends the old path, probably the first they've ever seen make the descent besides their own kin. [etheryn.highConfidence |Etheryn waves at them. "Hail, friends!" |Cait waves enthusiastically, a gesture that's made all the more endearing for the sheer amount of motion it puts into her chest. "Hey big fluffy friends!" ] Several shocked leothrans wave back, heads tilted and tails swishing. ] The dock itself isn't in much better shape than the descent, a half-rotted wood strut extending into the narrow terminus of the fjord in the shadow of the once-great stone archbridge that crossed high above, sundred long ago by the Godswar. Shards of white stone stick up from the shallow waters to either side, worn smooth by tide and time. Sat beside the dock, though, is a ship utterly out of place with the disrepair you've seen thus far: she's a beautiful three-decked heavy warship, painted all in blood red and trimmed with gold, and with an azure moon painted on its single mast-sail. A golden figurehead juts forward from the prow, a curvaceous cowgirl holding a thunderbolt in one hand and an axe in the other, overlooking the bronze ram affixed to the fore. About a dozen boreal elves in breastplates and cloaks similar to Daliza's are moving crates of food and ammunition onto the ship with the help of a diverse gaggle of oar slaves, overseen by a host of minotaurs in the same azure livery as Livernon. A pair of marines in heavy bronze war panoply salute as the captain steps onto the dock, wood creaking under his hooves, but it's a cowgirl — the only one you've seen on the deck — that comes over to greet you. While she has the same blue-moon tabard as the men, she wears no armor that you can see and carries a crescent-headed staff rather than the ubiquitous hammers and axes. "All is well, my love?" Captain Livernon asks, marching past his guards to sweep the diminutive blonde cow-girl into his arms. "The elves have us ready to sail ahead of schedule, husband dear," she confirms, before turning her attention to the rest of you. She curtseys to Etheryn, showing off a frankly tremendous amount of thick, sun-kissed thigh beneath her short skirts. "My lady, noble guests, it is an honor. I am Juno, ship's mage for the Auroran Vigil." [party.has arona |Arona blinks. "Wait, Juno the Storm Witch? Hey, [pc.name], this babe's a legend. Brother said he saw her sink a half dozen pexighast raider boats with one vortex." The cow-girl smiles demurely, but there's a glint of amusement in her blue eyes. "Eight, actually. I wasn't aware that battle had Kervus spectators." "Yeah, he and his kid were out fishing. Said you stood out on the ram like an icon and bent Sorra's own ear for that kind of power. Didn't say how fuckin' hot you were, though, fuck." Juno's cheeks color, but she smirks nonetheless. "I'm shocked my appearance wasn't the first thing an orc would see." "First thing I noticed," your companion grins. "You being a badass is an awesome kicker, though." Livernon glowers. ] "Yes," the captain says, "indeed. We're in good hands with my wife's storm magic in our sails. Things will be a bit cramped with so many extra hands, but we should make good pace to Dracia. Juno, dear, would you mind showing our guests to their bunks?" "Aye, captain. Follow me, everyone. Let's get you settled in. This will be a journey of at least two full days. Perhaps more, if my husband's optimism is misplaced." The bovine witch sweeps a hand towards the small steps leading belowdecks while her husband begins bellowing orders in his native tongue, hastening the crew to the task of making ready to sail.
rows.translation: 从宫殿到峡湾的距离并不远，但这条路却并非容易通行——曾经连接精灵王国与下方码头的悬崖小径已经数代无人维护，杂草丛生，部分路段甚至已经半塌，因此你们的队伍必须排成单列行进，那些体型较大的人往往不得不在狭窄的小路上侧身挪动。 等这场战争结束……我应该把修复这一切作为优先事项，不是吗？”小琳自言自语道，同时也仿佛是在对在场的其他人说，“我真心希望贸易能再次恢复到北方来……” “我们也都希望如此，摄政夫人。”利弗农说道。当然，仅仅是艾尔萨拉提供的那种冰酒，就足以让这段旅途变得值得了。 [party.has arona |阿罗娜咧嘴笑了：“沿海地区贸易增多对我来说再好不过了。这肯定能让克维斯族人忙个不停！” “我好像认得那些部落标记……不是我把你们的首领给淹死了吗？”船长说道。 “是我爸爸，没错。别担心，他游上了岸，还下令制造一艘更快的长船来替换原来的那艘。Wavefucker达莉莎眨了眨眼：“你父亲将他的船命名为…… Wavefucker真的吗？” “是啊，有一艘船的船头像巨型阴茎一样，那真是我见过最搞笑的事情了……至少那幅画是这么画的。” 利弗农哼了一声笑了起来：“确实很搞笑。我们第一次与它交战的时候，那艘船撞上了我的一艘护航舰，把它撞成了两半。然后全体船员齐声高喊“Wave！ Fucked！ Wave！ Fucked！”，声音大到连暴风中的呼啸声都盖不住。 “那大概就是他们在向那些被他们救上来的人做自我介绍吧，”阿罗娜咧嘴笑道。 我知道。毕竟，有一半的人…… Wavefucker最终，那艘船的船员们被绑在了皇家造船厂的三列桨船上。” 阿罗娜若无其事地接受了这个事实，当利弗农听不见时，她小声嘀咕着，说那些弥诺陶洛斯船的船员们曾经为她造过几艘类似的船。 ] [party.has cait |哇，看那些利奥特兰猫吧，”凯特说道，她的手指指向对岸悬崖上的一群动物。当你的队伍沿着那条古老的路径向下走去时，数十只身上覆盖着雪斑、毛茸茸的猫科动物正从一些小洞穴和悬崖边好奇地注视着你们——对他们来说，这可能是除了自己的同类之外，第一次有其他人沿着这条路下来。 [etheryn.highConfidence |伊瑟琳向他们挥手致意：“嗨，朋友们！ |凯特热情地挥手，这个动作因为她的胸部会随着挥手而产生大幅度的起伏，显得更加可爱。“嘿，那些毛茸茸的大朋友们！ ] 几只震惊的利奥坦动物摇着尾巴，歪着头回应着。 ] 这个码头本身的状况也好不到哪里去：一根半腐烂的木柱伸入峡湾狭窄的尽头，在高处曾经横跨其上的那座宏伟石拱桥的阴影中矗立着。那座桥早已在“神战”中毁于一旦。白色石块的碎片从浅水区两侧凸了出来，这些碎片被潮水和时间的侵蚀而变得光滑平整。 然而，停靠在码头边的那艘船却与你们迄今为止所见到的那些破旧船只截然不同：它是一艘漂亮的三层甲板重型战舰，通体被漆成血红色，并用金色装饰；它的唯一主帆上还绘着一片蔚蓝色的月亮。船头矗立着一个金色的船首像，那是一个身形婀娜的牛仔姑娘，她一手握着雷电，另一手拿着斧头，正凝视着船头装置的那只青铜撞角。 大约有十几名穿着与达莉莎相似的胸甲和斗篷的极北精灵，在一群划船奴隶的帮助下，将装满食物和弹药的箱子搬上船只。这一切都在一群穿着与利弗农相同蓝色制服的弥诺陶洛斯的监督下进行。当船长踏上码头时，一对身着厚重青铜战甲的海军陆战队员向他敬礼，木板在他们的脚步下发出吱嘎声——然而前来迎接你的，却是一位女牛仔，也是你在甲板上见到的唯一一位女性。虽然她和男人们一样穿着同样的蓝色战袍，但她并没有穿戴任何可见的盔甲，手中拿的也是一根新月形的权杖，而不是那些随处可见的锤子和斧头。 一切都好吗，我的爱人？”利弗农船长一边走过他的卫兵，一边将这位身材娇小的金发女牛仔拥入怀中。 “亲爱的丈夫，精灵们已经让我们提前准备好了出发，”她回答道，随后将注意力转向在场的其他人。她向伊瑟琳行礼，露出她那短裙下那双结实、被阳光晒得黝黑的大腿，这一幕实在令人印象深刻。“我的女士们，尊贵的来宾们，能见到你们真是我的荣幸。我是朱诺，这艘船的魔法师。极光守望者。” [party.has arona |阿罗娜眨了眨眼。“等等，风暴女巫朱诺？嘿， [pc.name]，这个女孩可真是传奇人物。我哥哥说，他亲眼看到她用一个漩涡就击沉了六艘佩克西加斯特掠夺者船。 这位牛仔女孩羞涩地笑了笑，但她蓝色的眼睛里却闪着一丝笑意：“其实应该是八艘。我之前并不知道那场战斗还有凯尔维斯在现场观看。” “是啊，他和他的孩子当时正在外面钓鱼。他们说你在战场上简直像一个标志一样显眼，那种实力甚至让索拉都对你刮目相看。不过他们也没提到你到底有多他妈的性感，真是的。朱诺的脸颊泛起了红晕，但她依然露出了笑容：“真没想到，一个兽人看到的第一件事竟然不是我的外貌。” “第一件事我注意到了吧，”你的同伴笑着说，“不过你这么厉害，确实让人觉得很有意思。” 利弗农怒目而视。 ]是的，”船长说道，“确实如此。有我妻子的风暴魔法在助力，我们一定会顺利前行的。虽然多了这么多乘客，空间会显得有些拥挤，但我们应该能够快速抵达达拉西亚。朱诺，亲爱的，你能帮忙把我们的客人安排到他们的铺位上吗？遵命，船长。大家跟我来，我们会安排你们安顿下来的。这次旅程至少需要两天的时间，如果我丈夫太乐观的话，可能会更久一些。” 这位性格豪爽的女巫朝船舱下方的台阶挥了挥手，而她的丈夫则用他的母语大声下达命令，催促船员们尽快做好出发准备。
rows.raw: ' It's not a far journey from the palace to the fjord, but it isn't an easy one — the cliffside path that once connected the elvenrealm to the docks below hasn't been maintained in generations, overgrown and half-collapsed such that your party has to move single-file, and the larger among you often have to shuffle sideways along narrowed paths. "When this war is over... I should make repairing all of this a priority, shouldn't I?" Ryn says, as much to herself as to the rest of you. "I'd like to see trade coming north again..." "As would we, Lady-Regent," Livernon says. "Certainly that ice wine Elthara plied me with alone would make the transit worthwhile." [party.has arona |Arona grins. "More trade along the coast sounds good to me. Will sure keep the Kervus occupied!" "I thought I recognized those tribal markings," the captain says. "Didn't I sink your chieftain?" "My dad, yeah. Don't worry, he swam to shore and ordered a faster longboat built to replace the Wavefucker." Daliza blinks. "Your father named his ship the Wavefucker? Really?" "Yeah, had a giant dick for a ram, was the funniest shit I ever saw. Well, the painting of it anyway." Livernon snorts a laugh. "That it did. The first time we gave battle to it, the ship rammed one of my escorts, cracked her in half. Then the whole crew chanted 'Wave! Fucked! Wave! Fucked!' so loud we could hear it over the stormwinds." "That was probably them introducing themselves to the crew they fished out," Arona leers. "I'm aware. After all, half the Wavefucker's crew ended up lashed to building triremes at the royal shipyards in the end." Arona takes that in good stride, mumbling something about how the minotaur ship's crew built her several cousins once Livernon's out of earshot. ] [party.has cait |"Wow, look at all those leothrans," Cait says, drawing your attention up the cliffside across the water. Dozens of snow-patterned furry felines are staring in unabashed curiosity from small caves and cliffs as your party descends the old path, probably the first they've ever seen make the descent besides their own kin. [etheryn.highConfidence |Etheryn waves at them. "Hail, friends!" |Cait waves enthusiastically, a gesture that's made all the more endearing for the sheer amount of motion it puts into her chest. "Hey big fluffy friends!" ] Several shocked leothrans wave back, heads tilted and tails swishing. ] The dock itself isn't in much better shape than the descent, a half-rotted wood strut extending into the narrow terminus of the fjord in the shadow of the once-great stone archbridge that crossed high above, sundred long ago by the Godswar. Shards of white stone stick up from the shallow waters to either side, worn smooth by tide and time. Sat beside the dock, though, is a ship utterly out of place with the disrepair you've seen thus far: she's a beautiful three-decked heavy warship, painted all in blood red and trimmed with gold, and with an azure moon painted on its single mast-sail. A golden figurehead juts forward from the prow, a curvaceous cowgirl holding a thunderbolt in one hand and an axe in the other, overlooking the bronze ram affixed to the fore. About a dozen boreal elves in breastplates and cloaks similar to Daliza's are moving crates of food and ammunition onto the ship with the help of a diverse gaggle of oar slaves, overseen by a host of minotaurs in the same azure livery as Livernon. A pair of marines in heavy bronze war panoply salute as the captain steps onto the dock, wood creaking under his hooves, but it's a cowgirl — the only one you've seen on the deck — that comes over to greet you. While she has the same blue-moon tabard as the men, she wears no armor that you can see and carries a crescent-headed staff rather than the ubiquitous hammers and axes. "All is well, my love?" Captain Livernon asks, marching past his guards to sweep the diminutive blonde cow-girl into his arms. "The elves have us ready to sail ahead of schedule, husband dear," she confirms, before turning her attention to the rest of you. She curtseys to Etheryn, showing off a frankly tremendous amount of thick, sun-kissed thigh beneath her short skirts. "My lady, noble guests, it is an honor. I am Juno, ship's mage for the Auroran Vigil." [party.has arona |Arona blinks. "Wait, Juno the Storm Witch? Hey, [pc.name], this babe's a legend. Brother said he saw her sink a half dozen pexighast raider boats with one vortex." The cow-girl smiles demurely, but there's a glint of amusement in her blue eyes. "Eight, actually. I wasn't aware that battle had Kervus spectators." "Yeah, he and his kid were out fishing. Said you stood out on the ram like an icon and bent Sorra's own ear for that kind of power. Didn't say how fuckin' hot you were, though, fuck." Juno's cheeks color, but she smirks nonetheless. "I'm shocked my appearance wasn't the first thing an orc would see." "First thing I noticed," your companion grins. "You being a badass is an awesome kicker, though." Livernon glowers. ] "Yes," the captain says, "indeed. We're in good hands with my wife's storm magic in our sails. Things will be a bit cramped with so many extra hands, but we should make good pace to Dracia. Juno, dear, would you mind showing our guests to their bunks?" "Aye, captain. Follow me, everyone. Let's get you settled in. This will be a journey of at least two full days. Perhaps more, if my husband's optimism is misplaced." The bovine witch sweeps a hand towards the small steps leading belowdecks while her husband begins bellowing orders in his native tongue, hastening the crew to the task of making ready to sail.'

rows.original: You and [party.compNames] are shown to a set of hammocks behind the stairs, along a narrow corridor that leads to the only actual cabin on the ship — the captain's, naturally. By the time you've unloaded your bags and [pc.isBimbo |had Daliza explain that her asking if you wanted top or bottom wasn't a question about your sexual preference |claimed your bunk ], the upper deck's rumbling with the sound of footfalls, and oar-slaves come running down to man their posts. The Auroran Vigil casts off a short while later, to the sound of heaving oarsmen and minotaurs bellowing orders. The ship rocks nauseatingly underfoot as the crew takes to the water, pushing this way and that to weave between the ruins around the base of the fjord. Lady Juno wasn't kidding about the time it takes: even under the decks, you can feel that you aren't going anywhere quickly, optimistically about as fast as walking with how cautious the oarsmen have to be in the narrows. Ryn says she expects things to speed up once you reach the coast; Daliza says that if her experiences afoot are any indication, you'll be lucky to reach the coast at all. The forests are full of all manner of monsters. For the moment, though, things are slow and quiet. After a few hours, once you've cleared the elven rubble strewing the waters, one of the ship's officers invites your party up to the main deck.
rows.translation: 你和[party.compNames]被领到楼梯后方的一排吊床；那里有条狭窄走廊，通往船上唯一真正的舱室——自然是船长室。等你卸下行李，并且[pc.isBimbo |让达莉莎解释清楚，她问你想睡上铺还是下铺，并不是在打听你的性爱偏好 |占好自己的铺位 ]以后，上层甲板已被脚步声震得隆隆作响，桨奴纷纷跑下来，各就各位。 不久，伴随着桨手发力的号子与弥诺陶洛斯吼出的命令，极光守望号离开码头。船员开始划动船只，在峡湾底部周围的废墟间左右穿行，甲板在脚下摇晃得令人作呕。朱诺女士说航程漫长，绝非夸张：即使身处下层甲板，你也能感觉到船速快不起来；桨手在狭窄水道中必须如此谨慎，乐观估计也不过步行的速度。小琳说，抵达海岸后应该就能加速；达莉莎则表示，以她步行穿越此地的经验来看，能不能活着抵达海岸都要靠运气。森林里到处都是形形色色的怪物。 不过眼下，航程缓慢而安静。几个小时后，船驶离散落在水域中的精灵废墟，一名船上军官邀请你的队伍前往主甲板。

rows.original: Go and check in on the pensive princess. Even by Ryn's standards, she seems nervous.
rows.translation: 去看看那位陷入沉思的公主吧。即使以小琳的标准来看，她看起来也显得很紧张。
rows.raw: "Go and check in on the pensive princess. Even by Ryn's standards, she seems nervous."

rows.translation: 你已经和伊瑟琳谈过了。

rows.original: Go check in with the captain and his bewitching wife.
rows.translation: 去跟船长和他那位迷人的妻子聊聊吧。
rows.raw: "Go check in with the captain and his bewitching wife."

rows.translation: 你已经和利弗农谈过了。

rows.original: You're setting sail towards Daliza's homeland. She'll certainly have some thoughts to share.
rows.translation: 你即将启程前往达莉莎的故乡。她肯定有一些故事想要分享。

rows.raw: "Arona seems oddly serene for the moment. Might be worth checking in on the big brawler."

rows.translation: 你已经和阿罗娜谈过了。

rows.original: You've done all you care to on the deck of the Vigil for today. Head belowdecks and get some rest — you're going to need it.
rows.translation: 今天你在守望者号的甲板上已经做完了想做的事。下到舱里去休息一下吧——你会需要休息的。
rows.raw: "You've done all you care to on the deck of the Vigil for today. Head belowdecks and get some rest — you're going to need it."

rows.original:
You head over to where Ryn's standing, up near the ship's great bronze and gold icon. "Hey, [ryn.fucked
        |beautiful
        |Ryn
    ]."
    
    She turns with a [ryn.lowConfidence
        |barely-suppressed wince
        |smile
    ] and waves her guards away. "H-hey, [pc.name]. Something wrong?"
    
    "No," you say. "But you looked like something's bothering you."
    
    "Ah." Ryn's shoulders and ears slump, and her gaze returns eastwards towards the ocean. "I... I don't know. I haven't seen Alissa since, uh, since she turned. I have no idea what to expect, but I know it's going to be bad. Worse than it's ever been. Wh-which is pretty bad already. She was always a monster on the inside, ever since I can remember. I can't stop thinking about what she's become; about what we can possibly do for her."
    
    You raise a brow. "Don't you mean 'against' her?"
    
    Etheryn flinches, ears twitching. "I don't know. Even after everything, I want to believe there's still some way to... to fix her. I always hoped that, somehow, if I was good enough and obedient enough, someday Alissa would come around. That I could make up for killing our mother when I was born. [etheryn.highConfidence
        |These days I know that she's unwell, mentally. And now she's a demon to boot,
        |And now she's a demon, too,
    ] but... still, she's my sister. She raised me. I can't help hoping even now th-that there's something I can do for her. To bring her back from this madness."
    
    [pc.isDK
        |"Ryn, she's evil as hell. There's no helping that bitch."
        |"Even after everything she's done?"
    ]
    
    "I know... I know, I should hate her. And I do. But still..." 
    
    She sighs and plucks Harrick up from the railing, stroking her bird's head. "Alissa always said I was weak.[ryn.lowConfidence
        | B-but if hope is weak, then th-that's okay with me.
        | But I think hope, and caring about people even after they've wronged you, is an alright weakness to have. I'd rather get hurt again than live with knowing that I didn't try my best for her.
    ]"
    
    [pc.dcb
        |You roll your eyes. "You'll grow up eventually."
        |You pull Ryn into a hug. "You're hardly weak, Ryn."
        |You sweep Ryn up into a big ol' hug. "Awww no, you're such a sweetie. You're perfect."
    ]
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Ryn's ears droop. "That's what she said, too. But I'll still try. I have to."
        |"Th-thank you... I don't deserve you."
        
        "Yes, you do."
    ]
rows.translation:
你走向站在船只巨大青铜与黄金徽记附近的小琳。“嘿，[ryn.fucked
        |美人
        |小琳
    ]。”
    
    她转过身，[ryn.lowConfidence
        |几乎掩不住畏缩的神情
        |面带微笑
    ]，挥手示意卫兵退下。“嘿、嘿，[pc.name]。出什么事了吗？”
    
    “没有，”你说道。“但你好像有什么心事。”
    
    “啊。”小琳的肩膀和耳朵都垂了下来，目光重新向东投向海洋。“我……我不知道。自从、呃，自从艾莉莎转变之后，我就再也没见过她。我完全不知道将会面对什么，但肯定非常糟糕。比以往任何时候都糟。现、现在的情况已经够糟了。从我记事起，她内心一直是个怪物。我总忍不住去想她已经变成了什么；我们究竟能为她做些什么。”
    
    你挑起一边眉毛。“你的意思难道不是‘对付’她？”
    
    伊瑟琳缩了缩身子，耳朵轻颤。“我不知道。即使经历了这一切，我还是愿意相信，有某种方法可以……治好她。我一直希望，不知怎么，只要自己足够优秀、足够听话，总有一天艾莉莎会回心转意。这样，我就能弥补出生时害死母亲的过错。[etheryn.highConfidence
        |如今我明白，她的精神状况并不健康。而现在她还变成了恶魔，
        |而现在，她也变成了恶魔，
    ]可是……她终究是我的姐姐。是她把我养大。即使到了现在，我还是忍不住希望，自、自己能为她做些什么，把她从这场疯狂中带回来。”
    
    [pc.isDK
        |“小琳，她坏得无可救药。那个贱人已经无可救药。”
        |“即使她做过那么多事？”
    ]
    
    “我知道……我知道自己应该恨她。我也的确恨她。可我还是……”
    
    她叹了口气，从栏杆上抱起哈里克，抚摸着鸟儿的脑袋。“艾莉莎总说我软弱。[ryn.lowConfidence
        |可、可是，如果希望意味着软弱，那、那我也愿意接受。
        |但我觉得，即使别人伤害过你，仍然心怀希望、关心对方，也是一种可以接受的软弱。比起明知自己没有为她竭尽全力而活下去，我宁愿再受一次伤。
    ]”
    
    [pc.dcb
        |你翻了个白眼。“你总有一天会长大的。”
        |你把小琳拉入怀中。“你一点也不软弱，小琳。”
        |你把小琳一把抱进宽厚的怀中。“哦，不，你真是个小甜心。你很完美。”
    ]
    
    [pc.isDK
        |小琳的耳朵垂了下来。“她也这么说。但我还是会尝试。我必须这么做。”
        |“谢、谢谢你……我配不上你。”
        
        “不，你配得上。”
    ]

rows.original:
"I... I don't know," Ryn answers, glancing back towards the water and petting Harrick a little more slowly. The war bird shakes itself out and pecks at her glove until she picks the pace back up. "She gave up her soul and became a demon. I don't know if there's any going back from that. But I've got to try; try and get her help, now that I have the power — and the friends — to make it happen. I'll drag her before Lumia herself if I have to!"

        [pc.swornGod lumia
            |"Well, we've certainly got an in there," you say, unfurling your golden wings. "But I don't know if even Lumia can fix that personality."
            |"I'm not sure even the gods can fix that personality, Ryn."
        ]
        
        Etheryn shrugs helplessly. "Maybe. Maybe there's no helping her. Maybe without a soul the best mercy I can grant her i-is... is death. But I'll never be able to live with myself if I don't try. Despite it all, she's still my sister."
        
        [pc.isDK
            |"Do you really think she deserves a second chance, though?"
            
            "It's not... not about what she deserves, [pc.name]. It's about what's right. I wish you understood."
            
            You grunt, unconvinced. 
        ]"Do you think we can actually keep her safely? [wayfort.hasDungeon
            |In the dungeons, or...?"
    
            You think on that a moment. "We did have those built specifically to keep demons, if need be. It should be enough."
            |I... I don't know. I'm sure [viv.recruited
                |Lady Viviane
                |one of the hedge witches around the Marches
            ] can ward a prison cell, if it comes to it. We'll... we'll figure it out! I hope."
    
            Hope isn't exactly a strategy, but it's a little late for something more solid, you suppose.
        ] You'll just have to cross the Alissa bridge when you get there...

            |我……我不知道。但我很确定。 [viv.recruited
                |薇薇安女士
                |边境地区那些擅长占卜的女巫之一
            ]如果有必要的话，这个地方甚至可以用来关押囚犯。我们会……我们会想出办法的！我希望如此。
    
            希望虽然算不上是一种真正的策略，但在这个时候，要想出更切实可行的办法，恐怕也为时已晚了。
        ]当你到达那里时，只需要穿过阿丽莎桥就可以了……
rows.raw:
"
        "I... I don't know," Ryn answers, glancing back towards the water and petting Harrick a little more slowly. The war bird shakes itself out and pecks at her glove until she picks the pace back up. "She gave up her soul and became a demon. I don't know if there's any going back from that. But I've got to try; try and get her help, now that I have the power — and the friends — to make it happen. I'll drag her before Lumia herself if I have to!"

        [pc.swornGod lumia
            |"Well, we've certainly got an in there," you say, unfurling your golden wings. "But I don't know if even Lumia can fix that personality."
            |"I'm not sure even the gods can fix that personality, Ryn."
        ]
        
        Etheryn shrugs helplessly. "Maybe. Maybe there's no helping her. Maybe without a soul the best mercy I can grant her i-is... is death. But I'll never be able to live with myself if I don't try. Despite it all, she's still my sister."
        
        [pc.isDK
            |"Do you really think she deserves a second chance, though?"
            
            "It's not... not about what she deserves, [pc.name]. It's about what's right. I wish you understood."
            
            You grunt, unconvinced. 
        ]"Do you think we can actually keep her safely? [wayfort.hasDungeon
            |In the dungeons, or...?"
    
            You think on that a moment. "We did have those built specifically to keep demons, if need be. It should be enough."
            |I... I don't know. I'm sure [viv.recruited
                |Lady Viviane
                |one of the hedge witches around the Marches
            ] can ward a prison cell, if it comes to it. We'll... we'll figure it out! I hope."
    
            Hope isn't exactly a strategy, but it's a little late for something more solid, you suppose.
        ] You'll just have to cross the Alissa bridge when you get there..."

rows.original: How does Ryn think she can help Alissa?
rows.translation: 小琳究竟认为自己该如何帮助艾莉莎呢？
rows.raw: "How does Ryn think she can help Alissa?"

rows.original: Ryn glances down at Harrick, as if searching for answers in the war bird's gold eyes. "I... I want to help my people rebuild. We, the boer'alvar, have lost so much. Not just to Alissa and Kasyrra, but over the centuries since the Godswar. Now there's barely anything left of us. A bad harvest or a sickness could end my whole race." "So... you're saying you want to grow the population?" [ryn.fucked |Etheryn's cheeks darken perceptibly. "Mmmhm. This queen needs more subjects, and... and the people will eventually demand an heir to the throne. Or five. J-just something I have to think about, once this is over." "And what does the future queen want?" you tease, letting your hand drift onto one of Ryn's [ryn.hips]. Your elven lover's blush deepens, running all the way up her ears. "W-well. As long as I have you around, I'll always be happy. [pc.hasCunt |But if a certain future consort also demanded an heir, I-I guess I'd have to oblige. Maybe several times. Just to... just to be sure." "Is that so? I heard something about five..." "Lumia says a full house is a happy house," Ryn squeaks. "I'd like us to be happy..." |I'd like to have children too, someday. Lumia says a full house is a happy house, after all. And I do want us to be happy. But we uh, you know... we'll figure something out. Servants of Lumia have a long tradition of helping couples that c-can't, uh, well..." You pat Ryn's shoulder. "I understand where this is going. We'll talk about it later, okay?" She nods. "Definitely!" ] |Ryn nods. "We have to. Lumia's blessings be upon us, but we boreal elves need to start having children if we want to survive. A-and I guess, I'm probably not excluded from that, am I?" "A kingdom needs an heir," you say. [ryn.cageNeverRemoved |"Somehow." "Alissa's soul is the key! We have a way, I just... I just need to take it back. I can hardly wait." ] Ryn sighs. "I don't want to start thinking about a consort, though. After what happened in the palace, there's not exactly a lot of... of eligible women left in the capital. You know?" "The place is a little deserted. Who's even left to choose from?" "Mmm. Well. Elthara's like a mom to me, but I guess... she'd be my first choice? She's noble born and nobler of spirit, plus beautiful beyond compare... Ah, but there's also Lady Daliza. Stern and strong, but with a good heart.[flags.XADARON_RES | Lady Hethia is kind of bitchy, but a marriage between a high-ranking druid and the queen w-would certainly improve relations. It could be exactly what we need to secure peace forever. ][var0 | Of course, I wouldn't dream of taking a woman from you, [pc.name]! If worst comes to worst, I-I can write to one of the southern kingdoms. A wyld elf princess would help foster trade, anyway. ]" She sighs, leaning against the icon. "There's more than just the people though. Alissa only ever cared about her own pleasures, a-and now they've wasted all the treasury. Everything in the kingdom was withering for decades. Infrastructure, defenses. Commerce hasn't existed in centuries, but Captain Livernon said he had high hopes for trade between us and Khor'minos again. If we can rebuild the docks[flags.XADARON_RES|, and get the druids to start blessing the land again,] we could send fruit and wine to the minotaurs... maybe ore and other materials from the Rift through there to other cities further south. Things are bad, b-but they aren't hopeless." ]
rows.translation: 小琳低头凝视着哈里克，仿佛想在那只战鸟金色的眼睛中寻找答案。“我……我想帮助我的族人重建家园。我们这些布尔阿尔瓦人失去了太多。不仅仅是因为艾莉莎和卡希拉，更是自‘神战’以来几个世纪以来我们所遭受的一切。现在，我们的族群几乎已经所剩无几了。一次糟糕的收成或一场疾病，都可能让我的整个种族灭绝。” “所以……你是说你想增加我们族群的人口数量？ [ryn.fucked |伊瑟琳的脸颊明显变红了。“嗯……这位女王需要更多的子民，而且……最终人们也会要求有一位王位继承人。或者五位吧。总之，等这一切结束后，我还需要仔细考虑一下这些事情。” “那么，未来的女王想要什么呢？”你开玩笑地问道，同时将手轻轻地放在了小琳的脸上。 [ryn.hips]你的精灵恋人脸颊的红晕愈发浓烈，一直蔓延到了她的耳根。“嗯……只要有你在我身边，我就永远都会幸福。 [pc.hasCunt |但是，如果未来的某位配偶此外既然要求必须有一个继承人，我想我只好照做吧。也许还得再生几个孩子……只是为了……只是为了确保万无一失。” “是吗？我听说要生五个……” “卢米娅说，一个家庭人丁兴旺，才会幸福美满，”小琳轻声说道，“我也希望我们能幸福…… |我也希望有自己的孩子，总有一天。毕竟，Luma说过，一个充满孩子的家才是幸福的家。而我确实希望我们能够幸福。但是，我们……你知道的，我们会想办法解决的。Luma的仆从们有着帮助那些遇到困难的夫妇的悠久传统…… 你拍了拍小琳的肩膀：“我明白你的意思。我们晚点再讨论这个，好吗？” 她点了点头：“当然！ ] |小琳点了点头。“我们必须这么做。虽然卢米娅的祝福与我们同在，但如果我们想要生存下去，极北精灵就必须开始生育后代。嗯……我想，我也不例外吧？” “一个王国需要继承人，”你说道。 [ryn.cageNeverRemoved |不知怎么的。” “艾莉莎的灵魂就是关键！我们已经有办法了，只是……我只需要把它取回来。我简直等不及了。 ] 小琳叹了口气：“不过，我真不想去考虑找伴侣的事情。经历了宫廷里发生的那些事后，首都里符合条件的合适女性已经所剩无几了，你懂我的意思吧？” “那个地方是有点冷清吧……现在还能有谁可供选择呢？” “嗯……嗯，艾尔萨拉对我来说就像妈妈一样，但我想……她应该会是我的首选吧？她出身贵族，品格更加高尚，而且美得无与伦比……啊，还有达莉莎小姐也不错。她严厉而坚强，但心地善良。[flags.XADARON_RES | 希西娅女士虽然有点刻薄，但一位高级德鲁伊与女王的婚姻肯定能够改善双方的关系。这或许正是我们实现永久和平所需要的关键。 ][var0 | 我当然不会想从你手中夺走一个女人。 [pc.name]如果情况真的变得糟糕，我……我可以写信给南方的一些王国。反正，一位野精灵公主肯定能够帮助促进贸易发展。 ]她叹了口气，靠在那个图标上说道：“不过，问题不仅仅出在这些人身上。艾莉莎从来只关心自己的享乐，而现在他们已经把所有的国库都挥霍一空了。这个王国的方方面面都已经衰败了几十年——基础设施、防御体系，甚至连商业活动都已经中断了几个世纪。但是利弗农上尉表示，他对我们与科尔米诺斯重新恢复贸易关系抱有很大的期望。如果我们能够重建那些码头的话[flags.XADARON_RES|让德鲁伊们重新开始为这片土地带来祝福吧。]我们可以把水果和葡萄酒送给弥诺陶洛斯……或许还可以通过那里把裂谷地区的矿石和其他物资运送到更南边的城市。情况很糟糕，但还不至于毫无希望。 ]

rows.translation: 当艾莉莎最终被以某种方式处理掉之后，小琳究竟想如何度过一个不再有那位老女王阴影笼罩的未来呢？
rows.raw: "When Alissa's finally dealt with, one way or the other, what does Ryn want to do with a future free of the old queen's shadows?"

rows.original:
"See you[ryn.isAnyBedmate| tonight], [pc.name]," Ryn says as you turn to leave. Harrick squawks noisily at you. 

        You step back towards the main deck.
rows.translation:
“回头见[ryn.isAnyBedmate| 今晚]，[pc.name]，”小琳在你转身离开时说道。哈里克则大声地对你叫嚷着。

        你又退回到了主甲板上。

'
        "See you[ryn.isAnyBedmate| tonight], [pc.name]," Ryn says as you turn to leave. Harrick squawks noisily at you. 

        You step back towards the main deck.'

rows.original: You head towards the stern, and the raised, canopied quarterdeck that hosts the Vigil's commanding officers. A pair of armored minoan marines stand guard at the base of the steps up, their azure cloaks thrown back over their shoulders and a pair of spears crossed between them. Above, the captain is standing tall, helmet on and plume whipping in the breeze. Both of his hands rest on the shoulders of his sorceress-wife, each palm bigger than her head, tenderly massaging her slender shoulders while her arms are outstretched to the sails and moving in esoteric gestures that marshal the winds to your backs. "Ay-ah, Champion! Let [pc.himHer] come up, men," the captain says, giving you a friendly nod when you clear your throat. The marines diligently part their spears, letting you climb up to the commander's perch with the couple. "Ay-ah, indeed. A pleasure, Champion," Juno says, eyes still affixed to the sails. "You'll forgive me if I talk and work, I hope. This is a simple spell, but sustaining it for hours is... a touch taxing, I admit." You look between the cow-girl and the billowing sails. "You going to be okay?" She gives you the faintest hint of a smile and nods. "I'm not going to hurt myself, Champion, don't worry. I've been doing this since I was fifteen years old. By Sorra's leave, I'll still be weaving the winds when I'm fifty." The captain grins and pats her shoulders affectionately. "You and I will be a pair of raisins by the time the kingdom's had done with us, love. So, Champion, what can these old sailors do for you?" Juno huffs. "We're not old, love. I'm still a beauty in her prime, and you're a perfectly aged slab of beef. So as my husband was saying: what can these fine young sailors do for you?"
rows.translation: 你朝船尾走去，登上架有顶篷的高起后甲板；守望者号的指挥官们便驻守于此。两名身披盔甲的米诺斯海军陆战队员守在台阶底部，蔚蓝斗篷向后披过肩头，两柄长矛在二人之间交叉。上方，船长戴着头盔、挺直身躯站着，盔顶羽饰在微风中翻飞。他双手搭在女术士妻子的肩上，每只手掌都比她的脑袋还大，正温柔地按摩纤细的双肩；她则朝船帆伸展双臂，做出深奥手势，调遣风力从背后推动船只。 “哎—哈，冠军！弟兄们，让[pc.himHer]上来，”你清了清喉咙，船长友好地点头说道。海军陆战队员一丝不苟地移开长矛，让你登上指挥官所处的高台，与夫妻二人会合。 “的确，哎—哈。很荣幸见到你，冠军，”朱诺说道，目光依然牢牢盯着船帆。“希望你能原谅我边工作边说话。这道法术并不复杂，但持续维持几个小时……我承认，稍微有些累人。” 你在牛女和鼓胀的船帆之间来回看了看。“你不会有事吧？” 她露出几乎难以察觉的微笑，点了点头。“我不会伤到自己，冠军，不必担心。我从十五岁开始就在做这件事。承蒙索拉恩准，到了五十岁时，我仍会继续编织风势。” 船长咧嘴一笑，亲昵地拍了拍她的肩膀。“亲爱的，等王国终于把我们用尽，我们都已经皱得像两颗葡萄干了。那么，冠军，我们这些老水手能为你做些什么？” 朱诺哼了一声。“我们才不老，亲爱的。我仍是正值盛年的美人，而你是一块熟成得恰到好处的牛肉。所以，正如我丈夫所说：我们这些年轻俊美的水手能为你做些什么？”

rows.original: "Haha, that we have, my [pc.boyGirl]," the captain laughs. "The wife and I have been in the crown's service for, oh, a touch over two decades now. I've had the honor of commanding the Vigil for twelve years, and through twice as many campaigns. Mostly against the tribes of the Sailgrave[party.has arona |, as I'm sure your she-orc friend has mentioned ]. They've been a menace to the kingdom since before Old Belhar came north and found our ancestors centuries back. Their raids make settling the coastlands an exercise in loss and frustration, but that's our main route of trade with the kingdoms of Yvennes and Claremont, not to mention half our city's food supply comes from fishing. Tsk. On the upside, there's certainly plenty of chances for a young captain to make a name for himself in the navy, where this has been the first major campaign our army's fought on land in years." "Yes, no shortage of glory," Juno says. "Unfortunately it's come at the cost of hundreds of citizens enslaved by the Kervus and other tribes, and dozens of deaths in combat." Livernon scratches the back of his head. "What can I say, I like to look on the bright side." Juno chuckles. "Ah, khaak. Er, pardon me. But yes, with the goddesses' blessings and no small amount of luck, we've had a long and successful career between us. I dare say we might have lost the coastal villages entirely by now if it weren't for my husband's skill at sea." "And my wife's sorcery," Livernon adds quickly. "For every ship my crew's taken by ram or by blade, Juno's sunk another with her spells." She smiles. "I do my part, love, but the glory goes to the captain, as it should. I am but your instrument — one you've wielded well over the years. Dare I say since the first we met, all those years ago." "Indeed," Captain Livernon chuckles. "We met, Champion, on my first deployment as executive officer on the Victoria, an old ship with a hardened crew. We were both replacements for crew lost to the Kervus tribe's raiders, who'd grown brazen as rutting bulls under the last king's reign. We were sent to patrol the southern islands, try and find a raider basecamp that the navy suspected must have been built over winter to resupply and refit their vessels." "We hadn't learned the Sailgrave Pexighasts were nomadic back then," Juno adds. "Our superiors' fault for thinking so little of our foes that they needn't understand them. They believed brute force could overcome any foe, and so flooded the archipelago with new ships and new crew to flush out the raiders." Livernon sighs. "Just so. A lot of sailors paid the price for the admirals' hubris. See, the Kervus had struck a deal with the pexighasts of the, uh..." "Kalimoor." "Kalimoor tribe. They traded pearls to the lizards in exchange for their service in repairing their vessels, using them like a mobile drydock. When we finally found a raider vessel, the captain pulled the killing blow, let it limp off — and we followed on the horizon with sails drawn up like a thief in the night, counting on it leading us to a small island base full of shipwrights. Instead, they led us into a cove where a dozen Kalimoor light ships were moored and ready. The captain barely had time to curse the gods before he took a throwing spear to the gut. Him and half the crew! Their first barrage nearly wiped us off the fighting deck." You cringe. "A dozen to one sounds a bit insurmountable without your captain." "It would have been," Juno says, "if Livernon hadn't stepped up to his duty so commendably." "And if my dear Juno here hadn't been the strongest sorceress in the fleet by far, though nobody — least of all her — knew it yet. I took command and bellowed for this young filly of an apprentice ship's mage to conjure up some kind of cover, a barrier or obscurement to blunt the attack hurtling towards us. And she did! Gods, but she did. She'd taken an arrow too by then, robes torn and bloodied, but she raised her hands and screamed in outrage and agony, and pulled the waters between us and them fifty feet high!" Juno's cheeks color. "And then I passed out, and the wave dropped... luckily, in the direction of the foe. I'm told their fleet was blasted to splinters by the deluge." "What a show it was," Livernon says, clapping a hand on his breastplate. "Gods, I wish you'd seen what you wrought, love. Thirteen ships, including a trireme at least as heavy as the Victoria was, and all sunk to the bottom of the cove. Even the tribal huts on the beach were flooded out. Ended up ruining the Kervus-Kalimoor alliance, too — the orcs turned on their lizard allies the next year, all but dismantled the tribe." "I can't say I relish the destruction as much as you, love, but I am proud to have saved the ship," Juno says. "And prouder still that it earned you your own command. Naturally, Champion, he asked that I stay with him from then on. Two years later, and we'd made that a life-long oath..." The captain smiles and curls his hands around Juno's shoulders, pulling her flush against his breastplate. "I'd not be alive without her. And, frankly, would have little reason to be anyway." "So dramatic... and you've saved me more than once, love. Tell the Champion about the time you ran through the entire city in your nightclothes, with me in your arms close to dying from Livrea tearing me apart on her way out of my belly!" Even under his facial fur, you could swear you see Livernon blushing as he laughs. "I think [pc.heShe] gets the idea, Juno. Point is, we've been together since the start, and wouldn't be anywhere without each other." [pc.isBimbo |"You two are so precious!" |Aww. ]

]几个世纪前，当老贝尔哈尔北上来到这里并发现了我们的祖先之后，这些家伙就一直对这个王国构成威胁。他们的袭击使得在沿海地区定居成为一场充满损失与挫败感的冒险，但那里却是我们与伊文尼斯王国和克莱蒙特王国进行贸易的主要通道啊。更不用说，我们城市一半的食品供应都来自于渔业。啧，不过从好的方面来看，对于一位年轻的舰长来说，海军确实提供了很多机会让他脱颖而出。毕竟，这是我们军队多年来首次在陆地上进行大规模作战。 是的，荣耀确实不少，”朱诺说道，“但不幸的是，这一切都是以数百名公民被克尔维斯族和其他部落奴役、以及数十人在战斗中丧生为代价的。” 利弗农挠了挠后脑勺：“我该怎么说呢？我总是喜欢往好的方面看。 朱诺轻笑了一声：“啊，咳，不好意思。不过说真的，多亏了女神们的庇佑，再加上一些运气，我们才能够拥有这样一段漫长而成功的职业生涯。说实话，要不是我丈夫在航海方面的本领，我们现在可能早就失去那些沿海村庄了。 还有我妻子的魔法，”利弗农迅速补充道，“每当我们的船员被撞击或刀刃所伤时，朱诺总会用她的法术击沉另一艘船。” 她微笑着说道：“我只是在尽自己的一份力，亲爱的，但荣耀终究应该属于船长。我只不过是你手中的工具——这些年来，你一直运用得非常得当。敢说，从我们第一次相遇的那一刻起，就是如此。 的确，”利弗农上尉轻笑道，“我们是在我第一次担任执行官被派往那里的时候相识的，冠军。维多利亚那是一艘老旧的船只，船上的船员们都已经习惯了艰苦的环境。我们俩都是为了补充那些在凯尔维斯部落的袭击者手中丧生的船员而被派上这艘船的。在上一任国王的统治期间，那些袭击者的胆量变得越来越大，简直就像发情的公牛一样凶残。我们的任务是前往南部岛屿进行巡逻，试图找到海军怀疑那些袭击者一定在冬季建立的基地营地，以便他们能够补充物资并修理他们的船只。 当时我们还不知道Sailgrave Pexighasts其实是游牧民族，”朱诺补充道，“这是我们上级的错——他们太轻视我们的敌人，认为根本没有必要了解他们。他们坚信武力可以战胜一切敌人，于是派出大量新舰船和新船员，试图将那些掠夺者赶出这个群岛。 利弗农叹了口气：“就是这样。许多水手部都为那些海军将领的傲慢付出了代价。你看，‘克尔维斯号’其实是与‘卡利穆尔部落’的那些人达成了交易……” “卡利穆尔部落。” “他们用珍珠来换取那些生物的帮助，让这些生物帮忙修理他们的船只，把这些生物当作移动的船坞来使用。当我们终于找到那艘袭击者的船只时，船长发起了致命一击，使其失去行动能力——然后我们便像夜色中的小偷一样收起了船帆，紧随其后。我们相信，那艘船会带领我们前往一个拥有许多造船匠的小岛基地。相反，他们把我们引到了一个海湾，在那里有十几艘卡利穆尔轻型舰艇已经停泊好，随时准备行动。船长还没来得及咒骂那些神明，就被一支投掷矛刺中了腹部。他和一半的船员都死了！他们的第一波攻击几乎把我们所有人都从战斗甲板上击落。" 你不禁感到一阵尴尬。“如果没有你们的队长，‘十二比一’这个悬殊的差距听起来确实似乎无法克服。” “确实会这样，”朱诺说道，“如果利弗农没有如此出色地履行他的职责的话。” “当然，也要感谢我亲爱的朱诺——她其实是这支舰队中最强大的女巫，只不过目前还没有人知道这一点，尤其是她自己。我立刻接管了指挥权，大声命令这位年轻的女学徒法师立刻制造出某种屏障或遮挡物，来削弱朝我们袭来的攻击。她真的做到了！天啊，她真的做到了。那时她也已经中了一箭，长袍被撕裂，身上满是鲜血，但她依然举起双手，既愤怒又痛苦地尖叫着，然后将我们与敌人之间的水域抬高了五十英尺！" 朱诺的脸颊顿时红了。“然后我就昏了过去，海浪也消退了……幸运的是，它朝着敌人的方向去了。听说他们的舰队被那股巨浪彻底摧毁了。” “真是场惊心动魄的场面啊，”利弗农拍了拍自己的胸甲说道，“天啊，真希望你能亲眼看到自己造成的后果，亲爱的。有十三艘船被毁了，其中还包括一艘重量不亚于…… 维多利亚一切都沉入了海湾的下装，就连海滩上的部落小屋也被淹没了。这场灾难最终也破坏了凯尔维斯与卡利穆尔的联盟——第二年，兽人背叛了他们的蜥蜴人盟友，导致那个部落几乎彻底瓦解。我必须承认，我并没有你那么享受这种破坏带来的快感，亲爱的，但我为自己成功拯救了那艘船而感到自豪。更让我骄傲的是，这艘船让你获得了自己的指挥权。当然，冠军他当时请求我从那以后一直留在他身边。”朱诺说道。两年后，我们将其变成了终身恪守的誓言…… 船长微笑着，将双手搭在朱诺的肩上，将她紧紧拉向自己的胸甲。“没有她，我根本就不会活着。说实话，没有她，我活着也没有任何意义。真是太戏剧性了……而且你不止一次救了我，亲爱的。告诉冠军吧，那次你穿着睡衣带着我穿过整个城市，而那时莉维娅正在我的肚子里撕扯我，我差点就死了！即使在他面部的毛发遮盖下，你也会觉得利弗农在笑的时候脸一定红了。“我想[pc.heShe]明白我的意思了吧，朱诺。关键在于，我们从一开始就在一起，没有彼此，我们就什么都不是。 [pc.isBimbo |你们两个真是太珍贵了！ |哎呀。 ]
rows.raw: ' "Haha, that we have, my [pc.boyGirl]," the captain laughs. "The wife and I have been in the crown's service for, oh, a touch over two decades now. I've had the honor of commanding the Vigil for twelve years, and through twice as many campaigns. Mostly against the tribes of the Sailgrave[party.has arona |, as I'm sure your she-orc friend has mentioned ]. They've been a menace to the kingdom since before Old Belhar came north and found our ancestors centuries back. Their raids make settling the coastlands an exercise in loss and frustration, but that's our main route of trade with the kingdoms of Yvennes and Claremont, not to mention half our city's food supply comes from fishing. Tsk. On the upside, there's certainly plenty of chances for a young captain to make a name for himself in the navy, where this has been the first major campaign our army's fought on land in years." "Yes, no shortage of glory," Juno says. "Unfortunately it's come at the cost of hundreds of citizens enslaved by the Kervus and other tribes, and dozens of deaths in combat." Livernon scratches the back of his head. "What can I say, I like to look on the bright side." Juno chuckles. "Ah, khaak. Er, pardon me. But yes, with the goddesses' blessings and no small amount of luck, we've had a long and successful career between us. I dare say we might have lost the coastal villages entirely by now if it weren't for my husband's skill at sea." "And my wife's sorcery," Livernon adds quickly. "For every ship my crew's taken by ram or by blade, Juno's sunk another with her spells." She smiles. "I do my part, love, but the glory goes to the captain, as it should. I am but your instrument — one you've wielded well over the years. Dare I say since the first we met, all those years ago." "Indeed," Captain Livernon chuckles. "We met, Champion, on my first deployment as executive officer on the Victoria, an old ship with a hardened crew. We were both replacements for crew lost to the Kervus tribe's raiders, who'd grown brazen as rutting bulls under the last king's reign. We were sent to patrol the southern islands, try and find a raider basecamp that the navy suspected must have been built over winter to resupply and refit their vessels." "We hadn't learned the Sailgrave Pexighasts were nomadic back then," Juno adds. "Our superiors' fault for thinking so little of our foes that they needn't understand them. They believed brute force could overcome any foe, and so flooded the archipelago with new ships and new crew to flush out the raiders." Livernon sighs. "Just so. A lot of sailors paid the price for the admirals' hubris. See, the Kervus had struck a deal with the pexighasts of the, uh..." "Kalimoor." "Kalimoor tribe. They traded pearls to the lizards in exchange for their service in repairing their vessels, using them like a mobile drydock. When we finally found a raider vessel, the captain pulled the killing blow, let it limp off — and we followed on the horizon with sails drawn up like a thief in the night, counting on it leading us to a small island base full of shipwrights. Instead, they led us into a cove where a dozen Kalimoor light ships were moored and ready. The captain barely had time to curse the gods before he took a throwing spear to the gut. Him and half the crew! Their first barrage nearly wiped us off the fighting deck." You cringe. "A dozen to one sounds a bit insurmountable without your captain." "It would have been," Juno says, "if Livernon hadn't stepped up to his duty so commendably." "And if my dear Juno here hadn't been the strongest sorceress in the fleet by far, though nobody — least of all her — knew it yet. I took command and bellowed for this young filly of an apprentice ship's mage to conjure up some kind of cover, a barrier or obscurement to blunt the attack hurtling towards us. And she did! Gods, but she did. She'd taken an arrow too by then, robes torn and bloodied, but she raised her hands and screamed in outrage and agony, and pulled the waters between us and them fifty feet high!" Juno's cheeks color. "And then I passed out, and the wave dropped... luckily, in the direction of the foe. I'm told their fleet was blasted to splinters by the deluge." "What a show it was," Livernon says, clapping a hand on his breastplate. "Gods, I wish you'd seen what you wrought, love. Thirteen ships, including a trireme at least as heavy as the Victoria was, and all sunk to the bottom of the cove. Even the tribal huts on the beach were flooded out. Ended up ruining the Kervus-Kalimoor alliance, too — the orcs turned on their lizard allies the next year, all but dismantled the tribe." "I can't say I relish the destruction as much as you, love, but I am proud to have saved the ship," Juno says. "And prouder still that it earned you your own command. Naturally, Champion, he asked that I stay with him from then on. Two years later, and we'd made that a life-long oath..." The captain smiles and curls his hands around Juno's shoulders, pulling her flush against his breastplate. "I'd not be alive without her. And, frankly, would have little reason to be anyway." "So dramatic... and you've saved me more than once, love. Tell the Champion about the time you ran through the entire city in your nightclothes, with me in your arms close to dying from Livrea tearing me apart on her way out of my belly!" Even under his facial fur, you could swear you see Livernon blushing as he laughs. "I think [pc.heShe] gets the idea, Juno. Point is, we've been together since the start, and wouldn't be anywhere without each other." [pc.isBimbo |"You two are so precious!" |Aww. ]'

rows.original:
"Ah, of course. I understand you don't have much of a navy inside the Marches; I doubt you'd be familiar with my work," Juno says. "By trade, I'm a ship's mage — a sorceress trained specifically to marshal wind and water magic to help the vessels I'm assigned to. Most of my fellow magi merely blow wind into their ships' sails and raise mists and fog to obscure their vessels in combat; some learn to call lightning or fire to aid their crews in battle."
        
        "Seems that you take that a little further," you say. 
        
        She answers with a shrug, bovine tail flicking between her husband's thighs. "My father was a northern minotaur, an outcast from his tribe, who came south when he was about your age and joined the Royal Auxiliary as a warmage. War-shaman, really. I suppose you could say I had something of a head start in my craft, compared to other mages who first pick up spellcasting in school, but really... I'm not as special as my husband makes me out to be. A bit of Sorra's favor and a lot of hard work, that's all. Father taught me spellcraft near enough to teaching me to walk, so I could secure a job such as this, and a better life than he had led. I devoted nearly every hour of my life growing up to the study of magic or naval doctrine, and... that labor and sacrifice was rewarded by good postings and good tidings in the field! There's no secret to it."
        
        Livernon shakes his head. "She's too modest, my wife. The woman is a prodigy the likes of which we haven't seen since Estelore. She worked herself to the bone when we were younger, aye, but taking years off the waves to be a mother and a city councilwoman hardly blunted her edge. If anything, her power's proven to be a fine wine, sharpening with age." 
        
        "Ugh, you sound like the king," Juno groans. "If anything, a year spent browbeating Kelsaz's court into refunding the navy was the best practice I've ever had with lightning magic. And children love being bounced on the wind..."
        
        "Until they get sick all over you, anyway," the captain chuckles. When Juno blanches, he claps her shoulders hard enough to stagger her. "And anyway, you'll never convince me you aren't a damned favorite of the Storm Maiden's. Sorra's put the wind in your sails since our first voyage, and that's a fact. Not to say you don't work for it — you do! — but so do your apprentices, and look where they are."
        
        Juno frowns. "My girls have a lot of talent, Vernon. They're young and inexperienced; I had no idea what I was capable of until my first battle either. Gods willing, though, these demons keep the brunt of the war to the land and my apprentices need never test themselves in combat. Aha, we're getting carried away, though. Champion, if you'd like a demonstration of my spellcraft in earnest, I'd be happy to give it once we're on the open sea. [pc.isMage
            |At a glance, I'd guess you'd benefit from a more thorough lesson, but I didn't bring much in the way of study material with me. I can teach you a few things, though.
            |You don't strike me as a devoted student of the arcane, but I can certainly put on a good show. I swear, that's mostly what Kelsaz kept me around for when I was back home...
        ]"

“啊，当然。我明白在边境地区，你们的海军力量并不强大；想必你们也不太了解我的工作，”朱诺说道。“我的职业是舰船法师——一位专门学习如何运用风与水魔法来辅助所负责船只的女术士。我的大多数同行只是把风灌进船帆，或者在战斗中升起迷雾来遮蔽船只；有些人则学会召唤闪电或火焰来协助船员作战。”
        
        “看来你在这条路上走得更远一些，”你说。 
        
        她耸了耸肩，牛尾巴在丈夫的两腿间晃来晃去，然后回答道：“我父亲是个北方的弥诺陶洛斯，一个被部落驱逐的弃民；他在你这个年纪来到南方，加入了皇家辅助军，成为一名战法师。其实是战萨满。比起那些在学校里才开始学习施法的法师，我可以说在自己的技艺上有了一些先发优势，但说真的……我并没有我丈夫说的那么特别。不过是沾了点索拉的恩泽，再加上大量的苦功，仅此而已。父亲教我法术，几乎就像教我走路一样，好让我能谋到这样一份差事，过上比他更好的生活。我成长过程中几乎每一个小时都用在研究魔法或海军战术上，而……那些辛劳与牺牲换来了好的派驻和战场上的好消息！这里面没有什么秘密。”
        
        利弗农摇了摇头。“我妻子太谦虚了。她这样的天才，自从埃斯托洛尔之后我们就再没见过了。我们年轻时她确实拼命用功，没错，但为了当母亲和市议会议员而离开海浪数年，丝毫没有磨钝她的锋芒。要说的话，她的力量就像上好的葡萄酒，越陈越醇。” 
        
        “呃，你说话的样子简直就像个国王一样，”朱诺抱怨道。“说实话，花了一年时间去威逼凯尔萨兹的宫廷退还那笔海军经费，才是我用闪电魔法做过的最好的练习。而且孩子们喜欢被风吹得上下弹跳……”
        
        “不过，孩子们总归会吐你一身，”船长笑着说。当朱诺脸色发白时，他用力拍了拍她的肩膀，拍得她一个踉跄。“而且，你永远也说服不了我，你不是风暴少女的特别宠儿。从我们第一次启航以来，索拉就在往你的帆里送风，这是事实。并不是说你没有为此付出努力——你确实付出了！——但你的学徒们也同样努力，看看他们现在到了什么地步。”
        
        朱诺皱起了眉头。“我的姑娘们很有天赋，弗农。她们年轻、缺乏经验；在我打第一场仗之前，我也不知道自己能有什么本事。不过，但愿这些恶魔把战争的主要冲击都留在陆地上，这样我的学徒们就永远不必在战斗中考验自己了。啊，不过我们扯远了。冠军，如果你想认真见识一下我的法术，等我们到了公海上，我很乐意演示一番。 [pc.isMage
            |乍一看，我觉得你可能需要上一堂更全面的课，但我身上并没有带太多学习资料。不过，我还是可以教你一些东西的。
            |你给人的感觉并不像是一个热衷于钻研奥术的学生，但我当然能演一出好戏。我发誓，当初还在家乡的时候，凯尔萨兹把我留在身边，多半就是为了这个……
        ]”
