rows.original:
"Ah, Dracia. A place out of legend, that," Livernon answers with a stroke of his chin. "I can't say anyone I know has ever set foot there — you hear all sorts of stories about that place, haunted by the ghosts of dead dragons, some say — but the history of it's well known in these parts. Settled by the elves before Belhar had expanded this far north, and the bluefolk made pacts with dragons to protect them against the depredations of the orcs and other raider-folk of the Sailgraves. Dracia itself is the northernmost reach of the archipelago, and the largest island twice over at least. You can see its seawalls from leagues away, always glistening with hoarfrost. Legends go that in the old days, before the old empires crumbled, you could see dragons sunning themselves atop the battlements!"

        "Sounds like a fairy tale," Juno says. "Or elven propaganda to discourage raiders from attacking them."
        
        [ashe.around
            |"It's really not!" Ashe huffs in your mind.
        ]
        
        Livernon waves a hand dismissively. "Don't be such a realist, love, have a little fun with it. Who knows — [pc.name] and the Lady-Regent might find a mausoleum full of dragon bones on the island! Don't want to let these inlanders finally be the ones to prove you can be wrong, do you?"
        
        "I didn't say there were no dragons on Dracia. Just that it sounds unlikely to be as the legends state. Though... somehow the boreal elves of all people managed to fight the Belharan Empire to a standstill. I suppose dragon-riding knights would certainly balance the odds against the greatest empire the world's ever known." Juno shrugs. "Either way, nothing you should be worried about, Champion. There've been no dragons in the Sailgraves for centuries. It is true, though, that folk say Dracia is haunted — that sleeping near the island provokes nightmares, and hallucinations of fire on the battlements. Keep your head clear and your wits about you once we make landfall. I don't want to have to come ashore to rescue you."
        
        "Those sea walls will make any kind of support difficult from the sea," the captain adds. "We won't be able to shoot over them, and they block line of sight for Juno's spells. Unless you get up into that huge tower that juts up from the middle of the keep, we probably won't even be able to see a signal once you're inside. Our troops will keep the docks, or whatever passes for them in the state that castle's in, secure — but we won't be much help once you're in there."
        
        Juno gives you a wink. "That's why we're bringing a Champion with us, love. I'm sure [pc.heShe] can handle a few demons without breaking a sweat."
rows.translation:
啊，达拉西亚……一个传说中的地方，”利弗农摸了摸下巴说道，“我认识的人中，应该没有谁真正去过那里。关于那个地方，人们流传着各种各样的故事——有人说那里有死去巨龙的鬼魂出没……不过，它的历史在这片地区是众所周知的。在贝尔哈尔向北扩张之前，这里就已经被精灵们定居了。蓝族人与巨龙签订了契约，以此来保护自己免受兽人以及其他掠夺者的侵扰。达拉西亚岛是这个群岛中最北端的岛屿，其面积也是所有岛屿中最大的。几里之外就能看到它的海堤，上面总是覆盖着霜冻，闪闪发光。传说在古老帝国尚未覆灭的那些日子里，人们甚至能在城墙上看到龙在晒太阳呢！

        “听起来就像童话故事一样，”朱诺说道。或者是精灵们的宣传手段，用来阻止掠夺者对他们发动攻击。
        
        [ashe.around
            |真的不是这样！”艾希在你的脑海中愤愤不平地说道。
        ]
        
        利弗农漫不经心地挥了挥手：“别这么现实主义了，亲爱的，就开心地玩一玩吧。谁知道呢[pc.name]而且摄政王夫人可能会在岛上发现一座堆满龙骨的陵墓！你总不会想让这些内陆人最终证明你是错的吧？”
        
        “我并没有说过达拉西亚岛上没有龙。只不过，这听起来似乎不太可能像传说中描述的那样。不过……不知怎么的，那些生活在北方森林中的精灵们竟然成功地将贝拉兰帝国逼入了僵局。我想，那些会骑龙的骑士们，肯定能够改变这个世界有史以来最强大的帝国与他们之间的力量平衡。朱诺耸了耸肩，说道：‘不管怎样，你都没有必要担心，冠军。几个世纪以来，帆葬海岸地区再也没有出现过龙。不过，确实有人传说达拉西亚岛上有鬼魂出没——据说在岛附近睡觉会让人做噩梦，还会在城墙上看到火光幻象。等我们登陆后，一定要保持头脑清醒，机智应对。我可不想非得上岸去救你才行。
        
        那些海墙会使得从海上提供任何形式的支援变得极为困难，”船长补充道，“我们无法从那些墙后面进行射击，而且它们也会阻挡‘朱诺’法术的攻击范围。除非你们登上那座从城堡中央耸立起来的高塔，否则一旦你们进入塔内，我们很可能根本无法看到任何信号。我们的部队会负责守住码头——或者说，在那座城堡目前的状况下，那些勉强还能被称为码头的设施——但一旦你们进入塔内，我们就几乎无法提供任何帮助了。
        
        朱诺向你眨了眨眼：“这就是为什么我们要带一位冠军一起来，亲爱的。我相信[pc.heShe]应付几个小麻烦根本不在话下。

rows.original: Do the pair know anything about the island you're headed to?
rows.translation: 这对搭档是否了解你即将前往的那个岛屿的任何情况呢？
rows.raw: "Do the pair know anything about the island you're headed to?"

rows.original:
Livernon sighs, draping his arms entirely over Juno's shoulders. "Truth be, Champion, I'm thankful for this mission. The demons have barely any sea presence to speak of, but we've been forbidden from abandoning the ships to help fight on land — in other words, we've spent the whole siege up until now with our thumbs up-"

        "We've been idle and underused," his wife says, leaning back against her man. "The navy can't fight in the tunnel-rivers, and all but our smallest ships are too big to fit into the mountain anyway. So the last little while has been spent in impotent frustration, unable to stand to the defense of our city."
        
        "Indeed," Livernon says heavily, ruffling Juno's golden hair. "When I heard even [livrea.fucked
            |little Livrea
            |our youngest child
        ] had returned from her adventures to help the city's defense, I even petitioned the king — told him I would organize the royal marines into a ground force to fight! But he refused every offer. Even told me that if I resigned my commission to get around the orders, he'd have me sent to the mines. Bah!"
        
        Juno pats his arm. "Easy, love. Easy. We all have our duties to perform, and we must trust our monarch to see the bigger picture where we cannot. After all, if we were caught up in a ground skirmish now, we wouldn't be able to help Etheryn and her Champion today." 
        
        "Aye, aye... pardon my frustration, Champion. The whole situation has us all on edge, you can imagine. Knowing my children and grandchildren are in the city while we're away isn't much better than being docked at the harbor. At least what we're doing here has a chance of making a difference in the war."
        
        "Every difference matters," Juno says. "The gods preserve our great kingdom... but we'll do our part, too."
rows.translation:
利弗农叹了口气，将双臂完全搭在朱诺肩上。“说实话，冠军，我很感激这次任务。恶魔几乎没有值得一提的海上力量，可我们又被严令不得抛下船只、支援陆地作战——换句话说，直到现在，整场围城期间我们都只能闲得把拇指塞进——”

        “我们一直无所事事，也没有得到充分利用，”他的妻子说道，向后靠进自己的男人怀中。“海军无法在山腹隧河中作战；除了最小型的船只，其余舰船甚至大得无法驶入山中。所以近来我们只能在无力的挫败感中度日，无法挺身保卫自己的城市。”
        
        “没错，”利弗农沉声说道，揉乱朱诺的金发。“当我听说就连[livrea.fucked
            |小莉维娅
            |我们最年幼的孩子
        ]都结束冒险回来协助守城时，我甚至向国王请愿——告诉他，我愿意把皇家海军陆战队组织成地面部队投入战斗！但每一项提议都被他拒绝了。他甚至说，要是我辞去军职、试图规避命令，就把我送进矿井。呸！”
        
        朱诺拍了拍他的手臂。“放轻松，亲爱的，放轻松。我们都有职责需要履行；凡是我们看不清全貌的地方，都必须相信君主的判断。毕竟，要是此刻我们正陷在地面小规模战斗里，今天就没法帮助伊瑟琳和她的冠军了。”
        
        “是，是……请原谅我的牢骚，冠军。你应该能想象，整个局势让我们所有人都神经紧绷。明知儿女和孙辈都在城里，我们却远离他们，这不比停泊在港口好受多少。至少，我们在这里做的事情有机会改变战局。”
        
        “每一点改变都很重要，”朱诺说道。“愿诸神护佑我们伟大的王国……但我们也会尽自己的一份力。”

rows.original: "Ah, yes," Livernon laughs. "You can't imagine how shocked we were when little Livrea's letters mentioned your, ah, shared affection.[livrea.isMom | And then [livrea.numKids 1 2|a child|children]! Gods damn this war for what it's made us miss!" Juno has to stroke his arm several times before the captain's composed enough to continue. " | ]And to think, with the Champion of Frost no less — the famed hero of Lady Calise's, and deposer of the Demon Queen of the North. Well, our little girl certainly knows how to pick 'em." His wife nods. "I always used to tease Livrea that she needn't go out on these grand adventures to meet a[pc.mf | man |nother woman ]. A shame it took a siege of the city to prove me right, but I'm glad something pleasant's come of this conflict regardless." "As am I," you say. "Your daughter's incredibly charming. Brave, too, coming back to the city like she did." Juno chuckles and pokes her husband's stomach with an elbow between magical gestures. "Imagine where she gets that from." "Ha! Come, love, she clearly takes after you with that mighty brain and boundless beauty. Not to mention excellent taste in partners." You grin. "I can certainly see where Livrea gets that affectionate side. You two are about the sweetest couple I've ever seen." The captain beams and pats his wife's head. "Comes from half a lifetime spent pulling each other's asses out of the fire of battle. I don't know if I believe in love at first sight; a love built up over time and shared trials though? That, I'd bet my life on any day." "Hopefully something our Livrea will get to experience herself," the sorceress says with a wink. The captain chuckles and claps your shoulder. "She is very fond of you, [pc.name]. All this time plying the bard's trade and I've never seen her so excited about anything she's written as the first few stanzas of your epic she's started penning." Your brow arches. "Oh, she has... and sent it to you? Can I see?" "Ohhhh no," Juno giggles. "Livrea would never forgive us. But it paints you as a [pc.dcb |dark and tragic [pc.class] torn between honor and the quest for power. Very compelling! |a true Champion, a paragon of justice and righteousness. It's all very flattering — and from what I've seen, she's got a good eye for character. |fun-loving quixotic hero. Though I think she might be trying to paint you a little... more canny than perhaps is warranted. She certainly has your mannerisms down pat, though. I could tell right off you were a good soul from her verse. ]" [livrea.isMom |A moment passes with Juno silently bending her magics before she finally adds, "I am quite annoyed that you've both gone and had [livrea.numKids 1 2|a child|children] — not just because we weren't there, but because of this siege. I can't imagine the courage, or perhaps foolishness, of our daughter bringing a child into this world knowing what's going on around her. Still..." she sighs. "Still. I'm happy for you. We both are." Livernon nods. "Not the first time we've suddenly become grandparents, and I doubt it'll be the last. But as long as you and Livrea are happy, then so are we. I can't wait to meet our little grand-cal[livrea.numKids 1 2|f|ves]!" "Me neither," Juno says, bringing another of her radiant smiles to bear on you. "Plus, now I can brag to all my friends that I'm blood kin to the Champion of Frost. Nieves will be so jealous!" The two of them break out laughing, followed shortly by yourself. |Juno leans back against her husband, silently weaving her magics for a moment before adding. "Sooooo... [pc.hasRealCock |grandbabies when, oh Champion?" |just how serious are you two, anyway? Do we need to start looking at alchemy, or perhaps adoptions, for grandbabies...?" ] [pc.dcb |"Damn, you two are wasting no time with the nagging, huh?" |You just about spit. "Wha?" |You blink in confusion. "Grandbabies...? Oh! Grandparent, grandbaby, duh! Heheh, whenever she wants!" ] The two of them break out laughing. "Relax!" the captain grins. "Juno!" ] Livernon runs a hand through his muss of red hair under his helm, shaking his head between bouts of laughter. "Anyway, it's good to get to spend a couple days with our Livrea's [pc.mf |beau |very first girlfriend ]. Gives us a chance to get to know each other." You nod. "Sure. Sounds like a plan." [pc.mf |"Great, Champ. Maybe tomorrow morning you and I'll cast a line out over the side and see if we can haul in some fish." Juno's eyes roll. "As long as you don't start singing the 'women want me, fish fear me' song. I hate that." "It is factually accurate, at least," Livernon says, grinning wide. |Juno beams. "Great! rows.original:
Daliza nods along as you ask your question, glancing seaward. "A fair question. My family and their retainers settled the island some eight hundred years ago. My ancestors were determined to carve out a realm of their own, and believe it or not, back then the population of the kingdom was so great that the only way to expand was south towards the Belharan lands or seaward. While our race is well accustomed to the snow and ice, Dracia was our first attempt to settle a land of saltwater and storms, at the very edge of sight from the coast. My ancestors built great ships to carry them to the horizon, them and all their kin and thralls and the supplies that would be needed to make a new home. They were shocked to find the island already inhabited, of course."

        "Oh? Had your people never encountered orcs before?"
        
        "Orcs?" She shakes her head. "No, [pc.name], what my ancestors found on that island was a great temple. A single structure of solid stone, buried half beneath the dirt. The legend goes that there was a single person living there when the first longship beached itself, and my ancestor — the future Jarl of Dracia, then just Thane Eldred — stepped ashore. It was a woman, slender as a reed, nude save for a small sword at her hip. When Eldred told her he and his kin meant to settle the island, she smiled and told him that he was welcome to become her vassal; there was room enough for the elves, if he would but kneel."
        
        [ashe.around
            |Ashe whispers into your mind, "Dracia was home to one of dragonkind's most sacred sites. A burial ground for our honored dead from the giant wars. It was customary for a dragon to always stand vigil over it. Until the elves arrived, it was a lonely duty indeed."
        ]
        
        "I take it she was more than just a naked island girl."
        
        Daliza nods, a smirk spreading across her rose-painted lips. "Indeed. Eldred, though, was far less perceptive. He said he knelt as vassal before no woman but the elvenqueen; the girl said, then, that he and his kin must leave, for she wouldn't have her lands encroached on by any but her kin or her vassals. Eldred, the story goes, said that he would go nowhere: he had sacrificed his fortune and staked the lives of his clan to sail to this mysterious island, and no nameless waif would chase him away. The impasse lingered until finally he bade the girl draw her sword and, by the old ways, prove her claim."
        
        "So they fought. The legend says for three days and three nights, but I'm certain it was more like three strikes," Daliza chuckles. "No matter which way you choose to believe, the naked girl was a match for the lord stroke for stroke, giving no ground to a man head and shoulders taller, and near twice as broad. But he was a skilled fighter, and offered no chance for her to land a blow of her own. The battle drew on until finally the girl grew tired of the game, and with a roar that shook the heavens, transformed into a great and terrible dragon with scales the color of the open sea. She battered the blade from Eldred's hands and with a great claw threw the elf-lord to the ground, pinning him between talons sharp as spears. She told him again, 'Though you fight most impressively, I will still not share my sacred domain with those that are neither vassal nor kin. Kneel before me, or flee back home and tell your kind never again to disturb my island.'"
        
        "What did he do?" you ask.
        
        That just brings Daliza's smile back all the broader. "He knelt. But not as a vassal. When she released him, Thane Eldred took a knee before the towering she-dragon and produced from beneath his breastplate a ring, given him by his mother to present to the woman that would win his heart. He said, 'I kneel as vassal before none but the elvenqueen. But I will kneel before a woman of such majesty and beg her be my bride.' And she, of course, did not deny him. Thus my house became kin to dragons, and were given leave to settle Dracia."
        
        You blink. "So does that mean you have dragon blood, Daliza?"
        
        She answers with a casual shrug. "It could. Jarl Eldred already had several concubines when he arrived, and many children during his life. Truth be told, I don't know which bloodline I descend from. Of course, dragons married back into the clan more than once over the years. We required strength to survive, and dragons have plenty to spare."
        
        "You see, Dracia is the northernmost reach of the Sailgrave Archipelago, far from the boer'alvar heartland, so keeping the new settlement safe from orcish marauders and siorcanna shore-raiders necessitated strong lords and stronger allies. The skill at arms of my ancestors — and indeed all the warriors of Dracia — was legendary, and we were the first the kings and queens of the realm would call upon to lead warhosts against Old Belhar or the monsters of the Northern Rift. Still, a few dozen trained armsmen cannot protect an island of Dracia's size by sheer determination, so great stone seawalls were constructed to make landings impossible outside the docks, and towers raised to the heavens to spot enemy ships from afar."
        
        The bailiff sighs wistfully. "I have only ever heard stories of the great Cloudreach Tower, but I am assured that it earned the name. Wizards from the great Belharan academy of Estelore, once Njorhaalt and Belhar had made peace, came to study and practice there, benefitting from the tutelage of our house's draconic bondmates. And when war came to our shores, the Jarls of Dracia could call upon those ancient bonds and fly into battle on dragonback. Gods, what I wouldn't give just to see such a thing with my own eyes, even just once..."
rows.translation:
当你提出这个问题时，达莉莎点了点头，同时望向大海方向。“问得不错。我的家族以及他们的随从大约在八百年前来到了这个岛上。我的祖先们决心在这里建立属于自己的领地。信不信由你，那时候这个王国的疆域已经非常广阔了，要想继续扩张，唯一的途径就是向南进入贝尔哈兰地区，或者向海方向发展。虽然我们人类早已习惯了冰雪环境，但达拉西亚才是我们首次尝试在一片以咸水和风暴为特征的土地上建立定居点的地方——那片土地位于海岸线的最边缘，几乎看不见陆地本身。我的祖先们建造了巨大的船只，将这些人们、他们的亲族、奴仆，以及建立新家园所需的一切物资，都运到了那里。他们发现这个岛上已经有人居住，自然感到非常震惊。”

        “哦？你们的族人以前从未遇到过兽人吗？”
        
        “兽人？”她摇了摇头，“没有。 [pc.name]，我的祖先在那个岛上发现了一座宏伟的寺庙。那是一座由整块石头建造而成的建筑，有一半埋在泥土之下。传说中，当第一艘长船搁浅在那里时，岛上只有一个人居住着，而我的祖先——未来的达拉西亚伯爵，当时还只是埃尔德雷德领主——便走上了那片陆地。那是一位身形纤细如芦苇的女性，除腰间佩着一把小剑外，全身赤裸。当埃尔德雷德告诉她自己和族人打算在这座岛上定居时，她微笑着表示欢迎他成为自己的附庸；只要埃尔德雷德愿意屈膝臣服，这片岛上完全有足够的空间容纳这些精灵。"
        
        [ashe.around
            |阿什在你心中低语道：“达拉西亚曾是龙族最神圣的圣地之一。那里是我们为在那些伟大战争中牺牲的英雄们设立的陵墓。按照传统，总会有龙守卫在那里。直到精灵们到来之前，这份职责确实是一份孤独而漫长的使命。
        ]
        
        我猜，她绝对不只是一个普通的裸体岛民女孩。”
        
        达莉莎点了点头，玫瑰色嘴唇上浮现出一丝微笑：“确实如此。不过埃尔德雷德却完全没有察觉到这一点。他说，除了精灵女王之外，他从未以臣子的身份向任何女性跪拜过；而那个女孩则告诉他，他和他的族人必须离开，因为她不会允许除了自己的族人或臣子之外，有任何其他人侵占她的土地。据说，埃尔德雷德宣称自己不会离开：他牺牲了自己的财产，甚至拿整个族人的性命作为赌注，才得以驶向这个神秘的岛屿，因此没有任何无名小卒能够将他赶走。这种僵局持续了很久，直到最后他命令那个女孩拔出她的剑，按照古老的传统来证明自己的身份和权利。"
        
        于是他们展开了战斗。传说这场战斗持续了三天三夜，但实际上恐怕更像是三场激烈的交锋罢了，”达莉莎轻笑道。“无论你选择相信哪种说法，那个裸体女孩确实与那位领主展开了势均力敌的战斗——她没有给这个比她高出一头、体型几乎是她两倍的男人任何机会。但他是一名技艺高超的战士，根本不给她任何机会还手部。这场战斗持续了很久，直到最后，那个女孩终于对这场“游戏”感到厌倦了。随着一声震天响亮的咆哮，她化作了一条身披蔚蓝鳞片、庞大而可怕的巨龙。她将埃尔德雷德手中的剑柄猛地打落，然后用那双锋利如长矛的爪子将这位精灵领主重重摔在地上，将其牢牢按在爪下。她再次对他说：“尽管你的战斗技巧确实令人印象深刻，但我仍然不会将我的神圣领地让给那些既非我的附庸也不是我的亲族的人。要么跪在我面前，要么滚回你们的家乡，告诉你们的族人永远不要再打扰我的岛屿。
        
        他做了什么？”你问道。
        
        这反而让达莉莎的笑容更加灿烂了。“他跪了下来。但并不是以臣子的身份。当她放他走的时候，塞恩·埃尔德雷德在那头高大的雌龙面前跪了下来，然后从他的胸甲下面取出一枚戒指——这枚戒指是他母亲送给他的，让他用来送给那个能赢得他心的女人。他说：“除了精灵女王之外，我绝不向任何人屈膝称臣。但面对如此尊贵的女性，我愿意跪下恳求她成为我的新娘。”而她，自然没有拒绝他。就这样，我的家族与龙族建立了联系，也被允许在达拉西亚定居下来。"
        
        你眨了眨眼：“那么，这是否意味着你拥有龙之血脉，达莉莎？”
        
        她随意地耸了耸肩：“也有可能吧。埃尔德雷德领主刚来到这里的时候就已经有好几位妾室了，他在有生之年也育了很多孩子。说实话，我并不知道自己究竟属于哪个血脉。当然，这些年来龙族也曾多次与其他氏族通婚。为了生存，我们需要强大的力量，而龙族显然拥有足够的实力。
        
        您看，达拉西亚是赛尔格雷夫群岛最北端的地区，距离布尔阿尔瓦尔的中心地带相当遥远。因此，要想保护这个新建立的定居点免受兽人掠夺者的侵扰以及西奥卡纳海岸劫掠者的袭击，就必须拥有强大的领主和更强大的盟友。我的祖先们——事实上，整个达拉西亚的所有战士们——的武艺都是传奇般的。每当这个王国的国王和王后们需要派遣军队去对抗老贝尔哈尔或者北方裂谷的怪物们时，我们总是第一个被征召来带领军队的人选。然而，仅仅依靠几十名训练有素的武装人员，是无法凭借坚定的意志来保护像达拉西亚这样大的岛屿的。因此，人们建造了高大的石砌海堤，使得敌人无法从码头以外的地方登陆；同时还修建了高耸入云的塔楼，以便从远处就能发现敌舰。"
        
        执达员叹息道：“我以前只听说过关于那座伟大的云达塔的传说，但我相信它确实名不虚传。在埃斯特洛尔的贝尔哈兰学院，当恩乔哈尔特和贝尔哈尔达成和平之后，许多巫师便来到那里学习与修行，他们还得到了我们家族那些与巨龙为伴的导师们的指导。当战争降临到我们的海岸时，达拉西亚的领主们就可以召唤那些古老的盟约，骑着巨龙奔赴战场。天啊，我愿意付出任何代价，只为了能亲眼看到这样的场景，哪怕只有一次……

'
        Daliza nods along as you ask your question, glancing seaward. "A fair question. My family and their retainers settled the island some eight hundred years ago. My ancestors were determined to carve out a realm of their own, and believe it or not, back then the population of the kingdom was so great that the only way to expand was south towards the Belharan lands or seaward. While our race is well accustomed to the snow and ice, Dracia was our first attempt to settle a land of saltwater and storms, at the very edge of sight from the coast. My ancestors built great ships to carry them to the horizon, them and all their kin and thralls and the supplies that would be needed to make a new home. They were shocked to find the island already inhabited, of course."

        "Oh? Had your people never encountered orcs before?"
        
        "Orcs?" She shakes her head. "No, [pc.name], what my ancestors found on that island was a great temple. A single structure of solid stone, buried half beneath the dirt. The legend goes that there was a single person living there when the first longship beached itself, and my ancestor — the future Jarl of Dracia, then just Thane Eldred — stepped ashore. It was a woman, slender as a reed, nude save for a small sword at her hip. When Eldred told her he and his kin meant to settle the island, she smiled and told him that he was welcome to become her vassal; there was room enough for the elves, if he would but kneel."
        
        [ashe.around
            |Ashe whispers into your mind, "Dracia was home to one of dragonkind's most sacred sites. A burial ground for our honored dead from the giant wars. It was customary for a dragon to always stand vigil over it. Until the elves arrived, it was a lonely duty indeed."
        ]
        
        "I take it she was more than just a naked island girl."
        
        Daliza nods, a smirk spreading across her rose-painted lips. "Indeed. Eldred, though, was far less perceptive. He said he knelt as vassal before no woman but the elvenqueen; the girl said, then, that he and his kin must leave, for she wouldn't have her lands encroached on by any but her kin or her vassals. Eldred, the story goes, said that he would go nowhere: he had sacrificed his fortune and staked the lives of his clan to sail to this mysterious island, and no nameless waif would chase him away. The impasse lingered until finally he bade the girl draw her sword and, by the old ways, prove her claim."
        
        "So they fought. The legend says for three days and three nights, but I'm certain it was more like three strikes," Daliza chuckles. "No matter which way you choose to believe, the naked girl was a match for the lord stroke for stroke, giving no ground to a man head and shoulders taller, and near twice as broad. But he was a skilled fighter, and offered no chance for her to land a blow of her own. The battle drew on until finally the girl grew tired of the game, and with a roar that shook the heavens, transformed into a great and terrible dragon with scales the color of the open sea. She battered the blade from Eldred's hands and with a great claw threw the elf-lord to the ground, pinning him between talons sharp as spears. She told him again, 'Though you fight most impressively, I will still not share my sacred domain with those that are neither vassal nor kin. Kneel before me, or flee back home and tell your kind never again to disturb my island.'"
        
        "What did he do?" you ask.
        
        That just brings Daliza's smile back all the broader. "He knelt. But not as a vassal. When she released him, Thane Eldred took a knee before the towering she-dragon and produced from beneath his breastplate a ring, given him by his mother to present to the woman that would win his heart. He said, 'I kneel as vassal before none but the elvenqueen. But I will kneel before a woman of such majesty and beg her be my bride.' And she, of course, did not deny him. Thus my house became kin to dragons, and were given leave to settle Dracia."
        
        You blink. "So does that mean you have dragon blood, Daliza?"
        
        She answers with a casual shrug. "It could. Jarl Eldred already had several concubines when he arrived, and many children during his life. Truth be told, I don't know which bloodline I descend from. Of course, dragons married back into the clan more than once over the years. We required strength to survive, and dragons have plenty to spare."
        
        "You see, Dracia is the northernmost reach of the Sailgrave Archipelago, far from the boer'alvar heartland, so keeping the new settlement safe from orcish marauders and siorcanna shore-raiders necessitated strong lords and stronger allies. The skill at arms of my ancestors — and indeed all the warriors of Dracia — was legendary, and we were the first the kings and queens of the realm would call upon to lead warhosts against Old Belhar or the monsters of the Northern Rift. Still, a few dozen trained armsmen cannot protect an island of Dracia's size by sheer determination, so great stone seawalls were constructed to make landings impossible outside the docks, and towers raised to the heavens to spot enemy ships from afar."
        
        The bailiff sighs wistfully. "I have only ever heard stories of the great Cloudreach Tower, but I am assured that it earned the name. Wizards from the great Belharan academy of Estelore, once Njorhaalt and Belhar had made peace, came to study and practice there, benefitting from the tutelage of our house's draconic bondmates. And when war came to our shores, the Jarls of Dracia could call upon those ancient bonds and fly into battle on dragonback. Gods, what I wouldn't give just to see such a thing with my own eyes, even just once..."'

rows.original:
"Mmm. No chance of encountering one, I'm afraid. Nobody has seen a dragon at all in living memory, and the stories my mother told me made it clear that the last of Dracia's dragons, Senasthrelle, fell in battle when the demons first attacked the island at the onset of the Godswar. Perhaps we will find her bones, somewhere on the battlements."

        [ashe.around
            |You hear the hum of your draconic mace in your mind, chewing over that statement a moment. "Senasthrelle Anferra Skal'noria: Sentinel of the Seas, the Unbreaking Frost Which Shields the North. I remember her! She was... huge. Powerful. Regal. She loved mortals more than any of us, like you were all her beloved children. I don't believe she had any eggs of her own to nurture. When we heard that she'd died, it sent a wave of sorrow through all dragonkind. The best of us laid low by a single monster..."
            
            Daliza quirks a brow at you, seeing your attention wavering.
        ]
        
        "Tell me about her."
        
        Daliza nods thoughtfully. "Truth be told, I know less than I'd like. Certainly less than a hero like her deserves. She was of the Skal'noria clan, like all our bonded dragons, the 'Shields of the North' in the Imperial tongue. She was full-blooded dragon, of what age I don't know — it's possible she was the very dragon that first greeted my ancestors on the shore — but she had certainly been living amongst my people for centuries by the time the Godswar broke out. Her clan were sea dragons, with beautiful ocean-blue or seafoam-green scales, and among dragonkind were considered to be some of the largest by sheer physical size. They were also talented in the art of using blade and spell together, weaving frost magic into their fighting as deftly as I might use an off-hand dagger or shield."
        
        [ashe.around
            |You get the sense of Ashe nodding. "The Northshields were the mightiest warriors among us. Even I studied with them. Oh, hearing that made Ivy jealous! To see Senesthrelle weave blade and spell was like watching a dance. A very deadly dance, as more than a few Belharans learned during the wars."
        ]
        
        "So these dragons of yours were all gigantic spellblades?"
        
        "Basically, yes. Don't forget beautiful, majestic, and immortal. Each of them was a treasure beyond compare, a living demigod... and now, it seems, they're gone. The last of them died protecting my ancestors' flight from Dracia; if there were other dragons alive in Savarra when the Godswar began, they too must have perished. It's hard to imagine that Nareva would allow her most beloved to die out like that, but those days nearly wiped out all life, I suppose. I have to wonder how many races didn't make it out at all."
        
        "What do you know about dragons more generally?" you ask, before Dal gets too melancholy. 
        
        "Well," she says, "Aside from being immortal and beautiful? Hmm. They were shapeshifters, of course; or at least, they could condense their immense bodies down into humanoid shapes. They were all hermaphrodites naturally, but there are legends and art depicting human-form dragons of all sexes. They could breathe fire, and fly, and their scales were so thick as to make them nearly immune to mortal weapons — at least, of normal size."
        
        "There are legends of dragons being felled by siege weapons that get lucky shots, and in prehistory, it appears they fought some kind of massive war against the jotuns of the north-beyond-north. Some of my rangers used to come across old bits of architecture up on the Rift, bits of castles and towers, burnt black and frozen after centuries of disuse. Gods only know what the dragons and giants could have fought over, but I am sure axes and bows of such stature could pierce even an ancient dragon's hide. They may have been beyond the care of age, but the Godswar proved their immortality wasn't foolproof."
        
        [ashe.around
            |You feel an uncomfortable shifting in Ashe's presence.
        ]
        
        You [ashe.isMace
            |think back to watching Ashe die
            |have to ask
        ], "Are you really sure they're all gone?"
        
        She shrugs. "As I said, none have been seen in mortal memory. It is... possible that some endure, hiding among mortals using their shapeshifting. But I struggle to believe it. A dragon requires so much food to sustain itself that it must hunt in its true form at least, I should think, and that is hard to hide indefinitely."
        
        "I wish I could speak to their culture, but we know little of it for sure. The Skal'noria scions that bonded to my house lived on the islands with us — they wore little, fought and drunk hard, and adored gems and pearls as tribute, but there were so few that it's hard to say they had a culture different from our own at all. I've read some references to dragons living in the south that had some kind of kingdom up in the highest mountains, but no mortals were allowed to travel there. Assuming it existed, which I doubt... someone would have found it by now, and then you wouldn't need to ask me about dragon culture, you could read it in a book."
        
        [ashe.around
            |Ashe sighs. "That's the most depressing thing I've heard in days."
        ]
rows.translation:
嗯……恐怕我们根本没有机会遇到这样的生物。在人们的记忆中，从来没有人见过龙；而我母亲告诉我的那些故事也明确指出：在神战爆发时，当恶魔首次袭击这座岛屿时，达拉西亚最后的那些龙——包括塞纳斯特雷尔——都在战斗中阵亡了。也许我们能在城墙的某个地方找到它的骨头吧。

        [ashe.around
            |你在脑海中回响着那把巨龙之锤发出的嗡嗡声，仔细思考着这句话。“塞纳斯特蕾尔·安费拉·斯卡尔诺里亚：海洋的守护者，那守护北方、永不破碎的寒冰。我记得她！她……体型庞大得惊人。强大而高贵。她比我们任何人都更热爱人类，把你们都当作自己心爱的孩子。我相信她自己并没有后代需要抚养。当我们听到她去世的消息时，整个龙族都陷入了深深的悲痛之中。我们中最强大的人，也被一只怪物轻易击败了……”
            
            达莉莎看到你的注意力开始分散，微微挑了挑眉毛。
        ]
        
        跟我讲讲她吧。”
        
        达莉莎若有所思地点了点头。“说实话，我所知道的其实并不多。显然，这远远不够像她这样的英雄应得的了解。她属于斯卡尔诺里亚氏族，就像我们所有与龙缔结契约的族人一样——在帝国的语言中，他们被称为‘北方的守护者’。她是一条纯血的龙，具体年龄我并不知道——有可能她就是那位最初在海岸边迎接我祖先的龙——但在神战爆发时，她已经在我族人中间生活了几个世纪。她的族群属于海龙一族，拥有美丽的海洋蓝或海泡沫绿色的鳞片，在龙类中，它们的体型也被认为是最大的之一。它们还擅长将刀刃与法术结合起来使用，在战斗中巧妙地运用冰霜魔法，就如同我熟练地使用副手匕首或盾牌一样。"
        
        [ashe.around
            |你能感觉到阿什在点头。“北盾战士是我们当中最强大的战士们。就连我也曾跟他们一起学习。哦，听到这些，艾薇肯定会嫉妒的！看着塞内斯特雷尔同时运用刀法和法术，就像在观看一场舞蹈——一场极其致命的舞蹈，因为在战争中，有不少贝拉人因此丧命。
        ]
        
        所以你们那些龙，其实都是巨大的法术剑吗？”
        
        “基本上可以这么说。别忘了，它们还美丽、庄严，而且永生不灭。每一头都是无与伦比的珍宝，简直是活生生的半神……而现在，看来它们都已经消失了。它们中的最后一只，在保护我的祖先们逃离达拉西亚的途中牺牲了；如果在神战爆发时萨瓦拉还有其他龙类存活，它们也必定已经灭绝了。很难想象娜瑞瓦会任由自己最珍视的生物如此灭绝，但我想，那段时期确实几乎消灭了所有的生命。我不禁想知道，究竟有多少种族根本没能存活下来。
        
        关于龙，你究竟了解些什么呢？”你在达尔陷入过度忧郁之前问道。
        
        “嗯，”她回答道，“除了它们是不朽的、美丽的生物之外……它们还能变形，至少可以将自己庞大的身躯变形成人类的形态。它们本质上都是雌雄同体的生物，但传说与艺术作品中确实描绘过各种性别的龙类。这些龙能够喷火、飞翔，它们的鳞片极为厚实，使得它们几乎能够免疫普通的武器攻击——至少是那些普通尺寸的武器。"
        
        有传说称，某些幸运的攻击者曾用攻城武器击倒了龙；而在史前时期，它们似乎与北方极地地区的巨兽进行过大规模的战斗。我的一些游骑兵曾在裂谷地带发现过一些古老的建筑遗迹——那些被烧成焦黑的城堡和塔楼，在数个世纪无人使用之后，依然矗立在那里。只有神明才知道那些龙和巨人们究竟为了什么而争斗，但我敢肯定，那种威力的斧头和弓箭，甚至能够刺穿古老巨龙的皮甲。虽然它们似乎已经超越了时间的侵蚀，但“神战”证明了它们的永生并非牢不可破。"
        
        [ashe.around
            |在艾希的身边，你会感受到一种令人不适的异样感觉。
        ]
        
        你[ashe.isMace
            |回想起来，当时看着艾希死去，心里真是难受极了。
            |不得不询问
        ]你真的确定它们都消失了吗？”
        
        她耸了耸肩：“就像我说的，有生以来根本没有人见过它们。也有可能有些还活着，通过变形能力隐藏在人类中间……但我很难相信这一点。一条龙需要消耗大量的食物来维持生存，因此它至少必须以自己的真身形态进行捕猎，我想这样它是很难长时间隐藏自己的。”
        
        “我希望能更深入地了解他们的文化，但实际上我们对它知之甚少。那些与我家建立联系的斯卡尔诺里亚后裔，和我们一起生活在那些岛屿上——他们身材矮小，喜欢打架和饮酒作乐，还极其珍视宝石和珍珠作为贡品。不过他们的数量实在太少了，因此很难说他们拥有与我们不同的文化。我读过一些资料，说南方有龙居住，它们在最高的山脉中建立了自己的王国，但没有任何凡人被允许前往那里。不过，如果这样的地方真的存在的话——我对此表示怀疑……现在应该已经有人发现了吧。那样的话，你们就不用来问我关于龙文化的事情了，直接去书里查阅不就行了。"
        
        [ashe.around
            |艾希叹了口气：“这是我这些天听到的最让人沮丧的话了。
        ]

To see Senesthrelle weave blade and spell was like watching a dance. A very deadly dance, as more than a few Belharans learned during the wars."
        ]
        
        "So these dragons of yours were all gigantic spellblades?"
        
        "Basically, yes. Don't forget beautiful, majestic, and immortal. Each of them was a treasure beyond compare, a living demigod... and now, it seems, they're gone. The last of them died protecting my ancestors' flight from Dracia; if there were other dragons alive in Savarra when the Godswar began, they too must have perished. It's hard to imagine that Nareva would allow her most beloved to die out like that, but those days nearly wiped out all life, I suppose. I have to wonder how many races didn't make it out at all."
        
        "What do you know about dragons more generally?" you ask, before Dal gets too melancholy. 
        
        "Well," she says, "Aside from being immortal and beautiful? Hmm. They were shapeshifters, of course; or at least, they could condense their immense bodies down into humanoid shapes. They were all hermaphrodites naturally, but there are legends and art depicting human-form dragons of all sexes. They could breathe fire, and fly, and their scales were so thick as to make them nearly immune to mortal weapons — at least, of normal size."
        
        "There are legends of dragons being felled by siege weapons that get lucky shots, and in prehistory, it appears they fought some kind of massive war against the jotuns of the north-beyond-north. Some of my rangers used to come across old bits of architecture up on the Rift, bits of castles and towers, burnt black and frozen after centuries of disuse. Gods only know what the dragons and giants could have fought over, but I am sure axes and bows of such stature could pierce even an ancient dragon's hide. They may have been beyond the care of age, but the Godswar proved their immortality wasn't foolproof."
        
        [ashe.around
            |You feel an uncomfortable shifting in Ashe's presence.
        ]
        
        You [ashe.isMace
            |think back to watching Ashe die
            |have to ask
        ], "Are you really sure they're all gone?"
        
        She shrugs. "As I said, none have been seen in mortal memory. It is... possible that some endure, hiding among mortals using their shapeshifting. But I struggle to believe it. A dragon requires so much food to sustain itself that it must hunt in its true form at least, I should think, and that is hard to hide indefinitely."
        
        "I wish I could speak to their culture, but we know little of it for sure. The Skal'noria scions that bonded to my house lived on the islands with us — they wore little, fought and drunk hard, and adored gems and pearls as tribute, but there were so few that it's hard to say they had a culture different from our own at all. I've read some references to dragons living in the south that had some kind of kingdom up in the highest mountains, but no mortals were allowed to travel there. Assuming it existed, which I doubt... someone would have found it by now, and then you wouldn't need to ask me about dragon culture, you could read it in a book."
        
        [ashe.around
            |Ashe sighs. "That's the most depressing thing I've heard in days."
        ]'

rows.original:
"Ah, of course, my great-great-grandfather — Jarl Talraed var Dracia. He was a warrior of great renown, but also a scholar and collector of art. Well loved on the island and in Njorhaalt, I understand." A faint frown plays across Daliza's features. "Alas, he perished in the earliest hours of the Godswar. By our understanding, Dracia was the first part of the continent hit by the demons, and his people were taken utterly unawares. Still, Jarl Talraed and his warriors mounted a heroic defense, sacrificing themselves to the man to buy time for the citizens of the island to escape. Luckily, that included his wife and pregnant daughter, or else I'd not be here. I imagine that Jarl Talraed was likely among the last men to ever ride a dragon, and for that I will be infinitely jealous."

        "Do you know what exactly he was fighting, at the end?"
        
        "A demon — though not like the ones we face today," Daliza says. "The demons of the Godswar, it is said, were being of pure shadow and hungering darkness[flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS|, much like what you fought in the palace, I'm told]. I should think, comparatively, we've gotten off lucky. As awful as Alissa and her ilk are, I don't think they'll ever hold a candle to the devastation the last batch of demons wrought. From what my ancestors passed down, Jarl Talraed and his companions faced down a single beast of darkness, godlike in size and wormlike in shape, beached on the east coast of the island. It had dueled with the last of our house's dragons for hours, but eventually she fell, and the beast began moving inland; so the Jarl sallied out to buy what time he could for the rest of the evacuation. Alas, no one survived to tell of his glorious last stand. The last anyone saw of him was at the base of Cloudreach Tower, about to ride out and fight, where he charged the city's most powerful sorceress — an Estelorean magister studying at the tower — with the protection of the civilian ships fleeing towards the mainland."
        
        Daliza pauses a moment, tapping her chin. "One more thing comes to mind, now that I think on it. The Jarl took with him two relics of our house — his armor, made of dragonscale, and an enchanted ring that had been in our line since the first jarl settled Dracia. I know there's little chance such precious artifacts will still be there after all these centuries, but if there's a chance we could recover them... I'd be most obliged."
        
        [pc.isDK
            |"We're here to kill a demon lord, not find your family's trinkets, Daliza."
            
            Her ears droop. "Of course."
            |"We'll see what we can do," you say.
        ]
rows.translation:
“啊，当然，是我的高祖父——达拉西亚的塔尔拉德领主。他是一位声名远扬的战士，同时也是学者和艺术品收藏家。据我所知，他在岛上和Njorhaalt都深受爱戴。”达莉莎脸上浮起淡淡的愁容。“可惜，他在神战最初几个小时便牺牲了。按照我们的理解，达拉西亚是大陆最先遭恶魔袭击的地区，他的人民完全猝不及防。即便如此，塔尔拉德领主与麾下战士依然展开了英勇防御；他们全数牺牲，为岛上居民争取逃生时间。幸运的是，其中包括他的妻子和怀孕的女儿，否则我也不会站在这里。我猜，塔尔拉德领主很可能是最后一批骑乘巨龙的人；这点会令我永远羡慕。”

        “你知道他最后究竟在与什么战斗吗？”
        
        “一个恶魔——但不像我们今天面对的恶魔，”达莉莎说道。“据说，神战中的恶魔是由纯粹的阴影与饥渴的黑暗构成的存在[flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS|，就像你在宫殿里战斗过的东西一样]。相比之下，我觉得我们已经很幸运了。艾莉莎和她的同类固然可怕，但我想，他们永远无法与上一批恶魔造成的毁灭相提并论。根据祖先传下的故事，塔尔拉德领主与同伴在岛屿东岸迎战了一头搁浅的黑暗巨兽；它形如蠕虫，身形却庞大如神。它与我们家族最后一条巨龙鏖战数小时，可她最终还是倒下了，巨兽随即开始向内陆移动；于是领主率军出击，竭力为余下的疏散争取时间。可惜，无人生还，没能讲述他光荣的最后一战。人们最后一次见到他，是在云达塔脚下，正准备出发迎战；在那里，他将保护逃往大陆的平民船只之责，托付给城中最强大的女术士——一位在塔内求学的埃斯托洛尔魔导师。”
        
        达莉莎停顿片刻，轻敲下巴。“现在想来，还有一件事。领主随身带走了两件家传圣物——以龙鳞打造的盔甲，以及自第一任领主定居达拉西亚以来，便在家族中代代相传的一枚附魔戒指。我知道历经数百年后，这些珍贵物品仍留在原处的机会微乎其微；但若有机会将它们寻回……我会感激不尽。”
        
        [pc.isDK
            |“我们来这里是为了杀掉恶魔领主，不是寻找你家的小玩意，达莉莎。”
            
            她的耳朵垂了下来。“当然。”
            |“我们会看看能做些什么，”你说道。
        ]

rows.original: Ask about the last Jarl of Dracia.
rows.translation: 询问关于最后一位达拉西亚大君的事。
rows.raw: "Ask about the last Jarl of Dracia."

rows.original: "Less than I would like, unfortunately," Daliza says. "As I've said, nobody has been to the island in living memory — Alissa an her cronies excepted. My grandmother would often speak of it, though. The island is the largest of the Sailgraves, and there are several small villages along the coast, as well as a single city near the center. My guess would be that Alissa is at Dracia Keep, though — that would be on the southern coast of the island, best positioned to defend the jarldom against orcish raiders coming from the rest of the archipelago." "The seat of my ancestors was the greatest castle ever built by the boer'alvar. The walls that surrounded the keep were tall enough to withstand even the greatest tidal waves, and crusted with ice nearly year-round, such that they seemed to shine in the daylight. They were built around the ancient draconic shrine Jarl Eldred discovered when his clan first sailed to Dracia, half underground and surrounded by a small artificial lake. In the midst of the castle is the great Cloudreach Tower, home of the island's magisters. Within the tower was an enchanted forge, where my ancestors crafted swords and spears of peerless quality. The same equipment the demons are now using against us; I imagine they must have relit the old forges, though how Alissa's peons have matched the craftsmanship of the old days, I have no idea. Perhaps... perhaps there were manuals left behind? If so, recovering them would be a tremendous boon to the war effort, and to the boer'alvar's future." Daliza sighs, leaning against the ship's rail. "I hate the idea that my family's secrets, our ancient resources and wealth, are being used not just by a wastrel like Alissa, but to prosecute a war against our ancient allies of the south. Every minotaur that falls in battle is another red stain on Alissa's hands, and another black mark on my house." [daliza.fucked |You put a hand on Daliza's shoulder. "It's not your fault." She leans into you. "Perhaps. But I can't help but feel guilty that it's my family's bronze being used to such black ends." "We'll put it right. Do you think Alissa will be in the tower?" |You shake your head. "This one's all on Alissa. So, think she'll be in that tower?" ] "It's possible," Daliza says with a shrug. "Though from what I knew of her, Alissa had little mind for scholarship and craft. A wizards' tower seems ill suited to her. My guess would be that she has made her lair in the inner keep: my ancestral seat of power. It was a warrior's holdfast, with strong walls and hardy gates, nigh unassailable. In the six centuries my family occupied it, the keep was never once breached by enemies. Not for lack of orcs willing to die trying. I have no idea what state the last battle left the keep in, but it was certainly both palatial and well defended. It's where I would go, were I her." You nod along. "So how do we get in?" "That... is a good question. The answer will depend on the state of the castle; if it is a crumbling ruin, climbing through shattered walls should be easy enough. If the castle has somehow endured intact, though... we'll just have to improvise. Ah, I think this is the first time I've ever hoped the demons destroyed much of my birthright. At least then they'll have deprived Alissa of her strongest defenses..."
rows.translation: 不幸的是，数量并没有我期望的那么多，”达莉莎说道。“正如我之前所说，在有生之年内，没有人去过那座岛——除了艾莉莎和她的那些亲信。不过，我的祖母经常提起它。那座岛是赛尔格雷夫群岛中最大的，海岸线上分布着几个小村庄，而在岛屿的中心附近还有一座城市。我猜阿丽莎应该是在达拉西亚要塞——那位于岛屿的南岸，是防御来自群岛其他地区的兽人袭击者的最佳地点。 我祖先的城堡是布尔阿尔瓦人建造过的最宏伟的堡垒。环绕城堡的城墙高耸入云，甚至能够抵御最猛烈的海浪；这些城墙几乎一年到头都被冰雪覆盖，因此在阳光下会闪闪发光。这些建筑是围绕着埃尔德雷德领主所在的氏族首次航行至达拉西亚时发现的古老巨龙神殿而建造的，其中一半位于地下，周围还环绕着一个小型人工湖。城堡的正中央矗立着高大的云达塔，那里是岛上法师们的居所。在塔内有一座被施了魔法的铁匠铺，我的祖先们在那里锻造出了品质无与伦比的剑与长矛。那些恶魔现在用来对付我们的武器，其实就是当年他们使用的那些工具；我想他们肯定重新点燃了那些古老的熔炉，不过我实在不明白，艾莉莎的手下们是如何做到保持与古代工匠们同样的工艺水平的。也许……也许还留有一些手册吧？如果真的存在的话，找回它们将对战争事业以及布尔人的未来产生巨大的帮助。 达莉莎叹了口气，靠在船的栏杆上。“我实在无法接受这样的事实：我家的秘密、我们世代相传的资源和财富，不仅被像阿丽莎这样的挥霍无度之人利用，还被用来对我们南方的古老盟友发动战争。每一只在战斗中阵亡的弥诺陶洛斯，都是阿丽莎手上又一道血痕，也是我家名誉上的又一处污点。 [daliza.fucked |你把手放在达莉莎的肩上：“这不是你的错。” 她靠向你：“也许吧。但我还是忍不住感到内疚，因为我的家族的奖牌被用在了这种不好的事情上。” “我们会把事情解决好的。你觉得艾莉莎会在塔里吗？ |你摇了摇头：“这件事完全取决于艾莉莎。所以，你觉得她会待在那座塔里吗？ ] 这是有可能的，”达莉莎耸了耸肩说道，“不过以我对她的了解，艾莉莎对学术或技艺并没有什么兴趣。对于她来说，巫师塔似乎并不适合她。我猜她应该把她的据点设在了内堡里——那可是我祖先的权力中心。这是一座勇士的堡垒，拥有坚固的城墙和结实的城门，几乎无法被攻破。在我家族占据它的六百年时间里，敌人从未一次攻破过这座堡垒。当然，这也并非因为没有愿意拼死一战的兽人。我不知道最后那场战役让这座堡垒变成了什么样子，但可以肯定的是，它既宏伟壮观，又防御严密。如果我是她，我也会去那里。” 你点了点头，然后问道：“那么，该怎么做呢？我们怎么进去？” “这……是个好问题。答案取决于城堡目前的状况；如果它已经变成了一片废墟，那么从破碎的墙壁中爬进去应该没什么困难。但如果城堡完好无损地保存了下来……那我们就只能随机应变了。啊，我想这是我第一次希望那些恶魔能毁掉我大部分与生俱来的财产。至少这样，他们就能剥夺艾莉莎最强大的防御手段了……

[arona.isDom
        |You sashay over to where your brawny mistress is sitting, working on mixing the contents of several clay pots. As soon as you're in arm's reach, Arona grabs you around the waist and pulls you down into her lap. For once, you're not met with a firm bulge in her loins needing attention, nor a pair of rough hands manhandling your [pc.hasBoobs
            |tits
            |crotch
        ]. Arona just sits you on one of her muscular thighs and resumes her work, mixing musky-smelling paints together into her tribe's familiar woad.
        
        When she's finally reached a stopping point, Arona sets the pots aside and wraps one arm around your middle, setting the other hand to stroking your head.
        |You head over to where your subby amazon's sat, mixing the contents of several clay pots. She looks up with a grin, setting her work aside as soon as you catch her attention. "Hey, boss. Need me for something?"
        
        You shake your head. "Just checking in. Never seen this before," you say, gesturing to her work.
    ]
    
    "Mmm. Feels good to be back on the water. Been spending way the hell too much time on land for a Kervus. Was starting to worry I'd lose my sea legs," she chuckles. "Gotta paint up before we go into battle, though, or Sorra won't notice me on the waves."
    
    "I thought your clan were Lumians?"
    
    "Duh. She's the one we pray to the most. But Lumia's not the god of the waves, is she? Need Sorra's protection if we want to cross all the way to Dracia, especially this late in the year. Weather on the water that far north is ass."
    
    Arona picks up one of the pots and gives it a little sniff. "Should be ready. [arona.isDom
        |Tell ya what, pretty [pc.boyGirl], you get to paint me up today. Dip your fingers in, and give me thunderbolts all over: cheeks, biceps, stomach, thighs, all of it. Then I'll do you."
        |Say, [pc.name], you want me to paint you up too? Give you Sorra's thunderbolts all over that rockin' bod of yours! Other six'll all be jealous of Sorra having a couple of woaded-up beasts like us in her colors!"
    ]

    你根本没有机会去弄清楚。水从背后袭来，差点把你冲倒——对于那些被“幽灵”影响的人来说，更是如此。当你睁开眼睛时，他们剩下的身体早已被水冲到甲板上去了，只留下红色的痕迹，以及那些被烧黑的青铜斧头埋在木板上。 
    
    朱诺双膝跪地，由于过度用力而咳出血来。闪电在她周围闪烁，从她的角部一直延伸到她的蹄子。就连利弗农也不敢靠近她，当电流从她身上跳到他伸出的手上时，他立刻退了回去。 
    
    朱诺，亲爱的，你……”
    
    “我会……活下来的……”她呻吟着。那个女巫摇摇晃晃地站了一会儿，然后倒在了甲板上。
rows.raw:
"
    The Wraith-touched monsters keep coming, pushing you back step by step. Gods, they're strong! The few marines that are still standing do all they can to cover you, but they're taking just as much of a beating as you are. 

    "Cover your eyes!" comes a familiar cow-girl's cry. You obey, though you're still blinded by a flash of brilliant light through your lids, and deafened by a thunderclap. Something wet and hot splatters across your cheeks, making you retch. Oh, fuck, what is that... 
    
    You don't get the chance to find out. Water hits you from the back, nearly barreling you over — and doing just that to the Wraith-touched. Whatever's left of them has been washed off the deck by the time you open your eyes, leaving red smears and black-burnt bronze axes buried in the wood. 
    
    Juno's on her knees, coughing up blood from the overexertion. Lightning crackles around her, arcing from horns to hooves. Even Livernon hesitates to touch her, recoiling as electricity jumps from her to his out-stretched hand. 
    
    "Juno, love, are you-"
    
    "I'll... live..." she groans. The witch sways a moment before going face-down on the deck."

rows.original: Luckily, the Wraith-touched monsters don't mass for another attack... though until the Vigil leaves land behind, you're always half-sure you can see red eyes in the trees. Shortly after the fighting's done, Juno is carried below-decks by her husband to recover, and [daliza.fucked |you're left holding |Ryn ends up holding ] Dal's hair back as she stress-vomits over the railings. "Sorry," the bailiff eventually manages to say with a groan, cheeks bloodless. "These monsters... there's a reason my expedition had to turn back before we reached the coast." You can see why, yeah. Even with a full company of marines and a legendary witch, the ship could easily have been overrun. A few elven rangers were lucky to make it as far as they did. The ship makes it to the open ocean by daybreak, leaving the frosty fjord behind. [flags.RQ2_V_WRAITH -1 1 |Juno's too winded from destroying several dozen monsters all at once to return to her duties until well past noon, and even then, the ship's speed is barely faster than it was in the fjord. She's put dark bandages over her fingers, but still manages a smile and an encouraging word of "We all did our best," to you and the marines. |Juno's able to return to her duties come morning, thanking you for your help with a pretty smile and such a burst of air directed into the sails that you're half sure the boat's flying rather than sailing. ] The captain later tells you that while the crew suffered no dead, the better part of the marines have been injured in the fighting, though at least the oar-slaves fared better. "The Vigil could take one good enemy ship in it's current state," he assures you, "but if these Dracian devils have more than that at hand... I won't let Juno burn herself out for it." It turns out he needn't have worried. By noon, the island is in sight even through the wintry fog rolling in. By evening, the weather's cleared, and the keep comes into view. The setting sun is behind you, shining straight onto a set of titanic stone walls rising from the sheer white cliffs of the island such that they seem to glow. Dracia Keep is easily four times the size of Castle Hawkstone back home, sprawling across the southern tip of its vast island. Its walls are towering but no longer solid, crumbling in a dozen places almost down to the foundations. Ice clings to the stone, giving it a brilliant luster even as it slowly erodes the castle's protection year by year. A single, massive tower rises far above the walls, reaching well into the clouds above; how anyone is supposed to climb all the way up there without their heart bursting, you haven't the slightest idea, but that tower alone seems to have survived the passage of years unscathed. Even the inner keep, just visible over the curtain walls, seems well worse for wear, half collapsed under its own ill-kept weight. "Goddess, the tower is real," Daliza gasps at your side. She's practically slack-jawed at the sight, eyes wide and glistening. "The castle's still standing after all these years..." "Your ancestors built it well," Ryn says. [party.has arona |Arona points to a hole in the wall, seemingly at random. "Lotta Kervus died just to leave that much damage." ] [party.has cait |Cait whistles at your side. "So that's Dracia, huh? And here I thought Mallach was the king of giant phallic structures..." ] [party.has agni |Agni whistles at your side. "Something about the sight sparks a memory. I think I've been here a couple times. That tower really leaves an impression, even on a bird-brain like me!" ] You [daliza.fucked |put a hand on Dal's shoulder and ]gesture towards the sheer, white cliffs. "Any idea where we're supposed to dock?" Dal blinks, snapping out of her awestruck reverie and clicking her mouth shut. "Um. Th-the great docks are on the far side of the island, and... it looks like the watchtower overlooking them is still standing. If Alissa's mind isn't completely addled, she'll have her archers up there overwatching the approach. It's meant to be a murder hole." "Mmm," you nod, letting your eyes wander from the marble-colored rocks to the crumbling walls. "Guess we'll have to find another way in. How about there?" You point to a particularly jagged section of the cliffs, sitting just beneath a gash in the curtain wall that nearly reaches the ground. At least at this distance, you can't see any fortification trying to close the gap — you doubt Alissa has enough people to actually secure a castle this size even if she wanted. "That does look climbable. It'll be rough, though,[pc.hasWings | at least for those of us not blessed with flight, ]" Daliza says. "Especially at night and with that much ice on the rocks. I know Lady Etheryn has a bit of experience climbing the walls of the palace back home, but as for myself..." "I can help with that," a sweetly soft voice says behind you. A glance over your shoulder reveals the storm witch leaning heavily on her staff, following your companions' gazes to the castle. "Why climb when you can ride the air?" Ryn's eyes widen. "You can levitate people?" The witch nods. "Air and water are my specialties, dear princess. Controlled magical flight is quite difficult, even for me, but simple vertical movement is straightforward enough. You just worry about what's inside." Etheryn's ears droop, eyes cast towards the central keep. Yeah, she's going to be worrying alright. [etheryn.highConfidence |[etheryn.fucked |You put [daliza.fucked |your other |an ] arm around the princess, holding her tight. ] |Always with the fretting. ] "Get some rest," Juno advises. "We'll be in range shortly after nightfall."
rows.translation: 幸运的是，那些被怨灵影响的怪物并没有聚集起来发动另一次攻击……不过，在那之前守望者号当你离开陆地后，总会怀疑自己在树林中看到了红色的眼睛。 战斗结束后不久，朱诺被她的丈夫带到船舱下休息养伤。 [daliza.fucked |最终还是你来承担后果。 |最终，小琳掌握了它。 ]达尔将头发往后梳了梳，然后在栏杆边因情绪激动而呕吐起来。“对不起，”执达员最终艰难地挤出了这句话，他的脸颊已经变得毫无血色，“这些怪物……我们的探险队之所以在到达海岸之前就不得不折返，肯定是有什么原因的。” 现在你应该明白为什么了。即使有一整支海军陆战队和一位传说中的女巫在场，那艘船也很可能被这些怪物攻陷。只有少数精灵游荡者幸运地成功逃到了这里。 天亮时，那艘船终于驶入了开阔的海洋，将那片结满霜花的峡湾抛在了身后。 [flags.RQ2_V_WRAITH -1 1 |朱诺在一口气消灭了数十只怪物之后，累得根本无法继续执行任务，直到中午过后才勉强恢复过来。即便如此，飞船的速度也几乎和在峡湾里时一样慢。她的手指上缠着黑色的绷带，但她还是微笑着对你们和海军陆战队员们说了句“我们都已经尽力了”。 |朱诺在清晨便能够恢复她的职责了，她带着灿烂的笑容感谢你的帮助，同时还用力吹动船帆，那股风力之大，让你都有点怀疑这艘船其实是在飞行而不是在航行。 ]后来，船长告诉你，虽然全体船员都没有伤亡，但大部分海军陆战队员都在战斗中受了伤，不过至少那些划桨的奴隶们运气比较好。守望者号以它目前的状况，或许还能承受一艘强大的敌舰的攻击，”他向你保证，“但如果那些达拉西亚恶魔手头还有更多的舰船……我绝不会让朱诺为此付出惨重的代价。” 结果证明，他其实并没有必要担心。 到了中午，即便有冬日的雾气笼罩，也能看到那座岛屿。到了傍晚，天气放晴，那座堡垒终于出现在眼前。夕阳正好位于你的身后，它的光芒直射在那座岛屿上耸立的巨大石墙之上，使得那些石墙仿佛在发光一般。 达拉西亚要塞的规模几乎是家乡霍克斯通城堡的四倍，它横跨那片广阔岛屿的南端。它的城墙高耸入云，但却不再坚固，有十几处地方已经出现裂缝，几乎快要坍塌到地基了。冰块附着在石头上，使石头表面呈现出耀眼的光泽，然而与此同时，这些冰块也在逐年侵蚀着城堡的防御设施。有一座巨大的塔楼高高耸立在城墙之上，其顶端甚至伸入了云层之中；你根本无法想象，究竟是如何有人能够爬到那么高的地方而不会心脏破裂的，但就是这座塔楼，似乎在岁月的侵蚀中毫发无损。就连那些只能通过城墙的帷幕才能隐约看到的内城区域，也显得破败不堪，在自身严重失修的重压下，有一半已经半塌下来。 女神，这座塔是真的……”达莉莎在你身旁惊呼道。她看着这一幕，简直目瞪口呆，双眼瞪得大大的，闪闪发亮。“这么多年过去了，这座城堡依然屹立不倒……” “你们的祖先建造得确实很出色。”小琳说道。 [party.has arona |阿罗娜随意地指向墙上的一个洞：“很多凯尔维斯族成员都牺牲了，只为了留下这么大的破坏痕迹。 ] [party.has cait |凯特在你身边吹口哨，说道：“原来那就是达拉西亚啊？我还以为马拉克才是那些巨型阳具状建筑物的‘统治者’呢…… ] [party.has agni |阿格尼在你身边吹着口哨：“这个场景似乎唤起了我的某种记忆。我觉得我以前来过这里几次。那座塔确实给人留下了深刻的印象，就连像我这样的笨鸟也记得！ ] 你[daliza.fucked |把手放在达尔的肩上，然后说道： ]她指向那些陡峭的白色悬崖，问道：“知道我们应该在哪儿靠岸吗？” 达尔眨了眨眼，从那令人惊叹的景象中回过神来，连忙闭上嘴说道：“呃……那些大型码头在岛屿的另一边。看起来，那座俯瞰他们的瞭望塔依然矗立在那里。如果艾莉莎的头脑没有完全混乱的话，她肯定会让她的弓箭手们在那里监视来犯者的动向。那地方本来就是用来发动突然袭击的。” “嗯，”你点了点头，目光从那些大理石色的岩石移向那些摇摇欲坠的墙壁。看来我们得另想办法进去了。那边怎么样？” 你指向悬崖上一段特别崎岖的地方，那段悬崖正好位于那道几乎直达地面的裂隙下方。从这个距离来看，你并没有看到任何用于填补这道裂隙的防御工事——你怀疑，即使艾莉莎愿意，她也不可能有足够的人手来守护这么大的城堡。 那确实看起来可以攀爬。不过，过程会相当艰难。[pc.hasWings | 至少对于我们这些没有飞行能力的人来说是这样。 ]达莉莎说道，‘尤其是在夜晚，而且岩石上还覆盖着那么多冰。我知道艾瑟琳小姐在攀爬自己家乡宫殿的墙壁时有些经验，但至于我自己……’” “在这方面我可以帮忙，”一个温柔而甜美的声音在你身后说道。你回头一看，便看到那位风暴女巫正紧紧依靠着她的法杖，顺着你同伴的视线望向那座城堡。“既然可以乘风飞行，为什么还要爬山呢？” 小琳的眼睛瞪得大大的：“你可以让人悬浮在空中吗？女巫点了点头。“空气和水是我的专长，亲爱的公主。控制魔法飞行对任何人来说都相当困难，就连我也一样，但简单的垂直移动却相对容易。你只需要担心里面的东西而已。伊瑟琳的耳朵耷拉了下来，目光投向中央的堡垒。没错，她确实会感到担忧的。 [etheryn.highConfidence |[etheryn.fucked |你放好了。 [daliza.fucked |你的另一个…… |一个 ]紧紧搂住公主，将她紧紧抱在怀里。 ] |总是忧心忡忡。 ] 休息一下吧，”朱诺建议道，“天黑后我们很快就会进入攻击范围。

rows.original: Night falls early this far north, but Captain Livernon takes it slow getting the Vigil into position. "Don't want to hit the rocks," he says offhand while you and your companions tend to your weapons and secure your supplies; Daliza aggressively sharpens her Kitsuhon-forged sword, while Etheryn fastidiously sharpens Harrick's claws for battle. Juno spends much of the evening speaking softly to a small figurine of Sorra, praying for the Chainbreaker's aid in laying low the elven tyrant. You're as ready as you can be by the time the Vigil is snuggled up to the cliffs. Juno raps the butt of her staff on the deck, urging the lot of you to squeeze in tight together. Her only advice is a cheery "Don't puke!" before raising her staff and beginning to incant the spell. [pc.hasWings |You take wing, flying up towards the walls while the rest of your companions are pushed aloft by the witch's conjured winds. |The ground lurches underfoot, and then drops off completely; you kick your legs instinctively as you're buffeted into the air by the witch's magic. ] The spell works slowly but surely, lifting your party up the cliffs on a gentle platform of wind. Everyone's hair is absolutely a mess by the time you're pulling [pc.hasWings |yourself |your friends ] up onto the ruined battlements. Or at least, the V-shaped cleft that you've chosen as your infiltration point. Thanks to the dark of night, it doesn't seem anyone's noticed you yet — though that's not likely to continue, no matter how understaffed Alissa's garrison is. "Tsk. Maybe she didn't bring any actual soldiers with her after all," Daliza murmurs, drawing her sword. "No patrols. No sentries... wait, scratch that. I hear imps in the courtyard ahead." You can't see them in the gloom, but when Dal points it out and you strain an ear to listen... yeah, there are big wings flapping not all that far away. And something else, too. Gods help you, that sounds like a pig snorting in the mud. What the hell? You glance at the elves, but if either of them hear that particular brand of unsettling, they don't indicate it. Ryn gulps, clutching her [etheryn.weapon] close. "I... I can do this. We have to do this." "We'll keep you safe, [etheryn.daliza |Ryn |Lady Etheryn ]," Daliza says. "No harm will befall you while I live." You stand just above a landing halfway between the island's docks and the castle courtyard. A huge boarskull totem has been hung from a cargo crane that's still managing to stand after all these years of abandonment. 

    Several succubi are scurrying around here, trying desperately to load boxes of weapons onto a trireme docked below while the huge, burly specter of the boar charges after them, goring at their backs and biting their wings. Ryn's visibly trembling at the sight of him still, breathing so hard you're afraid she'll have a heart attack.
    
    If you want to get through to the docks — or save the succubi from their torment — then you'll need to dispatch the boar-geist.

    几只女妖正在这里慌忙地忙碌着，拼命地将一箱箱武器装上停靠在下面的三列桨船上，而那只庞大而魁梧的野猪幽灵则追在她们身后，用獠牙刺伤她们的后背，咬碎她们的翅膀。看到他时，小琳明显在颤抖，呼吸也变得如此急促，让人担心她会心脏病发作。
    
    如果你想到达码头，或者想拯救那些受折磨的女妖们，那么你就必须解决掉那头野猪幽魂。

rows.original: The side gate of the castle leads you down a steep set of wooden stairs on the cliffside, connecting the walls to the docks below. There's a ship docked here, hidden from the view of the Vigil on the other side of the island. A number of lesser demons, a mix of succubi, incubi, and imps, are hurriedly heaving crates from the pier onto the docked trireme amidst panicked gasps and yelps of surprise. It's not you that's spooking them, though — they don't seem to have even noticed you. No, their attention is wrapped up in the monster tormenting them. There's a boar the size of a draft horse rampaging around the dock, chasing imps and succubi with its sword-length tusks. It bites at their wings with jagged old teeth, tearing at the leathery flesh of any fiend too slow in its labors. A single baleful eye glowers at them from its half-translucent skull, aglow with malign intelligence; the other was lost long ago in life, leaving a vicious scar across the beast's face. [party.has arona |"Fucking ghosts," Arona hisses. |"A specter," Daliza murmurs. "Wait. Could that be..." ] Ryn squeaks, grabbing your arm in both of hers. "It can't be! Th-th-that's Grungendyr!" "But how? Queen Alissa killed the beast in vengeance for your father decades ago." "Slow down," you tell the elves. "What are you two talking about?" Daliza puts a comforting hand on Ryn's shoulder. "Unless we are both mistaken, that is the great boar that slew the former king-consort. It carried the name Grungendyr, and was a fearsome beast long before that fateful day. Legend has it the thing feasted on the flesh of the Wraith-touched that haunt the woodlands, and grew mighty from their corruption. It was a one-eyed monstrosity of such size that it is said to have brought jotuns low. After taking the throne, Alissa vowed to hunt the thing down to avenge her father, and indeed returned with its head as a trophy. It was celebrated throughout the kingdom." "That head?" you say, pointing towards a cargo crane overlooking the dock. While all the meat has long been cleaned off, there is a talc-white boarskull hanging from nails driven into the wood, watching over the scampering demons like a warden. Etheryn grimaces. "That was many, many years ago," the bailiff says. "How are we just seeing this fell spirit now, after so long in the queen's remit?" All [party.sizeText] of you answer at once: "Kasyrra." The boar and its victims are still distracting each other, giving you ample time to decide on your course of action...

        |她一支又一支地射箭，箭矢全都射中了那头怪物的头部。她不断前进，持续射击，直到她的靴子终于抵在了那头野猪的鼻子上。
        |她用长矛刺向那头野猪，用尽全力将长矛从野猪的肩膀刺到背部。直到她的靴子踩在野猪的鼻子上，长矛也完全刺入了它的身体，她才停下来。
    ]直到那股力量开始消退，公主才渐渐平静下来，她踉跄着后退，手中的武器重重摔在地上，双眼瞪得大大的。
    
    “我们做到了！”她震惊地喘息着，眨着眼睛说道，“父……父亲，我们真的做到了。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |嗯，其实是阿丽莎做的。但至少你证明了你自己也有这个能力，”你说。
        |你做到了，”你一边说，一边轻轻捏了捏她的肩膀。
    ]这种生物的身体最后部分化为了以太蒸汽，渐渐重新融入了那个它最初诞生的头骨之中。
    
    “我从没想过艾莉莎竟然对魔法如此精通，”达莉莎望着那个头骨说道，“但在卡希拉的军队到来之前，她就已经击败了格伦根迪尔。她一个人究竟做了什么，才会让那头野兽的灵魂受到如此严重的创伤，从而被迫束缚在地球上呢？”
    
    “或许最好不要去想这些吧，”你对她说。 [pc.isBimbo
        |我每天都是这样度过一天的！
    ]
    
    她点了点头。“嗯，你说得对。那么，恭喜你，摄政夫人，也是冠军。你的表现确实非常出色。”
    
    小琳微笑着说道：“谢谢大家帮助我对抗那个怪物。我很高兴能有这样的机会……不过，我们还有更强大的敌人需要面对。”
    
    确实如此。
rows.raw:
'
    With a pathetic final snort, Grungendyr's legs collapse out from under him, and the fell boar falls on its face. Etheryn shrieks furiously and [var0
        |looses arrow after arrow into the monstrosity's head, advancing and loosing until her boot comes to rest on the boar's snout.
        |charges the boar with her spear, running the thing through from shoulder to rear with all her might. She doesn't stop until her boot's planted on the boar's snout, and her spear is buried to the hilt in the beast.
    ] Only as the spirit begins to fade away does the princess calm herself, staggering back and letting her weapon clatter to the ground, eyes wide as saucers. 
    
    "We did it!" she gasps, blinking in shock. "F-father... we did it."
    
    [pc.isDK
        |"Well, Alissa did it. But you at least proved you could have," you say.
        |"You did it," you tell her, squeezing her shoulder.
    ] The last of the creature's body is reduced to etheric vapors, fading back into the skull from whence they came. 
    
    "I never thought Alissa was much for sorcery," Daliza says, eying the skull. "But she felled Grungendyr long before Kasyrra's horde came along. What could she alone have done to the beast to traumatize its soul into becoming earthbound?" 
    
    "Probably best not to think about it," you tell her. [pc.isBimbo
        |"That's how I get through the day every day!"
    ]
    
    She nods. "Aye, as you say. Well. Congratulations, Lady Regent. Champion. That was well-fought."
    
    Ryn smiles. "Thank you all for helping me t-to face that monster. I'm glad I got the chance... but we still have a bigger fiend to fight."
    
    That you do.
    '

rows.original: You reach up and take the skull totem down from the crane, examining the bleached white bone etched with dark runes of power. Just like the specter you fought, the skull has a gnarly scar running across one of its eyes and its tusks are jagged to the point of serration, like the most wicked swords you've ever seen. [etheryn.lowConfidence |"Y-you can't actually mean to take th-that monstrosity w-w-with us!?" Ryn squeaks. |Ryn gulps. "You... you're really taking that thing with us?" ] "Why not?" The princess flails her arms. "B-because that's... ahhhh!" Ryn slumps her shoulders and turns away. By the power of boar-skull, you learned the Summon Grungendyr power!
rows.translation: 你伸出手，从起重机上取下了那个头骨图腾，仔细观察那块被漂白成白色的骨头上面刻着的那些深色魔法符文。就像你之前与之战斗过的那个幽灵一样，这个头骨的一只眼睛上也有着一道扭曲的疤痕，而它的獠牙也变得极其锋利，甚至呈现出锯齿状的边缘，就像你见过的最凶猛的剑一样。 [etheryn.lowConfidence |“你、你不会真的想带着那个怪物一起走吧！？”小琳惊恐地尖叫道。 |小琳咽了咽口水，说道：“你……你真的要带着那个东西一起走吗？” ] “为什么不呢？” 公主挥舞着双臂，结结巴巴地说：“因为那……啊！！” 小琳耸了耸肩，转身走开了。 以野猪头骨的力量你已经掌握了召唤格伦根迪尔的力量！

rows.original:
The entrance chamber opens up into a vast vertical shaft, stretching to the heavens high above. The upper floors of the tower are rings around the shaft, lit by the runes etched into the walls. There must be at least a hundred of them, so many that even the tower's ceiling at the apex is hazy in the distance. 

    "I feel like I could fall upwards," Ryn gasps, putting a hand to her chest.
    
    "That... may be the point," Daliza says. She points to the center of the chamber, drawing your eyes down to the second floor and a platform that dominates it. It's the only floor you can see stairs leading up to, too. There are more crates stacked up here, dozens of boxes bulging with weapons meant to arm the demons surging through the mountains around Khor'minos. A group of boreal elves, or perhaps wingless demons that once were elves, are up on the dias dragging crates off a platform in its center. They're laughing and chatting amongst themselves, too engrossed in their work to have noticed you. 
    
    Ryn gasps and backpedals, slipping into the shadows so quick even you lose track of her. Might be worth taking a page from her book before the elves bring the next load of weapons your way...
    
    [pc.isMage
        |Then again, these runes etched all over the walls... perhaps they could be used to your advantage somehow.
    ]
rows.translation:
入口大厅通向一条巨大的垂直通道，这条通道一直延伸到高高的天空之中。塔楼的上一层层结构环绕着这条通道，墙壁上刻着的符文为这些空间提供了光源。这些符文至少有上百个，数量之多以至于甚至塔楼顶端的天花板在远处也显得朦胧不清。 

    我感觉自己仿佛在向上坠落，”小琳喘着气说道，同时将手放在胸口。
    
    “或许……这才是关键所在，”达莉莎说道。她指向大厅的中心，让你的视线向下移，看到二楼上那个占据整个区域的平台。这也是唯一一处你能看到楼梯通向上面的楼层。这里堆放着更多的箱子，有几十个装满武器的箱子，这些武器是用来武装那些在科尔米诺斯周围的山脉中肆虐的恶魔的。有一群极北精灵，或者也可能是那些曾经是精灵但现在失去了翅膀的恶魔，正在楼上的平台上把箱子搬下来。他们正在互相笑着聊天，完全沉浸在自己的工作中，根本没有注意到你。
    
    小琳倒吸一口凉气，迅速退到了阴影中，动作快得连你都跟丢了她的踪迹。在精灵们把下一批武器送来之前，或许真该学学她的做法……
    
    [pc.isMage
        |话说回来，这些刻在墙上的符文……或许可以想办法利用它们来为自己谋利。
    ]

rows.original:
Ryn's got the right idea. You duck into the dim shadows, hiding behind the stacks of weapon crates as best you can; the others follow suit, spreading out through the hall. Your hiding place isn't exactly brilliant, but the elves seem distracted enough that you might be able to keep hidden until they're close enough to take by surprise. 

        They don't keep you waiting long. The fiendish frost elves heave the last of the crates down off the platform, pausing only to wipe the sweat from their brows and glistening bare abs. One of them pauses, leaning against her crate. "That thing up there gives me the creeps," she says to her comrades, glancing skyward.
        
        "Why?" another teases, "cuz it's the only thing on this accursed island that won't let you suck its cock?"
        
        The first elf huffs indignantly. "It doesn't even have one! It barely even looks like a person. It's-"
        
        "If you say soulless..."
        
        The elf blows a raspberry at her companion and hefts up her box again. "Speaking of soulless, we gotta get these to Tollus before his monobrow falls out. If he's not sitting on the throne of Khor'minos by next winter..."
        
        "We're all going to the breeding pits!" the others finish for her. They all burst out laughing and get back to work, headed your way.
        
        [var0
            |You hold your breath and get real small in the shadows, hand tightening around your [pc.weapon]. The corrupted elves draw near, close enough that Daliza's able to lunge out from the dark and grab the first of them while you and Ryn rush the middle of the pack, sending them scrabbling back and shrieking in surprise.
            |You hold your breath, tightening your grip on your [pc.weapon]. Any second now...

            "Hey, who's that?" one of the elves asks casually, pointing right at you. "What're you doing hiding back there?"
            
            "That's not one of ours, you idiot!" another elf barks, dropping her crate and drawing her sword.
            
            Shit.
        ]
rows.translation:
小琳的想法很对。你迅速躲进昏暗的阴影中，尽量躲在那些武器箱堆后面；其他人也纷纷效仿，分散在走廊各处。你的藏身之处虽然不算特别巧妙，但那些精灵们似乎注意力都不太集中，因此你或许能够一直隐藏起来，直到他们靠近到足以让你发动突然袭击的时候。 

        他们没有让你等待太久。那些凶残的霜冻精灵把最后一个箱子从平台上搬下来，只是停下来擦了擦额头上的汗水，以及那些闪亮的裸露的腹部。其中一个人停了下来，靠在她的箱子上。上面那个东西让我觉得毛骨悚然，”她朝着天空说道，同时向同伴解释。
        
        “为什么？”另一个精灵开玩笑地问，“难道是因为它是这个该死的岛上唯一不会让你去‘舔它的阴茎’的东西吗？”
        
        第一个精灵气愤地哼了一声。它甚至连一个人形都没有！看起来根本就不像人……”
        
        “如果你想说它没有灵魂的话……”
        
        精灵对着她的同伴吐了吐舌头，然后又把她的箱子提了起来。“说起来没有灵魂的话，我们得在托勒斯的那一条眉毛掉下来之前把这些东西送到他那里去。如果到明年冬天他还没有坐上科尔米诺斯的王位……”
        
        “那我们所有人都会被送进繁殖场！”其他人替她把话说完了。他们全都大笑起来，然后继续工作，朝你的方向走去。
        
        [var0
            |你屏住呼吸，悄悄躲在阴影中，手紧紧握住[pc.weapon]那些被腐蚀的精灵们渐渐靠近，距离已经近到达莉莎能够从暗影中冲出来抓住其中的一个；而你和小琳则冲向这群精灵的中间，把他们吓得四处乱窜、惊声尖叫。
            |你屏住呼吸，紧紧握住手中的东西。 [pc.weapon]马上就来了……”

            “嘿，那是谁？”其中一个精灵随意地问道，手指直指你。“你躲在那里干什么？”
            
            “那不是我们的人，笨蛋！”另一个精灵厉声说道，扔下自己的箱子，拔出了剑。
            
            糟了。
        ]

rows.original: Slip into the shadows and strike when the corrupted elves least expect it.
rows.translation: 潜入阴影，在那些被腐蚀的精灵最不设防的时候发动攻击。
rows.raw: "Slip into the shadows and strike when the corrupted elves least expect it."

rows.original:
You draw your [pc.weapon] and let loose a warcry, hurling yourself up the stairs towards the elves before they know what's hit them. Crates clatter, and shouts of alarm replace their idle laughs. "Kas's ass! It's the Champion!" one of them shrieks. "We're fucked!"

        "Hold!" another bellows. "We take [pc.himHer], and we'll give the queen a gift worth our souls!"
        
        Like hell!
rows.translation:
你拔出你的[pc.weapon]，发出一声战吼，趁着精灵们还没反应过来就冲上楼梯扑向他们。木箱哗啦作响，原本的闲笑声被惊恐的呼喊取代。“卡希的屁股！是冠军！”其中一个尖叫道。“我们完蛋了！”

        “站住！”另一个吼道。“我们抓住[pc.himHer]，就能献给女王一份抵得上我们灵魂的礼物！”
        
        去他妈的！

rows.original: You've no patience for subterfuge. Charge the enemy.
rows.translation: 你可没有耐心使用那些隐秘的手段，直接冲向敌人吧。
rows.raw: "You've no patience for subterfuge. Charge the enemy."

rows.original: You brush your fingers along the glowing blue runes etched all along the walls, coiling towards the central spire. You haven't the faintest clue what these do or are meant to represent, but you can feel the ancient power stored inside them, just waiting to be unleashed. Closing your eyes, you push your hand hard against the stone and focus your will into the runes — no spell, no catalyst, just a brute force attempt to tap the ambient magic built up and let it free. The magic practically leaps to your touch, straining against the shackles binding it. All through the tower, the intricate runic filigree adorning the stone begins to glow, their inner light intensifying into a blinding radiance. One of the corrupted elves shrieks, dropping the crate of weapons she was carrying; another draws a sword from her hip, only to be crushed flat by a creature materializing out of thin air. What one moment is a haze at the light's edge suddenly takes the form of a salamander woman with great wings and horns, and wielding a blade of pure, crackling energy in her scaled hands. She unleashes a thunderous roar and brings her foot down hard on the elf's she's crushed already, ending her with a sickening crack. "Ach! My head!" Daliza groans, gritting her teeth. "[pc.name], what did you do!?" "No idea!" you tell her honestly. Dal seems kind of rough, but you have to take advantage of the chaos you've caused. Drawing your [pc.weapon], you leap into the fray!
rows.translation: 你的手指拂过铭刻在墙壁各处、蜿蜒伸向中央尖塔的发光蓝色符文。你对它们的作用或象征意义一无所知，却能感到其中储存的古老力量，正在等待释放。你闭上双眼，用力把手掌按在石头上，将自己的意志集中到符文中——没有咒语，没有媒介，只以蛮力尝试接触周围积聚的魔力，将其释放出来。 魔力几乎主动扑向你的触碰，奋力挣扎着对抗束缚自身的枷锁。整座塔中，装点石壁的繁复符文纹饰都开始发光；内在光芒愈发强烈，化作令人失明的辉耀。一名腐化精灵尖叫一声，丢下怀中搬运的武器箱；另一名精灵从腰间拔出长剑，却被凭空显形的生物压成扁平。一瞬间还只是光芒边缘的朦胧幻影，下一刻便化作生有巨翼和犄角的火蜥蜴人女子；覆满鳞片的双手握着一柄纯粹而噼啪作响的能量之刃。她爆发出雷鸣般的咆哮，一脚重重踩上已经被自己压倒的精灵，伴着令人作呕的喀嚓声结束了她的性命。 “啊！我的头！”达莉莎咬紧牙关，呻吟道。“[pc.name]，你做了什么！？” “不知道！”你如实告诉她。达莉莎的状态似乎有些糟，但你必须利用自己造成的混乱。你抽出[pc.weapon]，纵身投入战斗！

rows.original: You could use your magic to overcharge the runes in the walls, potentially causing a wild magic surge in the central chamber. Gods know what it'll do, but it'll be something!
rows.translation: 你可以用魔法让墙上的符文过载，这样可能会在中央大厅引发一场狂野魔法涌动。天知道它会做什么，但肯定会闹出点动静来！
rows.raw: "You could use your magic to overcharge the runes in the walls, potentially causing a wild magic surge in the central chamber. Gods know what it'll do, but it'll be something!"

rows.original: You don't have the training to interface with these runes, at least not on short notice.
rows.translation: 你没有接受过相应的训练，因此无法操作这些符文，至少短时间内是无法做到的。
rows.raw: "You don't have the training to interface with these runes, at least not on short notice."

rows.original:
You tumble back, [pc.weapon] scattering across the stone. A heeled boot presses you down, and a sword's tip grazes your chin. 

    "So you're the great Champion that Queen Kasyrra keeps going on about?" the elf laughs. "Well, look at you now. Queen Alissa's going to have a field day with you."
    
    She turns to where Ryn's slumped down beside you, holding her head in her hands. "And you, princess. If I could still feel bad for you, I'm sure I would. But instead... I'm just rock hard thinking about watching what she'll do to you."
    
    The woman grins down at you, and then her boot cracks against your head. Darkness takes you.
rows.translation:
你向后摔倒，[pc.weapon]也在石地上滑了出去。一只带跟的靴子把你踩住，剑尖擦过你的下巴。

    “原来你就是卡希拉女王一直挂在嘴边的伟大勇者？”精灵笑道，“瞧瞧你现在的模样。艾莉莎女王肯定会好好玩弄你。”
    
    她转向瘫坐在你身旁、双手抱头的小琳。“还有你，公主。要是我还能替你难过，想必我确实会难过。可现在……光是想象她会怎样对待你，我就硬得不行。”
    
    那个女人俯视着你咧嘴一笑，随后一脚重重踢中你的脑袋。黑暗吞没了你。
rows.raw:
"
    You tumble back, [pc.weapon] scattering across the stone. A heeled boot presses you down, and a sword's tip grazes your chin. 

    "So you're the great Champion that Queen Kasyrra keeps going on about?" the elf laughs. "Well, look at you now. Queen Alissa's going to have a field day with you."
    
    She turns to where Ryn's slumped down beside you, holding her head in her hands. "And you, princess. If I could still feel bad for you, I'm sure I would. But instead... I'm just rock hard thinking about watching what she'll do to you."
    
    The woman grins down at you, and then her boot cracks against your head. Darkness takes you."

rows.original: The last of the corrupted elves collapses, [var0 |and the spectral warrior conjured by your magic winks out of existence with a parting roar, leaving you in silence |letting quiet descend on the tower punctuated only by their groans of arousal and pain ]. Daliza lets out a breath and slides her blade back into its scabbard. She stares down at the fallen warriors, hands on her hips. "They were party of Alissa's personal guard," she says. "Never accounted for after the purge." "I recognize them. Barely," Ryn says, squatting down beside one. The muscular elven warrior hisses, recoiling from Ryn's touch. The princess glances up at you, frowning. "You... you used to sneak me sweets, when my sister [etheryn.lowConfidence |w-was particularly a-angry with me |was at her cruelest ] and locked me in my rooms. And her! Relanne, you once tripped yourself in the throne room to distract Alissa when she was about to hit me! Y-your daughter's almost my age. [etheryn.lowConfidence |I-I often wished we could have played together, as children. |I remember watching you train with her in the courtyard growing up! I've only just invited her to join the palace guard in your place. ] She misses you so much!" Etheryn rocks back on her heels, looking the elves over. "What happened to all of you..." The corrupted elves grumble and look askance. You [pc.dcb |cross your arms |put a comforting hand on Ryn's shoulder |give Ryn a hug from behind[pc.hasBoobs | and bury her head in your chest where it's nice and comfy ] ]. "They followed their queen. Even after everything she did." "But why..." "Loyalty," Daliza says evenly, "misguided though it is. Serving beneath a unworthy tyrant like Alissa makes blind obedience the easy choice. It takes courage to confront the truth; something all of us lacked for far too long. I'm afraid some never found theirs at all." "What do you know!" one of the fallen elves spits. "You fled the city at every chance, Jarlessa Dracia! Spent more time howling with your wolf in the wild than serving your queen. Where were you when the demon came?" Daliza balls her fist, but Ryn puts a calming hand on the bailiff's. "[etheryn.lowConfidence |D-don't hurt them. Please... |Don't let her bait you. This isn't your fault. Or theirs. ]" The redhead makes an effort to relax her shoulders. "As you wish, Lady Regent. What should we do with these traitors, then?"
rows.translation: 最后一名腐化精灵倒下，[var0 |由你的魔法召唤出的幽灵战士发出告别的咆哮，随即从现实中消失，只留下寂静 |塔内重新恢复安静，只有她们因情欲与痛楚发出的呻吟打破沉寂 ]。达莉莎松了口气，将长剑滑回鞘中。她双手叉腰，俯视倒下的战士。 “她们曾是艾莉莎私人卫队的成员，”她说道。“清洗过后便再也没人知道她们的下落。” “我认得她们。勉强认得，”小琳蹲在其中一人身旁说道。 肌肉健硕的精灵战士嘶叫一声，从小琳的触碰下畏缩退开。公主皱着眉，抬头望向你。“你……以前姐姐[etheryn.lowConfidence |对、对我格、格外生气 |对我最为残酷 ]、把我锁在房间里时，你会偷偷给我带甜食。还有她！蕾兰妮，有一次艾莉莎正要打我，你故意在王座厅里绊倒自己，转移她的注意力！你、你的女儿已经快和我一样大了。[etheryn.lowConfidence |我、我小时候常常希望自己能和她一起玩。 |我记得小时候曾看着你在庭院里训练她！我刚刚才邀请她代替你加入宫廷卫队。 ]她非常想念你！” 伊瑟琳坐回脚后跟上，打量着这些精灵。“你们所有人究竟遭遇了什么……” 腐化精灵们低声抱怨，纷纷移开目光。 你[pc.dcb |抱起双臂 |用一只手安慰地搭上小琳的肩膀 |从背后抱住小琳[pc.hasBoobs |，让她把脑袋埋进你舒适柔软的胸脯 ] ]。“她们追随了自己的女王。即使经历了她所做的一切。” “但为什么……” “忠诚，”达莉莎平静地说道，“即使这份忠诚受到了误导。在艾莉莎这种不配统治的暴君麾下效力时，盲目服从便成了轻松的选择。直面真相需要勇气；而我们所有人都缺乏这种勇气太久。恐怕有些人从未找到过自己的勇气。” “你懂什么！”一名倒下的精灵啐道。“你一有机会就逃离城市，达拉西亚的女领主！你花在荒野中和那头狼一起嚎叫的时间，比服侍女王还多。恶魔出现时，你又在哪里？” 达莉莎握紧拳头，小琳却用一只手安抚地按住女管事的手。“[etheryn.lowConfidence |别、别伤害她们。求你了…… |别中了她的挑衅。这不是你的错，也不是她们的错。 ]” 红发女子努力放松双肩。“如您所愿，摄政女士。那么，这些叛徒该怎么处置？”

rows.original:
You grab some of the ropes off the nearby crates and hog-tie the fallen elves. Ryn breathes a quiet sigh of relief and helps you bind them while Daliza climbs the stairs, examining the runework on the platform.

        "It looks like some kind of lift," the bailiff calls down. "There's an activation rune here, I think."
        
        That's your ticket upwards, then.
rows.translation:
你从附近的箱子里拿了一些绳子，把那些倒下的精灵们绑了起来。小琳悄悄地松了一口气，帮你把他们绑紧，而达莉莎则爬上了楼梯，仔细检查平台上的符文。

        “看起来这是某种升降装置，”法警从下面喊道，“这里应该有一个启动符文。”
        
        那么，这就是你向上攀登的途径了。
