"You'll help us with this one too, won't you, Gerry?" ] If you help me. Which, I think, you're in a position to. I-is this going to be another of those [silly |fetch quests where he asks you to get twenty bear asses for him |requests where he asks you to do a milk run for him ]? Actually, no. I'd like to understand you a little more. If you don't mind answering some questions that I think would help shed some insight on how you think, I would be happy to help Antonina with her most recent vision. O-ok... but he's a huge psychic monster, right? Can't he just read your mind and get his answers that way? Yes, but that would be exceedingly rude, especially for someone who isn't what you term a dreamwalker. Also, the way you phrase your answers tells me something in and of itself. You are inebriated, which makes you quite honest; this is a fine opportunity. A-all right, let's just get this over with... "

rows.original: Now then, [pc.name]. W-wait. You don't ever remember telling Gerry y-your name... It's lit up above your head like a blazing beacon. I suppose that's one way to describe it in terms you can understand. You look at Nina, and the harpy nods before taking a swig of ice wine. "Gerry's not lying, [pc.name]. Hard to not see if you've got eyes to look with. Which you don't, but we do." F-fine... Where were we? Ah, yes. If you could please answer some of these questions, I would be grateful. There are no right or wrong answers to any of them, and I'd prefer it if you didn't overthink the matter; happily, you are in a state conducive to such an outlook. Just go with your gut feeling, as they say — shall we begin? All r-right...
rows.translation: 那么，[pc.name]。 等、等等。你难道从来都不记得自己告诉过杰里你的名字吗…… 它就像一盏闪耀的信标，高高亮在你头顶。我想，用你能理解的话来说，大概就是这个意思吧。 你看着妮娜，那个鹰身女妖点了点头，然后喝了一口冰酒。“杰里没有说谎，[pc.name]。只要你有眼睛可以看，就很难看不到它。你没有眼睛，但我们有。” 好、好吧…… 我们刚才说到哪儿了？啊，对了。如果您能回答其中一些问题，我将不胜感激。这些问题没有对错之分，我也希望您不要想得太多；令人高兴的是，您的状态正适合这样的心态。就像人们说的，跟着直觉走吧——我们可以开始了吗？ 好、好的……
rows.raw: " Now then, [pc.name]. W-wait. You don't ever remember telling Gerry y-your name... It's lit up above your head like a blazing beacon. I suppose that's one way to describe it in terms you can understand. You look at Nina, and the harpy nods before taking a swig of ice wine. "Gerry's not lying, [pc.name]. Hard to not see if you've got eyes to look with. Which you don't, but we do." F-fine... Where were we? Ah, yes. If you could please answer some of these questions, I would be grateful. There are no right or wrong answers to any of them, and I'd prefer it if you didn't overthink the matter; happily, you are in a state conducive to such an outlook. Just go with your gut feeling, as they say — shall we begin? All r-right..."

rows.original: Which came first, the chicken or the egg?
rows.raw: "Which came first, the chicken or the egg?"

rows.original: What kind of question is this? This is ridiculous and you don't appreciate having your time wasted.
rows.translation: 这算什么问题啊？简直荒谬至极，你肯定不希望自己的时间被这样浪费吧。
rows.raw: "What kind of question is this? This is ridiculous and you don't appreciate having your time wasted."

rows.original: You have labored most of your life on a masterpiece when you're informed you're fatally ill and have three years left to live. Do you spend your remaining time finishing your life's work, or enjoy what little time you have left?
rows.translation: 当你得知自己患了绝症，只剩下三年的时间时，你一生中的大部分时间都在为一部杰作而努力。那么，在剩下的时间里，你是会选择完成自己一生的心血，还是选择好好享受这段短暂的时间呢？
rows.raw: "You have labored most of your life on a masterpiece when you're informed you're fatally ill and have three years left to live. Do you spend your remaining time finishing your life's work, or enjoy what little time you have left?"

rows.original: You've already sunk so much time into your work. No one may remember you, but your craft will inspire others beyond your death.
rows.translation: 你已经在自己的工作中投入了如此多的时间。也许没有人会记住你，但你的技艺将在你离世后继续激励他人。
rows.raw: "You've already sunk so much time into your work. No one may remember you, but your craft will inspire others beyond your death."

rows.original: You've sacrificed so much, but sunk costs shouldn't hold you up. What's the point if you're not going to be around to enjoy the fruit of your work?
rows.translation: 你付出了这么多，但已经投入的成本不应该成为你的负担。如果你无法享受到自己努力的成果，那这一切还有什么意义呢？
rows.raw: "You've sacrificed so much, but sunk costs shouldn't hold you up. What's the point if you're not going to be around to enjoy the fruit of your work?"

rows.original: Big tits or small tits? Pardon the phrasing, but you must understand that I had to borrow it in its totality, for obvious reasons.
rows.translation: 大胸还是小胸？抱歉用了这样的表达方式，但你必须明白，出于显而易见的原因，我不得不完全照搬这个说法。
rows.raw: "Big tits or small tits? Pardon the phrasing, but you must understand that I had to borrow it in its totality, for obvious reasons."

rows.original: Tits can't be compared, this is a silly and meaningless question.
rows.translation: 乳房是无法进行比较的，这是一个愚蠢且毫无意义的问题。
rows.raw: "Tits can't be compared, this is a silly and meaningless question."

rows.translation: 你更喜欢双性人的阴茎。

rows.original: A member of your immediate family and your lover are caught in a deathtrap, but you only have time to save one. Who do you save?
rows.translation: 你的直系亲属和你的爱人同时陷入了致命的陷阱，但你只有一次机会来救其中一个人。你会选择救谁呢？
rows.raw: "A member of your immediate family and your lover are caught in a deathtrap, but you only have time to save one. Who do you save?"

rows.original: You don't believe you can't at least make the attempt to save them both.
rows.translation: 你不会真的认为自己连尝试拯救他们俩的勇气都没有吧。
rows.raw: "You don't believe you can't at least make the attempt to save them both."

rows.original: Abandon both and not risk getting caught in the trap yourself.
rows.translation: 放弃这两者，这样才能避免自己陷入陷阱。
rows.raw: "Abandon both and not risk getting caught in the trap yourself."

rows.original: You appear to have taken up a considerable burden upon yourself with this whole demon menace matter. If you could turn back time and live a life of happiness on your own terms and leave your quest to someone else who could complete it better than you, would you agree to do so?
rows.translation: 你似乎因为这个恶魔威胁的事情而背负了沉重的负担。如果你能够回到过去，按照自己的方式过上幸福的生活，然后将这个任务交给别人去完成，因为别人可能会做得比你更好，你会同意这样做吗？
rows.raw: "You appear to have taken up a considerable burden upon yourself with this whole demon menace matter. If you could turn back time and live a life of happiness on your own terms and leave your quest to someone else who could complete it better than you, would you agree to do so?"

rows.original: Your beloved mentor has been kind to you and yours in the past, yet has begun a reign of terror across the land. What do you do?
rows.translation: 你敬爱的导师过去一直对你们充满善意，然而现在他却开始在这片土地上施行恐怖统治。你们该怎么办呢？
rows.raw: "Your beloved mentor has been kind to you and yours in the past, yet has begun a reign of terror across the land. What do you do?"

rows.original: Side with him out of loyalty.
rows.translation: 出于忠诚，选择站在他的一边。

rows.original: Defeat him as is your responsibility.
Become a hermit and distance yourself from the dilemma.
rows.translation: 成为隐士，远离这种困境吧。
rows.raw: "Become a hermit and distance yourself from the dilemma."

rows.original: Defeat him, and then commit suicide as atonement for your betrayal.
rows.translation: 击败他，然后自杀以赎清你的背叛之罪。
rows.raw: "Defeat him, and then commit suicide as atonement for your betrayal."

rows.original: Recently, there've been reports of pirates luring in victims with ruses. While at sea one day, you come across a sinking ship that looks to be moments from going under — any delay could mean lives lost, but it could also be a trap. Do you help the wrecked ship, or not?
rows.translation: 最近有报道称，海盗们正在用各种诡计诱骗受害者。有一天，你在海上遇到了一艘即将沉没的船只——任何拖延都可能意味着有人会丧命，但这也可能是一个陷阱。你是应该帮助这艘遇难的船只，还是选择不介入呢？
rows.raw: "Recently, there've been reports of pirates luring in victims with ruses. While at sea one day, you come across a sinking ship that looks to be moments from going under — any delay could mean lives lost, but it could also be a trap. Do you help the wrecked ship, or not?"

rows.original: Help the survivors unquestioningly. Time is of the essence.
rows.translation: 无条件地帮助幸存者。时间至关重要。
rows.raw: "Help the survivors unquestioningly. Time is of the essence."

rows.original: Stay back awhile and observe the situation. It could be a trap.
rows.translation: 稍等片刻，观察一下情况。这可能是个陷阱。
rows.raw: "Stay back awhile and observe the situation. It could be a trap."

rows.original: Not risk the danger and pass by.
rows.translation: 不要冒危险，直接绕过去吧。
rows.raw: "Not risk the danger and pass by."

rows.original: Do you believe in fate? Are our actions predetermined from the moment of our births?
rows.translation: 你相信命运吗？我们的行为是否从我们出生的那一刻起就已经被注定了呢？
rows.raw: "Do you believe in fate? Are our actions predetermined from the moment of our births?"

rows.original: Fighting destiny is hubris and folly, and can only bring grief.
rows.translation: 与命运抗争是傲慢与愚蠢的行为，只会带来痛苦。
rows.raw: "Fighting destiny is hubris and folly, and can only bring grief."

rows.original: While the major highlights may be set in stone, you have the freedom to choose how to approach the important events of your life.
rows.translation: 虽然那些重要的时刻或许早已注定，但你完全可以自由选择如何面对自己人生中的这些关键事件。
rows.raw: "While the major highlights may be set in stone, you have the freedom to choose how to approach the important events of your life."

rows.original: Fate doesn't exist, and perseverance will prevail over this so-called predestiny.
rows.translation: 命运并不存在，唯有坚持才能战胜这种所谓的宿命。
rows.raw: "Fate doesn't exist, and perseverance will prevail over this so-called predestiny."

rows.original: This is a silly question of the kind that's asked by people who do nothing, instead of those who actually perform deeds. Whether it's because of fate or not is immaterial.
rows.translation: 这是一个愚蠢的问题，这种问题通常是那些什么都不做的人才会提出来的，而不是那些真正有所作为的人。无论这是由于命运的安排还是其他原因，都无关紧要。
rows.raw: "This is a silly question of the kind that's asked by people who do nothing, instead of those who actually perform deeds. Whether it's because of fate or not is immaterial."

rows.original: You find a dead body by the side of the road. What do you do?
rows.translation: 你在路边发现了一具尸体。你会怎么做？
rows.raw: "You find a dead body by the side of the road. What do you do?"

rows.original: Even the ignomous deserve as much.
rows.translation: 即便是那些可耻之人，也理应得到同样的对待。

rows.original: Bury the body, but take any valuables. It may be the right thing to do, but you also deserve compensation for an otherwise thankless task.
rows.translation: 把尸体埋掉，但要把所有值钱的东西带走。这样做或许是正确的，但毕竟这项任务本就没什么回报，你也应该得到相应的补偿。
rows.raw: "Bury the body, but take any valuables. It may be the right thing to do, but you also deserve compensation for an otherwise thankless task."

rows.original: It could be a trap, the corpse could be diseased, or any other number of reasons. There's no reason for you to stick your neck out.
rows.translation: 这可能是个陷阱，那具尸体可能患有疾病，或者还有其他种种原因。你没有理由去自寻麻烦。
rows.raw: "It could be a trap, the corpse could be diseased, or any other number of reasons. There's no reason for you to stick your neck out."

rows.original: Given the finite time we all have, do you believe it's better to hone one skill to perfection, or embrace many skills to a lesser degree for flexibility?
rows.translation: 考虑到我们每个人所拥有的时间是有限的，你认为是应该将某一项技能磨练得炉火纯青，还是应该掌握多项技能，尽管这些技能的掌握程度可能都不高，但这样能带来更多的灵活性呢？
rows.raw: "Given the finite time we all have, do you believe it's better to hone one skill to perfection, or embrace many skills to a lesser degree for flexibility?"

rows.original: This is ridiculous, I'm talented enough to perfect many skills.
rows.translation: 这太荒谬了，我的天赋足以让我掌握许多技能。
rows.raw: "This is ridiculous, I'm talented enough to perfect many skills."

rows.original: If one day you're faced with an enemy far stronger than you, you'd...
rows.translation: 如果有一天你遇到了一个比你强大得多的敌人，你会……
rows.raw: "If one day you're faced with an enemy far stronger than you, you'd..."

rows.original: Surely an opportunity to turn the tables will present itself if you hang on for long enough.
rows.translation: 只要坚持足够长的时间，肯定会有机会扭转局势的。
rows.raw: "Surely an opportunity to turn the tables will present itself if you hang on for long enough."

rows.original: No shame in running to fight another day.
rows.translation: 推迟战斗也没什么可羞愧的。
rows.raw: "No shame in running to fight another day."

rows.original: This would never happen to begin with, your strength is unparalleled.
rows.translation: 这种事本来就不会发生，你的实力是无人能及的。
rows.raw: "This would never happen to begin with, your strength is unparalleled."

rows.original: While traveling, you come across someone you find attractive bathing in a mountain spring. You...
rows.translation: 在旅途中，你偶然看到有一个人在山间的泉水中沐浴，而你发现这个人非常吸引人……
rows.raw: "While traveling, you come across someone you find attractive bathing in a mountain spring. You..."

rows.original: Have some decency and give the person their privacy.
rows.translation: 请有点公德心，尊重他人的隐私吧。
rows.raw: "Have some decency and give the person their privacy."

rows.original: Nothing ventured, nothing gained; you should not just follow, but transcend your desires and approach this person.
rows.translation: 不入虎穴，焉得虎子；你不应该只是被动跟随，而应该超越自己的欲望，主动去接近这个人。
rows.raw: "Nothing ventured, nothing gained; you should not just follow, but transcend your desires and approach this person."

rows.original: A demon you've long been feuding with claims to have had a change of heart and has started doing good deeds, going so far as to express the intention of befriending you. Do you accept this friendship?
rows.translation: 一个与你长期结仇的恶魔声称自己已经改变了主意，开始做善事，甚至表示愿意与你交朋友。你愿意接受这份友谊吗？
rows.raw: "A demon you've long been feuding with claims to have had a change of heart and has started doing good deeds, going so far as to express the intention of befriending you. Do you accept this friendship?"

rows.original: Upon receiving your final answer, the lureling radiates an aura of contentment — or at least, something that mimics it to a sufficient degree. That will be all, [pc.name]. Thank you. C-cool, yeah. Now, w-what about Nina's vision? Although to be honest, you're not sure that all of this isn't a dream and you'll just come to completely smashed back at Rumie's... but if all of this is just one big fever dream, then it can't hurt to enjoy yourself while you're here, right? Well, yes, her vision. You're already on this little journey together, so I don't need to elaborate on that. Encountering various colorful characters, who may or may not be violent depending on your choices. "That's not very helpful," Nina points out. "What're we supposed to do, exactly?" [pc.name] here is meant to help you remember something you've forgotten. And after you drink it... Gerry hesitates. I'm not sure. "What, you're not sure? How can you be?" That future is impenetrable to my mind, I'm afraid. Nina takes another swig of ice wine and wipes her mouth with the back of her hand before passing you the bottle, which you gleefully drain. "Oh, by the gods, come on! Are you really that special, [pc.name]?" M-m-maybe? You're certainly keeping down far, far more ice wine than even you thought possible. It's c-certainly plausible that you've hidden d-depths. But isn't Gerry an all-powerful lureling with an equally amazing mind? We have our limitations, [pc.raceCute]. All of us do. Although the both of you will need this — the first step, after all, is that of collecting components. A large flask materializes from thin air and bobs over to Nina, who catches it in both hands. Judging by the label through your blurry vision, it holds conjuror's concoction. You're about to ask what the point of all this is when Nina's eye lights up and she snaps her fingers. "That's it!" That's w-what? "Gods, my head hurts from all this remembering. But what's important is that the conjuror's concoction is a component, an ingredient necessary in preparing a mundane's mind for way-walking. That's... that's one of the things the waystones do, amongst so many others. The brew lets you see, the concoction lets you enter..." H-how does she know all these things? Has she done this before? Nina's gaze turns distant. "It's all coming back to me, duh. To enter from what we call reality and to the Ways Between — our collective, shared dreams — and use it to get from place to place, your mind doesn't just need to be able to perceive the rift, it's also got to be able to go through with your body. Only if the mind knows which reality lies on the other side will it be able to reach its destination; otherwise, your body will pass freely, but the mind will stay behind. You'll be split: unless there's something or someone else keeping your sense of self in one piece, it's going to fizzle out since there's no fleshy brain to maintain it; on the other hand, your braindead body will exist as long as it can with no one home. That's no good. "If you make a less terrible mistake, you might get through in one piece, but things like memories and emotions could very well tear away from your psyche, and you're not getting those back. That's one of the reasons why the wizards of Old Belhar figured out the system of waystones and the keys to use them, to do all the work automatically so even the dumbest idiot could safely walk the Ways physically without tearing him or herself apart." M-makes sense... you've never been able to travel to a waystone you hadn't met and activated before.
rows.translation: 在收到你的最终答案后，那只诱饵鱼会散发出一种满足的气息——或者至少，会呈现出足以让人误以为它真的感到满足的状态。就这样吧。 [pc.name]谢谢。 酷，没错。那么，妮娜的预感又该怎么看呢？说实话，你也不确定这一切是否只是梦境，最终你可能会再次遭到露米的重创……但既然这一切都只是一场狂热的梦境，那么在这段时间里尽情享受当下吧，也没什么坏处，对吧？ 嗯，没错，就是她的愿景。你们已经一起踏上了这段旅程，所以我不需要再详细说明了。在旅途中，你会遇到各种各样性格迥异的角色，他们的行为是否具有暴力性，完全取决于你的选择。 这没什么帮助，”妮娜指出，“我们到底该怎么办呢？确实真的是这样吗？ [pc.name]的作用就是帮助你回忆那些你已经忘记的事情。而当你喝下它之后……杰里犹豫了一下。我不太确定。 什么，你不确定？怎么可能呢？ 恐怕，那个未来对我来说仍然是无法理解的。 妮娜又喝了一口冰酒，用手背擦了擦嘴，然后把酒瓶递给你，你高兴地一饮而尽。“哦，天啊，太棒了！开启！ 你真的有那么特别吗？ [pc.name]也许吧？你喝的冰酒数量肯定远远超出了你自己的预期。你藏了一些酒也是完全有可能的。但是，杰里不也是一个能力强大、头脑同样出色的家伙吗？ 我们也有自己的局限性。 [pc.raceCute]我们所有人都是这么做的。不过你们俩确实需要这个步骤——毕竟，第一步就是收集所需的组件。 一个巨大的烧瓶凭空出现，漂浮在尼娜面前，她用双手接住了它。透过模糊的视线，你看到标签上写着“法师的配方”。你正准备询问这一切到底是为了什么，这时尼娜的眼睛突然亮了起来，她打了个响指。 “就是这个！” 就、就是这个？ “天啊，回忆这些事情让我头疼得厉害……但重要的是，法师的配方其实是其中的一个成分啊成分这些做法对于让普通人准备好踏上这段旅程来说是必要的。也就是说……这些就是路标所具有的功能之一，除此之外它们还有很多其他作用。这种药剂能让人们看到某些东西，这种调配物能让人们进入某个特定的领域…… 她怎么会知道这些事情的呢？她以前做过这种事情吗？ 尼娜的目光变得恍惚起来。“这一切都在慢慢浮现在我的脑海中，这还用说。要想从我们所谓的‘现实’中进入那些‘中间通道’——那些我们共同拥有的梦想空间——并利用它们在各个地方之间穿梭，你的头脑不仅需要能够感知到那些通道的存在，你的身体也必须能够真正穿过它们。只有当心灵明白另一边存在着怎样的现实时，它才能够抵达目的地；否则，你的身体虽然可以自由移动，但心灵却会滞留在原地。你会陷入分裂的状态：除非有某种力量或存在将你的自我意识凝聚在一起，否则这种自我意识就会逐渐消散，因为没有实体化的头脑来维持它；而另一方面，你的没有意识的身体也会继续存在，只不过没有人会关注它罢了。那样可不行。 如果你犯的错误不那么严重，或许还能安然无恙地通过考验，但那些记忆与情感很可能会从你的精神世界中剥离出去，而你再也无法将它们夺回来。这就是为什么古贝尔哈尔的巫师们设计了路标系统以及使用这些路标的方法——让所有流程都自动化，这样即使是最愚钝的人，也能安全地走过这些道路，而不会因此受到伤害。 嗯……确实有道理……你从来不可能前往那些你之前从未遇到过、也从未激活过的路标地点。

rows.original: "Once you prepare the mind, you can enter the Ways. The Ways... our dreams shield us from the horrors of the void between the spheres, create a boundary between our world and that darkness. It's not perfect, but it's pretty damn good at its job nonetheless. Beyond the Ways, there're only untold horrors: abrasive winds that tear your flesh away, toxic fumes that melt your lungs, blinding darkness that'll totally mess up your eyes. Powerful energies capable of molding your fleshy self into a gibbering mess, dark dust up in every crevice, and of course, the wraiths. Can't forget them. All that and more keep on trying to reach us, hungry for our emotions, our lives, what we represent. "Can you imagine it? A dark, desolate landscape surrounding you on all sides, because the sky and the ground are the same, there's no up or down to be had. The air itself being alive, and the dark dust forming teeth, claws, blades, tentacles, wings. These will cut, bite, pierce, whack and flap at you, all manner of deadly unpleasantries, and there'll be nothing but the shrieking and the sound of flesh being torn apart. that's the kind of place you'll wind up in if you misstep your entry into the Ways and find yourself elsewhere instead. "That's not good, not good at all. Another reason why dreamwalkers leave their bodies behind, and you mundanes have to use waystones. Gods, we'd use waystones too if we could." T-that's been a lot of talking. You're not sure you caught it all, but you have the feeling in your heart — or the gurgling pit of your stomach, it's hard to tell — that this is the right thing to have done. Like... like you were following Nina's vision or something. Another swig of ice wine, and yeah, the sensation of rightness intensifies; that must've been in the vision, too. Heh. Thanks, Gerry. No, thank you for answering my questions.[QUEST_WINTER_WOLF.stateRange 9 | That, and getting me out of that bind. I'll find a way to deal with [silly |Pastor Mike |this Tollus person ] in my own time, but don't let up your own efforts, too. ] C-cool. So, you're done here? "You've got that feeling too, right, [pc.name]? That feeling of going with the flow?" Nina produces another bottle of ice wine. Or is it ale? It's a little hard to tell. "That's how you know the vision's guiding you, so long as you willingly follow it. Trust me. And the visions. Always trust the visions." Ok... It's then that your body — or whatever passes for your body in this condition — decides to keel over from sheer drunkenness, but it never actually hits the ground. Or is there ground? Whatever. Point being that Nina does the whole air-ripping thing yet again, and your drunken stumbling sends you falling neatly into the hole...
rows.translation: “心智准备妥当后，你便能进入界间之路。界间之路……我们的梦境保护我们，抵挡世界球体之间虚空里的恐怖存在，在我们的世界与那片黑暗之间筑起一道边界。它并不完美，但照样能把本职工作干得他妈相当出色。界间之路之外只有数不尽的恐怖：磨蚀性的风会刮走血肉，有毒烟雾会融化肺部，致盲黑暗会彻底毁掉眼睛。强大的能量能把你的肉身塑成咿呀怪叫的烂泥，暗尘会钻进每一条缝隙；当然，还有幽魂。可不能忘了它们。所有这些乃至更多东西，都在不停试图触及我们，渴求我们的情感、生命，还有我们所代表的一切。 “你能想象吗？一片黑暗荒凉的景象从四面八方包围你；天空与地面没有区别，那里不存在上下之分。空气本身拥有生命，暗尘则化作牙齿、利爪、刀刃、触手与翅膀。它们会切割、撕咬、刺穿、猛击、拍打你，使出各种致命而令人不快的手段；耳边只剩尖啸与血肉撕裂的声音。要是进入界间之路时踏错一步，误入了别的地方，你最终就会落进这样的境地。 “这可不好，一点也不好。这也是梦行者为何要把身体留在身后，而你们普通人必须使用道标石的另一个原因。诸神啊，要是可以，我们也会使用道标石。” 说、说了好多话。你不确定自己是否全部听懂，但心中有种感觉——也可能来自咕噜作响的胃，很难分辨——告诉你这样做才是正确的。就像……你在遵循妮娜的预知之类的东西。再喝一口冰酒；没错，那股正确的感觉变得更加强烈了。这肯定也在预知里。嘿嘿，谢谢你，杰里。 不，该感谢你回答我的问题。[QUEST_WINTER_WOLF.stateRange 9 | 还有帮我摆脱困境。我会按自己的步调想办法对付[silly |迈克牧师 |那个叫托勒斯的人 ]，但你也别松懈自己的努力。 ] 好、好吧。那么，你在这里的事结束了？ “你也有那种感觉，对吧，[pc.name]？那种顺势而行的感觉？”妮娜又拿出一瓶冰酒。或者是麦酒？有点难分辨。“只要你自愿遵循预知，它引导你时便会产生那种感觉。相信我，也相信预知。永远相信预知。” 好吧…… 就在这时，你的身体——或者说这种状态下勉强算作身体的东西——因烂醉如泥而决定一头栽倒，却始终没有真正撞上地面。这里真的有地面吗？算了。重点是，妮娜又使出一次撕裂空气的招数；你醉醺醺地踉跄着，正好跌进洞里……

rows.original: The first thing that strikes you is that it's cold. Not just from the temperature alone, but also from the fact that there's a gale howling all about you; woozily, you pick your face out of the snowdrift you've landed in and struggle to your feet, shivering. After the nondescript environment of the Ways Between, the biting chill is quite the change in atmosphere, although it doesn't do anything for your drunkenness. That still stays firmly atop your consciousness like a lead brick. Fingers curl about your own, helping you upwards and onwards. Right. Nina. Are you still... wherever you were? "No. We've left the Ways Between — the dreamscape — for a little while. Gerry needed some time to himself to process your answers." Oh. That's g-good, you guess. Why is it so cold? "I think we're at one of my old homes." One of? H-how many does she have? "Five? Six? It's been a while. If not for the vision, I don't think I'd have remembered this one. Maybe. Probably. But now I do — so many memories are flooding back in, my head hurts..." So s-she used to live here too? You look around with bleary eyes, and think you're on a mountainside — it could be a slope, or it could just be your drunken stumbling. There's a lot of packed snow here, and off in the distance you can maybe see a bunch of sea ice. All things considered, you're north of the Winter City, you think... "Yeah, I used to move around a lot after my sisters kicked me out from their flock; kept getting uprooted for one reason or the other. People wanting to kill me, ghosts following me around, nightmarish monsters appearing in my dreams and then following me out of them, it being too damned noisy, the usual stuff. Can't remember why exactly I left the old sluice gate, though, but I guess we'll be finding out shortly. What I do recall is that it used to be really comfy." Between the ice wine hammering away at the insides of your skull and the chattering of your teeth, you can only hope that she's right, because this is absolutely miserable. Nina leads you a little way on through the snow, and as you round a ridge you see what she's talking about: what looks like a large shack built directly over a stream of snowmelt running off the mountainside. That... that's her old home, you presume. "Yeah, the elves built it to sift all the water coming out of the mountain for metals, like a big pan or something. They then left because... because reasons, I guess. Maybe the metal they were sluicing out of the river ran out? But the point is that the vent that's melting the snow was still all nice and toasty, and I found it to my liking, so I moved in for a while. Problem with nice places like these is that everyone wants a piece of them, and can get very pushy about it. That's just the way things work, I guess..." You continue trudging through the snow along the mountainside, the sluice house rapidly coming more into view. Strange... your unsteady steps can't have brought you this far this quickly, but here you are anyway. It's like one of your steps counted for ten during the journey, not that you're about to question it in your current state... "This is the place, man. Here we go... drop of liquid courage?" Nina produces a bottle of ice wine from thin air, takes a swig, and offers it to you. Despite the chill of it going down your throat, fire ignites in your belly as the strong alcohol settles in your stomach, keeping good judgement at bay. Now that hit the spot! Together, you approach an old stone door in the side of the building and push it open, a gust of toasty air billowing out in your faces as it grinds aside. The sight that greets you is positively domestic — four siorcanna sitting around a large copper soup pot that's bubbling away in one of the side pools. The entire sluice-house has been built around the stream of tepid snowmelt with bridges spanning the flow, with door branching off the main building; a sluice gate at the top controls the water flowing in and out of the main floor. You don't have any more time to look around before the siorcs notice your drunken intrusion — an inevitability given that some inebriated part of your mind's decided that it's a good idea to wobble up to the mother and her daughters to say hi. H-hey, Nina's mom! What's cooking? Nina splutters, alcohol on her breath, and punches you in the shoulder. "What? [pc.name], that's not my mom, man! My mom's the harpy matron, this is a siorc!" The ancient, shrivelled shark-woman waves her ladle angrily at you. "Who in the gods-damned blazes are you and what are you doing in my home? If I'd wanted shitheads like you barging in when I'm cooking dinner for my girls, I'd never have left Seastone!" The younger siorcs show you their teeth, but your alcohol-addled mind has more important things to pay attention to. Mmm, dinner. The smell rising from the pot is heavy, if nothing else — bones, dense meat and blubber, a lot of blubber. It's the kind of food that's guaranteed to keep the cold out, quite suitable for this landscape of snow and ice... Happily, Nina steps in to save the day. "Excuse me, lady, but this place used to be mine, you know. So as it stands, you and your daughters are the ones barging into my place, you... you nasty woman. We just need to, like, find something important and then we're gone." If anything, that just incenses the old siorc even more, her voice rising to a shrill croak, if such a thing were ever possible. "Your place? Excuse me, my girls and I found this here sluicehouse fair and square, and there weren't a single trace of any feathered sluts! We came in here and fixed the place up nice, patched the roof and cleared out the geyser... if this place were ever yours at any point, something which you've only got your say-so to go on, it's ours now! How'd you like it if a couple idiots came a-barging into your home when you're cooking dinner and looking forward to a good pot of grub? You wouldn't, would you? "So my suggestion is this: you toe-lickers, beat it, you! Or else this old ma shows you right in front of her girls that she's still got some fight in this leathery body of hers!" Nina groans. Maybe she's feeling the beginnings of a hangover. "Lady —" "Don't you lady me, you feathery cumrag, an old ma like me's never been a lady in her life and I'm proud of it. Now get outta here! That goes for you too, pot-stuffer." You've reached an impasse here. Maybe, just maybe, it falls to you and your amazing gift of gab to defuse the situation...
rows.translation: 首先映入你眼帘的是刺骨的寒冷。这种寒冷不仅仅来自于气温，更来自于周围呼啸的狂风。你费力地从被雪堆埋住的地方钻出来，站起身来，不停地颤抖着。在“道路之间”那毫无特色的环境中，这种刺骨的寒意确实为氛围带来了巨大的变化——不过，对于你的醉意来说，这种寒冷丝毫没有起到任何缓解的作用。那个它依然像一块重型的砖块一样牢牢地占据着你的意识。 你的手指紧紧地握着自己的手指，帮助你不断向上、不断前进。对，尼娜，你还在……你在哪里吗？ “不，我们暂时离开了那些梦境世界。杰里需要一些时间来消化你的回答。” 哦，这样也好吧。不过为什么这里这么冷呢？ “我想我们现在是在我的一处旧居里。” 一处旧居？她到底有多少处这样的地方呢？ “五处？六个人？已经过去很久了。要不是有了那个幻象，我想我根本不会记得这个人。也许吧，大概吧。但现在我想起来了——太多回忆突然涌上心头，我的脑袋都疼了…… 那么，她也曾住在这里吗？你用模糊的目光环顾四周，问道。思考你此刻正站在山坡上——那可能是一片斜坡，也可能只是因为你喝醉了而跌跌撞撞地站在那里。这里积满了厚厚的雪，而在远处也许吧看到了大量的海冰。综合各种情况来看，你应该是在冬城以北吧…… “是啊，自从我的姐妹们把我赶出她们的群体之后，我就经常搬家；总是因为这样或那样的原因而被迫离开原来的地方。有人想杀我，鬼魂在我身边徘徊，噩梦中的怪物出现在我的梦中，然后又跟随我走出梦境，周围嘈杂声不断，都是些平常的事情。不过，我实在想不起来自己当初为什么会离开那座旧水闸门，不过我想我们很快就会知道原因的。我想要确实记得吗，过去这里确实非常舒适。 当冰酒不断冲击你的颅内，而你的牙齿也在不停地打颤时，你只能希望她是正确的，因为现在的情形实在糟糕透了悲惨的尼娜带着你在雪中前行了一段距离，当你绕过一个山脊时，你终于看到了她所说的那个地方：那看起来像是一个建在融雪溪流上的大型小屋，而这些融雪水正是从山坡上流下来的。你猜想，那……那就是她的旧家吧。 是的，精灵们建造了这个设施，用来过滤从山上流出的所有水，从而提取其中的金属，就像一个巨大的过滤器一样。后来他们离开了……我想，应该是出于某些原因吧。也许他们从河里提取的金属已经用完了？但关键在于，那个正在融化积雪的暖气管依然非常温暖舒适，我非常喜欢那里，所以就暂时搬去了那里住。不过，这类舒适的地方问题就在于，每个人都想占有一席之地，而且有些人会变得非常固执己见、毫不让步。我想，事情就是这样的吧…… 你继续在山腰的雪地里艰难前行，水闸房的身影渐渐清晰地出现在眼前。奇怪……你那不稳的步伐不可能让你这么快就走到这里，但事实就是如此。就好像在这段路程中，你的每一步都相当于走了十步那么远，不过以你现在的状态，当然也不会去质疑这种事情了…… 就是这里了，伙计。我们开始吧……需要来点‘勇气之酒’吗？” 尼娜凭空拿出一瓶冰酒，喝了一口，然后递给了你。虽然冰酒在喉咙里流淌时带来阵阵寒意，但当浓烈的酒精在胃里扩散开来时，你的肚子里顿时燃起了一股激情，让理智暂时被抛到了九霄云外。真是恰到好处！你们一起走向建筑物侧面的那扇古老石门，推开了它——一股温暖而芬芳的空气迎面扑来。 呈现在你眼前的景象充满了浓厚的家庭氛围——四位女性围坐在一个巨大的铜制汤锅旁，锅里的汤正在一旁的水池中沸腾着。整个水闸建筑都是围绕着那股温润的融雪水修建的，桥梁横跨在水流之上，一些小门从主建筑中延伸出来；位于顶部的水闸门控制着水流进出主楼层。在你被那些兽人注意到之前，你已经没有时间再四处张望了——毕竟你大脑中那个醉酒的部分坚持认为，去跟那位母亲和她的女儿们打个招呼是个好主意，所以这种事情不可避免地会发生。 嘿，尼娜的妈妈！在做什么呢？” 尼娜结结巴巴地回答，嘴里还带着酒味，然后一拳打在你的肩膀上：“什么？ [pc.name]，那根本不是我妈妈，伙计！我妈妈可是那个凶悍的女管家，这个才是真正的女巫！” 那位年迈而干瘪的鲨鱼女巫愤怒地用勺子朝你挥来。“你究竟是谁？在我家里搞什么鬼？如果我想让你们这种混蛋在我为女儿们准备晚餐的时候闯进来，我当初就不会离开海石镇了！” 那些年轻的女巫们露出了凶狠的表情，但你的头脑因为酒精的作用，此刻更关注别的东西。嗯……晚餐。锅里散发出来的香味重型至少从这些方面来看——骨骼、紧实的肌肉以及脂肪，这一切都构成了它的特征。很多这种食物富含脂肪，确实能够有效抵御寒冷，非常适合这种冰雪覆盖的环境…… 幸运的是，妮娜出现了，拯救了局面。“打扰一下，女士，不过这个地方曾经是我的。所以，现在的情况是，你和你的女儿才是闯入我的地盘的人，你……你这个恶毒的女人。我们只需要找到一些重要的东西，然后就可以离开了。” 然而，这种话反而让那个老巫婆更加愤怒了，她的声音变得尖锐刺耳，仿佛还能再尖锐一些似的。你的地方？不好意思，我和我的姐妹们是光明正大地在这里找到这个地方的，而且根本没有任何那些长着羽毛的贱人的踪迹！我们进来后把这里整理得干干净净，修好了屋顶，还清理掉了那些喷泉装置。…如果这个地方曾经属于你，如果你只是有决定权来决定是否继续拥有它的话，那么现在它属于我们了！想象一下，当你正在做晚饭，期待着一顿美味的饭菜时，如果有几个傻瓜闯进你的家里，你会怎么想？你不会这么做的，对吧？ “所以我的建议是：你们这些马屁精，赶紧滚开！否则这个老太婆就会当着她女儿们的面，让你们看看她这副老骨头里到底还剩下多少力气！” 尼娜叹了口气。也许她已经开始感到宿醉的迹象了。“女士——” “别跟我来这套‘女士’的套话，你这个毛茸茸的混蛋！像我这样的老太婆这辈子从来都不是什么‘女士’，而我对此感到非常自豪。现在给我滚出去！你也是，那个整天吸大麻的家伙。你目前遇到了一个僵局。也许，仅仅只是也许，正是你那出色的口才能够化解这个局面……
rows.raw: " The first thing that strikes you is that it's cold. Not just from the temperature alone, but also from the fact that there's a gale howling all about you; woozily, you pick your face out of the snowdrift you've landed in and struggle to your feet, shivering. After the nondescript environment of the Ways Between, the biting chill is quite the change in atmosphere, although it doesn't do anything for your drunkenness. That still stays firmly atop your consciousness like a lead brick. Fingers curl about your own, helping you upwards and onwards. Right. Nina. Are you still... wherever you were? "No. We've left the Ways Between — the dreamscape — for a little while. Gerry needed some time to himself to process your answers." Oh. That's g-good, you guess. Why is it so cold? "I think we're at one of my old homes." One of? H-how many does she have? "Five? Six? It's been a while. If not for the vision, I don't think I'd have remembered this one. Maybe. Probably. But now I do — so many memories are flooding back in, my head hurts..." So s-she used to live here too? You look around with bleary eyes, and think you're on a mountainside — it could be a slope, or it could just be your drunken stumbling. There's a lot of packed snow here, and off in the distance you can maybe see a bunch of sea ice. All things considered, you're north of the Winter City, you think... "Yeah, I used to move around a lot after my sisters kicked me out from their flock; kept getting uprooted for one reason or the other. People wanting to kill me, ghosts following me around, nightmarish monsters appearing in my dreams and then following me out of them, it being too damned noisy, the usual stuff. Can't remember why exactly I left the old sluice gate, though, but I guess we'll be finding out shortly. What I do recall is that it used to be really comfy." Between the ice wine hammering away at the insides of your skull and the chattering of your teeth, you can only hope that she's right, because this is absolutely miserable. Nina leads you a little way on through the snow, and as you round a ridge you see what she's talking about: what looks like a large shack built directly over a stream of snowmelt running off the mountainside. That... that's her old home, you presume. "Yeah, the elves built it to sift all the water coming out of the mountain for metals, like a big pan or something. They then left because... because reasons, I guess. Maybe the metal they were sluicing out of the river ran out? But the point is that the vent that's melting the snow was still all nice and toasty, and I found it to my liking, so I moved in for a while. Problem with nice places like these is that everyone wants a piece of them, and can get very pushy about it. That's just the way things work, I guess..." You continue trudging through the snow along the mountainside, the sluice house rapidly coming more into view. Strange... your unsteady steps can't have brought you this far this quickly, but here you are anyway. It's like one of your steps counted for ten during the journey, not that you're about to question it in your current state... "This is the place, man. Here we go... drop of liquid courage?" Nina produces a bottle of ice wine from thin air, takes a swig, and offers it to you. Despite the chill of it going down your throat, fire ignites in your belly as the strong alcohol settles in your stomach, keeping good judgement at bay. Now that hit the spot! Together, you approach an old stone door in the side of the building and push it open, a gust of toasty air billowing out in your faces as it grinds aside. The sight that greets you is positively domestic — four siorcanna sitting around a large copper soup pot that's bubbling away in one of the side pools. The entire sluice-house has been built around the stream of tepid snowmelt with bridges spanning the flow, with door branching off the main building; a sluice gate at the top controls the water flowing in and out of the main floor. You don't have any more time to look around before the siorcs notice your drunken intrusion — an inevitability given that some inebriated part of your mind's decided that it's a good idea to wobble up to the mother and her daughters to say hi. H-hey, Nina's mom! What's cooking? Nina splutters, alcohol on her breath, and punches you in the shoulder. "What? [pc.name], that's not my mom, man! My mom's the harpy matron, this is a siorc!" The ancient, shrivelled shark-woman waves her ladle angrily at you. "Who in the gods-damned blazes are you and what are you doing in my home? If I'd wanted shitheads like you barging in when I'm cooking dinner for my girls, I'd never have left Seastone!" The younger siorcs show you their teeth, but your alcohol-addled mind has more important things to pay attention to. Mmm, dinner. The smell rising from the pot is heavy, if nothing else — bones, dense meat and blubber, a lot of blubber. It's the kind of food that's guaranteed to keep the cold out, quite suitable for this landscape of snow and ice... Happily, Nina steps in to save the day. "Excuse me, lady, but this place used to be mine, you know. So as it stands, you and your daughters are the ones barging into my place, you... you nasty woman. We just need to, like, find something important and then we're gone." If anything, that just incenses the old siorc even more, her voice rising to a shrill croak, if such a thing were ever possible. "Your place? Excuse me, my girls and I found this here sluicehouse fair and square, and there weren't a single trace of any feathered sluts! We came in here and fixed the place up nice, patched the roof and cleared out the geyser... if this place were ever yours at any point, something which you've only got your say-so to go on, it's ours now! How'd you like it if a couple idiots came a-barging into your home when you're cooking dinner and looking forward to a good pot of grub? You wouldn't, would you? "So my suggestion is this: you toe-lickers, beat it, you! Or else this old ma shows you right in front of her girls that she's still got some fight in this leathery body of hers!" Nina groans. Maybe she's feeling the beginnings of a hangover. "Lady —" "Don't you lady me, you feathery cumrag, an old ma like me's never been a lady in her life and I'm proud of it. Now get outta here! That goes for you too, pot-stuffer." You've reached an impasse here. Maybe, just maybe, it falls to you and your amazing gift of gab to defuse the situation..."

rows.original: N-now, who's she calling a pot-stuffer? "You, that's who! I know your kind — you've got plenty of meat on you, but none of it's good for anything! Even the fat on a fucking selkie can keep that tub of blubber warm, all that you're good for is stewing in a pot!" S-see, that actually doesn't m-make any sense, because — "I don't take any lip from my daughters, and I sure aren't taking any from you, asshole. Now, if you'd kindy get going before an old ma like me finds herself forced to open a whole jar of whoop-ass on you..."
rows.translation: 现、现在，她说谁是只会炖锅的笨蛋？ “就是你，说的就是你！我太了解你这种人了——你身上肉倒是不少，可没有一块顶用！就连他妈的海豹精身上的脂肪都能让那坨肥肉保暖，而你呢，唯一能做的就是被丢进锅里炖！” 可、可是，这其实根本讲、讲不通啊，因为—— “我从不许我的女儿们跟我顶嘴，当然也绝不会容许你这样，混蛋。现在，趁我这种老太婆还没被逼得对你开一整罐揍人套餐之前，你最好赶紧滚……”

rows.translation: 现、现在，她是在骂谁是下锅的料呢？

rows.original:
Well, unless she... she wants to be the main in-g-gredient of that soup she's cooking...
        
        Ma Siorc shows you her teeth. "Pff. Come on, [pc.mf
            |boy
            |girl
        ], who're you trying to scare? You look like absolute shit right now — you aren't staring down no one when your eyes aren't even pointing in the same direction! Take it from an old ma who's been around some and then some more: there's a right way to be staring down folks, and you're so far from it that you've come full circle and your head's sticking out your ass."
        
        N-now then, you totally mean it! That... that, uh, soup? Well, it'll be a stew by the time s-she's done cooking in it, because she's just so tough and gamey all over...
        
        Ma Siorc's daughters start growling in earnest at this, but she stays them with a hand. "You don't scare me in the least, you. I've stared down Seastone and wrestled selkies tougher than your sorry ass, so unless you meant to put something up behind those fighting words of yours, I'd recommend you get outta my house while you've still got your kneecaps."
rows.translation:
好吧，除非她……她想亲自充当自己那锅汤的主、主料……
        
        希奥克老妈龇出牙齿。“呸。得了吧，[pc.mf
            |小子
            |丫头
        ]，你想吓唬谁？你现在看起来简直糟透了——两只眼睛都没朝同一个方向，还想瞪住谁！听听一个见过世面、而且见得还不止一点的老太婆怎么说：瞪人也有正确的方法，而你离正确实在太远，已经绕了一整圈，脑袋都从自己屁股里钻出来了。”
        
        那、那么，你可是认真的！那……那锅，呃，汤？等她在里面煮熟，早就变成炖菜了，因为她浑身上下都又老又韧……
        
        听见这话，希奥克老妈的女儿们当真低吼起来，但她抬手制止了她们。“你一点也吓不到我。我瞪退过海石，还摔跤打败过比你这副熊样强得多的塞尔奇人。所以，除非你打算让那些狠话后面跟点真本事，否则我建议你趁膝盖骨还在，赶紧滚出我家。”

rows.original: N-now, how can a fine woman like her be so h-heartless? Ma Siorc narrows her eyes. "Heartless, you say?" Y-yeah! Your f-feathered friend here has been trying to... uh, find her mother's brooch for ten years now! It's, uh, t-the only memory Nina has of her mother, so if this fine woman and her lovely daughters would let the both of you search for this heirloom that's been stashed in her home from when Nina was living here... "A brooch, you say." Y-yeah! Come on, has she n-no heart? Please, oh please, if she wouldn't let the two of you search for it, out of the single seed of goodness still within that tough old heart of hers, you'd be oh-so-grateful to her and her daughters. Ma Siorc scowls. "Friend... I can't blame you 'cause you're drunk out of your head, but next time, try coming up with a better lie; I know you think I'm just an old biddy, but this is frankly insulting. Harpies don't have half the brains to be putting away heirlooms, and even if they did they're greedy little fucks to the point that no feathery cumrag would leave a single copper to her daughters. And on the off-chance you're actually telling the truth and not just spouting whatever bullshit that comes to mind, there's no reason I wouldn't be keeping whatever gewgaw it is for myself and my daughters. "No dice. Answer's still for the both of you to get the fuck out of my kitchen."
rows.translation: 现在，像她这样一位优秀的女性，怎么会如此无情呢？ 希奥克老妈眯起了眼睛：“无情？你是这么说的吗？” 是的！你这位长着羽毛的朋友，已经努力了十年来……呃，一直在寻找她母亲的胸针呢！这是妮娜关于她母亲的唯一记忆，所以如果这位善良的女士和她的可爱女儿们能允许你们俩去寻找这件自妮娜在这里生活时就被藏在家里的传家宝的话…… 你说的是一枚胸针啊。” “对对！拜托，她难道没有一点心吗？求你了，如果她不是出于内心深处那一丝善良，允许你们俩去寻找那枚胸针的话，你们一定会对她和她的女儿们感激不尽的。 希奥克老妈皱起了眉头。“朋友……你喝得烂醉如泥，我也不能怪你，但下次最好想个更靠谱的谎言吧。我知道你觉得我不过是个老太婆，但这种话实在太侮辱人了。鹰身女妖根本没能力保管那些传家宝，就算有这个能力，她们也是些贪婪至极的家伙——根本不会给自己的女儿留下哪怕一枚铜币。而且就算你说的真的是实话，而不是随便编造一些鬼话，我也没有理由不把那些东西留给自己和我的女儿们。 “不行。我的回答还是：你们俩赶紧从我厨房里滚出去。

Please, oh please, if she wouldn't let the two of you search for it, out of the single seed of goodness still within that tough old heart of hers, you'd be oh-so-grateful to her and her daughters. Ma Siorc scowls. "Friend... I can't blame you 'cause you're drunk out of your head, but next time, try coming up with a better lie; I know you think I'm just an old biddy, but this is frankly insulting. Harpies don't have half the brains to be putting away heirlooms, and even if they did they're greedy little fucks to the point that no feathery cumrag would leave a single copper to her daughters. And on the off-chance you're actually telling the truth and not just spouting whatever bullshit that comes to mind, there's no reason I wouldn't be keeping whatever gewgaw it is for myself and my daughters. "No dice. Answer's still for the both of you to get the fuck out of my kitchen.""

rows.original: N-now, how can a fine woman like her be so h-heartless?
rows.translation: 现在，像她这样一位优秀的女性，怎么会如此无情呢？

rows.original:
L-look, you're a siorc like... like she is. Shark-people have got to stick together, right?
        
        "No."

        Phooey.
        
        Ma Siorc's jaws set in a grimace. "I don't owe you anything just because you happen to look a bit like me, punk. You aren't my friend, and you aren't my family, so you can just go suck harpy eggs or something, trying to pull off that nonsense with me. The elves, they've done more for me in building this place and leaving it empty for me and my daughters than any siorc's ever done for the likes of us, so don't you go around preaching no sor-soli-solidarity, that's the word."
        
        Double phooey, t-then.
        
        "Besides, you're a shitty example of a siorc if there were ever one. Turning up on my doorstep drunk out of your head and looking fit to puke anytime, plus you've got a feathery cumrag in tow to boot. Nah, you can fuck right off just like I told Seastone and her goons."
rows.translation:
听、听着，你也是希奥克人，就像……像她一样。鲨鱼族必须互相帮助，对吧？
        
        “不。”

        真扫兴。
        
        希奥克老妈咬紧双颚，露出不悦的表情。“你不过碰巧长得有点像我，我可不欠你任何东西，小混蛋。你既不是我的朋友，也不是我的家人，所以少拿这种屁话糊弄我，去吸鹰身女妖的蛋什么的吧。那些精灵建起这个地方，又把空房留给我和女儿们；他们为我们做的事，比任何希奥克人都多。所以别在我面前宣扬什么团、团结——对，就是这个词。”
        
        那、那就双倍扫兴。
        
        “再说，你简直是希奥克人最糟糕的榜样。醉得不省人事地出现在我家门口，随时都像要吐出来，还带着一个长羽毛的泄欲工具。不，你给我有多远滚多远，就像我对西斯通和她那帮喽啰说的一样。”

Well, shit. Looks like talking isn't going to help you here any — Ma Siorc's just too much of a tough customer to be swayed by words. Well then, maybe you'll just have to take another approach to the matter...

        "What are you doing, [pc.name]?" Nina pipes up woozily. "I suddenly feel like I should be really concerned about what's about to happen..."
        
        Oh, it's a-a-all right. You've got just the thing you need to encourage this cranky old crone and her daughters to be more cooperative...

        “你在干什么？ [pc.name]？”妮娜迷迷糊糊地说道，“我突然觉得，我真的应该为即将发生的事情感到担忧……”
        
        “哦，没关系的。你正好拥有让这个脾气暴躁的老太婆和她的女儿们更加配合的东西……

Y-yeah. How about you give this nice lady some coins for her trouble? Maybe it'd be fine to take a p-p-peek, then?

        The shark crone's eyes flare up. "Hawks, eh? Twenty, thirty years ago I'd have said yes without thinking twice, but now... not so much. Now? Only place we'd be able to spend any kind of money would be either with Seastone or the elves, and we're not exactly welcome with either. Sorry to say it, [pc.mf
            |kid
            |girl
        ] — you may as well be offering me shiny rocks. I'm open to being convinced that you and your feathery cumrag over there may be worth my time, but you aren't doing it with hawks, I'm afraid."
        
        D-damn it. Well, the old biddy's right: money isn't any good if you're not able to spend it on anything. You'll have to take a different tack here.
rows.translation:
嗯，对、对吧。你是不是该给这位好心的女士几个钱，算是谢她费心？也许偷偷看上一眼也没什么问题？

        鲨鱼老妇人的眼睛突然亮了起来。“鹰币啊？二十三十年前，我肯定会毫不犹豫地答应的，但现在……就不那么确定了。现在我们能把钱花在什么地方呢？要么是海石那边，要么是精灵们那里，而这两边都不怎么欢迎我们。抱歉把话说得这么直，[pc.mf
            |小孩
            |女孩
        ]——你倒不如直接塞给我几块亮闪闪的石头。我倒愿意被说服，相信你和那边那个长羽毛的精液抹布值得我花点时间，但恐怕光靠鹰币可不行。”
        
        该死……这个老太婆说得对：如果连花钱的地方都没有，钱也就毫无意义了。这次我得换种方法了。

rows.original:
A gift in exchange for being able to r-root around a little. How does that sound, uh, to her?

        The shark crone's eyes flare up, and her knuckles tighten about the handle of her ladle. "A gift, eh? Now what're you a-talking about exactly? Living in this kind of place with my daughters... it isn't bad, but it could be better."
        
        We-ll, maybe she could like, name what she wants...
        
        "And give you a handle on what I think I'm worth? No dice there, [pc.mf
            |kid
            |girl
        ]. You show me what you're offering, and I'll tell you what I think of it. Now then, pony up..."
rows.translation:
送一份礼物，换取能在这里稍微翻找一番的机会。你觉得，呃，她会怎么想呢？

        鲨鱼老婆子的眼睛猛地亮了起来，她握着汤勺柄的指节收紧了。“礼物，嗯？那你到底在说些什么？和我的女儿们住在这种地方……不算差，但本可以更好。”
        
        嗯——也许她可以，比如，说出她想要什么……
        
        “然后让你抓住我认为自己值多少的把柄？那可没门，[pc.mf
            |孩子
            |姑娘
        ]。你先让我看看你打算给什么，我再告诉你我觉得它怎么样。那么，把东西拿出来吧……”

rows.original:
Yep. Swaggering about drunkenly, you grab Nina by the scruff of her neck and swing her out before you — she flops around a bit, but doesn't put up a fight at all as you present her to Ma Siorc and her daughters.

        H-here. If they're calling your feathered friend a cumrag, why don't they go ahead and make it a reality? Will that do? Everyone knows that harpies are massive sluts, so it should be fine; those four daughters of hers look pretty pent-up and if Nina manages to make them all feel better would that be sufficient for the both of you to go in back and take a l-look around?"
        
        Ma Siorc waves her ladle at you. "You're whoring out the harpy?"
        
        [pc.isDK
            |D-damn right you are, nothing wrong with it
            |W-well, it's not something that she wouldn't have done of her own accord a-anyway 
        ]. And let's face it, Nina here p-probably already saw this coming in yet another vision of hers, so it's fine, right? Follow the visions and you'll never go wrong, that's what she said, isn't it?
        
        Nina hiccups and nods rapidly; you smell ice wine on her even as this distance, and are reminded to take a swig from your own bottle. "Yep. Saw me getting completely destroyed by your girls, Ma. Gotta stick to the visions, or else everything goes haywire and off the road."
        
        The leathery old shark-woman scowls. "Well, [pc.mf
            |kid
            |girl
        ], I'm an old biddy and my body's been ruined by what I did with it when I was younger — not that I regret any of it, mind you. But I've got four daughters right here, and while they've got needs they're also not the kind to take it up with each other. What was the saying again, any port in a storm? But to be reduced to using a drunk-ass harpy... well, at least she isn't a selkie. Come on up, then."
        
        W-wait, you've got to be sure about this first. Once the siorcs are done with Nina, Ma's going to let you poke around in her home?
        
        She shows you her teeth. "My kids ought to be taking you into the back for that kind of hanky-panky, so I guess you two can go do whatever you're here for after you're done. Deal?"
        
        D-d-deal.
        
        "[silly
            |Dominatin'
            |Now that's more like it
        ]! All right, girls, you heard the [pc.race]. Try not to break [pc.hisHer] harpy while you're at it."
        
        You don't remember receiving a half-empty bottle of ice wine anytime, but it's there in your hand as Ma Siorc's daughters bound up and cart Nina out of your hands and off into the rear of the sluicehouse. With a little time to burn, you adequately top up the amounts of alcohol in your blood until the pleasant haze of fuzziness thickens once again, only to be roused by Ma Siorc's daughters as they return with a very damp and sticky Nina in tow.
        
        "Ok, Ma. We're good."
        
        "Don't you look it." Ma Siorc sighs, and just for a moment looks a lot more hunched and haggard than how you've seen her carry herself. "All right, [pc.race], you've held up your end of the deal; it's time for me to do the same. Now get going — be quick about it, and don't make a ruckus. My girls will be keeping an eye on you to make sure you don't get up to any funny business."
        
        S-sure...
rows.translation:
没错。你醉醺醺地大摇大摆地走过来，一把抓住尼娜的脖子，把她拽到自己面前——她挣扎了几下，但根本没有反抗，你就这样把她带到了希奥克老妈和她的女儿们面前。

“给、给。如果他们称你的有羽毛的朋友为“cumrag”，那他们为什么不真的这么叫呢？这样不就行了吗？大家都知道女妖都是极其放荡的生物，所以应该没什么问题吧；她那四个女儿看起来也挺压抑的，如果妮娜能让她们都放松下来，那么你们俩再回去看看情况，应该就足够了吧？希奥克老妈用她的勺子朝你挥了挥。“你是在勾引那个女妖吗？
        
        [pc.isDK
            |没错，这样完全没问题。
            |嗯，反正这也是她自己会主动去做的事情。 
        ]说实话，尼娜很可能早就通过她的某种预知能力预见到了这一幕，所以也没关系吧？只要跟随那些预知带来的指引，你就永远不会犯错，她是这么说的，对吧？

尼娜打了个嗝，然后迅速点了点头；即使隔着这么远的距离，你也能闻到她身上散发着的冰酒香气，这让你忍不住也想喝一口自己瓶里的酒。没错，妈妈，我看到自己被你们那些女孩彻底打败了。必须坚持那些预感，否则一切都会变得一团糟。”

那位皮肤像皮革般的老女鲨皱起了眉头：“好吧[pc.mf
            |小孩
            |女孩
        ]我是个老妇人了，年轻时的一些行为让我的身体受到了损害——不过我可一点也不后悔。不过我这里有四个女儿，虽然她们各有各的需求，但她们也不会互相倾诉这些事情。那句话是怎么说的来着？‘暴风雨中的任何港口都值得依靠’吧？不过，用一个醉醺醺的哈比来帮忙……至少她不是海妖。过来吧。”

“等、等等，你确定要这么做吗？等那些希奥克人处理完尼娜的事情，妈妈才会允许你翻她的房子的吧？
        
        她露出牙齿，说道：“我的孩子们应该会带你去后面做那种事情吧，所以我想等你们忙完之后，就可以去干你们来这里要做的任何事情了。就这样吧？”

“好……好的。”

“就这样。[silly
            |称霸天下
            |这才对嘛。
        ]好了，姑娘们，你们都听到了吧。 [pc.race]尽量别弄坏它。 [pc.hisHer]既然你已经动手了，那就干脆把事情做彻底吧。”

你并不记得自己曾经收到过半瓶冰酒，但此刻它确实就在你手中——就在希奥克老妈的女儿们把妮娜从你手中夺走，带往水闸房后面的时候。当你有空闲时间时，你会适当补充血液中的酒精含量，直到那种令人愉悦的迷糊感再次出现。然而，这时希奥克老妈的女儿们回来了，她们带着一个浑身湿透、黏糊糊的妮娜回来了，于是你又被吵醒了。
        
        好了，妈妈。我们没问题的。”

“你看看自己这副样子。”希奥克老妈叹了口气，这一刻，她看起来比平时更加佝偻、更加憔悴。“好吧[pc.race]你已经履行了自己的承诺，现在我也该这么做了吧。快去吧，动作要快，别惹出麻烦来。我的女儿们会盯着你，确保你不会做出什么奇怪的事情。

rows.original: This is how it works, isn't it? You have a bit of a dust-up, and if you win, she's got to let you take a l-look in the back? Just Ma Siorc and you, one on one[silly |, no items, Final Destination ]. The leathery old shark-woman grins and holds up a hand to quell her snarling daughters. "No, no, girls, this is real interesting, real interesting; I want to handle [pc.himHer] myself. Go ahead, you little shit. That's got to be the liquid courage speaking there, because I haven't had a good fight in the gods know how damn long; just because I'm old doesn't mean I can't upend a whole jar of whoop-ass on your head in a minute flat." rows.original: This is usually how Siorcs settle their differences, right? If you do try this and lose, though, it'll mean that peaceful negotiation isn't going to be open any longer.
rows.translation: 通常，鲨人就是用这种方式来解决分歧的，对吧？不过，如果你尝试了这种方法却失败了，那就意味着和平谈判的机会就再也没有了。
rows.raw: "This is usually how Siorcs settle their differences, right? If you do try this and lose, though, it'll mean that peaceful negotiation isn't going to be open any longer."

rows.original: After having thrown hands with Ma Siorc and lost, you don't think this option is open to you any more.
rows.translation: 在和希奥克老妈交手并失败之后，你肯定不会再认为这个选择还属于你了吧。
rows.raw: "After having thrown hands with Ma Siorc and lost, you don't think this option is open to you any more."

rows.original: Somewhere in the alcohol-fogged recesses of your mind, a thought makes itself known. So, Ma Siorc and her daughters are cooking soup just by the bridge and the stream it spans, using the nearby geyser for heat. Conveniently, they also happen to be sitting in the very depression in the ground that implies the stream's original course if the sluice gate were to be opened. If you were to work the mechanisms and let the waters flow as they pleased... ...Hmm... ...Well, they're siorcs, they can't drown, but getting swept away by a deluge would certainly mean their day's going to be taking a turn for the worse. If nothing else, it means they'll be out of your way and you can head on in. Gods, you're a fucking genius. "The mechanism's around the back on the outside of the sluicehouse," Nina offers. "I remember as much from when I lived here. Either the siorcs don't know about it, or they've written it off as completely busted; either way, we'll be able to stay out of sight while fiddling with the pulleys and whatnot." G-g-good idea. And good on her for f-figuring out what you were intending — did she read your m-mind for that? "Yes. Need a little lubrication?" She holds out a half-drained bottle of ice wine to you. D-d-don't mind if you do, you'll be wanting to see this problem from as many p-perspectives as you can. Nina hands you the bottle, and you drain it cheerfully as she leads you around the back and indeed, there's a large copper gate partially damming the stream and controlling its flow through the sluicehouse, part of the simple elven machinery for sifting ore out of the water en masse. If you were to let all this water out into the sluicehouse all at once... yes, Ma Siorc and her daughters would be having a very bad day indeed. "I remember this," Nina says as she runs her fingers over the gate mechanisms with a wistful sigh. "Even remember fiddling with it so that it'd run easier — I fixed it up so well that it ought to still be working after all these years." W-wow, is she an artificer too? "No, I don't know the first thing about artifice as the old wizards of Belhar would classify it, but I do a lot of stuff the visions tell me to and it works out just fine. Impromptu work, as it were, like... like the visions are just using my body as a puppet. Well, that's a bad analogy, given I'm doing it willingly. Kind of like a guide. "Aanyways, I'm pretty sure I know how this works. Listen up, because this is kind of important: "See, how you lift the gate is through this wheel over here: you can turn it left, right, or just hold it in place for a bit. You've got to do this five times, and it's got to be in the correct sequence; for each action in the sequence that you perform correctly, the mechanism will click." That d-doesn't make sense at all, but everything stopped making sense long before the l-lureling, so you're good with it. So, like, if you got three out of five correct, there'd be three clicks? "That's right. What we want to hear is five clicks from the machine." C-cool. If she knows so much about how the sluice gate works, m-maybe she can tell you exactly how to turn the wheel so that the gate opens? "I wish I did, man, but I can't know everything. My head can't hold all the knowledge in the world; it'd explode. So I guess the way things work is that when new stuff from visions comes in, the least important stuff filters out, or it goes into deep storage, or whatever. Either way, it'll take a while to retrieve, if it comes at all; I think you'd be better off figuring this one out for yourself instead of waiting for something that might never happen." Damn, so mightily c-convenient that she'd just have forgotten t-the most important part of all of this. Oh well, guess it c-can't be helped, this must be part of the vision or something. And if it keeps you comfortably drunk for a little while longer, you're a-all for it. Fine, you'll t-take a look at it.
rows.translation: 在你那被酒精迷蒙的思维深处，有一个想法悄然浮现：希奥克老妈和她的女儿们正在桥边、那条横跨小溪的地方煮汤，她们利用附近的热泉来提供热量。巧合的是，她们恰好坐在地面的那个凹陷处——如果打开水闸，这个凹陷处正好能显示出小溪原本的流向。如果你能操纵这些机制，让水流按照它们自己的意愿流动…… ……嗯…… ……好吧，它们毕竟是兽人，不会被淹死，但被洪水冲走的话，那肯定会让它们今天的一整天都变得糟糕起来。至少这意味着他们不会再妨碍你，你可以直接开始了。 天啊，你真是个混蛋天才那个装置位于水闸房的外侧后面，”妮娜说道，“我记得我以前住在这里的时候就知道这个地方。要么那些siorcs并不知道它的存在，要么他们已经认为它完全坏掉了；不管怎样，我们在修理那些滑轮之类的部件时应该不会被人发现。 好主意。她能猜出你的意图，真是太厉害了——她难道读懂了你的心思吗？ “是啊。需要一点‘润滑剂’吗？”她递给你一瓶已经喝掉一半的冰酒。 你尽管去做吧，其实你真的应该从尽可能多的角度来审视这个问题。妮娜把瓶子递给你，你开心地喝了起来。在她带领下，你来到后面，果然看到有一道巨大的铜门部分地挡住了小溪的流水，从而控制着水通过水闸的流量——这些简单的精灵机械正是用来从水中大量分离矿石的。如果你让所有这些水一下子都流入泄洪道……那么，没错，希奥克老妈和她的女儿们肯定会度过非常糟糕的一天。 我记得这个，”妮娜一边说着，一边用手指轻轻触碰着那些门闸的机械装置，同时发出一声怅然的叹息。“甚至还记得自己曾经费了很大劲去调整它，让它运转得更加顺畅——我修得那么好，这么多年过去了，它应该仍然能正常使用才对。” 哇哦，她也是个机械师吗？ 不，我对那些被贝尔哈尔的老巫师们称之为‘人工制品’的东西一无所知，但我只是按照那些幻象的指示去行动，结果一切都进行得很顺利。可以说，这些都是即兴发挥……那些幻象只是利用我的身体作为工具而已。不过，这个比喻不太准确，因为我是自愿这么做的。更确切地说，他们就像是我的向导吧。 不管怎样，我差不多确定自己知道这是怎么运作的。听好了，因为这其实挺重要的： “你看，要打开大门，就得用到这里的这个轮子：你可以向左转、向右转，或者直接保持当前方向不变。暂时先这样吧。你必须得这么做。必须按照正确的顺序完成五次操作；只要你按照顺序正确地完成每一次操作，这个机制就会启动。这根本说不通啊，但早在那些诱人的说法出现之前，所有事情就已经变得毫无逻辑可言了，所以你接受这个解释也没关系。也就是说，如果你答对了五题中的三题，就会得到三次点击声吗？” “没错。我们想听的就是这个答案。距离机器只有五次点击的距离嗯，不错。如果她对水闸的运作原理了解得这么透彻，也许她能告诉你该怎样转动那个轮子才能让水闸打开吧？” “我也希望自己能知道，不过我真的不知道。一切我的大脑根本无法容纳世界上所有的知识，否则肯定会“爆炸”掉的。所以我想，事情的运作方式应该是这样的：当那些通过幻象获得的新信息进入我的大脑时，其中那些最不重要的部分就会被过滤掉，或者被储存在大脑的深处，诸如此类吧。无论如何，要想得到这个结果，恐怕都需要一些时间；而且我觉得，你还不如自己想办法解决这个问题，而不是等待那些可能永远都不会发生的事情。 该死，她竟然把这件事最重要的部分给忘了，真是太不方便了。好吧，我想这也是没办法的事吧，这肯定也是某种“愿景”的一部分吧。如果这能让你们再舒服地喝上一段时间酒，那我也没什么意见。好吧，你们就去看看吧。

rows.original:
Nina gives you a doleful glance as she takes the alcohol from you, pops it open and downs a swig. "Aw, man. Were you hiding this from me?"

            Not s-so much hiding as it didn't come up, but...
            
            "I shared all my good stuff with you, [pc.name], and here you are hiding booze from me. That burns worse than boiling manticore venom mixed with sulfuric acid — you just don't do that to a girl, man."
            
            H-hey, she gave you all of that stuff by herself you d-d-didn't ask for it or nothing —
            
            "But I might just forgive your sins if you manage to figure this one out. Cheers!" She takes another swig.
            
            Fine, if s-she's going to be that way. Time to take a look at this stupid sluice gate...
rows.translation:
尼娜接过你递给她的酒，沮丧地看了你一眼，然后打开瓶子灌了一大口。“哎呀，天。你这是瞒着我吗？”

            其实也不算完全瞒着，只是之前没提到而已……
            
            “我把所有好东西都分享给了你，[pc.name]，可你却在这里瞒着我藏酒。这比沸腾的曼提科尔毒液混着硫酸还要伤人——你可不能这样对一个姑娘，天。”
            
            嘿，那些东西都是她自己给你的，你又没有要求她这么做——
            
            “不过，只要你能把这件事弄明白，我或许就会原谅你的过错。干杯！”她又灌了一大口。
            
            好吧，既然她非得这样……那就去看看这个该死的泄水闸吧……

[var0
        |Ma Siorc folds her arms across her bosom and glares at you. "You taking me for a cheapass, [pc.mf
            |kid
            |girl
        ]? That's a right pittance and I'm not letting you in for that."
        
        W-what? All this is g-great stuff! She just doesn't know...
        
        "No, it isn't."
        
        As aggravating as it may be, the old biddy is right: a bad offer here may as well be no offer. You'll probably have to put more value on the table here for her to even consider your offer, and considerably more value at that.
        |Ma Siorc taps her chin. "Well, that's looking better."

        Great! So c-can you now, like, go in and start looking?
        
        "Hey, I didn't say that yet! If what you're looking for is so important, it should be worth more, yes?"
        
        The fuck, man? Gods, like, w-what a greedy bitch she is!
        
        "Damn right I'm a greedy bitch, [pc.mf
            |kid
            |girl
        ]. You don't get to live as I have and raise four daughters in the bargain without taking every single scrap that the world cares to throw at you, without squeezing every poor sucker for every last drop of blood. You get me?"
        
        [pc.bg slumrat
            |In the back of your drink-addled mind just behind the impending hangover, it's hard not to at least understand what Ma Siorc means, even if you may not wholly agree on account of being on the receiving end of the old biddy's greed. After all, you lived like this once, and doing what it takes to survive is something you understand too well... but that doesn't change the fact that she's being a massive bitch.
            |N-no, you get that she's just shaking you down for a better deal.
        ]
        
        "You're close, but not close enough. Make it a bit more and we'll be on speaking terms."
        |Ma Siorc grins. "[silly
            |Dominatin'

        So, you can l-like, go in now?

My girls will be watching the both of you to make sure you don't get up to any funny business. You'd have to be an idiot to not keep an eye on someone messing around where you sleep."
        
        All right, all right, got it. Gods... fine, you're going now.
        
        The siorcs part to give you a clear path across the bridge spanning the river and the makeshift bunkhouse beyond. Hopefully this will be good for what you gave up...

        ]这金额实在太少了，我绝对不会接受这样的条件。”

“什、什么？这些可都是非常不错的东西啊！她只是不明白而已……”

虽然这个老太婆的行为让人恼火，但她说的没错：如果给出的条件太差，那就等于没有条件。你可能需要提供更多的优惠，她才有可能考虑你的提议，而且需要的优惠幅度也会相当大。
        |希奥克老妈轻敲着下巴：“嗯，这样看起来好多了。”

“太好了！那你现在可以进去开始寻找了吗？”

“嘿，我还没说同意呢！如果你要找的东西真的那么重要，那它应该值更多的钱吧？”

靠，这家伙！天啊，她也太贪心了吧！

那些兽人会为你指明一条通往河对岸桥梁以及那间临时搭建的营房的道路。希望这能弥补你所放弃的一切……
        |希奥克老妈显然在努力控制自己的情绪，但这个老妇人显然不习惯这样的克制，尤其是面对那些对她来说无疑是一笔巨大财富的东西时。她自己也意识到了这一点，因此她并没有试图争取更多，而是用勺子朝你挥了挥，同时用空闲的手在背后比划着什么。[silly

“我又不是你的母亲。 [pc.ra siorcanna

rows.original:
Staggering back, Ma Siorc balls her fists and spits out a bloody tooth that clatters on the floor of the sluicehouse; her daughters come rushing up to her, but she waves them off. It's clear that the old biddy still has plenty of fight left in her, but she's also smart enough to realize that her ancient body's been pushed to its limits.

        "Fine, uncle, uncle. That was a pretty good show of strength for a drunk-ass [pc.race] — no way around admitting it."
        
        D-does that mean you can go into the back a-an-d take a look around?
        
        Ma Siorc hesitates, and you wonder if she's going to pull some kind of shenanigans on you, then she shakes her head and scowls. "You beat me fair and square, so I guess I can't say no. Now get going — be quick about it, and don't make a ruckus. My girls will be keeping an eye on you to make sure you don't get up to any funny business."
        
        Yeah, okay, s-sure. At least she's stopped the bragging and insults, by the gods that was f-fucking annoying.
        
        Nina tugs at your sleeve. "Come on, [pc.name]. Let's get going before all that liquid courage in you gets us into more trouble, okay?"
rows.translation:
希奥克老妈向后踉跄了几步，握紧双拳，吐出一颗带血的牙齿，牙齿掉在排水房的地板上发出叮当声。她的女儿们急忙冲过来想要扶她，但她却挥手让她们离开。显然，这个老女人身上还蕴藏着惊人的力量，但她也足够聪明，知道自己的身体已经到了极限。

        “好吧，叔叔，叔叔……对于一个醉鬼来说，这一番表现已经相当不错了。 [pc.race] ——承认这一点是不可避免的。”
        
        “那么，这是否意味着我可以去后面看看情况呢？”
        
        希奥克老妈犹豫了一下，你甚至怀疑她会不会耍什么花招，但最终她还是摇了摇头，皱起了眉头。你确实是公平地打败了我，所以我想我也没法拒绝。现在快走吧，动作要快，别惹出麻烦来。我的女儿们会盯着你的，确保你不会做出什么奇怪的事情。”
        
        “嗯，好的，当然。至少她不再吹嘘和辱骂别人了，看在诸神的份上，那真的他妈太烦人了。
        
        妮娜拽了拽你的袖子：“来吧， [pc.name]在我们体内的这些‘勇气’把我们引进更多的麻烦之前，我们还是赶紧出发吧，好吗？

rows.original:
All right, you were light-headed to begin with, but getting knocked around by Ma Siorc just makes it even worse. She moves far faster than a crinkled old woman like her would warrant at a glance, and in a moment of drunken inattentiveness you leave an opening for the shark-woman to land an uppercut to your jaw as you wave away from her snapping jaws. Stars explode in your vision, and the next thing you know you're sprawled out on the sluicehouse floor, staring up at the crumbling ceiling.

        Ma Siorc scowls. "Had enough yet, punk? Maybe try sobering up next time before you decide to pick on an old biddy."
        
        You feel hands hook themselves under your arms and drag you away from the scene — Nina, you presume. Ma Siorc says several derogatory things you don't quite make out through the ringing in your ears, but her tone makes it quite clear each and every one of her words are quite nasty.
        
        "Come on, [pc.name]. I think we've outstayed what little welcome we've had here."
        
        H-hard to disagree with that. Was th-this in her vision, too?
        
        "Yes." 
        
        And s-so the journey ends here...
        
        "No, not really. We'll be getting by the siorcs in another fashion."
        
        O-oh. So what do you do now? A-and if you were going to be d-doing something else to solve the p-problem anyway, then why did she let you get beat up by an old b-bitch?
        
        "Because if you fought Ma Siorc in the vision and got your ass kicked, man, that's what had to happen. It's like... uh, I don't know. But you've got to get through the bad stuff in order to get to the good stuff; you can't just decide to skip the bad stuff or do it out of order. Trying to pull that kind of shenanigans just results in everything going haywire and us winding up in uncharted territory.
        
        "Trust the visions, man."
        
        Yeah, but y-you'd trust them more if they didn't involve the stuffing being beaten out of you. Ah, fuck, whatever. Come to think of it, you're already not feeling that much pain — another swig of ice wine couldn't hurt.
rows.translation:
好吧，你本来就头晕目眩，又被希奥克老妈揍了一顿，情况只会更加糟糕。她动作之快，远非一个乍看皱纹满面的老妇人应有的水平；你醉醺醺地一时走神，露出了破绽。你后仰躲开她咬来的利齿，她却趁机一记上勾拳轰中你的下巴。无数星光在视野里炸开；回过神时，你已经四仰八叉地躺在水闸屋地板上，仰望着摇摇欲坠的天花板。

        希奥克老妈怒目而视。“受够了吗，小混蛋？下次决定欺负一个老太婆之前，或许该先醒醒酒。”
        
        你感觉有人从腋下勾住双臂，把你拖离现场——想必是妮娜。耳鸣让你听不清希奥克老妈接连抛出的贬损之语，但她的语气已经足以说明，每一句都相当恶毒。
        
        “走吧，[pc.name]。我觉得我们已经把这里那一点点欢迎耗得太久了。”
        
        很、很难不同意。这、这也是她预知的一部分吗？
        
        “是。”
        
        那、那么，旅程就在这里结束了……
        
        “不，也不算。我们会换一种方式越过希奥克人。”
        
        哦、哦。那么现在该怎么办？既、既然她本来就打算用别的办法解决问、问题，为什么还要让你被那个老、老泼妇揍上一顿？
        
        “因为，如果预知中你会同希奥克老妈交手，然后被她揍得屁股开花，那这件事就必须发生。就像……呃，我也说不清。但你必须经历坏事，才能走到好事面前；不能决定跳过坏事，也不能打乱顺序。想耍这种花招，只会让一切失控，让我们落进未经探明的境地。
        
        “相信预知吧，伙计。”
        
        是啊，但要是预知的内容不是让你挨顿狠揍，你肯定会更信任它们。啊，操，随便吧。仔细想想，你已经不怎么疼了——再喝一口冰酒也不会有什么坏处。

rows.original: You take one last look at the gate mechanism and shrug before turning back to the sluicehouse. This blasted thing's stumping you at every turn, and to be perfectly honest you don't want to look at it for a bit right now. It'll still be around if you want to raise the gate later... but maybe a more diplomatic solution to the siorcs would be easier than stumping yourself on this silly puzzle.
rows.translation: 你最后再看了一眼那复杂的门闸装置，耸了耸肩，然后转身回到了水闸房。这个该死的玩意儿每次都让你犯愁，说实话，你现在真的不想再去看它了。如果你以后还想打开那道门的话，它依然会在那里……不过，或许找那些鲨人谈谈，会比一直为这个愚蠢的谜题犯愁更容易一些吧。

rows.original: [var0 |You finish the sequence of turns with the wheel, and wait for something to happen. Nope. Nothing. Not even a single click. It looks like you didn't even get one part of the sequence correct. "Hey, it's fine," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "At least you know what not to do next." If she's being s-so smart about it, why isn't she the one turning this wheel? "Hey, I'm just trying to be helpful." Yeah, she admittedly kinda is. But s-sometimes, a [pc.mf |man |woman ]'s just got to say: stop helping me. Or something. "You'll have it figured out in no time. I believe in you." That was so cheesy that it just about had the opposite effect... |You finish the sequence of turns with the wheel, and wait for something to happen. After what feels like an eternity, you hear a single click from the gate mechanism. Better than nothing... or perhaps maybe worse, given that you've no way of telling exactly which turn of the wheel was the right one. Or do you? "Don't look so down," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "It's not like we're lacking for time here." Y-you don't know about that. Eventually you'll either s-sober up or, even if she has all the ice wine in the world stashed away wherever she keeps these things, throw up... "Just keep at it, okay?" |You finish the sequence of turns and wait for the gate's response. Before too long, two clicks sound from within the mechanism, the gate itself still unmoving. Not completely cold, perhaps, but still some ways off from the correct sequence. "We're getting there," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "You're doing good." Maybe b-but you don't feel so good. The thinky thing makes so much heat while it's worky, you can feel your head heating up. "I think that's just the drink." T-that's what you said... "Keep at it, okay?" |You finish the sequence of turns and wait to see if anything happens; sure enough, after a few seconds, you hear three clicks from the gate's internal mechanisms. More than halfway there, then — that's got to be good, right? "Getting warm," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "You'll figure it out before too long." While the en-encouragement is cute and all, she'd be a lot more help if s-she could just, you don't know, use those visions of hers and tell you the correct sequence of wheel turns to open the gate. That would be so much more useful... "Well, what the visions showed me is that you've got to be the one to open the gate, [pc.name]. You've got to follow the way things go, remember? I don't want to see you hurt or worse, in a vision or otherwise." Is that, like, a threat? "Not from me." D-damn it... all right, another go at this... |You finish the sequence of turns and wait for the gate's response, which comes almost immediately: a series of four loud clicks and several grinding noises from the sluice gate's old mechanisms. Close, but not close enough; despite knowing better, you can't help but hope that the gates will lift. Of course, it doesn't happen, but hey, you did know better. "Almost there," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "Just got one of them wrong. Question is: which one?" Could be any one of them, m-maybe? "I'm sure you've been doing this methodically, and your plan isn't just to turn the wheel at random until you get the sequence right by accident. Right? Right?" L-look, everyone's a damn critic-c. If she's going to be giving you this much sass, then maybe s-she should be the one to... know what, forget it. It's all about-t the visions, r-right? She can't turn the d-damn wheel herself because the visions say it's got to be y-you. "Yep! You're catching on really fast; Rumie says that you're smart that way." Oh. Great. Amazing. W-well, let's hope it works to f-figure out this wrong bit... |No sooner have you finished with the wheel that five clicks sound from within the sluice gate's mechanisms — something grinds deep within the metal monstrosity, and then the gate itself lifts, allowing all the dammed water that's pooled behind it to rush down the channel and into the sluicehouse. Several angry shouts rise from within, but are quickly cut off by the raging roar of the deluge that inundates the building. That's one way to make soup... by the time the water's settled and you feel brave enough to peek through the gate and into the sluicehouse, there's no sign of Ma Siorc, her daughters, or even the soup pot she was tending. What there is, though, are plenty of puddles strewn about the floor. Well, it's not like most of the sluicehouse was meant to be lived in, rather than sifting ore... "You got it!" Nina chirps, coming up beside you and peering about cautiously. "I knew you would!" E-eventually... Nevertheless, while the siorcs are gone, they presumably won't stay that way forever, and they'll be really mad when they finally make it back. There isn't any time to waste — taking Nina by the hand, you stumble on in and see if you can't find what she's looking for before Ma Siorc and her daughters return... ]

rows.raw: " [var0 |You finish the sequence of turns with the wheel, and wait for something to happen. Nope. Nothing. Not even a single click. It looks like you didn't even get one part of the sequence correct. "Hey, it's fine," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "At least you know what not to do next." If she's being s-so smart about it, why isn't she the one turning this wheel? "Hey, I'm just trying to be helpful." Yeah, she admittedly kinda is. But s-sometimes, a [pc.mf |man |woman ]'s just got to say: stop helping me. Or something. "You'll have it figured out in no time. I believe in you." That was so cheesy that it just about had the opposite effect... |You finish the sequence of turns with the wheel, and wait for something to happen. After what feels like an eternity, you hear a single click from the gate mechanism. Better than nothing... or perhaps maybe worse, given that you've no way of telling exactly which turn of the wheel was the right one. Or do you? "Don't look so down," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "It's not like we're lacking for time here." Y-you don't know about that. Eventually you'll either s-sober up or, even if she has all the ice wine in the world stashed away wherever she keeps these things, throw up... "Just keep at it, okay?" |You finish the sequence of turns and wait for the gate's response. Before too long, two clicks sound from within the mechanism, the gate itself still unmoving. Not completely cold, perhaps, but still some ways off from the correct sequence. "We're getting there," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "You're doing good." Maybe b-but you don't feel so good. The thinky thing makes so much heat while it's worky, you can feel your head heating up. "I think that's just the drink." T-that's what you said... "Keep at it, okay?" |You finish the sequence of turns and wait to see if anything happens; sure enough, after a few seconds, you hear three clicks from the gate's internal mechanisms. More than halfway there, then — that's got to be good, right? "Getting warm," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "You'll figure it out before too long." While the en-encouragement is cute and all, she'd be a lot more help if s-she could just, you don't know, use those visions of hers and tell you the correct sequence of wheel turns to open the gate. That would be so much more useful... "Well, what the visions showed me is that you've got to be the one to open the gate, [pc.name]. You've got to follow the way things go, remember? I don't want to see you hurt or worse, in a vision or otherwise." Is that, like, a threat? "Not from me." D-damn it... all right, another go at this... |You finish the sequence of turns and wait for the gate's response, which comes almost immediately: a series of four loud clicks and several grinding noises from the sluice gate's old mechanisms. Close, but not close enough; despite knowing better, you can't help but hope that the gates will lift. Of course, it doesn't happen, but hey, you did know better. "Almost there," Nina says, patting you on the shoulder. "Just got one of them wrong. Question is: which one?" Could be any one of them, m-maybe? "I'm sure you've been doing this methodically, and your plan isn't just to turn the wheel at random until you get the sequence right by accident. Right? Right?" L-look, everyone's a damn critic-c. If she's going to be giving you this much sass, then maybe s-she should be the one to... know what, forget it. It's all about-t the visions, r-right? She can't turn the d-damn wheel herself because the visions say it's got to be y-you. "Yep! You're catching on really fast; Rumie says that you're smart that way." Oh. Great. Amazing. W-well, let's hope it works to f-figure out this wrong bit... |No sooner have you finished with the wheel that five clicks sound from within the sluice gate's mechanisms — something grinds deep within the metal monstrosity, and then the gate itself lifts, allowing all the dammed water that's pooled behind it to rush down the channel and into the sluicehouse. Several angry shouts rise from within, but are quickly cut off by the raging roar of the deluge that inundates the building. That's one way to make soup... by the time the water's settled and you feel brave enough to peek through the gate and into the sluicehouse, there's no sign of Ma Siorc, her daughters, or even the soup pot she was tending. What there is, though, are plenty of puddles strewn about the floor. Well, it's not like most of the sluicehouse was meant to be lived in, rather than sifting ore... "You got it!" Nina chirps, coming up beside you and peering about cautiously. "I knew you would!" E-eventually... Nevertheless, while the siorcs are gone, they presumably won't stay that way forever, and they'll be really mad when they finally make it back. There isn't any time to waste — taking Nina by the hand, you stumble on in and see if you can't find what she's looking for before Ma Siorc and her daughters return... ] "
