rows.translation: 那么……她到底发现了什么？

rows.original: "Looks like we've found everything. Give me a moment and I'll have the Juice ready in a jiffy, man."
rows.translation: “看起来我们已经找到了所有需要的东西。等一下，我马上就把‘果汁’准备好的，伙计。”
rows.raw: "\n        \"Looks like we've found everything. Give me a moment and I'll have the Juice ready in a jiffy, man.\""

rows.original: Ask Nina to make this %"Juice" for you.
rows.translation: 让妮娜为你制作这种%“果汁”吧。
rows.raw: 'Ask Nina to make this %"Juice" for you.'

rows.original: You don't have the ingredients that she needs: brazenberry ale, winterstem and conjuror's concoction.
rows.translation: 你没有她所需要的材料：黄铜莓麦酒、冬茎以及术士的调配药剂。
rows.raw: "You don't have the ingredients that she needs: brazenberry ale, winterstem and conjuror's concoction."

rows.original:
"Since we're as safe as it gets here, I guess it won't hurt to stop and take stock of the situation, man. We've seen some weird things so far and I guess I wouldn't mind getting your opinion the same way you want mine.

        "Was there, like, anything you wanted to discuss in particular?"
rows.translation:
“既然我们在这里已经算是非常安全了，我觉得停下来仔细分析一下当前的情况也没什么坏处，伙计。到目前为止我们已经遇到了一些奇怪的事情，所以我也想听听你的意见，就像你希望听到我的意见一样。

        “有没有什么你特别想讨论的具体问题呢？”
rows.raw:
"
        "Since we're as safe as it gets here, I guess it won't hurt to stop and take stock of the situation, man. We've seen some weird things so far and I guess I wouldn't mind getting your opinion the same way you want mine.

        "Was there, like, anything you wanted to discuss in particular?""

rows.translation: 与妮娜讨论一下这个情况。

rows.original: Taking the ingredients from you, Nina produces one of her empties and pours a measure of the ale in, followed by all the conjuror's concoction you have. Without mortar and pestle, she tears up the winterstem leaves and stuffs them into the ale jug, then corks the ungodly mixture. Now it's time for her to work her magic. The one-eyed harpy huffs a bit, and her cheeks color. "You know full well that it's not arcane magic or anything..." Just a turn of phrase. Nina looks like she's going to protest that, then her peevishness completely evaporates as if the last few sentences of your conversation had never taken place. A completely placid expression on her face, she focuses on the ceramic jug and taps its side several times, focusing intensely. Then, it's over. No sparkles, pops, or flashy effects, just a palpable sense of relief from Nina. Nodding, she hands you the jug, then tips her thumb towards her lips in a quaffing motion. "Here you go, enough Juice for one. Drink up, and you'll see how it can be helpful — trust me, you need it more than I do." ...Juice, she says. You unstopper the jug and peer in at this so-called %"Juice" — it's a deep violet, the color of overripe wine grapes. Brazenberry ale, conjuror's concoction and winterstem — you can't figure out how mixing all three would produce something of this color, but there've been greater mysteries in life. [pc.isMage |That being said... you know something of arcane reagents, and while people have been using winterstem in various ways for a while ingesting it isn't something people really do. Enough wizards have swallowed, smoked, snorted and more enough substances and more that the fact that you've yet to hear of anyone eating the recreational herb is surprising. |[pc.bgMulti hunter barbarian courtesan |That being said, you know something of the plants of the region, and despite many a campfire tale being shared with fellow hunters you've yet to hear of anyone who's tried ingesting winterstem. Smoked it, yes, rubbed it on one's skin and wounds, yes, but not swallowing it... Looking at the brew that Nina's produced for you, one only wonders if there's a reason for that. |That being said, you know something of the plants of the region, and despite many a bonfire tale shared with the rest of the tribe you've yet to hear of anyone who's tried ingesting winterstem. Smoked it, yes, rubbed it on one's skin and wounds, yes, but not swallowing it... Looking at the brew that Nina's produced for you, one only wonders if there's a reason for that. |That being said, you've had the chance to pick up more than a passing familiarity with recreational drugs thanks to rubbing shoulders with the wealthy and powerful while being an escort. Despite all the indulgences and entertainments you've encountered, ingesting winterstem wasn't one of them. Smoking, rubbing on skin, yes... but swallowing any amount of it? Some curious schmuck would certainly have tried it, and yet you can't remember any who had. And looking at the brew that Nina's produced for you, one only wonders if there's a reason for that. |That being said, you've had the chance to pick up more than a passing familiarity with recreational drugs thanks to rubbing shoulders with the wealthy and powerful while being the musical entertainment; that, and the general propensity of musicians to partake themselves. Despite all the indulgences and entertainments you've encountered, ingesting winterstem wasn't one of them. Smoking, rubbing on skin, yes... but swallowing any amount of it? Some curious schmuck would certainly have tried it, and yet you can't remember any who had. And looking at the brew that Nina's produced for you, one only wonders if there's a reason for that. ] ] "Don't worry, man," Nina says, noticing your hesitation. "The visions told me it'd be totally okay. Like, I wouldn't ever knowingly hurt you. It's not poisonous or anything, trust me on this."
rows.translation: 妮娜从你手里接过材料，拿出一个她用过的空瓶，倒入一定量的麦酒，再把你手里所有的召唤师调配物全倒进去。没有研钵和杵，她就把冬茎叶撕碎，塞进那只麦酒罐里，然后给这瓶亵渎的混合物塞上塞子。 现在，该她施展魔法了。 那只独眼的鹰身女妖哼了一声，脸颊泛起红晕。“你明明清楚，这根本不是什么奥术魔法之类的……” 只不过是一种说法罢了。 妮娜看上去正要反驳，随即她的不满彻底烟消云散，仿佛你们方才那几句对话从未发生过。她脸上是一副完全平静的表情，专注地盯着那只陶罐，在它的侧面轻敲了好几下，神情极为专注。 然后，一切就结束了。没有闪光、爆响，也没有花哨的特效，只有妮娜脸上那份显而易见的释然。她点点头，把罐子递给你，然后把拇指朝自己嘴唇一翘，做出仰头灌饮的动作。 “给你，这些‘果汁’够一个人喝了。喝下去，你就会明白它多有用了——相信我，你比我更需要它。” ……‘果汁’，她是这么说的。你拔开罐塞，仔细端详这所谓的%“果汁”——它是深紫色的，像熟透的酿酒葡萄。黄铜莓麦酒、召唤师调配物和冬茎——你想不通把这三样混在一起怎么会变成这种颜色，不过人生中还有更大的谜团。 [pc.isMage |话虽如此……你对奥术试剂还算有些了解，虽然人们长期以来一直在以各种方式使用冬茎，但把它吃进肚子里并不是人们真正会做的事。已经有足够多的巫师吞下、吸食、鼻吸过各种东西，甚至更多，所以如果你至今没听说有谁把这种消遣用的草药吃下去，那反倒令人吃惊。 |[pc.bgMulti hunter barbarian courtesan |话虽如此，你对这一带的植物还算有些了解，尽管你和猎人同伴们分享过许多篝火边的故事，却从没听说有谁尝试过把冬茎吃下去。熏它，有；把它抹在皮肤和伤口上，也有；但吞下去……没有。 看着妮娜为你调出的这瓶药水，人不免要想，这其中是不是有什么原因。 |话虽如此，你对这一带的植物还算有些了解，尽管你和部落里的其他人分享过许多篝火边的故事，却从没听说有谁尝试过把冬茎吃下去。熏它，有；把它抹在皮肤和伤口上，也有；但吞下去……没有。 看着妮娜为你调出的这瓶药水，人不免要想，这其中是不是有什么原因。 |话虽如此，你当保镖时与那些富人和权贵打过不少交道，因此对各种消遣性药物也略知一二。尽管你见识过种种放纵与享乐，吃冬茎却不在其中。抽烟，往皮肤上抹，这些都有……可要吞下哪怕一点点？总该有些好奇的傻瓜试过，可你偏偏想不起有谁这么干过。 而看着妮娜为你调出的这瓶药水，人不免要想，这其中是不是有什么原因。 |话虽如此，你靠音乐表演谋生，与那些富人和权贵打过不少交道，因此对各种消遣性药物也略知一二；再加上乐师本来就多半爱亲自尝尝这些东西。尽管你见识过种种放纵与享乐，吃冬茎却不在其中。抽烟，往皮肤上抹，这些都有……可要吞下哪怕一点点？总该有些好奇的傻瓜试过，可你偏偏想不起有谁这么干过。 而看着妮娜为你调出的这瓶药水，人不免要想，这其中是不是有什么原因。 ] ] “别担心，老兄，”妮娜注意到你的犹豫，说道。“那些预感告诉我，一切都会没事的。我绝不会明知故犯地伤害你。它没有毒，也没有别的害处，这一点你相信我。”

Despite all the indulgences and entertainments you've encountered, ingesting winterstem wasn't one of them. Smoking, rubbing on skin, yes... but swallowing any amount of it? Some curious schmuck would certainly have tried it, and yet you can't remember any who had. And looking at the brew that Nina's produced for you, one only wonders if there's a reason for that. ] ] "Don't worry, man," Nina says, noticing your hesitation. "The visions told me it'd be totally okay. Like, I wouldn't ever knowingly hurt you. It's not poisonous or anything, trust me on this.""

rows.original: You sigh, then tip your head back and drain the jug in a few gulps. The taste is surprisingly rich and thick, almost addictive; like the color, there's no way it could be derived from the stated ingredients. The sensation of it sliding down your throat to settle heavily in your stomach is palpable, but the effects have already begun to take place before that; the Juice works in more dimensions than simply the physical, as your vision blurs and colors a faint violet at the edges. It's... it's like there's two of Nina, the bed, the dusty decorations that line the private bedchamber — you can see where not just everyone, but also everything will be a few seconds ahead in time before they actually move there. The sensation is similar, but not identical, to the ominous crawling sensation in the back of your mind every time you faced one of those broken psyches wandering the fort. It's definitely not something that people with normal senses should have to endure for too long — the way your mind's put together, it just fundamentally doesn't fit. A nice place to visit, perhaps, but not somewhere you'd want to live on a permanent basis or run the risk of being driven to madness. Is this how Nina feels most of the time? "You okay, man? Like, it's going to hit someone who isn't a dreamwalker pretty hard. Breathe, man, breathe — but don't focus. Forcing it isn't going to work, like one of those glass finger doodads they have in Tychris; the more you struggle, the deeper it sinks its teeth into you. Just relax, don't think too hard, let your mind wander. It's all good." The soothing tones of Nina's voice cut through your panic, and you find that relaxing does help: it's like looking at something out the corner of your eye in that the less you focus, the sharper the images of the near-immediate future appear. They're still not comfortable by any means and your mind instinctively rebels at the torment it's being put through, but at least the disorientation's more bearable. Is that what this Juice does? Let you see a few seconds into the future? You can think of several situations where the blink of an eye could make all the difference... And then, the precognition subsides but doesn't fade completely as you get used to it — things are almost normal, but not quite. This feels like it's going to last for a while, perhaps forever given that time doesn't flow in this place. Well, that's useful given how Nina claims it'll be helpful; you won't risk running out of Juice at a critical juncture. That being said, there's still the headache and disorientation... "Yeah, I get you," Nina says. "But we all gotta pay a price for our powers, man. Tough it out — I totally believe in you, a killer headache isn't going to be enough to lay you out, right? "Oh, and that jug's yours now, man. Hygiene and all." ...Did you just see into the future, even if it was for the blink of an eye? "Well, I wouldn't like, call it seeing into the future. Like, this is a place where there's literally no future, man, so it can't be that. People and things... I'd say it's more like you're seeing what's really there, and that kinda information can be plenty useful." Well, seeing into the future is closest to how you can describe what happened to you, precognition of a sort, so you'll stick with that. Oh gods, it's hard to put into words. The Juice's effects aren't going to run out anytime, but you ought to be careful to not accidentally overwrite it with another boon. That would suck something awful. Oh, and Nina insinuated that Juice has a much more powerful effect on dreamwalkers than other people, so it's a pity there's only enough for one dose. Nina smiles drunkenly and claps you on the shoulder, giving it a reassuring squeeze. "Don't sweat it, man; like I said, you need it far more than I do. As for exactly why... I've learned that trying to explain usually doesn't help and makes you confused as well. Let's just say that it works, and I totally, like, get it." So... this stuff is okay, then? You're not going to be having ominous visions or start spacing out and babbling like she does? "You're not a dreamwalker, so unlikely." Nina's expression turns serious. "If anything, it's me who needs to worry about that, man. This place does a number on your head, and being a dreamwalker means you're more open to both the good and bad." So... what happens now? "Now that you can really see things for what they are, maybe we should like, backtrack a little and search some more, man. Maybe there're clues here and there that we missed the first time around, but you can now see that you're all juiced up. Maybe going forward will be a bit easier. I know it sounds weird, given that in our time together I've been the one to see things, so it's your turn to shine. Go get them, tiger."
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，然后仰起头，几口就把那一罐喝光了。这味道出奇地浓郁醇厚，几乎让人上瘾；就像它的颜色一样，绝不可能来自所标注的那些成分。它顺着喉咙滑下去、沉甸甸地积在胃里的感觉清晰可感，但在此之前，效果就已经开始显现了；果汁的作用远不止肉体一个层面——你的视线开始模糊，视野边缘染上了一层淡淡的紫色。 就好像有两个妮娜、两张床，还有那间私密卧房里积满灰尘的装饰品——你能看到，不只是每个人，连每一样东西都会在实际移动之前几秒钟就提前出现在那里。这种感觉与你每次面对堡垒里游荡的破碎心灵时，脑海深处那种不祥的爬动感相似，但并不完全相同。对感官正常的人来说，这绝对不是该长期承受的东西——就你头脑的构造而言，它从根本上就不契合。也许是个值得一游的好地方，但绝不是你想长期居住、或冒着被逼疯风险待下去的地方。尼娜大部分时候都是这种感觉吗？ “你没事吧，老兄？这东西对不是梦行者的人来说，冲击会相当大。呼吸，老兄，呼吸——但别去聚焦。硬来是没用的，就像提克里斯那些玻璃手指小玩意一样；你越挣扎，它咬得越深。放松就好，别想太多，让心思随便飘。没事的。” 妮娜那安抚的语调穿透了你的恐慌，你发现放松确实有用：这就像用眼角余光看东西——你越不去聚焦，那些近在眼前的未来影像就越清晰。它们绝称不上舒适，你的头脑也会本能地抗拒所承受的这种折磨，但至少那种迷失感变得可以忍受一些了。 这就是果汁的作用吗？让你看见几秒钟后的未来？你能想到好几种情形，眨眼的功夫就能决定一切…… 然后，这种预知能力会逐渐减弱，但当你习惯之后并不会完全消失——一切似乎又恢复了正常，却又不太一样。这种感觉似乎会持续一段时间，甚至可能永远持续下去，因为在这个地方时间并不流动。嗯，既然尼娜说这会有用，那确实挺实用的——你不会在关键时刻面临果汁耗尽的风险。话虽如此，头痛和迷失方向感还是有的…… “是啊，我懂你，”妮娜说。“但我们的能力总要付出代价，老兄。硬撑过去——我完全相信你，区区剧烈的头痛还撂不倒你，对吧？ “哦，还有，那个罐子现在归你了，老兄。注意卫生之类的。” ……你刚才是不是看到了未来，哪怕只有眨眼的一瞬？ “嗯，我不会把它称为看见未来。你想啊，这地方根本就没有未来可言，老兄，所以不可能是那样。人和事物……我倒觉得你看到的更像是那里真正存在的东西，而那种信息往往相当有用。” 嗯，看见未来最接近你对自身遭遇的描述，算是某种预知，所以你就沿用这个说法吧。哦，天哪，这实在难以用言语形容。果汁的效果一时半会儿不会消退，但你得小心，别不小心用另一种恩惠把它覆盖掉。那可就太糟了。哦，还有，妮娜暗示过，果汁对梦行者的效果比对其他人强得多，可惜只够一份的量。 尼娜醉醺醺地笑了笑，拍了拍你的肩膀，又安慰地捏了捏。“别担心，老兄；就像我说的，你比我更需要它。至于具体原因……我发现试图解释通常没什么用，反而会让你也跟着一头雾水。就这么说吧，它有效，而我完全、呃，明白。” 那么……这东西没问题吧？你不会像她那样产生不祥的幻象，或者开始走神、胡言乱语吧？ “你不是梦行者，所以不太可能。”尼娜的表情变得严肃起来。“真要说的话，是我才需要担心那种事，老兄。这个地方会把你的脑子搅得一团糟，而身为梦行者意味着你对好的和坏的都更加敞开。” 那么……现在会怎样？ “既然你现在真的能看到事物的本来面目，也许我们该稍微往回走一点，再多搜一搜，老兄。也许有些线索散落在各处，是我们第一次来时漏掉的，但你现在能看见自己已经充满了果汁的效力。也许继续往前走会轻松一些。我知道这听起来很怪，毕竟在我们共处的这段时间里，一直是我在看东西，所以现在轮到你发光了。去把他们拿下吧，小老虎。”

rows.original: Nina freezes up for a second, then heaves a huge sigh. "Gods, no. I'm not that dumb — anyone worth their salt quickly learns not to stray too close to the edge, man. You gotta give these borders a wide berth, because people who wander up don't come back, like, at all. Only Gerry and his ilk can pull off that kind of stunt, and even they don't stay very long. What he's told me had me convinced that it wasn't anything I wanted to try." So, all of this is as new to her as it is to you. "From a first-hand perspective, yeah. It's kinda crazy and actually a little enjoyable if you don't mind the whole being in peril thing, but I wouldn't want to live here. Your watering hole is much cozier and warmer. Being up close to the edge has certainly opened my mind — I guess that's why I remembered how to make Juice — but the thing is your mind's liable to fall out if you open it too much. That's no good, man. But what do you think of it?" To be honest? It's strangely familiar in a way that you can't quite put to words even though it's on the tip of your tongue. While you understand that space is shattered and time doesn't flow on the border of reality and chaos, this ruin is still surprisingly navigable despite you not even having a solid handle on which way is up, if up has any meaning at all. It's like... like you know something ought to be there, and no sooner are you thinking about being in that place that you're starting to move towards it, even though 'towards' might be meaningless in this broken image of the Wayfort's past. "Weird way to travel, isn't it? Haven't figured that one out, either." Doesn't it work the same way for her? Nina shakes her head resolutely. "I dunno, man. I've just been following you all this while. Good thing you didn't leave me back in that storeroom while you scouted ahead — I might have never been able to leave like that."
rows.translation: 尼娜愣了一下，然后长叹一声：“天啊，不。我没那么傻——任何有点脑子的人都会很快明白，千万不要靠边缘太近。那些靠近边界的人，根本就不会再回来。只有杰里和他那一类人才能做出那种事，而且就连他们也不会长久坚持下去。他告诉我的那些事，让我确信那根本不是我想尝试的事情。 所以，对她来说，这一切和你一样新鲜。 从亲身体验的角度来说，确实是这样。这种感觉有点疯狂，但如果你不介意总是处于危险之中，其实还挺有趣的。不过，我可不想在这里生活——你们的那个聚集地要舒适得多，也温暖得多。身处边缘确实让我有了很多新的领悟，我想这就是我突然想起来如何制作果汁的原因吧……不过问题在于，如果你把思维敞开得太彻底，你的脑子反而有可能会‘掉出来’哦。那可不行，伙计。不过我们该怎么办呢？你觉得呢？” 说实话？这种感觉有一种奇怪的熟悉感，让你甚至无法用语言表达出来，尽管这些词语已经浮现在你的脑海中。虽然你明白，在现实与混沌的边界上，空间已经破碎，时间也不再流逝，但这个废墟依然可以让人在其中行走——尽管你甚至不清楚哪边是上方，也不知道“上方”这个概念是否还有意义。这就好像……就好像你曾经知道那里应该有什么东西，而一旦你开始思考要去那个地方，你就会开始朝那个方向前进——尽管在这个关于荒废驿堡过去的破碎片段中，“前进”这个概念可能根本没有任何意义。 这种旅行方式真是奇怪，不是吗？我也还没弄明白这是怎么运作的。” 对她来说，不也是同样的原理吗？ 尼娜坚决地摇了摇头：“我不知道，真的。我一直都在跟着你而已。幸亏你在前面探路的时候没有把我留在那个储藏室里——否则我可能永远也没办法离开那里了。

rows.original: Is this kind of thing familiar to her? Being up against the edge of reality, that is.
rows.translation: 她是否对这种体验感到熟悉呢？那种处于现实边缘的感受，就是我指的。
rows.raw: "Is this kind of thing familiar to her? Being up against the edge of reality, that is."

rows.original:
Those broken minds you've seen wandering the halls of the Wayfort's past... they aren't really ghosts, are they?

        Nina shrugs. "Walks like a duck, looks like a duck, quacks like a duck — yeah, we know it isn't a duck, but for our purposes it might as well be one. You're right that they aren't ghosts, not in the way we understand them; this close to the edge I think everyone was dusted right away. But you still have these echoes of thoughts remaining because, well, from what's keeping us here, I think."
        
        Is she sure about that?
        
        "You aren't a dreamwalker, so you wouldn't know, but there's this constant pressure that I'm feeling, man. It's, like, sucking not just us in, but everything around it as well, keeping all of this stuff in orbit around it. Without the pull of that mental vortex, all these half-torn thoughts and feelings would've fizzled out a long time ago, man. I don't know which is worse, oblivion or being perpetually kept in this crazy state.
        
        "You don't have to feel bad about putting them down, they were never people and more are just going to keep on coming out the walls before we get to wherever it is we're going. It's also what in all likelihood's going to happen to us if we die here, so... if you're ever feeling poorly, just think about that, man."
        
        You will.
rows.translation:
你曾看见那些破碎的心智在驿堡往昔的走廊中游荡……它们其实并不是鬼魂，对吧？

        妮娜耸耸肩。“走路像鸭子，长得像鸭子，叫声也像鸭子——是啊，我们知道它不是鸭子，可对我们而言，就当它是鸭子也没差。你说得对，它们并非我们理解中的鬼魂；这么靠近边缘，我想所有人当场就化成了尘埃。不过思想的回声仍旧留存，呃，我想是因为那个把我们困在这里的东西。”
        
        她确定吗？
        
        “伙计，你不是梦行者，所以不会明白；可我一直能感受到某种压力。它就像不只把我们吸进去，也把周围的一切一并吸入，让所有这些东西都环绕着它运转。若没有那道心智漩涡的引力，这些残缺的思想与情感早就消散了。伙计，我不知道彻底归于虚无，和永远被困在这种疯狂状态里，哪一个更糟。
        
        “消灭它们不用感到难过；它们从来都不是真正的人。在我们到达目的地前，还会有更多东西不断从墙里冒出来。要是我们死在这里，多半也会落得同样下场，所以……以后心里不好受，就想想这一点吧，伙计。”
        
        你会的。

rows.original: What does she think of Thalia so far? Can the Astrida — or what's left of her — be trusted? [pc.swornGod nareva |Nina tilts her head and looks at you funny. "I dunno, man. That's a totally weird question to be asking, given that you're both Astrida. That's like, a given that you trust each other, no?" |Nina wrinkles her nose and fixes her one good eye on you. "Ehhhh. I dunno. Aren't they supposed to be like the most upright and uptight of people ever? You think one of them godsworn would do that? Just go up and apparate, then start telling lies?" ] Deception doesn't have to be deliberate or malicious. Those big gaps in Thalia's memory, are those common for people who've been in similar situations? "We-ll." Scratching her chin, Nina thinks a bit. "Memories are one of the things you can lose, yeah, but there're also a lot of other things you could lose, man. Your personality could completely change, for example, or you could go numb in a limb, or have everything you want to say line up in your head, but it's all gibberish when it comes from your mouth. Getting your sense of self sundered like what she says happened to her can cause all sorts of nasty stuff, it really depends on which bits of you — that's you you — fell off." It's just a little too convenient that she lost the bits that held her memories of the answers to the most pressing questions. "Doesn't have to be malice on her part, but you already said that. Well, if you ask me, I think that the clean cut there means there's something more. She's not consciously lying — or at least, I think so — but we gotta be on our toes for evidence and draw our own conclusions, man. Like, if you're talking about it being convenient it'd be too convenient for us if the last person with her head screwed on right in this place had all the answers all neatly wrapped up."
rows.translation: 她目前对塔莉娅是什么看法？阿斯特里达——或者说她残存的那部分——可以信任吗？ [pc.swornGod nareva |妮娜歪着头，用一种古怪的眼神看着你。“我不知道啊，伙计。既然你们俩都是阿斯特里达，这问题问得也太奇怪了。你们互相信任不是理所当然的吗？” |妮娜皱了皱鼻子，用她那只完好的眼睛盯着你。“呃……我不知道。他们不该是世上最正直、最古板的那种人吗？你觉得那些神誓者里会有人干这种事？直接现身上去，然后就开始说谎？” ] 欺骗未必是有意为之，也未必出于恶意。塔莉娅记忆里的那些大段空白，是经历过类似处境的人都会有的吗？ “嗯——这个嘛。”妮娜挠了挠下巴，想了想。“记忆确实是你会失去的东西之一，对，但还有很多别的东西也可能丢掉，伙计。比如说，你的性格可能彻底改变，或者某个肢体失去知觉，又或者你想说的每句话在脑子里都排得好好的，可一从嘴里出来就全是胡言乱语。自我认知像她说的那样被撕碎，会引发各种各样糟糕的后果，这真的取决于你身上哪些部分——也就是 你 本身——掉了下去。” 偏偏她丢掉的正是那些承载着最要紧问题的答案的记忆，这未免太方便了。 “她那边未必是出于恶意，不过这话你已经说过了。嗯，要我说，我觉得那么干净的切口意味着还有别的东西。她不是有意识地在撒谎——至少我 认为 如此——但我们必须时刻留意证据，自己下结论，伙计。比如说，你要说这事方便，那要是这地方最后一个脑子还清醒的人把所有答案都整整齐齐地备好了，对我们 我们 来说也太方便了。”
rows.raw: " What does she think of Thalia so far? Can the Astrida — or what's left of her — be trusted? [pc.swornGod nareva |Nina tilts her head and looks at you funny. "I dunno, man. That's a totally weird question to be asking, given that you're both Astrida. That's like, a given that you trust each other, no?" |Nina wrinkles her nose and fixes her one good eye on you. "Ehhhh. I dunno. Aren't they supposed to be like the most upright and uptight of people ever? You think one of them godsworn would do that? Just go up and apparate, then start telling lies?" ] Deception doesn't have to be deliberate or malicious. Those big gaps in Thalia's memory, are those common for people who've been in similar situations? "We-ll." Scratching her chin, Nina thinks a bit. "Memories are one of the things you can lose, yeah, but there're also a lot of other things you could lose, man. Your personality could completely change, for example, or you could go numb in a limb, or have everything you want to say line up in your head, but it's all gibberish when it comes from your mouth. Getting your sense of self sundered like what she says happened to her can cause all sorts of nasty stuff, it really depends on which bits of you — that's you you — fell off." Like, if you're talking about it being convenient it'd be too convenient for us if the last person with her head screwed on right in this place had all the answers all neatly wrapped up.""

rows.original: Is this really the Wayfort's past? It certainly gives a new perspective on the state of your adopted home, but you've also noticed some discrepancies. "I wouldn't say so much that this is the Wayfort's past as it's a figment of how these people remember it, man." Nina sighs, reaches for a drink, then looks forlorn as she remembers she's all out of booze while in this place. "And given that just about everyone in here is a crazy, screaming echo, I'm surprised it's holding together as well as it is." Yeah, there's that. Places like these sleeping chambers are really put together in a lot more detail than, say, the maze of corridors and hallways that led out from your vault and into the rest of the keep. Those were as forgettable as it gets — it feels like the troops garrisoned here didn't really care for them, if Nina's hypothesis is true. "That, and I wouldn't expect it to be exactly as it was, as opposed to how these people remember it as being. So if there're any differences between then and now that can't be explained away by the passage of time, that would totally cover for it, man." She's right, you guess. Still, with the knowledge of your Wayfort fresh in your mind, you have to double-take every now and then when you spot a particularly egregious discrepancy. Nina smiles and [pc.heightRange 58 |reaches up to pat |pats ] you on the shoulder. "It's okay, man. I feel off too, but then I remind myself how all these people are literally caught up here. Let them have it, that's what I'm saying."
rows.translation: 这里真的是驿堡的过去吗？它确实让你对自己收归名下的家园有了全新的看法，但你也注意到一些出入。 “与其说这是驿堡的过去，不如说它只是这些人如何记住驿堡的产物，伙计。”妮娜叹了口气，伸手想拿杯酒，随后想起自己在这里已经没酒了，神情顿时变得落寞。“况且这里几乎所有人都是疯狂尖叫的回声，它居然还能维持得这么完整，我都觉得很惊讶。” 的确如此。这些寝室之类的地方，构造细节远比从金库通往城堡其余区域的迷宫般走廊丰富。相比之下，那些地方简直平凡到让人过目即忘——如果妮娜的假设属实，驻守这里的军队似乎根本不在乎那些地方。 “而且，我也不觉得它会和当年一模一样；它呈现的只是这些人记忆中的模样。所以，要是过去与现在之间出现任何无法用时间流逝来解释的差异，完全可以归咎于这一点，伙计。” 你觉得她说得对。不过，想到自己所熟知的那座驿堡，每当你发现特别离谱的差异时，还是免不了再看一眼。 妮娜微笑着，[pc.heightRange 58 |伸手拍了拍 |拍了拍 ]你的肩膀。“没事的，伙计。我也觉得不太对劲，不过我会提醒自己，这些人确实都被困在这里。我的意思是，就让他们保留自己记忆中的样子吧。”

rows.original: After what you've experienced, has she gotten any closer to figuring a way out of here? "I already told you one, man." Okay, another way out of here? One that doesn't involve confronting whatever's at the bottom of this shattered illusion? Has she managed to conveniently remember anything, perhaps have it jarred loose by experiencing the inner horrors of her mind manifested in madness? Nina squints at you with her good eye. "C'mon, man, that's just silly." There was that bird-thing. It looked a bit like a chicken — why does her evil self look like a chicken? "Look, joke around all you want, but them's the breaks, man. Our original plan aside, I don't have anything new — that thing that's keeping us in is still there. Whatever it is, I'm pretty sure we're closer to it than when we started; you should be able to feel it on the inside of your head." Hmm. You focus a bit and yeah, there's an insistent pounding on the inside of your skull, even though you're not a dreamwalker like Nina. She gives you a slow nod, then sighs. "It's not going to get any better until it's over. Sorry to bring bad news, but it really looks like the only way out is through."
rows.translation: 经历了那些事情之后，她有没有找到离开这里的办法呢？ “我已经告诉过你一个办法了，伙计。” 好吧，另一个离开这里的办法呢？有没有什么办法可以不必面对这个破碎幻象底部的东西？她是否侥幸地想起了一些事情，又或者是因为经历了自己内心深处的恐惧化为疯狂，这些记忆才被震得松动起来呢？ 尼娜用她那只完好的眼睛眯着看你。“得了吧，伙计，那也太蠢了。” 还有那个鸟一样的东西。它看起来有点像鸡——为什么她的邪恶化身会长得像鸡呢？ “听着，你想开玩笑就开玩笑吧，但事情就是这样，伙计。撇开我们最初的计划不谈，我也没有什么新消息——那个把我们困在这里的东西还在那里。不管它是什么，我很确定我们现在比刚开始的时候离它更近了；你应该能在大脑内侧感觉到它。” 嗯。你稍微集中了一下注意力，没错，你的头骨内侧确实有一种持续不断的敲击感，尽管你并不像妮娜那样是个梦行者。她缓缓地点了点头，然后叹了口气。 “在这一切结束之前，情况不会好转。很抱歉带来坏消息，但看起来，唯一的出路就是硬闯过去。”

rows.original: "No problem. Once you've rested your feet enough, we can be on our way."
rows.translation: “没问题。等你们休息够了，我们就可以出发了。”
rows.raw: '\n        "No problem. Once you\'ve rested your feet enough, we can be on our way."'

rows.original:
"Huh, feeling like a nap?"

    She said the bedchamber was safe, the bed looks serviceable enough, and you're exhausted. She can join you if she wants.
    
    Nina thinks about that for all of two seconds, then shrugs and pulls up a tattered blanket. Whoever the previous commander of the fort was, he or she was into impressive bedrooms — old and creaky as it may be, the bed has more than enough room to accommodate the both of you comfortably. Before you know it, you're fast asleep.
    
    Darkness descends...
    
    You wake up an indeterminate amount of time later, unmolested and still in one piece. On the upside, you don't feel any worse than when you laid yourself to rest. On the downside, you don't feel any better, either. Every single one of the pains an aches in your mind and body alike haven't faded in the least — time may heal all wounds, but since it doesn't pass in this place you're completely unchanged from your attempt to recover. Looking at Nina, she's in the same boat as you are, looking just as miserable and ruffled as she was when she'd curled up beside you.
    
    "Didn't work, huh?"
    
    You'd hoped it might, but clearly it was in vain. Oh well, not too much lost, not even time.
    
    Nina just sighs, thinks a moment, then shudders. "Gods damn. Hope neither of us actually gets any serious cuts or anything while we're here. Bleeding that won't stop, gashes that won't heal..."
    
    On the bright side, given the nature of your adversaries in this place they're more likely to shatter your mind to pieces rather than inflict physical wounds.
    
    A weak smile. "That's one way to put it, but it's still bleak, man. Okay, are we ready to move on?"
rows.translation:
“嗯，想小睡一会儿吗？”

    她说卧室是安全的，床看起来也还算能用，而且你确实累坏了。如果她愿意，她可以跟你一起睡。
    
    尼娜只用了两秒钟考虑这件事，然后耸了耸肩，拉过一条破旧的毯子。不管这座堡垒的前任指挥官是谁，他或她显然很讲究卧室的排场——床虽然又旧又吱呀作响，但宽敞得很，足够你们俩舒舒服服地躺下。不知不觉中，你就睡熟了。
    
    黑暗降临……
    
    不知过了多久，你醒了过来，没有人来打扰你，你也完好无损。好的方面是，你并不比躺下休息时更难受；坏的方面是，你也没有好受一点。你身心里的每一处疼痛都丝毫没有消退——时间或许能治愈一切伤口，但既然在这个地方时间根本不会流逝，你这次尝试恢复也就毫无成效。看看尼娜，她的处境和你一样，看上去依旧那么痛苦、那么狼狈，就像她蜷缩在你身边时那样。
    
    “没用吧？”
    
    你原本希望会有点用，但显然只是徒劳。算了，也没损失什么，连时间都没损失。
    
    尼娜只是叹了口气，想了想，然后打了个寒颤。“该死的。希望我们待在这儿的时候，谁都别碰上什么严重的伤口。止不住的血，长不好的裂口……”
    
    往好处想，考虑到这个地方那些对手的性质，它们更可能把你的心智撕成碎片，而不是给你造成肉体上的伤害。
    
    她勉强挤出一个微笑。“话是这么说，可还是够凄凉的，老兄。好了，我们准备继续走了吗？”

rows.original: You step up to the fountain by one side of the bridge — carved in the likeness of a boreal elf druid with a pitcher in his hands, water continually streams from the pitcher's lip into a basin at his feet, the sound of its trickling adding to the roar of the river under you. That is, you think it's water. That, and there's no obvious way for the fountain to be supplied atop a bridge, nor is there any apparent outflow from the basin. By all reasonable measure, it should be impossible for this fountain to exist, but it does anyway — a small holdout of intact beauty amidst the shattered chaos that is the remains of Wayfort past. Gingerly, you reach out and test the flow with your fingertips — it's cool, it's clear, and it's neither oily nor viscous like the stuff flowing under the bridge. By all appearances, it's water all right. Now that you think about it, you haven't gotten one iota hungrier or thirstier the entire time you've been here, but seeing this flow has the back of your head pointing out that you just might feel a little parched at the moment. "Doesn't feel off to me, man," Nina points out helpfully. "No visions that scream out danger from any part of the fountain, at any rate. Like, I wouldn't have it as my first choice, but if it came down to it I'd chance a drink all right. Leastways it isn't stagnant water." Oh, you think stagnant water is the least of your worries right now. That being said, are you willing to chance a sip?
rows.translation: 你走到桥的一侧，那里有一座喷泉——喷泉的造型被雕刻成一位北欧精灵德鲁伊的形象，他手中握着一个水壶，水不断从水壶的嘴部流进他脚边的水池中，那潺潺的水声与你脚下的河流奔腾声交织在一起，构成了一幅美妙的音景。 也就是说，你就是站在那里。思考那是水。而且，从逻辑上来看，这座喷泉根本不可能建在桥上，水池里也没有任何明显的出水口。按常理来说，这样的喷泉根本不可能存在，但它确实存在了——在荒废驿堡遗迹那片一片破碎的废墟中，这是一处难得的、依然保持着原始美感的角落。 你小心翼翼地伸出手指去触摸那流动的物质——它很凉，很清澈，既不油腻也不黏稠，完全不像桥下流淌的那些东西。从表面上看，这确实就是水。现在想来，在你来到这里的这段时间里，你的饥饿感或口渴感丝毫没有增加，但看到这种流动的场景，你突然觉得可能现在有点口渴呢。” “我觉得没什么问题，”尼娜热心地建议道，“至少从喷泉里没有任何信号表明有危险。虽然这不是我的首选，但如果非得喝的话，我也愿意试试。至少这水不是死水。” 哦，你以为现在最值得担心的是水是否是死水吧……那么，你愿意冒险喝一口吗？

rows.original:
You rinse off your hands in the flow, then cup them and take a sip. Looks like water, feels like water, smells like water, tastes like water. So far, so good — you take another sip, and when something terrible fails to happen chance a full gulp.

            Much better. There's something in the cool clarity of the water as your aches and pains dissolve and your mind clears, leaving you refreshed. It's much welcome considering all the madness you've experienced so far, a lucky break to be sure. Seeing you fail to explode or crumble into dust, Nina chances a drink herself to much the same effect.
            
            "Huh, now that hit the spot. Feels good, man."
            
            Well, she'd better prepare herself. A restorative fountain inexplicably in the middle of nowhere likely means you're going to be placed in considerable peril pretty soon. Probably just a few paces over, in fact.
            
            Nina squints at you. "You sound pretty confident about this, man."
            
            The moment you confirmed that this was a restorative fountain, it became a lot more probable. There're just some recurring themes in your adventuring career and you've learned to identify them, that's all. There's no guarantee that something nasty's awaiting you at the end of the bridge, but you wouldn't be surprised if there were. No need for any visions.
            
            "Hey, man. You're the boss."
            
            No sooner have Nina and you had your fill that the fountain dries up, the flow from the pitcher abruptly stopping. It's as if it'd been waiting for you all this while and now that you're here, it has no more purpose in existence... it's a small mercy that it merely dried out and didn't outright crumble to rubble.
            
            Time to move on, then...
rows.translation:
你将双手放在水流中冲洗，然后捧起水来喝了一口。它看起来像水，摸起来像水，闻起来像水，尝起来也像水。一切看起来都很正常——你又喝了一口，这时，既然没有发生什么糟糕的事情，于是你大胆地喝了一大口。

            好多了。当你的疼痛消失，思绪变得清晰，感受到水的清凉与纯净时，真的会让人感到神清气爽。考虑到你迄今为止经历的一切，这样的体验实在是非常难得的，可以说是幸运之至。看到你既没有爆炸，也没有化为尘埃，尼娜便自己也喝了一杯，希望能达到同样的效果。
            
            哈，这一下真是说到点子上了。感觉真好，伙计。”
            
            嗯，她最好做好准备。在荒郊野岭中出现这样的恢复泉水，很可能意味着你很快就会遇到危险。事实上，危险可能就就在几步之遥的地方。
            
            妮娜眯着眼睛看着你：“你听起来对此相当有信心啊，伙计。”
            
            从你确认这确实是一处恢复力泉水的那一刻起，这件事就变得更有可能性了。在你的冒险生涯中，总有一些反复出现的主题，而你已经学会了如何识别它们，仅此而已。并不能保证在桥的尽头会有什么危险在等着你，但如果有的话，你也不会感到惊讶。根本不需要什么预感或预言。
            
            嘿，老兄，你才是老板啊。”
            
            你和妮娜刚喝个够，那喷泉就干涸了，水从水壶里流出的声音也突然停止了。就好像它一直在等待你们，而现在你们来了，它就再也没有存在的意义了……幸好它只是干涸了，而没有直接变成碎片。
            
            那么，是时候继续前进了……
rows.raw:
"
            You rinse off your hands in the flow, then cup them and take a sip. Looks like water, feels like water, smells like water, tastes like water. So far, so good — you take another sip, and when something terrible fails to happen chance a full gulp.

            Much better. There's something in the cool clarity of the water as your aches and pains dissolve and your mind clears, leaving you refreshed. It's much welcome considering all the madness you've experienced so far, a lucky break to be sure. Seeing you fail to explode or crumble into dust, Nina chances a drink herself to much the same effect.
            
            "Huh, now that hit the spot. Feels good, man."
            
            Well, she'd better prepare herself. A restorative fountain inexplicably in the middle of nowhere likely means you're going to be placed in considerable peril pretty soon. Probably just a few paces over, in fact.
            
            Nina squints at you. "You sound pretty confident about this, man."
            
            The moment you confirmed that this was a restorative fountain, it became a lot more probable. There're just some recurring themes in your adventuring career and you've learned to identify them, that's all. There's no guarantee that something nasty's awaiting you at the end of the bridge, but you wouldn't be surprised if there were. No need for any visions.
            
            "Hey, man. You're the boss."
            
            No sooner have Nina and you had your fill that the fountain dries up, the flow from the pitcher abruptly stopping. It's as if it'd been waiting for you all this while and now that you're here, it has no more purpose in existence... it's a small mercy that it merely dried out and didn't outright crumble to rubble.
            
            Time to move on, then..."

rows.original:
You consider the fountain, then decide against it. Looks like water, feels like water, smells like water, tastes like water — doesn't have to be water, or at least potable water. Who knows where it came from, or where it is going?

            It takes some force of will to tear yourself away from the fountain, especially since it looks so inviting and refreshing, but traps are meant to be appealing so that people will fall into them. You've come this far, you'll handle what lies ahead on your own without taking the risk. Besides, you can always come back if you change your mind, right?
rows.translation:
你看着那座喷泉，最终却放弃了这个想法。它看起来像水，摸起来像水，闻起来像水，尝起来也像水——但其实并不一定是水，至少不一定是可以饮用的水。谁知道它是从哪里来的，又将会流向哪里呢？

            要强迫自己离开那个喷泉确实需要一定的意志力，尤其是当它看起来如此诱人、如此令人感到清凉的时候。但陷阱本来就是用来吸引人们的，这样才能让人掉进去。你已经走了这么远，接下来的挑战你也一定能独自应对，而不会冒险。另外，如果你改变主意了，随时都可以回来，对吧？

rows.original: Remembering what happened the last time you left a chaotic maze like this, you're well-on guard for something like the feathered fiend to emerge. Interesting things live on borders, after all... one might have been expecting the Wayfort's old commander, your predecessor, or something of importance back in the days of the Wayfort's past, someone with a strong enough psyche to leave an impression on this construct of collective memories and spirits. This, though... while it wasn't completely out of the question, it's unlikely to have been your first choice, either. Have you been here so long that your mind has so deeply imprinted itself on the Wayfort's past? As its future ruler, do you have some particular sway you don't know about? Or are you just that special without any particular reason? Of course you recognize the [pc.race] standing in your way. It's you. Made of star-stuff and glimmering with thousands of motes of light, but it's undoubtedly you. The image is so vivid and clear — the more you look, the more you can only marvel at how perfect you are in minute detail. You're not mirrored; a looking-glass would flip your image, but this is the real deal, you as you truly are. You walk slowly towards yourself, a chill spreading over your shoulders and running down your spine. No words are needed — why would they be, when you already know everything that you'd say to yourself? The feeling of unreality that enveloped the chaotic mess that's everything outside the Wayfort's southern gate intensifies, the sights that you passed through — dark, oily water, shattered islands of dirt, bridges that twist upon themselves — all those pale and feel so vague in compared to how vivid and real the both of you are. Maybe that's what Nina meant when she said you had weight upon the fabric of this place. Nina. You cast a glance over at your feathered companion, only to find her frozen mid-stride, suspended in time and space. Wearing her most cheerful smile that she can muster given the circumstances, the silly bird's completely oblivious to what's going on right beside her.
rows.translation: 回想上一次离开这样一个混乱的迷宫时发生的事情，你自然会格外警惕，生怕那些有羽毛的恶魔之类的东西突然出现。毕竟，有趣的东西往往就存在于边界地带……人们或许本会期待看到荒废驿堡家族的老指挥官——你的前任，或者是在荒废驿堡家族辉煌往昔中那些举足轻重的人物；那些拥有足够强大精神力量的人，才有可能在这个由集体记忆与灵魂构成的体系中留下自己的痕迹。 不过……虽然这种可能性并非完全不存在，但它也不太可能成为你的首选吧。你在这里待了这么久，难道荒废驿堡的过去已经深深地烙印在你的脑海中了吗？作为它的未来统治者，你是否拥有某些自己尚未意识到的影响力？还是说，你就是那么特别，没有任何特别的理由？ 当然，你能够认出来[pc.race]挡在你的路上的人，就是你。 这个形象由星辰物质构成，闪烁着数千颗微光，但毫无疑问，那就是你。这个画面如此生动、如此清晰——你看得越久，就越会惊叹于你在细节上竟是如此完美。你并没有看到自己的镜像；镜子只会反射出你的影像，但此刻呈现的正是真实的你，那个真实的你自己。 你缓缓地走向自己，一阵寒意从肩头蔓延开来，顺着脊椎一直向下。此刻不需要任何言语——既然你已经知道了自己想要对自己说的一切，那么言语又有什么意义呢？当你走过荒废驿堡南门外的那一片混乱景象时，那种不真实的感觉会愈发强烈。你所看到的那些景象——浑浊的黑色水体、支离破碎的泥泞岛屿、那些扭曲变形的桥梁——与那些原本如此生动鲜明的画面相比，都显得如此苍白、如此模糊不清真实的你们两个就是这样的。 也许尼娜说“你们给这个地方带来了某种影响”时，指的就是这个意思。 尼娜，你瞥了一眼你的羽毛伙伴，却发现她停在了那里，仿佛被时间与空间所冻结。在这种情况下，这只傻鸟还是露出了她所能做出的最开心的笑容，完全没有意识到发生在她身边的这一切。

rows.original: Thanks to Nina, though, you've got Juice flowing in your veins and giving you quite the buzz. Things might have turned out differently otherwise — with you being able to see you for what you really are, something clicks in the back of your mind as realization dawns. There isn't two of you — there's just you. It really is as simple as that: the you before you isn't a mirror image, a split sense of self, some nightmare dredged from the deepest recesses of your mind. It's just you. None of this makes the slightest lick of sense, of course, but that's about par for the course so close to the edges of the Ways that you've gotten used to it now. You raise a hand with your palm forward, and you do the same; now that you're able to see you for what you really are thanks to Nina's Juice, there's no fear, only a strange sense of serenity and acceptance. As you meet yourself, your bodies flow into each other, and acceptance turns into a sense of completion and being stronger for being whole. Trippy. Maybe it's all in your head; it probably is. But that doesn't make it any less real, especially on the frayed edges of reality. When the fugue in your head dissipates, there's just one of you, as things should be and always have been; you just needed to see things from the correct perspective, one that's admittedly quite hard to come to terms with. "Hey man, are you okay? Dude, you just stopped for a second there out of the blue; I almost bumped right into your butt." [pc.isDK |Maybe she should have |Sorry about that ]. You were just coming to terms with yourself. "Oh. One of those. Yeah, you just have to treat them right, man." Nina mimics taking a swig from an ale jug. "Get down on your own level, don't make any sudden moves, and most importantly, don't do anything you wouldn't. Looks like you turned out just fine." Her Juice really helped you see things the right way. "That's what it's supposed to do, man. Think not just outside the box, but inside, around, and as it, too. You ready to go? I get the feeling that we're getting close — this didn't just happen to you for no reason. This kind of inner demons stuff almost never happens spontaneously to someone who isn't a dreamwalker, so it damn well was an attack on you, man. Whatever's holding us here, it's resorting to more desperate measures." Could it have been the Juice? "No." All right, if she says so. The answer's just up ahead, anyway...
rows.translation: 多亏了妮娜，你的血管里流淌着果汁，让你兴奋得不行。要是没有她，事情也许就会是另一番结局——在你能看清自己的真实面目之时，随着恍然大悟，你脑海深处有什么咔哒一声接通了。 根本不存在两个你——只有一个你。真的就这么简单是：你眼前的那个你并不是镜像，不是分裂出的另一个人格，也不是从你脑海最深处打捞上来的梦魇。它就是你。 当然，这一切根本毫无道理，但既然离界间之路的边缘这么近，这种事早就是家常便饭，你也已经习惯了。你抬起一只手，掌心朝前，而你也做出了同样的动作；如今多亏了妮娜的果汁，你能看清自己的真实面目，于是不再有恐惧，只剩下一种奇异的平静与接纳。当你们彼此相触，两具身体流入彼此，接纳便化作了圆满，以及因完整而变得更强的感觉。 真够迷幻的。也许这一切都只存在于你的脑海里；多半确实如此。但这并不会让它变得不那么真实，尤其是在现实那些磨损的边缘上。 当脑海中的恍惚消散，你就只剩下一个了，本该如此，也一直如此；你只是需要从正确的角度来看待事情，而这个角度，坦白说，相当难以接受。 “嘿，兄弟，你没事吧？伙计，你刚才突然就那么停住了，我差点一头撞上你的屁股。” [pc.isDK |也许她本该那样 |抱歉，刚才走神了 ]。你只是在慢慢接受自己。 “哦，原来是这样。没错，你只要好好待他们就行，伙计。”妮娜模仿着从酒壶里灌了一口的样子。“把自己放到他们的位置上，别做任何突然的举动，最重要的是，别做你自己不会做的事。看来你最后变得挺好的。” 她的果汁确实帮你从正确的角度看清了事情。 “它本来就是干这个的，伙计。不仅要跳出框框思考，还要从框内、四周，乃至于作为它本身去思考。你准备好出发了吗？我有种感觉，我们快接近了——这事不会无缘无故地发生在你身上。这种内心恶魔之类的东西，几乎从不会自发地出现在不是梦行者的人身上，所以那绝对就是冲你来的攻击，伙计。不管是什么把我们困在这里，它都开始使出更绝望的手段了。” 会不会是那果汁的缘故？ “不。” 好吧，既然她这么说。反正答案就在前面不远处……

You ready your [pc.weapon], and so do you.[silly | Finally, an opponent worthy of your skills. ] It's a fight!

rows.original: Time and space grow more unstable as the battle drags on...
rows.translation: 随着战斗的持续，时间和空间变得越来越不稳定……
rows.raw: "\n \n Time and space grow more unstable as the battle drags on..."

rows.original: Soon enough, the fight becomes a deadlock — evenly matched as you are, the only way you're getting any kind of advantage over yourself is from without. You're tiring, but so are you; each bone-jarring impact as two identical [pc.weapon]s meet sends you staggering, two exactly equal forces countering each other. Maybe it's luck, maybe it's you doing something that you would never do, maybe you simply know yourself too well and managed to blindside you by fooling yourself. You're certainly in two minds over the sense all of this makes as your [pc.weapon] slips past your own guard and smashes right through yourself. There's no blood, no ugliness. Just splinters of star-stuff exploding outwards into space as your [pc.weapon] emerges out the other end of your dream-self like a rock through fine Tychrisian glasswork. Motion slows to a crawl, and then the exploded star-stuff reverses course and flows into you. One body flows into another, and acceptance turns into a sense of completion and being stronger for being whole. Trippy. Maybe it's all in your head; it probably is. But that doesn't make it any less real, especially on the frayed edges of reality. When the fugue in your head dissipates, there's just one of you, as things should be and always have been. "Hey man, are you okay? Dude, you just stopped for a second there out of the blue; I almost bumped right into your butt." [pc.isDK |Maybe she should have |Sorry about that ]. You were just coming to terms with yourself. "Oh. One of those. Yeah, you just have to treat them right, man." Nina mimics taking a swig from an ale jug. "Get down on your own level, don't make any sudden moves, and most importantly, don't do anything you wouldn't. Looks like you turned out just fine." It was quite the internal struggle, but as exhausted as it left you victory was had, you think. At least, you think that's what happened... it's kind of hard to be sure. You're you, of course, but you feel more you than before, if that makes any kind of sense. "That's what happens when everything's dreams and stars, man. Think not just outside the box, but inside, around, and as it, too. You ready to go? I get the feeling that we're getting close — this didn't just happen to you for no reason. This kind of inner demons stuff almost never happens spontaneously to someone who isn't a dreamwalker, so it damn well was an attack on you, man. Whatever's holding us here, it's resorting to more desperate measures." Yeah. You reckon it's just up ahead...

Motion slows to a crawl, and then the exploded star-stuff reverses course and flows into you. One body flows into another, and acceptance turns into a sense of completion and being stronger for being whole. Trippy. Maybe it's all in your head; it probably is. But that doesn't make it any less real, especially on the frayed edges of reality. When the fugue in your head dissipates, there's just one of you, as things should be and always have been. "Hey man, are you okay? Dude, you just stopped for a second there out of the blue; I almost bumped right into your butt." [pc.isDK |Maybe she should have |Sorry about that ]. You were just coming to terms with yourself. "Oh. One of those. Yeah, you just have to treat them right, man." Nina mimics taking a swig from an ale jug. "Get down on your own level, don't make any sudden moves, and most importantly, don't do anything you wouldn't. Looks like you turned out just fine." It was quite the internal struggle, but as exhausted as it left you victory was had, you think. At least, you think that's what happened... it's kind of hard to be sure. You're you, of course, but you feel more you than before, if that makes any kind of sense. "That's what happens when everything's dreams and stars, man. Think not just outside the box, but inside, around, and as it, too. You ready to go? I get the feeling that we're getting close — this didn't just happen to you for no reason. This kind of inner demons stuff almost never happens spontaneously to someone who isn't a dreamwalker, so it damn well was an attack on you, man. Whatever's holding us here, it's resorting to more desperate measures." Yeah. You reckon it's just up ahead..."

rows.original: Soon enough, the fight becomes a deadlock — evenly matched as you are, the only way you're getting any kind of advantage over yourself is from without. You're tiring, but so are you; each bone-jarring impact as two identical [pc.weapon]s meet sends you staggering, two exactly equal forces countering each other. Then at the last moment, you twist down and strike at your own exposed [pc.belly] — the only problem is, you also had the same idea. The look of surprise on your face should have been completely predictable, and yet here you are. Perhaps it really is possible to fool yourself, but not like this, not now. A gasp of pain rushes from both your mouths as your weapons sink all the way through, smashing through your dream-bodies like a rock through fine Tychrisian glass. It doesn't hurt, for you need a mind to perceive pain. Your body might keep going for a while longer inasmuch as that has any meaning in a place where time doesn't flow, but your sense of self shatters into dozens of fragments, blowing away into the void between the stars. Your [silly |heart may go on, but your ]adventure ends here.
rows.translation: 战斗很快陷入僵局——你们势均力敌，想要从自己身上取得任何优势，都只能依靠外力。你在疲惫，而另一个你同样如此；两把完全相同的[pc.weapon]每次相撞，震彻骨髓的冲击都会令你们踉跄后退，两股分毫不差的力量彼此抵消。 最后一刻，你猛然扭身向下，击向自己暴露的[pc.belly]——唯一的问题是，另一个你也想到了同样的办法。你脸上的惊讶本该完全在预料之中，事情却还是发生了。也许人的确能欺骗自己，但不是以这种方式，也不是在这一刻。武器双双贯穿身体，像石头砸碎精致的提克里斯玻璃般击穿你们的梦境之躯；痛苦的喘息同时冲出两张嘴。 这并不疼，因为感知疼痛需要心智。你的身体也许还能继续活动片刻——如果在时间不流动的地方，这种说法还有意义——可你的自我意识已经碎成数十片，飘散进群星之间的虚空。 你的[silly |心也许仍会延续，但你的 ]冒险到此结束。

Your [silly |heart may go on, but your ]adventure ends here."

rows.original: It defies all sense. You left the Wayfort and headed over the bridge, so by all rights you should've ended up in the gardens where you met the Alraune. Yet up ahead is the courtyard — it's as if the bridge had twisted in upon itself in a loop or flipped around. At least the courtyard is recognizable for what it is, save for the enormous chunk of glossy black rock embedded in its center, complete with a crater of its very own. You turn to Nina, raising an eyebrow and pointing at it questioningly. After a second's consideration, she nods. "That's it, man. That's the thing which is keeping us here. Can you feel it in the air? The weight of the thing? It's kinda like yours, only heavy in a different sense. Like... like how an iron beam is heavy, compared to a full keg." You frown and focus on your surroundings — [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |with the second sight from Nina's psi-alcoholic cocktail, you're indeed able to perceive with not just your gut, but with your eyes as well what's going on. Streams of multihued flames emanate outward from the chunk of dark matter in the courtyard — while they eventually disappear from sight, the bent of their arc suggests that they form a cage of sorts about this little pocket on the edge of the Ways. "Huh, you can see it too? Didn't expect the Juice to be that strong, but that'll help us." |if you concentrate really, really hard, you can feel the power in your gut and against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], crackling and seething. "It's strong enough that even someone who isn't sensitive can feel it," Nina says with a shake of her head. "No wonder it could keep me in — going up head-to-head with that kind of strength, I wouldn't stand a chance, man." ] [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |Yes, that's it, Thalia says from her urn at your side. Like I said... that day the wraiths tore a portal open in the air, and a meteorite came crashing down from whatever horrible place was on the other side. It smashed into the Wayfort's courtyard... and here it is. And here you are. Be careful. It's undoubtedly what struck us that day, and yet it's not the same thing as it was. I would be surprised if it has not changed somewhat in the intervening period. ] The chunk of rock — a shadowy monolith, a shadowlith even — may seem inanimate at this distance, but you have little doubt that so much power concentrated in one place is more than capable of defending itself. After all, everything you've faced so far no doubt has been a result of its actions. The only question remaining, then, is what you're going to do next.
rows.translation: 这一切完全有悖常理。你离开驿堡、走过桥梁，按理说应当来到初遇阿尔劳妮的花园。可前方却是庭院——仿佛桥梁扭转成环，又像是彻底翻转了方向。至少你还能认出这里是庭院，只不过中央嵌着一大块光滑的黑色岩石，甚至还带着专属的撞击坑。 你转向妮娜，挑起眉毛，疑惑地指了指那块岩石。她思考片刻后点点头。 “就是它，伙计。正是这东西把我们困在这里。你能感觉到空气里的存在吗？感觉到它的重量吗？有点像你，只是沉重的方式不同。就像……铁梁的沉重，与装满的酒桶并不一样。” 你皱起眉，专注感受四周——[pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |借助妮娜那杯灵能酒精鸡尾酒赋予的第二视觉，你不仅能用直觉，还能亲眼看见这里发生的一切。道道多彩火焰从庭院里的暗物质块向外散发——尽管它们最终消失在视野中，但弧线弯曲的方向表明，它们在界间之路边缘的这片小空间四周形成了某种牢笼。 “咦，你也看得见？没想到那杯特饮效果这么强，不过这会帮上我们的忙。” |只要非常、非常努力地集中精神，你便能从腹中和[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]表面感受到那股力量噼啪翻腾。 “它强大到即使不敏感的人也能察觉，”妮娜摇头说道。“难怪它能困住我——正面对抗这种力量，我根本没有胜算，伙计。” ] [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |是的，就是它，塔莉娅在你身旁的骨灰瓮中说道。正如我所说……那天，幽魂在空中撕开一道传送门，一颗陨石从另一侧那个可怕的地方坠落下来。它撞进驿堡的庭院……如今就在那里。 而你也已经来到这里。 小心。它无疑就是那天袭击我们的东西，可它已不再是当初的模样。时隔这么久，如果它没有发生某些变化，反倒会让我惊讶。 ] 那块岩石——阴暗的巨石，甚至可谓一块影石——从这个距离看似乎毫无生命；但如此强大的力量集中在一处，你毫不怀疑它完全有能力保护自己。毕竟，你目前面对的一切无疑都是它造成的。于是，唯一剩下的问题，就是你接下来打算怎么做。

rows.original: Of course, one option is obvious: you're not just one of the Order Astrida, but champion of Nareva herself. The power the shadowlith exudes isn't arcane in nature, but it feels close enough that the natural weapons imbued in you as an Astrida would be effective in dealing with it[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains | — if Thalia's recounting of her previous struggle against this chunk of otherworldly ordnance is right, then they're the only means of harming it. Should you wish to attempt this, be assured that I will help you in every way possible, Thalia informs you with a soft mental sigh. To get a second chance, even by proxy, and make up for one's failures is not something that comes by easily. I will add my power to yours; together, we will be able to defeat it all the quicker ]. It is your duty to take care of magical threats. At the same time, [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |it proved to be too strong a foe for Thalia |you're well aware of the danger of committing yourself against an unknown foe in every sense of the word ] — there's always the option of sticking to the original plan and disrupting the shadowlith for long enough so that Nina can engineer an escape for the both of you. You don't suppose there's a chance you could adjust your strategy on the fly depending on how things shake out? "No can do, man. I'm fine with whatever you choose, but I've got to put my mind to it." Nina looks thoughtful a moment, then snaps her fingers. "Like, I'm okay with trying to help you fight this thing even if I can't hurt it directly, but you can't just ask me to drop it in the heat of things and get us out of here. It's like, a task that you've got to be excellent to, man — one thing or the other." So it boils down to a commitment that you've got to make: uphold your honor as an Astrida and destroy the shadowlith, or occupy it long enough so you can escape. Which course of action will you pursue?
rows.translation: 当然，其中一个选择显而易见：你不仅是阿斯特里达教团的一员，还是娜瑞瓦本人的冠军。影石散发的力量并非奥术性质，却足够相似；因此，你作为阿斯特里达所获得的天生武器，应该能有效对付它[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |——如果塔莉娅讲述的往日经历属实，那便是伤害这块异界兵器的唯一手段。 如果你想尝试，请相信我会尽一切可能帮助你，塔莉娅在你脑海中轻轻叹息着告诉你。得到第二次机会——哪怕借助他人之手——去弥补自己的失败，并非轻易能够遇见的事。我会把力量加诸于你；我们联手，便能更快地击败它。 ]。 处理魔法威胁的确是你的职责。但与此同时，[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |事实已经证明，它对塔莉娅而言是过于强大的敌人 |你非常清楚，与一个从各种意义上都完全未知的敌人殊死相搏有多么危险 ]——你始终还可以坚持原计划，长时间干扰影石，让妮娜设法带你们二人逃离。 难道不能先随机应变，再根据事态发展调整策略吗？ “做不到，伙计。你选什么都行，但我必须专心去做。”妮娜沉思片刻，然后打了个响指。“比如，即使我不能直接伤到它，我也愿意尝试帮你作战；但你不能在激战中突然叫我放弃战斗，转而带我们离开这里。伙计，这就像一项必须全神贯注、做到完美的工作——只能二选一。” 所以说，你必须作出承诺：要么坚守身为阿斯特里达的荣誉，摧毁影石；要么把它拖住足够长的时间，让你们得以逃脱。 你要选择哪种行动？

rows.original: You can't in good conscience leave the shadowlith intact. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |After what it did to Thalia, after seeing everything it's capable of, there's no way you can just allow this otherworldly power to fester in its little pocket of the Ways. Should it happen to break out, you'd be responsible for sitting around and doing nothing. Besides, you're Nareva's personal champion. You've got to set a good example for the rest of the Order Astrida, especially since you were inducted and not born to the order. An admirable sentiment. No doubt you will succeed where I have failed; the advantage is with us now. |This is not a thing that belongs even here in the Ways — with how it's able to warp space and time to pluck Nina and you mid-travel, it's clearly a danger that needs to be dealt with, and not just for the occasional traveling dreamwalker. Should it happen to break out, you'd be responsible for sitting around and doing nothing. Besides, you're Nareva's personal champion. You've got to set a good example for the rest of the Order Astrida, especially since you were inducted and not born to the order. "It's all up to you and your funky powers, man. I've got your back, but you'll be in the front. I wouldn't be able to do that." ] A final reminder: only powers granted by the Astrida soulbind are capable of damaging the shadowlith.
rows.translation: 凭良心说，你不能放任那块影石完好无损。 [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |在它对塔莉娅做过那些事之后，在见识过它的全部能耐之后，你绝不能让这种异界的力量在界间之路那一小片角落里继续滋生。万一它真的脱困而出，坐视不管的你就要为此负责。 再说，你可是娜瑞瓦的私人勇士。你必须为阿斯特里达教团的其他人树立一个好榜样，尤其是你并非生来就是教团成员，而是被引荐加入的。 令人钦佩的想法。毫无疑问，你将在我失败的地方取得成功；如今优势在我们这边。 |这东西甚至不该存在于界间之路——既然它能在旅途中扭曲时空，把妮娜和你硬生生抓走，那它显然是一种必须处理的危险，而不只是偶尔威胁一下路过的梦行者。万一它真的脱困而出，坐视不管的你就要为此负责。 再说，你可是娜瑞瓦的私人勇士。你必须为阿斯特里达教团的其他人树立一个好榜样，尤其是你并非生来就是教团成员，而是被引荐加入的。 “一切就全靠你和你的那些古怪本事了，伙计。我会替你掩护，但要打头阵的是你。那种事我可做不到。” ] 最后提醒一次：只有阿斯特里达灵魂绑定所赐予的力量才能损伤影石。

rows.original: Attempt to destroy the shadowlith. Only an Astrida can do it, after all.
rows.translation: 尝试摧毁那块影石。毕竟，只有阿斯特里达才能做到这一点。
rows.raw: "Attempt to destroy the shadowlith. Only an Astrida can do it, after all."

rows.original: You can't in good conscience leave the shadowlith intact. However, there're more people than just you at stake here, and you don't have leave to be as reckless with Nina[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains| and Thalia] as you would if it were just you. In such a situation, faced with an unknown foe, it's best to not overextend oneself and simply retreat. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |There is no shame in admitting that you need help, Thalia offers from her urn. Retreating to Tychris and returning properly equipped... that may be the best solution. The time between there and now may be but the blink of an eye here, or it may be an eternity. But throwing your life away after mine is not what I want for the next generation. |"Stick to the original plan, then?" Nina looks almost relieved. Many things this silly bird may be, but she's not brave. "I'm good with that." ] All right, then. About how long will you need to keep the shadowlith occupied for? "Eh. Dunno, man. Won't be short, at least not in relative terms when folks are fighting." Nina thinks a moment. "Would depend on how much of a fight it puts up, but I'd say five rounds will do it." You take it that Nina won't be in the fray, then? "Don't worry, man. I'll have your back." Huh? Isn't she going to — "I'll be putting up a token fight, man. Would be really suspicious if you were fighting for your life and I was just standing back, right? Don't want to tip off that big old rock about what I'm really up to if I can help it. So yeah, I'll have your back, man." That... makes sense, you guess. All right, you're ready.
rows.translation: 从良心上讲，你不能就这么放着那块影石不管。但这件事牵涉到的不仅仅是你一个人，而且你也不能像孤身一人时那样，带着妮娜[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains| 和塔莉娅]去冒险。在这种情况下，面对一个未知的敌人，最好的做法就是不要过度逞强，干脆撤退。 [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |承认自己需要帮助并不可耻，塔莉娅从她的骨灰瓮里说道。退回提克里斯，带上合适的装备再回来……这或许才是最好的办法。从这里到那里的时间，在这里可能只是眨眼之间，也可能漫长得如同永恒。但我不希望下一代人重蹈我的覆辙，白白送命。 |“那就按原计划来？”妮娜看起来几乎松了一口气。这只傻鸟也许有很多缺点，但她一点也不勇敢。“我没问题。” ] 好吧。那么，你需要把那块影石拖住多久？ “呃，不知道啊，兄弟。反正不会短，至少在人打起来的时候，按相对时间算肯定不短。”妮娜想了一会儿。“这得看它能撑多久，不过我说五个回合就够了。” 那么说，妮娜不会参与这场混战了？ “别担心，兄弟。我会罩着你的。” 哈？她不是要—— “我会装模作样地打一场，兄弟。要是你在拼死拼活，我却站在一边不动手，那也太可疑了，对吧？只要能做到，我可不想让那块老石头看出我真正的打算。所以，没错，我会罩着你的，兄弟。” 嗯……你觉得这倒也说得通。好吧，你准备好了。
rows.raw: " You can't in good conscience leave the shadowlith intact. However, there're more people than just you at stake here, and you don't have leave to be as reckless with Nina[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains| and Thalia] as you would if it were just you. In such a situation, faced with an unknown foe, it's best to not overextend oneself and simply retreat. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |There is no shame in admitting that you need help, Thalia offers from her urn. Retreating to Tychris and returning properly equipped... that may be the best solution. The time between there and now may be but the blink of an eye here, or it may be an eternity. But throwing your life away after mine is not what I want for the next generation. |"Stick to the original plan, then?" Nina looks almost relieved. Many things this silly bird may be, but she's not brave. "I'm good with that." ] All right, then. About how long will you need to keep the shadowlith occupied for? "Eh. Dunno, man. Won't be short, at least not in relative terms when folks are fighting." Nina thinks a moment. "Would depend on how much of a fight it puts up, but I'd say five rounds will do it." You take it that Nina won't be in the fray, then? "Don't worry, man. I'll have your back." Huh? Isn't she going to — "I'll be putting up a token fight, man. Would be really suspicious if you were fighting for your life and I was just standing back, right? Don't want to tip off that big old rock about what I'm really up to if I can help it. So yeah, I'll have your back, man." That... makes sense, you guess. All right, you're ready."

rows.original: This is beyond you; simply seek an escape.
rows.translation: 这超出了你的能力范围；干脆选择逃避吧。
rows.raw: "This is beyond you; simply seek an escape."

rows.original: You're planning to escape? You give Thalia's urn a reassuring pat. That would indeed be the case — it's not like you have any means of harming the shadowlith. There is another option, should you be so inclined. Help me finish the job that I started. You may not have the means to harm the shadowlith, but even as I am now, that is within my power. Keep it occupied and fend it off while I reap it of its energy — once it realizes what I'm doing, it will no doubt do everything in its power to destroy you and me alike. That sounds just like Nina's original plan of holding it off while she breaks open a portal from within its cage. How's that any different? In one scenario, it merely loses out on prey. In the other, it's an existential struggle. Call it a hunch, but I think it would be more inclined to be aggressive in the latter case. Okay, but would you need to stall it for longer compared to Nina's plan? I don't know. I only half-know the shadowlith from the short time between it falling from the sky and decimating the Wayfort garrison, and I know not your little bird at all. Sorry, but I don't have an answer to that. It's a risk that you would have to take. You see. If you go along with Thalia's suggestion, you'll be able to get rid of this menace for once and for all; though you're not an Astrida, she is and hence capable of destroying the shadowlith. On the other hand, you have next to no information about how much longer you'll need to hold out or the resistance you'll face — it could be about the same as Nina's original plan of escape, or drastically more. The decision is ultimately in your hands. Which course of action will you choose?
rows.translation: 你打算逃跑吗？ 你轻轻拍了拍塔莉娅的骨灰瓮，心中感到一丝安慰。事实也确实如此——你根本没有任何办法伤害那块暗影石。 如果你愿意的话，还有另一个选择。帮我完成我已经开始的工作吧。你可能没有能力伤害那块影石，但以我现在的实力，这也是可行的。在我吸取它的能量之前，你只需要让它保持忙碌状态，阻止它发动攻击。一旦它察觉到我在做什么，它肯定会不遗余力地摧毁你和我。 这听起来和尼娜最初的计划一模一样——她打算在打开笼子里的传送门的同时拖延时间。这有什么不同呢？ 在一种情况下，它只是无法捕获猎物；而在另一种情况下，这就变成了一场生存斗争。虽然这只是我的直觉，但我认为在后一种情况下，它更有可能采取攻击性行为。 好的，但与尼娜的计划相比，这样做是否需要更长的时间来拖延进展呢？ 我不知道。在那种阴影石从天而降并摧毁荒废驿堡驻军的那段短暂时间里，我也只了解了一点点关于它的信息，而对于你说的那只小鸟，我更是一无所知。抱歉，我无法回答你的问题。这个风险，你得自己去承担。 你看，如果你同意塔莉娅的建议，你就能够一劳永逸地消除这个威胁；虽然你不是阿斯特里达，但她却是，因此她有能力摧毁那块暗影石。另一方面，你几乎没有任何关于自己还能坚持多久、又会遇到哪些阻力的信息——这可能和尼娜原本制定的逃跑计划所需的时间差不多，也可能要长得多。 最终，这个决定还是掌握在你手中。你会选择哪条路呢？

rows.original: All right, then. Now that the situation's changed and you actually have a means of harming the shadowlith, there's going to be a change of plans. You're going to defend Thalia while she does her thing and remove this threat from the Ways. Nina doesn't look too enthused at this prospect — many things she may be, but brave certainly isn't one of them. Sure, she's insane, but not in that particular fashion. "Really, dude? I don't know about this, I've got a bad feeling about it, man. I'd rather not reach for the sun and get burnt, if you follow my meaning. Getting out of here's going to be hard enough, at least if you want to stay in one piece, man." Yeah, well, you wouldn't be able to live it down if you knew there was something like the shadowlith lurking in the Ways, just waiting to snatch up dreamwalkers and anyone using the waystones. You don't want to have to look over your shoulder every time you get around, and if she gets plucked out again without you around to help her out... Nina folds her arms and thins her lips. Of course, she's not a brave creature and miserably sober to boot, so it takes her all of four seconds to crumble. "Fine, fine. We'll do it your way..." Glad to see that she's come around. Now, to be sure, all you need to do is to stall the shadowlith until Thalia does her thing and kills it? Inasmuch a term like %"killing" applies to a meteorite, yes. I expect it to be far easier said than done. All right, then. Simple enough: Nina and you need to hold out for as long as it takes for Thalia to destroy the shadowlith. Doesn't matter by what means, so long as it's done.
rows.translation: 好吧。既然情况变了，而你现在确实有了伤害影石的手段，那计划就得改一改。你要保护塔莉娅，让她完成她的事，把这个威胁从界间之路中清除掉。 妮娜对这前景显得兴致不高——她或许有很多特点，但勇敢肯定不在其中。没错，她是疯疯癫癫的，但不是那种疯法。“说真的，老兄？这事我可说不准，我有个不好的预感，伙计。如果你明白我的意思，我宁愿不去伸手够太阳，结果被烧着。想从这里出去已经够难了，至少如果你想完整地离开的话，伙计。” 是啊，可要是你知道界间之路里潜伏着影石这种东西，正等着抓走梦行者和任何使用路石的人，你恐怕也没法安心过日子。你不想每次出门都得回头提防，而且要是她再被人掳走，而你却不在旁边帮她…… 妮娜双臂交叉，抿紧嘴唇。当然，她不是个勇敢的生物，而且此刻还清醒得难受，所以她只用了四秒钟就垮了。 “好吧，好吧。就按你说的来……” 很高兴看到她回心转意了。那么，确认一下：你只要拖住影石，直到塔莉娅完成她的事、把它杀掉就行？ 像%“杀戮”这样的说法用在陨石上，是可以的。不过我预计，这事说起来远比做起来容易。 好吧。简单来说：你和妮娜必须坚持住，直到塔莉娅摧毁影石为止。用什么方法都无所谓，只要办成就行。

rows.original: Actually removing a threat for good sounds much better.
rows.translation: 实际上，彻底消除威胁才是更好的解决办法。
rows.raw: "Actually removing a threat for good sounds much better."

rows.original: While actually having a means of harming the shadowlith is nice, you don't think you're going to take the risk of aggravating whatever intelligence dwells within that thing. Simply getting out of here in one piece will be enough — once safe and sound, you can head to Tychris, inform the Order Astrida of this threat lurking in the Ways, and they'll send a proper team to deal with the threat. By comparison, you're not liking the chances a lone adventurer, a miserably sober harpy and a shattered spirit in an urn stand. All right, you've made your point quite clear. Fleeing — I mean, a tactical retreat it is, then. It's the plan that Nina and you had been building up towards till now. While you're not one for clinging to sunk costs, it genuinely still remains the best idea for getting out of the shadowlith's clutches in one piece. Nina steps up and elbows you lightly. "Don't worry, man. I'll work as quickly as I can." All right. About how long will you need to keep the shadowlith occupied for? "Eh. Dunno, man. Won't be short, at least not in relative terms when folks are fighting." Nina thinks a moment. "Sorry I can't give you a number, but in boxer's terms just hold out for a handful of rounds." You take it that Nina won't be in the fray, then? "Don't worry, man. I'll have your back." Huh? Isn't she going to — "I'll be putting up a token fight, man. Would be really suspicious if you were fighting for your life and I was just standing back, right? Don't want to tip off that big old rock about what I'm really up to if I can help it. So yeah, I'll have your back, man." That... makes sense, you guess. All right, you're ready.
rows.translation: 虽然拥有能够伤害那影石的手段确实很不错，但你觉得自己不会去冒这个险——去激怒潜藏在其中那个不知名的智慧体。只要能完好无损地离开这里就已经足够了——一旦安全无事，你就可以前往提克里斯，把这个潜伏在通道中的威胁告知阿斯特里达教团，他们会派一支合适的队伍来处理这个威胁。相比之下，你可不看好一个孤身冒险者、一只清醒得难受的鹰身女妖，以及一个困在瓮中的破碎灵魂的胜算。 好吧，你已经把你的意思表达得非常清楚了。逃跑——我是说，那就来一次战术性撤退吧。 这就是妮娜和你一直以来筹备的计划。虽然你并不喜欢执着于已经投入的成本，但这个计划确实仍然是让你们俩完好无损地摆脱影石掌控的最佳方案。 妮娜走上前，轻轻用肘碰了碰你。“别担心，伙计。我会尽快完成的。” 好吧。你需要让那影石被牵制多长时间呢？ “呃，不太确定啊，伙计。不会短，至少在人们战斗的时候相对来说不会短。”尼娜思考了一会儿。“抱歉，我没法给你一个具体的数字，但用拳击手的说法来说，再坚持几轮就好。” 那么你的意思是妮娜不会参与这场战斗了？ “别担心，伙计。我会支持你的。” 哈？她不是要—— “我会象征性地打几下，伙计。如果你在拼命战斗，而我却站在一旁，那肯定会引起怀疑，对吧？我可不想让那大块头看出我真正在做什么。所以，没错，我会支持你的，伙计。” 嗯……这样想的话，确实挺合理的。好吧，你准备好了。

rows.original: This is beyond you; you're content to simply seek an escape.
rows.translation: 这超出了你的能力范围；你只想要找到一个逃避的方法罢了。
rows.raw: "This is beyond you; you're content to simply seek an escape."

rows.original: Good thing, then, that the question's already been answered for you: keep the shadowlith occupied long enough for Nina to tear its clutches from the both of you and escape. It's the plan you had going forward at the beginning, and while one might have hoped that other solutions might have presented themselves none came up during your trip through the shattered wayfort. Nina sighs and balls her fists, gazing out over the courtyard with her one good eye. She may be many things, but brave is not one of them, and the silly bird is miserably sober to boot. "Damn, I need a drink, and one that actually works. That thing hurts to look at, man." It's not pretty, yeah. "No, like, it actually hurts to look at. Like someone's jabbing a fuck-you finger right into my eye — man, that is totally not cool." [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |Yeah, you saw it. Even with that little bit of second sight which the Juice afforded you, it's a bitch to look at. And you're going to have to fight that thing, or at least withstand what it can throw at you... ] All right, then. About how long will you need to keep the shadowlith occupied for? "Eh. Dunno, man. Won't be short, at least not in relative terms when folks are fighting." Nina thinks a moment. "Would depend on how much of a fight it puts up, but in boxer's terms I'd say five rounds will do it." You take it that Nina won't be in the fray, then? "Don't worry, man. I'll have your back." Huh? Isn't she going to — "I'll be putting up a token fight, man. Would be really suspicious if you were fighting for your life and I was just standing back, right? Don't want to tip off that big old rock about what I'm really up to if I can help it. So yeah, I'll have your back, man." That... makes sense, you guess. All right, you're ready.
rows.translation: 幸好，这个问题已经有人为你解答过了：只要让那影石持续处于被占用的状态，足够长的时间，妮娜就能把它的控制从你们两人身上扯开，从而逃脱。这本来就是你们最初制定的计划。虽然人们或许希望会出现其他解决办法，但在你们穿越那破碎的驿堡的过程中，确实没有出现任何其他的方案。 妮娜叹了口气，握紧双拳，用她那只完好的眼睛望向庭院外。她或许有很多身份，但勇敢绝对不是其中之一，而且这只愚蠢的鸟现在也清醒得难受。“该死，我需要喝点什么，而且必须是真正能起作用的酒。看着那东西真的让人心里不好受，伙计。” 确实，它没什么好看的。 “不，我是说，看着它实际上很疼。真他妈难受。就好像有人伸出一根他妈的手指直戳我的眼睛——天啊，这简直太糟糕了。” [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |没错，你看到了。即使有果汁赋予你的那一点点预知能力，看着那东西也真他妈难受。而你将不得不与它战斗，或者至少承受它所能施加的一切…… ] 好吧，那么。你需要让那影石被牵制多长时间呢？ “呃，不太确定啊，伙计。不会短，至少在人们战斗的时候相对来说不会短。”尼娜思考了一会儿。“这得看它能撑多久，但用拳击手的说法来说，五轮就足够了。” 那么你的意思是妮娜不会参与这场战斗了？ “别担心，伙计。我会支持你的。” 哈？她不是要—— “我会象征性地打几下，伙计。如果你在拼命战斗，而我却站在一旁，那肯定会引起怀疑，对吧？我可不想让那大块头看出我真正在做什么。所以，没错，我会支持你的，伙计。” 嗯……这样想的话，确实挺合理的。好吧，你准备好了。

rows.original: There's no dragging it out any longer. Steeling yourself, you force your feet forward at a steady pace, [pc.weapon] in hand for all the good that it'll do. The oppressive sensation emanating from the towering chunk of black, glossy stone intensifies with each step forward, [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |undulating pulses of alien light rhythmically flaring up in your second sight and blinding you |turning into a harsh whispering on the edge of your hearing, the individual words just impossible to make out ]. Nina's suffering far more than you are, making little chirping noises as she clings to you, but you guide her forward and she holds herself together with your help. You've come within two dozen feet of the shadowlith when its power flares up for the final time in one tremendous burst, the multiple streams of otherworldly flame that formed the cage about this pocket space melding into one. Rapidly, it takes the shape of a serpent wrapped in cosmic energy, burning with the stars and flames alike of an infinite expanse of inky ocean between worlds. Coiled protectively about the shadowlith, the void serpent rears back, baring its fangs and preparing to strike. You've faced a bird. You've faced yourself. And now... [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |like Nina and yourself, no doubt this is meant to reflect Thalia. Those holes in her psyche and memory... well, now you know where they ended up |well, if a big snake is all that this chunk of rock has in the way of imagination, then you rate your chances just a bit more than you did going in ]. There's nothing left for it. For whatever reason that the shadowlith dragged you out of the Ways, it's not about to let you leave as you please. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 已经不能再拖延了。你鼓起勇气，强迫双脚以稳定的步伐向前；手里握着[pc.weapon]，哪怕不知道它究竟能有多少用处。高耸、光滑的黑色巨石散发出压迫感，每走一步，那感觉便更加强烈，[pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |异质光芒的波动脉冲有节奏地在第二视觉中迸发，刺得你睁不开眼 |化作听觉边缘刺耳的低语，根本无法辨清其中的字句 ]。妮娜承受的痛苦远胜于你；她紧紧依偎着你，发出细小的鸟鸣，但你领着她继续向前，而她也借助你的帮助勉强支撑下来。 你走到距离影石不足二十四英尺时，它的力量最后一次爆发，形成一道无比猛烈的冲击。原先构成这片口袋空间牢笼的数道异界火焰融为一体，迅速化作一条缠绕着宇宙能量的巨蛇；它燃烧着世界之间无垠墨色汪洋里的群星与火焰。虚空之蛇盘绕在影石四周，做出保护姿态；它昂起身躯，露出獠牙，准备发动攻击。 你面对过一只鸟。你面对过自己。而现在……[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |它与妮娜和你一样，无疑是为了映照塔莉娅。她心智与记忆里的那些空洞……嗯，现在你知道它们去了哪里 |好吧，如果这块岩石的想象力只能造出一条大蛇，那么你觉得自己的胜算比进来时稍微大了一点 ]。 已经没有别的办法。无论影石是出于什么原因把你从界间之路里拖出来，它都不会任你随心所欲地离开。 战斗开始！
rows.raw: " There's no dragging it out any longer. Steeling yourself, you force your feet forward at a steady pace, [pc.weapon] in hand for all the good that it'll do. The oppressive sensation emanating from the towering chunk of black, glossy stone intensifies with each step forward, [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |undulating pulses of alien light rhythmically flaring up in your second sight and blinding you |turning into a harsh whispering on the edge of your hearing, the individual words just impossible to make out ]. Nina's suffering far more than you are, making little chirping noises as she clings to you, but you guide her forward and she holds herself together with your help. You've come within two dozen feet of the shadowlith when its power flares up for the final time in one tremendous burst, the multiple streams of otherworldly flame that formed the cage about this pocket space melding into one. Rapidly, it takes the shape of a serpent wrapped in cosmic energy, burning with the stars and flames alike of an infinite expanse of inky ocean between worlds. Coiled protectively about the shadowlith, the void serpent rears back, baring its fangs and preparing to strike. You've faced a bird. You've faced yourself. And now... [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |like Nina and yourself, no doubt this is meant to reflect Thalia. Those holes in her psyche and memory... well, now you know where they ended up |well, if a big snake is all that this chunk of rock has in the way of imagination, then you rate your chances just a bit more than you did going in ]. There's nothing left for it. For whatever reason that the shadowlith dragged you out of the Ways, it's not about to let you leave as you please. It's a fight!"

rows.original: The shadowlith is not death; that is merely the absence of life. This is something that is on the other side of death, a life-not-life of its very own; the power it represents is essentially opposed to your existence, the two completely and utterly annihilating each other on contact. Which is exactly what it does to Nina and you. Every trace of your being is consumed by chaos and erased from existence in the blink of an eye; when the wave of void energy subsides; not even dust remains of the two of you to be blown away into the void between the spheres. Your existence and adventure end here.
rows.translation: 影石并非死亡；那只是生命的缺失。它位于死亡的彼岸，是一种独属于它自己的非生之生；它所代表的力量本质上与你的存在相互对立，两者一旦接触，就会将彼此彻底湮灭。 它对妮娜和你做的正是这件事。你存在的每一丝痕迹都被混沌吞没，在眨眼之间从存在中被抹去；当那股虚空能量的浪潮退去时，你们两人甚至连能被吹进诸界之间虚空的尘埃都不剩。 你的存在与冒险在此终结。

rows.original: Throughout all this, the only thing capable of actually harming the otherwise impervious shadowlith is through the Astrida powers that Nareva granted you. The thing that resides where your soul used to be resonates within your sense of self, and you know what you have to do. Draining someone of all magical power and turning him or her into a dreamless isn't something that's done lightly, but is this really magical power? And... is this someone to begin with? At least, in the way the people understand it? [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |"Do it!" Thalia's voice echoes from her urn. "I'll help you — there isn't any other way to destroy it!" ] Well, it's your only chance. What the shadowlith possesses isn't arcane power, but it's close enough; with it sufficiently weakened from your battle, it isn't able to resist you as you step up to the chunk of dark matter and place your palms upon its glossy surface. It's unnaturally smooth and chilly for a rock, like a gelatin dessert, and your [pc.skinFurScales] crawl[s|s] as you start drawing that immense, otherworldly power into yourself[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains|. You feel Thalia doing her share as well, adding her divine might to yours]. That the power is inimical to you doesn't matter — you don't need to make use of it, just to remove it from this alien chunk of rock. The serpent attached to it, that cosmic creature wrought of vicious memories — it lashes out at you in desperation, feeling the source of its power flow away. Yet there's no fight left in it, either; the psychic creature loses consistency mid-strike and crashes down onto the old flagstones, exploding into a mess of glimmering stardust that blows away into the empty void. The world narrows down to a point as you dedicate your existence to consuming this otherworldly form of energy, this stuff from beyond the Ways; Nina is presumably out there somewhere, [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |and you're only aware of Thalia's presence because she's struggling to do what you are, pulling the shadowlith's power in the other direction so that it's less able to resist you |hopefully she can take care of herself while you're busy ]. This feels wrong on every level — godsworn as it is, your body rebels with each influx of alien, cosmic power. Your muscles shake uncontrollably, your stomach turns, you feel short of breath as your heart pounds. By all rights you should have been completely and utterly annihilated by this attempt to contain that which is essentially opposed to your existence, but the essence that Nareva infused your body with to remake it into her image protects you from that fate. It's not death, that would merely be the absence of life. This is something that is on the other side of death, a life-not-life of its very own. Take it! Take it all in!
rows.translation: 在这一切之中，唯一真正能伤害原本坚不可摧的影石的，便是娜瑞瓦赐予你的阿斯特里达之力。寄居在你灵魂原本所在之处的东西，与自我认知产生共鸣；你知道自己必须做什么。吸干一个人的全部魔力，把对方变成无梦者，绝不是可以轻率对待的事；但这真的算是魔力吗？而且……这东西起初又算是一个“人”吗？至少在人们通常理解的意义上呢？ [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |“动手！”塔莉娅的声音从骨灰瓮中响起。“我会帮你——没有别的办法能摧毁它！” ] 好吧，这是唯一的机会。影石拥有的并非奥术力量，却足够相似；经过战斗，它已经十分虚弱。你走到暗物质巨块前，把双掌按在光滑表面，它根本无力抗拒。这块岩石异常光滑冰冷，触感宛如果冻甜点；当你开始把那股庞大的异界力量吸入体内时，你的[pc.skinFurScales]上泛起[s|]鸡皮疙瘩[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains|。你也感觉到塔莉娅正在贡献力量，把她的神力加入你的力量]。这种力量与你相克并不重要——你无须运用它，只需将它从这块异质岩石中抽走。 依附其上的巨蛇，那头由恶毒记忆塑造的宇宙生物——感觉到力量源泉正在流失，它绝望地朝你猛扑。然而，它也已经无力战斗；灵能生物在攻击途中失去形体，坠落到古老石板上，炸成一片闪耀星尘，被吹散进空无的虚空。 当你把全部存在都投入到吞噬这种异界能量、这种来自界间之路之外的物质时，整个世界缩成一点；妮娜大概在外面的某个地方，[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |而你之所以能察觉塔莉娅，只因她正努力做着与你相同的事，从另一方向牵引影石之力，使其更难抵抗你 |希望你忙碌期间，她能照顾好自己 ]。 这种感觉从每个层面来说都不对劲——即便身体已经向神明宣誓，每一股异质宇宙力量涌入时，它仍在奋力反抗。你的肌肉不受控制地颤抖，胃部翻腾，心脏狂跳，令你呼吸困难。你试图容纳的东西与自身存在从根本上相斥，按理说，这种尝试早该把你彻彻底底地抹除；然而，娜瑞瓦为把身体重塑成她的形象而注入的精华，保护你免遭这种命运。 这并非死亡；死亡只不过是生命的缺失。这是存在于死亡另一侧的某种东西，是一种独属于它自己的非生命之生命。 吞下它！把它全部吞下！
