rows.original: [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |And then something happens: Nina's Juice meets with the torrent of otherworldly power gushing into your being, and in that moment you perceive the nature of the shadowlith, because that's what Juice does. It swallows your thoughts without pause, its infinitely hungry darkness insatiable. Soon, you feel your consciousness touching the surface of the void represented by the monolith of blackrock. Every now and then, with your mind's eye, you see a spark inside the void that lights it up, and that brilliance projects many sounds, colors, shapes, thoughts, and more. Curved rays of light, many-dimensional pockets of space, liquid color that springs from ethereal fountains, purple fires that burn in reverse. None of these you can experience fully and some are too strange and unintuitive to even behold — those remain veiled inside the void, or perhaps your mind refuses to perceive them even with aid. But there are also terrible things in the void — long sinewy worms with needles at their tips, amorphous blobs of corrosive gelatinous matter, curtains of razor wire cutting through thick fleshy smoke and other things too gruesome to describe. These things have life of their own, but it's not life as you know it; in a way, you are as alien and terrifying to them as they are to you. Their dreams are nightmares, pushing in from the other side, and the Ways form where the two meet. Once you get used to it, maintaining your focus becomes easier; the connection is still tenuous, but you feel more comfortable looking around. As your mind's eye gains clarity, you perceive something else in this void, something greater than the entities you've beheld so far. Maybe the wonders and horrors you behold are made out of it or by it, you're not sure, but its form is eerily familiar to you and while it can't be said to be hateful, its hunger is palpable. And then you realize that it's noticed you. It welcomes you, not wholeheartedly, but with the kind of bashful caution one would use with distant relations that one has never met before. A stranger, but a stranger whom which one nevertheless has kinship with. There's nothing left but to flee; this is more than what you bargained for. Slowly but surely, your mind starts grinding again and your mundane senses are restored to you. You might have died for a moment, but you're fine now. |The not-magic doesn't just taste horrible, it is horrible in every sense of the word. The clammy, viscous texture, the alien sensations that ripple through your body as you do your best to drain the shadowlith dry — every single fiber of your body rebels against this madness as you force yourself forward. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |It's a small mercy that you have Thalia to help you, but that only helps with the volume of this horrid stuff you have to ingest. ] You can feel something writhing within your skull, trying to get into your mind, but you're already occupied by Nareva's decoy soul and it leaves this alien force nowhere to find purchase. The torrent of otherworldly power gushing into your being swallows your thoughts without pause, its infinitely hungry darkness insatiable; but your self is protected, cocooned by godly power against this empty void. Before the gods lent their help to the people of Savarra, there was no way to fight even the lowest of wraiths... and this isn't even one, just a bundle of raw energy now that the intelligence of the void serpent attached to it is gone. Brimming over, you try to fit more in, and to your surprise, actually manage the feat — the sensations within you simply get thicker, heavier, denser. This is what you get for putting something that doesn't belong into your mouth, but it's not as if you had a choice, right? ] Gods. Oh, gods.
rows.translation: [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |然后，某种事情发生了：尼娜的“果汁”与你体内涌出的那股超自然力量相遇了，在那一刻，你终于领悟到了“暗影石”的本质——因为这正是“果汁”的作用。它毫无停歇地吞噬你的思绪，那无尽的、永不满足的黑暗仿佛永远也填不饱它的胃口。 不久之后，你感觉到自己的意识正在触碰那由黑岩构成的虚无之表面。偶尔，通过心灵的视野，你会看到虚无之中有火花闪烁，那些光芒会迸发出各种声音、色彩、形状、思想等等。弯曲的光线、多维的空间结构、从虚无中喷涌而出的液态色彩、逆向燃烧的紫色火焰……这些现象中，没有一种你能完全体验到位；而有些则太过奇特、违背常理，甚至连观察都变得困难——它们依然隐藏在虚无之中，或者你的意识即便借助外力也拒绝去感知它们。 但在虚无之中，也存在着一些极其恐怖的东西——那些末端长着针刺的细长蠕虫，那些形态不定、由腐蚀性胶状物质构成的团块，还有那些如同剃刀丝般割裂浓密肉状烟雾的屏障，以及其他那些简直无法用语言形容的怪物。这些生物拥有自己的生命，但这种生命并非你所认知的那种；从某种意义上来说，你对它们来说，就和它们对你一样陌生而可怕。它们的梦境其实就是噩梦，从另一个维度侵袭而来，而那些“通道”，正是这两者相遇的地方。 一旦你习惯了这种状态，保持注意力就会变得容易一些；那种联系依然很微弱，但当你环顾四周时，会感到更加自在。随着你的想象力逐渐清晰起来，你在这个虚空中察觉到了其他东西——一些比你迄今为止所见到的任何事物都要重要的存在。也许你所看到的那些奇迹与恐怖，都是由这种东西构成的，又或许它们本身就是这种东西的表现形式，你并不确定……但它的形态却让你感到一种诡异的熟悉感。虽然不能说它令人厌恶，但它所散发出的那种“渴望”却是显而易见的。 然后你意识到，它注意到了你的存在。它对你表示了欢迎，虽然并非满心热情，而是带着那种对待从未谋面过的远亲时才会有的羞涩与谨慎。一个陌生人，但却与自己存在着某种亲缘关系。 现在只剩下逃跑了；这种情况完全超出了你的预料。慢慢地，你的思维又开始恢复清醒，那些平常的感觉也重新回来了。有那么一刻，你似乎已经死了，但现在你已经没事了。 |这种非魔法物质不仅味道极差，而且是从任何角度来看，这都是极其糟糕的体验。那种黏腻、滑腻的质地，以及当你竭力将那些阴影石中的液体吸干时，那种会蔓延至全身的陌生感觉……当你强迫自己继续前进时，你身体的每一根纤维都在反抗这种折磨。 [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |有你这样的朋友塔莉娅帮忙，也算是件好事吧，不过这也只能帮你减轻那些糟糕东西的摄入量而已。 ] 你可以。感受有什么东西在你的颅骨中蠕动，试图侵入你的思维，但你的注意力早已被娜瑞瓦的诱饵灵魂所占据，因此这种外来的力量无处可乘。那股来自异世界的力量汹涌而入，毫不留情地吞噬了你的所有思绪；它那无穷无尽的黑暗仿佛永远也填不饱自己它受到神圣力量的保护，被这种力量包裹起来，从而免受这片虚空的侵害。在众神帮助萨瓦拉的人们之前，人们根本无法对抗哪怕是最低级的怨灵……而现在，由于附着在它身上的虚空巨蛇的智慧已经消失，这股能量只不过是一团纯粹的能量罢了。 当你试图强行容纳更多东西时，你会感到快要溢出来了，但令你惊讶的是，你竟然真的做到了——那种感觉会变得更为强烈、更为沉重、更为密集。这就是把本不属于你的东西塞进嘴里后会产生的结果，不过你其实也没有其他选择，对吧？ ] 神啊。哦，神明啊。

Brimming over, you try to fit more in, and to your surprise, actually manage the feat — the sensations within you simply get thicker, heavier, denser. This is what you get for putting something that doesn't belong into your mouth, but it's not as if you had a choice, right? ] Gods. Oh, gods."

rows.original: "[pc.name]?" Nina's voice. "C'mon man, don't die on me! I need you!" Your response is to fall to your knees in the face of a tidal wave of nausea that grips your body. Head spinning, you retch up a thick, vile liquid upon the floor, a puddle of inky stuff spreading outward before seeping into the mortar. Barely has one heave of your insides finished before another begins, your Astrida body completely and utterly rejecting this indigestible if not outright poisonous stuff, trying to get rid of it with all haste. You're not sure how long you remain there, a constant stream of star-stuff pouring from you while Nina thumps you between the shoulderblades for what small relief that affords[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |; judging by Thalia's silence, she's likely doing the same, just more metaphorically ]. This dark matter feels just as repulsive coming out as it was going down, which makes matters worse, but there's that faint hope that this will all be over soon... And at long last, it is. No sooner have you stopped that Nina grabs you by under the shoulders, yanks open your jaw and washes out your mouth with brazenberry ale. It's piss-weak, but that's for the best as a terrible taste is replaced with a merely bland one. Slowly, the world starts to piece itself together again, and you manage to stand with Nina's help, if barely. "Careful, man. I can't believe you did it. You ate the entire thing — even if you threw it all up immediately after, you ate the entire thing." It's hilarious, how Nina says it like you merely won some kind of eating competition — well, in a sense you did. It was no small torment, but you managed it; where that unholy power went doesn't matter, so long as it's removed from the shadowlith. And speaking of the shadowlith... when you raise your eyes to gaze upon it, all that remains is a dull gray boulder, completely and utterly mundane. In fact, it's identical to the boulder in the courtyard that greeted you when you first entered your future home. Guess you know what that used to be, then. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |I'm really proud of you, Thalia says, her voice weak and shaky as it touches your mind. You did what I could not. [pc.isDK |Damn right you did. Nareva didn't pick you as her personal champion for nothing |Well, to be fair, you did have help ]. For one generation to improve upon the efforts of and surpass the last, is this not how civilizations are built? ] It's over, then. There's nothing preventing Nina from taking the lot of you out of here? Nina doesn't reply immediately, glancing about the courtyard, turning her eyes up to the void above. She clearly sees something that you [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |can barely only sense with Juice in your veins, but judging by what you saw in the shadowlith's vision you can guess |can't, but judging by her complete enrapturement instead of terror you should either be utterly terrified or not at all ]. There's a yearning in the silly bird's bones that goes beyond consciousness and self, yet would completely and utterly annihilate her were it to be realized... ...And then she comes back to join you and gives you a slow nod. "Yeah, man. Just say the word, and we're good to go. Make sure you didn't leave anything behind, I couldn't bring you back here even if I wanted to." You don't want to stay here a moment longer. Everything important's right here with you; if there's anything you left in this figment of the Wayfort's past, it couldn't have been a big deal to begin with. Nina nods and clasps her hands, then tears open reality with a quick swipe of her claws. You feel yourself being drawn towards the hole by a familiar, comforting sensation, and are more than happy to let yourself be carried by the flow...
rows.translation: "[pc.name]？尼娜的声音响起，“拜托了，别在我面前死去啊！我需要你！” 你感到一阵强烈的恶心感袭来，整个人几乎跪倒在地。头晕目眩之中，你将一股黏稠、恶心的液体吐到了地上，那滩黑乎乎的液体逐渐扩散开来，最终渗入了地面。你的内脏才刚刚完成一次蠕动，下一次蠕动就已经开始了。你的阿斯特里达身体完全无法消化这种难以消化甚至具有毒性的物质，它正在竭力尽快将其排出体外。 你不知道自己会在那里待多久，有源源不断的星尘从你体内涌出，而尼娜则不断地敲打你的肩胛骨，只为换取那一点点短暂的缓解[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |从塔莉娅的沉默来看，她很可能也在做同样的事情，只不过方式更为隐喻化罢了。 ]这种暗物质在向上运动时与向下运动时所产生的排斥力是一样的，这让情况变得更加糟糕……不过，还是存在着那么一丝微弱的希望，希望这一切能尽快结束…… 终于，那一天到来了。你刚停下来，尼娜就抓住你的肩膀，强行掰开你的嘴，然后用那种味道极差的果酒冲洗你的口腔。这种酒其实没什么味道，但这样反而好，因为那种难闻的味道总算被那种淡而无味的液体取代了。慢慢地，这个世界又开始重新恢复秩序了。在尼娜的帮助下，你终于站了起来，尽管过程相当艰难。 “小心点，伙计。真不敢相信你居然做到了——你把那些东西全都吃掉了，即使之后立刻全都吐了出来，但你还是把它们全吃进了肚子。真是太好笑了，尼娜说这话的时候，就好像你只是赢得了什么吃货比赛而已——嗯，从某种意义上来说，确实是这样。确实这确实是一次巨大的折磨，但你最终还是挺过来了；那股邪恶的力量去了哪里并不重要，只要它已经从阴影石中消失就行了。 说到阴影石……当你抬头注视它时，会发现它只不过是一块灰暗无奇的巨石，完全没有任何特别之处。事实上，它和你刚来到未来家园时，在院子里看到的那块巨石一模一样。那么，你应该知道它曾经是什么了吧。 [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |我真为你感到骄傲。塞莉亚的声音虚弱而颤抖，当她的声音传入你的脑海时，你仿佛能感受到那份脆弱与不安。你做到了我无法做到的事情。 [pc.isDK |你做得太对了。娜瑞瓦之所以选择你作为她的私人守护者，肯定是有原因的 |嗯，公平地说，你确实得到了帮助 ]。 一代人继承前人的努力并取得更大的成就，不正是文明发展的本质吗？ ] 那么，一切都结束了。没有什么能阻止尼娜把你们所有人都从这里带走了吧？ 尼娜并没有立即回答，她环顾了一下庭院，然后将目光投向头顶的天空。显然，她看到了某些你们没有注意到的东西。 [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |只有当果汁在你的血管中流淌时，你才能勉强感受到这些感觉；但根据你在阴影石的视野中看到的那些景象，你应该能够猜到一些东西。 |做不到，但看她那完全沉浸在其中的样子，而不是表现出恐惧，那么你要么应该已经吓得魂不附体，要么根本就不应该感到害怕。 ]那只傻鸟的骨子里流淌着一种超越意识与自我的渴望，而一旦这种渴望得以实现，它将会彻底摧毁她自己…… ……然后，它又会回到你身边，缓缓地向你点头。没错，伙计。你只要说一声，我们就出发。一定要确保没有遗漏任何东西，就算我想带你回来，也没办法做到啊。” 你根本不想再在这里多待一刻。所有重要的东西都就在你身边；如果你还遗漏了什么与荒废驿堡过去有关的线索，那本来也不可能是什么重要的事情。 尼娜点了点头，双手合十，然后用爪子快速一划，将现实撕开了。你感受到一种熟悉而舒适的力量在将你吸引向那个洞穴，你非常乐意让自己被这股力量所引导……

rows.original: Throughout this entire battle, it's clear that the shadowlith is impervious to anything you can throw at it — weapons, spells and more fail to so much as scratch the alien monolith's glossy surface. The serpentine entity attached to it less so, but it keeps on coming back each time you defeat it. All except for Thalia's Astrida powers. The void serpent has realized that long ago, and in the last several exchanges has tried to target the urn in your possessions, as opposed to you. Nearly there! Thalia's voice echoes in your mind. Keep its attention just a little longer! What the shadowlith possesses isn't arcane power, but it's close enough; with the opening you've created by fending off the void serpent coiled about it, Thalia's finally able to finish the job she started all those years ago. You can't see it, but your [pc.skinFurScales] tingle[s|s] as she drains the shadowlith of whatever it is that it has. It can't be a pleasant experience — her misery is palpable even to you — but that's what you're here for. The void serpent, that cosmic creature wrought of vicious memories — it lashes out at you in desperation, feeling the source of its power flow away. Yet there's no fight left in it; after several failed blows which you repel with ease, the psychic creature loses consistency mid-strike and crashes down onto the old flagstones, exploding into a mess of glimmering stardust that blows away into the empty void. You tighten your grip on your [pc.weapon], expecting it to regenerate, but after several moments it looks like that torn part of Thalia's psyche has finally dissipated into the ether. Nothing left, then, but to wait for Thalia to finish and hope that she succeeds. [pc.swornGod lumia keros |It's a little embarrassing to not be able to help more as another of the Seven's godsworn, but everyone has their own talents |[pc.isDK |It feels pretty awful that she gets to steal the spotlight, but on the other hand you don't want to be at the centre of all the sensations of revulsion that are emanating from within the urn |You've done your part by getting her to this point, now only hope remains ] ]. Pulling out the urn, you hold up Thalia's remains to the shadowlith while Nina settles in by your side — you're not sure that it'll actually do any good, but it feels appropriate. And in this place, it's what people believe that matters more, isn't it? The world narrows down to a point as otherworldly energy flows about you and into the urn, this stuff from beyond the Ways; it feels wrong on every level, this alien, cosmic power swirling so close to your body. Just brushing up against it has your muscles shaking and stomach turning; your breath catches in your lungs as your heart pounds. Were it to flow into you, there's little doubt that this thing that is essentially opposed to your existence would completely and utterly annihilate you. How Thalia manages it... well, she's an Astrida. It's not death, that would merely be the absence of life. This is something that is on the other side of death, a life-not-life of its very own.
rows.translation: 在整个战斗过程中，很明显，影石对你能使出的任何手段都无动于衷——无论是武器还是法术，都无法在这尊异质巨碑光滑的表面上留下哪怕一道划痕。附着在它身上的那条蛇形生物则没那么坚不可摧，但每次你将其击败后，它总会再次出现。 不过，塔莉娅的阿斯特里达力量除外。那条虚空巨蛇早就意识到了这一点，在最近的几次交锋中，它总是试图攻击你手中的那个瓮，而不是你本人。 快成功了！塔莉娅的声音在你脑海中回荡。再吸引它的注意力一会儿吧！ 影石所拥有的并非神秘力量，但已经足够接近这种力量了；由于你成功挡开了缠绕在它身上的虚空巨蛇，为塔莉娅创造了行动的机会，她终于能够完成多年前就开始的那项任务了。你看不见它，但当她把影石所拥有的一切抽走时，你的[pc.skinFurScales]会传来一阵刺痛[s|]。那肯定不是什么愉快的体验——她的痛苦连你都能清楚地感受到——但这正是你来到这里的原因。 那条虚空巨蛇，这个由怨恨与痛苦记忆凝聚而成的宇宙生物——它会在绝望中向你发起攻击，因为它感觉到自己的力量正在逐渐消失。然而，它已经没有力气再战了；在你轻松挡开了几次徒劳的攻击之后，那个心灵生物在攻击过程中失去了稳定性，最终重重摔在那些古老的石板上，爆炸成一团闪烁的星尘，飘散进空无一物的虚空之中。你握紧你的[pc.weapon]，以为它会重新凝聚，但过了好一会儿，看来塔莉娅心灵中那被撕裂的部分终究还是消散在以太之中了。 那么，现在就只剩下等待塔莉娅完成她的努力，并希望她能够成功吧。 [pc.swornGod lumia keros |作为七神的又一名神誓者，却帮不上更多的忙，这多少有点让人尴尬，不过每个人都有自己的长处 |[pc.isDK |她竟能抢走所有的风头，这确实让人感到非常恼火；但另一方面，你也不想成为那些从那个瓮里散发出来的厌恶情绪的焦点吧。 |你能把她带到这一步，已经尽了你的责任，现在只剩下希望了。 ] ]。你取出那个瓮，将塔莉娅的遗骸举向那块影石，而妮娜则坐在你身旁——你并不确定这样做是否真的会有什么效果，但觉得这样做是恰当的。在这个地方，人们所相信的东西才是最重要的，不是吗？ 世界仿佛缩小到了一个点，那些来自异世界的能量在你周围流动，最终汇入那个瓮中——这些来自界间之路彼端的东西；从任何角度来看，这种感觉都是如此不对劲。这种陌生的、宇宙般的能量就在你身体附近旋转，仅仅是轻轻触碰到它，就会让你的肌肉颤抖、胃部不适；你的呼吸会变得急促，心脏也会剧烈跳动。倘若它流入你，毫无疑问，这种本质上与你存在相悖的东西，会彻底将你消灭殆尽。而塔莉娅又是如何应对它的……嗯，她毕竟是一名阿斯特里达。 这并不是死亡，死亡只不过是生命的终结而已。而这种东西，则位于死亡的彼岸，是一种属于它自己的、介于生死之间的存在。

rows.original: [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |But there's more. Something about the shadowlith resonates in your Juiced-up sight, and you're compelled to focus your mind on the chunk of dark matter, pulling on the psy-alchoholic brew in your veins. The experience is unlike anything you've experienced — the rock swallows your thoughts without pause, its infinitely hungry darkness insatiable. Soon, you feel your consciousness touching the surface of the void represented by the monolith of blackrock. Every now and then, with your mind's eye, you see a spark inside the void that lights it up, and that brilliance projects many sounds, colors, shapes, thoughts, and more. Curved rays of light, many-dimensional pockets of space, liquid color that springs from ethereal fountains, purple fires that burn in reverse. None of these you can experience fully and some are too strange and unintuitive to even behold — those remain veiled inside the void, or perhaps your mind refuses to perceive them even with aid. But there are also terrible things in the void — long sinewy worms with needles at their tips, amorphous blobs of corrosive gelatinous matter, curtains of razor wire cutting through thick fleshy smoke and other things too gruesome to describe. These things have life of their own, but it's not life as you know it; in a way, you are as alien and terrifying to them as they are to you. Their dreams are nightmares, pushing in from the other side, and the Ways form where the two meet. You are unable to maintain your focus long and when it finally breaks, you feel drained and empty, unable to move; even your thoughts are slowing down and are dangerously close to stopping. Perhaps this has been too much for your psyche and now your sense of self will disintegrate into dust, to be swallowed up by the void. It's as if all your will, all your life force, has been taken from you, just by chancing this glimpse of what lies beyond. But somewhere deep inside there's a persistent pulse and an eye that can still see. Slowly but surely, your mind starts grinding again and your senses are restored to you. You might have died for a moment, but you're fine now. One thing, though. There was something else in the void far worse than the terrible entities you remember seeing there. Maybe the wonders and horrors you beheld were made out of it or by it, you're not sure, but its form was eerily familiar to you and while it could not have been said to be hateful, it was certainly hungry. |You can tell Thalia's struggling, but there's no way for either Nina or you to help her. All you can do is clutch the urn tight, press down on the lid, and hope for the best. Even though you're not the one trying to drain the shadowlith's power into yourself, your mere proximity to the process sickens you — the clammy, viscous texture the air takes on, the alien sensations that ripple down your arms from the urn, every single fiber of your body cries out for you to drop the urn and flee. It takes all of your willpower to remain in place despite the primaeval fear, a form of insanity in its on right when the sane and sensible thing to do would be to flee. You can feel something writhing within your skull, trying to get into your mind, but Thalia reaches out and pulls its tendrils back before they can find purchase on you. The torrent of otherworldly power rushing around you like a river about a boulder swallows your thoughts without pause, its infinitely hungry darkness insatiable; but [pc.isSoulbound |your self is protected, cocooned by godly power against this empty void |that hunger is superseded by one even greater, as impossible as that might feel ]. Before the gods lent their help to the people of Savarra, there was no way to fight even the lowest of wraiths... and this isn't even one, just a bundle of raw energy now that the intelligence of the void serpent attached to it is gone. ]
rows.translation: [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |但还有更多。影石在你那被强化了的视觉感知中产生了某种共鸣，迫使你将注意力完全集中在那块黑暗物质上，同时牵引着血管中那股迷幻的酒液。这种体验是你前所未有过的——那块岩石仿佛毫无停歇地吞噬着你的思绪，它那无穷无尽的饥饿黑暗永远难以满足。 不久之后，你感觉到自己的意识正在触碰到那由黑色岩石构成的虚无之面的边缘。偶尔，通过心灵的视野，你会看到虚无之中有火花闪烁，那些光芒会引发各种声音、色彩、形状、思想等等。弯曲的光线、多维的空间结构、从虚无中喷涌而出的液态色彩、逆向燃烧的紫色火焰……这些现象中，没有一种你能完全体验到位；而有些则太过奇特、违背常理，甚至连观察都变得困难——它们依然隐藏在虚无之中，或者你的意识即便借助外力也拒绝去感知它们。 但在虚无之中，也存在着一些极其恐怖的东西——那些末端长着针刺的细长蠕虫，那些形态不定、由腐蚀性胶状物质构成的团块，还有那些如同剃刀丝般割裂浓密肉状烟雾的屏障，以及其他那些令人不忍直视的怪物。这些生物拥有自己的生命，但这种生命并非你所认知的那种；从某种意义上来说，你对它们来说，就和它们对你一样陌生而可怕。它们的梦境其实就是噩梦，从另一个维度侵袭而来，而界间之路正是这两者相遇之处。 你无法长时间保持专注，而当这种专注最终被打破时，你会感到精疲力竭、一无所有，甚至连思考的能力都在逐渐减弱，几乎快要停止了。或许，这一切对你的心理来说已经太过沉重了，此刻你的自我意识正在逐渐瓦解，最终被虚无所吞噬。就好像你所有的意志力、所有的生命力都被夺走了，只因为偶然瞥见了那些隐藏在事物背后的东西。 但在你内心深处，仍有某种持续的力量在运作，你的双眼依然能够看见事物。慢慢地，你的思维开始重新运转，感官也逐渐恢复了功能。虽然有那么一刻你仿佛已经死去，但现在你已经没事了。 不过有一点需要注意。在那个虚无之中，还有某种东西，它的危害远比你当时所看到的那些恐怖生物要严重得多。也许你所目睹的那些奇异景象和恐怖事件，都是由这种东西创造出来的，或者至少是与它有关的——你并不确定。不过，它的形态让你感到一种诡异的熟悉感。虽然不能说它具有恶意，但它无疑充满了渴望。 |你能看出塔莉娅正在苦苦挣扎，但妮娜和你都无法帮助她。你们所能做的，就是紧紧握住那个瓮，压住它的盖子，然后祈祷一切都能顺利。尽管并不是你在试图将影石的能量吸收到自己体内，但仅仅是置身于这个过程中，你就感到一阵恶心——空气中那种黏腻、潮湿的气息，从瓮中传来的那些陌生感觉，让你的全身每一根神经都在呐喊着让你放下那个瓮赶紧逃跑。尽管心中充满了原始的恐惧——这种恐惧本身就已经近乎疯狂了——但你必须凭借全部的意志力才能坚守在自己的位置上。因为在这个时候，最理智、最正确的做法其实是逃跑。 你能够感觉到有什么东西在你的颅骨中蠕动，试图侵入你的思维，但塔莉娅及时伸出手，将那些触手拉了回去，阻止它们附着在你的脑海上。 那股来自异世界的强大力量像湍急的河流绕过巨石一般，毫不停歇地吞噬着你的思绪，它那无穷无尽的饥饿黑暗永远难以满足；但是[pc.isSoulbound |你的自我受到神圣力量的保护，被神力包裹着，不受这空虚虚无的侵扰。 |那种渴望会被另一种更强烈的渴望所取代，尽管这种感觉似乎根本不可能实现。 ]在众神尚未帮助萨瓦拉的人民之前，人们甚至连最弱小的怨灵都无法对抗……而这甚至都算不上是一个怨灵，既然附着在它身上的虚空巨蛇的智慧已经消失，它只不过是一团原始的能量罢了。 ]
rows.raw: " [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |But there's more. Something about the shadowlith resonates in your Juiced-up sight, and you're compelled to focus your mind on the chunk of dark matter, pulling on the psy-alchoholic brew in your veins. The experience is unlike anything you've experienced — the rock swallows your thoughts without pause, its infinitely hungry darkness insatiable. Soon, you feel your consciousness touching the surface of the void represented by the monolith of blackrock. Every now and then, with your mind's eye, you see a spark inside the void that lights it up, and that brilliance projects many sounds, colors, shapes, thoughts, and more. Curved rays of light, many-dimensional pockets of space, liquid color that springs from ethereal fountains, purple fires that burn in reverse. None of these you can experience fully and some are too strange and unintuitive to even behold — those remain veiled inside the void, or perhaps your mind refuses to perceive them even with aid. But there are also terrible things in the void — long sinewy worms with needles at their tips, amorphous blobs of corrosive gelatinous matter, curtains of razor wire cutting through thick fleshy smoke and other things too gruesome to describe. These things have life of their own, but it's not life as you know it; in a way, you are as alien and terrifying to them as they are to you. Their dreams are nightmares, pushing in from the other side, and the Ways form where the two meet. You are unable to maintain your focus long and when it finally breaks, you feel drained and empty, unable to move; even your thoughts are slowing down and are dangerously close to stopping. Perhaps this has been too much for your psyche and now your sense of self will disintegrate into dust, to be swallowed up by the void. It's as if all your will, all your life force, has been taken from you, just by chancing this glimpse of what lies beyond. But somewhere deep inside there's a persistent pulse and an eye that can still see. Slowly but surely, your mind starts grinding again and your senses are restored to you. You might have died for a moment, but you're fine now. One thing, though. There was something else in the void far worse than the terrible entities you remember seeing there. Maybe the wonders and horrors you beheld were made out of it or by it, you're not sure, but its form was eerily familiar to you and while it could not have been said to be hateful, it was certainly hungry. |You can tell Thalia's struggling, but there's no way for either Nina or you to help her. All you can do is clutch the urn tight, press down on the lid, and hope for the best. Even though you're not the one trying to drain the shadowlith's power into yourself, your mere proximity to the process sickens you — the clammy, viscous texture the air takes on, the alien sensations that ripple down your arms from the urn, every single fiber of your body cries out for you to drop the urn and flee. It takes all of your willpower to remain in place despite the primaeval fear, a form of insanity in its on right when the sane and sensible thing to do would be to flee. You can feel something writhing within your skull, trying to get into your mind, but Thalia reaches out and pulls its tendrils back before they can find purchase on you. The torrent of otherworldly power rushing around you like a river about a boulder swallows your thoughts without pause, its infinitely hungry darkness insatiable; but [pc.isSoulbound |your self is protected, cocooned by godly power against this empty void |that hunger is superseded by one even greater, as impossible as that might feel ]. Before the gods lent their help to the people of Savarra, there was no way to fight even the lowest of wraiths... and this isn't even one, just a bundle of raw energy now that the intelligence of the void serpent attached to it is gone. ]"

rows.original: Thalia? Set me down. Is she okay? She sounds strained. Set me down! Hurry! You've barely placed the urn on the floor that a thick, vile liquid oozes from its ceramic base and spreads outwards upon the old masonry, dark, inky star-stuff that glistens and shimmers before seeping into the mortar. Barely has one wave of that vile stuff finished before another begins, Thalia's self completely and utterly rejecting this indigestible if not outright poisonous stuff, trying to get rid of it with all haste. Just watching it is repulsive — you can't imagine what Thalia is going through right now.[pc.isGodsworn | Small mercy that you picked another god to sell your soul to, eh? ] Oh, gods. Now that is nasty. But at last, it's over. No sooner has the outflow ceased that Nina steps forward with a jug and rinses off Thalia's urn with copious quantities of ale. You dry it off and pick it up, wondering about its occupant... I-I think I'm fine. That was exceedingly unpleasant. But at last, I've avenged myself upon the shadowlith. And speaking of the shadowlith... when you raise your eyes to gaze upon it, all that remains is a dull gray boulder, completely and utterly mundane. In fact, it's identical to the boulder in the courtyard that greeted you when you first entered your future home. Guess you know what that used to be, then. Where that unholy power went doesn't matter, so long as it's removed from the shadowlith. It's dead? Death does not really apply to what was never alive to begin with inasmuch as ley-crystals are not alive, but it is inanimate. It's over, then. There's nothing preventing Nina from taking the lot of you out of here? Nina doesn't reply immediately, glancing about the courtyard, turning her eyes up to the void above. She clearly sees something that you [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |can barely only sense with Juice in your veins, but judging by what you saw in the shadowlith's vision you can guess |can't, but judging by her complete enrapturement instead of terror you should either be utterly terrified or not at all ]. There's a yearning in the silly bird's bones that goes beyond consciousness and self, yet would completely and utterly annihilate her were it to be realized... ...And then she comes back to join you and gives you a slow nod. "Yeah, man. Just say the word, and we're good to go. Make sure you didn't leave anything behind, I couldn't bring you back here even if I wanted to." You don't want to stay here a moment longer. Everything important's right here with you; if there's anything you left in this figment of the Wayfort's past, it couldn't have been a big deal to begin with. Nina nods and clasps her hands, then tears open reality with a quick swipe of her claws. You feel yourself being drawn towards the hole by a familiar, comforting sensation, and are more than happy to let yourself be carried by the flow...
rows.translation: 塞莉亚？ 放我下来。 她没事吧？她的声音听起来很紧张。 快把我放下！快一点！ 你刚把那个瓮放在地上，一股浓稠、恶臭的液体就从它的陶瓷底座中渗出来，蔓延到那些古老的砖石上。这种黑色、黏稠如墨的液体闪闪发光，随后便渗入了灰浆之中。还没等这一波液体完全扩散，另一波又开始了。塔莉娅完全无法接受这种难以消化、甚至可能有毒的物质，她正在拼命试图将其清除掉。光是看着这一幕就已经让人感到恶心了——你根本无法想象塔莉娅现在正在经历什么。[pc.isGodsworn | 你还选了另一个神明来出卖你的灵魂，也算是有点“仁慈”吧，嗯？ ] 哦，天啊。真是太棒了。糟糕的但最终，这一切都结束了。当流出的液体停止后，尼娜立刻拿了一个水壶走过来，用大量的麦芽酒冲洗了塔莉娅的骨灰瓮。你把瓮擦干并拿起来，心中不禁开始思考里面装着的是谁…… 我想我没什么大问题。刚才的经历确实非常糟糕，但至少，我终于为那些shadowlith报了仇。 说到那块影石……当你抬头凝视它时，所看到的只是一块毫无特色的灰褐色巨石，完全就是一块普通的石头。事实上，它和你刚来到未来住所时，在院子里看到的那块石头一模一样。那么，你应该知道它曾经是什么了吧。那股邪恶的力量去了哪里并不重要，只要它从那块影石上消失掉就行了。 它已经死了？ 对于那些本来就不存在的生命体来说，死亡这个概念其实并不适用——因为晶石根本就不是生命体，它们只是无生命的物体罢了。 那么，一切都结束了。难道没有什么能阻止尼娜把你们所有人都从这里带走吗？ 尼娜并没有立即回答，她环顾了一下庭院，然后将目光投向头顶的天空。显然，她看到了某些你们没有注意到的东西。 [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |只有当果汁在你的血管中流淌时，你才能勉强感受到这些感觉；但根据你在影石视野中看到的那些景象，你应该能够猜到一些东西。 |做不到，但看她那完全沉浸在其中的样子，而不是表现出恐惧，那么你要么应该已经吓得魂不附体，要么根本就不应该感到害怕。 ]那只傻鸟的骨子里流淌着一种超越意识与自我的渴望，而一旦这种渴望得以实现，它将会彻底摧毁她自己…… ……然后，它又会回到你身边，缓缓地向你点头。没错，伙计。只要你开口吩咐，我们就立刻行动。一定要确保没有遗漏任何东西，就算我想带你回来，也没办法做到啊。” 你根本不想再在这里多待一分钟。所有重要的东西都就在你身边；如果你还遗漏了什么与荒废驿堡过去有关的线索，那本来也不可能是什么重要的事情。 尼娜点了点头，双手合十，然后用爪子快速一划，将现实撕开了。你感受到一种熟悉而舒适的力量在将你吸引向那个洞穴，你非常乐意让自己被这股力量所引导……

rows.original: You don't think you can hold out that much longer. Fueled by the power of the shadowlith, the void serpent continuously regenerates, its hunger insatiable. [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |Nina's Juice flowing through your veins has afforded you an advantage over the monster, but it can only carry you so far |You, on the other hand, are finite and limited. No matter how great your reserves were when you began, they will eventually run dry ]. Nina...! "Nearly there, man, just keep its attention a little longer! Just, like, give me a little more time!" There is no time here to give! "Got it!" With those words, Nina rips a tear in the ether. It doesn't look like it'll fit you at first, but she strains herself and eventually it widens enough to accommodate [a] [pc.race] and harpy[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |, along with one sundered spirit in an urn ]. You can sense two forces clashing against each other here — the shadowlith, having realized what you've been trying to do all along, and Nina's terror and exhilaration alike holding the way open. Nothing left for it. Breaking into a sprint, you grab Nina by about the waist and drag the both of you into the tear. The serpent chases you, snapping at your heels; as you pass through the unstable portal, you unthinkingly look over your shoulder and take in the entirety of the shadowlith all at once. The world narrows down to a point as otherworldly energy makes one last grab for the two of you, unwilling to let you go; this stuff from beyond the Ways feels wrong on every level, an alien, cosmic power clawing at your ankles. Just brushing up against it has your muscles shaking and stomach turning; your breath catches in your lungs as your heart pounds. Were it to flow into you, there's little doubt that this thing that is essentially opposed to your existence would completely and utterly annihilate every trace of your being. It's not death, that would merely be the absence of life. This is something that is on the other side of death, a life-not-life of its very own. [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |But there's more. Something about the shadowlith resonates in your Juiced-up sight, and you're compelled to focus your mind on the chunk of dark matter, pulling on the psy-alchoholic brew in your veins. The experience is unlike anything you've experienced — the rock swallows your thoughts without pause, its infinitely hungry darkness insatiable. Soon, you feel your consciousness touching the surface of the void represented by the monolith of blackrock. Every now and then, with your mind's eye, you see a spark inside the void that lights it up, and that brilliance projects many sounds, colors, shapes, thoughts, and more. Curved rays of light, many-dimensional pockets of space, liquid color that springs from ethereal fountains, purple fires that burn in reverse. None of these you can experience fully and some are too strange and unintuitive to even behold — those remain veiled inside the void, or perhaps your mind refuses to perceive them even with aid. But there are also terrible things in the void — long sinewy worms with needles at their tips, amorphous blobs of corrosive gelatinous matter, curtains of razor wire cutting through thick fleshy smoke and other things too gruesome to describe. These things have life of their own, but it's not life as you know it; in a way, you are as alien and terrifying to them as they are to you. Their dreams are nightmares, pushing in from the other side, and the Ways form where the two meet. You are unable to maintain your focus long and when it finally breaks, you feel drained and empty, unable to move; even your thoughts are slowing down and are dangerously close to stopping. Perhaps this has been too much for your psyche and now your sense of self will disintegrate into dust, to be swallowed up by the void. It's as if all your will, all your life force, has been taken from you, just by chancing this glimpse of what lies beyond. But somewhere deep inside there's a persistent pulse and an eye that can still see. Slowly but surely, your mind starts grinding again and your senses are restored to you. You might have died for a moment, but you're fine now. One thing, though. There was something else in the void far worse than the terrible entities you remember seeing there. Maybe the wonders and horrors you beheld were made out of it or by it, you're not sure, but its form was eerily familiar to you and while it could not have been said to be hateful, it was certainly hungry. |The escape is unforgettable, quite literally the stuff of nightmares — you wish you could move faster, but there's nothing you can do to speed things up. All you can do is to hold Nina tight[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |, make sure you don't drop Thalia's urn in the expanse of the Ways, ] and hope that it turns out all right. Hope... [pc.isDK |the feeling of impotency frustrates you, but here and now, it's all there is. |that's all that's left, isn't it? ] The echoes of the shadowlith's emanations sicken you to the core — the clammy, viscous texture the air takes on, the alien sensations that reverberate in your body. But what makes it worse is the very nature of the edge between the Ways and oblivion — it takes all of your willpower to steady yourself despite the primaeval fear when surrounded by all these things you can't fully perceive but nevertheless know are there. You can feel something writhing within your skull, trying to get into your mind, but you finally escape their reach before they can find purchase on you. ] [pc.swornGod nareva |You're not fleeing from something an Astrida should deal with, it's just a tactical retreat — well, fine: you are fleeing, but it's warranted when you're outmatched. One of you isn't going to be enough to get the job done; when you return to Tychris perhaps you can petition the goddess herself to put together a proper team to deal with the shadowlith, one that's actually equipped and prepared to deal with a threat of this scale. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |No shame in cutting losses, Thalia quips into your mind, her attempt at dry humor falling flat. If I thought there was a reasonable chance you could finish the job I started, I would've said so. I don't know how things are in your time, but there were always too few of us. Of course, our goddess never treated us as expendables; heroics were discouraged. You're just glad that this is all over for now, and besides, it wasn't a complete loss. Managing to extricate one of the first-generation Astrida from her predicament is no small feat, and no doubt she's glad to be out of that figment of the Wayfort's past. Decaying into incoherence and insanity would not have been my first choice, yes. See? Not the worst outcome. |Who knows, maybe down the line Nareva will even want you to head the team, since you've been there before. But that's comfortably in the future, in a place where time actually flows... and certainly not before the more immediate question of Kas has been resolved one way or the other. ] |[pc.isGodsworn |There's just a twinge of recrimination at fleeing — you are soulbound and the representative of a living god, after all. Even if you're outmatched... on the other hand, there's no sense in futilely throwing away your life. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |If you think your strength isn't enough, then it isn't enough, Thalia points out as you cartwheel through the ether. I overestimated myself, and look at what happened to me. Besides, this wasn't a total loss, was it? I am eternally grateful for your help. ] |That was harrowing, but at least you're safe now, with the inside of your head intact. A small mercy given the odds that you were up against... sure, running may not make for the best of stories, but better a retreat than ending up a cautionary tale against overconfidence or bravado. ] ] The world twists sharply, time and space alike coming into focus...
rows.translation: 你认为自己不可能再坚持那么久了。在暗影石力量的驱动下，虚空巨蛇不断自我再生，它的饥饿感永远无法得到满足。 [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |妮娜的汁液流淌在你的血管中，这使你在对抗怪物时拥有优势，但它所能带来的帮助也是有限的。 |而你，却是有限且受限的。无论你一开始拥有多少资源，这些资源最终都会耗尽。 ]尼娜……！ “快成功了，坚持一下，再集中注意力一会儿吧！再给我一点时间就好！” 就快了。是没时间可以浪费了！” “明白了！” 说完这句话，尼娜在电波中划出了一条通道。起初这条通道似乎还不够宽，但她不断努力，最终它变得足够宽敞，可以容纳通过了。 [pc.race]还有那些恶毒的女人[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |以及一个被封存在瓮中的破碎灵魂 ]你可以感受到这里有两种力量正在相互冲突——一方是Shadowlith，它已经意识到了你一直以来试图做的事情；另一方则是Nina的恐惧与兴奋，这两种情绪共同阻碍着事情的发展。 已经没有其他办法了。你突然加速奔跑，一把抓住尼娜的腰，将她拖进了那道裂隙中。那条蛇紧追不舍，不断地咬向你们的脚后跟；当你们穿过那不稳定的传送门时，你不自觉地回头看了一眼，将整个阴影石区域尽收眼底。 当那些超自然的能量试图最后一次抓住你们两人，不愿让你们离开时，整个世界仿佛缩小到了一个点上；这种来自彼岸的力量，在每一个层面上都让人感到不适，它就像是一种外来的、宇宙级的力量，正在紧紧抓住你们的脚踝。仅仅只是轻轻触碰到它，就会让你全身肌肉颤抖、胃部不适；呼吸会变得急促，心跳也会加速。如果它真的开始流动的话你毫无疑问，这种本质上与你自身的存在相对立的东西，将会彻底抹除你存在的任何痕迹。 这并非死亡，因为死亡仅仅意味着生命的终结。而这种东西则位于死亡的彼岸，是一种属于它自己的、介于生命与死亡之间的存在状态。 [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |但还有更多。那种名为“影石”的物质在你那被强化了的视觉感知中产生了某种共鸣，迫使你将注意力完全集中在那块暗物质上，同时调动你血液中那种特殊的心理物质。这种体验是你前所未有过的——那块岩石仿佛毫无停歇地吞噬着你的思绪，它那无穷无尽的黑暗似乎永远也满足不了…… 不久之后，你感觉到自己的意识正在触碰到那由黑色岩石构成的虚空表面。偶尔，通过心灵的视野，你会看到虚空之中有火花闪烁，这些火花照亮了虚空，而那种光芒会呈现出各种声音、颜色、形状、思想等等。弯曲的光线、多维的空间结构、从虚无中喷涌而出的液态色彩、逆向燃烧的紫色火焰……这些现象中，没有一种你能完全体验到；而有些则太过奇特、违背常理，甚至连观察都变得困难——它们依然隐藏在虚无之中，或者你的意识即便借助外力也拒绝去感知它们。 但在虚无之中，也存在着一些极其恐怖的东西——那些末端长着针刺的细长蠕虫，那些形态不定、由腐蚀性胶状物质构成的团块，还有那些如同剃刀铁丝网般穿透浓密肉状烟雾的屏障，以及其他那些简直无法用语言形容的恐怖存在。这些生物拥有自己的生命，但这种生命并非你所认知的那种；从某种意义上来说，你对它们来说，就如同它们对你一样陌生而可怕。它们的梦境其实就是噩梦，从另一个维度侵袭而来，而那些“通道”，正是这两者相遇的地方。 你无法长时间保持专注，而当这种专注最终被打破时，你会感到精疲力竭、一无所有，甚至连思维都变得迟缓，几乎要停止运转。或许，这一切对你的心理来说已经太过沉重了，此刻你的自我意识正在逐渐瓦解，最终被虚无吞噬。就好像你所有的意志力、所有的生命力，都被这场对未知领域的短暂窥探夺走了。 但在你内心深处，仍有某种持续的力量在运作，你的双眼也依然能够看见事物。慢慢地，你的思维又开始运转起来，各种感官也重新恢复了功能。虽然有那么一刻你仿佛已经死了，但现在你已经没事了。 不过有一点需要注意。在那个虚无之中，还有某种东西，它的危害远比你当时所看到的那些恐怖生物要严重得多。也许你所目睹的那些奇观与恐惧，都是由这种东西构成的，或者至少是与它有关的；你并不确定。不过，它的形态让你感到一种诡异的熟悉感。虽然不能说它具有恶意，但它无疑充满了“渴望”。 |那次逃生体验令人难以忘怀，简直就是噩梦的写照——你多么希望自己能跑得更快些，但却无能为力。你所能做的，就是紧紧抱住妮娜。[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |请务必不要让塔莉娅的骨灰罐掉落在那些广阔的区域里。 ]并希望最终一切都能顺利解决。 希望…… [pc.isDK |这种无能为力的感觉会让你感到沮丧，但此刻，这就是现实。 |就只剩下这些了，不是吗？ ]那些阴影石释放出的能量所留下的余波会让你感到极度不适——空气变得黏腻潮湿，那些陌生的感觉会在你的身体里回荡。但更糟糕的是，那些位于“道路”与“遗忘”之间的边界本身的性质：当你被这些东西包围时，尽管会感到原始的恐惧，但你仍必须动用全部意志力才能保持自己的冷静。各种物品你无法完全感知到它们的存在，但却知道它们确实存在。你能够察觉到这些。感受有什么东西在你的脑海中扭动、试图侵入你的思维，但你在它们真正影响到你之前，终于成功逃脱了它们的控制。 ] [pc.swornGod nareva |你并不是在逃避那些本该由阿斯特里达来处理的事情，这只是一种战术性的撤退罢了——好吧，也没关系：你是逃跑是情有可原的，当你处于劣势时，这样做确实有必要。你们其中一个人是无法完成这项任务的；或许回到提克里斯后，你们可以直接向女神请愿，让她组建一支真正有能力应对这种规模的威胁的队伍。这样一支队伍才具备应对这种挑战所需的装备和准备。 [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |及时止损并没有什么可羞愧的。塔莉娅在你的脑海中轻声调侃，但她试图用这种干巴巴的幽默来逗人笑，结果却完全失败了。如果我认为你有很大可能性能够完成我开始的那项工作，我就会直接说出来的。我不知道你们现在的情况如何，但在我们那个时候，人手总是不够。当然，我们的女神从来不会把我们当作可牺牲的工具；她从不鼓励人们去做那些冒险的行为。 你只是庆幸这一切暂时告一段落了，而且，这也不算完全的失败。能够将第一代阿斯特丽达中的一只从困境中解救出来，确实是一件了不起的事情；毫无疑问，它也会为能够摆脱荒废驿堡家族过去的那些纷扰而感到庆幸吧。 陷入混乱与疯狂，确实不是我想要的结果。 看到吧？这已经算是最坏的结果了。 |谁知道呢，也许将来娜瑞瓦会希望你来领导这个团队，因为你之前有过这样的经验。但那当然是未来的事，是在时间能够按正常顺序流逝的未来……而在目前这个阶段，当卡希的问题还没有得到解决之前，这样的事情肯定还不可能发生。 ] |[pc.isGodsworn |对于逃跑的行为，只会感到一丝自责而已——你是毕竟，你是与生神同契的存在。即使你处于劣势……但另一方面，也没有必要白白送命。 [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |如果你认为自己还不够强大，那么确实还不够。当你在空中翻滚着旋转时，塞莉亚指出了这一点。我高估了自己的能力，看看后来发生了什么。不过，这也不算彻底失败，对吧？我永远感激你的帮助。 ] |那确实是一次令人痛苦的经历，但至少你现在安全了，你的头脑也完好无损。考虑到你当时面临的种种困难，这已经算是上天赐予你的一个小恩惠了……当然，逃跑这个举动可能不会让故事变得多么美好，但总比成为一个关于过度自信或鲁莽行为的警示故事要好得多。 ] ] 世界骤然扭曲，时间和空间都变得清晰可辨……
rows.raw: " You don't think you can hold out that much longer. Fueled by the power of the shadowlith, the void serpent continuously regenerates, its hunger insatiable. [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |Nina's Juice flowing through your veins has afforded you an advantage over the monster, but it can only carry you so far |You, on the other hand, are finite and limited. No matter how great your reserves were when you began, they will eventually run dry ]. Nina...! "Nearly there, man, just keep its attention a little longer! Just, like, give me a little more time!" There is no time here to give! "Got it!" With those words, Nina rips a tear in the ether. It doesn't look like it'll fit you at first, but she strains herself and eventually it widens enough to accommodate [a] [pc.race] and harpy[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |, along with one sundered spirit in an urn ]. You can sense two forces clashing against each other here — the shadowlith, having realized what you've been trying to do all along, and Nina's terror and exhilaration alike holding the way open. Nothing left for it. Breaking into a sprint, you grab Nina by about the waist and drag the both of you into the tear. The serpent chases you, snapping at your heels; as you pass through the unstable portal, you unthinkingly look over your shoulder and take in the entirety of the shadowlith all at once. The world narrows down to a point as otherworldly energy makes one last grab for the two of you, unwilling to let you go; this stuff from beyond the Ways feels wrong on every level, an alien, cosmic power clawing at your ankles. Just brushing up against it has your muscles shaking and stomach turning; your breath catches in your lungs as your heart pounds. Were it to flow into you, there's little doubt that this thing that is essentially opposed to your existence would completely and utterly annihilate every trace of your being. It's not death, that would merely be the absence of life. This is something that is on the other side of death, a life-not-life of its very own. [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp |But there's more. Something about the shadowlith resonates in your Juiced-up sight, and you're compelled to focus your mind on the chunk of dark matter, pulling on the psy-alchoholic brew in your veins. The experience is unlike anything you've experienced — the rock swallows your thoughts without pause, its infinitely hungry darkness insatiable. Soon, you feel your consciousness touching the surface of the void represented by the monolith of blackrock. Every now and then, with your mind's eye, you see a spark inside the void that lights it up, and that brilliance projects many sounds, colors, shapes, thoughts, and more. Curved rays of light, many-dimensional pockets of space, liquid color that springs from ethereal fountains, purple fires that burn in reverse. None of these you can experience fully and some are too strange and unintuitive to even behold — those remain veiled inside the void, or perhaps your mind refuses to perceive them even with aid. But there are also terrible things in the void — long sinewy worms with needles at their tips, amorphous blobs of corrosive gelatinous matter, curtains of razor wire cutting through thick fleshy smoke and other things too gruesome to describe. These things have life of their own, but it's not life as you know it; in a way, you are as alien and terrifying to them as they are to you. Their dreams are nightmares, pushing in from the other side, and the Ways form where the two meet. You are unable to maintain your focus long and when it finally breaks, you feel drained and empty, unable to move; even your thoughts are slowing down and are dangerously close to stopping. Perhaps this has been too much for your psyche and now your sense of self will disintegrate into dust, to be swallowed up by the void. It's as if all your will, all your life force, has been taken from you, just by chancing this glimpse of what lies beyond. But somewhere deep inside there's a persistent pulse and an eye that can still see. Slowly but surely, your mind starts grinding again and your senses are restored to you. You might have died for a moment, but you're fine now. One thing, though. There was something else in the void far worse than the terrible entities you remember seeing there. Maybe the wonders and horrors you beheld were made out of it or by it, you're not sure, but its form was eerily familiar to you and while it could not have been said to be hateful, it was certainly hungry. |The escape is unforgettable, quite literally the stuff of nightmares — you wish you could move faster, but there's nothing you can do to speed things up. All you can do is to hold Nina tight[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |, make sure you don't drop Thalia's urn in the expanse of the Ways, ] and hope that it turns out all right. Hope... [pc.isDK |the feeling of impotency frustrates you, but here and now, it's all there is. |that's all that's left, isn't it? ] The echoes of the shadowlith's emanations sicken you to the core — the clammy, viscous texture the air takes on, the alien sensations that reverberate in your body. But what makes it worse is the very nature of the edge between the Ways and oblivion — it takes all of your willpower to steady yourself despite the primaeval fear when surrounded by all these things you can't fully perceive but nevertheless know are there. You can feel something writhing within your skull, trying to get into your mind, but you finally escape their reach before they can find purchase on you. ] [pc.swornGod nareva |You're not fleeing from something an Astrida should deal with, it's just a tactical retreat — well, fine: you are fleeing, but it's warranted when you're outmatched. One of you isn't going to be enough to get the job done; when you return to Tychris perhaps you can petition the goddess herself to put together a proper team to deal with the shadowlith, one that's actually equipped and prepared to deal with a threat of this scale. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |No shame in cutting losses, Thalia quips into your mind, her attempt at dry humor falling flat. If I thought there was a reasonable chance you could finish the job I started, I would've said so. I don't know how things are in your time, but there were always too few of us. Of course, our goddess never treated us as expendables; heroics were discouraged. You're just glad that this is all over for now, and besides, it wasn't a complete loss. Managing to extricate one of the first-generation Astrida from her predicament is no small feat, and no doubt she's glad to be out of that figment of the Wayfort's past. Decaying into incoherence and insanity would not have been my first choice, yes. See? Not the worst outcome. |Who knows, maybe down the line Nareva will even want you to head the team, since you've been there before. But that's comfortably in the future, in a place where time actually flows... and certainly not before the more immediate question of Kas has been resolved one way or the other. ] |[pc.isGodsworn |There's just a twinge of recrimination at fleeing — you are soulbound and the representative of a living god, after all. Even if you're outmatched... on the other hand, there's no sense in futilely throwing away your life. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |If you think your strength isn't enough, then it isn't enough, Thalia points out as you cartwheel through the ether. I overestimated myself, and look at what happened to me. Besides, this wasn't a total loss, was it? I am eternally grateful for your help. ] |That was harrowing, but at least you're safe now, with the inside of your head intact. A small mercy given the odds that you were up against... sure, running may not make for the best of stories, but better a retreat than ending up a cautionary tale against overconfidence or bravado. ] ] The world twists sharply, time and space alike coming into focus..."

rows.original: Slowly, the familiar atmosphere of Rumie's bar swims into view; the chatter of the bee-tender's patrons, the mound of forlorn empties between you and Nina. Off to one side, [party.som |a group of lupines clink their tankards and share a drink of mead |[party.compNames] is speaking with Rumie |[party.compNames] chat with each other at the next table over ], completely oblivious as to the harrowing adventure you've just had. No time seems to have passed in between you being yanked into the Ways Between with Nina, and if not for the [flags.VISION_SERPENT 3 |[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |nauseating sensation in the pit of your stomach and the weight of the urn holding Thalia's remains, it might all have been a hallucination. Your insides lurch a couple times, but thankfully you're all empty at this point. Rumie would overcome her subby nature to be thoroughly upset with you if you vomited black oily stuff all over her bar... There's Thalia's remains, of course — the urn's survived the escape quite well. Might want to return that to Tychris when you have the chance, pass her off to her goddess. |nauseating sensation in the pit of your stomach, it might all have been a hallucination. Your insides lurch a couple times, but thankfully you're all empty at this point. Rumie would overcome her subby nature to be thoroughly upset with you if you vomited black oily stuff all over her bar... ] |[pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |weight of the urn holding Thalia's remains, it might all have been a hallucination. The urn's survived the escape quite well. Might want to return that to Tychris when you have the chance, pass her off to her goddess; it'll have been a long trip home for the first-generation Astrida, but all's well that ends well. |cuts and scrapes, as well as the lingering ache in your muscles, it might all have been a terrible fever dream. ] ] Tired and sick to your stomach, you roll your eyes over to take in Nina. The image of the harpy psion hasn't quite settled yet, undulating and rippling in your vision — either she's taking longer than you to settle in one piece from returning to the real world, or you're just out of it. The latter's more likely as you gasp, sending cool air into your lungs and drawing her figure into sober focus. The both of you are content to lie there a moment, using the appearance of drunkenness as cover for taking a moment of recuperative peace, letting the absolute mundanity of Rumie's bar lull you into tranquillity. At last, Nina groans, rubbing her temples with a clawed hand. She looks at you, then at the mountain of empties, then [flags.VISION_SERPENT 2 3 |slowly shakes her head at the sight of the handful of dust you have. "We beat it, man. I totally didn't see that coming, even if Thalia did mention it as a possibility. I'm not a brave bird — there were points back there when I thought it'd be a better option to cut and run." Well, it's a good thing you didn't. Given the psychic weight of that... that thing that was born of Thalia's psyche and nested in the monolith, it's better all around that it was completely destroyed. And let's face it — Thalia did most of the work. The both of you were instrumental, sure, but you helped her finish the job she started back then. Nor, as it seems, did it come without a price. "Yeah. She just like, sucked all the stuff into her, man. I didn't know ghosts — I know she's not a ghost ghost — could do that. And then she puked it all back up, which was a little less awesome." You don't need reminding... the chunk of what she called blackrock was emanating something like magic, but not quite it. |slowly shakes her head at the sight of the handful of dust you have. "You beat it, man. Like, I totally didn't see that coming." She couldn't have. Given the psychic weight of that... that thing that lived in the monolith, that's not something that would have allowed itself to be the subject of anyone's vision. Neither did it come without a price — all of your Astrida-ness feels like it's been turned inside-out and hung out to dry. You don't think it's anything permanent, but you might want to have a lie-down for a day. "You just... like, sucked all the stuff into you, man. All the stuff that made that rock what it is — dude, that was awesome. Then you puked it all back up, which was a little less awesome." You don't need reminding... the chunk of what she called blackrock was emanating something like magic, but not quite it. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |Thalia pointed out the connection, and since you're an Astrida yourself it was something you weren't squeamish about trying given that the shadowlith was impervious to anything the two of you could throw at it. |Since the shadowlith was otherwise impervious to anything the two of you could throw at it, you weren't going to be squeamish about trying. ] |breathes a sigh of relief. "That was really close, man. I wasn't sure that we'd make it. Good job keeping its attention long enough for me to figure out how to get us out." As successful as this might have been, you think you'll refrain from entering the Ways by tearing holes in the weave of the world for a bit. The waystones will be enough for a good long while until the heat dies down. "Can't argue with that. I'll be consulting Gerry about this, but actually going places through the Ways is something I'm totally not doing anytime soon. Like, that nasty thing's still out there and while I only know one horror beyond comprehension, I think it's safe to say it's not happy we're gone." You don't know, your head's still ringing from that mental battering it took. Little of this makes sense, and you don't think it'll get any better with time. Maybe a lie-down would be the best thing after that harrowing escape. ] "I... I just need a little while to process all this." [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |Right. While she's out ordering a couple of stiff shots from Rumie, you'll take the opportunity to check in on Thalia. The urn with her remains made it out with you in one piece, but she's been awfully silent so far. You'd have expected some congratulations, expressions of relief, joy at finally having escaped that little pocket in the Ways — but there's been nothing from her. Come on, c'mon... "Dude, she's asking you to stop shaking her like that." You eye Nina. Is she? You can't hear Thalia speak, although now that you're concentrating, you can feel just a slight hint of a presence from within the urn. Yeah, Thalia's there all right, just whatever that allowed her to speak into your mind in the Wayfort's past is now gone. "Eh, I'm not really surprised about it, man. Like, you're not a dreamwalker and that place was several kinds of messed up and funky. Could've been worse. Besides, there's not much to talk about any more, is there? You've just got to head to Tychris and hand her back to her goddess." Yeah, there is that. [pc.swornGod nareva |You should be heading back to the palace to make a report of this whole affair |No doubt Nareva will appreciate the favor ]. |Sure, and you know just how to help the both of you. Calling Rumie over, you have your bee-tender get you a couple of stiff drinks. Exactly what doesn't matter, so long as Nina stops being so miserably [silly |knurd |sober ] and is back to her old self. Rumie returns with two shots of strong spirits — both for Nina — and the silly bird wastes no time downing both of them. ] "Anyways, aside from that, there's still one thing..." [pc.isDK |Unfortunately, she's not going to die, even if she might feel like it and desperately wants it. Nina tries to huff, but it comes out as a spluttering cough. "No, it's not that |Yes? Nina groans a bit, tries to sit up, and gives up. "Well, about everything ]. In all of this mess, I haven't had the time to sit down and figure out why I messed up so badly. Like, up until this particular leg everything was going smoothly, man. And now..." Didn't you talk about this when you were first wrenched out of the Ways and into that ruined keep? Her vision was completely hijacked by a being head and shoulders above her league, so she's not to blame here. There's nothing that she could've done about it. Nina shakes her head slowly. "N-no. Like I told you, I did have the feeling that something was off... but I chose to ignore it anyway. Everything had guided me to that point... I was afraid of disrespecting the vision. But it wasn't a vision at all, or if it was, it'd been mangled by that... thing. The visions have never ever failed me so long as I'd abided by them, but I didn't stop to consider the possibility that what this was wasn't a vision. That's how I created such a disaster this time. "I was so damn stupid, man! I've never dared go against a vision, since I always knew that things would fall apart if I did. That's why I... I mean, never mind. But when I felt that wrenching feeling while we were grabbed and tossed off somewhere in the Ways where we didn't belong, and from that point it was all one chaotic mess where anything could happen." She doesn't have to beat herself up so badly about it. In a way, the vision did come through, since you're back where you belong, relatively unharmed[flags.VISION_JUICE | and she remembered how to make Juice in the bargain. Given that making that psionic cocktail was probably the entire point of this whole vision quest to begin with, maybe the visions didn't lead her astray after all. Maybe the both of you were meant to be snatched up — a pretty drastic way to jog one's memory, but doubtlessly effective. |. That's got to count for something. ] Nina squints at you. Sighing, she checks the jugs, hoping to find one that's at least half full, and takes a long pull from the first suitable one. "I know you're trying to make me feel better, [pc.name]. Man, that was, like, totally harrowing. But you're right, in a roundabout way. "Well, now the vision's gone, and [flags.VISION_JUICE |it's left me with new and wondrous knowledge." Nina gives a small, bitter laugh. "Man, this had better be good for it to be worth all that. Gerry's going to give me a talking-to the next time we hang out. Like, dude, I'm looking forward to and dreading it at the same time. That's not right, is it?" Coming from her? That's quite the statement. And you're the calm one here. Well, does she have anything to add? Any new and wondrous insights, the recipe for Juice aside? |I'm still not sure what the point of everything was. That totally sucks, man." Well... maybe the vision did its thing. Is there anything about this harrowing experience that she can tie to what you've been doing all this while? ] Nina furrows her brow. "Not off the top of my head — my think-meat's all like, still rattled and bouncing around, man. Give me a few minutes to settle down and sort things out; I'm sure that it'll come to me in another vision, if it's really meant to be. You look pretty pooped, too, so why don't you like, get a drink and then we'll talk about it again?"

东西这些幻象从未出现过。曾经只要我遵守这些规则，就不会出现问题，但我从未想过，实际情况可能并非如此。不是一种愿景。正是这种愿景让我这次造成了这样的灾难。 “我真是太愚蠢了！我从来不敢违背任何愿景，因为我知道如果那样做，一切都会陷入混乱。所以……算了，先不说这个了。但当我们被强行带到那些不属于我们的地方时，我感受到了那种撕心裂肺的痛苦，从那一刻起，一切都变得混乱不堪，任何事情都可能发生。” Off to one side, [party.som |a group of lupines clink their tankards and share a drink of mead |[party.compNames] is speaking with Rumie |[party.compNames] chat with each other at the next table over ], completely oblivious as to the harrowing adventure you've just had. The image of the harpy psion hasn't quite settled yet, undulating and rippling in your vision — either she's taking longer than you to settle in one piece from returning to the real world, or you're just out of it. The latter's more likely as you gasp, sending cool air into your lungs and drawing her figure into sober focus. The both of you are content to lie there a moment, using the appearance of drunkenness as cover for taking a moment of recuperative peace, letting the absolute mundanity of Rumie's bar lull you into tranquillity. At last, Nina groans, rubbing her temples with a clawed hand. She looks at you, then at the mountain of empties, then [flags.VISION_SERPENT 2 3 |slowly shakes her head at the sight of the handful of dust you have. "We beat it, man. I totally didn't see that coming, even if Thalia did mention it as a possibility. I'm not a brave bird — there were points back there when I thought it'd be a better option to cut and run." Well, it's a good thing you didn't. Given the psychic weight of that... that thing that was born of Thalia's psyche and nested in the monolith, it's better all around that it was completely destroyed. And let's face it — Thalia did most of the work. The both of you were instrumental, sure, but you helped her finish the job she started back then. Nor, as it seems, did it come without a price. "Yeah. She just like, sucked all the stuff into her, man. I didn't know ghosts — I know she's not a ghost ghost — could do that. And then she puked it all back up, which was a little less awesome." You don't need reminding... the chunk of what she called blackrock was emanating something like magic, but not quite it. |slowly shakes her head at the sight of the handful of dust you have. "You beat it, man. Like, I totally didn't see that coming." She couldn't have. Given the psychic weight of that... that thing that lived in the monolith, that's not something that would have allowed itself to be the subject of anyone's vision. Neither did it come without a price — all of your Astrida-ness feels like it's been turned inside-out and hung out to dry. You don't think it's anything permanent, but you might want to have a lie-down for a day. "You just... like, sucked all the stuff into you, man. All the stuff that made that rock what it is — dude, that was awesome. Then you puked it all back up, which was a little less awesome." You don't need reminding... the chunk of what she called blackrock was emanating something like magic, but not quite it. [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |Thalia pointed out the connection, and since you're an Astrida yourself it was something you weren't squeamish about trying given that the shadowlith was impervious to anything the two of you could throw at it. |Since the shadowlith was otherwise impervious to anything the two of you could throw at it, you weren't going to be squeamish about trying. ] |breathes a sigh of relief. "That was really close, man. I wasn't sure that we'd make it. Good job keeping its attention long enough for me to figure out how to get us out." As successful as this might have been, you think you'll refrain from entering the Ways by tearing holes in the weave of the world for a bit. The waystones will be enough for a good long while until the heat dies down. "Can't argue with that. I'll be consulting Gerry about this, but actually going places through the Ways is something I'm totally not doing anytime soon. Like, that nasty thing's still out there and while I only know one horror beyond comprehension, I think it's safe to say it's not happy we're gone." You don't know, your head's still ringing from that mental battering it took. Little of this makes sense, and you don't think it'll get any better with time. Maybe a lie-down would be the best thing after that harrowing escape. ] "I... I just need a little while to process all this." [pc.hasKeyItem ThaliasRemains |Right. While she's out ordering a couple of stiff shots from Rumie, you'll take the opportunity to check in on Thalia. The urn with her remains made it out with you in one piece, but she's been awfully silent so far. You'd have expected some congratulations, expressions of relief, joy at finally having escaped that little pocket in the Ways — but there's been nothing from her. Come on, c'mon... "Dude, she's asking you to stop shaking her like that." You eye Nina. Is she? You can't hear Thalia speak, although now that you're concentrating, you can feel just a slight hint of a presence from within the urn. Yeah, Thalia's there all right, just whatever that allowed her to speak into your mind in the Wayfort's past is now gone. "Eh, I'm not really surprised about it, man. Like, you're not a dreamwalker and that place was several kinds of messed up and funky. Could've been worse. Besides, there's not much to talk about any more, is there? You've just got to head to Tychris and hand her back to her goddess." Yeah, there is that. [pc.swornGod nareva |You should be heading back to the palace to make a report of this whole affair |No doubt Nareva will appreciate the favor ]. |Sure, and you know just how to help the both of you. Calling Rumie over, you have your bee-tender get you a couple of stiff drinks. Exactly what doesn't matter, so long as Nina stops being so miserably [silly |knurd |sober ] and is back to her old self. Rumie returns with two shots of strong spirits — both for Nina — and the silly bird wastes no time downing both of them. ] "Anyways, aside from that, there's still one thing..." [pc.isDK |Unfortunately, she's not going to die, even if she might feel like it and desperately wants it. Nina tries to huff, but it comes out as a spluttering cough. "No, it's not that |Yes? Nina groans a bit, tries to sit up, and gives up. "Well, about everything ]. In all of this mess, I haven't had the time to sit down and figure out why I messed up so badly. Like, up until this particular leg everything was going smoothly, man. And now..." Didn't you talk about this when you were first wrenched out of the Ways and into that ruined keep? Her vision was completely hijacked by a being head and shoulders above her league, so she's not to blame here. There's nothing that she could've done about it. Nina shakes her head slowly. "N-no. Like I told you, I did have the feeling that something was off... but I chose to ignore it anyway. Everything had guided me to that point... I was afraid of disrespecting the vision. But it wasn't a vision at all, or if it was, it'd been mangled by that... thing. The sensation of ticklish heat in your limbs hasn't really abated before, and there just seems to be a little more... weight to your step. The thought brings you up short and a quick rundown of your anatomy reveals an alarming adjustment to your feminine attributes. You now have [a] [char.ass], [a] more shapely feminine face, [char.breasts], and [char.hips]."

rows.original:
You approach the pillar of light, shining up from below, and brandish your crystal charm. Thankfully, you feel the charge of energy building up all around you once more, and as you thrust your hand out, the world blackens.

    And you awaken in a world of color and vibrancy, [pc.feet] firmly planted on the ground!
rows.translation:
你走向那道从下方照射而来的光柱，挥动着手中的水晶饰品。幸运的是，你感觉到周围的能量再次开始汇聚起来，当你伸出双手时，整个世界陷入了黑暗。

    然后，你在一个充满色彩与活力的世界中苏醒了。 [pc.feet]牢牢地扎根于大地之上！
rows.raw:
"
    You approach the pillar of light, shining up from below, and brandish your crystal charm. Thankfully, you feel the charge of energy building up all around you once more, and as you thrust your hand out, the world blackens.

    And you awaken in a world of color and vibrancy, [pc.feet] firmly planted on the ground!
    
    "

rows.original: You take a deep, centering breath and unfurl your hand around the Waystone charm, holding it aloft towards that idol before you. Once more, the air around you throbs with untapped power; static clings to you, buzzing through the air. You take a step forward, feeling the energy cascade across your [pc.skinFurScales]... and then another step, and for a moment, the world goes black. You blinked, that's it, but you open your eyes into another world. Everything is roiling gray shadow, billowing around you in the fierce, overbearing winds. Your feet stand amongst the clouds, staring down onto the Marches far, far below you. The Waystone idol shines like a beacon below you, a pillar of light that tears up from the shadows of the world. Above you, the sky burns with light — but not with the sun. The heavens shine with the glimmer of a thousand thousand crystals, a ceiling of pale gemstones that stretches all the way to the horizon. "What in the world..." [party.has brint|"Khaak! [pc.name], why aren't my hooves touching the ground? What gives?" Brint bellows, stomping on the ground. Cracking, glass-like noises echo all around him as his hooves stamp down on the solid 'floor' of this plane.] [party.has brienne|"Khaak!" Brienne gasps, her face blanching. "What the hell is this, [pc.name]?"] [party.has etheryn|"[pc.name]!" Etheryn squeals, tumbling out of the nearby shadows. "This place is scary! Let's leave — right now!"] [party.has arona|"Aw, what the fuck is this place even?" Arona grunts. "This ain't right... buncha fucking wizard shit I bet. You better have a plan for getting us out of here, [pc.name]. Pronto!"] [party.has berwyn|Berwyn emerges from the nearby shadows, lips scrunched and tail tucked. "Where the heck are we? Not flying... teleportation? But where to...?"] [party.has atugia|Atugia picks her head up from the 'ground' nearby, complaining with a series of muted curses as she staggers about. "Some kinda magic zapped me... wait, where are we?"] [party.has azyrran|Your Hive Knight buzzes down from the mists above you, landing unsteadily on the glassy 'floor' of the plane. "I have never flown so high before! Is our sky truly wrapped with crystal, or has the sun simply shunned us for rising to such heights?"] [party.has cait|"Wooooah!" Cait gasps, emerging from a cloud bank behind you. "It's like we're flying! But... but not." She taps a foot, and a sound like crystal ringing echoes across the cloudscape. "We're somewhere else, [pc.name]. I've read about this, but I thought Magister Elrohm was just high as a kite when he penned Magisterium Imperius. All sorts of names for it: the paths of the gods, the astral plane or the dreamscape... the ways between." The ways between, huh?] [party.has kiyoko|"Ah," is all your fox-wife says as you emerge in this misty realm. "Well. I had not expected to see this again." Wait, she knows what this is? "It is how the nobles of Belhar traveled quickly from point to point in the distant past. When I first arrived on these shores, I had the benefit of having a salamander prince bring me and my retinue from our landing to his palace in this manner. I understand that one of my retainers was highly interested in how this was done; that interest has certainly borne fruit in the intervening centuries, has it not?"] Experimentally, you take a few steps forward, and find that your [pc.feet] touch a glassy, transparent surface beneath them. It almost feels like some sort of tile, rough but even. Though your heart hammers from the height, it seems safe enough to move — and when you do, it's as though every step is a league, taking you vast distances across the distant backdrop of the Marches. Is this how Kasyrra's been traveling, you wonder. Sure, the demoness has wings, too, but surely they can't be enough to take her across the world quick enough for all her schemes to have come to fruition. But traveling through this plane... you could step between Hawkethorne and Evergreen's backyard in a matter of seconds! Indeed, as you start to survey your surroundings, you see [var0|another pillar|other pillars] of light from [var0|a distant idol|distant idols]. Perhaps that's how you'll leave this shadowy realm?
rows.translation: 你深吸一口气，将手伸向那块路标符咒，将其高高举过身前那座神像。周围的气氛再次充满了未被释放的能量，静电在空气中嗡嗡作响。你向前迈出一步，感受到那股能量正缓缓传递到你的身上。 [pc.skinFurScales]……然后又迈出了下一步，刹那间，整个世界陷入了黑暗。 你眨了眨眼，就这样，当你再次睁开眼睛时，发现自己置身于另一个世界。周围是一片翻滚的灰色阴影，这些阴影在猛烈而压迫性的风中不断翻涌、扩散。你的双脚仿佛站在云层之中，俯瞰着下方那遥远的边境地区。脚下的路标神像犹如一座灯塔，光芒从世界的阴影中照射而出。而在你的头顶上，天空被光芒照亮——但那光芒并非来自太阳。苍穹之中，无数水晶闪烁着微光，仿佛由淡色宝石构成的穹顶，一直延伸到地平线的尽头。 “这究竟是 [party.has brint|喀！ [pc.name]，为什么我的蹄子碰不到地面？这是怎么回事？”布林特大声吼道，同时用蹄子猛烈地踩踏地面。随着他的蹄子踩在这个平面的“地面”上，发出类似玻璃破碎的声响，在他周围回荡着。] [party.has brienne|卡克！”布蕾妮惊呼出声，脸色瞬间变得煞白。“这到底是什么东西[pc.name]？”] [party.has etheryn|"[pc.name]哎呀！”伊瑟琳尖叫着，从附近的阴影中冲了出来，“这个地方太可怕了！我们赶紧离开吧——现在就走！] [party.has arona|啊，这他妈到底是什么地方？”阿罗娜嘟囔道，“肯定是什么该死的巫师把戏……你们最好能想个办法把我们弄出去才行。 [pc.name]马上就好！] [party.has berwyn|贝尔温从附近的阴影中走了出来，嘴唇紧抿，尾巴也缩了回去。“我们到底在哪儿？不是在飞行……也不是传送……那该去哪里……？] [party.has atugia|阿图吉娅从附近的“地面”上爬起来，一边踉跄着走，一边发出一连串低声的咒骂：“肯定是某种魔法把我击倒了……等等，我们在哪儿？] [party.has azyrran|你的蜂鸟骑士从上方的迷雾中飞下来，摇摇晃晃地降落在飞机的玻璃般的“地面上”。“我从来没飞得这么高过！我们的天空真的是被水晶覆盖着的，还是因为我们飞得太高，太阳才躲开了我们？] [party.has cait|哇哦！”凯特喘着气从你身后的云层中钻了出来，“感觉就像我们在飞翔一样！但是……其实又不是。” 她轻轻跺了跺脚，顿时一阵如同水晶碰撞般的清脆声响彻云间，“我们现在应该在别的地方吧[pc.name]我读过相关内容，但原本以为埃尔罗姆大师在写下那些话的时候只是处于极度兴奋的状态罢了。帝国教廷人们对它有着各种各样的称呼：神之路、星界通道或是梦境空间……总之，就是那些连接不同领域的道路。 连接不同领域的道路，啊？] [party.has kiyoko|啊，当你踏入这个雾蒙蒙的世界时，你的狐狸妻子就是这么说的。嗯，我真没料到会再次见到这一幕。 等等，她知道这是什么吗？ 在遥远的过去，贝尔哈的贵族们就是通过这种方式快速地从一个地方前往另一个地方的。当我第一次来到这片海岸时，有位蝾螈王子以这种方式将我和我的随从从登陆地点送到了他的宫殿。我记得我的其中一位随从对这种运输方式非常感兴趣；在接下来的几个世纪里，这种兴趣肯定带来了不少好处，不是吗？] 通过实验，你向前走了几步，然后发现[pc.feet]你的脚下是光滑而透明的表面，触感几乎像某种瓷砖，表面有些粗糙，但整体上非常均匀。尽管站在这么高的地方，你的心跳得飞快，但这种表面看起来足够安全，你可以放心地行走。而当你迈出脚步时，每一步似乎都像是在跨越漫长的距离，将你带到边境地区那辽阔的背景之中。 你不禁会想，卡希拉就是这样旅行的吗？当然，这位女恶魔也有翅膀，但她的翅膀肯定不足以让她快速穿越整个世界，从而让她的所有计划都能顺利实施。不过，通过这个维度空间旅行的话，或许另当别论…… 你只需几秒钟就能从鹰棘镇走到常青女士的后院！事实上，当你开始环顾四周时，你会看到[var0|另一大支柱|其他支柱]来自光芒[var0|遥远的偶像|遥远的偶像]也许，你就是通过这种方式离开这个阴暗领域的吧？

rows.original: "Ya wish to use th' torii gate, [pc.ra kitsune|yer Eminence|don'tcha]?" [dayNight|Miko|Mai] says as you step towards it with the crystal charm in hand. "Ya ain't gonna be needin' that none; this is an improvement on th' old idols that done existed couple centuries ago. Lemme jus' fiddle with th' permissions on this here thing an' ya'll be ready to go anytime ya like. Can't have jus' anyone portin' in an' out o' here, ya know." [dayNight|Miko|Mai] is good to her word; you're not exactly sure what she does, but there's a distinct surge of power in the air as the [dayNight|orange|gray]-furred shrine maiden touches one of the gate's posts and a shimmering portal of light appears in the empty air beneath the arch. "Safe travels, [pc.ra kitsune|yer Eminence," [dayNight|Miko|Mai] says as you pass by her and through the gate, bowing deeply|ya hear?" [dayNight|Miko|Mai] says as you pass by her and through the gate, bowing]. "Y'all come back here anytime — don't be a stranger, now!" [dayNight|Miko|Mai]'s words ring in your ears as the light envelopes you, and once more you find yourself in the Ways Between, familiar yet alien at the same time.
rows.translation: 你想用这个啊？鸟居大门，入口[pc.ra kitsune|阁下|你说是不是啊]？" [dayNight|米可|梅]当你手持水晶饰品走向它时，它发出了这样的声音。你根本不需要那些东西；这款新系统可比几百年前那些老版本的偶像系统先进多了。让我稍微调整一下这里的权限设置，等设置完成后，你们随时都可以开始使用了。毕竟不能随便让任何人随意进出这个系统，你知道的。 [dayNight|米可|梅]她确实守信用；虽然你不太清楚她具体做了什么，但当她出现的时候，空气中确实会弥漫着一股强大的能量。 [dayNight|橙子|灰色]那位身着毛皮的神社少女触碰了大门的其中一根柱子，顿时在拱门下方的空中出现了一道闪烁的光门。 旅途平安， [pc.ra kitsune|阁下， [dayNight|米可|梅]当你经过她身边并穿过大门时，你深深地鞠了一躬，说道：|你明白吗？ [dayNight|米可|梅]当你经过她身边并穿过大门时，你鞠了一躬，说道：]。 你们什么时候想回来都可以——别再当外人了，好吗！ [dayNight|米可|梅]当光芒将你笼罩时，他的话语仍在你耳边回响，而你又一次置身于那些“道路之间”——那些既熟悉又充满陌生感的场所。

rows.original: Travel to the Windy Peaks Courtyard.

Whoa there. 
    
    You suddenly lose your balance, gripping at your stomach as a sudden feeling of nausea grips you in turn. It feels like you're about to throw up, and you spend a bit of time hunched over and dry-heaving. By the time the feelings left, you're wondering if you could possibly be- nah, there's no way. You must've just eaten something bad.
rows.translation:
哇哦……
    
    你突然失去了平衡，双手紧紧抓住腹部，因为一阵突如其来的恶心感袭上了你。感觉自己马上就要吐出来了，于是你弯下腰干呕了好一会儿。等这种感觉终于消退后，你开始怀疑自己是否真的……不，不可能吧。肯定是吃了什么不好的东西才这样的。
rows.raw:
"
    Whoa there. 
    
    You suddenly lose your balance, gripping at your stomach as a sudden feeling of nausea grips you in turn. It feels like you're about to throw up, and you spend a bit of time hunched over and dry-heaving. By the time the feelings left, you're wondering if you could possibly be- nah, there's no way. You must've just eaten something bad.
    "

rows.original:
Alright. It's time to weigh the facts.

    Your stomach is getting bigger and more bloated by the day, making you feel more and more burdened each day, and your hunger is starting to get the better of you each day, not to mention your moods have been on the swing lately.
    
    Gods, there's no denying it, is there?
    
    You're pregnant.
    
    You wrack your mind trying to find out who or what it was that knocked you up, and find your thoughts constantly drifting to a certain wyld elf. The more you think about it, the more sure you are. You're carrying the spawn of that pointy-eared lover.
rows.translation:
好吧，是时候理一理事实了。

    你的肚子一天天变大、一天天胀起来，让你一天比一天更加不堪重负；而你的饥饿感也一天天开始压过你，更别提最近你的情绪还起伏不定。
    
    天啊，这没法否认，对吧？
    
    你怀孕了。
    
    你绞尽脑汁想弄清是谁、或者是什么东西搞大了你的肚子，思绪却总是不由自主地飘向某个荒野精灵。你越想，就越确信。你肚子里怀的是那个尖耳朵爱人的后代。
rows.raw:
"
    Alright. It's time to weigh the facts.

    Your stomach is getting bigger and more bloated by the day, making you feel more and more burdened each day, and your hunger is starting to get the better of you each day, not to mention your moods have been on the swing lately.
    
    Gods, there's no denying it, is there?
    
    You're pregnant.
    
    You wrack your mind trying to find out who or what it was that knocked you up, and find your thoughts constantly drifting to a certain wyld elf. The more you think about it, the more sure you are. You're carrying the spawn of that pointy-eared lover.
    "

rows.original:
Your body is going through it's natural changes.

    From your [pc.chest] getting bigger to your stomach expanding with each passing day, your body is doing what it needs to do to prepare for your coming offspring. Your swollen stomach is more than a burden for you when you need to move quickly. [pc.hasBreasts|Not to mention your sore, tender breasts; they take their toll on your body as well.]
    
    It's not just physical changes, however. You've found yourself having less control over your moods as of late. You're easily angered and prone to flights of laughter, and you're almost worried it's putting your companions on edge.
    
    And the hunger, by Gods the hunger.
    
    Everyday it's a new craving: chocolates, pickled eggs, potatoes fried and covered in cheese. It feels like your appetite is never sated. The precious life inside you is certainly hungry to say the least!
rows.translation:
你的身体正在经历它自然的生理变化。

    从你的[pc.chest]逐渐变大，到你的肚子随着每一天过去而隆起，你的身体正在做它必须做的事，为即将到来的孩子做好准备。当你需要快速行动时，肿胀的肚子对你来说远不只是负担。[pc.hasBreasts|更不用说你那又痛又敏感的乳房了；它们同样在损耗着你的身体。]
    
    然而，这并不只是身体上的变化。你发现自己近来对自己的情绪越来越缺乏控制。你很容易被激怒，也动不动就一阵大笑，你几乎担心这让同伴们感到紧张不安。
    
    还有那饥饿，天啊，那饥饿。
    
    每一天都是新的渴望：巧克力、腌鸡蛋、炸土豆盖上奶酪。感觉你的食欲永远得不到满足。你体内那条珍贵的生命，至少可以说是非常饥饿！

rows.original: Your stomach just keeps on getting bigger. Each day it grows more gravid to the point where you're barely able to move at more than a leisurely pace. No doubts your pregnancy is progressing normally, but you have plenty of time to spend before your offspring are out and in the world.
rows.translation: 你的肚子一天天变大，越来越像怀孕了，以至于你几乎只能以缓慢的速度移动。毫无疑问，你的孕期进展得很正常，但距离你的孩子出生还有很长一段时间。
rows.raw: "\n    Your stomach just keeps on getting bigger. Each day it grows more gravid to the point where you're barely able to move at more than a leisurely pace. No doubts your pregnancy is progressing normally, but you have plenty of time to spend before your offspring are out and in the world.\n    "

rows.original: Now, you can feel your coming child[var0|ren] kicking constantly and moving seemingly without stopping inside of you, and your stomach is so comically swollen your movement is reduced to a somewhat-speedy waddle. You're almost ready to give birth, and you know that for certain. Perhaps you should retire somewhere safe for the time being.
rows.translation: 现在，你已经能够感受到自己即将到来的孩子了，[var0|ren]这些东西在你体内不停地活动，似乎从未停止过，导致你的肚子胀得非常夸张，使得你的行动方式变成了那种速度还算快的摇摆步态。你快要分娩了，你对此非常清楚。或许，你现在应该去一个安全的地方暂避一阵吧。
