You're almost ready to give birth, and you know that for certain. Perhaps you should retire somewhere safe for the time being.\n "

rows.original:
Your gut lurches and you nearly collapse in pain, water wetting your legs. Grabbing your pregnant stomach, you hunch over and realize what's happening. 

    [atFH|Luckily for you, you're a short walk away from Gwyn and her area of expertise|[party.som|You manage to cry for help and get some assistance from the townsfolk in walking to Gwyn's nursery.|[companion.name] notices your struggle and quickly comes to your assistance, walking you towards Gwyn's nursery.|Your companion notices your struggle and quickly comes to your assistance, walking you towards Gwyn's nursery.]]
    
    After what feels like an eternity you finally make it to the nursery and soon find yourself in a comfortable bed with your legs spread and being prepared for labor. 
    
    It's a painful process that almost feels like it will last forever, but with the help of Gwyn and Cait, your pain is eased. The hours are still filled with pain, grunting, strain, and more yelling that leaves all in attendance exhausted.
    
    Finally, you're informed by Gwyn a head with two pointy ears has appeared between your legs, followed by a body, two legs, and two itty-bitty feet.
    
    [var0
        |You thought a modicum of relief might come to you after all that, but that's only one of your coming offspring. So, you must repeat the process one[var1|, if not more] time[var1|s] to birth your children. But, after the first of your young emerges and is carefully cleaned and swaddled, the rest come easy... or easier, at least.
        |You feel a wave of relief wash over your body as your child is born, and count yourself lucky that you don't have to repeat the process again. Taking in huge, heaving breaths, you let your body finally relax and watch on as Gwyn tends to your newborn, cleaning them off and wrapping them in clean cloth.
    ]
rows.translation:
你的腹部突然一阵剧痛，几乎疼得你瘫倒在地，汗水浸湿了你的双腿。你用手捂住隆起的腹部，弯下腰来，这才意识到发生了什么。 

    [atFH|对你来说，幸运的是，你只需步行一小段距离就能找到格温以及她所擅长的领域。|[party.som|你设法呼救，得到了镇上居民的帮助，一起走到了格温的托儿所。|[companion.name]注意到你的困难后，迅速前来帮助你，带你走向格温的婴儿房。|你的同伴注意到了你的困境，迅速前来帮助你，陪你走向格温的婴儿房。]]
    
    仿佛过了漫长的时间，你终于来到了产房，很快就被安置在一张舒适的床上，双腿被分开，准备开始分娩。
    
    这个过程非常痛苦，感觉似乎永远都不会结束，但在格温和凯特的帮助下，你的痛苦得到了缓解。那些个小时里，到处都是痛苦、呻吟、挣扎，还有不断的喊叫声，让在场的所有人都精疲力竭。
    
    最后，格温告诉你：在你的两腿之间出现了一个长着两只尖耳朵的脑袋，接着是一具身体、两条腿和两只小小的足部。
    
    [var0
        |你原本以为经历了这一切之后，自己总该得到一些缓解吧，但实际上，这只是你即将面临的一系列问题中的一个而已。因此，你不得不再次重复这个过程。[var1|甚至更多]时间[var1|]生下你的孩子。但是，当第一个孩子出生后，经过仔细的清洁和包裹，接下来的孩子就变得容易多了……至少是相对容易一些吧。
        |当你的孩子出生时，你会感到一股如释重负的感觉涌上心头，也会庆幸自己不必再经历这个过程了。你深深地吸了几口气，让身体终于放松下来，然后看着格温照顾你的新生儿——她为婴儿清理身体，再用干净的布将他们包裹起来。
    ]

rows.original: By the time all is said and done, you've birthed [var1] healthy elflette[var0|s], now quietly sleeping in your arms and swaddled and warm cloth. Although your journey and aventures are hardly at an end, you need to rest for now, but you can do so in the company of your newborn child[var0|ren], happy and safe with their [pc.mf|mother|father].
rows.translation: 当一切尘埃落定之时，你已生下了[var1]个健康的精灵幼崽[var0|]，她们此刻正安静地睡在你的怀里，被温暖舒适的布料包裹着。虽然你的旅程和冒险远未结束，但此刻你确实需要休息了——不过你可以在你[var0|ren]新生儿的陪伴下休息，与他们[pc.mf|母亲|父亲]在一起，快乐而安全。
rows.raw: "\n        By the time all is said and done, you've birthed [var1] healthy elflette[var0|s], now quietly sleeping in your arms and swaddled and warm cloth. Although your journey and aventures are hardly at an end, you need to rest for now, but you can do so in the company of your newborn child[var0|ren], happy and safe with their [pc.mf|mother|father].\n        "

rows.original: A sudden, sharp bout of nausea brings you to a dead stop, willing your roiling insides to calm. With your [pc.hand] placed on your belly in a reflexive attempt at settling your nausea, you don't miss the firmness that wasn't there previously. It could be nothing, but you remember the wyvern boy you recently tussled with and know it could also very much be something else.
rows.translation: 一阵突如其来的强烈恶心令你猛然停下，只盼腹中翻江倒海的感觉能平息下来。 你下意识地把[pc.hand]按在腹部，试图压下恶心感，却立即察觉到了一种先前并不存在的硬实感。 这也许什么都不是，但你想起最近曾与那个飞龙男孩纠缠过，也清楚这很可能意味着另一回事。

rows.original: The increasingly larger swell of your baby bump puts to rest any doubt you had about being pregnant. Even if your growing belly wasn't enough proof for you, the cravings would have been enough to assuage any lingering doubt. There's this burning need to fuck, and just keep fucking until all the heat is gone. Anytime you accidentally put pressure on the growing swell of your pregnant belly, sharp pangs of desire shoot through your spine, compelling you to chase something and fuck it until the need is sated. Resting a [pc.hand] against your belly, you take the moment to stroke where your body gives way to the growth of the egg within you and smile.
rows.translation: 你逐渐凸出的孕肚已经彻底消除了你对自己是否真的怀孕所抱有的任何疑虑。 即使你日益增大的腹部还不能让你确信这一点，那么渴望也足以打消任何残存的疑虑了。 你体内燃烧着一股强烈的操的渴望，只想一直操下去，直到那股燥热全部散去。每当你不小心压到日益隆起的孕肚，一阵阵尖锐的欲望便会窜过你的脊椎，迫使你去追逐某种东西，并且一直做爱，直到这种欲望得到满足。 你将一只[pc.hand]搭在肚子上，趁着这一刻抚摸着身体因体内那颗蛋的生长而隆起的地方，微微一笑。

Even if your growing belly wasn't enough proof for you, the cravings would have been enough to assuage any lingering doubt. rows.original: The egg in your womb makes no movement, yet somehow you simply know that everything is going the way it needs to. Your hips ache, widening as your child grows. The pangs tell you everything you need to know about the way your body is preparing itself for the birth of your child, yet you can't help but dig your knuckles into the sore dip of your lower back. Despite not being to term, your midsection is already large, impossible to hide beneath garments even if you wanted to. Pausing to rest just a moment, you let yourself breathe deep, egg pressing on your insides and making it difficult to properly maneuver the way you need to. You can already tell that this one is going to be a little troublemaker. The birth can't come soon enough.
rows.translation: 你子宫里的那颗蛋毫无动静，然而你却依然知道一切都在按预定的方向发展。 随着孩子的成长，你的臀部在变宽，隐隐作痛。这一阵阵的酸痛告诉了你所需知道的一切：你的身体正在为孩子的降生做准备。然而，你还是忍不住会用指关节去按压腰部那疼痛的部位。虽然还没到足月，但你的腹部已经变得相当大了，即使你想通过衣物来遮盖，也根本无法隐藏。 你暂停片刻休息，深吸一口气，却发现那颗蛋挤压着你的内脏，让你难以按需要的方式活动身体。 你已经能感觉到，这个家伙肯定会惹些麻烦……希望他能尽快出生吧。

The pangs tell you everything you need to know about the way your body is preparing itself for the birth of your child, yet you can't help but dig your knuckles into the sore dip of your lower back. Despite not being to term, your midsection is already large, impossible to hide beneath garments even if you wanted to. Pausing to rest just a moment, you let yourself breathe deep, egg pressing on your insides and making it difficult to properly maneuver the way you need to. You can already tell that this one is going to be a little troublemaker. The birth can't come soon enough. "

rows.original: A sharp contraction wracks through your belly, announcing the impending birth of your child. You waddle towards
rows.translation: 一阵剧烈的阵痛袭来，预示着你的孩子即将出生。你摇摇晃晃地朝着……走去。
rows.raw: "\n    A sharp contraction wracks through your belly, announcing the impending birth of your child. You waddle towards"

rows.original:
Gwyn's nursery, rushing as quickly as your engorged body will let you.
    
    You meet Cait and Gwyn in the nursery as they usher you towards a proper, suitably private spot. They move around you with precise, practiced movements, gathering the needed materials while you breathe between contractions. 
    
    The birth itself is a blur of pain and pushing, passing by in what feels both like seconds and years. In the end, you cradle a soft-shelled yet quickly hardening egg, still warm from its time within your body. 
    
    You can't suppress an exhausted yawn, body demanding rest as it all but forces you towards sleep. In the last moments of lucidity, you can feel warm, furry paws gently coax the egg from your arms. Gentle hushes return the faint noise of protest that slips from your mouth, and then all is dark.
rows.translation:
格温的婴儿室里，你以自己所能承受的最快速度奔跑着。
    
    在婴儿室里，你遇到了凯特和格温，她们将你引向一个既合适又私密的地方。她们动作娴熟、精准，一边在你身边忙碌着收集所需的物品，一边让你在阵痛的间隙稍作休息。 
    
    分娩的过程充满了痛苦与挣扎，那些瞬间仿佛既像几秒钟那么短暂，又像几年那么漫长。最终，你怀中抱着一个外壳柔软、但很快就会变硬的蛋，它还带着在你体内时留下的温暖。
    
    你忍不住打了一个疲惫的哈欠，身体迫切地需要休息，几乎是在强迫你进入睡眠状态。在最后的清醒时刻，你能感觉到温暖而柔软的爪子正轻轻地将鸡蛋从你的怀里取走。轻柔的安抚声让那些从你口中发出的微弱抗议声消失了，随后，一切都陷入了暗影。

rows.original:
When you wake, it takes several long minutes for you to properly place where you are. Your mind slowly catches up with the rest of you, the panging soreness of your body quickly making itself known as you shift in place.
        
        Looking around the area of the nursery where you've been tucked in and left to sleep, you see a deep green shelled egg sitting warmly in a straw-lined incubator, safe and sound.
        
        Pushing yourself up, you begin tugging on your [pc.gear], laying neat and folded beside your resting spot. You've been properly cleaned up, and there's a small cup of water laying near you that you swiftly drink down once noticed. 
        
        Once you've properly collected yourself — and stopped to check on the egg with your still growing child inside — you head outside and into the Frosthound across the way. You've got stuff to do.
rows.translation:
醒来时，你花了好几分钟才真正弄清自己在哪儿。你的意识慢慢追上身体的其他部分，你一挪动身子，浑身的酸痛便立刻显现出来。
        
        你环顾育婴室里自己被人安顿下来睡觉的那片区域，看见一枚深绿色外壳的蛋暖洋洋地待在铺着稻草的孵化器里，安然无恙。
        
        你撑起身子，开始拉扯自己的[pc.gear]——它整整齐齐地叠放在你休息处旁边。你已经被人仔细清理干净，身旁还放着一小杯水，你一注意到就立刻喝光了。
        
        等你完全整理好自己——又停下来看了看那枚里面装着你仍在成长中的孩子的蛋——你便出门，走进对面的寒霜猎犬。你还有事要做。

rows.original: There's a part of you that just knows it'll be soon. You quickly wrap up what you're doing and make your way to the nursery in Hawkethorne where you'll soon meet a brand new, scaly little family member. Gwyn beckons to you when you slip into the building, guiding you towards the incubator where a green shelled egg twitches and cracks as the little one fights their way out. A tiny, clawed foot shoves its way through the eggshell, wiggling about in surprise before the rest of the shell quickly meets the same fate. A soft-scaled child sits in the straw bewildered, with some small remains of eggshell perched on the top of their head. You can't help but beam at your child, listening to the soft coos and grunts that come from the baby currently gumming at the end of an uncoordinated tail. After some time you pull yourself away, saying temporary goodbyes as you drag yourself out the door.
rows.translation: 你内心有个部分，就是知道很快就会到了。 你迅速完成手头的工作，然后前往鹰棘镇的育婴室，在那里你很快就会见到一位全新的、长满鳞片的小家庭成员。 当你走进育婴室时，格温向你招手，引导你走向孵化器。在那里，一个绿色的蛋壳正在不停地蠕动、破裂，小生命正在努力破壳而出。 一只小小的、长着爪子的脚从蛋壳中探了出来，惊慌地扭动着，不久之后，整个蛋壳也跟着被挤破了。一个长着柔软鳞片的幼崽困惑地坐在草堆里，头上还沾着一些蛋壳的残渣。 当你听到婴儿发出那些轻柔的咿呀声和咕噜声时，你不禁会露出幸福的笑容，因为那婴儿正在啃咬着一根长短不一的尾巴。 过了一会儿，你才勉强拉开自己的注意力，边说着暂时性的告别，边拖着脚步走出了门去。
rows.raw: " There's a part of you that just knows it'll be soon. You quickly wrap up what you're doing and make your way to the nursery in Hawkethorne where you'll soon meet a brand new, scaly little family member. Gwyn beckons to you when you slip into the building, guiding you towards the incubator where a green shelled egg twitches and cracks as the little one fights their way out. A tiny, clawed foot shoves its way through the eggshell, wiggling about in surprise before the rest of the shell quickly meets the same fate. A soft-scaled child sits in the straw bewildered, with some small remains of eggshell perched on the top of their head. You can't help but beam at your child, listening to the soft coos and grunts that come from the baby currently gumming at the end of an uncoordinated tail. After some time you pull yourself away, saying temporary goodbyes as you drag yourself out the door. "

rows.original: [flags.GIANNA_CARAVAN_MET |You’re caught off guard by a familiar metal chirp in the distance, and cautiously approach its origin. The caravan’s driver seems to sense you; the bundle of rags is already turning eerily to face you before waving. The incredibly loud, cheerful, female voice of Gianna calls out. "'Lo there, [pc.name]! Looking to be a customer?" |A strange, metallic chirping sounds from the path up ahead, out of place compared to the ambiance of nature. [party.som|You opt for caution, carefully approaching its source|You share a glance with [companion.name], nodding before approaching carefully|You share a look with your companions, and you all get low before approaching cautiously]. There’s another metallic, ringing chirp. The origin of the sound is easily spotted... indeed, how it got even remotely close to you without being spotted is beyond you. At first glance — if you were incredibly far away — it would look like a caravan. The closer you get, the more that seems like an understatement. It’s certainly shaped like a caravan, albeit it’s long, and riding on eight wheels... How does it even get around? Instead of being pulled by beasts, a large cat made of stone and metal is lashed onto the front. The body of the caravan itself is brightly painted wood, covered in arcane runes; they glitter whenever the sun touches upon them. The metallic chirp happens again, and you see that there’s a metal bird perched on the driver’s seat. Right beside... someone, you can’t really make them out well underneath a large bundle of rags and scarves. As though your thoughts had drawn their attention, the figure’s head (or so you assume) turns to where you watch them from. "'Lo there! Customer?" a hand pokes out of the fabric, and the voice is loud and feminine. Customer? When you walk towards them, the owner of the caravan hops off the chair and slams a fist on the wall. For a brief moment you half-expect a horde of outrageous magical bandits to come pouring out, but the entire carriage-wall glows for a moment before opening upwards, turning into an awning and revealing two more figures sat behind little desks. That... must be quite some magic. ]
rows.translation: [flags.GIANNA_CARAVAN_MET |远处突然传来一阵熟悉的金属碰撞声，你不由得有些措手不及，便小心翼翼地朝着声源走去。商队的车夫似乎察觉到了你的存在；那个用破布包裹着的包裹竟然突然转向你的方向，然后开始挥手。吉安娜那极其响亮、充满活力的女声响起：“喂，那边[pc.name]想成为我们的顾客吗？ |前方的小路上传来一种奇怪的金属声，这种声音与大自然的环境完全不协调。 [party.som|你选择了谨慎的态度，小心翼翼地探寻它的来源。|与你对视一眼[companion.name]他点了点头，然后小心翼翼地走了过去。|你与同伴对视一眼，然后都低下身子，小心翼翼地靠近。]又传来一阵金属般的、清脆的鸣叫声。声源很容易就被发现……不过，它究竟是如何在未被察觉的情况下靠近你的，这就实在让人费解了。 乍一看——如果你距离它非常远的话——它会看起来像一支商队。而当你逐渐靠近时，才会发现这种描述其实远远不够贴切。它确实被塑造成某种形态就像一支商队一样，虽然它很长，而且是由八轮车组成的……它是如何移动的呢？并不是由牲畜来拉动的，而是在一辆车的前面绑着一头由石头和金属制成的巨型猫。 这支商队的车身是由色彩鲜艳的木头制成的，上面刻满了神秘的符文；每当阳光照射在这些符文上时，它们就会闪闪发光。那种金属般的鸣叫声再次响起，你看到有一只金属鸟停在了驾驶座上。就在……某个人的旁边，不过在那一大堆破布和围巾的遮盖下，你实在看不清楚那个人的样貌。 仿佛你的思绪吸引了它们的注意，那个身影的头部（至少你是这么认为的）转向了你正在注视的方向。喂！有顾客吗？”一只手从布料后面伸了出来，那声音响亮而带有女性特征。顾客？ 当你朝他们走去时，商队的主人从椅子上跳下来，一拳砸在墙上。有那么一瞬间，你甚至以为会有一群凶残的魔法强盗冲出来，但墙面上突然亮了起来，随后向上翻开，变成了一个遮阳篷，露出了另外两个人，他们正坐在小桌子后面。那……肯定是一种非常强大的魔法吧。 ]

rows.original: The figure in rags and scarves watches you approach, leaning gently back once it becomes apparent that you aren’t going to be drawing your weapons on them. The moment you’re within a few yards of the caravan, it feels warm and comfortable... Although you’ve now figured out what the runes that cover the vehicle are for, the person underneath all of that clothing must be boiling hot. "Hey there stranger! Name’s Gianna, and this is my Caravan of Wonders!" The female voice that pipes out is entirely at odds with the menacing shadow of the robes that conceal her. She throws her arms out in a sweeping gesture, and you catch a glimpse of pale gray skin. [pc.dcb|"Mmn. Name’s [pc.name].|"Oh, I’m [pc.name].|"Ah! I’m [pc.name]! Nice to meet you!] [party.som||This is [companion.name]."|These two are [companion1.name] and [companion2.name]."] "A pleasure. Oh, also I go by Gia sometimes. No last name though! I know, super spooky. Anyways; over there in the body of the caravan are my fuck-buddies!" There’s a call of something that sounds suspiciously like 'fuck you!’ from within the caravan, but Gia only giggles. "No, but really. We can do the whole spiel. Also come get a drink! Every first time customer gets a free drink!" You’re grabbed at the arm with a surprisingly powerful grip and led under the awning of the garish, many-wheeled monstrosity. A tall, lithe man is leant back in an overstuffed chair that clings to his entire body. Soft-looking gray fur covers the majority of his chest and arms but for a handsome face, and large mouse ears sprout from the top of scruffy hair of a similar gray. His clothing itself appears to be more like a loose assortment of messy, greasy rags, from out which pokes a long thick rat’s tail that wraps around his waist. Shelves of miscellany keep him very much trapped in his spot, amidst a great deal of shiny bronze. "Hey there [party.som|traveler|travelers|travelers], name's Svern. I'm the junk rat—" he’s interrupted by a whisper of 'mouse' from Gia, sighing before continuing. "Rat around here, and most of my time is spent keeping this marvel of magic and metal moving. I do occasionally tinker up some fun stuff, though." You can practically sense Gia rolling her eyes at that, before guiding you over to the other seated figure. It’s a catgirl, no doubt. She has a thin pink veil hiding her mouth, and cute little purple kitty ears poking out from long shaggy purple hair. She’s got a perky C-cup chest barely concealed by a tiny bra beneath a silken shirt so thin it’s almost see through, and even as you inspect her she slips a flask beneath her veil and takes a swig. To her left is a set of tightly-bound alchemical goods, and on the right is a stove and oven. Barrels of goodness-knows-what and a rack of mystery spices are lined up behind her and seem to use the majority of the caravan’s space. "Hey there! Name’s Tamarind, I’m the Caravan’s resident Alchemikitty." Gia nods, sounding proud while you’re busy gawping at the whole vehicle-slash-shopfront. "It took a long time between the three of us to get all the runes right... uh, especially ones that keep all the bottles from smashing and exploding." She slaps a hand down noisily into her palm. "Also, Tammy here brews all of the booze!" The catgirl pouts, adjusting her veil and twitching her cute little kitty-ears. "I hate that nickname. And sure, get excited about the alcohol instead of my incredible works of alchemy instead. Oh, right— speaking of..." she reaches under the counter, pulling out [party.som|a fist-sized wooden cup with a lid on it.|a couple of fist-sized, lidded wooden cups.|a few fist-sized, lidded wooden cups.] "Ale on the house. Enjoy!" Gia gives you a thumbs up, and you accept the drink curiously. With a shrug, you pop open the little wooden lid and drink it down, delighted to find it’s a rush of bitterness followed by fizzy sweetness. It’s a shame the drink is so small, because now it’s settling comfortably in your stomach... heck, you’re feeling a little bit tougher after that. Bring it on, world.
rows.translation: 那个身披破衣、戴着围巾的身影注视着你靠近，当你明显没有打算拔出武器攻击他们时，它便轻轻地向后靠去。当你距离商队只有几码远的时候，那里显得温暖而舒适。虽然你现在已经弄清楚了那些覆盖在车辆上的符文是用来做什么的，但穿着那么多衣服的人下面肯定热得要命吧。” “嘿，陌生人！我叫吉安娜，这是我的‘奇迹大篷车’！那个清晰响亮的女声，与她身上那件遮住身形的阴森长袍所营造出的威胁感截然不符。她突然伸出双臂，做了一个幅度很大的动作，这时你才能隐约看到她那苍白灰白的皮肤。 [pc.dcb|嗯……我叫[pc.name]。|哦，我是[pc.name]。|啊！我是[pc.name]，很高兴认识你！] [party.som||这就是[companion.name]。“|这两位是[companion1.name]和[companion2.name]。”] 很高兴认识你。哦，有时候我也用‘吉娅’这个名字来称呼自己。不过我没有姓氏哦！我知道，这听起来有点诡异吧……总之，商队队伍里的那些人就是我的好朋友们！去你的！从商队内部传来了声音，但吉娅只是咯咯笑了起来。“不，说真的。我们可以把整个介绍过程都讲一遍。而且来喝杯东西吧！每位首次光顾的顾客都可以免费获得一杯饮料！” 突然，有人用出惊人的力气抓住了你的手臂，然后将你领到了那辆色彩鲜艳、轮子众多的怪异车辆下的遮阳处。 一个高大而身形矫健的男子靠在一把过于宽大的椅子上，椅子紧紧贴合着他的身体。他的大部分胸部和手臂都被柔软的灰色毛发覆盖，唯有那张英俊的面孔显露在外；而同样呈灰色的杂乱头发中，还长着一对大大的老鼠耳朵。他的衣服看起来更像是一堆凌乱、油腻的破布，其中还有一根长长的、粗粗的“老鼠尾巴”从那些破布中露出来，绕在了他的腰上。各种杂乱物品把他牢牢地束缚在了那个地方，而周围则摆满了闪闪发光的青铜器。嘿，你好啊。 [party.som|旅行者|旅行者们|旅行者们]我叫斯文，大家都叫我“垃圾鼠”——就在这时，一阵低语声打断了他。鼠标吉娅叹了口气，然后继续说道：“在这儿忙来忙去，我大部分时间都在维护这个由魔法与金属构成的奇迹。不过，偶尔我也会捣鼓一些有趣的东西。” 你能想象到吉娅在说这些话时肯定是在翻白眼吧，然后她便带你走向了另一个坐着的人。毫无疑问，她是一个猫娘。她戴着一层薄薄的粉色面纱遮住嘴巴，而从那头浓密蓬乱的紫色头发中，露出两只可爱的紫色小猫耳朵。她那傲人的C罩杯胸部几乎被一件薄得几乎透明的丝绸衬衫遮住了，而就在你仔细观察她的时候，她突然将一个小水壶藏在面纱下面，喝了一口。在她左边，放着一堆包装严实的炼金物品；右边则有一台炉子和一个烤箱。在她身后，排列着一桶桶不知是什么的东西，以及一架架装满各种神秘香料的架子，这些似乎占据了商队里大部分的空间。嘿，大家好！我叫塔玛琳德，是这个商队的驻队炼金猫。 吉娅点了点头，语气中带着自豪，而你则一直目不转睛地盯着那整个被改造成了商店的车子。“我们三个人花了很长时间才把所有的符文都配置正确……尤其是那些能够防止那些瓶子破碎或爆炸的符文。”她大声地拍了一下自己的手掌。“而且，这里的塔米负责酿造所有的酒！ 猫娘撅着嘴，调整着自己的面纱，同时抽动着那对可爱的小猫耳朵。“我讨厌那个外号。对了，你们应该为酒而兴奋才对，而不是为我那些了不起的炼金术成果。哦，对了——说到这个……”她伸手到柜台下面，拿出了[party.som|一个拳头大小的、带有盖子的木杯。|几个拳头大小、带有盖子的木杯。|几个拳头大小的、带有盖子的木杯。]不过这杯酒是免费的，请享用吧！” 吉亚向你竖起了大拇指，你好奇地接过了这杯饮料。耸了耸肩，你打开了那个小木盖，喝了一口——首先感受到的是一阵苦味，紧接着便是那种泡沫般的甜味。真可惜这杯酒的量太少了，否则现在它应该已经在你的胃里慢慢发挥作用了…… 见鬼，经历那些事后，你感觉自己变得坚强多了吧。来吧，世界，让我看看你的实力！

rows.original: See what the 'Junkrat' has to offer.

rows.translation: 来看看炼金猫的商品吧。

rows.original:
[pc.dcb|"Sure, fuck it."|"I just might be..."|"Oh! Yes! Totes!"]

    Although you can’t see Gianna’s smile beneath the bundle of rags, you can certainly sense it as she waves you closer. After a quick slap on the side of her mystical vehicle, out folds the now-familiar awning with its lovely shop display. The smell of food wafts into your nose, having you [party.som|immediately salivating in anticipation.|and [companion.name] salivating in anticipation.|and your companions salivating hungrily in anticipation of tasty treats.]

    Svern and Tamarind give you grins and waves, taking up positions at their fancy seats.

[pc.dcb|好吧，管它呢。|我也许真的……|哦！对！完全同意！]

    虽然你看不见吉安娜那层破布下面露出的笑容，但当她招手让你靠近时，你肯定能感受到那份喜悦。她轻轻拍了拍她那辆神秘的交通工具，顿时，那个你已经熟悉了的遮阳篷就展开了，上面还装饰着漂亮的店铺标识。食物的香气飘进了你的鼻孔，让你立刻[party.som|一想到这个，我就立刻流口水了。|以及[companion.name]期待得直流口水。|而你的同伴也急切地流着口水，期待着那些美味的零食。]

    斯文和塔玛琳德向你微笑致意，然后各自坐到了他们那些精美的座位上。

rows.original: Okay, you’ll bite; you have no idea how one gets an incredibly magical caravan to just turn up places. When you pose the question to Gianna, she hums curiously, and the back of her robes set to rustling. She mulls over the concept, folding her arms, before finally taking a deep breath to answer. "Magic!" [pc.dcb|"I’m... more interested in the how of that."|"Okay, yes. I figured that part out. but how does the magic work?"|"No silly! Well, yes, magic. But how does the magic do the thing?"] Gia leans back against the caravan and sighs, before yawning and revealing the glimmer of [dayNight|sun|moon]light reflecting from sharp teeth. "I’m an accomplished writer of runes, or I’d not even be here. This caravan’s basically a part of me, and is as indestructible as... Well, as me." She reaches into the bundle of cloth and rubs her chin, fidgeting for a moment. "Runes are an art, and a... math... thing. I’m incredibly good at writing runes, but I’m crap at writing the correct... math... thing for them." Gianna shrugs, standing straight and fidgeting. "Thankfully our resident cat’n’mouse duo have some sweet thinking-meat in their noggins." She hops from foot to foot giddily. "So, a bunch of experimenting later, a little bit of mechanical work, and some banditry-of-bandits, we had everything we needed for my pride and joy!" "You went bandit hunting?" "Uhm... No?" There’s a muffled 'snikt' underneath her robes and you catch a hint of sharp, bright teeth. Right... "I always wanted freedom. But freedom without a goal is just aimless, sad-person stuff. Didn't want that! No m'dear I did not. I got away from my old... uh, 'home' — and no I'm not telling that story — and decided I liked the romance of wandering and helping adventurers." She stretches — giving you a glimpse of her gray flesh — hopping on the spot afterwards. "Anything else dear?"
rows.translation: 好吧，你就问问看；你完全不明白怎样才能让一辆魔法强得离谱的商队马车随意出现在各个地方。你向吉安娜提出问题，她好奇地哼了一声，长袍后摆随即沙沙作响。她抱起双臂，仔细琢磨这个概念，最后深吸一口气回答：“魔法！” [pc.dcb|“我……更想知道的是这件事怎么做到。”|“好吧，没错。这一点我已经猜到了。但魔法是如何运作的？”|“不是啦，笨蛋！好吧，的确是魔法。但魔法究竟怎样做到这件事？”] 吉娅靠上商队马车，叹息一声，随后打了个哈欠；[dayNight|日|月]光在她锋利的牙齿上闪烁。“我是一名造诣高深的符文书写者，否则根本不会在这里。这辆马车基本算是我的一部分，而且和……嗯，和我一样坚不可摧。”她把手伸进层叠布料里，揉着下巴，烦躁地动了片刻。“符文是一门艺术，也是某种……数学……玩意儿。书写符文我厉害得不得了，可要给它们写出正确的……数学……玩意儿，我可烂透了。”吉安娜耸耸肩，站直身体，仍不安地动来动去。“幸好我们常驻的猫鼠组合脑袋里装着十分灵光的思考肉。” 她兴奋得双脚交替蹦跳。“所以，在大量实验、少许机械加工，还有对强盗实施一点强盗行为以后，我们终于凑齐了打造我这件得意珍宝所需的一切！” “你们去猎杀强盗了？” “呃……没有吧？”她的长袍下传来一声含混的“嗤啦”，你还瞥见了一线锋利明亮的牙齿。好吧…… “我一直渴望自由。但没有目标的自由，只是漫无目的、令人悲伤的东西。我可不想要！不，亲爱的，我一点也不想。我逃离了以前的……呃，‘家’——而且我不会讲那个故事——然后发现自己很喜欢四处漂泊、帮助冒险者的浪漫生活。” 她伸了个懒腰，让你得以瞥见灰色肌肤，随后又在原地跳了起来。“还有别的问题吗，亲爱的？”

rows.original: "Tell me about yourself, Svern." The mouse boy runs a hand through his short, scruffy hair. "Uuuuh. Crap, I don’t know what there is to tell, [pc.name]. I grew up next to a noble who had a good book collection, and then got apprenticed to a smith... then a mage." He pronounces 'mage' with a slow drawl, clicking his tongue afterwards. "Turns out those combined sources of knowledge are pretty decent! I came across Gia a few years back, wracking her little brain around actually making this all work... uh, I left. Seemed like too much trouble." He pauses and clears his throat, knocking gently on the partition built into the caravan that keeps him separated from Tamarind’s workplace. A few moments later a tankard is passed around to him, and he takes a slow mouthful before sighing in relief. "That wasn't our last meeting though! She 'dealt' with a few bandits and I felt compelled to help her out... uh, Tammy over there’s a dingus but we got along well enough. Keeping everything running is interesting, I’m making good money... can’t complain." "What do you mean she dealt with some bandits?" Svern blinks, nibbling his lip for a moment. "Uuuh, tore the lot of 'em to shreds, bud. Aaaanyway, want to buy anything? I've got some stuff to suit the more... perverse clientele, and a bunch of other random bits and pieces."
rows.translation: 介绍一下你自己吧，斯文。” 那个老鼠男孩用手捋了捋自己那头短而凌乱的头发，说道：“呃……该死，我其实不知道该说些什么呢。 [pc.name]我在一位拥有丰富藏书的高贵人士家附近长大，后来成为了铁匠的学徒……后来又成为了法师。”他这样说道。法师他拖着缓慢的腔调说着，说完后还舔了舔舌头。“原来这些不同的知识来源结合起来效果还挺不错的！几年前我遇到了吉娅，当时她正在绞尽脑汁想办法让这一切真正发挥作用……呃，后来我就离开了。看来麻烦有点太大了。” 他停顿了一下，清了清嗓子，然后轻轻敲了敲商队中那道将他的工作区域与塔玛琳德的工作区隔开的隔板。过了一会儿，有人把一个酒壶递给了他，他慢慢地喝了一口，这才松了一口气。不过，那并不是我们最后一次见面！她成交有几个强盗，我觉得自己有义务帮她摆脱困境……呃，那边的塔米有点古怪，不过我们相处得还挺不错。维持一切正常运转其实挺有意思的，我赚的钱也挺多的……没什么可抱怨的。” “你的意思是，她把那些强盗都解决了？” 斯文眨了眨眼，咬了咬嘴唇说道：“嗯，把他们全都揍得屁滚尿流，伙计。总之，想买点什么吗？我有一些适合那些……比较特殊需求的顾客的商品，还有其他一些零零碎碎的小东西。

rows.original:
"Going already?" Svern asks, blinking a few times before leaning under his counter to pull out a drink. He takes a slow mouthful and nods. "Guess we’ll be headed off too then."

        You step back and out of the way, watching as they begin to pack up and fold away their shops into the magical caravan. It only takes a minute for the trio to be ready, and soon enough Gianna is perched up in her seat.
        
        The last thing you hear is the metal chirping of their magical caravan as it rides off into the distance.
rows.translation:
“这就要走了？”斯文问着眨了几下眼，然后弯腰从柜台下拿出一杯饮料。他慢慢喝了一口，点了点头。“那我们也该出发了。”

        你退后一步让开路，看着他们开始收拾摊子，把店铺折起来收进那辆魔法商队篷车里。三个人只用了一分钟就准备妥当，很快吉安娜就坐到了自己的位子上。
        
        你最后听到的，是他们那辆魔法商队篷车驶向远方时金属般的鸣响。

Its main body consists of a large brass cylinder, a detachable glass receptacle at the bottom, and two long slime-latex hoses that snake out like grasping appendages. rows.translation: 斯文愣了一下，然后露出尴尬的笑容，挠了挠后脑勺说道：“哦，对。那个仔细观察这台机器，会发现它引发的问题远多于它所提供的答案——它的构造与吉安娜的旅行车相同，同样是一件精美的金属工艺品，看起来确实相当复杂。它的主体由一个大型黄铜圆筒、下装的一个可拆卸玻璃容器，以及两条像触手一样延伸出来的长软胶管组成。从它们末端那些显然是用来固定配件的黄铜环来看，这个猜测或许并不太离谱…… 机器的其余部分看起来都很普通，唯一可以用来与之交互的部件就是几个按钮和一个非常大的杠杆。看到你的注意力从他身上转移到他的创作上，斯维恩的紧张感愈发加剧，于是这个机械师清了清嗓子，说道： “那么，这是什么？[pc.isBimbo | 这看起来确实是一件能让人们玩得非常开心的事情！ 斯文顿时愣住了——他实在不太擅长掩饰自己的情绪，而你似乎说到了点子上。“嗯，其实并不是这样意思是只是为了好玩而已，不过如果大家想用它来达到这个目的，那也是可以的…… 哦！原来如此！是好的！ | 呃，其实……”斯文顿时有些结巴——他果然不太擅长隐藏自己的情绪，不是吗？“只是我刚才突然想到的一个主意，而已。” 他的行为比他的言语更能说明问题，至少足以让人继续追问下去。而这个主意是什么呢？如果可以这么说的话，它看起来确实是一件相当精巧的“人工制品”。 ] 啊，其实吧，我这个人有点邋遢，每次做完工作后，吉安娜小姐总是提醒我要把工作区清理干净。那些灰尘、碎屑和金属屑真的很难打扫，所以我在想，能不能设计个装置，把它们都吸进去，然后收集到垃圾桶里，等以后再处理掉。一开始我遇到了一些问题——你知道，为了保证吸力顺畅，我就必须让吸管保持直立状态，但这样一来，吸管很快就会被堵塞，导致设备在很短的时间内就无法正常使用了。我花了很长时间试图找到解决办法，终于找到了，就在这时—— [pc.isBimbo |哦，他明明是在试图转移你的注意力，让你偏离这个话题，但你可比他聪明多了！那么，人们到底是怎么通过这个东西来获得乐趣的呢？ |是啊，他只是在故作掩饰，用一堆无关紧要的话来迷惑你。他难道就不愿意直截了当地说明白吗？ ] 被逼得无处可逃，就像一只老鼠一样，斯文叹了口气，肩膀耷拉了下来。“好吧，好吧，其实就是一台挤奶机。” “一台挤奶机，”他说。 “没错。只是想让你知道，这个主意不是我想的——塔玛琳看到我用这个东西来打扫卫生，立刻就想到了这个办法。这些杯子现在还不在手上，使用之间你必须把它们清洗干净并进行蒸汽消毒，这样才能确保它们得到彻底清洁。幸运的是，这种黏液乳胶材质相当耐用。不过，塔玛琳德确实提出了一些建议——你只需要把杯子装上去，然后我按下按钮、打开开关，就可以开始使用了。于是，他接受了她的建议，甚至对自己的清洁设备进行了修改，直到 “你看，她就是这么做的。真的我极力推荐这个想法，吉安娜小姐也觉得不错。我还能说什么呢？不？不行吗？直播在这里， [pc.name]确实，他对这件事表现得相当 defensive，但你会觉得，再继续刺激可怜的斯文的话，也不会让他说出更多有用的信息。 [pc.isDK |也许稍后吧。 ]所以……其实就是一台挤奶机，对吧？ “一台功能非常专门的挤奶机。乳房挤奶机，”斯文一边点头一边叹息道，“塔玛琳德和吉安娜小姐对此要求非常明确。使用方法很简单——把奶杯连接到软管上，然后把需要挤奶的人放在奶杯上，拉动杠杆，机器就会开始工作。中间确实有一些繁琐的细节，但对于被挤奶的人来说，这些其实并不需要了解。” 人们就是这么使用的吗？ 斯文双臂交叉抱在胸前，不知从哪里找来了几分坚毅：“嗯，就是这样。通常情况下我本来可以收费的，但既然[flags.GIANNA_WF |你在我们那里让我们做了不少生意，我想你可以把这也看作是我们应得的一部分回报吧。 |您真是位非常不错的顾客，我就免收这笔费用吧。吉安娜小姐说，自从我们遇到了您之后，生意确实变得越来越好。 ]作为额外的优惠，对于你带来的任何朋友，我也会免费为他们提供服务。这样怎么样？ [pc.isBimbo |那听起来简直太棒了！这种乐趣在和朋友一起分享的时候才最有趣呢！ |那个……嗯……单看这个效果还算不错，但你能看出，斯文还是设法取得了优势。不过，这不正是商旅的意义所在吗？ ] 现在，你可以向斯文询问关于这个问题的详细解释。正是如此这个机器能为你做些什么呢？如果你已经听够了“废品狂人”先生的一番讲解，那么等到你真正使用这台机器的时候，自然就会明白它的用途了。当然，前提是你要或者你身边的人有使用它的必要。 那么，你想要用它来做什么呢？

Its main body consists of a large brass cylinder, a detachable glass receptacle at the bottom, and two long slime-latex hoses that snake out like grasping appendages. Given the brass rings on their ends, clearly intended to secure attachments, that might not be too far off... The rest of the machine is nondescript, with the only visible means of interacting with it a handful of buttons and one very large lever. Noticing your attention wandering away from him and to his creation, Svern's nervousness only grows, and the mecian clears his throat. rows.original: Svern pinches the bridge of his nose, then relaxes as he realizes you're going back into safe and familiar territory for him. "Well, take a seat. Don't want your legs stiff by the time I'm done talking. "So first... yeah, it's the simple stuff. Plain old milking, nothing else — the machine drains your tits of whatever they've got and makes you feel pretty damn good while at it. Tamarind tells me just having the cups sucking away is pretty great on its own, but there're other, uh, optional attachments that you can ask for if you want more out of the experience. After all, they say in Jassira that happy sheep give better milk. Whatever gets sucked out ends up in the big glass jar, and we keep that." [pc.isBimbo |Aww. ]You don't get to take it with you? "Nah, that's also part of what I need to cover costs. Gotta make a living somehow." [pc.isBimbo |Phooey |That doesn't seem like fully fair dealing, but the way Svern says it, it doesn't sound like that was his idea ]. So, what happens if the jar gets full? "Oh, the machine doesn't explode or anything. If it did, we'd never be able to do business in Khor'minos — some of the ladies there are incredibly productive, much to Tamarind's delight, and have arranged themselves to be even more so over generations as a side effect of 'fine breeding', as they call it. No, while there's space for a whole lot of, uh, produce, the mechanisms will shut down in the case of overflow, and any excess in the system will be vented. We don't want people to have to worry about such things, and instead focus on feeling good while being milked. "Once you're dry, I come and detach you, then put the cups aside for washing and steaming... and that's about it. Simple, really." Can you, um, still use the milker even if you're dry? Svern raises an eyebrow. "Sure, I guess; it'll suck anyway, even if there's nothing to be drained. Tamarind will be disappointed, but we can't have it all. If you just want to feel good, then that's perfectly fine — the machine won't hurt you or anything if you don't have anything in your chest. In fact, it'll still suffice for that purpose even if you don't have a chest to speak of." [pc.cupRange A B |Some people might call it borderline, but it shouldn't be a problem for you. Probably. |Well, good thing that's not a worry for you. |That's, uh, very interesting to know. ] "I mean it. We have latex cups for, uh, flatties, as Tamarind likes calling them. There's no need to be shy or anything about the matter if that's what you want. Of course, the milking machine can also do something about that if you're so inclined." Another functionality there, you take it? "Two, in fact. Though they both work off the same idea of, uh, encouraging one's body to do better through appropriate stimulation and reward, I can indeed make them bigger and milkier, even if it means starting from absolute nothing. Enough sessions with the milker, and you can have whatever you want — up to a limit, of course. Some people can't or won't use alchemy, and this is much, much more pleasant, so... "Please don't ask me how it works, because I have no idea. It's been a lot of trial and error, and I'm thankful that everyone who helped me with getting the rhythms right has been more than enthusiastic in participating and very pleased with the final results." [pc.isBimbo |So, like, he's totally saying that his thingamajig can give even the saddest flattie big, milky boobies? |So to condense all his blathering, what he's saying is that his machine can make anyone chestier and milkier. ] "Yes. Yes, that's right. Up to a reasonable limit, of course. Not that you still can't do it for fun, but it won't do anything beyond that point." Oh. "Well, that's all there is to explain, really." Svern sighs and folds his arms. "Unless there're any pressing questions?" Yes. Is there any chance that you might be able to get one of these for yourself? [flags.GIANNA_WF |The Wayfort could do with one of these for some of the residents... Svern shakes his head at that. "No can do, I'm afraid. With all respect, even if I wanted to make another, the machine draws its power from the caravan's engine. You wouldn't be able to use it unless I were around anyway. If you have someone in mind who really wants to be milked... well, bring that someone around while we're at the fort. Hey, we're there every time you've gone looking for us, right? |Svern shakes his head at that. "No can do, I'm afraid. Even if I were willing to make one for you, the machine draws its power from the caravan's engine; you wouldn't be able to use it without us, so that's kind of pointless. Sorry, but them's the breaks. ]" Aww. He could make quite a bundle with more of these around... "The milking machine already more than covers its cost, Tamarind sees to that. Sometimes, it's really not about the money... I like things how they are. Same way that not everyone who gets hooked up to this thing wants to be bustier or milkier, just a bit of fun." So... if you wanted to, could you take the milking machine for a spin right now? Svern bites his lip. "Not right now, it still needs to be cleaned out. I swap all the personal bits between each customer, but the insides still require scrubbing and steaming every so often. I was about to get to it when you came in — come back to me in a few minutes, and I'll have everything sorted out if you're so minded." All right, a few minutes it is, then. You'll be back later... or not.
rows.translation: 斯文捏了捏自己的鼻梁，然后放松下来，因为他意识到你即将进入对他来说安全且熟悉的领域。“好吧，坐下吧。我可不想等我说完话后，你的腿都僵掉了。 “那么，首先……嗯，就是这些简单的东西。普通的挤奶过程，没有其他什么复杂的步骤——机器会把你乳房里的奶全部吸出来，同时还会让你感觉非常舒服。塔玛琳告诉我，仅仅让这些吸奶杯发挥作用就已经非常棒了，但如果你想让体验更加丰富，还可以选择一些其他的附加配件。毕竟，在贾西拉有句俗话：快乐的羊才能产出优质的奶水。无论吸出来的是什么，最终都会被收集到那个大玻璃罐里，而我们也会把它们保存起来。 [pc.isBimbo |哎呀。 ]不行，这也是我用来支付各项开销的一部分。总得想办法谋生吧。 [pc.isBimbo |呸。 |这样似乎并不完全公平，但听斯文这么一说，倒也不像是他的主意。 ]那么，如果罐子装满了会发生什么呢？ “哦，机器不会爆炸或者发生什么异常。如果真的发生了那样的事，我们在科尔米诺斯就根本无法开展业务了——因为那里有些女士难以置信地多亏了这种机制，产量非常高，这让塔玛林德非常满意。而且，经过几代人的发展，由于他们称之为“优良选育”的过程，这些机制的效率更是得到了进一步提升。当然，虽然系统有足够的容量来容纳大量的产物，但一旦超过这个限度，相关机制就会自动启动，将系统中多余的产物排出体外。我们不希望人们为此而烦恼，而是希望他们在被挤奶的过程中也能感受到愉悦。 “等你的奶被挤干后，我会把吸奶器取下来，然后把吸奶杯收起来清洗和消毒……就这样而已。很简单，真的。” 那么，就算你已经没有奶了，还能继续使用那个吸奶器吗？ 斯文挑了挑眉毛：“应该可以吧；反正不管里面有没有奶，它都会继续吸的。虽然塔玛琳德会失望，但我们也不能什么都拥有啊。如果你只是想让自己感觉好一点，那完全没问题——只要你的胸腔里什么都没有，这个机器就不会伤害到你。事实上，即使你根本没有胸腔，它仍然可以达到这个目的。" [pc.cupRange A B |有些人可能会认为这有点勉强，但对你来说应该不会成为问题。至少应该是这样吧。 |嗯，幸好这对你来说不是什么需要担心的事情。 |知道这个，呃，确实非常有趣。 ] 我是认真的。我们有专门为平胸女性设计的乳胶杯，塔玛琳德就是这么称呼它们的。如果你有这个需求，完全不必感到害羞或尴尬。当然，如果你愿意的话，吸奶机也可以帮助你解决这个问题。还有另一个功能，你明白我的意思吧？ “实际上有两个。虽然它们的原理都是一样的——也就是通过适当的刺激和奖励来促使身体表现得更好——但我确实可以让这些功能变得更加强大、更有效，哪怕这意味着要从零开始重新设计。只要多使用几次那个设备，你就可以得到任何你想要的东西——当然，也是有一定限度的。有些人无法或不愿意使用炼金术，而这种方法要方便得多，所以…… “请别问我这是怎么工作的，因为我根本不知道。经历了许多尝试和失败，我很感激所有帮助我调整节奏的人——他们都非常热情地参与了这个过程，并且对最终的结果感到非常满意。 [pc.isBimbo |所以，他的意思就是说，他的那个东西甚至能让最扁平的胸部也变得丰满、乳晕明显吗？ |总而言之，他的意思就是他的机器能够做到这一点。有人吗？更丰盛，更美味。 ] 是的，没错。当然，是在合理的范围内。并不是说你不能为了乐趣而使用它，但超过这个限度的话，就没什么用了。” 哦。 “嗯，其实也就这些需要解释的。”斯文叹了口气，双臂交叉抱在胸前，“除非还有其他紧急的问题需要解答？” 是的，有没有可能你能为自己弄一个这样的东西呢？ [flags.GIANNA_WF |对于一些居民来说，荒废驿堡确实需要这样的设备…… 斯文对此摇了摇头。“恐怕不行。尽管我很愿意帮忙，但这台机器所需的能量来自商队的引擎。除非我在场，否则你们根本无法使用它。如果你有谁真的需要使用这个设备……嗯，那在我们还在堡垒的时候，就把那个人带过来吧。嘿，每次你们来找我们，我们不都是在这里吗？ |斯文听到这话摇了摇头。“恐怕不行。即使我愿意为你制作一个，这台机器也是依靠商队的引擎来供电的；没有我们，你根本无法使用它，所以这样做也没什么意义。抱歉，但事实就是如此。 ]哇，要是再多几台这样的机器，他肯定能赚一大笔钱……” “塔玛琳德会确保这台挤奶机带来的收益绝对能够覆盖它的成本。有时候，其实钱并不是最重要的因素。……我就喜欢事物保持原来的样子。就像并不是每个使用这个设备的人都想让自己的胸部变得更大或更丰满一样，这只是为了寻求一点乐趣而已。 那么……如果你愿意的话，现在就可以试试用这个挤奶器试试看吗？ 斯文咬了咬嘴唇：“现在还不行，里面还需要清理一下。虽然我会把每个客户的个人物品都换过来，但设备内部还是需要定期进行清洗和消毒。你进来的时候我正准备动手呢——如果你愿意的话，过几分钟再来找我，我会把一切都处理好的。好吧，那就再等几分钟吧。你之后会回来……也可能不会回来。

rows.original:
"Would you tell me about yourself?" you ask, grinning when she blinks in confusion.

        Tamarind hums, lifting her veil to take a sip from her flask. "Well’p! I’m trained in music, mathematics, alchemy, aaaand I cook good. Honestly I was never trained in the chef stuff, but I picked it up when I found out Svern was crap at eating food and Gia never packed anything edible." She glances side-to-side with shifty eyes. "She eats rocks and metal!"
        
        Weird.
        
        "I guess you want to know about how I came into all that stuff, but it’s not that interesting. I grew up in Jassira, got abducted, got rescued, got abducted again, got rescued again, followed a lover to this brand new holy-crap-it’s-so-cold land, it didn’t work out, now I’m here." She pauses you with a finger held up, checking her oven. Just opening it fills her portion of the caravan with the smell of delicious baked bread, and the purple alchemi-kitty seems pretty pleased with herself before she returns to her chair. "Well... I met Gia while her caravan was totally shagged. She had a bunch of runes put in place to keep it in motion without breaking, glide over bumps... uh, but she overdid it with the set that keeps this whole place toasty warm."
        
        "Big fire?" you inquire.
        
        "Big fire." Tamarind nods, sighing. "But it’s fine, it got my attention, I came, I helped... I stuck around. And I’m really happy! I’m very fond of Gia and Svern, but don’t tell Svern about that... he gets weirdly grouchy."
        
        You shrug; "My lips are sealed."
        
        "Damn right. Now... would you be interested in some of my goodies? I’ve got food and potions!"
rows.translation:
你能跟我讲讲你自己吗？”你笑着问道，看到她困惑地眨了眨眼。

        塔玛琳德轻声哼着，掀起面纱喝了一口水壶里的水。“嗯！我接受过音乐、数学和炼金术方面的训练，而且我的厨艺也还不错。说实话，我其实并没有接受过专业的烹饪训练，但后来我发现斯文根本不会做饭，而吉娅从来都不会准备任何可吃的东西，于是我就自学学会了。”她用狡黠的眼神左右扫视着，“她连石头和金属都敢吃！
        
        奇怪。
        
        “我想你肯定想知道我是怎么卷入这些事情中的，但其实并没有那么有趣。我在贾西拉长大，被绑架了，又被救了出来，然后又再次被绑架，又一次被救出来。后来为了追随一个恋人，我来到了这个冷得要命的地方，结果一切都失败了，现在我就在这里。她举起手指示意你稍等，然后去检查她的烤箱。当她打开烤箱的那一刻，整个商队中都弥漫起了美味烤面包的香气，而那只紫色的炼金术猫咪似乎也对自己非常满意，之后它才回到自己的椅子上。嗯……我在吉亚的商队遭到袭击时遇到了她。她安装了一堆符文，用来让商队保持运转状态而不发生故障，还能让商队顺利地越过各种障碍……不过，她在使用那些用来保持这个地方温暖舒适的符文时，似乎有点过头了。"
        
        发生大火了？”你问道。
        
        “是啊，大火。”塔玛琳德点点头，叹了口气，“不过没关系，这场大火引起了我的注意，所以我来了，帮忙灭火……还留了下来。我真的很高兴！我非常喜欢吉亚和斯文，不过别告诉斯文这件事……他有时候会变得特别暴躁。
        
        你耸了耸肩：“我什么都没说。”
        
        “没错。那么……你有没有兴趣尝尝我的东西？我这里有食物和药剂哦！

rows.original:
Tamarind’s kitty-ears fwip back and she pouts at you, adjusting her clothes. "Heading off already? Weell... okay. I guess that means we’re packing up for now. [party.som|You’ll|You two|You guys] will be careful and take care 'til then, right?"

        You give the purple-haired catgirl a nod, stepping away so that she can begin storing her goodies away. She pauses for a moment, shifty-eyes-ing around before leaning over her makeshift counter and giving [party.som|you|both of you|each of you] a cookie. "Shhh~"
        
        It’s a matter of minutes for the whole caravan to be packed away and the inhabitants hidden behind the folded wall, and when the caravan turns to leave it’s with a casual wave from Gianna and a metallic chirp before it wheels away into the distance.
rows.translation:
塔玛琳德把耳朵向后一甩，撅着嘴看着你，同时整理着自己的衣服。“这么快就要走了吗？嗯……好吧，看来我们得开始收拾东西了。 [party.som|你会|你们两个|你们这些人]会小心的，到时候一定会照顾好自己的，对吧？”

        你向那位紫色头发的猫娘点了点头，然后退到一边，让她开始把那些东西收起来。她停了一会儿，目光四处扫视了一下，随后俯身在她的临时柜台前，递给[party.som|你|你们两个|你们每个人]一块饼干。“嘘~”
        
        整个商队只需几分钟就能收拾完毕，所有居民也会躲到折叠起来的墙后面。当商队准备出发时，吉安娜会随意地挥了挥手，然后伴随着一声金属般的鸣叫声，商队便缓缓驶向远方。

rows.original:
Tamarind smiles, serving up some little bronze containers full of beans, sliced bacon and sausage, and mashed potatoes. She pours on a handy cup’s worth of spicy gravy and gives you a metal spoon.
        
        It’s delicious; warm and buttery, spicy and meaty in all the best ways. It only takes ten or so minutes to wolf the whole lot down, and when you look up from the proffered meal there’s a smug smile on the purple-haired kitty’s face. The aftertaste of spicy gravy is strong on the back of your tongue when you mop up the remains of the bronze tin, reluctantly handing it back. "Not bad, eh?" Tamarind smiles, placing [party.manyCompanions|yours and your companions' dishes into a little sink|your dishes into a little sink]. "Is there anything else I can do for you, [pc.mascFem|handsome|cutie]?"
rows.translation:
塔玛琳德微笑着，端上来一些小青铜容器，里面装着豆子、切片的培根和香肠，还有土豆泥。她倒上足足一杯辣味肉汁，然后递给你一把金属勺子。
        
        这食物真是太美味了——温暖而带有黄油的味道，同时又充满辣味和肉香，简直完美无缺。只需大约十分钟的时间，就能把所有食物一扫而光。当你从餐盘中抬起头时，会发现那只紫发小猫的脸上正挂着得意的笑容。当你舔干净铜罐里剩下的食物时，辛辣肉汁的余味会在你的舌头上久久挥之不去，最终你还是不情愿地把罐子还了回去。“还不错，嗯？”塔玛琳德微笑着说道，同时把[party.manyCompanions|你和同伴们的餐具放进那个小水槽里|你的餐具放进那个小水槽里]。“还有什么我能为你做的吗，[pc.mascFem|英俊的|小可爱]？”

rows.original: Breakfast is a misnomer, it’s great to eat at any time.
rows.translation: 早餐这个称呼其实有点不准确，其实什么时候吃都很好吃。
rows.raw: "Breakfast is a misnomer, it’s great to eat at any time."

rows.original:
The purple-haired alchemeowst smiles brightly, reaching into the oven and pulling out a slice of glazed, sweet-smelling cake. She cuts off a few dense, moist-looking slices and places them on a piece of paper before handing them out to you[party.manyCompanions| and your companions]. "This stuff’s a personal favorite of mine. Well, except for the pie. And the soup. And the booze... okay, I like all of these."

        You smile back and dig right in to the warm, moist cake. Sugary-sweetness covers your tongue before giving away to rich softness; it’s thicker than cake, but lighter than bread... but whatever it is you devour the whole lot in a few bites. That’s a dangerous meal; you could eat that stuff all day.
rows.translation:
那个紫发的炼金喵术士露出了灿烂的笑容，她伸手进入烤箱，取出一块表面裹着糖霜、散发着甜香味的蛋糕。她切下几片质地紧密、看起来湿润的蛋糕，将它们放在一张纸上，然后递给了你。[party.manyCompanions| 以及你的同伴们]。“这些食物都是我的个人最爱。嗯，除了派、汤和酒……好吧，其实这些我全都喜欢。”

        你微笑着，也动手吃起了那块温暖湿润的蛋糕。甜腻的味道首先充满你的舌头，随后又带来一种浓郁而柔软的口感；它的质地比蛋糕更厚实，却又比面包更轻盈……总之，你几口就吃光了整块蛋糕。这真是一顿让人欲罢不能的美味大餐——你完全可以一整天都不停地吃这些东西。

rows.original:
Tamarind pulls out a small tray of flat bread-disks, slicing into the side of the bread with a sharp knife. It peels back like a pouch, and she hurriedly shovels in all manners of diced cooked meats. "Here, a speciality from my homeland! Trust me when I say that nobody can make 'em like me." Her tail proudly swishes around while you accept the pouch.

        Your hands are warmed up by the bread-y pouch, salivating at the sheer smell of spiced and salted meats cooked to tender perfection. Every bite feels like it’s melting in your mouth, but the tough bread means you have to take your time or risk getting too full too fast. It gets easier to eat the longer you go though; the grease and fat soaks into the food pouch, ensuring that the final mouthful is perfectly rich.

        The purple-haired catgirl smiles brightly, leaning on the counter. "I love a happy customer."
rows.translation:
塔玛琳拿出一盘扁平的面包片，用一把锋利的刀在面包边上切了一些口子。面包皮像口袋一样被掀开，她迅速地把各种切成小块的熟肉装了进去。“来，这是我家乡的特色美食！相信我，没有人能做出像我这样的东西。当你接过那个装满食物的袋子时，她的尾巴正骄傲地摆动着。

        手中的袋子散发着面包的温暖气息，那浓郁的香料与咸肉的味道让人忍不住流口水——这些肉一定被烹制得恰到好处，变得无比鲜嫩可口。每一口下去，食物仿佛都在口中融化，但由于面包比较硬，因此必须慢慢品尝，否则很容易吃得太饱。不过，随着咀嚼时间的延长，食用起来会变得越来越容易——食物中的油脂会渗入面包中，使得最后一口食物充满浓郁的风味。

        那个紫发猫娘靠在柜台上，笑容灿烂地说道：“我喜欢快乐的顾客。

Tammy giggles, bum wiggling when she gets up out of her chair to get to the very bottom of her oven. "Yay! Prepare for the only pie we’ll give you that isn’t full of cream; I promise it’s amazing. It’s full of fish! Feeesh! Delicious spicy hot fish!"

        When Tamarind hands out [party.som|a pie for you|the pies for you and [companion.name]|the pies to you all] it’s with a satisfied smile. "Eat it quick while it’s hot, okay?"

        [party.has cait|There’s a gasp from Cait beside you, and she claps her hands to her cheeks. "Yes! Feeeesh! I love fish!" ]You dig into the meal with gusto, and are hurriedly transported to a world of savory fish and hot spices from the purple kitty’s homeland. The crust crumbles and the top-layer flakes, but altogether holds up well as a perfect handheld snack. [party.has cait|Your curvy cat companion is in her own private world of bliss, purring like a literal feline and buying another. When you pause to look at her she blushes and elbows you, "Hey, don’t judge."]

        Tamarind smiles and reaches down, nibbling a little pie for herself with a satisfied sigh. "I do love a good fish."
rows.translation:

rows.translation: [flags.SVERN_METAL_RELIC |哦，又是那件事啊？嗯，我应该还把它放在后面的某个地方吧。虽然还没来得及把它搬走，但这并不意味着我会改变我的提议。上次说的那些条件依然有效，所以如果你愿意付款的话…… |哦，那个东西？斯文舔了舔舌头，思考了一会儿。是啊，我不记得自己把它搬过了，所以它应该还在原地。给我两秒钟。 那个机械人男子消失在商队的后方，不久后便回来了，他手里拿着一个用破旧布料包裹着的鼓鼓囊囊的东西。他把这个包裹放在你面前，解开那块质量低劣的麻布，于是你看到了——那应该是一把长匕首或短剑的剑柄，剑身早已断裂成参差不齐的残端，上面还布满了锈迹。不过，这个剑柄和护手显然都是精工制作的，而且护手上还镶嵌着半宝石——应该是猫眼石吧。无论这把武器原本是用来做什么的，它更可能只是一种仪式用品或装饰品罢了……只能希望那些狐狸的判断是正确的。 你到底是怎么知道我有的？ 哦，你花了很长时间来调查这件事，后来听说他拥有某种符合条件的事物。当你终于找到吉安娜时，问问总没坏处，于是你就来到了这里。 这位机械狂人垃圾鼠缓缓地点了点头。我想，这也挺合理的；其实之前我在我们经过的几个地方都试图把它们卖给别人，但在像提克里斯这样的大城市里，也毫无结果。你可能会觉得人们应该会对古董更感兴趣，哪怕是那些有损坏的也不例外，但在你出现之前，我还在考虑把那些宝石取出来，按照它们的实际价值来卖掉呢。所以，你有兴趣购买这些古董吗？ 是的。他开的价格是多少呢？” 斯文故作沉思地挠了挠下巴，假装在认真思考。嗯，这显然是来自古老的贝尔哈尔，甚至可能更古老。工艺非常精湛——虽然刀刃已经损坏了，但你们本来也不打算把它当作武器来使用吧？上面还有宝石镶嵌和黄金装饰，而且我猜它可能曾经具有魔法效果……吉安娜是这么说的，而且这些特征也与我手头掌握的信息相符。这绝对是一件极具价值的古董，如果遇到合适的买家，肯定能卖个好价钱。 你觉得两千只鹰怎么样？ 两千只鹰，只为了一个破损的剑柄？ 它确实有很多优点。 就在他还在为找不到买家而懊恼的时候？ 是啊，我当初在提克里斯的时候，开价是五千。现在降到两千，这已经不到我最初定价的一半了。我跟你说，这样的价格实在让我自己亏本了——总不能把商品免费送给别人吧，否则吉安娜非要把我骂死不可。我和塔米以前有哪次会让你把我们的价格压下来过吗？ 不，但是…… 我不得不承认，我现在处境确实很不妙，但我也知道你们对此很感兴趣。再降价的话，我就要开始亏本出售了，而我可不想那样。那个还是不行啊。两千块吧，朋友。 除了给他钱，你难道就没有其他办法可以帮助他了吗？ 我们……这一次，他是真的在认真思考。我想，如果能在和你一起享受亲密时光之后再放弃它，我应该也不会介意吧。其实我一直很好奇，像你这样的人在床上的表现会是怎么样。 坑你”竟然值整整两千霍克斯？ 嘿，你可是挺了不起的人物啊。他舔了舔嘴唇。或者更准确地说，吉安娜是这么说的，而她在这些事情上很少会弄错。考虑到我这么早就入手了，我觉得这个价格相当不错。 你叹了口气。 [party.has cait |不过，如果你觉得没精力做的话，那边还有一只粉色小猫呢。斯文继续前进。贾西拉的马拉克信徒，据说她们拥有举世闻名的性技巧。我们的喜好确实各不相同，但我觉得吉安娜短期内应该不会去贾西拉吧。如果你不介意你的伴侣代替你前往贾西拉，花两千多块钱雇一位那里的‘神圣妓女’的话，我完全没问题。 嗯，我总是乐于向那些愿意倾听的人传播关于马拉克的信息！凯特开口说道。或者，直接去感受它吧。真的太遗憾了，并不是每个人都有机会在自己有生之年内体验到我们能为他们做些什么——只要你说出那个词[pc.name]，这样，这个可怜的男孩很快就会感觉好多了！ ] 还有其他事情吗？ 我想，确实是有什么事情吧。几个月前，吉安娜曾去过丰收谷的一个农场——那个地方有很多女牛仔。我个人对牛奶并不感兴趣，但那里的淡色艾尔啤酒是我尝过最好喝的。之后我们偶尔会再去那个地区，不过吉安娜再也没去过那家农场。光是想起那种啤酒的味道，我就觉得喉咙发干……所以如果你能给我弄来一桶那种啤酒，我非常愿意用那把镶满宝石的剑柄来交换。你觉得这个交易怎么样？ 嗯，你可以仔细考虑一下。 没必要急于做出任何决定。斯文干笑着回应道。你可以慢慢考虑这一切，不过如果你犹豫得太久，我可能就已经把东西卖掉了。我已经给了你很多选择，所以现在主动权就在你手里了——就像特洛纳里那边人们说的那样。等你做出决定后，告诉我吧。 ]
rows.raw: " [flags.SVERN_METAL_RELIC |"Oh, that thing again? Yeah, I've still got it around here somewhere in the back. Still haven't been able to move it, but that doesn't mean I'm changing my offer any. Everything from last time still stands, so if you're willing to pay up..." |"Oh, that thing?" Svern clicks his tongue and thinks a moment. "Yeah, I don't remember moving it, so it ought to still be around. Give me two seconds." The mecian man disappears into the back of the caravan, and returns shortly after with a lumpy bulge wrapped in ratty cloth. He sets it down in front of you, unwrapping the low-quality sackcloth, and before you lies the hilt of what might once have been a long dagger or shortsword, the blade long since broken off to a jagged stump and flecked with rust. The pommel and crossguard are clearly finely made, though, and semiprecious stones are set into the latter — cat's eye, you think. Whatever weapon this was, it was probably more a ceremonial or decorative piece than anything else — you can only hope that the foxes assays were right. "How'd you know I had this, anyway?" Oh, you've been tracking this down for some time, and then you came across some hearsay that he had something like this that fit the bill. Couldn't hurt to ask about it when you finally caught up to Gianna, and here you are. The mecian junkrat gives you a slow nod. "That makes sense, I guess; just between the two of us, I'd been trying to foist it off onto people at a couple places we stopped by, but no dice even in a big city like Tychris. You'd think people would have more interest in antiques, even damaged ones, but I was considering prying out the gems and taking them for what they're worth just before you came along. So, you're interested in buying?" Yes. What's his asking price? Svern makes a show of scratching his chin and thinking deeply. "Well, it's clearly from Old Belhar, if not older. Fine workmanship — the blade is a goner, but then you weren't hoping to use it as a weapon, were you? Gem inlay, gold finish, and I think it might have been magical once — Gianna says so, anyway, and it matches up with what I've got. Very certainly an antique conversation piece and worth something to the right buyers. If you knew some, I'm sure you could get a pretty sum flipping it. "What say you at two thousand hawks?" Two thousand hawks for a broken sword hilt? "It's got a lot going for it." When he was just lamenting the fact that he couldn't find buyers? "Yeah, my original asking price when I was back in Tychris with five thousand. At two thousand, that's less than half of what I started out with. I tell you, I'm cutting my own throat at prices like these — I can't just start giving the merchandise away, or Gianna would have my hide. Have I or Tammy ever let you haggle down any of our prices?" No, but... "I'm not going to deny I'm in a bad spot, but I also know you're interested and there's only going so low before I start selling at a loss, and I'm not that hard-off yet. Two thousand it is, friend." Isn't there anything else you could do for him, aside from the money? "We-ll..." this time he's genuinely thinking. "I guess I wouldn't mind letting it go if I could have a romp in the hay with you. Been wondering for a while what someone like you would be like in the sack." Fucking you would be worth two whole thousand hawks? "Hey, you're a pretty big deal." He licks his lips. "Or more correctly, Gianna says you'll be, and she's rarely wrong about these things. Price's pretty good, I'd say, given that I'm getting in this early." You sigh. [party.has cait |"If you're not feeling up to it, though, you've got a pink kitten right over there, too," Svern continues. "A Jassiran Mallachite, famed the world over for their amazing sexual skills, or so I hear. We range quite a bit, but I don't think Gianna's ever going to go to Jassira anytime soon. I'll give you the hilt if you don't mind your kitty over there taking your place in the romp — sailing over to Jassira and hiring myself one of their sacred prostitutes would put me out more than two thousand, I'm sure." "Well, I'm always up for spreading the word of Mallach to those who're willing to listen!" Cait pipes up. "Or feel it, for that matter. It's a real shame that not everyone gets to experience what we can do for them in their lifetimes — say the word, [pc.name], and I'll have this poor boy feeling tip-top in no time!" ] Anything else? "There is something, I suppose. Some months ago Gianna stopped by a farm down in Harvest Valley — big place full of cowgirls. Couldn't care less for the milk myself, but they had some of the best pale ale that I'd ever tasted. We've been in the region every now and then, but Gianna's never stopped at that farm again. Just thinking about the taste makes my throat feel dry already, so if you get me a cask of that stuff I'd be more than willing to let go of that jeweled hilt in exchange. Sound good to you?" Hmm. You'll think about it. "No need to rush into anything," Svern replies with a dry chuckle. "Take your time thinking about it all, although if you dither too long I might've gotten lucky and hawked it off by then. I've given you plenty of options, so the ball's in your court here, as they say down in Tronarii. Let me know when you've made a decision." ]"

rows.original: Fine. If it's two thousand he wants, it's two thousand that he'll be getting, then. You dump out the money in front of the junkrat in a bag and let him count out the sum; if only one were feeling more spiteful, you'd have paid him all in copper coins. Svern's completely nonplussed by your irritated demeanour, calmly moving to wrap up the broken-off hilt in brown paper and string before pushing it over to your side. "Cheers, mate. Good doing business with you." Yeah, okay. This may have been the easiest and most direct way to go about it, but there's something in you that still instinctively rebels against just ponying up this kind of cash for a broken hilt, jewelled relic as it may be. Hopefully this will all have been worth it. "Oh, by the by. I tried asking around some places as to what this thing might once have been while we were in Tychris — discreetly, of course — and it turns out this piece has a bit of a colorful history, if it's what it's supposed to be. I gave the broken hilt a run over with my own instruments and if there ever was any magic on this thing it's long gone, but hearsay is that it used to be cursed." Oh, really? No wonder no one was buying this thing despite everything he touted it as being. "According to legend, upon her twentieth birthday, the lady of some Belharan principality down in the south was given a special present by her dusk elven servant to give her husband, a sword that would make him great among men. She ran to his bedchamber to present him with the great gift — the dusk elves of Tronarii and beyond are supposed to be great metalworkers and all — but upon opening the door she was shaken by a great evil. Within her hand, the sword blade began to glow and she screamed as she raised the blade over her head and cleaved her husband's head from off his shoulders. From there, she went from one child's chamber to the next until she had slain all her children and once that was done, she ran mad and was seen no more. "The weapon was cursed, but whoever had imbued the curse into the weapon had fucked up really bad. Instead of only firing up the wielder to murder all wyld elves in sight — the servant who'd made the thing apparently had a huge chip on his shoulder against them — the curse didn't differentiate between wyld elves and anyone else. There're some inconsistencies in various iterations of the legend, but that's why it's a legend — no one expect folk tales like these to be consistent." And it's perfectly safe, he says? "Not so much as a cantrip's worth of potential left in it." [pc.isMage |You pass a bit of your own power into the broken-off hilt, and as far as you can tell Svern's being straight with you. If there was once a curse on this thing, it's dead as a doornail now |You eye Svern for a bit, then slowly nod; the junkrat knows what he's talking about ]. Still, if it had the potential to hold such an enchantment on it, you can see why the kitsune might be interested in its composition. He's telling you all this when he strictly isn't obliged to, in any way... "Hey, this isn't some kind of strange little shop where the shopkeep hands out curses like candy," Svern replies with a pout. "You know, those little hole-in-the-wall places that weren't there the day before and aren't there the next day? Now those, they're a bunch of shady, unscrupulous characters. I, on the other hand, always fully disclose any potential problems with stuff I sell." How responsible of him, and to do so after the money's changed hands — but it's appreciated nonetheless.. "Just thought I'd say it. Anything else you want of me?"
rows.translation: 好吧。如果他非要两千，那就给他两千吧。把钱装在袋子里放在那个“狂鼠”面前，让他自己数数；要是有人心怀更多怨恨的话，你恐怕就得用铜币来支付了。斯文完全搞不懂你这种恼怒的态度，他只是冷静地把那根断掉的刀柄用棕色纸包起来，用绳子捆好，然后放在你旁边。 干杯，伙计。能与你做生意真是太愉快了。 嗯，好吧。这或许确实是条最简单、最直接的做法，但你的内心深处，似乎仍然本能地抗拒为这样一个破损的剑柄——尽管它可能是一件镶嵌着宝石的古老遗物——支付这么多钱。希望这一切最终都是值得的。 哦，顺便说一下。我在一些地方打听过，想弄清楚这件东西在我们身处提克里斯的时候可能曾经是什么——当然，都是悄悄地打听。结果发现，如果这件东西真的是我想象中的那种东西的话，它的历史还挺复杂的。我用自己的工具检查了那把断掉的剑柄，如果这件东西曾经带有任何魔法，那么那些魔法早就消失了；不过有传言说，这件东西曾经被诅咒过。 哦，是吗？难怪尽管他极力宣传这款产品的优点，却没有人愿意购买它。 传说，在她二十岁生日那天，那位来自南方某贝拉兰公国的年轻女子收到了一位黄昏精灵仆从送来的特别礼物——那把剑将会使她的丈夫在人间成就一番伟业。她跑进他的卧室，想要送给他这份珍贵的礼物——据说特洛纳里以及更远地区的暮色精灵都是出色的金属工匠……然而，当她打开门时，一股邪恶的力量震撼了她。她手中的剑刃突然开始发光，她惊声尖叫着，将剑举过头顶，将丈夫的头部从肩上斩了下来。从那里开始，她一个接一个地走进孩子的房间，直到杀光了所有的孩子。做完这件事后，她彻底发疯了，从此再也没人见过她。 这把武器被下了诅咒，但那个给武器施加诅咒的人真的搞砸了一切。原本这个诅咒应该只会让持有者杀光眼前所有的野精灵——显然，制造这把武器的那个人对野精灵怀有深深的怨恨——但实际上，这个诅咒并不会区分野精灵和其他人。关于这个传说的不同版本中存在一些矛盾之处，但这就是传说的特点吧——没人会期望这样的民间故事会完全一致。 他说，这完全安全吗？ 里面已经没有任何价值了，甚至连最微小的利用价值都没有。 [pc.isMage |你将自己的部分力量注入那断裂的剑柄之中，从你的感知来看，斯维恩确实是诚实地与你合作。如果这把剑曾经被施加过诅咒，那么现在那份诅咒也已经彻底消失了。 |你盯着斯文看了一会儿，然后缓缓点了点头——这个废品回收者确实知道自己在说什么。 ]不过，如果这种物质确实拥有这样的魔力，那么你就能理解为什么狐妖会对它的成分如此感兴趣了。他之所以告诉你这些，其实根本没有任何义务这么做……” “喂，这又不是什么奇怪的小店，店主会像分发糖果一样随意给人施加诅咒吧？”斯文撅着嘴回答道。你知道吗，那些前一天还不存在，第二天就消失的无名小店？现在那些他们是一群阴险、不择手段的人。我另一方面，我总会彻底公开我所销售的任何产品可能存在的潜在问题。 他真是太有责任感了，能做到这一点真是太棒了。之后钱已经转手部了——但无论如何，我还是很感激的。 “只是觉得应该说出来。你还有其他什么要求吗？

rows.original: Pay the junkrat his asking price of 2000 EC.
rows.translation: 按狂鼠开的价，付给他2000枚琥珀金币。
rows.raw: "Pay the junkrat his asking price of 2000 EC."

rows.original: You don't have Svern's asking price of 2000 EC on you.
rows.translation: 你身上并没有斯文要求的2000枚琥珀金币。
rows.raw: "You don't have Svern's asking price of 2000 EC on you."

rows.original: Svern's eyebrows shoot up when you agree to his asking price. "Huh. Didn't actually think you'd go for it." Hey, he's a merchant. He shouldn't give offers that he doesn't think people will follow up on — at a valuation of two thousand hawks, there's no way you're not selling a fuck to him in exchange for that weapon hilt. Flattery will get you everywhere, it seems. Hearing this, the mecian junkrat flushes a bit and adjusts his collar. "Well, I guess it's my loss. Come into the caravan with me and we'll work something out." Indeed. You [party.hasCompanions|ask for [party.compNames] to wait for you outside, then ]follow Svern around the back into his living quarters in the magical, mechanical caravan. Despite being a one-room affair and the piles of shop stock off in a corner, there's actually plenty of space about, plus a stove that keeps out the cold of the Marches. Svern steps over to one wall and pulls a lever, and a bed swings outwards from the wall, its descent slowed by a couple of heavy springs. "Impressive, isn't it?" the mecian says with a grin. "Designed it myself — although the springs came later after Tammy hit herself on the head for the third time letting it out. Shall we begin, then?" Yes, yes. Although taller than most for a mecian, Svern's short by Marches standards. That doesn't hurt his confidence any as he throws off his working rags to reveal... well, he's not ripped, but neither is he scrawny despite all the stereotypes about being lithe. Svern has a little muscle definition atop his bones, and he very definitely could be handsome if he just cleaned up and dressed sharply. Given his line of work, this is a body that's fit from manual labor, yet doesn't have the wherewithal or inclination to grow thick like a lupine might. His eight-inch cock and proportional balls hang loosely between his legs, already half-hard and ready to go even as he curls his long rodent tail about his thigh and calf. He notices you watching and flexes a bit, a confident smile on his face that turns into a lazy grin as you hold his gaze. "Not quite worth two thousand hawks, but pretty damn good all the same, I'd say. Now it's your turn to show off the goods." He lets the foam subside, then raises the mug for a sip; soon, a sip isn't enough for the mecian, and he throws his head back to chug the entirety of the mug, stopping with lip-smacking relish only when it's empty. "Gods, that hit the spot!" You take it he's satisfied? "More than satisfied. Here you go, [pc.name], you've earned it. This baby here, she's worth more than two thousand hawks to me. We're going to have a lot of long nights together as I draw her out for all she's worth. Almost feels like a shame to drink from her, even though that's what she's made for." You can only shake your head at that, but don't resist as Svern presses a brown, string-wrapped bag into your hands, and with a little pressing from your fingers you're able to be certain that this is the broken hilt you're looking for. "Take it, you've earned it." Well, you're glad that he's satisfied with his end of the deal. "And I hope you are with yours, because this baby and I are going in to have some alone time." Maybe he didn't quite mean for that to sound sexual, or maybe he completely and totally did. Either way, Svern hefts the cask up, tap and all, and marches straight into the caravan, slamming the door right behind him.

rows.translation: 把这种淡色艾尔啤酒送给斯文吧。
rows.raw: "Present Svern with the pupper pale ale."

rows.original: You don't have any pale ale to present Svern with. Pupperidge Farms down in Harvest Valley should be able to sell you some.
rows.translation: 你没有任何淡色艾尔啤酒可以送给斯文吧。位于收获谷的帕珀里奇农场应该能帮你买到一些。
rows.raw: "You don't have any pale ale to present Svern with. Pupperidge Farms down in Harvest Valley should be able to sell you some."

rows.original: "Sure, sure. Take as much time as you need to think it over. We don't do refunds here, after all." Svern shrugs. "I'll say, though — those offers aren't going to change regardless of how long you draw this out, so." Yeah, yeah, you know. You just want to think it over, maybe get your hands on some of the things he wants. Consider your options, as it were. "Just thought I'd say it. Anything else you want of me?"
rows.translation: “当然，当然。你可以花尽可能多的时间来仔细考虑。毕竟，我们这里是不提供退款的。”斯文耸了耸肩。“不过我得说——无论你把这件事拖多久，那些提议都不会改变的，所以。” 嗯，你知道的。你只需要仔细考虑一下，或许还可以弄到他想要的一些东西。也就是，好好权衡一下你的选择吧。 “只是觉得应该说一声。你还需要我做些什么吗？”

rows.original: By the time you've finally wiped off the worst of the fluids and gotten your [pc.armor] back on, Svern is already out front, tying the strings on a brown paper package. He looks up at you as you approach, then hands it over with a nod. "Here you go, the broken hilt you wanted, all wrapped up nicely. Check it before you go, okay? Don't want you getting buyer's remorse or anything." Why, is he getting seller's remorse over the price he agreed on already? Svern shrugs. "Just take it and make sure it's to your liking, okay?" You press on the package with your fingers, test its weight in your hands; by the feel of it, the hilt's indeed in there and everything's in order. Giving Svern a nod, you stow away your new acquisition quite nicely and declare the business concluded. "Good. We've hung around long enough — I think I can hear Gianna calling for me to get this heap moving again. Nice doing business with you, [pc.name]."
rows.translation: 当你终于擦去那些最难处理的液体，把你的[pc.armor]清理干净的时候。你刚走过来，斯文就已经走在前面了，他正在用棕色纸包好东西。当你靠近时，他抬头看了你一眼，然后点了点头，把包递给了你。 给你，这就是你想要的那个损坏的刀柄，已经包得很好了。在离开之前先检查一下，好吗？可不想让你事后后悔买了这个。 为什么，他会因为已经同意的价格而感到后悔呢？ 斯文耸了耸肩。你就拿去吧，确保它符合你的喜好，好吗？ 你用手指轻轻按压那个包裹，感受一下它的重量；从手感来看，刀柄确实就在里面，所有东西都完好无损。你向斯文点了点头，然后把新得到的东西妥善地收好，宣布这次交易已经完成。 好了，我们在这里待得太久了——我觉得我已经听到吉安娜在催我赶紧让这群人动起来呢。能与您合作真是非常愉快。 [pc.name]。”

rows.original:
Amid the pleasant aromas and the cheerful greetings of the three caravaneers, you notice one thing: your elven companion's gone up to the stalls to take a closer look. With some curiosity, you follow at a respectful distance; it's always [pc.dcb
        |amusing
        |interesting
        |neat
    ] to watch somebody else shop, even if you're not sure what they're looking for. And between Tamarind's bubbling alchemical potions and Svern's knickknacks, there's plenty to peruse — both for Ryn and for the ever-glowering warbird perched on her forearm. [etheryn.lnhConfidence
        |She does so from a distance, anxiously shifting her gaze from trinket to trinket, once or twice opening her mouth as if to ask a question... and then closing it sharply as soon as you or Svern or Gianna notice.
        |Apart from a few muted questions to Svern and Gia, though, she doesn't say much about what she's thinking about.
        |Whatever she's looking at, it has her awfully pleased, smiling animatedly at the caravaneers as she chats with them.
    ]
    
    Well, it couldn't hurt to ask her what she's looking at; after all, it could make for a lovely gift. Should you see about getting something for her?

        |很有趣
        |很有意思
        |挺不错

        |她在远处这么做着，不安地把目光从一件小饰品移到另一件，有一两次张开嘴像是想问什么……可一旦你、斯文或吉安娜注意到，她就立刻把嘴紧紧闭上。

“哦……”她轻声说道，“他摸起来真舒服……” 你双臂交叉，微笑着说道：“我敢打赌，他确实很舒服。[pc.isBimbo |宝贝，你小时候也有过一个和他一样的小伙伴吗？ |这会不会让你想起小时候的自己，小琳？ ]不[etheryn.lowConfidence |、不 ]完全是[etheryn.highConfidence |。 |…… ]小琳咽了咽口水，继续说道：‘但是艾莉莎发现了。她总是能发现。她解雇了那个女仆，拿走了那只熊，然后……她当着我的面把它的头扯了下来。 |我……我确实有一个。”小琳抽泣着说道，“我五岁的时候，有一个女仆送了我一只毛绒熊，尽管艾莉莎告诉她不要这么做。她甚至还为那只熊做了小衣服。[silly | 他用一块旧桌布告诉我，那其实就是他的……他的化名。那块旧桌布啊…… ]我……我本来不应该带他的。但是我还是带了，结果被抓住了，就因为我的缘故，艾莉莎把女仆赶走了，然后她——”她闭上湿润的眼睛，低下了头。“她当着我的面，把他的头拧了下来。 ] 哦不！”吉安娜皱起了眉头，“你真可怜。” 你将一只安慰的手放在小琳的肩上。 “唉，算了，”斯文喃喃道，然后慷慨地耸了耸肩，“其实你可以……” 吉安娜转向他，竖起了一根手指。啊，啊！你难道打算免费送掉这么贵重的东西吗？说真的，你不能这么做吧！你可是个商人啊，看在上帝的份上！” 斯文挑了挑眉毛：“我不能吗？” 在那个毛绒狮子模型后面，伊瑟琳的眼睛瞪得大大的。 不！当然不行。她必须像其他顾客一样为他付款。”那个石像鬼向小琳倾身靠近，脸上露出愤怒的表情……但很快，她的表情又变得尽可能温柔。“我向你收取费用一个微笑亲爱的，让我看看你看到那些东西后脸上的笑容吧，那么小猫就完全属于你啦。 [etheryn.highConfidence I j-just thought that the doll n-next to Svern l-looked nice." |Your elven companion just about leaps out of her skin. "O-oh! [pc.name]!... s-sorry. "Well then! Nisse aside, if you want something from us, you'll have to pay for it — we're not running that much of a charity! See anything else that's to your liking?" '

rows.original: Ryn could always use a little cheering up — see if you can buy her whatever she's looking at.
rows.translation: 小琳总是需要一些鼓励和安慰——看看你能不能买到她想要的东西来让她开心一下。
rows.raw: "Ryn could always use a little cheering up — see if you can buy her whatever she's looking at."

rows.original: Shaking your head, you turn away from Ryn and size up the caravaneers. Gia, Svern, and Tamarind all give you friendly waves as your attention shifts back over to them. Who's got what you need?
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，转身离开了小琳，开始观察那些商队成员。吉娅、斯文和塔玛琳德都向你友好地挥了挥手，这时你的注意力又重新回到了他们身上。那么，谁拥有你所需要的东西呢？
rows.raw: "\n        Shaking your head, you turn away from Ryn and size up the caravaneers. Gia, Svern, and Tamarind all give you friendly waves as your attention shifts back over to them. Who's got what you need?\n        "

rows.original: Let her look around on her own for now. You've got other shopping to do.
rows.translation: 让她自己先四处看看吧，你还有其他购物任务要完成呢。
rows.raw: "Let her look around on her own for now. You've got other shopping to do."

rows.original:
Yeah, you're not interested in getting Ryn something nice. There are bigger fish to fry — in fact, Tamarind might be doing some of that right now.

        Gia, Svern, and Tamarind sit in their fancy seats and grin with anticipation as your attention shifts back over to them. Who's got what you need?
rows.translation:
是啊，你根本没兴趣给小琳买些好东西。你还有更重要的事情要忙——事实上，塔玛琳德现在可能正在忙这些事情吧。

        吉娅、斯文和塔玛琳德坐在他们那些豪华的座位上，期待地笑着，等你把注意力重新转向他们。那么，谁掌握了你所需要的东西呢？
rows.raw:
"
        Yeah, you're not interested in getting Ryn something nice. There are bigger fish to fry — in fact, Tamarind might be doing some of that right now.

        Gia, Svern, and Tamarind sit in their fancy seats and grin with anticipation as your attention shifts back over to them. Who's got what you need?
        "

rows.original: Etheryn's a grown-ass lady. She can buy her own stuff if she wants. This will remove this button from the game permanently.
rows.translation: 伊瑟琳已经是个成年女性了。如果她想买东西，完全有能力自己购买。这样做将会永久删除游戏中的这个按钮。
rows.raw: "Etheryn's a grown-ass lady. She can buy her own stuff if she wants. This will remove this button from the game permanently."

rows.original: "What's that? You want tea?" Gianna reaches beneath her hood and scratches the back of her head, giving you a glimpse of her faceted eyes. "No, for a... person, a lot further up north." Her tail taps the ground in time with her raptor-like foot-claws. "We haven't had much reason to travel up across the ice and past that winter city. Might be about time we change that, at least occasionally. Can this friend of yours pay for the journey's worth?" With a smug smile, you pull out the fist-sized ruby Kaina entrusted you with. "Can you make change for a fucking huge jewel?" Gianna makes the kind of hungry growl you'd expect to earn from sinking a thumb into her asshole, but she manages to show some self-restraint before extending her hands. "I... yes, I can do that." She greedily claims the red ruby and waves you over, climbing up into her chair and pulling out a small wooden chest. Her large, muscular rear sways from side-to-side beneath the many rags thrown over her body, but your imagination does plenty of work making up the difference. When she spins around in her chair, it's with a box full of individual pouches. "Let's see... here!" Gianna takes out one of the pouches and tosses it into your own waiting grasp, securing the crate once more. You test the pouch's weight and take a peek inside; 500 electrum. Not... not bad at all. "We can pick some up from Hawkethorne where it meets some measure of southern trade; probably thanks to you it's gotten a lot clearer around there." [flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED |"And the kitsune?" Gianna tilts her head and hums softly, bouncing in her seat. "Sure, we'll drive over there and pick some up. Sure beats having to slap down the thie[pc.ra kitsune |— uuh, foxes. |ving rats ] when we drive by." [pc.ra kitsune |You're sure she was going to say something a lot ruder about the Kitsune's proclivities |You're not sure they'd appreciate the comparison to rats ], but it's no skin off your teeth. Their fault for putting them anywhere near Gianna's wrong side. "That has to happen a lot?" "Used to... once again, I imagine thanks to you they've behaved themselves a little; do you know a trader there?" "Tell 'Kohaku' I sent you, be sure to haggle." You grin wickedly, trying to imagine the spritely shop-fox trying to mean-mug the powerful gargoyle. A shame you probably won't see that. "Well get underway now, then, unless you need something?" Gianna asks with a smile just visible beneath her rags. [flags.GIANNA_ANAL |"I hope you say you need me at least, my asshole feels oh-so-lonesome." ] |You give the gargoyle a deep bow, smiling warmly. "A pleasure doing business with you." ]
rows.translation: “那是什么？你想喝茶？”吉安娜把手伸到兜帽下，挠了挠后脑勺，让你瞥见了她的复眼。 “不是，是给一个……住在很远的北方的人。” 她的尾巴与猛禽般的脚爪同拍敲打地面。“我们一直没什么理由穿越冰原、经过那座冬城去更北边。或许是时候改变一下了，至少偶尔去一趟。你这位朋友付得起这趟旅程的费用吗？” 你得意地笑着，取出凯娜托付给你的拳头大小的红宝石。“这么他妈巨大的一颗宝石，你能找得开吗？” 吉安娜发出饥渴的低吼，听起来就像你把拇指插进她屁眼时会得到的反应；不过在伸出双手前，她勉强表现出几分克制。“我……能，我找得开。” 她贪婪地接过鲜红宝石，向你招招手；随后爬上椅子，拉出一只小木箱。层层破布下，她硕大而肌肉结实的屁股左右摇摆；不过那些遮住的细节，你的想象力足以补齐。她在椅子上转过身时，手里已多了一只装满独立小袋的箱子。“我看看……这里！”吉安娜取出一只小袋，抛进你早已伸出的手中，再次锁好箱子。 你掂了掂袋子的重量，朝里面看了一眼；500枚琥珀金币。还……真不错。 “我们可以从鹰棘镇收购一些；那里多少能接触到南方贸易。大概多亏了你，附近的道路已经畅通许多。” [flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED |“那么狐妖那边呢？” 吉安娜歪着脑袋轻声哼唱，在座位上上下弹动。“行啊，我们可以驾车过去收购。总比每次路过时都得教训那些贼[pc.ra kitsune |——呃，狐妖。 |老鼠 ]好得多。” [pc.ra kitsune |你确信她原本打算针对狐妖的习性说出粗鲁得多的话 |你不确定他们会不会喜欢被比作老鼠 ]，但这也不会让你掉一块肉。谁让他们非要撞上吉安娜最惹不得的一面。“经常发生这种事吗？” “以前经常……我想又是多亏了你，他们现在老实了一点；你在那里认识商人吗？” “告诉‘琥珀’是我介绍你去的，而且一定要讲价。”你坏笑着，试图想象那只活泼的商店狐妖故作凶狠、瞪着强壮石像鬼的模样。可惜你大概没机会亲眼看见。 “那么我们现在就出发，除非你还需要什么？”吉安娜问道，破布下刚好能看见她的微笑。[flags.GIANNA_ANAL |“我希望你至少会说需要我，我的屁眼可孤单得不得了。” ] |你向石像鬼深深鞠躬，温暖地微笑。“很高兴与你做生意。” ]

rows.translation: 让吉安娜她们自己处理这件事吧。

rows.original:
"What's that m'dear? Magical charms? Uuuh... possibly. What does it look like?"
    
    "Silver ring, silver bell, about this big. Should hook onto this sword's chain here." You pull out the aptly-named Songstress blade and show it off.
    
    "Aaah, I know just what you mean! I think Tammy tried to use it as a clit-ring once but it was a little too heavy to be comfortable."
    
    "Seriously?"
    
    "Hey, do you know how hard it is to find magical silver? I can't blame her... now, the real question is: how much for it, m'dear?" Gianna's hood lifts up a little so that you can see her eyes 'glitter'.
rows.translation:
“那是什么，亲爱的？魔法饰品？呃……也许吧。它长什么样？”
    
    “银环，银铃，大概这么大。应该能挂在这把剑的链子上。”你抽出那把名字起得恰如其分的歌姬之刃，展示给她看。
    
    “啊哈，我明白你的意思！我记得塔米曾经试过把它当阴蒂环用，但那东西有点太重了，用着不舒服。”
    
    “真的假的？”
    
    “嘿，你知道找到魔法银有多难吗？这不能怪她……现在，真正的问题是：这东西你要出多少钱，亲爱的？”吉安娜的兜帽微微掀起，让你能看到她的眼睛闪闪发亮。
rows.raw:
'
    "What's that m'dear? Magical charms? Uuuh... possibly. What does it look like?"
    
    "Silver ring, silver bell, about this big. Should hook onto this sword's chain here." You pull out the aptly-named Songstress blade and show it off.
    
    "Aaah, I know just what you mean! I think Tammy tried to use it as a clit-ring once but it was a little too heavy to be comfortable."
    
    "Seriously?"
    
    "Hey, do you know how hard it is to find magical silver? I can't blame her... now, the real question is: how much for it, m'dear?" Gianna's hood lifts up a little so that you can see her eyes 'glitter'.
    '

rows.original:
Gianna grins and palms off the charm to you — after a few minutes of rummaging around in her caravan — in exchange for a small pouch of coin. "Perfect, as ever, m'dear customer; it is a pleasure. You'll come back soon, right?"
        
        "Of course."
        
        You slip the ring onto the chain dangling from your greatsword, relieved to see it melt onto the chain and fit securely. Now when you give the hilt a shake it jingles pleasantly.
rows.translation:
吉安娜微笑着，从她的商队里翻找了几分钟后，终于把那枚护符交给了你——作为交换，你只需要给她一小袋硬币。“太好了，亲爱的顾客，每次都是这样，能为您服务真是我的荣幸。您很快还会再来吧？”
        
        “当然会。”
        
        你把那枚戒指挂在悬挂在巨剑上的链子上，看到它牢牢地固定在链子上，你顿时松了一口气。现在，每当你摇晃剑柄时，那铃声都会悦耳地响起。

rows.original:
"So, what can I do to help?" you ask your [pc.isSoulbound|fellow divine champion|fellow hunter of demons].
    
    Calise pulls her black veil aside and gives you a warm smile, putting a hand on your shoulder. "Ready to make a name for yourself, Champion? Good. This city is in desperate need of those strong enough to stand in her defense. And more importantly, I'm sorely lacking in trustworthy and capable agents I can rely on. The legions are a fearsome fighting force, but they're the least subtle instrument in Savarra: our enemies can see us coming from miles away and scurry into the shadows before we strike!"
    
    Calise balls a fist and slams it into an open palm. "So I need you to strike where my soldiers cannot. The first step, then? These imps are armed with more than just scavenged blades and hand-carved totems: they have swords and shields and staves, many of which seem castle-forged. Ever since your victory in the Winter City, we've begun seeing more imps armed with quality bronze. Somebody out their is financing the imp assault, and supplying them with arms. I need you to find out who's responsible, and then cut their supply lines."
    
    "Sounds [pc.isBimbo|nice and easy-peasy!|straightforward enough,]" you say. "Any idea where to start?"
    
    "I have a lead I've been unable to follow up on myself," Calise says, gesturing to one of her soldiers. The bull produces a vellum map of the Undermountain — a much larger, more labyrinthine complex than you've seen, from just a glance at the maps. Gods, the minotaurs really must have collapsed a huge amount of tunnels when this war broke out. Calise taps a gloved finger to the south of the city, near a tremendous underground lake. "The Khor'minoan waterways have canals leading out to the River Ridell and the coastlands to the east, but they all have this lake as their terminus. They're also the only entrances into the Undermountain not guarded by sealed gates and companies of Royal Chargers on the surface. I lead an expedition to secure the lake early in the crisis, but found no sign of imps whatsoever... so devoid of them in fact that it was downright suspicious. If there's smugglers down there, they'd have known the legion was marching a long way off. You though? A small party of adventurers won't draw so much attention."
    
    You nod. "So go to the lake and find the smugglers. Got it."
    
    "Excellent. While you're gone, I'll lead a cohort north to draw attention away from your activities. If the smugglers really are using the lake, they'll take our movements on the other side of the deeplands as an opportune time to do some business. Good luck, Champion, though I pray you'll not need against a group of smugglers and imps."
    
    "You too, Calise."
rows.translation:
“那么，我能帮什么忙？”你问自己的[pc.isSoulbound|神选勇士同僚|恶魔猎人同僚]。
    
    卡莉丝拨开黑色面纱，向你温暖一笑，一只手搭上你的肩膀。“准备好扬名立万了吗，冠军？很好。这座城市迫切需要足够强大、能挺身保卫她的人。更重要的是，我极度缺少值得信任、能力出众，能够依靠的探员。军团是可怕的战斗力量，却也是萨瓦拉最不隐蔽的工具：敌人在数英里外就能看见我们到来，等我们出击前便逃进了阴影！”
    
    卡莉丝握起拳头，重重砸进摊开的掌心。“所以，我需要你袭击士兵无法触及的地方。那么，第一步呢？这些小恶魔拥有的不只是捡来的刀刃和手工雕刻的图腾：他们有刀剑、盾牌和法杖，其中许多似乎由城堡锻造。自从你在冬城获胜以来，我们开始看见更多装备优质青铜武器的小恶魔。外面有人正在资助小恶魔的攻势，为他们提供武装。我需要你查清是谁负责此事，然后切断补给线。”
    
    “听起来[pc.isBimbo|简单又轻松！|相当直接，]”你说道。“知道该从哪里入手吗？”
    
    “我有条线索，但一直无法亲自追查，”卡莉丝说着，向一名士兵示意。那头公牛拿出一张山腹深域的羊皮地图——只需扫一眼便能看出，这片建筑群远比你去过的区域庞大、错综复杂。诸神啊，战争爆发时，弥诺陶洛斯一定炸塌了大量隧道。卡莉丝用戴着手套的手指点向城市南方，那里靠近一座巨大的地下湖。“科尔米诺斯的水道设有运河，通往里德尔河与东部海岸；但所有运河都以这座湖泊为终点。这也是山腹深域唯一一处未在地表受到封闭大门和皇家冲锋者部队把守的入口。危机初期，我率领一支远征队控制湖泊，却完全没有发现小恶魔的踪迹……那里空荡得如此彻底，反倒十分可疑。若地下藏着走私者，军团还在很远以外行军时，他们便会得到消息。可你呢？一小队冒险者不会引起那么大关注。”
    
    你点点头。“所以去湖边，找出走私者。明白。”
    
    “很好。你离开期间，我会带领一支大队向北进军，把注意力从你的行动上引开。如果走私者确实在使用湖泊，他们会把我们在深地另一端的行动当作做生意的好机会。祝你好运，冠军；不过我祈祷，你对付一群走私者和小恶魔时根本用不上运气。”
    
    “你也一样，卡莉丝。”
