rows.original: On the central table is a stack of papers that have each been folded in half once and sealed with a drop of wax. These are unsent letters – it may be an invasion of her privacy, but maybe there’s something in there you can use.
rows.translation: 中央的桌子上放着一叠纸张，每张都被对折过一次，并用一滴蜡封住了。这些都是未寄出的信件——这样做可能会侵犯她的隐私，但也许其中有些内容能对你有所帮助。

rows.original: You pass through the way into the next room without issue; there’s little ambient light to guide you forward as it is, and soon, you find yourself enveloped in total darkness. You can’t see where you’re going; you can’t see where you came from; and you can’t see the floor you’re walking on. You hear the uncomfortable grinding of stone against stone as you progress forward, followed by the rush of objects whizzing through the air; the room ahead of you is being built as you approach, and the room you left behind has been dismantled. Eventually, a gentle glow emanates from deeper down the corridor, guiding you towards it. When you enter the room the light is coming from, you’re shown to a... particular sight. The room is a massive dome with smoothened, gold-colored bricks, reaching roughly forty feet high and forty feet across in a semicircle. Sitting in the center of the domed room is a massive statue that makes up the centerpiece of the room: a number of women, and at least two men, of different sizes, shapes, and races, all surround a statue depicting a six-legged dragon. The men and women are all roughly scaled to your average [pc.race], but the dragon by itself is almost large enough to make the room feel claustrophobic. Among the smaller statues are two depicting lizard people, somewhat reminiscent of the pexighast, each of them bearing similar body shapes, but one is a man and the other is a woman; two lupine women, each of them with incredible musculature, with one set into a pose with her right leg up until her ankle is behind her neck and the other flexing her arms in a typical showman style, but they each have awkward etchings, with the leg-up woman having a gash across her eyes and the strongwoman having them across the backs of her hands; a human woman with flawless skin and an exaggerated hourglass figure; a shorter woman, looking like a cross between a lupine and a leothran, with breasts larger than her hips; a massive, muscular leothran man with sabertooth tusks and hair fashioned into a mohawk; a naga woman with a serpentine upper-body and facial features and a snake-like lower body large enough to coil around the entire base of the massive statue; and, towering over them all but smaller than the dragon, is a wyvern woman with four arms, two legs, and an impressive wingspan. And they’re all nude. Both of the men, the wyvern woman, the naga, and the massive dragon are all sporting thick erections of varying lengths and girths. The naga even has two. Set in the base of the exhibit is a plaque, and beneath that, a solid gold coin with a gigantic letter B etched into its face. The plaque reads: Hello! My name is... well, that doesn’t matter. What matters is my art! It’s thanks to people like you coming to see the hard work I’ve put into these statues that makes it all worth it. Take this coin as my thanks, and I hope you’ll enjoy my next project, whatever that may be! You pick up the coin and flip it between your fingers, testing its weight as it rolls between them. Wondering if it’s indeed made of gold, you put it between your teeth and bite – and the soft metal yields ever so slightly. Yep: it’s real gold. Something like this will be worth a pretty penny back in the real world. [lyric.around |As you turn and set the coin into your pack, you see Lyric’s head out of the corner of your eye, poking out through the opening of your pack. [lyric.HisHer] eyes are wider than you’ve ever seen them, and you can feel the swish of [lyric.hisHer] tail moving with enough force to shift the entire pack. [lyric.HisHer] tongue slips out to wetly lick [lyric.hisHer] lips once, twice, a third time. "Is that gold?" [lyric.heShe] asks. You answer that you believe it is. "You gonna eat that?" You’ll... maybe. You don’t know yet. Lyric’s nostrils flare at the news that you might not eat it. "'Kay," [lyric.heShe] says, but [lyric.heShe] doesn’t go back into the bag – not until you put your hand on [lyric.hisHer] head and push [lyric.himHer] in. ]
rows.translation: 你顺利地穿过通道，进入了下一个房间。由于周围几乎没有光线，你几乎无法看清前方的路，不久之后，你就陷入了一片彻底的黑暗之中。你看不见自己正在往哪里走，看不见自己是从哪里来的，甚至连脚下的地面也看不见。当你向前移动时，会听到石头相互摩擦产生的刺耳声响，紧接着是物体在空气中呼啸而过的声音；当你靠近前方房间时，那个房间正在被建造中，而你刚刚离开的房间则已经被拆除了。 最终，一道柔和的光芒从走廊的深处散发出来，指引着你朝着那个方向前进。当你走进那间灯光照射着的房间时，你会看到一幅……特别的景象。 那个房间是一个巨大的圆顶结构，由光滑的金色砖块砌成，半圆形的形状，高度和宽度都大约有四十英尺。在这个圆顶形房间的中央，矗立着一座巨大的雕像，这也是整个房间的核心装饰：几名女性以及至少两名男性，他们有着不同的体型、外貌和种族，全都围绕着这座描绘着六条腿的龙的雕像而站立。这些男女角色的体型都大致按照平均水平来设计的。 [pc.race]然而，那条龙本身就已经大到足以让整个房间显得拥挤不堪。 在那些较小的雕像中，有两座描绘了类蜥蜴生物的形象，它们与“佩克希加斯特”有些相似，体型也大致相同，但其中一座是男性形象，另一座则是女性形象；还有两座雌性狼族雕像，她们的肌肉线条都非常夸张——其中一座将右腿抬高，使得脚踝部位紧贴后颈；另一座则将双臂弯曲成典型的表演姿势。不过，这两座雕像的表面都有一些奇怪的雕刻痕迹：那只抬高腿部的雕像眼睛部位有一道裂口，而那位肌肉强健的女性雕像的手背上也有一道类似的伤口；还有一座皮肤完美无瑕、身材呈标准沙漏型的女性人类雕像；还有一座体型较矮的雕像，她的样子看起来像是狼族与莱奥特兰人的混合体，她的胸部甚至比臀部还要大；还有一座体型庞大、肌肉发达的莱奥特兰男性雕像，他长着剑齿，头发也被剃成了莫霍克发型；还有一座娜迦女性雕像，她的上半身有着蛇一般的轮廓和面部特征，而下半身则像一条蛇一样，长度足以绕过那座巨大雕像的基座；最后，还有一座高耸在所有雕像之上的雌性翼龙雕像，它有四条手臂、两条腿，翼展也非常壮观。 他们全都处于裸体状态。那两个男人、那名女妖怪、那条娜迦以及那条巨大的龙，他们的生殖器都处于勃起状态，长度和粗细各不相同。那条娜迦甚至有两条。 在展览区的底部有一块铭牌，而在铭牌的下方，有一枚纯金硬币，硬币的正面上刻着一个巨大的字母“B”。铭牌上写着： 你好！我的名字是……嗯，其实那并不重要。重要的是我的艺术！正是像你们这样的观众来看我为这些雕像所付出的努力，才让这一切变得有意义。请收下这枚硬币作为我的谢意，也希望你们能喜欢我的下一个作品，无论那会是什么！ 你捡起那枚硬币，在手指间把它抛来抛去，感受它落在指缝间的重量。你怀疑它是否真的由黄金制成，于是把它放在牙齿间咬了咬——那种柔软的金属确实有轻微的弹性。没错，这确实是真金。 在现实世界中，这样的东西肯定能卖个好价钱。 [lyric.around |当你转身把硬币放回背包时，你瞥见莉里克的脑袋从背包的缝隙中探了出来。 [lyric.HisHer]你的眼睛睁得比以往任何时候都要大，而且你能感受到那种“嗖”的一声[lyric.hisHer]尾巴的摆动力量足以使整个兽群发生移动。 [lyric.HisHer]舌头不由自主地伸出来，轻轻舔了舔[lyric.hisHer]一次，两次，第三次。 “那是黄金吗？ [lyric.heShe]你打算吃那个吗？” “嗯……也许吧。现在还不知道呢。” 听到你可能不会吃那个，莉里克的鼻孔微微张大了。“好吧，”她说。 [lyric.heShe]说是这样，但实际上[lyric.heShe]不会重新放进袋子里——除非你把手放上去。 [lyric.hisHer]带头推进[lyric.himHer]在……里面。 ]

Set in the base of the exhibit is a plaque, and beneath that, a solid gold coin with a gigantic letter B etched into its face. The plaque reads: Hello! My name is... well, that doesn’t matter. What matters is my art! It’s thanks to people like you coming to see the hard work I’ve put into these statues that makes it all worth it. Take this coin as my thanks, and I hope you’ll enjoy my next project, whatever that may be! You pick up the coin and flip it between your fingers, testing its weight as it rolls between them. Wondering if it’s indeed made of gold, you put it between your teeth and bite – and the soft metal yields ever so slightly. Yep: it’s real gold. Something like this will be worth a pretty penny back in the real world. [lyric.around |As you turn and set the coin into your pack, you see Lyric’s head out of the corner of your eye, poking out through the opening of your pack. [lyric.HisHer] eyes are wider than you’ve ever seen them, and you can feel the swish of [lyric.hisHer] tail moving with enough force to shift the entire pack. [lyric.HisHer] tongue slips out to wetly lick [lyric.hisHer] lips once, twice, a third time. "Is that gold?" [lyric.heShe] asks. You answer that you believe it is. "You gonna eat that?" You’ll... maybe. You don’t know yet. Lyric’s nostrils flare at the news that you might not eat it. "'Kay," [lyric.heShe] says, but [lyric.heShe] doesn’t go back into the bag – not until you put your hand on [lyric.hisHer] head and push [lyric.himHer] in. ]'

rows.original: Standing in the center of the room is a figure – a tall, thick figure wearing a dreary, ashen-gray cloak that hides most of their body except their size. They stand with their back facing you and the hood of the cloak left down off their head. A thick tail sprouts from behind them, curled into a shallow C shape, and at the end of their tail is a lick of flame that burns bright and healthy – but with a gray light, rather than the warm orange of a typical fire. At first, the person’s silhouette reminds you of Astraea. Could she have somehow made it into the fortress after you? [pc.isBimbo |You nearly step forward and call out to her, surprised-but-happy that Astraea came into the Ways Between after you did, but you feel Berwyn’s hand roughly backhand your chest to keep you in place. |"Is that...?" you hear Berwyn ask, and you see him take a step forward out of the corner of your eye. You stop him with a quick swing of your hand, blocking his way forward – Astraea said that the 'air’ of the Ways Between burned her skin and made her weak. She couldn’t have made it this far. ] As soon as [pc.isBimbo |you make |Berwyn makes ] a sound, the figure’s head whips toward you, spotting you instantly. It’s definitely a salamander, similar to Astraea, but where Astraea showed signs of recovery, this woman’s color has been entirely drained from her skin, her hair, and her eyes. The webbing that sprouted from Astraea’s eyes are similarly dominant on this woman’s face, but they stretch endlessly across her skin, disappearing into the fabric of her cloak. Her eyes stare into you with intensity, drilling into your very soul with their gaze, and yet you don’t exactly feel any emotion, or even conscious intelligence, in her glare. Wait... didn’t Astraea say she had a partner when she stormed this fortress? One that didn’t make it out when Astraea escaped? Her name was... Elexis, if you remember right. Once Elexis spots you, her left hand disappears into her cloak to withdraw a weapon – a gleaming sword etched with magical runes in its blade. And her right hand, while unarmed, begins to flex as colorless magic crackles and jumps between her fingertips. Elexis makes no sound as she regards you: she doesn’t grunt or moan or attempt to parlay. You’re not certain she’s breathing. And as soon as her weapon is tight in her grip, she doesn’t hesitate to charge you. It’s a fight with Elexis!
rows.translation: 站在房间中央的是一个身影——一个高大魁梧的人，身穿一件灰暗沉闷的斗篷，这件斗篷遮住了他们身体的大部分，只露出了他们的体型。他们背对着你站立，斗篷的兜帽也垂在他们的头上。他们的身后长出一条粗壮的尾巴，尾巴弯曲成浅C形，尾端燃烧着明亮的火焰——但那火焰呈现出灰色，而非普通火焰那种温暖的橙色。 起初，这个人的轮廓会让你联想到阿斯特莱娅。难道她是在你之后以某种方式进入了这座堡垒吗？ [pc.isBimbo |你几乎要上前去叫她，既惊讶又高兴，因为阿斯特莱娅在你之后也进入了那些通道，但这时你感觉到贝尔温的手猛地按在你的胸口上，将你拉了回来。 |那是……吗？”你听到贝尔温问道，同时隐约看到他正从视线的一角朝你走来。你迅速抬手阻住了他，让他无法继续前进——阿斯特莱娅说过，那些“通道”中的空气会灼伤她的皮肤，还会让她变得虚弱。无法能够走到这一步，实在来之不易。 ] 一有机会就[pc.isBimbo |你做到了。 |贝尔温制造 ]随着一声响动，那个身影的头猛地转向你，瞬间就发现了你。这无疑是一只蝾螈，与阿斯特莱娅相似，但与阿斯特莱娅有所不同的是，这个女人的皮肤、头发和眼睛都失去了原有的颜色，完全变得苍白无轻型。从阿斯特莱娅的眼中延伸出来的那些纹路，在这位女性的脸上也同样明显，但它们仿佛无休止地延伸着，覆盖了她的整个肌肤，最终消失在她的斗篷布料之中。她的目光紧紧地盯着你，那目光仿佛能穿透你的灵魂，然而你在她那凝视中却感受不到任何情绪，甚至没有任何智慧的痕迹。 等等……阿斯特莱娅在冲进这座堡垒的时候不是说过她有一个同伴吗？那个同伴在阿斯特莱娅逃跑时没能跟上来……如果我没记错的话，她的名字应该是……埃莱克西斯吧。 一旦埃莱克西斯发现了你，她的左手就会伸进斗篷里取出一件武器——那是一把剑身刻着魔法符文的闪亮宝剑。她的右手虽然没有持任何武器，却开始微微活动，无色的魔力在她的指尖闪烁跳跃。 埃莱克西斯没有发出任何声音，只是静静地注视着你：她既没有低吼，也没有呻吟，更没有试图与你交涉。你甚至不确定她是否还在呼吸。一旦她将武器牢牢握在手中，她就会毫不犹豫地向你冲过来。 这是与埃莱克西斯之间的战斗！

rows.original:
Despite not being fully in control of herself, Elexis is still a formidable fighter – she was one of Nareva’s finest magehunters for a reason. All of that brainwashing has done nothing to remove her training and combat prestige.

    With a blow to your hands, your [pc.weapon] is knocked from your grip, spiraling across the room, and with a second blow to the face, you’re knocked off your feet. Your vision is swimming and clouded by the strike, and when it finally rights itself, it’s just in time for you to clearly see the bottom of Elexis’ boot as it rushes toward your head.
    
    She’s a big, heavy woman, and the floor underneath you isn’t very soft. Luckily, the pain only lasted a second.
rows.translation:
尽管无法完全控制自己的行为，但埃莱克西斯仍然是一位令人敬畏的战士——她能够成为娜瑞瓦最出色的法师猎手之一，自然是有原因的。所有的洗脑尝试都未能抹去她所接受的训练以及她在战斗中积累的声誉。

    用一记重击击中你的手[pc.weapon]你的东西从手中脱落，在房间里飞旋着，而第二记击中你的面部，使你彻底倒地。那一下让你的视线变得模糊不清，但当视线终于恢复清晰时，你正好看到埃莱克西斯的高跟鞋跟正朝你的头部袭来。
    
    她是个身材高大、体重重型的女人，而你脚下的地面也并不柔软。幸运的是，那种疼痛只持续了一秒钟而已。

rows.original: Elexis rears back from that final blow, knocked off her balance. It takes a moment for her to correct herself, and when she eventually does, it’s only for a fleeting moment before she slips to one knee. Her grip on her sword comes loose, until eventually, it slips from her fingers and hits the stone floor with a loud 'clang!’ Elexis’ expression is smooth as stone, unblinking and laser-focused on you and your party – it’s almost like she isn’t present of mind to even acknowledge that her body is having difficulty moving with the wounds she’s sustained. And yet, some part of her knows that she’s beaten: her fingers fidget at the hilt of her weapon, grasping for its handle, and once she finally manages to wrap her fingers limply around its grip, she hoists herself upward once more, and with more effort than it ought to have. You ready yourself for another round, assuming that she’s found her second wind – but rather than approach, she turns and makes for the nearest exit, her weapon dragging across the floor as she walks. "Hey!" Berwyn shouts, readying his staff to try and intercept her with a spell, but before he can get anything off, the floor of the fortress roils beneath her feet, rippling like an ocean’s wave, picking up Elexis and gliding her down the nearest hallway faster than you could chase after her. And once she’s clear of the doorway’s frame, the walls seal behind her, leaving only brick where there was once a corridor. You and Berwyn stay tense and ready for whatever might happen next – the very walls of the fortress just conspired to protect Elexis from you, after all. But the room you’re in is silent as the dead, and after a moment of total stillness, you slowly relax your stance, assuming it to be safe. "You okay?" Berwyn asks you, his staff dug into a groove between the bricks at his feet as he leans on it for support. The adrenaline of the fight must be catching up with him. You reply that you’re fine and you ask him the same. "Y-yeah, I... I think so." He buries his face into the sleeve of his robe, panting from the exertion and wiping the sweat from his brow. "Imagine if she had gotten Astraea, too," he says in between his gasps for breath. Once you’ve caught up with yourselves, you survey the room that you’re in. You hadn’t noticed in the heat of the battle, but the layout of the room had shifted while you were busy with Elexis. You weren’t were you were before: now, you’re in a smaller room with a shallow ceiling and nothing adorning the walls. It’s a plain, featureless room, likely meant to be a connecting room to other, more important locations in the maze. Its utter lack of defining features is what makes it so memorable, though. You’re back where you started. At least Elexis likely won’t be stalking you now.
rows.translation: 艾丽克丝被最后一击打得向后仰去，失去了平衡。她花了片刻才稳住身体；可这份平衡稍纵即逝，她很快便单膝跪地。握剑的手逐渐松开；最终，长剑从指间滑落，“铛”的一声重重砸在石地上。 艾丽克丝面容如岩石般僵硬，眼也不眨地死死盯着你和同伴——她仿佛神志不清，甚至没有意识到，所受的伤已让身体难以行动。然而，她的某一部分知道自己已经落败：她的手指在剑柄旁抽动，努力抓向握柄；终于无力地将手指绕上去后，她再次撑起身体，而这远比本应付出的力气更加艰难。 你做好再战一轮的准备，以为她已经恢复力气——但她没有靠近，而是转身走向最近的出口，武器一路拖过地板。“嘿！”贝尔温大喊着举起法杖，准备施法截住她；可法术还没出手，堡垒的地板便在她脚下翻涌，像海浪一样起伏，将艾丽克丝托起，沿最近的走廊滑去，速度快到你根本追赶不上。她一离开门框，墙壁便在身后闭合；原本通往走廊的位置，只剩下坚实砖墙。 你和贝尔温仍紧绷身体，准备应对接下来可能发生的一切——毕竟，堡垒的墙壁刚刚合谋保护艾丽克丝逃离你们。但所在的房间死一般寂静；片刻的彻底安静过后，你慢慢放松架势，认为这里已经安全。 “你没事吧？”贝尔温问道。他把法杖插进脚边砖块间的凹槽，靠着它支撑身体。战斗带来的肾上腺素大概开始追上他了。你回答自己没事，又反问他相同的问题。“没、没事，我……应该没事。” 他把脸埋进长袍袖子里，因疲惫而不断喘息，顺便擦去额头的汗水。“想象一下，要是她连阿斯特莱娅也抓住了，”他在喘息间说道。 等你们缓过劲来，便开始查看所在的房间。激战中你没有注意到，但忙着对付艾丽克丝时，房间的布局已经发生变化。你们已不在先前的位置：如今所在的房间更小、天花板低矮，墙壁没有任何装饰。这是一间朴素而毫无特色的房间，大概用来连接迷宫中其他更重要的地点。 不过，正是因为完全没有辨识特征，它才如此令人印象深刻。你们回到了起点。 至少艾丽克丝现在应该不会继续尾随你们。

rows.original:
You travel down the wide hallway with Berwyn at your side; the walls slowly close in with each step you take until you’re nearly walking shoulder-to-shoulder with him beside you. Eventually, the hallway opens into a larger, wider, more opulent room, and once it does, the bricks of the fortress shift and transform behind you, sealing the way you came shut... but the shifting stops earlier than you expected. It doesn’t make any more rooms ahead of you. Have you found the end of the maze?

    The room you’re in holds a large, wide staircase, with the stairs spaced far enough apart that you’d need a full gait to go from one to the other, and they’re low enough that it’s almost more like a ramp than a staircase. The stairs are dressed with a plush purple rug with a golden trim, reaching from the landing you’re on and going all the way up to the top of the stairs. On either side of the staircase are candelabras, two every twenty stairs or so, each of them taller than you are and each of them lit with seven candles burning with a purple flame.
    
    "Can you feel that?" Berwyn asks you, his voice lowered to a nervous whisper.
    
    You pause and take in what it is he could mean. Aside from the general sense of foreboding that you’re getting from the sight in front of you, you admit that you don’t feel anything out of the ordinary.
    
    Berwyn raises his right arm, eyeing the fur across his skin. The individual hairs stand on end on his arm, waving slightly with each movement he makes. It doesn’t seem like goosebumps making him all poofy like that – it’s more like static electricity in the air. Or... perhaps the air is overly saturated with power.
    
    "She’s at the top of these stairs," he says, priming his staff at his side. "We’ve made it to the end."
    
    He turns to you, looking you in the eye. He’s trying to put on a surely, confident face: his eyes are narrowed on yours, trying to stare daggers into you, but he can’t help his chin from quivering from the nervous anticipation.
    
    "R-ready when you are."
rows.translation:
你与贝尔温并肩沿着宽阔的走廊前行，每走一步，墙壁似乎都在慢慢逼近，最终你们几乎肩并肩地走在了一起。不久之后，走廊尽头出现了一个更加宽敞、豪华的房间，而就在这时，堡垒背后的砖墙开始移动并发生变化，将你们来时的道路彻底封闭了起来……然而，这种变化在你们预期的地方就停止了。前方再也没有其他的房间出现了。难道你们已经找到了这个迷宫的尽头吗？

    你所在的这个房间里有一段宽敞的楼梯，台阶之间的距离相当大，因此你需要迈出完整的步幅才能从一级台阶走到另一级；同时，这些台阶的高度也较低，因此它们更像是一条斜坡，而不是传统的楼梯。楼梯上铺着一条柔软的紫色地毯，边缘还饰有金色的边纹，这条地毯从你所在的楼梯平台一直延伸到楼梯的顶端。在楼梯的两侧，每隔大约二十级台阶就摆放着一盏烛台，每盏烛台都比你还要高，上面点着七支燃烧着紫色火焰的蜡烛。
    
    你能感觉到吗？”贝尔温用紧张的低语声问道。
    
    你停顿了一下，试图理解他所说的意思。除了眼前这一幕所带给你的那种不祥预感之外，你确实没有感觉到任何异常。
    
    贝尔温抬起右臂，注视着自己皮肤上的那些毛发。他的手臂上的每一根毛发都竖了起来，每当他移动身体时，这些毛发就会微微摆动。这看起来并不像是普通的鸡皮疙瘩造成的，更像是空气中的静电作用……或者……也许这片空气中的能量过于浓郁了。
    
    她就在这些楼梯的顶端，”他说着，将手杖紧握在身侧。“我们终于到达目的地了。”
    
    他转向你，直视着你的眼睛。他努力展现出一种自信的神情：他的眼睛紧盯着你，仿佛要用目光刺穿你，但紧张的情绪还是让他下巴不由自主地微微颤抖着。
    
    等你准备好了，我们就开始吧。

It doesn’t make any more rooms ahead of you. Have you found the end of the maze?

    The room you’re in holds a large, wide staircase, with the stairs spaced far enough apart that you’d need a full gait to go from one to the other, and they’re low enough that it’s almost more like a ramp than a staircase. The stairs are dressed with a plush purple rug with a golden trim, reaching from the landing you’re on and going all the way up to the top of the stairs. On either side of the staircase are candelabras, two every twenty stairs or so, each of them taller than you are and each of them lit with seven candles burning with a purple flame.
    
    "Can you feel that?" Berwyn asks you, his voice lowered to a nervous whisper.
    
    You pause and take in what it is he could mean. Aside from the general sense of foreboding that you’re getting from the sight in front of you, you admit that you don’t feel anything out of the ordinary.
    
    Berwyn raises his right arm, eyeing the fur across his skin. The individual hairs stand on end on his arm, waving slightly with each movement he makes. It doesn’t seem like goosebumps making him all poofy like that – it’s more like static electricity in the air. Or... perhaps the air is overly saturated with power.
    
    "She’s at the top of these stairs," he says, priming his staff at his side. "We’ve made it to the end."
    
    He turns to you, looking you in the eye. He’s trying to put on a surely, confident face: his eyes are narrowed on yours, trying to stare daggers into you, but he can’t help his chin from quivering from the nervous anticipation.
    
    "R-ready when you are."'

rows.original: The climb up the stairs was longer than either of you had anticipated – the hallway seemed to stretch as if the fortress itself was trying to keep you away from Matiha. Yet, eventually, you find the peak of the staircase, and at its top is a single wooden door with a rusted metal latch – a far departure from the fanciness of the stairs you had just climbed, but it also has some... nostalgia to it. You had been here before: you had climbed this tower before; you had seen this door before; and you know what’s behind it. You ignore the tingly feeling your hand feels when you place it on the metal handle, and you give the room a push, entering the highest room of the fortress’s tower. You’re in the room that Matiha has adopted for her personal study – a large desk made of beautifully-carved wood is the centerpiece, with a number of leather bound books sitting on its top. [var0 |Unlike the laboratory you had found earlier, Matiha goes through painstaking lengths to keep this room neat and tidy: the books are stacked neatly near one edge of the table, and a single piece of parchment is on its top, facing a regal chair at the desk’s front. |Matiha has been going through lengths to keep the place neat and tidy – or maybe she just doesn’t actually do a lot of work up here. If not here, then... maybe somewhere else in the fortress? Not that you’re about to turn around and start looking. ] Standing beside the desk is Elexis, as tall and firm and soulless as she had before. Her grip on her weapon is sturdier than it was when you last saw her, but judging from the wounds she still has, she hasn’t properly recovered from your last encounter. Nonetheless, she remains in place, standing stalwart before you and ready to defend Matiha’s office, perhaps to the death. Sitting in the chair behind the desk is Matiha, her hand hurriedly scribbling something into the parchment before her. Just as the last time you met her, she’s wearing the same black magician’s outfit as she had before: a set of blue robes that cling too-tightly to her curvaceous body, and with an oversized hat to go with it. From her current posture and her face down on her paper, you can’t quite make out the details of her body. But the thing that commands your attention the most is the stone with the rune painted on it. The last time you had been here, it was little more than a rock with some ink, despite being a powerful focus for Matiha’s magic. Since then, it’s... mutated. Grown and splintered, with pale green lights shining from between the cracks of the stone as it struggles to contain the absurd amount of energy that’s been stored inside of it, bathing the room in an eerie green incandescent glow. The pieces of the stone rattle gently against each other, held in place more by the gravity of the sheer power it’s struggling to contain than its own structure. "Ah, Berwyn," Matiha says smoothly. She doesn’t look up from her writing. Her voice is as regal and seductive as you remember it being. "I almost didn’t hear you come in. You should start wearing sandals or something on those paws of yours." Berwyn stands beside you, his staff at the ready – but he doesn’t try to engage. You both know it’d be a losing battle. Astraea and Elexis, two Astrida magehunters, couldn’t beat her, and now one of them is working for her. "M-Matiha," he croaks, his voice breaking and coming out as a shrill hiccup. Suddenly, something comes over Berwyn: it’s as if he realized how he looked and how he sounded, and he didn’t approve of himself at all. He takes a deep breath, in through his nose and out through his mouth, as he rights his posture and realigns his grip on his staff. With a steely, determined gaze, he faces forward, ready to try again. "Matiha," he says again, his voice coming out lower, more commanding, more confident. "We’re here to stop you." Matiha doesn’t respond at first; she takes her time finishing the thought she had and putting it down onto the paper before placing her quill in its inkwell. She pushes her chair away from the desk, the legs scraping loudly across the stone, and she stands.
rows.translation: 爬上楼梯的过程比你们任何人预想的都要漫长——走廊似乎无穷无尽地延伸着，仿佛整个堡垒都在试图将你们与玛蒂哈隔开。然而，最终你们还是到达了楼梯的顶端，在那里有一扇木门，门上装着一个生锈的金属锁扣。这与你们刚刚爬过的那些华丽楼梯相比，显得朴实了许多，但也不乏独到的韵味。这种感觉让人充满怀旧之情。你曾经来过这里：你曾经爬过这座塔；你曾经见过这扇门；你知道门后有什么。 你没有在意手触碰到金属门把手时那种刺痛的感觉，推开门，走进了这座堡垒塔楼中最高的房间。 你现在所处的这个房间，是玛蒂哈用来进行个人学习的场所。房间中央摆放着一张由精美木料制成的大型书桌，书桌面上放着几本皮封书籍。 [var0 |与你之前遇到的那些实验室不同，玛蒂哈花费了大量的精力来保持这个房间的整洁：书籍被整齐地堆放在桌子的一边，桌面上只放着一张羊皮纸，它正对着书桌前那把豪华的椅子。 |玛蒂哈一直在不遗余力地保持这个地方的整洁——或者也许她其实并没有在这里花太多心思去打扫。如果不是在这里，那么……也许是在堡垒的其他地方吧？不过你也不会真的转身去那里查看就是了。 ] 站在办公桌旁的是埃莱克西斯，她依旧那么高大、结实，却也依旧缺乏生气。她握武器的姿势比你上次见到她时更加稳重，但从她身上那些仍未愈合的伤口来看，她显然还没有从上次的遭遇中完全恢复过来。不过，她依然坚守在自己的岗位上，坚定地站在你面前，准备为玛蒂哈的办公室赴汤蹈火，甚至不惜牺牲性命。 坐在书桌后面的椅子上的是玛蒂哈，她的手正在匆忙地在面前的羊皮纸上写着什么。就像你上次见到她时一样，她仍然穿着那套黑色的魔法师服装：一套紧贴着她曲线优美的身形的蓝色长袍，还戴着一顶超大号的帽子。从她现在的姿势以及她把头低在纸上的样子来看，你根本无法看清她身体的细节。 但最吸引你注意的，是那块刻有符文的石头。上次你来到这里时，它只不过是一块被涂上墨水的石头而已，尽管它其实是玛蒂哈魔法力量的重要汇聚点。从那以后，它发生了……变异。它不断扩张、分裂，石头裂缝中透出淡绿色的光芒，那是因为它正在努力抑制体内储存的巨大能量，这种能量使得整个房间都被一种诡异的绿色光芒笼罩着。这些石块相互轻轻碰撞着，它们之所以能保持在一起，更多的是依靠那股它们竭力想要抑制的巨大力量所产生的重力，而非它们自身的结构。 啊，贝林，”玛蒂哈平静地说道。她没有从写作中抬起头来，她的声音依旧如你记忆中那样高贵而迷人。“我差点没听到你进来。你以后应该穿双凉鞋之类的，不然你的脚会疼的。” 贝林站在你身旁，手中的法杖已经准备就绪——但他并没有试图与她争执。你们都知道，那只会是徒劳的。就连两位名叫阿斯特莱娅和埃莱克西斯的女法师猎手也未能战胜她，而现在，其中一个人竟然还在为她效力。 马-玛蒂哈，”他嘶哑着声音说道，声音颤抖着，听起来像是一连串尖锐的抽噎声。 突然，贝尔温仿佛意识到了自己现在的样子和声音，他对自己感到非常不满意。他深吸一口气，通过鼻子吸气，然后通过嘴巴呼气，调整好自己的姿势，重新握紧手中的法杖。他目光坚定，充满决心地向前看去，准备再次尝试。 玛蒂哈，”他再次说道，声音变得低沉而有力，更具威严感。自信的。我们在这里是为了阻止你。” 起初，玛蒂哈没有回应；她花了一些时间来完成自己的想法，然后将其写在纸上，之后才将羽毛笔放回墨水瓶中。她把椅子从桌子旁推开，椅腿在石板上发出刺耳的声响，随后她站了起来。

rows.original: You remember Matiha’s skin being pale, and her hair being brown, reaching down to her shoulders. You remember her eyes being a deep brown, the irises taking up most of the space. You remember her complexion being damn-near perfect, across her face and her exposed thigh. This 'new’ Matiha has dark-gray skin, looking similarly to Elexis beside her. Her mage’s outfit hasn’t been updated and her thigh is still exposed to the air. Pulsating veins criss-cross in thick spider webs across her face, her thigh, and, judging by the dull glow beneath her clothing, all throughout her body: the spider webs focus in on her eyes and the direction of the pulses start at her chest and emanate outwards, rolling across her face from the neck up, as if her heart wasn’t pumping blood, but ether. Her hair is longer, reaching down to her shoulder blades, but the roots have been frosted to the same pale teal as what courses through the veins. And her eyes... have been replaced by something else altogether. Gone are the vibrant-brown irises, replaced with a dark, swirling void of teals and blacks, daring you to stare into them for longer than a second at a time. Bluish tendrils claw their way into her pupils, giving her eyes a shattered look to them, and they seem to ripple with every pulse of her heart. "Stop me?" Matiha asks, tilting her head to one side. Her massive hat sways underneath its own weight from the motion. "From doing what? What have I done wrong?" [pc.isDK |You gesticulate wordlessly towards Elexis. |You answer for Berwyn, saying that she’s been siphoning the very energy straight from Savarra and leaving barren, lifeless husks of earth in their place – and, also, she’s kidnapped and brainwashed Elexis, which would be reason enough. ] "Who’s talking to you?" she snaps, her eyes widening and her nose flaring towards you. As her expression changes, the tendrils in her eyes flare and wriggle wildly. And just as soon as it started, she calms herself as she addressed Berwyn again. "Berwyn... I always knew this was going to be a difficult conversation to have. I was always worried that you wouldn’t come back to me with open arms, understanding that what I’ve done, I’ve done for not just the betterment of you or me, but for the betterment of the world." She leans forward, her lips curling into a hopeful smile that crescents the lower half of her eyes. The entirety of her massive cleavage is on display for Berwyn to ogle. He, however, displays more willpower than you gave him credit for, and his stare on her doesn’t break[pc.isBimbo |, whereas you, as soon as you saw those fat sweater cows, nearly forgot where you were and what you were doing ]. But he also doesn’t say anything more: he keeps his staff at the ready and continues to let her speak. "I’ve made so much progress since we last spoke, Berwyn. I’ve learned so much. And I’m excited to teach you everything that I know, so that you can share in my success." She turns, walking towards the rune stone hovering a few inches off the pedestal. "I’m sure you remember seeing this last time you were here. Although I’m certain it looks a bit different." She giggles as she turns back towards you and Berwyn. As she gets closer to the stone, the pulsating in her veins gets faster and their colors become deeper and richer – and the tendrils in her eyes start shifting in her irises, causing them to glow faintly. "I’m sorry for keeping this from you, but I needed to make sure I knew what I was doing... and I needed to make sure that you weren’t as crude as your grandfather was." Berwyn starts, his grip getting tighter on his staff at the mention of his grandfather. "You knew him?" "Oh, yes. We were mages from the same college. Fiodoir was a brilliant battlemage, as proficient with a sword as he was with a tome. But I’m sure you’ve heard all the stories by now." She turns towards the stone, regarding it with a muted sort of passion – the kind that a lover would give to their partner while they enjoy some comfortable silence together. She even reaches out to stroke its side, her finger lightly grazing the ink on the stone. "But, and forgive me for saying, your grandfather was also a fool. We had found this stone after a massive hurricane had devastated the western coastline and unearthed a number of artifacts that we had determined to be Jotun in origin. This was many decades ago, of course – over a century, if my math is right. And he wanted to destroy it." She takes a deep sigh through her nose before turning to face you two again. "This stone carried over twenty-five-hundred years of ambient mana stored in it. It was essentially a store of near-infinite potential, just waiting to be untapped for anyone smart enough to do it and brave enough to try." She frowns. "Your grandfather was neither." She strides towards her desk, her legs sashaying with an exaggerated gait, meant to draw your eyes to her exposed hips[pc.isBimbo |. And it works. Matiha is being very seductive, and you’re all for it, frankly |, but neither you nor Berwyn fall for it ]. "And thanks to Nareva’s gifts," she continues, coming up beside Elexis and wrapping her arms around the salamander’s waist and resting her cheek against her arm, embracing her lovingly. Elexis does not acknowledge Matiha’s presence. "I’ve learned so much about mana conservation; about utilization and proficiency; and I’ve even learned a bit about polymorphization, that notoriously-difficult school of magic." She pouts, her lips curling in frustration. "Although I would have learned more if I hadn’t let that other magehunter slip away from me." She steps towards Berwyn, entering his personal space. He takes one step back, raising his staff across his body defensively, but he doesn’t make a move to use it, and she simply lowers it with her right hand. He doesn’t want to fight – in part because he probably doesn’t want to hurt Matiha, and in part because that’s not a winning battle – but if she keeps getting handsy, something is going to happen sooner rather than later. She gently cups his chin, lifting his eyes up to hers. "Your grandfather was brilliant at what he did, Berwyn... but the potential you have is far, far greater than his own." A moment of silence passes between the two of them. "Really?" he asks, his voice lilting with hope. He always wanted to be a powerful magician. From the way his body is moving, Berwyn isn’t about to interrupt Matiha from what she’s saying or doing. Maybe you should interrupt while you still can. But on the other hand, if you wait, maybe she’ll let something slip – something damning that can help you against her. After all, you’ll need everything that you can get against someone as powerful as her.
rows.translation: 你记得玛蒂哈的皮肤很白，头发呈棕色，长及肩膀。你记得她的眼睛是深棕色的，虹膜占据了眼睛的大部分面积。你记得她的肌肤几乎完美无瑕，无论是她的脸庞还是裸露的大腿部位。 这个“新的”玛蒂哈拥有深灰色的皮肤，站在她身边的埃莱克西斯看起来和她颇为相似。她的法师装束仍未得到更新，大腿依然裸露在外。在她脸上、大腿上，以及从她的衣物下隐约可见的那些部位，粗大的血管像蜘蛛网一样纵横交错。这些血管主要集中在她的双眼周围，而脉动的方向则从她的胸部开始，向外延伸，仿佛她的心脏输送的不是血液，而是某种其他物质——以太。 她的头发更长了，已经垂到了肩胛骨处，但发根被染成了与她血管中流淌的血液相同的淡蓝绿色。而她的双眼……也完全变了样。那曾经充满活力的深棕色虹膜已经消失，取而代之的是一片由蓝黑色交织而成的暗影虚空，仿佛在挑衅你，让你不敢长时间注视它们。一些带有蓝色的细丝仿佛在她的瞳孔中蔓延，使得她的眼睛看起来仿佛破碎了一般，而且这些颜色似乎会随着她每一次的心跳而波动。 阻止我？”玛蒂哈歪着头问道。她那顶巨大的帽子因为她的动作而自行晃动起来。“阻止我做什么？我到底做错了什么？ [pc.isDK |你无声地朝埃莱克西斯做了个手势。 |你为贝尔温辩护，声称她一直在直接吸取萨瓦拉的能量，导致那些地区变成了荒芜不堪、毫无生机的土地；此外，她还绑架了埃莱克西斯并对她进行了洗脑，这些理由已经足够说明她的罪行了。 ] 谁在和你说话？”她厉声问道，眼睛瞪得大大的，鼻子也朝你的方向挺了起来。随着她的表情发生变化，她眼中的那些细纹也开始剧烈地蠕动起来。然而，这种状态仅仅持续了一瞬间，她很快又恢复了平静，继续对贝尔温说话。贝尔温……我早就知道，这次谈话会非常艰难。我一直担心，你不会张开双臂接纳我，也不会理解我所做的一切，其实并不是为了你或我的利益，而是为了整个世界的进步。她向前倾身，嘴角勾起一丝充满希望的微笑，这微笑让她的下眼睑也仿佛弯成了月牙形。她那巨大的胸脯完全暴露在贝尔温的视线之中，任由他欣赏。 然而，贝尔温展现出的意志力比你想象中的要强得多，他的目光始终没有从她身上移开。[pc.isBimbo |而你，一看到那些穿着肥厚毛衣的女人，差点就忘了自己当时在哪里、在做什么了。 ]但他也没有再说什么：他只是让手下的工作人员随时待命，继续让她继续说话。 “自从我们上次见面以来，我取得了很大的进步，贝尔温。我学到了很多东西。现在，我非常渴望把我所知道的一切都传授给你，这样你就可以分享我的成功了。 她转过身，朝着那块悬浮在基座上方几英寸处的符文石走去。“我相信你上次来这里的时候肯定见过这个。虽然现在它的样子应该有点不同了。”她边说边轻笑，然后又转向你和贝尔温。当她逐渐靠近那块石头时，她体内的脉动变得愈发剧烈，石头的颜色也变得更加深沉、浓郁——同时，她眼中的那些触须开始在虹膜中移动，使得她的双眼会发出微弱的光芒。“很抱歉没有告诉你这件事，但我必须确保自己清楚自己在做什么。……而我必须确保你不会像你祖父那样粗鲁。 贝尔温一听到提到他的祖父，手中的法杖就握得更紧了。“你认识他？” “哦，是的。我们曾是同一所魔法学院的法师。菲奥多尔是一位非常出色的战斗法师，他使用剑的技巧，和运用法术书的能力一样娴熟。不过，我相信你现在应该已经听过了所有关于他的故事吧。 她转向那块石头，以一种充满柔情的眼神注视着它——那种情感，就像恋人们在共享宁静时光时对彼此所怀有的感情一样。她甚至伸出手去，轻轻抚摸它的表面，手指轻轻划过石头上的文字。 她大步走向自己的办公桌，脚步摇摆得有些夸张，就是为了吸引人们的目光，让大家注意到她露出的臀部。[pc.isBimbo |而且这个方法确实有效。玛蒂哈表现得非常迷人，说实话，你们所有人都很喜欢她。 |但是，你和贝尔温都没有上当。 rows.raw: ' You remember Matiha’s skin being pale, and her hair being brown, reaching down to her shoulders. You remember her eyes being a deep brown, the irises taking up most of the space. You remember her complexion being damn-near perfect, across her face and her exposed thigh. This 'new’ Matiha has dark-gray skin, looking similarly to Elexis beside her. Her mage’s outfit hasn’t been updated and her thigh is still exposed to the air. Pulsating veins criss-cross in thick spider webs across her face, her thigh, and, judging by the dull glow beneath her clothing, all throughout her body: the spider webs focus in on her eyes and the direction of the pulses start at her chest and emanate outwards, rolling across her face from the neck up, as if her heart wasn’t pumping blood, but ether. Her hair is longer, reaching down to her shoulder blades, but the roots have been frosted to the same pale teal as what courses through the veins. And her eyes... have been replaced by something else altogether. Gone are the vibrant-brown irises, replaced with a dark, swirling void of teals and blacks, daring you to stare into them for longer than a second at a time. Bluish tendrils claw their way into her pupils, giving her eyes a shattered look to them, and they seem to ripple with every pulse of her heart. "Stop me?" Matiha asks, tilting her head to one side. Her massive hat sways underneath its own weight from the motion. "From doing what? What have I done wrong?" [pc.isDK |You gesticulate wordlessly towards Elexis. |You answer for Berwyn, saying that she’s been siphoning the very energy straight from Savarra and leaving barren, lifeless husks of earth in their place – and, also, she’s kidnapped and brainwashed Elexis, which would be reason enough. ] "Who’s talking to you?" she snaps, her eyes widening and her nose flaring towards you. As her expression changes, the tendrils in her eyes flare and wriggle wildly. And just as soon as it started, she calms herself as she addressed Berwyn again. "Berwyn... I always knew this was going to be a difficult conversation to have. I was always worried that you wouldn’t come back to me with open arms, understanding that what I’ve done, I’ve done for not just the betterment of you or me, but for the betterment of the world." She leans forward, her lips curling into a hopeful smile that crescents the lower half of her eyes. The entirety of her massive cleavage is on display for Berwyn to ogle. He, however, displays more willpower than you gave him credit for, and his stare on her doesn’t break[pc.isBimbo |, whereas you, as soon as you saw those fat sweater cows, nearly forgot where you were and what you were doing ]. But he also doesn’t say anything more: he keeps his staff at the ready and continues to let her speak. "I’ve made so much progress since we last spoke, Berwyn. I’ve learned so much. And I’m excited to teach you everything that I know, so that you can share in my success." She turns, walking towards the rune stone hovering a few inches off the pedestal. "I’m sure you remember seeing this last time you were here. Although I’m certain it looks a bit different." She giggles as she turns back towards you and Berwyn. As she gets closer to the stone, the pulsating in her veins gets faster and their colors become deeper and richer – and the tendrils in her eyes start shifting in her irises, causing them to glow faintly. "I’m sorry for keeping this from you, but I needed to make sure I knew what I was doing... and I needed to make sure that you weren’t as crude as your grandfather was." Berwyn starts, his grip getting tighter on his staff at the mention of his grandfather. "You knew him?" "Oh, yes. We were mages from the same college. Fiodoir was a brilliant battlemage, as proficient with a sword as he was with a tome. But I’m sure you’ve heard all the stories by now." She turns towards the stone, regarding it with a muted sort of passion – the kind that a lover would give to their partner while they enjoy some comfortable silence together. She even reaches out to stroke its side, her finger lightly grazing the ink on the stone. "But, and forgive me for saying, your grandfather was also a fool. We had found this stone after a massive hurricane had devastated the western coastline and unearthed a number of artifacts that we had determined to be Jotun in origin. This was many decades ago, of course – over a century, if my math is right. And he wanted to destroy it." She takes a deep sigh through her nose before turning to face you two again. "This stone carried over twenty-five-hundred years of ambient mana stored in it. It was essentially a store of near-infinite potential, just waiting to be untapped for anyone smart enough to do it and brave enough to try." She frowns. "Your grandfather was neither." She strides towards her desk, her legs sashaying with an exaggerated gait, meant to draw your eyes to her exposed hips[pc.isBimbo |. And it works. Matiha is being very seductive, and you’re all for it, frankly |, but neither you nor Berwyn fall for it ]. "And thanks to Nareva’s gifts," she continues, coming up beside Elexis and wrapping her arms around the salamander’s waist and resting her cheek against her arm, embracing her lovingly. Elexis does not acknowledge Matiha’s presence. "I’ve learned so much about mana conservation; about utilization and proficiency; and I’ve even learned a bit about polymorphization, that notoriously-difficult school of magic." She pouts, her lips curling in frustration. "Although I would have learned more if I hadn’t let that other magehunter slip away from me." She steps towards Berwyn, entering his personal space. He takes one step back, raising his staff across his body defensively, but he doesn’t make a move to use it, and she simply lowers it with her right hand. He doesn’t want to fight – in part because he probably doesn’t want to hurt Matiha, and in part because that’s not a winning battle – but if she keeps getting handsy, something is going to happen sooner rather than later. She gently cups his chin, lifting his eyes up to hers. "Your grandfather was brilliant at what he did, Berwyn... but the potential you have is far, far greater than his own." A moment of silence passes between the two of them. "Really?" he asks, his voice lilting with hope. He always wanted to be a powerful magician. From the way his body is moving, Berwyn isn’t about to interrupt Matiha from what she’s saying or doing. Maybe you should interrupt while you still can. But on the other hand, if you wait, maybe she’ll let something slip – something damning that can help you against her. After all, you’ll need everything that you can get against someone as powerful as her.'

rows.original: "You might have noticed the changes to your body. I’m sorry for deceiving you like that, Berwyn, but there was a reason for it." Her other hand goes through his hair, stroking his thick, luscious locks and running her fingers through the soft, white strands. "I was trying to get your potential to manifest in the golems I was having you practice animating. And it worked to a certain degree. Summoning isn’t a novice-level school of magic, and yet you were conjuring stone golems that could walk and perform basic tasks by the end of your third week." For the first time since she started talking, Berwyn breaks eye contact with Matiha to look at his hands, still tightly grasping at his staff. "I," he mutters, "I thought... that I was bad at it." "Gracious, no!" Matiha says, leaning backward in surprise. "You took to it like a fish to water, Berwyn! At three weeks, a summoner would have an easier time making a snowman than getting some rocks to move. You were a natural at it!" She relaxes, cupping both of his cheeks with her hands. "Although, my efforts weren’t exactly perfect. You probably assumed that I was spiking your tea, right?" Berwyn says nothing in response. "That probably would have been the more direct approach, and maybe it would have had better results, but I’m no alchemist. I was enchanting the cup you drank the tea from instead. The physical changes to your body were unintentional side effects, from me putting a bit of myself into the spells. The shorter body; the svelte hourglass figure...." Her hands go to herself, sensually rubbing at her hips, her waist, and up to her ribs, just beneath her breasts. "I’ll take it as a compliment that you came out as gorgeous as you did, Berwyn." He pauses once again, absorbing everything that Matiha was telling him. "What about the libido? And the big dick?" he asks. "I never knew you to be particularly libidinous. Or to be hung like a minotaur." "The libido was a manifestation of your magical aptitude. Once the enchantments starting taking hold, your magical prowess needed an outlet somehow, and you were still working on your summoning." She leans in closer, until her nose is pressed against Berwyn’s. "And as for the big dick," she says lowly. Her mouth goes to his left ear, her lips brushing against its furred edge. "I like it that way. And you can learn just how libidinous I can be later, if you’d like." At that, Berwyn’s body language visibly changes: his body gets stiff and his grip on his staff tightens. When Matiha pulls away from him, you can see that the hem of his robe is beginning to pitch. "I know we’ve had our misgivings, Berwyn. Given that your mission statement is to 'stop me,’ you think what I’m doing is wrong, by siphoning the mana from Savarra and," she says, gesturing over her shoulder with a flick of her hair, "from our guest. But think about the possibilities. A stone with as much power as mine could fuel all of Savarra’s needs for centuries. And since finding my way into the Ways Between, I’ve learned how to improve the Jotun enchantment and increase its intake." Her hands travel down his arms, closing around his hands. His grip loosens a bit on his staff until she can worm her fingers into his. "With potential like yours, Berwyn, and with my experience, and with unlimited power, we could do a lot of good for the world." She leans in closer, her face against his once more. "We’d be heroes." Her nose presses against his gently, softly brushing against it. "We could be king and queen." Her voice drops to a whisper. "You and me." Her lips touch his. You can still stop this, before it gets out of hand.

rows.translation: 时间既短暂又无关紧要。在“彼岸之道”中，不存在秒、分钟、小时、天、月或年这样的概念，也没有什么事物会比其他事物更长或更短。那里只有事件。 当你让贝尔温和玛蒂哈重逢后，他们至少连续进行了八次性行为。在他们恢复之后，玛蒂哈对你进行了一系列操作……或许应该说是一种治疗，现在你几乎感觉不到任何东西了。你仍然清醒、有意识，但变得优柔寡断、无精打采：你只是在等待下一个指令，然后在指令下达时乖乖执行而已。 这生活比你想象中的要好得多。你从来没有被分配过任何特别困难的任务。说实话，自从你让贝尔温和玛蒂哈重新在一起之后，你的性生活反而变得更加频繁了。虽然你很少主动付出什么；通常都是在他们做完事后，你去收拾残局或者帮他们打扫卫生。但偶尔也会有一些特殊情况——比如玛蒂哈会让你好好地为她服务一番，又或者贝尔温会在他有精液剩余的时候，让你为他口交来释放那些多余的精液。 后来——你不知道具体过了多久，但这并不重要——一些入侵者试图攻占玛蒂哈的堡垒。他们都是像埃莱克西斯和阿斯特莱娅那样的蝾螈法师猎手。在这次袭击之后，直到你加入她的阵营，玛蒂哈的实力已经得到了极大的提升。而在贝尔温的帮助下，这些入侵者被轻易地击败并制服了。 [var0 |埃莱克西斯曾先于你出现。 你并非被击败，而是选择了投降。这两者之间有着本质的区别。 |你和埃莱克西斯在他们之前。 ] 在那之后不久，玛蒂哈谈到了完成她计划的最后步骤：将萨瓦拉的世界引入“道路之间”。起初，贝尔温表示反对；随后，他犹豫不决；最后，他放弃了抵抗，选择了让位。这需要一些耐心——以及一定的策略。巨大的其中充满了疯狂而令人兴奋的性爱场景——但最终，贝尔温还是开始相信玛蒂哈的事业，并帮助她实现了目标。 现在，你与贝尔温、埃莱克西斯以及玛蒂哈一起，站在那座由她用“道路之间”早已存在的建筑材料亲手建造而成的尖塔前。在你们四个人的正中央，摆放着玛蒂哈的魔法石；当你们在很久以前第一次看到它时，它的体积已经增长了数倍。如今，淡绿色的光芒从它的裂缝中透射出来，光芒如此明亮，以至于在你们四周的各个方向上，数以千计的步程范围内，这些光芒都足以照亮那些道路。数百名曾经参与猎魔行动的蝾螈战士在塔基周围形成了包围圈，他们将手臂举高，手掌朝远离建筑物的方向。 在你头顶的天空之中，有一个旋转着的传送门，而通过它，就能进入萨瓦拉的世界。你并不认识自己此刻所处的这片大陆，但这并不重要：计划要求整个世界都与这些传送门相连，因此无论从哪个地方开始都是一样的。 准备好了吗？”玛蒂哈问贝尔温，她的右手轻轻穿过他的左手，与他的手指交织在一起。贝尔温没有说话，只是点了点头。 过了一会儿，他们将空着的双手举向空中——在那些被称为“道路之间”的地方，这里所谓的“空气”其实并不存在——他们的手指中迸发出一阵神奇的能量波动，这些能量从他们的手指传递到那块石头，再从石头传递到那个传送门上。就在他们开始行动的瞬间，围绕堡垒的每一只蝾螈的指尖都迸发出了魔法火花，这些火花融入了石头之中，随后又从那里延伸到了上方传送门边缘。 你看着那道传送门逐渐敞开，萨瓦拉的世界越来越近，越来越近……
rows.raw: ' Time is both fleeting and irrelevant. There are no seconds, minutes, hours, days, months, or years in the Ways Between, nor is there anything longer or shorter. There are only events. When Berwyn and Matiha commiserated their relationship after you reunited them, they fucked for at least eight rounds, back-to-back. After they recovered, Matiha had performed some sort of sequence, or... maybe it was an operation, on you, and now, you don’t really think or feel much of anything. You’re present and conscious and aware, but indecisive and listless: you await your next command and you comply when it’s given. It’s a much better life than you had expected. You’re never given any particularly difficult tasks. In fact, honestly, you’ve never had more sex in your life than when you reunited Berwyn and Matiha together. Although it’s rare that you give much of anything; you’re mostly used to either fluff them or to clean up after them when they’re done. But there are rare occasions where Matiha has you go down on her properly, or Berwyn fucks your ass to unload a bit of spare jizz whenever he has it. Later – you don’t know how much later, but it doesn’t matter – a number of intruders attempted to storm Matiha’s fortress. They were all salamander magehunters, like Elexis and Astraea. Matiha had gotten much more powerful between this raid and when you entered her fold, and with Berwyn by her side, they were handily overwhelmed, defeated, and subjugated, like [var0 |Elexis was before you. You were not defeated; you surrendered. There is a stark difference. |you and Elexis were before them. ] Sometime after that, Matiha spoke of completing the final steps of her plan: of bringing the world of Savarra into the Ways Between. At first, Berwyn protested; then, he hesitated; then, he relented and abdicated. It took a bit of patience – and an enormous amount of wild, hair-raising sex – but Berwyn eventually came around to believing in Matiha’s cause and helping her achieve it. You stand with Berwyn, Elexis, and Matiha at the point of a spire she had custom-built into the fortress using errant building materials that had already existed within the Ways Between. In the center of all four of you is Matiha’s enchanted stone; it had grown to be several times its own size when you first saw it a lifetime ago, with pale-green light shining brightly enough through its cracks that it illuminates the Ways Between for many thousands of paces in every direction around you. Hundreds of salamander ex-magehunters form a perimeter around the base of the tower, their arms up and their palms facing away from the building. In the sky above you is a swirling portal, and through it is the world of Savarra. You don’t recognize the continent you’re positioned over, but it doesn’t matter: the plan calls for the entire world to join with the Ways Between, and any starting place is as good as any. "Ready?" Matiha asks Berwyn, her right hand worming her fingers in through his left. He says nothing in response; he only nods. After a moment, they raise their free hands into the air – or what passes for air in the Ways Between – and a magical crackle of energy emanates from their fingers to the stone, and the stone to the portal. Just as they start, magic sparks fire from the fingertips of every salamander surrounding the fortress and into the stone, and, likewise, from there, to the rim of the portal above. You watch as the portal yawns wider, and the world of Savarra draws closer, and closer, and closer...'

rows.original: It’s clear to you that Berwyn isn’t in the right headspace to reject Matiha’s advances – not that you can blame him. Despite coming here to put a stop to what she’s doing, she still means a great deal to him. But that just means that you’ll have to be the one to act. And you do so quickly: you lunge at Matiha, your right hand balled into a fist, and you strike at her face while she’s distracted with Berwyn. It connects: you feel your hand make solid impact against Matiha’s cheek, but... she doesn’t flinch. She hardly registers the blow. It’s like you were punching solid stone. The light around Matiha’s face shimmers and ripples from the impact your fist made against her, and you hear a faint trill as the air around her shuffles and rearranges, absorbing the impact for her. She’s enchanted herself with a barrier that’s resistant to kinetic attacks. Still, the barrier isn’t perfect: [var0 0 1 |the force of your fist against her barrier is enough to push her off balance, disengaging herself from Berwyn’s body |the sudden force has her lips disengage from Berwyn’s, and she’s knocked off balance, forced to disengage from his embrace ]. Your fist hitting her barrier didn’t have as much of an impact as you were hoping, but you doubt it’d last forever, especially if you used your [pc.weapon].... Matiha doesn’t take to the interruption lightly. "You [pc.mf |[pc.mascFem|SON OF A WHORE|FUCKING WHORE] |FUCKING WHORE ]!" she shrieks, her voice echoing off the walls. The very bricks of the fortress ripple away from her, as if they were afraid to be near her while she’s this angry. "I’ll FUCKING KILL YOU!" She lunges back at you, her own hands extended and her fingers tensed; her fingernails had been sharpened into pale-green points pulsating with mana, almost resembling ephemeral claws, and she doesn’t hesitate to go straight for your throat – but Berwyn[var0 2 |, having pulled himself together in the nick of time, ] swings his staff towards her, blocking her strike and cutting her off by putting himself between you and her. Before she has a chance to react, Berwyn casts a simple fireball at point-blank, striking Matiha in the chest. It rolls off her body thanks to the barrier she’s put up around herself, causing the air around her to shiver from the strike. It doesn’t do any damage, but it forces her to back away. "Berwyn?!" she gasps, stepping backward and steadying her stance. He maintains his position between you and her, his staff raised defensively and his free hand at the jeweled foci at its point. "I," he stammers, "Matiha... I...." He takes a long, steady breath as he closes his eyes. His back straightens and his stance gets slightly wider, steadying himself. "We’re here to stop you!" Matiha pauses, her eyes resting on Berwyn’s for a moment – before lifting to your own, her face contorting into an aggressive, hate-filled scowl. "FUCK YOU!" she shouts, pointing her finger in your direction. "This is YOUR FAULT! You’ve ruined Berwyn! You’ve ruined EVERYTHING!" Her arms swirl around herself, her hands glowing bright-green as she focuses the ambient ether in the air into them. "Give him back to me! I’ll make this right! I’m SO CLOSE and I won’t let you FUCK WITH MY PLANS!" Berwyn takes a step back, putting himself beside you, his staff still raised in its horizontal position. "[pc.name]," he says, turning his head slightly to talk over his shoulder. "Leave the stone to me! I need you to focus on Matiha!" "Elexis!" Matiha shouts, turning to the up-until-now stoic, statuesque salamander remaining stationary by her desk. "Don’t touch Berwyn, and [party.som |KILL THAT MOTHERFUCKER! |KILL THOSE FUCKERS! |KILL EVERY LAST ONE OF THOSE FUCKERS! ]" Suddenly, and despite her injuries from your previous encounter, Elexis readies her magic sword, stepping toward you with aggressive intent. It’s a fight with Matiha and Elexis!
rows.translation: 你很清楚，贝尔温目前的心态根本不适合拒绝玛蒂哈的追求——不过这也不能怪他。尽管他来到这里是为了阻止她继续做出那些行为，但她对他来说仍然非常重要。所以，现在只能由你来采取行动了。 你的动作极其迅速：你猛地冲向玛蒂哈，右手握成拳头，就在她被贝尔温分散注意力的瞬间，一拳击中了她的脸。 那一拳精准无误——你感觉到自己的拳头狠狠地击中了玛蒂哈的脸颊……她没有丝毫退缩，几乎感觉不到那一击的力量。就好像你在击打一块坚硬的石头一样。 你的拳头击中玛蒂哈的脸庞后，周围的光芒开始闪烁、波动，与此同时，你还能听到一阵微弱的颤动声——那是周围的空气在重新流动、吸收着那一股冲击力。她为自己施加了一道能够抵御动能攻击的屏障。 不过，这道屏障也并非完美无缺： [var0 0 1 |你用拳头击打她的防护屏障，这一力量足以使她失去平衡，从而让她与贝尔温的身体分离。 |这突如其来的力量使她的嘴唇与贝尔温的嘴唇分离，她失去了平衡，不得不从他的怀抱中挣脱出来。 ]你的拳头击中她的屏障后，并没有产生你期望中的效果，但你也知道这种屏障不可能永远持续下去，尤其是当你再次使用力量攻击的时候。 [pc.weapon]玛蒂哈对这种打扰可不会轻易容忍。“你[pc.mf |[pc.mascFem|混蛋|该死的贱人] |该死的贱人 ]！她尖叫起来，她的声音在墙壁间回荡。就连堡垒的砖块似乎也在她如此愤怒的时候吓得远远躲开，不敢靠近她。“我一定要去你的！她猛地向你扑来，双手伸直，手指紧绷；她的指甲已经被磨得尖锐如淡绿色的爪子，上面跳动着魔力，几乎就像是一对转瞬即逝的利爪。她毫不犹豫地直接朝着你的喉咙扑去——但是贝瑞wyn[var0 2 |他在最后关头及时恢复了冷静。 ]他挥动法杖挡住了她的攻击，将自己置于你和她之间，切断了她的攻击路线。 在她还有机会反应之前，贝尔温就已经掷出了一颗火球，火球正中玛蒂哈的胸部。由于她在自己周围构筑了一道屏障，这些攻击只是从她身上弹开了，使得周围的空气都因这些冲击而震动。这些攻击并没有造成任何伤害，但却迫使她不得不后退。 “贝尔温？！”她惊呼着，一边后退一边稳住自己的身体。 他站在你和她的中间，双手防御性地举在身前，空出的那只手则指向那些镶嵌着宝石的装饰物。“我，”他结结巴巴地说，“玛蒂哈……我……” 他深吸一口气，然后闭上了眼睛。他的背部挺直了，站姿也稍微开阔了一些，以此来稳定自己。 “我们来这里是阻止你的！” 玛蒂哈停顿了一下，她的目光在贝尔温身上停留了片刻，然后转向了你——此时她的脸上浮现出充满敌意与仇恨的阴沉表情。 "去你的！她大声喊道，手指直指你的方向，‘这都是你的错！你毁了贝林，你毁了一切！’她的双臂在身前挥舞着，双手散发着亮绿色的光芒，她将空气中的能量聚集到自己的手中。‘把他还给我！我会把一切都弄好的差一点就成功了。我绝不会让你得逞。别破坏我的计划！贝尔温后退一步，站在你身旁，他的法杖依然保持着水平姿态。[pc.name]，”他说着，微微侧过头，用肩膀后面的声音继续说道。这块石头就交给我吧！我需要你集中注意力，关注玛蒂哈！” “埃莱克西斯！”玛蒂哈喊道，转向那个一直保持着沉静、如同雕像一般站在她桌旁的蝾螈。“千万不要碰贝尔温，还有[party.som |干掉那个混蛋！ |干掉那些混蛋！ |把那些混蛋一个个都消灭掉！ ]突然间，尽管在之前的战斗中受了伤，埃莱克西斯还是拔出了她的魔法剑，带着攻击的意图朝你走了过来。 这是与玛蒂哈和埃莱克西斯之间的战斗！

rows.original: While you should probably do something about Matiha putting the moves on Berwyn, you can’t help but notice that this is the perfect opportunity to try and get the upper hand in the coming confrontation by getting in a cheap shot against her bodyguard, Elexis. You don’t know how much damage you’ll really be able to do, but any sort of leg-up is one that you could use. As Matiha dotes on Berwyn and continues talking, you rush between them, straight for the stoic, statuesque salamander standing beside her desk, and you make a swing at her with your [pc.weapon]. It connects squarely on her stomach, the sound of her leather armor absorbing the shock reverberating throughout the room. Elexis, perhaps unsurprisingly, [pc.strengthRange 0 33 66 |does not react to the blow. Her body is as stiff as stone. And yet you know for certain that she at least registers the impact: her fingers at her sides fidget and tense, but she doesn’t reach for her weapon |is thrown off her balance by the strike, but she otherwise doesn’t react to the blow; she takes a step backward as if she had merely lost her balance, and she’s quick to resume her stance. She acts as though she didn’t even feel it, but you can plainly see her fingers twitch and her mouth part slightly to take in deeper breaths |is knocked far enough backward from the strike that she’s forced to one knee, her left hand coming down to help herself balance. Yet, she doesn’t give herself time to catch her breath: as soon as she’s stabilized, she returns to her standing posture, her hands at her sides. She acts as if nothing had happened at all – but her mouth has parted to help her breathe after taking a shot as strong as that was ]. She stands autonomous before you, awaiting whatever command Matiha will give her next. "I suppose I should deal with that," Matiha sighs, disengaging from Berwyn for a moment. "Elexis?" Before Matiha can get out another word of instruction, Berwyn grabs Matiha by the wrist and whips her around him, tossing her across the room – not with enough force to make her lose her balance, but with enough force to put some distance between you and her[var0 2 |. As soon as he does, he reaches down for his staff, gripping onto it and lifting it into a defensive position with you at his back | and lifting his staff into a defensive position, putting his back to yours ]. "Berwyn?" Matiha asks once she’s regained her footing. She looks at him with arched eyebrows and her tone lilts and wavers – his throw didn’t hurt her physically, but the damage was certainly done. "I thought...." He maintains his position between you and her, his staff raised defensively and his free hand at the jeweled foci at its point. "I," he stammers; despite coming here to put a stop to what she’s doing, she still means a great deal to him. "Matiha... I...." He takes a long, steady breath as he closes his eyes. His back straightens and his stance gets slightly wider, steadying himself. "We’re here to stop you!" Matiha’s eyes go from Berwyn’s to yours, then back to his. "Wait, you were serious?" she asks, her head tilting and her brow furrowing in confusion. "You’re really not here to rejoin me and my research?" Berwyn says nothing; he takes a few steps backward, putting himself beside you and keeping you close to him. "[pc.name]," he says – he doesn’t bother whispering it, with Matiha standing so close by. "Leave the rune to me. I need you to keep Matiha’s focus off me." Matiha’s eyes go to yours once more, and they widen like a predator that’s found its prey. Her brow furrows and her lips curl upward into a fierce snarl. "I should never have let you leave this tower with Berwyn," she spits. "Whatever you’ve done to him, I’ll make certain to undo it once I suck every last drop of Essence from your body." She leans upward, her eyes going to Elexis behind you. "Elexis!" she shouts, and instantly, the formerly-near-lifeless Elexis stands at attention. "Leave Berwyn to me. [party.som |I want you to kill the other [pc.mf |bastard |bitch ] |I want you to deal with his bastard hangers-on |Kill every other bastard in their group ]! Suddenly, and despite her injuries from your previous encounter, Elexis readies her magic sword, stepping toward you with aggressive intent. It’s a fight with Matiha and Elexis!
rows.translation: 虽然你或许应该采取一些措施来阻止玛蒂哈对贝尔温采取那些行动，但你也不得不意识到，这正是一个绝佳的机会——通过攻击她的保镖埃莱克西斯，来在即将到来的对峙中取得优势。你根本不知道自己真正能造成多大的伤害，但任何能够帮助你的优势都是值得利用的。 当玛蒂哈宠爱着贝尔温并继续说着话时，你迅速穿过他们两人，径直走向站在她办公桌旁的那个坚毅而威严的蝾螈，然后朝它挥出了你的[pc.weapon]它准确地落在了她的腹部，皮革铠甲吸收冲击所产生的震动在房间里回荡。 或许并不奇怪，埃莱克西斯[pc.strengthRange 0 33 66 |她对这一击毫无反应，身体僵硬得像石头一样。但你可以肯定，她至少感受到了这一冲击：她身侧的手指不停地扭动、紧绷着，却始终没有去拿她的武器。 |这一击使她失去了平衡，但除此之外，她并没有对这一打击做出任何反应；她向后退了一步，仿佛只是暂时失去了平衡而已，然后很快又恢复了原来的站姿。她的表现就好像根本没有感觉到这一击一样，但你可以清楚地看到她的手指在微微颤抖，她的嘴唇也微微张开，似乎在努力深呼吸。 |她被这一击击退了好几步，不得不单膝跪地，左手撑地以保持平衡。然而，她没有给自己喘息的机会：一旦站稳，她就立刻恢复了站立姿势，双手放在身体两侧。她的表现就好像什么都没发生一样——但事实上，在遭受了如此猛烈的攻击之后，她的嘴唇确实微微张开，以便更好地呼吸。 ]她站在你面前，静静地等待着玛蒂哈接下来会下达的指令。 “我想这个事情应该由我来处理吧，”玛蒂哈叹了口气，暂时松开了贝尔温的手部。“埃莱克西斯？” 还没等玛蒂哈说出更多的指令，贝尔温就抓住了她的手腕，猛地将她拉到自己身边，然后甩到房间的另一边——这一下力道虽然不足以让她失去平衡，但足以让你和她之间保持一定的距离。[var0 2 |他一这么做，就会立刻伸手去拿他的法杖，握住它，然后将它举到防御姿势，让你站在他的身后。 | 他将手杖举到防御姿势，背对着你。 ]贝尔温？”玛蒂哈在站稳身体后问道。她挑起眉毛看着他，语气里带着一丝犹豫和动摇——他的推搡并没有对她造成身体上的伤害，但无疑对她的心灵产生了影响。“我本来以为…………” 他站在你和她的中间，双手防御性地举在身前，空着的那一只手则紧握着那枚镶满宝石的饰品。“我，”他结结巴巴地说道；尽管他是来阻止她所做的事情的，但她对他来说仍然意义重大。玛蒂哈……我……” 他深吸一口气，闭上了眼睛。他的背部挺直，站姿也稍微开阔了一些，以此来稳定自己。 “我们来这里是阻止你的！” 玛蒂哈的目光先从贝尔温身上移到了你身上，然后又回到了贝尔温身上。等等，你是认真的吗？”她问道，歪着头，眉头紧锁，显得十分困惑。“你真的是不是来陪我一起做研究的？” 贝尔温没有说话，他后退了几步，站在你的旁边，让你紧挨着他。 "[pc.name]，他说，”他并没有刻意压低声音，因为玛蒂哈就站在旁边。把那个符文交给我吧。我需要你让玛蒂哈不要把注意力放在我身上。” 玛蒂哈的目光再次落在你身上，她的双眼像发现了猎物的捕食者一样瞪得大大的。她的眉头紧锁，嘴唇扭曲成一副凶狠的表情，咬牙说道：“我当初真不该让你和贝尔温一起离开这座塔。无论你对他做了什么，等我吸干你体内最后一滴精华，我一定会把你造成的伤害全部消除。” 她向上倾身，目光转向你身后的埃莱克西斯。“埃莱克西斯！”她大声呼喊，瞬间，那个原本几乎奄奄一息的埃莱克西斯便恢复了活力，站直了身体。把贝林的事交给我吧。 [party.som |我希望你杀了那个家伙。 [pc.mf |混蛋 |贱人 ] |我希望你把那些依附在他身上的混蛋们处理掉。 |把他们那群人里的其他所有人全都干掉。 ]突然间，尽管在之前的战斗中受了伤，埃莱克西斯还是拔出了她的魔法剑，带着攻击的意图朝你走了过来。 这是与玛蒂哈和埃莱克西斯之间的战斗！
rows.raw: ' While you should probably do something about Matiha putting the moves on Berwyn, you can’t help but notice that this is the perfect opportunity to try and get the upper hand in the coming confrontation by getting in a cheap shot against her bodyguard, Elexis. You don’t know how much damage you’ll really be able to do, but any sort of leg-up is one that you could use. As Matiha dotes on Berwyn and continues talking, you rush between them, straight for the stoic, statuesque salamander standing beside her desk, and you make a swing at her with your [pc.weapon]. It connects squarely on her stomach, the sound of her leather armor absorbing the shock reverberating throughout the room. Elexis, perhaps unsurprisingly, [pc.strengthRange 0 33 66 |does not react to the blow. Her body is as stiff as stone. And yet you know for certain that she at least registers the impact: her fingers at her sides fidget and tense, but she doesn’t reach for her weapon |is thrown off her balance by the strike, but she otherwise doesn’t react to the blow; she takes a step backward as if she had merely lost her balance, and she’s quick to resume her stance. She acts as though she didn’t even feel it, but you can plainly see her fingers twitch and her mouth part slightly to take in deeper breaths |is knocked far enough backward from the strike that she’s forced to one knee, her left hand coming down to help herself balance. Yet, she doesn’t give herself time to catch her breath: as soon as she’s stabilized, she returns to her standing posture, her hands at her sides. She acts as if nothing had happened at all – but her mouth has parted to help her breathe after taking a shot as strong as that was ]. She stands autonomous before you, awaiting whatever command Matiha will give her next. "I suppose I should deal with that," Matiha sighs, disengaging from Berwyn for a moment. "Elexis?" Before Matiha can get out another word of instruction, Berwyn grabs Matiha by the wrist and whips her around him, tossing her across the room – not with enough force to make her lose her balance, but with enough force to put some distance between you and her[var0 2 |. As soon as he does, he reaches down for his staff, gripping onto it and lifting it into a defensive position with you at his back | and lifting his staff into a defensive position, putting his back to yours ]. "Berwyn?" Matiha asks once she’s regained her footing. She looks at him with arched eyebrows and her tone lilts and wavers – his throw didn’t hurt her physically, but the damage was certainly done. "I thought...." He maintains his position between you and her, his staff raised defensively and his free hand at the jeweled foci at its point. "I," he stammers; despite coming here to put a stop to what she’s doing, she still means a great deal to him. "Matiha... I...." He takes a long, steady breath as he closes his eyes. His back straightens and his stance gets slightly wider, steadying himself. "We’re here to stop you!" Matiha’s eyes go from Berwyn’s to yours, then back to his. "Wait, you were serious?" she asks, her head tilting and her brow furrowing in confusion. "You’re really not here to rejoin me and my research?" Berwyn says nothing; he takes a few steps backward, putting himself beside you and keeping you close to him. "[pc.name]," he says – he doesn’t bother whispering it, with Matiha standing so close by. "Leave the rune to me. I need you to keep Matiha’s focus off me." Matiha’s eyes go to yours once more, and they widen like a predator that’s found its prey. Her brow furrows and her lips curl upward into a fierce snarl. "I should never have let you leave this tower with Berwyn," she spits. "Whatever you’ve done to him, I’ll make certain to undo it once I suck every last drop of Essence from your body." She leans upward, her eyes going to Elexis behind you. "Elexis!" she shouts, and instantly, the formerly-near-lifeless Elexis stands at attention. "Leave Berwyn to me. [party.som |I want you to kill the other [pc.mf |bastard |bitch ] |I want you to deal with his bastard hangers-on |Kill every other bastard in their group ]! Suddenly, and despite her injuries from your previous encounter, Elexis readies her magic sword, stepping toward you with aggressive intent. It’s a fight with Matiha and Elexis!'

rows.original: The rune stone that Matiha likes so much sits off to the side of the room, behind her desk and a bit off the center of the room. Her whole attention is on Berwyn, and yet, the rune is unquestionably important to her – if you were to rush the stone right now, odds are pretty good that you’d at least get her to stop trying to seduce him. You put one foot in front of the other and break into a running stride, aiming straight for the rune sitting on its pedestal. You cock your arm back, and once you’re in striking range, you launch it forward– "Stop!" you hear Matiha yell, but it’s too late for you to stop even if you wanted to. Your fist flies through the air – but when you go in to strike the stone, you feel a force push back against you, dulling the velocity of your fist. It’s like you were punching through snow. When your fist makes contact with the stone, it’s not with one-tenth of the strength you had put into it. The stone shakes and rattles on its dais. The light seeping through its cracks illuminates the walls of the room, and the bulges in the stone seem to move and shift with the stone as its weight rotates. It’s as if the stone had felt the strike, as light as it wound up being, and it’s recoiling from the blow. "You IMBECILE!" Matiha shrieks. She lunges away from Berwyn, scrambling straight over her own desk to get to you before you can do any more damage to her rune. "Do you have any IDEA what you’re doing?!" Matiha’s hands lunge for your neck, her fingers tensed and her fingernails, sharpened into claws and glowing the same pale-green glow as the veins in her body, aimed straight for your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. But before she can close the distance any further, a pair of arms wrap around her waist and pull her back – and with a twist of their hips, Matiha is sent tumbling backward across the room, having lost her footing from the throw. There, where she was standing, is Berwyn. His staff is gripped tightly in his right hand and raised defensively across his body, with his left on the foci at the staff’s end. "I," he stammers; despite coming here to put a stop to what she’s doing, she still means a great deal to him. His grip on his staff is too tight: his arms are tensed, causing his stance to waver in front of her. "Matiha... I...." He takes a long, steady breath as he closes his eyes. His back straightens and his stance gets slightly wider, steadying himself. "I’m here to stop you!" Matiha’s stance is crouched, her center-of-gravity brought low after having just lost her balance. "Berwyn," she says, trying to maintain a smooth and steady tone, but there’s clearly a real sense of underlying urgency to it. "You two don’t know what you’re dealing with. There’s... many thousands of years’ worth of magic in that stone. You can’t mishandle it like that. What good is 'stopping me’ if you wind up doing something much worse to yourself?" Berwyn takes a step backward, his staff still raised, until he’s standing right next to you. "[pc.name]," he says over his shoulder, keeping his eyes on Matiha. "Matiha’s probably right. Leave the stone to me. I have an idea on how to handle it, but I need you to keep Matiha’s focus off me." "Berwyn," Matiha starts again. The confident, seductive, focused Matiha from just a minute before has gone: the woman before you is nervous, jumpy, and reflexive. "I’m serious. Think about this. That’s not a toy behind you. That rune is dangerous." "All the more reason to not let a dangerous woman like you handle it," he responds defiantly. Matiha’s eyes flit from yours, to Berwyn’s, back to yours, as she hurriedly calculates her next move. "Elexis!" she shouts, and instantly, the formerly-near-lifeless Elexis stands at attention. "[party.som |Kill [pc.himHer]! But don’t kill Berwyn! |Kill them both! Leave Berwyn alive! |Kill all of them except Berwyn! ]" Suddenly, and despite her injuries from your previous encounter, Elexis readies her magic sword, stepping toward you with aggressive intent. It’s a fight with Matiha and Elexis!
rows.translation: 玛蒂哈非常喜欢的那块符文石就放在房间的角落里，她的书桌后面，稍微偏离房间的中心位置。她的全部注意力都集中在贝尔温身上，然而，那块符文对她来说无疑非常重要——如果你现在去干扰那块符文，很有可能会让她停止试图诱惑贝尔温的行为。 你一步一步地向前跑，目标直指那个矗立在基座上的符文。你将手臂向后摆好姿势，一旦进入攻击范围，就立刻向前挥动手臂—— “站住！你听到玛蒂哈在呐喊，但即使你想停下来，也为时已晚。你的拳头划破空气飞了出去——然而当你的拳头击中那块石头时，你感到有一股力量在反冲，使你的拳头失去了原有的冲击力。就好像你在雪中挥拳击打一样。当你的拳头接触到那块石头时，所用的力量连当初的十分之一都不到。 石头在基座上微微摇晃，光线从它的裂缝中渗了进来，照亮了房间的墙壁。而石头上的那些凸起部分，似乎也会随着石头重心的移动而一起发生变化。那块石头仿佛感受到了那一击，尽管那一击本来就非常轻，但它仍在试图摆脱那股冲击力。 “你白痴！玛蒂哈尖叫着，猛地从贝尔温身边冲开，爬过自己的桌子，试图在你进一步伤害她的符文之前赶到你身边。“你到底知不知道自己在做什么？！” 玛蒂哈的双手伸向你的脖子，手指紧绷，指甲已经变成了锋利的爪子，散发着与她身体血管相同的淡绿色光芒，直直地朝你的脖子袭来[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]但就在她即将进一步靠近的时候，有一双手臂环住了她的腰，将她拉了回去。随着他们扭动腰肢，玛蒂哈被猛地推向后方，整个人在房间里翻滚着摔了出去，因为她失去了平衡。 就在她刚才站立的地方，站着贝尔温。他的权杖紧紧握在右手手中，防御性地举在身前，而左手则放在权杖末端的握把上。 “我……”他结结巴巴地说道；尽管他是来这里阻止她的行为的，但她对他来说仍然意义重大。他握着手杖的手部太紧了：手臂紧绷着，导致他在她面前站立不稳。“玛蒂哈……我……” 他深吸一口气，闭上眼睛。背部挺直，站姿也稍微开阔了一些，这样就能站得更稳了。 我是来阻止你的！” 玛蒂哈蹲了下来，由于刚刚失去了平衡，她的重心已经大幅下降。“贝尔温，”她说道，努力让自己的肌肉度听起来平稳而坚定，但显然其中蕴含着一种紧迫感。你们两个根本不知道自己在面对什么。那块石头里蕴含着……数千年积累的魔力。你们绝不能那样随意对待它。如果你们最终害了自己，那么‘阻止我’又有什么意义呢？贝尔温向后退了一步，手中的法杖依然举着，直到他站在你的旁边。[pc.name]，”他说着，一边回头看了一眼，目光仍然紧盯着玛蒂哈。“玛蒂哈可能是对的。把这块石头交给我吧。我有个办法来处理这个问题，但我需要你让玛蒂哈不要把注意力放在我身上。 “贝尔温，”玛蒂哈又开口了。刚才还那么自信、迷人、专注的玛蒂哈已经不见了——现在站在你面前的这个女人显得紧张、慌乱，而且反应过度。“我是认真的。你好好想想吧……你背后那个可不是个玩具，那个符文危险的。这就更有理由不让像你这样的危险女人来处理这件事了，”他挑衅地回答道。 玛蒂哈的目光在你们两人之间来回扫视，一边匆忙地思考着下一步该怎么做。“埃莱克西斯！”她喊道，立刻，那个原本几乎奄奄一息的埃莱克西斯便站直了身子，恢复了意识。[party.som |击杀[pc.himHer]但是千万不要杀死贝尔温！ |把他们两个都杀掉！让贝尔温活下来！ |除了贝尔温，把他们全部消灭！ ]突然间，尽管在之前的战斗中受了伤，埃莱克西斯还是拔出了她的魔法剑，带着攻击的意图朝你走了过来。 这是与玛蒂哈和埃莱克西斯之间的战斗！

rows.original: That previous blow on the rune breaks through whatever veil surrounded it; the impact against the bloated stone causes the ruptures within its makeup to shift out of place, and more of its pale-green light floods the room you’re all in. "No!" Berwyn cries, his hands reaching out in front of himself, desperately weaving more magic from his palms to try and contain what’s about to happen. "[pc.name]...!" A large chunk of the rune slides out of place, and thousands of years of stored, ambient mana is released into the room all at once. A white light erupts from the stone’s surface, instantly blinding you, and a massive rush of wind and energy billows from the rune. You aren’t sure what happens next. You didn’t live long enough to find out. On the bright side, though, you did stop Matiha.
rows.translation: 那次对符文的攻击打破了笼罩它的所有屏障；冲击力使得那块膨胀的石头内部的结构发生错位，于是更多淡绿色的光芒开始涌入你们所在的房间。 “不要！”贝尔温惊叫道，他双手向前伸出，拼命地从掌心释放出更多的魔法，试图阻止即将发生的事情。[pc.name]……！” 一块巨大的符文从原本的位置滑落出来，数千年来积聚在其中的魔力瞬间释放到了房间里。一道白轻型从石头的表面迸发出来，瞬间让你的视线变得一片漆黑，与此同时，一股强大的气流与能量也从那块符文处涌了出来。 你不知道接下来会发生什么。因为你没有活到能够看到结局的那一刻。 不过，从好的方面来看，你确实阻止玛蒂哈。

A large chunk of the rune slides out of place, and thousands of years of stored, ambient mana is released into the room all at once. A white light erupts from the stone’s surface, instantly blinding you, and a massive rush of wind and energy billows from the rune. You aren’t sure what happens next. You didn’t live long enough to find out. On the bright side, though, you did stop Matiha.'

rows.original: You’re brought to your knees, resting your body weight on your [pc.weapon] for stability. You pant from the exertion of the battle with Matiha, and you struggle to lift yourself back up, to continue the fight against her, but it’s no use – your body fails you every time you try to move. Your limbs burn with exhaustion and your vision swims. You look up, to at least try and keep your eyes on your target, and Matiha stands before you. "Pathetic," she spits, before raising her right foot up and placing it square on your chest and pushing, knocking you backwards and back onto your ass. Your [pc.weapon] awkwardly slips from your fingers, sliding back across the floor and out of your reach. "Elexis, keep [pc.himHer] pinned. I don’t want [pc.himHer] moving." The hulking salamander follows her instructions are clearly and simply as she could: Elexis stands over your shoulders and kneels onto both her knees, her forelegs pinning your shoulders down and keeping you from moving them. And she, perhaps unintentionally, squats her stuffy, overbearing rear end almost directly onto your face. Now unopposed, Matiha saunters towards Berwyn, who, up to this point, had his undivided attention on the runestone, continually casting spells towards it. He barely registers Matiha’s presence until it’s too late: she reaches forward and grips onto both of his hands by the wrists, stopping his spell-slinging and forcing his eyes onto hers. He flinches, trying to pull away from her, but she’s stronger. "Berwyn," she says soothingly, her fingers locked around his wrists. "Please, just listen to me. I don’t want to hurt you. I never have." "No!" he yells, yanking on both of his arms to try and pull free from her grip. He manages to get his right arm out, but not his left. "Matiha, what you’re doing is wrong! You’re siphoning the ether from Savarra and... you’re putting it into this rock! Don’t you realize what kind of damage you’re doing to the world by doing that?" Matiha patiently lets him finish, and although she doesn’t release her grip on his hand, she doesn’t pull or tug him back into her. "Yes, I’m aware of the scars I’ve left behind," she answers. "I’ll fully admit that I’ve been... acting without permission lately. In my studies and experiments to master the rune and this fortress, I’ll fully admit that I had done some damage to the places I had visited." "But Berwyn," she continues, pulling herself closer to him. He, in turn, takes a step away and pulls on his arm once more. "Don’t you realize the potential that the runestone contains? It contains hundreds of generations of mana – any amount that I had siphoned from Savarra would be as a drop of water in an ocean caught in a storm compared to what’s already in there. You’re a magician; aren’t you even the least little bit curious about the possibilities a font like that would make available to us if we could master it?" Berwyn hesitates. "It doesn’t matter," he answers. "Look at you, Matiha! I can see the Essence in your veins! You’ve let the rune transform you into something else – how can I even tell that I’m speaking to Matiha anymore?" She opens her mouth to answer, but pauses. Her eyes go over her shoulder, towards you and Elexis. "I can promise you that I’ve never had a clearer mind than I have right now, Berwyn," she answers. "And I’m even willing to prove to you just how sincere and in-control I am. Right here and now." She nods her head towards you. "But that should be a private conversation, I think." She fully turns her head, facing you and Elexis. "Elexis," she instructs, "be a darling and take your friend somewhere else. Somewhere secluded. And make sure [pc.heShe] has no shortage of entertainment." Upon her mistress’s new command, Elexis removes herself from your shoulders (and giving you your first breath of air that hasn’t been tainted by salamander ass for the past several minutes) and she, without pause, picks up your body and hefts it over her shoulder[pc.heightRange 0 84 | |. She’s quite strong to be lifting someone of your size, even despite the wounds from her previous battle with her ]. You’re still too beaten to put up much of a resistance, and now, your shoulders ache from having Elexis lean on them for so long. "Wait!" Berwyn commands. Elexis does not comply; Berwyn is not her master. "Put [pc.himHer] down, what are you doing?!" "Berwyn, please," Matiha coos again, reaching forward to gently cup his cheek. "It’s okay. Elexis is just making sure that we have a bit of privacy while we talk this through, like a pair of rational adults." "But–" "Look at me," she instructs, and, reluctantly, Berwyn’s eyes go from yours to hers. "It’ll be okay. I promise. You came here in the first place to talk, right? Then let’s talk. That’s all I want with you." Berwyn doesn’t put up any more resistance as you’re hauled out of the room, and the bricks of the fortress shift and close in behind you, cutting Matiha’s office from your view.
rows.translation: 你双膝跪地，将整个身体重量都压在[pc.weapon]上。 为了保持稳定，你竭尽全力与玛蒂哈战斗，但汗水淋漓，身体已经不堪重负。你努力想要站起来继续战斗，却一次次失败——每当试图移动时，身体都会背叛你。四肢因疲惫而剧烈疼痛，视线也变得模糊不清。 你抬头望去，至少试图将视线保持在目标上，这时玛蒂哈站在了你面前。“真可悲，”她冷笑道，然后抬起右脚，狠狠地踩在你的胸口上，将你推得向后倒去，重重地摔在了地上。你的[pc.weapon]它尴尬地从你的手指间滑落，重新落在地板上，再次超出了你的触及范围。“埃莱克西斯，快抓住[pc.himHer]被固定住了。我可不想这样。 [pc.himHer]移动。” 这只庞大的蝾螈严格按照她的指令行动：埃莱克西斯站在她的肩膀上方，双膝跪地，前肢压住她的肩膀，使她无法移动。而她，或许是无心之中，将自己那闷热、霸道的身躯几乎直接压在了你的脸上。 此刻再无人阻挡，玛蒂哈大步走向贝尔温。在此之前，贝尔温的全部注意力都集中在那块魔法石上，不断地向它施加各种法术。他几乎完全没有注意到玛蒂哈的存在，直到为时已晚：她伸出手来，紧紧抓住了他的手腕，阻止了他继续施展法术，同时迫使他的目光与她的对视。他试图挣脱，但她的力气更大。 贝尔温，”她轻声说道，手指紧紧握住他的手腕，“求你，先听我说完。我真的不想伤害你，从来都没有。” “不！”他大喊着，用力拽着自己的手臂，试图挣脱她的控制。他设法把右臂抽了出来，但左臂却无法动弹。“玛蒂哈，你这样做是错误的！你在把萨瓦拉的以太抽出来，然后……又把它注入这里。岩石你难道没有意识到自己的行为正在对世界造成多大的伤害吗？” 玛蒂哈耐心地听他说完，虽然她没有松开握着他的手，但也没有拉他回到自己身边。“是的，我清楚自己留下了哪些伤痕，”她回答道，“我必须承认，最近我确实有些……擅自行动。在研究以及尝试掌握那些符文和这座堡垒的过程中，我确实对一些地方造成了破坏。 但是贝尔温，”她继续说道，同时向他靠近了一些。而他则退后了一步，再次拉住了她的手臂。“你难道没有意识到那块石碑所蕴含的潜力吗？其中蕴含着数百代人的魔力——与其中储存的能量相比，我从萨瓦拉那里获取的任何魔力都只不过是暴风雨中海洋中的一滴水而已。你真是个魔术师啊；难道你对自己如果能掌握这样的字体，它会为我们带来哪些可能性，一点也不感到好奇吗？ 贝尔温犹豫了一下，然后回答道：“没关系。看看你吧，玛蒂哈！我能感受到你体内流淌着的那种力量！那些符文已经将你改变成了另一个人……我甚至都怀疑，现在和我说话的这个人，到底还是不是玛蒂哈了？她张开嘴想要回答，但突然停住了。她的目光越过肩膀，看向了你和埃莱克西斯。“我可以向你保证，现在我的头脑比任何时候都要清醒，贝尔温，”她说道，“而且我甚至愿意向你证明，我是多么真诚、多么能够控制自己的情绪。就是现在，就在这里。 她朝你点了点头。“不过，我觉得这个谈话应该私下进行。”她转过整个身体，面对着你和埃莱克西斯。“埃莱克西斯，”她吩咐道，“请你好心带你朋友去别的地方吧，找个僻静的地方。一定要确保[pc.heShe]不缺娱乐。根据女主人的新命令，艾莱克西斯从你的肩膀上移开了自己（这样你终于可以呼吸几分钟没有被蝾螈的味道污染的空气了），然后她毫不犹豫地抱起你的身体，将其扛到了自己的肩上。[pc.heightRange 0 84 | |她居然能举起像你这样体型的人，看来她的力量确实很强。尽管她在之前的战斗中受了伤，但这一点依然没有改变。 ]你现在已经虚弱得无法再进行任何抗性了，而且你的肩膀也因为长时间承受埃莱克西斯的重压而感到疼痛。” “等等！”贝尔温命令道。但埃莱克西斯并没有服从；贝尔温毕竟不是她的主人。“把……放下吧。 [pc.himHer]下来，你在干什么？！” “贝尔温，求你了，”玛蒂哈再次轻声说道，同时伸出手轻轻捧住了他的脸颊。“没关系的。埃莱克西斯只是想让我们在认真谈这件事的时候能有一点私人空间，就像两个理智的成年人一样。但是——” “看着我，”她命令道。尽管有些不情愿，贝尔温的目光最终还是从你身上移到了她身上。“不会有事的，我保证。你当初来到这里不就是为了谈话吗？那么我们就谈谈吧。我只想和你谈谈而已。当你被拖出房间时，贝尔温再也没有任何反抗的举动了。堡垒的砖墙开始移动，逐渐在你身后闭合，将玛蒂哈的办公室从你的视线中遮去。
