                    你突然意识到：自己随身携带着埃莱克西斯的神器“路标石”。从现在开始，你可以直接前往提克里斯。或者，更重要的是，你可以派玛蒂哈去提克里斯——娜瑞瓦曾派了她最出色的两名法师猎手去执行任务，但他们都失败了。你也可以替阿斯特莱娅完成她的使命。尽管贝尔温非常关心玛蒂哈，也希望她能得到最好的结果，但事实上，玛蒂哈仍然是一名被通缉的罪犯。
                    
                    如果你这么做，就等于背弃了贝林的意愿，但将玛蒂哈送到提克里斯去接受审判，才是公平的做法。而且，如果你这么做了，很可能还能获得阿斯特里达组织的认可与赞赏。
                    
                    那么，你是应该按照原计划把玛蒂哈送到常青女士之地，还是应该将她送到提克里斯去为她的罪行接受审判呢？
rows.raw:
"
                    The Waystone you had used to find the fortress in the Ways Between was only a dozen paces or so from the front entrance of the fortress.

                    You only need one hand to activate your Waystone charm and locate the Wayfort... but when your hand reaches into your pocket, where you normally keep your stone, your fingernails clink against two distinct charms. You realize, with a start, that you still have Elexis’ charm in your pocket.
                    
                    You pull them both out to examine them. Thankfully, they’re distinct from each other: yours is rather plain all around, while Elexis’ charm has a number of etchings and engravings across hers. Perhaps it’s some ancient script involving whatever language they speak in Tychris.
                    
                    With a start, you realize: you have Elexis’ Waystone charm with you. You could go straight to Tychris from here. Or, more importantly, you could send Matiha to Tychris – Nareva had sent two of her best magehunters for her, and they had both failed. You could complete Astraea’s mission for her. And as much as Berwyn is attached to Matiha and wants the best for her, she is, all the same, a wanted criminal.
                    
                    You’d be going behind Berwyn’s back if you did this, but sending Matiha to Tychris would be justice. And you’d probably get a lot of points with the Astrida Order if you did it.
                    
                    Do you keep to the original plan and send Matiha to Evergreen? Or do you send her to Tychris to be tried for her crimes?"

rows.original:
You’re not a liar. Not in the literal sense. Everything that you said to Berwyn is true – Evergreen would look after Matiha. Everything Matiha could possibly want would be there for her with Evergreen and her other daughters. It’d be everything that a witch of Matiha’s caliber could want. And, frankly, it’d probably be better for Matiha to be with Evergreen than in Tychris, where she’d be tried and sentenced for her crimes.
                        
                        Finding Evergreen’s home in Savarra is a simple enough task, and[pc.isDK
                            | as soon as you do, you simply dump Matiha there and let the Waystone do the rest of the work. In a blink and a flash of light, Matiha’s body vanishes without a trace, dumped like a sack of dirty laundry at the foot of Evergreen’s home. That’s one less thing to worry about, probably.
                            |, once you do, you step through it and find a spot to gently lay Matiha down in a sitting position. She’ll be confused and distraught when she wakes up – and, if you were right, she might still be violent – but, hopefully, she’d also have the sense to realize that staying with Evergreen is a safe place for her to be. Maybe one day she and Berwyn will be reunited.
                        ]
                        
                        That still leaves the issue of Elexis’ Waystone charm, but you think you have the answer to that. But it’ll have to wait until you get back to Hawkethorne.
                        
                        You make your way back to Berwyn. He hasn’t moved from his spot in the fort’s courtyard, and his hat remains gently placed against his chest, with his eyes downcast at where Matiha was. He’s still trying to come to terms with everything that’s happened – he could probably use a distraction.
rows.translation:
你并不是个骗子。至少从字面上来说不是。你对贝尔温说的每一句话都是真实的——常青女士会照顾玛蒂哈，玛蒂哈所渴望的一切，在常青女士和其他女儿们的陪伴下，都会得到满足。这对于像玛蒂哈这样有能力的女巫来说，无疑是她所渴望的一切。坦白说，对玛蒂哈来说，待在常青女士之地可能比待在提克里斯要好得多——在提克里斯，她将会因为自己的罪行而受到审判和惩罚。
                        
                        在萨瓦拉找到常青女士的家园其实是一项相当简单的任务，而且[pc.isDK
                            | 一旦你完成了这个步骤，只需把玛蒂哈放在那里，让路石完成剩下的工作。转眼间，玛蒂哈的身体就会消失得无影无踪，就像一袋脏衣服被扔在常青女士家的脚下一样。这样一来，也就少了一件需要担心的事情了。
                            |一旦你做到了这一点，就可以走进那里，找一个地方，轻轻地将玛蒂哈安置在坐姿状态下。她醒来时一定会感到困惑和不安——而且，如果你判断正确的话，她可能仍然会表现出攻击性——但希望她也能意识到，留在常青女士之地才是对她来说安全的地方。也许有一天，她和贝尔温能够重逢。
                        ]
                        
                        不过，艾丽克丝的传令石魔法仍然是个未解决的问题，但你认为自己已经找到了答案。不过，这个问题的答案要等到你回到鹰棘镇之后才能揭晓。
                        
                        你回到了贝尔温。他仍然站在堡垒的院子里，帽子轻轻搭在胸前，目光凝视着玛蒂哈曾经站过的地方。他仍在努力接受这一切发生的事情——他或许需要一些事情来转移一下注意力。

rows.translation: 不久之后，你听到了有人呻吟的声音，眼角的余光中你也看到了有人正在动——那是玛蒂哈，她终于开始苏醒了。 立刻， [berwyn.name]降至[berwyn.hisHer]跪在地上。 [berwyn.hisHer]紧随其后[berwyn.himHer]当玛蒂哈慢慢醒来时，她自己也感到非常兴奋。当她睁开眼睛时，视线在院子里四处游移，却无法聚焦在任何特定的物体上——直到最终，她的目光落在了贝尔温的身上。“贝尔温？”她迷迷糊糊地问道。[berwyn.mf | |你确定吗？ [berwyn.name]会在她犯错时纠正她。 [berwyn.heShe]已经准备就绪了。 ]是的，玛蒂哈，是我。 [berwyn.heShe]作出回应，随之而来的是[berwyn.hisHer]将手放在玛蒂哈的额头上，轻轻按住。 [berwyn.hisHer]动手吧。慢慢来。” 玛蒂哈眨了眨眼，然后把头扭到肩膀上，环顾着庭院，想弄清楚他们现在在哪里。“我们……不在我的办公室里，”她终于说道。她坐起来的动作比你预想的要轻松得多——她的动作看起来完全不像受了伤。“我们是在外面吗？” “是的，我们在外面。 [berwyn.name]回答着，一边后退一边坐下[berwyn.hisHer]呃……你还记得当时发生了什么吗？” 玛蒂哈的目光最终落在了你身上，她的双眼与你对视了片刻。她的瞳孔逐渐放大，然后她几乎带着些尴尬地移开了视线。“你记得吗？”她反问道，或许是在试图逃避自己回答这个问题。 [berwyn.name]点了点头，同时露出了痛苦的表情。 [berwyn.heShe]全部都是。” 听到这句话，玛蒂哈的表情瞬间垮了下来。她的肩膀耷了下来，你甚至觉得能看到她原本就苍白的脸上原本的颜色正在逐渐消失。“嗯 [pc.dcb |说吧，”你低声说道，刻意压低语调以增强威慑力。这既不是邀请，也不是建议。 |没关系的，”你说道，试图缓解她对发生的事情所怀有的恐惧。“如果我们不希望你在这里，就会把你送到别的地方去了。 |你变成了一团巨大的、怪异的肉团啊！”你兴奋地叫道，几乎在原地跳来跳去。“虽然看起来很恶心，但你又变回原来样子了！我更喜欢你现在的样子，这样你看起来酷多了。 ] 玛蒂哈将头微微转向你这边，侧耳倾听你的方向，然后又立刻转回原来的姿势，继续专注于她正在做的事情。 [berwyn.name]嗯……是的，我记得所有的事情。差不多所有的事情。”她把膝盖拉到身前，蜷缩在双腿上。“我记得我们在我的办公室见面……也记得我们当时发生了争执……然后……”她抬头望向堡垒的高塔，望着它的尖顶。“你……你毁掉了我的符文石，贝尔温。” “是我干的。 [berwyn.heShe]毫不掩饰地说道：“你难道没有意识到它对你造成了什么影响吗，玛蒂哈？” 玛蒂哈低头看着自己的右手，仔细检查着自己的手指。她的目光沿着手臂向上移动，一边观察一边在心中梳理着某些事情。是的，”她诚实地回答，“我一直都知道它对我产生了什么影响。那些流淌在我血管中的魔力……我以为它让我看起来更美丽，让我显得更有力量。而我的学习……每当我花费时间研究那些符文、试图揭开它们的秘密时，我都会告诉自己，我在为这个世界做些有益的事情，以此来为自己所花费的时间找借口。如果在我之后有更多的法师能够掌握我所学会的知识，那对他们来说一定会更有帮助。而如果我当初能够成功地将萨瓦拉带到“道路之间”…… 她的目光与我的相遇[berwyn.name]又一次，他们就这样静静地待在那里。有那么一会儿，他们谁也没有说话。“那并不……完全正确，”玛蒂哈最终开口反驳道，“其实主要是确实如此，但是……我原本以为，如果能把萨瓦拉带入“道路之间”，那么它就会拥有无穷的魔力，永远如此……而且我就可以从自己的所在地来统治它。只要有那块符文石，无论是哪位法师，还是哪支法师团队，甚至任何神明，都无法违抗我的意志。[pc.dcb |现在你什么都没有了，”你说道。 玛蒂哈点了点头。“或许这样反而更好。 |然后我们阻止了你，”你插话道。 玛蒂哈点了点头：“也许这样反而更好。 |但那样太奇怪了，”你插话道，“为什么要这么做呢？这听起来责任太大了。” “为了权力，”她简单地回答，“还有控制力。我想要这些。拥有这个世界。也许你阻止我，反而是件好事。 ]我觉得…… 更清晰现在，我感到的满足感比过去几十年来任何时候都要强烈，而我现在清楚地意识到，这一切都是因为那块符文石以及它所承载的承诺。 听到她这么说， [berwyn.name]它的尾巴兴奋地向上摆动——正是这样的场景。 [berwyn.heShe]很想听听。

rows.original: Matiha adjusts her sitting position to face [berwyn.name] directly. "I knew your grandfather personally, Berwyn," she explains. "Fiodoir and I were mages from the same guild. We were... treasure hunters, of a sort. Our primary task was to find stashes of knowledge buried within the lands of Savarra after the Godswar, and to liberate the knowledge and artifacts they contain. We believed that knowledge wasn’t something that should be hoarded from the world, and we wanted to find them before Nareva and her Astrida Order did, so we could bring about a new magical and technological age." "After one such successful liberation, Fiodoir and I found the rune stone that you’re familiar with. This was...." Matiha pauses, her eyes wincing and her fingers rapping against the ground as she does some mental math. "Roughly... seventy or eighty years ago, now. The stone wasn’t nearly as bloated and powerful as you last saw it, but even back then, it had enough magic within it to empower every mage in a city to godlike heights for years. To usher forth whole new generations of mages. And if there was just one of these runes, unearthed after one hurricane, then there likely was – is – many more, and we were determined to find them before she did." [berwyn.name] remains stationary, [berwyn.hisHer] triangular ears perked straight up as [berwyn.heShe] raptly listens to every word Matiha says. "I wanted to use the stone for the good I knew it could do, but I also knew that, while one Vodo rune stone with that much power within it could be one of the greatest boons the world had seen in centuries... it was also temporary. We would have found an oasis in a desert, and we would have drunk its water before we could be quenched. We needed something permanent, and short of getting lucky and finding, and raiding, one of Nareva’s vaults, I knew that studying the rune stone would be as good a starting point as we were going to get." [berwyn.name] opens [berwyn.hisHer] mouth to speak. "But grandpa would never have agreed," [berwyn.heShe] says softly. "You’re right," Matiha answers with a despondent lilt in her voice. "He conceded that it could do good – but he also saw too much potential for the evils that kind of power could have. He wanted it destroyed." She lowers her head, almost afraid to look [berwyn.name] in the eye for what’s next. "Perhaps he saw the influence that sort of power could have on a person within me that day. I fought him for control over the stone. And I won. And that was the end of our relationship." You remain in your standing position[pc.dcb |, cross your arms, and keep your mouth shut. It’s not your place to speak. And you’re honestly curious how [berwyn.name] is going to handle this | and stay silent. It’s not your place to butt in – and you’re sort of curious how this plays out. It’s up to [berwyn.name], after all | with your hands behind your back and your body rocking back and forth on your feet. This is exciting! You can hardly contain yourself waiting for what [berwyn.name] will say next ]. [berwyn.name] stutters through [berwyn.hisHer] next words, thinking of how to respond. "And now what do you want to do?" [berwyn.heShe] asks. It’s an excellent question: Matiha’s answer could give valuable insight into her current state of mind, and whether she’s still crazy from the rune stone and its power. Matiha doesn’t miss a beat with her answer. "My head might have been clouded and my thoughts might have been fuzzy, Berwyn, but there’s one thing that I was honest about the entire time," she implores. "The fortress; the rune stone; the plan to bring Savarra to the Ways Between... I wanted you to be there with me for all of it. A part of me was hoping that you’d come back to me if I managed to bring in enough power." [pc.dcb |And that’s exactly what happened, you think to yourself. |That’s not too far off from what happened, you realize. |Hey, that... that’s a thing! That happened! It worked! Gosh, Matiha is so smart and pretty, you think to yourself, elated that you realized you figured it out. ] Although maybe not in a way that anybody had expected it to. "And now that you’re here," she continues sadly, her eyes averting from [berwyn.name]’s, "I’m ashamed to say that... it’s what I still want. To be with you. After everything that I’ve done, I’m still so selfish as to say that I want more." [berwyn.name] reaches forward, gently placing [berwyn.hisHer] thumb and index finger on Matiha’s chin to guide her eyes back to [berwyn.mf |his |hers ]. "You and I are both stubborn as hell," [berwyn.name] says with a coy smile. "The only reason why I agreed to come chasing you into the Ways Between in the first place was so I could have my teacher back." Matiha’s back straightens slightly in surprise from that admission. "You mean...?" [berwyn.name] nods towards you, glancing up at you for a split second. "The only reason I went to [pc.name] in the first place, way back when you first teleported this fortress, was because I didn’t like what you were going through. All I wanted from the very beginning was to have you back, Matiha." [berwyn.HeShe] smiles. "And now, here you are." Matiha doesn’t respond, not with words: after a moment of her digesting what it is [berwyn.name] had just said, she lunges forward, wrapping her arms around [berwyn.name]’s neck, holding [berwyn.himHer] tightly to her. It catches [berwyn.name] by surprise at first – you never really knew [berwyn.name] to be a hugging type – but [berwyn.heShe] quickly relaxes, wrapping [berwyn.hisHer] own arms around Matiha’s shoulders. The hug doesn’t last quite as long as you expected: Matiha pulls away, turning around you face you. "[pc.name]," she says – if you’re not mistaken, that’s the first time she’s called you by your name. She doesn’t say anything more, and instead, she reaches for your hand at your side; as soon as she grasps it, she, with surprising strength and urgency, pulls you down beside herself and [berwyn.name] so she can include you, too. [pc.dcb |You... well... alright, whatever. This isn’t so bad. |You’d like to say that you were just doing a friend a favor, but... you also know that the better answer is to say nothing at all. |Hugs for everybody! Fuck yeah, hugs are awesome! ] After a long moment of you three enjoying each other’s company, eventually, Matiha is the first one to pull away. She takes a long sniffle through her nose, wiping at her eyes with one thumb to clear the tears forming there. "Berwyn. [pc.name]." She looks at you both, glancing between you two. The smile on her face doesn’t wane. "We have a few things to discuss.[berwyn.cupRange 0 1 | |" She can’t help but quickly glance at [berwyn.name]’s chest. "A few things in particular. ]" [berwyn.mf | |[berwyn.name] laughs well-meaningly. "Yeah, we do." ]

玛蒂哈调整了自己的坐姿，以便面对[berwyn.name]我与你的祖父有过直接交往，贝尔温，”她解释道，“菲奥多尔和我同属一个法师公会。我们……可以算是寻宝者吧。我们的主要任务就是在神战之后，寻找隐藏在萨瓦拉境内的知识藏匿处，并将这些知识以及其中蕴含的文物挖掘出来。我们相信，知识并不是应该被囤积起来、远离大众的东西。我们决心在娜瑞瓦和她的阿斯特里达教团之前找到那些知识，这样我们就能开启一个充满魔法与科技的新时代。 [berwyn.name]保持静止状态， [berwyn.hisHer]三角形的耳朵立刻竖了起来。 [berwyn.heShe]全神贯注地听着玛蒂哈说的每一句话。 “我本来想利用这块石头来行善，因为我知道它具备这样的力量；但我也明白，这样一块蕴含着如此强大能量的沃多符文石，确实可能是几个世纪以来这个世界所获得的最珍贵的礼物之一。…但这也只是暂时的解决办法。我们就像在沙漠中找到了绿洲，喝光了那里的水后，很快又会感到口渴。我们需要的是长久可行的方案。除非我们运气好，能够找到并攻破娜瑞瓦的某个藏宝库，否则我认为研究那些符文石应该是我们目前能采取的最佳办法。" rows.raw: ' Matiha adjusts her sitting position to face [berwyn.name] directly. "I knew your grandfather personally, Berwyn," she explains. "Fiodoir and I were mages from the same guild. We were... treasure hunters, of a sort. Our primary task was to find stashes of knowledge buried within the lands of Savarra after the Godswar, and to liberate the knowledge and artifacts they contain. We believed that knowledge wasn’t something that should be hoarded from the world, and we wanted to find them before Nareva and her Astrida Order did, so we could bring about a new magical and technological age." "After one such successful liberation, Fiodoir and I found the rune stone that you’re familiar with. This was...." Matiha pauses, her eyes wincing and her fingers rapping against the ground as she does some mental math. "Roughly... seventy or eighty years ago, now. The stone wasn’t nearly as bloated and powerful as you last saw it, but even back then, it had enough magic within it to empower every mage in a city to godlike heights for years. To usher forth whole new generations of mages. And if there was just one of these runes, unearthed after one hurricane, then there likely was – is – many more, and we were determined to find them before she did." [berwyn.name] remains stationary, [berwyn.hisHer] triangular ears perked straight up as [berwyn.heShe] raptly listens to every word Matiha says. "I wanted to use the stone for the good I knew it could do, but I also knew that, while one Vodo rune stone with that much power within it could be one of the greatest boons the world had seen in centuries... it was also temporary. We would have found an oasis in a desert, and we would have drunk its water before we could be quenched. We needed something permanent, and short of getting lucky and finding, and raiding, one of Nareva’s vaults, I knew that studying the rune stone would be as good a starting point as we were going to get." [berwyn.name] opens [berwyn.hisHer] mouth to speak. "But grandpa would never have agreed," [berwyn.heShe] says softly. "You’re right," Matiha answers with a despondent lilt in her voice. "He conceded that it could do good – but he also saw too much potential for the evils that kind of power could have. He wanted it destroyed." She lowers her head, almost afraid to look [berwyn.name] in the eye for what’s next. "Perhaps he saw the influence that sort of power could have on a person within me that day. I fought him for control over the stone. And I won. And that was the end of our relationship." You remain in your standing position[pc.dcb |, cross your arms, and keep your mouth shut. It’s not your place to speak. And you’re honestly curious how [berwyn.name] is going to handle this | and stay silent. It’s not your place to butt in – and you’re sort of curious how this plays out. It’s up to [berwyn.name], after all | with your hands behind your back and your body rocking back and forth on your feet. This is exciting! You can hardly contain yourself waiting for what [berwyn.name] will say next ]. [berwyn.name] stutters through [berwyn.hisHer] next words, thinking of how to respond. "And now what do you want to do?" [berwyn.heShe] asks. It’s an excellent question: Matiha’s answer could give valuable insight into her current state of mind, and whether she’s still crazy from the rune stone and its power. Matiha doesn’t miss a beat with her answer. "My head might have been clouded and my thoughts might have been fuzzy, Berwyn, but there’s one thing that I was honest about the entire time," she implores. "The fortress; the rune stone; the plan to bring Savarra to the Ways Between... I wanted you to be there with me for all of it. A part of me was hoping that you’d come back to me if I managed to bring in enough power." [pc.dcb |And that’s exactly what happened, you think to yourself. |That’s not too far off from what happened, you realize. |Hey, that... that’s a thing! That happened! It worked! Gosh, Matiha is so smart and pretty, you think to yourself, elated that you realized you figured it out. ] Although maybe not in a way that anybody had expected it to. "And now that you’re here," she continues sadly, her eyes averting from [berwyn.name]’s, "I’m ashamed to say that... it’s what I still want. To be with you. After everything that I’ve done, I’m still so selfish as to say that I want more." [berwyn.name] reaches forward, gently placing [berwyn.hisHer] thumb and index finger on Matiha’s chin to guide her eyes back to [berwyn.mf |his |hers ]. "You and I are both stubborn as hell," [berwyn.name] says with a coy smile. "The only reason why I agreed to come chasing you into the Ways Between in the first place was so I could have my teacher back." Matiha’s back straightens slightly in surprise from that admission. "You mean...?" [berwyn.name] nods towards you, glancing up at you for a split second. "The only reason I went to [pc.name] in the first place, way back when you first teleported this fortress, was because I didn’t like what you were going through. All I wanted from the very beginning was to have you back, Matiha." [berwyn.HeShe] smiles. "And now, here you are." Matiha doesn’t respond, not with words: after a moment of her digesting what it is [berwyn.name] had just said, she lunges forward, wrapping her arms around [berwyn.name]’s neck, holding [berwyn.himHer] tightly to her. It catches [berwyn.name] by surprise at first – you never really knew [berwyn.name] to be a hugging type – but [berwyn.heShe] quickly relaxes, wrapping [berwyn.hisHer] own arms around Matiha’s shoulders. The hug doesn’t last quite as long as you expected: Matiha pulls away, turning around you face you. "[pc.name]," she says – if you’re not mistaken, that’s the first time she’s called you by your name. She doesn’t say anything more, and instead, she reaches for your hand at your side; as soon as she grasps it, she, with surprising strength and urgency, pulls you down beside herself and [berwyn.name] so she can include you, too. [pc.dcb |You... well... alright, whatever. This isn’t so bad. |You’d like to say that you were just doing a friend a favor, but... you also know that the better answer is to say nothing at all. |Hugs for everybody! Fuck yeah, hugs are awesome! ] After a long moment of you three enjoying each other’s company, eventually, Matiha is the first one to pull away. She takes a long sniffle through her nose, wiping at her eyes with one thumb to clear the tears forming there. "Berwyn. [pc.name]." She looks at you both, glancing between you two. The smile on her face doesn’t wane. "We have a few things to discuss.[berwyn.cupRange 0 1 | |" She can’t help but quickly glance at [berwyn.name]’s chest. "A few things in particular. ]" [berwyn.mf | |[berwyn.name] laughs well-meaningly. "Yeah, we do." ]'

rows.original: This is probably going to come as a surprise to both of them – [berwyn.name] especially – but... you think you’d rather keep them both at arm’s length. With everything that’s happened recently, you think your body is tapped for all the adrenaline it has. [berwyn.name], of course, looks at you like you have two heads. "What the hell, [pc.name]?" [berwyn.heShe] asks incredulously. "Are you serious? You have [berwyn.isWynne |two ladies |a stacked witch and the world’s prettiest boy ] telling you, to your face, that they’re thirsty as could be for you and specifically you... and you’re seriously pulling the 'let’s just be friends’ card?" That’s about the short of it, yes. [berwyn.name] continues to stare, absolutely taken aback by what it is you’re saying. [berwyn.HisHer] mouth hangs slightly agape and [berwyn.hisHer] eyes start to cloud over from trying to process the words coming out of your mouth. "Is it us?" [berwyn.heShe] eventually asks. "Don’t be unfair, [berwyn.isWynne |Ber – I mean, Wynne |Berwyn ]," Matiha interjects, placing her hand on [berwyn.name]’s shoulder to get [berwyn.hisHer] attention. "[pc.name] said that [berwyn.heShe]’s not interested in taking on more lovers. I can respect that. And, in fact, take it from me: sometimes, a friend can be more valuable. Introducing something as volatile as sex can ruin what was originally a good thing." [berwyn.name], however, remains animated. "But what am I going to do about this?" [berwyn.heShe] nearly shouts, gesturing to [berwyn.hisHer] crotch with both hands. "And what are we going to do about that?" [berwyn.heShe] asks again, gesturing to Matiha’s. "First of all, don’t be crude," she chastises, extending an index finger and drumming it off [berwyn.name]’s nose. "Secondly: that is, unfortunately, not [pc.name]’s issue to be dealt with. It’d be wrong of us to foist our sexual complications onto [pc.himHer], especially after [pc.heShe] said [pc.heShe] wasn’t interested." Her hand goes to the collar of [berwyn.name]’s shirt, gripping onto it tightly, wrapping the fabric around her knuckles. "And third – that is a complication with an obvious solution between us, I should think." You’ve willingly excluded yourself from their sexual affections – you’re not surprised that the first thing they do is turn to each other. Although you’re a little surprised that it was Matiha that suggested it. rows.translation: 这对他们两个人来说，恐怕都会感到意外吧—— [berwyn.name]尤其是……但是……你觉得自己还是最好与他们保持一定的距离。经历了最近发生的一切，你认为自己的身体已经消耗掉了所有可以产生的肾上腺素了。 [berwyn.name]当然，别人会用那种奇怪的眼神看着你，仿佛你长了两个脑袋一样。“搞什么鬼，[pc.name]？” [berwyn.heShe]难以置信地问道：“你是认真的吗？你真的这么做了？ [berwyn.isWynne |两位女士 |一个狡黠的女巫与世界上最帅的男孩 ]我直截了当地告诉你，他们其实非常渴望得到你。具体来说你……你真的要打出‘我们还是做朋友吧’这张牌吗？” “差不多就是这个意思，没错。 [berwyn.name]继续盯着你看，完全被你所说的话惊呆了。 [berwyn.HisHer]嘴巴微微张开， [berwyn.hisHer]试图理解你口中说出的那些话，我的视线渐渐变得模糊起来。“是指我们吗？ [berwyn.heShe]最终，他问道： “不要不公平啊， [berwyn.isWynne |伯……我是说，温恩 |贝尔温 ]等等，”玛蒂哈插话道，同时把手放在[berwyn.name]依靠某人的帮助[berwyn.hisHer]注意。[pc.name]说道[berwyn.heShe]并不想再拥有更多的恋人，我对此表示尊重。事实上，相信我：有时候，一个朋友反而会更加重要。引入像性关系这样充满变数的因素，反而可能会破坏原本美好的关系。 [berwyn.name]然而，它依然充满活力。“但我该怎么处理这个？” [berwyn.heShe]几乎要喊出来，同时还不停地比划着手势。 [berwyn.hisHer]用双手抱住自己的胯部。“那我们又该怎么处理那个？” [berwyn.heShe]再次问道，同时指向玛蒂哈。 “首先，不要这么粗鲁，”她责备道，同时伸出食指轻轻敲了敲他的手。 [berwyn.name]其次：遗憾的是，那并不是[pc.name]这是一个需要解决的问题。如果我们把自己的性心理问题强加给别人，那就太不对了。 [pc.himHer]尤其是[pc.heShe]已经明确表示[pc.heShe]不想再接纳更多恋人之后。” 她的手伸向了自己的衣领。 [berwyn.name]她紧紧抓住那件衬衫，将布料缠在指关节上。“第三点——我认为，这其实是一个我们有明显解决办法的复杂问题。” 你主动选择了远离他们的感情纠葛，所以他们首先选择彼此依靠，这一点你并不感到意外。不过，让玛蒂哈提出这个建议，还是让你有些惊讶。 [berwyn.name]犹豫了一下，注视着玛蒂哈的眼睛片刻，然后[berwyn.hisHer]目光不由自主地落在玛蒂哈那引人注目的胸部上，她的乳头在长袍的布料下显得格外明显。“好吧。 [berwyn.heShe]说道，然后转身离开。 [berwyn.hisHer]那就算你输了。
rows.raw: ' This is probably going to come as a surprise to both of them – [berwyn.name] especially – but... you think you’d rather keep them both at arm’s length. With everything that’s happened recently, you think your body is tapped for all the adrenaline it has. [berwyn.name], of course, looks at you like you have two heads. "What the hell, [pc.name]?" [berwyn.heShe] asks incredulously. "Are you serious? You have [berwyn.isWynne |two ladies |a stacked witch and the world’s prettiest boy ] telling you, to your face, that they’re thirsty as could be for you and specifically you... and you’re seriously pulling the 'let’s just be friends’ card?" That’s about the short of it, yes. [berwyn.name] continues to stare, absolutely taken aback by what it is you’re saying. [berwyn.HisHer] mouth hangs slightly agape and [berwyn.hisHer] eyes start to cloud over from trying to process the words coming out of your mouth. "Is it us?" [berwyn.heShe] eventually asks. "Don’t be unfair, [berwyn.isWynne |Ber – I mean, Wynne |Berwyn ]," Matiha interjects, placing her hand on [berwyn.name]’s shoulder to get [berwyn.hisHer] attention. "[pc.name] said that [berwyn.heShe]’s not interested in taking on more lovers. I can respect that. And, in fact, take it from me: sometimes, a friend can be more valuable. Introducing something as volatile as sex can ruin what was originally a good thing." [berwyn.name], however, remains animated. "But what am I going to do about this?" [berwyn.heShe] nearly shouts, gesturing to [berwyn.hisHer] crotch with both hands. "And what are we going to do about that?" [berwyn.heShe] asks again, gesturing to Matiha’s. "First of all, don’t be crude," she chastises, extending an index finger and drumming it off [berwyn.name]’s nose. "Secondly: that is, unfortunately, not [pc.name]’s issue to be dealt with. It’d be wrong of us to foist our sexual complications onto [pc.himHer], especially after [pc.heShe] said [pc.heShe] wasn’t interested." Her hand goes to the collar of [berwyn.name]’s shirt, gripping onto it tightly, wrapping the fabric around her knuckles. "And third – that is a complication with an obvious solution between us, I should think." You’ve willingly excluded yourself from their sexual affections – you’re not surprised that the first thing they do is turn to each other. Although you’re a little surprised that it was Matiha that suggested it. [berwyn.name] hesitates, looking into Matiha’s eyes for a moment, before [berwyn.hisHer] eyes drift down to Matiha’s prodigious chest, her nipples straining against the fabric of her robe. "Fine," [berwyn.heShe] says, turning [berwyn.hisHer] eyes towards you. "Your loss, then."'

rows.original: You’re back in Hawkethorne. [matiha.isLover |[berwyn.name] and Matiha remained in the fortress inside the Ways Between for the time being; they told you that there was some loose ends that they needed to work through, and [berwyn.name] in particular was pretty excited about an idea [berwyn.heShe] had involving moving the fortress as you pleased. Whether they’re telling the truth and they’re earnestly just trying to get some work done is up to your imagination. |[berwyn.name] and Matiha remained in the fortress inside the Ways Between for the time being; they told you that there was some loose ends that they needed to work through, and [berwyn.name] in particular was pretty excited about an idea [berwyn.heShe] had involving moving the fortress as you pleased. Whether they’re telling the truth and they’re earnestly just trying to get some work done is up to your imagination. |[berwyn.name] remained in the fortress inside the Ways Between for the time being; [berwyn.heShe] had apparently taken some inspiration from Matiha’s old texts and journals [berwyn.heShe] had found elsewhere in the fortress and [berwyn.heShe] had an idea involving moving the whole thing as you pleased. [berwyn.HeShe] then started to babble a bit about magical theory and conservation of mass through teleportation – you were only paying half attention, if you were honest. ] As soon as you step out of the Ways Between and your feet hit the beaten road of Hawkethorne’s main intersection, you realize just how exhausted you are: you had been in that teleporting, shapeshifting fortress for who knows how long, and staying in a dimension between dimensions like you have for as long as you have probably wasn’t healthy in the long run. [dayNight |Astraea isn’t far from the Waystone: in fact, she’s right at its opening, sitting next to its mouth with her hood up and her body hunched over. She glances up towards the stone once she hears it whoosh to life, and, almost instinctively, her head dips back down – but she does a sudden, and almost aggressive, double-take when she realizes it’s you. |Astraea isn’t nearby, but given the hour of the day, that’s not surprising; you head to the Frost Hound Tavern, the next best place to look. And when you enter, there she is, sitting at the far corner of the long table surrounding the bar, numbly nursing a flagon. She glances up and toward the door at the sound of footsteps entering the tavern, and, instinctively, lowers her face back into her flagon – and then gasps in surprise, the mead inside her tankard splashing all over her cuirass when she realizes it’s you. ] [dayNight |She stands with enough speed and fervor to kick up the dust around her spot. |She slams down the tankard and takes two leaping strides towards you, her mass shaking the bottles in the racks with every step. ] "[pc.name]?" she asks bewilderingly, her hands clapping onto your shoulders with perhaps more energy than she meant. "Holy shit, you’re real. You’re real! You’re here!" Astraea’s mouth apprehensively cracks into a smile as she dares to hope in you having good news, but just as quickly, she nervously peers over your shoulder, towards the [dayNight |stone |door to the tavern ]. "But Berwyn... he’s not with you?" Whatever hint of a smile that played on her lips vanishes, replaced with panic. "No... don’t tell me that... Matiha...?" You interrupt her by saying that you have nothing but good news. At that, Astraea’s grip on your shoulders loosens, and her shoulders relax. Her body visibly deflates in front of you as the smile from before comes back wide enough to show off her teeth. She gives off two choked laughs, and you can see the bottoms of her eyes beginning to well up. It’s almost like she’s unfamiliar with the concept of 'good news’ and she only just found out what it means. [dayNight |"We’re going to the Frost Hound and every last round is on me," she says. "I don’t care if it’s the middle of the day. If you’re telling me the truth, you deserve every last drop you can drink." |"I am buying you every last drop you can drink, [pc.name]. If you’re telling the truth, you deserve it all." She stands upright, turning her head towards Garth. "In fact," she says loudly, getting the entire tavern’s attention, "everyone! Next round’s on me!" Everyone cheers Astraea and her announcement – before they all begin to swarm towards Garth, suddenly tripling his workload. His nose crunches in frustration as he gets to work. ] —- An hour and several meads later, you’re coming to the conclusion of the story, the part that you’re retelling second-hand: that [berwyn.name] was, according to [berwyn.himHer], unmade, and that [berwyn.heShe] had access to an unlimited amount of magic to reconstitute [berwyn.hisHer] body however [berwyn.heShe] saw fit. After the light from the explosion had dimmed, you found yourself in the fortress’s courtyard. "And then you came back here?" Astraea asks, wide-eyed, hanging on to your every word like a child being told her favorite bedtime story. You respond that you did – [berwyn.name] opted to stay in the fortress for the time being, to learn whatever else [berwyn.heShe] could from Matiha’s studies and notes. Apparently, [berwyn.heShe] knows how to teleport the tower; you were... kind of hoping that she and the Order Astrida would be okay with that, as long as [berwyn.name] doesn’t go around sucking the magic out of the earth like Matiha had. She hums in thought. "Maybe," she answers, taking a thick swig of her mead as she thinks about it. "Anyone with the knowledge and the power to teleport an entire fortress will always be a person of interest to the Order, but... as long as [berwyn.heShe] keeps things under control and [berwyn.heShe] doesn’t go all power-hungry like Matiha had, then I could maybe convince the Order to stay at arm’s length and just observe. For the time being." Astraea wipes her mouth with the back of her forearm, cleaning it of the mead wetting her lips. Her eyes narrow on yours. "Speaking of Matiha...." You had realized halfway through your first mead that you were going to get to the part where Matiha was found alive – and that you spared her. You sort of doubt Astraea’s going to appreciate hearing that, given her mission statement and the threat Matiha had posed to all of Savarra for the time. Everything you retold in your story was the truth as you remember it, except for that part: you answer Astraea by saying that, after searching the courtyard for her body, Matiha [flags.MATIHA_RES 4 |was sent to Tychris, still alive, but unconscious. You answer earnestly that it didn’t seem right to kill her when you had the opportunity, but she still needed to face justice, so you did the next best thing. Surely the Order Astrida would accept Matiha alive just as well as her dead, right? |was never found. You and [berwyn.name] both assumed that she had vanished in the explosion of light. ] When you get to the part about Matiha, Astraea’s body language changes. She sets down her flagon and gently sets her hands on her lap as she closes her eyes and takes a deep breath through her nose. "What about Elexis?" she eventually asks, her voice quiet enough to nearly be drowned out by the ambience of the tavern. "Did you... find her?" You reply that you did. She was in bad shape – you had bested her twice in combat, and you didn’t see her in the final fight against Matiha, but those aside, you couldn’t tell exactly what was wrong with her. She wouldn’t wake up when you tended to her. However, you also noticed that she was wearing a necklace with a faded blue gem, and when you pressed into the necklace with your thumb, Elexis disappeared a few seconds later in a flash of white light. You were sort of hoping that Astraea could tell you what that meant. [flags.MATIHA_RES 1 4 |In fact, you realized earlier that you still had the gem in your possession: when the light enveloped Elexis’ body, you panicked and lunged backwards, and the gemstone’s straps snapped off Elexis before the teleportation could finish. You thought about keeping the gem for yourself – never know when a quick shortcut into the heart of Tychris could come in handy – but you figured that it might be best if Astraea had it. You hand it to her. With a shaky hand, Astraea accepts the gemstone into her open palm. She stares at it for a moment, as if she’s struggling to accept what it is she’s seeing. ] "Oh, thank Nareva," Astraea eventually says, exhaling her held breath and releasing the tension in her shoulders. She reaches into the neck of her cloak, fishing out a necklace of her own and adorned with a similar faded-blue gem – but hers had been snapped in two. "These necklaces are waystone charms that will send us back to our home. All they need is a bit of stimulation to activate. Mine’s been broken, so I’ve been taking the long way back ever since." Astraea stops her explanation for a moment, her eyes lingering on [flags.MATIHA_RES 1 4 |both of the necklaces |her necklace ] for longer than you were expecting. Her nostrils flex as she takes a long, shuddering inhale through her nose – and she suddenly buries her eyes into her hands. Her chest heaves as she tries and fails to keep herself composed in front of you, and in the public of the tavern. You ask her if she’s okay. It takes her another moment to pull her eyes away from her hands. Her eyes are bloodshot and her nose is a little runny, but her mouth spreads into a warm, genuine smile – a smile of a woman that’s been through a lot, and she knows she’s only a few steps from home. "I will be," she answers.

当你喝到第一杯蜂蜜酒的时候，你就已经预感到接下来会讲到玛蒂哈被找到时还活着，以及你当时没有杀死她这一情节。考虑到阿斯特莱娅的使命目标，以及玛蒂哈当时对整个萨瓦拉地区构成的威胁，你有点怀疑她是否会喜欢听到这些事情。你在故事中讲述的一切，都是你记忆中所发生的真实事情，只有那一点除外：你告诉阿斯特莱娅，在院子里搜寻她的尸体之后，玛蒂哈[flags.MATIHA_RES 4 |她被送到了提克里斯，当时还活着，但已经失去了意识。你认真地回答说，既然有机会杀死她，不这么做似乎有些不妥，但她仍然应该受到应有的惩罚，所以你选择了次优的选择。想必阿斯特里达组织也会接受活着的玛蒂哈，而不会因为她死了而有所不同，对吧？ |始终没有被找到。你和[berwyn.name]两人都以为她在那道光芒的爆炸中消失了。 ] 当讲到玛蒂哈的部分时，阿斯特莱娅的神情和举止发生了变化。她放下了手中的酒壶，轻轻地将双手放在膝盖上，闭上眼睛，通过鼻子深吸了一口气。 “那埃莱克西斯呢？她最终问道，她的声音如此轻柔，几乎被酒馆里的嘈杂声所淹没：“你……找到她了吗？” 你回答说找到了。她的状况很糟糕——你在战斗中两次击败了她，而在与玛蒂哈的最后一场战斗中你也没有看到她，但除此之外，你实在无法确定她到底出了什么问题。当你照顾她时，她始终没有醒来。 然而，你也注意到她戴着一条挂着褪色蓝色宝石的项链，当你用拇指按压那颗宝石时，几秒钟后，艾莱克西斯便在一阵白轻型中消失了。你其实一直希望阿斯特莱娅能告诉你那意味着什么。 [flags.MATIHA_RES 1 4 |事实上，你早就在那一刻意识到自己仍然拥有那颗宝石：当光芒笼罩住埃莱克西斯的身体时，你惊慌失措地向后跃去，结果在传送过程尚未完成之前，那颗宝石的挂带就从埃莱克西斯身上脱落了。你本来想把那颗宝石留给自己——谁知道什么时候它会成为通往提克里斯核心的捷径呢——但最终你认为让阿斯特莱娅拥有它可能会更好。于是你将宝石交给了她。 阿斯特莱娅用颤抖的手将宝石接到了自己张开的手掌中。她盯着它看了一会儿，似乎在努力接受自己所看到的一切。 ] 哦，多亏了娜瑞瓦，”阿斯特莱娅终于说道，她呼出了憋在胸中的气息，放松了肩上的紧张。她伸手进入斗篷的领口，取出了自己佩戴的项链——那条项链上也镶嵌着一颗同样呈淡蓝色的宝石，但她的项链已经被折成了两半。这些项链其实是引导我们返回家园的符文饰品，只需要一点点外界刺激就能激活它们。我的项链已经损坏了，所以从那以后我就一直在绕道返回。” 阿斯特莱娅暂时停下了解释，她的目光停留在[flags.MATIHA_RES 1 4 |那两条项链 |她的项链 ]这个过程持续的时间比你预想的要长。她深深地吸了一口气，鼻孔随之收缩，身体不由自主地颤抖起来——然后她突然将双手捂住了眼睛。她的胸膛剧烈地起伏着，试图在你面前，在酒馆里这些旁观者的注视下，保持镇定自若，但却失败了。 你问她是否还好。 又过了片刻，她才将目光从自己的双手上移开。她的眼睛布满血丝，鼻子也有点流鼻涕，但她的嘴角却绽放出了一个温暖而真诚的微笑——那是一个经历过许多磨难的女性所特有的微笑，她知道，自己距离家已经只有几步之遥了。 我会的，”她回答道。
rows.raw: ' You’re back in Hawkethorne. [matiha.isLover |[berwyn.name] and Matiha remained in the fortress inside the Ways Between for the time being; they told you that there was some loose ends that they needed to work through, and [berwyn.name] in particular was pretty excited about an idea [berwyn.heShe] had involving moving the fortress as you pleased. Whether they’re telling the truth and they’re earnestly just trying to get some work done is up to your imagination. |[berwyn.name] and Matiha remained in the fortress inside the Ways Between for the time being; they told you that there was some loose ends that they needed to work through, and [berwyn.name] in particular was pretty excited about an idea [berwyn.heShe] had involving moving the fortress as you pleased. Whether they’re telling the truth and they’re earnestly just trying to get some work done is up to your imagination. |[berwyn.name] remained in the fortress inside the Ways Between for the time being; [berwyn.heShe] had apparently taken some inspiration from Matiha’s old texts and journals [berwyn.heShe] had found elsewhere in the fortress and [berwyn.heShe] had an idea involving moving the whole thing as you pleased. [berwyn.HeShe] then started to babble a bit about magical theory and conservation of mass through teleportation – you were only paying half attention, if you were honest. ] As soon as you step out of the Ways Between and your feet hit the beaten road of Hawkethorne’s main intersection, you realize just how exhausted you are: you had been in that teleporting, shapeshifting fortress for who knows how long, and staying in a dimension between dimensions like you have for as long as you have probably wasn’t healthy in the long run. [dayNight |Astraea isn’t far from the Waystone: in fact, she’s right at its opening, sitting next to its mouth with her hood up and her body hunched over. She glances up towards the stone once she hears it whoosh to life, and, almost instinctively, her head dips back down – but she does a sudden, and almost aggressive, double-take when she realizes it’s you. |Astraea isn’t nearby, but given the hour of the day, that’s not surprising; you head to the Frost Hound Tavern, the next best place to look. And when you enter, there she is, sitting at the far corner of the long table surrounding the bar, numbly nursing a flagon. She glances up and toward the door at the sound of footsteps entering the tavern, and, instinctively, lowers her face back into her flagon – and then gasps in surprise, the mead inside her tankard splashing all over her cuirass when she realizes it’s you. ] [dayNight |She stands with enough speed and fervor to kick up the dust around her spot. |She slams down the tankard and takes two leaping strides towards you, her mass shaking the bottles in the racks with every step. ] "[pc.name]?" she asks bewilderingly, her hands clapping onto your shoulders with perhaps more energy than she meant. "Holy shit, you’re real. You’re real! You’re here!" Astraea’s mouth apprehensively cracks into a smile as she dares to hope in you having good news, but just as quickly, she nervously peers over your shoulder, towards the [dayNight |stone |door to the tavern ]. "But Berwyn... he’s not with you?" Whatever hint of a smile that played on her lips vanishes, replaced with panic. "No... don’t tell me that... Matiha...?" You interrupt her by saying that you have nothing but good news. At that, Astraea’s grip on your shoulders loosens, and her shoulders relax. Her body visibly deflates in front of you as the smile from before comes back wide enough to show off her teeth. She gives off two choked laughs, and you can see the bottoms of her eyes beginning to well up. It’s almost like she’s unfamiliar with the concept of 'good news’ and she only just found out what it means. [dayNight |"We’re going to the Frost Hound and every last round is on me," she says. "I don’t care if it’s the middle of the day. If you’re telling me the truth, you deserve every last drop you can drink." |"I am buying you every last drop you can drink, [pc.name]. If you’re telling the truth, you deserve it all." She stands upright, turning her head towards Garth. "In fact," she says loudly, getting the entire tavern’s attention, "everyone! Next round’s on me!" Everyone cheers Astraea and her announcement – before they all begin to swarm towards Garth, suddenly tripling his workload. His nose crunches in frustration as he gets to work. ] —- An hour and several meads later, you’re coming to the conclusion of the story, the part that you’re retelling second-hand: that [berwyn.name] was, according to [berwyn.himHer], unmade, and that [berwyn.heShe] had access to an unlimited amount of magic to reconstitute [berwyn.hisHer] body however [berwyn.heShe] saw fit. After the light from the explosion had dimmed, you found yourself in the fortress’s courtyard. "And then you came back here?" Astraea asks, wide-eyed, hanging on to your every word like a child being told her favorite bedtime story. You respond that you did – [berwyn.name] opted to stay in the fortress for the time being, to learn whatever else [berwyn.heShe] could from Matiha’s studies and notes. Apparently, [berwyn.heShe] knows how to teleport the tower; you were... kind of hoping that she and the Order Astrida would be okay with that, as long as [berwyn.name] doesn’t go around sucking the magic out of the earth like Matiha had. She hums in thought. "Maybe," she answers, taking a thick swig of her mead as she thinks about it. "Anyone with the knowledge and the power to teleport an entire fortress will always be a person of interest to the Order, but... as long as [berwyn.heShe] keeps things under control and [berwyn.heShe] doesn’t go all power-hungry like Matiha had, then I could maybe convince the Order to stay at arm’s length and just observe. For the time being." Astraea wipes her mouth with the back of her forearm, cleaning it of the mead wetting her lips. Her eyes narrow on yours. "Speaking of Matiha...." You had realized halfway through your first mead that you were going to get to the part where Matiha was found alive – and that you spared her. You sort of doubt Astraea’s going to appreciate hearing that, given her mission statement and the threat Matiha had posed to all of Savarra for the time. Everything you retold in your story was the truth as you remember it, except for that part: you answer Astraea by saying that, after searching the courtyard for her body, Matiha [flags.MATIHA_RES 4 |was sent to Tychris, still alive, but unconscious. You answer earnestly that it didn’t seem right to kill her when you had the opportunity, but she still needed to face justice, so you did the next best thing. Surely the Order Astrida would accept Matiha alive just as well as her dead, right? |was never found. You and [berwyn.name] both assumed that she had vanished in the explosion of light. ] When you get to the part about Matiha, Astraea’s body language changes. She sets down her flagon and gently sets her hands on her lap as she closes her eyes and takes a deep breath through her nose. "What about Elexis?" she eventually asks, her voice quiet enough to nearly be drowned out by the ambience of the tavern. "Did you... find her?" You reply that you did. She was in bad shape – you had bested her twice in combat, and you didn’t see her in the final fight against Matiha, but those aside, you couldn’t tell exactly what was wrong with her. She wouldn’t wake up when you tended to her. However, you also noticed that she was wearing a necklace with a faded blue gem, and when you pressed into the necklace with your thumb, Elexis disappeared a few seconds later in a flash of white light. You were sort of hoping that Astraea could tell you what that meant. [flags.MATIHA_RES 1 4 |In fact, you realized earlier that you still had the gem in your possession: when the light enveloped Elexis’ body, you panicked and lunged backwards, and the gemstone’s straps snapped off Elexis before the teleportation could finish. You thought about keeping the gem for yourself – never know when a quick shortcut into the heart of Tychris could come in handy – but you figured that it might be best if Astraea had it. You hand it to her. With a shaky hand, Astraea accepts the gemstone into her open palm. She stares at it for a moment, as if she’s struggling to accept what it is she’s seeing. ] "Oh, thank Nareva," Astraea eventually says, exhaling her held breath and releasing the tension in her shoulders. She reaches into the neck of her cloak, fishing out a necklace of her own and adorned with a similar faded-blue gem – but hers had been snapped in two. "These necklaces are waystone charms that will send us back to our home. All they need is a bit of stimulation to activate. Mine’s been broken, so I’ve been taking the long way back ever since." Astraea stops her explanation for a moment, her eyes lingering on [flags.MATIHA_RES 1 4 |both of the necklaces |her necklace ] for longer than you were expecting. Her nostrils flex as she takes a long, shuddering inhale through her nose – and she suddenly buries her eyes into her hands. Her chest heaves as she tries and fails to keep herself composed in front of you, and in the public of the tavern. You ask her if she’s okay. It takes her another moment to pull her eyes away from her hands. Her eyes are bloodshot and her nose is a little runny, but her mouth spreads into a warm, genuine smile – a smile of a woman that’s been through a lot, and she knows she’s only a few steps from home. "I will be," she answers.'

rows.original: "I’m heading to Tychris," Astraea tells you several hours later. She hefts a sack almost as large as she is across her back, filled with enough supplies to provide a small caravan for a day’s journey. "It’s maybe a three-day hike west of Hawkethorne. It’s the headquarters for the Astrida in this part of the world." You ask her if she’ll be alright traveling by herself. You understand that she can’t take the Ways Between to get there faster, but if she could wait maybe a day or two, you’d be ready to travel with her. "I had polymorphed a body like this," she says, flexing her left arm and bulging its bicep so hard against her leather armor that it creaks from the strain, "specifically to handle physical challenges like a three-day walk, [pc.name]. My body is fine; it’s my magic that I can’t use." She hefts her backpack into place on her back. "And you and [berwyn.name] have already done so much for me. I can’t rely on the kindness of two strangers to get me through the rest of my life." If she’s sure.... "And besides," she continues, smiling brightly at you, "knowing that the mission is complete; that Matiha’s been dealt with; that Elexis is safe; and that I’ve already been walking so long, and Tychris seems so close... I feel like I could probably sprint there! I feel like I could run there as quickly as I could and I’d clothesline every one of those inky demons I’d meet on the way!" She turns her body towards you, facing you directly. She puts both of her massive, gloved hands on your shoulders as she looks directly into your eyes. "[pc.name], I’ll personally vouch for you and your companions if you ever come to Tychris," she says with a smile. "It’ll mean admitting to my own failures... but, really, they’ve probably been assumed by now, given I haven’t returned yet. And the whole of the Astrida Order would like to meet the hero of Savarra for themselves, I’m sure. Consider this a personal invitation." [flags.TYCHRIS_VISITS |You’re already familiar with the location, but you don’t want to spoil the mood for Astraea too much. You promise her that you’ll direct your own journey in that direction someday. |You tell her that you’re sure your own journey will see you there someday. ] [flags.ASTRAEA_HUG |Astraea’s eyes look up at the [dayNight |bright, blue, cloudless |starry, twinkling ] sky, her eyes scanning it for a moment. Her hands haven’t left your shoulders. "Before I go," she says, "there’s something that I owe you." Before you have the chance to ask her what that is, she steps forward and warps her massive arms around you, burying her face into the nape of your neck and holding you closely to her. Her grip isn’t particularly tight, but her arms hold you with such fervor that you couldn’t hope to break out if you wanted to[pc.strengthRange 0 75 | |, even if you thought you were about as strong as she is ]. She holds you there against her for a long time, her breath coming out heavy against your neck through her nose. When you [pc.isDK |hesitantly |eventually ] reciprocate the hug and put your own hands around her, her body relaxes against you, putting a bit more weight onto you. And when she finally pulls away, it’s with the same sort of belabored difficulty that a person exhibits when they try and pull themselves out of a warm bath. ] "I’ll see you again someday, [pc.name]," she says as she takes a deep sigh through her nose. "And when we do... remind me to thank you properly." With that, she hefts her backpack once more, and she sets off west, towards Tychris. True to her word, you’ll probably see her again there.
rows.translation: 我要去提克里斯，”几小时后，阿斯特莱娅对你说。她把一个几乎和她本人一样大的袋子背在背上，里面装满了足够的补给品，足够让一个小商队进行一天的旅程。“从鹰棘镇向西走，大概需要三天的时间才能到达。这是阿斯特里达在这个地区的总部。 你问她独自旅行是否不会有问题。你知道她无法通过“时空通道”来更快地到达那里，但如果她能等上一两天，你就可以陪她一起出发了。 我曾经将一个身体变形成了这个就是这样的，”她说着，弯曲左臂，将二头肌用力绷紧，抵在皮制铠甲上，以至于铠甲因受力而发出嘎吱声，“主要是为了应对像连续三天徒步这样的体力挑战。 [pc.name]我的身体没有问题，只是我的魔法无法使用了。”她把背包背在背上。“至于你[berwyn.name]已经为我做了这么多。我不能再依赖两个陌生人的善意来度过余生了。 如果她确实这么认为的话…… “而且，”她继续说道，脸上洋溢着灿烂的笑容，“知道这个任务已经完成了；知道玛蒂哈已经被处理掉了；知道埃莱克西斯安全无恙；再加上我已经走了这么长的路，而提克里斯似乎也近在咫尺了。我觉得我肯定能冲到那里！我相信自己可以以最快的速度跑到那里，然后把路上遇到的那些漆黑恶魔全部消灭掉！” 她转过身体，直接面对你。她将那双戴着手套的、宽大的手放在你的肩上，直视着你的眼睛。[pc.name]，如果你们有幸来到提克里斯，我本人会为你们和你的同伴提供担保，”她微笑着说，“不过这也意味着我要承认自己的失败……不过说实话，既然我至今还没有回来，这些失败恐怕早就被人猜到了。而且我相信，整个阿斯特里达组织都非常渴望亲自见到萨瓦拉的英雄。就把这看作是一份私人邀请吧。 [flags.TYCHRIS_VISITS |你对这个地方已经很熟悉了，但你也不想破坏阿斯特莱娅的好心情。你向她承诺，总有一天你会朝着那个方向前进的。 |你告诉她，你相信自己的努力总有一天会让自己达到那个目标。 ] [flags.ASTRAEA_HUG |阿斯特莱娅抬起双眼，望向[dayNight |湛蓝的天空，万里无云 |星光闪烁 ]她抬头望向天空，目光在那一片蔚蓝中停留了片刻。她的双手依然紧握着你的肩膀。“在我离开之前，”她说，“有件事我必须告诉你。” 你还没来得及询问那是什么，她便向前迈了一步，用她那宽大的双臂紧紧地将你拥入怀中，把脸埋在你的颈后，将你紧紧地贴在她的身体上。她的拥抱并不特别用力，但那份炽热的情感让你会觉得，即使你想挣脱，也根本无能为力。[pc.strengthRange 0 75 | |甚至如果你以为自己的实力和她差不多吧 ]她将你紧紧抱在怀中，久久不愿放开；她的呼吸通过鼻子呼出，轻拂着你的脖子。当你[pc.isDK |犹豫地 |最终 ]你回抱她，将自己的手臂环绕在她的身上，她的身体逐渐放松，靠在你的身上，甚至把更多的重量都压在了你身上。而当她最终拉开距离时，那种动作也显得十分吃力，就像一个人试图从温暖的浴缸中爬出来时一样困难。 ] 总有一天，我们会再见的。 [pc.name]，当我们真的做到了……记得让我好好感谢你，”她边说边通过鼻子深深地叹了口气。正确地说完之后，她再次背起背包，向西方向出发，前往提克里斯。正如她所说，你很可能会在那里再次见到她。

rows.original: Once you see Astraea off, you turn around and head back to the heart of Hawkethorne, where the village’s Waystone is. It’s not a far walk. Standing at the foot of the Waystone is [berwyn.name], carrying a stack of books across both of [berwyn.hisHer] arms and wearing a satchel that’s been stuffed full of more across [berwyn.hisHer] shoulder[matiha.isLover |. And Matiha is standing right behind [berwyn.hisHer], carrying two more, one in each hand – and with a small bookshelf hovering in the air behind her, kept afloat with the same magic she uses for her bust, presumably |. And Matiha is standing right behind him, carrying not books, but numerous rolled up scrolls and parchment, with several in each hand and several more tucked under her arms[silly |, with two more rolled up and stuffed into her breasts ] ]. When [berwyn.name] gets a glimpse of you, [berwyn.heShe] stops and sets down everything that [berwyn.heShe]’s carrying[matiha.isLover |, signaling to Matiha to do the same |, signaling to Matiha to do the same ]. "I take is Astraea’s gone?" You ask [berwyn.himHer] if that’s wise – it doesn’t seem especially, well, available most hours of the day. "On the contrary, and I’m glad you brought that up." [berwyn.name] reaches into [berwyn.hisHer] robe, withdrawing what appears to be a normal stone – but with familiar markings and textures. While the stone itself is slate gray, the markings on it seem to glow with a dull, eerie, muted green. [pc.cunningRange 0 50 |"This is a sigil I made using a brick from the fortress," [berwyn.heShe] explains. |You note that it almost looks like [berwyn.heShe] chiseled that straight out of a brick from the fortress. "That’s very observant of you," [berwyn.heShe] says with a wry grin. ] "Due to the very nature of the Ways Between and how it works, there’s very little a person can’t reach in Savarra, and a person could travel many hundreds of leagues in just a few minutes by traveling through it. To travel to essentially anywhere within the Ways Between in just a few steps by walking through Savarra?" [pc.dcb |You ask [berwyn.himHer] what [berwyn.heShe]’s learned. There’s nothing fun to do in the Ways Between. "Study and discovery don’t always have to be about fun things," [berwyn.heShe] sighs impatiently. Well... you don’t see the point in that, but it’s clearly important to [berwyn.himHer], so you ask [berwyn.himHer] what [berwyn.heShe] found out. ] "Well, [matiha.isLover |we’re |we’re |I’m ] still working on that part," [berwyn.heShe] continues, scratching at [berwyn.hisHer] head sheepishly, "but [matiha.isLover |we |we |I ] did learn something else: I want you to squeeze that sigil in your hand. Your fingers turn white and your arm flexes from the strain, to test out [berwyn.name]’s theory that it’ll survive. "Okay, smartass, that’s enough," [berwyn.heShe] interrupts ]. After a moment, you open your fingers, and the dull, eerie green glowing etched into the stone appears to have lit up; the light is strong enough that you can see it refract against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "When it glows like that, I can see where it – and you – are from the fortress in the Ways Between. Anywhere in Savarra. And since I know how to teleport the whole tower now, I can use that to move the whole thing straight to you." The whole fortress? Anywhere in Savarra? "That’s right," [berwyn.heShe] answers, putting [berwyn.hisHer] hands on [berwyn.hisHer] hips and smiling cockily. Clearly, it’s a big accomplishment for [berwyn.himHer]. "Well, almost anywhere. Give it one squeeze, and I’ll come running, fortress and all. I can transform the fortress to take any shape at all, brick by brick, so you don’t even need to worry about calling me indoors or underground or whatever. Anywhere you can set up a tent, I can come visit with the tower." You stow the little charm that [berwyn.name]’s made away. That sounds like a good thing to own. [berwyn.andMatiha |Unbidden, Matiha steps forward, placing herself between you and [berwyn.name]. "As long as we’re giving things out," she says, "there’s something of mine that I’d like you to have as well. Something that I hope might be of use to you." She removes her gigantic hat from her head, holding onto the brim with her fingers – and she hands it to you, offering it to you. She’s giving you her witch’s hat. You ask her if that’s really something she wants to do: you sort of got the impression that her hat was one of her more prized possessions, given she had it even when she was deep under the influence of that rune stone. That, and it’s easily the most iconic piece of her outfit. "That’s true on both accounts," she laughs, "but I insist, for two reasons. [pc.isMage |Someone as attuned to the magics of the world as you ought to understand once you grasp it. |I know you’re not a scholar of the magics like [berwyn.name] and I are, but hopefully, you’ll understand all the same. ]" You do as she asks and grip onto the wide brim of her hat with both hands – and you feel a sudden jolt of [pc.isMage |pure, archaic energy arc through your fingertips and up along your wrists. You thank her[pc.isDK | | sincerely ] for the gift, but you’re curious: she said that there was a second reason she wanted you to have it? "The second reason is that I have spares," she says with a laugh. "You’re right; it is my favorite look to my ensemble. I’m not going to just have one; what if I rip a hole in it?" Well, now you’ll have to treat it with even more care. |"There’s actually a few other things that I wanted you to have," [berwyn.heShe] continues. With [berwyn.hisHer] right hand, [berwyn.heShe] digs into the chest of [berwyn.hisHer] robe, searching for a hidden pocket within it. "And the first is... this." With a strained yank, [berwyn.heShe] manages to pull something from within it – something huge, but folded over and pressed flat several times. Or, perhaps given its size, it’s a witch’s hat. "I found this while I was exploring the fortress some more," [berwyn.heShe] says forlornly, [berwyn.hisHer] eyes downcast at the sight of Matiha’s hat. "With Matiha gone... I think I’d prefer it if you had this. So that there’s nothing that reminds me of her to keep me distracted." It’s clear to you that Matiha was [pc.isBimbo |super |highly ] important to [berwyn.himHer]: she was on [berwyn.hisHer] mind for the entire adventure. She’s still on [berwyn.hisHer] mind now. You ask if [berwyn.heShe]’s sure. "Yes, I’m sure," [berwyn.heShe] says impatiently. "If I wanted heirlooms to remember Matiha by, I have her entire fortress, now. Just as you reach your hand forward to accept the gift, [berwyn.heShe] suddenly jerks it away. "I should let you know, though," [berwyn.heShe] continues, "there’s... something different about this hat. It’s clearly been enchanted, but I don’t know with what, or how." You ask if it’s dangerous. "No, not at all," [berwyn.heShe] answers. "I doubt Matiha would have worn it if it was. But there’s something... new about this hat that I can’t explain. It’s an enchantment that I’ve never seen before, and it’s too strong and too unique for me to replicate. I’m just letting you know." Eventually, [berwyn.heShe] relents and gives you the oversized hat. You aren’t sure what it is you’re feeling. ] ] "And...," [berwyn.heShe] continues, reaching into [berwyn.hisHer] satchel at [berwyn.hisHer] hip. "I want you to have this, too." Rummaging through all the thick, heavy books flopping at [berwyn.hisHer] side, [berwyn.heShe] eventually pulls out something smaller – a leaflet, really, composed of a few pages folded against each other. [berwyn.name] hands it to you delicately, almost like it’ll flake to pieces if either of you mistreat it. "I’ve put everything I know about summoning and enchantments into these notes," [berwyn.heShe] continues. I know you can, [pc.name]; just sit down and power through it sometime." ] You take the parchment and put it among your belongings as well. Being able to summon a golem from the earth like [berwyn.name] can would be a useful skill to have if you’re ever outnumbered and [berwyn.name] isn’t there to help out. With that, [berwyn.name] kneels down to pick up the books [berwyn.heShe]’s set down[matiha.isLover |, and Matiha... doesn’t do the same insomuch as she lifts the books she had set down into the air with her magic, hovering them back into her hands |, and Matiha does the same, bending at the waist and giving you an obvious look straight into her tightly-bound cleavage – and anyone behind her a glance at her ass, still wrapped up in her robes ]. "Okay," [berwyn.heShe] sighs as [berwyn.heShe] stands back up. [berwyn.HeShe] takes one, long moment to look into your eyes, clutching [berwyn.hisHer] books to [berwyn.hisHer] chest. "Thanks again," [berwyn.heShe] says eventually. "For everything. From the very beginning. [matiha.isLover |We |We |I ], uh... wouldn’t be here without you." [berwyn.name] glances at the Waystone beside [berwyn.himHer], then, before [berwyn.heShe] changes [berwyn.hisHer] mind or loses [berwyn.hisHer] nerve, [berwyn.heShe] closes the distance between you two and leans in, [pc.heightRange 0 60 65 |tilting [berwyn.hisHer] head down and pressing |pressing |tilting [berwyn.hisHer] head up and pressing ] [berwyn.hisHer] lips pressing against yours for a split second. When [berwyn.heShe] pulls back, [berwyn.hisHer] tail swishes several times behind [berwyn.himHer]self, before [berwyn.heShe] consciously forces it to stop. "[matiha.isLover |We’ll |We’ll |I’ll ] see you whenever, alright?" [berwyn.heShe] says, [berwyn.hisHer] cheeks flushing a dull red. [berwyn.HeShe] turns and steps towards the Waystone, vanishing in a flash of light before you have a chance to respond. [matiha.isLover |Matiha follows behind [berwyn.himHer], just paces away – but she takes a moment to stop and repeat [berwyn.name]’s action, pressing her lips to yours and pulling away just as quickly. "Thank you from me, too," she says in a low whisper. "This is the first time in years that I’m thinking clearly and I have a chance to start again, and it’s because of you." Her eyes glance downward, at her own chest. You follow them down – and you can clearly see her nipples poking through her robe. "Maybe not clearly enough," she laughs. "Don’t take too long to visit us, [pc.name]. We’ll be lonely without you." rows.raw: ' Once you see Astraea off, you turn around and head back to the heart of Hawkethorne, where the village’s Waystone is. It’s not a far walk. Standing at the foot of the Waystone is [berwyn.name], carrying a stack of books across both of [berwyn.hisHer] arms and wearing a satchel that’s been stuffed full of more across [berwyn.hisHer] shoulder[matiha.isLover |. And Matiha is standing right behind [berwyn.hisHer], carrying two more, one in each hand – and with a small bookshelf hovering in the air behind her, kept afloat with the same magic she uses for her bust, presumably |. And Matiha is standing right behind him, carrying not books, but numerous rolled up scrolls and parchment, with several in each hand and several more tucked under her arms[silly |, with two more rolled up and stuffed into her breasts ] ]. When [berwyn.name] gets a glimpse of you, [berwyn.heShe] stops and sets down everything that [berwyn.heShe]’s carrying[matiha.isLover |, signaling to Matiha to do the same |, signaling to Matiha to do the same ]. "I take is Astraea’s gone?" [berwyn.name] asks, and you tell [berwyn.himHer] everything that’s happened since you came back: you went to Astraea, and she pulled you into the Frost Hound to buy you all the ale you could hold while you recounted everything that’s happened in the Ways Between. [berwyn.name] hums, [berwyn.hisHer] mouth twisting wryly as [berwyn.heShe] processes the news. "I guess that’s good," [berwyn.heShe] eventually says. "Happy endings all around." You ask [berwyn.himHer] [matiha.isLover |and Matiha what they’re doing. "We’re |and Matiha what they’re doing. "We’re |what [berwyn.heShe]’s doing. "I’m ]moving out of the Frost Hound – I’m sure Garth would appreciate not having a freeloader take up space in his tavern anymore," [berwyn.heShe] answers, looking over [berwyn.hisHer] shoulder towards the tavern. "And I’m not going to miss the constant smell of booze, and the noise, and the sound of people banging a few rooms over. I’m going to move into the fortress in the Ways Between." You ask [berwyn.himHer] if that’s wise – it doesn’t seem especially, well, available most hours of the day. "On the contrary, and I’m glad you brought that up." [berwyn.name] reaches into [berwyn.hisHer] robe, withdrawing what appears to be a normal stone – but with familiar markings and textures. While the stone itself is slate gray, the markings on it seem to glow with a dull, eerie, muted green. [pc.cunningRange 0 50 |"This is a sigil I made using a brick from the fortress," [berwyn.heShe] explains. |You note that it almost looks like [berwyn.heShe] chiseled that straight out of a brick from the fortress. "That’s very observant of you," [berwyn.heShe] says with a wry grin. ] "Due to the very nature of the Ways Between and how it works, there’s very little a person can’t reach in Savarra, and a person could travel many hundreds of leagues in just a few minutes by traveling through it. As you know." "But [matiha.isLover |Matiha and I were |Matiha and I were |I was ] wondering... wouldn’t it be possible to do this the opposite way? To travel to essentially anywhere within the Ways Between in just a few steps by walking through Savarra?" [pc.dcb |You ask [berwyn.himHer] what [berwyn.heShe]’s learned. Clearly something, if [berwyn.heShe]’s giving you this little charm. |And from the way [berwyn.heShe] jumped straight to giving you this little charm that [berwyn.heShe]’s made, clearly, [berwyn.heShe] must have made some discovery. |You ask [berwyn.name] what the point of that even is. There’s nothing fun to do in the Ways Between. "Study and discovery don’t always have to be about fun things," [berwyn.heShe] sighs impatiently. Well... you don’t see the point in that, but it’s clearly important to [berwyn.himHer], so you ask [berwyn.himHer] what [berwyn.heShe] found out. ] "Well, [matiha.isLover |we’re |we’re |I’m ] still working on that part," [berwyn.heShe] continues, scratching at [berwyn.hisHer] head sheepishly, "but [matiha.isLover |we |we |I ] did learn something else: I want you to squeeze that sigil in your hand. Don’t worry about breaking it; it’s made out of brick, it’ll be fine." You hesitate, then squeeze the charm[pc.strengthRange 0 90 | | as hard as you can. Your fingers turn white and your arm flexes from the strain, to test out [berwyn.name]’s theory that it’ll survive. "Okay, smartass, that’s enough," [berwyn.heShe] interrupts ]. After a moment, you open your fingers, and the dull, eerie green glowing etched into the stone appears to have lit up; the light is strong enough that you can see it refract against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "When it glows like that, I can see where it – and you – are from the fortress in the Ways Between. Anywhere in Savarra. And since I know how to teleport the whole tower now, I can use that to move the whole thing straight to you." The whole fortress? Anywhere in Savarra? "That’s right," [berwyn.heShe] answers, putting [berwyn.hisHer] hands on [berwyn.hisHer] hips and smiling cockily. Clearly, it’s a big accomplishment for [berwyn.himHer]. "Well, almost anywhere. Give it one squeeze, and I’ll come running, fortress and all. I can transform the fortress to take any shape at all, brick by brick, so you don’t even need to worry about calling me indoors or underground or whatever. Anywhere you can set up a tent, I can come visit with the tower." You stow the little charm that [berwyn.name]’s made away. That sounds like a good thing to own. [berwyn.andMatiha |Unbidden, Matiha steps forward, placing herself between you and [berwyn.name]. "As long as we’re giving things out," she says, "there’s something of mine that I’d like you to have as well. Something that I hope might be of use to you." She removes her gigantic hat from her head, holding onto the brim with her fingers – and she hands it to you, offering it to you. She’s giving you her witch’s hat. You ask her if that’s really something she wants to do: you sort of got the impression that her hat was one of her more prized possessions, given she had it even when she was deep under the influence of that rune stone. That, and it’s easily the most iconic piece of her outfit. "That’s true on both accounts," she laughs, "but I insist, for two reasons. [pc.isMage |Someone as attuned to the magics of the world as you ought to understand once you grasp it. |I know you’re not a scholar of the magics like [berwyn.name] and I are, but hopefully, you’ll understand all the same. ]" You do as she asks and grip onto the wide brim of her hat with both hands – and you feel a sudden jolt of [pc.isMage |pure, archaic energy arc through your fingertips and up along your wrists. Her hat’s been enchanted – and by something powerful. |energy arc up through your arms. It tingles quite a lot – you wouldn’t describe the sensation as painful, but you also don’t really know how to process it. You aren’t sure what it is you’re feeling. ] "I had learned some new skills whilst I was studying the Vodo rune stone, and I applied what I had learned to placing some... particular enchantments upon my clothing. I used it to amplify my focus; I hope that it’ll be of some use to you on your adventures." You thank her[pc.isDK | | sincerely ] for the gift, but you’re curious: she said that there was a second reason she wanted you to have it? "The second reason is that I have spares," she says with a laugh. "You’re right; it is my favorite look to my ensemble. I’m not going to just have one; what if I rip a hole in it?" She sighs, her eyes wandering slightly. "But that hat you hold is one-of-a-kind. I crafted that enchantment while I had the rune stone, and now it’s no more. I very much doubt I’ll have access to that kind of power for a second enchantment in the future." Well, now you’ll have to treat it with even more care. |"There’s actually a few other things that I wanted you to have," [berwyn.heShe] continues. With [berwyn.hisHer] right hand, [berwyn.heShe] digs into the chest of [berwyn.hisHer] robe, searching for a hidden pocket within it. "And the first is... this." With a strained yank, [berwyn.heShe] manages to pull something from within it – something huge, but folded over and pressed flat several times. When it’s finally made free from [berwyn.hisHer] robes, it unfolds and springs back into form instantly, and it suddenly takes a familiar shape: a wide brim; a conical top; and a spherical opening on the bottom... it’s a mage’s hat. Or, perhaps given its size, it’s a witch’s hat. "I found this while I was exploring the fortress some more," [berwyn.heShe] says forlornly, [berwyn.hisHer] eyes downcast at the sight of Matiha’s hat. "With Matiha gone... I think I’d prefer it if you had this. So that there’s nothing that reminds me of her to keep me distracted." It’s clear to you that Matiha was [pc.isBimbo |super |highly ] important to [berwyn.himHer]: she was on [berwyn.hisHer] mind for the entire adventure. She’s still on [berwyn.hisHer] mind now. You ask if [berwyn.heShe]’s sure. "Yes, I’m sure," [berwyn.heShe] says impatiently. "If I wanted heirlooms to remember Matiha by, I have her entire fortress, now. I think this hat would be better with you than it would be with me. And besides: you may have forgotten, but I have my own giant hat to keep me sheltered from the sun and the rain, you know." Just as you reach your hand forward to accept the gift, [berwyn.heShe] suddenly jerks it away. "I should let you know, though," [berwyn.heShe] continues, "there’s... something different about this hat. It’s clearly been enchanted, but I don’t know with what, or how." You ask if it’s dangerous. "No, not at all," [berwyn.heShe] answers. "I doubt Matiha would have worn it if it was. But there’s something... new about this hat that I can’t explain. It’s an enchantment that I’ve never seen before, and it’s too strong and too unique for me to replicate. I’m just letting you know." Eventually, [berwyn.heShe] relents and gives you the oversized hat. And as soon as your fingers grip onto the brim, you can feel exactly what [berwyn.heShe] was talking about: a jolt of [pc.isMage |pure, archaic energy arcs through your fingertips and up along your wrists. Her eyes glance downward, at her own chest. You follow them down – and you can clearly see her nipples poking through her robe. "Maybe not clearly enough," she laughs. "Don’t take too long to visit us, [pc.name]. We’ll be lonely without you." With that, she turns and approaches the Waystone behind [berwyn.name], bouncing her hips to make her robe dance off the swell of her thigh, before disappearing in a blink of light. ] [var0]'

rows.original:
"Ah, [pc.name], there you are darling," Lady Evergreen drawls, luxuriating on her divan like always. There's another tanuki girl sitting with her, hands folded demurely in her lap as the witch brushes out her short, reddish-brown locks. Compared to the witch's other daughters, this girl's got a quite tremendous rack, so huge that her breasts simply can't be contained by the tunics common to the other girls; she's had to put on a long robe, or perhaps a gown with how sheer and silky it is. The girl glances up at you, copper-colored eyes catching the light as they widen, just for a moment, before she giggles airily and her attention wanders.

    "A rather odd vagrant wandered onto my property just recently," Evergreen continues, idly running her fingers through her daughter's hair. "She came from the direction of [wayfort.owned|your fort|that old wayfort], I should think. I hope she wasn't someone important to you — a girl like that doesn't last long, collapsing in a faint in the wilderness at this time of year."
    
    You shake your head. [pc.isDK
        |"She was a menace. I think the world's better off without her."
        |"I hardly knew her."
    ]
    
    Evergreen flashes you the thinnest of smiles, a single canine showing. "A shame for her, I suppose. Now then, I'm sure there's some reason you've stopped by?" The witch sits up somewhat, giving the smaller tanuki a slap on the ass and sending her on her way. "What can I do for you today?"
rows.translation:
啊， [pc.name]，给你吧，亲爱的，”常青女士慢条斯理地说道，像往常一样惬意地躺在沙发上。另一个狸猫女孩也坐在她身边，双手端庄地交叠在膝上，而那位女巫则正在梳理她那头短而红棕色的头发。与其他女巫的女儿们相比，这个女孩的胸部实在太过丰满，大到普通的束腰外衣根本无法将它们包裹住；因此她不得不穿上长袍，或者那种质地极为轻盈、丝滑柔软的礼服。那个女孩抬头看着你，她那铜色的眼睛在光线照射下微微张开，仅仅那一瞬间，随后她就咯咯地笑了起来，注意力又转移到了别处。

    “最近有个相当奇怪的流浪者闯进了我的领地，”常青女士一边说，一边随意地用手指梳理着女儿的头发。她是从那个方向走来的。 [wayfort.owned|你的据点|那种老办法]我想应该是这样吧。希望她对你来说并不是什么重要的人——这种女孩通常不会有什么好结局的，尤其是在每年的这个时候，在荒野里晕倒的话……”
    
    你摇了摇头。 [pc.isDK
        |她是个麻烦人物。我觉得没有她，这个世界会变得更好。
        |我几乎不认识她。
    ]
    
    常青女士向你露出一个极其淡淡的微笑，只露出了一颗犬齿。“对她来说，真是件憾事……那么，我想你来找我肯定是有原因的吧？”女巫稍微坐直身子，轻轻拍了拍那只较小的狸猫的屁股，让它继续离开。“今天，我能为你做些什么呢？
