那些[var1]他们加倍发动攻击，用猛烈的攻势将那些翼龙逼离你的防线。最终，这些飞龙放弃了抵抗，直接逃离了攻击源头……结果却迎面撞上了恶魔的防线。当你看到那些惊慌失措、尖叫着的翼龙冲进敌人的阵营，把恶魔撞得东倒西歪，还抓走了许多俘虏时，你简直忍不住要露出微笑。

伊莎多拉惊呼道：“这下他们就知道，不该招惹这些‘山脉’了！ 
        |你朝那个方向点了点头。 [var1]旗帜开始升起，鼓声擂动，士兵们开始向战场边缘移动。“让那些翼龙有所畏惧吧！”你在战争的喧嚣中大声喊道，“把它们逼向堡垒！”

军队举起盾牌，开始冲锋，如雷霆般从侧翼冲向翼龙的群落。刀锋与獠牙的激烈碰撞，寒冰气息与青铜铠甲的对抗；你可以看到士兵们被爪子和尾巴击倒在地，而那些攻击巨龙的战士们，也凭借着自己的力量将它们重创。这是一场在边缘地带进行的殊死搏斗，幸运的是，这场战斗只持续了几分钟——但短短的这几分钟，已经足以让人看清其中的惨烈程度。 [var1]你的军队正在遭受重创。等到那些翼龙开始全面撤退时，你的士兵们也会跟着撤退。

至少那些该死的小龙们正惊慌失措地向恶魔的方向撤退，它们慌乱之中，几乎把那些被腐蚀的生物们都踩在脚下。当你看到那些惊慌失措、尖叫着的女妖龙冲进敌人的阵营，把恶魔撞到一边，然后抓起其他敌人，成群结队地带着俘虏飞走时，你简直忍不住会露出微笑。

伊莎多拉，哇哦！这样他们就知道不能随便招惹那些山脉了！

“但是这也让我们付出了沉重的代价，”卡莉丝望着他们留下的痕迹，以及那些在战场上受伤的士兵们，说道，“代价实在太大了。
        |你朝那个方向点了点头。 [var1]旗帜开始升起，鼓声擂动，士兵们开始向战场边缘移动。“让那些翼龙知道什么是恐惧！”你在战争的喧嚣中大声喊道，“把它们逼向堡垒！”

你的部队举起了武器，开始前进，他们利用自己的速度优势，从战场的侧翼迅速逼近敌人。不幸的是，与那些庞大而强壮的翼龙相比，这些士兵唯一的优势就是速度。他们的武器效果有限，而薄薄的盔甲在面对飞龙凶猛的爪子和獠牙时根本不堪一击。你惊恐地看着自己的士兵们溃败逃跑——或者被那些凶残的野人抓住，强行掳走，成为它们交配的牺牲品。

“不……”伊莎多拉哀嚎道，“天啊，太可怕了……卡莉丝紧握双拳：“这为我们争取到了时间。但愿这时间足够。
    ]

rows.original: You give the girls a reassuring look and step past them, towards the pack of wyverns. "I've got this." Isadora grins and leads the way to the flank of your formation, where you come face to face with two dozen massive frost wyverns, licking their lips and drooling venom-laced frost. Gods, these are big boys. But you have just the thing for them: a song passed down to you by Livrea from the age of heroes, which flows from your lips and the instruments of your command cadre like water from a spring. The wyverns roar and stamp at the snow, trying to intimidate you and your men, but you continue your advance without flinching, continuing to sing and play in the face of their beastly rage. And that rage begins to temper, to falter... and then the wyverns begin to drop. Their roars turn to yawns, and their eyes, so full of fierce resentment, begin to droop closed. You approach close enough to rub their faces now, gently urging them to the ground. The strongest of the wyverns protest still, but it's only with impotent pawing and growling. They, too, doze off soon enough. "Woah," Isadora says. "I can't believe that worked!" You flash her a grin. "Thank King Keldoran. But we've still got a battle to win."
rows.translation: 你给那些女孩们一个安心的眼神，然后从她们身边走过，朝着那群翼龙走去。“这个交给我吧。” 伊莎多拉笑了笑，带着你来到了你们队形的侧翼，在那里，你面对着二十多只巨大的冰霜翼龙——它们正舔着嘴唇，流着含有毒液的冰霜。天啊，这些家伙是各位勇士们。而你们正好拥有最适合他们的武器：一首由莉维娅从英雄时代流传下来的歌曲。当你们用嘴唇唱出这首歌，当你们指挥部的成员用乐器演奏它时，这些旋律就会像泉水一样从你们口中流淌出来。 那些翼龙在雪地上咆哮、跺脚，试图恐吓你们和你们的人马，但你们却丝毫不为所动，继续向前推进，继续歌唱、继续演奏，无视它们那凶猛的怒火。 那种愤怒开始消退，开始减弱……然后那些翼龙也开始缓缓降落。它们的咆哮声变成了哈欠，那双充满激烈怨恨的眼睛也开始慢慢闭上。 你现在可以靠近一些，轻轻抚摸它们的脸，轻轻地将它们引向地面。那些最强大的翼龙仍在抗议，但它们也只能用无力的爪子抓挠、发出低吼，最终也渐渐进入了梦乡。 “哇，”伊莎多拉说道，“真不敢相信这种方法真的有效！” 你朝她露出了微笑：“这都要归功于凯尔多兰国王。但我们仍然有一场战斗需要打赢。

rows.original: "Commander!" one of the minotaurs under your banner says, approaching with his helm under arm and lips drawn tight. "We've sighted war banners behind us, coming from the Steps of Sorra. Scouts report the icon of the First Legion." "Khor'minoan reinforcements?" you ask. Calise snorts. "We aren't that lucky. Even a demi-legion of Khor'minos's best would boost our shield strength by half again, but I went out of my way to make sure the king and court didn't know exactly when we'd march, or where to." "Survivors from a lost unit?" Isadora says hopefully. "The First got hit hard protecting Khor'telahn." If they're enemies, you'll need to send some force to meet them before your rear lines are struck. Then again, if you're an optimist, deploying your troops to intercept reinforcements will not just delay help, but leave you short-handed on the front. Choose a unit to meet the legion's soldiers, if any.
rows.translation: “指挥官！”你麾下一名弥诺陶洛斯走近；他把头盔夹在腋下，双唇紧抿。“我们发现后方出现战旗，正从索拉阶梯而来。斥候报告说上面是第一军团的徽记。” “科尔米诺斯的援军？”你问道。 卡莉丝哼了一声。“我们没那么幸运。哪怕科尔米诺斯最精锐的半个军团，也能让我们的盾墙力量再提升一半；可我特意确保国王和宫廷不知道我们具体会在何时、向哪里进军。” “某支失联部队的幸存者？”伊莎多拉满怀希望地说道。“第一军团为保卫科尔特兰遭到了重创。” 如果来者是敌人，你必须在后方阵线遇袭前派出兵力迎击。可换个乐观角度看，出动部队拦截援军不仅会延误救兵，还会让前线人手短缺。 选择一支部队与军团士兵接触；也可以不派。

rows.original:
[var0
        |"I don't want them anywhere near us," you tell [var2]. "Keep them back at all costs."

        You're given a crisp salute, and the [var1] start to wheel around to face the rear lines. 
        
        You trust them to handle this, and return your attention to the battle at hand.
        
        It's only later that you're given a report of their bombardment of the oncoming legion. They prove to have been a corrupted company of minoan soldiers, seething berserkers driven mad with lust. Your suspicion doubtless saved countless lives; the enemy never even got close with their rear-attack force.
        |"Meet them man to man," you tell [var2]. "I trust you to keep our rear secured if it comes to it."

        You're given a crisp salute, and the [var1] starts to wheel around to face the rear lines. 
        
        You trust them to handle this, and return your attention to the battle at hand.
        
        It's only later that you're given a report of a second battle line forming in your rear: a heavy clash of shield and blade against equally-matched forces. It seems the "First Legion" approaching was corrupted after all, reduced to frothing lust-mad berserkers by the cult. Calise spits at the news, but it seems your troops have things in hand, if slowly. It will be a grinding battle. 
        
        Your troops are out of the fight for all intents and purposes, but the line holds, for now.
        |"Form a picket," you tell [var2]. "Keep these men at a distance."

        You're given a crisp salute, and the [var1] starts ranging back towards the rear. 
        
        You trust them to handle this, and return your attention to the battle at hand.
        
        It's only when you hear screaming from the rear lines that you give it a second thought. You look over your shoulder to see your troops in full retreat, breaking and running back through your trains with frothing corrupted minotaurs at their back. Troops are barreled over and driven into the snow; others simply grabbed and dragged away.
        
        "Shit!" Calise snarls, grabbing up her axe. "I'll handle it."
        
        At least your skirmishers bought enough time for Calise and some of the commanders to respond in person, but this is a setback you can ill afford, even if they contain the damage.
        
        Your mistake for being so trusting.
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |“我不想让他们靠近我们半步，”你对[var2]说道，“不惜一切代价把他们挡在后面。”

        对方利落地向你敬礼，[var1]随即开始转向后方战线。 
        
        你相信他们能处理好这件事，于是将注意力重新放回眼前的战斗。
        
        直到后来，你才收到他们炮击来袭军团的报告。对方原来是一支遭到腐化的弥诺斯士兵连队，个个都是被欲火逼疯、怒气冲天的狂战士。你的疑虑无疑挽救了无数生命；敌人的背袭部队甚至没能接近阵线。
        |“正面迎战他们，”你对[var2]说道，“一旦开战，我相信你能守住我们的后方。”

        对方利落地向你敬礼，[var1]随即开始转向后方战线。 
        
        你相信他们能处理好这件事，于是将注意力重新放回眼前的战斗。
        
        直到后来，你才收到报告：后方又形成了第二条战线，势均力敌的两军以盾牌和刀剑猛烈碰撞。看来那支逼近的“第一军团”终究还是遭到了腐化，被邪教变成一群口吐白沫、欲火攻心的狂战士。卡莉丝听到消息后啐了一口，不过你方部队似乎掌控着局面，尽管推进缓慢。这将是一场漫长而残酷的消耗战。 
        
        你的部队实际上已经无力参加主战场的战斗，但至少目前，他们仍守住了防线。
        |“布置警戒线，”你对[var2]说道，“让这些人保持距离。”

        对方利落地向你敬礼，[var1]随即向后方散开。 
        
        你相信他们能处理好这件事，于是将注意力重新放回眼前的战斗。
        
        直到后方传来尖叫声，你才再次想起这件事。你转头望去，只见己方部队正全面溃逃，穿过辎重队向后奔逃，而一群口吐白沫的腐化弥诺陶洛斯正在身后穷追不舍。有些士兵被撞倒，跌进雪地；另一些则直接被抓住拖走。
        
        “操！”卡莉丝怒吼着抓起战斧，“我来处理。”
        
        至少你的散兵为卡莉丝和几名指挥官争取到了亲自应战的时间；可即便他们能控制住损失，这仍是你难以承受的挫败。
        
        这就是你过于轻信对方的代价。
    ]

        |"I don't want them anywhere near us," you tell [var2]. "Keep them back at all costs."

        You're given a crisp salute, and the [var1] start to wheel around to face the rear lines. 
        
        You trust them to handle this, and return your attention to the battle at hand.
        
        It's only later that you're given a report of their bombardment of the oncoming legion. They prove to have been a corrupted company of minoan soldiers, seething berserkers driven mad with lust. Your suspicion doubtless saved countless lives; the enemy never even got close with their rear-attack force.
        |"Meet them man to man," you tell [var2]. "I trust you to keep our rear secured if it comes to it."

        You're given a crisp salute, and the [var1] starts to wheel around to face the rear lines. 
        
        You trust them to handle this, and return your attention to the battle at hand.
        
        It's only later that you're given a report of a second battle line forming in your rear: a heavy clash of shield and blade against equally-matched forces. It seems the "First Legion" approaching was corrupted after all, reduced to frothing lust-mad berserkers by the cult. Calise spits at the news, but it seems your troops have things in hand, if slowly. It will be a grinding battle. 
        
        Your troops are out of the fight for all intents and purposes, but the line holds, for now.
        |"Form a picket," you tell [var2]. "Keep these men at a distance."

        You're given a crisp salute, and the [var1] starts ranging back towards the rear. 
        
        You trust them to handle this, and return your attention to the battle at hand.
        
        It's only when you hear screaming from the rear lines that you give it a second thought. You look over your shoulder to see your troops in full retreat, breaking and running back through your trains with frothing corrupted minotaurs at their back. Troops are barreled over and driven into the snow; others simply grabbed and dragged away.
        
        "Shit!" Calise snarls, grabbing up her axe. "I'll handle it."
        
        At least your skirmishers bought enough time for Calise and some of the commanders to respond in person, but this is a setback you can ill afford, even if they contain the damage.
        
        Your mistake for being so trusting.
    ]
    '

rows.original:
"Let them come, we need all the help we can get!"
    
    The soldier who brought the news thumps a fist to his breastplate. "Ay-ah, Champion!"
    
    You turn your back to the problem and focus on the battle at hand.
    
    ... Until the screaming starts. 
    
    You whirl around to see your supply train and medical corps scattering. A wedge of bull-men in tattered bronze armor are tearing through your backline, roaring like beasts... and rutting like them as they overpower your helpless noncombatants. 
    
    "Shit!" Calise says, strapping her helmet on. "Men, to me! Quickly now!" 
    
    The paladin doesn't wait for anyone to respond, but hurls herself headlong into the fray.
    
    Even with you rushing to the defense yourself, you're still forced to watch the [var0] be overrun from the rear, helplessly smushed between demons from either end. By the time you've laid low the last of the corrupted legionaries, your host has been reduced so badly you wonder if you can still call it an army...
rows.translation:
“让他们来吧，我们需要一切可能的帮助！”
    
    带来这个消息的士兵将拳头敲在胸甲上，大声说道：“遵命，冠军！”
    
    你选择无视这个问题，专心投入到眼前的战斗中。
    
    ……直到尖叫声响起。 
    
    你猛地转过身，发现你的补给车队和医疗队正在四散奔逃。一群身穿破旧青铜铠甲的牛头人正冲破你的后方防线，他们像野兽一样咆哮着，同时也像野兽一样肆无忌惮地侵犯那些毫无防御能力的非战斗人员…… 
    
    “该死！”卡莉丝一边说着，一边戴上头盔。“伙计们，跟我来！快点！” 
    
    这位圣骑士没有等待任何人的回应，就冲进了战斗之中。
    
    即使你自己也冲上去参与战斗，你仍然不得不眼睁睁地看着[var0]被敌人从后方包抄，只能无助地被夹在两侧的恶魔之间。当你终于消灭了最后一名被腐化的军团士兵时，你的部队已经元气大伤，你甚至开始怀疑：这还能算得上一支军队吗……

rows.original: The bulk of the demon host begins to split, warriors and witches stepping aside to give way to something dangerous enough to cow even the infinite egos of the corrupted. You raise a hand, stopping the advance of your troops, restraining them so you can be ready to counter whatever is about to show itself. Even from here you can feel the earth begin to tremble. "Centaurs," Calise says. "Tollus must have herded them up here from the valley. All the leftovers from his little ploy." "Not just centaurs," you say. You point to the vanguard as it appears, stomping heavily across the snowfield from the fortress gates. Each of them is a towering, muscle-bound behemoth strapped down with fifty pounds of bronze armor, hauling massive lances behind them like so many oak trunks. [flags.CQ_CLEAR |A small army of behemoths, all just as mutated and devolved as him. Gods! |They barely look human on their upper halves now, too, their flesh covered in shaggy fur and faces twisted into bestial snouts. Gods, what happened to them? ] Calise grimaces. "They'll cause a lot of chaos if we let them get close." [pc.bg soldier |Lucky you, all that armor seems to be slowing them down quite a lot. ] Choose a unit to counter the behemoths.
rows.translation: 恶魔大军的主体开始分开，战士们和女巫们纷纷退到一旁，为某种足以让那些腐化者无穷的自负也感到畏惧的东西让路。你举起一只手，让部队停止前进，约束住他们，好让你随时准备好应对即将现身的任何东西。 即使从这里，你也能感觉到大地开始颤抖。 “半人马，”卡莉丝说道。“托勒斯肯定把它们从山谷里赶到了这里。这些都是他那小把戏剩下的残渣。” “不只是半人马，”你说道。你指向正从堡垒大门外轰然踏过雪原现身的先锋。他们每一个都是高耸、肌肉虬结的贝希摩斯，身上绑着五十磅重的青铜护甲，身后拖着巨大的长枪，像一根根橡木树干。 [flags.CQ_CLEAR |一支由贝希摩斯组成的小军队，全都和他一样发生了变异、发生了退化。天啊！ |他们的上半身如今也几乎看不出人类的样子了，皮肉上覆着蓬乱的毛皮，脸扭曲成了野兽般的口鼻。天啊，他们到底出了什么事？ ] 卡莉丝做了个鬼脸。“要是让他们靠近，会引发很多混乱的。” [pc.bg soldier |算你走运，那些护甲似乎大大拖慢了他们的速度。 ] 选择一支部队来对抗贝希摩斯。

rows.original:
[var0
        |"Better make sure they don't get their momentum up then," you say, nodding towards [var2]. "Rain hell on them."

        Flags raise, and soldiers begin hurrying to positions just behind your army's front line. Your troops ready their weapons and dig their feet in, readying themselves for one overpowering volley.
        
        "Wait until they're starting to move," [var2] commands, holding up a fist to restrain the troops. "Let all that weight work against them."
        
        The ground shudders as the behemoths begin their march, slowly but surely picking up pace. Even with the overpowering weight of their wargear, the sheer inhuman muscle on these creatures proves stronger, and they begin barreling across the battlefield. A few imps unlucky enough to get in their way are trampled down or sent cartwheeling off the cliffside.
        
        "Now!" [var2] shouts. "Let loose!"
        
        Just as the centaurs are reaching their peak speed, a wall of fire slams into them like the fist of an angry god. The sudden impacts do more to startle the beast-men than hurt them, but that's all you need in this situation: the behemoths scream and rear back, arms flailing; weapons are dropped, and the second ranks come crashing into the asses of the first. 
        
        "Again!" you command. "Drive them back!"
        
        Another fusillade, and the centaurs are reduced to tripping over themselves in a panic. Their tiny, corrupted brains are filled with fear — and their demon masters are a far closer, easier target to vent their frustrations on than your men. Those who haven't fallen over in their fright twist around and flee, trampling down demons in their way.
        
        "Good thinking," Calise says.
        |"Let them break against our shields," you say, giving the nod to [var2]. "Don't give them an inch."

        [var2] nods and rallies the troops, leading them into the breach. They raise their shields and brace their weapons, turtling forward under a hail of demonic spells and poisoned arrows — nothing that can breach their defenses. But it's not the demons they need to worry about: their slow, defensive pace is giving the behemoths plenty of time to build up momentum, and when they hit your lines, it's with a deafening thunder of hooves and metal crashing together. 
        
        An unstoppable force meets an immovable object, and the results are [silly
            |explosive
            |as destructive as anything
        ]. The two forces collide, and centaurs start tumbling to the ground... and crushing men underneath them as they go. The sheer power of their assault crushes several of the defending soldiers before they can be brought to a halt; both formations break in equal measure. 
        
        "Shit," Calise grunts. "Fuck!"
        
        "At least they stopped," you sigh.
        |"We'll meet speed for speed," you say. "[var1]! Counter-charge!"

        Exuberant roars and war-cries rise for the chosen soldiers, and [var2] marshals them into a coherent formation and gets them rushing towards the behemoth pack. The two forces hurl themselves at each other across the field. 
        
        Massive, armored bodies bear down on your troops. Your hope was that speed and agility would counter the cumbersome strength the behemoths and bringing to bear, but the initial clash proves you so, so wrong. The sheer power of the centaurs' charge thunders straight through your light skirmishers, throwing them aside like so much chaff. The [var1] are crushed under hoof, flattened in the snow in the blink of an eye. 
        
        Calise grimaces. "Shit. Fuck!" She gives a sharp whistle, signaling to your troops to close ranks and raise spears. At least the [var1] bought you a few seconds to harden your defenses before the marauders close the distance.
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |最好确保他们当时不要建立起太强的攻势，”你边说边朝那个方向点了点头。 [var2]让他们陷入暴雨般的攻击中。”

        旗帜升起，士兵们开始匆忙地赶到你们军队前线的后方位置。你们的部队准备好武器，坚定地站立在那里，准备发动一次压倒性的齐射。
        
        “等他们开始移动的时候再行动。 [var2]指挥官举起拳头，命令部队停止前进：“让所有这些重量都成为对付他们的武器。”
        
        随着这些巨兽开始行进，地面开始震动，它们的速度虽然缓慢，但却逐渐加快。尽管它们身上装备着沉重的武器，但这些生物拥有的非人类般的力量依然强大无比，它们开始在战场上横冲直撞。那些不幸挡在它们道路上的小生物，要么被踩在脚下，要么被撞得滚下悬崖。
        
        “现在！ [var2]人们大声呼喊：“放开他们！”
        
        就在半人马们即将达到最高速度的时候，一堵火墙如同愤怒之神的拳头般猛烈地击中了他们。这种突如其来的冲击虽然并没有给这些野兽人造成实质性的伤害，但在这种情况下，这就已经足够了——这些庞然大物们发出惊叫声，猛地后退，双臂胡乱挥舞，手中的武器也被抛掉了，后面的队伍因此而撞上了前面的人。 
        
        再进攻！”你命令道，“把他们赶回去！”
        
        又一阵枪林弹雨之下，那些半人马们陷入了恐慌，纷纷跌跌撞撞地后退。他们那被腐蚀的脆弱大脑里充满了恐惧——而对于他们这些恶魔主人来说，你们的士兵们显然是一个更容易攻击、也更容易发泄他们怒火的目标。那些被吓得跌倒的人会立刻转身逃跑，途中还会踩死挡在路上的恶魔。
        
        “想得不错，”卡莉丝说道。
        |让他们来撞击我们的盾牌吧，”你说道，同时点了点头表示同意。 [var2]千万不要给他们任何可乘之机。

        [var2]他点了点头，然后召集部队，带领他们冲向敌军防线。士兵们举起盾牌，握紧武器，在恶魔的法术和毒箭的攻击下缓慢前进——但这些都无法突破他们的防御。然而，他们真正需要担心的并不是那些恶魔：敌人缓慢的防御步伐反而给了那些巨兽足够的时间来积蓄力量，而当它们冲向你们的防线时，将会伴随着震耳欲聋的蹄声和金属碰撞的声响。 
        
        一股不可阻挡的力量遇到了一个坚不可摧的物体，结果便是[silly
            |具有爆炸性的
            |破坏力极强
        ]这两种力量发生了碰撞，半人马们开始倒地翻滚……在坠落的过程中，他们将下面的士兵们压在身下。他们这种猛烈的攻击力让几名防守士兵在还来不及反应之前就被压死了；双方的阵型都因此陷入了混乱。
        
        “该死，”卡莉丝低声咒骂道，“真他妈见鬼！”
        
        “至少他们停止了攻击，”你叹了口气说道。
        |我们会以牙还牙的，”你说。[var1]反击！”

        为那些被选中的战士们，人们发出了热烈的欢呼声与战吼声[var2]他将这些部队整编成有序的战斗队形，然后指挥他们向那些庞大的敌群冲去。两支军队在战场上展开了激烈的交锋。
        
        那些庞大而披甲的敌军正朝你的部队压来。你原本以为，速度和灵活性足以抵消那些庞然大物所拥有的强大力量，但最初的交战证明，你的想法完全是错误的。半人马们那猛烈的冲锋所带来的冲击力，直接冲破了你的轻装步兵的防线，将他们像糠秕一样抛到了一边。 [var1]在瞬间，它们就被马蹄踩得粉碎，被积雪压得扁平不堪。
        
        卡莉丝皱起了眉头，咒骂道：“该死……真他妈见鬼！”她突然吹了一声尖锐的口哨，示意你的部队收紧阵型、举起长矛。至少这样还能[var1]这为你争取了几秒钟的时间，让你有时间加强防御，以免那些掠夺者迅速逼近。
    ]

rows.original: You watch as a volley of arrows soar into the air from the demons' lines, blazing with a green flame that makes your eyes hurt to look upon. "Cover!" you shout, trying to reach your vanguards' ears, but it turns out to be unnecessary — the arrows fall short of your lines by twenty paces, feathering the snowy road with a hundred burning missiles. ... Which then erupt into an eldritch conflagration, a wall of viridian flame that burns so hot it's nearly blinding. Your soldiers' advance is disrupted in the blink of a watering eye, sending troops reeling back from the blaze. "There goes our momentum," Calise says. "Damned witchfire!" You've got to do something before your army's boxed in by another volley. Choose a unit to deploy.
rows.translation: 你看到一阵箭矢从恶魔的阵线中射向空中，那些箭矢燃烧着绿色的火焰，光芒刺得你睁不开眼睛。“快躲开！”你大声喊叫，试图让前线的战士们听到，但事实证明这是多余的——那些箭矢在距离你们的阵地还有二十步的地方就落下了，一百支燃烧的箭矢散落在雪地上。 ……这些火焰随即化作一场可怕的烈火，一道翠绿色的火墙燃烧得如此炽热，几乎让人睁不开眼睛。在转瞬之间，你的士兵们的进攻就被彻底阻断了，那些士兵们都被这熊熊烈火逼得连连后退。 我们的攻势就这样被破坏了，”卡莉丝说道，“该死的巫火！” 你必须尽快采取行动，否则你的军队很快就会再次陷入包围之中。 选择一个单位进行部署。

rows.original:
[var0
        |You give the nod towards [var2]. "Flank around and hit those archers while there's still time."

        You're given a sharp salute, and the [var1] get underway with a series of shouts and beating drums. They march for the cliffside, hugging the stone — climbing it, in some cases — to get around the spreading blaze. While they're getting into position, you're organizing teams from the command cadre to start moving snow, or start casting spells to counteract the green flame, anything to punch a hole so that your soldiers can keep advancing. 
        
        The effort's thankfully unnecessary. You can't see the action past the flame, but the effect of your [var1] shock assault around the flank is felt a few minutes later: suddenly the flames gutter out, sputtering to fumes. There's a roar of cheering soldiers, and then the thunder of feet on stone as they charge through the faltered barrier. The [var1] stand triumphant over the blightflame archers, stealing as many enchanted weapons as they can before the bulk of the demonic army can wheel around and chase them back to your lines.
        |You'll fight fire with fire, then. "[var2]! Take out those archers!"

        [silly
            |"Counter-battery fire!" [var2] commands.
            |"We'll wipe them from the mountainside," [var2] swears, starting to direct the [var1] into position.
        ]
        
        "Take cover, [pc.name]," Calise says, stepping behind one of her Chargers' tower shield. 
        
        You've got just enough time to follow suit before arrows start raining down on your lines in answer to the long-range counterattack. At least it's not a concentrated volley to block your lines again this time, but now your troops are being peppered with flaming arrows; the acrid smell of blightflame billows across the battlefield. The [var1] gets the worst of it, hammered by volley after volley of corrupted arrows, but they give as good as they get, until both sides have been reduced to just a handful of desperate shooters flinging missiles across the battlefield.
        
        At least the flames have had a chance to die down, and your troops have a chance to surge forward again.
        |The only thing that can stand up to that kind of attack is a shield wall. You give a sharp whistle to [var2] and point to the demon archers. "Forward! Turtle up!"

        The soldiers howl their enthusiasm and lock their shields together, starting to march forward into the breach. The sky darkens above them with the sheer volume of arrows being loosed at them, embedding in the wooden faces of their shields... and spreading fire. It's not the arrows themselves that break your troops' assault but the flames spreading across their equipment, engulfing them in corrupted witchfire. The screams...
        
        "Shit," Calise grimaces. "Shit! Someone push through while the archers are distracted! We can't afford to lose the momentum now!" 
        
        She's right, this is your only chance, while the fire wall is guttering. You give the signal to advance.
    ]

[var0
        |你朝那个方向点了点头。 [var2]从侧面包抄他们，在他们还有时间的时候击溃那些弓箭手。”

        你收到了一个响亮的敬礼，然后[var1]一系列的呼喊和鼓声标志着行动的开始。他们沿着悬崖边缘前进，有的紧贴着岩石攀爬，以便绕过不断蔓延的火焰。当他们就位后，你立即从指挥人员中挑选出小队，让他们开始搬运积雪，或者施展法术来对抗那些绿色的火焰——无论采取什么方法，目的都是要为士兵们开辟一条前进的道路。
        
        幸运的是，这些努力最终证明是多余的。虽然被火焰遮挡，你无法看到火势后面的情况，但你的部队所采取的措施已经产生了效果[var1]几分钟后，侧翼突然遭到了猛烈的攻击：火焰骤然熄灭，只剩下阵阵烟雾。士兵们的欢呼声此起彼伏，紧接着，他们的脚步声如同雷鸣般在石板上响起，他们冲破了那摇摇欲坠的防线。 [var1]在那些燃烧着火焰的弓箭手的攻击下，你们依然取得了胜利，在恶魔大军主力开始反击并将你们逼回防线之前，尽可能多地抢走了那些被施了魔法的武器。
        |那么，你就得以火攻火了。[var2]把那些弓箭手都解决掉！

        [silly
            |反炮火攻击！ [var2]命令。
            |我们会把他们从山坡上彻底清除干净。 [var2]开始发号施令了。 [var1]到位。
        ]
        
        找掩护， [pc.name]，卡尔丽丝一边说着，一边站在她麾下冲锋者的塔盾后面。”
        
        你还有足够的时间效仿他们的行动，因为在远程反击之后，箭雨将会开始倾泻在你的部队身上。至少这次不会是一次集中式的攻击来彻底摧毁你的防线，但此刻你的士兵们正在遭受燃烧箭的攻击；灼热的火焰气息在战场上弥漫开来。 [var1]他们遭到了最猛烈的攻击，一连串腐烂的箭矢不断袭来，但他们也予以了坚决的反击，直到双方都只剩下少数几名孤注一掷的射手，在战场上投掷着导弹。
        
        至少，火焰已经有所减弱，你们的部队也有机会再次发起进攻了。
        |唯一能够抵御那种攻击的手段就是盾墙。你只需吹响一声尖锐的口哨即可。 [var2]他们指向那些恶魔弓箭手，高喊道：“前进！摆出防御姿态！”

        士兵们满怀斗志，将盾牌紧密地连接在一起，开始向缺口处前进。上方的天空被射向他们的箭矢所笼罩，那些箭矢纷纷刺入他们盾牌的木制面层。还有那蔓延的火焰……真正摧毁你们部队的并不是那些箭矢，而是火焰侵蚀他们的装备，将他们笼罩在那腐蚀性的巫火之中。那些惨叫声……”

rows.original: One of the auxilia-mages from Calise's company groans, clutching at her head. "Cold... so cold..." Calise sneers, "Get a coat on, woman! We're in the mountains and this is war!" The Champion's words don't seem to register. The sorceress drops to her knees with a pained howl, and weakly points towards the sky. You slowly crane your head upwards, squinting at the sun... and something glittering in the light high above the battlefield. "Is that... ice?" Calise follows your gaze. "... Yes, yes it is." "Demons... summoning... from the Chaos! Stop it!" [pc.isMage |You and e |E ]very mage nearby begin to feel the same thing: a deathly cold that pierces straight to the head. Something's drawing all this power into the world, and it is disrupting the very flow of aether all around you. "What is this witchcraft?" Calise says, clenching her fists. "Somebody's burying daggers of ice behind my eyes!" You've got to send someone to find the source, and put an end to it.

rows.original: [var0 |You hurry to grab the leader of the [var1]. "There's a mage out there responsible for this," you say, gesturing to the growing frost hanging over the battlefield. "Find them and stop it. Hurry!" The soldiers salute, and [var2] marshals them to move. Their strike across the field is quick and fast, rushing across the flanks while the rest of your forces push the front lines to cover their maneuver. You direct the action there, trusting the [var1] to execute your will from the edge of the field while you continue the fight across the front lines. A few minutes later, you hear a terrible shattering noise from all around you — and then a banshee-howl from behind the demon's lines. You glance up, shielding your eyes as tiny flakes of ice begin to fall across your forces. "Guess they got the witch," Calise says. She takes a deep breath, wiping sweat from her brow. "Thank the gods. My head is killing me." The paladin puts a hand on the sorceress's shoulder and helps her to her feet. "I'm sorry. Come on, we have a war to win!" |You quickly seek out [var2]. "I need you to bring that down!" you shout, pointing skyward. "Quick!" [var2] doesn't even respond, instead immediately moving to direct the [var1] into action. You watch with bated breath as the soldiers ready themselves and their armaments, sizing up the distance to the target. Only these troops have any chance of striking at such a monumental distance, and with enough force to shatter the sphere of frost before it... does whatever it's going to do. You watch as missiles begin to fly, and fire splashes across the frost. Steam rises from the ice ball, and cracks begin to form. "Hells," Calise hisses. "Cover!" The soldiers around you lock shields overhead a second before a horrid CRACK echoes across the mountainside. The frost ball collapses under the weight of the [var1]'s attack, but rather than dissipating like a fizzling spell, it shatters into a thousand shards of razor-sharp ice that come hurtling down — and mostly over the [var1]! You watch helplessly as the troops are riddled with fragments[silly | like frozen buckshot ]. "That was a costly trade," Calise sighs. "Medics!" You grimace and turn back to the fight. |"We've got to do something about whoever's casting that spell," you say. "[var2]! I need you to find them." "Are you sure?" [var2] says, glancing at the heavily-armored brawlers in the [var1]. "...Aye." The soldiers begin to march, slow and steady under the weight of their wargear. You watch them advance to the vanguard, but the enemy force surges in response, bogging them down in close combat before they can even hope to locate the witch responsible. The same witch that drops that whole ball of frost on their heads. It falls like a shooting star, hurtling into the middle of your vanguard in the blink of an eye with a deafening crash. Shards of razor-sharp ice are flung everywhere, as are the members of the [var1], blasted away by the impact. You slam a fist against a nearby soldier's shield. "No!" You can only imagine the frost mage cackling in the background... ]

rows.original:
"I've got this," you say, lifting a hand towards the sky. You incant a spell of absolute abjuration, pushing your will up and towards the heavens, towards the burning sun high above. You feel out the threads of magic, and peel them apart one by one, letting the frost slowly liquify.

    It's a matter of moments for you, but a spell of that magnitude would take hours to prepare again. You should be safe now. 
    
    "Well done," Calise says. [pc.isAstrida
        |"So this is the power of the Order Astrida..."
        |"You've become quite the powerful mage, [pc.name]. Quite powerful indeed..."
    ]
rows.translation:
“这个交给我，”你说道，把手举向天空。你念出一道绝对驱邪的法术，将自己的意志向上推去，推向天穹，推向高悬头顶的炽热太阳。你摸索出魔法的丝线，把它们一根根剥开，让冰霜缓缓融解。

    对你来说这只是片刻之间的事，但如此规模的法术若要再次准备，得花上好几个小时。现在你应该安全了。
    
    “干得不错，”卡莉丝说道。 [pc.isAstrida
        |“原来这就是阿斯特里达教团的力量……”
        |“你已经成了一位相当强大的法师，[pc.name]。确实相当强大……”
    ]

rows.original: "Champions!" Isadora yelps, jogging back to your position. "Trouble!" "Deep breaths," Calise says, clasping the younger woman's shoulders. "What's going on?" "Enemies on the cliffs," Isadora says, panting hard. You glance from her to the eastern rock face overlooking your position. Even from the command cadre's position you can make out figures clambering around the rocky ledges, hurling bolts of corrupted magic at your men. Imps buzz around them, bringing potions and scrolls to their masters while the demons concentrate on their spellcraft. Arcs of green fire and blasts of black ice streak across your front lines, pushing your men back with near-impunity. "That's going to be a tough nut to crack," Calise says. "They've got the high ground and plenty of power to hold it." Choose a unit to root out these demon mages.

"They've got the high ground and plenty of power to hold it." Choose a unit to root out these demon mages. '

rows.original: [var0 |"Then we'll get higher ground," you say, giving the nod to the [var1]. "Get climbing. We'll distract them." Calise sighs and hefts her axe. "Leave it to me, [calise.fucked|love|[pc.name]]." Your troops deploy, with Calise leading an anvil of men with shields to draw the ire of the demon mages from the foot of the cliffs. Witchfire splashes across their shields, followed by rocks and ceramic slingstones pelted by the imp lackeys, all a desperate attempt to keep Calise's men from reaching the bottom of the cliff at all. They're so terrified of someone making a direct climb in their faces, they don't look up themselves until the first shots start skewering imps. Your light, quick skirmishers were easily able to scale up the mountainside and get into a higher position, and now just as the demons did to your men, so too do they now strike from above. You watch as the demons are hunted down and eliminated by the [var1], before turning your attentions back to the front lines. Nice and clean. |"We'll blast them off the face of the mountain!" you declare, turning to [var2]. "Get out there and bring the rocks down on them!" [var2] nods and starts to marshal the [var1], marching them towards the cliffs. Your soldiers' attacks have range, too, and plenty of power... but it's an even match with them demons on the high ground, or near enough that the difference is too small to tell. The demons and the [var1] blast at each other with wild abandon, loosing attacks as quickly as they can as the overwhelming power of their heavy arsenal is brought fully to bear against their foe. The mountainside trembles with the force of the attacks being hammered into it, and rocks shatter and tumble from the cliffs. In a matter of minutes, you're watching a rockslide sweep away the demon mages and their impish lackeys... but the [var1] have been battered and bloodied, and the rocks falling threaten to crush those left standing. The remnants limp back victorious, but rendered a pale shadow of their former strength. |"I need someone who can get close," you say. "[var2], you're up." The [var1] moves out in short order, marching for the cliffs with shields raised high. As soon as the demons see the threat approaching, they shift their attention, raining witchfire upon your soldiers in near-solid waves of eldritch light. The [var1] buckles under the sheer weight of long-range attack, struggling to push forward — and the moment their momentum flags, the demons intensify their attacks, hammering the [var1] into the ground with spells, and imp-thrown stones. Their hopes of actually gaining the mountain are next to nil, you can see that now. At least they serve as a distraction for the rest of your forces; a sacrifice you'll have to take full advantage of if you want to win this thing. ]
rows.translation: [var0 |“那我们就抢占更高的地势。”你说着，朝[var1]点了点头，“爬上去。我们负责牵制他们。” 卡莉丝叹了口气，提起战斧。“交给我吧，[calise.fucked|亲爱的|[pc.name]]。” 你的部队开始部署：卡莉丝率领一支以盾牌武装的坚实队伍，在悬崖脚下吸引恶魔法师的怒火。巫火泼洒在他们的盾牌上，紧接着，小恶魔爪牙又投下岩石和陶制弹丸，拼命阻止卡莉丝的部下接近崖底。它们太害怕有人当面攀上悬崖，以至于始终不曾抬头，直到第一轮箭矢将小恶魔接连洞穿。 你那些轻装敏捷的散兵轻而易举地爬上山坡，占据了更高的位置。如今，正如恶魔先前从高处袭击你的士兵一样，他们也自上而下发动攻势。你看着[var1]逐一猎杀、清除恶魔，随后将注意力重新转向前线。 干净利落。 |“我们要把它们轰下山崖！”你宣告道，转向[var2]，“带人出击，把岩石全轰到它们头上！” [var2]点了点头，开始集结[var1]，率领他们向悬崖进军。你的士兵同样拥有射程和充足的火力……可恶魔占据着制高点，双方仍势均力敌，或者至少差距小到难以分辨。恶魔与[var1]不顾一切地互相轰击，以最快速度释放攻击，将重型武器的惊人威力尽数倾泻到敌人身上。山坡在接连砸落的攻势下震颤不止，岩石从悬崖上崩碎滚落。 短短几分钟后，一场岩崩便将恶魔法师和它们的小恶魔爪牙尽数卷走……但[var1]也被打得遍体鳞伤，而不断落下的岩石更威胁着仍站立的幸存者。 残兵们拖着伤躯凯旋而归，却已只剩昔日战力的一抹残影。 |“我需要能接近它们的人，”你说道，“[var2]，该你上了。” [var1]很快便开始行动，高举盾牌向悬崖进军。恶魔一发现逼近的威胁，便立刻转移注意力，用近乎连绵不绝的邪异光浪向你的士兵倾泻巫火。[var1]在远程攻势的恐怖重压下阵脚不稳，仍挣扎着向前推进——可他们的冲势刚一衰退，恶魔便加紧攻击，以法术和小恶魔投掷的石块把[var1]狠狠砸向地面。你现在已经看得清清楚楚：他们几乎不可能真正攻上山头。 至少他们为你的其余部队充当了诱饵；若想赢得这一仗，你就必须充分利用这份牺牲。 ]

rows.original: There's a sudden chorus of panicked screaming from just behind your vanguard. Soldiers fall over, scrambling to get away from... the snow? The blanket of ice your men had been walking over is erupting, disgorging a swarm of horrid little imps that had been waiting in ambush — or held in stasis by their demon masters, more likely — until just the right moment[silly | like a buncha living land mines ]! A swarm of cackling sex-fiends swarm throughout your second line, shoving their dicks in your medics' faces and setting fire to your supplies. The speed and shock of the attack is overwhelming, even from such pathetic creatures. "Hells," Calise snarls. "Who thought this up?" You don't wait to find out — you've got to stop this chaos before it disrupts your entire front. Choose a unit to deploy.
rows.translation: 就在你的先锋部队后方，突然爆发出一阵惊慌失措的尖叫声。士兵们纷纷倒下，拼命想要逃离……雪地？你的士兵们刚才一直踩在其上的那层冰正在迸裂，从中涌出一群可怕的小恶魔——它们要么一直潜伏着准备伏击，要么更有可能是被它们的恶魔主人封在静止状态中——直到那个刚刚好的时机[silly | 就像一堆活的地雷 ]！一群咯咯怪笑的淫魔蜂拥穿过你的第二道防线，把他们的鸡巴怼到你的医护兵脸上，还放火烧起了你的补给。这次攻击的速度和冲击力让人难以招架，哪怕对手只是这么可悲的生物。 “见鬼，”卡莉丝低吼道，“这是谁想出来的？” 你没有停下来等答案——你必须在它扰乱你整条战线之前阻止这场混乱。 选择要部署的部队。

rows.original:
[var0
        |"Shields up! Smash them!" you bark, signaling to the [var1]. They wheel from their position on the field and begin marching into the thick of the fray as a solid wall of shields. 

        The imps swarm around the [var1], pelting the troops with slingstones and daggers and lewder paraphernalia, but their defenses are unbreakable. [var2] barks an order, and the troops surge forward, hacking and slashing at the cloud for a brief, bloody moment before regaining their defensive posture. And then they repeat the action, again and again, until the surviving imps go screaming back towards the fortress. 
        
        "They never stood a chance!" Calise declares. 
        
        It's true. The imps' attacks had no chance of penetrating the [var1] defenses at all. 
        
        Crisis averted.
        |"We've got to get on top of this fast," you say. "[var2], get on top of it!" 

        You're given a salute, and the fleet-footed [var1] starts moving to intercept the impish horde. The demons may have surprise on their side, but your own troops move fast and hit hard once unleashed, charging down their much-smaller opponents with gusto. 
        
        The lightning counterattack is effective, but the imps have your troops outnumbered three to one, and they make your men pay for every inch they take back. Soldiers are overwhelmed by imps, dragged to the ground and violated; others are pelted with rocks and vials of alchemical pheromones; either way the result is troops taken out of the fight almost as quickly as the imps are.
        
        When the horde finally breaks and retreats, the [var1] is left mangled and limping back, down and out for now. But you've put an end to the crisis for now.
        |"Knock them out of the sky!" you command, giving the nod towards the [var1].

        Your ranged troops move up and take position, starting to rain fire down on the swarm of imps in the middle of your army — which, itself, proves to be their undoing. The imps are so tightly wound through your lines that the [var1] must restrain their attacks, picking them carefully to avoid friendly fire. This gives the screeching horde of imps more than ample time to regroup and change targets, whirling in a cloud of dicks and drooling pussies towards the [var1]. 
        
        The imp cloud slams into your heavy hitters like a bag of bricks, the first wave knocking soldiers over so the rest can swarm and violate them. 
        
        At least the [var1] prove enough of a distraction to let your other troops rally and close ranks, but by the time they've recovered, your counterattacking men have mostly been carried off by the imps, condemned to the demon pits — at least until you win this battle, you tell yourself.
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |“举盾！碾碎它们！”你厉声命令，向[var1]发出信号。他们从战场上的位置转向，组成一堵坚实的盾墙，向混战最激烈之处推进。 

        小恶魔蜂拥在[var1]周围，用投石、匕首和更加淫秽的玩意袭击士兵，但他们的防御坚不可摧。[var2]厉声下令，部队猛然向前冲锋，在短暂而血腥的片刻间对那团恶魔大砍大杀，随后又恢复防御阵形。他们一遍又一遍地重复这一动作，直到幸存的小恶魔尖叫着逃回要塞。 
        
        “它们从一开始就毫无胜算！”卡莉丝宣告道。 
        
        的确如此。小恶魔的攻击根本不可能穿透[var1]的防御。 
        
        危机解除。
        |“我们必须尽快控制局面，”你说道，“[var2]，快去处理！” 

        对方朝你敬礼，行动迅捷的[var1]随即出动，拦截小恶魔大军。恶魔或许占据了突袭的先机，但你自己的部队行动如风，一旦放开手脚便攻势凶猛，兴奋地冲向体形远小于他们的对手。 
        
        这场闪电反击卓有成效，但小恶魔在人数上有三比一的优势，让你的士兵为夺回的每一寸土地付出代价。士兵被小恶魔淹没，拖倒在地肆意侵犯；另一些则遭到石块和炼金信息素药瓶的轰击。无论遭遇哪种攻击，你的士兵退出战斗的速度几乎和小恶魔倒下的速度一样快。
        
        当这群恶魔终于崩溃撤退时，[var1]已经伤痕累累，只能一瘸一拐地返回，眼下再也无力作战。不过，你至少暂时终结了这场危机。
        |“把它们从天上打下来！”你下令道，朝[var1]点头示意。

        远程部队向前移动、占据阵位，开始朝盘旋在大军中央的小恶魔群倾泻火力——然而它们所处的位置反而令这支部队陷入败局。小恶魔与己方战线纠缠得太紧，[var1]不得不克制攻势，谨慎挑选目标，以免误伤友军。这给了尖叫的小恶魔大军充分的时间重整阵势、改变目标；一团由阴茎和滴液阴户组成的乌云旋即掉头扑向[var1]。 
        
        小恶魔群像一袋砖头般砸进你的重型火力部队，第一波冲击便撞倒了士兵，好让其余恶魔蜂拥而上、肆意侵犯。 
        
        至少[var1]成功吸引了足够多的注意，使你的其他部队得以重整阵势、收拢战线；可等他们恢复过来时，负责反击的士兵大多已被小恶魔掳走，注定要落入恶魔孵化坑——至少在你赢得这场战斗以前如此，你这样安慰自己。
    ]

rows.original: "Enemy breakthrough, Champions!" one of your commanders barks, pointing to your army's flank. "The left side is on the verge of collapse." You can see it, too: soldiers breaking and falling back as a horde of demons — true demons, with flowing cloaks and wicked blades, exploit the sudden opening. Their great wings speed their assault, letting them overwhelm your faltering front line with a ferocious lightning attack. In moments, your forces' left flank will completely collapse. "We've got to plug that hole," Calise says. "Quickly." Which unit is up for the task?
rows.translation: “敌人突破了，冠军们！”你们的一位指挥官厉声喊道，指向你们军队的侧翼。“左侧防线即将崩溃。” 你也看到了：士兵们溃散后退，而一群恶魔——真正的恶魔，身披飘动的斗篷、手持凶恶的刀刃——正利用这个突如其来的缺口。它们巨大的羽翼让攻势更快，以凶猛的闪电般攻势压垮了你摇摇欲坠的前线。用不了多久，你军队的左翼就会彻底崩溃。 “我们得把那个缺口堵上，”卡莉丝说道。“快。” 哪支部队能担此重任？

rows.original:
[var0
        |You give a command, and warhorns blast as the [var1] begin wheeling towards the left flank. They were already close to the breach, and even with their heavy gear, they're able to sprint into position and start shield-slamming demons in the face. There's a brief, chaotic melee where winged harridans and shielded soldiers clash, but your men deftly seize the upper hand. The demons' weapons are too light to do much damage through all that armor, and their wings offer them no protection from throwing spears and darts hurled by strong arms. 

        Almost as soon as it started, the break in your lines is plugged up nicely by the [var1], and the demons are sent scrambling back towards their lines — or left face-down in the snow. 
        
        "Good call, [pc.name]!" Calise sighs. "Those troops will anchor our lines for the rest of the fight!"
        
        You can only hope so.
        |A brazen attack like this has to be met with decisive speed, and so you tap the [var1], relaying orders to their commander to throw themselves hard and fast into the breach. The soldiers respond at once, peeling off from their positions and rushing to the flanks, sped by swift feet and light gear. They're able to make it to the crisis point in a matter of moments, and then the skirmish begins.

        Demons dodge skyward and strike on their great batlike wings, but your troops are able to hound them down, or strike with ranged weapons to cut down their foes' advantage. Still, the attacks they take in turn are withering, blasts of corrupted fluids and envenomed blades combining to try and overwhelm them with indecent desire. 
        
        The men hold on long enough to blunt the demonic attack, at least. When the demons flee back to their lines, tails tucked, they leave behind only the battered remnants of your [var1] though — not enough still standing to be considered a fighting force. But the job is done.
        |"Our troops need support," you declare, gesturing towards [var2]. "Pound those demons out of the sky!"

        The [var1] moves quickly into position, setting up for their long-range attack... but the winged demons are damnably fast, and keen-eyed too, it seems. The moment your troops get a clear line of attack, their enemies are already lunging towards them. The contact is brief and overwhelming, a lightning-bolt strike that sends your [var1] running for the hills — when they aren't dragged to the ground or carried off into the sky. 
        
        You grimace, helpless but to watch your counterattack become victims to the demons.
        
        Calise gives you a withering look, and sighs. "We've got to do better."
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |你一声令下，战号响彻战场，[var1]开始转向左翼。他们本就离缺口不远，即使身披重型装备，也能疾奔到位，用盾牌猛击恶魔的面孔。长翼悍妇与持盾士兵陷入一场短暂而混乱的近战，但你的士兵很快便巧妙地占据上风。恶魔的武器太过轻巧，根本无法穿透重甲造成多少伤害；而强壮臂膀掷出的长矛和飞镖，也不会因它们的翅膀而失去威胁。 

        几乎就在战斗打响的同时，[var1]便妥善堵住了防线缺口，把恶魔逼得仓皇逃回本阵——或是面朝下倒在雪中。 
        
        “好判断，[pc.name]！”卡莉丝松了口气，“这些部队会在接下来的战斗中稳住我们的阵线！”
        
        但愿如此。
        |如此悍然的进攻必须以果断迅捷的行动应对，于是你点选[var1]，命令他们的指挥官率部迅猛地扑向缺口。士兵立刻响应，从原先的阵位脱离，以轻快的脚步和轻便的装备迅速赶往侧翼。他们转眼便抵达危急之处，小规模交战随即爆发。

        恶魔振动巨大的蝙蝠翅膀，躲向空中再俯冲攻击，但你的部队能够穷追不舍，或用远程武器削弱敌人的空中优势。然而，他们承受的反击同样猛烈：腐化体液与淬毒利刃相辅相成，企图以不堪的欲望压垮众人。 
        
        至少士兵坚持得足够久，挫钝了恶魔的攻势。当恶魔夹着尾巴逃回阵线时，留下的却只有你麾下[var1]伤痕累累的残兵——站着的人已经少到无法再被视作一支作战部队。但任务已经完成。
        |“我们的部队需要支援，”你宣告道，朝[var2]示意，“把那些恶魔从天上轰下来！”

        [var1]迅速抵达阵位，准备发动远程攻击……可长翼恶魔快得该死，而且看来眼力也极佳。你的部队才刚得到清晰的射界，敌人便已朝他们猛扑而来。接触战短暂却势不可挡，如闪电般的一击令你的[var1]仓皇逃向山间——没被拖倒在地或掳上天空的人才有机会逃走。 
        
        你无能为力，只能皱着脸看自己的反击部队沦为恶魔的牺牲品。
        
        卡莉丝以令人难堪的目光瞪了你一眼，叹道：“我们得做得更好。”
    ]
rows.raw:
'
    [var0
        |You give a command, and warhorns blast as the [var1] begin wheeling towards the left flank. They were already close to the breach, and even with their heavy gear, they're able to sprint into position and start shield-slamming demons in the face. There's a brief, chaotic melee where winged harridans and shielded soldiers clash, but your men deftly seize the upper hand. The demons' weapons are too light to do much damage through all that armor, and their wings offer them no protection from throwing spears and darts hurled by strong arms. 

        Almost as soon as it started, the break in your lines is plugged up nicely by the [var1], and the demons are sent scrambling back towards their lines — or left face-down in the snow. 
        
        "Good call, [pc.name]!" Calise sighs. "Those troops will anchor our lines for the rest of the fight!"
        
        You can only hope so.
        |A brazen attack like this has to be met with decisive speed, and so you tap the [var1], relaying orders to their commander to throw themselves hard and fast into the breach. The soldiers respond at once, peeling off from their positions and rushing to the flanks, sped by swift feet and light gear. They're able to make it to the crisis point in a matter of moments, and then the skirmish begins.

        Demons dodge skyward and strike on their great batlike wings, but your troops are able to hound them down, or strike with ranged weapons to cut down their foes' advantage. Still, the attacks they take in turn are withering, blasts of corrupted fluids and envenomed blades combining to try and overwhelm them with indecent desire. 
        
        The men hold on long enough to blunt the demonic attack, at least. When the demons flee back to their lines, tails tucked, they leave behind only the battered remnants of your [var1] though — not enough still standing to be considered a fighting force. But the job is done.
        |"Our troops need support," you declare, gesturing towards [var2]. "Pound those demons out of the sky!"

        The [var1] moves quickly into position, setting up for their long-range attack... but the winged demons are damnably fast, and keen-eyed too, it seems. The moment your troops get a clear line of attack, their enemies are already lunging towards them. The contact is brief and overwhelming, a lightning-bolt strike that sends your [var1] running for the hills — when they aren't dragged to the ground or carried off into the sky. 
        
        You grimace, helpless but to watch your counterattack become victims to the demons.
        
        Calise gives you a withering look, and sighs. "We've got to do better."
    ]
    '

rows.original: Watching the battle with you are the commanders from your subordinate units and a cadre of officers and runners, ready to direct the flow of battle at your order. But that also means your army's staff is all gathered in one place. Even safely nestled in the rear of your forces, that fact still means you're too tempting a target for the enemy to pass up. While you're in the middle of discussing the flow of battle with Calise, one of the towering bulls in the cadre suddenly grunts and stumbles; you don't register the ear-splitting ting! of something hard and heavy impacting his helm until he's already on the ground, out cold. You twist around, watching a group of demonic fighters slipping out from among the rocks behind your lines — they must have rappelled down, or flown. Either way, your command cadre is suddenly being pelted with arrows and slingstones, making you all dive for cover or bring up shields to protect yourselves. The demons have the initiative, and use it to the fullest pushing towards your position under a hail of missiles. "Cowards!" Calise snarls, slashing an arrow out of the sky a split second before it would have buried itself in Isadora's backside. You've got to do something before you're overrun. Choose a unit to step in and secure the rear.
rows.translation: 与你一同观看这场战斗的，还有你下属部队中的指挥官们以及一批军官和传令兵，他们随时准备根据你的指令来指挥战斗的进程。但这也意味着你的军队所有参谋人员都聚集在了一个地方。即使你安全地驻扎在部队的后方，这一事实依然意味着你是一个对敌人来说极具吸引力的目标，他们绝对不会放过这个机会。 当你们正在与卡莉丝讨论战斗的进展时，队伍中那些身材高大的战士突然发出低吼声，踉跄了一下；你并没有注意到那震耳欲聋的叮！有什么坚硬重型的东西撞击了他的头盔，使他当场倒地，失去了意识。你迅速转身，看到一群恶魔般的战士从你后方阵地的岩石后面悄悄出现——他们一定是通过绳索滑下来的，或者是飞过来的。无论如何，你们的指挥官突然遭到了箭矢和投石器的攻击，这使得你们所有人都不得不赶紧寻找掩护，或者举起盾牌来保护自己。 这些恶魔占据了主动权，他们充分利用这一优势，向你们的阵地发射了大量导弹。 胆小鬼！”卡莉丝怒吼着，在那支箭即将刺中伊莎多拉的背部之前，瞬间将其截落在半空中。 在敌人蜂拥而至之前，你们必须采取行动了。 选择一个单位前去支援，确保后方安全。

rows.original:
[var0
        |You grab a warhorn from the fallen centurion and blow hard, trumpeting towards where the [var1] have their backs to you, still watching the front. The soldiers glance over their shoulders, and then go wide-eyed until [var2] starts barking orders. They only stay surprised for a brace of heartbeats before they're turning and presenting their shields, starting to march hard towards the army's rear. 

        Your men aren't the fastest, but the thunder of their boots and the ringing of weapons on shields draws the attention of the demonic assassins away from you sure enough. There's no great clash here: the fiends are smart enough to know when they're beat and make a hasty retreat, able to take nothing with them — though not for lack of trying. The [var1] barrel into their rear guard, hacking down any demon not swift enough to escape. 
        
        You help the dazed centurion to his feet, calling for medics to come and help any of the other members of the cadre hurt in the attack. Thankfully, it's a short list.
        
        "Crisis averted," Calise sighs. "Thanks to your quick thinking."
        |You grab a warhorn from the fallen centurion and blow hard, trumpeting towards where the [var1] have their backs to you, still watching the front. The soldiers glance over their shoulders, gasp, and wheel around to start charging into their own army's rear lines. 

        They're fast, but the demons are too, and it comes to a clash of speed as to who gets to the command cadre first — and the fiends have the advantage. You and Calise are forced to draw your weapons, wading into the fray yourself for a few brief, bloody seconds before the demons are pushed back by the [var1] counterattack. The fight is brief and brutal: with neither side carrying more than light armor and a few small shields, arrows and blades find easy marks everywhere. 
        
        By the time the clash is over, the [var1] and the demons are both badly mangled; your troops limp back to your lines while the remaining demons take wing, fleeing for the hills below. 
        
        "Costly," Calise pants. "But we made it."
        
        You help the dazed centurion to his feet, calling for medics to come and help any of the other members of the cadre hurt in the attack. Thankfully, it's a short list.
        |You grab a warhorn from the fallen centurion and blow hard, trumpeting towards where the [var1] have their backs to you, still watching the front. The soldiers glance over their shoulders, gasp, and turn their weapons around to face down the oncoming demons. 

        The [var1] send volleys of shots into the demons, but the fiends are already on you. You and Calise are forced to draw your weapons, wading into the fray yourself — and with you suddenly in close contact with the enemy, your support troops can't risk taking shots that might skewer you just as easily as a demon. Your officers begin to fall, torn down by poisoned blades and arrows, or enthralled by corrupted spells into turning against you. It's a mad, chaotic brawl. 
        
        Even with your superlative fighting skills, there's only so much you can do — so many of your commanders you can protect — against such overwhelming force. The demons are downright using you as a shield against your own [var1], ensuring they'll not be shot at from a distance. 
        
        Thankfully, the brave [var1] aren't content to just sit back and watch you be overrun. With their powerful attacks too dangerous to use, they draw blades and hammers and come charging in themselves — no one else is close enough or aware enough to take the risk. [var2] leads them in at the front, wading into the demons until there's some room cleared around you. You're able to get your officers back and into the hands of the medics, but the casualties your [var1] take in return are enormous. 
        
        By the time the last of the demons have fled or been felled, there's little left of your own men, either, and your command cadre's half its previous size. 
        
        "Let's... not do that again," Calise groans, pulling an arrow out of her bicep.
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |你从倒下的百夫长手中拿过一只战号，用力吹奏，将声音传向那个方向[var1]他们背对着你，却仍在注视前方。士兵们回头瞥了一眼，然后瞪大了眼睛，直到[var2]他们开始大声下达命令。仅仅过了几秒钟，那些恶魔刺客们就被吸引住了注意力，纷纷转身举起盾牌，开始朝军队的后方急速前进。

虽然你的士兵们速度并不快，但他们靴子踩在地面上的声响，以及武器撞击盾牌时发出的叮当声，确实把那些恶魔刺客们的注意力从你身上吸引了过去。这里并没有什么激烈的冲突：那些恶魔足够聪明，能够意识到自己已经被击败，于是会匆忙撤退，而且他们根本无法带走任何东西——尽管他们也会尝试去抢夺。 [var1]他们从后方突然发起攻击，将那些来不及逃走的恶魔全部消灭。

你帮助那位晕倒的百夫长站了起来，同时呼叫医护人员来救治在袭击中受伤的战友们。幸运的是，受伤的人并不多。

“危机终于化解了，”卡莉丝叹道，“多亏了你反应迅速。
        |你从倒下的百夫长手中拿过那支战号，用力吹奏，将声音传向那个方向[var1]他们背对着你，却仍在注视着前方。士兵们回头一看，顿时惊呼出声，随即转身冲向自己军队的后方防线。

他们的速度很快，但那些恶魔也同样迅速。最终，这场速度竞赛决定了谁会先赶到指挥官那里——而恶魔占据了优势。你和卡莉丝不得不拔出武器，亲自加入这场激烈的战斗。在短短的几秒钟里，鲜血飞溅，最终那些恶魔被击退了[var1]反攻开始了。这场战斗短暂而残酷：双方装备的都只是轻装铠甲和几面小盾牌，因此箭矢和刀刃轻易就能击中目标。

等到这场冲突结束的时候[var1]那些恶魔也都受到了严重的伤害；你的部队拖着伤痕累累的身体退回了自己的防线，而剩下的恶魔则振翅飞向了下方的山丘。

“代价太大了，”卡莉丝气喘吁吁地说，“但我们终于成功了。”

你帮助那位昏迷不醒的百夫长站了起来，同时叫来医护人员，去救治在这次攻击中受伤的其他士兵。幸运的是，受伤的人数并不多。
        |你从倒下的百夫长手中拿过那支战号，用力吹奏，将声音传向那个方向[var1]他们原本背对着你，却突然转向前方。士兵们回头一看，顿时惊呼出声，随即立即调转武器，迎向那些袭来的恶魔。 [var1]你向那些恶魔连续开枪，但这些邪魔已经逼近了你。你和卡莉丝不得不拔出武器，亲自投入战斗。由于你们与敌人已经处于近距离接触的状态，你的支援部队也不敢冒险开枪，因为那些子弹同样有可能击中你们。你的将领们开始倒下，他们要么被有毒的刀刃和箭矢所杀，要么被邪恶的法术控制，转而与你为敌。这是一场疯狂而混乱的混战。

即便你拥有高超的战斗技巧，面对如此强大的敌人，你所能做的也有限——你只能保护有限的几位指挥官而已。那些恶魔简直是在利用你作为挡箭牌，来保护他们自己。 [var1]这样就能确保他们不会被远距离射击。 

幸运的是，那些勇敢的人们[var1]他们可不会满足于只是坐视不管，眼睁睁看着你们被敌人攻陷。由于他们的强力攻击太过危险，其他人根本不敢使用，于是他们就拔出刀剑或锤子，亲自冲上去迎战——没有其他人愿意冒险这么做，也没有其他人有足够的勇气去尝试。 [var2]你走在最前面，带领他们冲入恶魔的包围圈，直到周围清理出一些安全的空间。你成功将你的军官们救出来，并交给了医护人员，但你所遭受的伤亡[var1]作为回报，你所获得的利益是巨大的。然而，当最后一只恶魔被消灭或被击败时，你的部队也已经所剩无几，你的指挥官团队的规模也只剩下原来的一半了。

“我们……不要再这样做了吧，”卡莉丝呻吟着，从自己的二头肌上拔出一支箭来。
    ]

rows.original: You've finally pushed the demons all the way back to the castle gates. [var0 |Your peerless command has seen your forces through with minimal losses, and your full host is ready to be brought to bear against the foe. |Though you've taken casualties, their numbers are far lower than your foes' have been, and those who remain are poised to take the fight to the enemy. |The casualties it took to get here would put some Heartlander warlords whole armies to shame, but your forces remain unbroken, their heads still in the fight. ] Calise barks orders to the rear line, commanding the rams and ladders be brought to the fore now. You've got enough men left to force the breach, though the demons on the walls don't mean to make it easy. Arrows, stones, and spells pelt your troops as they draw close, a last-ditch desperate attempt to keep the rams away from the gates. Desperate, but effective. The high ground proves to be a hell of an advantage, with most of your troops unable to strike back — and the fortress walls provide ample cover against any but the most precise, or most destructive, attacks. "We've got to dig them out!" Calise says. "Or there won't be anyone left to storm the gates once we have them open!" Choose a unit to hammer the demons' last defenses.

rows.original: [var0 |You give a sharp whistle to [var2], pointing towards the battlements. "You see that?" "Yes, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]!" "I don't want to anymore." "Yes, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]!" They let loose, hammering the battlements with volley after volley of devastating attacks, until the stone of it begins to shatter. rows.original: While you watch the maneuvers you've ordered begin to unfold, Calise steps close, voice low. "We're running out of men," she says. "This isn't working." You want to argue, but it's hard to deny the obvious truth: your army is in the process of collapse. Men are breaking and fleeing when they can; when they can't, they're being cut down or captured, dragged towards the fortress's indomitable gates. "We don't have enough men left to work the rams," she says. "Then what's the plan?" "We surrender." You blink. "What!?" "We have to get into that fortress. This is our only chance. With the men and women the demons have captured turned to imp breeders and then demons, the city will be overwhelmed for sure! Just... just trust me, please. I've escaped from worse binds before." A bit hard to believe, considering where you are. But even if you wanted to flee now, the demons are closing in. The last of your army is being torn down before your eyes, and there are precious seconds left to make a decision. Cursing, you throw your weapon down, and tell your remaining followers to do the same. The demons are on you moments later.
rows.translation: 你注视自己下令的调动逐步展开时，卡莉丝走近，用低沉的声音说道：“我们的人快打光了。这样行不通。” 你想反驳，却难以否认显而易见的事实：你的军队正在崩溃。能逃的人纷纷溃逃；逃不掉的则被杀死或俘虏，拖向堡垒牢不可破的大门。 “剩下的人已经不足以操纵攻城锤了。”她说道。 “那接下来怎么办？” “我们投降。” 你眨眨眼。“什么！？” “我们必须进入那座堡垒。这是唯一的机会。恶魔俘虏的男女会先被变成小恶魔的繁殖工具，再变成恶魔；那样一来，这座城市必定会被彻底淹没！只要……只要相信我，求你了。我以前曾从更糟糕的困境里逃出去。” 考虑到你们身处何地，这话很难令人信服。可就算现在想逃，恶魔也已经包围过来。残余军队正在你眼前被撕碎，只剩宝贵的几秒钟供你作出决定。 你咒骂着扔下武器，命令剩余的追随者也照做。 片刻后，恶魔们将你团团围住。

Deny them reinforcements or resources they need, that sort of thing. And if we do knock out the big base, the smaller ones might go to ground, along with whatever evils they've been cooking up." rows.original: "Anything else we need to worry about?" you ask. "I think that's it! I've got my gear packed up, and I have the maps Lord Raqian found for me in water-proofed scroll cases." The princess reaches down to where she's set down her pack and rattles it. "So I'm good to go when you give the word. Just make sure you're ready. This is the real deal, you know. When we're done.... The world will never be the same."

rows.original: You give Varena a confident look. "I'm ready if you are." She sighs, like she's trying to breathe out all her nerves. "Good, I'm ready too. Let's go." Just like that, casual as she can manage, Varena dismisses her silencing spell and picks up her staff and satchel. "Um, one thing first." Varena goes up to the bar, gestures to the wine rack behind Vitra, and gets herself a tall glass of something red and fragrant poured out. The princess picks it up, takes a deep whiff of it, and then chugs the whole thing in one go. "Okay. Now I'm ready. Follow me."
rows.translation: 你自信地注视着瓦蕾娜：“如果你准备好了，我也准备好了。” 她叹了口气，仿佛在努力释放自己所有的紧张情绪：“好吧，我也准备好了。我们走吧。” 就这样，瓦蕾娜以最随意的方式解除了自己的沉默咒语，然后拿起了法杖和背包。嗯，先有一件事要处理。” 瓦蕾娜走到吧台前，指向薇特拉身后的酒架，给自己倒了一杯红色且香气扑鼻的酒。这位公主拿起酒杯，深深地闻了闻，然后一饮而尽。 好的。现在我准备好了。跟我来吧。

rows.original: The two of you walk through the city[varena.fucked | hand in hand ], making way against the press of the crowd. There are soldiers everywhere now, stationed on every street corner. Their gear is rough and ill-fitting in many cases, clearly marking them as recent conscripts pressed into service, or volunteers from the outer provinces with little left to do to support themselves. Even in the more affluent parts of town your route takes, always some of the soldiers seem raw and untested, and the alleys and undercrofts are overflowing with the dispossessed. Varena stops now and then to pass out a few hawks and encouraging words. The sheer number of them drains her coinpurse dry before you're past the bath house. The princess gives you a tired, sad look and quickens her pace. "This city is dying, isn't it?" "[pc.dcb |Yeah," you shrug. "But we're gonna stop the bleeding at least." |Not if I can help it," you assure her. |Um, well, no. But it's changing, in a bad way. But we can still fix it!" you say, giving her a reassuring smile. "We got this!" ] "I hope so." [party.has cait |Cait gives her a pat on the back. "Don't worry, Varena. You're going to do great." ] [party.has etheryn |"Hey," Etheryn says softly. "[pc.name] saved my city. [pc.HeShe] can save yours too. I'll do all I can to help." ] [party.has atugia |Tui clasps Varena's shoulder. "It's not deing til we give up fighting." ] Varena unfurls the maps she's acquired and, with them, leads you through a winding series of alleys and backstreets until you arrive at a set of stairs that lead you up to the aqueduct that runs over the bath house. It looks rarely-used and poorly kept, a hidden entrance for laborers disguised as one of the archways behind a row of houses, just before the point where the city's edge meets the great cavern's walls. [var0 |"You might have to duck," Varena says to [party.randComp brint arona |Brint |Arona |[party.hasAll arona brint |you and your towering companions |you ] ]. ]The princess gives the door a good push — hard enough to make the muscles on her back strain visibly — and slowly inches it open. The sound of stone grating against stone makes your teeth ache, and there's a deeply musty, humid puff of air once it's ajar. And the sound of running water, thunderous in the stone tunnel. "Okay!" Varena says, having to shout to be heard as you step inside. "From here we go north and upwards. There should be an underground lake about six hundred paces ahead of us!" "Could the demons have been sneaking people in this way?" you ask. You follow Varena into the squat, narrow tunnel of the ductway; there's a skinny path of stone on either side of the waterflow for you to walk along, wet and mossy. Varena conjures a ball of dim, cool light in her hand, casting a pallid glow over the stone. "No — not easily anyway. There's a bunch of gates in the aqueduct to keep anything bigger than a mouse out, and we send workers through every few days to inspect them for blockages. Soldiers now, too. Somebody would notice if there'd been damage. They just couldn't have seen the corruption in the water itself!" You glance at the water. Even in the pale light of Varena's cantrip, it looks... normal. There's a faintly musky aroma to it, but here in the dank stone of the aqueduct, who's to say that isn't normal? You're not an engineer. Nothing here would tell you the water is anything dangerous. And yet you know what lies ahead.
rows.translation: 你们两个一起在城里漫步。[varena.fucked | 手牵手 ]他们在人群的挤压中艰难地前行。现在到处都是士兵，他们被部署在每一个街角。他们的装备粗糙，许多甚至不合身，这清楚地表明他们都是新近被征召入伍的士兵，或者是来自外省、没有什么其他谋生手段的志愿者。即使在城镇中较为富裕的地区，你所经过的道路上，也总有一些士兵显得缺乏经验、尚未经过实战考验；而那些小巷和隐蔽处，则挤满了那些流离失所的人们。 瓦蕾娜不时停下来，分发一些食物和鼓励的话语。在他们之中，有太多人让你的钱包在还没走出澡堂之前就变得空空如也。 公主疲惫而悲伤地看了你一眼，然后加快了脚步。“这座城市正在走向灭亡，对吧？[pc.dcb |是啊，”你耸了耸肩，“但至少我们得先止血才行。 |如果我能阻止的话，肯定不会让这种事发生，”你向她保证道。 |嗯，其实并没有。但情况正在恶化，而且方向很不好。不过我们还是可以解决这个问题的！”你这样说道，同时给她一个安慰的微笑，“我们一定能做到的！ ] 但愿如此。 [party.has cait |凯特轻拍她的背说道：“别担心，瓦蕾娜，你一定会做得很好的。 ] [party.has etheryn |嘿，”伊瑟琳轻声说道。[pc.name]拯救了我的城市。 [pc.HeShe]你也可以保住自己的东西的。我会尽我所能来帮助你。 ] [party.has atugia |崔握住了瓦蕾娜的肩膀：“在我们放弃抗争之前，一切都还没有结束。 ] 瓦蕾娜展开她收集到的那些地图，凭借这些地图，她引导你穿过一条条蜿蜒的小巷和背街，最终来到一组楼梯前。这些楼梯通向横跨浴场上方的输水渠。这条通道看起来很少有人使用，维护也相当不善，它其实是工人们隐藏起来的入口——这些入口被伪装成一排房屋后面的拱门，正好位于城市边缘与那座巨大洞穴的墙壁相接的地方之前。 [var0 |你可能得躲一下了，”瓦蕾娜说道。 [party.randComp brint arona |布林特 |阿罗娜 |[party.hasAll arona brint |你和那些高大的伙伴们 |你 ] ]。 ]公主用力推了推门，那力度之大甚至让她背部的肌肉明显出现了紧张的迹象，门这才缓缓被推开。石头相互摩擦发出的刺耳声响得人牙酸，而当门稍微打开后，一股充满霉味且潮湿的空气扑面而来。 石洞里，流水声轰鸣着，回荡不绝。 “好了！”瓦蕾娜大声说道，因为在洞穴里走路时，必须大声喊话才能让对方听到。“从这里开始，我们向北然后向上走。前面大约六百步的地方应该有一座地下湖！难道那些恶魔就是用这种方式偷偷把人带进来的吗？”你问道。跟随瓦蕾娜进入这条低矮狭窄的管道通道，水流两侧都有一条由石头铺成的狭窄小路，你可以沿着这条路行走，不过路面上积满了水，还长满了苔藓。 瓦蕾娜手中凝聚出一团昏暗而清凉的光芒，那光芒使石头表面呈现出淡淡的亮色。“不行——至少不是那么容易就能做到的。这条引水渠里设置了许多闸门，用来阻挡任何比老鼠更大的生物进入，我们每隔几天就会派工人去检查这些闸门是否被堵塞了。现在的士兵们也是如此。如果真的发生了损坏，肯定会有人注意到的。他们只是没能发现而已。腐败就在水里！” 你低头看了看水面。即使在瓦蕾娜的法术营造出的微弱光线下，它看起来也……很正常。水里散发着淡淡的麝香味，但在这潮湿的石渠中，谁又能说这种气味不正常呢？你又不是工程师，这里没有任何迹象能说明这水有什么危险。 然而，你心里很清楚，前方等待着什么。
rows.raw: ' The two of you walk through the city[varena.fucked | hand in hand ], making way against the press of the crowd. There are soldiers everywhere now, stationed on every street corner. Their gear is rough and ill-fitting in many cases, clearly marking them as recent conscripts pressed into service, or volunteers from the outer provinces with little left to do to support themselves. Even in the more affluent parts of town your route takes, always some of the soldiers seem raw and untested, and the alleys and undercrofts are overflowing with the dispossessed. Varena stops now and then to pass out a few hawks and encouraging words. The sheer number of them drains her coinpurse dry before you're past the bath house. The princess gives you a tired, sad look and quickens her pace. "This city is dying, isn't it?" "[pc.dcb |Yeah," you shrug. "But we're gonna stop the bleeding at least." |Not if I can help it," you assure her. |Um, well, no. But it's changing, in a bad way. But we can still fix it!" you say, giving her a reassuring smile. "We got this!" ] "I hope so." [party.has cait |Cait gives her a pat on the back. "Don't worry, Varena. You're going to do great." ] [party.has etheryn |"Hey," Etheryn says softly. "[pc.name] saved my city. [pc.HeShe] can save yours too. I'll do all I can to help." ] [party.has atugia |Tui clasps Varena's shoulder. "It's not deing til we give up fighting." ] Varena unfurls the maps she's acquired and, with them, leads you through a winding series of alleys and backstreets until you arrive at a set of stairs that lead you up to the aqueduct that runs over the bath house. It looks rarely-used and poorly kept, a hidden entrance for laborers disguised as one of the archways behind a row of houses, just before the point where the city's edge meets the great cavern's walls. [var0 |"You might have to duck," Varena says to [party.randComp brint arona |Brint |Arona |[party.hasAll arona brint |you and your towering companions |you ] ]. ]The princess gives the door a good push — hard enough to make the muscles on her back strain visibly — and slowly inches it open. The sound of stone grating against stone makes your teeth ache, and there's a deeply musty, humid puff of air once it's ajar. And the sound of running water, thunderous in the stone tunnel. "Okay!" Varena says, having to shout to be heard as you step inside. "From here we go north and upwards. There should be an underground lake about six hundred paces ahead of us!" "Could the demons have been sneaking people in this way?" you ask. You follow Varena into the squat, narrow tunnel of the ductway; there's a skinny path of stone on either side of the waterflow for you to walk along, wet and mossy. Varena conjures a ball of dim, cool light in her hand, casting a pallid glow over the stone. "No — not easily anyway. There's a bunch of gates in the aqueduct to keep anything bigger than a mouse out, and we send workers through every few days to inspect them for blockages. Soldiers now, too. Somebody would notice if there'd been damage. They just couldn't have seen the corruption in the water itself!" You glance at the water. Even in the pale light of Varena's cantrip, it looks... normal. There's a faintly musky aroma to it, but here in the dank stone of the aqueduct, who's to say that isn't normal? You're not an engineer. Nothing here would tell you the water is anything dangerous. And yet you know what lies ahead. '

rows.original: Follow the aqueduct to the underground lake.
rows.translation: 沿着这条引水渠，前往地下湖泊吧。
rows.raw: "Follow the aqueduct to the underground lake."

rows.original: The [party.som |two |three |four ] of you feel entombed, walking with nothing but the rush of water and your own echoing footsteps to accompany you. Steadily, the worked stone of the aqueduct gives way to natural rock formations, worn away by the passage of the water and then widened by Minoan hands, now just barely wide enough for you two walk single file. Varena's white-knuckling her staff, chest making the laces on her corset strain with her heavy breaths. As the tunnel widens, opening into the underground lake, you [varena.fucked |put an arm around her waist and draw her close, trying to calm her nerves. |give her a reassuring shoulder-squeeze. ] "We're going to be fine." "She will be," a voice in front of you booms.
rows.translation: 你们[party.som |两人 |三人 |四人 ]仿佛被埋进了地底，一路上陪伴你们的只有奔涌的水声和各自回荡的脚步声。渐渐地，水道经人工修整的石壁让位给了天然岩层；流水先将它们侵蚀，再由弥诺斯人的双手拓宽，如今宽度也只勉强够你们排成一列前行。 瓦蕾娜死死攥着手杖，沉重的喘息让胸部撑得紧身胸衣上的系带绷紧。隧道逐渐拓宽，通向地下湖泊时，你[varena.fucked |伸手搂住她的腰，把她拉近身边，试图安抚她紧张的情绪。 |宽慰地捏了捏她的肩膀。 ]“我们会没事的。” “她当然会没事，”你们前方响起一个洪亮的声音。
rows.raw: ' The [party.som |two |three |four ] of you feel entombed, walking with nothing but the rush of water and your own echoing footsteps to accompany you. Steadily, the worked stone of the aqueduct gives way to natural rock formations, worn away by the passage of the water and then widened by Minoan hands, now just barely wide enough for you two walk single file. Varena's white-knuckling her staff, chest making the laces on her corset strain with her heavy breaths. As the tunnel widens, opening into the underground lake, you [varena.fucked |put an arm around her waist and draw her close, trying to calm her nerves. |give her a reassuring shoulder-squeeze. ] "We're going to be fine." "She will be," a voice in front of you booms. '

rows.original:
The underground lake sprawls out before you, placid and black as night. Standing at the water's edge, just at the faintest reach of Varena's light, stands the captain of the king's guard, clad in resplendent golden armor and carrying a two-handed hammer over one of his broad, red-cloaked shoulders. 

    "L-Lord Raqian!?" Varena gasps. 
    
    "Apologies, princess," the half-minotaur says, taking a lumbering step forward. "Your father has bade me return you to the palace."
    
    "How does — oh, the maps. You told him."
    
    [var0|He shakes his head. "No, but the king has given very strict standing orders that if you leave the city, I am to bring you back. The world is too dangerous, princess. Please."|He shakes his head. "It was your brother, princess. His Highness has noted your long absences from the palace, and ordered that you be returned if you leave the city. He is quite worried for your safety, my lady. Please."]
    
    "I can't," Varena says. "We're doing something important. That could save the city."
    
    "Then come back and tell your father that. Whatever it is, it's a job for the Chargers, not a princess. Even with a Champion to lead her astray. What say you, [pc.name]?[pc.ra marefolk| I would hate to hurt [pc.mf|a stallion as handsome as you|such a beautiful mare as you].]"
rows.translation:
那片地下湖泊展现在你面前，平静而漆黑，如同夜色一般。站在水边，正好处于瓦蕾娜微弱光线的照射范围之内，站着国王卫队的队长。他身披华丽的金色铠甲，宽大的红色斗篷遮住了他的一个肩膀，而他的另一只肩膀上则扛着一把双柄巨锤。 

    拉-拉基安大人！？”瓦蕾娜惊呼道。
    
    “抱歉，公主，”那个半牛人说道，一边笨拙地向前迈了一步，“您的父亲命令我将您送回宫殿。”
    
    “怎么会这样——哦，那些地图。是你告诉他的吧。"
    
    [var0|他摇了摇头。“不行，但国王下了严格的命令：如果你离开这座城市，我就必须把你带回来。外面太危险了，公主，请您听我的吧。|他摇了摇头。“是你的哥哥，公主。殿下注意到了你长时间没有回到宫殿，因此下令如果你离开这座城市，就必须被带回。他非常担心你的安全，我的夫人。请吧。]
    
    我不能去，”瓦蕾娜说道，“我们正在做一件非常重要的事情，这件事可能会拯救整座城市。”
    
    “那就回来告诉你父亲吧。无论是什么事情，这都应该是由‘冲锋者’小队来完成的任务，而不是一个公主该做的事情。就算有冠军在旁边误导她，也没用啊。你怎么看？ [pc.name]？[pc.ra marefolk| 我绝对不愿意伤害任何人。 [pc.mf|像你这么英俊的种马|像你这样美丽的女子]。]"

rows.original: There's a traitor in the Khor'minoan court. You have to handle this with people you can trust.
rows.translation: 科尔米诺斯的宫廷里有一个叛徒。你必须和你可以信任的人一起处理这件事。
rows.raw: "There's a traitor in the Khor'minoan court. You have to handle this with people you can trust."

rows.original: You didn't actually find a traitor, so....
rows.translation: 你其实并没有找到那个叛徒，所以……
rows.raw: "You didn't actually find a traitor, so...."

rows.original: You thought Varena is the traitor, but clearly not anymore...
rows.translation: 你原本以为瓦蕾娜是叛徒，但显然现在不是这样了……
rows.raw: "You thought Varena is the traitor, but clearly not anymore..."

rows.original: Varena's perfectly capable of taking care of herself. She doesn't need her family's protection.
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜完全有能力照顾自己，她并不需要家人的保护。
rows.raw: "Varena's perfectly capable of taking care of herself. She doesn't need her family's protection. "

rows.original: You don't have time to dither around in the capital anymore! The demons have to be stopped here and now.
rows.translation: 你再也没有时间在首都里浪费时间了！必须立刻阻止那些恶魔。
rows.raw: "You don't have time to dither around in the capital anymore! The demons have to be stopped here and now."

rows.original: You don't owe this overgrown cow an explanation.
rows.translation: 你没有必要向这头长势过盛的牛解释什么。
rows.raw: "You don't owe this overgrown cow an explanation."

rows.original: "[var0] is a traitor. And if [var1 |he |she ] is, there could be more," you tell the golden warrior. "I trust Varena. We need to work together [pc.dcb |or your city's going to burn! |to fix this city! |or else how is friendship going to conquer all? ]" [var2 |You barely have the words out of your mouth before Raqian snarls and whirls his hammer to bear. "I will brook no insult to His Majesty!" "Raqian, no!" Varena gasps. He shows no sign of slowing down. "I will hear no such slander! Defend yourself, cur!" |Raqian scowls, hefting his hammer. "[var0] has been cleared of any wrongdoing. I've investigated the matter myself.[var3| Even Khaius, for all his faults, was blameless in Iavari's schemes. He has agreed to testify against the man.] This is foolishness, Champion. But I can see I must make you see reason. Come then." He brings his weapon up and plants his feet. "To the pain." |"You would really accuse the Champion of Velun of conspiring against the crown?" "She's not the Champion of anything!" you insist. "She's [calise.isKasyrra |the gods-damned demon queen in disguise! The whole point of this war has been to bump off Tollus — that's why she's been helping you! |a demon! The only reason she's been helping you at all is because she hates Tollus. ] But I still think she's working against the city all the same." Raqian's brow furrows. He glances at Varena, who nods, saying, "I believe [pc.himHer]. Calise's not who she says she is. Even you heard the rumors about her, Raqian: that she was half-marefolk, a huge woman, muscular, carrying a holy axe... none of that is true. She's been an impostor since day one." The bull-man snorts, then lowers his head. "I... had been eager to meet a half-mare from a distant land, true enough. But still, she has a paladin's powers..." "Magic is magic," Varena says. "Ask the Storm Witch when you get back to town. She could have been a paladin once, and still hold the power. Or learned it from one." [pc.isMage |You nod. "It's true." ] [party.has viv |From the corner of your eye, Viv looks like she's about to speak up, then thinks better of it and stops before saying anything. ] The princess casts her gaze down. "Even if we only have doubts, Raqian, surely you can see why we need to do this ourselves. Please, let us past. The city's been corrupted, that much is evident. We can stop it at the source, right now. We have to." Raqian takes a deep breath, and lets his hammer lower off his shoulder. "Princess, I need you to hit me." "What!?" The towering warrior unbuckles the straps on his golden breastplate, letting the armor fall to the floor at his feet, and he sets his hammer aside. "I need you and your Champion here to overpower me, or I can't let you past. My oaths demand as much. I taught you to fight, Princess. This should be easy." Raqian plants his feet and spreads his hands. "HIT ME!" Varena does so, hard enough that the impact echoes through the chamber. One strike across the brow from her staff, and Varena has Raqian slumping to his knees. The bull goes face-down with a meaty thump, and lies still. There's a moment of genuine panic on Varena's face. "Tira! Did I hit him too hard? Is he-" "He's fine," you assure her, glancing at one of his thumbs sticking up from a clenched fist. "Come on." Raqian's face contorts into a snarl of rage, but the more you speak, the more defeated the man looks. Slowly his shoulders slump. Varena too looks aghast, but she makes no move to contradict you. Finally, the guardian speaks. "I have... questioned the prince's actions. The lowness of the council he keeps. Even the king does as well. Now you, and Calise..." "Then why isn't anyone doing anything?" "He is the prince and heir of this kingdom!" Raqian bellows. "He cannot be a traitor to his homeland. It's not... it is impossible!" Varena cuts her gaze between you and the bull. "I... [pc.name], what are you saying? Vrannus? My brother?" "Think about it!" you say. "You of all people should have noticed something's wrong with him!" Varena grimaces. One strike across the brow from her staff, and Varena has Raqian slumping to his knees. The bull goes face-down with a meaty thump, and lies still. There's a moment of genuine panic on Varena's face. "Tira! Did I hit him too hard? Is he-" "He's fine," you assure her, glancing at one of his thumbs sticking up from a clenched fist. "Come on." You quickly glance at that golden armor, though... ]

“拉基安，不要！”瓦蕾娜惊呼道。 但他丝毫没有减速的迹象：“我绝不会听任这种诽谤！快自卫吧，贱人！ |拉谦皱着眉头，举起了他的锤子。[var0]已经证明他没有任何不当行为。这是我亲自调查过的。[var3| 即便凯乌斯有诸多缺点，但在雅瓦里的阴谋中，他却是清白的。他已经同意作证指控那个人。]这简直是愚蠢至极，冠军。不过我明白，我必须让你明白道理，那就来吧。” rows.original: Take that golden armor for yourself.
rows.translation: 把那件金色铠甲拿去吧。

rows.original: Give Raqian's armor to Princess Varena. It'll go a long way towards keeping her safe.
rows.translation: 把拉奇安的护甲交给瓦蕾娜公主。这对保护她的安全大有帮助。

rows.original:
"Varena can take care of herself," you say. "She's held her own against demons already. She doesn't need to be babied by her family."
    
    "That's not for you to decide," the minotaur says, lifting his hammer. "I'm sorry, Princess. I must insist."
    
    Varena steps up beside you. "And I still say no."
    
    "Then prove [pc.name] right, here and now. If you can defeat me, perhaps you have a chance against the demons outside."

瓦蕾娜有能力照顾自己，”你说，“她已经成功抵抗过恶魔了，根本不需要家人过分呵护。”
    
    “但这不是由你来决定的，”弥诺陶洛斯举起他的锤子说道，“对不起，公主，我必须坚持自己的立场。”
    
    瓦蕾娜走到你身边：“我还是不同意。”
    
    “那么，你就证明给我看吧。 [pc.name]就在现在，就在这里。如果你能打败我，或许你就有机会对抗外面的那些恶魔了。

rows.original: "We don't have time for this," you say. "Or for the king and his court to get their heads out of their asses! Get out of our way so we can save this city!" "Your belief in the urgency of your cause doesn't give you the right to endanger the king's daughter," Raqian says firmly, lifting the hammer from his shoulders. "Princess, please listen to reason: you family is worried about you, and your behavior of late has given them cause for great concern. It's one thing to play savior in the slums, and another to go out in the middle of war to-" "That's enough!" Varena snaps. "Who gave you the right to talk to me like a child? What we're doing matters, Raqian. And if we have to, we'll make you see." "Then prove [pc.name] right, here and now. If you can defeat me, perhaps you have a chance against the demons outside."
rows.translation: “我们没时间耗在这上面，”你说。“也没时间等国王和他的宫廷把脑袋从屁股里拔出来！让开，好让我们拯救这座城市！” “你坚信自己的事业十万火急，但这并不赋予你危及国王女儿的权利，”拉奇安坚定地说，同时把锤子从肩上举下。“公主，请您听从理性：您的家人很担心您，您近来的行为让他们极为担忧。在贫民窟里扮演救世主是一回事，在战争期间跑出去则是另一回事——” “够了！”瓦蕾娜厉声说。“谁给了你权利，用这种对小孩说话的口气跟我说话？我们正在做的事至关重要，拉奇安。如果有必要，我们会让你看清楚的。” “那就现在、就在这里证明[pc.name]说得对。如果你能打败我，或许你还有机会对付外面的恶魔。”

    Varena sighs. "Oh, yeah, let's just antagonize the captain of Daddy's guard. Great idea!"
    
    Raqian hefts his hammer off his shoulder and plants his feet. "I see it falls to me to bring Princess Varena back to polite society. So be it."

rows.original: You cross your arms, refusing to answer him. Varena sighs and takes a step forward. "Please, Raqian, we have to do this. I can do this. Trust us." "I'm afraid His Majesty's orders are absolute," Raqian says, hefting his hammer off his shoulders. "Stand aside, [pc.name], or be made to." You don't move an inch. "So be it."

rows.original:
Raqian slumps to a knee, barely able to keep himself upright by leaning against his hammer's haft. "Khuun. Well done." 

    The half-bull yanks the clasps on his breastplate, letting the gilded armor clatter to the ground, and pulls off his crimson cape. The scarlet cloth falls to the mired floor of the waterway, carried off in an instant. "My duty is done, as best as I am able. It seems I had nothing to worry about after all." 
    
    "Raqian... thank you." 
    
    He looks up at Varena, breathing hard. "Go, Princess. Go now, follow [pc.name]. To glory, for Khor'minos."
    
    He falls face-down on the ground, hard enough to make the earth rumble beneath your feet. 
    
    "Is he okay?" Varena asks. 
    
    "He's breathing," you assure her. You glance from the fallen guard to the golden armor he's discarded.
rows.translation:
拉基安跪倒在地，几乎只能依靠倚在锤柄上的力量来保持身体不倒。“库恩……干得不错。”

    这个半人半牛的生物扯开了胸甲上的扣子，让那件镀金的盔甲哗啦一声掉落在地上，然后脱下了自己那件深红色的斗篷。那片猩红色的布料落入水道中浑浊的淤泥里，瞬间就被冲走了。“我已经尽了自己最大的努力去完成我的职责。看来，我其实没有什么好担心的了。”
    
    “拉基安……谢谢你。”
    
    他抬起头，望着瓦蕾娜，呼吸依然有些急促。去吧，公主。现在就动身，跟随[pc.name]为了荣耀，为了科尔米诺斯。”
    
    他面朝下重重摔在地上，震得地面都仿佛在震动。
    
    “他没事吧？”瓦蕾娜问道。
    
    “他还在呼吸，”你向她保证。你的目光从倒地的卫兵身上移向他丢弃在地上的金色盔甲。

    He falls face-down on the ground, hard enough to make the earth rumble beneath your feet. 
    
    "Is he okay?" Varena asks. 
    
    "He's breathing," you assure her. You glance from the fallen guard to the golden armor he's discarded.
    '
