rows.original: It's a much, much longer walk this time. The tunnel is small enough that Varena has to walk sideways now and then, sucking in her chest to squeeze through tight passages. [party.has brint |Poor Brint's having a rough time, bumping his horns on the ceiling and side-stepping full time down the tunnel. ] [party.has cait |Cait whines about how damp it is, making her hair frizz up. ] And then there's the smell... The entire underground had a murky, dank scent, but as you follow the water to its source, it grows earthier. Muskier. By the time you're on the final incline, it's undeniable what you're smelling: cum. Hundreds of gallons of tainted semen, mixing into the water from the breeding pits. This is it. The heart of the cult's operation, just ahead of you — and it's [pc.corruptionRange 90 |intoxicating. What magnificent excess! |nauseating. Gods! ] Varena pinches her nose. "Oh, Tira! It's unbearable." "It's about to get a lot worse," you whisper, pointing ahead to where you can finally see the first rays of flickering light from something other than her magic. Several grates are punched into a long rift in the ceiling, and waterfalls of effluvia pour down through it — along with the echoes of moans, groans, and screams that range the gamut of from horror to orgiastic pleasure. "And that's our way in." "Oh, no." [party.has viv |"There's a chemical scent to the air," Viviane observes dryly. "Somebody's doing a lot of alchemy up there, too." ] [party.has brint |Brint groans. "Never going to get this smell out of my fur now." ] [party.has arona |"Gods damn," Arona says, spitting into the river. "People've been drinking this shit?" ] [party.has atugia |"I wish i could turn my nose off," Tui says with a gag. "We've got to get these people out of here." ] [party.has cait |Cait clutches her staff. "We've got to help these people..." ] [party.has azzy |Azyrran looks appalled, tightening the grip on her spear and shield. "Lumia preserve... my home would have become this in time." ] "Remember," Varena says, reaching into her bust and producing the runestone again. "We have got to throw this outside before we do anything to draw the demons' attention!" You nod, and reach for one of the grates. "Then let's hope nobody's looking."

rows.original:
Your return to the city is slow and steady, harried occasionally by demon remnants or wyverns from the mountain, but by and large peaceful. Your troops' spirits are sky high, and your march is accompanied by singing all the way back from the peaks to the city. 
    
    When you arrive back in Khor'minos, it's to the cheers of the people. Crowds gather around your marching columns, showering you in favors and blown kisses. Calise lifts your hand, a show of shared triumph as you march through the streets and towards the palace gates. A few of your soldiers are whisked away into the crowd by loved ones, or soon-to-be lovers; even Isadora arrives at the palace covered in lipstick marks.
    
    The Chargers escort you in, and soon enough you're standing before the throne, with King Kelsaz striding in with Lord Raqian and [var0
        |Princess Varena
        |Prince Vrannusbut by and large peaceful
        |his children on either side of him
    ]. You and your comrades kneel before the king as he takes his throne. "Champions, you return with victory in your [pc.hasWings
        |wings
        |eyes
    ]! Already, the legions are reporting that the imp hordes are breaking, leaderless! Well done, all of you. Today will be remembered for generations as the day when the two Champions turned the tide of this war!"
    
	There's a general cheer from the assembled soldiers, and the Chargers clap for you. You exchange a look with Calise[bk.isChamp
        |, watching the demoness roll her eyes a little. Still, she behaves herself as the praise is heaped falsely upon her, nodding to a few soldiers, waving at others, accepting handshakes. Nobody's the wiser so far.
        | and [calise.fucked
            |take her hand, enjoying the moment.
            |[kasyrra.fucked
                |take her hand, enjoying the moment.
                |try to smile at the crowd, keeping up the illusion of two perfectly normal heroes, allies to the end.
            ]
        ]
    ]
    
    [bk.isChamp
        |Calise takes a breath and straightens her back, addressing the king in a booming voice for all to hear: "My king! The Champion and I delivered you a great victory. The war's balance is in your favor now. And with that, I must now take my leave. The call of Velun draws me elsewhere, but you will, I know, be in safe hands with my comrade here." 
        
        A shocked gasp runs throughout the audience hall. Soldiers look amongst themselves in disbelief, and even King Kelsaz seems taken aback. 
        
        "I... of course, you are free to leave if Velun calls you, Lady Calise," the king says following a long pause. "But you will leave an outsized hole not just in the war, but in this court. Is there anything at all we can do to convince you to stay?"
        
        Calise shakes her head. "This city isn't the only realm suffering, King Kelsaz. Kasyrra threatens all the world, and I mean to oppose her wherever her touch spreads filth like wildfire. But I leave you in good hands," she says, giving you such a violent slap on the shoulder that you nearly lose your footing. You try not to glower, instead giving the king a reassuring nod. You've got this.
        
        The king sighs, but inclines his head to Calise. "Then I wish you godspeed in your travels, and know that the City of Khor'minos will always consider you a friend. Our gates will never be shut to you, Champion of Velun. Nor to you, Champion of Frost."
        
        You and Calise both bow. 
        
        "At the least, though, I insist you stay for the celebrations tonight," Kelsaz says. "And you, [pc.name]. We should discuss what comes next."
        |"Your victory will live eternal in the annal of Khor'minos, but tonight, Champions, will be a night of celebration!" Kelsaz declares, standing. "You and all the valiant warriors who stood beside you deserve a hero's welcome — the best that the kingdom has to offer!"
        
        "You're too kind, King Kelsaz," Calise says. "We did only what was right."
        
        The king smiles at that, [var0
            |as does Varena.
            |though you catch a hint of a snarl on the Crown Prince's features, directed at your fellow Champion. Does he suspect what she really is? Or perhaps he just sees through the lies of her speech. Doing what's right... it's almost funny.
            |as does Varena... but the Crown Prince is practically snarling at Calise. Does he suspect what she really is? Or perhaps he just sees through the lies of her speech. Doing what's right... it's almost funny.
        ]
        
        Calise glances at you, and for a second you could swear you see her eyes flash golden. 
        
        "King Kelsaz," she says, taking a step forward. "Perhaps we could discuss what comes next, while the city prepares to celebrate?"
        
        "Ah, of course. You do hate to sit on your hands even for a moment!" Kelsaz says. "Come, then, Champions. Let us speak in private."
    ]
    
    "And to the rest of you," Raqian says, gesturing to a group of slave-servants standing in the wings. They hurry forth with kegs of beer and bottles of wine, to the cheering of your soldiers.
rows.translation:
你们返回城市的进程缓慢而平稳，偶尔会遭到山中残留的恶魔或翼龙的袭击，但总体来说还是相当平静的。你们的军队士气高涨，从山峰一直回到城市，一路上大家都在歌唱。 
    
    当你回到科尔米诺斯时，人们纷纷欢呼起来。人群聚集在你的队伍周围，向你赠送各种礼物并送上亲吻。当你沿着街道走向宫殿大门时，卡莉丝举起了你的手，这一举动象征着大家共同取得的胜利。你的一些士兵被心爱的人或即将成为恋人的人带进了人群中；就连伊莎多拉来到宫殿时，身上也沾满了口红痕迹。
    
    冲锋者们护送你进入宫殿，不久之后，你就站在了王座前，而凯尔萨兹国王则与拉基安大人一同走了进来[var0
        |瓦蕾娜公主
        |弗拉努斯王子，总体来说，是个性格平和的人。
        |他身旁的孩子们
    ]当国王登基时，你和你的战友们跪在他面前。“勇士们，你们胜利而归[pc.hasWings
        |翅膀
        |眼睛
    ]军团们已经报告，那些小妖怪的队伍正在陷入混乱，因为他们没有领袖了！大家干得真棒。今天将会被后人铭记为两位冠军扭转这场战争局势的关键时刻！”
    
	在场的士兵们爆发出一阵欢呼声，那些冲锋者也为你们鼓掌庆祝。你与卡莉丝交换了一个眼神。[bk.isChamp
        |看着那个女恶魔微微翻了个白眼，但她还是装作若无其事的样子，一边接受着那些虚假的赞美，一边向一些士兵点头致意，向另一些人挥手示意，还接受了他们的握手。到目前为止，还没有人察觉到什么异常。
        | 以及[calise.fucked
            |牵着她的手，尽情享受这一刻。
            |[kasyrra.fucked
                |牵起她的手，尽情享受这一刻。
                |尽量对人群微笑，维持着这两个完全正常的英雄、永远是盟友的假象。
            ]
        ]
    ]
    
    [bk.isChamp
        |卡莉丝深吸一口气，挺直身子，用响亮的声音对国王说道：“我的国王！我和冠军一起为您赢得了这场伟大的胜利。如今，战争的局势已经对您有利了。因此，我现在必须离开了。维伦的召唤将我引向别处，但我相信，在我的这位同伴的守护下，您一定会安然无恙的。 
        
        观众厅里顿时响起一片震惊的倒吸声。士兵们面面相觑，难以置信；就连凯尔萨兹国王也似乎被这一消息惊到了。
        
        “我……当然，如果维伦召唤你，卡莉丝女士，你完全可以离开，”国王在长时间的沉默后说道，“但你的离开不仅会影响到战争局势，也会让这个宫廷陷入空缺。我们有没有什么办法能说服你留下呢？
        
        卡莉丝摇了摇头说道：“凯尔萨兹国王，这座城市并不是唯一遭受苦难的地方。卡希拉正在威胁整个世界，无论她的邪恶势力蔓延到哪里，我都会坚决反抗。不过，我相信您能把事情处理得很好。”说着，她突然用力拍了拍你的肩膀，让你差点失去平衡。你努力忍住怒火，只是向国王点了点头，表示自己有信心完成这项任务。
        
        国王叹息着，但还是向卡莉丝点了点头。“那么，我祝你在旅途中一切顺利。请记住，科尔米诺斯城永远会将你视为朋友。对于你，维伦的冠军；对于你，霜之冠军，我们的城门也永远不会向你关闭。
        
        你和卡莉丝都鞠了一躬。
        
        “不过，至少我坚持要求你们留下来参加今晚的庆祝活动，”凯尔萨兹说道，“还有你[pc.name]我们应该讨论接下来该怎么做。
        |你们的胜利将永远载入科尔米诺斯的史册，但今晚，各位冠军们，将是庆祝的时刻！”凯尔萨兹站起身来宣布道，“你们以及所有与你们并肩作战的勇士们，都值得享受到最隆重的欢迎——这是这个王国所能提供的最高礼遇！”
        
        “您太客气了，凯尔萨兹国王，”卡莉丝说道，“我们只是做了应该做的事而已。”
        
        国王听到这番话，露出了微笑。 [var0
            |瓦雷娜也是如此。
            |尽管你能从王太子的面容上察觉到一丝怒意，那怒意是针对你的那位冠军同伴的。他是否怀疑她的真实身份？又或许，他只是看穿了她言辞中的谎言。做正确的事情……这简直有点可笑。
            |瓦蕾娜也是如此……但王储对卡莉丝的态度简直可以说是怒目而视。他是不是怀疑她的真实身份？又或者，他只是看穿了她那些虚伪的言辞？坚持做正确的事情……这种做法反而有点滑稽。
        ]
        
        卡莉丝瞥了你一眼，有那么一瞬间，你甚至觉得她的眼睛仿佛闪着金色的光芒。
        
        “凯尔萨兹国王，”她说道，向前迈了一步，“或许我们现在就可以讨论接下来该怎么做，而城里的人们也可以开始准备庆祝活动了。”
        
        “啊，当然。你可从来不喜欢闲着不动，哪怕只是片刻！”凯尔萨兹笑道，“来吧，各位勇士，让我们私下谈谈。
    ]
    
    至于你们其他人，”拉基安说道，同时指向站在一旁的一群奴隶仆从。在士兵们的欢呼声中，这些仆从急忙拿出了桶装啤酒和瓶装葡萄酒。
rows.raw:
'
    Your return to the city is slow and steady, harried occasionally by demon remnants or wyverns from the mountain, but by and large peaceful. Your troops' spirits are sky high, and your march is accompanied by singing all the way back from the peaks to the city. 
    
    When you arrive back in Khor'minos, it's to the cheers of the people. Crowds gather around your marching columns, showering you in favors and blown kisses. Calise lifts your hand, a show of shared triumph as you march through the streets and towards the palace gates. A few of your soldiers are whisked away into the crowd by loved ones, or soon-to-be lovers; even Isadora arrives at the palace covered in lipstick marks.
    
    The Chargers escort you in, and soon enough you're standing before the throne, with King Kelsaz striding in with Lord Raqian and [var0
        |Princess Varena
        |Prince Vrannusbut by and large peaceful
        |his children on either side of him
    ]. You and your comrades kneel before the king as he takes his throne. "Champions, you return with victory in your [pc.hasWings
        |wings
        |eyes
    ]! Already, the legions are reporting that the imp hordes are breaking, leaderless! Well done, all of you. Today will be remembered for generations as the day when the two Champions turned the tide of this war!"
    
	There's a general cheer from the assembled soldiers, and the Chargers clap for you. You exchange a look with Calise[bk.isChamp
        |, watching the demoness roll her eyes a little. Still, she behaves herself as the praise is heaped falsely upon her, nodding to a few soldiers, waving at others, accepting handshakes. Nobody's the wiser so far.
        | and [calise.fucked
            |take her hand, enjoying the moment.
            |[kasyrra.fucked
                |take her hand, enjoying the moment.
                |try to smile at the crowd, keeping up the illusion of two perfectly normal heroes, allies to the end.
            ]
        ]
    ]
    
    [bk.isChamp
        |Calise takes a breath and straightens her back, addressing the king in a booming voice for all to hear: "My king! The Champion and I delivered you a great victory. The war's balance is in your favor now. And with that, I must now take my leave. The call of Velun draws me elsewhere, but you will, I know, be in safe hands with my comrade here." 
        
        A shocked gasp runs throughout the audience hall. Soldiers look amongst themselves in disbelief, and even King Kelsaz seems taken aback. 
        
        "I... of course, you are free to leave if Velun calls you, Lady Calise," the king says following a long pause. "But you will leave an outsized hole not just in the war, but in this court. Is there anything at all we can do to convince you to stay?"
        
        Calise shakes her head. "This city isn't the only realm suffering, King Kelsaz. Kasyrra threatens all the world, and I mean to oppose her wherever her touch spreads filth like wildfire. But I leave you in good hands," she says, giving you such a violent slap on the shoulder that you nearly lose your footing. You try not to glower, instead giving the king a reassuring nod. You've got this.
        
        The king sighs, but inclines his head to Calise. "Then I wish you godspeed in your travels, and know that the City of Khor'minos will always consider you a friend. Our gates will never be shut to you, Champion of Velun. Nor to you, Champion of Frost."
        
        You and Calise both bow. 
        
        "At the least, though, I insist you stay for the celebrations tonight," Kelsaz says. "And you, [pc.name]. We should discuss what comes next."
        |"Your victory will live eternal in the annal of Khor'minos, but tonight, Champions, will be a night of celebration!" Kelsaz declares, standing. "You and all the valiant warriors who stood beside you deserve a hero's welcome — the best that the kingdom has to offer!"
        
        "You're too kind, King Kelsaz," Calise says. "We did only what was right."
        
        The king smiles at that, [var0
            |as does Varena.
            |though you catch a hint of a snarl on the Crown Prince's features, directed at your fellow Champion. Does he suspect what she really is? Or perhaps he just sees through the lies of her speech. Doing what's right... it's almost funny.
            |as does Varena... but the Crown Prince is practically snarling at Calise. Does he suspect what she really is? Or perhaps he just sees through the lies of her speech. Doing what's right... it's almost funny.
        ]
        
        Calise glances at you, and for a second you could swear you see her eyes flash golden. 
        
        "King Kelsaz," she says, taking a step forward. "Perhaps we could discuss what comes next, while the city prepares to celebrate?"
        
        "Ah, of course. You do hate to sit on your hands even for a moment!" Kelsaz says. "Come, then, Champions. Let us speak in private."
    ]
    
    "And to the rest of you," Raqian says, gesturing to a group of slave-servants standing in the wings. They hurry forth with kegs of beer and bottles of wine, to the cheering of your soldiers. 
    '

rows.original:
Your return to the city is slow and steady, harried occasionally by demon remnants or wyverns from the mountain, but by and large peaceful. Your troops' spirits are crushingly low, heads hung with a pallor of fear and confusion amongst them. How could their champion have fallen? The question lingers, and you haven't the time or heart to answer it again and again. 
    
    When you arrive back in Khor'minos, it's to the cheers of the people. Crowds gather around your marching columns, showering you in favors and blown kisses. A few of the soldiers wave back, especially those who hadn't worked with Calise before; Isadora's inconsolable, covering her tear-stained face beneath a scarf. Only a few of the assembled onlookers realize something's amiss, crying out Calise's name.
    
    You make your way to the palace as quick as you can, before the rumors begin to spread.
    
    The Chargers escort you in, and soon enough you're standing before the throne, with King Kelsaz striding in with Lord Raqian and [var0
        |Princess Varena
        |Prince Vrannus
        |his children on either side of him
    ]. You and your remaining officers kneel before the king as he takes his throne. "Champion, you return with victory in your [pc.hasWings
        |wings
        |eyes
    ]! Already, the legions are reporting that the imp hordes are breaking, leaderless! Though you[calise.fucked
        | and your
        |r
    ] comrades do not look to be in a celebratory mood. Tell us, what happened?"
    
    [var0
        |Varena gives you a worried look as she surveys the room. She notices who's missing first, you guess.
        |Vrannus bites a knuckle, trying to hide whatever emotion has come over him.
        |Varena gives you a worried look as she surveys the room, while Vrannus bites a knuckle, trying to hide whatever emotion has come over him.
    ]
    
    You repeat what you told the soldiers at the tower: that Calise [var1|fell in battle|disappeared the moment the fighting ended|was corrupted into a demon, and fled the field when her true identity was discovered]. 
    
    "Khaak," Kelsaz grunts. "[var2|How could we have been so blind!? I will have our soldiers tighten their grip around every entrance to the kingdom; she will never be allowed back in, in any guise!"|This is a terrible blow to the kingdom. Calise has been instrumental in our war since she first arrived, and has been a good friend to me as well. I am [var3|heartbroken, truly. And without even a body to bury... let it be known henceforth that this day will be a day of mourning for a Champion of Velun who gave her life to protect this city, and a day of thanks for all those who fought to free us from the demon menace."
    
    A number of soldiers around you salute, fists crashing against breastplates.|deeply saddened that she chose to leave, but I am glad for the help she gave us throughout this war. I expect the worst is now behind us, thanks to all of you. All those who fought today will forever be friends of Khor'minos, so long as this city stands!"]]
    
    "There will be victory celebrations tonight," the king declares. "[var3|And mourning, too. ]We will raise a glass for Calise, and for all those heroes who fought beside her!"
    
    The king stands, and gestures you up with him. "Come, Champion. There is more to discuss. Your soldiers deserve a chance to breathe and recover from the march."
rows.translation:
你缓缓而稳健地返回城市，途中偶尔会遭到山中残余的恶魔或翼龙的袭击，但总体来说，旅途还算平静。你的部队士气低落至极，他们的脸上都写满了恐惧与困惑。他们的英雄怎么可能会失败呢？这个疑问一直萦绕在心头，但你却没有时间和精力去一遍又一遍地思考这个问题。

当你回到科尔米诺斯时，人们正欢呼着迎接你的归来。人群聚集在你的行进队伍周围，向你赠送各种礼物，还送上热切的吻。有几位士兵向他们挥了挥手，尤其是那些之前没有与卡莉丝共事过的士兵；伊莎多拉则无法抑制自己的情绪，用围巾遮住了那张被泪水浸湿的脸。在场的旁观者中，只有少数人察觉到了不对劲，他们开始呼喊卡莉丝的名字。
    
    你尽快赶往宫殿，以免谣言开始传播。

冲锋者们护送你进入宫殿，不久之后，你就站在了王座前，而凯尔萨兹国王则与拉基安大人一同走了进来。 [var0
        |瓦蕾娜公主
        |弗拉努斯王子
        |他身旁的孩子们
    ]当国王登基时，你和剩下的官员们一起跪在他面前。“冠军，你胜利而归[pc.hasWings
        |翅膀
        |眼睛
    ]！ 目前，各军团已经报告称，那些兽人军队正在陷入混乱，完全没有领袖来指挥他们！虽然你[calise.fucked
        | 以及你的
        |r
    ]同志们，看起来大家并没有庆祝的情绪。告诉我们，到底发生了什么？
    
    [var0
        |瓦蕾娜环顾房间，脸上露出担忧的神情。她最先注意到了谁不见了，你猜是吧？
        |瓦兰努斯咬住指关节，试图隐藏自己心中涌起的那些情绪。
        |瓦蕾娜忧心忡忡地环顾着房间，而弗拉努斯则咬着手指关节，试图隐藏自己内心涌起的那些情绪。
    ]
    
    你重复了在塔楼里对士兵们说过的话：那就是关于卡莉丝的事[var1|在战斗中阵亡|战斗一结束，它就消失了。|她被邪恶力量侵蚀，变成了恶魔，在真相被揭露后便逃离了现场。]咔克，”凯尔萨兹低声说道。[var2|我们怎么会如此盲目呢！？我会命令我们的士兵严密把守王国的每一个入口，绝对不能让她以任何借口重新进入！|这对王国来说是一个沉重的打击。自从卡莉丝来到这里，她就在我们的战争中发挥了重要作用，同时她也是我的好朋友。我真是[var3|心碎了，真的是心碎了。而且甚至连一具可以安葬的遗体都没有……从今以后，让所有人都知道：这一天，将是为那位为保护这座城市而献出生命的维伦勇士哀悼的日子；同时，也是为所有为我们将我们从恶魔的威胁中解救出来而战斗的人们表达感激的日子。

你周围的许多士兵都向你们敬礼，他们的拳头狠狠地敲打着胸甲。|她选择离开，让我感到十分难过，但也很庆幸她在整个战争期间为我们提供了帮助。多亏了大家，我想最糟糕的时刻已经过去了。今天所有参与战斗的人们，只要这座城市依然存在，就永远会是科尔米诺斯的盟友！]]
    
    今晚将会举行胜利庆典，”国王宣布道。[var3|还有哀悼。 ]让我们为卡莉丝，以及所有与她并肩作战的英雄们举杯致敬！”

国王站起身来，示意你与他一同起身。“来吧，冠军。还有许多事情需要讨论。你的士兵们也需要机会休息，恢复体力。

Battle damage happens, and nobody stops you save for a couple of soldiers here and there saluting you, and bowing to the princess.[flags.FACELESS_CAPTURE | More attention is paid to your kitsune prisoner, corrupted and mutated as she is; the crowd parts where you walk, and it's not long before a group of Royal Chargers have fallen in to escort you. Isadora flaps her arms and stammers something about having just seen her leave, but you quietly reassure the young soldier that everything's already while the double-imposter slips inside without a word. She continues quietly grumbling about looking like a whore in a toga, but by now you've learned not to engage — she just wants any excuse to argue and complain. [calise.fucked |Despite her claims to the contrary, she does look just as stunning as... as Kasyrra did. Gods. ] When that's done, you resume your journey to the palace. ]
rows.translation: 幸运的是，返回科尔米诺斯的旅途并没有发生太多意外，几个小时后，你就重新回到了内城区。 [var0 |你们那些被囚禁的怪物令路过的镇民们感到恐惧与敬畏，人群纷纷避让，不敢靠近这些被锁链束缚的怪物。不久之后，一群皇家卫兵赶来护送你们，他们从宫殿中冲出来，想要弄清楚发生了什么。然而瓦蕾娜坚决拒绝回答他们的提问，只是简单地说必须见到她的父亲。 |城里的人群纷纷盯着你抓来的那个恶魔俘虏看，当你走动时，他们就像水一样散开了。孩子们尖叫着、哭喊着，这让本就脾气暴躁的卡莉丝更加愤怒。不久之后，就有几名镇卫兵围了上来，试图维持秩序。瓦蕾娜坚决拒绝回答他们的问题，只是简单地说必须见到她的父亲。 |所有人的目光都集中在你抓来的那只狐狸囚犯身上——毕竟她已经被腐蚀、发生了变异。当你走进城市时，人群会自动为你让开道路，不久之后，一群皇家冲锋队员就会出现来护送你。然而瓦蕾娜坚决拒绝回答他们的任何问题，只是简单地表示必须见她的父亲。 |[bk.isChamp |卡莉丝穿着破烂不堪的盔甲，那些盔甲只是用你背包里的绳子勉强固定在一起，因此她引来了一些奇怪的目光。不过你想，这种事情其实也不应该让任何人感到惊讶吧。战斗中难免会有人受伤，而除了有几位士兵向你敬礼、向公主行礼之外，也没有人会阻止你继续行动。[flags.FACELESS_CAPTURE | 人们更加关注你的那只狐狸囚犯了——毕竟她已经被腐蚀、发生了变异。当你走动时，人群会自动让开道路，不久之后，一群皇家冲锋队员便前来护送你。然而瓦蕾娜坚决拒绝回答他们的任何问题，只是简单地表示必须见到她的父亲。 ] ] ] [bknight.isChamp |你经过卡莉丝的公寓，为她取来了适合参加皇家宴会的换洗衣物。伊莎多拉挥舞着手臂，结结巴巴地说自己刚才还看到她离开了，但你悄悄地安慰这位年轻士兵，告诉他一切都已经安排妥当了。而那个冒名顶替者则一言不发地溜了进去。 她继续小声抱怨，说穿着托加袍看起来就像个妓女，但你现在已经知道不应该跟她争论——她只是想找任何借口来抱怨和发牢骚罢了。 [calise.fucked |尽管她声称并非如此，但实际上她的确和……和卡希拉一样美丽动人。天啊。 ] 完成这些之后，你就可以继续你的旅程，前往宫殿了。 ]

rows.original: It takes the better part of an hour before you finally stand before the king, freshly sat upon his throne with his hair still glistening from the bath. You remember seeing guards around the last time you were here, but now there's a full company of Chargers standing along the flanks of the audience hall, heavy armor and two-handed axes on display. Lord Ignafaerus stands at the king's right hand, hands clasped behind his back, sporting a beauty of a bruise on his brow from your fight in the tunnels.[var0| You wonder if every guest gets this sort of attention, or just ones escorting his daughter back from the front lines of a conflict on an unauthorized mission.] "[pc.name]," Kelsaz says evenly, taking a goblet from a slave that scurries to his side. "Varena. I'm sure you don't need me to tell you how unsettling your behavior has been. I have reports of you causing disturbances all over town, from the docks to the bath house, and now..." he looks pointedly at you, "I hear my daughter has been swept out of the city into the dangerous warrens of the Undermountain and-" "Dad! We just came back from destroying the demons' base. We [flags.BK_KILLED |killed |took down ] their general! Don't give [pc.name] a hard time for doing what you and everybody else wanted [pc.himHer] to." The princess's outburst takes the king aback, making him choke on his words for a moment. The soldier at his side stifles the slightest hint of a grin. Kelsaz's big, black-furred fingers tighten around the arm rests of the throne, and he leans forward to stare down at the both of you. "I know. But no amount of heroism excuses going behind my back and putting my daughter at risk." "I want to be at risk! I'm tired of sitting around like an ornament. And it worked."
rows.translation: 将近一个小时后，你才终于站到国王面前。他刚在王座上坐定，头发仍闪烁着沐浴后的水光。你记得上次来时周围只有几名守卫，如今却有整整一连的冲锋者沿接见厅两侧列队，展示着重甲和双手斧。伊格纳法鲁斯领主站在国王右手边，双手背在身后；你们在隧道中的交手，给他额头留下一块漂亮的淤青。[var0|你不禁想知道，是每位来宾都能享受这般阵仗，还是只有那些擅自执行任务、护送他女儿从战斗前线归来的人才有此待遇。] “[pc.name]。”凯尔萨兹语气平淡，从匆匆跑到身边的奴隶手中接过酒杯，“瓦蕾娜。我想不必由我告诉你，你最近的举动有多么令人不安。我收到的报告称，你在城里四处引发骚动，从码头到浴场都有。而现在……”他意味深长地看向你，“我又听说，我的女儿被人带出城市，深入了山腹深域危险的隧道，而且——” “爸爸！我们刚摧毁恶魔的基地回来。我们[flags.BK_KILLED |杀死了 |打败了 ]它们的将军！[pc.name]做了你和所有人都希望[pc.himHer]做的事，别为难人家。” 公主的爆发令国王猝不及防，一时被自己的话噎住。他身旁的士兵极力压下嘴角那一丝笑意。凯尔萨兹覆有黑毛的粗大手指收紧，抓住王座扶手；他倾身向前，俯视着你们两人。“我知道。但无论立下多少英雄功绩，都不能成为你背着我行事、让我女儿身陷险境的借口。” “我就想身陷险境！我受够了像个摆件似的坐在这里。而且这次成功了。”
rows.raw: ' It takes the better part of an hour before you finally stand before the king, freshly sat upon his throne with his hair still glistening from the bath. You remember seeing guards around the last time you were here, but now there's a full company of Chargers standing along the flanks of the audience hall, heavy armor and two-handed axes on display. Lord Ignafaerus stands at the king's right hand, hands clasped behind his back, sporting a beauty of a bruise on his brow from your fight in the tunnels.[var0| You wonder if every guest gets this sort of attention, or just ones escorting his daughter back from the front lines of a conflict on an unauthorized mission.] "[pc.name]," Kelsaz says evenly, taking a goblet from a slave that scurries to his side. "Varena. I'm sure you don't need me to tell you how unsettling your behavior has been. I have reports of you causing disturbances all over town, from the docks to the bath house, and now..." he looks pointedly at you, "I hear my daughter has been swept out of the city into the dangerous warrens of the Undermountain and-" "Dad! We just came back from destroying the demons' base. We [flags.BK_KILLED |killed |took down ] their general! Don't give [pc.name] a hard time for doing what you and everybody else wanted [pc.himHer] to." The princess's outburst takes the king aback, making him choke on his words for a moment. The soldier at his side stifles the slightest hint of a grin. Kelsaz's big, black-furred fingers tighten around the arm rests of the throne, and he leans forward to stare down at the both of you. "I know. But no amount of heroism excuses going behind my back and putting my daughter at risk." "I want to be at risk! I'm tired of sitting around like an ornament. And it worked." '

rows.original: The king sighs. "So you say." His attention shifts towards Calise. "Champion of Velun. I thought you had left with your soldiers, to destroy this base. What changed?" Calise straightens her back and clasps her hands behind her back. "The Princess and... other Champion... asked me to come with them. Should I not have?" The king shakes his head. "No, it is alright. I suppose if the fortress you set out to conquer has already been destroyed, there's no point in besieging it." "Actually, dad, we need to tell you something... it's about Calise." "Yes, what about me?" You turn about as the audience hall doors open, and Calise — the one you've known all along — strides in, accompanied by Isadora and a cadre of her soldiers. "It seems we missed the party, Majesty. We — oh!" She stops, facing her doppelganger dead on. "Oh, my, what's this? [pc.name], you seem to have found someone wearing my face. And clothes. If I'd known it was this easy to fool the royal court-" "You'd have done it yourself?" you snap. [calise.isKasyrra |"Darling... what are you playing at?" Kasyrra says, a dangerous edge in her voice. "This isn't like you." You shake your head. "You aren't manipulating me any more." ] "[silly |Now there are two of them! This is getting out of hand! |What is the meaning of this? ]" Kelsaz says, pushing himself to his feet. Well this isn't how you wanted this to go down, but... "She's a demon!" you say, pointing to Kasyrra. "You've all been deceived!" "I think you'll find that she is the demon!" Kasyrra retorts, pointing at Calise. [silly |Great, it's like that Spider Man meme now. ] "Yeah!" Isadora says, taking a defensive step in front of Kasyrra and swinging her shield off her back. On the opposite end, Raqian and several chargers close ranks around their king. All eyes are on Calise, and you. And then you hear an excited clap from the sidelines, and Prince Vrannus steps into view.
rows.translation: 国王叹了口气。“你是这么说的。” 他将注意力转向卡莉丝。“维伦的冠军。我以为你已经带兵出发，准备摧毁那座基地了。发生了什么变化？” 卡莉丝挺直腰背，将双手扣在身后。“公主和……另一位冠军……请我和他们同行。难道我不该去吗？” 国王摇了摇头。“不，没关系。既然你原本准备征服的要塞已经被摧毁，自然也就没有继续围攻的必要了。” “其实，爸爸，我们有件事得告诉你……是关于卡莉丝的。” “对，关于我什么事？” 接见厅的大门打开，你转过身去。卡莉丝——你始终认识的那位卡莉丝——在伊莎多拉和一队士兵的陪同下大步走了进来。“看来我们错过了好戏，陛下。我们——哦！” 她停下脚步，与自己的冒牌货正面对峙。“哎呀，这是怎么回事？[pc.name]，你好像找到了一个披着我的面孔、还穿着我衣服的人。早知道王廷这么容易糊弄——” “你就会亲自来骗？”你厉声打断她。 [calise.isKasyrra |“亲爱的……你到底在玩什么把戏？”卡希拉说道，声音中透出危险的锋芒，“这可不像你。” 你摇了摇头。“你再也别想操纵我。” ] “[silly |现在有两个了！事情开始失控了！ |这到底是什么意思？ ]”凯尔萨兹说着站起身来。 这可不是你希望事情败露的方式，不过…… “她是恶魔！”你指向卡希拉，“你们全都受骗了！” “我看，她才是恶魔！”卡希拉指向卡莉丝反驳道。[silly |太好了，现在简直就是那张蜘蛛侠梗图。 ] “没错！”伊莎多拉说道，向前一步挡在卡希拉身前，并从背后卸下盾牌。另一侧，拉奇安与几名冲锋者也围拢起来，护住国王。所有人的目光都落在卡莉丝和你身上。 就在这时，场边传来兴奋的拍手声，弗兰努斯王子走入众人视野。

rows.original: "Leave it to the Champion of Frost to keep us all entertained," Vrannus says, voice airy as a spring's morning. He doesn't have a care in the world. "But I think I believe [pc.himHer], and my dear sister. Our Champion of Velun has been playing us for a good long time." Varena blinks. "You knew?" "Suspected," Vrannus says. "Just like you, sister. I've been following the trail of one of her agents in the city, hoping it would lead me to the source. But you've found the proof before me, it seems." The king steeples his fingers. "Both my children stand against one of you, as does the Champion of Frost. What say you to your defense, Calise?" The soldiers around Kasyrra take a threatening step closer. You can see Isadora's hackles go up, but Kasyrra puts a restraining hand on her shoulder. "I see my deceptions have worked far too well on you, naive worm. You truly had no idea! Laughable!" "My lady?" Kasyrra pushes her away, hard enough to make Isadora topple onto her side, and draws the axe from her back. "I say your children speak true, king. I am Kasyrra, Queen of Demons, Unrivaled Mistress of the Cult. And I have come to deliver a message: the war you endured is now over. Your daughter and Champion have accomplished my goals, and now our business is concluded. Do not attempt to find or foil me, and your people will be spared." She laughs wickedly, and turns her gaze to you. "[kasyrra.hlr |A fine puppet you make, [pc.name], but now I must cut your strings! Now I can see full well that you have risen to your potential, and soon your soul will be mine... but not today. You've played well, to force me into the open. Bravo, truly! |You've done well to make it this far, [pc.name], and well played in forcing my hand here. But now your soul has grown ripe for the harvest. Come to me, and we shall see at last which of us prevails. I cannot wait! |You've played well, my love, to force me into the open! Our games of deceit are so exhilarating... but it seems I've been outplayed. So I'll take my bow, now, and bid farewell 'till next we meet... and I do so look forward to paying your asshole back for this delightful insolence! ]" Even with Kas out in the open, you can feel gazes from all around the room boring into you. She always does know just what to say... Still, King Keslaz addresses her before you. "You wage war on my kingdom, demon, and then think you get to decide when it is finished? No! Khor'minos will hunt you and your co-conspirators until the end of days for what you have done, to the lives of my subjects and to the honor of this court!" "Oh, my dear king, I do wish to see you try. But another day. I have what I came for." Kelsaz motions to his Chargers, and as one they raise their shields and draw their blades, beginning to advance on the demoness. "Lady Calise!" Isadora gasps. "Please, don't do this!" Kasyrra gives the young soldier a look, somewhere between pity and remorse, and then slams her axe into the ground with so much force that the tiles underhoof shatter. The shockwave sends the soldiers flying back, and Kasyrra takes wing, shrouding herself in a haze of magic that twists the light around her until she's vanished before your eyes. "Find her!" the king bellows. But you know the score by now, she's long gone... and left you hold the bag, words woven to make you look like a traitor. Shit.
rows.translation: 就让冰霜冠军来为我们所有人带来欢乐吧，”弗兰努斯说道，他的声音如同春天的清晨般清脆悦耳。他似乎完全无忧无虑。“不过，我有点怀疑[pc.himHer]还有我亲爱的妹妹。我们的维伦冠军已经为我们效力了很长时间。” 瓦蕾娜眨了眨眼：“你早就知道了？” “只是有所怀疑而已，”弗兰努斯说道，“就像你一样，妹妹。我一直在追踪她派在城里的一个代理人，希望这能帮助我找到幕后黑手。不过，你似乎已经找到了比我更有力的证据。” 国王将手指交叉在一起：“我的两个孩子都站在了你们中的某一方对立面，就连霜之冠军也是如此。卡莉丝，你对此有何解释？” 卡希拉周围的士兵们纷纷向前迈出了威胁性的步伐。你可以看到伊莎多拉的怒火正在燃烧，但卡希拉却把手放在她的肩上，制止了她。“看来我的欺骗手段对你来说确实太有效了，天真的傻瓜。你真的什么都不明白！真是可笑！” “我的夫人？” 卡希拉用力将她推开，使得伊莎多拉摔到了旁边，然后从背后抽出了那把斧头。陛下，您的孩子们说的是实话。我是卡希拉，恶魔女王，邪教无与伦比的女主人。我来是为了传达一个消息：您所经历的战争已经结束了。您的女儿和那位勇士已经实现了我的目标，因此我们的使命已经完成。不要试图找到我或阻止我，否则你的人民将会免于遭害。” 她邪恶地笑了，然后将目光转向了你。[kasyrra.hlr |你制作的这个木偶真是太精致了。 [pc.name]，但是现在，我必须切断与你之间的联系了！我清楚地看到，你已经充分发挥了自己的潜力，而你的灵魂……也即将迎来属于它的时刻。会属于我的……但不是今天。你玩得真好，成功把我逼到了绝境。真棒，真的！ |你能走到这一步，已经做得非常不错了。 [pc.name]，你确实把我的处境逼到了绝境，干得漂亮。但现在，你的“灵魂”已经成熟，可以被收割了。来到我面前吧，让我们最终看看谁会获胜。我等不及了！ |你玩得真棒，我的宝贝，竟然把我逼到了公开场合！我们的这场欺骗游戏真是太刺激了……不过看来这次是我输给了你。那么，现在我就告辞了，期待下次再见的时候，能好好报复你这种令人愉快的无礼行为！ ]即使卡丝已经公开露面，你仍然能感觉到房间里的所有人都在用目光注视着你。她总是那么懂得该说些什么…… 不过，凯斯拉兹国王还是在你之前先对她说了话：“恶魔，你向我的王国发动战争，难道还以为可以自己决定这场战争何时结束吗？不！科尔米诺斯会追捕你和你的同谋，直到世界末日，为你们所犯下的罪行负责——这些罪行夺去了我的子民的生命，也玷污了这座宫廷的尊严！” “哦，我亲爱的国王，我倒很想看看您如何应对。不过，改天再谈吧。我得到了我想要的东西。” 凯尔萨兹向他的战士们发出了指令，他们立刻举起了盾牌，拔出了武器，开始向那位女恶魔逼近。 “卡莉丝女士！”伊莎多拉惊呼道，“求您，千万不要这样做！卡希拉瞥了那名年轻士兵一眼，眼中既有怜悯也有懊悔，然后她用力将斧头插入地面，巨大的冲击力甚至使地面的瓷砖都碎裂了。冲击波将周围的士兵们震得向后倒退，而卡希拉则展开了翅膀，身上环绕着一层魔法光晕，那光芒扭曲着周围的光线，让她在转眼间就从你的视线中消失了。 找到她！”国王怒吼道。但你们现在应该都明白了吧，她早就逃走了……而把烂摊子留给了你们，那些被编造出来的话只会让你们看起来像叛徒。真他妈的。

rows.original:
A few minutes later, the Chargers declare the throne hall safe once again. Isadora's still lying where Kasyrra tossed her down, staring at the floor; Varena has taken a step closer to you, putting herself between you and the king... though Kelsaz's eyes have been boring holes in you since the Demon Queen made her exit. The prince, too, regards you with interest, arms crossed over his willowy chest. 
    
    "Daddy, Vranny..."
    
    Kelsaz puts up his hand. "Allow the Champion to speak for [pc.himHer]self, Varena. The Demon Queen's words do not paint a promising picture, but [pc.heShe] has done enough to warrant being heard out, at least."
    
    "As did Calise," Vrannus says. "And yet... speaking of whom, what are we to do with this one? Calises seem to be growing on trees today."
    
    "Are you a demon, too, woman?" Keslaz asks.
    
    Calise's lips draw taut. You give her a nod. "Yes, Your Grace. Not by choice. The bitch-queen captured me early in the war. These two... found me in the demon fort, and brought me here. They thought it would be easier on the city if you didn't unmask the queen wearing my clothes in public."
    
    "Ah, yes, we should certainly lie to the entire city! Father I must protest," Vrannus says. 
    
    "First I would hear from [pc.name]," the king says.
    
    Choose your words carefully...
rows.translation:
几分钟后，冲锋者们宣布王座厅再次安全。伊莎多拉仍躺在卡希拉把她扔下的地方，凝视地板；瓦蕾娜向你靠近一步，挡在你与国王之间……不过自恶魔女王离开后，凯尔萨兹的目光便一直死死盯着你。王子也饶有兴致地看着你，双臂交叉在纤细的胸前。
    
    “爸爸，弗拉尼……”
    
    凯尔萨兹抬起一只手。“瓦蕾娜，让勇士替[pc.himHer]自己说话。恶魔女王的话确实不容乐观，但至少[pc.heShe]已经做了足够多的事情，值得我们听完辩解。”
    
    “卡莉丝也一样。”弗兰努斯说道，“不过……说到她，我们该怎么处理这一位？今天的卡莉丝简直像树上长出来的一样多。”
    
    “女人，你也是恶魔吗？”凯尔萨兹问道。
    
    卡莉丝抿紧嘴唇。你朝她点点头。“是的，陛下，但并非出于自愿。那个贱人女王在战争初期俘虏了我。这两个人……在恶魔堡垒里找到我，又把我带到这里。他们认为，与其在公众面前揭穿那个穿着我衣服的女王，暂时隐瞒真相对城市更有利。”
    
    “啊，没错，我们当然应该欺骗全城！父亲，我必须反对。”弗兰努斯说道。
    
    “我想先听[pc.name]解释。”国王说道。
    
    谨慎选择你的措辞……

    "Daddy, Vranny..."

    "As did Calise," Vrannus says. "And yet... speaking of whom, what are we to do with this one? Calises seem to be growing on trees today."
    
    "Are you a demon, too, woman?" Keslaz asks.
    
    Calise's lips draw taut. You give her a nod. "Yes, Your Grace. Not by choice. The bitch-queen captured me early in the war. These two... found me in the demon fort, and brought me here. They thought it would be easier on the city if you didn't unmask the queen wearing my clothes in public."
    
    "Ah, yes, we should certainly lie to the entire city! Father I must protest," Vrannus says. 
    
    "First I would hear from [pc.name]," the king says.
    
    Choose your words carefully... 
    '

rows.original: Ever since she arrived in Savarra, Kasyrra's made one thing clear: she wants your soul for her experiments, and will stop at nothing to claim it.
rows.translation: 自从她来到萨瓦拉，卡希拉就明确表示了一件事：她想要你的灵魂用于她的实验，而且会不择手段地得到它。
rows.raw: "Ever since she arrived in Savarra, Kasyrra's made one thing clear: she wants your soul for her experiments, and will stop at nothing to claim it."

rows.original: Kasyrra just wants to stir chaos in the royal court, spreading lies and confusion everywhere she goes!
rows.translation: 卡希拉只是想在皇宫里制造混乱，无论她走到哪里，都会散布谎言和制造混乱！
rows.raw: "Kasyrra just wants to stir chaos in the royal court, spreading lies and confusion everywhere she goes!"

rows.original: You hate Kasyrra, what she represents, what's she's done. Anything she says it to try and slow you down.
rows.translation: 你恨卡希拉，恨她所代表的一切，恨她所做的一切。她说的每一句话，都是为了拖慢你的脚步。
rows.raw: "You hate Kasyrra, what she represents, what's she's done. Anything she says it to try and slow you down."

rows.original: Kasyrra fooled everyone, you included — you worst of all, considering she tricked you into bed with her. You feel violated.
rows.translation: 卡希拉骗了所有人，也骗了你——你受骗最深，毕竟她还把你骗上了床。你感到自己受到了侵犯。
rows.raw: "Kasyrra fooled everyone, you included — you worst of all, considering she tricked you into bed with her. You feel violated."

rows.original: Admit it in front of everyone: you love Kasyrra, and you don't care who knows it. What are they going to do about it?
rows.translation: 在所有人面前承认吧：你喜欢卡希拉，而且你不在乎别人会不会知道。他们又能怎么样呢？
rows.raw: "Admit it in front of everyone: you love Kasyrra, and you don't care who knows it. What are they going to do about it?"

rows.original: You've spent all this time trying to redeem Kasyrra — to bring back the courageous and kind lady-knight that she once was.
rows.translation: 你花费了这么多时间，试图让卡希拉重获新生——让那位曾经勇敢而善良的女骑士重新回到人们面前。
rows.raw: "You've spent all this time trying to redeem Kasyrra — to bring back the courageous and kind lady-knight that she once was."

rows.original:
"Kasyrra wants my soul. There's something special about that makes her obsess over it," you admit, looking between Kelsaz and his children. "She's been stalking me ever since she got here. I can't get her to leave me alone!"
    
    "A likely story," Vrannus says. "Or she's scouting you to become an agent of hers. If you aren't already..."
    
    Varena gasps. "Vrannus! [pc.name] helped us..."
    
    "So did Kasyrra, by all appearances," Vrannus says. "But to what end? We'd be fools to trust her beneficence... or [pc.name]'s innocence. [pc.HeShe] has clearly been in league with Kasyrra since [pc.heShe] arrived in the city. It's a matter of record."
    
    King Kelsaz sighs and steeples his fingers. "Even if you are not an agent of the enemy, [pc.name], it is clear their leader considers you a valuable asset. One we should deny to her."
    
    "Daddy, no!" Varena protests. "After everything we've done!?"
    
    "Your Majesty!" Isadora gasps. "Don't take [pc.himHer] away too!"
    
    "Make this easy on yourself, [pc.name]," Kelsaz says. "If you are innocent, you will have ample time to prove it. I will remand you to Vrannus's custody for a few days; my son has been working on tests to confirm a person's purity."
    
    Surrounded by a hundred of the kingdom's best soldiers, you have little choice but to drop your [pc.weapon] and let them take you.
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Bunch of gods-damned ingrates...
        |This has to be some kind of mistake...
    ]
    
    "Can I have Calise too?" Vrannus asks. "Perhaps I can find some way to revert her."
    
    Kelsaz nods. "Take her too."
    
    "Fuck this bullshit! I was promised freedom!"
rows.translation:
“卡希拉想要我的灵魂。那里面似乎有什么特别之处，令她对此执迷不悟。”你坦言道，目光在凯尔萨兹与他的子女之间移动，“她来到这里以后就一直跟踪我。我根本甩不掉她！”
    
    “倒是个像模像样的故事。”弗兰努斯说道，“也可能是她在考察你，准备让你成为她的代理人。除非你已经是了……”
    
    瓦蕾娜倒吸一口气。“弗兰努斯！[pc.name]帮助过我们……”
    
    “表面上看，卡希拉也帮助过我们。”弗兰努斯说道，“但她有何目的？若是信任她的善心……或是[pc.name]的清白，我们就是傻瓜。[pc.HeShe]从[pc.heShe]抵达这座城市开始，显然就一直与卡希拉有所勾结。这一点已有记录。”
    
    凯尔萨兹国王叹了口气，十指指尖相抵。“即便你并非敌人的代理人，[pc.name]，也显然被她们的首领视作珍贵的资产。我们不该让她得到这项资产。”
    
    “爸爸，不要！”瓦蕾娜抗议道，“我们都做了那么多事了！？”
    
    “陛下！”伊莎多拉倒吸一口气，“别连[pc.himHer]也带走！”
    
    “别让事情变得更难看，[pc.name]。”凯尔萨兹说道，“如果你是无辜的，自然有充分的时间证明。我会将你交给弗兰努斯看管几天；我儿子一直在研究检验一个人纯洁程度的方法。”
    
    被王国最优秀的一百名士兵包围，你别无选择，只能放下[pc.weapon]，任由他们将你带走。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |一群诸神诅咒的忘恩负义之徒……
        |这一定是什么误会……
    ]
    
    “我能把卡莉丝也带走吗？”弗兰努斯问道，“或许我能找到让她恢复原状的方法。”
    
    凯尔萨兹点点头。“也把她带走。”
    
    “去他妈的鬼话！他们明明答应过给我自由！”

rows.original:
"She's just trying to sow discord!" you say. "That's what she does. She's a demon."
    
    "True enough," Kelsaz says. "And, conspiring to endanger my daughter aside, you have given [flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE|me|the kingdom] leal service."
    
    Vrannus clicks his tongue. "Still, we can't be too careful. Father, if you'd permit me, I'd like to confine [pc.name] for a short while. To test [pc.hisHer] purity. We can't afford another Calise incident."
    
    "Daddy, no!" Varena pleads. "Not after everything we've done. [pc.HeShe] doesn't deserve that!"
    
    "The kingdom doesn't deserve what's happened to it," Kelsaz says sadly. "But these are dangerous times, full of dangerous people. My son is right, [pc.name]. We can't take risks with someone as important as you. We must be sure, before we continue to prosecute this war."
    
    "Your Majesty, please..."
    
    "Make this easy on yourself, [pc.name]," Kelsaz says. "If you are innocent, you will have ample time to prove it. I will remand you to Vrannus's custody for a few days; my son has been working on tests to confirm a person's purity."

rows.translation:
“她只是想挑起内讧！”你说道。“她就是干这个的。她是个恶魔。”
    
    “说得没错，”凯尔萨兹说。“而且，撇开密谋危及我女儿不谈，你为[flags.KM_FEAST_KELSAZ_INTIMATE|我|这个王国]效过忠。”
    
    弗兰努斯咂了咂舌。“不过，再怎么小心也不为过。父亲，如果您允许，我想把[pc.name]关押一小段时间。检验一下[pc.hisHer]纯洁。我们承受不起又一起卡莉丝那样的事件。”
    
    “爸爸，不要！”瓦蕾娜恳求道。“我们已经做了这么多，不能这样。 [pc.HeShe]不该受到这种对待！”
    
    “这个王国不该遭受这样的命运，”凯尔萨兹悲伤地说。“但如今是危险的时代，到处都是危险的人。我儿子说得对， [pc.name]。对像你这样重要的人物，我们不能冒险。在继续打这场战争之前，我们必须确定。”
    
    “陛下，求您……”
    
    “别让自己难堪， [pc.name]，”凯尔萨兹说。“如果你是清白的，你会有充足的时间来证明。我会把你交给弗兰努斯看管几天；我儿子一直在研究能确认一个人是否纯洁的检验方法。”
    
    王国最精锐的上百名士兵将你围住，你别无选择，只能丢下你的[pc.weapon]，任由他们带走你。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |一群该死的忘恩负义之徒……
        |这一定是什么误会……
    ]
    
    “卡莉丝也能给我吗？”弗兰努斯问道。“也许我能找到办法把她变回去。”
    
    凯尔萨兹点点头。“把她也带走。”
    
    “去他妈的！说好了给我自由的！”

rows.original: "I hate her," you seethe. "I'm going to stop her. She just wants to use you to slow me down." Kelsaz laughs. "Well said. I suspected as much." Vrannus clicks his tongue. "Still, we can't be too careful. Father, if you'd permit me, I'd like to confine [pc.name] for a short while. To test [pc.hisHer] purity. We can't afford another Calise incident." "Daddy, no!" Varena pleads. "Not after everything we've done. [pc.HeShe] doesn't deserve that!" "The kingdom doesn't deserve what's happened to it," Kelsaz says sadly. "But I can feel the hate in [pc.name]'s voice. The rage! You'd have made a good Charger in another like. Vrannus, you will have to make do with the captives you already have. We must discuss what is to be done now, with one of our Champions fled." "The city doesn't need to know that," you suggest. "Now when we have the real Calise right here. She can say her farewells now that the enemy has been broken, and leave a hero." Kelsaz narrows his eyes, then laughs. "I suppose we do. I dislike lying to my people, though I recognize morale will crumble any other way." You glance over your shoulder, watching a variety of emotions playing across Isadora's face. Disgust, horror, sorrow. Poor girl. "That's what I'm here for," Calise says. "Your Champion here said I could go free if I made a show of it, and promised not to hurt anyone after." "And what would you do with freedom, demon?" Vrannus says. Calise ponders that for a moment, then gives him an ugly smirk. "Find the biggest, ugliest monster in the Marches to get myself killed fighting." The king laughs. "Now that's the attitude I expected of the rumored Calise, Champion of Velun, when she first arrived. Very well, if [pc.name] and my daughter both vouch for you in turn..." You and Varena nod. "... Then I permit you go free, under [pc.name]'s aegis. And you, [pc.name]... if you feel as we do, that the Demon Queen must be punished for her deceptions, then allow me to aid you once more in your quest."
rows.translation: “我恨她，”你咬牙切齿地说。“我要阻止她。她只是想利用你来拖慢我的脚步。” 凯尔萨兹笑了。“说得好。我也这么怀疑过。” 弗兰努斯咂了咂舌。“不过，我们再小心也不为过。父亲，如果您允许，我想把[pc.name]暂时关押一阵子，检验[pc.hisHer]纯洁。我们不能再出一次卡莉丝那样的事了。” “爸爸，不要！”瓦蕾娜恳求道。“在我们做了这么多之后，不能再这样。[pc.HeShe]不该受这种对待！” “这个王国不该遭这样的罪，”凯尔萨兹悲伤地说。“但我能听出[pc.name]声音里的恨意。那份怒火！换一种人生，你会成为一名出色的冲锋者。弗兰努斯，你只能用现有的俘虏将就了。我们的一位冠军已经逃走，现在必须商量接下来该怎么办。” “城里的人没必要知道这件事，”你提议道。“反正我们手头就有真正的卡莉丝。敌人已被击溃，她可以就此告别，然后以英雄的身份离开。” 凯尔萨兹眯起眼睛，随后笑了。“我想也确实如此。我不喜欢对我的人民撒谎，但我也明白，换个做法士气就会崩溃。” 你回头望了一眼，看着各种情绪在伊莎多拉脸上交替浮现。厌恶、恐惧、悲伤。可怜的姑娘。 “我就是为此而来的，”卡莉丝说。“你们这位冠军说过，只要我演得像样，就放我自由，还答应之后不伤害任何人。” “那你要自由做什么，恶魔？”弗兰努斯说。 卡莉丝思索了片刻，然后朝他露出一个难看的笑。“去边境地区找一头最大、最丑的怪物，让自己战死。” 国王笑了。“这才是我听说过的、维伦的冠军卡莉丝初来时所期待的态度。很好，如果[pc.name]和我的女儿都愿意依次为你作保……” 你和瓦蕾娜点了点头。 “……那么，我准许你在[pc.name]的庇护下自由离去。而你，[pc.name]……如果你和我们一样，认为魔后必须为她的欺瞒受到惩罚，那就让我再一次在你的使命中助你一臂之力。”

rows.raw: ' "She tricked me worst of all," you say. "Tricked me into sleeping with her. I thought she was Calise. I thought..." "It's true!" Isadora chimes in. "[pc.name] didn't do anything wrong. We all thought she was so kind, so... so awesome! She was irresistible." Varena nods. "You can't blame [pc.name] for falling for the same duplicity we all did, Daddy. [pc.HeShe] is the victim here, more than most." Kelsaz sighs, steepling his fingers. "The heart does lead one astray, hm? You can hardly be blamed for that. Your affection for Lady Calise was well known to me, but you've gone well out of your way to disrupt her plans, and if Varena and the Chargers vouch for you..." Vrannus clicks his tongue. "Still, we can't be too careful. Father, if you'd permit me, I'd like to confine [pc.name] for a short while. To test [pc.hisHer] purity. We can't afford another Calise incident." "Daddy, no!" Varena pleads. "Not after everything we've done. [pc.HeShe] doesn't deserve that!" "The kingdom doesn't deserve what's happened to it," Kelsaz says sadly. "But you are right. [pc.name] has been abused enough. Vrannus, you will have to make do with the captives you already have. We must discuss what is to be done now, with one of our Champions fled." "The city doesn't need to know that," you suggest. "Now when we have the real Calise right here. She can say her farewells now that the enemy has been broken, and leave a hero." Kelsaz narrows his eyes, then laughs. "I suppose we do. I dislike lying to my people, though I recognize morale will crumble any other way." You glance over your shoulder, watching a variety of emotions playing across Isadora's face. Disgust, horror, sorrow. Poor girl. "That's what I'm here for," Calise says. "Your Champion here said I could go free if I made a show of it, and promised not to hurt anyone after." "And what would you do with freedom, demon?" Vrannus says. Calise ponders that for a moment, then gives him an ugly smirk. "Find the biggest, ugliest monster in the Marches to get myself killed fighting." The king laughs. "Now that's the attitude I expected of the rumored Calise, Champion of Velun, when she first arrived. Very well, if [pc.name] and my daughter both vouch for you in turn..." You and Varena nod. "... Then I permit you go free, under [pc.name]'s aegis. And you, [pc.name]... if you feel as we do, that the Demon Queen must be punished for her deceptions, then allow me to aid you once more in your quest." '

rows.original:
You turn to the king and give him a genuine smile. "I love her. I'm not afraid to say it. I love Kasyrra!"
    
    Varena, Isadora, even Kelsaz — just about everyone but the Crown Prince gasps in surprise. Vrannus just throws his head back and laughs, "Oh, gods, you're serious? And you just came out and say it for all to hear, are you mad?"
    
    "Madly in love," you say proudly.
    
    "Ha! It seems Champions are just as vulnerable to corruption as the rest of us," Vrannus says. "Father, let me take these two so-called Champions into custody. I will find a way to break the taint's hold on them."
    
    "Daddy, no!" Varena pleads. "Not after everything we've done. [pc.HeShe] doesn't deserve that!"
    
    "The kingdom doesn't deserve what's happened to it," Kelsaz says sadly. "But these are dangerous times, full of dangerous people. My son is right, [pc.name]. We can't take risks with someone as important as you. We must purge this madness before it is too late."
    
    "Your Majesty, please..."
    
    "Make this easy on yourself, [pc.name]," Kelsaz says. "My son can help you. You aren't thinking straight."
    
    Surrounded by a hundred of the kingdom's best soldiers, you have little choice but to drop your [pc.weapon] and let them take you.
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Bunch of gods-damned ingrates...
        |Kas will come and rescue you, right? Surely...
    ]
rows.translation:
你转向国王，露出了真挚的微笑：“我爱她。我毫不畏惧地说出来，我爱卡希拉！”
    
    瓦蕾娜、伊莎多拉，甚至凯尔萨兹——几乎所有人，除了王储，都惊讶得倒抽了一口气。而弗兰努斯则只是仰头大笑：“哦，诸神啊，你是认真的吗？你就这么当着所有人的面说出来了，你是疯了吗？”
    
    “我简直是爱得发狂了，”你骄傲地回答。
    
    “哈！看来这些所谓的‘冠军’也和我们其他人一样，容易受到诱惑啊，”弗兰努斯说道。“父亲，让我把这两个所谓的‘冠军’带走关起来吧。我会想办法让他们摆脱这种诅咒的束缚。”
    
    “爸爸，不要！”瓦蕾娜恳求道，“在我们付出了这么多努力之后，千万不要这样。 [pc.HeShe]根本不值得这样的对待！”  
    
    “这个王国根本不应该遭受这样的命运，”凯尔萨兹悲伤地说道，“但如今是危险的时代，到处都是危险的人。我儿子说得对[pc.name]对于像您这样重要的人物，我们绝不能冒任何风险。我们必须在为时已晚之前制止这种疯狂的行为。”
    
    “陛下，请……”
    
    “您就成全我吧[pc.name]，”凯尔萨兹说，‘我的儿子可以帮你。你现在肯定没有冷静下来思考。’”
    
    在王国里一百名最精锐的士兵的包围下，你别无选择，只能放弃抵抗。 [pc.weapon]让他们带你一起去吧。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |一群该死的忘恩负义之徒……
        |卡斯会来救你的，对吧？肯定会的……
    ]

rows.original: "Very well, very well," Kelsaz sighs, almost indulgently. "I hope you have both brought a suitably interesting story for me. Perhaps I can be convinced towards lenience..." You step up, preparing to [pc.bg minstrel |regale the king with a story worthy of song |recount the events as you experienced them ] when the door behind you slams open once again. "I believe I have an even more interesting story for you, father!" You turn, watching Prince Vrannus enter the audience hall, accompanied by Calise — Kasyrra, now you realize — along with Isadora and her chosen Chargers. "Vrannus, what's the meaning of this?" the king says, frowning. "This is hardly the time for one of your outbursts." The prince smiles disarmingly. "No outbursts today, Daddy dear. I'm too tired after running halfway across the city to cut these two off before they could do any more damage." Kasyrra-Calise nods, stepping up beside the prince. She's holding her helm under arm, and draws down her face mask and shakes out her hair. "My king! Prince Vrannus saved my forces from catastrophe today. A catastrophe unleashed by the reckless actions of [pc.name] and Princess Varena." [calise.hdk |What the hell is this? |You give Calise-Kasyrra a look. What is she playing at... |You give Kas a hurt look. What the hell is she playing at now? ] "Explain," Kelsaz demands. "Daddy, she's not what she seems," Varena says, trying to edge in before Kasyrra can confuse things further. "We met the real Calise in the fortress[flags.BK_KILLED|, and she was so corrupted we had to kill her. We have proof!|, and she's right here to testify! Look what Kasyrra did to her!]" "I don't think that would hold up in court, Varena," Vrannus tuts. Kelsaz grumbles like grinding stone. "I've had enough of feeling left out in my own home! Lady Calise, what military disaster do you accuse my daughter and Champion of?" Kasyrra points across the hall at you. "They entered the Pleasure Cult's fortress and summoned a storm of wyverns upon it, forcing us to break off our attack or risk being pinned between stone and wing. Our entire force was exposed to wild attacks from demons and beastman up and down the mountain; the cult members not within the fortress staged a serious attack on our rear guard when we made our way back down. Prince Vrannus suggested I come and lay this grievance at the court's feet, and it seems that we've arrived just in time to see the troublemakers return." The king nods slowly, and turns his attention towards you and Varena. "And you two, what have you to say?" You turn around and point an accusatory finger at Kasyrra. "I say that she's a demon, and has been [pc.isBimbo |sub-uh... subducing |subverting ] you all for her own ends!" [pc.isBimbo |Varena slaps her palm against her face. ] "Well that's a bit of an escalation," Vrannus laughs. "I hope you have some real proof, dear Champion. This is the kind of accusation that can land you in a lot of trouble." Calise's testimony would probably have been more than enough in other circumstances, but with the Crown Prince all but calling you a liar, and supporting Kasyrra's disguise... shit. "Daddy," Varena says, "[pc.heShe] is telling the truth! The demon general[flags.BK_KILLED|| here] confessed to being the real Calise, and that a demon took her place." [flags.BK_KILLED||Kelsaz glances at Calise. "Is this true? Are you really the Champion of Velun?" "Yeah." "Why did you forsake your oaths and become a general of the demonic army, then?" "Fuck you, that's why," Calise says, spitting on the floor. "Fuck the gods and the world." Kelsaz gives you and Varena a look. "A fine guest you've brought. Can she even prove who she says she is?" "Nope," Calise says belligerently. "We have her maps, war plans, her equipment..." "None of that is conclusive," Vrannus says. "And besides, my Calise has been with her soldiers this whole time. Practically inseparable from them. They'll all vouch for her." "That's right!" Isadora blurts out. Her face turns scarlet when the king and his bodyguards turn their attention to her, but Calise's hand on her shoulder reassures her. The king sighs. rows.raw: ' "Very well, very well," Kelsaz sighs, almost indulgently. "I hope you have both brought a suitably interesting story for me. Perhaps I can be convinced towards lenience..." You step up, preparing to [pc.bg minstrel |regale the king with a story worthy of song |recount the events as you experienced them ] when the door behind you slams open once again. "I believe I have an even more interesting story for you, father!" You turn, watching Prince Vrannus enter the audience hall, accompanied by Calise — Kasyrra, now you realize — along with Isadora and her chosen Chargers. "Vrannus, what's the meaning of this?" the king says, frowning. "This is hardly the time for one of your outbursts." The prince smiles disarmingly. "No outbursts today, Daddy dear. I'm too tired after running halfway across the city to cut these two off before they could do any more damage." Kasyrra-Calise nods, stepping up beside the prince. She's holding her helm under arm, and draws down her face mask and shakes out her hair. "My king! Prince Vrannus saved my forces from catastrophe today. A catastrophe unleashed by the reckless actions of [pc.name] and Princess Varena." [calise.hdk |What the hell is this? |You give Calise-Kasyrra a look. What is she playing at... |You give Kas a hurt look. What the hell is she playing at now? ] "Explain," Kelsaz demands. "Daddy, she's not what she seems," Varena says, trying to edge in before Kasyrra can confuse things further. "We met the real Calise in the fortress[flags.BK_KILLED|, and she was so corrupted we had to kill her. We have proof!|, and she's right here to testify! Look what Kasyrra did to her!]" "I don't think that would hold up in court, Varena," Vrannus tuts. Kelsaz grumbles like grinding stone. "I've had enough of feeling left out in my own home! Lady Calise, what military disaster do you accuse my daughter and Champion of?" Kasyrra points across the hall at you. "They entered the Pleasure Cult's fortress and summoned a storm of wyverns upon it, forcing us to break off our attack or risk being pinned between stone and wing. Our entire force was exposed to wild attacks from demons and beastman up and down the mountain; the cult members not within the fortress staged a serious attack on our rear guard when we made our way back down. Prince Vrannus suggested I come and lay this grievance at the court's feet, and it seems that we've arrived just in time to see the troublemakers return." The king nods slowly, and turns his attention towards you and Varena. "And you two, what have you to say?" You turn around and point an accusatory finger at Kasyrra. "I say that she's a demon, and has been [pc.isBimbo |sub-uh... subducing |subverting ] you all for her own ends!" [pc.isBimbo |Varena slaps her palm against her face. ] "Well that's a bit of an escalation," Vrannus laughs. "I hope you have some real proof, dear Champion. This is the kind of accusation that can land you in a lot of trouble." Calise's testimony would probably have been more than enough in other circumstances, but with the Crown Prince all but calling you a liar, and supporting Kasyrra's disguise... shit. "Daddy," Varena says, "[pc.heShe] is telling the truth! The demon general[flags.BK_KILLED|| here] confessed to being the real Calise, and that a demon took her place." [flags.BK_KILLED||Kelsaz glances at Calise. "Is this true? Are you really the Champion of Velun?" "Yeah." "Why did you forsake your oaths and become a general of the demonic army, then?" "Fuck you, that's why," Calise says, spitting on the floor. "Fuck the gods and the world." Kelsaz gives you and Varena a look. "A fine guest you've brought. Can she even prove who she says she is?" "Nope," Calise says belligerently. "We have her maps, war plans, her equipment..." "None of that is conclusive," Vrannus says. "And besides, my Calise has been with her soldiers this whole time. Practically inseparable from them. They'll all vouch for her." "That's right!" Isadora blurts out. Her face turns scarlet when the king and his bodyguards turn their attention to her, but Calise's hand on her shoulder reassures her. The king sighs. "Varena... not only have you interfered in the war, but you've brought a demonic imposter into the court. Why? Why have you involved yourself in this, when I explicitly forbade it?" The princess looks at you pleadingly.] '

rows.original: Take the blame for Varena's misbehavior — she wouldn't have gotten involved if you hadn't encouraged her.
rows.translation: 为瓦蕾娜的不良行为承担责任吧——如果不是你鼓励她，她根本不会参与其中。
rows.raw: "Take the blame for Varena's misbehavior — she wouldn't have gotten involved if you hadn't encouraged her."

rows.original: You would have liked to do this the 'right' way, but nobody would listen if you told them your theories — and they still aren't listening!
rows.translation: 你本来想用正确的方式来做这件事，但当你向别人阐述你的想法时，根本没有人愿意听——现在他们依然没有在听！
rows.raw: "You would have liked to do this the 'right' way, but nobody would listen if you told them your theories — and they still aren't listening!"

rows.original: You know there's a traitor in the court. You can't trust the people here; you had to act on your own!
rows.translation: 你知道宫廷里有一个叛徒。这里的人根本不可信任，你必须独自采取行动！
rows.raw: "You know there's a traitor in the court. You can't trust the people here; you had to act on your own!"

rows.original:
"It's my fault, Your Majesty. Entirely," you say. "Varena never would have stepped out of line if I hadn't agreed to work with her. If you want to punish somebody, put the blame on me."
    
    "Noble of you, [pc.name]." Kelsaz sighs. "Still, you bring a demon to my court and slander its first Champion..."
    
    "Perhaps," Vrannus says, "we might take advantage of this situation. [pc.name] could be a perfect test subject for my research into the effects of demonic influence. Father, if I might confine our Champion for a few days, I am sure I could determine if [pc.heShe] has been touched by the corruption..."
    
    "Daddy, no!" Varena pleads. "Not after everything we've done. [pc.HeShe] doesn't deserve that!"
    
    "The kingdom doesn't deserve what's happened to it," Kelsaz says sadly. "But these are dangerous times, full of dangerous people. My son is right, [pc.name]. We can't take risks with someone as important as you. We must ensure you are not tainted, as your behavior would suggest."
    
    "Your Majesty, please..."
    
    "Make this easy on yourself, [pc.name]," Kelsaz says. "My son can help you. You aren't thinking straight."
    
    Surrounded by a hundred of the kingdom's best soldiers, you have little choice but to drop your [pc.weapon] and let them take you.
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Bunch of gods-damned ingrates...
        |This is bullshit. But you can turn this around, you're sure of it.
    ]
rows.translation:
“都是我的错，陛下。全都是我的错，”你说道，“要不是我答应和她合作，瓦蕾娜绝不会越界。如果您要惩罚谁，就把责任算在我头上吧。”
    
    “您真是高尚， [pc.name]。”凯尔萨兹叹了口气。“不过，你把一个恶魔带进我的宫廷，还诽谤它的第一位冠军……”
    
    “也许，”弗兰努斯说，“我们可以利用这个局面。 [pc.name]可以成为我研究恶魔影响力作用的完美实验对象。父亲，如果我能把我们的冠军关押几天，我一定能查明[pc.heShe]是否沾染了腐化……”
    
    “爸爸，不要！”瓦蕾娜恳求道。“我们做了这么多，不能这样。 [pc.HeShe]不该受到这种对待！”
    
    “这个王国不该遭受这样的命运，”凯尔萨兹悲伤地说。“但如今是危险的时代，到处都是危险的人。我儿子说得对， [pc.name]。对像你这样重要的人物，我们不能冒险。我们必须确保你没有受到污染，因为你的行为正暗示着这一点。”
    
    “陛下，求您……”
    
    “别让自己难堪， [pc.name]，”凯尔萨兹说。“我儿子可以帮你。你现在脑子不清醒。”
    
    王国最精锐的上百名士兵将你围住，你别无选择，只能丢下你的[pc.weapon]，任由他们带走你。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |一群该死的忘恩负义之徒……
        |这他妈就是胡扯。但你能扭转局面，你确信这一点。
    ]

rows.original: "We had to act on our own!" you insist. "Somebody has betrayed this court, this kingdom, and it's not just Kasyrra. Between them, how could we trust anybody?" "You could have trusted your family, Varena," Kelsaz says sadly. Vrannus chuckles. "I don't think she could, father. Not with [pc.name] confusing her. You know how innocent she can be." Varena sputters. "Vrannus! What are you saying!?" "I'm saying," her brother purrs, sashaying closer, "that you've been manipulated. The Champion's clearly been feeding your fears, confusing you. You aren't yourself. Don't worry, dear sister. We'll sort this out." "I'm not... you... you bitch!" Kelsaz slaps his hand on the armrest of his throne. "Varena, enough. You've caused enough damage today." "Damage? We saved this city!" Kasyrra tuts. "You interfered in military operations, nearly got my forces routed, and brought a demon to court. All so that you could stroke your own egos in doing what we planned to do before us. Just because foolishness works doesn't mean it isn't foolish." "This is bullshit," you say. The king sighs and gestures to his men. The Chargers begin to close around you. "Regardless. My son is right, [pc.name]. We can't take risks with someone as important as you. We must ensure you are not tainted, as your behavior would suggest." "Your Majesty, please..." "Make this easy on yourself, [pc.name]," Kelsaz says. "My son can help you. You aren't thinking straight." Surrounded by a hundred of the kingdom's best soldiers, you have little choice but to drop your [pc.weapon] and let them take you. [pc.isDK |Bunch of gods-damned ingrates... |This is bullshit. But you can turn this around, you're sure of it. ]

rows.original:
"I suppose it did at that," Kelsaz admits. "I'm angry, Varena, but also proud. You've done well, my daughter. The same goes to you as well, Champion." Kelsaz sighs, a long-suffering sound well accustomed to having to surrender to Varena's headstrong ways, and he sits back on his throne.
    
    "Now, Daddy," Varena says, "there's something else we need to tell you. It's about Calise."
    
    [bk.isChamp
        |Calise straightens her back a little, hands clasped behind herself.
        |The demon next to you perks up, a looking between you and the king like a cornered animal.
    ]
    
    Kelsaz [bk.isChamp
        |looks at the woman in question
        |takes a breath
    ]. "Go on."
    
    Varena [varena.fucked
        |takes your hand
        |glances at you
    ], then tells her father, "She's a demon. She has been this entire time. And we have testimony to prove it."
    
    Shocked silence falls over the audience hall. [bk.isChamp
        |All eyes are on Calise, but she defiantly shows no fear. You imagine she wishes they'd lash out, but no such luck.
        |Slowly, gazes begin to fall upon the demon in your midst; realization dawns on the crowd with shocked gasps.
    ] Calise plants her hands on her hips and says, "That's right. You've all been made fools of by the Bitch Queen herself. I am Calise, Champion of Velun, and I have never set foot in this room before."
    
    [bk.isChamp
        |Calise clasps her hands over her heart. "When this war began, I was captured by Kasyrra and tortured! She took my name and masqueraded as me to undermine your war effort. Everything she's done for you was in service to her own wicked ends. I'd still be in that fortress if it wasn't for these two heroes."
        
        Really playing this up, isn't she? But that over-dramatic soliloquy is exactly what you'd expect from Calise.
        |She crosses her arms defiantly. "The Bitch Queen stole my name to dupe you all. So go ahead, kill us both. I'll die laughing knowing she's been fucked over for what she's done."
    ]
    
    "That is a terrible accusation," Kelsaz says. "But if Varena and [pc.name] both testify to its truth..."
    
    "We do," you affirm. 
    
    The king nods. "Even Vrannus has voiced suspicions for some time now, but could not muster any proof. Herald, go and call for Lady Calise. Let her come here and testify." He turns to Raqian. "And summon all my Chargers."

    “现在，爸爸，”瓦蕾娜说道，“还有另一件事得告诉你。是关于卡莉丝的。”
    
    [bk.isChamp

    接见厅里陷入震惊的沉默。[bk.isChamp
        |所有目光都集中在卡莉丝身上，但她毫无惧色，依旧桀骜不驯。你猜她巴不得众人当场发难，可惜没人动手。
        |众人的目光缓缓落在你们之中的恶魔身上；人群发出震惊的抽气声，显然终于明白了过来。
    ]卡莉丝双手叉腰，说道：“没错。你们全都被贱人女王本人耍得团团转。我是卡莉丝，维伦的冠军；在今天以前，我从未踏进过这个房间。”
    
    [bk.isChamp
        |卡莉丝将双手扣在胸前。“战争爆发时，我被卡希拉抓走，遭受了严刑拷打！她夺走我的身份，冒充我破坏你们的战事。她为你们做的一切，都只是在服务自己的邪恶目的。若不是这两位英雄，我现在还被关在那座要塞里。”
        
        她还真会添油加醋，不是吗？不过，这番夸张的独白倒确实很符合众人心目中的卡莉丝。

    ]
    
    “这是极其严重的指控，”凯尔萨兹说道，“不过，既然瓦蕾娜和[pc.name]都愿意作证，证明此事属实……”
    
    “我们愿意。”你肯定道。 
    
    国王点点头。“就连弗兰努斯也怀疑此事多时，只是始终拿不出证据。传令官，去召卡莉丝女士前来。让她亲自到这里作证。”他转向拉奇安，“再召集我所有的冲锋者。”

rows.original: Kasyrra arrives with a small detachment of her chosen men, and Isadora, in tow. Calise has been taken to another room by Lord Raqian, while the full strength of the Chargers line the halls. You and Varena stand at the king's hand[party.som | |, alongside [comp1.name] |, alongside your companions ]. You can feel a tension tight inside you, like an animal ready to pounce. You're about to come face to face with Kasyrra with her mask off[calise.hdk | for the first time in... gods, since you came to Khor'minos? 凯尔萨兹向他的战士们发出了指令，他们立刻举起了盾牌，拔出了武器，开始向这位女恶魔发起进攻。 “卡莉丝女士！”伊莎多拉惊呼道。求你，不要这样做！” 卡希拉看着那位年轻的士兵，眼中既有怜悯，也有懊悔，然后她用力将斧头插入地面，巨大的冲击力甚至让地面的瓷砖都碎裂了。冲击波将周围的士兵们震得向后倒退，而卡希拉则展开了翅膀，身上环绕着魔法光环，那些光芒在她周围扭曲变形，直到她彻底从你的视线中消失。 rows.original:
A few minutes later, the Chargers declare the throne hall safe once again. Isadora's still lying where Kasyrra tossed her down, staring at the floor; Varena has taken a step closer to you, [varena.fucked
        |threading her fingers through yours
        |leaning heavily on her staff
    ]. When the king finally acknowledges you again, it's with a weary nod. "Champion. Varena. I am glad you're both alright."
    
    "Me too," Varena sighs.
    
    [bk.isChamp
        |He turns towards Calise. "And you, Champion of Velun. It's hard to believe we were all fooled by her, yet... the resemblance is striking. I had not realized the demons' shapeshifting was so perfect. Still, be welcome in my court."
        
        Calise stiffly bows. "Thank you, Majesty, but I... will be leaving Khor'minos. [pc.name] said I should put on a show on the way out, so people don't realize anything's amiss. The big battle's won; it's time one of their Champions bows out." 
        
        Isadora makes a despairing noise off to the side.
        
        Keslaz turns to you. "You believe we should lie to our people? Weave a falsehood about the falsehood the Demon Queen wove over us all?"
        
        "I do," you say. "[pc.isDK
            |The last thing you need is panic, or people turning against each other. Revealing the truth will cause a witch hunt.
            |People deserve hope... not a witch hunt for more demons. Let Calise leave on a high note, with victory on everyone's mind.
        ]"
        
        Kelsaz sighs. "You make a good point. Very well, Calise. We shall hide the switch from the city. It would be best if you left quickly, before anyone in the city has a chance to realize the deception."
        
        "Happily," Calise says.
        |[flags.BK_CAPTURE
            |The king turns his gaze to the demon. "And what do you plan to do with this... fallen Champion?"
            
            "She's my prisoner," you say. "My fort has cells [pc.isBimbo
                |that can keep demons nice and safe
                |capable of incarcerating demons
            ]."
            
            "Very well," the king says. "Varena?"
            
            The princess nods. "If [pc.name] is confident, then I see no reason not to. I'd rather [pc.himHer] keep the demon than Vrannus have to deal with her."
            
            Yeah, Vrannus... You've got to wonder what that weasel is up to.
            |[flags.BK_KILLED
                |"What of the real Lady Calise?" Kelsaz asks, resting his chin in his hand. "We had heard rumors she was coming this way before the war began."
                
                "We met her," Varena says. 
                
                "I killed her," you say.
                
                Varena sighs. "She'd become a demon, corrupted by Kasyrra into leading the war effort for them. It's terrible... even a chosen of a god can be twisted by her."
                
                The king puts a hand on his daughter's head, tousling her raven hair. "I know. I'm only sorry we never had a chance to meet her, before all this."
                
                "Me too," Varena says.
            ]
        ]
    ]
    
    Kelsaz strokes his beard. "Now then, we should discuss what comes next, hm?"

伊莎多拉在旁边发出了绝望的声音。

“她是我的囚犯，”恶魔回答道，“我的堡垒里有许多牢房。 [pc.isBimbo
                |那个东西能把恶魔关得严严实实，确保他们的安全。

            |[flags.BK_KILLED

rows.original:
"Recognition of your claim?" Kelsaz says, fingers steepling. "If I understand you correctly, that land is well within the bounds of Njorhaalt."
    
    "It was," you say. "But there's nothing left of that old kingdom but the Winter City, maybe a handful of little villages. My fort is thriving already without their interference."
    
    "And you would stand to tax trade between the kingdoms, sitting on the one route between us by land."
    
    You give him a slight nod. "And protect trade, of course. I'm sure Etheryn will understand."
    
    It's not as though she could do much about it even if she disagreed. The Winter City is in no condition to push the matter, especially if you play the part of a good neighbor besides this one little land grab.
    
    "Very well," Kelsaz says. "As King of Khor'minos, I hereby recognize you as a Marcher-Baron, a ruler of land allied — but not subservient to — my realm, so long as you and your descendants shall hold it. May our territories remain friends forevermore."
    
    You shake the king's hand, lord to lord.
rows.translation:
“承认你的领土主张？”凯尔萨兹十指相抵，“如果我理解得没错，那片土地完全位于Njorhaalt境内。”
    
    “以前是。”你说道，“可那个古老王国如今只剩冬城，或许再加上寥寥几个小村庄。没有他们干涉，我的驿堡已经发展得十分繁荣。”
    
    “而你占据两国之间唯一的陆路，便能向往来贸易征税。”
    
    你微微点头。“当然，也会保护贸易。我相信伊瑟琳能够理解。”
    
    即便她反对，也做不了多少事情。冬城根本没有能力追究此事；只要除了这次小小的土地吞并以外，你仍扮演友善邻邦的角色，就更是如此。
    
    “很好。”凯尔萨兹说道，“作为科尔米诺斯国王，我在此承认你为行进者男爵：只要你和后代仍持有这片领地，你便是与我的王国结盟、却不臣属于我的领主。愿我们的疆土永世友好。”
    
    你以领主对领主的身份，与国王握手。

"I've been living in and around Hawkethorne for a while now," you tell the king. "It's in bad shape. The castle's crumbling, the walls are wood that's a generation old, and the countryside around it is dotted with ruins."
    
    "From the Godswar, yes," Kelsaz says. "Livrea's told the story plenty of times that some great tragedy befell the barony. Burned most of it to ash."
    
    You nod. "I'd like to help my new home, and I've seen what Khor'minos is capable of. Your engineers are second to none. You could bring fresh, clean water from Lake Tarahugen straight to the town. You know how to build walls that will last centuries. You could revitalize Hawkethorne."
    
    Kelsaz smiles proudly. "All true, but Hawkethorne is outside my domain. Its ruler-"
    
    "Would be receptive if you offered, I'm sure," you say. "[flags.CARMEN_KILLED
        |Because that's me, more or less. And I know my
        |The Baroness tries to help her people, she just... doesn't know how. And I am sure the
    ] villagers would welcome your help with open arms. They're proud, but not stupid. As long as they know this was my wish."
    
    "Then I will make the offer to them," the king says. "It will be some time before we can make good on it, with the war still raging, but I swear to you: if the people of Hawkethorne will have our aid, [pc.name], we will transform it into a polis worthy of the kingdom's highest houses."

Kelsaz paces towards the fireplace, refilling his goblet as he walks. "Now, another matter, while I have you. I understand the leader of the cult wasn't present in the fortress, this... Master Tollus?"
    
    You nod.
    
    "While you were assailing the demons' fortress, there was an attack against what remains of our forces on the east coast. Cultists, not demons, attempted to steal a warship moored in Saltmantle Cove. It would have been the third ship we'd lost in the region since the war began; the first two disappeared without a trace, with no sign of what became of the crew or vessel. This time, the crew was ready: they fought the cultists off, but were in no position to pursue their attackers — the bastards decided they'd rather burn the ship than simply abandon their attack."
    
    Kelsaz balls his fist. "There's been an explosion of activity in the area, too brazen to be random acts of chaos; the cult is up to something out there."
    
    "Any idea what?" you ask.
    
    "The coast was ravaged by the Godswar," Kelsaz says. "The wreckage of that conflict still litters the beach. I fear they may be interested in some leftover from Old Belhar, a weapon or magic. There is an ancient golem that patrols the cove, larger than most castles, and the lair of an old dragon that no one has managed to breach for centuries. Any of these, or gods-know what might be worse out there. Whatever their objective, they must be stopped."
    
    [party.has calise

        "Estelore? Gods," Kelsaz groans. "I pray it isn't so. The mad mages of that realm nearly destroyed the world once. If the cult gets a hold of their magic..."
    ]
    
    "Where do we start?" you ask. 
    
    "The cult must have a base on the coast," the king says. "Perhaps one of the abandoned villages has been taken over. Khor'elthos is near to where the warship was attacked, overlooking Saltmantle Cove. Before the Godswar it was the kingdom's primary port of trade, and even now is our second-largest port. It would not surprise me if that was now the destination of the stolen ships."
    
    The king turns to face you. "I will have the First Legion clear a path to Highcliff Road for you. May Tira watch over you[party.has calise

    ]."
    
    You[party.has calise
