凯尔萨兹走向壁炉，边走边为酒杯斟满酒。“趁你还在这里，再谈另一件事。据我所知，邪教领袖当时并不在要塞里……是叫托勒斯大师吧？”
    
    你点点头。
    
    “你进攻恶魔要塞期间，我们在东海岸所剩的部队也遭到了袭击。企图夺走停泊在盐壳湾战舰的是邪教徒，而非恶魔。若被他们得手，那将是战争爆发以来我们在该地区损失的第三艘船；前两艘船都消失得无影无踪，船员和船只的下落也毫无线索。这一次，船员早有准备，成功击退了邪教徒，却无力追击来犯者——那群混蛋宁愿烧掉战舰，也不肯放弃袭击后直接撤退。”
    
    凯尔萨兹攥紧拳头。“那一带的活动突然激增，而且行事太过猖狂，绝不可能只是随意制造混乱；邪教一定在那里谋划什么。”
    
    “知道是什么吗？”你问。
    
    “神战曾蹂躏那片海岸，”凯尔萨兹说道，“那场冲突留下的残骸至今仍散落在海滩上。我担心他们会对旧贝尔哈的遗物产生兴趣，无论是武器还是魔法。海湾里有一尊古老魔像来回巡逻，比大多数城堡更加庞大；那里还有一头古龙的巢穴，几个世纪以来无人能够攻破。他们的目标可能是其中任何一个，或是天知道还有什么更加糟糕的东西。无论所图为何，都必须阻止他们。”
    
    [party.has calise
        |卡莉丝叹了口气。“托勒斯……我猜他是想找埃斯托洛尔留下的某样东西。那个枯萎国度的遗迹在几个世纪前被冲上了海岸。我相信，他很久以来一直对那里有着……强烈的兴趣。”
        
        “埃斯托洛尔？诸神啊。”凯尔萨兹呻吟道，“但愿不是如此。那个国度的疯狂法师曾险些毁灭世界。若是邪教掌握了他们的魔法……”
    ]
    
    “我们从哪里开始？”你问道。 
    
    “邪教在海岸上一定有据点，”国王说道，“或许他们占据了某座废弃村庄。科雷尔托斯俯瞰盐壳湾，离战舰遇袭的地点很近。神战以前，那里是王国最重要的贸易港；即使到了现在，仍是我国第二大港口。若是被盗的船只最终都驶向那里，我一点也不会惊讶。”
    
    国王转身面对你。“我会命令第一军团为你清理出一条通往海崖路的道路。愿蒂拉守护你[party.has calise
        |们两位冠军
        |，冠军
    ]。”
    
    你[party.has calise
        |与卡莉丝
    ]躬身行礼，随后回到城中，参加那场喧闹而持续整夜的庆典…… 
    
    [party.has calise
        |分别前，卡莉丝抓住你的手臂。“有空时来我的公寓找我……或者，我们也可以在界间之路见面。[flags.DREAM_PALACE
            |我在那里有一处奢华得多的住所。
        ]无论如何，我们该私下谈谈！”
    ]
rows.raw:
'
    Kelsaz paces towards the fireplace, refilling his goblet as he walks. "Now, another matter, while I have you. I understand the leader of the cult wasn't present in the fortress, this... Master Tollus?"
    
    You nod.
    
    "While you were assailing the demons' fortress, there was an attack against what remains of our forces on the east coast. Cultists, not demons, attempted to steal a warship moored in Saltmantle Cove. It would have been the third ship we'd lost in the region since the war began; the first two disappeared without a trace, with no sign of what became of the crew or vessel. This time, the crew was ready: they fought the cultists off, but were in no position to pursue their attackers — the bastards decided they'd rather burn the ship than simply abandon their attack."
    
    Kelsaz balls his fist. "There's been an explosion of activity in the area, too brazen to be random acts of chaos; the cult is up to something out there."
    
    "Any idea what?" you ask.
    
    "The coast was ravaged by the Godswar," Kelsaz says. "The wreckage of that conflict still litters the beach. I fear they may be interested in some leftover from Old Belhar, a weapon or magic. There is an ancient golem that patrols the cove, larger than most castles, and the lair of an old dragon that no one has managed to breach for centuries. Any of these, or gods-know what might be worse out there. Whatever their objective, they must be stopped."
    
    [party.has calise
        |Calise sighs. "Tollus... I can imagine he's after something from Estelore. The remains of that blighted realm washed up along the coast centuries ago. I believe he's had an... acute interest in the place for a long time now."
        
        "Estelore? Gods," Kelsaz groans. "I pray it isn't so. The mad mages of that realm nearly destroyed the world once. If the cult gets a hold of their magic..."
    ]
    
    "Where do we start?" you ask. 
    
    "The cult must have a base on the coast," the king says. "Perhaps one of the abandoned villages has been taken over. Khor'elthos is near to where the warship was attacked, overlooking Saltmantle Cove. Before the Godswar it was the kingdom's primary port of trade, and even now is our second-largest port. It would not surprise me if that was now the destination of the stolen ships."
    
    The king turns to face you. "I will have the First Legion clear a path to Highcliff Road for you. May Tira watch over you[party.has calise
        | both, Champions
        |, Champion
    ]."
    
    You[party.has calise
        | and Calise
    ] bow and return to what proves to be a raucous, night-long celebration throughout the city... 
    
    [party.has calise
        |Calise grabs your arm before you part ways. "Come and see me at my apartment when you can... or perhaps, in the Ways Between.[flags.DREAM_PALACE
            | I have a much more luxurious place there.
        ] Either way, we should talk in private!"
    ]
    
    '

rows.original:
Hello, Champion, lead developer Savin here.
    
    You made some questionable choices that've lead you here, to being taken to Prince Vrannus's private dungeon. I am sure nothing bad will happen to you there.
    
    The Prince's dungeon is located in the Coastlands, the next area of the game, and will for you be a small dungeon you're going to be taken to. If you're reading this, though, the Coastlands aren't in the game yet. So, you're going to be teleported back to Khor'minos for now. When the dungeon's ready, you're going to get teleported there to pick up where we left off. 
    
    I am sure nothing bad will happen to you, and that Prince Vrannus has only your best interests at heart :)
     
    See you then!
rows.translation:
你好，冠军，我是首席开发人员萨文。
    
    你做出了一些令人质疑的选择，这些选择才让你来到了这里，被带到了弗兰努斯王子的私人地牢里。我相信你在那里不会遇到任何危险。
    
    王子的地牢位于游戏的下一个区域——海岸之地，实际上那只是一个规模较小的地牢，你会被带到那里去。不过，如果你正在阅读这段文字，那么说明“海岸之地”这个区域目前还没有加入游戏中。因此，你将会被传送到科尔米诺斯。等这个地下城准备好之后，你就会被传送到那里，继续我们之前未完成的游戏内容。 
    
    我相信你不会遇到任何不好的事情，而且弗兰努斯王子也是真心为你的利益着想的呢 :)
     
    到时候见吧！
